ex: We quickly grew tired in the blazing sunshine. (Biz jazirama quyoshda tezda charchadik.)

Blazing heat made it impossible to walk.(Juda issiq harorat yurishga imkon bermadi.)• It was a blazing hot day with no shade.(Soya bo‘lmagan olovdek issiq kun edi.)• The blazing fire lit up the entire valley.(Yong‘in butun vodiyga nur sochdi.)
blazing.meta: Very hot, burning, or shining intensely.

syn: emblazon – bezatib ko‘rsatmoq• The shirt was emblazoned with the team logo. (Futbolka jamoa logotipi bilan bezatilgan edi.)proclaim – baralla e’lon qilmoq• The city proudly proclaimed its independence. (Shahar mustaqilligini baralla e’lon qildi.)plaster – yozuv bilan to‘ldirmoq• Posters were plastered all over the walls. (Devorlar butunlay posterlar bilan to‘ldirilgan edi.)
ex: They woke to find the company’s name blazoned across the morning papers. (Ular ertalab uyg‘onib, kompaniya nomining ertalabgi gazetalarda ko‘z-ko‘z qilinganini ko‘rishdi.)

He had the word “Cool” blazoned across his chest.(Uning ko‘kragida “Cool” so‘zi ko‘rga hassadek qilib yozilgan edi.)• The scandal was blazoned on the front page of every newspaper.(Janjal barcha gazetalar sarlavhasida yaqqol ko‘rsatildi.)• Slogans were blazoned on banners throughout the stadium.(Shiorlar butun stadion bo‘ylab bannerlarda ko‘rga hassadek yozilgan edi.)
blazon.meta: To make something very visible, especially to attract attention or proclaim it widely; often used to describe writing, symbols, or headlines spread across a surface.

syn: whiten – oqartirmoq• She whitened her shirt using a special detergent. (U ko‘ylagini maxsus yuvish vositasi bilan oqartirdi.)fade – rangini yo‘qotmoq• The fabric faded after many washes. (Mato ko‘p yuvilgandan so‘ng rangini yo‘qotdi.)lighten – yorqinroq qilmoq / ochartirmoq• The hairdresser lightened her hair shade. (Sartarosh uning soch rangini ochartirdi.)
ex: His hair was bleached by the sun. (Quyosh uning sochini oqartirib yuborgan edi.)

She bleached her hair blonde.(U sochini sarg‘ish rangga oqartirdi.)• Raw cloth is bleached and then dyed.(Xom mato avval oqartiriladi, so‘ng bo‘yaladi.)• Bones of animals bleaching in the sun.(Quyoshda oqayotgan hayvon suyaklari.)• Bleached cotton and paper are used in printing.(Chop etishda oqartirilgan paxta va qog‘oz ishlatiladi.)• The paper is bleached with chlorine.(Qog‘oz xlor bilan oqartiriladi.)
bleach.meta: To remove color from something, either naturally (like from sunlight) or by using chemical agents, often for cleaning or lightening purposes.

syn: chlorine bleach – xlorli ohak• Chlorine bleach is effective at killing germs. (Xlorli ohak mikroblarni yo‘q qilishda samarali.)disinfectant – dezinfeksiyalovchi vosita• Bleach is a strong disinfectant. (Ohak kuchli dezinfeksiya vositasidir.)whitener – oqartirgich• She used a fabric whitener on the curtains. (U parda uchun oqartirgich ishlatdi.)
ex: I poured bleach down the loo. (Men hojatxonaga ohak quyib yubordim.)

Use bleach to disinfect the kitchen surfaces.(Oshxona yuzalarini dezinfeksiya qilish uchun ohakdan foydalaning.)• Be careful—bleach can damage coloured fabrics.(Ehtiyot bo‘ling — ohak rangli matolarga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.)• The smell of bleach filled the bathroom.(Hammomda ohakning hidi tarqaldi.)• Always wear gloves when using bleach.(Ohak ishlatayotganda doimo qo‘lqop taqing.)• Chlorine bleach is commonly used in laundry.(Kiyim yuvishda odatda xlorli ohak ishlatiladi.)
bleach.meta: A cleaning and whitening chemical, usually containing chlorine or similar substances, used for disinfecting surfaces or lightening fabrics.

syn: German shepherd – bo‘ribosar• The German shepherd helped track the missing child. (Bo‘ribosar it yo‘qolgan bolani izlab topdi.)police dog – politsiya iti• The police dog sniffed out the drugs. (Politsiya iti giyohvand moddalarni hidlab topdi.)guard dog – qo‘riqchi it• They kept a guard dog in the yard. (Ular hovlida qo‘riqchi it saqlashardi.)
ex: The police officer was walking with an Alsatian. (Politsiyachi bo‘ribosar it bilan yurardi.)

Alsatians are known for their loyalty and intelligence.(Bo‘ribosarlar sadoqat va aql-zakovati bilan tanilgan.)• Their Alsatian barked loudly at strangers.(Ularning bo‘ribosar iti begonalarni baqirib qarshi oldi.)• He trains Alsatians for search and rescue missions.(U bo‘ribosar itlarni qidiruv-qutqaruv ishlari uchun tayyorlaydi.)• The Alsatian followed every command without hesitation.(Bo‘ribosar har bir buyruqni darhol bajardi.)
alsatian.meta: A powerful, trainable dog breed originally from Germany, commonly used by police and military forces due to its strength, loyalty, and intelligence.

syn: stadium (adj) – stadionga oid• Stadium seating filled up quickly. (Stadiondagi o‘rindiqlar tez to‘ldi.)spectator (adj) – tomoshabinlarga oid• Spectator zones were crowded. (Tomoshabinlar zonasi gavjum edi.)grandstand (adj) – asosiy o‘rindiqlarga oid• The grandstand area was reserved. (Asosiy o‘rindiqlar zonasi band qilingan edi.)
ex: Bleacher seats offer a great view for a low price. (Tribuna o‘rindiqlari arzon narxda yaxshi ko‘rinish taqdim etadi.)

They cheered loudly from the bleacher section.(Ular ochiq tribuna qismidan baland ovozda qichqirishdi.)• He grabbed a bleacher hot dog during halftime.(U tanaffusda tribuna kolbasa-sosiska sendvichidan oldi.)• Bleacher fans are known for their energy and loyalty.(Tribuna muxlislari o‘zlarining faolligi va sadoqati bilan tanilgan.)
bleacher.meta: Used to describe something associated with the bleachers (rows of inexpensive, open-air seats in a stadium, usually farthest from the field or stage).

syn: gloomily – xafa tarzda• She gloomily admitted her mistake. (U xafa tarzda xatosini tan oldi.)despairingly – umidsiz tarzda• He despairingly asked for help. (U umidsiz tarzda yordam so‘radi.)hopelessly – umidsiz tarzda• She hopelessly stared at the broken phone. (U sindirilgan telefonga umidsiz tikildi.)
ex: “There seems no hope,” she said bleakly. (“Umid yo‘qdek tuyuladi,” dedi u umidsizlarcha.)

“I doubt it,” she said bleakly.(“Shubham bor,” dedi u umidsiz ohangda.)• He looked bleakly out the window, lost in thought.(U umidsizlanib derazadan termuldi, o‘yga cho‘mdi.)• They spoke bleakly about the future.(Ular kelajak haqida umidsizlik bilan gaplashishdi.)
bleakly.meta: In a way that shows no hope, optimism, or encouragement; expressing sadness, despair, or pessimism.

syn: loser – yutqazgan• He was seen as a political loser. (U tanlovda ancha orqada qolgan ikkinchi darajadagi ishtirokchi edi.)underdog – quyi baholangan nomzod• The underdog never made it past the first round. (Quyi baholangan nomzod birinchi bosqichdan o‘ta olmadi.)
ex: A year ago he was just an also-ran for the Democratic nomination. (Bir yil oldin u Demokratlar nomzodligi uchun oddiy omadsiz ishtirokchi edi.)

The campaign transformed him from an also-ran in the polls to front-runner.(Kampaniya uni so‘rovnomalardagi oddiy nomzoddan asosiy da’vogarga aylantirdi.)• She finished the tournament as an also-ran.(U turnirni muvaffaqiyatsiz ishtirokchi sifatida yakunladi.)• The company used to be an also-ran, but now it's a market leader.(Kompaniya ilgari muvaffaqiyatsiz edi, hozir esa bozor yetakchisidir.)• His book was an also-ran in the literary awards.(Uning kitobi adabiy mukofotlar orasida yutqazganlar qatorida bo‘ldi.)
also-ran.meta: Someone who competes but fails to achieve a notable position or success; often refers to political candidates, athletes, or companies that were not victorious.

syn: despair – umidsizlik• A sense of despair hung in the air. (Havoda umidsizlik hukmron edi.)hopelessness – umidning yo‘qligi• The bleakness of the news added to the hopelessness. (Yangiliklardagi umidsizlik umumiy tushkunlikka qo‘shildi.)gloom – xiralik
tushkunlik• There was a feeling of gloom in the room. (Xonada tushkunlik hissi bor edi.)
ex: The continued bleakness of the American job market was blamed. (Amerika ish bozoridagi davomli umidsizlik ayblandi.)

She spoke of the bleakness she felt after losing her job.(U ishidan ayrilgach his qilgan umidsizlik haqida gapirdi.)• The novel captures the bleakness of post-war life.(Roman urushdan keyingi hayotning umidsizligini tasvirlaydi.)• His face showed the full bleakness of defeat.(Yuzida mag‘lubiyatning to‘liq umidsizligi aks etgan edi.)
bleakness.meta: A feeling or condition of being without hope, encouragement, or comfort — emotionally empty or depressing.

syn: sleepily – uyquchan holatda• She spoke sleepily without opening her eyes. (U ko‘zini ochmasdan uyquchan holatda gapirdi.)groggily – o‘ziga kelmay• He walked groggily to the door. (U o‘ziga kelmay eshik tomon yurdi.)drowsily – halsiz uyqu holatda• The child yawned drowsily and curled up again. (Bola uyqu holatda esnadi va yana bukilib yotdi.)
ex: “I was asleep,” she explained blearily. (“Men uxlayotgandim,” dedi u ko‘zini ishqalab.)

He looked around blearily, confused by the noise.(U ko‘zini ishqalab atrofiga qaradi, shovqindan hayron bo‘ldi.)• She rubbed her eyes and blinked blearily at the clock.(U ko‘zini ishqaladi va soatga xira tikildi.)• They sat up blearily after the alarm went off.(Budilnik chalingach, ular uyqudan zo‘rg‘a turishdi.)• He blearily reached for his phone on the nightstand.(U tun yarmida stol ustidan telefonini zo‘rg‘a topib oldi.)
blearily.meta: In a way that shows tiredness or mental fog; with blurry eyes or a sleepy expression — typically used to describe someone's appearance, movement, or speech after waking up or when very fatigued.

syn: acolyte – cherkov yordamchisi• The acolyte lit the candles before Mass. (Akolit missa oldidan shamlarni yoqdi.)church helper – cherkov yordamchisi• The church helper assisted the priest during the wedding. (Cherkov yordamchisi to‘y paytida ruhoniyga yordam berdi.)altar server – qurbongoh xizmatchisi• An altar server stood quietly beside the priest. (Qurbongoh xizmatchisi ruhoniyning yonida sokin turdi.)
ex: He served as an altar boy every Sunday at his local church. (U har yakshanba o‘z cherkovida ruhoniyga altar boy sifatida xizmat qilardi.)

The altar boy helped prepare the altar before the service.(Altar boy xizmat boshlanishidan oldin qurbongohni tayyorlashda yordam berdi.)• As an altar boy, he learned the importance of discipline and respect.(Altar boy sifatida u intizom va hurmatning ahamiyatini o‘rgandi.)• The priest motioned for the altar boy to bring the wine.(Ruhoniy altar boyga sharobni olib kelishini ishora qildi.)
altar boy.meta: A young male, typically in the Roman Catholic or Anglican tradition, who assists the priest during religious ceremonies, especially Mass, by carrying items, lighting candles, and participating in rituals.

syn: religious panel – diniy panelli rasm• The religious panel was placed above the altar. (Diniy rasm qurbongoh ustiga joylashtirilgan edi.)sacred artwork – muqaddas san’at asari• Tourists admired the sacred artwork in the chapel. (Sayyohlar kapelladagi muqaddas san’at asarini tomosha qilishdi.)church painting – cherkov rasmi• The old church painting was cleaned and preserved. (Eski cherkov rasmi tozalanib saqlab qolindi.)
ex: The cathedral houses a famous 15th-century altarpiece. (Soborda mashhur XV asrga oid altarpiece saqlanadi.)

They restored the damaged altarpiece last year.(Ular o‘tgan yili zararlangan altarpiece’ni ta’mirlashdi.)• The altarpiece shows scenes from the life of Christ.(Altarpiece Iso hayotidan lavhalarni tasvirlaydi.)• A golden altarpiece stood behind the priest.(Ruhoniyning orqasida oltin altarpiece turardi.)• The museum exhibits several medieval altarpieces.(Muzeyda bir nechta o‘rta asrlarga oid altarpiece’lar namoyish etiladi.)
altarpiece.meta: A religious artwork, usually a painting, sculpture, or a combination of both, displayed near or above the altar in a Christian church, often depicting biblical scenes or saints.

Radiation levels reached 1,000,000 Bq in the contaminated zone.(Zaharlangan hududdagi radiatsiya darajasi 1 000 000 Bq ga yetdi.)
bq.meta: Bq is the SI (International System of Units) derived unit used to measure radioactivity, defined as one nuclear decay per second.

braaivleis.meta: Meat cooked over an open fire, typically during a braai (South African barbecue); especially popular in South Africa.

syn: 1. furious – g‘azablangan• She was absolutely furious about the delay.(U kechikishga nisbatan juda g‘azablangan edi.)2. incensed – qattiq ranjigan• He was incensed by the accusation.(U ayblovdan qattiq ranjidi.)3. enraged – juda jahli chiqqan• The boss was enraged at the missed deadline.(Boshliq muddatga yetkazilmagan ish uchun qattiq jahli chiqdi.)
ex: He was apoplectic with rage at the decision. (U qarordan juda qattiq g‘azablandi.)

His apoplectic reaction shocked everyone in the room.(Uning juda qattiq g‘azablangan holati xonadagilarni hayratga soldi.)
apoplectic.meta: Very angry and furious, often to the point of being speechless or visibly enraged.[informal]

syn: 1. stroke (medical) – insult• He suffered a stroke last year.(U o‘tgan yili insultga uchradi.)2. fury (figurative) – g‘azab• She was shaking with fury.(U g‘azabdan titrab turardi.)3. rage (figurative) – jahl• His rage was uncontrollable.(Uning jahli nazorat qilolmas edi.)
ex: He was rushed to hospital after suffering apoplexy. (U apopleksiya tufayli shoshilinch kasalxonaga olib ketildi.)
Apoplexy can lead to permanent paralysis if not treated quickly.(Agar tezda davolanmasa, apopleksiya doimiy falajga olib kelishi mumkin.)
The doctor explained that apoplexy is caused by a blocked artery in the brain.(Shifokor apopleksiyaning miyadagi qon tomirining tiqilib qolishi sababli yuzaga kelishini tushuntirdi.)
apoplexy.meta: A sudden medical condition involving the loss of bodily function due to bleeding or blockage in the brain (stroke); often causes unconsciousness or paralysis.

syn: 1. defection – qarashni tark etish• His defection from the party was unexpected.(Uning partiyadan chiqib ketishi kutilmagan edi.)2. renunciation – rad etish

voz kechish• She made a public renunciation of her beliefs.(U e’tiqodlaridan omma oldida voz kechdi.)3. heresy (in a religious context) – bid’atchilik• He was burned for heresy in the Middle Ages.(O‘rta asrlarda u bid’atchilik uchun yoqib yuborilgan edi.)
ex: In those days, apostasy was punishable by death. (O‘sha davrlarda dindan voz kechish o‘lim bilan jazolangan.)
He was accused of apostasy after changing his political views.(U siyosiy qarashlarini o‘zgartirgani uchun dinga xiyonat qilishda ayblandi.)
The book was banned for allegedly promoting apostasy.(Kitob guyo dindan voz kechishni targ‘ib qilgani uchun taqiqlab qo‘yildi.)
Her decision to leave the faith was seen as an act of apostasy.(E’tiqoddan voz kechish qarori dinga xiyonat sifatida ko‘rildi.)
Some regimes consider apostasy a serious crime.(Ba’zi tuzumlar dindan voz kechishni jiddiy jinoyat deb hisoblaydi.)
His apostasy shocked the religious community.(Uning dindan voz kechishi diniy jamiyatni larzaga soldi.)
apostasy.meta: The formal renunciation of a religion, political ideology, or strongly held belief, especially when previously accepted or practiced.

syn: sodiqlikdan voz kechgan kishi• The general was branded a renegade after betraying his allies.(General ittifoqchilarini sotganidan so‘ng xoin deb ataldi.)2. defector – qochqin

tarafini o‘zgartirgan kishi• The defector shared secrets with the enemy.(Qochqin dushman bilan maxfiy ma’lumotlarni baham ko‘rdi.)3. traitor – xoin• He was viewed as a traitor for switching sides.(U taraf o‘zgartirgani uchun xoin deb qaraldi.)
ex: Julian the Apostate is a historical figure who rejected Christianity. (Murtad Julian — xristianlikdan voz kechgan tarixiy shaxsdir.)
They labeled him an apostate after he left the party.(Ular uni partiyadan chiqqani uchun murtad deb atashdi.)
Apostates are often harshly criticized by their former communities.(Murtadlar ko‘pincha sobiq jamoalari tomonidan qattiq tanqid qilinadi.)
He became an apostate in the eyes of religious leaders.(Diniy rahbarlar nazarida u murtad bo‘lib qoldi.)
Some consider whistleblowers as apostates of corporate loyalty.(Ba’zilar fosh qiluvchilarni korporativ sadoqatga nisbatan murtad deb hisoblashadi.)
apostate.meta: Someone who has renounced or rejected their religious or political beliefs, especially after previously following them with commitment.

diniy targ‘ibotchi• The missionary spent years preaching abroad.(Missioner xorijda yillar davomida targ‘ibot olib bordi.)

The twelve apostles followed Jesus during his lifetime.(O‘n ikki havoriy Iso hayotlik chog‘ida unga ergashganlar.)
apostle.meta: In Christian tradition, one of the 12 disciples specially chosen by Jesus to spread his teachings.

old-fashioned) – dori sotuvchi• The druggist sold handmade ointments._(Dori sotuvchi qo‘lbola surtmalarni sotgan.)

apothecary.meta: A historical term for a person who made and sold medicines and drugs; similar to a pharmacist or chemist in modern terms.

syn: 1. hand drill – qo‘l burg‘usi• The craftsman used a hand drill instead of power tools.(Usta elektr asboblari o‘rniga qo‘l burg‘usidan foydalandi.)2. manual drill – qo‘lda ishlatiladigan burg‘u• Manual drills are still useful in remote areas.(Uzoq joylarda qo‘lda ishlatiladigan burg‘ular hamon foydali.)3. crank drill – aylanma qo‘l burg‘u• He brought an old crank drill to demonstrate traditional woodworking._(U an’anaviy yog‘ochga ishlov berishni ko‘rsatish uchun eski aylanma burg‘uni olib keldi.)
ex: The carpenter used a brace and bit to drill a hole in the wooden beam. (Duradgor yog‘och nurlariga teshik ochish uchun qo‘l dreldan foydalandi.)
Before electric drills, most craftsmen used a brace and bit.(Elektr drellardan oldin, ko‘pchilik hunarmandlar qo‘l dreldan foydalanishgan.)
He rotated the brace and bit smoothly through the hardwood.(U qattiq yog‘ochga qo‘l dreldan foydalangan holda muloyimlik bilan burg‘uladi.)
The antique tool collection included a well-preserved brace and bit.(Qadimiy asboblar to‘plamida yaxshi saqlangan qo‘l dreli bor edi.)
brace and bit.meta: A traditional manual tool for boring holes, consisting of a crank-shaped handle (the brace) and a removable drill (the bit) that turns when the brace is rotated.

syn: 1. glorification – ulug‘lash• The film is a glorification of ancient warriors.(Film qadimgi jangchilarni ulug‘lashdir.)2. deification – ilohiylashtirish• The ruler’s deification came after his victories.(Hukmdorning ilohiylashtirilishi uning g‘alabalaridan so‘ng ro‘y berdi.)3. idolization – butunlay ilohiylashtirish• The fans’ idolization of the star bordered on obsession._(Muxlislarning yulduzni ideallashtirishi deyarli xastalik darajasiga yetgan edi.)

The hero's death marked his apotheosis in national memory.(Qahramonning o‘limi uni milliy xotirada ilohiylashtirish darajasiga olib chiqdi.)
In many cultures, great rulers experienced apotheosis after death.(Ko‘plab madaniyatlarda buyuk hukmdorlar vafotidan so‘ng ilohiylashtirilgan.)
apotheosis.meta: The act of raising someone to divine status, or treating them as a god; idealization or ultimate glorification.

syn: 1. application – dastur• This application is free to download.(Bu dastur bepul yuklab olinadi.)2. program – dastur• I need a program to convert videos.(Men videolarni aylantirish uchun dasturga muhtojman.)3. software – dasturiy ta’minot• The software includes several useful apps.(Dasturiy ta’minotda bir nechta foydali ilovalar mavjud.)

app.meta: A downloadable or pre-installed program on a smartphone, tablet, or computer that performs a particular task or service such as messaging, gaming, or banking.

syn: 1. horrify – dahshatga solmoq• The movie horrified the audience.(Film tomoshabinlarni dahshatga soldi.)2. shock – hayratga solmoq• The news shocked everyone.(Yangilik hammaga hayrat baxsh etdi.)3. dismay – xafa qilmoq

The thought of having to do it all again appals me.(Buni yana bir bor qilishim kerakligi haqida o‘ylash meni hayratga soladi.)
It appalled me that they could simply ignore the problem.(Ularning muammoni shunchaki e'tiborsiz qoldirishlari meni dahshatga soldi.)
He witnessed some appalling acts of barbarism during the war.(U urush davomida dahshatli vahshiyliklarni ko‘rdi.)
Conditions in the prison are said to be appalling.(Qamoqxona sharoitlari dahshatli deb aytiladi.)
appall.meta: To greatly shock or horrify someone, often because something is very bad or unpleasant.

The brachiopod’s shell is symmetrical along the midline.(Brachiopodning chig'anoq qopqog‘i o‘rta chiziq bo‘ylab simmetrikdir.)
brachiopod.meta: A sea animal with a hard shell composed of two valves hinged at the rear, distinct from bivalve mollusks.

ex: The brachiosaurus was one of the tallest dinosaurs that ever lived. (Braxiozavr yashagan eng baland dinozavrlardan biri edi.)
Scientists study brachiosaurus fossils to learn about prehistoric life.(Olimlar braxiozavr qazilma qoldiqlarini qadimgi hayotni o‘rganish uchun tadqiq qiladilar.)
The brachiosaurus used its long neck to reach leaves high in the trees.(Braxiozavr uzun bo‘yinini daraxtlardagi baland barglarga yetish uchun ishlatgan.)

appalled.meta: Feeling shocked or horrified by something unpleasant

The bracing sea breeze woke me up instantly.• A bracing swim in the cold water refreshed him.
bracing.meta: Fresh and invigorating, especially of air or weather.

bracken.meta: A type of large fern growing wild in woodland or upland areas.

syn: dahshatli)• The news was shocking to everyone.(Yangilik hammaga dahshatli bo‘ldi.)horrific (juda yomon

damnable.meta: — very bad, unpleasant, or annoying, often used to express frustration, irritation, or anger; sometimes used as a mild swear word.

damnation.meta: in religious belief, the state of being condemned by God to suffer eternal punishment in hell after death; often used to express the idea of spiritual ruin, divine judgment, or eternal separation from salvation

Her silence was seen as damning.(Uning jimligi aybdorligini tasdiqlovchi ishora sifatida baholandi.)
The documentary revealed damning footage of political corruption.(Hujjatli film siyosiy korrupsiya haqida ayblovchi videoyozuvlarni ochiqladi.)
damning.meta: showing or strongly suggesting that someone is guilty or deserves to be blamed or criticized; causing great harm to a person’s reputation or proving wrongdoing.

syn: humidity – namlik• High humidity makes the room uncomfortable.(Yuqarilikdagi namlik xonani noqulay qiladi.)mildew – zamburug‘ (ko‘pincha zaxlik natijasida hosil bo‘ladi)• The damp caused mildew on the walls.(Zaxlik devorlarda zamburug‘ paydo bo‘lishiga olib keldi.)
ex: The old house smells of damp. (Bu eski uydan zaxlik hidi keladi.)
Those marks above the window look like damp to me.(Deraza ustidagi izlar menga zaxlikdek ko‘rinmoqda.)

The house had got woodworm and rising damp.
The surveyor found damp in the kitchen.
One wall of my house is affected by rising damp.
damp.meta: Slight wetness or moisture, especially in a building or place where it is unwanted or unpleasant.

syn: moisture barrier – namlikdan himoya qoplamasi• The builder added a moisture barrier to protect the walls.(Quruvchi devorlarni himoya qilish uchun namlik to‘sig‘ini qo‘shdi.)waterproof layer – suv o‘tkazmaydigan qatlam• A waterproof layer under the bricks stopped water from rising.(G‘isht ostidagi suv o‘tkazmaydigan qatlam suvning ko‘tarilishini to‘xtatdi.)damp-proof membrane – namlikni to‘smaydigan membrana• The engineer used a damp-proof membrane to insulate the foundation.(Muhandis poydevorni izolyatsiya qilish uchun namlik to‘smaydigan membrana ishlatdi.)
ex: The house was built without a damp course, which caused rising damp. (Uy namlikka qarshi qoplamasiz qurilgan edi, bu esa zax ko‘tarilishiga sabab bo‘ldi.)
The damp course should be placed just above ground level.(Namlik to‘suvchi qoplama er sathidan biroz yuqoriga o‘rnatilishi kerak.)
Older buildings may lack a damp course and suffer from moisture damage.(Eski binolarda namlik to‘suvchi qoplama bo‘lmasligi va namdan zarar ko‘rishi mumkin.)
A plastic sheet is often used as a damp course in modern constructions.(Zamonaviy qurilishlarda ko‘pincha plastik qoplama namlikka qarshi ishlatiladi.)
Failure to install a proper damp course can lead to expensive repairs.(To‘g‘ri namlik qoplamasini o‘rnatmaslik qimmat ta’mirlarga olib kelishi mumkin.)
damp course.meta: A layer of waterproof material built into the walls of a building near the ground to prevent moisture from rising through the structure.

syn: moisture barrier – namlikdan to‘suvchi qatlam• The walls were lined with a moisture barrier.(Devorlar namlikdan to‘suvchi qatlam bilan qoplangan edi.)waterproof membrane – suv o‘tkazmaydigan membrana• A waterproof membrane was laid under the floor.(Pol ostiga suv o‘tkazmaydigan membrana yotqizildi.)damp course – namlikdan to‘suvchi qoplama• They had to replace the damp course in the old wall.(Ular eski devordagi namlikdan to‘suvchi qoplamani almashtirishlari kerak bo‘ldi.)
ex: A damp-proof course is essential in any new building to prevent moisture damage. (Har qanday yangi binoda namlik zararini oldini olish uchun namlikdan himoya qiluvchi qatlam muhimdir.)
The builder inserted a plastic sheet as a damp-proof course in the foundation.(Quruvchi poydevorga namlikdan himoya qiluvchi qatlam sifatida plastik qatlam joylashtirdi.)
The house was damp because it didn’t have a proper damp-proof course.(Uyda to‘g‘ri namlikdan himoya qiluvchi qatlam bo‘lmagani uchun u zax bo‘lgan.)
Damp-proof course failure can lead to major structural issues.(Namlikdan himoya qiluvchi qatlamning ishdan chiqishi katta konstruktiv muammolarga olib kelishi mumkin.)
A modern damp-proof course usually involves synthetic materials.(Zamonaviy namlikdan himoya qiluvchi qatlam odatda sun’iy materiallardan iborat bo‘ladi.)
damp-proof course.meta: A layer of waterproof material built into the lower part of a wall of a building to prevent rising damp from the ground.

syn: 1. identifier – identifikator• Pilots must always respond to their identifier in communications.(Uchuvchilar aloqa paytida har doim o‘z identifikatoriga javob berishlari kerak.)2. radio code – radio kodi• The distress signal was broadcast using a special radio code.(Favqulodda signal maxsus radio kodi yordamida uzatildi.)3. call number – qo‘ng‘iroq raqami• Each unit had its own call number in the operation.(Har bir birlik operatsiyada o‘zining qo‘ng‘iroq raqamiga ega edi.)

call sign.meta: A set of letters and/or numbers used to identify a person or organization, especially in radio communication.

syn: 1. call alert – qo‘ng‘iroq ogohlantirishi• The system uses a call alert to notify of incoming calls.(Tizim kiruvchi qo‘ng‘iroqlar haqida ogohlantirish uchun qo‘ng‘iroq ogohlantiruvchisini ishlatadi.)2. call notification – qo‘ng‘iroq xabarnomasi• Call notifications can help users manage multiple calls.(Qo‘ng‘iroq xabarnomalari foydalanuvchilarga bir nechta qo‘ng‘iroqlarni boshqarishga yordam beradi.)3. dual call feature – ikki tomonlama qo‘ng‘iroq xizmati• The dual call feature is especially useful for business users.(Ikki tomonlama qo‘ng‘iroq xizmati ayniqsa biznes foydalanuvchilari uchun qulay.)
ex: ICM is an internationally patented call waiting service suited to the domestic market. (ICM bu mahalliy bozor uchun moslashgan, xalqaro patentlangan kutishdagi qo‘ng‘iroq xizmati.)

With call waiting, you won’t miss important calls while talking.(Qo‘ng‘iroq kutish xizmati bilan suhbat davomida muhim qo‘ng‘iroqni o‘tkazib yubormaysiz.)• She heard the beep and knew she had a call waiting.(U signal tovushini eshitdi va yana bir qo‘ng‘iroq bo‘lganini bildi.)• Most smartphones have a call waiting feature enabled by default.(Aksariyat smartfonlarda qo‘ng‘iroq kutish funksiyasi odatda avtomatik yoqilgan bo‘ladi.)
call waiting.meta: A phone service feature that notifies you of another incoming call while you're already on a call, allowing you to answer the second call without ending the first.

syn: 1. dragonfly (ajdaho ninachi)• Dragonflies are larger than damselflies and keep their wings open while resting.(Ajdaho ninachilar oddiy ninachilardan katta va dam olayotganda qanotlarini ochiq tutadi.)2. aquatic insect (suv hasharoti)• Damselflies are one type of aquatic insect commonly seen near lakes.(Ninachilar suv havzalari yaqinida ko‘p uchraydigan suv hasharotlaridan biridir.)3. flying insect (uchuvchi hasharot)• Damselflies are graceful flying insects found in many wetland areas.(Ninachilar ko‘plab botqoqli hududlarda uchraydigan nafis uchuvchi hasharotlardir.)
ex: Damselflies are often seen hovering over ponds and rivers. (Ninachilar ko‘pincha hovuzlar va daryolar ustida uchib yuradi.)
Unlike dragonflies, damselflies close their wings when resting.(Ajdaho ninachilaridan farqli o‘laroq, oddiy ninachilar dam olayotganda qanotlarini yopib oladi.)
The bright colors of the damselfly help it attract mates.(Ninachining yorqin ranglari unga juft topishga yordam beradi.)
Damselflies are important indicators of clean, healthy freshwater ecosystems.(Ninachilar toza va sog‘lom chuchuk suv tizimlarining muhim ko‘rsatkichidir.)
damselfly.meta: A slender, delicate insect similar to a dragonfly, usually found near water. Unlike dragonflies, damselflies rest with their wings closed over their backs.

syn: 1. plum (olxo‘ri)• The damson is a variety of plum known for its tart flavor.(Tikanolxo‘ri — nordon ta’mi bilan tanilgan olxo‘ri turi.)2. prune (quritilgan olxo‘ri)• You can dry damsons to make prunes.(Tikanolxo‘rilarni quritib qurutilgan olxo‘ri tayyorlash mumkin.)3. fruit (meva)• Damsons are one of the most versatile fruits in the kitchen.(Tikanolxo‘rilar oshxonada eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan mevalardan biridir.)
ex: Damson jam is rich and slightly tart. (Tikanolxo‘ridan tayyorlangan murabbo boy ta’mga va biroz nordon bo‘ladi.)
I made a bottle of damson wine last autumn.(O‘tgan kuzda men tikanolxo‘ridan vino tayyorladim.)
She served fresh cheese with damson jelly.(U yangi pishloqni tikanolxo‘ri jele bilan tortdi.)
The garden has a damson tree that produces fruit in late summer.(Bog‘da yoz oxirida meva beradigan tikanolxo‘ri daraxti bor.)
damson.meta: A small, dark purple variety of plum, often used for making jam, jelly, wine, or preserves.

syn: 1. phone-in – telefon eshittiruv• The BBC hosted a phone-in on education reform.(Bi-bi-si ta’lim islohoti haqida telefon eshittiruv uyushtirdi.)2. live call show – jonli qo‘ng‘iroqli eshittiruv• A live call show gives the public a voice.(Jonli qo‘ng‘iroqli eshittiruv aholiga o‘z fikrini bildirish imkonini beradi.)3. talk radio – suhbatli radio dastur• Many talk radio programs use call-ins to boost engagement.(Ko‘plab suhbatli radio dasturlar tinglovchilar qo‘ng‘iroqlaridan foydalanadi.)
ex: She hosts a weekly call-in radio show called "Got a question?" (U har hafta “Savolingiz bormi?” nomli telefon orqali qatnashiladigan radio ko‘rsatuv olib boradi.)
A call-in show lets listeners voice their opinions live.(Call-in ko‘rsatuv tinglovchilarga o‘z fikrlarini jonli efirda bildirish imkonini beradi.)
The politician appeared on a late-night call-in to discuss the reforms.(Siyosatchi kechki call-in eshittiruvda ishtirok etib islohotlar haqida suhbatlashdi.)
That radio station’s call-in program always gets heated during election week.(Saylov haftasida o‘sha radiokanaldagi call-in ko‘rsatuvlar har doim qizg‘in o‘tadi.)
call-in.meta: A radio or television program where members of the public can participate by telephone, usually to ask questions, give opinions, or take part in discussions.

syn: 1. rank – daraja• He has achieved the highest rank in his dojo.(U o‘z dojo-sida eng yuqori darajaga erishgan.)2. belt – kamar• The belt color shows your dan level.(Kamar rangi sizning dan darajangizni ko‘rsatadi.)3. level – bosqich• She tested for the next level in taekwondo.(U taekvondoda navbatdagi bosqich uchun imtihon topshirdi.)
ex: She has a black belt, third dan, in judo. (U judodan uchinchi dan qora kamar egasi.)
Earning a dan rank takes years of dedication and training.(Dan darajasiga erishish uchun yillar davomida mehnat va mashg‘ulot kerak.)
He holds a fifth dan in karate and teaches professionally.(U karate bo‘yicha beshinchi dan egasi va professional tarzda dars beradi.)
After passing the test, he was promoted to first dan.(Imtihonni topshirgach, uni birinchi dan darajasiga ko‘tardilar.)
dan.meta: A level or rank in martial arts such as karate or judo, used to denote a practitioner’s degree of expertise.

syn: 1. conscription – harbiy xizmatga majburan chaqirish• Conscription was suspended in that country.(Bu mamlakatda harbiy xizmatga majburan chaqirish to‘xtatildi.)2. enlistment – harbiy xizmatga yozilish• He avoided enlistment by claiming medical issues.(U tibbiy muammolar sababli harbiy xizmatga yozilishni chetlab o‘tdi.)3. draft – chaqiruv (asosan AQShda)• Many protested the Vietnam draft.(Ko‘pchilik Vetnamdagi chaqiruvga qarshi chiqdi.)
ex: Because of his occupation, he was not liable for call-up. (Kasbi sababli u chaqiruvga tortilmadi.)
Young men of call-up age were required to register.(Chaqiruv yoshidagi yigitlar ro‘yxatdan o‘tishga majbur edilar.)
She was very upset when her boyfriend received his call-up papers.(Yigiti chaqiruv qog‘ozini olganida u juda xafa bo‘ldi.)
He tried to delay his call-up by applying for university.(U universitetga hujjat topshirib, chaqiruvni kechiktirmoqchi bo‘ldi.)
call-up.meta: An official order to join the armed forces for military service.

ex: The caller hung up.
an anonymous caller
There's a caller for you on line two.

syn: 1. number display – raqamni ko‘rsatuvchi tizim• The number display helped me avoid a spam call.(Raqam ko‘rsatuvchi tizim spam qo‘ng‘iroqdan saqladi.)2. caller recognition – qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchini tanish• Caller recognition helps in filtering unwanted calls.(Qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchini tanish kerakmas qo‘ng‘iroqlarni ajratib olishga yordam beradi.)3. phone ID – telefon aniqlagichi• My phone ID app blocks unknown numbers.(Telefon aniqlagich ilovam noma’lum raqamlarni bloklaydi.)
ex: I never answer calls without caller ID. (Men hech qachon abonent raqami ko‘rsatilmagan qo‘ng‘iroqlarga javob bermayman.)
Caller ID showed an unknown number.(Qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchining raqami noma’lum edi.)
Thanks to caller ID, I knew it was a scam.(Qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchini aniqlash tizimi tufayli bu firibgarlik ekanini bildim.)
Caller ID lets you decide whether to answer or ignore a call.(Qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchini aniqlash sizga javob berish yoki e’tiborsiz qoldirish imkonini beradi.)
caller id.meta: A system that shows the phone number or name of the person calling you before you answer.

syn: 1. penman – yozuvchi san’atkor• The skilled penman decorated the manuscript beautifully.(Mahir penman qo‘lyozmani go‘zal bezadi.)2. scribe – yozuvchi

kotib• Ancient scribes were responsible for copying texts.(Qadimgi yozuvchilar matnlarni ko‘chirish bilan shug‘ullangan.)3. lettering artist – harflarni chiroyli yozuvchi san’atkor• A lettering artist can turn any word into visual art.(Lettering artist har qanday so‘zni vizual san’atga aylantira oladi.)
ex: He was a skilled calligrapher and artist. (U mohir xattot va rassom edi.)
The wedding invitations were written by a professional calligrapher.(To‘y taklifnomalari professional xattot tomonidan yozilgan.)
In many cultures, a calligrapher is highly respected for preserving tradition.(Ko‘plab madaniyatlarda xattot an’analarni asragani uchun hurmat qilinadi.)
The museum hosted a live demonstration by a famous Arabic calligrapher.(Muzeyda mashhur arab xattoti jonli namoyish o‘tkazdi.)
calligrapher.meta: A person who practices or is skilled in the art of beautiful handwriting, especially using special pens or brushes.

syn: 1. penmanship – yozuv sifati (xattotlik)• His penmanship was so elegant it looked like printed text.(Yozuvi shu qadar chiroyli ediki

bosma matnga o‘xshardi.)2. script – yozuv turi• The invitation was written in an elegant script.(Taklifnoma nafis yozuvda yozilgan edi.)3. hand – qo‘l yozuvi• Her hand was beautiful and easy to read.(Uning qo‘l yozuvi chiroyli va o‘qilishi oson edi.)
ex: There's some wonderful calligraphy in these old manuscripts. (Bu qadimiy qo‘lyozmalarda ajoyib xattotlik namunasi bor.)
A poem written in neat italic calligraphy(Nimcha kursiv husnixatda yozilgan she’r.)
Arabic calligraphy is considered one of the highest forms of Islamic art.(Arab xattotligi islomiy san’atning eng yuksak shakllaridan biri hisoblanadi.)
She practices calligraphy as a hobby in her free time.(Bo‘sh vaqtida u husnixat bilan shug‘ullanadi.)
calligraphy.meta: The art of beautiful handwriting, often created with special pens or brushes for decorative or formal purposes.

ex: He realized that his calling was to preach the gospel.
I'm glad she's going into medicine. It's a very worthy calling.

syn: 1. doorbell – eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i• She heard the doorbell and rushed to answer it.(U eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘ini eshitib

javob berish uchun yugurdi.)2. buzzer – signal qo‘ng‘irog‘i• The buzzer went off as soon as I pressed it.(Men uni bosganim zahoti signal tovushi eshitildi.)3. chime – jiringlagich• A soft chime echoed through the hallway.(Yumshoq jiringlash koridorga tarqaldi.)
ex: The calling bell rang twice before she opened the door. (Eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i ikki marta jiringladi, keyin u eshikni ochdi.)
Please press the calling bell if no one answers.(Hech kim javob bermasa, eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘ini bosing.)
He installed a smart calling bell with a camera.(U kamera bilan jihozlangan aqlli qo‘ng‘iroq o‘rnatdi.)
The delivery man waited by the calling bell.(Yetkazib beruvchi eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i yonida kutdi.)
calling bell.meta: A device, usually placed near the entrance of a house or apartment, that produces a sound to alert people inside when someone is at the door; another term for doorbell in Indian English.

syn: • visiting card – tashrif qog‘ozi• He handed me his visiting card at the entrance.(U kirishda menga tashrif qog‘ozini berdi.)• name card – ism yozilgan karta• A neat name card was clipped to his jacket.(Kurtkasiga chiroyli ism yozilgan karta mahkamlangan edi.)• business card – biznes vizitka• She exchanged business cards with the client.(U mijoz bilan biznes vizitka almashdi.)
ex: In the past, gentlemen left a calling card after every visit. (Ilgari, janoblar har tashrifdan keyin tashrif qog‘ozi qoldirishardi.)

She placed her calling card on the silver tray.(U o‘z vizitkasini kumush likopchaga qo‘ydi.)• A calling card used to represent one’s social etiquette.(Tashrif qog‘ozi odatda kishining ijtimoiy odobini ifodalardi.)• The butler handed him a calling card from the visitor.(Xizmatkor unga mehmonning tashrif qog‘ozini topshirdi.)
calling card.meta: A small card with a person’s name and sometimes address or title, traditionally left to show one has visited.

syn: • vernier callipers – verniyer krontsirkul• He carefully adjusted the vernier callipers.(U verniyer krontsirkulni ehtiyotkorlik bilan sozladi.)• gauge – o‘lchov moslamasi• The gauge shows the thickness accurately.(O‘lchov moslamasi qalinlikni aniq ko‘rsatadi.)• measuring tool – o‘lchov quroli• This measuring tool is highly accurate.(Bu o‘lchov quroli juda aniq hisoblanadi.)
ex: He used a pair of callipers to measure the cylinder. (U silindrni o‘lchash uchun krontsirkuldan foydalandi.)

Callipers help ensure precision in mechanical work.(Krontsirkul mexanik ishda aniqlikni ta'minlaydi.)• Engineers often rely on digital callipers for quick readings.(Muhandislar tezkor o‘lchovlar uchun raqamli krontsirkullarga tayanishadi.)• Vernier callipers are commonly used in labs.(Vernier krontsirkullari laboratoriyalarda keng qo‘llaniladi.)
calliper.meta: A device used to measure the distance between two opposite sides of an object, especially the diameter.

syn: • bodyweight training – o‘z tana og‘irligi bilan mashq qilish• Bodyweight training is perfect for beginners.(O‘z tana og‘irligi bilan mashq qilish yangi boshlovchilar uchun juda mos.)• fitness exercises – jismoniy mashqlar• Fitness exercises improve overall health.(Jismoniy mashqlar umumiy sog‘liqni yaxshilaydi.)• workout routine – mashq dasturi• His workout routine includes 30 minutes of callisthenics.(Uning mashq dasturida 30 daqiqa jismoniy mashg‘ulotlar mavjud.)
ex: Many athletes use callisthenics as part of their warm-up. (Ko‘plab sportchilar isinish uchun jismoniy mashqlarni bajaradilar.)

Callisthenics improves body control and flexibility.(Jismoniy mashg‘ulotlar tana muvozanati va egiluvchanligini oshiradi.)• Push-ups and squats are classic callisthenics exercises.(Otjimaniye va cho‘nqayish klassik jismoniy mashqlardir.)• She practices callisthenics every morning in the park.(U har ertalab parkda jismoniy mashqlar bajaradi.)
callisthenics.meta: Callisthenics refers to a form of physical training consisting of simple movements and exercises, usually done without gym equipment, to increase strength, flexibility, and fitness.

syn: • station ID – stansiya identifikatori• The station ID is broadcast every hour.(Stansiya identifikatori har soatda efirga uzatiladi.)• broadcast identifier – efir belgilovchi kod• The broadcast identifier is required by law.(Efir belgilovchi kod qonun bilan talab qilinadi.)• radio call sign – radio stansiya belgisi• His job was to monitor the radio call signs of nearby stations.(Uning vazifasi yaqin atrofdagi stansiyalarning radio belgilarini nazorat qilish edi.)
ex: Most U.S. radio stations start their call letters with 'K' or 'W'. (Ko‘pgina AQSh radio stansiyalarining belgisi ‘K’ yoki ‘W’ harflari bilan boshlanadi.)
NBC and CBS are famous call letters in American broadcasting.(NBC va CBS — AQShda mashhur teleradio belgilaridir.)
The call letters were changed when the station switched ownership.(Stansiya egasi o‘zgargach, uning belgisi ham o‘zgartirildi.)
She worked for a small station with the call letters WJAX.(U WJAX belgili kichik bir stansiyada ishlagan.)
call letters.meta: Call letters are a group of letters (usually 3 or 4) assigned to identify a radio or television station, especially in the United States.

He asked me to dance.

Ruth and Richard danced together all evening.

an evening of drama, music and dance
modern / classical dance

syn: • heartless – bag‘ritosh• He gave a heartless response to her grief.(U uning qayg‘usiga bag‘ritosh javob berdi.)• cold-hearted – sovuqko‘ngil• Only a cold-hearted person would ignore such pain.(Faqat sovuqko‘ngil odam shunday azobni mensimaydi.)• insensitive – hissiz• That was an insensitive thing to say.(Bu aytiladigan gap emas edi — juda hissiz.)
ex: I still can't believe they were so callous. (Ularning bunchalik shavqatsiz bo‘lganiga hali ham ishonolmayapman.)
A callous killer/attitude/act.(Shafqatsiz qotil / munosabat / harakat.)
He was convicted of the particularly callous murder of two teenage boys.(U ikki nafar o‘smir bolani nihoyatda shafqatsiz o‘ldirgani uchun sudlangan.)
The troops showed a callous disregard for life and property.(Askarlar hayot va mulkka nisbatan shafqatsiz befarqlik ko‘rsatishdi.)
• She gave a callous laugh after hearing about his misfortune.(U uning baxtsizliklarini eshitib bag‘ritosh kulgu qildi.)
• His callous words left her in tears.(Uning shafqatsiz so‘zlari uni yig‘latdi.)
callous.meta: Someone who is callous behaves in a cruel or emotionally cold way, showing no sympathy or concern for others.

syn: • swing band – sving guruhi• A swing band played hits from the 1940s.(Sving guruhi 1940-yillardagi mashhur kuylarni ijro etdi.)• big band – katta orkestr• The big band created a lively atmosphere.(Katta orkestr ko‘tarinki muhit yaratdi.)• orchestra – orkestr• The orchestra included both strings and brass.(Orkestr tor va mis asboblarni o‘z ichiga olgan edi.)
ex: My mother was a singer in a dance band. (Onam raqs guruhining qo‘shiqchisi bo‘lgan.)
The hotel hired a dance band to entertain guests at the wedding.(Mehmonxona to‘y marosimida mehmonlarni xushnud etish uchun raqs guruhini yolladi.)
They listened to an old-school dance band playing swing music.(Ular sving musiqasi ijro etayotgan eski uslubdagi raqs guruhini tinglashdi.)
The couple danced to live music performed by a talented dance band.(Er-xotin iste’dodli raqs guruhi ijrosidagi jonli musiqa ostida raqsga tushishdi.)
dance band.meta: A dance band is a musical group that plays popular music suitable for dancing, often including vocals and performed at social events like parties or balls.

syn: • rough – qo‘pol• His rough hands told their own story.(Uning qo‘pol qo‘llari o‘z hikoyasini so‘zlab turardi.)• hardened – qotgan• His hardened skin couldn't feel the thorn.(Uning qotgan terisi tikanni sezmadi.)• thickened – qalinlashgan• Thickened skin formed on his elbows.(Uning tirsaklarida teri qalinlashgan edi.)
ex: Her calloused hands testified to a life of hard, physical work. (Uning qavarib ketgan qo‘llari og‘ir jismoniy mehnat hayotidan dalolat berardi.)
The calloused feet of the runner showed years of training.(Yuguruvchining qavarib ketgan oyoqlari yillar davomida mashq qilganini ko‘rsatardi.)
He had calloused palms from lifting bricks all day.(Uning kaftlari butun kun g‘isht ko‘targanidan qotib qolgan edi.)
Farmers often have calloused fingers from handling tools.(Dehqonlarning barmoqlari asbob-uskunalar bilan ishlashdan qotib qolgan bo‘ladi.)
calloused.meta: Calloused describes skin that has become hard and thick due to repeated pressure, friction, or work.

syn: • cruelly – shavqatsizlarcha• He cruelly insulted her in front of others.(U uni boshqalar oldida shavqatsizlarcha haqorat qildi.)• heartlessly – bag‘ritoshlik bilan• She heartlessly ended the friendship.(U do‘stlikni bag‘ritoshlik bilan yakunladi.)• brutally – vahshiylarcha• The prisoner was brutally interrogated.(Mahbus vahshiylarcha so‘roq qilindi.)
ex: He is accused of consistently and callously ill-treating his wife. (U doimiy ravishda xotinini shavqatsizlarcha haqorat qilganlikda ayblanmoqda.)
The manager callously ignored the workers' complaints.(Menejer ishchilarning shikoyatlarini shavqatsizlarcha e’tiborsiz qoldirdi.)
She callously walked past the injured dog without stopping.(U jarohatlangan it yonidan shavqatsizlarcha to‘xtamay o‘tib ketdi.)
The company callously fired staff without notice.(Kompaniya xodimlarni ogohlantirmasdan berahmlik bilan ishdan bo‘shatdi.)
callously.meta: To do something callously means to behave without care or sympathy for others’ feelings, often in a cold or cruel way.

syn: • disco floor – diskoteka pol maydoni• The disco floor lit up with flashing lights.(Diskoteka maydoni yaltirab turadigan chiroqlar bilan yoritildi.)• party floor – bayram maydoni• The DJ controlled the energy on the party floor.(DJ bayram maydonidagi kayfiyatni boshqardi.)• dance area – raqs zonasi• A live band performed near the dance area.(Jonli guruh raqs zonasida chiqish qildi.)
ex: Have you seen him on the dance floor? (Uni raqs maydonida ko‘rdingmi?)
He invited me onto the dance floor.(U meni raqs maydoniga taklif qildi.)
Whirling gracefully, they crossed the dance floor.(Ular nafislik bilan aylanishib, raqs maydonidan o‘tishdi.)
Everyone rushed to the dance floor when the music started.(Musiqa boshlanganda hamma raqs maydoniga shoshildi.)
dance floor.meta: A dance floor is an area in a club, hall, or venue where people go to dance. It is usually a flat, open space specifically designed for dancing.

syn: cruelty – shavqatsizlik• His cruelty was evident in every action.(Uning shavqatsizligi har bir harakatidan bilinib turardi.)insensitivity – hissiyatsizlik• Her insensitivity made others uncomfortable.(Uning hissiyatsizligi boshqalarni noqulay ahvolga solardi.)heartlessness – bagʻritoshlik• His heartlessness during the funeral shocked everyone.(Dafn marosimidagi bagʻritoshligi hammaga hayrat uygʻotdi.)
ex: The callousness of Raymond’s murder shocked the entire community. (Reymondning qotilligidagi shavqatsizlik butun jamiyatni larzaga soldi.)
His callousness towards the victims was truly disturbing.(Uning jabrlanuvchilarga nisbatan shavqatsizligi juda tashvishli edi.)
I was horrified by her callousness during the meeting.(Uchrashuv davomida uning bagʻritoshligi meni dahshatga soldi.)
Such callousness is unacceptable in a position of care.(Bunday berahmlik gʻamxoʻrlik bilan bogʻliq lavozimda qabul qilinmaydi.)
callousness.meta: The quality of being emotionally insensitive, cruel, or unfeeling, especially toward the suffering of others.

syn: ballroom – bal zali• The wedding took place in a grand ballroom.(Toʻy katta bal zalida boʻlib oʻtdi.)disco – diskoteka• We danced until midnight at the disco.(Biz yarim kechagacha diskotekada raqsga tushdik.)nightclub – tun klubi• The nightclub had a huge dance floor.(Tun klubida katta raqs maydoni bor edi.)
ex: Their eyes met across the crowded dance hall. (Ular nigohlari odamga toʻla raqs zalining narigi tomonidan toʻqnashdi.)
The old dance hall now hosts wedding receptions.(Eski raqs zali hozir toʻy marosimlari uchun ishlatiladi.)
We spent every Friday night at the local dance hall.(Har juma oqshom mahalliy raqs zalida oʻtkazardik.)
The music echoed through the large dance hall.(Musiqa katta raqs zalida jarangladi.)
dance hall.meta: A large room or building where people go to dance, often to live or recorded music.

syn: inexperienced – tajribasiz• He was too inexperienced to manage a team.(U jamoani boshqarish uchun juda tajribasiz edi.)naive – soddadil• She’s too naive to see his true intentions.(U uning asl niyatlarini tushunish uchun juda soddadil.)immature – g‘o‘r• His immature reaction disappointed the team.(Uning g‘o‘r munosabati jamoani xafa qildi.)
ex: Mark was just a callow youth of sixteen when he arrived in Paris. (Mark Parijga kelganida atigi o‘n olti yoshli, tajribasiz yigit edi.)
She dismissed his callow remarks with a smile.(U uning bebosh gaplarini jilmayib e’tiborsiz qoldirdi.)
At twenty-one, he was still callow and easily impressed.(Yigirma bir yoshida u hanuz tajribasiz edi va osongina ta’sirlanardi.)
The intern’s callow behavior showed he wasn’t ready for leadership.(Amaliyotchining bebosh harakati u rahbarlikka tayyor emasligini ko‘rsatdi.)
callow.meta: Callow describes a young person who is inexperienced, naive, and immature, especially in attitude or behavior.

syn: ragga – reggaening elektron varianti• Ragga quickly became a dominant style in Jamaican clubs.(Ragga Yamaykadagi klublarda tezda yetakchi uslubga aylandi.)dub reggae – instrumental reggi uslubi• He’s known for blending dub reggae with modern trap.(U dub reggini zamonaviy trap bilan aralashtirgani bilan mashhur.)toasting – reggi ritmida gapirish yoki kuylash uslubi• Toasting became the vocal foundation of dance-hall.(Toasting dancehallning vokal asosi bo‘lib xizmat qilgan.)
ex: He grew up listening to old-school dance-hall reggae. (U eski uslubdagi dancehall reggisini eshitib katta bo‘lgan.)
Dance-hall reggae has a more upbeat and energetic sound than traditional reggae.(Dancehall reggi an’anaviy reggiga qaraganda yanada ritmik va energiyaga boy.)
The artist mixes dance-hall reggae with electronic beats.(San’atkor dancehall reggini elektron ritmlar bilan aralashtiradi.)
Dance-hall reggae influenced both rap and electronic music.(Dancehall reggi rap va elektron musiqaga ta’sir ko‘rsatgan.)
dance-hall reggae.meta: Dance-hall reggae is a modern style of reggae music that emerged in Jamaica in the late 1970s. It is characterized by a faster rhythm, electronic instrumentation, and a focus on rhythmic spoken or chanted vocals, often referred to as "toasting".

syn: callosity – qalinlashgan teri• The doctor removed a painful callosity from his toe.(Shifokor uning barmog‘idan og‘riqli qalin terini olib tashladi.)thickened skin – qalinlashgan teri• Constant writing can lead to thickened skin on the finger.(Doimiy yozish barmoqda qalinlashgan teriga olib kelishi mumkin.)hardened skin – qattiqlashgan teri• You need a foot scrub to treat the hardened skin on your soles.(Oyoq tagidagi qattiqlashgan terini yumshatish uchun skrab kerak.)
ex: The calluses on her palm showed how hard she had had to work. (Kaftidagi qadoqlar uning qanday og‘ir mehnat qilganini ko‘rsatardi.)
He had workman's hands which were rough and covered with calluses.(Uning qo‘llari ishchi odamnikidek qo‘pol va qadoq bilan qoplangan edi.)
After weeks of playing guitar, he developed calluses on his fingertips.(Gitara chalgan haftalardan so‘ng, barmoqlarining uchida qadoqlar paydo bo‘ldi.)
Walking barefoot every day gave him thick calluses on his heels.(Har kuni yalangoyoq yurishi tufayli tovonlarida qalin qadoqlar hosil bo‘ldi.)

syn: energy unit – energiya birligi• Every food label shows the energy unit in calories.(Har bir oziq-ovqat yorlig‘ida kaloriyadagi energiya birligi ko‘rsatiladi.)kilocalorie (kcal) – kilokaloriya• Most food packaging mentions kilocalories instead of just calories.(Ko‘p ovqat mahsulotlarida oddiy kaloriya o‘rniga kilokaloriya ko‘rsatiladi.)nutritional energy – oziq-ovqat energiyasi• Bananas provide quick nutritional energy for athletes.(Banan sportchilar uchun tez oziq-ovqat energiyasini beradi.)

syn: heat meter – issiqlik o‘lchagich• The heat meter displayed a sharp rise during the reaction.(Reaksiya vaqtida issiqlik o‘lchagich ko‘rsatkichlari keskin oshdi.)energy gauge – energiya o‘lchovchi qurilma• The energy gauge confirmed the exothermic nature of the reaction.(Energiya o‘lchagich reaksiya ekzotermikligini tasdiqladi.)thermal analyzer – termik tahlilchi asbob• A thermal analyzer is similar to a calorimeter in function.(Termik tahlilchi asbob funksiyasi jihatidan kalorimetrga o‘xshaydi.)

syn: loan translation – nusxa tarjima• The term “skyscraper” has a loan translation in many other languages.(“Skyscraper” atamasi boshqa ko‘plab tillarda nusxa tarjimaga ega.)literal translation – so‘zma-so‘z tarjima• A literal translation can sometimes result in a calque.(So‘zma-so‘z tarjima ba’zida calque hosil qiladi.)word-for-word borrowing – so‘zlar asosida qarz olingan ibora• Calques are a form of word-for-word borrowing.(Calque-lar so‘zlar asosida qarz olingan iboralarning bir ko‘rinishidir.)
ex: 'Traffic calming' is a calque of the German 'Verkehrsberuhigung'. (“Traffic calming” iborasi nemis tilidagi “Verkehrsberuhigung” iborasining so‘zma-so‘z tarjimasidir.)
The English phrase “flea market” is a calque of the French “marché aux puces.”(Ingliz tilidagi “flea market” iborasi fransuz tilidagi “marché aux puces” iborasining nusxa tarjimasidir.)
Linguists often study calques to understand how languages influence each other.(Tilshunoslar ko‘pincha tillarning bir-biriga ta’sirini tushunish uchun calque-larni o‘rganadilar.)
“Superman” is considered a calque of the German “Übermensch.”(“Superman” so‘zi nemis tilidagi “Übermensch” so‘zining tarjima o‘xshashi deb hisoblanadi.)
calque.meta: A word or phrase borrowed from another language by literal, word-for-word or root-for-root translation.

'Silent Night' is my favourite (Christmas) carol.
Carols are traditional songs that are sung just before Christmas. Many of them celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

Carols were first sung in the 14th century. They were popular songs with a lively tune, and contained references to the celebrations and feeling of goodwill associated with Christmas, as well as to Christ's birth. One of the oldest printed carols, dating from 1521, is the Boar's Head Carol, which was sung in Queen's College, Oxford as Christmas lunch was carried in. Other traditional carols that are thought to have originated at this time include God Rest You Merry, Gentlemen and While Shepherds Watched Their Flocks by Night.

In England during the 16th century, the Puritans tried to stop people singing carols, but the words continued to be handed down (= passed) from one generation to the next. In the 19th century many of these carols were collected and printed. Some tunes were taken from folk songs, others were specially written. Many of the most popular carols heard today date from this time. They include O Come, All Ye Faithful, Hark! the Herald Angels Sing, Good King Wenceslas, Away in a Manger and O Little Town of Bethlehem.

Traditional carols are very popular in Britain and America, but children also like more modern songs, such as Rudolph, the Red-nosed Reindeer, about how a reindeer's bright red nose lights the way for Santa Claus to take toys to children during a storm, and Frosty the Snowman, which tells the story of a figure made of snow who comes to life.

In the 19th century groups of carol singers, called waits, used to gather in the streets to play and sing for local people, who thanked them by offering drinks or mince pies (= small round pies containing dried fruit, apples and sugar). This custom became known as wassailing and still continues in Britain, with people meeting to sing carols in most town and village centres. Any money that is collected is given to charity. Some singers walk from street to street, singing carols outside each house. In the US door-to-door carol singing is not common, except in a few small communities. Families sing carols when they decorate the Christmas tree.

Coal mining

Coal was very important in the economic development of Britain. It was used as fuel in the factories built during the Industrial Revolution and continued to be important until the 1980s. The main coalfields (= areas where coal is mined) were in north-east England, the north Midlands and the valleys of South Wales, especially the Rhondda Valley. Towns and villages grew around the collieries or pits (= coal mines) and were dominated by the pithead where the lifting machinery was, and by large black slag heaps (= piles of waste material). Poor conditions and low pay led to a long history of industrial trouble and caused miners to play a leading role in the development of the trade union movement.

In 1913 Britain produced 292 million tons of coal and employed over a million miners. In 1947, when the mines were nationalized (= brought under government control), there were still about 1 000 collieries and 700 000 miners. Increased use of North Sea oil and gas in the 1970s led to a lower demand for coal. Coal gas was replaced by natural gas. By the mid 1980s there were only 160 collieries and 200 000 miners. Fear of further job losses led to the long and violent miners' strike of 1984–5. In the 1990s there were more pit closures. In mining communities throughout Britain thousands of former miners have struggled to find new jobs. Collieries were returned to private ownership in 1994, and most coal now produced in Britain is sold to the electricity-generating industry. By 2003 no more than 11 000 people were employed in mining, and this number has grown smaller since then.

Political correctness

Political correctness or being 'politically correct', often called simply PC, is concerned with avoiding certain attitudes, actions and, above all, forms of expression which suggest prejudice and are likely to cause offence. This may be against men or women, against older people, or against people with a particular skin colour, racial background or physical disability.

The idea of political correctness developed in the 1980s and 1990s and was based on the belief that the language we use influences the way we think. Later the phrase was often used in a negative way to refer to politically correct expressions that people thought were clumsy or an unnecessary change. Some people doubt whether changing words will remove prejudice in people's minds or in the social system.

In the 1960s and 1970s public debate caused many people to accept the principle that discrimination is wrong. Changes of many kinds happened in schools and offices. History has been traditionally taught from the point of view of white people, but now more children learn about the history and culture of other groups in the community. In offices sexual and racial harassment are not allowed. The PC movement has also been against stereotyping (=odamlar haqida bir hil fikrlash), especially of women and black people, and making jokes against minority groups. A major concern of political correctness has been to avoid racist or sexist languagethat will offend particular groups. However some language changes are much older than the PC movement. Ms has been used for a long time as a title for women who do not wish to identify themselves as being either married (Mrs) or single (Miss). Other PC ► Phrases and Idioms, notably chair or chairperson instead of chairman, are also common. Changes in the US include saying African American instead of Black, Native American instead of Indian and using the term people of colour to refer to people who are not white.

baker's percentage.meta: bu retseptdagi har bir tarkibiy qismining miqdorini unning miqdoriga nisbatan foiz sifatida ifodalash usuli. Pishirishda ishlatiladigan ingredientlarning nisbati shunday belgilanishi kerakki, barcha tarkibiy qismlar un miqdoriga qarab hisoblanadi.

ex: I bought freshly baked bread and pastries from the baker's shop.
The baker's shop is the best place to buy fresh bread in the morning.
baker's shop.meta: bu pishirilgan mahsulotlar, masalan, non, pishiriqlar, kekslar, bulochka va boshqa shu kabilarni tayyorlab sotadigan do‘kon. Bu joyda ko‘pincha pishirish jarayoni o‘tkaziladi va yangi tayyorlangan mahsulotlar iste’molchilarga sotiladi.

ex: It's very easy to make fresh bread at home with baker's yeast.
Adding baker's yeast to pastries makes them soft and airy.
baker's yeast.meta: bu pishirishda, ayniqsa non va boshqa pishiriqlarni tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan xamirturush turi. Bu xamirturush turi asosan nonni ko‘tarish va xamirdagi gazni ishlab chiqarish uchun ishlatiladi, natijada non yengil va yumshoq bo‘ladi.

ex: I used baking beans to keep the pastry dough in shape during blind baking.
Using baking beans to weigh down the pastry helps maintain its shape during baking.
baking beans.meta: bu pishiriq xamirini yopishib qolmasdan yoki shaklini yo‘qotmasdan pishirish uchun ishlatiladigan quritilgan loviya, metall yoki keramika beadlar yoki boshqa kichik buyumlar.

ex: Before baking the bread, I spread baking paper to prevent the dough from sticking.
Baking paper ensures that the bottom of the pastries doesn’t stick.
baking paper.meta: bu pishirish yoki ovqat tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan qog‘oz bo‘lib, odatda u qattiq va yopishmaydigan yuzaga ega bo‘lishi uchun maxsus ishlov berilgan yoki qoplangan bo‘ladi.

ex: By placing the baking stone inside the oven, you can bake the pizza dough perfectly.
The baking stone helps bake the bottom of the dough evenly.
baking stone.meta: bu pishirish jarayonida ishlatiladigan yupqa tosh yoki qattiq keramika bo‘lak bo‘lib, odatda pechga yoki ochiq olovga joylashtiriladi va pishirish yuzasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: They took the bikkies in the last game, now they are the champions.
He left all his competitors behind and took the bikkies.
to take the bikkies.meta: bu Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya aksentida ishlatiladigan ifodadir, bu "o‘yin yoki musobaqada g‘alaba qozonish" degan ma'noni anglatadi. Bu ifoda odatda yutish yoki eng yaxshi natijaga erishish holatlarini tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: I noticed biscuit beetles in my biscuits.
By storing food properly, you can prevent the appearance of biscuit beetles.
biscuit beetle.meta: bu turli kichik qurtlar bo‘lib, asosan quritilgan oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarida, masalan, un, biskvit, o'tlar, urug'lar va boshqa oziq-ovqat materiallarida zararkunandalar sifatida uchraydi. Ular oziq-ovqatni yemish qilish va zarar yetkazish bilan tanilgan.

ex: Before rolling out the biscuit dough, the biscuit board needs to be prepared.
I need to roll the dough on the biscuit board and cut it into shapes.
biscuit board.meta: bu biskvit xamirini yoyish, shaklini kesish va boshqa pishirish tayyorgarliklarini qilish uchun ishlatiladigan taxta. Biskvit taxtasi asosan yog‘lanmagan yoki oson tozalana oladigan materialdan tayyorlanadi.

ex: In this old recipe, the biscuit cake is made from baked unleavened bread.
A biscuit cake can be made using a base of crushed biscuits.
biscuit cake.meta: bu ikki xil ma'noga ega bo‘lishi mumkin: Qovurilgan, xamirsiz, pishirilgan non bo‘lagi (bu ma'no endi ishlatilmaydi yoki eskirgan); Ezilgan biskvitlardan tayyorlangan asosga ega bo‘lgan tort, ayniqsa, ezilgan biskvitlardan tayyorlangan asosli tort.

ex: Don’t forget to add flour and baking powder when preparing the biscuit dough.
I will roll out the biscuit dough, cut it into various shapes, and place it in the oven to bake.
biscuit dough.meta: bu biskvit tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladigan xamir. Biskvit xamiri turli usullarda tayyorlanadi va odatda un, sut, yog‘, shakar, pishirish kukuni yoki boshqa ingredientlardan iborat bo‘ladi. Bu xamir biskvit shaklida pishiriladi.

ex: I used the biscuit joiner to cut the necessary slots in the wood pieces for joining them together.
The biscuit joiner is very useful for cutting crescent-shaped slots, as it creates precise and strong connections.
biscuit joiner.meta: bu kichik doira shaklidagi pichoqni o'z ichiga olgan quvvatli asbob bo'lib, u komponentlarning qirralariga yarim oylab shakllangan yoriqlarni kesish uchun mo'ljallangan.

ex: We joined the wood pieces using a biscuit joint, which created a strong connection between them.
I cut the slots into the edges of the wood and inserted the biscuits to create a biscuit joint.
biscuit joint.meta: bu ikki komponentni birlashtirish uchun ikkala qirrasiga kesilgan yoriqlarga "biskvit" (yarim oylik shakldagi ulanish qismlari) joylashtirilgan holda yopishtirish yoki joylashtirish orqali yaratilgan birikma.

ex: I used the biscuit jointer to cut precise slots into the edges of the wood pieces.
Using the biscuit jointer to cut the slots creates strong and precise connections for joining wood pieces.
biscuit jointer.meta: bu kichik doira shaklidagi pichoqni o'z ichiga olgan quvvatli asbob bo'lib, u komponentlarning qirralariga yarim oylik shakldagi yoriqlarni kesish uchun mo'ljallangan.

ex: The head of her bisque doll is made from bisque porcelain, while the body is covered with soft fabric.
Bisque dolls are sold at high prices in antique shops because they are very rare and well-preserved.
bisque doll.meta: bu to'liq yoki qisman biskvit porselindan (maxsus, yuqori sifatli keramika) tayyorlangan qo'g'irchoq; ayniqsa, biskvit yuz va boshli, tanasi esa matodan tayyorlangan qo'g'irchoq.

ex: The potter completed the bisque firing process, hardening the item in preparation for glazing.
Bisque firing is necessary to harden the pottery items for the first time before they are glazed.
bisque firing.meta: bu g'isht yoki keramika buyumlarini birinchi marta kuydirish jarayoni bo'lib, bu keramika materialini mustahkamlash uchun amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Her bisque-headed doll is highly valued because its head is made from bisque porcelain.
Bisque-headed dolls are often very aesthetically pleasing and are frequently added to collectors' collections.
bisque-headed.meta: bu qo'g'irchoqning boshining biskvit porselindan (maxsus keramika materialidan) yasalganligini anglatadi. Bunday qo'g'irchoqlar "biskvit qo'g'irchoq" deb ataladi.

ex: The potter prepared the bisqueware and planned to glaze them afterward.
Bisqueware is often used as pottery that is prepared for further processing.
bisqueware.meta: bu faqat bitta kuydirish jarayonidan o‘tgan keramika buyumlari, ayniqsa, ular keyinchalik glazuraga berilishi va ikkinchi marta kuydirilishi uchun tayyorlangan buyumlar. Bu turdagi buyumlar odatda mustahkam va qattiq bo‘ladi.

ex: The Bohemian Brethren had a strong religious influence in Bohemia and Moravia, based on the Hussite religious movement.
The Bohemian Brethren were a significant religious group of their time, striving to carry out their reforms.
bohemian brethren.meta: bu 15-asrda tashkil topgan, asosan Bohemya va Moraviya hududlarida yashagan, Xusitlar diniy oqimiga asoslangan bir diniy sekta.

ex: Box hockey is a two-player game where each player tries to push the disc towards their opponent's side in the box.
They went outside to play box hockey, trying to push the disc through the open top of the box.
box hockey.meta: bu ikki o'yinchi o'ynaydigan o'yin bo'lib, odatda ochiq havoda o'ynaladi. O'yinchilar tayoq yordamida disk yoki pukni ochiq yuqori qismga ega bo'lgan qutidan o'tkazishga harakat qilishadi.

ex: The phrase "bread and roses" expresses that people's needs should not only be physical but also spiritual and emotional.
The principle of "bread and roses" symbolizes the striving for economic and cultural equality.
bread and roses.meta: bu inson huquqlari sifatida oziq-ovqat va go'zallikni ifodalovchi ibora. Bu ibora shuni anglatadiki, har bir kishi nafaqat asosiy oziq-ovqatga, balki hayotda go'zallik va ruhiy baxtga ham ega bo'lishi kerak.

ex: This phrase means that people cannot live by just food or physical things; spiritual needs are equally important.
People cannot live by bread alone; love, spirituality, and creative happiness are essential for them.
man cannot live by bread alone.meta: bu ibora insonlarning faqat jismoniy ehtiyojlari bilan yashay olmasligini, ular uchun ma'naviy yoki ruhiy ehtiyojlarning ham muhimligini bildiradi

ex: He was always ready to help others because he believed in casting his bread upon the waters, doing good without expecting anything in return.
To cast one's bread upon the waters means to do good without any personal gain or expectation of reward.
to cast one's bread upon the waters.meta: bu ibora insonning hech qanday foyda yoki mukofot olish niyatisiz yaxshi yoki yordam beruvchi ishlarni amalga oshirishini bildiradi.

ex: She mixed flour, water, and yeast to prepare the bread dough.
He kneaded the dough by hand, left it for a few hours, and waited for the bread dough to rise.
bread dough.meta: non pishirish uchun tayyorlangan xamir. Bu xamir un, suv, tuz va xamirturushdan tayyorlanadi va pishirish jarayonida nonga aylantiriladi.

ex: Choosing bread flour is important because it ensures the right texture and softness of the bread.
Since bread flour has a high gluten content, it helps the bread rise well when baked.
bread flour.meta: non tayyorlash uchun maxsus tayyorlangan un, odatda qattiq bug‘doydan olinadi va u yuqori miqdorda glutenni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: The bread machine mixes the dough, kneads it, and finally bakes the prepared bread.
Now, using a bread machine is easy because it automatically handles all the processes.
bread machine.meta: non tayyorlash uchun mo‘ljallangan qurilma, odatda uyda foydalanish uchun elektr qurilmasi bo‘lib, u xamirni aralashtiradi, yoğiradi va pishiradi.

ex: The bread man arrived at the market in the morning to sell the fresh bread.
He brings fresh bread every morning, delivered by the bread man from the bakery.
bread man.meta: non tayyorlaydigan, sotadigan yoki keyinchalik non yetkazib beradigan kishi; ya'ni pechene yoki non pishiruvchi shaxs.

ex: White mould appeared on the bread, it could be bread mould.
If you store bread in a humid place, bread mould can appear quickly.
bread mould.meta: odatda non ustida o‘sadigan turli xil mog‘orlar, ayniqsa Rhizopus va Penicillium jinslariga mansub bo‘lgan mog‘orlar.

ex: Baking bread in an old bread oven gives it a very good taste.
The bread baked in the newly built oven turned out soft and fluffy.
bread oven.meta: non yoki boshqa xamir mahsulotlarini pishirish uchun mo‘ljallangan pech, odatda, olovga chidamli materiallardan, masalan, g‘isht, tosh, loy va boshqalardan yasalgan pishirish xonasi mavjud.

ex: During the Eucharist ceremony at the church, the consecrated bread was placed on the bread plate.
The freshly baked bread was placed on the newly decorated bread plate.
bread plate.meta: non uchun plastinka; ayniqsa, Euxaristiya marosimida, xuddi o‘sha paytda tasdiqlangan non yoki vafers joylashtiriladigan, odatda kumush yoki oltindan yasalgan plastinka yoki yassilangan idish.

ex: Bread rings are made by shaping the dough into a ring and baking it in the oven.
My favorite type of bread is this bread ring, especially bagels!
bread ring.meta: halqa shaklida tayyorlangan turli xil nonlar, masalan, bagel, simit va boshqalar.

ex: The bread salad consists of toasted bread, tomatoes, cucumbers, and olive oil.
Various types of bread salads can be made, such as Panzanella or Fattoush.
bread salad.meta: asosan nonning bo‘laklari (odatda eski yoki qovurilgan non) asosiy tarkibiy qismini tashkil etadigan turli xil salatlar.

ex: The bread shop sells freshly baked bread every morning.
They sell the tastiest pumpkin bread in the bread shop.
bread shop.meta: non va boshqa pishiriqlar tayyorlanadigan yoki sotiladigan do‘kon; pechka yoki baxsh (bakery).

ex: Bread soup typically includes fried bread pieces, vegetables, garlic, and spices.
One of the most famous types of bread soup in Spain is called Sopa de Ajo, which contains bread, garlic, and olive oil.
bread soup.meta: non asosiy tarkibiy qism sifatida ishlatiladigan turli xil sho‘rvalar.

ex: The bread trap (mouth) is where people begin the process of digesting food.
Each meal passes through the mouth and enters the bread trap.
bread trap.meta: og‘iz; bu atama ba'zan shaxsning og‘iz bo‘shlig‘i yoki oziq-ovqat olish jarayonida ishlatiladi. "Trap" so‘zining ma'nosi bilan birga, og‘iz yoki uning ishlash mexanizmi tushuniladi.

ex: Bread wheat is used as the main raw material in flour production.
Bread wheat is distinguished by its high gluten content, which ensures the quality of the bread during baking.
bread wheat.meta: asosan non pishirish uchun un ishlab chiqarishda ishlatiladigan bug‘doy turi; ayniqsa, umumiy bug‘doy (Triticum aestivum).

ex: This bread-and-butter pickle makes the sandwiches taste even better when added.
The bread-and-butter pickle has a sweet and slightly tangy taste, often eaten with sandwiches.
bread-and-butter pickle.meta: mayda bo‘laklarga kesilgan bodringdan tayyorlangan, tuzlangan sho‘rva ichida pishirilgan shirin marinad, odatda sendvichlarda iste'mol qilinadi.

ex: Before serving the meal, they placed the bread and butter plate on the table.
The bread and butter plate is typically used for placing accompaniments like bread and butter alongside the main dish.
bread and butter plate.meta: non va sariyog‘ yoki boshqa taomlar bilan birga iste'mol qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan kichik plastinka. Odatda, bu plastinka asosan non va sariyog‘ yoki taomga qo‘shimcha sifatida xizmat qiladi.

ex: He always keeps a bug-out bag packed for emergencies.
A bug-out bag should contain essential items, such as water, food, medicines, and more.
bug-out bag.meta: favqulodda vaziyatda yoki shoshilinch evakuatsiya qilish zarurati tug‘ilganda ishlatish uchun oldindan kerakli narsalar bilan to‘ldirilgan sumka.

ex: Urban planning must focus on ecological sustainability and creating a comfortable environment for people.
In the built environment, all necessary facilities should be available for people to live and work healthily and efficiently.
built environment.meta: odamlar hayoti, ishlashlari va salomatliklarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash uchun yaratilgan va saqlanib turadigan inson tomonidan yaratilgan tuzilmalar, xususiyatlar va inshootlar.

ex: He has a large bush lot in his new farm, where he plans to plant forests and create grazing grounds for animals.
Bush lots are hard to clear, but they provide a good opportunity to cut down the forest and convert the land for farming.
bush lot.meta: asosan fermerlikda ishlatiladigan, daraxtlar bilan qoplangan yoki hali tozalab chiqilmagan yer maydoni. Bu yerlar odatda o'rmon bilan qoplangan yoki dehqonchilikka tayyorlanmagan bo'lishi mumkin.

ex: The young people went to a remote forest area to hold their bush party.
When organizing a bush party, safety must be considered as the forest is unfamiliar and potentially dangerous.
bush party.meta: o'rmonli yoki uzoqdagi joylarda tashkil etilgan ochiq havodagi partiya, odatda yoshlar tomonidan o'tkaziladi va ko'pincha og'ir alkogol ichimliklarini ichish bilan bog'liq bo'ladi.

ex: His life is incredibly lucky. It's hard to see anything go wrong for him, his bread always falls butter side up.
Everyone wants to work with him because he always makes the right decisions, and all the projects are successful. His bread always falls butter side up.
a person’s bread always falls butter sid.meta: bu ifoda, odatda, biror kishining har doim omadli bo'lishini, ya'ni doimo yaxshi natijalar va ijobiy holatlarga duch kelishini anglatadi.

ex: He’s such a lucky person; his bread always falls buttered side up. That’s why he always succeeds in what he does.
a person’s bread always falls buttered s.meta: Biror kishining noni doimo sariyog‘ tomoni yuqoriga tushadi" degan ibora, bu odamning har doim yaxshi omadga ega bo‘lishini, ya'ni uning ishlarining doim muvaffaqiyatli va ijobiy bo‘lishini ifodalaydi.

ex: In his life, things always go wrong; his bread always falls buttered side down every time.
bread always falls buttered side down.meta: Non doimo sariyog‘ tomoni pastga tushadi (sariyog‘langan sifatida)" degan ibora, agar biror narsa noto‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lsa, u albatta noto‘g‘ri bo‘lishini bildiradi

ex: The checkstop was installed in the machine to prevent any malfunction.
In Canada, there is a checkstop at every border point to inspect freight trucks.
checkstop.meta: mexanik tizimda yoki mashinada harakatni cheklash yoki to‘xtatish uchun mo‘ljallangan mexanizm, qurilma. Bu qurilma tizimning xavfsizligini ta'minlash yoki noto‘g‘ri ishlashning oldini olish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: I tried the cherry Bakewell at the café today, and it was delicious!
A cherry Bakewell is usually served with tea in the afternoon.
cherry bakewell.meta: Bu Bakewell tartning gilos yoki gilos marmeladi bilan to‘ldirilgan varianti bo‘lib, odatda ustiga shakarli qoplama (icing) yoki badam bo‘lagi qo‘yiladi.

ex: The circular firing squad within the company prevented any progress, with everyone blaming each other.
circular firing squad.meta: doira shaklidagi otish" degan ibora, o‘zaro o‘tkir tanqidlar va muammolarni hal qilishda yordam berish o‘rniga, guruh a'zolarining bir-biriga qarshi kurashib, o‘zlarini yo‘q qiladigan holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: New civic amenities, such as a sports hall and a library, have been opened in the city.
Civic amenities are designed to improve the quality of life for the citizens.
civic amenity.meta: fuqarolik qulayliklari" deganda, shahardagi yoki qishloqdagi fuqarolar uchun taqdim etilgan xizmatlar, inshootlar yoki imkoniyatlar tushuniladi.

ex: You can take your old furniture to the civic amenity centre.
Civic amenity centres help communities manage waste responsibly.
civic amenity centre.meta: mahalliy boshqaruv organi tasarrufidagi yoki u tomonidan nazorat qilinadigan ob’ekt bo‘lib, aholiga maishiy chiqindilarni tashlab yuborish yoki qayta ishlash uchun topshirish imkonini beradi.

ex: The town opened a new civic amenity site for household waste.
Residents are encouraged to recycle their items at the civic amenity site.
civic amenity site.meta: bu mahalliy boshqaruv organiga tegishli yoki ular tomonidan boshqariladigan ob’ekt bo‘lib, aholiga o‘z maishiy chiqindilarini tashlab yuborish yoki qayta ishlash uchun olib borish imkonini beradi.

ex: The codmen of Newfoundland braved harsh winters to catch fish.
That old codman spent his whole life on the sea.
codman.meta: “Cod” so‘zi ingliz tilida treska (baliq turi) degan ma’noni bildiradi. “Codman” esa bu soha bilan shug‘ullanuvchi kishiga yoki u ishlatadigan kemaga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The fishermen lowered the cod nets into the cold Atlantic waters.
Cod nets are designed to catch fish by the gills.
cod net.meta: “Gill net” – baliqning suzgichlari (gill) orqali ilinishiga asoslangan to‘r turidir. Cod net esa aynan treska uchun moslashtirilgan versiyasidir.

ex: Cod roe is considered a delicacy in many countries.
She bought a tin of cod roe to make a fish spread.
