cod roe.meta: urg‘ochi treska baliqining tuxum (ikrasi) massasi bo‘lib, ayniqsa pishgan (yetilgan) holatida ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadi. U ko‘pincha konservalangan, qovurilgan yoki qaynatilgan shaklda tayyorlanadi.

ex: The fishermen set the cod trap near the bay before dawn.
The cod trap stretched from the deep water all the way to the shore.
cod trap.meta: treska baliqlarini tutish uchun ishlatiladigan, qutiga o‘xshash uzun shakldagi to‘r bo‘lib, u qirg‘oqqa qadar cho‘ziladi.

ex: The fish had a cod-like body and a similar head shape.
Some cod-like species live in deeper waters.
cod-like.meta: “-like” qo‘shimchasi ingliz tilida “...ga o‘xshash” degan ma’noni beradi. “Cod-like” esa "treskaga o‘xshash" degan sifat hosil qiladi.

ex: The witnesses followed a code of silence and refused to testify.
In organized crime, breaking the code of silence can be deadly.
code of silence.meta: biror shaxs yoki guruh ichida yashirin faoliyat, odatda jinoyat yoki noqonuniy ishlar haqida ochiqchasiga gapirmaslikka asoslangan og‘zaki yoki yozilmagan qoidalar to‘plami.

ex: The politician spoke in code to avoid controversy.
They communicated in code so that outsiders wouldn't understand.
in code.meta: bilvosita, shifrlangan yoki atayin yumshatilgan, noaniq iboralar orqali gapirish yoki yozish uslubi.

ex: The building is not up to code and needs major repairs.
All electrical wiring must be brought up to code.
up to code.meta: biror bino, uskunalar yoki tizimning amalda mavjud bo‘lgan qonuniy me’yorlar, qoidalar yoki standartlarga muvofiq bo‘lishi.

ex: The team is working on cleaning up the old codebase.
All modules share the same codebase for easier maintenance.
codebase.meta: muayyan dastur yoki dasturlar to‘plamini yaratish uchun ishlatiladigan asosiy manba kodlar to‘plami.

ex: Each function must be enclosed in a code block.
This error occurs when the code block is not properly closed.
code block.meta: Zamonaviy dasturlashda (b) ma’nosi ko‘proq ishlatiladi. Kod bloklari funksiyalar, shart operatorlari (if/else), sikllar (for/while) kabi strukturaviy birliklarni tashkil qiladi.

ex: Her code-choice depended on whether she was speaking to elders or friends.
Code-choice is influenced by context, audience, and setting.
code-choice.meta: biror nutq yoki muloqot davomida ikki yoki undan ortiq tillar, dialektlar yoki uslublardan qaysi birini tanlab ishlatish harakati yoki amali.

ex: The famous code cracker helped break enemy communications during the war.
Modern code crackers use AI to decrypt complex encryption systems.
code cracker.meta: shifrlangan kod, maxfiy yozuv yoki murakkab belgilar tizimini yechadigan shaxs, shuningdek, kodni tahlil qilib uni ochadigan dastur, kompyuter yoki qurilma.

ex: Code cracking played a critical role in ending the war.
The team specialized in code cracking and digital forensics.
code cracking.meta: shifrlangan ma’lumot, maxfiy kod yoki shifrni aniqlash, tushunish yoki buzish jarayoni. Bu jarayon qo‘lda yoki dasturiy vositalar yordamida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The code generator converts high-level language into machine code.
Optimizing the code generator can significantly improve program performance.
code generator.meta: kompilyatorning bir qismi bo‘lib, manba kodni (source code) obyekt kodi (object code) ga aylantiradi. Ya’ni, dasturchi yozgan yuqori darajadagi dasturiy kodni mashina tushunadigan shaklga o‘zgartiradi.

ex: Code generation is a key step in the compilation process.
Errors during code generation can result in faulty executables.
code generation.meta: bu kompilyator tomonidan manba kodni (source code) obyekt kodiga (object code) aylantirish jarayoni.

ex: Modern security systems are designed to resist code grabber attacks.
The thieves used a code grabber to clone the remote signal and steal the car.
code grabber.meta: masofadan boshqariladigan qurilmalarning (masalan, avtomobil signalizatsiyasi, garaj eshiklari va h.k.) simsiz kodlarini tutib qolish va nusxalash uchun ishlatiladigan elektron qurilma.

ex: In her speech, there was a lot of English-Uzbek code-mixing.
Code-mixing is common among bilingual speakers in casual conversation.
code-mixing.meta: bir nutq yoki muloqot ichida bir nechta tillar, dialektlar yoki nutq uslublarini aralashtirib ishlatish jarayoni.

ex: The team was full of talented engineers, not just code monkeys.
He got tired of being a code monkey and started his own software company.
code monkey.meta: bu atama kompyuter dasturchisi ma’nosida ishlatiladi, ayniqsa past baholovchi, kinoyaviy ohangda.

ex: The hospital went into code red after a massive fire nearby.
code red.meta: bu favqulodda vaziyat yoki yaqin xavf haqida darhol ogohlantirish bo‘lib, tezkor harakat talab etiladigan holatni bildiradi. Bu atama ko‘pincha harbiy, tibbiy, xavfsizlik yoki yong‘in xizmatlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: A code script may refer to any sequence of symbols representing encoded data.
Schrödinger described DNA as a kind of code script carrying genetic information.
code script.meta: bu ma’lumotlarning kodlangan shakldagi ifodasi. Maxsus kontekstlarda quyidagicha ma’nolarga ega bo‘ladi:

ex: Code talkers used native languages to send encrypted messages during WWII.
The Navajo code talkers played a crucial role in secure military communications.
code talker.meta: bu atama Ikkinchi jahon urushi (1939–1945) davrida AQSh harbiy kuchlarida xizmat qilgan Shimoliy Amerika hindularidan bo‘lgan askarlarni bildiradi.

ex: In intelligence circles, they used code words to refer to sensitive subjects.
“Sunrise” was the code word for the start of the operation.
code word.meta: bu oldindan belgilangan shifrlash tizimiga asoslangan holda boshqa so‘z, ibora yoki ma’noni ifodalovchi maxsus so‘zdir.

ex: She is a renowned codicologist specializing in medieval Arabic texts.
The codicologist examined the manuscript's binding and ink to determine its origin.
codicologist.meta: Kodikologiya – filologiya va tarix fanlariga yaqin turuvchi soha bo‘lib, asosan yozma manbalarni jismoniy obyekt sifatida o‘rganadi (matn emas, balki qo‘lyozma sifatida).

ex: The project failed because there were too many cooks in the kitchen.
We need a clear leader—right now it’s like too many cooks in the kitchen.
too many cooks in the kitchen.meta: Bu amerikaliklar orasida mashhur ibora bo‘lib, bitta vaziyatga yoki loyihaga juda ko‘p odam aralashsa, natijasi yaxshi bo‘lmaydi degan ma’noni bildiradi.

ex: Auditors suspected that someone had cooked the books for years.
The CEO was arrested for cooking the books to hide company losses.
to cook the books.meta: bu firibgarlik yo‘li bilan moliyaviy hisob-kitoblarni o‘zgartirish, ya’ni daromad yoki xarajatlar haqida yolg‘on yoki noto‘g‘ri ma’lumot berish, buxgalteriya hujjatlarini soxta ko‘rsatish degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: The new singer cooked up a storm with her debut performance.
She cooked up a storm with her powerful speech at the rally.
to cook up a storm.meta: aslida Shimoliy Amerikada kelib chiqqan ibora bo‘lib, katta shovqin, hayajon yoki jamoat e’tiborini jalb qiluvchi voqea/tashabbusni boshlash yoki amalga oshirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The scouts gathered around the cook fire to prepare dinner.
We built a cook fire and grilled fish by the river.
cook fire.meta: bu odatda lagerda (tashqarida) taom tayyorlash uchun yoqiladigan ochiq olov. Bu o‘t ochiq joyda, ko‘pincha lagerda, tabiat qo‘ynida yoki sayohat vaqtida taom pishirish uchun yoqiladi.

ex: Researchers are testing the cookability of plant-based meat alternatives.
The cookability of this type of potato makes it ideal for baking and frying.
cookability.meta: bu biror mahsulot yoki oziq-ovqatning pishirishga yaroqli yoki qulay ekanligini ifodalovchi tushuncha.

ex: I usually don’t have time for a cooked breakfast during the week.
We had a full cooked breakfast at the hotel — eggs, bacon, sausages, and beans.
cooked breakfast.meta: bu issiq holda taqdim etiladigan, oldindan pishirilgan nonushta taomlarining yig‘indisi.

ex: The cooker hood has a built-in light and a powerful fan.
We installed a new cooker hood to reduce cooking smells in the kitchen.
cooker hood.meta: bu gaz plitasi yoki elektr pishirgich ustiga o‘rnatiladigan metall qopqoq (qurilma) bo‘lib, u pishirish jarayonida chiqqan bug‘, tutun va hidlarni so‘rib olib chiqarib yuboradi.

ex: Cookie butter ice cream is my favorite dessert.
I spread some cookie butter on my toast for breakfast.
cookie butter.meta: bu maydalanib ezilgan pechenye (odatda "speculoos" turidagi), sariyog‘ yoki quyultirilgan sut va shakar bilan aralashtirib tayyorlangan pastasimon massadir.

ex: Cookie dough ice cream is very popular in the summer.
She made a big batch of cookie dough to bake with the kids.
cookie dough.meta: bu pechenye tayyorlash uchun aralashtirilgan xom xamir bo‘lib, tarkibida odatda un, sariyog‘, tuxum, shakar, vanilin va boshqa qo‘shimchalar bo‘ladi.

ex: His cookie-duster moustache was the first thing people noticed.
Grandpa still wears that big cookie-duster like it’s 1950.
cookie-duster.meta: bu yuqori lab ustini qoplab turadigan, to‘la va qalin mo‘ylovni bildiruvchi kinoyali va hazilomuz atama.

ex: Smoke rose from the cooking house at dawn as breakfast was being prepared.
The sailors gathered near the cooking house for their evening meal.
cooking house.meta: bu ovqat tayyorlanadigan yoki pishiriladigan bino yoki inshoot.

ex: Only a true man of craft could forge such a blade.
He was a man of craft, known for his fine woodworking.
man of craft.meta: Maxsus bir kasb, hunar yoki san’atda yuqori ko‘nikmaga ega bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: The craft store had everything from fabric to paintbrushes.
She bought beads and thread from the craft store to make a bracelet.
craft store.meta: bu qo‘l mehnati bilan bog‘liq hunar va hobbi faoliyatlari uchun materiallar va asbob-uskunalar sotiladigan do‘kon.She bought beads and thread from the craft store to make a bracelet.

ex: In craft unionism, each trade has its own organization and leadership.
Craft unionism allowed carpenters to negotiate better wages independently of factory workers.
craft unionism.meta: bu faqat ma’lum bir kasb yoki hunar egalarini (masalan, duradgorlar, payvandchilar, zargarlik ustalari) kasaba uyushmasiga birlashtirish shakli.

ex: The artist converted his garage into a craft workshop.
She runs a craft workshop where children learn to make paper art.
craft workshop.meta: Hunar ustaxonasi – bu hunar egasi (masalan, kulol, duradgor, zargar) ishlaydigan xona yoki bino

ex: During crunch time, the whole team worked late nights to meet the deadline.
It's crunch time — the exam is tomorrow and I still have three chapters to study.
crunch time.meta: bu muayyan vazifa, loyiha yoki jarayonning eng muhim bosqichi bo‘lib, unda tezda qaror qabul qilish yoki ishni yakunlash zarur bo‘ladi.

ex: The model was trained using deep learning techniques on millions of images.
Deep learning has revolutionized fields like computer vision and natural language processing.
deep learning.meta: bu **sun’iy intellekt (AI) sohasiga oid mashinaviy o‘rganish (machine learning)**ning bir turi bo‘lib, sun’iy neyron tarmoqlarga asoslanadi.

ex: Scholars of deep history often use DNA evidence and ancient tools to reconstruct early human life.
Deep history helps us understand human evolution long before civilization and writing emerged.
deep history.meta: bu insoniyatning yozma manbalar paydo bo‘lishidan avvalgi davrini anglatadi. Bu davrni o‘rganishda arxeologiya, tilshunoslik, genetika va antropologiya kabi fanlar metodlari qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Many families were displaced during the Dirty Thirties due to drought and poverty.
The Dirty Thirties were marked by economic collapse and devastating dust storms in North America.
dirty thirties.meta: bu atama asosan Shimoliy Amerikada, xususan Kanadada, 1930-yillardagi Buyuk Depressiya (Great Depression) va unga hamrohlik qilgan kuchli qurg‘oqchilik, chang bo‘ronlari va iqtisodiy tanglik davrini anglatadi.

ex: Fluid dynamics explains how water flows through pipes or rivers.
Engineers use fluid dynamics to design more efficient airplane wings.
fluid dynamics.meta: bu matematika va fizikaning bir bo‘limi bo‘lib, suyuqliklar (masalan, suv) va gazlarning (masalan, havo) harakati, oqimi va ularning harakatlanish qonuniyatlarini o‘rganadi.

ex: Some dental procedures are done under gas and air for mild sedation.
During labour, the midwife offered gas and air to help with the contractions.
gas and air.meta: bu azot oksidi (N₂O, kuldiruvchi gaz) bilan havo yoki kislorodning aralashmasidan iborat bo‘lib, odatda nafas olish yo‘li bilan og‘riqni kamaytirish uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: A gastric balloon is a non-surgical option for obesity treatment.
The doctor recommended a gastric balloon to help with weight loss.
gastric balloon.meta: bu me'daga joylashtiriladigan maxsus shishiriladigan ballon bo‘lib, u tajriba yoki davolash maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The wedding was supposed to be simple, but it ended up being a gong show.
That meeting turned into a total gong show—no one knew what they were doing.
gong show.meta: bu tartibsizlik, betartiblik yoki noxushlik bilan ajralib turadigan vaziyat yoki voqeani bildiradi.

ex: Stop whining and grow a pair — deal with the situation.
It’s time you grew a pair and told your boss how you really feel.
to grow a pair.meta: so‘zlashuv tilida ishlatiladigan, ba’zan qo‘pol yoki kinoyali ibora bo‘lib, bu inson qiyin vaziyatda qat’iyatli, jasur, yoki dadil harakat qilishi kerakligini bildiradi.

ex: She picked a bunch of gypsy flowers from the meadow.
In old herbals, the gypsy flower was prized for its healing properties.
gypsy flower.meta: Bu atama hozirda kam ishlatiladi va ko'proq tarixiy manbalarda uchraydi. "Gypsy rose" (lo'li atirguli) bilan qiyos qilinadi.

ex: They traveled across the countryside in a traditional gypsy caravan.
The gypsy caravan was beautifully painted with flowers and patterns.
gypsy caravan.meta: an’anaviy ravishda rom (lo‘li) xalqlari tomonidan yashash joyi sifatida ishlatilgan, otlar tortadigan, usti yopiq, odatda yog‘ochdan yasalgan va bezakli bo‘yalgan arava.

ex: She wore a colorful dress for the gypsy dance.
The performance included a passionate gypsy dance that captivated the audience.
gypsy dance.meta: odatda ispan lo‘lilari (rom xalqlari) tomonidan ijro etiladigan an’anaviy raqs va musiqa uslubi.

ex: The band played lively gypsy jazz at the festival.
Django Reinhardt is famous for pioneering the gypsy jazz style.
gypsy jazz.meta: akustik gitarada ijro etiladigan va tezkor, o‘ziga xos "swing" ritmiga ega bo‘lgan jazz musiqasi uslubi.

ex: She feared the gypsy’s curse and avoided angering the fortune teller.
The story spoke of a gypsy’s curse that would bring bad luck to anyone who ignored it.
gypsy’s curse.meta: an’anaviy stereotipga ko‘ra, rom (lo‘li) xalqiga oid bo‘lgan ruhiy yoki sehrli kuchlarga ega deb hisoblangan odam tomonidan aytiladigan la’nat yoki yomon tilak

ex: The gypsy skirt is known for its flowing fabric and vibrant patterns.
She wore a colorful gypsy skirt that swirled as she danced.
gypsy skirt.meta: to‘liq, keng va erkin oqimga ega uzun yubka bo‘lib, odatda to‘qimachilikda naqshli yoki murakkab bezakli matodan tikiladi.

ex: Watch out for the dog’s gypsy’s kiss when walking near the yard.
He gave the fence a gypsy’s kiss to mark his territory.
gypsy’s kiss.meta: (hazil yoki norasmiy so‘zlashuvda) siydik chiqarish harakati. Bu ibora ko‘pincha kulgili yoki kinoyali ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The band played some energetic gypsy swing that got everyone dancing.
Gypsy swing is known for its fast rhythms and virtuosic guitar playing.
gypsy swing.meta: akustik gitara asosida ijro etiladigan, o‘ziga xos tez va ritmik “sving” ohangiga ega, ko‘pincha improvizatsion melodiya chiziqlari bilan birga bo‘lgan jazz musiqasi uslubi.

ex: Gypsy tart is known for its rich, sweet filling made from evaporated milk and muscovado sugar.
She baked a delicious gypsy tart for the tea party.
gypsy tart.meta: asosan Kent hududida tayyorlanadigan, evaporatsiya qilingan sut va muskovado shakaridan tayyorlangan to‘ldirishga ega shirin tort.

ex: Many Romani families lived in traditional gypsy wagons while traveling.
The gypsy wagon was beautifully painted and served as a mobile home.
gypsy wagon.meta: asosan yog‘ochdan yasalgan, bezak bilan chiroyli bezatilgan, an’anaviy ravishda ot tortadigan qoplangan arava turi bo‘lib, Rom (lo‘li) xalqining yashash joyi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Products made from HDPE are durable and resistant to many chemicals.
HDPE is commonly used in making plastic bottles and piping due to its strength and resistance.
hdpe.meta: polimer zanjirlari kam shoxlangan bo‘lgan polietilenning bir turi. Bu material qattiqroq va kimyoviy hamda mexanik ta’sirlarga yuqori chidamlilikka ega.

ex: We had fun trying to find our way through the hall of mirrors at the amusement park.
The palace had a magnificent hall of mirrors reflecting all the chandeliers.
hall of mirrors.meta: ko‘ngilochar bog‘, yarmarka va boshqalarda odamlarni adashtirish yoki ko‘ngil ochish maqsadida joylashtirilgan ko‘plab oynalardan tashkil topgan labirint yoki xona.

ex: In many countries, have provinces enjoy better infrastructure and services.
The have provinces attract more investment due to their abundant natural resources.
have province.meta: boshqa viloyatlarga nisbatan ko‘proq afzalliklarga ega yoki boyroq, resurslarga boy bo‘lgan viloyat; keyingi qo‘llanishda aynan o‘ziga xos iqtisodiy yoki resurs jihatdan kuchli viloyat nazarda tutiladi.

ex: Government programs aim to support have-not provinces to reduce regional disparities.
Have-not provinces often struggle with poor infrastructure and limited job opportunities.
have-not province.meta: boshqa viloyatlarga nisbatan kamroq imkoniyatlarga ega, kambag‘alroq yoki resurslari yetishmaydigan viloyat; keyingi qo‘llanishda aynan iqtisodiy yoki resurs jihatdan zaif viloyat nazarda tutiladi.

ex: The horse-cod helps distribute the load evenly across the horse’s shoulders.
The farmer fitted the horse with a strong horse-cod before hitching it to the cart.
horse-cod.meta: Ot bo‘ynagi — otning bo‘yni atrofida taqiladigan, odatda yuk yoki arava tortishda ishlatiladigan maxsus bo‘ynak yoki yagi.

ex: Virtualization platforms rely heavily on hypervisors to manage hardware resources efficiently.
A hypervisor allows multiple operating systems to run on a single physical machine simultaneously.
hypervisor.meta: bu kompyuter tizimida bir vaqtda bir nechta turli operatsion tizimlarni ishga tushirish imkonini beruvchi dasturiy ta’minot

ex: Parents often use idiot strings to keep their children’s gloves together.
The child wore mittens connected by an idiot string so they wouldn’t get lost.
idiot string.meta: bu qo‘lqop yoki barmoqliklarni yo‘qotilishidan saqlash uchun ularni bir-biriga bog‘laydigan jun yoki ipning uzunligi; odatda yelka atrofiga yoki ayniqsa bolalar tomonidan kiyiladi.

ex: Many graduates end up taking joe jobs before finding a career in their field.
He quit his job because he was tired of doing the same joe job every day.
joe job.meta: bu oddiy, takroriy va ko‘pincha kam maosh bilan bajariladigan, kelajagi kam bo‘lgan va rag‘batlantirmaydigan vazifa yoki ish.

ex: Jury tampering undermines the fairness of the judicial process.
The defendant was accused of jury tampering during the trial.
jury tampering.meta: Sud jarayoni davomida sud hay’atining muhokamalari yoki hukmiga noqonuniy ta’sir qilish harakati; odatda pora berish yoki boshqa noqonuniy usullar orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The kitchen tidy is placed under the sink for convenience.
Please empty the kitchen tidy; it’s full of vegetable peels.
kitchen tidy.meta: Oshxonada chiqindilarni tashlash uchun ishlatiladigan idish yoki quti.

ex: In old houses, the kitchen chamber was often used by servants.
The kitchen chamber was small but comfortable enough for the guest.
kitchen chamber.meta: Oshxona ustida yoki oshxonaga ulangan xona, odatda xonadon ishchilari, mehmonlar yoki ijarachilar uchun mo‘ljallangan kamroq qulay yotoqxona

ex: The kitchen cleaner comes every morning to wash the floors and surfaces.
I bought a new kitchen cleaner to remove grease from the stove.
kitchen cleaner.meta: (a) Oshxonani, ayniqsa ish sifatida, tozalovchi shaxs. (b) Oshxonani va oshxona jihozlarini tozalash uchun ishlatiladigan mahsulot, odatda kimyoviy tozalovchi vosita.

ex: The kitchen front was considered vital in maintaining morale during World War II.
During the war, many women worked hard on the kitchen front to support the troops.
kitchen front.meta: Ikkinchi Jahon Urushi (1939–45) davrida ayniqsa: oshpazlik, ovqatlanish va uy xo‘jaligi ishlari, urushga kengroq jamoat hissasi sifatida qabul qilingan faoliyat.

ex: She converted the kitchen loft into a guest bedroom.
The old house had a small kitchen loft where they stored extra supplies.
kitchen loft.meta: Oshxonaning ustida joylashgan podval yoki mansard xonasi, odatda saqlash uchun yoki past darajadagi yotoq xonasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The room comes with kitchen privileges but no private bathroom.
Tenants have kitchen privileges, so they can cook their own meals.
kitchen privileges.meta: Ijarachi sifatida umumiy yoki egasi yashaydigan uydagi oshxonadan foydalanish huquqi; ya’ni, ovqat tayyorlash, jihozlardan foydalanish va idishlarni yuvish imkoniyati.

ex: Instead of a formal dinner, they hosted a relaxed kitchen supper.
We had a cozy kitchen supper with friends on Friday night.
kitchen supper.meta: Oshxonada beriladigan kechki ovqat; ayniqsa, rasmiy ovqat xonasida emas, balki oshxonada o‘tkaziladigan norasmiy kechki ziyofat.

ex: During the expedition, we set up a kitchen tent to cook our meals.
The soldiers gathered in the kitchen tent for their evening meal.
kitchen tent.meta: (Odatda harbiy kontekstda) ovqat tayyorlanadigan yoki iste'mol qilinadigan chodir

ex: We threw the kitchen sink at the marketing campaign to boost sales.
The team threw the kitchen sink at their opponents in the final minutes of the match.
throw the kitchen sink at.meta: Muammo, vazifa yoki raqibga qarshi barcha mumkin bo‘lgan resurs va vositalarni ishga solish; barcha kuch va imkoniyatlarni ishga solib harakat qilish.

ex: Unlike HDPE, LDPE is more flexible and has a lower melting point.
LDPE is commonly used to make plastic bags and film wraps.
ldpe.meta: keng tarmoqlangan polimer zanjirlariga ega bo‘lgan, yumshoqroq va egiluvchanroq plastmassa turi

ex: You got a lung dart? I left mine at home.
He stepped outside for a quick lung dart before the meeting.
lung dart.meta: ingliz tilida so‘zlashuv uslubidagi (sleng) ibora bo‘lib, sigaretani bildiradi. Bu ibora ko‘pincha hazil aralash yoki norasmiy holatlarda ishlatiladi

magic e.meta: bu ingliz tilida, ayniqsa, boshlang‘ich sinflarda savod o‘rgatishda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, so‘z oxirida keladigan jim (aytilmaydigan) “e” harfini bildiradi

ex: Traffic is always heavy on the highways during May long.
We're planning to go camping over May long.
may long.meta: Kanadada har yili may oyining oxirlarida (odatda oxiridan oldingi dushanba kuni) nishonlanadigan Victoria kunini o‘z ichiga olgan uzoq dam olish haftasining oxiri

ex: May two-four usually kicks off the summer season with barbecues and fireworks.
We’re heading to the cottage for May two-four weekend
may two-four.meta: Kanadada Victoria kuni bilan bog‘liq uzoq dam olish haftasining oxirini bildiradi. Ushbu ibora "May 24" (ya'ni 24-may) sanasiga ishora qiladi, garchi bayram har yili aynan shu kunga to‘g‘ri kelmasa ham

ex: The company is developing a mixed reality headset to blend physical and digital worlds.
Mixed reality allows users to interact with both virtual and real objects simultaneously.
mixed reality.meta: bu kompyuter tomonidan yaratilgan muhit bo‘lib, unda jismoniy (haqiqiy) va virtual (sun’iy) elementlar birlashtirilgan

ex: Police are investigating a suspected murder-suicide in the suburban neighborhood.
The tragic case was a murder-suicide where the perpetrator killed his family before taking his own life.
murder-suicide.meta: (a) qotillik va o‘z joniga qasd qilishni o‘z ichiga olgan hodisa yoki voqea; ayniqsa, qotillik-o‘zini o‘ldirish paktida (kelishuvda) uchraydi. (b) qotillikdan so‘ng yoki undan oldin o‘z joniga qasd qilish harakati.

ex: The documentary explores the life of a famous porn star.
She became a well-known porn star in the adult film industry.
porn star.meta: pornografik filmlarda ijrochi bo‘lib mashhur bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: A reflector oven uses radiant heat to bake food efficiently outdoors.
We cooked the chicken in a reflector oven by the campfire.
reflector oven.meta: ochiq olov yoniga qo‘yilib, porlab turgan issiqlikni aks ettiruvchi, oziq-ovqatni pishirish uchun ishlatiladigan, charaqlagan metall qutiga o‘xshash idish; asosan tashqarida foydalaniladi.

ex: The ritual suicide was performed according to ancient religious customs.
In some cultures, ritual suicide was practiced to preserve honor.
ritual suicide.meta: o‘z joniga o‘zi rituallik, ya’ni diniy e’tiqod yoki madaniy an’analarga muvofiq, marosim tarzida qasd qilib o‘limga erishish

ex: After the rough edit, the team made several changes to improve the flow.
The director showed us the rough edit of the film before the final cut.
rough edit.meta: film, audio yozuv yoki boshqa materialning dastlabki, tahrirlangan birinchi varianti; dastlabki tahrirlash jarayonidan keyingi holat

ex: Sapphire glass is commonly used in high-end smartphones for screen protection.
The watch features a scratch-resistant sapphire glass.
sapphire glass.meta: (a) Ko‘pincha kobalt yoki boshqa moddalarning qo‘shilishi orqali ko‘k rangga bo‘yalgan bezakli shisha; (b) Juda qattiq, rangsiz shisha bo‘lib, odatda qimmatbaho soatlar va elektron qurilmalarda foydalaniladi.

ex: In search after answers, she traveled to many countries.
They set out in search after the lost treasure.
in search after.meta: biror narsani topish yoki uni izlash jarayonida bo‘lish holati.

ex: They were in search to find the lost city.
He is in search of a better life.
in search.meta: biror narsani topish yoki erishish uchun izlab topishga urinayotgan holat; maqsadga erishish uchun harakat qilayotgan holat

ex: Search and recovery of the missing hikers took several days.
The team was involved in search and recovery operations after the ship sank.
search and recovery.meta: yo‘qolgan narsalarni, ayniqsa suv ostida bo‘lgan narsalarni yoki yo‘qolgan odamlarni topish va qaytarib olish jarayoni

ex: Search and retrieval operations are crucial in disaster response.
The search and retrieval of the sunken artifacts took several months.
search and retrieval.meta: yo‘qolgan, ayniqsa suv ostida bo‘lgan narsalarni yoki yo‘qolgan odamlarni (odatda o‘lik deb taxmin qilingan) topish va tiklash jarayoni

ex: Search and seizure must be authorized by a warrant.
The police conducted a search and seizure of the suspect’s house.
search and seizure.meta: qonuniy ruxsatnoma asosida biror shaxsning joyini yoki mulkini qidirish va kerak bo‘lganda musodara qilish protsedurasi

ex: A search tree is used in computer science to organize data for quick retrieval.
Binary search trees help speed up the process of searching for values.
search tree.meta: ma’lumotlarni samarali qidirish va topishni osonlashtirish uchun daraxt shaklida tashkil etilgan ma’lumotlar tuzilmasining bir turi

ex: The search dog was able to find the missing hiker in the forest.
Search dogs are often used by police to detect drugs in suspicious vehicles.
search dog.meta: yo‘qolgan odamlarni topish yoki giyohvand moddalar, portlovchi modda kabi noqonuniy narsalarni aniqlash uchun maxsus o‘qitilgan it

ex: They carried out a search and destroy operation against the harmful pests in the crops.
The military launched a search and destroy mission to eliminate enemy forces.
search and destroy.meta: dushman yoki zararli, keraksiz narsani izlab topib, yo‘q qilish, yo‘qotish yoki neytrallashtirish harakati

ex: The search and replace function helps you find all instances of a word and change them quickly
I used search and replace to update the company name throughout the document
search and replace.meta: hujjat yoki matn ichida ma’lum bir belgilar qatorini tizimli ravishda qidirib topish va uni boshqa belgilar qatori bilan almashtirish uchun ishlatiladigan funksiya

ex: The searched-for file was finally recovered from the backup.
He is the most searched-for celebrity on the internet this year.
searched-for.meta: (a) Qidirilgan yoki izlanuvchi narsa yoki shaxs. (b) Raqamli qidiruv natijasida topilgan yoki qidiruv obyekti bo‘lgan narsa.

ex: The scientists are searching out new methods to treat the disease.
His job involved searching out the best locations for new stores.
searching out.meta: Biror narsani topmaguncha uni qat’iy va sinchiklab izlash, yoki uni aniqlash, fosh etish harakati

ex: I was searching up train schedules online.
He spent the afternoon searching up recipes for the dinner party.
searching up.meta: Biror ma’lumot yoki narsani izlab topish harakati, ayniqsa internet orqali ma’lumot qidirish va tekshirish

ex: The baby was born with a ventricular septal defect.
Surgery may be required to repair the septal defect.
septal defect.meta: Tana a’zolaridagi to‘siq (septum)da paydo bo‘lgan g‘ayritabiiy teshik yoki yorig‘, ayniqsa yurakning ikki bo‘limi orasidagi to‘siqda tug‘ma nuqson sifatida uchraydi. Bu holat yurakdagi qon oqimini buzishi mumkin

ex: The septal neck is a critical structure in supporting the siphuncle in cephalopod shells.
In nautiloids, the septal neck is typically short and curves backward.
septal neck.meta: Pallali boshoyoqlilar (masalan, ammonitlar yoki nautiloidlar) qobig‘ida har bir to‘siq (septum)dagi teshikdan cho‘zilgan, qisqa naycha yoki halqa shaklidagi tuzilma

ex: The patient was admitted to the ICU with septic shock and required vasopressors to maintain blood pressure.
Early recognition and treatment of septic shock are essential to improve survival.
septic shock.meta: bu sepsis (ya'ni, og‘ir infeksiyaga organizmning haddan tashqari kuchli yallig‘lanish reaksiyasi)ning eng og‘ir bosqichi bo‘lib, u qon bosimini saqlab qolish uchun tomir ichiga suyuqliklar va dori vositalari yuborishni talab qiladi

ex: The church began preparing for Lent during the Septuagesima week
Septuagesima week is a time for reflection and anticipation of the Lenten season
septuagesima week.meta: Septuajesima yakshanbasidan boshlanadigan hafta bo‘lib, bu Masihiy liturgik taqvimda, ayniqsa katolik va ba’zi anglikan an’analarida, Katta Ro‘za (Lent) boshlanishidan taxminan uch hafta oldin boshlanadigan davrdir

ex: He always acts like a shit disturber in meetings – he turns everyone against each other.
There are a couple of shit disturbers in this group, they enjoy causing trouble.
shit disturber.meta: ataylab janjal, nizo, yoki notinchlik chiqishini istaydigan va bundan zavqlanuvchi odam; ataylab odamlar orasida kelishmovchilik keltirib chiqaruvchi kishi

ex: The monks took a vow of silence during their retreat in the mountains.
She made a personal vow of silence to help focus her meditation.
vow of silence.meta: gapirishni butunlay voz kechish uchun, ayniqsa, ma’lum diniy yoki monastik tartib a’zolari tomonidan qilingan qasamyod; keng ma’noda esa va’dasi yoki majburiyati

ex: The shocking news reduced her to silence.
His powerful speech reduced the audience to silence.
to reduce a person to silence.meta: odam yoki tashkilotni gapirishni yoki muloqot qilishni to‘xtatishga majbur qilish; ayniqsa, odamni hayrat, ta’sir yoki boshqa kuchli his-tuyg‘ular sababli so‘zsiz qoldirish

ex: The artillery fire reduced the enemy battery to silence.
Our forces managed to reduce the enemy guns to silence by noon.
to reduce a person to silence.meta: (dushman qurolini): ayniqsa, ustun otish kuchi orqali dushmanning qurolini, artilleriyasini yoki o‘q-dorini harakatdan to‘xtatish, faoliyatini susaytirish; umumiy ma’noda esa shovqin chiqaruvchi narsani harakatdan chiqarish

ex: She was the first silence breaker to speak out about the issue.
In the meeting, he acted as a silence breaker and shared his opinion.
silence breaker.meta: uzoq vaqt sukutda bo‘lgandan so‘ng yoki boshqalar jim turganida gapiradigan yoki shovqin chiqaradigan odam; ayniqsa, hozirgi paytda jamoat oldida muhim mavzuda gapiradigan kishi

ex: She experienced a silent earthquake of emotions after the news.
Geologists study silent earthquakes that don’t produce surface shaking.
silent earthquake.meta: (a) faqat ta’sirlangan odam uchun seziladigan katta ichki o‘zgarish, ruhiy zo‘riqish yoki muhim voqea; (b) Geologiyada — ko‘pincha yuzaga chiqmaydigan, lekin yer qobig‘ida yuz beradigan sinish yoki silkinish.

ex: High blood pressure is often called a silent killer because it shows no symptoms until it’s too late
Diabetes can be a silent killer if left untreated
silent killer.meta: kasallik yoki buzilish, yoki biologik, kimyoviy yoki jismoniy omil bo‘lib, oldindan seziladigan alomatlarsiz odamning o‘limiga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin

ex: Please put your phone on silent mode during the meeting
He didn’t hear the call because his phone was in silent mode
silent mode.meta: mobil telefon yoki boshqa elektron qurilmalarda ovozlar (masalan, qo‘ng‘iroq ohangi, bildirishnomalar) o‘chiriladigan, odatda tebranish yoki vizual signal orqali ogohlantirish yoqiladigan sozlama holati.

ex: Squirrel pox is harmless to humans but can be fatal to red squirrels.
Conservationists are worried about the spread of squirrel pox among native species.
squirrel pox.meta: Shimoliy Amerikadagi bir nechta sichqoncha turlariga ta’sir qiluvchi, odatda yengil kechadigan, Leporipoxvirus jinsiga mansub poksvirus sababli yuzaga keladigan virusli kasallik

ex: The start codon AUG signals the beginning of protein synthesis.
Translation begins at the start codon on the mRNA strand.
start codon.meta: xabar beruvchi RNK (mRNK) tarkibida bo‘lib, oqsil sintezi (tarjimasi)ni boshlash signali sifatida xizmat qiluvchi uchta nukleotiddan iborat kodon

ex: The patient reported frequent suicidal ideation during therapy.
Suicidal ideation can be a symptom of severe depression.
suicidal ideation.meta: odamning o‘z joniga qasd qilish haqida o‘ylashi, bu haqda jiddiy mulohaza qilishi yoki reja tuzishi holati

ex: The city installed a suicide barrier on the bridge to prevent further tragedies.
Suicide barriers have been proven to reduce the number of jump attempts.
suicide barrier.meta: ko‘prik, bino, minora kabi inshootlarda o‘rnatilgan baland panjara yoki boshqa jismoniy to‘siq bo‘lib, odamlarning o‘z joniga qasd qilishining oldini olish maqsadida qo‘yiladi

ex: The suicide bomb exploded near the checkpoint.
Authorities discovered a suicide bomb vest before the attack could happen.
suicide bomb.meta: (dastlab) o‘z joniga qasd qilish uchun ishlatilgan portlovchi qurilma; (hozirda odatda) bomba portlovchi qurilmani tanasiga yoki kiyimiga yashirib, uni o‘zi bilan birga portlatadigan shaxs — suitsidchi hujumchi tomonidan ishlatiladi

ex: The suicide bomber detonated the device in a crowded market.
Security forces stopped a suicide bomber before he could reach his target.
suicide bomber.meta: portlovchi moddalar bilan to‘ldirilgan samolyotni dushman nishoniga ataylab urib portlatadigan uchuvchi masalan, kamikadze

ex: Researchers inserted a suicide gene into the cancer cells to trigger their self-destruction.
The suicide gene is activated only in targeted cells during therapy.
suicide gene.meta: hujayrada ifodalanishi (faollashishi) natijasida uning apoptoz yo‘li orqali o‘z-o‘zini yo‘q qilishiga olib keladigan gen

ex: Switzerland is often associated with suicide tourism due to its assisted dying laws.
Ethical debates continue around the growing phenomenon of suicide tourism.
suicide tourism.meta: o‘z joniga qasd qilishda yordam berishga qonuniy ruxsat etilgan mamlakat yoki hududga shaxsning o‘z hayotini tugatish maqsadida sayohat qilishi

ex: The documentary tells the story of a suicide tourist who traveled to Switzerland.
Many suicide tourists suffer from terminal illnesses and seek a dignified death.
suicide tourist.meta: o‘z joniga qasd qilishda yordam berish qonuniy bo‘lgan mamlakatga o‘z hayotini tugatish maqsadida safar qiluvchi shaxs

ex: The police found a suicide vest hidden in the suspect’s home.
Suicide vests are often used in terrorist attacks to cause maximum damage.
suicide vest.meta: suitsidchi hujumchilar tomonidan kiyiladigan, portlovchi moddalar va detonator bilan jihozlangan, yengsiz kiyim. Bu kamar yordamida hujumchi o‘zini va atrofdagilarni portlatadi

ex: She wore a stylish suit dress to the business meeting.
The boutique offers a variety of suit dresses for formal occasions.
suit dress.meta: ayollar uchun yubka yoki ko‘ylak hamda unga mos keladigan jaketdan iborat kiyim to‘plami; shuningdek, bunday kostyumning bir qismi sifatida alohida kiyiladigan ko‘ylak yoki libos.

ex: The suit-wearing attendees looked very professional at the conference
He is known as a suit-wearing businessman who takes his job seriously
suit-wearing.meta: kostyum kiyadigan, ishbilarmon yoki professional ko‘rinishga ega bo‘lgan shaxs. Bu ifoda ko‘pincha rasmiy kiyim kiygani uchun ishlatiladi

ex: The astronaut was fully suited-up before the spacewalk.
The diver got suited-up in his wetsuit before entering the water.
suited-up.meta: ma’lum bir faoliyat yoki ish uchun mo‘ljallangan yoki talab qilinadigan kiyim yoki kiyimlar to‘plamini kiygan holat. Bu kiyimlar odatda himoya, qulaylik yoki ish uchun zarur bo‘lgan maxsus xususiyatlarga ega

ex: After the accident, she suffered from survivor guilt because her friends did not make it.
Survivor guilt is common among those who live through natural disasters.
survivor guilt.meta: biror falokat, ofat yoki dahshatli voqeadan omon qolgan, lekin boshqalar omon qolmaganligi uchun ichki ayb va noqulaylik his qilish holati. Bu ko‘pincha ruhiy stress va xafagarchilikka olib keladi

ex: Synthetic cannabinoids can be more dangerous than natural cannabis due to unknown additives
The police seized several packets of synthetic cannabinoids during the raid
synthetic cannabinoid.meta: kannabis o‘simligidagi tabiiy moddalar ta’sirini imitatsiya qiluvchi, laboratoriyada yaratilgan kimyoviy birikmalar

ex: He works hard every day to put bread on the table for his family
Finding a stable job is important to put bread on the table
to put bread on the table.meta: oilani boqish yoki o‘zini moddiy ta’minlash uchun doimiy va asosiy daromad topish. Ko‘pincha ish yoki kasb orqali o‘zini va oilasini ta’minlash ma’nosida ishlatiladi

ex: The restaurant used a warming closet to keep the plates hot before serving.
She placed the food in the warming closet to keep it fresh and warm.
warming closet.meta: odatda pechning bir qismi bo‘lib, ovqatlar, idishlar va boshqa buyumlarni iliq saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan kichik isitilgan xona yoki shkaf

ex: Some sociologists study the phenomenon of white guilt in modern societies.
White guilt can influence people’s attitudes toward racial equality.
white guilt.meta: irqiy adolatsizliklar va tengsizliklarga oid masalalarda oq tanli shaxslar tomonidan his qilinadigan ichki ayb yoki uyat hissi. Bu tushuncha ijtimoiy ong va irqiy munosabatlar kontekstida ishlatiladi

ex: The defendant was charged with witness tampering after trying to bribe a key witness.
Witness tampering is a serious offense that undermines the justice system.
witness tampering.meta: sud jarayonida, tergovda yoki so‘rovlarda guvohning ko‘rsatmalarini o‘zgartirish yoki yo‘qotish maqsadida pora berish, qo‘rqitish yoki bosim ko‘rsatish orqali amalga oshiriladigan noqonuniy harakat

ex: The C-19 pandemic affected the whole world
Scientists are studying the behavior of the C-19 virus
c-19.meta: SARS-CoV-2 virusining sababchi bo‘lishi bilan yuzaga kelgan yuqumli kasallik, ya’ni COVID-19. Bu kasallik global pandemiya sifatida tarqaldi va nafas yo‘llari infektsiyasi bo‘lib, turli darajadagi og‘irlikda kechishi mumkin

ex: Patients with comorbid conditions need special medical care
Depression and anxiety are often comorbid disorders
comorbid.meta: bir shaxsda bir vaqtning o‘zida mavjud bo‘lgan kasalliklar yoki buzilishlarni ifodalovchi tibbiy atama. Masalan, yurak kasalligi bilan birga qandli diabet ham bo‘lsa, ular komorbid hisoblanadi

ex: The patient’s comorbidity made treatment more complicated
Diabetes and hypertension are common examples of comorbidity
comorbidity.meta: bir kishida bir vaqtning o‘zida ikki yoki undan ortiq kasalliklar, buzilishlar yoki patologik jarayonlarning mavjudligi, ko‘pincha bu holat kasalliklarni davolashni murakkablashtiradi

ex: The contact tracer interviewed everyone who had been near the infected person
Contact tracers play a crucial role in controlling outbreaks
contact tracer.meta: yuqumli kasallik aniqlangan odam bilan yaqindan aloqada bo‘lgan shaxslarni aniqlash, ularni izlash va kasallikning tarqalishini kamaytirish maqsadida ma’lumot to‘playdigan va kuzatuv olib boradigan mutaxassis

ex: Contact tracing is essential to control the spread of infectious diseases
During the pandemic, governments invested heavily in contact tracing systems
contact tracing.meta: yuqumli kasallik aniqlangan bemor bilan yaqin aloqada bo‘lgan shaxslarni topish, ular bilan bog‘lanish va kasallikning tarqalishini kamaytirish uchun olib boriladigan jarayon

ex: The number of Covid cases is rising
Hospitals are overwhelmed with Covid patients.
covid.meta: SARS-CoV-2 virusidan kelib chiqadigan yuqumli kasallik, asosan COVID-19 nomi bilan tanilgan. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha kasallik yoki virus bilan bog‘liq holatlar va hodisalarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi

ex: The patient was treated with CPAP to help with breathing.
CPAP machines are commonly used for sleep apnea patients.
cpap.meta: Bu nafas olish terapiyasining usuli bo‘lib, unda atmosferadan yuqori bosimdagi havo doimiy ravishda nafas yo‘liga kiritiladi

ex: The CV caused a global pandemic.
Many were infected with CV during 2020.
cv.meta: Bu atama ayniqsa COVID-19 kasalligini keltirib chiqaruvchi koronavirusga yoki undan kelib chiqadigan kasallikka nisbatan ishlatiladi

ex: The CV-19 pandemic affected millions worldwide.
Scientists studied the CV-19 virus to develop vaccines.
cv-19.meta: Bu atama COVID-19 kasalligini yoki uni keltirib chiqaruvchi koronavirusni anglatadi

ex: Doctors prescribed dexamethasone to reduce inflammation.
Dexamethasone is used in treating severe allergic reactions.
dexamethasone.meta: Bu sun’iy kortikosteroid dori bo‘lib, asosan yallig‘lanishga, allergiyaga va ba’zi buyrak usti bezlari kasalliklariga, shuningdek boshqa holatlarga qarshi qo‘llaniladi

ex: The frontliners in the army faced the toughest battles.
During the pandemic, frontliners like doctors and nurses worked tirelessly.
frontliner.meta: urushda oldingi safda jang qiluvchi askar yoki muhim vazifalarda, ayniqsa odamlar bilan bevosita muloqot qiluvchi, muhim vazifalarni bajaruvchi shaxs

ex: The doctor diagnosed the child with Kawasaki disease.
Kawasaki symptoms include high fever and rash.
kawasaki.meta: Bu atama asosan chaqaloqlar va kichik yoshdagi bolalarda uchraydigan o‘tkir kasallikni bildiradi.

ex: MERS is a respiratory illness first reported in the Middle East.
Patients with MERS often have fever and cough.
mers.meta: Bu kasallik koronavirus tomonidan yuzaga keladigan o‘tkir yuqumli kasallik bo‘lib, odatda isitma va yo‘tal bilan boshlanadi, ba’zan esa og‘ir nafas olish muammolari bilan kechadi

ex: During the pandemic, physical distancing helped slow the spread of the virus.
People were advised to practice physical distancing in public places.
physical distancing.meta: boshqalar bilan kasallikning tarqalishini kamaytirish uchun ma’lum bir masofani saqlash yoki to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri jismoniy aloqani kamaytirish amaliyoti

ex: The triaged patients were sent to different departments based on urgency.
During the disaster, victims were triaged to prioritize those needing immediate care.
triaged.meta: bemorlar yoki ishlar shoshilinchlik darajasiga ko‘ra dastlabki baholashdan o‘tkazilgan, ularning muolajasi yoki bajarilishi uchun tartib belgilangan holat

ex: The hospital set up a system for triaging patients during emergencies.
Effective triaging helps prioritize the most urgent cases first.
triaging.meta: bemorlarni ularning holati va shoshilinchlik darajasiga ko‘ra dastlabki baholash yoki ishlarni ahamiyatiga qarab tartibga solish jarayoni

ex: The dictionary was updated with several new sub-entries under the word "run."
New sub-entries help clarify different meanings of a complex term.
new sub-entries.meta: asosiy yozuv ostida qo‘shilgan, ma’lumot yoki tushunchani batafsilroq tushuntirish uchun kiritilgan kichik bo‘limlar yoki yozuvlar

ex: The CFR of the disease was reported to be 5% during the outbreak
Tracking the CFR helps health officials understand the severity of an epidemic
cfr.meta: ma’lum bir kasallik yoki holat bilan kasallangan bemorlarning qanchasi o‘limga olib kelganini ko‘rsatadigan foiz yoki nisbat

ex: Health officials warned about community spread of the virus.
When there is widespread community spread, controlling the disease becomes more difficult.
community spread.meta: infektsion kasallik yoki patogenning jamoat a’zolari orasida, ko‘pincha oddiy aloqa orqali, yuqishi jarayoni

ex: Authorities confirmed cases of community transmission of the virus.
community transmission.meta: infektsion kasallik yoki patogenning jamoat a’zolari orasida, ko‘pincha kundalik muloqot natijasida yuqishi jarayoni

ex: A cytokine storm can lead to organ failure and death if not treated promptly.
Some severe COVID-19 cases are associated with a cytokine storm.
cytokine storm.meta: immun tizimining haddan tashqari kuchli javobi bo‘lib, organizmda juda ko‘p sitokinlar ishlab chiqarilishi natijasida og‘ir yallig‘lanish yoki to‘qimalarning shikastlanishi sodir bo‘ladi

ex: Cloth masks are a common type of face covering.
Wearing a face covering in public spaces was mandatory during the pandemic.
face covering.meta: turli materiallardan tayyorlangan va odatda og‘iz hamda burunni yopib turadigan vosita bo‘lib, insonni havodagi zararli zarrachalar yoki yuqumli kasalliklardan himoya qilish uchun ishlatiladi

ex: Use hand gel before eating if soap and water are not available.
She keeps a small bottle of hand gel in her purse.
hand gel.meta: Qo‘llarni tozalash yoki namlantirish uchun ishlatiladigan gel; ayniqsa, tarkibida odatda spirt bo‘lgan va bakteriyalar, viruslar yoki boshqa mikroorganizmlarni o‘ldiruvchi dezinfeksiyalovchi vosita

ex: Wearing a medical mask can reduce the spread of airborne viruses
medical mask.meta: og‘iz va burunni yopuvchi, yuqumli kasalliklarni yuqtiruvchi zarrachalarning tarqalishini oldini olish uchun mo‘ljallangan niqob; ayniqsa, tibbiyot xodimlari tomonidan foydalanish uchun ishlab chiqarilgan

ex: Middle East respiratory syndrome was first identified in Saudi Arabia in 2012.
Patients with Middle East respiratory syndrome often require hospitalization.
middle east respiratory syndrome.meta: koronavirus tufayli yuzaga keladigan o'tkir yuqumli kasallik bo‘lib, odatda isitma va yo‘tal bilan boshlanadi, ko‘p hollarda og‘ir nafas olish yetishmovchiligiga olib keladi

ex: The government imposed restrictions when the R number rose above 1
An R number below 1 means the outbreak is declining.
r number.meta: yuqumli kasallik tarqalish ko‘rsatkichi bo‘lib, bir bemor o‘rtacha nechta yangi odamga kasallikni yuqtirishi mumkinligini ko‘rsatadi

ex: The reproduction number of the virus dropped below 1 after restrictions were implemented.
A reproduction number of 2 means one person infects two others on average.
reproduction number.meta: bu yuqumli kasallik tarqalish darajasini ko‘rsatuvchi ko‘rsatkich bo‘lib, bitta kasallangan odam o‘rtacha nechta boshqa odamga kasallikni yuqtirishi mumkinligini anglatadi

ex: The basic reproductive number (R₀) of measles is around 12 to 18.
If the reproductive number is greater than 1, the disease will likely spread.
reproductive number.meta: bu bir kasallangan odamdan o‘rtacha nechta yangi odamga kasallik yuqishini ko‘rsatuvchi epidemiologik ko‘rsatkichdir

ex: The spike protein of the coronavirus allows it to attach to and enter human cells
Vaccines train the immune system to recognize the spike protein of the virus.
spike protein.meta: bu virus yuzasidan chiqib turadigan glikoprotein bo‘lib, u virusning odam yoki hayvon hujayralariga yopishib, ularni yuqtirishiga yordam beradi

ex: The surgeon wore a surgical mask during the operation.
Surgical masks help prevent the spread of infections in hospitals.
surgical mask.meta: og‘iz va burunni yopadigan, yuqumli kasalliklarni tarqalishidan himoya qiluvchi niqob bo‘lib, asosan tibbiyot xodimlari tomonidan ishlatiladi

ex: The cave had an Acheronian atmosphere that chilled the soul.
He painted an Acheronian landscape full of shadows and fire.
acheronian.meta: qadimgi yunon mifologiyasidagi Acheron daryosi yoki ostki dunyo (ya’ni o‘liklar dunyosi, do‘zax) bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan yoki shunga ishora qiladigan narsa

ex: If we want to win this match, we need to bring our A-game.
She really brought her A-game to the interview.
a-game.meta: "A-game" iborasi, ayniqsa sport, ish yoki har qanday faoliyat kontekstida, odamning eng yuqori darajadagi ijrosi yoki eng yaxshi ko‘rsatkichda harakat qilishini bildiradi

ex: Alkannin is used as a natural red dye in food and cosmetics.
The roots of Alkanna tinctoria contain alkannin, which gives a deep red color.
alkannin.meta: Boraginaceae (bug'doygul) oilasiga mansub ayrim o‘simliklarning, xususan alkanet (lotincha: Alkanna tinctoria) ildizidan olinadigan qizil rangli bo‘yoq modda

ex: The tiger salamander is one of the largest ambystomatid species.
Ambystomatid salamanders are known for their underground lifestyle and secretive behavior.
ambystomatid.meta: Ambystomatidae (ilgari Ambystomidae) deb atalgan amfibiyalar oilasiga oid bo‘lib, bu oilaga Ambystoma jinsiga mansub bo‘lgan hayvonlar, ayniqsa mol salamandralari kiradi

ex: He argued that the cultural values of the Anglosphere promote individual freedom.
The Anglosphere plays a major role in global politics and economics.
anglosphere.meta: odatda "the Anglosphere" shaklida ishlatiladi va ingliz tilida so‘zlashuvchi mamlakatlar majmuasini bildiradi

ex: It was anighst dawn when they returned.
He stood anighst the fire, warming his hands.
anighst.meta: asosan Shotland shevasiga xos so‘z bo‘lib, qadimgi ingliz tilida va ayrim dialektlarda ishlatiladi. U “yaqin”, “deyarli”, “yonida”, “yonginasida” degan ma’nolarni bildiradi

ex: Antenation is a key behavior in social insects for recognizing colony members
The ants engaged in antennation before exchanging food.
antennation.meta: bu atama hasharotlarning mo‘ylovlari (antenna) yordamida atrofdagi narsalarni yoki boshqa hasharotlarni payqashi, tegib ko‘rishi yoki sezishi harakatini anglatadi

ex: Astronomers captured a rare antitail during the comet's perihelion passage.
The comet displayed both a typical tail and a faint antitail directed towards the Sun.
antitail.meta: bu **kometaning boshi (yadrosi)**dan Quyosh tomon cho‘zilib ko‘rinadigan yorqin chiqindi bo‘lib, odatda quyoshdan qarama-qarshi tomonga yo‘naltirilgan odatiy dum (tail) bilan farqlanadi

ex: “Are you coming to the meeting?” — “Ar"
“Is that your tractor?” — “Ar"
ar.meta: bu his-tuyg‘ular, javoblar yoki rozilikni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan aro’z (orqa ovozli so‘z). Ko‘pincha qishloq yoki dialekt nutqlarida uchraydi

ex: The pirate shouted “Arr!” to warn his crew about the approaching ship.
“Arr! We’ve found the treasure!”
She prefers wearing athleisure because it’s comfortable and stylish.
Athleisure clothes are designed to be suitable for both workouts and casual outings.
athleisure.meta: bu atama sport bilan shug‘ullanish uchun ham, kundalik kiyim sifatida ham mos keladigan, qulay va erkin kiyim yoki poyabzalni anglatadi

ex: Atlanticism has shaped the security policies of many Western countries since World War II.
The summit focused on strengthening Atlanticism between Europe and North America.
atlanticism.meta: bu siyosiy prinsip yoki siyosat bo‘lib, unda Yevropa va Shimoliy Amerika davlatlari (ayniqsa AQSh va Kanada) o‘rtasida harbiy, iqtisodiy va siyosiy yaqin hamkorlik o‘rnatish va rivojlantirish maqsad qilinadi

ex: He is a prominent Atlanticist who advocates for stronger ties between Europe and North America.
Atlanticist policies emphasize collective security and economic cooperation.
atlanticist.meta: bu shaxs yoki guruh bo‘lib, u Yevropa va Shimoliy Amerika davlatlari (masalan, AQSh va Kanada) o‘rtasidagi harbiy, iqtisodiy va siyosiy yaqin hamkorlikni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi yoki targ‘ib qiladi

ex: The antique bedroom featured a beautiful bateau lit with carved wooden details.
She prefers a bateau lit because of its elegant, ship-like design.
bateau lit.meta: bu krovat turi bo‘lib, unda bosh va oyoq taxtalari yuqori va kemaning bow (old qismi) shaklida bezatilgan

ex: He comes from a brewstered family with a large estate.
After years of hard work, they became brewstered and lived comfortably.
brewstered.meta: bu sifat bo‘lib, odam yoki oilani moddiy jihatdan juda boy, mol-mulki ko‘p, farovon hayot kechirayotgan deb ta’riflaydi

ex: There was a noticeable bumfle on the sleeve of his jacket.
She ironed the shirt carefully to remove any bumfles.
bumfle.meta: bu so‘z kiyim, mato yoki boshqa matolar yuzasida hosil bo‘lgan ajin, burish yoki chiroysiz shishni bildiradi

ex: She bumfled the cushions to make them look fuller.
The tailor bumfled up the sleeves to add volume.
bumfle.meta: bu fe’l bo‘lib, biror narsani shishirish, qalinlashtirish yoki qomatini oshirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha kiyim, mato yoki boshqa sirtlarni ko‘proq hajmga ega qilish uchun qo‘llaniladi

ex: He wore a bumfly shirt that looked wrinkled and unkempt.
The bumfly fabric made the dress look old and worn out.
bumfly.meta: bu sifat bo‘lib, kiyim yoki matoning burishgan, ajinli yoki joy joyda shishib ko‘rinadigan holatini ifodalaydi

ex: The buzzer beater shot brought the crowd to their feet in excitement.
He scored a buzzer beater to win the championship for his team.
buzzer beater.meta: bu atama, asosan basketbol sportida, o‘yin vaqtining so‘nggi soniyasida amalga oshirilgan va odatda o‘yin yoki davr yakunida g‘alaba keltiruvchi zarbani anglatadi

ex: By-catch can negatively impact marine ecosystems by reducing populations of non-target species.
Fishermen try to reduce by-catch by using selective fishing gear.
by-catch.meta: bu atama, asosan tijorat baliq ovlashda, boshqa maqsad qilingan turdan tashqari, tarmoqlarga tushib qolgan va kerak bo‘lmagan baliq yoki boshqa dengiz hayvonlarini anglatadi

ex: Scientists are exploring de-extinction to bring back species like the woolly mammoth.
De-extinction raises ethical questions about interfering with nature.
de-extinction.meta: bu ilmiy atama bo‘lib, yo‘qolib ketgan hayvon yoki o‘simlik turlarini genetik usullar orqali (masalan, klonlash yoki tanlab ko‘paytirish) yana mavjud qilish yoki “tiriltirish” g‘oyasi va jarayonini bildiradi

ex: In the trade negotiations, the demandeur pushed for more favorable tariffs.
The demandeur state submitted a proposal to the international tribunal.
demandeur.meta: bu atama, ayniqsa xalqaro huquq, siyosat yoki savdo shartnomalari kontekstida, huquqiy jihatdan majburiy bo‘lgan kelishuvlar bo‘yicha muzokaralarda so‘rov bilan chiqqan, talab qo‘yuvchi tomon yoki davlat(lar) blokini bildiradi

ex: The government's denialism delayed an effective response to the health crisis.
Climate change denialism remains a challenge despite overwhelming scientific consensus.
denialism.meta: bu atama ilmiy, tarixiy yoki statistik jihatdan ishonchli asosga ega bo‘lgan faktlar yoki voqeliklarni ataylab inkor etish, ularni tan olmaslik siyosati yoki qarashini bildiradi

ex: Many climate change denialists refuse to accept the overwhelming scientific evidence.
The documentary exposed the tactics used by denialists to spread misinformation.
denialist.meta: bu aniq ilmiy, tarixiy yoki faktlarga asoslangan haqiqatni tan olmaydigan yoki ataylab inkor qiladigan shaxsni anglatadi

ex: The average ozone concentration over the Arctic in spring is around 400 Dobson units.
A reading below 220 Dobson units is considered an ozone hole.
dobson unit.meta: bu Yer yuzasidagi ma’lum bir nuqta ustidagi atmosferadagi iz gaz (ayniqsa, ozon) miqdorini o‘lchovchi birlikdir

ex: The newspaper editionalized the front page to reflect regional interests.
They plan to editionalize the content for different age groups.
editionalize.meta: bu fe’l biror narsani (ayniqsa gazeta yoki uning mazmunini) turli nashrlar yoki versiyalarda ishlab chiqish yoki chop etish ma’nosini bildiradi

ex: An editionalized article may appear slightly different depending on the location.
The editionalized versions of the newspaper were tailored for different regions.
editionalized.meta: gazeta, jurnal yoki boshqa nashrlar uchun har xil hududiy, demografik yoki mavzuli ehtiyojlarga moslashtirilgan tahririy kontent haqida gap ketadi

ex: Advancements in printing technology have simplified the editionalizing process
The editionalizing of newspapers allows publishers to target content to local readers
editionalizing.meta: bu gazeta, jurnal yoki boshqa nashrlarni turli versiyalarda yoki nashrlarda ishlab chiqish, tayyorlash va chop etish amaliyoti yoki jarayoni

ex: This is an editioned lithograph, signed by the artist and limited to 100 copies.
Collectors prefer editioned works because of their exclusivity and value.
editioned.meta: bu atama, ayniqsa san’at asarlari (ayniqsa grafik nashrlar yoki bosmalar) uchun ishlatiladi va cheklangan miqdorda, maxsus seriyalarda tayyorlangan, raqamlangan va ko‘pincha rassom tomonidan imzolangan nusxalarni bildiradi

ex: Editioning is a critical step in producing high-quality limited edition prints.
The artist oversaw the editioning to ensure each print met his standards.
editioning.meta: bu atama asosan grafik san’at (printmaking) sohasida ishlatiladi va biror bosma yoki san’at asarini cheklangan miqdorda, maxsus seriya shaklida ko‘paytirish jarayonini bildiradi. Har bir nusxa odatda raqamlanadi va imzolanishi mumkin

ex: The newspaper’s editorialism on climate change sparked widespread debate.
Editorialism differs from news reporting because it reflects an opinion rather than just facts.
editorialism.meta: bu atama oddiy faktik xabar yoki hisobotdan farqli o‘laroq, biror mavzu bo‘yicha tahririyatning shaxsiy fikrini, tahlilini yoki mulohazasini ifodalashni anglatadi. Bu odatda gazetalar yoki jurnallardagi tahririy maqolalar yoki sharhlar shaklida bo‘ladi

ex: The editorialization of news reports can sometimes lead to biased coverage.
Editorialization involves expressing opinions rather than just stating facts.
editorialization.meta: bu atama oddiy yangilikni yoki voqeani xabar berishdan ko‘ra, unga tahririy sharh yoki shaxsiy fikr qo‘shish, baho berish amaliyotini bildiradi. Bu holatda jurnalist yoki muallif faktlarni emas, balki o‘z qarashlari va mulohazalarini taqdim etadi

ex: She has many years of experience in editing and editoring for major publishing houses.
Editing and editoring are crucial steps in producing quality publications.
editoring.meta: bu atama muharrirning faoliyati, kasbi yoki bajaradigan ishini anglatadi. Muharrir matnlarni tahrirlash, yaxshilash, tuzatish va tayyorlash bilan shug‘ullanadi

ex: An either-way offence can be tried either in a Crown Court or by a magistrates’ court.
The judge decides whether an either-way offence will be heard summarily or on indictment.
either-way.meta: bu atama huquq sohasida ishlatiladi va jinoyat yoki huquqbuzarlik, u sudda ikki xil tartibda ko‘rilishi mumkinligini bildiradi

ex: The enoughness of the food supply ensured no one went hungry.
She questioned the enoughness of the evidence presented in court.
enoughness.meta: bu atama biror narsaning yetarli yoki kifoya qiladigan sifatini yoki holatini bildiradi. Ya’ni, ma’lum bir ehtiyoj, talab yoki maqsad uchun yetarlilik darajasi.

ex: The policy was based on eugenical principles.
Eugenical theories were popular in the early 20th century.
eugenical.meta: bu atama yugensiya (eugenics) bilan bog‘liq yoki unga oid narsalarni ifodalaydi. Yugensiya — inson naslini yaxshilash maqsadida genetik xususiyatlarni boshqarish yoki tanlash nazariyasi va amaliyotidir.

ex: He found himself in a fankle over the misunderstanding with his boss.
The fishing lines got into a terrible fankle.
fankle.meta: bu so‘z biror narsaning to‘qilib qolishi, aralashib ketishi yoki chalkash holatni anglatadi. Ko‘pincha keng ma’noda ishlatilib, murakkab, tushunarsiz yoki qiyin vaziyatni, muammoni ifodalaydi

ex: The farmacia is open 24 hours in this neighborhood.
I bought the medicine at the farmacia.
farmacia.meta: Farmacia so‘zi ispan va italyan tillarida dorixona, ya’ni dori sotiladigan joy ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: In British jokes, Farmer Giles often represents the unsophisticated countryman.
He was called Farmer Giles because of his simple, rustic ways.
farmer giles.meta: bu atama asosan Britaniya madaniyatida ishlatiladi va qishloq xo‘jaligi bilan shug‘ullanuvchi oddiy, soddalashgan, ba’zan qishloqning oddiy kishisi sifatida stereotipik tasvirlangan fermer ma’nosini beradi

ex: Many people are interested in buying a farmette to start organic farming.
They live on a farmette where they grow vegetables and keep a few chickens.
farmette.meta: bu kichik fermer xo‘jaligi yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi yerining kichik bir qismi. Ko‘pincha oilaviy yoki kichik hajmdagi dehqonchilik uchun ishlatiladi.Ingliz tilida bu so‘z smallholding (kichik yer maydoni) sinonimi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Many farm holders in the region rent the land from larger estates.
The farm holder was responsible for managing the crops and livestock.
farm holder.meta: dastlab fermer xo‘jaligining ijarachisi ma’nosida ishlatilgan. Keyinchalik bu so‘z yanada kengroq ma’noga ega bo‘lib, fermer xo‘jaligini egallagan yoki ijaraga olgan shaxsni bildiradi

ex: They decorated their cottage in a farmhousey style to make it feel more welcoming.
The kitchen had a warm, farmhousey feel with wooden cabinets and checkered curtains.
farmhousey.meta: bu so‘z odatda fermer uyi yoki qishloqdagi hayotni eslatuvchi narsalarni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi. Ayniqsa, oddiy, qulay, shinam yoki jozibali tarzda rustik (qishloqsifat) bo‘lgan joylar, mebel, bezak yoki muhit uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Through a farm-in deal, the investor obtained 30% of the exploration rights.
The company signed a farm-in agreement to participate in offshore oil exploration.
farm-in.meta: bu neft yoki gaz izlash huquqi berilgan hududda, investor boshqa bir kompaniya bilan kelishuv asosida loyiha xarajatlarining bir qismini qoplash evaziga qidiruv huquqidan ulush oladigan bitimdir

ex: Farmouts are common in the oil industry as a way to share exploration costs.
The company signed a farmout agreement for its offshore drilling rights.
farmout.meta: bu moliyaviy, yuridik yoki ayniqsa neft-gaz sanoati sohasida qo‘llanadigan atama bo‘lib, u faoliyat, huquq yoki aktivlar yer (uchastkasi, geologik qidiruv litsenziyasi ) ni boshqa kompaniyaga vaqtincha yoki doimiy asosda topshirishni anglatadi

ex: The farmscape includes rolling fields, red barns, and grazing cattle.
The gallery’s latest exhibit features rural farmscapes by contemporary artists.
farmscape.meta: bu ferma yoki dehqonchilik yerlari tasvirlangan san’at asari, masalan, rasm, surat, haykal yoki boshqa badiiy ifoda. Kengroq ma’noda, bu so‘z ferma atrofidagi tabiiy va sun’iy landshaft, arxitektura va tabiat bilan bog‘liq umumiy ko‘rinishni ham anglatadi

ex: (U.K.) We stopped by a local farm shop to buy fresh eggs and homemade cheese.
(U.S.) The school offers a course in farm shop where students learn welding and machinery repair.
farm shop.meta: Qishloq xo‘jaligi asbob-uskunalari va texnikalarini yasash yoki ta’mirlash uchun mo‘ljallangan ustaxona. Bu joyda ferma texnikasi, traktor qismlari, qishloq xo‘jalik mashinalari ustida ishlanadi

ex: We booked a farm stay in Tuscany to experience rural life and help with grape harvesting
The farm stay included fresh meals, animal feeding, and horseback riding.
farm stay.meta: bu dam olish turi bo‘lib, unda mehmonlar ferma yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi yerida yashab, ko‘pincha kundalik fermada olib boriladigan ishlarda (masalan, sigir sog‘ish, sabzavot terish, ot minish) qatnashadilar.Bu turizm shakli agroturizm deb ham ataladi.

ex: The farmsteader rose at dawn to tend to his crops and animals.
Many early American farmsteaders built their homes by hand and lived off the land.
farmsteader.meta: bu fermada yashaydigan va ishlaydigan odam, odatda o‘zining yerida yoki oila bilan birga yashab, dehqonchilik, chorvachilik kabi qishloq xo‘jaligi ishlari bilan shug‘ullanadi

ex: He started out playing in a farm team before joining the major league.
The farmer hitched up his farm team to plow the field.
farm team.meta: bu ferma ishlarida ishlatiladigan otlar jamoasi, ya’ni yer haydash, arava tortish yoki boshqa og‘ir qishloq xo‘jaligi ishlarida ishlatiladigan bir nechta otlardan iborat guruh

ex: Farm-to-market highways are essential for local economies.
The government invested in farm-to-market roads to help rural farmers sell their produce.
farm-to-market.meta: bu dehqonchilik bilan shug‘ullanuvchi qishloq hududini yaqin atrofdagi shahar, tuman markazi yoki bozor bilan bog‘lovchi yo‘l yoki avtomobil trassasini bildiradi

ex: He grew up in a small farmtown in the countryside.
The old farmtown included the farmhouse, barn, and several sheds.
farmtown.meta: bu fermaga tegishli yer, bino va inshootlarning yig‘indisi; ya’ni ferma hovlisi, fermer uyi va qo‘shimcha binolar birgalikda ko‘riladigan joy. So‘z hozirda biroz eski, arxaik hisoblanadi.

ex: Every feke is carefully hidden from the audience to maintain the illusion.
The magician pulled a rabbit out of his feke during the show.
feke.meta: sehrgar yoki sehrli ko‘rsatuvchi tomonidan maxsus fokus yoki hiyla ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladigan buyum yoki uskuna.

ex: Modern garbageologists study waste patterns to help improve recycling methods.
The garbageologist analyzed ancient refuse to learn about the daily life of the community.
garbageologist.meta: bu jamiyat yoki jamoani ularning tashlab yuborilgan axlatlari asosida tizimli tahlil qiluvchi antropolog yoki arxeolog. Shuningdek, ba’zan atrof-muhitga axlatning ta’siri bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassisni ham anglatadi

ex: The field of garbageology provides valuable insights into human consumption and waste patterns.
Garbageology helps researchers understand the habits and lifestyle of ancient communities.
garbageology.meta: jamiyat yoki jamoani ularning tashlab yuborilgan axlatlari orqali tizimli o‘rganish; antropologiya yoki arxeologiyaning axlatni tahlil qilish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi sohasidir

ex: The city cleaned up a large garbage patch near the river.
Ocean garbage patches are areas where floating plastic debris accumulate.
garbage patch.meta: ishlatilmayotgan yer maydoni bo‘lib, unga keraksiz materiallar, chiqindilar tashlanadi; shuningdek, begona va begona chiqindilar bilan to‘ldirilgan bo‘sh yoki qoldiq yer maydoni

ex: The garbhagriha houses the main deity of the temple.
The priest entered the garbhagriha to perform the ritual.
garbhagriha.meta: ibodatxonadagi ichki muqaddas xona (ayniqsa hind ibodatxonalarida), odatda bitta eshik va derazalarsiz bo‘ladi, va bu yerda ibodatxona bag‘ishlangan xudoning haykali yoki tasviri joylashgan

ex: Garbure is a hearty dish perfect for cold winter days.
We enjoyed a hot bowl of garbure during our trip to southern France.
garbure.meta: janubiy Fransiya va shimoli-sharqiy Ispaniyadan kelib chiqqan an’anaviy qalin sho‘rva yoki go‘shtli pishloq, odatda unda jambon (cho'chqa go‘shti), karam va turli sabzavotlar ishlatiladi

ex: The stem shows upward gravitropic movement against gravity.
Roots exhibit gravitropic growth by growing downward into the soil.
gravitropic.meta: o‘simliklarning qismlari (ildizlari, novdalari va boshqalar) tortishish kuchiga javoban pastga yoki yuqoriga o‘sishini ifodalovchi; gravitropizmga oid yoki uni namoyon qiluvchi.

ex: Gravitropism causes roots to grow downward and stems to grow upward.
The plant’s gravitropism helps it orient itself correctly in the soil.
gravitropism.meta: o‘simliklarning qismlari (ildiz, novda va boshqalar) yer tortishish kuchiga javoban pastga yoki yuqoriga o‘sishi; geotropizm deb ham ataladi.

ex: Hindi-Urdu is spoken by millions of people across South Asia.
The movie was made in Hindi-Urdu to reach a wider audience.
hindi–urdu.meta: Hindi va Urdu tillari birgalikda ko‘riladigan yoki yagona til yoki guruh sifatida qaraladigan til. Shuningdek, Hindi va Urdu tillarining kelib chiqqan umumiy tili; ya’ni Hindustani tiliga teng.

ex: The Hindko dialects vary across different regions.
Hindko is spoken by many people in northern Pakistan.
hindko.meta: Shimoliy Pokistonda Hindki xalqlari tomonidan so‘zlanadigan Lahnda guruhiga oid dialektlar yoki lahjalar to‘plami; shuningdek, Hindki so‘zining sinonimi

ex: The architecture shows Hinduish influences.
The festival has many Hinduish traditions and rituals.
hinduish.meta: hind xalqlari yoki hinduizmga oid, unga tegishli yoki unga o‘xshash

ex: His beliefs are strongly Hinduistic in nature.
The temple has many Hinduistic symbols and motifs.
hinduistic.meta: Hind xalqlari yoki hinduizmga taalluqli yoki uning xarakterli xususiyatlarini ifodalovchi.

ex: The celebration was a reflection of their deep sense of Hinduness.
She embraces her Hinduness with pride and devotion.
hinduness.meta: biror kishining hindu ekanligini, uning diniy, madaniy yoki etnik jihatdan hinduizmga oidligini ifodalovchi holat.

ex: He traced his ancestry back to the rulers of Hindustan.
Hindustan was once the common language of traders and poets across northern India.
hindustan.meta: Hindustan tili — Janubiy Osiyoning shimoliy hududlarida tarqalgan, hind va urdu tillarining umumiy ajdodi hisoblangan indo-ariy til. Tarixan lingua franca (umumiy aloqa tili) sifatida ishlatilgan. Hozirda kam ishlatiladi

ex: No other word quite captures the hiraeth he feels for his homeland.
After moving abroad, she often felt hiraeth for the hills and songs of her childhood.
hiraeth.meta: (asosan Uels va uels madaniyati kontekstida) yo‘qolgan yoki uzoqda bo‘lgan odam, joy yoki narsaga nisbatan chuqur sog‘inish, ichki sog‘inch va nostalgiya hissi; qaytmas narsani orzu qilish bilan bog‘liq ma’yus va yurakni ezadigan tuyg‘u

ex: She dreamed of sleeping in an elegant lit bateau with carved wooden panels.
The guest room was furnished with a 19th-century French lit bateau.
lit bateau.meta: bosh va oyoq tomonlarida qayiqning burun qismini eslatuvchi baland va egri shakldagi ramkalari bo‘lgan, odatda nafis ko‘rinishga ega to‘shak turi. Bu to‘shak fransuz uslubidagi interyerlarda keng tarqalgan bo‘lib, "qayiq to‘shak" deb ham ataladi

ex: There was no mal-intent behind her words.
He was accused of acting with mal-intent.
mal-intent.meta: bu atama birovga zarar yetkazish, jinoyat sodir etish yoki yomon ish qilish niyatini anglatadi. Bu yovuzlik bilan bog‘liq, qasddan zarar yetkazishga yo‘naltirilgan harakat yoki fikrni bildiradi. Huquqiy va kundalik kontekstlarda ishlatiladi

ex: Each ordu included not only families but also craftsmen and merchants.
The khan’s ordu moved westward during the summer grazing season.
ordu.meta: Markaziy Osiyodagi mo‘g‘ullar va turkiy xalqlar orasida ko‘chmanchi guruhlar tomonidan foydalanilgan, ko‘chma yashash va faoliyat yuritish uchun mo‘ljallangan lager yoki qarorgohdir

ex: The slower the rise of the bubbles, the more elegant the perlage appears.
The fine perlage in this champagne indicates a high-quality secondary fermentation.
perlage.meta: shampan, gazlangan sharob yoki boshqa shampansimon ichimliklar yuzasida to‘planadigan mayda pufakchalar yig‘indisi. Bu ko‘rinish ichimlikning sifat belgisi bo‘lib, ko‘p hollarda uning tayyorlanish usuli va tarkibidagi tabiiy karbonat angidridga bog‘liq

ex: A plant-based laboratory was set up to test the materials onsite.
A plant-based diet excludes meat, dairy, and eggs.
plant-based.meta: Zavodga asoslangan — zavod yoki sanoat korxonasi negizida tashkil etilgan, joylashgan yoki u bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi,

ex: The candidate was accused of quilling after reports emerged of free drinks being distributed before the election,
In the 18th century, quilling was a common tactic used by candidates to influence voters.
quilling.meta: saylovchilarning ovozini olish maqsadida ularga spirtli ichimliklar bepul taqdim etish orqali pora berish amaliyoti; shuningdek, ushbu spirtli ichimlikni iste’mol qilish harakati.

ex: During Navratri, people perform raas garba in colorful costumes.
Raas garba is a vibrant traditional dance from Gujarat that combines movements from both garba and dandiya raas.
raas garba.meta: Gujaratliklar orasida mashhur bo‘lgan doira shaklidagi raqs bo‘lib, unda garba va dandiya raas raqslari elementlari birlashtiriladi. Bu an’anaviy raqs asosan diniy bayramlarda, ayniqsa Navratri festivalida ijro etiladi.

ex: The book tells the story of several famous sheros from history.
She is a true shero who fought bravely for her people.
shero.meta: qahramon ayol; qahramon qiz yoki ayol shaxs. Erkak qahramonga o‘xshash jasorat va fazilatga ega ayol.

ex: The two boxers gave a slobberknocker of a fight that lasted all ten rounds.
He is known as a real slobberknocker on the football field, always tackling hard.
slobberknocker.meta: ayniqsa agressiv o‘yin uslubiga ega Amerika futbolchisi. Shuningdek, bu so‘z zo‘r jismoniy kurash yoki urush holatini ifodalash uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The slobberiness of his work caused many problems.
There was noticeable slobberiness in the way the project was managed.
slobberiness.meta: dangasa yoki beparvo bo‘lish sifati, holati yoki fakt; tartibsizlik va dangasalik.

ex: His constant slobbing made the place quite unpleasant.
The dog was slobbing all over the floor.
slobbing.meta: so‘lak to‘kilishi yoki so‘laklanish holati; asosan Amerika ingliz tilidagi og‘zaki ifoda. Shuningdek, dangasalik yoki beparvolikni ifodalash uchun ham ishlatilishi mumkin.

ex: The coach gave a spiriting talk before the game.
His speech was truly spiriting and motivated the whole team.
spiriting.meta: ruh beradi; ilhomlantiruvchi, ruhlantiruvchi yoki qalbni ko‘taruvchi sifat. Bu so‘z odamda ijobiy ruhiy holat, kuch yoki ishtiyoq uyg‘otadigan narsalarni ifodalaydi. (Qiyoslash uchun: dispiriting — ruh tushiruvchi, umidsizlantiruvchi.)

ex: Spiriting is often seen as a divine act of giving life or inspiration.
The spiriting of the community by the leader gave them new hope.
spiriting.meta: Kimnidir ilohiy ruh yoki hayotiy ruh bilan to‘ldirish, ruh berish harakati yoki holati.

ex: The team played spiritly throughout the match.
She danced spiritly across the stage.
Though rare now, the word spiritly once described things related to the spirit.
The ancient text describes a spiritly presence in the sacred grove.
spiritly.meta: Ruhga o‘xshash yoki ruhiy tabiatga ega bo‘lgan, ruhga xos xususiyatlarni bildiruvchi.

ex: The spiritus of the community inspired everyone.
Many believe that the spiritus leaves the body at death.
spiritus.meta: tirik mavjudotlarda harakatlantiruvchi yoki hayot beruvchi printsip; ruh, jon yoki hayot kuchi.

ex: Early philosophers spoke about the spiritus mundi as the force shaping nature and life.
The spiritus mundi is believed to connect all living things on Earth.
spiritus mundi.meta: “dunyo ruhi”: qadimgi faylasuflar tomonidan dunyoni shakllantiruvchi yoki uning asosida turgan printsip deb hisoblangan tushuncha. Bu tushuncha anima mundi (dunyo jonlanishi) va world-spirit (dunyo ruhi) bilan bog‘liq

ex: The writer’s work expresses a deep topophilia for the natural landscape.
Many people develop a strong topophilia for their hometowns.
topophilia.meta: ma'lum bir joyga yoki jismoniy muhitga bo‘lgan sevgi yoki hissiy bog‘lanish.

ex: Some human emotions are so complex that they are almost unfathomable.
The detective tried to unfathom the mysterious disappearance.
unfathom.meta: sirli, chalkash yoki murakkab narsani tushunib bo‘lmaslik, anglab bo‘lmaslik; sirni, muammoni yechimini topolmaslik

ex: Vot are you doing?
Vot is this?
vot.meta: savol so‘zi yoki aniqlovchi so‘z bo‘lib, narsani yoki odamni so‘rashda ishlatiladi, “nima” degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ingliz tilidagi what so‘zining ekvivalenti.

ex: The legislative process included a long vote-a-rama with dozens of consecutive votes.
After the debate ended, the Senate entered a vote-a-rama session to decide on all remaining amendments.
vote-a-rama.meta: AQSh Senatida byudjet rezolyutsiyasining rasmiy munozarasi uchun belgilangan vaqt tugagandan keyin o‘tkaziladigan ovoz berish sessiyasi. Bu sessiyada qolgan tuzatishlar va takliflarga ovoz beriladi.

ex: He graduated from the local Vo-Tech
She attended a Vo-Tech school to learn automotive repair.
vo-tech.meta: AQSh va Kanadada o‘quvchilarni kasbga tayyorlash va texnik bilim berishga ixtisoslashgan litsey yoki o‘rta maktab. Bunday maktabda o‘quvchilar amaliy kasb-hunar ko‘nikmalarini va texnik ta’limni olishadi.

ex: The candidate is very vote-wise and knows how to appeal to the voters.
Vote-wise, the party has improved its strategy this election.
vote-wise.meta: Saylovda ovozlarni qanday yutish yoki qozonish haqida bilimli yoki tushuncha ega bo‘lgan.

ex: The policy is popular vote-wise, but controversial in other respects.
Vote-wise, the candidate performed better than expected.
vote-wise.meta: Ovozlar bilan bog‘liq yoki ovozlar nuqtai nazaridan bo‘lgan. Kam ishlatiladi.

ex: She lit a votive candle in front of the altar to pray for her family.
The church was full of votive candles, each representing a prayer or wish.
votive candle.meta: Ibodat yoki duo ramzi sifatida yoqiladigan, odatda oq yoki rangsiz mumdan yasalgan kichik sham. Ko‘pincha diniy tasvir yoki muqaddas joy oldida yoqiladi.Yana bir ma’nosi — istak, umid yoki minnatdorlik ifodasi sifatida yoqiladigan sham.

ex: In some parts of South Africa, people use the earth from ant heaps to build walls.
The children found an ant heap in the garden and watched the ants working.
ant heap.meta: (a) Murg‘aklar tomonidan qilingan tuproq va boshqa materiallardan tashkil topgan kichik to‘planma yoki tepalik. (b) (Asosan Janubiy Afrika hududida) murg‘ak uylarini tashkil etuvchi tuproq va boshqa materiallar, ayniqsa qurilishda ishlatilganda.

ex: Some ant plants provide nectar to feed the ants that live inside them.
The ant plant has hollow stems where ants live and protect it from herbivores.
ant plant.meta: Maxsus tuzilmalarga ega bo‘lib, murg‘aklarga boshpana beradigan va ba’zan ularga oziqa taqdim etadigan o‘simliklarning har qanday turi; myrmecophyte deb ham ataladi

ex: Every assemblyperson has the right to vote on the legislation.
The assemblyperson proposed a new law to improve education.
assemblyperson.meta: Qonun chiqaruvchi majlis yoki parlament a’zosi; erkak yoki ayol vakil.

ex: The assemblywoman was elected to represent her district in the legislature.
The assemblywoman spoke passionately about women’s rights.
assemblywoman.meta: Qonun chiqaruvchi majlis yoki parlament a’zosi bo‘lgan ayol.

ex: Banana bread is a popular sweet treat in many countries.
She baked a delicious banana bread using overripe bananas.
banana bread.meta: (a) Banan unidan tayyorlangan non (zamonaviyda kam ishlatiladi). (b) Asosiy tarkibida ezilgan banan bo‘lgan shirin, kekga o‘xshash non.

ex: She baked a delicious banana bread for breakfast.
In old recipes, banana bread was made using banana flour.
