banana bread.meta: (a) Banan unidan tayyorlangan non (endilikda kam ishlatiladi) (b) Bosh ingredient sifatida ezilgan banan ishlatiladigan shirin, pirogga o‘xshash non

ex: Banana cake is delicious and easy to bake at home.
She made a moist banana cake for the party.
banana cake.meta: Banan asosiy tarkibiy qism bo‘lgan turli xil kekslar; ayniqsa, pishirishdan oldin aralashmaga ezilgan banan qo‘shilgan keks

ex: Banana cake is delicious when served with cream.
She baked a moist banana cake for the party.
banana cake.meta: Tarkibida banan asosiy ingredient bo‘lgan turli xil tortlar; ayniqsa, pishirishdan oldin ezilgan banan qo‘shilgan tort

ex: Many electronics suffer from built-in obsolescence to encourage consumers to buy new models.
Built-in obsolescence reduces the lifespan of products, increasing waste.
built-in obsolescence.meta: Ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulot ma’lum bir muddat ishlatilgach, qasddan ishlamas holga kelishi, eskirishi yoki talabga javob bermasligi uchun yaratilishi jarayoni yoki amaliyoti.

ex: Built-in obsolescence is criticized for increasing waste and consumer costs.
Many electronic devices suffer from built-in obsolescence to encourage consumers to buy new models.
built-in obsolescence.meta: Mahsulot ishlab chiqarishda maqsadli ravishda cheklangan muddatdan so‘ng ishlamay qolishi, eskirishi yoki kerakmas holga kelishi uchun mo‘ljallangan jarayon yoki amaliyot.

ex: Scientists study centres of diversity to understand evolution and conservation needs.
The Amazon rainforest is known as a centre of diversity for many plant species.
centre of diversity.meta: O‘zgaruvchan bir tur yoki turlar guruhi geografik tarqalish doirasida eng katta genetik xilma-xillik namoyon bo‘ladigan hudud

ex: The centre of origin of the potato is in the Andean region of South America.
Scientists believe that Central Asia is the centre of origin for many wheat varieties.
centre of origin.meta: O‘ziga xos xususiyatlarni birinchi marta olgan deb hisoblangan o‘zgaruvchan tur yoki turlar guruhi geografik hududi, ko‘pincha uning kelib chiqqan joyi sifatida qaraladi.

ex: The discovery of Cheddar Man provided important insights into Mesolithic humans.
Cheddar Man is one of the oldest known human skeletons found in Britain.
cheddar man.meta: 1903-yilda Cheddar Gorge, Gough g‘oridan topilgan, O‘rta tosh davriga oid inson qoldiqlari — fosil skelet.

ex: Scientists have studied Cheddar Man to learn about early human life
Cheddar Man is one of the oldest known human skeletons found in Britain
cheddar man.meta: 1903 yilda Cheddar Bo‘g‘ozidagi Gof g‘orida topilgan, Mezolit davriga oid odamning fosil skeleti.

ex: Circle dances are common in many cultures as a way to celebrate together.
At the wedding, everyone joined the circle dance and held hands.
circle dance.meta: Raqschilar doira hosil qilib bajaradigan turli xil, ayniqsa an’anaviy, xalq yoki diniy raqslar.

ex: Circle dances are common in many cultures around the world.
The villagers performed a traditional circle dance at the festival.
circle dance.meta: Raqschilar doira hosil qilib bajaradigan turli (ayniqsa an’anaviy, xalq yoki diniy) raqs turlari.

ex: Cubic zirconia is popular in fashion jewelry due to its affordability and brilliance.
She bought a ring with cubic zirconia instead of a real diamond.
cubic zirconia.meta: Kubik shaklidagi kristallangan tsirkoniya (tsirkoniy dioksidi) — taqinchoqlarda olmosga o‘xshash, ammo arzonroq muqobil sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Cubic zirconia is often mistaken for real diamonds.
She wore earrings made of cubic zirconia.
cubic zirconia.meta: Geometriyada yoki kristall strukturada uch o‘lchamli (uzunlik, kenglik, balandlik) shaklga ega bo‘lgan narsalarni ifodalaydi

ex: The company cut a cheque to settle the contractor’s invoice.
He cut a cheque to pay the electricity bill.
to cut a cheque.meta: Biror narsani to‘lash uchun chek yozish yoki to‘lov qilish; keng ma’noda esa pul to‘lash.

ex: They cut a cheque to cover the medical expenses.
The company cut a cheque for $5,000 to pay the supplier.
to cut a cheque.meta: ingliz tilida kimdandir biror tovar yoki xizmat uchun pul to‘lashi uchun chek yozish (yoki to‘ldirish) degan ma’noni bildiradi. Bu, keng ma’noda, kimdirdan pul to‘lash degan tushunchani ham anglatadi.

ex: They cut him a cheque as a reimbursement for travel expenses.
The company cut her a cheque for the work she completed.
to cut (a person) a cheque.meta: Biror shaxsga to‘lash uchun chek yozish yoki to‘lov qilish; keng ma’noda esa kimgadir pul to‘lash.

ex: They cut her a cheque to cover the travel expenses.
The company cut him a cheque for his freelance work.
to cut (a person) a cheque.meta: bu biror kishiga pul to‘lovi sifatida chek yozish yoki to‘ldirishni bildiradi. Bu ibora ko‘pincha korporativ yoki rasmiy moliyaviy kontekstda ishlatiladi.

ex: The edit room is equipped with the latest software and editing tools.
The director spent hours working in the edit room to finalize the film.
edit room.meta: Montaj ishlarining olib boriladigan xonasi; ayniqsa, kino yoki televidenie studiyasida filmlar yoki dasturlarni tahrir qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan xona; kesish xonasi

ex: Software with high editability is preferred for collaborative projects.
The editability of the document allows users to make changes easily.
editability.meta: Biror narsaning tahrir qilinishi yoki o‘zgartirilishi mumkin bo‘lgan darajasi yoki sifati.

ex: The editing room is equipped with the latest technology for video production.
The director spent all day in the editing room perfecting the movie.
editing room.meta: Montaj yoki tahrir ishlari olib boriladigan xona; ayniqsa, kino yoki televidenie studiyasida filmlar yoki dasturlarni tahrir qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan xona.

ex: Editing out background noise improved the audio quality of the recording.
The director was careful with the editing out of certain scenes to keep the story clear.
editing out.meta: Matn, film, audio yoki video yozuvdan tahrir qilish yo‘li bilan keraksiz yoki ortiqcha materialni olib tashlash.

ex: She was appointed editor-at-large because of her extensive experience in journalism.
The editor-at-large writes articles on various topics for the magazine.
editor-at-large.meta: Gazeta, jurnal yoki shunga o‘xshash nashr uchun keng doirada maqolalar yozuvchi yoki tahrir qiluvchi, odatda ma’lum bir bo‘limga bog‘lanmagan, yuqori lavozimdagi muharrir.

ex: She works as an editorial writer for a leading national newspaper.
The editorial writer expressed strong opinions about the new policy.
editorial writer.meta: Gazeta, jurnal yoki shunga o‘xshash nashr uchun tahririy maqolalar yoki fikr bildirish maqolalari yozuvchi shaxs

ex: She has more than enough experience to handle this job.
There is more than enough food for everyone at the party.
more than enough.meta: Zarur bo‘lganidan ko‘proq miqdor yoki daraja; kerakdan ortiq. Kerakli darajadan oshib ketgan holat.

ex: She had enough time and to spare to complete the assignment early.
We have enough food and to spare for all the guests.
enough and to spare.meta: Zarur bo‘lganidan ko‘p, ortiqcha miqdor yoki darajada mavjudlik; kerakdan ortiqcha.

ex: The evidence is clear—enough said.
When the CEO resigned suddenly, enough said about the company’s future.
enough said.meta: Qo‘shimcha gapirish shart emas; natija yoki xulosa aniq va tushunarli.

ex: He bet the farm on his new business idea, risking all his savings.
Don’t bet the farm on that investment—it’s very risky.
to bet the farm.meta: Biror ishga yoki garovga hamma mol-mulkini yoki mavjud barcha narsasini xavf ostiga qo‘yish; barcha resurslarini bitta narsaga tikish.

ex: The restaurant prides itself on serving fresh ingredients from farm to table.
The farm-to-table movement promotes local food and sustainable agriculture.
from farm to table.meta: Oziq-ovqatning yetishtirilishidan tortib, iste’mol qilinishigacha bo‘lgan butun jarayon.

ex: The farmer takes good care of his farm animals to ensure healthy production.
Cows, sheep, and chickens are common farm animals.
farm animal.meta: Ferma yoki dehqonchilikda foydalanish yoki daromad olish maqsadida boqiladigan uy hayvoni; mol-mulkka o‘xshash

ex: Many young people start as farm cadets before becoming full-time farmers.
The farm cadet worked alongside experienced farmers to learn the trade.
farm cadet.meta: Amaliy tajriba orqali dehqonchilikni o‘rganayotgan shaxs; fermerlikka o‘rganuvchi shogird.

ex: Many star athletes began their careers in a farm club.
The young player was sent to the farm club to gain more experience before joining the major league team.
farm club.meta: Asosiy yirik liga jamoasi bilan shartnomasi bor futbolchilar yoki sportchilarning qo‘shimcha tayyorgarlik va rivojlanish uchun yuborilgan kichik liga jamoasi.

ex: I love the farm-fresh taste of these vegetables.
They sell farm-fresh eggs at the local market every morning.
farm-fresh.meta: Oziq-ovqat, ichimlik yoki ta’m juda yangi yoki yangi singari ta’mlarga ega bo‘lgan, go‘yo bevosita fermadan kelgan.

ex: The farm horse helped the farmer plough the fields.
Farm horses are strong and patient animals bred for hard work.
farm horse.meta: Qoradori ishlari, tortish yoki boshqa ferma ishlarida foydalaniladigan ot; bunday ishlar uchun maxsus boqilgan ot turi.

ex: She sells fresh vegetables at the local farm market every Saturday.
Prices in the farm market have been affected by recent droughts.
farm market.meta: (a) Qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlarini tijorat yo‘li bilan sotib olish va sotish bilan bog‘liq iqtisodiy soha. (b) Dehqonlar yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi mahsulotlari uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus bozor.

ex: All the records were kept in the farm office.
She manages the finances from the small farm office near the barn.
farm office.meta: (a) (Eskirgan) Ferma hududidagi yordamchi binolar, masalan, ombor, to‘nka yoki boshqa xo‘jalik binolari. (b) Fermer xo‘jaligida hujjatlar yuritish, rejalashtirish va boshqaruv ishlari olib boriladigan idora yoki xona.

ex: The farm park includes a cafe, a nature trail, and a petting zoo.
We took the children to a farm park last weekend where they could feed animals.
farm park.meta: Dam olish yoki ta’limiy maqsadlarda foydalaniladigan ferma yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi yer maydoni; hozirda ayniqsa mehmonlar uchun o‘yin maydonchalari, kafelar, hayvonlarni ko‘rish joylari kabi attraksionlarga ega bo‘lgan joy

ex: These farm-raised chickens are fed a controlled diet.
Farm-raised salmon is commonly found in supermarkets.
farm-raised.meta: Hayvonlar, go‘sht, mevalar yoki sabzavotlar kabi mahsulotlarning yovvoyi tabiatda emas, balki an’anaviy fermada yetishtirilgan yoki boqilgan bo‘lishi holati.

ex: The farmer pays his farm rent at the start of every season.
In that region, farm rent is often paid partly in kind, with a portion of the harvest given to the landlord.
farm rent.meta: Qishloq xo‘jaligi yeridan yoki boshqaruv mulklaridan foydalanish uchun pul yoki moddiy to‘lov shaklida to‘lanadigan summa; Biror shaxs tomonidan yer yoki uning hosillaridan foydalanish imtiyoziga ega bo‘lish uchun belgilangan miqdorda to‘lanadigan summa

ex: This farm road connects the village with the main highway.
The farm road was muddy after the heavy rain.
farm road.meta: Ferma hududidagi yoki fermaga olib boruvchi yo‘l; ayniqsa, qishloq xo‘jaligi hududini shahar yoki aholi punktlari bilan bog‘lovchi yo‘l.

ex: He inherited a small farm room near the highlands.
In the 18th century, many families lived in farm rooms owned by landlords.
farm room.meta: (a) Asosan Shotlandiyada ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, ferma yoki dehqonchilik uchun mo‘ljallangan yer maydonini anglatadi. (b) Ijaraga olingan xona yoki ijaraga berilgan ko‘chmas mulk (kam ishlatiladigan yoki tarixiy ma’no).

ex: The farm school was established to educate the children of seasonal workers.
My grandmother studied in a small farm school in her village.
farm school.meta: Odatda fermer tomonidan o‘z yerida qurilgan, qishloq xo‘jaligi ishchilarining bolalariga boshlang‘ich ta’lim berish uchun mo‘ljallangan maktab.

ex: She used farmer cheese in the pie for a rich, creamy texture.
Farmer cheese is perfect for making blintzes or cheesecakes.
farmer cheese.meta: Kottaj pishlog‘iga o‘xshash usulda tayyorlanadigan, ammo biroz siqilib, zichroq va maydalanuvchan tuzilma oladigan, yetilmagan oq pishloq turi.

ex: He trained hard to improve his performance in the farmer’s walk.
The farmer’s walk is one of the toughest events in strongman competitions.
farmer’s walk.meta: Kuch va chidamlilik musobaqalarida ishtirokchilar har bir qo‘lda og‘ir yukni ushlab, imkon qadar uzoq yoki tez yurishga harakat qiladigan mashq yoki bellashuv.

ex: The farmhouse sink is perfect for washing large pots and pans.
Many rustic kitchens feature a farmhouse sink for its practicality and charm.
farmhouse sink.meta: (a) Ferma oshxonasida joylashgan yuvish idishi; (b) Asosan Shimoliy Amerika va Avstraliyada keng tarqalgan, odatda to‘rtburchak shaklida, chuqur va old qismi vertikal bo‘lgan, stol ustining chetidan biroz chiqib turuvchi yuvinish idishi turi.

ex: She decorated her kitchen in a cozy farmhouse-style.
The living room has a farmhouse-style charm with wooden furniture and rustic decor.
farmhouse-style.meta: Ferma uylariga xos bo‘lgan yoki ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan uslub, ya’ni oddiy, tabiiy va amaliy dizayn xususiyatlari.

ex: They bought a farmhouse table for their kitchen to create a warm and rustic atmosphere.
farmhouse table.meta: Ferma uylarida oshxona yoki ovqatlanish uchun ishlatiladigan stol; odatda katta va yog‘ochdan tayyorlangan, rustik (qishloqcha) uslubda bo‘lgan stol.

ex: Historians often study the First Fleet to understand the beginnings of European settlement in Australia.
The First Fleet arrived in Australia in 1788 to establish a penal colony.
first fleet.meta: 1788 yilda Avstraliyaga kelgan va u yerda jazoni koloniyalarini tashkil qilgan oʻn birta Britaniya kemalaridan iborat guruh. Bu kemalar birinchi Yevropa qishloqlarining asoschisidir.

ex: His new haircut looks as ugly as a box of frogs!
That old car is as ugly as a box of frogs.
as ugly as a box of frogs.meta: Bu ifoda juda jirkanch yoki yoqimsiz ko‘rinishni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi, odatda hazil yoki kuchli ta’rif sifatida.

ex: That idea is as mad as a box of frogs!
He's as mad as a box of frogs—nobody knows what he'll do next.
as mad as a box of frogs.meta: Bu ifoda to‘liq aqldan ozgan yoki juda g‘alati, oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan xatti-harakatlarga moyil odamni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Catfish used to be considered a garbage fish, but now it's widely eaten.
Fishermen often throw back garbage fish because they have no market value
garbage fish.meta: Oziq-ovqat yoki tijorat qiymati past bo‘lgan, odamlar odatda yeymaydigan yoki bozorda arzon bahoga baholanadigan baliq turi. Bunday baliqlar ko‘pincha tasodifan tutiladi va istalmagan hisoblanadi.

ex: He has a real garbage mouth when he's angry.
Don't talk like that—you sound like a garbage mouth!
garbage mouth.meta: Doimiy ravishda haqoratli, so‘kinchi yoki yomon so‘zlarni ishlatadigan odam. Bu atama kinoyali yoki laqab sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: His garbage-mouthed rants offended many people.
She was known for being garbage-mouthed during arguments.
garbage-mouthed.meta: Ko‘p hollarda qo‘pol, haqoratli yoki so‘kinchi so‘zlar ishlatadigan odamga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan sifat. Bu odamlar og‘zidan yomon so‘zlar tez-tez chiqadi.

ex: Most of his points came during garbage time when the game was already decided.
They put in the bench players during garbage time.
garbage time.meta: O‘yinning yakuniga yaqin bo‘lgan, natija deyarli aniq bo‘lgan davr. Bu paytda asosiy o‘yinchilar dam oladi yoki zaxira o‘yinchilar maydonga tushadi, chunki o‘yin taqdiri deyarli o‘zgarmaydi.

ex: The old garbage tin was rusty and needed replacing.
He took the garbage out and threw it into the garbage tin outside
garbage tin.meta: Uy-ro‘zg‘or chiqindilarini saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan, odatda metall (temir) materialdan tayyorlangan idish yoki quti. Bu chiqindilarni vaqtincha yig‘ish uchun ishlatiladi

ex: The actor was invited to guest-edit the summer issue of the fashion magazine.
She will guest-edit a special edition focused on environmental issues.
guest-edit.meta: Gazeta, jurnal yoki dasturning bir soni uchun doimiy bo‘lmagan, taklif etilgan shaxs sifatida vaqtincha muharrirlik qilish. Bu odatda taniqli yoki soha mutaxassisi bo‘lgan mehmon tomonidan amalga oshiriladi

ex: She will guest-edit a special edition of the newspaper focusing on climate change.
The famous author was invited to guest-edit the summer issue of the magazine.
guest-edit.meta: gazetа, jurnal yoki televizion/radiodasturning bitta soni yoki epizodi uchun mehmon sifatida vaqtincha muharrirlik qilish. Bu ishni odatda taniqli shaxslar, yozuvchilar yoki mutaxassislar bajaradi.

ex: The famous author was the guest editor of the magazine’s anniversary issue.
As a guest editor, she focused on stories about social justice.
guest editor.meta: (Odatda taniqli shaxs yoki mutaxassis bo‘lgan) biror kishining gazeta, jurnal yoki dasturning faqat bitta soni uchun tahririy materiallarni tanlash va boshqarish uchun taklif etilgan shaxs.

ex: The magazine features a new guest editor every month.
A famous scientist was invited to be the guest editor of the environmental issue.
guest editor.meta: gazeta, jurnal yoki tele/radiodasturning bitta soni yoki epizodi uchun maxsus taklif etilgan, odatda taniqli yoki nufuzli shaxs bo‘lgan, vaqtincha muharrirlik vazifasini bajarayotgan shaxs

ex: They built a guest wing to accommodate visiting relatives.
The guest wing includes two bedrooms and a private bathroom.
guest wing.meta: Uyda mehmonlarni joylashtirish uchun mo‘ljallangan alohida qism yoki qanot. Bu hudud odatda yotoqxonalar, hammom va ba’zida mehmonlar uchun maxsus qulayliklarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: They built a separate guest wing for visiting relatives.
The guest wing is located on the east side of the house.
guest wing.meta: uyning mehmonlarni joylashtirish uchun mo‘ljallangan, alohida qismi yoki qanoti. Odatda, bu hududda mehmonlar uchun yotoqxona, hammom va ba’zida kichik yashash xonasi bo‘ladi

ex: Hell money is an important part of some Chinese ancestor rituals.
At the funeral, the family burned hell money to honor their ancestors.
hell money.meta: Xitoy madaniyatida marhumlarga bag‘ishlab, o‘liklar dunyosida ishlatilsin deb o‘tilgan marosimlarda yoki festivalda yoqiladigan soxta qog‘oz pullar

ex: She is a fluent Hindi speaker.
This is a Hindi speaker community.
hindi speaker.meta: Noun: Hind tilida so‘zlashuvchi odam. Adjective: Hind tiliga oid yoki hind tilida gapiradigan.

ex: She belongs to a Hindi-speaking family.
This is a Hindi-speaking region of India.
hindi-speaking.meta: Adjective: Hind tilida gapiradigan, hind tiliga oid. Noun (rarely): Hind tilida gapiruvchi odam yoki jamoa.

ex: Many Hindi belt residents speak different dialects of Hindi.
The Hindi belt covers states like Uttar Pradesh and Bihar.
hindi belt.meta: Hindiston shimolida joylashgan va unda hind tili hamda uning dialektlari asosiy til sifatida gapiriladigan hudud.

ex: The culture of the Hindi heartland has a strong influence on Indian traditions.
The Hindi heartland includes states like Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan.
hindi heartland.meta: Hindiston shimolida joylashgan va unda hind tili hamda uning dialektlari asosiy til sifatida keng tarqalgan hudud.

ex: Many festivals in India follow the Hindu calendar.
The Hindu calendar is used to determine the date of Diwali.
The Hindu trinity symbolizes creation, preservation, and destruction.
Trimurti is a central concept in Hindu theology.
hindu trinity.meta: Hinduizmda eng muhim uchta xudoning — Brahma (yaratuvchi), Vishnu (saqlovchi), va Shiva (yo‘q qiluvchi) — birgalikda oliy xudo Brahmanning turli qirralari sifatida qaraladigan tushunchasi

ex: The Hinduization of certain regions affected local customs and traditions.
Hinduization often involves adopting rituals and festivals.
hinduization.meta: Hindu xususiyatlari, madaniyati yoki dinini qabul qilish jarayoni; hindu bo‘lib borish holati yoki sharoiti.

ex: The festival became more Hinduized with time.
The region was Hinduized over several centuries.
hinduized.meta: Hindu xususiyatlariga ega qilinadigan yoki hind madaniyati, diniyati bilan yanada yaqqolroq ifodalangan holatga keltirilgan

ex: Hinduizing the region took many years.
The Hinduizing influence on local customs was strong.
hinduizing.meta: Sifat: Hind xususiyatlarini qo‘shadigan yoki hind shaklini beradigan. Ot: Hind bo‘lish yoki nimanidir hindlashtirish jarayoni yoki harakati.

ex: Human milk banks play a vital role in neonatal care.
The hospital has a human milk bank to help premature babies.
human milk bank.meta: Emizikli onalar tomonidan berilgan ona sutini yig‘ib, saqlab, asosan erta tug‘ilgan yoki ona suti bilan emizib bo‘lmaydigan chaqaloqlarga kasalxonada berish uchun mo‘ljallangan joy

ex: The children were in hysterics during the comedy show.
She was in hysterics after hearing the funny joke
in hysterics.meta: Nazorat qilib bo‘lmaydigan, juda kuchli va to‘xtovsiz kulish holati.

ex: Hysterorrhaphy was performed to correct uterine prolapse.
The surgeon explained the process of hysterorrhaphy to the patient.
hysterorrhaphy.meta: (a) G‘urdog‘ni normalroq holatga qaytarish uchun uni atrofdagi to‘qimalarga jarrohlik yo‘li bilan mahkamlash operatsiyasi (histeropeksiya deb ham ataladi; hozir kam qo‘llaniladi). (b) G‘urdog‘ni jarrohlik usulida tikish

ex: Hysterosalpingogram is a common diagnostic tool in fertility clinics.
The doctor reviewed the hysterosalpingogram to check for blockages.
hysterosalpingogram.meta: G‘urdog‘ va tuxumdon naylarini tekshirish uchun radiosalpingografiya yordamida olingan tasvir yoki tasvirlar to‘plami.

ex: The doctor recommended hysterosalpingography to evaluate fertility issues.
Hysterosalpingography is used to detect blockages in the fallopian tubes.
hysterosalpingography.meta: G‘urdog‘ bo‘shlig‘i va tuxumdon naylarini rentgen yordamida, rentgen kontrasti moddasini kiritish orqali tekshirish usuli.

ex: Hysteroscope was once used to listen to fetal heart sounds but is now mostly replaced by ultrasound.
The doctor used a hysteroscope to examine the uterine cavity.
hysteroscope.meta: (a) G‘urdog‘ ichidagi chaqaloq yuragi tovushi yoki boshqa tovushlarni tinglash uchun ishlatilgan eski tibbiy asbob (hozir kam ishlatiladi). (b) G‘urdog‘ bo‘shlig‘ini ko‘zdan kechirish uchun ishlatiladigan zamonaviy tibbiy asbob.

ex: Hysteroscopic surgery is minimally invasive and uses a small camera.
The doctor performed a hysteroscopic examination to investigate the uterine cavity.
hysteroscopic.meta: G‘urdog‘skop yoki g‘urdog‘ni ko‘zdan kechirish (gisteroskopiya) orqali amalga oshiriladigan yoki unga tegishli.

ex: The patient underwent hysteroscopy to remove uterine polyps.
Hysteroscopy is used to diagnose abnormal uterine bleeding.
hysteroscopy.meta: G‘urdog‘ni g‘urdog‘skop yordamida tekshirish yoki davolash; g‘urdog‘ endoskopiyasi yoki endoskopik jarrohlik; ushbu jarayonning bir holati.

ex: That was an inside joke only we at the office understand.
They laughed at the inside joke that no one else got.
inside joke.meta: Faqat ma’lum bir odamlar yoki guruh tomonidan tushuniladigan, faqat ular orasida kulgili bo‘lgan hazil.

ex: They always make inside jokes from their college days.
Everyone laughed, but I didn’t get it — must have been an inside joke.
inside joke.meta: faqat ma’lum bir guruh (masalan, do‘stlar, hamkasblar yoki oilaviy a’zolar) tomonidan tushuniladigan hazil. Bu hazil odatda umumiy tajriba, sirli voqea yoki ichki kelishuvga asoslanadi

ex: The leopard seal is one of the top predators in the Antarctic waters.
Leopard seals have a spotted coat that helps them camouflage in the icy environment.
leopard seal.meta: Antarktika hududida yashovchi, katta va kulrang rangdagi morj, Hydrurga leptonyx ilmiy nomi bilan ataladi. Teri yuzasida dog‘-dog‘ naqshlar bo‘lib, asosan pingvinlar va boshqa morjlar bilan oziqlanadi.

ex: Leopard seals have powerful jaws and sharp teeth for hunting penguins.
The leopard seal is one of the top predators in the Antarctic ecosystem.
leopard seal.meta: Antarktika hududida yashovchi yirik, kulrang rangli, dog‘-dog‘li mo‘ynali yirtqich tyulen turi. Uning ilmiy nomi Hydrurga leptonyx. Ushbu tyulen asosan pingvinlar, baliqlar va hatto boshqa tyulenlar bilan oziqlanadi

ex: An MBI often brings fresh leadership and strategic change.
The company was acquired through an MBI led by a group of former executives.
mbi.meta: Tashqi boshqaruv jamoasi kompaniyaning asosiy ulushini sotib olib, uni boshqarishni o‘z zimmasiga oladigan jarayon.

ex: Modern roundabouts reduce the likelihood of serious accidents.
The city replaced a dangerous intersection with a modern roundabout.
modern roundabout.meta: Bir nechta yo‘llar tutashgan, markazida odatda aylana shaklidagi orolcha bo‘lgan, transport vositalari faqat bitta yo‘nalishda harakatlanadigan, harakat xavfsizligini oshirish va oqimini tartibga solish uchun mo‘ljallangan zamonaviy yo‘l kesishmasi

ex: I want to go with you — nobody else.
Nobody else knew the answer.
nobody else.meta: Oldin aytilgan shaxsdan boshqa hech qanday kishi; boshqa hech bir odam yo‘qligi ifodalanadi.

ex: I trust no one else with this secret.
No one else was invited to the meeting
no one else.meta: Faqat bitta shaxs haqida gap ketayotganini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi; undan boshqa hech qanday odam yo‘qligi bildiriladi

ex: Oat milk is a popular dairy-free alternative for coffee and cereals.
She uses oat milk instead of cow’s milk in baking.
oat milk.meta: Jo‘xori (yong‘oqsiz donga o‘xshash o‘simlik) dan tayyorlangan sutga o‘xshash suyuqlik. Bu ichimlik ko‘pincha sut mahsulotlariga o‘rinbosar sifatida, ichish yoki pishirishda ishlatiladi

ex: The umpire awarded five penalty runs to the batting team.
Penalty runs are given for unfair actions such as ball tampering.
penalty run.meta: Kriket o‘yinida raqib jamoaning qoidabuzarligi yoki adolatsiz o‘yin harakati tufayli beriladigan qo‘shimcha yugurish (ochko).

ex: In a safety squeeze, the runner waits to see the bunt before committing to home.
The team executed a perfect safety squeeze to score a run.
safety squeeze.meta: Beysbol o‘yinida uchinchi bazadagi yuguruvchi to‘p uruvchining to‘pni muvaffaqiyatli bint (yumshoq urish) qilganini kutib, shundan keyingina uy bazasiga qarab yugurishni boshlaydigan xavfsizlikka asoslangan hujum strategiyasi.

ex: The pep rally boosted the students’ school spirit before the big game.
Wearing school colors is a great way to show school spirit.
school spirit.meta: O‘quvchilar (yoki talabalarning) o‘z maktabiga bo‘lgan faxr, sadoqat va birdamlik tuyg‘usi; ayniqsa, maktabning sport jamoalari yoki tadbirlarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash orqali namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: The team lost possession because they didn’t shoot before the shot clock expired.
The shot clock was down to two seconds when he made the basket.
shot clock.meta: Ayniqsa basketbol o‘yinida ishlatiladigan taymer bo‘lib, jamoa ma’lum vaqt ichida to‘pni savatchaga yo‘llashi (zarba berishi) kerak. Bu vaqt tugasa, zarba berilmasa, to‘p raqib jamoaga o‘tadi.

ex: The team was penalized for a shot clock violation.
The shot clock was down to two seconds when he took the shot.
shot clock.meta: asosan basketbol o‘yinida ishlatiladigan taymer bo‘lib, jamoa hujum vaqtida to‘pni savatga yo‘llash (zarba berish) uchun qancha vaqt qolganini ko‘rsatadi. Bu taymer o‘yin tezligini saqlash va hujumni cho‘zmaslik uchun ishlatiladi

ex: The actor became even more popular after turning into a silver fox.
He may be over fifty, but he’s a real silver fox.
silver fox.meta: Ko‘pincha kulrang yoki kumushrang sochli bo‘lgan, jozibador va chiroyli yoshi katta erkakni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan norasmiy ibora

ex: He embraced his grey hair and became a true silver fox.
George Clooney is often described as a silver fox.
silver fox.meta: odatda yoshi katta, lekin o‘ziga xos jozibadorlik va chiroyga ega bo‘lgan, kumush yoki kulrang sochli erkak. Bu ibora ingliz tilida erkakning yoshi ulg‘ayganiga qaramay, u hali ham jozibador ekanini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi

ex: Their conversation quickly became a slagging match with harsh insults.
The debate turned into a slagging match between the two politicians.
slagging match.meta: Odatda omma oldida yoki guruhda bo‘lib o‘tadigan, bir-biriga qarata davomli haqorat va tanqidlar almashinuvi.

ex: He got tired of all the slagging off at work.
The politician complained about the constant slagging off by the media.
slagging off.meta: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir yomonlab, haqoratlab yoki yomon gapirish harakati; ko‘pincha yomon niyat bilan yoki adolatsiz tanqid.

ex: Many talented workers were thrown on the slagheap during the restructuring.
After the scandal, the company threw him on the slagheap without any support.
to throw someone on the slagheap.meta: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir ahamiyatsiz, foydasiz deb hisoblab, hurmatsiz yoki be e’tibor tarzda rad etish yoki tashlab qo‘yish.

ex: That old jacket makes you look like a bag of spanners!
He called himself a bag of spanners after the haircut.
bag of spanners.meta: Biror kishining juda jozibasi yo‘qligini yoki noqulay ko‘rinishini ifodalovchi hazil yoki haqorat ma’nosidagi ibora.

ex: I woke up with my hair a mess and my face swollen — like a bag of spanners.
He’s got a great personality, but he looks like a bag of spanners.
bag of spanners.meta: ingliz tilidagi so‘zlashuv uslubidagi, odatda haqoratli yoki kulgili tilda ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, kimningdir tashqi ko‘rinishini juda xunuk, tartibsiz yoki g‘alati deb tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi

ex: He spent the night praying in the Spirit for guidance.
Many believers try to pray in the Spirit to feel closer to God.
to pray in the spirit.meta: Muqaddas Ruhning yo‘llanmasi yoki ilhomi bo‘yicha ibodat qilish; ba’zi nasroniy guruhlarda erkin, ruhiy ilhom bilan ibodat qilishni anglatadi.

ex: He struggled to resist the spirit of the world and stay true to his faith.
The spirit of the world often leads people away from spiritual values.
spirit of the world.meta: Dunyoviy yoki moddiy tashvishlarga berilish, bu kuch yoki tamoyil sifatida ko‘riladi, ayniqsa Xudo ruhi yoki ma’naviyat bilan solishtirilganda.

ex: Try to enter into the spirit of the meeting to get the best out of it.
Everyone entered into the spirit of the festival with songs and dances.
to enter into the spirit of.meta: Biror voqea, bayram yoki holatga chin dildan, to‘liq va shijoat bilan qo‘shilish, ishtirok etish.

ex: The eagle is often seen as a powerful spirit animal representing freedom and vision.
Many shamans believe each person has a spirit animal that guides them through life.
spirit animal.meta: Ruhoniylik va shamanizmda, ruhiy yo‘l-yo‘riqchi yoki qo‘riqchi sifatida qaraladigan sehrli yoki g‘ayrioddiy hayvon; ramziy ma’noda insonning yo‘l-yo‘riqchi hayvoni

ex: Spirit money is often used in traditional Chinese festivals to pay respect to the spirits.
During the funeral, spirit money was burnt to honor the deceased’s ancestors.
spirit money.meta: Xitoy va unga o‘xshash madaniyatlarda diniy marosimlar va dafn marosimlarida ishlatiladigan, bezatilgan qog‘ozdan tayyorlangan soxta pul; bu pullar ajdodlarga yoki ruhlarga qurbonlik sifatida yoqiladi.

ex: Traditional Chinese homes often have a spirit screen to block direct view inside.
The spirit screen outside the gate protects the house from evil spirits.
In ancient times, spirit songs were believed to communicate with the supernatural.
The shaman sang a spirit song to call upon the ancestors.
spirit song.meta: (a) Ruh tomonidan kuylangan qo‘shiq (hozir kam ishlatiladi); (b) Ruhni chaqirish yoki unga murojaat qilish uchun, ayniqsa shamanik marosimlarda qo‘llaniladigan qo‘shiq.

ex: Spirit week helps build school pride and unity among students.
During spirit week, students participate in themed dress-up days and competitions.
spirit week.meta: O‘rta maktab, kollej yoki universitetda talabalar o‘rtasida qiziqish va jamoaviy ruhni oshirish maqsadida tashkil etilgan tadbirlar yoki faoliyatlar o‘tkaziladigan hafta.

ex: Many vitamins are spirit-soluble and require alcohol for extraction.
This dye is spirit-soluble, so it dissolves easily in alcohol.
spirit-soluble.meta: Alkogol va shunga o‘xshash organik erituvchilarda eriydigan modda yoki xususiyat.

ex: This recipe calls for spirit vinegar because of its strong acidity.
Spirit vinegar is commonly used in pickling and food preservation.
spirit vinegar.meta: Odatda nisbatan yuqori konsentratsiyadagi sirka kislota (asetik kislota) o‘z ichiga olgan tiniq sirka; ayniqsa, suyultirilgan alkogolning asetik fermentatsiyasi orqali olingan sirka turi.

ex: The spiritual healer helped him find peace and overcome his fears.
Many people visit spiritual healers to seek emotional and physical relief.
TSRs help farmers move their livestock safely across different regions.
The cattle were driven along the TSR to reach new grazing lands.
tsr.meta: Hayvonlarni uzoq masofaga ko‘chirish uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus yo‘l yoki maydon; ko‘pincha qishloq yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi hududlaridan o‘tadi.

ex: TSRs are essential for sustainable livestock movement.
Drovers used the TSR to move cattle across the outback
tsr.meta: TSR qisqartmasi ingliz tilida asosan Avstraliya kabi mamlakatlarda ishlatiladi va chorva hayvonlari uzoq masofaga haydalayotganda foydalaniladigan maxsus yo‘llar yoki ularning zaxira dam olish hududlarini anglatadi

ex: The car was racing at full tilt down the highway.
She worked at full tilt to finish the project on time.
at full tilt.meta: Eng yuqori tezlikda; maksimal kuch yoki energiya bilan; to‘liq imkoniyatda

ex: The factory is running at full tilt to meet the holiday demand.
The car was moving at full tilt down the highway.
at full tilt.meta: bu ibora biror narsa (harakat, ish, voqea) maksimal tezlikda, eng katta energiya bilan yoki to‘liq quvvatda sodir bo‘layotganini anglatadi. Harakatdagi shiddat, to‘xtovsizlik yoki kuchli intensivlikni ifodalaydi.

ex: He is an Urdu speaker and can communicate fluently.
The program offers courses for Urdu speakers.
urdu speaker.meta: Urdu tilida so‘zlaydigan shaxs; Urdu tiliga oid yoki uning bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The Urdu-speaking population is concentrated in certain regions.
She works with Urdu-speaking clients regularly.
urdu-speaking.meta: (a) Urdu tilida so‘zlaydigan shaxs yoki guruh. (b) Urdu tilida so‘zlash bilan bog‘liq yoki uning xususiyatiga ega.

ex: The Parliament passed the Vote of no Addresses in 1648 to stop petitions to King Charles I.
The Vote of no More Addresses was a significant step in the English Civil War.
vote of no (more) addresses.meta: Parlament tomonidan qabul qilingan, Qirol Charlz I ga keyingi murojaatlar va so‘rovnomalarni taqiqlovchi qaror, ayniqsa 1648-yil 17-yanvarda qabul qilingan.

ex: Vote-buying undermines the fairness of elections.
Authorities are working to prevent vote-buying during the election.
vote-buying.meta: Ovoz evaziga pora yoki boshqa rag‘batlar taklif qilish amaliyoti.

ex: Vote-fixing damages the integrity of democratic elections.
The government promised to crack down on vote-fixing.
vote-fixing.meta: Saylov jarayonini firibgarlik yo‘li bilan boshqarish, maqsad qilingan natijaga erishish uchun ovozlarni soxtalashtirish amaliyoti.

ex: Vote fraud threatens the legitimacy of elections.
Authorities investigate allegations of vote fraud.
vote fraud.meta: Ovozlar yoki saylovchilar bilan bog‘liq har qanday firibgarlik amaliyoti.

ex: Political parties focus their campaigns on vote-rich districts.
This city is a vote-rich area that can decide the election outcome.
vote-rich.meta: Saylovda ko‘plab saylovchilarga ega bo‘lgan hudud yoki demografik guruh.

ex: "Vote early and often" is not a serious recommendation, but a sarcastic comment about election fraud.
They joked that the candidate told his supporters to vote early and often.
vote early and (vote) often.meta: Saylovlarda aldash ma'nosida, ko‘p marta yoki oldindan ovoz berish degan hazilomuz yoki ironik ibora.

ex: Many consumers vote with their wallets by choosing eco-friendly products.
Voters often vote with their wallets, supporting parties that promise tax cuts.
to vote with one’s wallet.meta: O‘z moliyaviy manfaatlariga mos keladigan siyosiy partiya, siyosat yoki mahsulotni qo‘llab-quvvatlash ma’nosida pul sarflash orqali ovoz berish.

ex: Customers vote with their wallets by choosing to buy from ethical companies.
People vote with their wallets when they stop buying products from brands they don’t trust.
to vote with one’s wallet.meta: Ma’lum mahsulotlar, xizmatlar yoki yetkazib beruvchilar haqidagi fikrini nima sotib olish va qayerdan xarid qilish orqali ifodalash.

ex: The team voted the uncooperative member off the island.
The reality show contestants voted him off the island after the challenge.
to vote (a person or thing) off the isla.meta: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir rad etish, ishdan bo‘shatish yoki tashlab yuborish.

ex: The authorities are investigating allegations of voter fraud in the recent election.
Voter fraud undermines the integrity of the democratic process.
voter fraud.meta: Saylov jarayonini saylovchi tomonidan ataylab buzish, masalan, bir necha marta ovoz berish, boshqasining nomidan ovoz berish kabi firibgarlik

ex: You need to show your voter ID before casting your ballot.
The government introduced new rules requiring voter ID at polling stations.
voter id.meta: Saylovda qatnashish uchun odamning shaxsini tasdiqlovchi hujjat, odatda ovoz berish joyida taqdim etiladi; ko‘pincha fotosuratli yoki rasmiy hujjat.

ex: The election commission publishes the updated voters’ list before each election.
Before voting, make sure your name is on the voters’ list.
voters’ list.meta: Saylovlarda ovoz berish huquqiga ega bo‘lganlarning rasmiy ro‘yxati; saylovchilar ro‘yxati.

ex: The committee decided to put the proposal to voting.
The motion was put to voting at the end of the meeting.
to put (something) to voting.meta: Muayyan masalani bir guruh odamlar qaroriga havola qilish uchun uni ovoz berishga qo‘yish.

ex: The voting list must be updated before every election.
Her name was not found on the voting list.
voting list.meta: Saylovda ovoz berish huquqiga ega boʻlgan fuqarolarning rasmiy roʻyxati.

ex: There are five voting precincts in this city district.
Each voter must vote in their assigned voting precinct.
voting precinc.meta: Saylovlarni oʻtkazish maqsadida shahar yoki qishloq hududi ichida tashkil etilgan maʼlum maʼmuriy-hududiy bo‘linma.

ex: Shareholders with voting rights will decide the company’s next CEO.
Women gained full voting rights in many countries during the 20th century.
voting right.meta: (a) Saylovda ovoz berish huquqi; (b) (Biznes va moliya sohasida) Aksiya yoki ulush egasiga kompaniya yigʻinlarida qarorlar qabul qilishda ovoz berish imkonini beruvchi huquq.

ex: The inmates at the work farm grow vegetables and raise livestock.
He was sentenced to six months at a work farm for petty theft.
work farm.meta: Yengil jinoyatlar uchun jazoni o‘tayotgan mahbuslar majburiy ravishda qishloq xo‘jaligi ishlariga jalb etiladigan, odatda past darajadagi xavfsizlikka ega bo‘lgan jazoni ijro etish muassasasi.

ex: Healthcare providers should respect each patient’s affirmed sex.
She is a transgender woman and lives as her affirmed gender.
affirmed.meta: Shaxs o‘zini qanday jins yoki gender sifatida identifikatsiya qilsa, shu jins/genderni bildiruvchi atama; bu holat odatda shaxsga tug‘ilganida berilgan jinsdan farq qiladi.

ex: The term “blue duck” was once used for the northern shoveler in certain regions.
In old British texts, the blue duck is sometimes described as a sacred bird.
blue duck.meta: Tarixiy matnlarda uchraydigan, “liver bird” bilan bog‘langan va ba’zan shimoliy qoshiqburun o‘rdak sifatida talqin etilgan kamyob va eskirgan atama.

ex: Fishermen use special nets to catch demersal species that dwell near the ocean floor.
Demersal fish live close to the seabed and feed on organisms found there.
demersal.meta: Dengiz (yoki katta ko‘l) tubiga yaqin, bentik zonasining ustida joylashgan zonani ifodalovchi; ayniqsa baliqchilikda suv osti tubiga yaqin yashovchi yoki shu hududga tegishli.

ex: Demersal fishing requires different equipment than pelagic fishing.
Demersal fish like cod and haddock live near the sea floor.
demersal.meta: dengiz yoki katta ko‘lning tubiga yaqin joylashgan suv zonasiga oid bo‘lgan (bentik zonaning usti), ayniqsa baliqchilikda, suv ostining pastki qatlamlariga yaqin yashaydigan baliqlarga yoki bu qatlamda ov qilishga taalluqli.

ex: Scientists isolated eugenin from the buds of wild clove trees.
Eugenin is a bitter-tasting compound found in wild clove buds.
eugenin.meta: Yovvoyi mix daraxtining guldonlaridan ajratilgan, achchiq ta’mga ega xromon birikma.

ex: The farmerhood united to protect their lands from being taken away.
In old times, the farmerhood was responsible for maintaining irrigation systems.
farmerhood.meta: Qishloq xo‘jaligi bilan shug‘ullanuvchi odamlar — dehqonlar guruh sifatida, birgalikda. Hozirda kam ishlatiladigan, eskirgan atama.

ex: His clothes had a farmy scent after working all day in the barn.
The farmy smell of hay and animals filled the barn.
farmy.meta: Ferma yoki fermada yashash bilan bog‘liq yoki unga xos bo‘lgan; ayniqsa hid nuqtai nazaridan, ferma hayvonlari yoki go‘ng hidiga o‘xshash xususiyatga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: The old mansion was the fascinator of the town, with its mysterious history.
She was the fascinator of the evening, captivating everyone with her charm.
fascinator.meta: Juda qiziqarli, maftunkor yoki diqqatni tortadigan odam yoki narsa. Ko‘pincha of bilan yoki u qaysi kimsa yoki narsaga oidligini ko‘rsatadigan so‘z bilan ishlatiladi.

ex: The veterinarian treated the sheep for fasciola to prevent further health problems.
Fasciola infections can cause liver damage in livestock.
fasciola.meta: Zoologiyada — Fasciola turkumiga mansub jigar parazit qurtlari (trematod flatwormlar oilasi), ular turli sutemizuvchilarning jigarida oziqlanib, ko‘payadi.

ex: Stop all that garbology and speak clearly.
All that technical talk sounded like pure garbology to me.
garbology.meta: Kulgili yoki kinoyali tarzda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, mazmunsiz, bema'ni, chalkash yoki hech qanday foydali ma’lumot bermaydigan so‘zlar yoki iboralarni bildiradi. Kam ishlatiladi va ko‘proq hazil tariqasida qo‘llanadi.

ex: The Hindki community in Peshawar has preserved its traditions.
She speaks the Hindki language fluently.
hindki.meta: Etnik guruh sifatida tanilgan Hindki xalqi yoki ularning tiliga oid bo‘lgan narsa. Hindkilar asosan Pokistonning shimoli-g‘arbiy hududlarida yashovchi musulmon etnik guruh bo‘lib, ularning ona tili Hindko deb ataladi

ex: After years of spiritual searching, he began to Hinduize.
Some communities gradually Hinduized through cultural influence.
hinduize.meta: Hinduizm dinini qabul qilish, unga moslashish yoki uning e’tiqodlariga ko‘ra yashay boshlash. Bu fe’l intransitiv bo‘lib, ya’ni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri to‘ldiruvchisiz ishlatiladi

ex: She speaks Hindustani at home, but Dutch in public.
Many Hindustanis in Suriname trace their roots to India.
hindustani.meta: Surinam va Niderlandiyaliklar orasida qo‘llaniladigan atama bo‘lib, u bilan odatda Hindiston yoki Janubiy Osiyodan kelib chiqqan shaxslar nazarda tutiladi.

ex: Old steam locomotives used hosebags to refill their water tanks.
The firemen connected the hosebag to the water crane.
hosebag.meta: Suvni suv krani, suv tanki yoki boshqa manbalardan olib, odatda bug‘li lokomotivning suv tankiga yetkazish uchun ishlatiladigan keng va egiluvchan quvur. Hozirda kam ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: Hysteresis effects can complicate the prediction of economic growth.
The labor market shows hysteresis when unemployment remains high even after an economic
hysteresis.meta: Iqtisodiyotda yuzaga keladigan hodisa yoki tendentsiya bo‘lib, bunda iqtisodiy ta’sir uni yuzaga keltirgan jarayon yoki voqealardan ko‘ra uzoqroq davom etadi.

ex: The leader’s speech hystericized the crowd, causing chaos.
Media reports sometimes hystericize the public during crises.
hystericize.meta: Biror shaxs yoki ayniqsa odamlar guruhida haddan tashqari hayajon, vahima yoki xayoliy vahshiylik holatini keltirib chiqarish, ularni gisterik (hysterical) holatga solish.

ex: Researchers studied the behavior of hystricid porcupines in the wild.
The hystricid species are known for their sharp quills.
hystricid.meta: Hystricidae oilasiga mansub bo‘lgan, bu oilaga oid yoki ularning tabiati, xususiyatlari bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan g‘o‘ng‘irchoq ayiqlari (ya’ni tuyaqushga o‘xshash shishgan tikanlari bo‘lgan yovvoyi hayvonlar).

ex: The porcupine is a typical hystricomorph rodent.
Hystricomorph rodents are characterized by unique jaw muscles.
hystricomorph.meta: Sichqonlar oilasining katta guruhiga mansub bo‘lgan hayvonlarni bildiradi. Dastlab Hystricomorpha subordeni sifatida ajratilgan, hozir esa Hystricognatha subordeni sifatida tanilgan

ex: In older grammar books, the pluperfect was sometimes called the pluterperfect.
Pluterperfect tense is an obsolete term for the pluperfect tense.
pluterperfect.meta: Grammatikada o‘tmishdan oldingi zamon ma’nosini bildiruvchi so‘z. Hozirda bu atama pluperfect so‘zi bilan almashtirilgan va kam ishlatiladi, eski va kam uchraydigan grammatik termin hisoblanadi.

ex: Slobbed lime was common in traditional English masonry.
The old building used slobbed lime in its construction.
slobbed.meta: Ohakka taalluqli bo‘lib, namlangan yoki suv qo‘shilgan, nam va yumshoq holatdagi ohak. Bu so‘z hozirda kam ishlatiladi va asosan ba’zi hududiy dialektlarda uchraydi.

ex: The critic called the author a slobberer because of his overly sentimental writing style.
He is just a slobberer, always talking nonsense and overdoing his emotions.
slobberer.meta: Aqlli yoki mazmunli emas, ortiqcha hissiyot bilan yoki yuzaki gapiradigan yoki yozadigan odam.

ex: The dog is a real slobberhannes, leaving drool everywhere after drinking water.
He is such a slobberhannes, always making a mess while eating.
slobberhannes.meta: Tartibsiz va iflos odatlari bor odam yoki hayvon, ayniqsa ovqat yoki ichimlikda tartibsiz va namlik bilan iflos qiluvchi.

ex: Don’t slummock all day; you should find something useful to do.
On weekends, he just slummocks around the house doing nothing productive.
slummock.meta: Dangasa, tartibsiz yoki bo‘shqoq tarzda harakat qilish; maqsadsiz va samarali bo‘lmagan vaqt o‘tkazish.

ex: The spirital organs, like the heart and lungs, are vital for life.
Spirital health refers to the well-being of the chest organs and their vital functions.
spirital.meta: Tana hayotiy ruhi yoki tananing boshqa ruhlari bilan bog‘liq; ayniqsa ko‘krak sohasidagi organlarga taalluqli.

ex: The decisions were made by the spiritalty to guide the religious community.
The spiritalty gathered to discuss matters of the church.
spiritalty.meta: Bir guruh sifatida qaraladigan ruhoniylar; diniy tashkilot yoki diniy xodimlar jamiyati

ex: Spirit houses were common in the past but are now rarely seen.
The old village had a spirit house where they stored whiskey and brandy.
spirit house.meta: Alkogolli ichimliklarni saqlash yoki sotish uchun mo‘ljallangan ombor yoki do‘kon. (Hozirda kam uchraydi.)

ex: The old house had a spiritish atmosphere that made visitors uneasy.
The child’s spiritish smile hinted at a mischievous nature.
spiritish.meta: G‘ayritabiiy ruhga o‘xshash yoki unga xos bo‘lgan; ayniqsa yovuz, shaytoniy yoki mayda jinoyatkorlik qiluvchi.

ex: The ghost appeared spirit-like, floating silently through the room.
She moved with a spirit-like grace that captivated everyone.
spirit-like.meta: Ruhga o‘xshash yoki ruh tarzida, uning xususiyatlarini bildiruvchi.

ex: She has a spiritualistic approach to life, always seeking deeper meaning.
The group consisted mostly of spiritualistics interested in mysticism
spiritualistic.meta: Ruhiylik yoki mistitsizmga oid yoki u bilan bog‘liq; (shaxs uchun) ruhiy fikrga ega yoki ruhi bilan shug‘ullanuvchi.

ex: The painting captured the spiritualized features of the saint perfectly.
Her spiritualized face showed a deep inner calm and sensitivity.
spiritualized.meta: Biror kishining yuzi yoki chiziqlari ruhiylik, noziklik va nafislikni ifodalovchi, shunday taassurot qoldiruvchi.

ex: Spiritually-minded individuals often seek deeper meaning in life.
The spiritually-minded gather regularly to discuss their beliefs.
spiritually-minded.meta: (Sifat sifatida) ruhiy fikrga ega yoki ruhiyatga e’tiborli; (ot sifatida) ruhiy fikrli odamlar guruhi.

ex: Spiritual-minded individuals often seek knowledge beyond the material world.
She is a spiritual-minded person who spends much time in meditation.
spiritual-minded.meta: Ruhiy yoki aqliy masalalarga qiziqadigan, diqqatini shunga qaratadigan shaxs yoki xususiyat.

ex: Spirituous substances were once believed to sustain the body's vital forces.
The old medical texts describe spirituous qualities as essential for health.
spirituous.meta: Hayotiy ruh yoki tananing boshqa ruhiy moddalari bilan bog‘liq yoki ularni o‘zida mujassam etgan. (Hozir eskirgan so‘z.)

ex: The concept of spiritus rector is now considered outdated in modern science.
In old chemistry, the spiritus rector was believed to control the properties of a substance.
spiritus rector.meta: Bir moddaning uning asosiy xususiyatlarini beruvchi deb hisoblangan tarkibiy qismi. (Hozir tarixiy atama sifatida ishlatiladi.)

ex: Spirit weed is used traditionally for medicinal purposes in some tropical regions.
The spirit weed grows abundantly in Caribbean tropical forests.
spirit weed.meta: Tropik Amerikaga xos Aegiphila jinsiga mansub kichik daraxt yoki buta; ayniqsa Karib mintaqasida keng tarqalgan o‘simlik turi.

ex: The red roots of spirit weed were once used in traditional remedies.
Spirit weed is found in the wetlands of eastern United States and Cuba
spirit weed.meta: Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlari sharqiy botqoq hududlari va Kubada o‘sadigan, qizil ildizlarga ega Lachnanthes caroliniana o‘simligi.

ex: Traditional healers use spirit weed for various medicinal purposes.
Spirit weed is commonly used in Jamaican cuisine for its strong aroma.
spirit weed.meta: Asosan Yamaykaga xos bo‘lgan, tropik Amerikaning o‘simligi bo‘lib, kuchli hidli barglari oshxonada va o‘simlik dorilarida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: She is studying the Udmurt language.
The Udmurt are a Finno-Ugric people living in Russia.
udmurt.meta: Udmurt xalqi yoki ularning tiliga oid bo‘lgan, ularga tegishli.

ex: Only votable stocks grant the right to vote at the annual meeting.
Votable shares allow shareholders to influence company decisions.
votable.meta: Chiqaruvchi kompaniyaning boshqaruvi bilan bog‘liq masalalarda ovoz berish huquqini beruvchi aksiyalar yoki ulushlar.

ex: Votation allows citizens to participate directly in the legislative process.
The Swiss hold votations regularly to decide on important national issues.
votation.meta: Shveytsariyada aholining qonun, siyosat yoki tashabbus bo‘yicha to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ovoz berishi orqali o‘tkaziladigan referendum.

ex: Being a good vote collector is essential for winning the campaign.
He was known as a strong vote collector in the last election.
vote collector.meta: Asosan AQShda saylovda ko‘p ovoz olgan nomzod

ex: Some investors prefer voteless stocks because they focus on dividends rather than control.
Voteless shares do not give shareholders any influence over company decisions.
voteless.meta: Chiqaruvchi kompaniyaning boshqaruvi bilan bog‘liq masalalarda ovoz berish huquqini bermaydigan aksiyalar yoki ulushlar.

ex: Votian language is closely related to Finnish and Estonian.
The Votians are a small Finno-Ugric ethnic group in Russia.
votian.meta: Finno-ugor xalqlaridan bo‘lib, Rossiyaning shim-g‘arbida, Finlandiya ko‘rfazi yaqinida yashovchi vot xalqining a’zosi.

ex: The Votic people once lived near the Gulf of Finland.
The Votic language is now almost extinct.
votic.meta: Rossiyaning shim-g‘arbida, Finlandiya ko‘rfazi yaqinida yashagan finno-ugor xalqlaridan biri bo‘lgan vot xalqining a’zosi. Qadimiy va kam ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: He pledged votively to serve the community.
The gift was given votively as a sign of devotion.
votively.meta: Jiddiy va rasmiy qasamyod yoki va’dalar orqali amalga oshirilgan. (Qadimiy atama)

ex: In the satire, the votograph was depicted as a strange new way of voting.
The politician joked that the votograph was more reliable than a spoken vote.
votograph.meta: Hazilomuz yoki satirik ma’noda: yozma shaklda berilgan ovoz. Kam uchraydi.

ex: Several assemblypersons attended the session to discuss the budget.
The assemblyperson voted in favor of the new law.
assemblyperson in assembly.meta: Qonun chiqaruvchi majlisning a’zosi; erkak yoki ayol deputat.

ex: She is the first assemblywoman elected from her district.+
The assemblywoman advocated for women’s rights during the session.
The crowd watched on in silence as the firemen worked.
I just stood there and watched on as they argued.
to watch on.meta: biror voqeani yoki harakatni faqat kuzatish, tomosha qilish; ya’ni o‘zidan hech qanday ishtirok yoki aralashuvsiz shunchaki qarab turish holati. Bu ibora ko‘pincha passiv holatda, chetdan kuzatishni bildiradi.

ex: An infodemic can be as dangerous as the disease itself.
The Covid-19 pandemic was accompanied by a massive infodemic of rumors and conspiracy theories.
infodemic.meta: bu favqulodda holat, inqiroz yoki jamoaviy voqealar (masalan, pandemiya, siyosiy mojarolar) davrida turli, ko‘pincha ishonchsiz yoki tasdiqlanmagan ma’lumotlarning haddan ziyod ko‘plab va tez tarqalishi

ex: To stop the spread of Covid-19, measures were taken to reduce its R₀.
The R₀ of measles can be as high as 18, making it extremely contagious.
r₀.meta: bu bir kasallangan odamdan, to‘liq himoyalanmagan yoki avval kasallik bilan to‘qnash kelmagan aholiga o‘rtacha qancha odamga infeksiya yuqishini ko‘rsatadigan miqdor

ex: People returning from abroad were asked to self-isolate
After showing symptoms, she decided to self-isolate for ten days.
self-isolate.meta: bu atama odamning o‘z ixtiyori bilan boshqalardan ajralgan holda yashashi yoki qolishi holatini bildiradi, ayniqsa sog‘lig‘i xavf ostida bo‘lsa yoki infeksiyani boshqalarga yuqtirmaslik maqsadida

ex: All self-isolated individuals must follow government guidelines.
The self-isolated patients are being monitored daily by health workers.
self-isolated.meta: bu atama kasallik yuqtirish yoki boshqalarga yuqtirish xavfini kamaytirish maqsadida biror shaxs yoki guruhning o‘zini ixtiyoriy tarzda boshqa odamlar bilan aloqadan ajratib qo‘yganini bildiradi

ex: She is currently self-isolating after testing positive for Covid-19.
The self-isolating travelers were provided with food and medical support.
self-isolating.meta: bu atama ayni vaqtda o‘zini boshqalardan ajratgan, ya’ni izolyatsiya jarayonida bo‘lgan shaxs yoki guruhni tasvirlashda ishlatiladi. Odatda, bu harakat sog‘liqni saqlash maqsadida, kasallik yuqtirmaslik yoki uni tarqatmaslik uchun amalga oshiriladi

ex: The government enforced a strict policy of self-isolation during the outbreak.
Self-isolation is recommended if you have symptoms of a contagious illness.
self-isolation.meta: bu shaxsning o‘z ixtiyori bilan vaqtincha boshqalardan ajralgan holda yashashi, odatda kasallik belgilari paydo bo‘lganda yoki kasallik yuqtirish/yuborish xavfi bo‘lsa, kasallik tarqalishining oldini olish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi

ex: Self-quarantine is essential to slowing the spread of the virus.
After traveling abroad, he went into a two-week self-quarantine.
self-quarantine.meta: bu shaxsning o‘z xohishi bilan vaqtincha boshqalardan ajralgan holda, odatda uyda, qolishi bo‘lib, bu kasallik tarqalishining oldini olish uchun amalga oshiriladi

ex: All travelers were required to self-quarantine for 14 days.
He decided to self-quarantine after learning he was exposed to the virus
self-quarantine.meta: bu shaxsning o‘z xohishi bilan boshqa odamlar bilan aloqani vaqtincha to‘xtatib, o‘zini karantinga joylashtirishi bo‘lib, odatda yuqumli kasallik (masalan, gripp, Covid-19) tarqalishining oldini olish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi

ex: All self-quarantined individuals were instructed to avoid public contact.
The self-quarantined patients were checked on daily by healthcare staff.
self-quarantined.meta: bu atama o‘zini kasallikdan himoya qilish yoki uni boshqalarga yuqtirmaslik maqsadida mustaqil ravishda karantinga joylashtirgan shaxs yoki guruhni ifodalaydi

ex: People were told to shelter in place until the active shooter threat was resolved.
During the chemical spill, the authorities issued a shelter in place order.
shelter in place.meta: bu favqulodda vaziyatlarda odamlar xavfsizlik nuqtai nazaridan o‘z joyida qolishlari, ya’ni eng yaqin xavfsiz boshpanani topishlari kerakligini bildiruvchi xavfsizlik protokoli.

ex: During the shooting, we had to shelter in place in a locked office.
Residents were told to shelter in place as the tornado approached.
shelter in place.meta: bu favqulodda holatda (hayot yoki sog‘liq uchun bevosita xavf mavjud bo‘lganda) odamning o‘z joyini tark etmasdan, aynan shu joyda yoki yaqin atrofdagi xavfsiz hududda boshpana topishi

ex: The school implemented social distancing by spacing desks six feet apart
Social distancing was one of the key strategies used during the pandemic
social distancing.meta: bu yuqumli kasalliklarning (ayniqsa virusli infeksiyalar, masalan, COVID-19) tarqalishini oldini olish maqsadida odamlar orasida belgilangan masofani saqlash amaliyotidir

ex: Long-term social isolation can lead to depression and anxiety.
Elderly people living alone are at higher risk of social isolation.
social isolation.meta: bu shaxsning boshqa odamlar bilan deyarli yoki umuman aloqasi bo‘lmagan holati bo‘lib, u do‘stlar, oila yoki ijtimoiy guruhlar bilan muloqotdan uzilgan bo‘ladi.

ex: PPE such as gloves and face shields is essential in chemical labs
Doctors wore full PPE while treating COVID-19 patients.
ppe.meta: bu ishchi yoki foydalanuvchini xavfli moddalar, zararli muhit, yoki yuqumli kasalliklardan himoya qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan kiyim-bosh va asbob-uskunalardir

ex: The factory provides personal protective equipment to all its employees.
Healthcare workers must always wear personal protective equipment when treating contagious patients.
personal protective equipment.meta: bu insonni zararli moddalar, xavfli ish muhitlari yoki yuqumli kasalliklardan himoya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus kiyimlar va jihozlar to‘plamidir

ex: Loneliness and reduced community support are signs of a growing social recession.
The COVID-19 pandemic led not only to an economic recession but also a deep social recession.
social recession.meta: bu jamiyat a'zolari orasidagi ijtimoiy aloqalar zaiflashgan, odamlar o‘rtasida muloqot kamaygan va umumiy hayot sifati yomonlashgan davrdir

ex: These additions to unrevised entries help users understand how the word is used today
The dictionary includes additions to unrevised entries to reflect recent language changes.
additions to unrevised entries.meta: bu hali to‘liq yangilanmagan yoki tahrir qilinmagan lug‘at yoki ma’lumot bazasidagi yozuvlarga vaqtinchalik yoki qo‘shimcha ma’lumot sifatida kiritilgan izohlar, misollar yoki yangi tushunchalardir

ex: He gave his friend a friendly elbow bump instead of a hug.
During the pandemic, people replaced handshakes with elbow bumps.
elbow bump.meta: bu ikki inson qo‘l berish yoki quchoqlash o‘rniga tirsaklarini yengilgina tegizish orqali salomlashish yoki xayrlashish harakatidir. Bu usul ayniqsa yuqumli kasalliklar tarqalishining oldini olish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: During the lockdown, almost the entire staff switched to WFH.
Many companies now offer WFH as a permanent option
wfh.meta: bu odatda ofisda bajariladigan ishlarni doimiy, vaqtincha yoki vaqti-vaqti bilan uydan turib bajarish shaklidir

ex: Turn off the desk lamp and just leave the ambient lighting on.
The ambient lighting in the restaurant created a cozy and relaxing atmosphere.
ambient lighting.meta: bu tabiiy (masalan, quyosh nuri) yoki sun’iy (masalan, shiftdagi chiroq) manbalardan tarqaladigan, butun xonani yoki muhitni yoritib turadigan yorug‘likdir

ex: Music played ambiently in the background, enhancing the dining experience.
The room was ambiently lit, giving it a calm and peaceful feeling.
ambiently.meta: bu narsaning yoki hodisaning muhitni to‘ldiruvchi, sezilmas tarzda atrofni qamrab oladigan, shinam va osoyishta usulda tarqalishini bildiradi. Bu odatda yorug‘lik, tovush yoki reklama bilan bog‘liq kontekstlarda qo‘llaniladi

ex: She often speaks in ambigues to avoid giving a direct answer.
His reply was an ambigue that left everyone wondering what he really meant.
ambigue.meta: bu ma’nosi bir nechta talqinga ega bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan, aniqlikdan yiroq yoki ataylab noaniq qilib aytilgan ibora yoki gapdir. Ko‘pincha chalkashlik yoki turlicha tushunishga sabab bo‘ladi.

ex: Traditional ceremonies featured singing, dancing, and ambira performances.
The musician played a haunting melody on the ambira.
ambira.meta: Afrikada paydo bo‘lgan, chuqur ohangli, yog‘och kalitchalardan iborat musiqa asbobi bo‘lib, har bir kalit ostida ohangni kuchaytiruvchi rezonator joylashgan bo‘ladi.

ex: Ambisyllabic consonants are important in understanding English stress patterns.
In the word "hurry", the /r/ can be considered ambisyllabic.
ambisyllabic.meta: fonetika va fonologiyada ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, bir vaqtning o‘zida birinchi bo‘g‘inning oxiri (koda) va keyingi bo‘g‘inning boshlanishi (onset) vazifasini bajaradigan tovushni bildiradi

ex: The court charged him with ambitus after discovering illegal campaign payments.
In ancient Rome, ambitus was a punishable offence for candidates who bribed voters.
ambitus.meta: lavozim yoki siyosiy mansabni noqonuniy, yashirin yoki nopok usullar orqali qo‘lga kiritishga intilish jarayoni.

ex: Ancient Greek chemists used an ambix in their experiments on distillation.
The alchemist placed the herbs into the ambix to distill their essence.
ambix.meta: qadimgi davrlarda ishlatilgan, seramika yoki metall idish bo‘lib, oddiy distillatsiya jarayonlarida foydalanilgan. Unda suyuqlik bug‘lanib yuqoriga ko‘tariladi, so‘ngra sovib kondensatsiyalanadi va yig‘ib olinadi

ex: Her ambrotypic skills were admired at the vintage photography exhibition.
The photographer’s ambrotypic technique gave the portrait a haunting, antique quality
ambrotypic.meta: ambrotip (shisha plastinka ustiga olingan 19-asr daguerrotipga o‘xshash surat) usuli bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan yoki shunday suratlarning ko‘rinishini eslatuvchi narsalarni ifodalaydigan sifat so‘zidir

ex: The museum displayed a 19th-century ambulance car used in military campaigns.
During the civil war, ambulance cars were drawn by horses to carry the injured off the battlefield.
ambulance car.meta: ilgari, ayniqsa urush paytida, yarador askarlarni tashish uchun ishlatilgan yopiq arava yoki vagon. Bu atama hozirda eskirgan hisoblanadi, chunki zamonaviy davrda motorli tez yordam mashinalari ishlatiladi.

ex: Historical records describe the enemy’s repeated ambuscading along the narrow mountain passes.
The soldiers were trained in tactics such as ambuscading and guerrilla warfare.
ambuscading.meta: dushmanni yashirincha kuzatib, kutilmaganda hujum qilish harakati; yashirincha hujum uyushtirish. Bu harakat odatda harbiy yoki strategik maqsadlarda amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The rebels ambuscadoed themselves behind the rocks, waiting for the convoy to pass.
The general ambuscadoed his men in the forest before launching the surprise attack
ambuscado.meta: dushman yoki qurbonni kutilmaganda hujum qilish uchun askar yoki odamlarni yashirincha joylashtirish; o‘zini yashirin hujum uchun bekitish.

ex: Ambushing is a common tactic used in guerrilla warfare.
The unit was caught off guard due to a sudden ambushing by enemy forces
ambushing.meta: dushman yoki qurbonni yashirin joydan kutilmaganda hujum bilan yo‘q qilish yoki zararsizlantirish harakati. Bu harakat ko‘pincha harbiy strategiya sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The tiger salamander is a well-known ambystomid found in North America.
The ambystomid species are known for their underground lifestyle and regenerative abilities.
ambystomid.meta: Ambystomatidae (oldingi nomi Ambystomidae) deb nomlanuvchi suvda va quruqlikda yashovchi amfibiyalar oilasiga oid yoki shu oilaga mansub hayvon

ex: Amchur is often used as a souring agent in Indian vegetarian dishes.
The curry had a unique tangy flavor, thanks to the addition of amchur.
amchur.meta: xom (yetilmagan) mango mevasi quritilib, kukun holiga keltirilgan ziravor. Bu ziravor asosan hind oshxonasida taomlarga nordon va achchiq ta’m berish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Some parthenogenetic species reproduce through ameiosis instead of standard meiosis.
Ameiosis can lead to the formation of diploid gametes, affecting the offspring’s chromosome number.
ameiosis.meta: odatda meyoz jarayonida hosil bo‘ladigan haploid (yarim to‘plamli) jinsiy hujayralar (gametalar) o‘rniga diploid (to‘liq to‘plamli) gametalar hosil bo‘lishi. Bu biologik jarayon meyozdagi buzilish yoki o‘zgarish hisoblanadi.

ex: The researchers observed ameiotic parthenogenesis in a population of lizards.
In some species, ameiotic reproduction allows females to produce offspring without fertilization
ameiotic.meta: jinsiy bo‘lmagan ko‘payishga, xususan partenogenez (urg‘ochi organizmning erkak gametasiz nasl qoldirishi) jarayoniga taalluqli atama. Bu holatda gametalar ameyoz orqali hosil bo‘lib, diploid (to‘liq xromosoma to‘plamiga ega) bo‘ladi

ex: Amelanosis in the skin may indicate a genetic or autoimmune condition.
Diagnosing melanoma can be more difficult in cases of amelanosis, where pigmentation is absent.
amelanosis.meta: tananing odatda melanin pigmenti bo‘lgan joylarida (masalan, teri, ko‘z to‘qimalari yoki melanoma o‘smalarida) melanin pigmentining yetishmasligi yoki butunlay yo‘qligi

ex: Amelanotic melanoma lacks the dark pigment melanin.
The tumor was amelanotic, making it harder to detect.
amelanotic.meta: Melanin pigmentini o‘z ichiga olmaydigan yoki melanin pigmentini ishlab chiqarmaydigan; melanin pigmentatsiyasidan mahrum.

ex: Farmers add ameliorants to the land to increase crop yields.
Compost is often used as an ameliorant to improve soil fertility.
ameliorant.meta: Biror narsani yaxshilaydigan yoki yengillashtiradigan modda yoki buyum; ayniqsa, tuproqning tuzilishi, drenaji yoki unumdorligini yaxshilash uchun qo‘shiladigan modda

ex: Many social reformers believe in ameliorism.
Ameliorism teaches that human efforts can make society better.
ameliorism.meta: Dunyo yoki jamiyat insonning to‘g‘ri yo‘naltirilgan harakatlari orqali yaxshilanishi va azoblarning kamayishi mumkinligi haqidagi ta’limot yoki e’tiqod; = meliorizm

ex: The ameliorist movement seeks to create positive social change.
He is an ameliorist who believes society can improve through reform.
ameliorist.meta: (ot) Dunyo yoki jamiyat insonning to‘g‘ri yo‘naltirilgan harakatlari orqali yaxshilanishi va azoblarning kamayishi mumkinligi haqidagi ta’limotni qo‘llovchi yoki tarafdori. (sifat) Ushbu ta’limotga oid yoki uni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi.

ex: Ameloblastoma is a rare tumour of the jawbone.
The patient was diagnosed with an ameloblastoma in the lower jaw.
ameloblastoma.meta: Ameloblastlardan tashkil topgan o‘sma, asosan jag‘ suyagida (ayniqsa pastki jag‘da) uchraydi.

ex: His singing style is often described as amelodic.
The song was amelodic, lacking any clear tune.
amelodic.meta: Melodiyadan iborat bo‘lmagan, melodiyaga ega bo‘lmagan yoki melodiyaga xos bo‘lmagan.

ex: Any disruption in amelogenesis can lead to enamel defects.
Amelogenesis is a crucial process in tooth development.
amelogenesis.meta: Ameloblastlar tomonidan tish emalini hosil qilish jarayoni.

ex: Aminds carry out judicial investigations in rural areas.
The amin was called to resolve the dispute between the villagers.
amin.meta: Hindistonda: nizolarni hal qilish, sud tergovlarini olib borish va hokazo vazifalarni bajarishga tayinlangan turli mansabdor shaxslardan biri.

ex: Anecdotal evidence can sometimes be misleading.
The report was based mainly on anecdata rather than scientific studies.
anecdata.meta: Yagona holatlar haqidagi xabarlar yoki hikoyalarga asoslangan, tizimli tadqiqot yoki tahlildan ko‘ra shaxsiy voqealarga asoslangan ma’lumotlar yoki dalillar; anekdot dalillar.

ex: The story was told anecdotally, without scientific proof.
Anecdotally, many people say this remedy works well.
anecdotally.meta: Anekdotlar orqali yoki anekdotlarga oid tarzda; anekdot uslubida.

ex: Anecdoting is a popular way to share personal stories.
His talent for anecdoting makes conversations very entertaining.
anecdoting.meta: Anekdotlarni so‘zlab berish harakati yoki faoliyati.

ex: Anejo rum has a richer flavor than younger varieties.
This tequila is anejo, aged for over a year in oak barrels.
anejo.meta: Kamida bir yil eman yoki boshqa turdagi barabanda saqlangan va shu sababli ta’mi va hidida o‘ziga xos boylik hosil qilgan rum yoki tekila.

ex: The demand for some goods is anelastic, meaning it changes moderately with price shifts.
Umberto Ricci described anelastic demand curves in his economic models.
anelastic.meta: Narx o‘zgarishlariga qisman javob beradigan, ya’ni talab yoki taklifning qisman elastik bo‘lgan holatini ifodalovchi iqtisodiy atama.

ex: Many trees produce anemochore seeds that travel long distances by wind.
Dandelion is an example of an anemochore plant.
anemochore.meta: Urug‘lari yoki ko‘paytiruvchi qismlari shamol yordamida tarqaladigan o‘simlik yoki boshqa organizm.

ex: Anemochorous plants rely on wind dispersal to spread their seeds.
Maple trees are anemochorous because their seeds are carried by the wind.
anemochorous.meta: Urug‘lari yoki ko‘paytiruvchi qismlari shamol yordamida tarqaladigan o‘simlik yoki organizmga xos bo‘lgan, yoki shamol orqali tarqalish uslubiga taalluqli.

ex: Anemotactic responses help spores disperse efficiently with the wind.
Some insects show anemotactic behavior by flying in the direction of the wind.
anemotactic.meta: Shamol yo‘nalishi ta’sirida harakat qiluvchi yoki shamol yo‘nalishiga muvofiq harakatlanadigan xususiyat yoki holat.

ex: The spores exhibit anemotaxis by drifting in the wind’s direction.
Anemotaxis helps certain insects move efficiently with the wind.
anemotaxis.meta: Shamol yo‘nalishi bilan belgilanadigan yo‘nalishda organizmning harakatlanishi hodisasi.

ex: Anemotropic behavior helps organisms orient themselves efficiently in windy environments.
Some plants show anemotropic growth by bending towards the wind direction.
anemotropic.meta: Shamol yo‘nalishi ta’sirida yo‘nalishini o‘zgartiruvchi yoki shamol yo‘nalishiga qarab yo‘naladigan xususiyat yoki holat.

ex: Anepigraphic artefacts can be difficult to date accurately without inscriptions.
The archaeologists found an anepigraphic coin with no inscriptions.
anepigraphic.meta: Tangada yoki boshqa qadimiy buyumda hech qanday yozuv yoki yozma belgilar mavjud bo‘lmagan holat.

ex: Anergic symptoms are common in depression and certain mental disorders.
The patient appeared anergic, showing little motivation or energy.
anergic.meta: Ruhiy yoki jismoniy kuch, energiya yetishmasligi holatini ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: The patient suffered from anergy, showing no interest in daily activities.
Anergy is often observed in cases of severe depression.
anergy.meta: Ruhiy yoki jismoniy kuchning yo‘qolishi yoki kamligi, bu holat odatda harakatsizlik yoki faoliyatga qarshi bo‘lish sifatida ko‘rinadi

ex: Unlike traditional lamps, the aneucapnic lamp does not need a chimney.
The aneucapnic lamp is useful in poorly ventilated rooms since it produces no smoke.
aneucapnic lamp.meta: Tutun chiqarmaydigan yog‘li chiroq bo‘lib, fitil ustida joylashgan ikkita metall shar orqali havo olovga yetkaziladi, shuning uchun shoxobchaga ehtiyoj qolmaydi.

ex: Scientists are researching aneutronic fusion as a potential energy source.
Aneutronic fusion reactions are considered cleaner because they produce fewer neutrons.
aneutronic.meta: Neytronlar chiqarmasdan, chiqarilgan energiyaning deyarli hammasi zaryadlangan zarralar orqali tashiladigan yadro sintezi reaksiyasi turi.

ex: Antpittas are shy birds found in subtropical forests of Central and South America.
The antpitta is known for feeding mainly on ants and other insects.
antpitta.meta: Subtropik va tropik o‘rmonlarda yashovchi, hasharotlar, xususan tamalar bilan oziqlanadigan, Yangi Dunyo qushlari oilasiga kiruvchi kichik o‘lchamdagi o‘rmon qushi.

ex: “I won the lottery!” — “April Fool’s!”
On April Fool’s Day, people play jokes on their friends and family.
april fool’s.meta: Har yili 1-aprel kuni odamlar bir-birini hazil yoki aldash orqali o‘ynaydi; bu kun aprel jinni kuni deb ataladi.

ex: Many people like to celebrate their b-day with friends and family.
We are planning a party for her b-day next week.
b-day.meta: Insonning tug‘ilgan kunining har yili nishonlanadigan sanasi.

ex: They beanhonded that the new policy would benefit everyone.
He beanhonded that he had finished the work on time.
beanhond.meta: Biror narsani rostligi yoki to‘g‘riligini qat’iy aytish, bildirish.

ex: Many countries have banned bear dancing due to animal welfare concerns.
Bear dancing was once a popular street performance but is now widely criticized for cruelty.
bear dancing.meta: Ayiqni maxsus o‘rgatib, odatda burniga halqa taqib bog‘lab, majburan raqsga tushirish orqali ko‘rsatiladigan ko‘ngilochar tomosha.

ex: The group of artists was full of beardos, each with a unique style.
He’s a real beardo with his thick beard and glasses
beardo.meta: Mo‘ylovi bor odamga beriladigan laqab; ayniqsa, ma’lum bir uslub yoki dunyoqarashga ega bo‘lgan, ko‘pincha mo‘ylovli insonni anglatadi.

ex: Her dress had a Beardsleyan design with intricate floral patterns.
The gallery displayed several Beardsleyan illustrations from the late 19th century.
beardsleyan.meta: Aubrey Beardsley ismli rassom va uning san’at nouveau uslubidagi bezakli rasm yoki chizmalariga tegishli yoki o‘xshash.

ex: The book was illustrated with Beardsleyesque drawings that captured the dark elegance of the period.
The artist’s work features Beardsleyesque details, reminiscent of 1890s art nouveau.
beardsleyesque.meta: Aubrey Beardsleyning 1890-yillarda yaratilgan art nouveau uslubidagi qora va oq rangdagi chiziqli chizmalariga xos yoki o‘xshash uslub.

ex: The professor’s lecture was full of abstract ideas and beard-stroking.
His constant beard-stroking during the meeting made him seem overly philosophical.
beard-stroking.meta: Biror masala ustida chuqur o‘ylayotgan paytda soqolni silash harakati; ba'zida haddan tashqari ziyolilik yoki o‘zini aqlli ko‘rsatishga urinayotganlik sifatida talqin qilinadi.

ex: His bear-fighting ways got him kicked out of the club.
The tavern was known for its nightly bear-fighting among drunken sailors.
bear-fighting.meta: odamlar oʻrtasida yuz beradigan qattiq, tartibsiz, va qoʻpol muomala yoki xatti-harakat; koʻpincha shovqin-suron va tartibsizlik bilan kechadigan holat. Bu soʻz hozirda kam ishlatiladi va eski adabiy manbalarda uchrashi mumkin

ex: He recognized the Bear Flag flying over the state capitol.
The Bear Flag is a symbol of California's independence spirit.
bear flag.meta: AQShda, ayniqsa Kaliforniya shtatining rasmiy bayrog‘i bo‘lib, unda ayiq tasviri mavjud. Bu bayroq ko‘pincha “Bear Flag” deb ataladi va Kaliforniya tarixida muhim o‘rin tutadi

ex: In some regions, bear hunters are licensed to control the bear population.
The bear hunter tracked the animal through the snowy forest.
bear hunter.meta: ayiq ovlaydigan yoki ov qilish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi kishi.

ex: In some countries, bear hunting is regulated by law.
Bear hunting requires skill, patience, and knowledge of the wilderness
bear hunting.meta: ayiqni ovlash faoliyati, sport turi yoki mashg‘uloti. Shuningdek, “ayiq oviga chiqmoq” ma’nosida ham qo‘llanadi

ex: Béarnais cuisine is known for its rich flavors.
The Béarnais are proud of their cultural heritage.
béarnais.meta: Fransiyaning Béarn mintaqasida yashovchi odam yoki shu hududga oid narsaga nisbatan ishlatiladigan so‘z.

ex: The herbalist recommended using beewort to calm the nerves.
In medieval gardens, beewort was grown to attract bees.
beewort.meta: Ilk ma'noda: asalarilarni o‘ziga tortadigan bir nechta o‘simliklarga berilgan umumiy nom, ayniqsa melissa (Melissa officinalis, ya’ni limon o‘ti). Keyinchalik bu atama shirin kalamus (Acorus calamus) degan o‘simlikka nisbatan ham ishlatilgan

ex: She was taken to the birthing room as soon as labor began.
The hospital's birthing rooms are designed to feel more like home.
birthing room.meta: Kasalxona yoki boshqa tibbiy muassasada joylashgan, tug‘ruq (mehnat jarayoni) va bola tug‘ilishi uchun maxsus jihozlangan, bemorga qulay va kamroq klinik muhit yaratishga mo‘ljallangan xona

ex: The concept of birth stain has shaped centuries of theological debate
According to Christian doctrine, baptism cleanses the birth stain.
birth stain.meta: An’anaviy yahudiy va nasroniy ilohiyotiga ko‘ra, odam zotining Odam Atoning gunohi tufayli gunohkor holatga tushib qolganligi; bu holat barcha insonlarga tug‘ilishdan boshlab xos bo‘ladi. Bu tushuncha ibtidoiy gunoh nomi bilan ham tanilgan.

ex: Every child has a unique birth story that parents love to tell.
She shared her birth story on a parenting blog.
birth story.meta: Biror shaxsning qanday tug‘ilganligi haqidagi voqea yoki onaning farzandini dunyoga keltirish (tug‘ruq) tajribasi haqida hikoya

ex: Snack companies often engineer their products to hit the bliss point of salt, sugar, and fat.
The government aimed to reach the bliss point between public investment and private enterprise.
bliss point.meta: Asosan iqtisodiyotda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, dastlab davlat va xususiy tovarlar kombinatsiyasi orqali jamiyat farovonligining optimal darajasiga erishilgan holatni bildiradi

ex: The ambulance blue-lighted through traffic to reach the accident scene.
They had to blue-light the patient to the hospital.
blue-light.meta: Asosan tez yordam, politsiya yoki yong‘in xavfsizligi kabi favqulodda xizmatga oid transport vositasi, haydovchisi yoki ichidagi shaxslar tomonidan yo‘lga ko‘k miltillovchi chiroqlarni yoqib, odatda zudlik bilan biror joyga borish harakati.

ex: The antique candlestick had a beautifully engraved glass bobeche.
She replaced the metal bobeche to match the new chandelier design
bobeche.meta: Odatda shisha yoki metall materialdan tayyorlangan, shamdonning sham joylashadigan qismi atrofida joylashgan kichik likob yoki chuqurcha shaklidagi halqa bo‘lib, sham eriganda oqib tushadigan mum tomchilarini ushlab qolish uchun mo‘ljallangan

ex: Chemists study bornane derivatives to understand terpene chemistry.
Bornane is the parent hydrocarbon structure for borneol and camphor.
bornane.meta: Kristall holidagi, ikki halqali uglevodorod bo‘lib, uning molekulasi borneol va unga yaqin bo‘lgan boshqa birikmalar uchun asosiy tuzilma hisoblanadi

ex: In thermochemistry classes, students often learn to construct the Born–Haber diagram.
The Born–Haber cycle helps determine the lattice energy of an ionic solid.
born–haber.meta: Kimyoviy termodinamika sohasida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, bu Born–Haber tsikli (yoki davri) deb ataladi. Bu tsikl ion birikmasining oddiy elementlardan hosil bo‘lish jarayonini ketma-ket reaksiyalar orqali tushuntirib beradi

ex: Bornyl acetate is a naturally occurring ester found in essential oils.
The compound contains a bornyl group bonded to an acid molecule.
