bornyl.meta: Kimyoda borneol birikmasidan gidroksil (–OH) guruhining ajralishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan, C₁₀H₁₇ formulasiga ega bo‘lgan ikki halqali uglevodorod radikali.U boshqa birikmalar tarkibida modifikator yoki tarkibiy element sifatida ishtirok etadi.

ex: Scientists observed a brinicle forming beneath the Antarctic sea ice.
A brinicle can freeze and kill marine life on the sea floor as it forms
brinicle.meta: Dengiz muzlari ostida shakllanadigan, juda sovuq va yuqori sho‘rlikdagi suv oqimi atrofida hosil bo‘lgan uzun, uchiga tomon torayuvchi muz naychasi. Bu hodisa odatda yangi shakllanayotgan muz qatlamidan pastga tomon sho‘r suv oqimi tushganda yuzaga keladi

ex: During the Calvin cycle, carbon dioxide is fixed into glucose
The Calvin cycle takes place in the stroma of chloroplasts.
calvin cycle.meta: bu o‘simliklar va ayrim bakteriyalarda fotosintez jarayonining bir qismi sifatida sodir bo‘ladigan metabolik reaksiyalar ketma-ketligidir. Ushbu sikl orqali karbonat angidrid (CO₂) organik birikmalarga aylantiriladi

ex: She was recognized as a dedicated childbearer, committed to raising her children with love and care
In many ancient societies, the childbearer was highly valued for her ability to produce heirs
childbearer.meta: bola tug‘diradigan ayol, ona. Shuningdek, (xususan, keyingi foydalanishda) bolalarni dunyoga keltiruvchi ayol sifatida qaraladigan ayol.

ex: He was engaged in chin-stroking as he considered the complex problem
Her constant chin-stroking indicated she was deep in thought about the decision.
chin-stroking.meta: odamning savol yoki muammoni o‘ylab, fikrlash uchun chinni qo‘l bilan silash harakati. Shuningdek, haddan tashqari fikrlash yoki muhokama qilish

ex: Chrissie shopping is always hectic.
We’re having a big Chrissie lunch at my aunt’s place.
chrissie.meta: bu ingliz tilidagi "Christmas" (Rojdestvo bayrami) so‘zining qisqartirilgan, norasmiy shakli bo‘lib, ko‘pincha do‘stona yoki hazil aralash ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: Christ Almighty, what was that noise?
They prayed to Christ Almighty for protection.
christ almighty.meta: Iso Masihning oliy va qudratli Zot sifatida nomlanishi, ya’ni "Qodir Masih." Norasmiy undov sifatida: Kuchli hissiy holatni bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu holatda dindor bo‘lmagan yoki shunchaki odatiy og‘zaki tilda tez-tez uchraydi.

ex: Her christenly attitude inspired many people around her
He lived a christenly life, full of kindness and compassion
christenly.meta: Xristianlik diniga sodiq bo‘lgan, xristian axloqiy qadriyatlariga muvofiq yoki ular bilan uyg‘un bo‘lgan xatti-harakat yoki fazilatlarni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: The christianing was held at the local church with close relatives.
The family gathered for the baby’s christianing last Sunday.
christianing.meta: bolani yoki kattani rasmiy tarzda suvga cho‘miltirish orqali Xristian diniga qabul qilish amali; bu diniy marosim orqali inson Xudoning farzandi deb tan olinadi va cherkov a’zoligiga qabul qilinadi.

ex: The book describes the life of a Christianocategorian who later converted to Christianity.
In ancient Rome, a Christianocategorian could report believers to the authorities.
christianocategorian.meta: Xristianlarga qarshi ayblov qo‘yuvchi, ularni tanqid qiluvchi yoki dindor sifatida ta’qib qiluvchi shaxs; ko‘pincha diniy e’tiqodlari uchun ularni qoralaydigan inson.

ex: The law aims to prevent discrimination rooted in Christianophobia.
Acts of violence driven by Christianophobia are increasing in some regions.
christianophobia.meta: Xristian diniga nisbatan kuchli nafrat, dushmanlik yoki irratsional qo‘rquv; masihiylarga nisbatan salbiy munosabat, kamsitish yoki ularga nisbatan murosasizlik.

ex: He was raised in a family devoted to Christian Scientism.
Christian Scientism teaches that spiritual understanding can heal the body.
christian scientism.meta: Masihiy Ilmotiqati (Christian Science) deb nomlanuvchi diniy harakatning e’tiqodlari va amaliyotlari majmui. Ushbu harakat 19-asrda Mary Baker Eddy tomonidan asos solingan bo‘lib, Xudoning shifobaxsh kuchiga ishonish

ex: Paul often referred to him as Christ Jesus in his letters.
Salvation comes through Christ Jesus
christ jesus.meta: Xristianlik e’tiqodiga ko‘ra, najotkor va Xudoning O‘g‘li bo‘lgan Iso payg‘ambarning unvoni va nomi. “Masih” so‘zi “mo‘jaz qilingan” yoki “mas’uliyatli shaxs” degan ma’noni anglatib, yahudiylar kutgan najotkorni bildiradi

ex: He ran christly fast down the street.
That’s a christly big mess you’ve made!
christly.meta: og‘zaki va emotsional nutqda kuchaytiruvchi ravish sifatida ishlatiladi; nimanidir haddan tashqari darajada, juda ko‘p yoki nihoyatda deb ifodalash uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: What a Christly day—everything went wrong!
That was a Christly mess you made of the report.
christly.meta: Asosan ingliz tilining og‘zaki, so‘zlashuv shaklida, ayniqsa AQShda ishlatiladigan bu so‘z asl diniy ma'noga ega bo‘lsa-da, bu 3-ma’noda u keskin salbiy ohangda, g‘azab, norozilik yoki jirkanish ifodasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Christophene can be eaten raw or cooked.
She prepared a stew with chicken and christophene.
christophene.meta: Sechium edule nomli o‘simlik mevasi bo‘lib, ko‘proq chayote nomi bilan tanilgan. Bu sabzavot qovoqqa o‘xshab ketadi, och yashil rangda bo‘ladi va ko‘pincha issiq iqlimli hududlarda yetishtiriladi.

ex: Christophobia can manifest as mockery of Jesus and Christian beliefs.
The rise of Christophobia in media has concerned many religious leaders.
christophobia.meta: Iso Masih shaxsiga yoki Unga sig‘inishga nisbatan kuchli nafrat, dushmanlik yoki irratsional qo‘rquv; bu holat Xristianlik g‘oyalariga va ularning tarafdorlariga salbiy munosabat ko‘rinishida namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: As Christotokos, Mary is honored as the one who gave birth to the Messiah.
The early church debated whether Mary should be called Christotokos or Theotokos.
christotokos.meta: bu so‘z yunon tilidan olingan bo‘lib, “Masihni tug‘uvchi” degan ma’noni anglatadi. U Iso Masihning onasi bo‘lgan Muqaddas Maryamga beriladigan unvon bo‘lib, xristian ilohiyotida Maryamni Masih onasi sifatida tan oladi.

ex: The soul moved Christwards through faith and grace.
Let your heart turn Christwards in prayer and repentance.
christwards.meta: bu so‘z “Iso Masih tomon”, “Masihga qarab” yoki “Unga yo‘nalgan holda” degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ravish sifatida harakatning yo‘nalishini bildiradi (qayerga? — Masih tomon), ot sifatida esa bu yo‘nalishning o‘zi (Masih sari intilish) ifodalanadi

ex: The museum displays a range of vintage Christy bowler hats.
He wore a black Christy hat to the formal event.
christy.meta: bu atama, ayniqsa shlyapa (bosh kiyim) modasi kontekstida, Christy & Co. nomli mashhur ingliz kompaniyasi tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan shlyapani anglatadi. U yumaloq tepalik va tor labli (ayniqsa “bowler hat”) shlyapalar uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: People with coulrophobia avoid circuses or children’s parties with clowns.
Her coulrophobia started after watching a horror movie with a clown.
coulrophobia.meta: bu masxarabozlardan (klounlardan) haddan tashqari yoki irratsional qo‘rqish holatidir. Ushbu fobiya asosan psixologik holat bo‘lib, masxarabozlarning bo‘yalgan yuzi, g‘alati harakatlari vahima yoki qo‘rquv uyg‘otadi.

ex: She delayered after entering the warm room.
As the sun came out, the hikers began to delayer.
delayer.meta: bu so‘z ust-boshning bir qatlamini yechish, ya’ni biror kiyim qatlamidan xalos bo‘lish harakatini bildiradi. Odatda bu harakat harorat, qulaylik yoki harakatlanish ehtiyoji bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

ex: Offensive comments are deletable under the website’s moderation policy.
The paragraph contains deletable information that adds no value.
deletable.meta: bu sifatdosh bo‘lib, o‘chirilishi yoki olib tashlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan narsa, shuningdek, yo‘q qilinishi yoki chiqarib yuborilishi kerak bo‘lgan (keraksiz yoki nomaqbul) ma’lumot, so‘z, rasm, matn va h.k. uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Make sure you don’t hit the delete button by mistake while editing data.
On older keypunch machines, the delete button allowed operators to cancel incorrect holes.
delete button.meta: bu klaviaturada joylashgan tugma bo‘lib, kiritilgan belgilarni yoki ma’lumotlarni o‘chirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ayniqsa, tarixan teshib yozuvchi mashinalar yoki kompyuter klaviaturalarida ma’lumotni teshilgan kartochkadan o‘chirish uchun qo‘llanilgan.

ex: The technician accidentally pressed the delete key, erasing the relay message.
In early telegraph systems, the delete key allowed corrections before final transmission.
delete key.meta: bu telegraf tizimlarida ishlatilgan tugma bo‘lib, saqlash releysidan ma’lumotni o‘chirish uchun xizmat qilgan. Bu atama ayniqsa eski telegraf yoki kodlovchi klaviaturalarda ishlatilgan.

ex: Be careful — the deleter in this software can’t be undone.
The virus acted as a deleter, removing important files from the system.
deleter.meta: bu nimanidir o‘chiradigan shaxs yoki narsa degan ma’noni bildiradi. Bu atama kompyuter texnologiyalarida keng qo‘llanadi va fayllarni, ma’lumotlarni, matnni yoki raqamli kontentni o‘chiradigan foydalanuvchi yoki dasturiy vositani anglatadi

ex: After the financial crisis, many banks started to deleverage their balance sheets.
The company decided to deleverage by selling off non-core assets.
deleverage.meta: bu kompaniya, soha yoki balans hisobotidagi qarz darajasini (ayniqsa, kapitalga nisbatan qarzni) kamaytirish bo‘yicha choralar ko‘rishni bildiruvchi moliyaviy atama

ex: Deleveraging can lead to slower growth, but also reduces long-term risk.
After the economic downturn, companies focused on deleveraging to survive
deleveraging.meta: bu kompaniya, sektor yoki iqtisodiyotda umumiy qarz miqdorini, ayniqsa kapitalga nisbatan qarzni, kamaytirish amaliyoti yoki jarayonidir

ex: Verbs like have in “have a rest” or make in “make a decision” are delexical.
In the phrase "take a shower", the verb take is delexical — it doesn’t mean “to carry” but helps form the phrase.
delexical.meta: bu atama tilshunoslikda ishlatiladi va ba’zi fe’llar (masalan, take, have, make, give) o‘zining aniq semantik (leksik) ma’nosiga ega bo‘lmay, asosan yonidagi ot orqali ma’no hosil qiladigan holatni bildiradi.

ex: The vase had a classic Delft blue pattern of windmills and flowers.
She collects Delft blue plates from the Netherlands.
delft blue.meta: bu oq fon ustiga ko‘k naqshlar bilan bezatilgan, qalay sirli sopol buyumlar turini bildiradi. Ushbu uslub aslida Gollandiyaning Delft shahrida paydo bo‘lgan va aynan shu yerda mashhur bo‘lgan.

ex: The museum was designed by a young Delhiite architect.
As a true Delhiite, she knows all the best places to eat in the city.
delhiite.meta: bu Hindistonning Dehli shahrida tug‘ilgan yoki yashovchi odamni bildiradi. Bu so‘z etnik, madaniy yoki hududiy mansublikni ifodalaydi.

ex: Each deli was known for his wild appearance and unshakable loyalty to the vizier.
The deli were feared for their fearless charges into enemy lines.
deli.meta: bu Usmonli imperiyasining eski davrlarida faoliyat yuritgan yengil otliq harbiy bo‘linma a’zosi bo‘lgan. Ular asosan vazirning shaxsiy qo‘riqchilari sifatida xizmat qilgan hamda janglarda zarba kuchi sifatida foydalanilgan

ex: The company was delicensed for failing to meet safety standards.
The authorities decided to delicense the bar after repeated violations.
delicense.meta: bu shaxs, biznes, transport vositasi yoki muassasani rasmiy faoliyat yuritish huquqini beruvchi litsenziyadan mahrum qilish deganidir. Bu atama ko‘pincha qonuniy buzilishlar yoki litsenziya shartlarini buzganlik sababli qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Education is essential in the destigmatizing of HIV/AIDS.
Public campaigns play a key role in the destigmatizing of mental illness.
destigmatizing.meta: bu biror inson, hodisa yoki holat bilan bog‘liq salbiy ijtimoiy qarashlar (ya’ni stigma, uyat yoki kamchilik deb qaralish)ni bartaraf etish jarayoni.

ex: Her destigmatizing speech helped change public opinion about mental illness.
The film had a destigmatizing message about addiction and recovery.
destigmatizing.meta: ilgari uyatli, jirkanch yoki ijtimoiy jihatdan salbiy deb qaralgan holat yoki mavzularga bo‘lgan salbiy munosabatni kamaytiruvchi yoki yo‘qotuvchi degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: The structure of a dinucleotide includes two linked nucleotide units.
NAD⁺ is a common example of a dinucleotide involved in cellular respiration.
dinucleotide.meta: bu ikkita mononukleotid molekulasidan iborat bo‘lgan kimyoviy birikma. Nukleotidlar DNK va RNKning asosiy tarkibiy qismlari hisoblanadi. Shunday qilib, dinukleotidlar genetik material tuzilmasi va biologik jarayonlarda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: (adjective): Emirati culture places great importance on hospitality.
(noun): She is an Emirati who works in the government sector.
emirati.meta: (ot sifatida): *Birlashgan Arab Amirliklari (BAA)*da tug‘ilgan yoki u yerda yashovchi shaxs. (sifat sifatida): BAAga oid, Amirliklarga xos bo‘lgan narsalarni bildiradi (masalan, madaniyat, til, urf-odat, kiyim, boshqaruv va h.k.).

ex: She finna tell him the truth.
I’m finna go to the store.
finna.meta: bu “fixing to” iborasining qisqartirilgan va og‘zaki shakli bo‘lib, biror ishni qilish arafasida bo‘lish, yaqin orada biror ishni amalga oshirish niyatida bo‘lish ma’nolarini anglatadi

ex: His writing style is marked by a lot of gee-whizzery—he seems amazed by every invention.
The documentary was full of gee-whizzery about space travel.
gee-whizzery.meta: bu kutilmagan narsalar, texnologik yoki ilmiy yangiliklar oldida bildiradigan ajablanish, zavq-shavq yoki quvonch holati, ko‘pincha bu hissiyot ortiqcha, bolalarcha, yoki sodda ishonuvchanlik tarzida ifodalanadi.

ex: Some social networks encourage heterophilic connections to promote diversity.
A heterophilic person may prefer friends from different cultural or ethnic backgrounds.
heterophilic.meta: ijtimoiy fanlarda, ayniqsa sotsiologiyada, bu atama insonlarning o‘zlariga o‘xshamagan, turlicha madaniyat, qarash, irq, ijtimoiy kelib chiqishga ega bo‘lgan boshqalar bilan aloqa qilishga yoki ularga jalb bo‘lishga moyilligini bildiradi

ex: jeez louise, can you stop yelling for one minute?
jeez louise, that was a close call!
it’s so jeezly hot outside today.
i can’t open this jeezly jar!
jeezly.meta: ingliz tilida kuchaytiruvchi sifat yoki ravish sifatida ishlatiladi. Mazmuni jihatidan “damned” yoki “darned” so‘zlariga o‘xshaydi. Ba'zan salbiy ohangda ishlatiladi (masalan, la’natlagan ma’noda), ba’zida esa shunchaki kuchaytiruvchi ifoda bo‘ladi.

ex: jeezum crow, i forgot my keys again!
jeezum! did you see the size of that dog?
jeezum.meta: bu ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan norasmiy undov so‘z bo‘lib, ajablanish, ishonchsizlik, hayrat, yoki hafsalasi pir bo‘lish kabi holatlarda qo‘llaniladi. U ko‘pincha interjektsion iboralarning boshida, masalan, "jeezum crow!" shaklida ishlatiladi

ex: jesus god, that scared the hell out of me!
jesus god, what happened here?!
jesus god.meta: bu ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan kuchli hissiy undov bo‘lib, ajablanish, hayrat, dahshat, ishonchsizlik, yoki hafsala pir bo‘lish holatlarida aytiladi. Bu ibora ko‘pincha hissiy portlash, hayrat yoki tushkunlikni ifodalashda ishlatiladi

ex: his speech was a little too jesusy for a political rally.
she gave away all her money to the poor—pretty jesusy if you ask me
jesusy.meta: sifat (adjective) bo‘lib, iso masihga oid, iso masihga o‘xshash, yoki iso masihga xos fazilatlarni o‘zida aks ettiruvchi degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: the megalodon had a large, thick shell adapted to deep marine environments.
fossils of the megalodon mollusc are often found in ancient seabed rocks.
megalodon.meta: qadimda yashagan, hozirda yo‘qolib ketgan, ikkita po‘choqli (bivalve) dengiz mollyuskasi turkumiga mansub suv jonzoti bo‘lib, uning qotib qolgan (fossillashgan) po‘choqlari Devon, Karbon yoki Perm davridagi tosh qatlamlarida topilgan.

ex: the morache creates a rhythmic scraping sound unique to Ute music.
the musician played the morache during the traditional Ute ceremony.
morache.meta: bu ute xalqiga mansub qadimiy zarbli musiqa asbobi bo‘lib, u tirnalgan (tishli) yog‘och tayoq va unga qarshi ishqalanadigan qisqaroq tayoqcha (yog‘och, suyak yoki metall) dan iborat. U ishqalab chalinadi va ritmik tovushlar chiqaradi

ex: the task was newst complete when they lost power.
he was newst asleep when the noise woke him.
newst.meta: uslub, xarakter yoki daraja nuqtai nazaridan "deyarli", "sal qoldi", "taxminan", "yaqin" ma’nolarida ishlatiladigan eski yoki kam ishlatiladigan ravish (adverb). Hozirgi zamonda bu so‘z juda kam qo‘llanadi yoki eskirgan hisoblanadi

ex: early Christian scribes used nomina sacra to show reverence for holy names.
the word "Jesus" was often written as a nomen sacrum in ancient manuscripts.
nomen sacrum.meta: bu ilk nasroniy kotiblari tomonidan muqaddas diniy ma’noga ega bo‘lgan ayrim so‘zlar uchun maxsus belgilangan qisqartma shaklidir

ex: many non-trinitarian groups emphasize the unity of God rather than a triune nature.
he is a non-trinitarian and does not accept the traditional Christian view of God.
non-trinitarian.meta: bu xristianlikdagi "uchlik aqidasi"ga ishonmaydigan shaxs (ya'ni, Xudo Otani, Xudo O‘g‘lini (Iso), va Muqaddas Ruhni yagona ilohiy mavjudotning uch qiyofasi sifatida qabul qilmaydigan) shaxsni yoki shu e’tiqodga mansub oqimni bildiradi.

ex: novichok agents are among the most dangerous chemical weapons ever developed.
the spy was poisoned with novichok, a deadly nerve agent.
novichok.meta: bu sobiq Sovet Ittifoqida ishlab chiqilgan, juda kuchli va o‘ta zaharli nerv gazlari guruhiga mansub kimyoviy moddadir. U organofosfat birikmalariga kiradi va insonning asab tizimini falaj qilish orqali qisqa vaqt ichida o‘limga olib kelishi mumkin.

ex: the problem with nutritionism is that it overlooks how foods work together in a diet.
nutritionism focuses more on individual nutrients than whole foods.
nutritionism.meta: bu ovqatlanishga oid yondashuv bo‘lib, u **butun oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari o‘rniga ularning ichidagi alohida oziq moddalari (masalan, oqsil, yog‘, uglevod, vitaminlar)**ga urg‘u beradi.

ex: olinguitos are elusive and live high in the cloud forests of the Andes.
the olinguito was only officially identified as a new species in 2013.
olinguito.meta: bu Bassaricyon neblina turiga mansub, Procyonidae (burunduklar va rakunlar) oilasiga kiruvchi, kechqurun faol bo‘ladigan, daraxtlarda yashovchi kichik sut emizuvchi hayvon.

ex: she’s such a pronoid—she always expects the best from everyone.
unlike a paranoid, a pronoid believes the world is conspiring to help them.
pronoid.meta: bu atrofdagi odamlarning unga nisbatan faqat yaxshi niyatda ekaniga, baxtli tasodiflar (serendipity) har yerda mavjudligiga qat’iy ishongan odam

ex: platypus mothers carry their puggles in burrows until they grow stronger.
the zookeeper showed us a puggle, a baby echidna recently hatched.
puggle.meta: bu yosh yoki chaqaloq bosqichidagi ekhidna (tikanli tuyoqli hayvon) yoki platipus (dumaloq burunli suv hayvoni). Ushbu atama asosan hayvonlarning yosh avlodini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: she was pussivanted through the busy market without much ceremony.
he pussivanted the crowd aside to get a better view.
pussivant.meta: biror odamni hurmatsiz yoki shoshilish uchun itarish yoki tortish harakati. Bu so‘z eskirgan va kam ishlatiladi.

ex: developers use sandboxing to test new code without risking system stability.
sandboxing helps prevent malware from damaging the whole system by isolating it.
sandboxing.meta: dastur yoki kodning kompyuter tizimida maxsus ajratilgan va xavfsiz hisoblangan muhitda ishlashini ta’minlash jarayoni. Bu muhitda dastur faqat ruxsat etilgan funksiyalarni bajarishi mumkin va tizimning qolgan qismiga zarar yetkazishdan saqlanadi.

ex: the workers side-loaded the containers onto the ship.
they side-loaded the cargo into the truck to save time.
side-load.meta: biror buyumni, yukni yoki boshqa narsani kemaning, transport vositasining old yoki orqa qismidan emas, balki yon tomonidan yuklash harakati. Shuningdek, bu harakat transport vositasiga yon tomondan yuk tushirishni anglatadi.

ex: the phrase “to spaff one’s load” means to ejaculate semen.
he spaffed after their intimate moment.
spaff.meta: erkaklarda jinsiy ejakulyatsiya qilish harakati. Ba’zan to spaff one’s load iborasi sifatida ishlatiladi, bu urug‘ chiqarishni anglatadi.

ex: the squeeze chute helps keep the animals calm and still during medical treatment.
the farmer led the cattle through the squeeze chute to brand them.
squeeze chute.meta: hayvonlarni, asosan qoramollarni, tor yo‘lakdan birma-bir o‘tkazish uchun mo‘ljallangan joy. Bu qurilma hayvonlarni belgilash, muolaja qilish yoki boshqa maqsadlarda oson ushlab turish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: the st christopher pendant shows the saint carrying the child jesus across a river.
he wore a st christopher medal for protection during his travels.
st christopher.meta: bolakay isho’ni ko‘tarib turgan sent kristofor tasviri tushirilgan diniy medal’yon yoki boshqa buyum. Odatda bu buyum xavfsizlik, himoya va saqlanish ramzi sifatida kiyiladi yoki namoyish etiladi.

ex: steek allows knitters to work in the round before cutting the fabric open.
the knitter added a steek section to make it easier to sew the cardigan edges.
steek.meta: asosan fair isle uslubida to‘qishda ishlatiladigan, qo‘shimcha tikuvlar qismi. Ushbu joy oxir-oqibat kesilib ochiladi, bu esa to‘quvchiga kiyimni orqa yoki old tomonini bemalol ishlash imkonini beradi.

ex: The steeked sweater had a neat opening for the zipper.
This knitted vest is steeked for easy wearing.
steeked.meta: Tikilgan buyumda: Steek (toʻqilgan joyni kesish yoki ochish uchun qilingan kesma) yordamida ishlangan. Ochilishda: Steek yordamida kesilgan yoki ochilgan.

ex: steeking makes it easier to add sleeves to a knitted sweater.
the process of steeking involves cutting the knitted fabric carefully.
steeking.meta: toʻqilgan buyumda ortiqcha tikuv qatorini kesib ochish uchun ishlatiladigan amal, jarayon yoki texnika.

ex: theonomous governance means ruling under god’s authority.
a theonomous society lives according to divine laws
theonomous.meta: xudo hokimiyati, qonunlari yoki vakolatiga bo‘ysunadigan, boshqariladigan.

ex: fishermen warned against being tinkermen to protect fish populations.
the tinkerman was caught using illegal nets to catch small fish.
tinkerman.meta: trink toʻriqidan foydalangan, ayniqsa, noqonuniy ravishda kichik baliqlarni tutuvchi baliqchi.

ex: a tinkerman can sometimes unsettle the players with constant changes.
the tinkerman kept changing the football team’s lineup every match.
tinkerman.meta: sport klubining, ayniqsa futbol klubining boshqaruvchisi yoki murabbiyi boʻlib, doimiy ravishda jamoa tarkibini oʻzgartirib, tajriba qiluvchi shaxs.

ex: a tinker man often travels from village to village for work.
the tinker man repaired the broken pot quickly.
tinker man.meta: temir buyumlarni tuzatadigan yoki yasaydigan erkak.

ex: a tinker woman often travels to different villages for work.
the tinker woman fixed the broken kettle quickly.
tinker woman.meta: temir buyumlarni tuzatadigan yoki yasaydigan ayol.

ex: the tin-kettlers celebrated the newlyweds with loud banging on pots and pans.
tin-kettlers are known for making a joyful but noisy serenade.
tin-kettler.meta: yangi turmush qurgan juftlikni qaynata va boshqa idishlarni urib, shovqin chiqarib tabriklaydigan shovqinli guruh a’zosi.

ex: tivertine is valued for its light color and durability in construction.
the ancient building was made from tivertine stone.
tivertine.meta: qurilishda ishlatiladigan oq yoki och rangli konventsion ohaktosh, asosan bahor suvlaridan yoki yer osti suvlaridan kalsiy karbonatning tushishi natijasida hosil boʻladi.

ex: the travel centre provides information and services for visitors.
the city is a major travel centre attracting tourists from all over the world.
travel centre.meta: koʻplab odamlar sayohat qiladigan yoki keladigan shahar, hudud yoki joy; sayohatchilar yoki sayyohlar uchun qulay baza yoki diqqatga sazovor joy.

ex: the travel guide offers useful tips for tourists.
she bought a travel guide before visiting the new city.
travel guide.meta: sayohatchilar yoki sayyohlar uchun diqqatga sazovor joylar, turar joylar, restoranlar va boshqa ma’lumotlarni taqdim etuvchi kitob, veb-sayt va boshqalar.

ex: a travelling stockman must be skilled at managing large herds on the move.
the travelling stockman moved the cattle across the vast plains.
travelling stockman.meta: chorvani, qo‘ylarni va boshqa hayvonlarni uzoq masofalarga haydovchi, haydovchi yoki haydovchi.

ex: the traversière differs from the recorder by its horizontal position.
the musician played a beautiful melody on the traversière.
traversière.meta: yoqilish o‘qi bo‘ylab emas, balki yon tomondan chaladigan naycha shaklidagi nay, recorderdan farqli ravishda. Keyinchalik asosan barokko davrining fleytasi.

ex: ambrosian music has a distinct style compared to gregorian chant.
the choir performed an ambrosian chant during the ceremony.
ambrosian chant.meta: st. ambrose bilan an’anaviy bog‘liq bo‘lgan, gregorian navodan farq qiluvchi liturgik oddiy qo‘shiq turi; shuningdek, ushbu turdagi madh yoki navolar.

ex: he warned his opponent that he might go home in an ambulance.
if you don’t stop, you’ll be going home in an ambulance.
to go home in an ambulance.meta: og‘ir jarohat olib, zo‘r jazosini olish; ayniqsa, “tez yordamda uyga borasan” iborasi tahdid sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: ambulance airplanes are equipped with medical equipment for emergencies.
the ambulance airplane flew the injured patients to the hospital quickly.
ambulance airplane.meta: kasallar yoki jarohat olgan odamlarni tashish uchun ishlatiladigan samolyot.

ex: ambulance chase is often criticized as unethical behavior in law.
some lawyers are known for ambulance chasing after accidents.
ambulance chase.meta: advokatlarning jarohatlangan yoki zarar ko‘rgan mijozlarni topishga urinishi, kompensatsiya da’volaridan foyda ko‘rish maqsadida mijozlarni izlash.

ex: the lawyer was accused of ambulance chasing after the accident.
ambulance chasing is considered unethical in many legal systems.
ambulance chasing.meta: (a) advokatlarning jarohatlangan yoki zarar ko‘rgan mijozlarni faol ravishda izlab topishi, kompensatsiya da’volaridan foyda olish maqsadida yurishi; (b) bunday amaliyot noetik va qonuniy qoidalar bilan taqiqlangan

ex: ambulance crews are trained to provide emergency medical care on the spot.
the ambulance crew arrived quickly to help the injured person.
ambulance crew.meta: kasallarga yoki jarohat olganlarga favqulodda tibbiy yordam koʻrsatadigan va ularni shifoxonaga olib boradigan malakali tez yordam xodimlari guruhi.

ex: ambulance drivers often receive special training in emergency medical care.
the ambulance driver quickly took the patient to the hospital.
ambulance driver.meta: tez yordam mashinasini boshqaradigan shaxs; keyinchalik ko‘proq jiddiy kasal yoki jarohatlanganlarga favqulodda tibbiy yordam ko‘rsatishga tayyorlangan haydovchi.

ex: the ambulanceman drove the ambulance quickly through the city streets.
the ambulanceman helped carry the wounded soldier to the field hospital.
ambulanceman.meta: (boshida) maydon shifoxonasiga biriktirilgan yordamchi yoki xizmatkor; keyinchalik tez yordam mashinasini haydovchi yoki tez yordam jamoasi a’zosi sifatida ishlatiladi, ayniqsa erkak shaxs.

ex: in Australia, ambulance officers provide emergency medical care on-site.
the ambulance officer coordinated medical aid at the field hospital.
ambulance officer.meta: (a) armiyada maydon shifoxonasiga biriktirilgan zobit (hozir tarixiy atama); (b) (asosan Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya) tez yordam jamoasi a’zosi.

ex: ambulance trains were essential during wartime for medical evacuation.
the ambulance train transported wounded soldiers from the battlefield.
ambulance train.meta: tez yordam vagonlaridan tashkil topgan poyezd; shuningdek, yarador askarlarni tashish uchun maxsus jihozlangan temiryo‘l poyezdi.

ex: ambulance wagons were used before motorized ambulances became common.
the ambulance wagon carried the wounded soldiers to the field hospital.
ambulance wagon.meta: kasal yoki jarohatlangan odamlarni (ayniqsa askarlarni) shifoxonaga olib borish uchun ishlatiladigan yopiq arava.

ex: ambulancewomen played a crucial role during wartime medical evacuations.
the ambulancewoman helped transport injured soldiers to the hospital.
ambulancewoman.meta: kasal yoki jarohatlangan odamlarni (boshida askarlarni) shifoxonaga olib borishda qatnashadigan ayol; tez yordam mashinasini boshqaruvchi yoki tez yordam jamoasi a’zosi bo‘lgan ayol.

ex: amelic conditions often require specialized medical treatment.
the doctor examined the amelic child carefully.
amelic.meta: (a) ameliya kasalligiga chalingan shaxs; (b) ameliya bilan bog‘liq, ameliya xususiyatiga ega yoki shunday tabiatdagi.

ex: ameloblastic tumors develop from cells related to enamel production.
ameloblastic cells play a key role in tooth enamel formation.
ameloblastic.meta: ameloblastlar bilan bog‘liq yoki ular bilan taalluqli.

ex: anemophobia is a rare phobia but can cause significant anxiety.
her anemophobia made it difficult for her to go outside on windy days.
anemophobia.meta: shamoldan qo‘rqish, shamolga nisbatan kuchli bezovtalik yoki fobiya.

ex: meteorologists use anemovanes to study wind speed and direction.
the anemovane showed that the wind was blowing at 15 km/h from the north.
anemovane.meta: shamol tezligini o‘lchash va uning yo‘nalishini ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladigan anemometr va shamol yo‘nalishini ko‘rsatuvchi qurilmaning birlashmasi.

ex: you shouldn’t poke the bear if you want to avoid trouble.
he knew he was poking the bear by criticizing the powerful leader.
to poke the bear.meta: biror xavfli yoki kuchli shaxs yoki guruhni qasddan qo‘zg‘atish, bezovta qilish yoki qattiq ta’sir qilish.

ex: the average bear doesn’t understand complex scientific concepts.
he’s smarter than the average bear.
the average bear.meta: oddiy inson, o‘rtacha shaxs; asosan solishtirma iboralarda, "dan ko‘ra oddiy odam" tarzida ishlatiladi.

ex: the sound of a bear bell can help prevent dangerous encounters with bears.
hikers often wear bear bells to warn bears of their presence.
bear bell.meta: (ko‘proq ko‘plikda ishlatiladi) ayiq yashaydigan hududda yurilayotganda odam borligini signal qilish uchun ryukzak, sayr tayoqchasi va boshqalarga biriktiriladigan qo‘ng‘iroq.

ex: the use of bear bile is controversial due to animal welfare concerns
bear bile has been used in traditional medicine for centuries.
bear bile.meta: ayiqdan olingan jigar suyuqligi; an’anaviy xitoy va Osiyo tibbiyotida jigar kasalliklari va boshqa turli kasalliklarni davolashda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: bear crawl helps to strengthen the core muscles and improve coordination.
the trainer asked us to do a bear crawl for warm-up.
bear crawl.meta: jismoniy mashq turi bo‘lib, unda odam tizzalarini yerga tekkizmasdan, qo‘l va oyoqlari ustida oldinga sudraydi, sonlari havoda bo‘ladi.

ex: make sure your trash bin is bear-proof to avoid unwanted visitors.
the campsite provided bear-proof containers to store food safely.
bear-proof.meta: ayiqdan himoya qiluvchi, ayniqsa chiqindi idishi, oziq-ovqat idishi kabi buyumlar ayiqlarning oziq-ovqatga yoki chiqindiga kirishini samarali oldini oladigan.

ex: they plan to bear-proof the campsite by installing special fences.
the park staff bear-proofed all the trash bins to keep bears away
bear-proof.meta: (ot yoki bino kabi narsani) ayiqlardan himoyalash, ayiqlarning unga kira olmasligini ta’minlash.

ex: bear spray can be very effective in deterring aggressive bears.
hikers carry bear spray as a safety measure in bear country.
bear spray.meta: capsaicin va unga o‘xshash birikmalardan tayyorlangan suyuqlik bo‘lib, ayiqlarning hujum qilishini oldini olish uchun aerosol shaklida purkalanadi; shuningdek, bunday suyuqlikni o‘z ichiga olgan spreyi idishi.

ex: the herbalist prepared a remedy using bear root to treat digestive problems.
bear root has been traditionally used in herbal medicine.
bear root.meta: turli o‘t o‘simliklarning ildizi, odatda dori sifatida ishlatiladi; dastlab hellebore yoki yolg‘on hellebore o‘simligi ildizi nazarda tutilgan; keyinchalik esa boshqa o‘t ildizlari ham shunday ataladi.

ex: the garden was full of bear’s breeches blooming in the summer.
bear’s breeches are popular garden plants because of their large, decorative leaves.
bear’s breeches.meta: Acanthus oilasiga mansub o‘simliklarning istalgan turi, ayniqsa Acanthus mollis va Acanthus spinosus, ko‘pincha bog‘larda barglari va gul qismi uchun yetishtiriladi.

ex: bear spreads are popular among traders who expect a bearish market.
the investor used a bear spread to protect his portfolio from a market decline.
bear spread.meta: bozor pasayishini kutayotgan treyder tomonidan qo‘llaniladigan strategiya; bunda biri sotish uchun, ikkinchisi esa sotib olish uchun mo‘ljallangan ikkita optsion orqali pasayishdan foyda ko‘riladi.

ex: the bearwale protects the sides of the boat from damage.
the sailor held onto the bearwale to keep his balance on the rocking boat.
bearwale.meta: qayiqlarda yoki kemalarda yon tomonda joylashgan mustahkam qism, ya’ni gunwale — qayiqning yuqori qirrasidagi mustahkam qism.

ex: to bear the crown means to carry the responsibility of ruling a nation.
she bore the crown for over twenty years, leading her country wisely.
to bear the crown.meta: monarx sifatida hukmronlik qilish; hukmdor bo‘lish.

ex: to bear the crown means to be recognized as the best among competitors.
she bore the crown in the singing contest last year.
to bear the crown.meta: (haqiqiy yoki ramziy) musobaqada birinchi o‘rinni egallash; g‘olib bo‘lish; eng yaxshi bo‘lish.

ex: she bears a strong resemblance to her mother.
this painting bears a resemblance to the work of a famous artist.
to bear a resemblance to.meta: biror narsaga o‘xshash bo‘lmoq, o‘xshashlik, o‘xshashlik belgisini ko‘rsatmoq.

ex: the consequences of the disaster are not to bear thinking about.
the accident was so terrible, it was not to bear thinking about.
not to bear thinking about.meta: biror narsa juda dahshatli yoki yomon bo‘lib, uning haqida o‘ylashga chidab bo‘lmaslik.

ex: good planning often bears fruit in the long run.
their hard work finally bore fruit and the project was a success.
to bear fruit.meta: musbat natija yoki samaralar berish; meva berish (to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri yoki ramziy ma’noda).

ex: beard burn can be uncomfortable and irritating for sensitive skin.
after their kiss, she noticed a painful beard burn on her cheek.
beard burn.meta: boshqarning soqoli yoki soch tolalari teriga, ayniqsa yuzga tegib, surilishidan kelib chiqqan tirnash, ayniqsa o‘pish paytida yuzaga keladigan shikastlanish.

ex: beardtongue plants are popular for their ornamental tubular flowers.
the garden was full of colorful beardtongue flowers in spring.
beardtongue.meta: Penstemon oilasiga mansub turli gullaydigan o‘simliklar, ularning o‘ziga xos ikki labli, trubka shaklidagi gullari uchun yetishtiriladi.

ex: beard worms have a plume of vascular tentacles resembling a beard.
the beard worm lives in deep-sea hydrothermal vents.
beard worm.meta: Siboglinidae oilasiga mansub, uzun va ingichka dengizdagi trubka shaklidagi jonzotlar bo‘lib, ular qon tomirli tutilgan soqolga o‘xshash cho‘tkaga ega.

ex: bearded clam is a vulgar slang for female genitalia.
he used a slang term referring to the bearded clam in his joke.
bearded clam.meta: ayolning tashqi jinsiy a'zolari, ya’ni vulva va vagina uchun ishlatiladigan noformal ibora.

ex: in the past, bearded ladies were often part of freak shows.
the bearded lady was a famous attraction in old circuses.
bearded lady.meta: chanoq sohasida sezilarli soch o‘sishi bo‘lgan ayol; ko‘pincha tarixda karnaval yoki g‘alati ko‘rgazmalarda namoyish etilgan ayol.

ex: when threatened, the bearded dragon puffs up its beard to look bigger.
the bearded dragon is a popular pet because of its unique appearance.
bearded dragon.meta: australiyaga xos Pogona genusi tarkibidagi agamid ilonboshlari; uy hayvoni sifatida mashhur, bo‘ynining ostida tikanli sumka bor, u qorayadi va kengayadi.

ex: bearded irises are known for their distinctive hairy falls.
the garden is full of colorful bearded irises in spring.
bearded iris.meta: ko‘plab yovvoyi yoki yetishtiriladigan irislardan biri, gullarining pastki barglarida tukchalar (soqolga o‘xshash tuklar) bor.

ex: bearded pigs use their long snouts to dig for roots and insects.
the bearded pig is found in the forests of borneo and sumatra.
bearded pig.meta: janubi-sharqiy osiyoda yashovchi ikki turdagi cho‘chqa — sus barbatus va sus ahoenobarbus; bu cho‘chqalar kichik yumaloq quloqlari, cho‘zilgan tumshug‘i va jag‘ atrofiga o‘sgan tuklari (soqolga o‘xshash) bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: the thick white whiskers of the bearded seal help it detect prey on the seafloor
the bearded seal is commonly found in arctic coastal waters.
bearded seal.meta: katta hajmli arktik tyulen turi — erignathus barbatus; kulrang-jigarrang mo‘yinga ega, oldingi suzgichlari to‘rtburchak shaklida bo‘ladi va yuzida uzun oq mo‘ylov (soqolga o‘xshash) tuklari o‘sadi.

ex: The male bearded tit has a distinctive black patch on either side of its throat.
bearded tit.meta: tananing (odatda yuzning) ikki tomonida o‘sib turgan tuklar bilan ajralib turadigan. Qushlar yoki hayvonlarda, bu so‘z ko‘pincha yuzning yon tomonlarida qora yoki qalin tuklar mavjudligini bildiradi.

ex: Farmers often choose bearded wheat varieties for their resistance to birds and better seed retention.
Bearded wheat is more common in drier climates, where the long awns help protect the grain from pests.
bearded wheat.meta: bug‘doy, arpa yoki boshqa donli o‘simliklarning boshoqlarida uzun va ingichka tuk yoki suyaklarga ega bo‘lgan navlariga nisbatan ishlatiladi. bu suyaklar o‘simlikning urug‘larini himoya qiladi va ba’zan tarqalishiga yordam beradi.

ex: The plant is beardleted, with tiny awns barely visible to the naked eye.
Some varieties of barley are only slightly beardleted, making them easier to harvest.
beardleted.meta: o‘simlik (odatda bug‘doy, arpa va boshqa don ekinlari) boshoqlarining ustida joylashgan, mayda, ingichka tuk yoki sersuyak shaklidagi tuzilmalarga ega bo‘lgan holatni bildiradi. Bu tuzilmalar ba’zan himoya yoki tarqalishga yordam beradi.

ex: During labor, the woman experienced strong bearing down sensations.
The ship was bearing down on the harbor at full speed.
bearing down.meta: faol harakat bilan kuchli bosim o‘tkazish yoki yo‘nalgan hujum. Bu harakat odatda jismoniy kuch bilan yoki maqsadga yo‘naltirilgan harakat shaklida ifodalanadi

ex: There was a noticeable bearing out of the stone ledge beyond the wall.
The bearing out of the beam provided extra support for the upper floor.
bearing out.meta: biror yuzaga nisbatan tashqariga qaratilgan qism yoki chiqindi. Bu qism asosiy sirt bilan bir tekisda bo‘lmaydi, balki undan chiqib turadi yoki ko‘rinadi.

ex: The structure’s bearing up of the load was tested during the inspection.
His bearing up during the crisis was truly admirable.
bearing up.meta: biror og‘irlik, bosim yoki ruhiy sinov oldida mustahkam turish, qulamaslik, og‘irlikni ko‘tarish yoki boshqani ruhlantirish holati. Bu harakat ruhiy-psixologik yoki jismoniy kontekstda qo‘llanilishi mumkin.

ex: Historical records mention the use of bearing arrows in medieval battles.
The archer selected a bearing arrow for the long-range shot.
bearing arrow.meta: katta masofaga uchirish uchun mo‘ljallangan, odatda uzunroq va og‘irroq bo‘lgan kamon o‘qi. U janglarda yoki ovda ishlatilgan bo‘lishi mumkin. "Bearing" bu yerda tashish yoki ko‘tarish ma’nosini emas, uzoqqa yetadigan xususiyatni bildiradi.

ex: The baby was wrapped in a white bearing sheet for the baptism ceremony.
Traditional families often preserve the bearing sheet as a keepsake.
bearing sheet.meta: odatda sifatli, yumshoq matodan tayyorlangan bo‘lib, chaqaloqni o‘rash uchun ishlatiladi, ayniqsa suvga cho‘qinish (xristiancha marosim) paytida

ex: The bearing sword was a symbol of authority and tradition during the coronation.
The guard carried the bearing sword at the front of the royal procession.
bearing sword.meta: odatda ikki qo‘l bilan ko‘tariladigan katta marosim qilichi bo‘lib, bu qilich jang qilish uchun emas, balki rasmiy yurishlarda, qirollik marosimlarida yoki boshqa davlat tantanalarida timsol sifatida ko‘tarib yuriladi

ex: Several bearing trees were used to identify the exact corner of the property.
The bearing tree was marked with paint and recorded in the surveyor’s notes.
bearing tree.meta: geodeziya (yer o‘lchash) ishlarida biror burchak yoki nuqtaning aniq joylashuvini ko‘rsatish uchun tanlab olinib, belgilab qo‘yilgan daraxt. U yerda maxsus belgilar bilan yozuv qoldiriladi va xaritalarda ko‘rsatiladi

ex: Engineers installed bearing plates beneath the bridge beams for stability.
The column rests on a bearing plate that distributes the load to the foundation.
bearing plate.meta: odatda metalldan yasalgan va qurilish inshootlarida ustunlar, nurlar yoki boshqa yuk tashuvchi elementlar ostida joylashtiriladigan plastinka bo‘lib, u bosimni kengroq maydonga taqsimlash va strukturaviy yukni barqaror taqsimlash uchun xizmat qiladi

ex: The architect identified which walls were bearing walls and which were partitions.
Removing a bearing wall without reinforcement could cause the building to collapse
bearing wall.meta: bu bino yoki inshootda yuqoridagi qavatlar, tom yoki boshqa yuklarni ko‘taradigan va bu yukni poydevorga taqsimlab uzatadigan asosiy devor

ex: The divine word gave birth to the universe.
According to mythology, the goddess gave birth to the first humans.
to give (a person or thing) birth.meta: bu kontekstda, biror ilohiy kuch tomonidan insonni yoki mavjudotni hayotga olib kelish, unga hayot ato etish yoki yaratish harakatini bildiradi.

ex: This small village gave birth to one of the most famous poets in the country.
The city of Salzburg gave birth to Mozart.
to give birth to (a person).meta: bu ibora biror shaxsning tug‘ilgan joyini bildiradi. Ya’ni, biror shahar, mamlakat yoki hudud kimningdir vatani, tug‘ilgan yeri bo‘lganini aytish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: According to ancient belief, the goddess gave birth to the first humans from clay.
The Creator gave birth to the universe and all that is within it.
to give birth to.meta: bu kontekstda, Xudo yoki ilohiy kuch tomonidan inson, mavjudot, yoki butun borliqni hayotga keltirish, ularni bor qilganlik harakatini anglatadi. Bu jismoniy tug‘ilish emas, balki ruhoniy yoki yaratuvchan jarayondir.

ex: The birth announcement included the baby’s name, weight, and date of birth.
They placed a birth announcement in the local newspaper.
birth announcement.meta: Yangi tug‘ilgan bola haqida yozma ravishda beriladigan rasmiy yoki norasmiy e’lon; avval gazetalarda tug‘ilish, o‘lim va boshqa shaxsiy voqealar haqidagi e’lonlar bo‘limida chop etilgan

ex: Some people do not identify with their birth-assigned sex.
She identifies as a woman, although her birth-assigned gender was male.
birth-assigned.meta: Shaxs tug‘ilganida hujjatlarda yoki tibbiy ko‘rik asosida belgilanadigan jins (erkak yoki ayol). Bu atama odatda ijtimoiy yoki huquqiy kontekstda, ayniqsa gender identifikatsiyasi muhokamasida ishlatiladi.

ex: Many rural communities rely on traditional birth attendants.
The birth attendant stayed with the mother throughout labor.
birth attendant.meta: Ayollarga homiladorlik (antenatal), tug‘ruq (childbirth) va tug‘ruqdan keyingi (postnatal) davrlarda tibbiy yoki amaliy yordam ko‘rsatadigan shaxs; ayniqsa, bu ish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi malakali mutaxassis (ko‘pincha akusher yoki do‘la).

ex: Any blockage in the birth canal can complicate delivery.
During natural childbirth, the baby passes through the birth canal.
birth canal.meta: Homila (chaqaloq) tug‘ilish vaqtida ona bachadonidan tashqariga o‘tadigan yo‘l — bu yo‘l bachadon bo‘yni (serviks), qin (vagina) va tashqi jinsiy a’zolar (vulva)dan iborat.

ex: Birth centres focus on natural childbirth and personalized care.
She chose to give birth at a birth centre instead of a hospital.
birth centre.meta: Asosan homilador ayollarni qabul qilish, tug‘ruqni kuzatish va chaqaloqni dunyoga keltirishga ixtisoslashgan tibbiy muassasa. Bu markazlar odatda uyga o‘xshash muhit yaratadi va tibbiy aralashuvni minimal darajada saqlashga harakat qiladi.

ex: Historically, birth chairs were commonly used before hospital beds became standard.
The midwife helped her onto the birth chair when contractions became strong.
birth chair.meta: Ayolning tug‘ruq vaqtida o‘tirgan holatda bola tug‘ishini qulaylashtirish uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus stul. Ushbu stul odatda U shaklida bo‘ladi, pastki qismi ochiq bo‘lib, chaqaloqning chiqqanini osonlashtiradi va akusherlarga qulaylik yaratadi.

ex: Researchers compared different birth cohorts to study changes in childhood obesity.
The study followed a birth cohort of children born in 2000 to assess long-term health trends.
birth cohort.meta: Demografik yoki epidemiologik tadqiqotlarda — muayyan vaqt oralig‘ida tug‘ilgan shaxslar guruhidan tashkil topgan populyatsiya bo‘limi. Bu guruh odatda bir xil yillarda tug‘ilgan odamlardan iborat bo‘ladi

ex: Doctors monitored the newborn closely for signs of birth injury
The baby suffered a minor birth injury to the shoulder during delivery.
birth injury.meta: Tug‘ruq jarayonida homila (chaqaloq) olgan tan jarohati. Bu jarohatlar mexanik bosim, noto‘g‘ri holat yoki tibbiy aralashuvlar natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Ba’zan jiddiy asoratlarga olib keladi.

ex: Researchers study how birth order affects personality development.
His birth order as the eldest child made him more responsible.
birth order.meta: Bir oiladagi farzandlarning tug‘ilish ketma-ketligi — ya’ni kim birinchi, kim ikkinchi, kim oxirgi tug‘ilgan. Tug‘ilish tartibi ko‘pincha shaxsning xarakteri, roli va oilaviy munosabatlardagi o‘rniga ta’sir qilishi mumkin, degan nazariyalar mavjud.

ex: Birth palsy can result from prolonged or complicated labor.
The child was diagnosed with birth palsy affecting the right arm.
birth palsy.meta: Tug‘ruq jarayonida miya, orqa miya yoki periferik asablarning shikastlanishi natijasida chaqaloqda yuzaga keladigan mushaklarning zaifligi, falajlik yoki harakat muvofiqligining buzilishi.

ex: The astrologer prepared a birth paper predicting the child’s destiny.
You need your birth paper to apply for a passport.
birth paper.meta: Bolani tug‘ilganda astrolog tomonidan tuziladigan yulduzlar xaritasi yoki horoskop. Unga ko‘ra bolaning kelajagi, xarakteri va taqdiri bashorat qilinadi. Bu atama asosan Hindiston inglizchasida ishlatilgan va hozirda kam uchraydi.

ex: Native American medicine included birthroot as a remedy for menstrual cramps.
In old herbal texts, birthroot was used to ease childbirth.
birthroot.meta: Tarixda Aristolochia rotunda kabi ayrim o‘simliklar ayollarning tug‘ruqdagi holatini yengillashtirish yoki tug‘ruqni tezlashtirish uchun ishlatilgan. Bu atama hozirgi davrda deyarli qo‘llanilmaydi.

ex: They proudly submitted the baby’s details to the births column.
Her son’s name appeared in the births column of the local newspaper.
births column.meta: Gazetaning yangi tug‘ilgan bolalar haqida e’lonlar beriladigan maxsus rukni yoki ustuni. Unda odatda bolaning ismi, tug‘ilgan sanasi, ota-onasining ismi va ba’zan tug‘ilish joyi ko‘rsatiladi.

ex: Birth spacing is important for the health of both the mother and the child.
Doctors recommend at least two years of birth spacing between children
birth spacing.meta: Bir oiladagi ketma-ket farzandlarning tug‘ilishlari orasidagi vaqt oralig‘i. Shuningdek, farzandlar orasidagi sog‘lom oraliqni saqlash maqsadida rejalashtirilgan tug‘ilish muddatlari ham shu tushunchaga kiradi.

ex: The birthday honours list recognizes people from all walks of life.
She was included in the birthday honours list for her contributions to education.
birthday honours list.meta: Buyuk Britaniya monarxining rasmiy tug‘ilgan kuni munosabati bilan har yili e’lon qilinadigan, turli shaxslar davlat xizmatlari, fan, san’at, sport, ijtimoiy faoliyat kabi sohalardagi xizmatlari uchun orden bilan taqdirlanadigan faxriylar ro‘yxati.

ex: She attended antenatal classes where they practiced positions on a birthing ball.
Using a birthing ball helped ease her back pain during labour.
birthing ball.meta: Tug‘ruq vaqtida yoki tug‘ruqqa tayyorgarlik ko‘rish davrida ayollar tomonidan ishlatiladigan katta, havo bilan to‘ldirilgan elastik gimnastik to‘p. Bu to‘p ayolga og‘riqni yengillashtirish, holatni o‘zgartirish va qulayroq o‘tirish imkonini beradi

ex: Historical birthing chairs were made of wood and had a hole in the center.
The midwife brought a birthing chair to help her during active labour.
birthing chair.meta: Ayol tug‘ruq vaqtida o‘tirgan holatda farzand dunyoga keltirishi uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus kursi. Ushbu kursilar odatda U shaklidagi o‘rindiqqa ega bo‘lib, bu ayolga qulay holatda bo‘lish va chaqaloqning chiqishini osonlashtirishga yordam berad

ex: The birthing stool helped her stay upright and use gravity during delivery.
Some traditional cultures still use birthing stools for home births.
birthing stool.meta: Ayol tug‘ruq vaqtida o‘tirgan holatda farzand tug‘ishi uchun maxsus ishlab chiqilgan, odatda U shaklidagi o‘rindiqqa ega bo‘lgan past va tayanchli stul (kursicha).

ex: Many countries do not recognize birthright citizenship unless at least one parent is a citizen.
In the United States, birthright citizenship is guaranteed by the Constitution.
birthright citizenship.meta: Shaxsning ota-onasidan qat’i nazar, biror mamlakat hududida tug‘ilganligi asosida avtomatik tarzda o‘sha mamlakat fuqaroligiga ega bo‘lish huquqi.

ex: In moments of despair, she would say she wished she had never been born.
After losing everything in the fire, he wished he had never been born.
to wish one had never been born.meta: Shunchalik og‘ir ruhiy iztirob yoki jismoniy azobni boshdan kechirishki, odam o‘z hayoti mavjud bo‘lmaganini, umuman tug‘ilmaganini afzal ko‘rgan bo‘ladi. Bu ifoda asosan kuchli depressiya, qayg‘u yoki umidsizlik holatlarida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: They always get out of trouble unharmed. I guess one born to be hanged will never be drowned.
He fell into the river but somehow survived. “Well,” said the old man, “one born to be hanged will never be drowned.”
one born to be hanged will never be drow.meta: Bu maqol inson taqdiridan, ya’ni taqdirda nima yozilgan bo‘lsa, o‘sha sodir bo‘lishiga ishonch bildiradi. Ya’ni kimdir osilish uchun tug‘ilgan bo‘lsa, u cho‘kib o‘lmaydi — unga boshqacha o‘lim nasib etmagan.

ex: They act like they deserve respect, but really, their father was just born before them.
He lives in a mansion and never worked a day in his life — well, his father was born before him.
his father was born before him.meta: Bu ibora biror kishi o‘z boyligini yoki ijtimoiy mavqeini o‘zi ishlab topmaganini, balki ota-onasidan yoki ajdodlaridan meros qilib olganini kinoyali tarzda ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi

ex: He fell for the scam so easily — well, there’s one born every minute.
You paid $200 for that fake watch? There’s one born every minute.
one born every minute.meta: Bu ibora odatda sodda, ishonuvchan yoki aldovga tez uchraydigan odamlar har doim va hamma joyda mavjudligini kinoyali tarzda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi

ex: She says she’s tired again? That girl was born tired!
He never lifts a finger to help — must’ve been born tired.
born tired.meta: Bu ibora doimiy ravishda erinchoq, faol emas yoki hech narsaga qiziqmaydigan odamlarga nisbatan kinoyaviy va hazil aralash tarzda qo‘llanadi. Ya’ni, odam shunchalik dangasa yoki beparvo ekanki, go‘yoki u allaqachon charchagan holatda tug‘ilgandek.

ex: He burps loudly at the dinner table. His sister says, “Were you born in a barn?”
You put your muddy shoes on the couch — were you born in a barn?
were you born in a barn?.meta: Bu ibora odatda eshikni yopmasdan kirgan, odobsizlik qilgan yoki umumiy gigiyena/odob qoidalariga amal qilmagan odamga nisbatan tanbeh sifatida aytiladi.

ex: From me born, I never see snow.
From her born, she never eat meat.
from me born.meta: Bu ibora asosan yamaykalik ingliz tilida qo‘llanadi va “men dunyoga kelganimdan beri”, ya’ni butun hayotim davomida degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: Some people don’t realize how lucky they are — they just don’t know they are born.
He complains all the time, but he doesn’t know he is born.
not to know one is born.meta: Bu ifoda biror odam o‘z hayotidagi qulayliklar, omad yoki farovonlikni qadrlamasligi, o‘zining qancha yaxshi sharoitda yashayotganini tushunmasligini bildiradi.

ex: Many heirs are born on third base, inheriting family wealth and privileges.
He didn’t have to struggle for success — he was born on third base.
to be born on third (base).meta: kimningdir hayotga boshqalarga nisbatan katta imtiyozlar, ayniqsa moliyaviy yoki ijtimoiy jihatdan qulay sharoitlarda tug‘ilgani, ko‘pincha ota-onadan meros sifatida katta boylik yoki mavqega ega bo‘lganini anglatadi

ex: Don’t be fooled by him; he’s just someone born behind a cow.
He believes every story he hears — he was born behind a cow.
to be born behind (or back) a cow.meta: Bu ibora yamaykalik ingliz tilida ishlatiladi va kimningdir juda sodda, bexabar yoki tajribasizligini ifodalash uchun qo‘llanadi. Ya’ni, odam boshqalar oldida juda oddiy, nazdor yoki “donolikdan yiroq” ekanligini bildiradi. Kinoya va hazil aralash ta’rif.

ex: Doctors confirmed that the child was born alive, showing a heartbeat at delivery.
The baby was born alive but passed away shortly after birth.
born alive.meta: Bu atama tug‘ilgan paytda yurak urishi yoki boshqa hayotiy belgilar ko‘rsatilgan chaqaloqni ifodalaydi, lekin u tug‘ilgandan keyin qisqa vaqt ichida o‘ladi yoki deyarli o‘lish holatida bo‘ladi.

ex: They grew up together as born brothers.
He is my born brother; we share the same mother.
born brother.meta: Bir kishining kamida bitta ota-onasi bir xil bo‘lgan boshqa erkak yoki yigit bilan bog‘lanishi. Ya’ni, tug‘ma aka-uka, qon orqali bog‘langan aka-uka.

ex: He is a born-free South African, born after the end of apartheid.
The born-free generation grew up with hopes for equality and freedom.
born-free.meta: Asosan Afrika mamlakatlarida, xususan, Janubiy Afrikada apartheid (irqiy ajratish siyosati) tugaganidan keyin yoki mustaqillikka erishganidan keyingi davrda mamlakatda tug‘ilgan avlod a’zosi

ex: He acted like a born idiot by ignoring all the warnings.
The term "born idiot" is offensive and should not be used.
born idiot.meta: Avvaliga tug‘ma aqli ojizlik yoki ruhiy nogironlik bilan dunyoga kelgan odamni bildirgan, ammo bugungi kunda bu ibora haqorat sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: Be careful not to be caught in a bull trap during volatile market conditions.
Many investors fell into a bull trap when the stock price briefly rose before falling again.
bull trap.meta: Moliyaviy bozorlar yoki savdo sohasida pastlash davrida bozor yoki aksiyalar, tovarlarning qiymati ko‘tarilgandek ko‘rinib, investorlarni sotib olishga undovchi, ammo aslida o‘sish barqaror emas va keyinchalik yana tushib ketadigan holat

ex: That breakout looked promising, but it turned out to be a classic bull trap.
Many traders got caught in a bull trap when the stock temporarily rallied above resistance before crashing again.
bull trap.meta: Bull trap (soxta o‘sish) — bu bozordagi yoki aksiyadagi kamayish davridan keyin, u go‘yoki tiklana boshlagandek ko‘ringan holatdir.

ex: Please, for Christ’s sake, help me understand this problem.
For Christ’s sake, stop making so much noise!
for christ’s sake.meta: Bu ifoda iltimos, achinish, norozilik yoki hayratni kuchli tarzda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda jiddiy yoki qattiq his-tuyg‘ularni bildiradi va biroz ta’kid yoki shiddat qo‘shadi.

ex: The harvest will be good this year, Christ willing.
We will meet again next year, if Christ will.
if christ will (also christ willing).meta: Bu ibora Xristning yordami yoki ijozatiga bog‘liqlikni ifodalaydi. Ya’ni, biror ishning Xristning roziligi yoki yordamiga bog‘liq ekanligini bildiradi

ex: Christ be praised for keeping us safe during the storm.
Christ be thanked, the operation was successful.
christ be thanked.meta: Bu ibora Xristning yordami yoki aralashuvi uchun minnatdorchilikni ifodalaydi. Ya’ni, qandaydir yaxshi natija yoki yordam uchun Xristga shukur aytiladi.

ex: Christ on a bike, why did you do that?
Christ on a bike! I can’t believe what just happened!
christ on a bike.meta: Bu ibora asosan hazil yoki hayrat, hayajon, g‘azab, yoki hafsala pir bo‘lishni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. “Christ on a bike” deganda so‘zma-so‘z ma’no emas, balki kuchli emotsiyani ifodalovchi ta’bir sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: I swear by Christ, I am telling the truth.
By Christ, I did not expect to see you here!
by christ.meta: Bu ibora qasam sifatida yoki hayrat, ishonchsizlik, ta’kid ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha kuchli his-tuyg‘ularni ifodalashda qo‘llanadi va diniy mazmuni bor bo‘lsa-da, kundalik nutqda kuchli so‘z sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: To Christ, I hope everything will be fine.
I swear to Christ, I never lied to you.
to christ.meta: Bu ifoda gapning rostligi yoki samimiyligini kuchaytirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha umid, tilak yoki istak ifodasida qo‘llanadi, ya’ni kimdir biror narsani chin dildan yoki qattiq umid qilib aytmoqda.

ex: The Christ candle symbolizes the light of Jesus entering the world.
Every Christmas, we light the Christ candle and place it in the window.
christ candle.meta: Dastlab, bu sham’ Rojdestvo bayramida yoqilib, derazaga qo‘yilgan sham’ bo‘lib, uning vazifasi Xrist bolani (Masih bolasi) yo‘naltirish yoki yo‘l ko‘rsatish hisoblangan

ex: Her teachings are deeply Christ-centred, focusing on love and forgiveness.
The church promotes a Christ-centred approach to faith and life.
christ-centred.meta: Diniy e’tiqod yoki qarashda Xrist asosiy o‘rin tutadi; Iso Masihning ta’limotlariga tayangan, ularni markaz qilib olgan

ex: Scholars often study the Christ event as a historical phenomenon.
The Christ event is central to Christian history and belief.
christ event.meta: Asosan Iso Masihning hayoti va o‘limi bilan bog‘liq tarixiy voqea. Bu voqea diniy yoki teologik masaladan ko‘ra, tarixiy hodisa sifatida ko‘riladi. Iso Masihning dunyoga kelishi, xizmatlari va qurboni sifatida o‘limi bu voqeani tashkil etadi.

ex: The term 'Christ-killer' is now considered offensive and is rarely used.
In old texts, some people were called Christ-killers for opposing Christian teachings.
christ-killer.meta: Tarixda yoki eski matnlarda Iso Masihning ta’limotlariga qarshi harakat qilgan yoki gapirgan shaxs uchun ishlatilgan atama (hozirda eskirgan va noto‘g‘ri hisoblanadi).

ex: He is a devoted member of Christ’s church.
Christ’s church is found all over the world with many different denominations.
christ’s church.meta: Nasroniylikka oid diniy tashkilot yoki aynan Iso Masihga tegishli deb hisoblangan cherkov. Bu atama umumiy ma’noda nasroniy diniy jamiyatini yoki uning ma’lum bir denominatsiyasini bildiradi.

ex: He spoke with anger, as if pronouncing Christ’s curse on his enemies.
Some believed that the evil-doer had received Christ’s curse.
christ’s curse.meta: (a) Iso Masih tomonidan berilgan la’nat yoki qasos so‘zi; (b) Iso nomidan aytilgan yoki Iso nomiga asoslangan la’nat.

ex: In medieval times, the christen court had significant authority over religious matters.
The christen court handled disputes related to church property and clergy conduct.
christen court.meta: Din bilan bog‘liq masalalarni ko‘rib chiqadigan sud yoki diniy sudyalar majlisi. Ushbu sud kanonik huquq va diniy ishlar bo‘yicha yurisdiktsiyaga ega. Odatda, cherkov va diniy muassasalarning qonuniy masalalarini hal qiladi.

ex: In Christendom, many holidays are based on Christian traditions.
He is known as one of the greatest scholars in Christendom.
in christendom.meta: Nasroniylik dunyosida yoki nasroniylar yashaydigan hududlarda. Ko‘pincha butun nasroniy jamoasini yoki nasroniylik ta’siri ostidagi hududlarni anglatadi.

ex: The new employees looked like a whore at a christening among the old staff.
He was like a whore at a christening at the meeting — completely uncomfortable and out of place.
like a whore at a christening.meta: Ma’lum bir vaziyatda yoki tadbirda o‘z o‘rnini topa olmaydigan, nomuvofiq yoki noqulay holatda bo‘lgan odamni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora. Asosan, odamning joyi noto‘g‘ri, vaziyatga mos kelmayotganini anglatadi.

ex: Please, call me by my Christian name, not by my surname.
They christened the baby John at the church ceremony.
christian-name.meta: (a) Bir kishiga rasmiy yoki an’anaviy ravishda berilgan ismi, odatda cherkov yoki diniy marosimlarda beriladigan ism; (b) Bir kishini uning rasmiy ismi bilan chaqirish yoki murojaat qilish.

ex: He listens mostly to Christian rock because of its positive and inspiring lyrics.
Christian rock bands often perform at church events and religious festivals.
christian rock.meta: Xristianlik mavzulariga bag‘ishlangan, asosan protestant evangelizmi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan va xristian ruhiyati, e’tiqodi haqida kuchli xabarlarni o‘z ichiga olgan rok musiqasi turi.

ex: Christian-wise, many traditions focus on charity and compassion.
Christian-wise, forgiveness is very important.
christian-wise.meta: (a) Xristian odatlari, qadriyatlari va e’tiqodi asosida amalga oshirilgan; (b) Nasroniylarga oid yoki nasroniylar nuqtai nazaridan.

ex: Many stores have big sales during Christmas in July.
We threw a Christmas in July party to enjoy the festive spirit in the summer.
christmas in july.meta: Iyul oyida (yoki iyun oyida) nishonlanadigan, haqiqiy Rojdestvoga o‘xshash bayram. Bu bayram yoz oyida Rojdestvo kayfiyatini yaratish uchun o‘tkaziladi.

ex: You won the lottery? Christmas comes early for you!
I got a huge bonus at work today — Christmas comes early this year!
christmas comes early.meta: “Rojdestvo erta keladi” iborasi juda yoqimli yoki omadli voqea sodir bo‘layotganini yoki allaqachon sodir bo‘lganini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi, ayniqsa bu voqea kutilganidan oldin yoki o‘z vaqtida bo‘lsa.

ex: Winning the jackpot and getting a surprise party the same day is like having all your Christmases come at once.
When she got the job offer, the house, and the car all in one week, it felt like all her Christmases had come at once.
all one’s christmases come at once.meta: Barcha Rojdestvolaring bir vaqtda kelishi” iborasi juda katta omad yoki baxtga duch kelganini bildiradi; ya’ni, kishi hohlagan yoki umid qilgan barcha narsalar bir vaqtning o‘zida amalga oshmoqda.

ex: In South Africa, the arrival of Christmas beetles signals the start of the holiday season.
The Christmas beetles make a loud buzzing noise during the summer evenings.
christmas beetle.meta: Janubiy Afrikaga xos bo‘lgan ba’zi turdagi sikadalar (kapalaklar), ularning erkaklari yozda (ya’ni, Rojdestvo vaqtida) baland va shovqinli shirr-shirr ovoz chiqaradi.

ex: Many banks offer Christmas clubs to help customers budget for the festive season.
She joined a Christmas club to save money gradually for holiday gifts.
christmas club.meta: Rojdestvo klub — yil davomida ishtirokchilar muntazam ma’lum miqdorda pul yig‘ib boradigan, shuningdek, bayramlar oldidan tovar yoki xizmatlarni sotib olish uchun mo‘ljallangan qisqa muddatli jamg‘arma dasturi.

ex: The Christmas cracker made a loud cracking noise when it was pulled apart.
At Christmas dinner, they pulled the Christmas crackers and laughed at the jokes inside.
christmas cracker.meta: Rojdestvo puflagi — o‘yin yoki hazil uchun tayyorlangan, ichida suv va o‘ram bor bo‘lgan qurol kamarasi (miltiq qopqog‘i kabi), olovga qo‘yilganda, olovli o‘q kabi shovqin chiqaradigan predmet (hozirda asosan Britaniya bayramlarida ishlatiladi).

ex: The Christmas tree was covered with colorful decorations and lights.
They put up beautiful Christmas decorations around the house.
christmas decoration.meta: Rojdestvo bezagi — Rojdestvo bayramida uy yoki boshqa joylarni bezash uchun ishlatiladigan turli narsalar, masalan, zanjirlar, chiroqlar, qog‘oz zanjirlar, gulchechaklar va boshqalar; odatda ko‘plik shaklda ishlatiladi.

ex: Finding the perfect Christmas gift can be challenging.
She received many Christmas gifts from her family and friends.
christmas gift.meta: Rojdestvo sovg‘asi — (a) Rojdestvo bayramida beriladigan sovg‘a; shuningdek, ma’noda ham ishlatiladi. = Rojdestvo hadiyasi. (b) Qo‘llanilishi: (AQShning ba’zi hududlarida, ayniqsa janubiy va markaziy mintaqalarda) hazil tariqasida ishlatiladigan ibora.

ex: Every year, we hang Christmas lights on the tree and around the windows.
The house was beautifully decorated with colorful Christmas lights.
christmas lights.meta: Rojdestvo davrida bezak sifatida ishlatiladigan shamlar, lampalar yoki boshqa turdagi chiroqlar; ba’zida yagona shaklda ham ishlatiladi. Keyingi paytlarda ayniqsa (a) ketma-ket ulanadigan kichik elektr chiroqlar qatori.

ex: She baked a delicious Christmas log cake decorated with chocolate and berries.
On Christmas Eve, families traditionally burn the Christmas log in the fireplace.
christmas log.meta: (a) An’anaviy ravishda Rojdestvo kechasida pechda yoqiladigan katta yog‘och bo‘lagi; = Yule log (qishki bayram yog‘ochi). (b) Yog‘och shaklidagi pirojnoe (ko‘pincha shveytsariyalik rulon).

ex: The Christmas number one single usually gets a lot of radio play and attention.
Every year, artists compete to have the Christmas number one on the music charts.
christmas number one.meta: (muzika chartida, kitob ro‘yxatida va boshqalarda) ma’lum bir Rojdestvoga yaqin davrda eng ko‘p sotilgan mahsulotning (qo‘shiq, albom, kitob va boshqalar) birinchi o‘rni.

ex: Locals decorate their homes with branches of the Christmas bush during the holiday season.
The Christmas bush blooms with fragrant white flowers in late autumn.
christmas bush.meta: (a) tropik Amerika mintaqasida tez o‘sadigan, Chromolaena odorata nomli o‘simlik bo‘lib, hidli barglari va oq rangli truba shaklidagi gulchambarlari bor; (b) ba’zi hududlarda Rojdestvo atrofida gullaydigan boshqa o‘simliklar nomi sifatida ham ishlatiladi

ex: He carefully wrote down the addresses on his Christmas card list.
Every December, she updates her Christmas card list to include new friends.
christmas card list.meta: har yili Rojdestvo bayrami munosabati bilan kartochka jo‘natiladigan odamlar ro‘yxati.

ex: Her Christmas decorations were a bit too Christmas-cardy for my taste—too sweet and sentimental.
The movie had a very Christmas-cardy feel with all the snowy scenes and cheerful music.
christmas-cardy.meta: an’anaviy Rojdestvo kartochkalaridagi kabi ko‘rinadigan, ko‘pincha oddiy, hissiy yoki stereotipik tasvirlar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan. Odatda biroz zerikarli yoki ortiqcha hissiyotli ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The theology of this church is strongly Christocentric, centering its teachings around Jesus.
Christocentricism emphasizes the importance of focusing on Christ in all aspects of faith.
christocentricism.meta: din yoki teologiyada Iso Masihni markazga qo‘yish, uning ta’limotlari va shaxsiga asoslanish. Bu qarash Iso Masih markazida turishini, barcha e’tiqod va amal shunday asosda shakllanishini anglatadi.

ex: The theologian analyzed the text Christologically to understand the role of Christ in salvation.
The book discusses the issue Christologically, focusing on the nature of Jesus.
christologically.meta: Iso Masihning tabiati, shaxsi va ta’limotlarini o‘rganish yoki muhokama qilish usuli bilan bog‘liq holda, Iso Masihga oid nuqtai nazardan yoki Isoga oid ilohiy masalalar nuqtai nazaridan.

ex: Contrast agents are commonly used in MRI and CT scans to highlight organs.
The doctor injected a contrast agent to get a clearer image of the blood vessels.
contrast agent.meta: tananing bir qismiga kiritiladigan, rentgen yoki boshqa tibbiy tasvir olish usullarida ichki tuzilmalarning farqlanishini oshirish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus moddalar.

ex: Before the MRI, the patient was given a contrast agent to highlight possible tumors.
The contrast agent helped the doctors see the blood vessels more clearly during the CT scan.
contrast agent.meta: bu organizmning muayyan qismlariga (odatda qon tomirlari, ichki a’zolar yoki to‘qimalar) yuboriladigan maxsus kimyoviy moddadir.

ex: Please sit criss-cross applesauce for the meditation exercise.
The children sat criss-cross applesauce on the classroom floor during story time.
criss-cross applesauce.meta: oyoqlarni xoch shaklida kesib o‘tirish holati; oyoqlarni xochlab o‘tirish.

ex: They took deliberation on the proposal for several days.
The council took deliberation before making the final decision.
to take deliberation.meta: biror narsani diqqat bilan ko‘rib chiqish, maslahatlashish yoki qaror qabul qilishdan oldin yaxshilab o‘ylash; eski uslubda ishlatiladi.

ex: Deliberative democracy encourages citizens to discuss issues before voting.
In a deliberative democracy, public debate is essential for making informed decisions.
deliberative democracy.meta: qaror qabul qilish jarayonida haqiqiy munozara va bahs-munozara olib boriladigan, ko‘pincha umumiy kelishuvga erishishga intiladigan demokratiya shakli. Ba’zan bu atama aynan bir demokratik tizim shaklini ifodalaydi.

ex: Handle the antique vase delicatively to prevent damage.
She spoke delicatively to avoid hurting his feelings.
delicatively.meta: biror ishni nozik, muloyim, ehtiyotkorlik bilan qilish holati yoki tarzda. Bu so‘z odatda biror harakat yoki so‘zlarni yumshoqlik bilan, ehtiyotkorlik bilan bajarishni ifodalaydi.

ex: The enzyme's activity depends on the formation of disulphide bonds.
Disulfide bonds help stabilize the three-dimensional structure of proteins.
disulphide bond.meta: ikki oltingugurt (sulfur) atomlari o‘rtasidagi kovalent bog‘lanish, —S—S— shaklida bo‘lib, bu bog‘ polipeptid zanjirlarini uch o‘lchamli tuzilishda bir-biriga bog‘laydi. Bu bog‘ oqsillarning barqarorligi va funktsiyasini ta’minlashda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: Insulin consists of two chains held together by disulphide bonds.
Disulphide bonds help stabilize the tertiary structure of proteins.
disulphide bond.meta: Disulfid bog‘i — bu ikki oltingugurt (S) atomi o‘rtasida yuzaga keluvchi kovalent bog‘, ya’ni —S—S— shaklidagi kimyoviy ulanishdir. U oqsil molekulalaridagi polipeptid zanjirlarini o‘zaro bog‘lab, ularning uch o‘lchamli strukturasini barqarorlashtiradi

ex: The knight dree death defending his kingdom.
In old tales, many heroes dree death with honor.
to dree deat.meta: hayotdan chiqish, jon berish, vafot etish. Bu so‘z hozirda kam ishlatiladi, ko‘proq eski adabiy yoki tarixiy matnlarda uchraydi

ex: Vaccination programs aim to achieve herd immunity in the population.
Herd immunity helps prevent outbreaks of contagious diseases.
herd immunity.meta: yuqumli kasallikning jamoa ichida tarqalishini to‘xtatishga qodir holat, bunda aholining yetarli qismi emlangan yoki kasallikni boshidan kechirgan bo‘ladi.

ex: During the pandemic, scientists debated whether herd immunity could be reached without vaccination.
Herd immunity can protect vulnerable individuals who cannot be vaccinated.
herd immunity.meta: Jamoaviy immunitet — bu yuqumli kasallik aholining katta qismi (ko‘pincha 70–90%) emlangan yoki kasallikni boshdan kechirgan taqdirda yuzaga keladigan holat bo‘lib, bunda kasallik populyatsiya bo‘yicha tarqalmaydi.

ex: Horse hockey is a popular sport among the nobility.
He has been playing horse hockey since childhood.
horse hockey.meta: ot ustida o‘ynaladigan sport turi, unda o‘yinchilar to‘pni tayanch tayoqcha yordamida raqib darvozasiga kiritishga harakat qilishadi.

ex: Watching horse hockey for the first time, I was amazed by the speed and control.
He plays horse hockey on the weekends at the country club.
horse hockey.meta: Otli xokkey (polo) — bu ot ustida o‘ynaladigan jamoaviy sport turi bo‘lib, unda har bir o‘yinchi uzun tayoq yordamida kichik koptokni raqib darvozasiga urishga harakat qiladi. O‘yin tezlik, koordinatsiya va chavandozlik mahoratini talab qiladi.

ex: He is an Irish Traveller with a rich cultural heritage.
Irish Traveller traditions are unique and centuries old.
irish traveller.meta: Irlandiyadagi an’anaviy ravishda ko‘chib yuruvchi sayyohlar jamiyati a’zosi. Ular o‘ziga xos madaniyat, til va an’analarga ega bo‘lgan ko‘chmanchi xalqdir.

ex: It was a Jesus, Mary, and Joseph moment when the car broke down.
“Jesus, Mary, and Joseph! What a terrible accident!”
jesus, mary, and joseph.meta: hayrat, ajablanish yoki jahldorlik kabi kuchli his-tuyg‘ularni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora. Odatda kutilmagan holatlar yoki qiyinchiliklar yuz berganda ishlatiladi.

ex: To Jesus, I’m telling the truth!
I swear to Jesus, I didn’t do it!
to jesus.meta: bir gapning haqiqatligi yoki samimiyligini ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladigan ifoda. Ko‘pincha “Iso nomiga umid qilaman” yoki “Iso nomiga qasam ichaman” kabi iboralarda uchraydi.

ex: They beat the Jesus out of the old car trying to fix it.
He got the Jesus beaten out of him in that fight
to —— the jesus out of.meta: kimnidir yoki nimanidir haddan tashqari kuch bilan urish, zo‘rlik ko‘rsatish yoki qattiq jarohat yetkazish ma’nosida ishlatiladigan so‘z birikmasi.

ex: The Jesus altar is beautifully decorated with flowers.
The faithful prayed before the Jesus altar in the chapel.
jesus altar.meta: cherkov yoki kapellada Iso Muqaddas Ismiga bag‘ishlangan oltor, ibodat va marosimlar uchun mo‘ljallangan muqaddas joy

ex: He wore Jesus creepers during the summer for comfort.
Jesus creepers are popular among those who like simple and natural footwear.
jesus creeper.meta: oddiy yoki amaliy uslubda tayyorlangan, teridan yasalgan ochiq oyoqli sandal, afsonaga ko‘ra Iso payg‘ambar kiyganiga o‘xshash.

ex: The Jesus fish is a well-known Christian symbol.
He has a Jesus fish sticker on his car to show his faith.
jesus fish.meta: Iso Masihni ifodalovchi stilize qilingan baliq rasmi yoki ramzi, ko‘pincha nasroniylikka ishonch va sadoqat belgisi sifatida kiyimda yoki boshqa joylarda namoyish etiladi.

ex: If the Jesus nut fails, the helicopter can lose its rotor blade.
The pilot checked the Jesus nut carefully before the flight
jesus nut.meta: ba’zi vertolyotlarda asosiy rotor pallasini mastga (ustunga) va shu bilan vertolyot tanasiga mahkamlovchi muhim yong‘oq (somun).

ex: The Jesus Prayer is a central practice in Eastern Orthodox spirituality.
The monks recite the Jesus Prayer throughout the day.
jesus prayer.meta: Sharqiy pravoslav cherkovida "Ey Rabbim Iso Masih, Xudoning O‘g‘li, meni gunohkor bo‘lganim uchun marhamat qil" degan iborani o‘z ichiga olgan, doimiy takrorlanadigan ibodat. Bu ibodat ruhiy tozalanish va meditatsiya uchun ishlatiladi

ex: He swore by Jesus Christ that he told the truth.
By Jesus Christ, I will finish this task!
by jesus christ.meta: kuchli ta’kid yoki qasam sifatida ishlatiladigan ifoda. Hozirda biroz kam uchraydi.

ex: Companies use KPIs to track their progress toward goals.
The sales KPI showed a 10% increase this quarter.
kpi.meta: kompaniya yoki shaxsning muhim maqsadlariga erishish darajasini o‘lchaydigan aniq va o‘lchanadigan ko‘rsatkich.

ex: Each department has different KPIs based on their goals.
Customer satisfaction is one of our main KPIs.
kpi.meta: Asosiy samaradorlik ko‘rsatkichlari (KPI) — bu tashkilot, bo‘lim yoki xodim faoliyatining asosiy maqsadlarga erishish darajasini o‘lchovchi aniq va o‘lchanadigan ko‘rsatkichlardir. KPIlar orqali samaradorlik baholanadi va qarorlar qabul qilinadi.

ex: Managers use key performance indicators to assess employee productivity.
Customer satisfaction is an important key performance indicator for our company.
key performance indicator.meta: tashkilot, xodim yoki boshqa tizimning belgilangan maqsadlarga erishish darajasini o‘lchash uchun ishlatiladigan aniq va o‘lchanadigan ko‘rsatkich.

ex: The poem’s meaning changes at the line break.
Use a line break to start a new paragraph in the document.
line break.meta: matnning ikkita qatorga bo‘linadigan joyi; qatorning oxiri.

ex: In poetry, a line break can affect the rhythm and meaning of a stanza.
Press Shift + Enter to insert a line break without starting a new paragraph.
line break.meta: Satr bo‘linishi — bu matn ichida bir satr tugab, keyingi satr boshlanadigan nuqtani anglatadi. Bu bo‘linish avtomatik tarzda yoki foydalanuvchi tomonidan maxsus kiritilgan enter/return tugmasi orqali sodir bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: They greeted each other with a man hug and a firm handshake.
After the game, the teammates shared a man hug.
man hug.meta: ikki erkak o‘rtasidagi do‘stona quchoqlashish, ko‘pincha qo‘l berish, orqadan ta’qillatish kabi harakatlar bilan birga bo‘ladi.

ex: Every technology has its moment before being replaced by something new.
That style had its moment in the 90s but isn’t popular anymore.
to have its moment.meta: biror narsa qisqa vaqt davomida mashhur yoki moda bo‘lishi.

ex: She was honored as the Mother of the House for her many years of service.
The Mother of the House gave a speech at the opening session.
mother of the house.meta: qonunchilik yig‘inidagi eng uzoq vaqt xizmat qilgan ayol deputat yoki a’zo.

ex: Researchers studied the leaves of the oak of Cappadocia for potential health benefits.
The oak of Cappadocia is known for its strong aroma and medicinal uses.
oak of cappadocia.meta: Ambrosia turkumiga mansub bir nechta o‘t o‘simliklar, xususan, Ambrosia maritima — O‘rta Yer dengizi mintaqasiga xos, hidli o‘t o‘simlik bo‘lib, uning barglari dori sifatida ishlatiladi, deb hisoblanadi.

ex: Relay neurons play a crucial role in the nervous system by connecting different neurons.
The relay neuron passes signals from sensory neurons to motor neurons.
relay neuron.meta: nerv yo‘lida ikkita boshqa neyron orasida joylashgan va ularning orasida impulslarni uzatadigan neyron; interneyron deb ham ataladi

ex: Knitting in the round creates a smooth, seamless fabric.
This hat is knitted in the round to avoid seams.
in the round.meta: to‘qish yoki kashf qilishda, orqa va oldinga emas, balki doira shaklida, har bir qatordagi oxiri keyingi qatordagi boshiga ulangan holda tikilgan usul.

ex: Historians often discover secret histories hidden in archives.
The book reveals the secret history of the royal family.
secret history.meta: tarix yoki biografiyaning sirli, shaxsiy yoki ilgari nashr etilmagan voqealaridan tashkil topgan asar.

ex: She is working on a secret history of the Cold War based on newly declassified documents.
The book reveals a secret history of political intrigue and betrayal.
secret history.meta: Secret history — bu rasmiy yoki ommaga ma'lum bo‘lgan tarixiy voqealarning ortida yashiringan, ilgari e’lon qilinmagan yoki maxfiy bo‘lgan tafsilotlar, hodisalar yoki shaxsiy epizodlarni ochib beruvchi tarixiy yoki biografik asar.

ex: There were a shit ton of people at the concert.
He has a shit ton of homework to do tonight.
shit ton.meta: Juda ko‘p — biror narsaning nihoyatda katta miqdori yoki soni; noformal va biroz vulgarlik bilan ifodalangan.

ex: A surveyor’s wheel helps quickly calculate distances on uneven terrain.
The surveyor used a surveyor’s wheel to measure the length of the road.
surveyor’s wheel.meta: ma’lum aylanasiga ega bo‘lgan g‘ildirak va tutqichdan iborat, yer yuzasida aylantirib, masofani o‘lchash uchun ishlatiladigan asbob.

ex: Surveyor’s wheels are useful for quick distance measurements on uneven ground.
The engineer used a surveyor’s wheel to measure the length of the road.
