surveyor’s wheel.meta: bu yer ustidagi masofalarni aniqlash uchun ishlatiladigan qurilma bo‘lib, u ma’lum aylana uzunligiga ega bo‘lgan g‘ildirak va unga ulangan dastakdan iborat. G‘ildirak yer ustida aylantiriladi, aylanishlar soni orqali bosib o‘tilgan masofa aniqlanadi.

ex: Timber circles were likely used for ceremonial or social purposes.
Archaeologists discovered a timber circle dating back thousands of years.
timber circle.meta: tarixdan oldingi davrlarga oid, yog‘ochdan yasalgan aylana yoki elliptik shakldagi me’moriy yodgorlik (odatda katta yog‘och ustunlar doirasi sifatida tushuniladi).

ex: Timber circles were often aligned with the solstices or celestial events.
Archaeologists discovered the remains of a timber circle near the ancient settlement.
timber circle.meta: Yog‘och aylana — bu qadimgi tarixiy davrlarda (odatda neolit yoki bronza davrida) qurilgan, katta yog‘och ustunlardan iborat bo‘lgan, aylana yoki ellips shaklida joylashtirilgan monumental inshootdir.

ex: They say travel broadens the mind by exposing you to new cultures.
If you want to understand the world better, remember that travel broadens the mind.
travel broadens the mind.meta: sayohat qilish odamga yangi narsalarni o‘rganish yoki turli nuqtai nazarlarni ko‘rish imkonini beradi, insonning fikr doirasini kengaytiradi degan xalq maqoli.

ex: You must submit all your receipts to get reimbursed for travel expenses.
His travel expenses were fully covered by the company.
travel expenses.meta: xizmat safari yoki muayyan topshiriqni bajarish jarayonida (ayniqsa, boshqa birov nomidan) yuzaga keladigan yo‘l, turar joy, ovqatlanish va boshqa xarajatlar

ex: She works in the travel industry as a tour operator.
The travel industry was badly affected during the pandemic.
travel industry.meta: sayohatchilar va turistlarga xizmatlar hamda sharoitlar taqdim etish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi tijorat faoliyati sohasi

ex: Travel insurance covered the cost of his emergency surgery.
Before going abroad, it’s wise to buy travel insurance.
travel insurance.meta: shaxsning sayohati davomida yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo‘lgan kutilmagan moliyaviy yo‘qotishlarni qoplashga mo‘ljallangan sug‘urta turi

ex: This store sells travel-size versions of most beauty products.
I packed a travel-size shampoo and toothpaste in my carry-on bag.
travel-size.meta: odatda kichik, ixcham va osongina olib yurish mumkin bo‘lgan o‘lchamda bo‘lgan (buyum, mahsulot); sayohatga qulay tarzda moslashtirilgan.

ex: This store sells a variety of travel-sized toiletries.
I always pack travel-sized shampoo and toothpaste when I fly.
travel-sized.meta: bu atama odatda mahsulotlarning kichraytirilgan, ixcham shaklini bildiradi, ularni sayohat paytida olib yurish oson bo‘ladi. Odatda gigiyena vositalari, kosmetika, dori-darmonlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: A good travel system can make traveling with a newborn much easier.
We bought a travel system that includes a car seat and a stroller.
travel system.meta: bu chaqaloqlarni tashish uchun mo‘ljallangan ko‘p funksiyali aravacha tizimi bo‘lib, u odatda quyidagilardan iborat bo‘ladi: chaqaloqlar uchun beshik (karyolka), aravacha (pushchair) o‘rindig‘i, avtomobil o‘rindig‘i (car seat).

ex: Most people in the travel-to-work area commute to the city by train.
This village is part of a travel-to-work area centered around Manchester.
travel-to-work area.meta: bu odatda aholisi yaqin atrofdagi yirik shaharga yoki markazga ishlash uchun har kuni qatnaydigan ma’muriy yoki geografik hudud. Ushbu atama asosan urbanizatsiya va mehnat bozori tadqiqotlarida qo‘llanadi.

ex: Road repairs are being made to the southern travelway of the highway.
The travelway must be kept clear of debris to ensure safe driving conditions.
travelway.meta: bu avtomobillar harakatlanadigan yo‘lning bir qismi yoki bo‘lagi. Bu atama odatda yo‘l qurilishi va transport muhandisligi sohalarida ishlatiladi va piyodalar yo‘laklari, yo‘l chetlari (yo‘l yoqalari) va boshqa zonalardan farq qiladi.

ex: Travel writing blends personal reflection with cultural observation.
He became famous for his travel writing about remote parts of Asia.
travel writing.meta: bu yozma adabiyot janri bo‘lib, mualliflar o‘zlari borgan joylar, u yerda boshdan kechirgan voqealar, taassurotlar va madaniy tajribalari haqida hikoya qiladilar. Bu janrga bloglar, maqolalar, kitoblar va sayohat kundaliklari kiradi.

ex: Some entrepreneurs believe that he travels the fastest who travels alone, avoiding delays caused by group decisions.
He declined the partnership, saying, “He travels the fastest who travels alone.”
he travels (the) fastest who travels alo.meta: Bu ibora majoziy ma’noga ega bo‘lib, inson munosabatlar va boshqalarga bog‘liqlikdan holi bo‘lsa, maqsadga tezroq yetadi, degan fikrni bildiradi.

ex: The journey itself was full of discovery — a perfect example of how it is better to travel hopefully than to arrive.
She enjoys the process of learning so much that for her, it is better to travel hopefully than to arrive.
it is better to travel hopefully than to.meta: Bu ibora majoziy ma’noda ishlatiladi va shuni anglatadi: insonning maqsad sari yo‘ldagi harakati, umidi, intilishi va tajribasi ko‘pincha yakuniy natijadan ko‘ra muhimroq va qadrlidir

ex: Traveller’s diarrhoea is the most common illness affecting tourists.
He got traveller’s diarrhoea after eating street food in a foreign country.
traveller’s diarrhoea.meta: bu sayohat paytida, ayniqsa boshqa mamlakatlarga yoki gigiyena sharoitlari past bo‘lgan hududlarga borganda yuzaga keladigan, odatda to‘satdan boshlanadigan ich ketish holati.

ex: A travelling bed is essential when you're staying in places without proper sleeping arrangements.
We packed a travelling bed for the camping trip.
travelling bed.meta: bu sayohat vaqtida ishlatiladigan, osongina yig‘iladigan va ko‘chiriladigan karavot. U odatda engil, portativ bo‘lib, lagerda, safarda yoki vaqtinchalik turar joylarda yotish uchun mo‘ljallangan. Bolalar uchun mo‘ljallangan variantlari ham mavjud

ex: Without a travelling statement, transporting livestock is not permitted by law.
The farmer submitted a travelling statement before moving his cattle across the region.
travelling statement.meta: bu rasmiy hujjat bo‘lib, unda boshqa joyga olib ketilayotgan chorva mollarining tafsilotlari (soni, turi, manzili, egasi, sog‘liq holati va yo‘nalishi) ko‘rsatiladi. Bu hujjat odatda veterinariya, transport va nazorat organlari tomonidan talab qilinadi

ex: As a travelling agent, she spends most of her time on the road
The travelling agent visits clients in rural areas to promote the company's products.
travelling agent.meta: bu kompaniya yoki tashkilot nomidan turli joylarga safar qilib, mahsulot yoki xizmatlarni taklif qiladigan vakil. U mijozlar bilan bevosita uchrashish, buyurtmalar qabul qilish yoki mahsulotni targ‘ib qilish uchun doimiy ravishda safarda bo‘ladi.

ex: He started as a stable hand and later became a trusted travelling lad for the team.
The travelling lad made sure the racehorse was calm and well-fed before the big race.
travelling lad.meta: bu ot poygasi fermasida ishlovchi xodim bo‘lib, poygaga olib ketilayotgan otlarning parvarishi, oziqlanishi, tozaligi va umumiy holatiga mas’ul bo‘ladi. U otlar bilan birga musobaqalarga sayohat qiladi va ularning holatini nazorat qiladi.

ex: My grandfather was a travelling man who sold tools to farmers across the region.
In the 19th century, a travelling man would go from village to village selling goods.
travelling man.meta: bu bir joyda do‘koni bo‘lmay, turli hududlarga safar qilib, eshikma-eshik yurib yoki bozorlarda mahsulot sotadigan odam. Dastlab, u ko‘cha savdogari (yoki "ot aravada" yuradigan savdogar) bo‘lgan.

ex: Travelling mattes are crucial in scenes where the background is digitally added.
The visual effects team used a travelling matte to composite the actor into the sci-fi environment.
travelling matte.meta: bu kinematografiya va video montajda ishlatiladigan maxsus effekt bo‘lib, unda harakatlanuvchi obyekt (masalan, aktyor yoki animatsion rasm) boshqa fon bilan birlashtiriladi

ex: many travelling people have maintained their cultural identity despite modern challenges
the travelling people of ireland have a rich oral tradition.
travelling people.meta: bu doimiy yashash joyiga ega bo‘lmagan, turli hududlar bo‘ylab ko‘chib yuradigan xalq, qabila yoki etnik guruh. ular odatda an’anaviy turmush tarzi, madaniyati va kasb-hunar faoliyati bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: in the age of sail, sailors had to work a traverse every day to stay on course.
the navigator worked a traverse to estimate the ship’s position after a day of sailing.
to work a traverse.meta: bu kemaning taxminiy joylashuvini aniqlash uchun kurslar (yo‘nalishlar) va bosib o‘tilgan masofalar yozuvi asosida amalga oshiriladigan yo‘lni taxminiy hisoblash usuli (dead reckoning).

ex: instead of heading straight for the summit, the hikers worked a traverse across the slope.
the ship worked a traverse to avoid the reefs scattered along the coast.
to work a traverse.meta: bu kema tomonidan to‘g‘ri yo‘l o‘rniga egri-bugri, aylana yo‘llar orqali harakatlanishidir. kema yoki odam biron maqsadga to‘g‘ri yo‘l bilan emas, balki burilishlar, chetlab o‘tishlar yoki o‘ralma yo‘llar orqali yetib boradi.

ex: they worked a clever traverse to win the deal without raising suspicion.
he really worked a traverse to get out of paying the fine.
to work a traverse.meta: majoziy va so‘zlashuv uslubida kimnidir aldash, ustun kelish yoki foyda olish maqsadida reja, hiyla yoki nayrangni amalga oshirish. bu ibora ko‘pincha aqlli yoki yashirin reja orqali boshqani chuv tushirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi

ex: historically, a traverse jury could overturn findings of a coroner’s inquest.
the traverse jury was convened to reconsider the earlier verdict challenged by the defendant.
traverse jury.meta: bu ikkinchi instansiya sudi yoki apellyatsiya bosqichida ishlaydigan hay’at bo‘lib, oldingi sud qaroriga qarshi bildirilgan e’tiroz (traverse) bo‘yicha qaror chiqaradi.

ex: each traverse point was calculated using compass bearings and distance sailed.
the navigator marked a traverse point to estimate the ship’s location.
traverse point.meta: navigatsiyada, xaritada kemaning joylashuvini ko‘rsatib beradigan nuqta bo‘lib, u ikki chiziq yoki ikki aylananing kesishgan nuqtasi sifatida aniqlanadi

ex: the new railway line will serve as a traverse way connecting eastern and western regions.
the engineers built a traverse way through the mountain range.
traverse way.meta: bu biror hudud yoki joy orqali harakatlanish uchun mo‘ljallangan yo‘l, temir yo‘l yoki boshqa transport marshruti.

ex: travertine marble is popular for its natural texture and durability.
the entrance hall was decorated with polished travertine marble.
travertine marble.meta: bu bezakli qurilish materiali sifatida ishlatiladigan travertin toshi bo‘lib, u tabiiy ohaktoshning bir turi hisoblanadi

ex: the trial turned into a travesty of justice due to political interference.
the verdict was widely seen as a travesty of justice.
travesty of justice.meta: bu nohaq sud qarori yoki adolatsizlik holati bo‘lib, odatda buzilgan, nosog‘lom yoki korrupsiyalashgan sud jarayoni natijasida yuzaga keladi. bu ibora keskin tanqidiy ma’noda ishlatiladi va odil sudlovning yo‘qligini ifodalaydi.

ex: woolly pullies became popular among civilians for their warmth and durability.++++
the soldier wore a green woolly pully under his jacket.
woolly pully.meta: bu junli, issiq sviter bo‘lib, ko‘pincha harbiylar tomonidan kiyiladi. bu turdagi sviter odatda yelkalar va tirsaklar qismida mustahkamlovchi yamoqlar bilan bezatilgan bo‘ladi.

ex: Woolly pullies are standard winter issue for many armed forces.
The soldier wore a green woolly pully under his uniform jacket.
woolly pully.meta: Woolly pully — bu harbiy yoki xizmat kiyimi sifatida ishlatiladigan qalin, jun materialdan tikilgan, yelkalar va tirsaklarda maxsus mustahkamlovchi yamoqlari bo‘lgan sviter. U sovuq ob-havo sharoitlarida kiyiladi va odatda formaning bir qismi hisoblanadi.

ex: the ambassador's ambidextral diplomacy only deepened the conflict.
his ambidextral behavior in court lost him the trust of both parties.
ambidextral.meta: bu ikki tomonlama o‘ynovchi, ya’ni qarama-qarshi tomonlarga birdek yoqishga urinuvchi, ikkiyuzlamachilik qiluvchi, yolg‘onchi yoki munofiqlik qiluvchi shaxsga nisbatan ishlatiladigan so‘z

ex: ambidextral people often have an advantage in sports like baseball or boxing.
she’s ambidextral and can write with both hands at the same time
ambidextral.meta: bu o‘ng va chap qo‘lni teng darajada mohirlik bilan ishlata oladigan shaxsga nisbatan ishlatiladi. bunday odam yozishda, chizishda, sportda yoki boshqa harakatlarda har ikkala qo‘lni bir xil darajada yaxshi boshqara oladi. sinonimi: ambidextrous.

ex: ambidextry is rare but useful in many sports and creative fields.
his ambidextry impressed the coaches during training.
ambidextry.meta: bu insonning o‘ng va chap qo‘lni teng darajada mohirlik bilan ishlata olish qobiliyati. ya’ni yozish, chizish, sport bilan shug‘ullanish va boshqa harakatlarni har ikkala qo‘l bilan birdek bajara olish holati.

ex: In advanced geometry, ambigenous curves are studied for their unique asymptotic behavior.
The ambigenous curve crosses its asymptote before curving back towards it.
ambigenous.meta: bu geometriyada ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, giperbolaning bir tarmog‘iga o‘xshash egri chiziqni ifodalaydi. Bu chiziq asimptotani kesib o‘tadi, keyin esa unga yaqinlashib boradi (ya’ni, konvergentsiyalanadi).

ex: Many successful leaders are ambiverts — they can adapt to both social and solitary situations.
As an ambivert, she enjoys parties but also needs time alone to recharge.
ambivert.meta: bu inson shaxsiyatiga oid tushuncha bo‘lib, ekstravert (ochiq, ijtimoiy) va introvert (yopiq, ichki olamga sho‘ng‘igan) xususiyatlarning uyg‘un aralashmasiga ega odamni bildiradi.

ex: She is an Ambonese by birth, but now lives in Jakarta.
The Ambonese have a rich cultural heritage influenced by Malay and European traditions
ambonese.meta: bu Indoneziyadagi Ambon oroli yoki shahridan bo‘lgan mahalliy aholi yoki u yerdan kelib chiqqan shaxsni bildiradi

ex: The trial and execution of English traders in the Amboyna case caused outrage in London.
The Amboyna incident was used by the English as a justification for hostilities against the Dutch.
amboyna.meta: **1623-yilda Gollandiyaliklar tomonidan Ambon (hozirgi Indoneziyadagi Ambon oroli)**da ingliz va boshqa savdogarlarning qiynoqqa solinib o‘ldirilishiga nisbatan ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: The soup had an ambrosial aroma that filled the entire kitchen.
The chef prepared an ambrosial dessert made with honey and cream.
ambrosial.meta: Ambrosial so‘zi taom yoki ta’m haqida aytilganda ishlatiladi va nihoyatda mazali, ajoyib, xush ta’mli, yoqimli hidli, ba’zan esa xudolarga xos darajadagi lazzatli degan ma’nolarni anglatadi

ex: Scholars study Ambrosian chants to understand early Christian liturgical music.
The choir performed an Ambrosian hymn during the early morning liturgy.
ambrosian.meta: Ambrosian bu yerda milodiy IV asrda yashagan Milan yepiskopi Muqaddas Ambrosiy tomonidan yozilgan yoki uning uslubida yaratilgan madhiyalarni bildiradi.

ex: They were ambuscaded while marching through the narrow valley.
The patrol was ambuscaded by rebels near the border.
ambuscade.meta: Ambuscade fe’l sifatida, ayniqsa passiv shaklda, biror shaxs yoki guruhga qarshi kutilmagan, to‘satdan hujum uyushtirmoq degan ma’noni anglatadi. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha harbiy, tarixiy yoki strategik kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: She felt ambushed by the reporter’s sudden questions. (fig.)+
The soldiers were ambushed during their routine patrol.
ambushed.meta: Ambushed sifat sifatida ishlatilganda, bu so‘z odam yoki guruhning yashirin yoki to‘satdan amalga oshirilgan hujumga uchraganini bildiradi.

ex: Amelia is a rare congenital disorder that may be linked to genetic or environmental factors.
The child was diagnosed with amelia affecting both arms.
amelia.meta: bu bir yoki bir nechta qo‘l yoki oyoqlarning tug‘ma holda yo‘qligi holatini ifodalaydigan tibbiy atama. U embrional rivojlanishdagi nuqsonlar sababli yuzaga keladi.

ex: The new policy included several amelioratives to support low-income families.
Education is often seen as an ameliorative for poverty.
ameliorative.meta: Ameliorative ot shaklida ishlatilganda, bu biror holatni yaxshilovchi, og‘irligini kamaytiruvchi yoki yumshatuvchi narsa yoki vosita degan ma’noni bildiradi. U moddiy, ijtimoiy yoki tibbiy kontekstda qo‘llanilishi mumkin

ex: The valley stretched aneath the mountain ridge.
The treasure lay hidden aneath the old oak tree.
aneath.meta: qadimgi yoki shevaga xos so‘z bo‘lib, pastda, quyi darajada, yoki biror narsaning tagida yoki ostida joylashgan holatni bildiradi. Bu so‘z zamonaviy ingliz tilida deyarli ishlatilmaydi va hozirgi beneath yoki underneath so‘zlariga teng

ex: Anechoic areas on the scan typically indicate fluid-filled structures.
The ultrasound showed an anechoic cyst in the patient's kidney.
anechoic.meta: Radiologiyada, anechoic atamasi ultratovush to‘lqinlarini deyarli qaytarmaydigan modda yoki tana tuzilmasiga nisbatan ishlatiladi

ex: Understanding the local anemology is crucial for wind turbine placement.
The anemology of the coastal region reveals strong seasonal winds from the north.
anemology.meta: muayyan hududga xos shamollar yo‘nalishi, kuchi va takrorlanuvchi namunalarini o‘rganadigan fan yoki shamollarning hududiy xususiyatlarini tasvirlovchi tushuncha. Bu meteorologiya sohasi doirasida ishlatiladi.

ex: The pollen from anemophiles is usually small and lightweight.
Grasses and many trees like birch and oak are typical anemophiles.
anemophile.meta: bu changini shamol orqali tarqatadigan o‘simlik. Bunday o‘simliklar changlanuvchi o‘simliklar bo‘lib, changni ko‘pchilik hollarda boshqa o‘simliklarga shamol yordamida yetkazadi. Bu biologiyada anemofilli changlanish deb ataladi.

ex: Anencephalic infants usually die shortly after birth due to severe brain malformation.
The ultrasound confirmed that the fetus was anencephalic.
anencephalic.meta: miya va bosh suyaklari to‘liq shakllanmagan holda tug‘iladigan homila yoki chaqaloq. Bu og‘ir tug‘ma nuqson bo‘lib, anentsefaliya deb ataladigan holat natijasidir. Bunday chaqaloqlar odatda tirik tug‘ilmaydi yoki tug‘ilgach ko‘p yashamaydi.

ex: The character was portrayed as an anencephaloid fool in the satirical play.
He stared at me with that anencephaloid look, as if thought were foreign to him.
anencephaloid.meta: ehtimol “miya yo‘qdek”, “ahmoqona”, yoki “juda nodon, fikrlay olmaydigan” degan ma’noni bildirgan tarixiy yoki kam ishlatiladigan sifat so‘zidir.

ex: The knight rode anent the king in the procession.
He walked anent his brother through the fields.
anent.meta: birga, hamroh bo‘lib, biror kishining yonida yoki birgalikda harakatda bo‘lish holatini bildiruvchi eski inglizcha so‘z. Bu ma’noda ishlatilishi eskirgan bo‘lib, hozirgi zamon ingliz tilida deyarli uchramaydi.

ex: He came anewst when the horn was sounded.
The messenger departed anewst upon hearing the news.
anewst.meta: tezda, darhol, zudlik bilan bajariladigan harakatni bildiruvchi eski inglizcha so‘z. Hozirgi zamonda ishlatilmaydi; eskirgan (obsolete) hisoblanadi.

ex: His bearability during the difficult times amazed everyone.
The bearability of extreme cold varies from person to person.
bearability.meta: biror og‘riq, qiyinchilik yoki noqulay holatni sabr bilan yoki chidab o‘tish qobiliyati, chidamlilik darajasi.

ex: Bear bait is often used in hunting to attract bears to a specific spot.
The hunter set up bear bait near the cave to catch the animal.
bear bait.meta: ovchilar tomonidan ayiqlarni o‘ziga tortish yoki tuzoqqa tushirish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus yem yoki o‘lat

ex: The practice of bear-baiting requires careful placement of the bait.
Bear-baiting is a common technique used by hunters in remote forests.
bear-baiting.meta: ayiqlarni o‘ziga jalb qilish yoki tuzoqqa tushirish uchun ovchilar tomonidan o‘lat ishlatish amali yoki usuli.

ex: Bearberry fruit was used traditionally in some remedies.
The bearberry was once a common term for the American cranberry.
bearberry.meta: Amerikada o‘sadigan Vaccinium macrocarpon nomli o‘simlikning mevasidir. Bu atama hozirda kamdan-kam ishlatiladi va eski hisoblanadi.

ex: His performance was a bearcat, leaving everyone amazed.
That new sports car is a real bearcat on the road.
bearcat.meta: Gaplashuv uslubida ishlatiladi (asosan AQShda). Juda kuchli, ta’sirli yoki ajoyib narsa; o‘z turidagi eng zo‘r yoki betakror namunasi.

ex: The café is famous for its almond-filled bear claw pastries.
I bought a delicious bear claw from the bakery this morning.
bear claw.meta: AQShda ishlatiladigan atama. Ayiq panjasiga o‘xshash shaklda tayyorlangan pishiriq, odatda bodom pastasi bilan to‘ldirilgan va eritilgan shakar bilan yaltilatib pishiriladi.

ex: Historically, bear dances were performed as a popular form of folk entertainment.
The circus featured a bear dance to entertain the audience.
bear dance.meta: Ayiq tomonidan o‘ynaladigan raqs, ko‘ngilochar maqsadda bajariladi.

ex: In old botanical texts, the term beardlet was used to describe small awns on plants.
The wheat had a tiny beardlet at the tip of each grain.
beardlet.meta: Mayda tuk yoki tukcha. Eski va kam uchraydigan so‘z

ex: The bear dog is now an obsolete term not commonly used.
In old stories, the bear dog was known for its strength and size.
bear dog.meta: Katta zotli, ayiqqa o‘xshash it. Eski, kam uchraydigan atama.

ex: Investors were worried about the growing bearishness in the stock market.
The market showed signs of bearishness as stock prices began to fall.
bearishness.meta: Fond bozorida: narxlarning pasayishiga moyillik yoki shunday holat; aksiyalar narxining tushish tendensiyasi yoki bunday holatni yuzaga keltiruvchi ta’sir.

ex: The chef prepared a delicious Béarnaise chicken for dinner.
We ordered a steak served with Béarnaise sauce.
béarnaise.meta: Bernar sousi bilan tayyorlangan taomni ifodalaydi. Bu sous asosan sariyog‘, sirk, shivit va boshqa ziravorlardan tayyorlanadi.

ex: The traditional bear paw snowshoe is ideal for deep, soft snow.
He strapped on his bear paws before hiking into the snowy mountains.
bear paw.meta: Yog‘och ramkadan va hayvon terisidan tayyorlangan to‘rli tuzilishga ega, oval yoki dumaloq shakldagi qor oyoqqop. Qorli va tog‘li hududlarda yurish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Working in that company is like being in a bear pit—everyone’s fighting for promotions.
The debate quickly turned into a bear pit, with both sides shouting over each other.
bear pit.meta: Ko‘pincha figural ma’noda ishlatiladi. Mojaro, tajovuzkorlik yoki shiddatli raqobat bilan ajralib turadigan joy yoki vaziyat. Qarang: bear garden (2-ma’no).

ex: Spectators gathered to watch the brutal bear play in the town square.
In medieval times, bear play was a common form of public entertainment.
bear play.meta: Ayiqlarning o‘zaro o‘ynashi yoki jang qilishi harakati; tomosha yoki ko‘ngilochar tadbir sifatida uyushtirilgan ayiq jangi. Qarang: bear-baiting (1a-ma’no). Eski va endi ishlatilmaydigan atama.

ex: Investors reacted nervously to a bear report suggesting a market downturn.
The latest bear report warns of a potential decline in tech stocks.
bear report.meta: Fond bozorida: aksiyalar narxining tushishi yoki tushishi kutilayotgan holat haqida ma’lumot beruvchi hisobot.

ex: How the bejesus did he fix that engine so fast?
What the bejesus is going on here?!
bejesus.meta: "The bejesus" ifodasi savol gaplarda kuchaytiruvchi ma’no beradi. Odatda sabrsizlik, g‘azab yoki hayratni ifodalaydi. Ingliz tilida so‘z ohangini kuchaytiruvchi (ba’zan odobsizlik darajasiga yaqin) og‘zaki ifoda hisoblanadi.

ex: Unlike his adopted brother, he is their birth child.
She finally reunited with her birth child after 20 years.
birth child.meta: Ma’lum bir ota-onaning qonidan (ya’ni biologik jihatdan) tug‘ilgan farzand. Bu atama asrab olingan farzand (adoptiv bola) yoki o‘gay farzanddan farqlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: From the moment of his birthhood, he was marked for greatness.
The poet reflected on the mystery of birthhood and human origin.
birthhood.meta: Tug‘ilgan bo‘lish holati yoki insonning tug‘ilish paytidagi ahvoli va mavjudligi. Ya’ni, biror shaxsning dunyoga kelgan vaqtidagi holati yoki mavjudlik faktini bildiradi.

ex: His love for her felt birthless, beyond time or memory.
A birthless sorrow settled in her heart, as if it had always been there.
birthless.meta: (Biror hissiyot, tajriba va hokazo haqida) — aniq kelib chiqishsiz, boshi yo‘qdek tuyuladigan yoki doim mavjud bo‘lgan holat. Ya’ni u hech qachon "boshlanmagan", balki har doim bor bo‘lgan kabi seziladi.

ex: This very hall was the stage of our company’s birthnight.
The revolution’s birthnight was marked by fire and thunder.
birthnight.meta: Biror narsa boshlangan, yuzaga kelgan yoki muhim bir voqea sodir bo‘lgan tun. Bu nafaqat tirik mavjudotning tug‘ilgan tuniga, balki biror hodisa, an’ana yoki g‘oya paydo bo‘lgan kechaga nisbatan ham ishlatiladi

ex: Many politicians continue to maintain strong ties to their birth state.
He moved away from his birth state at the age of ten.
birth state.meta: Inson tug‘ilgan davlat ichidagi ma’lum bir hudud, masalan, shtat, viloyat yoki mintaqa. Bu atama ayniqsa AQSh kabi federativ tuzilishga ega mamlakatlarda ishlatiladi, lekin keng ma’noda har qanday tug‘ilgan hududiy birlikni anglatadi.

ex: We pulled over as soon as we saw the blue lights behind us.
The ambulance raced through traffic with its blue lights flashing.
blue light.meta: Politsiya mashinasi, tez yordam yoki boshqa favqulodda xizmat avtomobillarida o‘rnatilgan, odatda voqea joyiga zudlik bilan yetib borilayotganda ishlatiladigan ko‘k rangda miltillovchi ogohlantiruvchi chiroq.

ex: Chapeau to all the volunteers who worked day and night for the event.
You finished the marathon in under three hours? Chapeau!
chapeau.meta: Fransuz tilidan kirib kelgan ibora bo‘lib, kimningdir yutug‘i, muvaffaqiyati yoki a’lo darajadagi ishlari uchun hayrat, tasanno, yoki hurmat bildirishda ishlatiladi. Bu so‘z so‘zma-so‘z "shlyapamni yechaman" degan ma’noni bildiradi

ex: She managed to finish the marathon despite the injury — chapeau!
Chapeau to the entire team for pulling off such an amazing project!
chapeau.meta: Chapeau — bu so‘z odatda yuksak hurmat, qoyil qolish yoki maqtov izhor qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ingliz tilida “I take my hat off to you” degan ibora bilan ma’nodosh bo‘lib, yutuq, iqtidor yoki mehnatni tan olish holatida ishlatiladi.

ex: In early Christian practice, a christened might spend weeks studying before baptism.
The christened waited with reverence for the day of baptism
christened.meta: Diniy (xristian) kontekstda — suvga cho‘miltirish (baptizm) marosimiga tayyorlanayotgan shaxs, ya’ni katexumen. Shuningdek, oldindan maxsus marosim yoki duo bilan tayyorlangan, ammo hali rasmiy ravishda suvga cho‘miltirilmagan kishi uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The politician’s platform was heavily influenced by Christianism, especially regarding abortion laws.
Critics argue that Christianism threatens the separation of church and state.
christianism.meta: Asosan AQShda qo‘llanadigan, ko‘pincha tanqidiy yoki salbiy ohangda ishlatiladigan atama. Bu so‘z konservativ xristian e’tiqodlarini siyosat, qonunchilik va jamiyat hayotida kuchliroq ta’sirga ega qilishga intiluvchi harakat yoki mafkurani bildiradi

ex: I had a Christless headache all night.
That was a Christless mess you made in the kitchen!
christless.meta: Bu so‘z aslida “Masihsiz” degan ma’noni anglatsa-da, so‘zlashuv tilida va ayniqsa AQSh inglizchasida “dahshatli, jirkanch, juda yomon” kabi salbiy his-tuyg‘ularni kuchaytiruvchi sifat sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: They cared for the orphans Christ-like, without expecting anything in return.+
He spoke with Christ-like compassion to the suffering.
christ-like.meta: Masih (Iso Masih) fazilatlari, xulq-atvori yoki shuuriga o‘xshash tarzda — mehr-muruvvat, kechirimlilik, fidoyilik va poklikni namoyon qiladigan uslub yoki sifat

ex: The company gave all employees a small Christmas box as thanks
I got a lovely Christmas box from my aunt this year.
christmas box.meta: Bu sovg‘a odatda bayram kayfiyatini ifodalaydi va yaqinlar, do‘stlar yoki xizmat ko‘rsatgan odamlarga beriladi. Ma’no ko‘chishi orqali kutilmagan sovg‘a, quvonchli voqea, yoki mukofot ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Everyone dressed Christmasly for the party, in red and green sweaters.
The house was Christmasly decorated with lights and garlands.
christmasly.meta: Rojdestvo bayramiga xos, unga mos yoki uni eslatuvchi tarzda harakat qilish yoki qandaydir holatni ifodalash. Ushbu so‘z kayfiyat, bezak, kiyinish yoki harakatdagi bayramona ruhiyatni tasvirlashda qo‘llaniladi

ex: Her soul moved unto Christward, seeking redemption.
The faithful turned Christward in their prayers.
christward.meta: Bu so‘z tarixiy va diniy matnlarda “Iso Masih tomonga”, “Masihga yuzlanib” yoki “Masihni maqsad qilib” kabi ma’nolarda ishlatilgan. U odatda predlog birikmalarida qo‘llangan, ayniqsa "to Christward" yoki "unto Christward" shaklida.

ex: A del credere commission is usually higher due to the added risk.
The agent acted on a del credere basis and guaranteed payment to the seller.
del credere.meta: bu savdo vakili yoki broker tomonidan beriladigan kafolat bo‘lib, agar xaridor to‘lovni bajarmasa, u holda vakil sotuvchiga to‘lovni o‘zi amalga oshirishga mas'ul bo‘ladi.

ex: In times of war, a delectus was raised from among the Roman citizens.
The Roman Senate ordered the delectus to be formed to face the invading Gauls.
delectus.meta: Rim tarixida ishlatilgan atama bo‘lib, harbiy xizmatga chaqirilgan yoki yollangan askarlar guruhini bildiradi. Bu so‘z odatda ko‘plikda ishlatiladi va bugungi kunda eskirgan, kam qo‘llaniladigan tarixiy termin hisoblanadi

ex: Delhi sores are typical signs of cutaneous leishmaniasis.
The patient developed a Delhi on his arm after returning from a tropical region
delhi.meta: bu terida paydo bo‘ladigan tugunli va yarali shikastlanish bo‘lib, u teri leishmaniozi (protozoa parazitlar sababli yuzaga keladigan yuqumli kasallik) bilan bog‘liq. Bu yara odatda chandiq qoldirgan holda bitadi.

ex: Delian art and architecture were influential in the Aegean world.
The Delians built a famous sanctuary to Apollo on their island.
delian.meta: qadimgi tarixda Kiklad orollari guruhiga kiruvchi Delos oroli aholisi yoki shu orolga tegishli bo‘lgan narsalar, ayniqsa qadimgi ioniyaliklar qabilasi a’zosi bo‘lgan shaxslar uchun ishlatiladi

ex: He is a deliberative thinker who rarely makes impulsive decisions.
Her deliberative nature makes her a strong mediator.
deliberative.meta: odamlarga nisbatan ishlatilganda, bu so‘z harakat qilishdan yoki qaror qabul qilishdan oldin jiddiy o‘ylab ko‘radigan, fikrli, ehtiyotkor, va mulohazali shaxsni bildiradi. Bunday odamlar odatda har qanday vaziyatda shoshqaloqlik qilmaydi

ex: The lemon délice was light, creamy, and perfectly tart.
We ended the meal with a rich chocolate délice topped with berries.
délice.meta: odatda qalin mus (mousse) yoki yengil, yumshoq kremli to‘ldirma bilan tayyorlanadigan mazali, nafis desert turi

ex: I dree the long winter alone in that empty house.
She drees the pain of loss long before it comes.
dree.meta: og‘riqli, yoqimsiz yoki og‘ir bir voqeani oldindan sezish, undan qo‘rqish yoki uni kutib, havotirga tushish holatini bildiradi. Bu fe’l emotsional og‘irlik va tashvish bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The minister addressed the crowd dreichly, as if delivering a solemn warning.
He spoke dreichly of the old days.
dreichly.meta: hozirda eskirgan (obsolete) bo‘lgan bu so‘z jiddiylik, tantanavorlik yoki rasmiylik bilan biror ishni bajarish yoki aytishni anglatadi. Bu so‘z ohang va munosabatda tortinchoq, mulohazali, jiddiy bo‘lish holatini bildirgan.

ex: He specialized in playing the flauto piccolo during Baroque performances.
The flauto piccolo added a bright, sparkling tone to the orchestra.
flauto piccolo.meta: bu kichik o‘lchamli, balandroq ovoz chiqaruvchi fleyta turi bo‘lib, odatda ikki asosiy shaklda uchraydi: (a) Kichik to‘g‘ri (vertical) chalinar fleyta yoki rekorder. (b) Kichik yo‘nalgan (transversal) fleyta — ya’ni pikolo deb ataladigan cholg‘u asbobi.

ex: He pulled the flauto traverso stop to add a delicate touch to the melody.
The flauto traverso stop gave the organ a soft, flute-like tone.
flauto traverso.meta: bu so‘z organ (cholg‘u asbobi) kontekstida ishlatilganda, organning o‘ziga xos tovush chiqargan registr (stop) turini bildiradi. Bu registr tovushi yon tomonga (gorizontal) chalinar fleyta — ya’ni travers fleyta ovoziga o‘xshaydi.

ex: Gee whiz, this new game is amazing!
Gee whiz, I didn’t expect that surprise party!
gee whiz.meta: bu ingliz tilida odatda bolalarcha yoki sodda hayrat, quvonch yoki hayajonni ifodalovchi undov yoki bunday hissiyot bilan to‘la narsalarni tavsiflovchi sifat. Ko‘pincha biror narsa kutilmagan, ajoyib yoki yangilik bo‘lganda ishlatiladi.

ex: Gee willikers! I didn’t know he could sing that well!
Gee willikers, that roller coaster was amazing!
gee willikers.meta: bu ingliz tilidagi amerikancha, og‘zaki va ko‘proq eski yoki bolalarga xos ibora bo‘lib, ajablanish, quvonch yoki hayratni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The governor proclaimed May 23 as Jesus Day to recognize the role of faith in the community.
On Jesus Day, thousands gathered downtown to march and pray
jesus day.meta: bu AQShdagi ayrim evangelist xristian jamoalari tomonidan Pentikost (Ruhul Qudus tushgan kun) arafasidagi shanba kuni nishonlanadigan diniy tadbir bo‘lib, u marosimiy yurishlar, ommaviy ibodat va targ‘ibot nutqlari bilan o‘tkaziladi

ex: Among the three brothers at Eton, John Maximus was known for his leadership skills.
Smith Maximus was the head boy of his house, while Smith Minimus had just started.
maximus.meta: Britaniyaning ba’zi o‘g‘il bolalar uchun mo‘ljallangan xususiy maktablarida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, bir xil familiyali bir nechta o‘quvchi bo‘lgan hollarda, ulardan eng kattasini ajratib ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: During the negotiations, both sides agreed not to cross the red line marked in the treaty.
The red line on the map indicates the disputed border between the two countries.
red line.meta: bu xaritada qizil rangda chizilgan chiziq bo‘lib, u geosiyosiy chegara, ya’ni davlatlar yoki hududlar o‘rtasidagi siyosiy ajratilgan chiziqni bildiradi.

ex: She is studying old Romaika manuscripts from the Ottoman period.
The Romaika spoken in the 18th century differed significantly from classical Greek.
romaika.meta: bu antik yunon tilidan keyingi davrda, ayniqsa Vizantiya va usmonli davrlarida Gretsiyada keng ishlatilgan xalq tilidir.

ex: A sandbox environment helps detect malicious behavior without risking the main system.
The developers tested the new app in a sandbox before deploying it to production.
sand-box.meta: bu kompyuter tizimida yaratilgan xavfsiz muhit bo‘lib, yangi dastur, kod yoki faylni asosiy tizimdan ajratilgan holda ishga tushirish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: On New Year’s Eve, children ran through the streets clanging tin kettles to celebrate.
The villagers banged on tin kettles to protest the new tax law.
tin kettle.meta: bu bayramona yoki norozilik ifodasi sifatida ko‘pincha odamlar tomonidan urib-shovqin chiqarish uchun ishlatiladigan temir idish, masalan, choynak yoki qozon.

ex: The explorer’s travel documents later became important historical sources.
Her travel document described her journey across Central Asia in vivid detail.
travel document.meta: Travel document bu ma’noda shaxsning sayohatlari davomida boshidan kechirgan voqealari, kuzatishlari yoki taassurotlari yozilgan kundalik, daftarcha yoki boshqa yozma materialdir.

ex: Ted’s Travelling Circus was one of the most mobile units during the war.
The 93rd Bombardment Group, nicknamed the Travelling Circus, was known for its rapid deployments.
travelling circus.meta: Travelling Circus — bu harbiy jargon bo‘lib, AQSh havo kuchlarining 93-bombardimonchi guruhiga nisbatan ishlatilgan noformal nom hisoblanadi.

ex: The old manuals taught the use of traversa to outmaneuver an opponent.
With a quick traversa, the duelist avoided the lunge.
traversa.meta: Traversa — bu qilichbozlik san’atida ishlatilgan eski va kamyob atama bo‘lib, yon tomonga qilingan harakat yoki qadamni bildiradi. Bu harakat hujum yoki himoyani chetlab o‘tishda, dushmanning zarbasi ostidan chiqishda ishlatilgan.

ex: The speaker, with a traversable understanding, rambled on in confusion.
His traversable mind could make no sense of the simplest matter.
traversable.meta: Traversable — bu atama tarixda inson tafakkuri, ongi haqida ishlatilgan bo‘lib, adashgan, tartibsiz yoki chalkash fikr yuritayotgan holatni ifodalaydi. Bugungi zamonda bu ma’no eskirgan (obsolete) hisoblanadi va ishlatilmaydi.

ex: Such a traversal must be supported with evidence and legal reasoning.
The defendant entered a traversal of the plaintiff’s claims.
traversal.meta: Traversal — bu so‘z, asosan, huquqiy tilda ishlatiladi va da’vo, bayonot yoki ayblovga qarshi chiqish, uni rad etish yoki unga e’tiroz bildirish harakatini bildiradi.

ex: They studied the traversary currents in the strait.
The traversary motion of the vehicle followed the winding mountain path
traversary.meta: Traversary — bu sifat muayyan yo‘l, chiziq yoki yo‘nalish bo‘ylab harakat qilayotgan yoki harakatga qodir bo‘lgan narsani bildiradi.

ex: The traversed claim was no longer accepted without further evidence.
The traversed plea delayed the proceedings for several weeks.
traversed.meta: Huquqiy kontekstda traversed sifatida ishlatilganda, bu atama biror sud da’vosi yoki bayonotga qarshi e’tiroz bildirilganini, inkor etilganini yoki uning ko‘rib chiqilishi keyinga qoldirilganini anglatadi.

ex: A secure traverse line made it possible to explore the cave ledge safely.
The climbers attached their harnesses to the traverse line before crossing the cliff face.
traverse line.meta: Asosan tog‘ga chiqish, g‘or o‘rganish, yoki boshqa sarguzasht sport turlarida ishlatiladigan traverse line — bu gorizontal yo‘nalishda mahkamlangan xavfsizlik arqoni bo‘lib, u odamga vertikal emas, balki yonlama yo‘nalishda harakatlanishga imkon beradi.

ex: His traversing arguments, though interesting, confused the audience.
The philosopher's traversing remarks led the discussion far from its original focus.
traversing.meta: Traversing sifatida ishlatilganda (eski va kam qo‘llaniladigan ma’noda), bu so‘z biror mavzu yoki bahsdan chetga chiqadigan, asosiy yo‘nalishdan og‘uvchi, yon yo‘lga buriladigan fikr yoki so‘zlashuv shaklini bildiradi.

ex: He dismissed the speech as a travestiment of real political debate.
The poem was not a serious homage but a mere travestiment of the original epic.
travestiment.meta: Travestiment — bu biror narsa yoki asarning masxara, hajv yoki kulgili shaklda buzib ko‘rsatilishi, ya’ni parodiya yoki karikatura sifatida ko‘rsatilgan talqin. Bu atama hozirda eskirgan bo‘lib, klassik adabiyot yoki eski matnlarda uchraydi.

ex: A makeshift travois was used to drag supplies to the campsite.
The medics improvised a travois to carry the wounded soldier through the rough terrain.
travois.meta: Travois — aslida ikki uzun tayoqdan iborat, ularning uchlari erga tegib, boshqa uchlari esa ot yoki boshqa hayvonning orqasiga bog‘langan bo‘lib, orasiga mato yoki platforma mahkamlanadi.

ex: Two cysteine residues form a disulphide bridge through oxidation.
The stability of many proteins depends on the formation of disulphide bridges.
disulphide bridge.meta: Disulfid ko‘prik — bu ikki sistein aminokislotasi orasida yuzaga keladigan oltingugurt-oltingugurt (S—S) kovalent bog‘i bo‘lib, oqsil molekulalarining shaklini saqlab turadi va uni mexanik jihatdan mustahkamlaydi.

ex: They travelled a-eastell the river to reach the next town.
The village lay a-eastell of the great forest.
a-eastell.meta: A-eastell — qadimgi ingliz tilidagi predlog bo‘lib, biror joyning sharqiy qismida yoki sharq tomonda joylashganligini bildiradi. Bu so‘z zamonaviy ingliz tilida "east of", "to the east", yoki "in the east" degan ifodalar bilan almashtirilgan.

ex: The agric sector plays a key role in the country’s economy.
He is an agric student at the university.
agric.meta: "agricultural" so‘zining qisqartma shaklidir. U sifat sifatida qishloq xo‘jaligiga oid narsalarni ifodalash uchun, ot sifatida esa qishloq xo‘jaligi talabasi yoki mutaxassisini anglatuvchi norasmiy, asosan G‘arbiy Afrikada ishlatiladigan iboradir.

ex: He was accused of anti-Semiticism after making offensive remarks about Jewish people.
The rise of anti-Semiticism in Europe during the 1930s led to devastating consequences.
anti-semiticism.meta: bu yahudiy millatiga mansub odamlarga nisbatan diniy, madaniy yoki irqiy asosda salbiy munosabat, dushmanlik, nafrat yoki kamsitishni ifodalaydigan tushuncha.

ex: Assault rifles are standard weapons for many modern armies.
The soldier was equipped with an assault rifle and body armor.
assault rifle.meta: harbiy maqsadlarda qo‘llaniladigan, avtomatik yoki yarim avtomatik rejimda o‘q otishga qodir, o‘q saqlagich orqali zaryadlanadigan zamonaviy o‘qotar qurol turidir. U piyoda askarlar tomonidan dushmanga tezkor va uzluksiz o‘q otish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Assault weapons were a key element in the successful capture of the fortress.
The army deployed heavy assault weapons to breach the enemy’s fortifications.
assault weapon.meta: keng miqyosdagi harbiy hujumlar uchun mo‘ljallangan, ayniqsa qal’a, bunker yoki boshqa mustahkam himoyalangan joylarga qarshi ishlatiladigan quroldir. Bu turdagi qurollar katta zarar yetkazish, devor yorib o‘tish kabi maqsadlarda qo‘llanilgan.

ex: The awedde woman ran into the storm, screaming with rage.
He stared with awedde eyes, muttering words no one understood.
awedde.meta: Awedde — bu insonning g‘azab, jinnilik yoki kuchli ruhiy azob ta’sirida aqliy muvozanatini yo‘qotgan holatini bildiruvchi sifat. Bu so‘z eski ingliz tilida ishlatilgan bo‘lib, zamonaviy ingliz tilida deyarli qo‘llanilmaydi.

ex: The cathedral was awe-inspiringly beautiful in the morning light.
The mountains rose awe-inspiringly against the crimson sky.
awe-inspiringly.meta: Awe-inspiringly — bu nimanidir juda ta’sirli, hayratlanarli yoki kuchli tarzda sodir bo‘lishini ifodalovchi zarf bo‘lib, u ko‘ruvchida chuqur hayrat, hurmat yoki qo‘rquv uyg‘otadi.

ex: Historians discovered an awel in the ruins of the medieval dungeon.
The prisoner was shown the awel before the interrogation began.
awel.meta: Awel — bu temirdan yasalgan ilgak yoki ilgak shaklidagi asbob bo‘lib, tarixiy kontekstlarda ko‘pincha qiynoq vositasi sifatida ishlatilgan. Shuningdek, ba'zida turli amaliy texnik maqsadlarda ham ishlatilgan

ex: Awendaw is softer and moister than regular cornbread.
For dinner, she made fried chicken with collard greens and a side of Awendaw.
awendaw.meta: Awendaw — bu AQShning Janubiy Karolina shtatida tayyorlanadigan, yumshoq va nam bo‘lgan makkajo‘xori unidan qilingan non turi bo‘lib, u ko‘pincha qoshiq bilan tovoq ichiga solinadi yoki to‘kib pishiriladi.

ex: You made cookies? Awesomesauce!
That concert was totally awesomesauce!
awesomesauce.meta: Awesomesauce — bu biror narsa juda ajoyib, juda yaxshi yoki hayratlanarli darajada yoqimli bo‘lganini ifodalovchi zamonaviy ingliz sleng so‘zidir. Bu so‘z odatda samimiy, quvnoq va kulgili ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: The village lies awestell the great river.
The castle stood awestell the forest.
awestell.meta: Awestell — bu biror joy yoki narsa boshqa bir joyning g‘arbiy qismida yoki g‘arb yo‘nalishida joylashganini bildiruvchi qadimgi yoki shevaga oid predlog shaklidir.

ex: People who awfulize tend to increase their own anxiety.
Try not to awfulize the situation — it’s not as bad as you think.
awfulize.meta: Awfulize — bu biror holat, voqea yoki narsani o‘ta salbiy, dahshatli yoki yomon deb baholash, uni haddan tashqari yomon tarzda tasvirlash yoki his qilish deganidir.

ex: He’s an awfy good singer, really!
It was an awfy storm last night.
awfy.meta: Awfy — bu asosan Shotland shevasida ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, biror narsa nihoyatda yomon, qo‘rqinchli yoki salbiy ekanini bildiradi

ex: Researchers studied the traditional healing practices of the Babemba people.
The Babemba are known for their communal approach to justice and social harmony.
babemba.meta: Babemba — bu Bantu tillarida so‘zlashuvchi etnik guruh bo‘lib, ular asosan Zambiyaning shimoli-sharqiy hududlarida va Kongo Demokratik Respublikasining unga qo‘shni hududlarida istiqomat qiladilar.

ex: The essay took a Barthesian approach to visual culture.
Many Barthesians reject traditional notions of authorship in literary criticism.
barthesian.meta: Barcheschi (Bart tarafdori) — bu frantsuz adabiyotshunosi va faylasufi Rolan Bart (Roland Barthes) ning semiotika, adabiy tanqid, va matnshunoslik sohalaridagi nazariyalariga ergashuvchi yoki ularni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs

ex: In medieval Germany, bauers formed the backbone of the rural economy.
The Bavarian bauer owned a small plot of land where he grew vegetables.
bauer.meta: Bauer — bu atama asosan Germaniya va nemis tilida so‘zlashuvchi hududlarda qishloqda yashovchi, o‘z kichik yer maydonida dehqonchilik bilan shug‘ullanuvchi insonni anglatadi.

ex: She is fluent in Bemba and often translates for her community.
The Bemba are one of the largest ethnic groups in Zambia.
bemba.meta: Bemba — bu atama Zambiyaning shimoliy-sharqiy hududida va Kongo Demokratik Respublikasining ayrim joylarida yashovchi bantu tillarida so‘zlashuvchi etnik guruhni bildiradi.

ex: Bialystoks are softer and less dense than bagels.
I had a fresh Bialystok for breakfast with a cup of coffee.
bialystok.meta: Bialystok — bu yumshoq, chaynalmali, dumaloq shakldagi non, markazida mayda tug‘ralgan piyoz bilan to‘ldirilgan chuqurchasi bo‘ladi. U Polshaning Białystok shahridan nom olgan bo‘lib, asosan Yahudiy oshxonasiga mansub.

ex: Don't confuse a lieutenant colonel with a bird colonel—they have different ranks.
He served as a bird colonel in the U.S. Air Force before retiring.
bird colonel.meta: Bird colonel — bu to‘liq polkovnik harbiy unvoni bo‘lib, u leytenant polkovnikdan yuqori, ammo brigada generali darajasidan past turadi.

ex: He was a bright young bochur with a passion for Jewish law.
The bochur spends most of his day studying Talmud at the yeshiva.
bochur.meta: Bochur — bu ibroniycha kelib chiqadigan atama bo‘lib, u o‘smir yoki yosh yigit, ayniqsa yeshiva deb ataluvchi yahudiy diniy maktabida Talmud va ravvin yozuvlarini o‘rganayotgan talabani anglatadi. U ko‘proq ortodoks yahudiylar doirasida ishlatiladi.

ex: Different lenses produce different types of bokeh, some smooth and others harsh.
The portrait was stunning, with a creamy bokeh that made the subject stand out beautifully.
bokeh.meta: Boke — bu fotosuratdagi asosiy obyektdan tashqarida qolgan (fokusdan chiqqan) qismlarning xiralashuvi bo‘lib, ko‘pincha san’atkorona yoki estetik maqsadlarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Forecasters warned that a bombogenesis event was likely to develop overnight.
The bombogenesis off the East Coast caused widespread blizzards and hurricane-force winds.
bombogenesis.meta: Bombogenez — bu ekstratropik tsiklon markazida bosimning juda tez va barqaror pasayishi bilan tavsiflanadigan meteorologik hodisa bo‘lib, odatda kuchli bo‘ron yoki portlovchi tsiklon (bomb cyclone) ni yuzaga keltiradi

ex: You shouldn’t criticize your boss so openly — that’s just bridge-burning.
His harsh resignation email was a classic case of bridge-burning.
bridge-burning.meta: Ko‘priklarni yoqish — bu harakat yoki qaror orqali o‘zining oldingi munosabatlarini, imkoniyatlarini yoki yo‘llarini butunlay yo‘q qilish yoki qaytish imkonini yo‘qotish holatidir.

ex: He wore a vintage bridge coat with brass buttons and a wool lining.
The admiral stood on the deck in his traditional navy bridge coat.
bridge coat.meta: Kapitan pal’tosi — bu og‘ir, uzun, ikki qatorli tugmalari bo‘lgan junli ustki kiyim bo‘lib, dastlab sovuq ob-havoda kemadagi boshqaruv maydonida turgan dengiz zobitlari tomonidan kiyilgan. Keyinchalik ushbu uslubdagi pal’tolar umumiy modaga aylangan.

ex: In medieval towns, the bridger was an important figure in city defense.
The bridger ensured the drawbridge was raised at dusk.
bridger.meta: Ko‘prik noziri — bu ko‘prikning holatini nazorat qiluvchi, undan foydalanishni boshqaruvchi yoki uni saqlab turish uchun mas’ul bo‘lgan shaxs. Bu atama asosan eski ingliz tilida ishlatilgan va hozirda deyarli qo‘llanilmaydi.

ex: The Brightonian culture blends tradition with modern seaside life.
She’s a true Brightonian—born and raised by the sea.
brightonian.meta: Braytonlik — bu Angliyaning Brighton shahrida tug‘ilgan yoki u yerda yashovchi odam. Braytongacha oid — Brayton shahriga oid bo‘lgan, unga tegishli yoki u yer bilan bog‘liq narsalarni bildiradi.

ex: Brik is a staple in many North African iftar meals during Ramadan.
We tried a delicious brik filled with egg and tuna at a Tunisian café.
brik.meta: Brik — ayniqsa Tunis va Shimoliy Afrikaning boshqa hududlarida tayyorlanadigan ingichka xamir (filo)dan yasalgan, ko‘pincha uchburchak shaklida bo‘lib, ichiga mazali (masalan, tuxum, baliq, kartoshka yoki go‘sht) solinadigan qovurilgan pishiriqdir.

ex: Don’t get all broigus—I was just joking!
He’s still broigus about what happened at the party.
broigus.meta: Broigus — bu biror kishining g‘azablangan, ranjigan yoki jahli chiqqan holatini bildiruvchi so‘z bo‘lib, u ko‘pincha o‘zaro munosabatlardagi araz va janjal kontekstida ishlatiladi.

ex: The buka near the station serves delicious homemade soups at very low prices.
We stopped at a buka for some quick lunch on the highway.
buka.meta: Buka — ko‘pincha yo‘l chetida joylashgan, arzon narxlarda tayyor ovqatlar sotiladigan kichik do‘kon yoki ovqatxona. Odatda bu yerda mijozlar o‘tirib ovqatlanishlari uchun joy ham mavjud bo‘ladi.

ex: We grabbed some snacks at the bukateria on our road trip.
The bukateria near the market offers a variety of local dishes at affordable prices.
bukateria.meta: Bukateria — ko‘pincha yo‘l chetida joylashgan, arzon narxlarda tayyor ovqatlar sotiladigan kichik do‘kon yoki ovqatxona. Odatda bu joyda mijozlar o‘tirib ovqatlanishlari uchun joy ham mavjud bo‘ladi.

ex: Cab-over trucks are popular in urban areas because they are easier to park.
The truck has a cab-over design, which allows for better maneuverability in tight spaces.
cab-over.meta: Cab-over — yuk mashinasi yoki treyler dizaynida dvigatel haydovchi kabinasining oldida emas, uning ostida joylashgan turdagi konstruktsiya. Bu dizayn avtomobilning uzunligini qisqartiradi va boshqaruv maydonini kengaytiradi.

ex: Many commercial vehicles use cab-over-engine designs to maximize cargo space.
The cab-over-engine truck allows for better visibility and easier maneuvering in urban areas.
cab-over-engine.meta: Cab-over-engine — yuk mashinasi yoki treylerlarda dvigatel haydovchi joyidan oldinda emas, balki uning ostida joylashgan konstruktsiya turi.

ex: Many wine enthusiasts prefer cab sav for its bold taste.
He ordered a glass of cab sav to accompany his steak.
cab sav.meta: Cab sav — Cabernet Sauvignon uzumidan tayyorlangan qizil vino turi. Bu vino o‘zining boy ta’mi va kuchli aromati bilan mashhur.

ex: His performance was very camped-up, full of dramatic gestures and flamboyance.
The play was deliberately camped-up to entertain the audience with humor and exaggeration.
camped-up.meta: Camped-up — san’at yoki ko‘ngilochar asar, drama yoki ijro ko‘pincha qasddan haddan tashqari, kulgili yoki teatr tarzda ijro etilgan holat. Bu uslub ko‘pincha o‘yin-kulgi va o‘ziga xos estetikani ta’minlaydi.

ex: Chicagoese expressions are unique to the city's local culture.
He spoke in a strong Chicagoese accent that was hard to understand for outsiders.
chicagoese.meta: Chicagoese — Chikago shahriga, uning odamlariga yoki u yerda ishlatiladigan maxsus nutq, lahja yoki tilda xos bo‘lgan holat yoki narsa. Bu atama hozirda kamroq qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The weather in Chicagoland can be very unpredictable.
Many businesses in Chicagoland benefit from the large metropolitan market.
chicagoland.meta: Chicagoland — Chikago shahri bilan birga uning yaqinidagi shimoli-sharqiy Illinois, shuningdek, Indiana va Viskonsinning yaqin hududlarini o‘z ichiga olgan mintaqa. Bu hudud ko‘pincha bir birlik sifatida qaraladi.

ex: Chichimec tribes played a significant role in the history of pre-Columbian Mexico.
The Chichimec were known for their nomadic lifestyle in ancient Mexico.
chichimec.meta: Chichimec — Meksikadagi tarixiy mahalliy xalqlardan biri bo‘lib, ular ko‘p hollarda ko‘chmanchi yoki yarim-ko‘chmanchi hayot tarzini olib borgan. Ispan istilosidan oldingi davrlarda shimoliy va markaziy Meksikada yashagan.

ex: Chichimeca tribes resisted the Spanish conquest fiercely.
The Chichimeca were known for their nomadic lifestyle in ancient Mexico.
chichimeca.meta: Chichimeca — Meksikadagi turli mahalliy xalqlarning vakili, ko‘p hollarda ko‘chmanchi yoki yarim-ko‘chmanchi hayot tarzini olib borgan. Ispan istilosidan oldingi davrda shimoliy va markaziy Meksikada yashaganlar.

ex: A chickee provides shelter while allowing air to flow freely.
The Seminole tribe traditionally lived in chickees built in the Florida Everglades.
chickee.meta: Chikiy — Qo‘shma Shtatlarning janubi-sharqiy qismida, xususan Floridada joylashgan, yog‘ochdan yasalgan ramka ustida palmetto barglari bilan qoplangan, tomoni ochiq bo‘lgan, pol ko‘tarilgan turar joy.

ex: Many modern chicken factories confine the birds in small spaces to maximize production.
The chickens are hatched in a large chicken factory under controlled temperature and humidity.
chicken factory.meta: Ko‘p miqdorda tovuqlarni harorat va boshqa sharoitlar nazoratida tuxumdan chiqishini ta’minlaydigan bino yoki inshoot. So‘nggi vaqtlarda ayniqsa, tovuqlarni zich joylashtirilgan holda saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan joy sifatida tushuniladi.

ex: Chicken fat is often used in traditional recipes to add flavor.
Render the chicken fat slowly to get a clear cooking fat.
chicken fat.meta: Tovuq yog‘i — Tovuq go‘shtidan olingan, eritib tozalangan yog‘ bo‘lib, ko‘pincha pishirishda ishlatiladi. U taomlarga o‘ziga xos lazzat beradi va yog‘ sifatida foydalaniladi.

ex: She dipped the chicken fingers in barbecue sauce.
Chicken fingers are a popular snack in many fast-food restaurants.
chicken finger.meta: Tovuq barmog‘i — Tovuq ko‘krak go‘shtidan olingan ingichka bo‘lakchalar bo‘lib, ular non maydalari yoki qalin xamirdan qoplanib, chuqur yog‘da qovuriladi. Odatda, ularni turli souslar bilan dasturxonga tortishadi.

ex: Chicken gloves are prized for their softness and fine texture.
She wore delicate chicken gloves to the formal event.
chicken glove.meta: Mayda qo‘lqop — Juda nozik va nozik teridan, asosan qo‘y, yosh qo‘y (kid) yoki buzoq terisidan yasalgan yupqa qo‘lqoplar. Ular ko‘pincha an’anaviy kiyimlarda yoki nafis vaziyatlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: He acted like a total chickenhead in the meeting
Don’t be such a chickenhead!
chickenhead.meta: Chickenhead — So‘zma-so‘z “tovuq bosh” degan ma’noga ega, ammo odatda AQShda shivirlashda ishlatiladi. Bu atama ahmoq, aqldan ozgan yoki juda beaqldor odamni ifodalash uchun qo‘llaniladi. Shuningdek, sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi (chicken-headed).

ex: Don’t be chicken-headed; think carefully.
That was a chicken-headed decision.
chicken-headed.meta: Chicken-headed — aqldan ozgan, ahmoqona, beaqldor odamni yoki harakatni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: She’s always acting like Chicken Licken, spreading panic around.
Don’t be such a Chicken Licken every time something small happens.
chicken licken.meta: Chicken Licken — oson vahimaga tushadigan yoki boshqalar orasida vahima, qo‘rquv tarqatadigan odam. Ingliz tilidagi Chicken Little so‘zining sinonimi.

ex: He acted like a Chicken Little, spreading panic about the storm
Don’t be a Chicken Little every time something bad happens.
chicken little.meta: Chicken Little — oson vahimaga tushadigan yoki boshqalarga vahima, qo‘rquv tarqatadigan odam. Shuningdek, sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi (vahimachi, vahima ko‘taruvchi). Ingliz tilidagi Chicken Licken so‘ziga o‘xshash ma’noga ega.

ex: Chicken noodle soup is often considered a comfort food for the sick.
When I’m sick, I always ask my mom to make chicken noodle soup
chicken noodle soup.meta: Tovuqli noodle sho‘rva — tovuq go‘shti va noodle (ingichka makaron) bilan tayyorlangan sho‘rva. Ba’zan odamlar uni barcha kasalliklar uchun davo sifatida yoki tiklovchi xususiyatlari uchun qadrlashadi.

ex: Her handwriting is just chicken scratch, almost impossible to understand.
I couldn’t read his notes; they looked like chicken scratch.
chicken scratch.meta: Tovuq tirnoqlari — qo‘lda tez yoki ehtiyotkorliksiz chizilgan, o‘qib bo‘lmaydigan yoki tushunarsiz belgilar, chiziqlar yoki harflar. Ko‘pincha, yomon yoki notekis qo‘l yozuvi ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Chicken soup is often considered a comforting and healing food.
My grandmother always makes chicken soup when someone is sick.
chicken soup.meta: Tovuq sho‘rva — tovuq go‘shti va suvidan tayyorlangan sho‘rva turi. Odatda oddiy, tiniq bulon shaklida bo‘lib, ko‘plab odamlar uni turli kasalliklarda davo sifatida yoki charchoqni yengillashtiruvchi vosita sifatida qadrlashadi.

ex: She prefers chicken tenders because they are more tender than other parts of the chicken.
Chicken tenders are often breaded and fried for a crispy snack.
chicken tender.meta: Tovuq qovurg‘a go‘shti — tovuq ko‘kragining tag qismida, umurtqa yaqinida joylashgan, juda yumshoq va nozik mushak bo‘lagi. Bu go‘sht odatda tez pishadi va ta’mi yumshoq bo‘ladi.

ex: This dish tastes a bit chickeny but is actually made from vegetables.
The soup had a chickeny flavor that reminded me of my grandmother’s cooking.
chickeny.meta: Tovuqga o‘xshash — tovuq go‘shtiga xos ta’m, hid yoki ko‘rinishga ega bo‘lgan; tovuqdan tashkil topgan yoki tovuq ta’mi bilan tayyorlangan.

ex: She called her daughter "chickie" affectionately.
Hey chickie, come here and give me a hug!
chickie.meta: Mehribon chaqiriq — ko‘pincha bola yoki ayolga nisbatan sevgi, mehr ko‘rsatish maqsadida ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: Chrains is a traditional condiment in Eastern European cuisine.
She added a spoonful of chrain to the roast beef.
chrain.meta: Xren — achchiq ta’mga ega bo‘lgan ildiz o‘simlik; ayniqsa, maydalangan xren, sirka va ba’zan qizil chigit (beetroot) bilan tayyorlangan achchiq sous bo‘lib, ko‘pincha taomlar bilan qo‘shimcha sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: His chuckheaded decisions caused many problems.
Don’t be so chuckheaded; think before you act.
chuckheaded.meta: Chuckheaded — aql-idrokdan mahrum, kam aql, aqlli emas, ahmoqona xulq-atvor yoki fikrlash tarziga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: That chutzpadik attitude helped her get what she wanted.
He was quite chutzpadik to speak back to the teacher.
chutzpadik.meta: Chutzpadik — yahudiy tilida ishlatiladigan so‘z, juda katta o‘ziga ishongan, jasoratli, ba’zida qo‘pol yoki beparvo tarzda o‘zini tutuvchi odamni ta’riflaydi.

ex: A traditional couscoussier has two pots that fit together tightly.
The chef used a couscoussier to steam the couscous perfectly.
couscoussier.meta: Kuskus pishiruvchi idish — kuskus pishirish uchun ishlatiladigan bug‘da pishirish idishi. Bu ikki bir-biriga yopishgan idishdan iborat bo‘lib, yuqori idishda kuskus joylashadi va uning qopqog‘i hamda teshiklari bo‘lgan tagi mavjud bo‘ladi.

ex: “Cousin Sally” was a nickname used to mock the Confederate States.
During the Civil War, some soldiers referred to the Confederacy as “Cousin Sally.”
cousin sally.meta: Qoshing Sally — Amerika Fuqarolar urushi davrida Janubiy Qo‘shma Shtatlari konfederatsiyasiga berilgan laqab. Bu atama konfederatsiya uchun kinoya yoki xalq tilidagi nom sifatida ishlatilgan.

ex: Gardeners enjoy growing cucamelons for their unique sour flavor.
The cucamelon vine produces small fruits that look like tiny watermelons.
cucamelon.meta: Markaziy Amerikaga xos bo‘lgan va boshqa joylarda ham yetishtiriladigan, o‘rganishli ovloq o‘simliklar oilasiga mansub o‘suvchi o‘simlik. Uning mevasi uzum kattaligida, tashqi ko‘rinishi kichik qovuncha yoki tarvuzchaga o‘xshaydi va nordon ta’mga ega.

ex: The danfo minibuses are known for their crowded and lively atmosphere.
Many people in Lagos rely on the danfo for their daily commute.
danfo.meta: Nigeriyaning Lagos shahrida keng tarqalgan, sariq rangdagi minibus. Bu minibus norasmiy jamoat transporti sifatida ishlaydi va yo‘lovchilarni to‘lov evaziga tashiydi. Ko‘pincha shahar ichida qisqa masofalarga qatnov qiladi.

ex: The poem criticizes the dulce et decorum belief by showing the brutal reality of battle.
Many soldiers grew skeptical of the dulce et decorum ideology after witnessing the horrors of war.
dulce et decorum.meta: Dulce et decorum — o‘z yurtiga xizmat qilish uchun jangda halok bo‘lish shonli va sharafli deb hisoblanadigan qarash yoki ideologiya. Bu ifoda ko‘pincha urushdagi qahramonlik va fidoiylikni madh etishda ishlatiladi.

ex: Many modern writers question the validity of dulce et decorum est given the brutal realities of war.
The phrase “dulce et decorum est” has been used historically to inspire soldiers to fight bravely.
dulce et decorum est.meta: Dulce et decorum est — o‘z yurtiga xizmat qilib, jang maydonida halok bo‘lish sharafli va buyuk ekanligiga ishonch yoki g‘oya. Bu ibora ko‘pincha vatanparvarlik va jasoratni madh etish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: The ember months are often busy due to holiday preparations and end-of-year deadlines
Many businesses experience increased sales during the ember months.
ember months.meta: Ember oylari — yilning sentabr, oktyabr, noyabr va dekabr oylarini ifodalaydi. Bu davr ko‘pincha faoliyat, ishlar, bayram tayyorgarliklari yoki savdo-sotiqning kuchaygan davri sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: The report criticized the abundance of e-waste on the internet.
Some websites are filled with e-waste that offers no real value.
e-waste.meta: Elektron chiqindi — arzimagan yoki sifatsiz elektron matn yoki kontentga nisbatan ishlatiladigan atama. Kamdan-kam uchraydi.

ex: She looked at the painting eyefully, impressed by its grandeur.
The ancient castle stood eyefully on the hilltop.
eyefully.meta: Hayratlantiruvchi tarzda — ko‘z qarash orqali hayrat, qo‘rqish yoki vahimaga soladigan tarzda amalga oshiriladigan holat.

ex: Eyelessness of authority often leads to disorder.
His eyelessness towards the law shocked many officials.
eyelessness.meta: Hokimiyatdan qo‘rqmaslik — hokimiyat oldida qo‘rqish, hurmat yoki e’tibor yo‘qligi holati. Hokimiyatga hurmatsizlik — vakolat yoki rahbarlarga nisbatan qo‘rqmaslik yoki ularni hurmat qilmaslik.

ex: U axlat bilan qoplangan skameykaga o‘tirmaslikka harakat qildi.
Bayramdan keyin ko‘cha axlat bilan qoplangan edi.
farkakte.meta: Axlat bilan qoplangan — najas yoki chiqindi bilan to‘liq yoki qisman qoplangan holat. Juda kam ishlatiladigan so‘z.

ex: Spectators cheered loudly at the flag-off.
The flag-off for the race is scheduled at 9 a.m.
flag-off.meta: Start berish vaqti — poyga yoki musobaqa boshlanishining ayni lahzasi, ayniqsa avtomobil poygalarida qo‘pol bayroq yoki belgi yordamida start berish.

ex: The arrow was carefully fletched with bright feathers.
He used a high-fletched arrow for better accuracy.
fletched.meta: Qanotli — o‘qning orqa qismiga tuklar yoki qanotlar o‘rnatilgan bo‘lib, uning parvozini barqarorlashtiradi. Ko‘pincha oldiga boshqa so‘zlar qo‘shilib, masalan, feather-fletched (tuk bilan qanotlangan), high-fletched (yuqori qanotlangan) kabi ishlatiladi.

ex: Many contemporary theorists can be described as Foucauldians in their approach to discourse.
The analysis adopts a Foucauldian perspective on power and surveillance.
foucauldian.meta: Fukolcha — frantsuz faylasufi va tarixchisi Mishel Fuko (Michel Foucault) g‘oyalari yoki asarlariga oid, ularga xos bo‘lgan yoki ularni ifodalovchi tushunchalarni bildiradi.

ex: He pulled a franger out of his wallet.
Don't forget to take a franger — better safe than sorry!
franger.meta: jinsiy aloqada homiladorlikning oldini olish va jinsiy yo‘l bilan yuqadigan kasalliklardan himoyalanish uchun ishlatiladigan elastik vosita, ya’ni prezervativning inglizcha so‘zlashuv tilidagi (ayniqsa, Avstraliya slangida) nomi.

ex: Stop futzing and get to work!
He spent the whole afternoon futzing around in the garage without fixing anything.
futzing.meta: Futzing – foydali natijaga olib kelmaydigan, arzimas yoki samarasiz mashg‘ulot bilan shug‘ullanish; vaqtni behuda sarflash yoki biror ishni chala-chulpa qilib, bekorchilik bilan ovora bo‘lish holati. Odatda futzing around shaklida ishlatiladi.

ex: Garrick are known for their speed and strength in the water.
The fisherman caught a large garrick off the coast of South Africa.
garrick.meta: Garrick — Lichia amia nomli baliq turi bo‘lib, u Carangidae oilasiga mansub. Garrick — dengiz baliqlari orasida yirtqich va tez suzuvchi baliq hisoblanadi. Ko‘proq iliq suvli hududlarda uchraydi va sport baliqchiligi uchun mashhur hisoblanadi.

ex: This meat is certified as glatt kosher by a rabbinical authority.
They only serve glatt kosher meals at that restaurant.
glatt kosher.meta: Glatt kosher — yahudiy diniy ovqatlanish qonun-qoidalari (kashrut)ning eng qat’iy talqiniga muvofiq tayyorlangan ovqat yoki mahsulotni bildiradi

ex: He launched his guber campaign with a strong focus on education reform.
The state is gearing up for the upcoming guber elections.
guber.meta: Guber — gubernator yoki uning lavozimi (hokimlik) bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan narsalarni ifodalovchi sifat (adjective).

ex: The hanukkiah stood proudly in the window, visible from the street.
We lit the first candle on the hanukkiah to begin Hanukkah.
hanukkiah.meta: Hanukkiah — bu Xanuka bayramida ishlatiladigan to‘qqizta sham qo‘yiladigan shamdon, ulardan sakkiztasi har bir bayram kuni uchun, bittasi esa “shamash” deb ataladigan yordamchi sham uchun mo‘ljallangan

ex: That guy at the gym is so hench, he must work out every day.
Have you seen Tom lately? He’s looking proper hench these days.
hench.meta: jismonan kuchli, mushaklari rivojlangan, sog‘lom va baquvvat gavdali odamni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan norasmiy so‘z. Asosan erkaklar uchun qo‘llanadi, lekin umumiy jismoniy holatga nisbatan ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Hen-day production is a key metric in poultry farming
The farm recorded an average of 0.85 eggs per hen-day.
hen-day.meta: bu tovuq tuxumdorligini baholashda ishlatiladigan birlik, ya’ni bir dona tovuqning bir kun ichidagi tuxum ishlab chiqarish imkoniyatini bildiradi. Bu birlik yordamida tovuq fermalarida umumiy tuxum ishlab chiqarish samaradorligi hisoblab chiqiladi.

ex: Her hendiship won the hearts of all who met her.
He treated his guests with true hendiship.
hendiship.meta: bu mehribonlik, muloyimlik, odamga nisbatan iliq va xushmuomalalik bilan munosabatda bo‘lish holatini bildiradi. Ushbu so‘z qadimgi yoki kam ishlatiladigan shakl bo‘lib, graciousness va kindliness ma’nolariga yaqin turadi.

ex: He used a hen feather to decorate his traditional hat.
The old pillow was filled with soft hen feathers.
hen feather.meta: Hen feather — tovuqdan olinadigan pat, asosan yostiq, ko‘rpa-to‘shaklarni to‘ldirish, kiyim-kechak va bosh kiyimlarni bezash, yoki sun’iy qarmoq (fly fishing) tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: Hennigian cladistics rejects paraphyletic groupings.
The Hennigian approach revolutionized biological classification.
hennigian.meta: bu atama organizmalarni tasniflashning bir uslubiga, ya’ni filogenetik yoki kladistik tizimga oid bo‘lib, uni olmon olimi Willi Hennig ishlab chiqqan. Bu tizimda faqat monofiletik guruhlar tan olinadi.

ex: The Pope rejected the Henotikon, leading to a schism between Constantinople and Rome.
The Henotikon was an attempt to reconcile opposing theological factions in the Byzantine Empire.
henotikon.meta: Henotikon — bu Vizantiya imperatori Zenon tomonidan 482-yilda chiqarilgan diniy farmon bo‘lib, uning maqsadi Xalkedon tarafdorlari bilan monofizitlar o‘rtasida diniy birlikni tiklash edi.

ex: Henpecking can damage communication in a relationship.
His friends joked about the constant henpecking he endured at home.
henpecking.meta: Henpecking — bu ayolning o‘z erini yoki erkak sherigini doimiy ravishda tanqid qilishi, buyruq berishi yoki nazorat ostida ushlashi holatini bildiradi.

ex: Scholars often study the Henriad as a single narrative arc.
The Henriad explores themes of power, legitimacy, and kingship.
henriad.meta: bu atama Uilyam Shekspirning to‘rt tarixiy pyesasi to‘plamiga berilgan nom bo‘lib, ular quyidagilardan iborat:

ex: Critics argue that Henry VIII powers undermine parliamentary sovereignty.
The new bill includes a Henry VIII clause allowing ministers to override existing laws.
henry viii.meta: sifatlovchi so‘z sifatida, bu atama hukumatga parlament tomonidan qabul qilingan qonunni parlament ruxsatisiz o‘zgartirish yoki bekor qilish vakolatini beruvchi huquqiy mexanizmni bildiradi.

ex: The manuscript was full of hen scrats instead of proper letters.
His note was just a hen scrat—no one could read it.
hen scrat.meta: Hen scrat — bu tarixiy va kam ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, tovuqlarning yerda tirnaganiga o‘xshash chiziq yoki tushunarsiz, chalkash, o‘qib bo‘lmaydigan qo‘l yozuvini anglatadi.

ex: Old folk used to say that hen scrattins meant heavy rain.
The sky was streaked with hen scrattins, and the shepherds knew a storm was coming.
hen scrattin.meta: bu atama odatda osmonda ko‘rinadigan uzun va ingichka sirrus bulutlariga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Tovuq tirnashiga o‘xshagan bulut shakllari sifatida tasvirlanadi va odatda yomg‘ir yoki bo‘ronli ob-havoning yaqinlashuviga ishora qilgan deb hisoblangan.

ex: (noun): Don’t wear that hen-skin; it won’t keep you warm at all.
(adj.): She wore a hen-skin dress that barely held together in the wind.
hen-skin.meta: Hen-skin — bu so‘z kiyim-kechak yoki oyoq kiyimi haqida aytilganda, uning juda yupqa, nozik yoki mustahkam bo‘lmagan materialdan tayyorlanganini bildiradi.

ex: Conservationists are working to protect the habitat of Henslow’s sparrow.
The Henslow’s sparrow is rarely seen in open fields because it prefers dense grass.
henslow’s sparrow.meta: bu Shimoliy Amerikaning o‘tloqli hududlarida yashaydigan bir turdagi chumchuqdir. Ilmiy nomi Ammodramus henslowii bo‘lib, Passerellidae (chumchuqsimonlar) oilasiga mansub.

ex: She left the court i-waldes, not by force.
He confessed i-waldes, without coercion.
i-waldes.meta: i-waldes — bu qadimgi va hozirda ishlatilmaydigan (archaic) ravish bo‘lib, biror ishni o‘z ixtiyori bilan, ataylab yoki ongli ravishda qilish ma’nosini bildiradi.

ex: (n.): The ancient Greeks were considered Japhetans in biblical tradition.
(adj.): The historian argued that many European nations have Japhetan roots.
japhetan.meta: Japhetan — bu so‘z Bibliyadagi Nuh payg‘ambarning o‘g‘li Yofas (inglizcha Japheth) bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, Yofasdan kelib chiqqan xalqlar yoki odamlarni anglatadi.

ex: Who’s that jerkweed blocking the road?
Stop acting like a jerkweed and listen!
jerkweed.meta: Jerkweed — bu so‘zlashuv tili va haqoratli slang bo‘lib, ahmoq, yoqimsiz, jirkanch yoki asabiylashtiruvchi odamni, ayniqsa erkakni, ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Her Jewdar is so strong, she can spot a fellow Jew from a mile away.
As soon as he walked in, my Jewdar went off.
jewdar.meta: Jewdar — bu hazilomuz va norasmiy so‘z bo‘lib, “Jew” (yahudiy) + “radar” so‘zlarining qo‘shilishidan hosil bo‘lgan.

ex: My uncle runs a jeweller’s shop where he makes custom gold rings.
She bought the necklace from a small jeweller’s shop in the bazaar.
jeweller’s shop.meta: bu zargarga tegishli do‘kon yoki ustaxona bo‘lib, unda qimmatbaho taqinchoqlar (tilla, kumush, olmos, zargarlik buyumlari) sotiladi, ta’mirlanadi yoki buyurtma asosida tayyorlanadi. Ba’zida bu joy sotuv va ishlab chiqarish funksiyasini birlashtiradi.

ex: The comedian is known for his signature Jewfro.
His Jewfro was impossible to comb, but he wore it with pride.
jewfro.meta: Jewfro — bu asosan ayrim yahudiy erkaklar orasida uchraydigan, tabiiy holda jingalak, taram-taram va taralgan soch turmagi bo‘lib, afroamerikaliklarning afro deb ataladigan soch turmiga o‘xshaydi.

ex: Jew-hating propaganda was widespread during the Nazi era.
The film explores the roots of Jew-hating in 20th-century Europe.
jew-hating.meta: Jew-hating — bu yahudiy xalqi, dini, madaniyati yoki millatiga nisbatan dushmanlik, nafrat yoki adovat tuyg‘ularini anglatuvchi atama. U antisemitizm (xalqaro atama) bilan sinonimdir.

ex: Grilled jewie is a popular dish in coastal restaurants.
He caught a massive jewie off the coast of New South Wales.
jewie.meta: bu asosan Avstraliya va Janubiy Osiyo suvlarida uchraydigan, ilmiy nomi Argyrosomus japonicus bo‘lgan katta yirtqich baliq turini bildiradi. Bu baliq "jewfish" nomi bilan ham tanilgan bo‘lib, asosan sport baliqchiligi va ovqat tayyorlashda qadrlanadi.

ex: The novel explores the life of a young Jewish American growing up in New York
Albert Einstein was a prominent Jewish American physicist.
jewish american.meta: bu yahudiy kelib chiqishga ega Amerika fuqarosi yoki AQShda yashovchi yahudiy millatiga mansub insonni anglatadi

ex: Scholars study the Jewish-Christian sects to understand the roots of Christianity.
The early Jewish-Christian communities observed both the Torah and the teachings of Jesus.
jewish-christian.meta: bu tarixiy nuqtai nazardan dastlabki nasroniylikni qabul qilgan, ammo yahudiylik diniy urf-odatlarini saqlab qolgan yahudiylarga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan atama

ex: Scholars debate whether Jewish Christianity was a separate movement or part of early Christianity.
Jewish Christianity preserved many of the religious practices of Second Temple Judaism.
jewish christianity.meta: bu dastlabki nasroniylik shakli bo‘lib, yahudiylar tomonidan qabul qilingan va yahudiy diniy urf-odatlari, qonunlari va madaniyatiga asoslangan holda rivojlangan xristianlikni anglatadi.

ex: During the 19th century, many European cities had a Jew town where Jewish communities lived and worked.
The old Jew town in Cochin, India, is known for its historic synagogue and spice markets.
jew town.meta: bu asosan yahudiylar istiqomat qiladigan shahar yoki shahar ichidagi hudud yoki mahalla. Tarixan bu atama yahudiylar jamlangan, o‘z madaniyati, diniy binolari va savdo faoliyatiga ega bo‘lgan hududlarni ifodalagan

ex: The use of the term Jew York is considered offensive and antisemitic.
Some extremists refer to New York as Jew York, implying undue Jewish influence.
jew york.meta: bu New York shahrining haqoratli yoki istehzo aralash alternativ nomi bo‘lib, yahudiylar sonining ko‘pligiga ishora qilish uchun ishlatilgan.

ex: Actors from Kannywood are gaining popularity across West Africa.
Kannywood has produced hundreds of films that reflect Hausa culture and traditions.
kannywood.meta: bu Nigeriyaning Hausa tilidagi kino sanoati nomi bo‘lib, asosan Kano shahrida joylashgan. Bu atama Kano va Hollywood so‘zlarining birikmasidan olingan.

ex: Prolonged vitamin D deficiency can lead to K-legs in children.
The child was diagnosed with K-legs and referred to a specialist.
k-leg.meta: K-leg — bu bir yoki ikkala tizzaning ichkariga egilgan holati, natijada odam oyoqlarini birga qo‘yganda oyoq panjalari orasida katta bo‘shliq paydo bo‘ladi.

ex: Her kvetching tone annoyed everyone in the meeting.
He’s such a kvetching old man—nothing ever pleases him.
kvetching.meta: bu doimiy ravishda shikoyat qiladigan, norozi yoki tanqid qiladigan odam yoki holatni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z Yiddish (yahudiy nemis tili)dan ingliz tiliga kirgan bo‘lib, shikoyat qilish yoki egil-egil gapirish ma’nosini bildiradi.

ex: Don’t be so kvetchy—it’s just a small delay.
My kvetchy coworker keeps complaining about the air conditioning.
kvetchy.meta: bu tez-tez shikoyat qiladigan, har narsadan norozi bo‘ladigan, yoki o‘ta jizzaki va asabiy odamni yoki holatni ifodalaydigan sifatdosh.

ex: Lane cake is known for its rich filling with nuts and dried fruits.
She baked a delicious Lane cake for the party.
lane cake.meta: AQShning janubiy shtatlarida an’anaviy tayyorlanadigan oq qatlamli shirinlik (keks). Odatda ichida boy to‘ldirish bo‘ladi, u yerda yong‘oqlar, quritilgan mevalar va bourbon (spirtli ichimlik) yoki boshqa alkogolli ichimliklar bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Macarons are delicate French confections made from egg whites and sugar.
She bought colorful macarons from the bakery.
macaron.meta: tuxum oqi, shakar va kukun shakardan tayyorlangan, merengga o‘xshash yumshoq va yengil konsistensiyaga ega bo‘lgan, ikki kichik dumaloq (odatda rang-barang) pechenyadan iborat shirinlik.

ex: Mama puts are popular for quick and affordable meals in many cities.
I often buy lunch from the mama put near my office.
mama put.meta: ko‘cha sotuvchisi, odatda ayol bo‘lib, qo‘l aravachasi yoki savdo do‘koni orqali arzon narxda tayyorlangan taomlarni sotadi. Shuningdek, yo‘l chetida joylashgan kichik ovqatlanish joyi yoki ko‘cha do‘koni ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Beware of mentionitis when writing reports — only include relevant information.
His speech suffered from mentionitis, as he kept bringing up unrelated details.
mentionitis.meta: dastlab, biror narsani ahamiyatsiz yoki muhimligi yo‘q bo‘lsa ham, to‘liq yoki batafsilroq qilish maqsadida eslatib o‘tish holati. Keyinchalik esa, haddan tashqari ko‘p va keraksiz eslatib o‘tish, doimiy ta’kidlab yurish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Don’t say rude things with your mouthie.
He wiped his mouthie after eating.
Nanoplastic is a rare and futuristic concept in material science.
Scientists are researching nanoplastic materials that can adapt their shape.
nanoplastic.meta: nanoteknologiya yordamida ishlab chiqarilgan, shaklini va boshqa xususiyatlarini kerak bo‘lganda o‘zgartira oladigan taxminiy material. Kam uchraydigan atama.

ex: The event is scheduled for next tomorrow.
We will meet next tomorrow.
next tomorrow.meta: bugun hisoblaganda ikki kundan keyingi kun; ya’ni "ötkazgan kundan keyin keladigan kun", ya’ni "bugundan keyin keladigan ikkinchi kun". Oddiy til bilan aytganda — "ötkazgan kundan keyingi kun".

ex: Non-indigenes often face social challenges in some regions.
He is a non-indigene of the town.
non-indigene.meta: tug‘ilgan yoki asosan yashaydigan joyi emas; biror hududga xos, asli bo‘lmagan. Ko‘proq G‘arbiy Afrika kontekstida ishlatiladi, ya’ni ma’lum bir hududga mahalliy bo‘lmagan etnik guruhga mansub bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: The children giggled when they heard the word noonie.
She used the word noonie in a funny joke.
noonie.meta: Nooni — asosan Britaniya inglizchasida ishlatiladigan, ayol jinsiy a’zolarini (vulva yoki vagina) bildiruvchi noformal, ko‘pincha hazil yoki yumshoq ifoda sifatida ishlatiladigan so‘z.

ex: The okada driver helped me cross the busy street.
Many people use okada to get around the city quickly.
okada.meta: Nigeriyada — yo‘lovchilarni tashish uchun ishlatiladigan mototsikl taksi. Bu mototsikl orqali odamlar tez va arzon yo‘lga borishadi.

ex: Why are you late, sef?
You don’t know anything, sef!
sef.meta: Sef — gap yoki ritorik savoldan keyin ishlatiladigan urg‘u beruvchi so‘z, ko‘pincha norozilik yoki sabrsizlikni ifodalaydi.

ex: Segways are popular for city tours and short-distance travel.
He bought a Segway to travel around the city easily.
segway.meta: Segway — ikki g‘ildirakli, motorli shaxsiy transport vositasi; oyoqlar uchun platformadan tashkil topgan, gorizontal o‘q ustida g‘ildiraklari joylashgan va balansni saqlash orqali harakatlanadigan qurilma.

ex: Many Semiticists specialize in ancient Hebrew and Arabic texts.
