The Semiticist gave a lecture on the history of Semitic languages.
semiticist.meta: Semitikist — Semit tillari, adabiyoti va madaniyatini o‘rganadigan shaxs; Semitist bilan sinonim.

ex: Many Semiticists specialize in ancient texts written in Aramaic.
The Semiticist delivered a lecture on the evolution of the Hebrew language.
semiticist.meta: Semitshunos — semit tillari (masalan, arab, ibroniy, aramey tillari), ularning adabiyoti, tarixiy rivoji va madaniyatini o‘rganadigan olim yoki tadqiqotchi.

ex: We are organizing a send-forth party for her before she moves abroad.
The company held a send-forth for their retiring manager.
send-forth.meta: Xayrlashuv marosimi — biror kishining ish joyidan ketishi, boshqa joyga ko‘chib o‘tishi yoki uzoq safarga chiqishi munosabati bilan o‘tkaziladigan rasmiy yoki norasmiy bayram tadbiri.

ex: The family hired a Shabbat goyah to turn on lights during the Sabbath.
shabbat goyah.meta: Shabbat goya — yahudiylikda shanba kuni (Shabbat) muqaddas sanalib, qat’iy ortodoks yahudiylar ayrim jismoniy ishlarni (masalan, chiroq yoqish, o‘choqni yoqish, elektr asboblarni ishlatish) bajarmaydi

ex: He served as a shaliach tzibur during the Sabbath services.
The rabbi appointed a shaliach to deliver aid to the distant community.
shaliach.meta: Vakil yoki elchi — birov nomidan topshiriqni bajaradigan, ishni yuritadigan shaxs; bu ma’noda u oddiy diplomatik yoki diniy topshiriq bilan yuborilgan vakil sifatida tushuniladi.

ex: Their advertisement was so shticky that viewers couldn’t take it seriously.
The comedian’s routine felt too shticky to be genuinely funny.
shticky.meta: Shticky — asosan teatr, komediya, reklama yoki ommaviy axborot vositalarida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, u haddan tashqari hiyla-nayrang, samimiylikdan yiroq bo‘lgan sun’iy usullar orqali tomoshabinni o‘ziga jalb qilishga urinishni bildiradi.

ex: In traditional wrestling manuals, the side hug was a common setup for more complex holds.
The wrestler used a side hug to gain control before attempting a takedown.
side hug.meta: Yon quchoqlash — kurash sportida qo‘llaniladigan texnika bo‘lib, unda kurashchi raqibini yon tomondan quchoqlab, uni harakatsizlantirish yoki yiqitish maqsadida nazorat ostiga oladi.

ex: The Sinixt have a deep cultural connection to the Columbia River region.
She is a member of the Sinixt people.
sinixt.meta: Sinixt — Salish til oilasiga mansub tubjoy shimoliy amerikalik xalqlardan biri. Ular tarixan Britaniya Kolumbiyasining janubi-sharqiy hududlarida yashaganlar, ammo hozirda ko‘pchilik Sinixt xalqi AQShning Vashington shtatida istiqomat qiladi.

ex: During practice, the team played tag rugby to work on positioning.+
Tag rugby is a safe way for children to learn the basics of the sport.
tag rugby.meta: Tag regbi — klassik regbi o‘yinining kontaktlarsiz (to‘qnashuvsiz) varianti bo‘lib, bunda o‘yinchilar beliga yoki soniga maxsus tasmalar (taglar) bog‘lab o‘ynaydi.

ex: They tea-bag premium black tea using biodegradable sachets.
The factory tea-bags various herbal blends for export.
tea-bag.meta: Tea-bag — bu fe’l ma’lum bir miqdordagi quritilgan choy barglari yoki o‘simlik aralashmalarini kichik, havo o‘tkazuvchi (ko‘pincha filtr qog‘ozidan yasalgan) xaltachalarga solish orqali choy paketchalarini yasash jarayonini bildiradi.

ex: They are one of the largest teabaggers in the region
The factory invested in a new high-speed teabagger to increase production.
teabagger.meta: Texnika (mashina): quritilgan choy yoki giyohlarni kichik teshikchali filtrli xaltachalarga avtomatik tarzda joylashtiradigan, ularni yopishtirib va qadoqlaydigan mashina.

ex: Modern teabagging processes ensure consistent weight and quality.
The company invested in automated teabagging equipment to increase efficiency.
teabagging.meta: Teabagging — choy (yoki giyoh) aralashmalarini mayda, havo o‘tkazuvchi xaltachalarga (choyxaltachalarga) solish, ularni yopishtirish, ip va yorliq bilan ta’minlash va qadoqlashdan iborat sanoat jarayonidir

ex: The market is full of tokunbo electronics and household items.
He drives a tokunbo Toyota Camry from Germany.
tokunbo.meta: Tokunbo — Nigeriya va ayrim G‘arbiy Afrika davlatlarida keng ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, u chet eldan import qilingan ishlatilgan mahsulot, ayniqsa avtomobilni bildiradi.

ex: That free kick was perfect — straight into the top bin.
He smashed the ball right into the top bin!
top bin.meta: Top bin — futbol terminologiyasida darvozaning yuqori chap yoki o‘ng burchagini bildiradi. Bu atama ko‘pincha to‘pni aniqlik bilan darvozaning yuqori burchagiga yo‘llab gol urilgan holatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi

ex: In traditional weddings, the role of unterfirer is often given to respected family members.
The rabbi and the unterfirer walked the bride to the chuppah with blessings and songs.
unterfirer.meta: Unterfirer — yahudiylarning an’anaviy to‘y marosimida ishtirok etuvchi shaxs bo‘lib, u kelin yoki kuyovni chuppah (nikoh chodiri) ostiga olib borish vazifasini bajaradi.

ex: Don’t listen to him, he’s just a wankstain.
There was a wankstain on his bedsheet.
wankstain.meta: Wankstain — ingliz tilida qo‘pol va haqoratli og‘zaki atama bo‘lib, asosan jinsiy aloqadan yoki onanizmdan keyin qoladigan sperma dog‘ini bildiradi.

ex: She prepared a traditional stew using lamb and fresh waterblommetjies.
Waterblommetjies are harvested during the rainy season in the Western Cape.
waterblommetjie.meta: Waterblommetjie — bu Janubiy Afrikada o‘sadigan suv o‘simligi bo‘lib, u Aponogeton distachyos nomi bilan ilmiy jihatdan tanilgan.

ex: Their performance last night was total weak sauce.
That excuse was weak sauce — try harder next time.
weak sauce.meta: Weak sauce — norasmiy inglizcha ibora bo‘lib, biror narsa yoki kishining kuchi, mazmuni, ahamiyati yoki ishonchliligi yo‘qligini bildiradi. Odatda tanqid qilish, masxara qilish yoki kamsitish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: They would wiele under the moon to seek answers from the spirits.
The priestess wieleth a charm to protect the village.
wiele.meta: Wiele — qadimiy yoki poetik tildagi fe’l bo‘lib, sehr-jodu yoki fol ochish amallarini bajarishni anglatadi. Bu so‘z tantiya (divination), afsun, marosim, yoki boshqa g‘ayritabiiy amallarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: His son became a yeshiva bochur in Jerusalem.
The yeshiva bochur studied the Talmud late into the night.
yeshiva bochur.meta: Yeshiva bochur — bu yahudiy diniy ta’lim tizimi bo‘lgan yeshivada (ya’ni Talmud va rabbinik yozuvlar o‘rganiladigan diniy maktabda) ta’lim olayotgan yigit yoki yosh erkak talaba.

ex: The fans chanted ‘Yiddo!’ in support of their team.
He’s a proud Yiddo and never misses a Spurs match.
yiddo.meta: Yiddo — bu so‘z ingliz tilida birinchi navbatda yahudiy inson degan ma’noda ishlatiladi. Biroq, ayniqsa Angliyada, Tottenham Hotspur futbol klubining yahudiy jamoasiga aloqasi sababli, bu so‘z shu klub tarafdorlariga nisbatan laqab sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The fever awede in the town for weeks, taking many lives.
The storm awede through the valley all night.
awede.meta: Awede — bu so‘z, 2-ma’nosida, biror tabiiy kuch (masalan, bo‘ron, shamol), kasallik yoki boshqa faol kuchli agent haqida aytiladi va ularning kutilmagan darajada shiddat bilan avj olishi yoki o‘zini ko‘rsatishini bildiradi.

ex: The leader awelded the crowd with a powerful speech.
She awelded him to support the proposal despite his doubts.
aweld.meta: Bu fe’l biror shaxsga ruhiy, hissiy yoki mantiqiy yo‘l bilan ta’sir o‘tkazib, uning qarorlarini yoki harakatlarini o‘zgartirish, fikrini o‘zgartirish, yoki o‘z xohishiga ko‘ndirish ma’nolarini anglatadi.

ex: His performance was competent but aweless.
Despite the hype, the movie was aweless and forgettable.
aweless.meta: Aweless so‘zi bu ma’noda hech qanday hayrat uyg‘otmaydigan, odamlarda taassurot qoldirmaydigan, oddiy yoki loqayd tuyulgan narsa yoki odamni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Extra precautions were taken to awend any accidents.
She wore a charm to awend evil spirits.
awend.meta: Awend fe’li bu ma’noda biror salbiy, zararli yoki yoqimsiz hodisa yoki narsaning yuz berishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaslik, uni chetlab o‘tishga yoki zararsizlantirishga qaratilgan harakatni bildiradi.

ex: Her awesomeness in solving tough problems always amazes me.
I can't get over the sheer awesomeness of that concert!
awesomeness.meta: Awesomeness — bu og‘zaki (suhbatdagi) uslubda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, biror narsaning nihoyatda yaxshi, zavqli, qoyilmaqom bo‘lish holatini bildiradi.

ex: The cattle were driven a-west before the storm.
He dwells a-west the loch.
a-west.meta: A-west — bu so‘z Shotland shevasida ishlatilgan eskirgan predlog yoki ravish bo‘lib, biror narsaning yoki harakatning g‘arbda joylashganini, g‘arbga qarab yo‘nalganini yoki g‘arb tomonga harakatlanayotganini bildiradi.

ex: I need to visit the barbing salon before the wedding.
He opened a new barbing salon in the city center.
barbing salon.meta: Barbing salon — bu so‘z asosan Afrika inglizchasi (ayniqsa Nigeriya va Gana kabi davlatlarda)da ishlatiladi va "barber's shop" (sartaroshxona)ning muqobil ifodasidir.

ex: Great leaders are often bridge-builders, bringing together diverse voices.
As a mediator, she acted as a bridge-builder between the two communities
bridge-builder.meta: Bridge-builder — bu odamlar, guruhlar, madaniyatlar yoki xalqlar o‘rtasidagi kelishmovchiliklarni yumshatish, munosabatlarni yaxshilash, yoki samarali muloqot o‘rnatish uchun harakat qiladigan shaxsdir.

ex: Her sharp-bridged nose matched her angular features.
He had a high-bridged nose that gave him a regal appearance.
bridged.meta: “Bridged” sifati burunning yuqori qismidagi ko‘prik (ya’ni burun suyagining o‘rtadagi qismi)ning qanday shaklga ega ekanligini bildiradi. Bu so‘z baland, tekis, chuqur, yoki aniq chiqib turgan burun shakllarini ta’riflashda ishlatiladi.

ex: They marched to the bridgeward before the battle.
The knight rode to the bridgeward at dawn.
bridgeward.meta: Bridgeward — bu yo‘nalishni bildiruvchi so‘z bo‘lib, ko‘prik tomon harakatlanish yoki qarash ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Faqat “to the bridgeward” iborasida ishlatilgan, va hozirda eskirgan (arxaik) hisoblanadi.

ex: Bridging cultural differences is essential in a multicultural workplace.
The new program is aimed at bridging the digital divide between rural and urban communities.
bridging.meta: Bridging — bu ikki tomon orasidagi kelishmovchilik, farq, ijtimoiy, madaniy yoki boshqa to‘siqlarni bartaraf etish harakatini bildiradi.

ex: The brightened classroom atmosphere made learning more enjoyable.+
She had a brightened expression after hearing the good news.
brightened.meta: Brightened — bu sifat avvalgidan ko‘ra yorqinroq yoki yaxshiroq bo‘lgan holatni bildiradi. Ko‘proq ko‘chma ma’noda ishlatiladi:

ex: Astronomers analyze bright lines to determine the chemical composition of celestial bodies.
The bright line in the star’s spectrum indicates the presence of hydrogen.
bright line.meta: Bright line — bu fizika va astronomiyada elektromagnit nurlar spektrida ma’lum manbadan kelayotgan nurlanishning nisbatan yorqin chizig‘i.

ex: Cab-forward cars offer better visibility for the driver.
The truck has a cab-forward design to maximize cargo space.
cab-forward.meta: Cab-forward — transport vositasining haydovchi va yo‘lovchilar joylashgan bo‘limi oldinga surilgan yoki old qismga yaqinlashtirilgan dizayn shakli. Bu ko‘proq yuk mashinalari va ba’zi avtomobillarda uchraydi.

ex: The cab rank principle ensures that everyone has access to legal representation.
Under the cab rank rule, barristers must accept cases in their area of expertise.
cab rank.meta: Cab rank — bu Ingliz qonunlarida advokatlar uchun belgilangan qoidadir. Unda advokat o‘z sohasida ishlashni istagan mijozni, shartlar ma’lum va adolatli bo‘lsa, rad eta olmaydi. Ya’ni, u mijozning ishini bajarishga majbur.

ex: Cabriole legs give furniture a graceful and curved appearance.
The antique chair had elegant cabriole legs.
cabriole.meta: Cabriole — mebel va me’morchilikda ishlatiladigan oyoq turi. Kabriyol oyog‘i egri, silliq va bezakli shaklda bo‘lib, ko‘pincha zamonaviy va klassik stullar, stollar va boshqa mebellarda uchraydi.

ex: Chaghatai soldiers played a crucial role in the expansion of the Mongol Empire.
The Chaghatai were known for their military skills and governance in Central Asia.
chaghatai.meta: tarixiy atama bo‘lib, Chaghatai xonligi (1183–1242) doirasidagi boshqaruvchi, harbiy yoki oddiy odamlarni bildiradi. Bu xonlik Chingizxonning ikkinchi o‘g‘li tomonidan tashkil etilgan.

ex: The Chicago style hot dog is famous for its unique combination of ingredients.
I ordered a Chicago hot dog with all the classic toppings.
chicago.meta: Chicago — Qo‘y yoki mol go‘shtidan tayyorlangan, maxsus non ichida beriladigan, turli qo‘shimchalar (masalan, achchiq souslar, piyoz, bodring, pomidor, qora zaytun va boshqalar) bilan bezatilgan Amerika hot-dogining maxsus turi.

ex: Chicagoan jazz has influenced many musicians worldwide.
He is a true Chicagoan who loves his city deeply.
chicagoan.meta: Chicagoan — Chicago shahriga tegishli yoki bu shahar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan, shuningdek, Chicago shahrida tug‘ilgan yoki yashaydigan odam; shuningdek, Chicago jazz uslubiga xos bo‘lgan.

ex: He was known as a chickenhawk who targeted young boys.
The community was wary of the chickenhawk lurking around the park.
chickenhawk.meta: Chickenhawk — slangda, yosh bolalar yoki o‘smir yigitlarga, kamdan-kam holatda esa qizlar yoki yosh ayollarga jinsiy qiziqish bildiruvchi, odatda kattaroq yoshdagi erkak.

ex: Chicken meat is a popular source of protein worldwide.
She cooked the chicken meat with vegetables for dinner.
chicken meat.meta: Tovuq go‘shti — ovqat sifatida ishlatiladigan tovuq tanasining go‘shti.

ex: The doctor explained that chicken skin is caused by keratosis pilaris, a harmless skin condition.
Some people get chicken skin when they feel cold or scared.
chicken skin.meta: Tovuq terisi — inson terisida paydo bo‘ladigan, mayda, doimiy, go‘sht rangli yoki oqimtir papulalar bilan qoplangan va terisi so‘ngan tovuq terisiga o‘xshash ko‘rinishga ega bo‘lgan holat.

ex: Don’t underestimate the chickling; he’s learning fast.
The seasoned teacher was patient with the new chicklings in her class.
chickling.meta: Chickling — ma’nosi figurativ bo‘lib, yosh bola yoki tajribasiz, yosh shaxsni bildiradi.

ex: Coushatta traditions and culture remain important to the descendants living in Alabama
The Coushatta people originally lived in eastern Tennessee during the 16th century.
coushatta.meta: Kushatta — Shimoliy Amerikaning hindularidan bo‘lib, 16-asrda Tennessi sharqida yashagan, keyinchalik Alabama markazi va Florida Panhandle hududiga ko‘chib o‘tgan qabila vakili.

ex: Cousinry ties are important in many cultures for inheritance and social relations.
The cousinry between the two families has always been strong.
cousinry.meta: Cousinry — aka-uka yoki opa-singil farzandlari o‘rtasidagi qarindoshlik holati yoki ular orasidagi munosabat. Kam uchraydigan atama.

ex: Czechian traditions are still preserved in the rural parts of the country.
He is a proud Czechian who speaks the Czech language fluently.
czechian.meta: Chex — Chexiya Respublikasiga oid bo‘lgan yoki tarixiy "Chex yerlariga" taalluqli odam, til yoki madaniyatni anglatuvchi atama.

ex: In a dextral fault, the block across the fault moves to the right from the observer’s point of view.
The San Andreas Fault has both dextral and sinistral segments.
dextral.meta: Dextral — geologiyada: siljishli (suriluvchi) yoriq turi bo‘lib, kuzatuvchiga nisbatan qarama-qarshi tomondagi qatlam (blok) o‘ng tomonga siljigan holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Dextral faults are common in areas of lateral tectonic stress.
The San Andreas Fault exhibits dextral movement.
dextral.meta: Dextral — geologiyada bu atama tektonik yoriqlarni tavsiflash uchun ishlatiladi. Agar kuzatuvchi yoriqqa tik qarab turganida, qarama-qarshi tomonda joylashgan yer qatlami o‘ngga siljigan bo‘lsa, bu dextral yoriq deyiladi.

ex: The deep sound of the drone pipe echoed through the forest.
He learned to play the drone pipe while traveling in Australia.
drone pipe.meta: Drone pipe — bu didjeridu (yoki didgeridoo) nomli qadimiy shamol cholg‘usi bo‘lib, Avstraliya aborigenlariga tegishli. U uzun yog‘och quvur shaklida bo‘lib, chuqur va uzluksiz, g‘o‘ng‘iroq tovush chiqaradi.

ex: Targeted droning has become a controversial aspect of modern warfare.
The village was destroyed in a droning operation last night.
droning.meta: Droning — harbiy kontekstda drondan foydalanib ma’lum bir nishonga zarba berish, shaxsni yo‘q qilish yoki kuzatuv, razvedka kabi maqsadlar uchun uchirilishi jarayonidir. Bu atama odatda harbiy operatsiyalar doirasida qo‘llanadi.

ex: The dulcian is considered the predecessor of the modern bassoon.
The dulcian was commonly used in 16th-century church music.
dulcian.meta: Dulsian — Renessans davriga oid, ikki tilchali (ikkilik kamishli) nafasparda cholg‘u asbobi bo‘lib, u zamonaviy fagotning ilk shakllaridan biri hisoblanadi.

ex: He used his gelt to play dreidel with his cousins.
The children were excited to receive chocolate gelt during Hanukkah.
gelt.meta: Gelt — bu Xanuka yahudiy bayramida bolalarga sovg‘a qilinadigan pul yoki shokoladdan yasalgan tanga ko‘rinishidagi shirinlik. Bu tangalar "dreydl" nomli an’anaviy stol o‘yinida tikish uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: We used gelt as tokens while playing dreidel.
The children received chocolate gelt during Hanukkah celebrations.
gelt.meta: Gelt — bu yahudiylarning Hanuka bayrami davomida bolalarga beriladigan pul yoki hozirgi kunda ko‘proq shokolad tangalarga o‘xshatib tayyorlangan shirinliklar. Bu shirin tangalar “dreydl” nomli an’anaviy o‘yinda garov sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: If they catch him, he’s going for a long time.
He went for five years after the robbery.
go (to prison).meta: og‘zaki tilda, ayniqsa kundalik ingliz tilida, bu ibora biror shaxs jinoyat sodir etgani uchun hibsga olinib, qamoqxonaga yuborilganini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha "go to jail" yoki "go inside" shaklida ishlatiladi.

ex: Some herbalists still use black horehound, a type of henbit, for traditional remedies.
The meadow was full of purple henbit blooming in early spring.
henbit.meta: Henbit — asosan Lamium turkumiga mansub bo‘lgan, ko‘pincha mayda gulli, begona yoki yovvoyi o‘simliklarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: She laughed with a sharp hen-cackle that startled the room.
The morning was filled with hen-cackles from the coop.
hen-cackle.meta: Hen-cackle — bu so‘z tovuqning tuxum qo‘yganidan keyin yoki hayajonlangan vaqtda chiqaradigan xos qag‘illagan ovozini bildiradi. Ba’zan bu atama shu ovozni eslatadigan boshqa tovushlar uchun ham ishlatilgan.

ex: The henchboy followed orders without question, proving his loyalty.
The gang leader was always accompanied by his teenage henchboys.
henchboy.meta: Henchboy — bu atama kattalarga, ayniqsa, jinoyatkor rahbarlarga sodiq bo‘lgan yosh yigit yoki bolani bildiradi. U ko‘pincha o‘z rahbari uchun jinoyat yoki zo‘ravonlik qilishga tayyor bo‘ladi.

ex: The cheap hostel felt more like a hen coop than a place to rest.
We were crammed into a hen coop of a room with barely enough space to move.
hen coop.meta: Hen coop so‘zining bu ma’nosi majoziy bo‘lib, tovuqxonaga o‘xshatilgan joyni anglatadi — ya’ni juda tor, noqulay, odamga yoqmaydigan yoki shovqinli joy.

ex: In the tales of old, the kings were hend and just.
The hend warrior rode forth with honor in his eyes and steel in his hand.
hend.meta: Hend — qadimgi yoki she’riy tilda ishlatiladigan sifat (ba’zan ot), u riddorga xos fazilatlarni bildiradi: olijanoblik, jasurlik, qudrat, sadoqat va xushmuomalalik.

ex: His sudden hendness startled me, for I had not heard him approach.
The hendness of the village to the river made it an ideal place for fishing.
hendness.meta: Hendness — bu eski (arxaik) so‘z bo‘lib, yaqinlik yoki yaqin joylashuvni anglatadi. Biror narsa yoki odamning boshqa narsaga nisbatan yaqin joyda joylashuvi, ya’ni masofa jihatdan yaqin bo‘lish holatini bildiradi.

ex: Histologists identified the fenestrated layer of Henle in the retina.
The loop of Henle is crucial for concentrating urine in the kidney.
henle.meta: Henle — bu atama nemis anatomi F.G.J. Henle tomonidan tasvirlangan va uning nomi bilan atalgan tanadagi tuzilmalarni bildiradi.

ex: His henlike behavior made everyone laugh during the play.
She clucked around the kitchen in a henlike way, fussing over every little detail.
henlike.meta: Henlike — sifat yoki ravish sifatida ishlatiladi, va bu tovuqning odatlari yoki harakatlariga o‘xshash tarzda degan ma'noni anglatadi.

ex: A henotheist may worship one god without denying the existence of others.
The ancient Vedic religion is sometimes described as henotheist.
henotheist.meta: Henoteist — bir asosiy xudoga sig‘inishni tan olgan, ammo boshqa xudolarning mavjudligini inkor qilmaydigan diniy e’tiqodga ega shaxs. Henoteistik esa bu e’tiqodga oid yoki u bilan bog‘liq degani.

ex: During the investiture controversy, Henrician nobles stood firmly with the king.
The Henrician bishops supported the emperor in defiance of papal authority.
henrician.meta: Henrixchi — Germaniya imperatori Henrix IV bilan bog‘liq yoki unga oid bo‘lgan shaxs, ayniqsa u bilan Papa Gregoriy VII o‘rtasidagi ziddiyatda Henrix IV tarafdori bo‘lgan kishi.

ex: Henricianism rejected the authority of priests and emphasized lay preaching.
The Church condemned Henricianism as heresy in the 12th century.
henricianism.meta: Henrixizm — 12-asrning birinchi yarmida janubiy Fransiyada faoliyat yuritgan sayyor va ruhoniylarga qarshi chiqqan voiz Lausannalik Henrixning diniy ta’limotlari va qarashlari.

ex: Old farmers say hen scratches mean rain is coming.
The sky was full of hen scratches, and the wind began to rise.
hen scratch.meta: Tovuq tirnalmasi bulutlar — bu osmonning yuqori qatlamida paydo bo‘ladigan ingichka, chiziq yoki ipga o‘xshash sirus bulutlari bo‘lib, odatda bo‘ronli yoki yomg‘irli ob-havoning yaqinlashayotganidan darak beradi.

ex: The miners left after a hen-scratched attempt at finding gold.
The field was just hen-scratched, not properly ploughed.
hen-scratched.meta: Yuzaki kovlangan (yer) — yerga shunchaki ko‘zbo‘yamachilik bilan ishlov berilgan holat; masalan, haydalgan, qazilgan yoki izlangan bo‘lsa-da, bu ish chuqur va puxta bajarilmagan.

ex: Grandma always made hen’s milk during the holidays — sweet, rich, and comforting.
At the winter feast, they served warm hen’s milk with nutmeg and brandy.
hen’s milk.meta: Tuxumli sutli ichimlik — tuxum yoki tuxum sarig‘i sut yoki suvga aralashtirib tayyorlanadigan, ko‘pincha shakar bilan shirinlashtirilgan va rom yoki brendi kabi spirtli ichimliklar bilan lazzat berilgan issiq yoki sovuq ichimlik.

ex: The homophilic nature of the hiring process can unintentionally reinforce inequality.
Social networks often display homophilic patterns, where users mostly interact with those who share their views.
homophilic.meta: Homofilik — kishilarning o‘zlariga o‘xshash bo‘lgan boshqa shaxslarga nisbatan ko‘proq jalb qilinishi yoki ular bilan muloqot qilishga intilishi holatini ifodalovchi sifat

ex: The antique jewel box had compartments for rings, necklaces, and brooches.
She opened her jewel box and chose a pair of pearl earrings.
jewel box.meta: Zirak qutisi — odatda bezakli, turli bo‘limlarga ega bo‘lgan quti bo‘lib, unda taqinchoqlar yoki javohirlar saqlanadi. Bu qutilar ko‘pincha estetik ko‘rinishga ega bo‘ladi va har xil zargarlik buyumlarini tartibli saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: A jewelled sunset lit up the horizon with hues of gold and crimson.
The jewelled words of the poet captivated the audience.
jewelled.meta: Javohirdek — badiiy yoki ko‘chma ma’noda ishlatiladi; chiroyli, jozibador, yorqin yoki qimmatli narsani ifodalaydi. Ba’zan faqat tashqi ko‘rinishigagina qarab baholanadi, ya’ni u faqat yuzaki go‘zallikka ega bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The antique box featured exquisite jewelling on its lid.
The crown was adorned with fine jewelling of rubies and sapphires.
jewelling.meta: Jewelling — qimmatbaho toshlar bilan bezatilgan har qanday bezak yoki bezak turi; zargar tomonidan tayyorlangan bezaklar ishlovi. Hozirda kam qo‘llanadi.

ex: She worked as a jewel setter in a luxury watch company.
The jewel setter carefully placed the diamond into the ring.
jewel setter.meta: Jewel setter — taqinchoqlar, soat mexanizmlari va boshqa buyumlarda qimmatbaho toshlarni joyiga o‘rnatadigan mutaxassis; zargarlik bilan shug‘ullanadigan kishi.

ex: She may not speak much, but her kokum is evident in every decision she makes.
The elder’s kokum helped settle many disputes in the village.
kokum.meta: Kokum — insonning oqilona fikrlashi, to‘g‘ri qaror chiqarish qobiliyati, teran tafakkur va yaxshi mulohaza yurita olish xususiyati. Bu so‘z tarixan yaxshi aql va mulohazani ifodalagan, hozirda esa kamdan-kam uchraydi.

ex: Although she’s often dismissed as a kugel, she actually runs a successful business.
She's turned into a real kugel since she moved to Johannesburg.
kugel.meta: Janubiy Afrikada odatda boy oilalardan chiqqan, o‘zining tashqi ko‘rinishi, kiyim-kechaklari va moddiy jihatlarni haddan tashqari muhim deb biladigan, ko‘pincha yuzaki fikrlovchi yosh ayollarni (ayniqsa yahudiy ayollarni) atashda ishlatiladi.

ex: "My daughter got into Harvard,” he kvelled proudly to his friends.
“Just look at him!” she kvelled.
kvell.meta: Kvell – kimningdir yutug‘i, muvofaqqiyati yoki yaxshi xulqi ustidan faxrlanib yoki qoyil qolib, hayajonlangan holda so‘z aytish; quvonchli va g‘ururli ohangda gapirish.

ex: Meristic development allows ferns to grow and differentiate sexual organs from a single tissue region.
The meristic gametophyte of this fern can develop both male and female sex organs.
meristic.meta: Meristik — botanikada, ayniqsa, paporotniklar gametofiti haqida qo‘llanadi. Bu so‘z meristema (ya’ni o‘suv to‘qimasi)ga ega bo‘lgan va oogoniya hamda anteridiya (erkak jinsiy hujayralar)ni hosil qila oladigan gametofitni bildiradi.

ex: They say a schlimazel spills the soup, while a schlemiel is the one who gets it spilled on him.
He’s such a schlimazel — every time he starts something new, disaster follows.
schlimazel.meta: odatda kutilmagan va doimiy ravishda yomon hodisalar sodir bo‘ladigan holatni yoki insonni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z Yiddish tilidan kirgan bo‘lib, "har doim baxtsiz hodisaga uchraydigan odam" yoki "ketma-ket omadsizlik" degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: Many Semites contributed to the development of early writing systems.
He is a Semite, descended from an ancient Middle Eastern people.
semite.meta: Semit — bu atama qadimiy Sem (Shom) xalqlariga mansub yoki ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan insonlar va madaniyatlar uchun ishlatiladi. Semit xalqlariga yahudiylar, arablar, arameylar va ba’zi boshqa Yaqin Sharq xalqlari kiradi.

ex: The law was sinisterly interpreted to suit their own ends.
He judged the matter sinisterly, lacking full understanding.
sinisterly.meta: Bu ma’noda sinisterly so‘zi tarixda xato, noto‘g‘ri yoki adashgan holda qilingan harakatni ifodalagan. Hozirgi zamonda bu ma’no eskirgan (obsolete) hisoblanadi va zamonaviy ingliz tilida deyarli uchramaydi.

ex: In this species, the shell spirals sinistrad instead of dextrad.
The organ curves sinistrad from the midline.
sinistrad.meta: Sinistrad — bu ilmiy (ayniqsa anatomiya, biologiya va geometrik kontekstlarda) ishlatiladigan adverb (ravish) yoki adjective (sifat) bo‘lib, biror narsa yoki harakatning chap tomonga yo‘nalganligini yoki harakatlanishini bildiradi.

ex: He had a sinistral way of influencing decisions without ever speaking openly.
The minister was accused of sinistral dealings behind closed doors.
sinistral.meta: Bu ma’noda sinistral so‘zi yashirin yoki nojo‘ya yo‘l bilan ish yurituvchi, ishni ochiq emas, ostidan qiladigan, ayyorona harakat qiladigan odam yoki narsa haqida ishlatilgan.

ex: In sinistrally displaced faults, the far side appears to shift left from the observer’s point of view.
The fault moved sinistrally during the tectonic event.
sinistrally.meta: Geologiyada sinistrally so‘zi tekislik bo‘ylab siljiydigan yoriqlarda harakat yo‘nalishini bildiradi. Agar kuzatuvchi yoriqning bir tomonida turgan bo‘lsa va qarama-qarshi tomon chapga siljigandek ko‘rinsa, bu holat sinistral siljish deb ataladi.

ex: He believed the comet was a sign of approaching sinistration.
The kingdom fell into ruin after a time of great sinistration.
sinistration.meta: Sinistration — bu so‘z tarixiy ingliz tilida ishlatilgan va ehtimol baxtsizlik, yomonlik, yoki falokatli holatni anglatgan. U lotincha “sinister” (ya’ni “chap”, lekin ko‘pincha "yovuz", "yomon alomat") so‘ziga asoslangan.

ex: Only a few snail species possess sinistrorse coiling.
A sinistrorse shell spirals to the left when viewed from the apex.
sinistrorse.meta: Sinistrorse — bu atama zoologiya va konxologiyada (qobiqshunoslikda) ishlatiladi. U spiral shakldagi mollyuska qobig‘i haqida bo‘lib, soat miliga teskari yo‘nalishda (chapga) burilgan shaklni bildiradi.

ex: A sinistrous interpretation of the event spread among the villagers.
He regarded their silence with a sinistrous suspicion.
sinistrous.meta: sifatdosh bo‘lib, fikr, qarash yoki nuqtai nazarning chuqur shubha, ishonchsizlik, yoki noxolislik bilan ajralib turishini bildirgan. Bu so‘z, ayniqsa, yomon niyat, bashoratli yomonlik, yoki g‘arazli fikrlar haqida so‘z borganda qo‘llanilgan.

ex: He smiled sinistrously before delivering the bad news.
The wind howled sinistrously through the ruins.
sinistrously.meta: Sinistrously — bu fe’l sifatdoshi bo‘lib, biror narsa yoki harakat vahima uyg‘otadigan, yomon narsa sodir bo‘lishi mumkinligini anglatadigan, yoki tahdid soluvchi tarzda amalga oshirilganini bildiradi.

ex: The farmer offered the swink of his field to the lord.
They gathered the swink of a long summer's toil.
swink.meta: Swink — qadimgi ingliz tilida ishlatilgan, hozirda eskirgan (obsolete) hisoblangan ot bo‘lib, kishining mehnatidan hosil bo‘lgan mahsulot, ya’ni unumi, natijasini bildirgan.

ex: Taxiing in the city has become a full-time profession for many.
He took up taxiing after losing his job at the factory.
taxiing.meta: Taksi haydash yoki taksichilik qilish faoliyati — ya’ni biror kishining kasb sifatida taksi haydashi yoki taksi xizmati bilan shug‘ullanishi.

ex: Wald though she knew the truth, she kept silent.
He’ll come back, wald though.
wald.meta: Wald so‘zi zamonaviy ingliz tilida ishlatilmaydigan, eskirgan yoki shevaga oid ibora bo‘lib, faqat "wald though" shaklida uchraydi. Bu ibora “balki”, “ehtimol”, “kim biladi” degan noaniq ehtimolni bildiradi.

ex: That kid just said "wiener" and everyone laughed.
He got hit right in the wiener!
wiener.meta: Wiener — bu Shimoliy Amerikada ishlatiladigan so‘zlashuv tilidagi ibora bo‘lib, erkak jinsiy a’zosini bildiradi.

ex: The Yekke community in Tel Aviv preserved many German traditions.
He’s a real Yekke — always on time and impeccably dressed.
yekke.meta: Yekke atamasi asosan Isroil yahudiylari orasida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, u bilan Germaniyadan kelgan yahudiylar yoki ularning urfi-odati, madaniyati yoki xulq-atvori nazarda tutiladi.

ex: Are the investors on board with the new business plan?
We need everyone on board if we're going to finish this project on time.
on board.meta: On board iborasi loyihada yoki g‘oyada ishtirok etishga tayyorlik, rozilik bildirganlik yoki uni qo‘llab-quvvatlash holatini anglatadi.

ex: He said he stays home on Fridays just to choke the chicken and watch movies.
I caught him trying to choke the chicken in the bathroom.
to choke the chicken.meta: To choke the chicken — ingliz tilidagi erkak kishining masturbatsiya qilayotganini kinoyali, hazilomuz va slang shaklida ifodalovchi qo‘pol ibora.

ex: The crew cab truck comfortably seats five people.
We bought a new pickup with a crew cab to carry the whole team.
crew cab.meta: Crew cab — bu yuk mashinasi yoki pikap mashinasining old qismi bo‘lib, unda ikki qatorda o‘rindiqlar, to‘rtta eshik, va odatdagidan ko‘proq oyoq joyi mavjud.

ex: Double cousins are genetically closer than ordinary first cousins.
My double cousin and I share all four grandparents.
double cousin.meta: Double cousin — bu amakivachchalarning bir turi bo‘lib, ikkala ota-onangiz orqali ham qarindosh bo‘lgan odamdir

ex: By analyzing the emission lines, scientists can determine what stars are made of.
Hydrogen has a well-known red emission line called H-alpha.
emission line.meta: Emissiya chizig‘i — bu elektromagnit nurlanish spektrida ko‘rinadigan yorqin chiziq bo‘lib, u ma’lum bir modda yoki manbadan aniq to‘lqin uzunligida chiqadigan nurlanish natijasida hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: The race was flagged off despite the heavy rain.
The mayor flagged off the marathon at exactly 8 a.m.
to flag off.meta: Flag off — bu odatda motor sporti yoki yugurish musobaqasi kabi musobaqalarda bayroqni hilpiratish orqali ishtirokchilarga start berish yoki poyga boshlanishini bildiruvchi ishora qilishni anglatadi.

ex: Fried rice is a quick and easy dish made with leftover rice.
I ordered chicken fried rice at the Chinese restaurant.
fried rice.meta: Qovurilgan guruch — bu avval bug‘da yoki qaynatib pishirilgan, so‘ngra panga solib ozgina yog‘da qovurilgan guruch taomi bo‘lib, odatda tuxum, go‘sht, sabzavot kabi qo‘shimchalar bilan birga tayyorlanadi.

ex: Unlike snakes, glass lizards cannot unhinge their jaws.
The glass lizard looks like a snake but has movable eyelids and ear openings.
glass lizard.meta: Anguinae kichik oilasiga mansub, Anguidae oilasiga kiruvchi uzun tanali, ilon shaklidagi, odatda oyoqlarisiz yoki juda kichik oyoqli kaltakesak turlaridir. Tashqi ko‘rinishi ilonni eslatadi, lekin ular kaltakesaklar oilasiga kiradi va haqiqiy ilon emas.

ex: Some jelly fungi are edible when cooked, like the wood ear mushroom.
The jelly fungus on the log looked like orange jelly.
jelly fungus.meta: Jel zamburug‘i — tashqi ko‘rinishi va tuzilishi jihatidan shilimshiq yoki jelga o‘xshagan zamburug‘lar guruhidir. Ayrim hollarda bu Gymnosporangium sabinae kabi zang zamburug‘lari bo‘lib, ular nam sharoitda jelga o‘xshash tuzilishga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: The new manager changed the line of report to streamline communication.
All employees must follow the official line of report when raising concerns.
line of report.meta: Hisobot yo‘nalishi — bu tashkilot yoki korxona ichidagi aloqa va boshqaruv tizimi bo‘lib, unda bir shaxs yoki bo‘lim boshqa bir yuqori lavozimli shaxsga muntazam ravishda hisobot beradi. Bu tizim tartibli boshqaruv va javobgarlikni ta’minlash uchun zarur.

ex: Marketers often exploit the lizard brain by triggering fear or desire.
When you're scared and lash out without thinking, that’s your lizard brain in control.
lizard brain.meta: “Ibtidoiy miya” — bu inson miyasi tarkibidagi eng qadimgi qism bo‘lib, u instinktiv, ongli emas, hayotiy ehtiyojlarga asoslangan harakatlarni boshqaradi. Ushbu atama odatda miya ustuni yoki limbik tizim kabi strukturalarni nazarda tutadi.

ex: This speaker cab can hold two large loudspeakers for better sound quality.
The band loaded the speaker cab into the truck before the concert.
speaker cab.meta: Speaker kabinasi — ichida bitta yoki bir nechta karnay (loudspeaker) joylashgan, mustahkam quti shaklidagi o‘ram. U tovushni yanada aniq va kuchli chiqarish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Please don’t disturb me; I have a lot of WIP to finish.
The project is still WIP and will be completed next month.
wip.meta: WIP (work in progress) — hozirda davom etayotgan, hali yakunlanmagan ish yoki loyiha. Bu atama ish jarayonidagi ishni ifodalaydi.

ex: The dish was cooked à la Chinoise, with soy sauce and ginger.
She decorated the room à la Chinoise.
à la chinoise.meta: uslub, usul, ko‘rinish va boshqalarga nisbatan: xitoy uslubida, xitoycha tarzda bajarilgan yoki ko‘rinadigan. Shuningdek, ko‘pincha oshpazlikda xitoy taomlari uslubida tayyorlangan narsalarni ifodalashda ishlatiladi.

ex: His allyship with marginalized communities has brought positive change.
Allyship is important in the fight for social justice.
allyship.meta: Allyship — ittifoqchi bo‘lish yoki ittifoqchiga ega bo‘lish holati yoki sharti. Asosan, chetga qilingan yoki kam himoyalangan guruhlarning huquq va qadr-qimmatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxslik holati.

ex: The organization works to fight against anti-black racism.
Anti-black attitudes have led to widespread discrimination.
anti-black.meta: Antiqora — qora tanlilarga nisbatan nohaqlik, qarshilik yoki kamsituvchi munosabatda bo‘lgan; bu turdagi irqchilikni ifoda etuvchi yoki uning belgisi bo‘lgan.

ex: The campaign aims to raise awareness about anti-blackness.
Anti-blackness has been a serious social issue worldwide.
anti-blackness.meta: Antiqoralik — qora tanlilarga nisbatan qarshilik, nafrat, yomon ko‘rish yoki kamsitish holati.

ex: The tassels on each corner of the arba kanfot have religious significance.
Jewish men wear the arba kanfot during prayer.
arba kanfot.meta: Arba kanfot — to‘rt burchakli kiyim bo‘lib, har bir to‘rt burchagida burilgan va tugmali ipdan yasalgan shoxcha bor, o‘rtasida esa boshdan o‘tishi uchun katta teshik mavjud; yahudiylar tomonidan ibodat paytida kiyiladi.

ex: Scientists study the archistriatum to understand evolutionary brain development.
The archistriatum is an important brain region in birds and reptiles.
archistriatum.meta: Boshida: sudralib yuruvchilar va qushlarning miyasi hududi bo‘lib, u korpus... (phylogenetika rivojlanishidagi o‘rta bosqichni ifodalovchi deb hisoblangan).

ex: His astraphobia made it difficult for him to stay outside during lightning storms.
Many children suffer from astraphobia during thunderstorms.
astraphobia.meta: Yomg‘ir va chaqmoq bilan birga keladigan bo‘ronlardan, ayniqsa chaqmoqdan qo‘rqish hissi.

ex: She is a Bermudian English speaker, born and raised on Bermuda Island.
Bermudian English has some unique expressions not found in standard British English.
bermudian english.meta: Bermuda orolida tug‘ilgan yoki yashaydigan, ingliz kelib chiqishiga ega bo‘lgan odamlar yoki Bermudalik va ingliz aralash kelib chiqishga ega bo‘lgan odamlar bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Social media can sometimes body-shame people, which affects their self-esteem.
It is wrong to body-shame someone because of their weight.
body-shame.meta: Biror kishining tana shakli, o‘lchami yoki tashqi ko‘rinishidagi taxmin qilingan kamchiliklar yoki nuqsonlar asosida kulgu qilish, kamsitish yoki ularni jamiyatda yomon ko‘rsatish.

ex: Nobody should be a body-shamer because everyone deserves respect.
A body-shamer often makes hurtful comments about others' appearances.
body-shamer.meta: Kimningdir tana shakli, o‘lchami yoki tashqi ko‘rinishidagi taxmin qilingan kamchiliklar yoki nuqsonlar asosida kulgu qiluvchi, kamsituvchi yoki jamiyatda yomon ko‘rsatadigan odam.

ex: The car’s design lacks smooth curves and has a certain boxiness.
The boxiness of the building made it look less elegant.
boxiness.meta: Qutilik — quti shaklida bo‘lish sifat yoki holati; quti (to‘rtburchak, burchakli) shakliga o‘xshashlik.

ex: Box kicks are often used to relieve pressure in rugby.
The scrum half performed a perfect box kick to gain territory.
box kick.meta: Box zarbasi — odatda skram yarim himoyachisi tomonidan amalga oshiriladigan, to‘pni baland ko‘tarib, oldinga uzoq masofaga emas, balki qisqa masofaga tashlash uchun mo‘ljallangan zarba turi.

ex: Box kicking is an essential skill for a scrum half in rugby.
His box kicking has improved a lot this season.
box kicking.meta: Box zarbasini berish — box zarbasini amalga oshirish harakati; box zarbalarini berish amaliyoti yoki mahorati.

ex: Boxla is faster-paced than field lacrosse because of the smaller playing area.
He plays boxla every weekend with his friends.
boxla.meta: Box lakros — yopiq maydonda (ko‘pincha zalda) o‘ynaladigan lakros sport turi. Bu lakrosning maxsus shakli bo‘lib, o‘yin maydoni kichikroq va devorlar bilan o‘ralgan bo‘ladi.

ex: After several tough box-offs, the best boxer was finally chosen for the competition.
The box-off matches will determine who advances to the final championship bout.
box-off.meta: Chempionat oldi janglari yoki saralash janglari — chempionlik yoki musobaqani hal qilish uchun o‘tkaziladigan ketma-ket boks jangi seriyasi; shuningdek, kim musobaqada qatnashishini aniqlash uchun o‘tkaziladigan dastlabki janglar ketma-ketligi.

ex: Good boxouts are essential to winning the basketball game.
The player made a perfect boxout to secure the rebound.
boxout.meta: Basketbolda — to‘p otilgandan keyin, raqib va savatcha orasiga o‘zingizni joylashtirib, raqibingizning to‘pga ega bo‘lishini oldini olish va o‘z jamoangizga to‘pni olish imkoniyatini oshirish harakati.

ex: The coach prefers a box-to-box style of play for his midfielders.
He is a true box-to-box midfielder who helps both defense and attack.
box-to-box.meta: Futbolda — o‘yin maydonining bir uchidan (o‘z jamoasining himoyasidan) ikkinchi uchiga (hujumga) tez va faol harakat qiladigan o‘yinchi uslubi. Bunday o‘yinchi hujum va himoyada faol ishtirok etadi.

ex: Boxwork structures form when minerals fill cracks in limestone.
The cave walls were covered with beautiful boxwork formations.
boxwork.meta: Geologiya sohasida — ohaktosh yoki boshqa toshlardagi yoriqlarga to‘planib, odatda kalsit minerali tomonidan hosil qilingan ingichka katak shaklidagi tuzilma.

ex: The technician fastened the cables together with several cable ties.
Use a cable tie to secure the wires neatly.
cable tie.meta: Ingichka, egiluvchan neylon tasma bo‘lib, uning bir uchi teshiklardan o‘tib, boshqa uchidagi qulflash mexanizmi orqali mahkamlanadigan bog‘ich. Asosan simlarni, kabellarni yoki boshqa narsalarni bir joyga yig‘ish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: At the party, guests enjoyed pouring champagne from the tiered champagne fountain.
The wedding had a beautiful champagne fountain that flowed all night.
champagne fountain.meta: Shampan ichimligini oqizadigan fontan. Keyinchalik, ko‘proq ziyofat va tadbirlarda ishlatiladigan ko‘p qavatli portativ shampan quyish fontani.

ex: After being out in the sun all day, she applied chapstick to soothe her dry lips.
I always carry chapstick in my bag during winter to keep my lips soft.
chapstick.meta: Lablarni quruqlik, yorig‘lik va og‘riqdan himoya qiluvchi yoki ularni tinchlantiruvchi malham. Odatda kichik tayoq yoki idishda bo‘ladi va lablarga surtiladi.

ex: She always carries a chapstick in her bag.
I use chapstick in winter to keep my lips from drying out.
chapstick.meta: Chapstick — aslida savdo belgisi (brand nomi) bo‘lib, lab terisini qurish, achishish yoki yorilishdan himoya qilish yoki davolash uchun surtiladigan, odatda stik (qalamcha) ko‘rinishidagi maxsus malhamni anglatadi.

ex: Chin-chin is popular in Nigerian households as a quick and tasty treat.
We enjoyed some chin-chin as a crunchy snack during the party.
chin-chin.meta: Nigeriya oshxonasiga oid kichik bo‘lak yoki tasmasimon shakldagi chuqur qovurilgan yoki ba’zan pishirilgan xamirdan tayyorlangan yengil tamaddi.

ex: While his invention was clever, it was really just a chindogu with no practical use.
The umbrella with holes is a classic example of a chindogu.
chindogu.meta: Amalda kam yoki umuman foydasi bo‘lmagan, yangilik va aql bovar qilmaydigan xususiyatlarga ega, odatda o‘yin-kulgi yoki hazil uchun yaratilgan ixtiro.

ex: The Chinese-American community in San Francisco is very vibrant.
She is a Chinese-American artist known for blending both cultures in her work.
chinese-american.meta: Xitoy va Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlari bilan bog‘liq yoki ularga tegishli bo‘lgan. Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlarida yashovchi yoki undan kelgan, lekin kelib chiqishi xitoylik bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: Chinese chequers is a strategic game that requires careful planning.
We played Chinese chequers all afternoon and had a lot of fun.
chinese chequers.meta: Ikki dan oltigacha o‘yinchi uchun mo‘ljallangan taxta o‘yini. O‘yinning maqsadi - yulduz shaklidagi taxtada bir burchakdan qarama-qarshi burchakka marmar yoki belgilarni harakatlantirishdir.

ex: During the prank, the group performed a Chinese fire drill around the car.
The meeting was a complete Chinese fire drill — nobody knew what to do.
chinese fire drill.meta: Tartibsizlik yoki chalkashlik holati, tartibsiz vaziyat. (Slang, ayrim hollarda haqorat sifatida qabul qilinadi) Avtomobildagi odamlar tezda tushib, avtomobil atrofida yugurib, yana o‘tirishi bilan bog‘liq hazil yoki o‘yin.

ex: Her dress had a Chinese-like pattern that reminded me of traditional silk designs.
The painting has a Chinese-like style with delicate brush strokes.
chinese-like.meta: Xitoyga yoki uning xalqiga, tiliga xos yoki eslatadigan; tabiati, ko‘rinishi va boshqa jihatlari bilan xitoycha.

ex: His Chineseness is evident in his language, customs, and values.
The artist’s work expresses a strong sense of Chineseness through traditional motifs.
chineseness.meta: Xitoyga xoslik, xitoylik bo‘lish holati yoki xitoycha xususiyatlarni namoyon etish.

ex: His style of painting is quite chinesey, with exaggerated features and colors.
The decorations looked a bit chinesey, not very authentic.
chinesey.meta: Ba’zan salbiy yoki kamaytirilgan ma’noda ishlatiladi. Xitoyga yoki xitoylikka xos yoki shunga o‘xshash, xitoy tabiatida yoki ko‘rinishida bo‘lgan.

ex: Wow, chingas, that was an amazing performance!
Chingas! I didn’t expect to see you here.
chingas.meta: Ajablanish, hayrat yoki boshqa kuchli his-tuyg‘ularni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. Odatda “voy!”, “ah!” kabi ifodalar o‘rnida ishlatiladi.

ex: Using the word "Chinky" to describe someone is disrespectful.
The term "Chinky" is considered offensive by many people.
chinky.meta: Bu so‘z odatda kamsituvchi, haqoratli ma’noda ishlatiladi va Xitoyliklarga yoki Xitoy madaniyatiga taalluqli bo‘lgan, ular bilan bog‘liq yoki ularni eslatadigan xususiyatlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: He chopsed his brother for breaking the vase.
The teacher chopsed the students for being late.
chopse.meta: Bu so‘z asosan Midlands va Uels hududlarida ishlatiladigan ingliz tiliga xos. Kimnidir yomon so‘z bilan atash, so‘z orqali haqorat qilish yoki g‘azab bilan baqirishni anglatadi.

ex: Stop the chopsing and focus on the work.
His constant chopsing made the meeting very unpleasant.
chopsing.meta: Chopsing — bu chopse fe’lining harakati bo‘lib, kimnidir tanqidiy yoki g‘azabli ravishda haqorat qilish yoki baqirishni bildiradi. Bundan tashqari, bu so‘z odamlar o‘rtasida shov-shuv qilish, gap-so‘z tarqatish yoki bo‘sh suhbatlashishni ham anglatadi.

ex: Good cinematics can greatly enhance the storytelling in a film.
The cinematics of this movie are breathtaking, especially the camera movements.
cinematics.meta: Kinematika — film yaratish san’ati yoki texnikasi, asosan kamera ishining san’ati. Bu atama kinoda ko‘rsatiladigan tasviriy elementlar va ularning tashkil etilishi bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Coercive control can be subtle, involving manipulation and intimidation rather than physical violence.
The victim suffered years of coercive control from their partner.
coercive control.meta: Majburiy nazorat — zo‘ravonlik, tahdid yoki jazo orqali biror shaxs yoki guruh ustidan amalga oshiriladigan kuch va hokimiyat. Bu tushuncha, shuningdek, kimnidir cheklash va ustunlik qilish uchun ishlatiladigan boshqaruv shaklini anglatadi.

ex: Many activists called to defund the police department.
The government decided to defund the project due to budget cuts.
defund.meta: Moliya ta’minotini to‘xtatmoq — biror tashkilot, korxona yoki muassasaga ajratilgan mablag‘ni to‘liq yoki qisman olib qo‘yish, moliyalashtirishni to‘xtatish.

ex: Defunding often results in reduced services and layoffs.
The defunding of the education program caused many problems.
defunding.meta: Moliya ta’minotini to‘xtatish — biror korxona, muassasa yoki loyiha uchun ajratilgan mablag‘larni to‘liq yoki qisman olib qo‘yish harakati yoki amaliyoti.

ex: He spoke in a deliriated manner, confused and restless.
The patient was deliriated after the high fever.
deliriated.meta: Deliriyga tushgan — ongining buzilishi, bezovtalik va g‘alati tushunchalar bilan ifodalanuvchi ruhiy holatda bo‘lgan; deliriy holatida.

ex: The term "ding" is often used in informal speech.
He joked about his ding in front of friends.
ding.meta: Ding — erkak jinsiy a’zosi (penis) ni ifodalovchi so‘z; odatda norasmiy va slang tarzda ishlatiladi.

ex: The dog wagged its ding happily.
He slipped and fell right on his ding.
ding.meta: Ding — insonning orqa, dum qismi; shuningdek, hayvonning dum qismi. Norasmiy va ko‘pincha hazilomuz ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The bike has a few dings from minor falls.
He got a ding on his arm after bumping into the door.
ding.meta: Ding — tanaga tushadigan katta bo‘lmagan jarohat yoki shikastlanish turi. Bu kichik shish, tirnalish yoki ozgina kesik bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: His dinged jacket needed a good wash.
The old walls were dinged and covered with soot.
dinged.meta: Dinged — chang, kir, tutun yoki boshqa iflosliklar ta’sirida rangsiz, xira yoki qorong‘u bo‘lib qolgan; so‘nib, xira ko‘rinishda.

ex: My laptop has a dinged corner from being dropped.
The car was dinged in the parking lot.
dinged.meta: Dinged — biror narsaga kichik zarar yetgan yoki zarba, urilish tufayli dog‘, tirnalish, teshik paydo bo‘lgan holat. Ko‘pincha buyumlar uchun ishlatiladi, ba’zida eskirgan, ta’mirsiz ko‘rinishni ham bildiradi.

ex: She forgot the dinger on the oven, and the cake got burnt.
The microwave’s dinger went off, signaling that the food was ready.
dinger.meta: Dinger — odatda signal yoki eslatma berish uchun ovoz chiqargan qurilma; masalan, mikroto‘lqinli pech yoki oddiy pechdagi taymer. Shuningdek, beysbolda kuchli zarba yoki uyga yugurish ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The dinger struck quickly and disappeared.
He was known as a dinger in the old days.
dinger.meta: Dinger — Shotlandiyada ishlatiladigan eski so‘z bo‘lib, boshqa odamga zarba beruvchi, uruvchi shaxsni anglatadi. Hozirda kam ishlatiladi va eskirgan.

ex: She dingolayed around the room, twisting her body with joy.
The children were dingolaying happily to the music at the party.
dingolay.meta: Dingolaymoq — o‘zini cheklamasdan, quvnoq va hayajonli tarzda raqs tushish; shuningdek, tanani burish yoki aylantirish harakati.

ex: We always dogfood our products to ensure they work well.
The company decided to dogfood their new software before launching it to customers.
dogfood.meta: Dogfood qilish — kompaniya yoki uning xodimlari tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan mahsulot yoki xizmatni ommaga chiqarishdan oldin sinov uchun o‘zlari ishlatish, shu orqali uning sifatini tekshirish va takomillashtirish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The company encourages dogfooding to improve software quality.
Dogfooding is an important step in product development.
dogfooding.meta: Dogfooding — kompaniya mahsuloti yoki xizmatini ishga tushirishdan oldin, kompaniya xodimlari tomonidan uni sinovdan o‘tkazish uchun ishlatilishi; mahsulotning sifatini va ishlashini tekshirish usuli.

ex: He saved the dox on his computer for later reference.
The police collected all the dox related to the case.
dox.meta: Doks — jismoniy yoki elektron shakldagi hujjatlar, ma’lumotlar to‘plami

ex: Many people are afraid of doxing on social media.
Doxing can lead to serious privacy violations.
doxing.meta: Doks qilish — odatda zararli maqsadda, internetda biror shaxsning shaxsiy yoki aniqlovchi ma’lumotlarini topib, ularni oshkor qilish jarayoni.

ex: People often raise their hands in dua during prayer.
She made a dua for her family’s health.
dua.meta: Dua — odatda shaxs tomonidan bajariladigan, maxfiy yoki shaxsiy ibodat, Allohga murojaat qilish yoki iltijo qilish. Bu ibodatlar diniy marosimdagi rasmiy ibodatlardan farq qiladi. Shuningdek, bir necha bunday ibodatlarning yig‘indisi ham dua deb ataladi.

ex: Many countries have endonyms that differ from their English names.
The endonym for Germany is “Deutschland.”
endonym.meta: Endonim — bu atama asosan biror joy, odamlar guruhi yoki til nomi bo‘lib, o‘sha joyda yoki o‘sha jamoa ichida ishlatiladigan ichki nom hisoblanadi. U tashqi yoki boshqa tillardagi nom — ekzonymdan farq qiladi.

ex: “Venice” is the English exonym for the Italian city known locally as “Venezia.”
The English exonym for Germany is “Germany,” while the endonym is “Deutschland.”
exonym.meta: Ekzonim — bu atama asosan biror joy, odamlar guruhi yoki til nomi bo‘lib, faqat o‘sha joy, xalq yoki til jamoasidan tashqarida, boshqalar tomonidan ishlatiladigan nom hisoblanadi. U endonimdan farq qiladi, chunki endonim ichki foydalanishda bo‘ladi.

ex: Fat-shaming can cause serious emotional damage to a person.
She felt hurt when people fat-shamed her because of her weight.
fat-shame.meta: bu atama ortiqcha vaznga ega yoki semizlikda deb hisoblangan kishini hazillashish, kamsitish yoki jamiyatda yomon ko‘rinishga solish ma’nosini anglatadi. Shuningdek, bu odamning tana hajmi yoki vazniga nisbatan tanqidiy yoki salbiy munosabatni bildiradi.

ex: Nobody wants to be around a fat-shamer because it hurts people’s feelings.
The fat-shamer made rude comments about her appearance.
fat-shamer.meta: Fat-shamer — bu semizlik yoki ortiqcha vazn sababli boshqalarni haqorat qiluvchi, masxara qiluvchi yoki ularga nisbatan salbiy munosabatda bo‘ladigan shaxsdir.

ex: Many campaigns now work to end fat shaming and promote body positivity.
Fat shaming can severely affect a person’s self-esteem.
fat shaming.meta: Fat shaming — bu odamni semizlik yoki ortiqcha vazn uchun tanqid qilish, haqoratlash, kamsitish yoki jamiyatda salbiy ko‘rinishga solish amali yoki odatidir.

ex: The freshies at the college are having their orientation this week.
As a freshie at university, he found it hard to adjust to the new environment.
freshie.meta: Freshie — universitet, kollej yoki litseyning birinchi kurs talabasi yoki maktabning yangi o‘quvchisi. Shu bilan birga, kengroq ma’noda yangi kelgan, yangi boshlovchi yoki tajribasiz kishini ifodalash uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The freshing up of the room made it look more welcoming.
After a long day, she went to the bathroom for a quick freshing up.
freshing up.meta: Freshing up — nimanidir yangi, toza yoki yangi holatga keltirish harakati yoki jarayoni.

ex: The company often targets fresh meat — young employees who are easy to manipulate.
He was proud to be the fresh meat in the group, the one who had never been with anyone before.
fresh meat.meta: Fresh meat — odatda jinsiy tajribasi kam yoki umuman yo‘q yangi sherikni ifodalaydi. Shuningdek, yangi, tajribasiz, oson aldash yoki boshqarish mumkin bo‘lgan kishiga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The orientation program is designed to help freshpeople adjust to college life.
Freshpeople often feel nervous during their first week at university.
freshpeople.meta: Freshpeople — universitet, kollej yoki maktabning birinchi kurs talabalarini bildiradi. Shuningdek, yangi kelganlar yoki tajribasiz boshlovchilar uchun kengroq ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: As a freshperson, he was eager to learn and make new friends.
She is a freshperson at the university this year.
freshperson.meta: Freshperson — universitet, kollej yoki maktabdagi birinchi kurs talabasini bildiradi. Shuningdek, yangi kelgan yoki tajribasiz boshlovchi shaxs ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Gentamicin is commonly used to treat serious bacterial infections.
The doctor prescribed gentamicin to combat the patient’s infection.
gentamicin.meta: Gentamitsin — tuproq yoki loyda yashovchi mikroorganizmlar (aktinomitsetlar) tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan bir nechta moddalarning aralashmasidan iborat aminoglikozid antibiotik.

ex: In old French literature, a gentilhomme was often a nobleman or a man of good birth.
The gentilhomme greeted everyone with great courtesy.
gentilhomme.meta: Asosan fransuz yoki fransuz tilida so‘zlashadigan mintaqalarda ishlatiladi; muloyim, odobli va xushmuomala erkak, "jantilmon" degan ma'noni anglatadi.

ex: Cultural gentilization can lead to significant changes in traditions and beliefs.
The gentilization of certain communities occurred over several generations.
gentilization.meta: Xususiyat yoki tabiati jihatdan gentilga (ya'ni, yahudiy bo'lmagan yoki boshqa din va madaniyatga mansub odamga) aylanish jarayoni.

ex: Gentilizing practices often led to blending of different cultural traditions.
The gentilizing of the village involved adopting many pagan rituals.
gentilizing.meta: Gentil (yahudiy bo‘lmagan yoki boshqa dinlarga mansub) yoki pag‘an (to‘qsonlik) urf-odatlari va amaliyotlariga moslashish yoki ularni qabul qilish harakati yoki amaliyoti.

ex: The chemical structure of gentiobiose helps in understanding the properties of crocin.
Gentiobiose is an important sugar component in certain medicinal plants.
gentiobiose.meta: Gentiobioza – gentianozaning qisman gidrolizidan hosil bo‘ladigan shakar turi bo‘lib, u ba’zi glikozidlarning, masalan, krotsin va amigdalinga tarkibiy qism hisoblanadi.

ex: In old literature, characters of gentle blood were often portrayed with great honor and dignity.
He proudly claimed to come from gentle blood, tracing his lineage back to medieval nobility.
gentle blood.meta: Yuqori ijtimoiy tabaqaga, nobel yoki yuqori sinf nasliga ega bo‘lish holati.Shuningdek, nozik yoki ulug‘vor naslga mansub kishilar, ya’ni yuqori tabaqadagi odamlar yoki qardoshlar jamlanmasi . Hozirda bu so‘z ko‘proq qadimiy, tarixiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The speaker acknowledged the gentlelady’s contributions to the committee.
The gentlelady from Texas spoke passionately during the debate.
gentlelady.meta: AQShda, ayniqsa Vakillar palatasi a’zosi bo‘lgan ayolni murojaat qilish yoki uning haqida gapirish uchun ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, eski va odobli ayol uchun hurmat bilan ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: The gentlemen’s club had an elegant dining room and a well-stocked library.
He was a member of a prestigious gentlemen’s club in London.
gentlemen’s club.meta: Erkaklar uchun maxsus ijtimoiy klub (an’anaviy ravishda yuqori ijtimoiy mavqega ega erkaklar uchun). Bunday klubning bino va inshootlari, odatda rasmiy ovqatlanish xonasi, kutubxona yoki boshqa dam olish joylarini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: She behaved like a true gentleperson, showing kindness and respect to everyone.
The gentleperson attended the royal ceremony with grace.
gentleperson.meta: Nafis kelib chiqishga ega bo‘lgan yoki yuqori ijtimoiy mavqega ega bo‘lgan kishi; erkak yoki ayol. Muloyim, odobli va hurmatga sazovor odam.

ex: Many young people prefer working in the gig economy for its flexibility.
The gig economy allows workers to take on multiple short-term jobs rather than committing to a single employer.
gig economy.meta: Doimiy, to‘liq vaqtli ish bilan solishtirganda, qisqa muddatli shartnomalar va mustaqil freelans ishlarining ko‘pligi bilan xarakterlanadigan mehnat bozori.

ex: Every Boxing Day, the islanders celebrate with a vibrant Gombey procession through the streets.
The Gombey dancers wore colorful costumes and moved rhythmically to the beat of the drums.
gombey.meta: Bermuda madaniyatiga oid xalq ijrosi yoki marosimi bo‘lib, unda niqob va kiyim kiygan raqqoslar baraban va fitna tovushlari bilan hamroh bo‘lib, an’anaviy ravishda Boxing Day (26-dekabr) kuni o‘tkaziladi.

ex: At the rally, many greenshirts gathered to show their support for the party.
The greenshirt proudly represented his team during the match.
greenshirt.meta: Jamoa, tashkilot yoki siyosiy partiyaga a’zolikni bildiruvchi maqsadda yashil rangli ko‘ylak kiygan odam.

ex: She prepared a hearty greeze for her family.
After a long day, they enjoyed a big greeze together.
greeze.meta: Katta, to‘yimli va qoniqarli ovqat. Shuningdek, umumiy ma’noda — oziq-ovqat.

ex: Don’t be so gribble; try to relax and enjoy the party.
He was feeling gribble after a stressful day at work.
gribble.meta: Oson jahli chiqadigan, g‘azablangan, yomon kayfiyatda bo‘lgan.

ex: An image server helps manage large collections of pictures efficiently.
The website uses an image server to quickly load all photos on the homepage.
image server.meta: Kompyuter sohasida, rasm fayllarini yetkazib berish va ularga kirishni boshqarish uchun ishlatiladigan server; ayniqsa, internetda rasm fayllarini taqdim etishga ixtisoslashgan veb-server.

ex: The kirana merchant delivered fresh vegetables to our house.
I bought some kirana goods from the local shop.
kirana.meta: Uy-ro‘zg‘or uchun oziq-ovqat va kundalik ehtiyojlar mahsulotlari. Ko‘pincha “kirana goods” (kirana mahsulotlari), “kirana merchant”, “kirana store” (kirana do‘koni) kabi iboralarda ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, ko‘plik shaklida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: She always carries lip balm in her bag to keep her lips soft.
In winter, using lip balm helps prevent dry and cracked lips.
lip balm.meta: Lablarga surtish uchun mo‘ljallangan malham yoki krem, og‘riq, quruqlik va yorilishlarning oldini olish yoki ularni yengillashtirish uchun ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, lab balzam odatda tayoqcha yoki idishda bo‘ladi.

ex: Many people watched the football match through a livestream on their phones.
The concert was available to watch via livestream on the official website.
livestream.meta: Internet orqali biror tadbir yoki voqeaning to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri efirda uzatilishi.

ex: Schools are teaching students media literacy to prepare them for the digital age.
Media literacy helps people distinguish between real news and fake news.
media literacy.meta: Ommaviy axborot vositalarini baholash, tahlil qilish va tushunish qobiliyati; ayniqsa, taqdim etilgan har qanday voqea yoki hikoyani tanqidiy ravishda tahlil qila olish mahorati.

ex: She felt negged after hearing the harsh criticism.
Don’t let one failure neg your confidence.
neg.meta: Kimnidir xafa qilish, ruhiy tushkunlikka solish, qaytarish yoki umidsizlikka solish. (Boshqa ma’nolari ham bo‘lishi mumkin, kontekstga qarab turadi.)

ex: The manager’s negging of the proposal discouraged the team.
His constant negging of my ideas made it hard to work together.
negging.meta: Bir fikr, taklif yoki qarashni rad etish yoki e’tiborsiz qoldirish harakati; rad etish, inkor etish. Tanqid yoki e’tiroz bildirish; kamchilik topish.

ex: Many Pasifika communities celebrate their heritage with festivals and dances.
Pasifika cultures have rich traditions and unique languages.
pasifika.meta: Mikroneziya, Polineziya va Melaneziya hududlaridagi Tinch okeani orollarining mahalliy xalqlari bilan bog‘liq yoki ular haqida. Shuningdek, Tinch okeani orollari xalqlariga oid yoki ularning madaniyati, tili, an’analari bilan bog‘liq narsalar.

ex: Efforts are being made to reduce the racial pay gap in the country.
The gender pay gap remains a significant issue in many industries.
pay gap.meta: Ikkita aholining bir qismi yoki guruhlari orasidagi maoshlar yoki ish haqi darajasidagi farq. Shuningdek, jinslar, irqiy guruhlar yoki boshqa ijtimoiy guruhlar o‘rtasidagi maosh farqlari.

ex: Activists spoke out against queerbaiting as a harmful practice in media.
The show was criticized for queerbaiting by hinting at a same-sex relationship without confirming it.
queerbaiting.meta: Queerbaiting — LGBT odamlariga (ayniqsa, dastlab gay erkaklarga) qilingan ta'qib, haqorat yoki maqsadli provokatsiya.

ex: She accepted her servanthood with dignity and hard work.
In old novels, servanthood was often seen as a lifelong position.
servanthood.meta: Xizmatkorlik — dastlab xizmatkorlar guruhini umumiy atash (eski, kam ishlatiladigan so‘z). Keyinchalik esa xizmatkor bo‘lish holati, vazifasi yoki maqomi.

ex: The serve-over counter displayed a variety of fresh pastries.
In the cafeteria, the serve-over case kept the salads chilled.
serve-over.meta: Ovqatni xizmat qilish uchun ustida joylashgan stend, shkaf yoki shunga o‘xshash jihoz. Ayniqsa, tijorat sohasida ishlatiladigan, oziq-ovqatni ko‘rsatish va xizmat qilish uchun oynali vitrin.

ex: The Servetan movement spread throughout Europe in the 16th century.
He was a devoted Servetan who supported Michael Servetus' theological ideas.
servetan.meta: Maykl Servet (Michael Servetus) tarafdori yoki uning qarashlarini himoya qiluvchi shaxs. Shuningdek, Servetning ta’limotlarini qo‘llovchi yoki unga oid bo‘lgan.

ex: She bought elegant serveware for the dinner party.
The restaurant invested in new serveware to enhance the dining experience.
serveware.meta: Taom va ichimliklarni xizmat qilish uchun ishlatiladigan buyumlar, odatda umumiy holda nazarda tutiladi.

ex: Servoing allows for accurate control of the machine’s parts.
The robot’s precise movements are achieved through servoing.
servoing.meta: Servomexanizm yordamida qurilma yoki mashinani boshqarish harakati, ayniqsa aniq va nazorat ostidagi harakatlarni amalga oshirish uchun.

ex: The seven-out ended the round, and the bettors on Pass lost their wagers.
He rolled a seven-out and lost his turn in the craps game.
seven-out.meta: Craps o‘yinida: point raqami belgilanganidan keyin yetti tashlash; bu o‘yinchining navbatini tugatadi va Pass garoviga tikkanlar uchun yo‘qotishni anglatadi.

ex: Many followers of Seventh-day Adventism practice a healthy lifestyle and vegetarianism.
Seventh-day Adventism emphasizes observing the Sabbath on the seventh day of the week.
seventh-day adventism.meta: Yettinchi kun adventistlarining (Seventh-day Adventist) tamoyillari yoki e’tiqodlari.

ex: The seventh-inning stretch is a tradition that helps players and spectators relax.
During the seventh-inning stretch, fans usually stand up and sing the national anthem.
seventh-inning stretch.meta: Beysbol o‘yinida — yettinchi inningning birinchi yarmidan keyin qisqa tanaffus, odatda tomoshabinlar turib cho‘zilishadi va ko‘proq harakat qilishadi. Shuningdek, boshqa o‘yinlar yoki tadbirlarda qisqa tanaffus ma’nosida ishlatilishi mumkin.

ex: Sinographs are used not only in Chinese but also in Japanese and Korean scripts.
Chinese writing consists of thousands of sinographs.
sinograph.meta: Xitoy tilida yozishda ishlatiladigan har bir belgi; shuningdek, ko‘pincha moslashtirilgan shaklda, Xitoy tiliga aloqador yoki undan kuchli ta’sirlangan boshqa tillarda ham ishlatiladigan belgilar.

ex: After moving to a new city, she spent a few nights sofa-surfing at friends’ places.
On weekends, he tends to sofa-surf and watch TV all day.
sofa-surf.meta: Faol bo‘lmagan va o‘tirgan holda bajariladigan faoliyatlar bilan shug‘ullanish, masalan, televizor ko‘rish.

ex: After losing his apartment, he became a sofa surfer, staying at different friends’ places.
He is such a sofa surfer, spending most of his free time watching TV.
sofa surfer.meta: Odatda passiv va o‘tirgan holda bajariladigan faoliyatlar bilan shug‘ullanadigan odam, ayniqsa televizor ko‘ruvchi. Yoki vaqtincha boshqalar uyida, do‘stlarning divanlarida qolib yashaydigan shaxs.

ex: Sofa surfing can sometimes lead to a sedentary lifestyle if done excessively.
His weekends are mostly spent doing sofa surfing and watching movies.
sofa surfing.meta: Passiv va o‘tirgan holatda bajariladigan faoliyatlar bilan shug‘ullanish odati yoki harakati, ayniqsa televizor ko‘rish.Vaqtincha do‘stlar yoki tanishlarning uylarida, divanlarida qolib yashash harakati.

ex: Suhoor is an important meal to sustain energy throughout the day during Ramadan.
Muslims wake up early to eat suhoor before starting their fast.
suhoor.meta: Ramazon oyida ro‘za tutish boshlanishidan oldin, tong otishdan avval yeyiladigan ovqat; shunday ovqatlanish vaqti yoki marosimi.

ex: They served tacos filled with beef tinga at the party.
Tinga is a popular Mexican dish made with shredded chicken in a spicy tomato sauce.
tinga.meta: Meksika oshxonasida: achchiq pomidor asosidagi sousda pishirilgan, mayda to‘g‘ralgan tovuq, mol go‘shti yoki cho‘chqa go‘shti taomi; ko‘pincha takos, tortillyalar yoki boshqa taomlarda to‘ldiruvchi sifatida xizmat qiladi.

ex: She bought a new doll from the toy department for her niece.
The toy department in the store is located on the second floor.
toy department.meta: Do‘kondagi o‘yinchoqlar sotiladigan bo‘lim.(Qo‘shimcha ma’no) — Ba’zan o‘yinchoqlar va bolalar uchun boshqa mahsulotlar sotiladigan joy yoki bo‘lim.

ex: Toyetic movies often lead to a wide range of merchandise being sold.
The new cartoon is very toyetic, so many toys will be released soon.
toyetic.meta: Film, teleko‘rsatuv, multfilm qahramoni yoki shunga o‘xshash narsalar uchun ishlatiladi; o‘yinchoqlar, o‘yinlar va boshqa savdo mollari marketingiga mos keladigan, ularga asos bo‘luvchi.

ex: The businessman’s toygirl attracted a lot of media attention.
He was often seen with his young toygirl at luxury events.
toygirl.meta: Jinsiy yoki romantik sherigidan ancha yoshroq bo‘lgan ayol; ayniqsa, boy va kattaroq yoshdagi sherigi yoki sevgilisi bor yosh va jozibali ayol.

ex: Sushi is often dipped in toyo before eating.
Please add some toyo to the stir-fry for extra flavor.
toyo.meta: Xitoy, Yapon yoki boshqa Osiyo oshxonalarida ishlatiladigan, fermentatsiyadan o‘tgan soya loviyasidan tayyorlangan sho‘r, qoramtir suyuqlik.

ex: She bought a new puzzle from the toy store.
The children were excited to visit the toy store before their birthday.
toy store.meta: O‘yinchoqlar sotiladigan do‘kon.(Keng ma’noda) bolalar uchun o‘yinchoq va o‘yin mahsulotlarini sotuvchi har qanday savdo nuqtasi.

ex: Activists are fighting against transphobes to promote equality.
The transphobe refused to accept her friend’s gender identity.
transphobe.meta: Transgender yoki transseksual odamlar yoki transgenderlikka nisbatan g‘arazli, nafratli yoki qo‘rqadigan shaxs; transfobiya qiluvchi odam.

ex: Many politicians virtue signal to gain public approval.
She was accused of virtue signaling by posting about charity without actually donating.
virtue signal.meta: O‘zining yaxshi xarakteri, ijtimoiy ong yoki axloqiy qadriyatlarini namoyish qilish niyatida bo‘lib, so‘zlash yoki harakat qilish.

ex: She was seen as a virtue signaller because she constantly posted about social causes.
The virtue signaller often talks about helping others but rarely takes action.
virtue signaller.meta: Asosan o‘zining yaxshi xarakteri, ijtimoiy ong yoki siyosiy tamoyillarini boshqalar oldida namoyish etishga intiladigan, shunday niyat bilan so‘zlar yoki harakatlar qiladigan odam.

ex: Some people accuse celebrities of virtue signalling rather than making real change.
His constant virtue signalling on social media annoyed many of his friends.
virtue signalling.meta: Asosan o‘zining yaxshi xarakteri, ijtimoiy ong yoki siyosiy tamoyillarini boshqalar oldida namoyish etishga intilib, fikr bildirish yoki harakat qilish amali yoki odati.

ex: The city has a large population of visible minorities contributing to its cultural diversity.
Visible minorities often face unique challenges in the workplace.
visible minority.meta: Jamiyatdagi asosiy etnik yoki irqiy guruhdan tashqari, tashqi ko‘rinishi bilan osongina ajralib turadigan etnik yoki irqiy guruh a’zolari; odatda rangli yoki boshqa tashqi belgilar bilan farqlanadi.

ex: Womxn face unique challenges in many professional fields.
The event was organized to celebrate womxn in leadership roles.
womxn.meta: Ayollar, ayniqsa, gender inklyuzivligi va jinsiy tenglikni ta’kidlash maqsadida ishlatiladigan atama. Ba’zida yagona shaklda – bir ayol ma’nosida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: She wrinched him harshly for his careless mistake.
The teacher wrinched the student for being late to class.
wrinch.meta: Kimnidir qattiq tanbeh berish, og‘ir so‘zlar bilan tanqid qilish.(Qo‘shimcha ma’nosi) Qattiq og‘iz bilan siqib olish yoki cho‘zish (masalan, yuz ifodasi).

ex: The city introduced a special lane similar to the Zil lane for VIPs during major events.
During the Soviet era, the Zil lane was exclusively used by government officials.
zil lane.meta: Sovet Ittifoqida yuqori martabali amaldorlar uchun ajratilgan markaziy avtomagistral yo‘l yo‘lagi; (keng ma’noda) har qanday elita vakillari uchun ajratilgan yo‘l yo‘lagi.

ex: The couple was warned against zina according to religious laws.
Zina is considered a serious sin in Islamic teachings.
zina.meta: Islom qonunlariga ko‘ra taqiqlangan har qanday jinsiy aloqa shakli, ayniqsa, qonuniy turmush qurmagan ikki kishi o‘rtasidagi jinsiy munosabat; xiyonat, fohishalik.

ex: Many zinesters use their work to express personal stories and social issues.
She is a dedicated zinester who publishes her own zine every month.
zinester.meta: Zin (kichik mustaqil jurnal yoki nashr) uchun yozuvchi yoki uni tayyorlovchi shaxs.

ex: She spoke zingily about her new project, full of enthusiasm.
The sauce was added zingily to the dish, giving it a fresh, spicy kick.
zingily.meta: Hayajonli, jonli, tetik va qiziqarli tarzda; nordon yoki achchiq ta’m bilan.

ex: Her performance was full of zinginess and energy.
The zinginess of the lemon added a refreshing taste to the dish.
zinginess.meta: Jonlilik, tetiklik; hayajon, shijoat va nordonlik sifati.

ex: The zinging sound of the bees filled the garden.
I heard a constant zinging in my ears after the loud concert.
zinging.meta: O‘tkir, baland va doimiy tovush — shivirlash, vichirlash yoki qichqiriq tovushi.

ex: We heard the zinging noise of the speeding motorcycle.
The zinging arrow flew past us with a sharp sound.
zinging.meta: Tez harakatlanayotgan yoki o‘tkir, baland, qichqiruvchi tovush chiqaradigan narsa.

ex: She spoke zingingly, full of energy and enthusiasm.
The guitar strings were played zingingly, filling the room with vibrant music.
zingingly.meta: Zing (zing n. 1) yoki zinging tovush bilan; o‘tkir va baland tovushda; jonli, energiyali tarzda; achchiq yoki shirintomondan ta’mi bor holda

ex: Many locals view the Zion Curtain as a symbol of the state’s conservative cultural values.
The Zion Curtain was established to separate alcohol preparation areas from customers in Utah restaurants.
zion curtain.meta: Utah shtatidagi ko‘pchilik Mormon aholisi va ularning konservativ qadriyatlari bilan bog‘liq madaniy chegara yoki to‘siq.

ex: The book discusses Zionistic movements in the 20th century.
Zionistic beliefs emphasize the support for the establishment of a Jewish homeland in Israel.
zionistic.meta: Sionizmga oid yoki sionizmni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi.Sionistlar bilan bog‘liq, ularning g‘oyalari yoki harakatlariga tegishli.

ex: After getting the job, he said, “Zip-a-dee-doo-dah!” ironically.
She sang “Zip-a-dee-doo-dah” with a big smile on her face.
zip-a-dee-doo-dah.meta: Quvonch, hayajon, shodlikni ifodalovchi so‘z (ko‘pincha hazil yoki ironik ma’noda ishlatiladi). Qulay, yaxshi, rohatli yoki omadli holatni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Some marketers zip-code people to target ads more effectively.
The post office zip-coded all the letters before sending them out.
zip-code.meta: Pochta jo‘natmasiga zip-kod (pochta indeksi) qo‘yish. Biror kishini uning yashash joyi yoki pochta indeksi orqali belgilash yoki farqlash.

ex: Zip cuffs are often used for quick and temporary handcuffing.
The police used zip cuffs to restrain the suspect’s hands.
zip cuff.meta: Odatiy ko‘p holda ko‘plikda ishlatiladi. Qo‘lga olish asbobi sifatida ishlatiladigan, yupqa va egiluvchan neylon tasma bo‘lib, yirtilgan yoki jag‘li yuzaga ega va ikki halqa hosil qilish uchun shakllangan.

ex: Beginners should always wear safety gear when they become zipliners.
The zipliner enjoyed the thrill of gliding over the forest canopy.
zipliner.meta: Zip layndan sirpilib tushuvchi shaxs; odatda, dam olish yoki o‘yin-kulgi maqsadida zip layndan foydalanadigan odam.

zip lining.meta: Zip layndan sirpilib tushish harakati; odatda dam olish yoki o‘yin-kulgi maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Zippies were known for their radical views and distinctive activism.
He was a zippie who actively fought for social change in the 1970s.
zippie.meta: Radikal qarshi madaniyat faollari guruhining a’zosi; ayniqsa, Yoshlar Xalqaro Partiyasi (Youth International Party) a’zolaridan qisqa muddatli ajralib chiqqan guruh a’zosi.

ex: He has zippo chance of winning the contest.
I tried to find evidence, but I got zippo.
zippo.meta: Noun: Hech narsa, nol, mutlaqo yo’q.Adjective: Yo’q, hech qanday, nol.

ex: The police officers fastened the suspect’s hands with zip ties.
He used a zip tie to secure the cables behind the desk.
zip tie.meta: Nozik, egiluvchan, notched yuzaga ega bo‘lgan, bir uchini qulflash mexanizmi orqali o‘tkazib mahkamlash uchun mo‘ljallangan lenta shaklidagi mahkamlovchi vosita.

ex: In anatomy class, we learned that the greater omentum (zirbus) plays a role in fat storage and immune response.
The surgeon carefully examined the zirbus during the abdominal operation.
zirbus.meta: Omentum; ayniqsa, katta omentum — oshqozondan ko‘ndalang ichakning kolon qismiga o'tib, ichak oldida osilgan periton qavatining burmalangan qismi.

ex: Zirconyl salts are commonly used in ceramic glazes.
The compound contains a zirconyl group that stabilizes the structure.
zirconyl.meta: Zirkoniy va kisloroddan tashkil topgan kation guruh bo‘lib, ba’zi tuzlar va suvli eritmalarda uchraydi. Odatda kimyoviy nomlarda modifikator sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Zoomers often have different values compared to younger generations.
Many boomers have now become zoomers as they enter retirement.
zoomer.meta: Aslida va asosan Shimoliy Amerikada ishlatiladi. Katta harf bilan yozilishi ko‘p uchraydi. Boomer (boomer n.3) avlodidan bo‘lib, hozir o‘rta yosh yoki nafaqaga chiqqan yoshda. Shuningdek, yosh avlod vakili sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: He's my aceboy from childhood.
Hey aceboy, how have you been?
aceboy.meta: Ya’ni yaqin do‘st erkak. Shuningdek, bu so‘z murojaat shaklida yoki mehr-muhabbat ifodasi sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: She’s my acegirl since school days.
Hey acegirl, what’s up?
acegirl.meta: Ya’ni yaqin do‘st ayol. Shuningdek, bu so‘z murojaat shaklida yoki mehr-muhabbat ifodasi sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: During counseling sessions, active listening helps build trust.
Active listening is essential for effective communication.
active listening.meta: Gapirayotgan odamning so‘zlariga to‘liq e’tibor berish va faol ravishda ishtirok etish harakati yoki amaliyoti; keyinchalik ayniqsa maslahat berishda va mojarolarni hal qilishda qo‘llaniladigan texnika.

ex: In that small town, being anybody’s could lead to gossip.
She was known to be anybody’s, never committed to one person.
to be anybody’s.meta: Norasmiy so‘zlashuvda: kimningdir bo‘lish — bu osonlik bilan tasodifiy jinsiy yoki romantik munosabatlarga ochiq bo‘lish; kengroq ma’noda esa juda bo‘ysunuvchan yoki oson ta’sirlanadigan bo‘lish.

ex: In that party, he acted like he was anyone’s.
She was known to be anyone’s in the small village.
to be anyone’s.meta: Norasmiy so‘zlashuvda (asosan Britaniya va Irlandiya inglizchasida): kimningdir bo‘lish — tasodifiy jinsiy yoki romantik yaqinlashuvlarga juda ochiq yoki shunday deb hisoblanish.

ex: The spacecraft passed through the asteroid belt carefully to avoid collisions.
Most of the asteroids in our solar system are found in the asteroid belt.
asteroid belt.meta: Quyosh atrofida Mars va Yupiter orbitalari orasida joylashgan fazoviy mintaqa bo‘lib, unda Quyosh tizimidagi asteroidlarning ko‘pchiligi joylashgan.

ex: Scientists study the asteroid belt to understand the formation of the solar system.
Most of the small bodies orbiting the sun are located in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
asteroid belt.meta: asteroid belt (ot): Quyosh atrofida Mars va Yupiter orbitasi orasida joylashgan, Quyosh tizimidagi ko‘pchilik asteroidlarning orbitasi mavjud bo‘lgan kosmik mintaqa. asteroid (sifat): asteroidlarga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Pilots must avoid the asteroid field to prevent damage to their ships.
The spaceship navigated carefully through the dense asteroid field.
asteroid field.meta: Ko‘plab asteroidlar joylashgan fazoviy hudud; asteroid kamariga o‘xshash, lekin ko‘pincha ko‘proq zichlikdagi asteroidlar to‘plami.
