ex: Scientists study the asteroid field to learn about asteroid collisions.
The spacecraft navigated carefully through the dense asteroid field.
asteroid field.meta: asteroid field (ot): kosmosda ko‘plab asteroidlar joylashgan hudud; asteroidlar kamariga o‘xshash, ammo ko‘proq tosh va jismlarga ega. asteroid (sifat): asteroidlarga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The spacecraft passed through the asteroid zone on its way to Jupiter.
Most asteroids in the solar system are found within the asteroid zone.
asteroid zone.meta: Quyosh atrofidagi, Mars va Yupiter orbitalari orasida joylashgan fazoviy hudud, unda Quyosh tizimidagi ko‘pchilik asteroidlar mavjud.

ex: Scientists explore the asteroid zone to understand the solar system’s formation.
Most asteroids orbit the sun within the asteroid zone between Mars and Jupiter.
asteroid zone.meta: asteroid zone (ot): Mars va Yupiter orbitasi orasida Quyosh atrofida joylashgan, Quyosh tizimidagi ko‘pchilik asteroidlarning orbitasi mavjud bo‘lgan kosmik hudud. asteroid (sifat): asteroidlarga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq.

ex: They beat the bells out of the suspect to get a confession.
The gang threatened to beat the bells out of him if he didn’t pay the debt.
to beat — bells out of a person.meta: Kimgadir juda qattiq urish, kaltaklash yoki qo‘rqitish. Ko‘pincha zo‘rlik bilan jismoniy ta’sir ko‘rsatishni anglatadi.

ex: The boxer promised to beat the bells out of his opponent in the next match.
They threatened to beat the bells out of him if he didn’t pay the debt.
to beat — bells out of a person.meta: to beat — bells out of (kimnidir) (slang) — kimnidir qattiq urish, kaltaklash, oyoq bilan urish yoki jiddiy zarar yetkazish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, kimnidir qo‘rqitish yoki dahshatga solish ma’nosida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: Bell miners live in colonies in the eucalyptus forests of southeastern Australia.
The bell miner is known for its distinctive tinkling bell-like call.
bell miner.meta: Janubi-sharqiy Avstraliyaga xos bo‘lgan, Manorina melanophrys turi asalxo‘r qush. Uning patlari zaytun-yashil rangda bo‘lib, tovushi chiroyli chaynash tovushiga o‘xshaydi.

ex: This bird, the bell miner, has olive-green feathers.
The bell miner is known for its distinctive bell-like call.
bell miner.meta: bell miner (ot): janubi-sharqiy Avstraliyaga xos bo‘lgan Manorina melanophrys turi, zaytun-yashil rangli patlarga ega va bellarga o‘xshash tiniq ovoz chiqaradigan asalxo‘r qush turi.

ex: Oxalis pes-caprae, or Bermuda buttercup, has distinctive yellow flowers and clover-like leaves.
The Bermuda buttercup is commonly found in gardens and wild areas around the world.
bermuda buttercup.meta: Janubiy Afrikaga xos bo‘lgan va dunyoning boshqa qismlarida keng tarqalgan "goat’s foot" nomli Oxalis pes-caprae o‘simligi. Bu o‘simlik ko‘pincha o‘rmon ostida o‘sadi va o‘zining sariq gullari bilan tanilgan.

ex: Many chefs prefer Bermuda onions for salads because they are less pungent.
Bermuda onions are popular for their mild and sweet flavor.
bermuda onion.meta: Odatdagi piyozning bir nechta katta turlari bo‘lib, ularning terisi oq yoki sariq rangda va ta’mi shirin va yumshoq bo‘ladi; shuningdek, bunday piyoz hosil qiluvchi o‘simlik.

ex: Sailors prefer the Bermuda sloop because of its efficient triangular sails.
The Bermuda sloop is known for its speed and agility on the water.
bermuda sloop.meta: Bitta mastli, old tomondan orqaga cho‘zilgan, baland uchburchak shaklidagi yashiqchalar (plyuslar) bilan jihozlangan yelkanli kemadir.

ex: During summer, the Bermuda high brings warm and dry conditions to the region.
The Bermuda high influences weather patterns along the east coast of the United States.
bermuda high.meta: Shimoliy Atlantika okeanida, yoz va kuz fasllarida Bermuda yaqinida joylashgan, yarim-muomalali yuqori atmosfera bosim zonasidir.

ex: She bought a Bermudan-rigged yacht for recreational sailing.
The Bermudan-rigged sailboat is popular for its speed and agility.
bermudan-rigged.meta: Bermuda rig’i bilan jihozlangan — uzun, uchburchak shaklidagi plyajlar bilan jihozlangan bitta mastli yelkanli kemani ifodalaydi.

ex: Everyone deserves to live their best life filled with happiness and success.
She is finally living her best life after moving to a new city.
one’s best life.meta: Eng yaxshi hayot – odam tasavvur qilishi yoki intilishi mumkin bo‘lgan eng yaxshi, eng baxtli yoki eng to‘liq hayot.

ex: She approached the problem with a blank canvas, open to all possibilities.
The project started as a blank canvas, allowing the team to explore many creative ideas.
blank canvas.meta: San’atkorning rasm chizishdan oldingi bo‘sh parda yoki tasvirga o‘xshash, ya’ni hali shakllanmagan, ochiq va ijodiy imkoniyatlarga to‘la narsa.

ex: Her mind was a blank canvas, open to new ideas and inspirations.
The project started as a blank canvas, allowing us to shape it any way we wanted.
blank canvas.meta: blank canvas (ot): rassomning bo‘yalmagan, hech qanday chizmalar yoki tasvirlar bo‘lmagan tuvali kabi, shakllanmagan yoki ochiq bo‘lgan, keng ijodiy imkoniyatlarga ega bo‘lgan narsa

ex: When he started the job, he was a blank slate with no prior experience.
Children are often described as a blank slate, ready to learn from their environment.
blank slate.meta: Yozilmagan taxtaga o‘xshab, ichida hech qanday ma’lumot yoki tabiiy xususiyatlari bo‘lmagan, shuning uchun ham cheklovlarsiz va o‘zgarishga tayyor bo‘lgan shaxs yoki narsa.

ex: After moving to a new city, she saw it as a blank slate to start fresh.
The child’s mind is often described as a blank slate, ready to learn and absorb knowledge.
blank slate.meta: blank slate (ot): yozilmagan, ichida hech narsa yo‘q bo‘lgan, tabiiy xususiyatlardan mahrum yoki shakllanmagan kishi yoki narsa; yangi tajribalar yoki ta’sirlarga ochiq holat.

ex: Fisheries, tourism, and marine renewable energy are key sectors of the blue economy.
The government promotes the blue economy to protect marine biodiversity while boosting economic growth.
blue economy.meta: Dengiz va sho‘r yoki ichimlik suvlari muhitlarini asrashga intilib, ularni barqaror tarzda foydalanib, iqtisodiy o‘sishni rivojlantirishga qaratilgan iqtisodiyot shakli.

ex: She promotes body-positive messages to help others feel confident in their own skin.
The body-positive movement encourages people to love their bodies as they are.
body-positive.meta: Inson tanasiga nisbatan bag‘rikeng, zamonaviy va ochiq munosabatni ilgari suruvchi, tananing haqiqiy holatini qabul qilish, qadrlash va nishonlashni targ‘ib qiluvchi qarash yoki harakat.

ex: Social media plays a big role in promoting body positivity among young people.
Body positivity encourages people to accept and appreciate their bodies as they are.
body positivity.meta: Inson tanasini, ayniqsa o‘z tanasini qabul qilish va qadrlash; shuningdek, tananing real va haqiqiy tasvirini targ‘ib qilish va nishonlash.

ex: Gardeners must monitor box plants carefully to prevent box blight.
Box blight causes dark spots and leaf drop on box plants.
box blight.meta: Box o‘simliklarini (Buxaceae oilasi) zararlovchi Volutella buxi va Cylindrocladium buxicola ismli ikki tur ascomycete qo‘ziqorinlari tomonidan yuzaga keladigan kasallik bo‘lib, o‘simlikda chirish va shikastlanishga olib keladi.

ex: She’s been on the box several times this year with her cooking show.
Did you see the new drama on the box last night?
on the box.meta: Shovqinli nutq uslubida, asosan britan tilida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, televizorda efirga uzatilgan yoki televizion dasturda namoyish etilgan narsani bildiradi.

ex: The old phrase "box of ivories" referred to the mouth or teeth.
He smiled, revealing his box of ivories.
box of ivories.meta: Qadimiy va kam ishlatiladigan jargon ifodasi bo‘lib, odamning og‘zi yoki tishlari to‘plamini anglatadi.

ex: You need to understand the box and dice before making a decision.
They discussed the box and dice of the project before starting.
box and dice.meta: Ma’lum bir vaziyatga oid barcha narsalar yoki odamlar to‘plami; butun masala yoki holatning barcha jihatlari.

ex: She has a whole box of tricks to handle difficult customers.
The magician pulled a rabbit out of his box of tricks.
box of tricks.meta: Muayyan maqsadga xizmat qiluvchi, ko‘pincha kichik quti yoki shunga o‘xshash idishda saqlanadigan, turli hiyla-nayranglar, fokuslar yoki maxsus uskunalar to‘plami.

ex: Don’t underestimate her; she’s a box of tricks and knows how to get what she wants.
He’s a real box of tricks when it comes to negotiating deals.
box of tricks.meta: Ijodiy, mahoratli yoki hiyla-nayranglardan foydalanuvchi odam; turli fokuslar yoki hiylalar yordamida maqsadiga erishadigan shaxs.

ex: The new manager brought the whole box of tricks to improve the company’s performance.
He used the whole box of tricks to solve the problem.
the whole box of tricks.meta: Butun narsalar yoki vaziyat; biror ish yoki holatdagi barcha elementlar, barcha imkoniyatlar va usullar.

ex: Don’t drive if you’re off your box.
After the party, he was completely off his box.
off one’s box.meta: Spirtli ichimlik yoki dorilar ta’sirida juda mast, behush yoki o‘zini yo‘qotgan holatda bo‘lish.

ex: Don’t listen to him; he’s completely out of his box.
He’s been acting out of his box lately, saying strange things.
out of one’s box.meta: Aql-idrokni yo‘qotgan, ongini boshqarolmaydigan, aqldan ozgan yoki ruhiy holati buzilgan odam.

ex: She walked in completely out of her box, laughing at nothing.
He was totally out of his box after just two drinks.
out of one’s box.meta: Spirtli ichimlik yoki giyohvand moddalar ta’sirida juda mast, hushini yo‘qotgan yoki o‘zini tutolmaydigan holat; odamning ongli nazorati yo‘qolgan holati. Bu ibora ba’zida ravish sifatida ham ishlatiladi (masalan, “u butunlay mast holatda edi”).

ex: She kept interfering until someone told her to get back in her box.
He started shouting, but the manager told him to get back in his box.
to get back in one’s box.meta: Boshqalarni bezovta qilishni, ahmoqona yoki asabbuzar harakatlarni to‘xtatish; o‘zingni bosish, jim turish yoki o‘zingni joyingga qaytarish ma’nosida ishlatiladigan og‘zaki ibora.

ex: She made a rude comment, but the teacher quickly put her back in her box.
He was acting like he owned the place, so the boss put him back in his box.
to put a person back in his box.meta: Kimnidir haddini bildirish, manmanlik yoki haddan oshgan ishonchni jilovlash; kibrli yoki betakalluf odamni kamsitish yoki joyiga qaytarish. Bu ibora ko‘proq kimnidir o‘zini katta tutganidan keyin uni noqulay holatga solib qo‘yishni bildiradi.

ex: They switched to a box-and-one after the opponent’s shooter got hot.
The coach used a box-and-one defense to contain their star player.
box-and-one.meta: Bu basketbolda ishlatiladigan himoya strategiyasi bo‘lib, to‘rt nafar himoyachi jarima maydonchasining to‘rt burchagida zona himoyasida joylashadi, beshinchi o‘yinchi esa raqibning eng xavfli hujumchisiga qarshi shaxsiy himoyada o‘ynaydi.

ex: The museum had an exhibition of surrealist box art from the 20th century.
box art.meta: “Box art” iborasi ikki xil ma’noda qo‘llaniladi: San’at asari sifatida – quti ichida kollej yoki installyatsiya tarzida tayyorlangan asar. Marketing vositasi sifatida – mahsulotning tashqi qutisidagi grafik dizayn

ex: They converted the box body into a mobile workshop.
The delivery truck has a box body that can hold large amounts of cargo.
box body.meta: Yuk mashinasi yoki furgon orqa qismiga o‘rnatilgan, yopiqlikda bo‘lgan katta quti shaklidagi yuk bo‘limi; bu tuzilma mashinaning shassisi ustiga alohida tarzda mahkamlangan bo‘ladi.

ex: She worked as a box boy during the summer to earn some extra money.
The box boy quickly packed all the groceries for the customer.
box boy.meta: Do‘kon yoki supermarketda ishlovchi, odatda yosh yigit bo‘lib, mijozlarga xarid qilingan mahsulotlarni sumka yoki qutilarga joylashda va ularni ko‘tarishda yordam beradi. Unga o‘xshash atama: bag boy (sumkaga joylovchi yigit).

ex: Box braids can take several hours to complete, but they last for weeks.
She got box braids for the summer because they’re low-maintenance and stylish.
box braids.meta: Asosan qora tanli ayollar orasida mashhur bo‘lgan soch turmagi bo‘lib, unda soch kichik kvadrat (quti shaklida) bo‘limlarga ajratiladi va har bir bo‘lim alohida, mahkam qilib o‘riladi.

ex: Box calls are popular because they’re easy to use and produce realistic bird sounds.
The hunter used a box call to lure the turkey closer.
box call.meta: Qadimiy ravishda yog‘ochdan tayyorlangan, ichi bo‘sh kichik quti shaklidagi qurilma bo‘lib, uning harakatlanuvchi qopqog‘i (yopqichi) qutining chetiga ishqalanadi.

ex: As kids, we used to race down hills in homemade box carts.
The farmers loaded vegetables into the box cart for delivery to the market.
box cart.meta: (a) Quti shaklidagi korpusi yoki yopiq yon devorlari bo‘lgan arava — yuk tashish, saqlash yoki yetkazish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The company needs visionaries, not box-checkers who only follow procedure.
He’s just a box-checker — more worried about completing paperwork than solving real problems.
box-checker.meta: Asosan tanqidiy yoki kamsituvchi ma’noda ishlatiladi. Bu atama:Rasmiy protseduralarga, qoidabuzilmasligiga haddan ortiq bog‘langan, ijodkorlikdan ko‘ra, tartib-qoida, me'yoriy hujjat va shakllarni to‘ldirish bilan ortiqcha shug‘ullanuvchi kishi.

ex: We need innovation, not box-checking and blind rule-following.
This training feels like box-checking — there’s no real engagement or learning.
box-checking.meta: Kengroq, tanqidiy ma’noda esa — ishning mohiyatiga ahamiyat bermasdan, faqat qoidalarga amal qilish yoki hisobot uchun rasmiy shaklda ko‘rsatish uchun amalga oshiriladigan harakat. Bunday ish odatda ijodiy yondashuvsiz, mexanik tarzda bajariladi.

ex: The main character in the movie was an old-school badman — no one dared to cross him.
He’s not just any guy — he’s a respected badman on the streets.
badman.meta: aslida Yamayka slengidan olingan atama bo‘lib, qattiqqo‘l, jangari yoki hurmat uyg‘otadigan darajada xavfli deb qaraladigan erkakni anglatadi. Ba’zida u jinoyatchilik bilan bog‘liq yoki ko‘cha hayotida o‘z o‘rniga ega bo‘lgan odamni ifodalaydi.

ex: I was shocked at how she shamelessly humiliated him, so bald-faced.
What he said was a complete bald-faced lie.
bald-faced.meta: Bald-faced — dastlabki ma’noda “hech narsa bilan berkitilmagan, yaqqol ko‘rinadigan” deganidir (ya’ni ochiq va yashirilmagan).

ex: The bald-faced truth is that they never intended to help.
He told a bald-faced lie without any shame.
bald-faced.meta: bald-faced (sifat): dastlab, yashirinmagan, ochiq-oydin va aniq holatlarni bildiradi; keyinchalik esa uyatsiz, beparvo, betayoq xatti-harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Bermuda onions are milder than other types.
Add Bermuda to the salad, and it will taste even better.
bermuda.meta: Bermuda so‘zi bu kontekstda Bermuda piyozini anglatadi — bu yumaloq, katta, suvli va nisbatan shirin ta’mga ega bo‘lgan piyoz turi bo‘lib, odatda salatlar yoki xom iste’mol uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Bermudan culture is a blend of British and Afro-Caribbean influences.
She married a Bermudan and now lives in Hamilton.
bermudan.meta: Bermudan — bu so‘z sifatida Bermudaga oid degan ma’noni bildiradi; ot sifatida esa Bermuda orollarida tug‘ilgan yoki u yerlik ajdodlarga ega bo‘lgan odamni anglatadi. Bu so‘z Bermudian bilan sinonim hisoblanadi.

ex: His new car is boasty — turning heads everywhere.
This track is so boasty — great beat and lyrics!
boasty.meta: Boasty — Bermudalik ingliz tilida maqtovga sazovor, juda yaxshi yoki taassurotli narsa yoki odamni ifodalovchi norasmiy sifatdir.

ex: They live box and cox in the same room — one during the day, the other at night.
Two workers operate box and cox, so there's constant supervision.
box and cox.meta: Box and Cox — ingliz tilida, ayniqsa eski yoki kinoyaviy uslubda ishlatiladigan ifoda bo‘lib, bu ikki odamning navbat bilan bir narsadan foydalanishi yoki biror ishni almashib bajarishi ma’nosini bildiradi.

ex: She easily cut through the cardboard with a box cutter.
The workers were given box cutters to open the shipping boxes.
box cutter.meta: bu kichik, o‘ta o‘tkir va nozik pichoq bo‘lib, karton qutilarni ochish uchun mo‘ljallangan. Ularning pichog‘i almashtiriladigan bo‘ladi. Bu pichoq asosan ombor, do‘kon yoki ofis ishlarida ishlatiladi va xavfsizlikni inobatga olgan holda ishlab chiqiladi.

ex: The players’ movement in a box formation proved effective against the opponent.
The coach positioned the defenders in a box formation.
box formation.meta: Box formation — bu sport terminidir (ayniqsa amerika futboli, basketbol va ba'zida futbolda ham) va odatda to‘rt nafar o‘yinchining kvadrat yoki to‘rtburch shaklida joylashuvini bildiradi.

ex: The ship was moving too fast, so we had to box-haul.
During the storm, the crew box-hauled the ship.
box-haul.meta: Box-haul — bu dengizchilik atamasi bo‘lib, kema jamoasi tomonidan bajariladigan harakatni bildiradi: kemani shamolga qarshi tezda burish, ya’ni old yelkanlarni orqaga burish orqali kemani to‘xtatish yoki orqaga harakatlantirish.

ex: This ancient dagger features a tip known as a box head.
Archaeologists discovered a metal object thought to be a box head
box head.meta: Box head — bu atama hozirda eskirgan va kam uchraydigan hisoblanadi.Qadimiy arxeologik topilma (artefakt), ehtimol, quti shaklida bo‘lgan buyum.Xanjar yoki yoyilgan qilich ning bir qismi, ayniqsa quti yoki to‘g‘ri shakldagi uchi yoki boshi.

ex: The newly built buildings all looked box-like.
The house had a very box-like structure.
box-like.meta: Box-like — bu sifat yoki ravish bo‘lib, tashqi ko‘rinishi yoki shakli jihatidan qutiga o‘xshagan degan ma’noni bildiradi. U quti shaklida bo‘lgan narsalarni yoki qutisimon tarzdagi harakat yoki tuzilmani tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: Funds were gathered by the boxman to send food to the prisoners.
The boxman went around collecting donations in boxes before the holiday.
boxman.meta: bu tarixiy atama bo‘lib, kambag‘allar yoki mahbuslarga tarqatish uchun pul, oziq-ovqat yoki boshqa yordam turlarini qutiga yig‘ib yuradigan shaxsni bildiradi. U xayriya yig‘ish ishlariga mas’ul bo‘lgan kishi bo‘lgan, masalan, cherkov yoki jamoa nomidan.

ex: The box step helped drivers mount the coach box.
The elderly found it easy to reach the theatre box via the box step.
box step.meta: Box step — bu atama teatr lojasi, ot-arava haydovchisi joyi (coach box), yoki temiryo‘l signal qutisi (signal box) kabi balandroq joylarga chiqish uchun o‘rnatilgan pog‘onalar yoki zinapoyalar majmuasini bildiradi.

ex: In the old photo, he is wearing a Champagne Charlie-style hat.
A 19th-century Champagne Charlie hat is on display in the museum.
champagne charlie.meta: Champagne Charlie — tarixda ishlatilgan, hozirda deyarli qo‘llanmaydigan atama bo‘lib, u toj qismi past va qirrasi tepaga burilgan maxsus shlyapa turini bildiradi.

ex: The traveler wrote in detail about the customs in Chinadom.
This ancient map shows Chinadom covering all of East Asia.
chinadom.meta: Chinadom — tarixiy yoki uslubiy jihatdan ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, u Xitoy mamlakati, uning xalqi yoki madaniyatini umumiy holda ifodalaydi. Hozirda bu so‘z kam qo‘llanadi va ba’zan tarixiy yoki adabiy matnlarda uchraydi.

ex: The port was crowded with Chinamen arriving from Canton.
That Chinaman carried spices and porcelain to Europe.
chinaman.meta: Chinaman — tarixiy atama bo‘lib, u Xitoy bilan savdo qilgan yirik dengiz kemasini bildiradi. Bu kemalar ko‘pincha 18–19-asrlarda yelkanli bo‘lgan va chinni, ipak, choy kabi mahsulotlarni tashishda ishlatilgan.

ex: The town had only one Chinesery, but it was always full.
We stopped at a small Chinesery for a quick meal.
chinesery.meta: Chinesery — bu so‘z tarixan Xitoy restoranini, yoki Xitoy ovqatlarini taqdim qiluvchi joyni, shuningdek, o‘sha yerda xizmat qilinadigan Xitoy taomlarini ifodalash uchun ishlatilgan.

ex: They served some ‘authentic Chinesian cuisine’—which turned out to be instant noodles.
He claimed to know all about Chinesian culture after watching two kung fu movies.
chinesian.meta: Chinesian — bu “xitoy” yoki “xitoylik” degan ma’noni bildiruvchi nostandart (rasmiy bo‘lmagan) yoki hazil aralash atama. Bu so‘z ingliz tilida standart “Chinese” so‘zi o‘rnida ishlatilgan, lekin noaniq, kinoyali yoki hazilomuz ohangda.

ex: The chef used a chinois to get a smooth, velvety sauce.
Strain the soup through a chinois to remove any lumps.
chinois.meta: Chinois — bu pazandachilikda ishlatiladigan, konus shaklidagi, mayda teshikli metall süzgich bo‘lib, odatda sous, sho‘rva yoki pyurelarni nihoyatda silliq holatga keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: He’s acting like a complete ding-a-ling today.
Don’t be such a ding-a-ling! Think before you act.
ding-a-ling.meta: Sifat sifatida: ahmoqona, dangasalik qiladigan yoki aqlsiz odamni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi. Keyinchalik: aqldan ozgan, g‘alati, bexush yoki biroz aqlsiz odam haqida aytiladi.

ex: The city looked frightening in the dinge.
They planned the robbery during the dinge.
dinge.meta: Dinge — jinoyatchilar orasida ishlatiladigan sleng so‘z bo‘lib, qorong‘i, qorong‘u tunni anglatadi. Hozirda kam uchraydigan va eskirgan atama.

ex: The metalworker uses dinging as a method to remove dents.
He removed the dents on the old car hood by dinging it.
dinging.meta: Metall yuzasini shakllantirish yoki silliqlash uchun bolg‘a bilan urish harakati, ayniqsa, ta’sirlanish natijasida hosil bo‘lgan dog‘lar (bossalar)ni yo‘qotish uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: It was considered improper to talk about dingle-dangle men.
U always waited for his dingle-dangle wife.
dingle-dangle.meta: Kechgan zamonlarda ishlatilgan, kamdan-kam uchraydigan, hurmatsiz yoki past baholovchi ma’noda erkak yoki (ehtimol) er uchun ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: He used the word dingus as a joke.
The kids were talking about dingus during playtime.
dingus.meta: Erkak jinsiy a’zosi uchun ishlatiladigan she’riy yoki og‘zaki so‘z (slang).

ex: In our company, dog food practice helps improve product quality.
Developers test the new app themselves as dog food during development.
dog food.meta: Kompaniya xodimlari tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan mahsulot yoki xizmatni ommaga taqdim etishdan oldin sinov maqsadida ichki foydalanish.

ex: He spends the summer in a fishing box located by the river.
A fishing box is usually simple and comfortable.
fishing box.meta: Asosan yozda baliq ovlash uchun daryo, so‘lak yoki boshqa suv bo‘yida vaqtincha istiqomat qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan kichik qishloq uyi.

ex: We use a freshener that gives a new scent inside the car.
Air fresheners improve the quality of air in the room.
freshener.meta: Biror narsani yangilash yoki tozalash uchun qo‘llaniladigan harakat yoki asosan moddiy vosita, mahsulot. Ko‘pincha so‘z birikmalarida ikkinchi element sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: This perfume product gives a freshening scent to the room.
Spring air is refreshing and freshening.
freshening.meta: Biror narsani yangi, tetik yoki yangilangan holga keltiruvchi, yangilovchi ta’sir ko‘rsatadigan.

ex: Lakes and rivers are filled with fresh water.
Fresh water sources are limited in Uzbekistan.
fresh water.meta: Tuzsiz, ichimlikka yaroqli, asosan daryo, ko‘l yoki boshqa ichki suv havzalari tomonidan tashkil topgan suv.

ex: Gansey jerseys are light and comfortable.
This sweater is made of gansey wool.
gansey.meta: Nozik va sifatli jun turi, ko‘pincha kiyim uchun ishlatiladi. Gansey ko‘pincha futbolka yoki kiyim nomlari oldida ishlatiladi.

ex: This pigment gives color to plants.
Gentianine is a natural pigment derived from blue flowers.
gentianine.meta: Gentiana acaulis o‘simligining ko‘k gullaridan ajratilgan, antotsianin sinfiga mansub o‘simlik pigmenti.

ex: In English, the suffix “-ian” often forms gentilic words, e.g., “Canadian.”
The word "O‘zbek" is used as a gentilic to indicate nationality.
gentilic.meta: Grammatika sohasida, shaxs yoki narsaning qaysi mamlakat, hudud yoki joyga mansub ekanligini bildiruvchi ot yoki sifat. Shuningdek, bunday ma’noni ifodalovchi qo‘shimcha yoki so‘z shakli.

ex: Gentish behavior is typical of a gentleman.
He always dresses gentishly and speaks politely.
gentish.meta: Janobga xos maqom, tashqi ko‘rinish yoki odob-axloq; janobona, muloyim va odobli.

ex: He longed to rise from peasantry to the ranks of the gentlehood.
In the days of old, the gentlehood were honored above all others.
gentlehood.meta: Gentlehood — bu tarixiy va eskirgan atama bo‘lib, zodagonlar sinfini, ya’ni ijtimoiy jihatdan yuqori mavqega ega bo‘lgan erkaklarni (ashrafni) umumiy holda anglatadi.

ex: We are honored by your gentlemanship’s presence.
May I inquire, your gentlemanship, whether you will attend the ball tonight?
gentlemanship.meta: Gentlemanship — tarixiy va hozir kam ishlatiladigan hurmatli murojaat shakli bo‘lib, “sizning janobligingiz” ma’nosida qo‘llaniladi. Bu ibora odatda "your gentlemanship" tarzida ishlatiladi va zodagon yoki hurmatli kishiga murojaat qilishda qo‘llanilgan.

ex: She spoke gentlewomanlike, with calm dignity and grace.
She carried herself in a gentlewomanlike manner at the royal banquet.
gentlewomanlike.meta: Gentlewomanlike — ayol kishining odob-axloq, muloyimlik, nafislik va ijtimoiy mavqega xos tarzda harakat qilishi yoki ko‘rinishini ifodalaydi. Bu sifat yoki ravish shaklida qo‘llanilib, “zodagon ayolga xos” tarzdagi xatti-harakatni bildiradi.

ex: Their formerly simple lifestyle has now become quite gentrified.
After years abroad, his manners became noticeably gentrified.
gentrified.meta: Gentrified — odam, turmush tarzi yoki ijtimoiy holatga nisbatan ishlatiladigan sifat bo‘lib, avvalgiga qaraganda yanada nafislashgan, madaniylashgan yoki obro‘-e’tibori ortgan holatni bildiradi.

ex: Discussions around glory-holes often involve concerns about anonymity and safety.
The adult venue had private booths, some with glory-holes.
glory-hole.meta: Glory-hole — odatda erkaklar hojatxonasida yoki jinsiy xizmat ko‘rsatiladigan joylarda devorlar orasiga maxsus qilib o‘yilgan teshik bo‘lib, u shaxsni ko‘rmasdan turib jinsiy aloqada bo‘lish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: Some people use the glory-hole to engage in anonymous sexual encounters.
The glory-hole is often found in men's public restrooms or certain adult venues.
glory-hole.meta: glory-hole (ot): odatda erkaklar uchun jamoat hojatxonalarining yoki jinsiy xizmat ko‘rsatadigan joylarning kabinalaridagi devorda joylashgan kichik teshik; odamlar anonim jinsiy aloqada bo‘lishlari uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Tourists gathered to watch the energetic goombay at the beach celebration.
The festival featured a traditional goombay performed by local dancers.
goombay.meta: Goombay — Bahama orollariga xos bo‘lgan an’anaviy baraban (goombay drum) yoki musiqasi jo‘rligida bajariladigan madaniy raqs turi.

ex: He owns a stable of fifteen-handers trained for jumping events.
The racehorse is an impressive sixteen-hander.
-hander.meta: -hander qo‘shimchasi otlarning bo‘yini ifodalashda ishlatiladi. Bu atama odatda sonlar bilan birikib, ot yelkasining balandligini “hand” birliklarida bildiradi. Bir “hand” (qo‘l bo‘yi) taxminan 4 dyuym (ya’ni 10.16 sm) ga teng.

ex: Harvesting medicinal herbs from the forest is a centuries-old tradition.
The villagers relied on harvesting wild berries for food during the dry season.
harvesting.meta: Harvesting — bu holatda qishloq xo‘jaligida yetishtirilmagan, balki tabiatda yovvoyi holda o‘sadigan o‘simliklar, mevalar, giyohlar yoki boshqa tabiiy resurslarni qo‘lda yoki vositalar yordamida to‘plash jarayonidir

ex: Successful harvesting ensures enough food supply for the winter.
The harvesting of wild berries takes place in late summer.
harvesting.meta: harvesting (ot): yovvoyi o‘sadigan o‘tlar, mevalar va boshqa mahsulotlarni yig‘ish jarayoni.

ex: Many public figures were exposed during the height of the MeToo campaign.
The MeToo movement gave survivors a platform to share their stories.
me-too.meta: Me-too — bu 2006-yilda boshlangan va 2017-yildan boshlab global miqyosda ommalashgan ijtimoiy harakat bo‘lib, u jinsiy zo‘ravonlik va tazyiq holatlarini fosh etish, ularning oldini olish va jabrlanganlarni qo‘llab-quvvatlashni maqsad qilgan.

ex: You need to hit your point number again before a seven comes up.
He rolled a five, so his point number is five.
point number.meta: Point number — bu craps deb ataluvchi zar o‘yinida o‘yinchi tomonidan birinchi tashlashda chiqqan va o‘yin davomida yana aynan shu raqamni chiqarishi kerak bo‘lgan raqamdir.

ex: In classic French dining rooms, a servante is a common piece of furniture.
The wine and cheese were placed on the servante for guests to help themselves.
servante.meta: Servante — bu fransuz madaniyatida ishlatiladigan maxsus yon stol bo‘lib, u ovqatlanish paytida ichimliklar, taomlar yoki idish-tovoqlarni joylashtirish uchun qo‘yiladi.

ex: The old manuscript spoke of the nobleman's servantry during the war.
His years of servantry to the lord were marked by loyalty.
servantry.meta: Servantry — bu tarixiy va kam ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, boshqaga xizmat qilish, ya’ni xodim, xizmatkor yoki qulluqchi sifatida ishlashni anglatadi. U ko‘proq feodal davr yoki eski ingliz tilidagi matnlarda uchraydi.

ex: The military-served personnel are eligible for housing benefits.
A police-served eviction notice was posted on the door.
served.meta: "Served" sifati ko‘pincha boshqa so‘z bilan birikib, qandaydir xizmat, yordam yoki boshqaruvga duch kelgan yoki undan foydalangan narsani bildiradi. Bu kim tomonidan xizmat ko‘rsatilganini aniqlovchi so‘zlar bilan birga ishlatiladi.

ex: The new grocery store is completely serve-self.
We ate at a small serve-self café near the station.
serve-self.meta: mijozlar xodim yordamisiz o‘zlari ovqat tanlaydigan, tovar oladigan yoki xizmatdan foydalanadigan joylar tushuniladi. Bu ko‘pincha restoranlar, kafelar, do‘konlar yoki avtomatlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Bu so‘z “self-service” degan iboraning sinonimidir.

ex: It’s a serve-yourself buffet — just grab a plate and help yourself.
The hotel offers a serve-yourself breakfast every morning.
serve-yourself.meta: mijozlar xodim yordamisiz o‘zlari ovqat yoki mahsulotlarni oladigan uslubga ega bo‘lgan tizim. Bunday joylarda xaridorlar mustaqil ravishda tanlov qiladi va xizmatdan foydalanadi. Bu atama "self-service" bilan bir xil ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: The device is now obsolete and serviceless.
We were stranded in a serviceless mountain village with no phone or internet connection.
serviceless.meta: Serviceless sifati bu yerda hech qanday xizmat turlari (masalan, transport, internet, telefon, elektr, yordam, diniy xizmat va boshqalar) mavjud bo‘lmagan joy yoki holatni bildiradi.

ex: Please use the service plate to serve the appetizers.
The roast lamb was brought out on a large service plate.
service plate.meta: Service plate bu – asosiy taomlar, gazaklar yoki boshqa ovqatlar dasturxonga olib kelinayotganda yoki mehmonlarga tortilayotganda ishlatiladigan katta likop yoki idishdir.

ex: Your mortgage servicer is responsible for collecting your monthly payments.
The loan servicer sent a reminder about the overdue payment.
servicer.meta: Servicer bu – odatda bank yoki kredit tashkiloti emas, balki qarzdor mijozlardan to‘lovlarni yig‘ib, ularni asl qarz beruvchiga yetkazib beradigan oraliq tashkilotdir.

ex: The hotel’s service room is located behind the kitchen.
The waiters entered the service room to collect the dishes.
service room.meta: Service room — bu biror xizmat ko‘rsatiladigan yoki boshqa xonaga yordamchi bo‘lgan maxsus xona. Ular turli maqsadlarda — ovqat tortish, tayyorlash, tozalash, saqlash yoki xizmat ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Several species of service trees are cultivated in temperate gardens for their decorative leaves and fruit.
The European service tree (Sorbus aucuparia) is known for its clusters of red berries.
service tree.meta: Service tree — bu Sorbus jinsiga kiruvchi daraxtlar yoki butalarning umumiy nomidir. Bu atama o‘ziga xos so‘z yoki ibora bilan birga ishlatiladi va turli xil turlarni (xususan Sorbus aucuparia) bildiradi.

ex: Artillery manuals from the 19th century specify the service weight of shells for different guns.
The cannon’s service weight determined the size of the projectile used in battle.
service weight.meta: Service weight — harbiy sohada, aynan artilleriya qurollarida, foydalanish uchun maxsus belgilangan snaryad yoki o‘qning og‘irligi. Bu og‘irlik qurolning to‘g‘ri ishlashi va samaradorligini ta’minlash uchun standart sifatida qabul qilingan.

ex: The manual mentions servicing as the labor necessary to maintain the machinery.
In old texts, servicing often referred to the effort put into completing a task.
servicing.meta: Servicing — ma’lum bir maqsadga erishish uchun bajarilgan ish yoki mehnat. Bu so‘z hozirda kam qo‘llaniladi va ko‘proq tarixiy yoki eskirgan atama sifatida qaraladi.

ex: Workers collect their materials from the serving room.
The finished garments are sent to the serving room for inspection.
serving room.meta: Serving room — matо ishlab chiqarish yoki kiyim to‘qish fabrikasida, tayyor mahsulotlarni nazoratga topshirish, ishchilarga materiallarni taqsimlash va shunga o‘xshash jarayonlar uchun mo‘ljallangan xona.

ex: A new seven-a-side tournament is starting.
They played seven-a-side football.
seven-a-side.meta: Yetti kishilik — har bir jamoada yetti o‘yinchi bo‘lgan holda (o‘yin turi). Asosan “yetti kishilik o‘ynash” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Their production volume increased sevenfold.
This year’s income was seven times as much as last year.
seven-double.meta: Yettibarobar — miqdorni ifodalovchi ibora sifatida ishlatiladi; biror narsaning yettibarobar ko‘p miqdorini bildiradi.

ex: Seven-inch records usually contain a single song.
He bought a seven-inch vinyl record.
seven-inch.meta: Yetti dyuymli — diametri yetti dyuym bo‘lgan, odatda 45 rpm tezlikda ijro etiladigan va har ikki tomonida bitta trekdan iborat yozuv (rekord).

ex: The author sold his book for sevenpence.
He bought a seven-pennyworth newspaper from the shop.
seven-pennyworth.meta: Yetti penslik narsa — yetti pensga sotib olinadigan yoki sotiladigan miqdor; ayniqsa gazeta yoki kitob kabi yetti pensga sotilgan narsa. Hozirda kam ishlatiladi.

ex: He takes care of the lightest cat among the pets, a seven-pounder.
The newborn baby was a seven-pounder.
seven-pounder.meta: Yetti funtlik — og‘irligi taxminan yetti funt (taxminan 3,2 kg) bo‘lgan shaxs, hayvon yoki narsa.

ex: The fashion of the seventies was very popular.
This movie relates to the seventies era.
seventies.meta: Yetmishlar — bir asrning yetmishdan yetmish to‘qqizgacha bo‘lgan yillarini ifodalaydigan atama; ayniqsa, 20-asrning yetmish yillari davri.

ex: In seven-up, players try to tap each other with their hands.
The children played seven-up at school.
seven-up.meta: Sevin-ap — asosan Shimoliy Amerikada keng tarqalgan bolalar o‘yini; unda yetti tanlangan ishtirokchi guruhdagi boshqa o‘yinchilardan birini qo‘l bilan urishga harakat qiladi.

ex: The man shirted in white entered the house.
The boy shirted in red was looking out of the window.
shirted.meta: (biror rang, tur, holatdagi) ko‘ylak kiygan — ma’lum tur, rang yoki holatdagi ko‘ylak kiygan odam yoki shaxsni ifodalaydi.

ex: The shirtless swimmer jumped into the pool.
The photo shows a group of shirtless men playing football.
shirtless.meta: Ko‘ylaksiz – kiyimdan, xususan ko‘ylakdan mahrum bo‘lgan, ko‘ylak kiymaslik holatini ifodalaydigan sifat. Masalan, odamlar yoki guruh ko‘ylaksiz bo‘lsa, ular ko‘ylak kiyishmagan.

ex: The novel described a shirtwaister walking through the city streets.
In the early 1900s, many young women were shirtwaisters.
shirtwaister.meta: Ko‘ylakli ayol — kiyimi ko‘ylakdan iborat bo‘lgan, ya’ni ko‘ylakli libos kiyadigan ayol. Bu so‘z eskirgan va kam ishlatiladigan ma’noga ega.

ex: Many East Asian languages contain Sinicisms due to historical contact with Chinese culture.
The poem includes several Sinicisms borrowed from classical Chinese.
sinicism.meta: Xitoycha so‘z — boshqa tilga xitoy tilidan olingan yoki kiritilgan so‘z, ifoda yoki maqol.

ex: The Sinitic languages include Mandarin, Cantonese, and many other dialects.
Mandarin is a Sinitic language spoken by millions.
sinitic.meta: Sinitik – Sharqiy Osiyo tillarining umumiy nomi, ayniqsa, Xitoy tillari dialektlari kiradigan Sino-Tibet til oilasining bir tarmog‘i.

ex: Linguists study the Sino-Tibetan languages to understand their mutual influences.
The Sino-Tibetan variety of Tibetan contains many Chinese loanwords.
sino-tibetan.meta: Sino-Tibet – tilshunoslikda Xitoy tilidan kuchli ta’sir olgan Tibet tilining bir varianti yoki unga oid narsalar. Masalan, bu tilda ko‘plab xitoycha so‘zlar bor yoki xitoy elementlari ishlatiladi.

ex: The article was full of swivel-eyed ideas that few people agreed with.
His swivel-eyed rant about conspiracy theories scared everyone.
swivel-eyed.meta: Aqldan ozgan, fanatik — so‘zlar, g‘oyalar yoki fikrlar uchun ishlatiladi, juda g‘ayrioddiy, aqldan ozgan yoki haddan tashqari ishtiyoq bilan ifodalangan.

ex: They called him a ting-tang in contempt, but he was skilled at his trade.+
The old ting-tang wandered from village to village fixing pots and pans.
ting-tang.meta: Kuyovchi — eski paytlarda temir buyumlarni ta’mir qiluvchi, kichik ustachilik qiluvchi kishi. Bu so‘z eskirgan va kam ishlatiladi. Ba’zida haqorat yoki e’tiborsizlik bildirish uchun ishlatilgan.

ex: The city’s markets are a toy shop for shoppers looking for unique items.
The library is a toy shop of knowledge with books on every subject.
toy shop.meta: O‘yinchoqlar do‘koni — turli xil qiziqarli va rang-barang narsalar to‘plangan joy, tanlash uchun keng imkoniyat beradigan makon. Bu ibora ko‘pincha figurativ ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: Many early Zionites worked hard to promote the establishment of a Jewish homeland.
He was a passionate Zionite, believing in the return of the Jewish nation to Palestine.
zionite.meta: Yahudiy xalqi orasida Falastinda yahudiy millatini qayta tiklash harakatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs. (Endi kam ishlatiladi, tarixiy atama)

ex: The data follows a typical Zipf curve.
The Zipf distribution describes the frequency of words in natural languages.
zipf.meta: Zipf — statistikada Zipf qonuniga asoslangan tushunchalarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan atama. Bu qonun va uning ilovalari tilshunoslik, ma’lumotlarni tahlil qilish kabi sohalarda so‘zlar yoki elementlarning chastotaviy taqsimotini ifodalaydi.

ex: The party was dull and zipless without music.
After the long day, he felt completely zipless.
zipless.meta: zipless (sifat): kuch, jon, faollik yoki hayajon yetishmaydigan holatni ifodalaydi; bo‘sh, zaif, hayajonsiz, energiyasiz.

ex: The jacket has a ziplock closure to keep the wind out.
I keep snacks in a ziplock bag to keep them fresh.
ziplock.meta: ziplock (ot): zip yordamida yopiladigan yoki mahkamlanadigan narsani ifodalaydi; ayniqsa, ichidagi narsalarni saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan, zip bilan yopiladigan sumka yoki qop.

ex: Please put your belongings in a zip-up bag.
He wore a comfortable zip-up sweatshirt during the hike.
zip-up.meta: zip-up (sifat/ot): zip yordamida yopiladigan kiyim, oyoq kiyim yoki sumkani bildiradi. Ko‘pincha, zip bilan yopiladigan futbolka, flees kabi kiyimlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: We heard a zizzy sound coming from the machinery.
The old fan made a zizzy noise all night.
zizzy.meta: zizzy (sifat): shanqir-shanqir yoki jiring-jiring kabi baland va doimiy shovqin yoki vurnoq tovush bilan xarakterlanadigan; hozirda kam ishlatiladi.

ex: Many celebrities have faced cancel culture after controversial statements.
Cancel culture has become a powerful force on social media.
cancel culture.meta: cancel culture (ot): kimnidir yoki tashkilotni jamoatchilik oldida ochiqchasiga boykot qilish, rad etish yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlashni to‘xtatish amaliyoti; ko‘pincha ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda salbiy munosabat bildirilgan shaxs yoki guruhga nisbatan qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Chew toys help keep dogs' teeth clean and healthy.
The puppy loves playing with his chew toy.
chew toy.meta: chew toy (ot): it yoki boshqa uy hayvonlari uchun mo‘ljallangan, odatda qattiq rezinadan tayyorlangan, chaynash uchun ishlatiladigan o‘yinchoq; u hayvonlarni rag‘batlantirish va tish sog‘ligini saqlashga yordam beradi.

ex: Many families experience the truth of clogs to clogs when their fortunes vanish after a few generations.
The saying "clogs to clogs in three generations" warns about the loss of family wealth over time.
clogs to clogs.meta: clogs to clogs (maqol): birinchi avlodda to‘plangan boylik uchinchi avlodga o‘tguncha yo‘qolib ketishini ifodalovchi inglizcha maqol; oilaviy mol-mulkni saqlash va uning avlodlarga o‘tishini ehtiyotkorlik bilan boshqarish zarurligini bildiradi.

ex: Each side had the opportunity to give their closing argument before the verdict.
The lawyer presented a strong closing argument to convince the jury.
closing argument.meta: closing argument (ot): sud jarayonining oxirida sud hay’atiga qaratilgan og‘zaki bayonot; bu yerda har bir tomon dalillarni qisqacha takrorlab, sud hay’atini o‘z tarafiga o‘tkazishga harakat qiladi.

ex: She bought a large cuddly toy bear for her daughter.
The child hugged his favorite cuddly toy tightly.
cuddly toy.meta: cuddly toy (ot): odatda matodan tayyorlangan va yumshoq to‘ldirish bilan to‘ldirilgan, bolalar uchun mo‘ljallangan yumshoq o‘yinchoq; bolalar uni quchoqlashni yaxshi ko‘radi.

ex: The new supplement is marketed as an elixir of youth that restores energy and vitality.
Many myths tell of an elixir of youth that can make a person young forever.
elixir of youth.meta: elixir of youth (ot birikmasi): yoshlikni uzoqroq saqlash yoki qarish jarayonini teskari yo‘nalishda o‘zgartirishga qodir deb hisoblangan dori yoki vosita; shuningdek, odamga quvvat va hayotiylik beruvchi narsa ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The government provided special support for essential workers in healthcare and emergency services.
During the pandemic, essential workers kept hospitals and supermarkets running.
essential worker.meta: essential worker (ot birikmasi): ma’lum bir sohada yoki tashkilotda juda muhim ahamiyatga ega bo‘lgan ishchi yoki xodim; ayniqsa, jamoat uchun zarur bo‘lgan xizmatlarni taqdim etuvchi xodim.

ex: Folk religion often includes rituals and customs passed down through generations.
Many rural areas still practice folk religion alongside mainstream faiths.
folk religion.meta: folk religion (ot birikmasi): ma’lum bir jamoaga xos, yirik diniy tashkilotlarga aloqasi bo‘lmagan ma’naviy e’tiqodlar va amaliyotlar; shuningdek, an’anaviy diniy shakl.

ex: The garden is full of fresh garlic chives growing alongside other herbs.
Garlic chives are often used in Asian cuisine for their mild garlic flavor.
garlic chive.meta: garlic chive (ot): asosan ko‘plikda ishlatiladigan Osiyo o‘simligi, Allium tuberosum oilasiga mansub; uzun, maysaga o‘xshash barglari bor va ta’mi sarimsoqqa o‘xshaydi.

ex: She felt a shock of the new when she moved to a foreign country.
The shock of the new art style surprised many viewers.
shock of the new.meta: Biror yangi, hayajonli yoki bezovta qiluvchi narsaga duch kelganda paydo bo‘ladigan hayrat, noqulaylik yoki shodlik holati. Bu holat yangi va odatdagidan farqli bo‘lgan, ta’sirchan, qiziqarli yoki bezovta qiluvchi narsalar sabab yuzaga keladi.

ex: The stimulus package helped increase consumer spending and boost the economy.
The government introduced a stimulus package to support businesses during the recession.
stimulus package.meta: Hukumat tomonidan iqtisodiy o‘sishni rag‘batlantirish maqsadida vaqtinchalik moliyaviy choralar majmuasi. Ayniqsa iqtisodiy pasayish (rejessiya) davrida iqtisodni jonlantirish uchun qabul qilinadi.

ex: Don’t stir the pot if you don’t want to cause trouble.
He likes to stir the pot by bringing up controversial topics.
to stir the pot.meta: Biror vaziyatda odamlar orasida nizolar, mojarolar yoki muammolarni ataylab yoki bevosita qo‘zg‘atish.Odamlarni bahs-munozaraga yoki ziddiyatga jalb qilish.

ex: Libraries often serve as a third place for community gatherings.
The café is considered a third place where people can relax outside of home and work.
third place.meta: Uy ham, ish joyi ham bo‘lmagan, odamlar dam olishlari va ijtimoiy aloqalar o‘rnatishlari uchun mo‘ljallangan jamoat joyi.

ex: It’s a good idea to dip your toe in the water before investing a lot of money.
She decided to dip her toe in the water before committing to the new project.
to dip one’s toe in.meta: Yangi faoliyat yoki tajribani ehtiyotkorlik bilan, asta-sekin boshlash. To‘liq sho‘ng‘imasdan avval kichik qadamlar bilan sinab ko‘rish.

ex: Trying out a small market first is a good toe in the water before expanding.
The company decided to put its toe in the water by launching a pilot program.
toe in the water.meta: Yangi faoliyat yoki tashabbusni kichik miqyosda, xavfsiz va asta-sekin sinab ko‘rish usuli. Bu yangi ishning muvaffaqiyatini yoki ishlash qobiliyatini past xavf bilan tekshirish uchun qilinadi.

ex: Some couples use the withdrawal method as their birth control technique.
The withdrawal method is less reliable than other forms of contraception.
withdrawal method.meta: Jinsiy aloqada urug‘ tushishining oldini olish uchun jinsiy a’zo organga tushishidan oldin chiqarib olinadigan tug‘ilishdan saqlanish usuli. Bu usulda erkak ejakulyatsiyadan oldin penisni vaginalardan chiqaradi.

ex: The almuce is traditionally lined with grey fur.
The canon wore an almuce during the religious ceremony.
almuce.meta: Diniy orden a’zolari, ayniqsa kanoniklar tomonidan kiyiladigan, kulrang mo‘ynadan yasalgan yoki ichki qismi mo‘yna bilan qoplangan bosh kiyim yoki paltorcha. Bu kiyim diniy marosimlarda yoki xizmatlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Among the Nguni people, Amabhunu refers collectively to Afrikaners.
The Amabhunu speak Afrikaans as their primary language.
amabhunu.meta: Nguni tillarida ko‘plik shaklida ishlatiladigan so‘z. Afrikanerlarni (Janubiy Afrikadagi nemis va gollandiyalik ildizli aholi) umumiy nomlash uchun qo‘llanadi.

ex: If you prefer wines that are not too dry, try an amabile.
This wine is classified as amabile, meaning it has a slightly sweet taste.
amabile.meta: Italiyan vinosining ta’mi biroz shirin yoki shirinroq bo‘lgan turi. Qattiq shirin bo‘lmagan, lekin yoqimli shirinlik darajasida bo‘ladi.

ex: In Japanese culture, amae is seen as an important part of social relationships.
The concept of amae describes a child's natural desire to depend on their parents’ care.
amae.meta: Yapon psixologi Takeo Doi tomonidan ishlatilgan tushuncha. Boshqalarning mehr-muhabbati va e’tiboriga faol, qasddan bog‘lanish istagi yoki ehtiyoji.

ex: Critics argue that amakudari can lead to conflicts of interest and corruption.
Amakudari is a common practice in Japan where retired government officials take executive roles in private companies.
amakudari.meta: Yaponiya madaniyatida nafaqaga chiqqan davlat xodimini xususiy yoki davlatga yaqin tashkilotlarda yuqori lavozimga tayinlash amaliyoti. Bu orqali sobiq rasmiylar o‘z ta’sirini saqlab qolishlari va turli imtiyozlardan foydalanishlari mumkin.

ex: Police are cracking down on amalaita members involved in gang-related crimes.
The amalaita are notorious for their violent activities in the city.
amalaita.meta: Shahar hududida ko‘pincha zo‘ravonlikka oid turli jinoyatlar sodir etuvchi guruhlar. Ushbu guruhlarning a’zolari ham shunday ataladi. Ko‘pincha sifat sifatida ham qo‘llanadi (amalaita guruhlari, amalaita a’zolari kabi).

ex: The Bible mentions the conflicts between the Israelites and the Amalek.
The Amalek were known as fierce nomads south of Canaan.
amalek.meta: Qadimiy tarixda Qan’an hududining janubida yashagan ko‘chmanchi xalq. Ularning a’zolari Amalekiylar deb ataladi. Bibliya va qadimiy manbalarda tilga olinadi.

ex: Amalekite enemies attacked the land of Israel.
Amalekites fought many battles with the people of Israel.
amalekite.meta: Noun: Qadimiy Bibliya davrida Kanaan janubida yashagan ko'chmanchi xalqning a'zosi.Adjective: Amalekiy qabilasiga oid yoki undan kelib chiqqan.

ex: The architecture of Amalfi is a prime example of Amalfitan style.
He was an Amalfitan, highly experienced in the art of seafaring.
amalfitan.meta: Noun: Italiyaning janubidagi Amalfi shahridan yoki sobiq Amalfi gertsogligidan bo‘lgan kishi.Adjective: Amalfi shahri yoki uning madaniyati, tarixi yoki aholisiga oid.

ex: They were displaced during the Mfecane period and settled in different parts of southern Africa.
The AmaMfengu people speak Xhosa and have a rich cultural heritage.
amamfengu.meta: Xosa tilida so‘zlashuvchi janubi-sharqiy Afrikadagi xalq. Ular Mfekan davrida (Mfecane) turli urushlar va ko‘chishlar natijasida joyidan ko‘chirilgan bir necha boshpanasiz guruhlarning avlodlari bo‘lib, keyinchalik janubi-sharqiy Afrikaga joylashgan.

ex: At the restaurant, the vegetables were served amandine, topped with slivered almonds.
They prepared green beans amandine for dinner.
amandine.meta: Asosan AQShda ishlatiladi. Bodom bilan bezatilgan yoki bodom bilan pishirilgan taomni bildiradi. Odatda so‘zdan keyin keladi (postmodifier), masalan: “ko‘k loviya amandine” — “bodomli ko‘k loviya”.

ex: The crowd shouted 'Amandla!' as the leader stepped forward to speak.
'Amandla!' — the people responded with raised fists during the protest.
amandla.meta: Aslida janubiy Afrikada paydo bo‘lgan. Siyosiy faollar tomonidan apartheidga va adolatsizlikka qarshi norozilik namoyishlarida “quvvat” yoki “kuch” degan ma’noda ishlatilgan shior.

ex: He was her amant de cœur — loved for who he truly was.
She had many suitors, but only one amant de cœur.
amant de cœur.meta: Fransuz tilidan olingan ibora bo‘lib, ayni o‘zi uchun, ya’ni jismoniy jozibasi, shaxsiy sifatlari yoki qalban sevilgan erkak sevgilini anglatadi.

ex: He gifted her an amatorio bearing her likeness and a verse of poetry.
The museum’s collection includes a 15th-century amatorio depicting a noblewoman.
amatorio.meta: Bezakli sopol buyum, odatda majolica (italyancha sirlangan sopol) texnikasida ishlangan bo‘lib, sevgi timsoli sifatida, sevgili uchun sovg‘a qilinadi. Ayniqsa, ayolning portreti va unga atalgan iltifotli yozuvlar tasvirlangan.

ex: She adjusted the amaut to keep the child warm and close to her body.
The baby slept peacefully in the amaut as his mother walked across the snow.
amaut.meta: Amaut — Inuit ayollari tomonidan ishlatiladigan, kichik bolani orqada ko‘tarib yurish uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus qopcha yoki kiyim. Bu qopcha odatda ayolning kiyimining bir qismi bo‘lib, bolani tanaga yaqin va issiq tutishga imkon beradi.

ex: She wore traditional amaXhosa clothing during the ceremony.
The amaXhosa have a rich oral tradition and history of resistance.
amaxhosa.meta: Janubiy Afrikada yashovchi, Bantu tilida so‘zlashuvchi katta etnik guruh — Xosa xalqi. “Ama-” old qo‘shimchasi ko‘plikni bildiradi, shuning uchun amaXhosa — “Xosa xalqi” yoki “Xosalarning o‘zlari” degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: He sought therapy to overcome his amaxophobia after a traumatic accident.
Her amaxophobia was so severe that she avoided cars entirely.
amaxophobia.meta: Amaxofobiya — odamning har qanday transport vositasida, ayniqsa avtomobilda yurish yoki haydovchi bo‘lishdan haddan tashqari qo‘rqishi (psixologik fobiya).

ex: Amazake is naturally sweet due to the fermentation of rice starches.
On New Year's Day, many people in Japan drink warm amazake for good health.
amazake.meta: Amazake — yapon oshxonasiga xos bo‘lgan, guruch, suv va koji (fermentatsiyalovchi zamburug‘ – Aspergillus oryzae) yordamida tayyorlanadigan shirin, past yoki nol darajadagi alkogol saqlovchi ichimlikdir.

ex: That concert was totally amazeballs!
You got us front row tickets? Amazeballs!
amazeballs.meta: “Amazeballs” — bu “amazing” (ajoyib) so‘zining kulgili va orttirilgan shakli bo‘lib, do‘stona, erkin kontekstlarda qo‘llanadi. Odatda ijobiy hodisa yoki narsani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Amazigh jewelry is known for its intricate silver designs.
The Amazigh have preserved their language and culture for thousands of years.
amazigh.meta: Amazigh (ko‘plik shakli: Imazighen) — Shimoliy Afrikada qadimdan yashab kelayotgan tub xalqlardan biri bo‘lib, ko‘pincha Berberlar deb ataladi. Ular Liviya, Jazoir, Marokash, Tunis, Mali va Niger kabi mamlakatlarda yashaydilar.

ex: The amazone became fashionable among aristocratic women in 19th-century Europe.
She wore an elegant amazone while riding through the estate.
amazone.meta: Uzbekcha ta’rif (lotin): Amazone — tarixan, ayollar uchun mo‘ljallangan chavandoz libosi, ayniqsa 18–19-asrlarda rasmiy yoki hashamatli ot minish uchun ishlatilgan maxsus kiyim. U odatda uzun yubkali yoki maxsus tikilgan shimli kostyumdan iborat bo‘lgan.

ex: Vase paintings of Amazonomachia were popular in ancient Athens.
The Parthenon frieze includes a detailed Amazonomachia scene.
amazonomachia.meta: Amazonomachiya — qadimgi yunon san’atida, Amazonkalar (afsonaviy jangchi ayollar) va yunon qahramonlari o‘rtasidagi afsonaviy jang sahnalarini tasvirlovchi san’at asari (masalan, friz, kulolchilik buyumlari, haykaltaroshlik).

ex: Amazonomachy was a popular theme in ancient Greek vase painting.
The west metope of the Parthenon depicts an Amazonomachy between Greeks and Amazons.
amazonomachy.meta: Amazonomachy — qadimgi yunon san’atida Amazonkalar (afsonaviy jangchi ayollar) va yunon qahramonlari o‘rtasidagi afsonaviy janglarni tasvirlovchi sahnalar, odatda frizlar, keramika buyumlari yoki haykallarda tasvirlangan.

ex: The amaZulu language, isiZulu, is one of South Africa’s official languages.
The amaZulu have a proud history of resistance and cultural preservation.
amazulu.meta: amaZulu — Janubiy Afrikaning KwaZulu-Natal provinsiyasida asosiy aholini tashkil qiluvchi bantu tilida so‘zlashuvchi xalqlardan biri. “amaZulu” — bu "zulular" degan ko‘plik shaklidir (zulular tilida).

ex: She studied Amhara traditions during her research trip to Ethiopia.
The Amhara have played a dominant role in Ethiopian politics and culture.
amhara.meta: Amhara — Efiopiyaning markaziy va shimoli-g‘arbiy hududlarida yashovchi, amxar tilida so‘zlashuvchi xalqlardan biri. Ular Efiopiyaning tarixiy, siyosiy va madaniy hayotida muhim rol o‘ynagan. Amxara tili (Amharic) — Efiopiyaning rasmiy tillaridan biridir.

ex: The government announced a new development project in the Amharan region.
Amharan culture is deeply rooted in Orthodox Christianity.
amharan.meta: Amharan — Efiopiyaning Amxara mintaqasi yoki u yerda yashovchi amxar xalqi bilan bog‘liq narsalarni ifodalovchi atama. So‘z madaniy, geografik yoki etnik ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The Amharinya language has its roots in the ancient Ge'ez script.
He is fluent in Amharinya and uses it daily at home.
amharinya.meta: Amharinya — Efiopiyaning markaziy qismida yashovchi amxar xalqi tomonidan so‘zlashiladigan semit til oilasiga mansub til. Bu til ingliz tilida ko‘proq Amharic nomi bilan tanilgan va Efiopiyaning rasmiy tillaridan biridir.

ex: She’s never alone—her loyal amico is always by her side.
He greeted his old amico with a warm hug.
amico.meta: Amico — bu so‘z italyan tilidan olingan bo‘lib, ingliz tilida "friend" (do‘st) yoki "companion" ma’nosida ishlatiladi. U ko‘pincha norasmiy, samimiy yoki madaniy rang beruvchi shaklda ishlatiladi. Boshqa o‘xshash so‘z: amigo (ispan tilidan).

ex: The Amidah includes prayers for peace, health, and forgiveness.
The congregation rose to recite the Amidah.
amidah.meta: Amidah — bu yahudiy dinidagi eng muhim ibodatlardan biri bo‘lib, ibodat qiluvchilar turib holatda o‘qiydigan va bir nechta duolar (barakalashlar) dan iborat bo‘lgan matndir.

ex: They added extra armor to the amidship section of the vessel.
The explosion occurred amidship, damaging the engine room.
amidship.meta: Amidship — bu so‘z dengizchilik (kemachilik) terminlaridan bo‘lib, kema yoki har qanday suvda yuruvchi transport vositasining o‘rtasida, ya’ni old va orqa (burun va qopqa) orasidagi markaziy qismda joylashganlikni bildiradi

ex: She received a letter from her chère amie in Lyon.
He introduced her as his amie from Paris.
amie.meta: Amie — bu so‘z fransuz tilidan olingan bo‘lib, ingliz tilida “female friend” (ayol do‘st), “sweetheart” (sevgili) yoki “lover” (oshno, oshiq qiz) ma’nolarida ishlatiladi. U odatda sevgi yoki samimiylikni ifodalovchi kontekstlarda qo‘llanadi.

ex: The poet often addressed his verses to a mysterious amiga.
Maria is my closest amiga—we’ve known each other since childhood.
amiga.meta: Amiga — bu so‘z ispan tilidan olingan bo‘lib, ingliz tilida ayol do‘st yoki ayol hamroh, shuningdek tarixan sevgili ayol ma’nolarini bildirgan. Zamonaviy ingliz tilida esa u odatda “female friend” (oddiy do‘st ayol) ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Amigurumi requires patience and attention to detail.
She sells handmade amigurumi animals at the craft market.
amigurumi.meta: Amigurumi — bu yapon san’at shakli bo‘lib, ipdan to‘qish (crochet yoki knitting) usulida tayyorlangan kichik, yumshoq, ichi to‘ldirilgan o‘yinchoqlarni yaratishni anglatadi.

ex: Free pizza makes everything better, amirite or amirite?
Mondays are the worst, amirite?
amirite.meta: Amirite — bu ingliz tilidagi “Am I right?” (Men to‘g‘rimanmi?) iborasining norasmiy, qisqartirilgan va odatda yozma yoki internet so‘zlashuvida kinoyali, kulgili, yoki do‘stona ohangda ishlatiladigan shaklidir.

ex: An elderly Amishman greeted us with a quiet nod.
The Amishman drove his horse-drawn buggy into town.
amishman.meta: Amishman — bu Amishlar jamoasiga mansub erkak degan ma’noni anglatadi. Amishlar — bu Mennonit cherkovining juda qattiq diniy va an’anaviy hayot tarziga rioya qiluvchi oqimiga mansub nasroniy jamoa

ex: It was an amitié amoureuse—neither just friendship nor a committed relationship.
Their amitié amoureuse lasted for years, though they never called each other partners.
amitié amoureuse.meta: Amitié amoureuse — bu fransuz tilidagi ibora bo‘lib, ikki do‘st orasidagi romantik yoki jinsiy aloqadorlik bo‘lgan, lekin odatda rasmiy bo‘lmagan yoki boshqalar tomonidan tan olinmagan munosabatni ifodalaydi.

ex: The sunlight reflected off the ammil, making the branches sparkle.
By morning, the trees were coated in a delicate layer of ammil.
ammil.meta: Ammil — bu daraxtlar, binolar, simyog‘ochlar yoki boshqa sirtlarga yomg‘ir suvi tushib muzlaganida hosil bo‘ladigan shaffof muz qatlami. Odatda bu hodisa havo sovuq bo‘lgan kechalarda yoki erta tongda sodir bo‘ladi.

ex: Ammonian divisions help scholars compare passages across the Gospels.
The manuscript includes Ammonian sections marked in the margins.
ammonian.meta: Ammonian — Injil matnlarini tahlil qilishda ishlatiladigan termin bo‘lib, Iskandariyalik Ammoniy tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan deb hisoblangan Injilning bo‘linmalari (qismlari) tizimini bildiradi.

ex: The Amphionic power of his music could calm even the wildest animals.
The poet's Amphionic verses seemed to charm everyone who heard them.
amphionic.meta: Amphionic — yunon mifologiyasidagi Zevs va Antiopaning egizak o‘g‘li Amfion bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan sifat.

ex: The strange question left him at an amplush, completely speechless.
Caught in an amplush, she didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
amplush.meta: Amplush — juda qiyin, murakkab yoki chigal bir holatni bildiradi. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha biror odam nima qilishni bilmay, hayron bo‘lib qolgan, yoki vaziyatni qanday hal qilishni bilmasdan noaniqlikda turgan holatni ifodalaydi

ex: Amratian culture represents a key phase in early Egyptian societal development.
The site yielded many Amratian pottery fragments typical of the predynastic era.
amratian.meta: Amratian — Misrshunos olim U. F. M. Petri tomonidan predinastik Misr (fir’avnlar sulolalari boshlanishidan oldingi davr) madaniyatini Naqada davriga ajratishda belgilangan uch bosqichdan birinchisiga berilgan nom.

ex: The preparation of amrit is done with great reverence and strict rituals.
During the Amrit Sanchar ceremony, initiates drink amrit as a symbol of spiritual rebirth.
amrit.meta: Amrit — bu Hindistonning sikx dinida muhim ahamiyatga ega bo‘lgan muqaddas sirop, odatda shakar va suvdan tayyorlanadi. U Amrit Sanchar deb nomlanuvchi sikxlar sadoqatga kirish marosimi paytida ichiladi.

ex: Amritdhari Sikhs wear the five Ks as symbols of their devotion.
After taking part in the Amrit Sanchar, he became an Amritdhari and committed to the Sikh code of conduct.
amritdhari.meta: Amritdhari — bu Amrit Sanchar (sikxlar tashabbus marosimi) orqali Khalsa (sikxlarning sadoqatli jamoasi)ga qabul qilingan shaxs. U Amrit ichish marosimi orqali o‘zini din va uning qonun-qoidalariga to‘liq bag‘ishlagan bo‘ladi.

ex: Cops are coming, we gotta amscray!
This is private property — amscray!
amscray.meta: Amscray — bu sleng so‘z bo‘lib, "tezda jo‘namoq" yoki "ket" degan ma’noni bildiradi. Bu so‘z imperativ (buyruq) shaklida ishlatiladi va tezda ketishni talab qiluvchi og‘zaki nutqda uchraydi.

ex: Many Amsterdammers commute by bicycle every day.
She is a proud Amsterdammer who loves her city's canals and culture.
amsterdammer.meta: Amsterdammer — bu Niderlandiyadagi Amsterdam shahrida tug‘ilgan yoki yashaydigan odamni anglatadi. Bu so‘z shahar fuqarosi yoki u yerlik inson haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

ex: Each amt had its own council and administrative head.
The town falls within the borders of the Sønderborg amt in Denmark.
amt.meta: Amt — asosan Daniya, Islandiya, Germaniya va Norvegiyada ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, ma’muriy hududiy bo‘linma yoki okrugni bildiradi. Bu hududlar odatda davlat boshqaruvi yoki mahalliy boshqaruv uchun tashkil etilgan.

ex: That’s exactamundo what I was thinking!
You got it, correctamundo!
-amundo.meta: -amundo — bu inglizcha norasmiy va asosan hazilomuz yoki yoqimli ohangdagi kuchaytiruvchi qo‘shimcha bo‘lib, odatda sifatlarga ulanadi.

ex: Amurca is the watery sediment left after pressing olives for oil.
The Romans used amurca as a pesticide and a cleaning agent.
amurca.meta: Amurca — bu zaytunning yog‘i siqib olingach qoladigan suvli va loyqa yon mahsulot bo‘lib, zaytun chiqindisi yoki cho‘kmasi deb ham ataladi. U qadimda ba’zan o‘g‘it, insektitsid yoki sirt tozalovchi vosita sifatida ishlatilgan.

ex: Despite his love for concerts, he remained completely amusical.
Her amusical nature made it hard for her to follow the rhythm.
amusical.meta: Amusical — bu odamda musiqiy iste’dod, ohangdorchilik yoki musiqiy sezuvchanlikning yo‘qligini bildiruvchi sifatdir. Bu so‘z musika bilan bog‘liq hech qanday qobiliyatga ega bo‘lmagan yoki musiqani anglay olmaydigan odamga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The statue was dressed anachronismatically in 20th-century clothes.
The film portrays medieval knights anachronismatically using modern slang.
anachronismatically.meta: Anachronismatically — bu biror narsa yoki voqeani o‘z zamonidan tashqarida yoki noo‘rin tarixiy kontekstda tasvirlash yoki ko‘rsatish tarzida degan ma’noni bildiradi.

ex: His costume was entirely anachronistical for a Victorian-themed event.
The novel contains several anachronistical references to technology not yet invented.
anachronistical.meta: Anachronistical — bu so‘z biror narsa o‘z davriga tegishli bo‘lmagan holda ko‘rsatilganda yoki tasvirlanganda ishlatiladi. Bu tarixiy haqiqatga to‘g‘ri kelmaydigan, zamonlar aralashuvi yuz bergan holat uchun qo‘llanadi

ex: The king in the story spoke anachronistically, using modern slang.
The movie set in ancient Rome anachronistically features wristwatches.
anachronistically.meta: Anachronistically — bu so‘z biror voqea, buyum yoki fikr o‘z zamonidan tashqarida yoki tarixiy kontekstga mos kelmaydigan tarzda ko‘rsatilgan holatni bildiradi.

ex: Anachronizing can distort the understanding of historical events.
The historian criticized the film for its anachronizing of medieval culture.
anachronizing.meta: Anachronizing — bu atama biror shaxs, narsa yoki g‘oyani o‘ziga tegishli bo‘lmagan tarixiy davrga joylashtirish, ya’ni tarixiy kontekstga mos kelmaydigan holatda tasvirlash yoki ifodalash harakatini bildiradi.

ex: Cinematic anachrony is common in non-linear storytelling.
The novel uses anachrony to reveal the protagonist's past gradually.
anachrony.meta: Anachrony — adabiy tanqidda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, u hikoya ichida voqealarning sodir bo‘lish tartibi bilan ularning syujetda taqdim etilish tartibi orasidagi tafovutni bildiradi.

ex: Anacoluthal constructions often appear in spoken language and informal writing.
The sentence was anacoluthal, breaking the expected grammatical structure.
anacoluthal.meta: Anacoluthal — gap yoki matnda sintaktik xatolik yoki to‘g‘ri grammatik bog‘lanishning buzilishi bilan tavsiflanadigan holatga oid

ex: His writing style was distinctly anacreontical, filled with playful and romantic imagery.
The poem had an anacreontical tone, celebrating love and joy with light-hearted verses.
anacreontical.meta: Anakreontik — qadimgi yunon shoiri Anakreonga oid yoki uning uslubiga xos bo‘lgan. Bu uslub odatda yengillik, o‘yin-kulgi, sevgi bayrami va zavqlanish mavzularini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: The term Anadyomene is often used in art history to describe depictions of Venus emerging from the water.
The statue depicted Venus Anadyomene rising gracefully from the sea.
anadyomene.meta: Anadiyomena — odatda keyin qo‘yiladigan sifat sifatida ishlatiladi. Yunon ma’budasi Venusa (Aphrodita) uchun epitet sifatida ishlatiladi, u dastlab mashhur yunon rassomi Apelles tomonidan yaratilgan rasmda tasvirlangan

ex: The delicate flavor of anago makes it a popular choice in Japanese cuisine.
Anago is often served grilled or as a topping for sushi.
anago.meta: Anago — Yapon oshxonasida ishlatiladigan turli sho‘r suvda yashovchi ilonbaliqlarning (ayniqsa oq dog‘li konger, Conger myriaster) go‘shti. Asosan sushi va boshqa yapon taomlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: Anagrammatization is a popular word game technique.
The anagrammatization of 'listen' results in 'silent'.
anagrammatization.meta: Anagrammatizatsiya — Bir so‘z, ibora yoki ism harflarini joyini almashtirib, boshqa so‘z, ibora yoki ism hosil qilish harakati yoki natijasi. Shuningdek, bunday holatning o‘zi.

ex: The puzzle involved the anagrammatizing of several famous words.
Anagrammatizing requires careful attention to each letter.
anagrammatizing.meta: Anagrammatizatsiya jarayoni — Bir so‘z, ibora yoki ism harflarini joyini almashtirish, boshqa so‘z, ibora yoki ism hosil qilish harakati yoki jarayoni. Qarang: anagrammatization.

ex: Anagrammed words can reveal hidden meanings in puzzles.
The word ‘listen’ is an anagrammed form of ‘silent’.
anagrammed.meta: Harflari joyi almashtirilgan, anagramma hosil qilingan; ya’ni anagramma bo‘lgan.

ex: Practicing meditation can help open the anahata center.
The anahata chakra is often associated with love and compassion.
anahata.meta: Yurak sohasiga to‘g‘ri keladigan, mehr-shafqat va sevgi kabi tuyg‘ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan chakra (energiya markazi). Asosan yoga va hind falsafasida yurak chakrasi sifatida tanilgan.

ex: He is an anak among men, towering above everyone else.
Anak was said to be a giant living in the ancient land of Canaan.
anak.meta: Qadimiy vaqtlar Qan’an janubida yashagani aytilgan ulkan odamlar (gigantlar) qabilasidan bir kishi. Shuningdek, juda baland yoki kuchli shaxsni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Anand Karaj is the traditional Sikh wedding ceremony.
The couple celebrated their Anand with family and friends.
anand.meta: Sikh diniy an’analariga oid, nikoh marosimi yoki to‘y jarayonini ifodalovchi so‘z.

ex: He experienced ananda after achieving enlightenment.
Meditation can lead to a state of ananda.
ananda.meta: Mutlaq zavq, cheksiz baxt, ruhiy yuksalish yoki ulug‘ ne’mat holati.

ex: Anand Karaj is an important ritual in Sikh culture.
They celebrated their Anand Karaj with close family and friends.
anand karaj.meta: Sikh diniga xos bo‘lgan rasmiy nikoh marosimi yoki to‘y tantanasi.

ex: She wore traditional Anangu clothing during the ceremony.
The Anangu people have a rich cultural heritage.
anangu.meta: Markaziy Avstraliyada yashovchi Avstraliya aborigenlari avlodidan bo‘lgan odam; shu atama bilan bog‘liq yoki unga xos bo‘lgan.

ex: Even gods must submit to Ananke.
In Greek mythology, Ananke represents the unavoidable fate.
ananke.meta: Qadimgi yunon mifologiyasida taqdirni ifodalovchi, qochib bo‘lmaydigan va hatto xudolar ham unga bo‘ysunadigan kuch; muqarrarlik, zarurat.

ex: She gave an anapologetic refusal despite the consequences.
His behavior was anapologetic and rude.
anapologetic.meta: Kechirim so‘rash yoki uzr so‘rashni istamaydigan, xatoni yoki aybini tan olmaslik holati; kechirilmas, uzr so‘ramaydigan.

ex: The anarchos gathered to promote their ideas about society without rulers.
He identifies as an anarcho who opposes all forms of government.
anarcho.meta: Anarxiya yoki anarxizm tarafdori yoki targ‘ibotchisi; tartibsizlik va hokimiyatsizlikni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs.

ex: Anaretical influences are believed to affect a person's destiny according to astrology.
The planet was in an anaretical position in her natal chart.
anaretical.meta: O‘simlik yoki boshqa osmon jismlari, yoki ularning shaxsning tavallud jadvalidagi (horoskopdagi) joylashuvi bilan bog‘liq. Astrologiyada ishlatiladi.

ex: An anaretical plant grows under specific celestial conditions.
The anaretical position of the planet in the natal chart affects the person's destiny.
anaretical.meta: Anaretik — o‘simlik yoki boshqa osmon jismining, yoki odamning tug‘ilgan vaqtidagi (natal) jadvallardagi joylashuvi bilan bog‘liq sifat.

ex: I bought fresh anari cheese to make a traditional dish.
Anari is often used in Cypriot desserts and pastries.
anari.meta: Anari — Kiprga xos, yumshoq, oq rangli, kam tuzli qatiq pishlog‘i bo‘lib, u shirin va sho‘r taomlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Anarkali suits are popular for festive occasions in South Asia.
She wore a beautiful anarkali dress to the wedding.
anarkali.meta: Anarkali — Janubiy Osiyo ayollari tomonidan an’anaviy kiyiladigan, tanaga yopishgan yengli ko‘ylak va erga yoki tizzagacha uzun, keng taglikli yubkadan tashkil topgan kiyim turi.

ex: An anasceuastic statement challenges the accepted theory.
His anasceuastic argument disproved the previous claim.
anasceuastic.meta: Anaskevastik — boshqa bir dalilni rad etuvchi yoki inkor qiluvchi, qarama-qarshi fikrni bildiruvchi sifat.

ex: His anasceuastical remarks clearly opposed the earlier statement.
The lawyer presented an anasceuastical argument to refute the prosecution's claims.
anasceuastical.meta: Anaskevastik — boshqa bir dalilni rad etuvchi yoki inkor qiluvchi, qarama-qarshi fikrni bildiruvchi sifat. Bu so‘z cataskeuastic so‘ziga qarshi ishlatiladi. Qarama-qarshilik yoki inkor etishni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: His writing style shows clear Anastasian influences.
The Anastasian manuscripts are valuable sources for medieval studies.
anastasian.meta: Anastasiyalik — Papa kutubxonachisi, muallifi va tarjimoni Anastasiy Bibliotekariy (810–878) yoki uning asarlariga oid sifat. Anastasiyga xos davr yoki uslub bilan bog‘liq sifat.

ex: Christians celebrate the anastasis of Jesus Christ on Easter.
The story symbolizes the anastasis of hope after hardship.
anastasis.meta: Anastasis — o‘likdan tirilish, qayta jonlanish. (Mavhum ma’noda) yangilanish, jonlanish, tirilish holati. Ruhiy yoki ramziy qayta tug‘ilish.

ex: Every year, the village celebrates the Anastenaria festival with traditional dances and prayers.
The Anastenaria sect is famous for its fire-walking rituals.
anastenaria.meta: Anastenariya — Gretsiyaning shimoli-sharqiy qismida joylashgan, Muqaddas Konstantin va Muqaddas Elena sharafiga har yili tantana o‘tkazadigan, odatda olov ustidan yurish marosimi bilan yakunlanadigan ekstaz holatidagi pravoslav xristian jamoasi.

ex: The anastylosis of the ruined monument attracted many visitors.
The archaeologists performed anastylosis to restore the ancient temple.
anastylosis.meta: Anastiloz — qadimiy yodgorlikni asl joyida, odatda tushgan qismlar va yangi materiallardan foydalanib qayta tiklash jarayoni. Shuningdek, bunday tiklashning o‘zi.

ex: Corruption is anathematic to a fair society.
His views were considered anathematic by the religious community.
anathematic.meta: Anatema bilan bog‘liq yoki anatema kabi — kishini yoki narsani la’natlaydigan, qoralaydigan, qat’iyan rad etadigan sifat. Juda nafretga sazovor yoki jirkanch sifat.

ex: The land was divided anatically among the heirs.
The ingredients were mixed anatically to ensure consistency.
anatically.meta: Teng nisbatda — bir xil o‘lchamda yoki miqdorda, teng taqsimlangan holda.

ex: The judge’s biasedness affected the fairness of the trial.
Media biasedness can influence public opinion.
biasedness.meta: Bir tomonlama bo‘lish — ma’lum bir shaxs yoki narsaga nisbatan adolatli bo‘lmagan, tarafkashlik yoki afzallik ko‘rsatish holati.

ex: Teachers should provide bias-free evaluations of their students.
The report was written in a bias-free manner to ensure fairness.
bias-free.meta: Tarafkashliksiz — har qanday tarafkashlik, afzallik yoki oldindan shakllangan fikrdan holi bo‘lgan, adolatli va teng qarashli sifat. Til uchun esa, hech kimga yoki guruhga nisbatan kamsituvchi bo‘lmagan.

ex: That bitch ass refused to help when we needed him.
Don’t be such a bitch ass, stand up for yourself!
bitch ass.meta: Yomon odam — pastkash, jirkanch yoki qadr-qimmati yo‘q shaxs, odatda haqorat sifatida ishlatiladi. Qo‘rqoq yoki kuchsiz odamni bildiruvchi ifoda.

ex: She was talking bitchingly about the delays all night.
That party was bitchingly fun!
bitchingly.meta: Juda kuchli yoki zo‘r darajada — ma’nosini kuchaytiruvchi, “juda” yoki “a’lo darajada” degan ma’noda ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, g‘azab yoki norozi bo‘lib gapirish uslubini ifodalaydi.

ex: They were accused of blockbusting to drive down property prices.
Some real estate agents blockbust neighborhoods to make quick profits.
blockbust.meta: Blokbast qilish — ko‘chmas mulk sohasida, odatda noqonuniy yoki noto‘g‘ri usullar bilan qo‘shni hududdagi odamlarning kelishi evaziga mulk egalarini past narxda sotishga undash jarayoniga taalluqli. Shu jarayon bilan shug‘ullanish.

ex: She earns money by camming on a popular streaming platform.
The documentary involved a lot of camming in remote locations.
camming.meta: Kameraga olish — biror narsani kamera (video kamera, kamkorder yoki vebkamera) yordamida yozib olish yoki vebkamera orqali jonli efir qilish jarayoni. Ko‘pincha ko‘ngilochar yoki kattalar uchun jonli video efir qilish harakati.

ex: Business cards are usually made from durable cardstock.
The wedding invitations were printed on high-quality cardstock.
cardstock.meta: Qalin qog‘oz yoki karton qog‘oz — qattiq, mustahkam va bardoshli qog‘oz turi, odatda tabrik kartalari, rasmiy taklifnomalar, vizit kartalar va boshqa shunga o‘xshash narsalarni tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Fund managers often receive a carried interest as a reward for successful investments.
The company held a carried interest in the oil well without paying for drilling costs.
carried interest.meta: Tashqi ulush — neft yoki gaz qazib olish loyihasida xarajatlarni qoplamaydigan, ammo ulushga ega bo‘lgan tomonning hissasi. Investitsiya yoki sheriklikdagi foydaning ulushi, odatda kapital kiritmagan, lekin loyihani boshqaradigan sherikka beriladi.

ex: The new laptop is a perfect carry-along for business trips.
She always carries a carry-along charger for her phone.
carry-along.meta: Olib yuriladigan — sayohat yoki kundalik ishlar davomida o‘zingiz bilan olib yurishingiz mumkin bo‘lgan, ayniqsa kichik va qulay buyum yoki uskuna. Olib yuriladigan narsa — osongina ko‘chiriladigan, ko‘chma bo‘lak yoki buyum.

ex: A carryback provision allows businesses to offset past taxable income with current losses.
The company applied a carryback of losses to the previous tax year to reduce its tax liability.
carryback.meta: Oldinga qaytarilgan ulush — buxgalteriya hisobida yoki soliqqa oid hisob-kitoblarda, biror yo‘qotish, balans yoki imtiyoz avvalgi soliq davriga ko‘chirib o‘tilgan holat.

ex: He packed his camera carefully in a padded carry case.
The laptop carry case has extra compartments for accessories.
carry case.meta: Ko‘tarib yurish uchun quti — biror narsani olib yurish uchun mo‘ljallangan, odatda tutqich yoki tutqichlari bo‘lgan quti yoki idish. Ko‘pincha ushbu buyumni tashishda himoya qilish uchun yaratiladi.

ex: The event was a carry-in party, so no food was provided by the hosts.
We organized a carry-in dinner where everyone brought their favorite dish.
carry-in.meta: O‘z olib keladigan — odatda mehmonlarning barchasi o‘zlari tayyorlagan taomlarni olib keladigan ijtimoiy yig‘ilish, masalan, hamma o‘z ovqatini olib keladigan kechki ovqat yoki nonushta.

ex: Inventory carrying charges can significantly affect a business’s profitability.
The company had to pay a high carrying charge to transport the goods overseas.
carrying charge.meta: Yuk tashish to‘lovi — mahsulot yoki yukni bir joydan boshqa joyga yetkazish uchun to‘lanadigan pul miqdori. Qo‘shimcha ma’noda, mahsulotlarni saqlash yoki omborda ushlab turish uchun sarflanadigan xarajatlar.

ex: High carrying costs can make holding onto unused property expensive.
The company tries to minimize its carrying costs by reducing inventory levels.
carrying cost.meta: Saqlash xarajatlari — moliyaviy sohada, asosan jismoniy aktivni, masalan, tovar yoki bo‘sh bino kabi mulkni saqlash yoki ushlab turish bilan bog‘liq xarajatlar.

ex: Using a carry-log makes moving heavy timber easier in rough terrain.
The workers loaded the logs onto the carry-log to transport them through the forest.
carry-log.meta: Yog‘och tashish aravasi — yog‘ochni tashish uchun mo‘ljallangan qurilma bo‘lib, ikkita baland g‘ildirakdan va ular orasidagi o‘qdan iborat. Yog‘och bo‘lagi yoki bo‘laklari shu oqqa osilib, hayvonlar yoki texnika yordamida tortiladi.

ex: Scientists are studying the chytrid infections in frogs to find a cure.
The chytrid fungus has caused declines in amphibian populations worldwide.
chytrid.meta: Chitrid — Chytridiomycetes sinfiga yoki kengroq ma’noda Chytridiomycota filumiga mansub mikroskopik suvda yashovchi qo‘ziqorinlar, ular harakatlanuvchi sporalar yordamida ko‘payadi.

ex: A commonable person thinks not only about themselves but about everyone around them.
He is a commonable leader who always puts the community’s needs first.
commonable.meta: Jamoat manfaati uchun harakat qiluvchi — boshqalarni hisobga olib, umumiy foyda yoki manfaatlar uchun harakat qiladigan shaxs.

ex: The park and swimming pool are considered common areas for all the residents in the complex.
The residents gathered in the common area to discuss building maintenance.
common area.meta: Umumiy joy — bino ichida barcha foydalanishi uchun mo‘ljallangan xona yoki boshqa hudud; ayniqsa, bir nechta odam yashaydigan joylarda barcha turar joy egalari yoki mehmonlari foydalanadigan maydon.

ex: Historians often use C.E. instead of A.D. to avoid religious connotations.
The year 2025 C.E. marks the current year in the Common Era calendar.
common era.meta: Umumiy Eramiz — Iso Masihning an’anaviy tug‘ilgan sanasidan boshlangan vaqt davri nomi; qisqartmasi UE. Bu atama diniy bo‘lmagan holda "Masihiy davr" yoki "Anno Domini" o‘rnida ishlatiladi

ex: Police were deployed to prevent clashes between the protest and the counterprotest.
The government supporters organized a counterprotest to the opposition rally.
counterprotest.meta: Qarshi norozilik namoyishi – bu boshqa bir norozilik namoyishiga javoban o'tkaziladigan namoyish. Bu odatda bir guruhning fikriga qarshi bo‘lgan boshqa guruh tomonidan tashkil etiladi. Maqsad – ilgari surilgan fikr yoki talabga qarshi munosabat bildirish.
