ex: The counterprotesters stood across the street holding signs in support of the government.
Police had to separate the protesters and the counterprotesters to avoid conflict.
counterprotester.meta: Qarshi norozilik namoyishchisi – bu boshqa bir norozilik namoyishiga qarshi chiqqan, ya’ni unga nisbatan o‘z pozitsiyasini namoyon qilgan shaxs. U odatda ommaviy yig‘in yoki namoyishda ishtirok etadi va dastlabki norozilikka zid fikrlarni ilgari suradi.

ex: She asked everyone to stop using her deadname and respect her new identity.
Using a transgender person’s deadname can be very disrespectful.
deadname.meta: bu inson, ayniqsa transgender shaxs, o‘ziga yangi ism tanlaganidan keyin ilgari ishlatgan ismi. Bu ism endilikda u shaxs tomonidan rad etilgan yoki ishlatilmaydi, va uni qayta ishlatish ko‘pincha hurmatsizlik yoki kamsitish sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: She explained how deadnaming affected her mental health.
Deadnaming can be harmful and disrespectful to transgender individuals.
deadnaming.meta: bu, ayniqsa, transgender inson yangi ism tanlaganidan keyin, unga ilgari ishlatilgan ismi bilan murojaat qilish yoki u ismni tilga olish harakati. Bu ko‘pincha shaxsiyatga hurmatsizlik yoki e’tiborsizlik sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: Archaeologists uncovered the remains of a decumanus in the ancient city.
The decumanus in a Roman city typically intersected the cardo at the forum.
decumanus.meta: Dekumanus – dastlab yer o‘lchovchilari tomonidan belgilangan sharqdan g‘arbga qarab yo‘nalgan chiziq yoki chegara. Keyinchalik, ayniqsa Rim shaharlarida, sharqdan g‘arbga qarab ketuvchi asosiy ko‘cha yoki yo‘l ma’nosida ishlatilgan

ex: My digital assistant reminds me of my meetings and can even send messages.
In the early 2000s, many businesspeople used digital assistants to manage their schedules.
digital assistant.meta: Raqamli yordamchi – bu odatda kichik va ko‘chma kompyuter qurilmasi bo‘lib, u elektron rejalashtiruvchi funksiyalarini va tarmoq orqali ulanish (masalan, internet yoki boshqa qurilmalar bilan bog‘lanish) imkoniyatlarini birlashtiradi.

ex: Emotional support can be just as important as medical treatment in healing.
After the accident, she received a lot of emotional support from her friends and family.
emotional support.meta: Hissiy ko‘mak – bu insonning hissiy yoki ruhiy holatini yaxshilashga qaratilgan yordam yoki dalda. Bu do‘stona, rahmli, mehribon va tushunishga asoslangan munosabatlar orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: His story was truly eye-opening — I never realized what he had gone through.
The documentary was an eye-opening experience about poverty in urban areas.
eye-opening.meta: bu biror hodisa, tajriba yoki ma’lumot kishi dunyoqarashini o‘zgartirishi, yangi fikr, tushuncha yoki haqiqatni ochib berishi mumkin bo‘lgan holatni ifodalaydi. Ko‘pincha bu shaxsga foydali saboq, tushuncha yoki ongli anglash olib keladi.

ex: As a fastballer, he dominated the early innings with his speed.
The team’s best fastballer can throw at over 100 miles per hour.
fastballer.meta: Tez to‘p otuvchi – bu beysbolda asosan tezlikka asoslangan to‘plarni otishga ixtisoslashgan to‘p uzatuvchi (pitcher). Ularning asosiy kuchi — raqibni tez harakatlanuvchi to‘plar bilan chalg‘itish va imkon qadar zarba berishga yo‘l qo‘ymaslikdir.

ex: Fast-breaking is a moment of gratitude and reflection in many religions.
The family gathered for the evening fast-breaking meal during Ramadan.
fast-breaking.meta: Ro‘za ochish – bu uzoq muddatli ovqat yemay turish (ya’ni ro‘za tutish)dan keyin, ayniqsa diniy sabablarga ko‘ra tutilgan ro‘zani yakunlab ovqat yeyayotgan holat.

ex: the fast-breaking food is usually light and nutritious.
they shared a simple fast-breaking meal after sunset.
fast-breaking.meta: ro‘zani buzuvchi — uzoq vaqt ochlik yoki ro‘zadan so‘ng iste’mol qilinadigan ovqat, ro‘zani tugatish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: They stopped at a fast foodery on the highway for a quick lunch.
There’s a new fast foodery near the university that sells great burgers.
fast foodery.meta: Fast foodery – bu asosan tez tayyor ovqatlar (masalan, gamburger, hot-dog, fri kartoshka, pizza va shu kabi ovqatlar) sotiladigan restoran yoki kichik ovqatlanish joyidir.

ex: Don’t try to pull a fastie on me — I know all your tricks.
He really pulled a fastie when he pretended to be sick to skip work.
fastie.meta: Fastie — bu kishi boshqasini aldash, ayyorona hiyla ishlatish yoki kutilmagan aql bilan chalg‘itish harakatini bildiradi.

ex: Can you finish this report fastish?
He walked fastish to catch the bus.
fastish.meta: Fastish — bu so‘z “fast” (tez) so‘zining noaniq darajali shakli bo‘lib, biror harakatning biroz tez, ancha tez, yoki ortiqcha kechiktirmasdan bajarilayotganini bildiradi.

ex: The team needed a fast-medium pace to exploit the pitch conditions.
He is a reliable fast-medium bowler with excellent line and length.
fast-medium.meta: Fast-medium — bu kriket sportida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, to‘p uloqtirish tezligi tez va o‘rtacha oralig‘ida bo‘lgan holatni bildiradi.

ex: The team transitioned from slow-pitch to fast-pitch for more intensity.
She plays in a competitive fast-pitch softball league.
fast-pitch.meta: Fast-pitch — bu softbol sportiga oid atama bo‘lib, to‘pni pastdan , lekin juda tezlikda uloqtirish uslubini anglatadi. Ayniqsa, “windmill pitching” deb ataladigan, to‘p uloqtirishdan oldin qo‘lni aylantirish texnikasiga asoslangan usulda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Don’t fall for his fast talk — he’s trying to trick you.
The salesman used fast talk to convince me to buy the car.
fast talk.meta: Fast talk — bu kimnidir ishontirish, manipulyatsiya qilish yoki chalg‘itish maqsadida ishlatiladigan tez va uzluksiz gapirish usuli. Odatda bu usul sotuvchilar, firibgarlar yoki yolg‘onchilar tomonidan ishlatiladi.

ex: The fast talker convinced them to invest all their money.
Don’t trust him — he’s just a fast talker trying to sell you something.
fast talker.meta: Fast talker — bu odatda tez va uzluksiz gapiradigan odam bo‘lib, uning maqsadi ko‘pincha boshqalarni ishontirish, manipulyatsiya qilish yoki aldash bo‘ladi.

ex: She tried fast talking her way out of trouble.
His fast talking confused everyone in the room.
fast talking.meta: Fast talking — bu tez va uzluksiz gapirish uslubi bo‘lib, u ko‘pincha boshqalarni aldash, chalg‘itish, yoki ishontirish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: For farmers, it’s often feast or famine depending on the weather.
Freelancing can be a feast or famine lifestyle — some months are busy, others are empty.
feast or famine.meta: Feast or famine — bu ibora ikki mutlaq qarama-qarshi holat — ya’ni bir paytlar juda ko‘p narsa bo‘lishi (to‘qchilik), boshqa paytda esa hech narsa qolmasligi (ocharchilik, tanqislik) kabi keskin almashinadigan sharoitni ifodalaydi.

ex: The accused had a festerman who swore he would follow the law.
Under Danelaw, a festerman would guarantee the proper transfer of land rights.
festerman.meta: Festerman — bu qadimgi Daniya qonunchiligi amalda bo‘lgan hududlarda (Danelaw deb atalgan joylarda) yer sotib olish yoki ko‘chirish jarayonida kafillik beradigan shaxsni anglatadi.

ex: The fest-goers danced all night in the open field.
Thousands of fest-goers gathered for the summer music festival.
fest-goer.meta: Fest-goer — bu festivalga qatnashuvchi odam; ya’ni biror san’at, musiqa, madaniyat, ovqat, kino yoki boshqa bayram/festival tadbirlarida ishtirok etadigan shaxs.

ex: As a true festie, she never misses the annual music festival.
The festies set up their tents early to get the best camping spot.
festie.meta: Festie — bu festivallarda muntazam qatnashadigan odam, odatda san’at, musiqa, madaniy tadbirlar kabi ommaviy bayramlarga doimiy boruvchi va ularni sevadigan shaxs.

ex: There was a sense of festiveness in the decorated streets.
The festiveness of the New Year’s Eve celebration was felt by everyone.
festiveness.meta: Festiveness — bu bayramona muhit yoki holat, ya’ni odamlar orasida quvonch, ko‘tarinki ruh, tantana va shodlik hukm surayotgan holat. Bu sifat odatda bayramlar, tantanali tadbirlar yoki quvonchli vaziyatlarda ko‘zga tashlanadi.

ex: He had a festy wound on his leg that needed treatment.
Ugh, that bin smells really festy — take it out!
festy.meta: Festy — bu so‘z norasmiy tilda ishlatilib, juda yoqimsiz, iflos, jirkanch yoki chiriyotgan narsani tasvirlashda qo‘llanadi. Ayniqsa, yomon hidli, iflos joylar yoki narsalar, ba’zan esa yiringlayotgan yoki chiriyotgan yaralar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: A fistulate passage developed between the bladder and the skin.
The patient had a fistulate opening near the intestine that required surgery.
fistulate.meta: bu so‘z tibbiyotda ishlatiladi va fistula xususiyatiga ega yoki fistula bilan zararlangan degan ma’noni anglatadi. Fistula — bu tana ichidagi ikki bo‘shliq orasida yoki tana yuzasi bilan ichki a’zo o‘rtasida hosil bo‘lgan noodatiy yo‘l yoki teshikdir.

ex: They decided to flatshare while attending university.
When I moved to London, I had to flatshare because rent was too high.
flatshare.meta: Flatshare — bu so‘z fe’l bo‘lib, asosan bir nechta odamning ijaraga olingan kvartirada birga yashashini anglatadi.

ex: Many employers are now adapting workplaces to attract Generation Z.
Generation Z grew up with smartphones and social media.
generation z.meta: Generation Z — bu atama 1990-yillarning oxiri va 2010-yillarning boshlarida tug‘ilgan avlodni anglatadi. Ular texnologiyalar bilan o‘sib ulg‘aygan, internet, smartfonlar va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarga odatlangan.

ex: Activists threw a glitter bomb at the politician to protest anti-LGBTQ+ policies.
He received a glitter bomb in the mail as a prank.
glitter bomb.meta: Glitter bomb — bu kichik porloq zarrachalar (yaltir-yaltirlar) to‘plami bo‘lib, kimnidir ustiga sepish yoki biror joyda portlash uchun mo‘ljallangan. Bu odatda hazil sifatida yoki siyosiy norozilik ifodasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The senator was the target of a glitter bombing during a speech.
Glitter bombing has become a popular form of protest among activists.
glitter bombing.meta: Glitter bombing — bu kimningdir ustiga yaltirab turuvchi zarrachalarni sepish yoki sochish harakati, ayniqsa hazil sifatida yoki siyosiy norozilik aksiyasi sifatida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: After moving to London, he had to house-share to afford rent.
I used to house-share with three other students during university.
house-share.meta: House-share — bu bir nechta odamning bir uyda birgalikda yashashi, ayniqsa ijaraga olingan uyda xarajatlarni bo‘lishish asosida. Bu ko‘pincha talaba, yosh ishchilar yoki shaharda mustaqil yashayotganlar orasida keng tarqalgan.

ex: The imum coeli is the nadir point directly opposite the zenith.
In astrology, the imum coeli represents your roots and family background.
imum coeli.meta: Imum coeli (lotincha "osmonning eng past nuqtasi") — bu osmon gumbazidagi zenitga (eng yuqori nuqtaga) qarama-qarshi joylashgan nuqta, ya’ni nadir. Astronomiyada bu nuqta osmon sferasining eng past qismi sifatida aniqlanadi

ex: Dysregulation of inflammasome activity can lead to chronic inflammatory diseases.
Inflammasomes play a key role in the body's response to infection and tissue damage.
inflammasome.meta: Inflammasoma — bu hujayra sitoplazmasida joylashgan oqsillar majmuasi bo‘lib, u patogenlarga (kasallik chaqiruvchi mikroorganizmlarga) qarshi immun va yallig‘lanish javoblarini tartibga soluvchi fermentlarni faollashtirishda ishtirok etadi.

ex: People with anxiety disorders may have heightened interoception, making them overly aware of bodily changes.
Interoception allows a person to feel internal bodily sensations like hunger or heartbeat.
interoception.meta: Interotsepsiya — bu tana ichkarisidagi a’zolar (ichki organlar) holatidan kelib chiqadigan sezgi bo‘lib, organizmning ichki holatini anglash jarayonidir.

ex: He is a respected elder in the local jamaat.
The jamaat gathered at the mosque for Friday prayers.
jamaat.meta: Jamoat — bu islom dini e’tiqodiga mansub bo‘lgan kishilarning bir butun guruh sifatida qaralishi, ya’ni diniy hamjamiyat. Bu atama kengroq ma’noda muayyan diniy qarash yoki urf-odatga ega bo‘lgan insonlar to‘plamini bildiradi.

ex: Lionfish have become an invasive species in the Atlantic Ocean.
The lionfish is beautiful but dangerous due to its venomous spines.
lionfish.meta: Arslonbaliq — bu Scorpaenidae oilasiga mansub, zaharli tikanlarga ega bo‘lgan dengiz baliqlari guruhi, ayniqsa Pterois jinsiga mansub baliqlar.

ex: Farmers in Trinidad fear the macajuel for its strength.
The macajuel can grow up to 13 feet long.
macajuel.meta: Macajuel — bu bo’a konstriktor nomi bilan tanilgan katta, zaharsiz, biroq o‘lja tanasini siqib o‘ldiruvchi ilon turiga berilgan nom. Bu nom asosan Karib mintaqasida, ayniqsa Trinidad va Tobagoda bo’a konstriktorga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The astrologer explained that her medium coeli was in Leo, indicating a career in the spotlight.
At noon, the sun reaches the medium coeli.
medium coeli.meta: Medium coeli — bu osmon gumbazidagi eng yuqori nuqta, ya’ni kuzatuvchining joylashgan nuqtasidan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri tepada joylashgan nuqta. Bu astronomiyada zenit (lotincha: “zenith”) deb ham ataladi.

ex: Her misophonia made it difficult for her to eat in crowded places.
People with misophonia may become angry when they hear chewing or slurping sounds.
misophonia.meta: Misofoniya — bu baʼzi tovushlarga (masalan, chaynash, nafas olish, qarsillash, qalam bilan taqillatish kabi) nisbatan kuchli, gʻayritabiiy hissiy va jismoniy salbiy reaksiya bilan namoyon bo‘ladigan holatdir.

ex: We organized a clean-up-palooza to involve the whole community in cleaning the park.
Foodpalooza was the biggest culinary event of the year.
-palooza.meta: -palooza — bu musobaqa, festival yoki yirik tadbir ma’nosini bildiruvchi qo‘shimcha shakl bo‘lib, odatda biror mavzuga oid katta hajmdagi tadbir, bayram yoki tantanani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The company scheduled a regular paydown of its business loan.
He made a $5,000 paydown on his mortgage.
paydown.meta: Paydown — bu qarz yoki kreditni to‘liq emas, balki bir qismini to‘lash uchun berilgan yoki olingan pul miqdori. Shuningdek, bu so‘z bunday to‘lovni amalga oshirish harakati yoki jarayonini ham anglatadi.

ex: Doctors used remdesivir to treat patients with severe respiratory symptoms.
Remdesivir was approved for emergency use during the COVID-19 pandemic.
remdesivir.meta: Remdesivir — bu RNA viruslari, jumladan Ebola isitmasi va koronavirus kasalliklari (masalan, SARS va MERS)ni davolash uchun ishlatiladigan antivirus prodrug (ya'ni, organizmda faollashadigan dorivor modda).

ex: The movie is a slow burner, but by the end, it's incredibly powerful.
Don’t underestimate him—he’s a real slow burner. When he gets angry, it’s intense.
slow burner.meta: Slow burner — (1) G‘azabi yoki hissiy reaksiyasi asta-sekin kuchayadigan, ammo kuchli portlashga olib keladigan odam; (2) Shuningdek, sekin rivojlanadigan yoki asta-asta e’tibor va ta’sir kuchiga ega bo‘ladigan film, kitob, g‘oya yoki holat.

ex: She prefers slow cooking to preserve nutrients in food.
Slow cooking allows the flavors to develop more deeply.
slow cooking.meta: Sekin pishirish — ovqatni past haroratda uzoq vaqt davomida pishirish jarayoni. Ayniqsa, slow cooker (ya’ni, elektrli sekin pishirgich) qurilmasida amalga oshiriladigan pishirish usuli tushuniladi.

ex: The couple slow danced to a romantic ballad.
They shared a slow dance at the end of the night.
slow dance.meta: Sekin raqs — bu ikki kishi, odatda juftlik shaklida, bir-birini quchoqlagan yoki yaqin holatda ushlab, sekin va romantik ohangdagi musiqaga mos harakatlanadigan raqs turi. U ko‘pincha his-tuyg‘ular, muhabbat yoki yaqinlik ifodasi sifatida ijro etiladi.

ex: After the update, the system has become slowed-down.
The video showed a slowed-down replay of the goal.
slowed-down.meta: Sekinlashtirilgan — harakat, jarayon yoki rivojlanish odatdagidan sekinroq yoki sustroq tarzda davom etayotgan holatni bildiradi. Bu so‘z biror narsa atayin yoki tabiiy ravishda sekin harakat qilayotganini anglatadi.

ex: Traffic was slowed-up by the heavy rain.
The project is slowed-up due to lack of funds.
slowed-up.meta: Sekinlashtirilgan yoki sekinlashgan — biror narsa yoki jarayon odatdagidan sustroq, sekinroq harakat qilishi, ishlashi yoki rivojlanishi natijasida yuzaga kelgan holat.

ex: A slower ball can surprise the batter and reduce scoring chances.
The bowler used a slower ball to deceive the batsman.
slower ball.meta: Sekinroq to'p — to‘pni past tezlikda uloqtirish usuli bo‘lib, maqsadi to‘p uruvchini hayratda qoldirish va uning harakatini chalkashtirishdir.

ex: Don't be a slowie, try to understand faster!
He is a slowie when it comes to learning new things.
slowie.meta: Sekin odam — voqealarga, so‘zlarga yoki vaziyatlarga sekin javob beradigan yoki biror narsani sekin tushunadigan kishi. Shuningdek, bu so‘z ba’zida hazil yoki ozor ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Slow orders ensure safety by limiting train speed in hazardous sections.
The train received a slow order due to maintenance work on the tracks.
slow order.meta: Sekin yurish buyruği — temir yo‘lning bir bo‘lagida poyezdning odatdagi tezligidan pastroq tezlikda harakatlanishini cheklovchi rasmiy buyruq yoki ko‘rsatma.

ex: In poker, slow-playing can be an effective strategy to win big.
He slow-played his cards to trick the opponents into betting more.
slow-play.meta: Sekin o‘ynash — (bir qo‘l yoki harakatni) asl kuchidan zaifroq qilib o‘ynash, raqibni chalg‘itish yoki aldash maqsadida qasddan sekinroq yoki ehtiyotkorlik bilan o‘ynash. Bu atama asosan karta yoki boshqa strategik o‘yinlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Slow roll is a common aerobatic maneuver that requires precision and control.
The pilot performed a slow roll during the airshow, impressing the audience.
slow roll.meta: Sekin aylantirish — aviatsiyada aerobatik harakatlardan biri bo‘lib, uchoqning uzunlik o‘qi atrofida 360 daraja aylanib, parvozini davom ettirishi.

ex: During the airshow, the plane executed a perfect slow-rolling.
The slow-rolling maneuver requires great skill from the pilot.
slow-rolling.meta: Sekin aylantirish — aviatsiyada uchoqning uzunlik o‘qi atrofida 360 daraja aylanib, to‘g‘ri yo‘nalishda parvoz qilish harakati.

ex: They slow-walked the paperwork, causing unnecessary delays.
The manager slow-walked the approval process to buy new equipment.
slow-walk.meta: Sekinlashtirib kechiktirmoq — biror jarayon, so‘rov yoki odamni ataylab o‘z ishini sekinlashtirib, kechiktirish. Maqsadli tarzda harakat tezligini pasaytirib, jarayonni to‘xtatish yoki sustlashtirish.

ex: The orchestra played a beautiful slow waltz that filled the room with romance.
They danced a slow waltz under the dim ballroom lights.
slow waltz.meta: Sekin vals — 3/4 taktli vaqt o‘lchamida raqsga tushiladigan vals turi; shunday vals uchun yozilgan musiqa asari.

ex: He tries to social distance himself in crowded places to stay safe.
During the pandemic, people were advised to social distance to prevent the spread of the virus.
social distance.meta: Ijtimoiy masofa saqlamoq — boshqalar bilan jismoniy aloqani yoki yaqinlikni cheklash uchun ma’lum masofani ushlab turish. Bu harakat ko‘pincha kasalliklarning tarqalishini oldini olish yoki ijtimoiy qoidalarni bajarish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: During the pandemic, social distancing was mandatory in public places.
Maintaining social distance helps prevent the spread of infectious diseases.
social distance.meta: Ijtimoiy masofa — kasallikning yuqishi yoki tarqalishini oldini olish maqsadida odamlar o‘rtasida saqlanadigan jismoniy masofa yoki boshqa ehtiyot choralaridan biri.

ex: Some people socially distance to protect their emotional well-being.
She began to socially distance herself from her old friends after moving to a new city.
socially distance.meta: Ijtimoiy jihatdan uzoqlashmoq — kimdir bilan ijtimoiy aloqadan saqlanish yoki boshqalar bilan munosabatda hissiy jihatdan uzoq va sovuqroq bo‘lish; boshqa odam yoki guruhdan ma’naviy yoki emotsional jihatdan ajralib turish.

ex: The team members were socially distanced due to the pandemic restrictions.
He felt socially distanced from his classmates after moving to a new school.
socially distanced.meta: Ijtimoiy jihatdan uzoqlashgan — hissiy jihatdan uzoq yoki sovuq bo‘lgan, boshqa odam yoki guruh bilan ijtimoiy muloqoti cheklangan yoki chegaralangan holat.

ex: People used sousveillance during protests to document police behavior.
Sousveillance helps citizens hold authorities accountable by recording their actions.
sousveillance.meta: Suvyans — hukumat, politsiya va boshqa rasmiylarni oddiy fuqarolar tomonidan yaqindan kuzatish yoki yozib olish harakati, odatda shaxsiy qurilmalar, masalan, video kameralar yordamida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The holiday park offers static caravans for tourists who want a comfortable stay.
During summer, many families rent a static caravan by the seaside.
static caravan.meta: Statik karvan — doimiy joylashgan, katta o‘lchamdagi karvan yoki oldindan tayyorlangan ko‘chma tuzilma bo‘lib, u ma’lum bir joyda doimiy turadi va dam olish uchun ijaraga beriladi yoki yashash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: As a staykatsioner, she enjoys relaxing without the hassle of traveling.
During the summer, many staykatsioners prefer to explore local attractions.
staycationer.meta: Staykatsioner — uyda yoki o‘z yashash mamlakatida ta’til qiladigan odam.

ex: I prefer using my smartphone’s tap-to-pay feature instead of carrying cash.
Many stores now support tap-to-pay technology for faster checkout.
tap-to-pay.meta: Teginib to‘lash — kredit yoki debit karta, smartfon va boshqalar orqali, kontaktlarsiz texnologiya yordamida to‘lov qilish tizimini ifodalovchi sifat yoki ot.

ex: He was arrested for thugging and causing trouble in the streets.
The city has been struggling to reduce thugging in its neighborhoods.
thugging.meta: Jalloblik — zo‘ravonlik, tajovuzkorlik yoki jinoyatchilik harakati; jalloblik qilish (jallob v. harakatining turli ma’nolarida).

ex: The crowd behaved thuggishly, causing fear among the bystanders.
He acted thuggishly during the fight.
thuggishly.meta: Jalloblik bilan — zo‘ravon yoki tajovuzkor tarzda, qattiq va agressiv usulda.

ex: His thuggishness often got him into trouble with the law.
The thuggishness of the gang scared the neighborhood.
thuggishness.meta: Jalloblik — zo‘ravonlik, tajovuzkorlik yoki qattiq, agressiv xulq-atvor sifati yoki holati.

ex: The thuggy behavior of the group scared the locals.
He has a thuggy attitude that often causes problems.
thuggy.meta: Jallobona — zo‘ravon yoki tajovuzkor xulq-atvor bilan xarakterlangan; jallobga o‘xshash yoki jallobga xos bo‘lgan.

ex: Under thugocracy, law and order break down, and fear controls society.
The country fell into thugocracy after the collapse of the central government.
thugocracy.meta: Banditlar tomonidan boshqariladigan hukumat; kuch ishlatib, zo‘ravonlik bilan boshqaradigan jamiyat yoki davlat. Shuningdek, zo‘ravonlik qiluvchi guruh yoki tashkilotning hukmronligi.

ex: Transcranial magnetic stimulation is a non-invasive method used to treat depression.
Transcranial ultrasound can be used to examine blood flow in the brain.
transcranial.meta: Bosh suyagidan o‘tuvchi; bosh suyak qobig‘i orqali amalga oshadigan yoki sodir bo‘ladigan. Bosh suyak qobig‘i orqali amalga oshiriladigan tibbiy protsedura yoki ta’sir (masalan, transkranial magnit stimulyatsiya).

ex: Please unmute your microphone before speaking.
The pianist unmuted the violin to play a loud solo.
unmute.meta: (Musiqa) Biror musiqa asbobining ovozini to‘sib qo‘yilgan holatdan chiqarib, ovoz chiqishini ta’minlamoq. (Texnologiya) Telefon, kompyuter yoki boshqa qurilmalarda ovozni o‘chirilgan (mute) holatdan qayta yoqmoq, ovoz chiqishini tiklamoq.

ex: The conditions in the desert were unsurvivable without water.
The plane crash was unsurvivable for most passengers.
unsurvivable.meta: O‘tilmaydigan; jon saqlab qolib bo‘lmaydigan; hayotda qolish imkoni yo‘q bo‘lgan.

ex: Researchers are studying virotherapy to improve its effectiveness against tumors.
Virotherapy is an innovative method used to treat certain types of cancer.
virotherapy.meta: Saraton yoki boshqa kasalliklarni virus yordamida, ya’ni o‘simtaga yoki kasal odamga virusni ataylab yuqtirish orqali davolash usuli.

ex: A virtual assistant can schedule meetings and send reminders automatically.
Siri and Alexa are popular virtual assistants that help users with daily tasks.
virtual assistant.meta: Buyruqlarga yoki savollarga javob beradigan va elektron tarzda vazifalarni bajaradigan dastur yoki qurilma. (Keng ma’noda) Onlayn yoki masofadan turib yordam beruvchi inson yoki dastur.

ex: Vote-by-mail ballots must be received by election day to be counted.
Due to the pandemic, many states increased vote-by-mail options for voters.
vote-by-mail.meta: Saylovda saylovchilar ovoz berish varaqalarini pochta orqali yuborish tizimi yoki saylovi. Shunday ovoz berishning natijasi sifatida berilgan ovozlar. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Shaxsning saylov joyiga bormasdan, masofadan ovoz berishi usuli.

ex: The weather system over the region caused heavy rain and strong winds.
A cold front is a type of weather system that can bring storms.
weather system.meta: Atmosfera aylanishining ma’lum naqshi va unga bog‘liq ob-havo sharoitlari; yuqori yoki past bosimli hudud yoki shunga bog‘liq shamol va ob-havo naqshlari.

ex: She spends a lot of time webcamming with her friends.
Webcamming has become popular for online teaching and meetings.
webcamming.meta: Vebkamera yordamida nimanidir yozish yoki jonli efirda uzatish harakati; internet orqali vebkamera orqali muloqot qilish. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Vebkamera yordamida video-chat yoki jonli video translyatsiya jarayoni.

ex: Wildlands are important for preserving biodiversity and natural ecosystems.
The national park protects thousands of acres of wildland.
wildland.meta: Tabiiy yoki o‘g‘itlanmagan, inson tomonidan yetarlicha o‘zgartirilmagan yer. Bunday tabiiy yovvoyi yer yoki hududning katta maydoni yoki mintaqasi.

ex: Amazonian Indians have rich cultural traditions tied to the rainforest.
The Amazonian tribes depend on the forest for their livelihood.
amazonian indian.meta: Amazon daryosi yoki uning havzasida yashovchi turli tubjoy xalqlarning biror vakili. Amazon daryosi yoki uning atrofidagi hududlarga taalluqli yoki ularga oid.

ex: An amicus curiae brief can provide additional perspectives for the court’s consideration.
The organization submitted an amicus curiae brief to support the plaintiff’s case.
amicus curiae brief.meta: Sud ishiga bevosita tomon emas, balki sudga yordam berish maqsadida taqdim etilgan yozma fikr yoki hujjat.

ex: Many tourists visit Amish country to experience a simpler way of life.
Amish country in Pennsylvania is known for its traditional lifestyle and farming.
amish country.meta: AQShda, asosan Pensilvaniya, Ohio va Indiana shtatlarida yashovchi Amishlar yashaydigan hududlar. Amishlarga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The army moved the ammunition dump to a safer location.
The soldiers guarded the ammunition dump carefully.
ammunition dump.meta: O‘q-dori yoki qurol-aslahani saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan joy.

ex: Among others, the report mentioned economic and social issues.
She, among others, was invited to the conference.
among others.meta: Bir guruh yoki to‘plam ichida, ayniqsa boshqa shaxslar yoki narsalar qatorida.

ex: The manager’s sarcastic comment showed that he was not amused by the delay.
When the joke offended them, they said, "We are not amused."
we are not amused.meta: Bir vaziyatga norozi yoki norozilik bildiruvchi, ko‘pincha hazil bilan kamtarona ifoda etilgan munosabat.

ex: The children played pranks to the amusement of their parents.
He told a funny story to the amusement of everyone in the room.
to the amusement of.meta: Biror kishini quvontirish yoki o‘ynatish maqsadida, kimningdir kulgusi yoki xursandligiga sabab bo‘lib.

ex: She enjoys anagramming to find hidden meanings in phrases.
Anagramming is a popular word game that challenges your vocabulary skills.
anagramming.meta: Bir so‘z, ibora yoki ism harflarini qayta tartibga solib, boshqa so‘z, ibora yoki ism hosil qilish harakati yoki jarayoni; anagrammalarni yaratish yoki yechish.

ex: The pronoun "he" shows anaphoricity when it refers back to a previously mentioned person.
Anaphoricity helps maintain coherence in a text by linking phrases together.
anaphoricity.meta: Bir so‘z yoki iboraning oldingi gap yoki matnda ilgari tilga olingan narsaga ishora qilish xususiyati yoki sifati.

ex: The group promoted anarcha-feminism as a way to challenge social hierarchies and patriarchy.
Anarcha-feminism opposes both state control and gender oppression.
anarcha-feminism.meta: Ijtimoiy-siyosiy nazariya va harakat bo‘lib, unda anarxizm va feminizm birlashtiriladi; asosan ijtimoiy ierarxiya va patriarxiyaga qarshi kurashishga qaratilgan.

ex: The anarcha-feminist movement challenges both patriarchy and the state.
She is a committed anarcha-feminist who fights for both gender equality and the abolition of hierarchical power.
anarcha-feminist.meta: (a) Noun: Anarxist va feminist bo‘lgan shaxs; anarcha-feminizm harakatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi yoki tarafdori. (b) Adjective: Anarcha-feminizmga oid yoki unga tegishli.

ex: He is a dedicated anarcho-punk fan who attends all underground concerts.
Anarcho-punk bands often sing about anti-authoritarian and social justice themes.
anarcho-punk.meta: Anarxizm mavzusidagi so‘zlar bilan ifodalangan yoki anarxizmni targ‘ib qiluvchi pank rok musiqasi uslubi; shuningdek, bunday musiqani ijro etuvchi yoki muxlisi.

ex: The bias of the bowl affects its path and strategy in the game.
The player rolled the bias bowl carefully to curve around the other balls.
bias bowl.meta: Bowls o‘yinida ishlatiladigan, egilishga ega bo‘lgan (ya’ni, aylanganda buriladigan yo‘l tutuvchi) to‘p. Bu egilishga sabab bo‘luvchi xususiyat unga yo‘nalishni o‘zgartirish imkonini beradi.

ex: The bias-ply construction affects the flexibility and strength of the tire.
Bias-ply tires are commonly used on older vehicles due to their durability.
bias-ply.meta: Egilgan qatlamli shina — bu shina bo‘lib, uning mato qatlamlari shinaning aylanasiga nisbatan qiyshiq burchak ostida joylashtirilgan. Bu uslub shinaning chidamliligi va egiluvchanligini oshiradi.

ex: Bias tape is flexible and ideal for binding curved seams.
She used bias tape to finish the raw edges of the quilt.
bias tape.meta: Tikuvchilikda, egilgan lenta — xom chetlarni tugatish, tikuvlarni bog‘lash va bezash uchun mo‘ljallangan, egilgan yo‘nalishda kesilgan, burilgan lenta yoki tasma.

ex: Yeah, life’s a bitch, but we just have to keep going.
I lost my job and my car broke down—life’s a bitch sometimes.
life’s a bitch.meta: Qiyin, yoqimsiz yoki adolatsiz vaziyatni taslim bo‘lib qabul qilish ifodasi. Hayotning ba’zan og‘ir va mashaqqatli ekanligini bildiradi.

ex: You gonna be in this bitch or what?
We’re all up in this bitch tonight!
in this bitch.meta: AQSh slangi. “Mana shu joyda”, “ana shu yerda” ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha “up in this bitch” shaklida ishlatiladi va ayni joyda yoki ayni holatda ekanlikni ta’kidlaydi.

ex: Their conversation was just a bitchfest full of insults and complaints.
The meeting turned into a bitchfest with everyone blaming each other.
bitchfest.meta: Norasmiy. Yomon yoki achchiq gap-so‘zlarning almashinuvi; odatda, kishilar o‘rtasidagi dushmanlik yoki tortishuv bilan xarakterlanadigan munosabat yoki muloqot.

ex: The argument quickly turned into a bitch fight with harsh words.
The two women got into a bitch fight at the party.
bitch fight.meta: Norasmiy. Ayniqsa ayollar yoki gomoseksual erkaklar o‘rtasida bo‘ladigan shiddatli, qattiq janjal yoki tortishuv.

ex: She can give cards and spades in negotiations, showing her full strength.
When the team gave cards and spades, they played better than ever.
to give cards and spades.meta: Slang (asosiy AQShda). Biror kishi yoki tashkilot o‘zining barcha imkoniyatlari, kuch-quvvati va qobiliyatlarini to‘liq ko‘rsatadi yoki namoyish etadi, hech narsani yashirmaydi.

ex: Don’t be surprised if they get married soon — it’s in the cards.
A promotion is definitely in the cards for her this year.
in the cards.meta: Asosiy Amerika inglizchasida. Ehtimol yoki taqdirda sodir bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan, ehtimoli bor hodisa yoki vaziyat.

ex: They pulled her card from the union after she broke the rules.
After repeated violations, the company decided to pull his card.
to pull a person’s card.meta: Shimoliy Amerika so‘zlashuvida (hozir kam ishlatiladi). Biror kishini ishidan bo‘shatish yoki lavozimidan chetlashtirish; shuningdek, biror kishining uyushma yoki klubdagi a’zoligini bekor qilish yoki vaqtincha to‘xtatish.

ex: The card company offers various rewards and benefits to its customers.
Visa and MasterCard are well-known card companies.
card company.meta: Kredit kartalar yoki hisob-kitob kartalarini chiqaruvchi kompaniya; kredit karta xizmatlarini taqdim etuvchi tashkilot.

ex: To complete the purchase, please enter your card details carefully.
Never share your card details with strangers online.
card details.meta: To‘lov kartasida (ayniqsa kredit yoki debet kartada) yozilgan va karta egasining hisobidan to‘lovlarni amalga oshirishga imkon beruvchi ma’lumotlar, xususan karta raqami, amal qilish muddati, CVV kodi va boshqalar.

ex: He looked through the card file to find the address he needed.
The office keeps a card file of all its clients’ contact information.
card file.meta: Ma’lumot yoki yozuvlarni o‘z ichiga olgan kartochkalar to‘plami, ma’lum tartibda (asosan alifbo bo‘yicha) bir yoki bir nechta quti yoki tortmalarda saqlanadi.

ex: The old-fashioned card match easily ignited with a single spark.
Before modern lighters, people used card matches to light their candles.
card match.meta: Qolipdan chiqargan yupqa kartochka yoki yupqa yog‘och parchasini eritilgan oltingugurtga botirib, osongina olov oladigan qilib tayyorlangan vosita. Mum chiroqlar, lampalar yoki boshqa narsalarni yoqishda ishlatilgan

ex: The bank offers special benefits to its cardmembers.
As a cardmember, you can enjoy exclusive discounts and rewards.
cardmember.meta: Kredit karta yoki to‘lov kartasiga ega bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: The casino collected a portion of the card money as profit.
Players placed their card money on the table before the game started.
card money.meta: (a) Garovli karta o‘yinlarida o‘ynash uchun mo‘ljallangan pul yoki bunday o‘yinlardan tushgan daromad; (b) O‘yin kartalarini xarid qilish uchun sarflanadigan pul.

ex: The online store requires you to enter your card number to process the payment.
Never share your card number with anyone you don’t trust.
card number.meta: To‘lov kartasida (xususan kredit yoki debet kartada) bosib chiqarilgan yoki emboss qilingan raqamlar qatori, shuningdek, magnit lenta yoki chipda kodlangan, kartani aniqlash uchun xizmat qiluvchi noyob raqamlar majmui.

ex: : Before digital storage, data was often stored on punched cards created by a card punch.
The operator used the card punch to input data into the computer system.
card punch.meta: Kartochkalarga teshiklar o‘tkazish uchun mo‘ljallangan uskuna, ayniqsa, hisoblash mashinasi, kompyuter va boshqa qurilmalarga ma’lumot yoki kod uzatish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: The receptionist always kept a card receiver for guests' calling cards.
She placed the visiting cards neatly in the card receiver on the desk.
card receiver.meta: Kartalarni, xususan tashrif kartalarini qo‘yish uchun mo‘ljallangan kichik bezakli idish yoki patnis.

ex: Be careful at the table; there might be a card shark cheating.
He is a real card shark and rarely loses any game.
card shark.meta: Kartochka o‘yinlarida juda mohir bo‘lgan shaxs; shuningdek, kartalarda firib qiladigan, aldovchi odam.

ex: Learning card tricks is a popular hobby among young magicians.
The magician amazed the audience with a clever card trick.
card trick.meta: Sehrgarlik san’atida, o‘yin kartalari yoki bitta karta yordamida bajariladigan sehrli hiyla yoki fokus.

ex: On stage, his character was just a cardboard cutout with no real emotions.
The store used a cardboard cutout of a famous actor to attract customers.
cardboard cutout.meta: Asosiy ma’nosi: Reklama ko‘rgazmasida, teatr dekoratsiyasida va boshqa joylarda ishlatiladigan kartondan kesilgan haykalcha yoki shakl.

ex: The flag was bright cardinal red with a golden emblem.
She wore a beautiful dress in cardinal red to the ceremony.
cardinal red.meta: (a) sifat: Kardinal ruhoniyning kiyimiga va shapkasiga o‘xshash, chuqur qizil rang. (b) ot: Chuqur, yorqin qizil rang.

ex: She painted the walls in cardinal scarlet to create a bold statement.
The robe was a rich cardinal scarlet, symbolizing authority.
cardinal scarlet.meta: (a) ot: Kardinal ruhoniyning liboslari va shapkasiga o‘xshash chuqur qizg‘ish-qizil rang; kardinal qizil bilan bir xil. (b) sifat: Bunday rangga oid; kardinal qizil rangga o‘xshash.

ex: Many gardeners appreciate the cardinal beetle because it helps control pest insects.
The cardinal beetle is easily recognized by its bright red wing cases and long antennae.
cardinal beetle.meta: Yevropada yashovchi Pyrochroidae oilasiga mansub bir nechta turlar, ularning qattiq qanotlari chuqur qizil rangda bo‘ladi, bosh qizil yoki qora rangda, va uzun tishli antennalari bor. Ayniqsa, shu turdagi hasharotlar.

ex: The cardinalfish family includes many species that are active at night.
Cardinalfish are small, colorful fishes often found in coral reefs.
cardinalfish.meta: (a) Opah — Lampris guttatus — (eskirgan va kam uchraydigan atama). (b) Apogonidae oilasiga mansub turli xil kichik, odatda yorqin rangli baliqlar. Ular odatda tropik va subtropik dengizlarda uchraydi.

ex: Mariners use cardinal marks to avoid shallow waters and dangerous rocks.
The cardinal mark indicates the safe direction to navigate around a hazard.
cardinal mark.meta: Dengiz yoki suv yo‘llarida joylashgan, kompasning asosiy to‘rt yo‘nalishini (shimol, janub, sharq, g‘arb) ko‘rsatadigan, xavfsiz harakat yo‘nalishini belgilovchi mayoq yoki boshqa belgi.

ex: Cardinal numerals answer the question “how many?”
"One," "two," and "three" are cardinal numerals.
cardinal numeral.meta: Sanovchi so‘zlar sinfidan bo‘lib, hisoblanadigan miqdorni bildiradi va “necha dona?” savoliga javob beradi (masalan: bir, ikki, uch va hokazo). Bu so‘zlar tartib sonlardan farq qiladi.

ex: A clear care pathway helps doctors and nurses coordinate patient care effectively.
The hospital developed a care pathway for stroke patients to improve treatment outcomes.
care pathway.meta: Sog‘liqni saqlashda — ma’lum bir kasallikni aniqlash va davolashda eng maqbul bosqichlar ketma-ketligi; Umuman olganda — muayyan maqsadga erishish uchun reja yoki strategiya.

ex: Developing a clear care pathway helps improve patient outcomes.
The hospital follows a specific care pathway for stroke patients to ensure timely treatment.
care pathway.meta: Parvarish yo‘li — biror kasallikni aniqlash va davolash jarayonida bosqichma-bosqich qo‘yiladigan eng yaxshi tartibdagi amallar ketma-ketligi yoki rejalashtirilgan davolash strategiyasi.

ex: In a carriage forward shipment, the receiver assumes all the transportation costs.
The goods were sent carriage forward, so the buyer had to pay the delivery charges upon receipt.
carriage forward.meta: Belgilanadigan buyumni tashish va yetkazib berish xarajatlari oluvchi tomonidan to‘lanadigan transport turi. Bunga qarama-qarshi atama — carriage-paid (yetkazib berish xarajatlari jo‘natuvchi tomonidan to‘langan).

ex: Carriage bolts are commonly used in wooden carriage construction for secure fastening.
The carriage bolt has a round head and a square collar to prevent rotation when tightened.
carriage bolt.meta: Kareta qurilishida ishlatiladigan turli murvatlardan biri; ayniqsa, keyingi paytlarda bosh qismi dumaloq yoki oval, bosh ostida esa to‘rtburchakli yelimli (yoqimli) qisqa bo‘lakcha (yozuv) bo‘lgan katta murvat.

ex: In old times, carriage dogs helped pull sledges through the snow.
The carriage dog was trained to run alongside the horse-drawn carriage.
carriage dog.meta: (a) Eskirgan, kam uchraydigan ma’noda: qor yozadigan aravani tortishda ishlatiladigan it (qarabog‘it itiga o‘xshash). (b) Arava yonida yurish uchun maxsus tayyorlangan it, ayniqsa mashinalar yoki aravalar yonida hamrohlik qiladigan it.

ex: The carriage pole must be strong enough to support the weight of the carriage and the horses.
The horses were hitched to the carriage pole before the journey began.
carriage pole.meta: Arava yoki arabaning tayoq qismi bo‘lib, unga otlar yoki boshqa tortuvchi hayvonlar bog‘lanadi.

ex: They replaced the broken carriage spring to ensure a smoother ride.
The carriage spring helps absorb shocks when the horse-drawn carriage moves over rough terrain.
carriage spring.meta: Ot aravasi, temiryo‘l vagonlari va shunga o‘xshash transport vositalarining to‘xtovsiz va yumshoq harakatlanishini ta’minlaydigan, suspenziya tizimida ishlatiladigan prujina. Ayniqsa, barg shaklidagi (leaf spring) prujina.

ex: The elegant carriage sweep led directly to the grand entrance of the estate.
The carriage sweep at the mansion was wide enough for two carriages to pass each other.
carriage sweep.meta: Katta uyning oldiga olib boruvchi, odatda egilgan yoki aylana shaklida bo‘lgan arava yo‘li yoki haydash yo‘lagi.

ex: Carrier current technology allows data to be sent over existing power lines without additional wiring.
The radio signal is transmitted using a carrier current over the electrical wiring.
carrier current.meta: Elektr toki ustiga signal superimpozitsiya qilinib, elektr o‘tkazgich orqali uzatiladigan o‘zgaruvchan tok.

ex: Coconut oil is a popular carrier oil in aromatherapy.
Carrier oils are often used to dilute essential oils before applying them to the skin.
carrier oil.meta: Yog‘da eriydigan efir moyi yoki boshqa moddalarni suyultirish yoki eritish uchun ishlatiladigan yog‘, ayniqsa terapevtik maqsadlarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Hemoglobin is a carrier protein that transports oxygen in the blood.
Carrier proteins help transport molecules across the cell membrane.
carrier protein.meta: (a) No-protein funksional guruh yoki hapten bilan bog‘lanadigan oqsil. (b) Maxsus moddani hujayra membranasidan yoki boshqa biologik tizimlardan o‘tkazishda ishtirok etuvchi oqsil.

ex: Carrier state is important to consider in controlling infectious diseases.
A person in the carrier state can spread the disease without showing symptoms.
carrier state.meta: Maxsus kasallik, patogen yoki genni tashuvchi bo‘lgan holat.

ex: Many investors use carry trade to profit from differences in interest rates between countries.
Carry trade involves borrowing money in a currency with low interest rates and investing it where returns are higher.
carry trade.meta: Past foiz stavkalari bo‘lgan valyutadan qarz olib, yuqori daromadli moliyaviy vositalarga investitsiya qilish amaliyoti.

ex: Many carry traders monitor interest rate differences to make profitable trades.
A carry trader borrows funds in low-interest currencies and invests in higher-yield assets.
carry trader.meta: Foiz farqi savdosi (carry trade) qiladigan, ya’ni past foiz stavkali valyutadan qarz olib, yuqori daromadli moliyaviy vositalarga investitsiya qiladigan moliyaviy savdogar.

ex: They carried me go from the accident site to the ambulance.
Please carry me go to the hospital.
to carry me go.meta: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir bir joydan boshqa joyga olib borish, olib ketish harakati.

ex: Can you carry me come to the meeting?
Please carry me come home.
to carry me come.meta: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir bir joydan olib kelish, ya'ni kimnidir yoki nimanidir shu joyga olib kelish harakati.

ex: She always carries a small carry bag for her laptop.
I took a carry bag to put all the groceries in.
carry bag.meta: Nimani bir joydan boshqasiga olib yurish uchun ishlatiladigan sumka; ayniqsa: (a) xarid qilish uchun ishlatiladigan sumka; = carrier bag (b) ma’lum bir buyumni oson ko‘tarish yoki saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan sumka.

ex: The laptop comes with a sturdy carrying case for easy transport.
He put his camera in a padded carrying case to protect it during travel.
carrying case.meta: Biror narsani tashish uchun mo‘ljallangan quti yoki shunga o‘xshash idish, odatda tutqichi yoki tutqichlari bo‘ladi va ko‘pincha muayyan buyumni tashish paytida himoya qilish uchun yaratilgan.

ex: Companies must report the carrying value of their assets in the financial statements.
The carrying value of the machinery is lower than its current market value.
carrying value.meta: Kompaniyaning hisob-kitob daftaridagi aktivning qiymati (odatda uning asl xarajatidan amortizatsiya yoki qadrsizlanish summasi chiqarilgandan keyingi qiymat). Bozor qiymatidan farqli.

ex: He kept asking questions even though it caused trouble. Curiosity killed the cat, after all.
You should be careful with that topic; remember, curiosity killed the cat.
She warned him not to ask too many questions, saying "curiosity killed the cat."
I know you want to know everything, but remember, curiosity killed the cat.
curiosity killed the cat.meta: Qiziquvchanlik mushukni o‘ldiradi — ortiqcha yoki keraksiz qiziquvchanlik odamga zarar yetkazishi yoki noqulayliklar keltirishi mumkinligini bildiruvchi maqol.

ex: Sometimes you just have to throw caution to the wind and take a chance.
She threw caution to the wind and invested all her savings in the startup.
to throw caution to the wind.meta: Ehtiyotkorlikni to‘xtatib, o‘zini impulsga yoki xohishga berish; jasoratli yoki xavfli yo‘lni tanlash.

ex: Sometimes you have to throw caution to the wind and take risks to succeed.
He threw caution to the wind and invested all his savings in the startup.
to throw caution to the wind.meta: Ehtiyotkorlikni unutmoq — ehtiyotkorlik yoki ogohlikni chetga surib, ichki istak yoki impulsga berilib, jasur yoki xavfli qaror qabul qilish.

ex: During cellular respiration, glucose is broken down to release energy.
Cellular respiration is essential for producing energy in living organisms.
cellular respiration.meta: (a) Nafas olish jarayoni, ayniqsa o‘pkadagi alveolalar va kichik havo yo‘llari orqali havo o'tishi; (b) hujayrada yuz beradigan metabolik jarayon, bunda kislorod yordamida oziq moddalar oksidlanib, energiya hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: Chemo brain can cause problems with memory and concentration.
Many cancer patients experience chemo brain during or after chemotherapy.
chemo brain.meta: Ximyoterapiya davrida yuzaga keladigan xotira yo‘qolishi va miyaning boshqa funksiyalaridagi qiyinchiliklar.

ex: He ordered a chocolate lava cake for dessert.
The chocolate lava inside the cake was rich and gooey.
chocolate lava.meta: Shokolad lava – eritilgan shokolad; ayniqsa, shokoladli tort, pishiriq (masalan, fondant yoki lava cake) ichida yumshoq, quyuq va oqib tushadigan shokoladli markaz.

ex: Some people rely on comfort animals to manage depression.
The comfort animal helped the child cope with anxiety.
comfort animal.meta: Tinchlantiruvchi hayvon – insonni xotirjam qiladigan, unga taskin beradigan hayvon; ayniqsa, ruhiy travma, depressiya, yolg‘izlik yoki shunga o‘xshash holatlarni boshdan kechirayotgan odamlarga ruhiy yordam beruvchi hayvon.

ex: Many people rely on comfort animals during stressful times.
Her comfort animal, a small dog, helped her cope with anxiety.
comfort animal.meta: Tasalli hayvoni — odamga tinchlik va qulaylik baxsh etuvchi, ayniqsa ruhiy qiynalishlar, yolg‘izlik yoki depressiya vaqtida yordam beradigan hayvon.

ex: As a common keeper, she monitors public access to the forest area.
The common keeper ensures the grazing land is protected and not overused.
common keeper.meta: Umumiy yer qo‘riqchisi – umumiy foydalaniladigan yerlar (masalan, yaylov, bog‘, o‘rmon yoki boshqa jamoat mulklari)ga qarovchi va ularni saqlash uchun yollangan shaxs. U bu yerlarning toza, xavfsiz va belgilangan tartibda ishlatilishini nazorat qiladi.

ex: She denied the accusations, but common fame is seldom to blame.
They say he was dishonest in business, and you know — common fame is seldom to blame.
common fame is seldom to blame.meta: Bu maqol shuni anglatadiki, keng tarqalgan mish-mishlar yoki gap-so‘zlar odatda asossiz bo‘lmaydi; ularning tagida bir haqiqat bo‘ladi. Ya’ni, odamlardan eshitilgan umumiy fikr yoki shov-shuv kamdan-kam hollarda mutlaqo noto‘g‘ri bo‘ladi.

ex: Before independence, the rupee was the common coin across the region.
The euro serves as a common coin for many European countries.
common coin.meta: Umumiy tanga – ma’lum bir hududda odatiy yoki rasmiy muomaladagi pul birligi; shuningdek, bir nechta davlatlar yoki hududlar tomonidan qo‘llaniladigan yagona pul tizimi yoki tanga.

ex: The common-emitter configuration is widely used due to its high voltage gain.
A common-emitter amplifier inverts the input signal.
common-emitter.meta: bu bipolyar o‘tishli tranzistor ulanish usuli bo‘lib, unda emitter elektrod kirish va chiqish zanjirlariga umumiy qilib ulanadi. Bu eng keng tarqalgan tranzistorli kuchaytiruvchi konfiguratsiyalardan biridir, kuchaytirish va teskari fazani ta’minlaydi.

ex: In elementary school, students first learn to add and subtract common fractions.
¾ is a common fraction, while 0.75 is a decimal fraction.
common fraction.meta: Oddiy kasr – bu sonlar kasr chizig‘i bilan yozilgan ko‘rinishdagi ifoda bo‘lib, surat (yuqori qism) va maxraj (pastki qism) orqali ifodalanadi, masalan: ¾, ⁷⁄₈. U o‘nlik kasr (masalan, 0.75) ko‘rinishida emas, balki an’anaviy kasr shaklida yoziladi

ex: The fact that smoking is harmful to health is now common knowledge.
It’s common knowledge that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
common knowledge.meta: Umumiy ma’lumot – ko‘pchilik odamlar biladigan, hayotiy tajriba yoki kundalik hayot orqali o‘rgangan, odatda tadqiqot yoki ilmiy o‘rganishsiz tan olinadigan haqiqat yoki bilim.

ex: Common nails are ideal for framing and other construction tasks.
He used a common nail to fasten the wooden boards together.
common nail.meta: Oddiy mix – qurilish va yog‘ochga ishlov berishda keng qo‘llaniladigan mix turi. Bu mixning bosh qismi nisbatan keng bo‘ladi, tanasi silliq yoki ba’zida boshiga yaqin yengil yivlarga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: Fishermen must manage the common-pool resource carefully to avoid depletion.
Clean air is a common-pool resource that everyone benefits from.
common-pool resource.meta: Umumiy foydalaniladigan resurs – shaxsiy mulk bo‘lmagan, balki bir jamoa yoki kengroq guruh tomonidan foydalanishga mo‘ljallangan tabiiy yoki sun’iy resurs.

ex: Modern diesel cars use common rail injection technology for better performance.
The common rail system improves fuel efficiency in diesel engines.
common rail.meta: Umumiy yo‘l — dizel dvigatelida barcha silindrlarga yonilg‘i yetkazib beradigan bitta quvur yoki tizim. Yonilg‘i elektron nazorat qilinadigan valf orqali to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri inyeksiya qilinadi.

ex: A common thread running through the speeches was the call for unity.
The common thread in all her stories is hope.
common thread.meta: Umumiy mavzu – bir nechta narsalarda yoki hodisalarda davomiy yoki takrorlanuvchi xususiyat, belgi yoki tema. Bu atama, ayniqsa, turli voqea, fikr yoki holatlar orasidagi bog‘lanishni ifodalashda ishlatiladi.

ex: The nurse located the common vein before inserting the needle.
The common vein is often used by doctors to draw blood samples.
common vein.meta: Umumiy vena – qo‘lning old (palmar) tomonida joylashgan o‘rta vena bo‘lib, ko‘pincha qon olish uchun ishlatiladi. Ba’zida bu atama qo‘lning boshqa asosiy yuzaki venalariga ham nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The Common Prayer service follows the liturgy outlined in the Book of Common Prayer.
The congregation gathered for the Common Prayer service on Sunday.
common prayer service.meta: Umumiy ibodat marosimi – Common Prayer kitobidagi tartibga muvofiq olib boriladigan cherkov ibodati. Bu marosimda diniy matnlar, duo va marosim qoidalari umumiy kitobda belgilangan shaklda o‘qiladi va bajariladi.

ex: the commons house of assembly no longer exists and is now part of history.
the commons house of assembly was the legislative body in several british colonies.
commons house of assembly.meta: commons house of assembly – shimoliy amerikadagi ba’zi britaniya mustamlakalarining parlamentlaridagi saylangan vakillardan iborat quyi palata. bu organ hozirda tarixiy atama bo‘lib, hozirgi parlament tizimlarida ishlatilmaydi.

ex: fisheries often suffer from the tragedy of the commons due to unregulated fishing.
the tragedy of the commons occurs when individuals overuse a shared resource, causing its depletion.
tragedy of the commons.meta: umumiy resurslarning fojiasi – cheklangan va umumiy foydalaniladigan resurslarni, odamlar o‘z manfaatlari uchun nazoratsiz yoki haddan tashqari foydalanish natijasida kamayishi yoki buzilishi.

ex: historically, commonty land was essential for rural communities.
commonty land is used by villagers for grazing their animals.
commonty land.meta: jamoat yerlari – bir guruh odamlar tomonidan umumiy foydalaniladigan, shaxsiy mulk bo‘lmagan yer maydoni. Bu yer ko‘pincha qishloq yoki jamoa a’zolari tomonidan birgalikda ishlatiladi, masalan, chorva boqish, yig‘im-terim qilish uchun

ex: many textbooks teach commonwealth english alongside british english.
commonwealth english includes variations from countries like australia, india, and canada.
commonwealth english.meta: hamdo‘stlik ingliz tili – Hamdo‘stlik mamlakatlarida (hozirgi yoki sobiq a’zolarda) so‘zlashiladigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tili. Bu ingliz tilining regional varianti bo‘lib, unda mahalliy talaffuz, lug‘at va grammatik xususiyatlar mavjud.

ex: the proposal to increase the number of supreme court justices was seen as court packing.
court packing is often criticized as a way to undermine judicial independence.
court packing.meta: sudni kengaytirish – hukumat yoki boshqaruvchi organ tomonidan sud a’zolarining sonini oshirish amaliyoti, ayniqsa, AQSh Oliy sudida, sud tarkibini o‘z foydasiga o‘zgartirish yoki siyosiy ta’sirni kuchaytirish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The proposal to increase the number of justices was seen as an attempt at court packing.
Court packing has been a controversial issue in U.S. politics.
court packing.meta: Sudni kengaytirish — sud organidagi o‘rinlar sonini ko‘paytirish orqali sud tizimiga siyosiy yoki boshqa ta’sirlarni o‘tkazish harakati yoki siyosati.

ex: many drivers install dashboard cameras to have evidence in case of disputes.
the dashboard camera recorded the accident on the highway.
dashboard camera.meta: salon kamerası – avtomobil salonidagi panelga yoki old oynaning ichki tomoniga o‘rnatilgan kichik video kamera. U olddagi yo‘l va atrofdagi vaziyatni yozib borish uchun ishlatiladi, ko‘pincha harakat davomida xavfsizlik maqsadida.

ex: Dashboard cameras are useful evidence in case of accidents.
He installed a dashboard camera to record his driving trips.
dashboard camera.meta: Panel kamera — avtomobilning old qismidagi yo‘l ko‘rinishini yozib olish uchun panelga yoki oynaning ichki tomoniga o‘rnatilgan kichik video qurilma. Ko‘pincha avtohalokatlar yoki sug‘urta da’volari uchun dalil sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: she felt betrayed because her closest friend did her dirty.
he did me dirty by spreading false rumors about me.
to do (a person) dirty.meta: kimnidir aldash — biror kishiga yomon, nohaq yoki nohonuniy munosabatda bo‘lish; uni aldaganlik qilish yoki xiyonat qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Don’t trust him; he might do you dirty.
He really did her dirty by spreading false rumors.
to do (a person) dirty.meta: Kimnidir yomon ko‘rsatmoq — biror kishiga yomon, adolatsiz yoki halol bo‘lmagan tarzda munosabatda bo‘lish; aldash yoki xiyonat qilish.

ex: activists fight for disability rights to end discrimination.
disability rights ensure equal access to education and employment.
disability rights.meta: nogironlik huquqlari – nogironligi bo‘lgan shaxslarning insoniy, fuqarolik va huquqiy huquqlari; ayniqsa, ular diskriminatsiyasiz muomala qilinishlari, teng imkoniyatlarga ega bo‘lishlari va jamiyatda to‘liq ishtirok etishlari uchun berilgan huquqlar.

ex: scientists use the doomsday clock to warn about global threats.
the doomsday clock is currently set two minutes to midnight.
doomsday clock.meta: qiyomat soati – dunyoning oxiri, halokat yoki yirik falokat belgisi sifatida tasavvur qilingan soat. Ramziy ma’noda, bu soat yarim tun chog‘ida qiyomat yaqinlashayotganini ko‘rsatadi.

ex: Scientists use the doomsday clock to raise awareness about nuclear threats and climate change.
The doomsday clock is currently set at 90 seconds to midnight, indicating high global risk.
doomsday clock.meta: Qiyomat soati — dunyoning oxiri yaqinligini yoki global halokat yaqinligini ramziy ko‘rsatadigan, tun yarim tunda boshlangan deb tasavvur qilinadigan soat.

ex: they have supported the project from day dot.
she has loved music from day dot.
from day dot.meta: boshlang‘ichdan boshlab – biror ish yoki holat ilk marta boshlangandan boshlab, eng dastlabki paytdan davom etayotganini bildiradi.

ex: an optimal energy mix can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
the country is working to diversify its energy mix by adding more renewable sources.
energy mix.meta: energiya aralashmasi – ma’lum bir hududda ichki va sanoat ehtiyojlarini qondirish uchun ishlatiladigan turli yoqilg‘i manbalari, jumladan, fosil yoqilg‘ilar, yadroviy energiya va qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbalarining kombinatsiyasi.

ex: fan art allows followers to express their creativity inspired by their favorite characters.
she shared her fan art of the popular TV series online.
fan art.meta: muxlis san’ati – mashhur ijodkor, kitob, teleko‘rsatuv va boshqa asarlarning ishqibozlari tomonidan yaratilgan san’at asarlari.

ex: Fan art allows fans to express their love for their favorite characters.
She shared her fan art of the popular TV show online.
fan art.meta: Muxlis san’ati — taniqli shaxs, kitob, serial yoki boshqa madaniy mahsulotlarni yaxshi ko‘ruvchi muxlislar tomonidan yaratilgan, ularning qahramonlari yoki mavzularini tasvirlovchi san’at asarlari.

ex: new trends are often introduced during fashion week events.
fashion week in paris attracts designers and buyers from all over the world.
fashion week.meta: moda haftaligi – odatda bir hafta davom etadigan tadbirlar majmui bo‘lib, unda yuqori darajadagi moda uylari va dizaynerlar yangi kolleksiyalarini namoyish qiladilar.

ex: She attended the fashion week to see the latest trends.
Paris Fashion Week attracts designers and celebrities from all over the world.
fashion week.meta: Moda haftaligi — bir hafta davomida o‘tkaziladigan va mashhur moda brendlari hamda dizaynerlarning yangi kiyim kolleksiyalarini taqdim etadigan ko‘rgazma va namoyishlar.

ex: the fast end of the mine was difficult to access due to the surrounding rock.
miners reached the fast end of the coal bed where it met the rock.
fast end.meta: qattiq uchi – (a) ko‘mir, ruda va boshqa minerallar yotqizilgan joyda, toshga tutashgan qismi; (b) (eskirgan) kon ichidagi yo‘lak, ikki tomonida tosh bo‘lgan; (c) tunel yoki kon yo‘lining uchi, u erda tosh yoki qattiq qatlam mavjud.

ex: fast-attack vehicles are designed to quickly engage the enemy.
the navy deployed several fast-attack boats for the mission.
fast-attack.meta: tez hujum qiluvchi – yuqori tezlikda harakatlana oladigan, odatda zirhli bo‘lgan harbiy texnika yoki transport vositasini ifodalovchi atama; masalan, tez hujum qiluvchi qayiq, kemа yoki avtomobil.

ex: the team’s success depended on their fast bowling attack.
fast bowling is an important skill in cricket.
fast bowling.meta: tez tashish – kriketda to‘pni yuqori tezlikda tashish usuli. Bu usulda bowler to‘pni tez va kuch bilan tashib, qarshi jamoaning batsmenlarini qiynashga harakat qiladi.

ex: critics say fast fashion harms the environment due to mass production.
fast fashion allows consumers to buy trendy clothes at low prices.
fast fashion.meta: tez moda – ommaviy bozorga mo‘ljallangan, so‘nggi trendlar asosida tezkor va arzon kiyim-kechak ishlab chiqarish tizimi. Bu kiyimlar tez-tez yangi uslublar bilan yangilanadi va xaridorlarga arzon narxda taklif etiladi.

ex: they offer fast-fit services for brake repairs and oil changes.
the fast-fit garage fixed my car’s tires in no time.
fast-fit.meta: tez o‘rnatiladigan – tez va ishonchli tarzda o‘rnatilishi yoki ta’mirlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan narsaga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Ayniqsa, Britaniyada avtomobil ustaxonasi yoki garaj uchun ishlatiladi, u tezkor ta’mirlar yoki xizmatlar ko‘rsatadi.

ex: fast followers benefit by learning from the mistakes of the market leader.
the company acted as a fast follower, quickly adopting the new technology.
fast follower.meta: tez ergashuvchi – biror tashkilot, sanoat yoki kompaniya bo‘lib, boshqa bir tashkilot yoki kompaniya tomonidan boshlangan yo‘nalishni tezda kuzatib, unga o‘xshash harakatlarni amalga oshiradi.

ex: fast house is an archaic term for a disreputable brothel.
in the old novel, the fast house was located on a shady street.
fast house.meta: yomon obro‘ga ega uy – obro‘siz yoki yomon nomga ega bo‘lgan uy, ayniqsa, fahişa yoki yomon yashash joyi sifatida qaraladi. Hozirda bu so‘z kamroq ishlatiladi va ko‘proq tarixiy ma’noda qabul qilinadi.

ex: fast-paced news updates are common in today’s media.
the movie had a fast-paced plot that kept viewers engaged.
fast-paced.meta: tezkor – voqealar, hikoya yoki jarayon tez va faol ravishda rivojlanadigan, harakatlanuvchi holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: fast radio bursts last only a few milliseconds but carry immense energy.
astronomers study fast radio bursts to understand cosmic phenomena.
fast radio burst.meta: tez radio to‘lqini – osmon jismlari tomonidan millisekund davomida chiqariladigan juda qisqa, lekin juda kuchli radio to‘lqin impulsi.

ex: fast-roping allows rapid deployment of troops in difficult terrain.
the soldiers fast-roped from the helicopter to the ground.
fast-rope.meta: tez arqondan tushish – harbiy xodimlarning vertolyot havoda turgan paytda qalin arqondan tez va xavfsiz tarzda tushish harakati.

ex: the town observes fast time, which is one hour ahead of standard time.
in some regions, fast time is used during daylight saving months.
fast time.meta: oldinroq vaqt – bir hududda ikki turdagi soat vaqti mavjud bo‘lganda, ulardan biri boshqasidan oldinroq, odatda bir soat yoki ba’zida yarim soat ilgari ko‘rsatiladigan vaqt.

ex: these fast-twitch muscles fatigue faster than slow-twitch muscles.
fast-twitch muscle fibers help sprinters run quickly.
fast-twitch.meta: tez qisqaruvchi – tez harakat qiluvchi va tez qisqarib, tez bo‘shaydigan mushak yoki mushak tolasi turi. Bunday mushak tolalari tez harakatlar va kuch talab qiladigan ishlar uchun javobgardir, ammo tez charchaydi.

ex: the baby was fast off and didn’t wake up all night.
after a long day, he was fast off by 9 pm.
fast off.meta: chuqur uxlab qolgan – qattiq va chuqur uxlash holati, ko‘pincha juda tinch va uyg‘onishga qiyin bo‘lgan uyquni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z ayniqsa britancha ingliz tilida va ayrim mintaqaviy lahjalarda ishlatiladi.

ex: some people choose to live fast, die young, embracing risk and excitement.
the rock star lived fast, died young, and became a legend.
live fast, die young.meta: tez yashab, yosh o‘lish – hayotdan to‘liq, shiddat bilan zavqlanib yashash, lekin ko‘pincha uzoq umr ko‘rmaslik degan ma’noni bildiruvchi maqol yoki hayot tarzi ifodasi.

ex: he said he would leave, but I told him, “not so fast.”
“I’m going to quit now.” — “Not so fast! Let’s think this through first.”
not so fast.meta: shunchalik tez emas – kimdir aytgan gapiga yoki qilmoqchi bo‘lgan ishiga qarshi turish, uni to‘xtatish yoki qayta o‘ylashga chaqirish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

ex: with the fast-approaching deadline, she worked nonstop.
the fast-approaching storm forced everyone to seek shelter.
fast-approaching.meta: tez yaqinlashayotgan – fazoda, vaqtda yoki vaziyatda tezda yaqinlashib kelayotgan, yaqinlashishi kutilayotgan hodisa yoki holat.

ex: fast-living often leads to health problems later in life.
he lived a fast-living lifestyle, full of parties and late nights.
fast-living.meta: tezz yashash – behuda, betartib va odatda tartibsiz yoki mo‘’tadil bo‘lmagan hayot tarzida yashash; odatda hasharotli va ortiqcha hayot kechirishni anglatadi.

ex: the athletes gave their best in the fast-run event.
it was a fast-run race, and the winner set a new record.
fast-run.meta: tez yugurilgan – musobaqa yoki yugurish butun vaqt davomida yuqori tezlikda o‘tkazilgan, qisqa vaqtda yakunlangan.

ex: the dictator fastened his hold on power through strict laws.
the company fastened its hold on the market by launching new products.
to fasten one’s hold.meta: ushtini mahkamlash – nimanidir yanada qattiqroq ushlash yoki mahkamlash; (ma’nosi kengaytirilgan) o‘z hokimiyati, ta’siri yoki nazoratini kuchaytirish, mustahkamlash.

ex: the announcement was surprising, so fasten your seatbelt.
fasten your seatbelt, this movie has lots of unexpected twists!
fasten your seatbelt.meta: xavfsizlik kamarini taqing – (sharhda, asosan AQShdan kelgan) hayratlanarli yoki hayajonli voqea yoki holatga tayyorlanish uchun ishlatiladigan ifoda; o‘zini oldinda kutayotgan kutilmagan yoki hayajonli narsaga tayyorlash.

ex: as the feast-giver, she prepared a delicious meal for everyone.
the feast-giver welcomed all guests warmly.
feast-giver.meta: to‘y uyushtiruvchi – ziyofat yoki bayram tadbirini tashkil qiluvchi, mehmonlarni ovqat bilan ta’minlaydigan odam.

ex: during the festival of the dead, families visit cemeteries and light candles.
the festival of the dead is celebrated in many cultures to honor ancestors.
festival of the dead.meta: o‘liklar bayrami – turli dinlar va madaniyatlarda o‘limdan keyingi oilaviy yoki jamoaviy a’zolarni yodga olish uchun o‘tkaziladigan turli bayramlar.

ex: during the festival of colours, people throw colored powder on each other.
the festival of colours is celebrated with much joy and vibrant colors.
festival of colours.meta: anglar bayrami – asosan hinduizmda nishonlanadigan Holi bayrami; odamlar bir-biriga turli rangdagi kukunlar sepib, quvonch va do‘stlikni bayram qiladilar.

ex: many filmmakers participate in the international festival circuit every year.
the band toured the festival circuit to promote their new album.
festival circuit.meta: festival tsirkulyatsiyasi – ma’lum bir soha yoki janr, masalan, musiqa, kino, adabiyot sohasidagi doimiy tashkil etilgan festival yoki tadbirlar zanjiri yoki ketma-ketligi.

ex: being a festival headliner can greatly boost a musician’s career.
the band was the festival headliner and played last on the main stage.
festival headliner.meta: festivalning asosiy ishtirokchisi – musiqa festivalida eng katta e’tibor qaratilgan, ko‘pincha festival kunining oxirida chiqadigan, eng mashhur yoki asosiy sahna ishtirokchisi.

ex: the concert had festival seating, so people arrived early to get good spots.
festival seating means you can choose any available seat when you arrive.
festival seating.meta: festival o‘rindig‘i – konsert, spektakl, opera va boshqa tadbirlarda joylashgan o‘rindiq yoki o‘rindiqlar maydoni; hozirda ko‘pincha bitta chipta egasiga aniq belgilangan o‘rin emas, balki erkin joylashish tizimi.

ex: fistulous withers can cause pain and swelling at the horse’s withers.
the horse was suffering from fistulous withers and required veterinary treatment.
fistulous withers.meta: fistulyoz bo‘yin sohasidagi shish — otlarda bo‘yin orqasidagi (withers) supraspinatus bursa (yiringli bo‘shliq) ning yallig‘lanishi yoki infektsiyasi bilan tavsiflanadigan kasallik; ko‘pincha yiring to‘planib, sohada yaralar yoki teshiklar paydo bo‘ladi.

ex: the living room had several colorful floor cushions for extra seating.
she sat comfortably on a floor cushion during the gathering.
floor cushion.meta: pol yostiqchasi – o‘tirish uchun polga qo‘yiladigan katta yumshoq yostiqcha.

ex: Floor cushions add a cozy feel to any living room.
She sat comfortably on the floor cushion while reading a book.
floor cushion.meta: Pollik yostiq — odamlar pollarga o‘tirishlari uchun joy sifatida ishlatiladigan katta yumshoq yostiq.

ex: food poverty affects children’s health and development significantly.
many families suffer from food poverty and struggle to provide nutritious meals.
food poverty.meta: ovqat tanqisligi – insonning o‘zining asosiy oziq-ovqat ehtiyojlarini qondirish uchun yetarli yoki to‘yimli ovqatga ega bo‘lmaslik holati.

ex: thank fuck I found my keys; I thought they were lost.
thank fuck the rain stopped before the picnic.
thank fuck.meta: yahshi bo‘pti – biror narsa sodir bo‘lgani yoki bo‘lmagani, holat shunday ekanligi uchun minnatdorlik yoki yengillik bildiruvchi qo‘pol ifoda; “xudoga shukr” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: some people prefer to avoid GE foods due to health concerns.
GE crops are modified to resist pests and improve yield.
ge.meta: genetik muhandislik qilingan (GM) – genetik muhandislik usuli yordamida o‘zgartirilgan yoki ishlab chiqarilgan oziq-ovqat, organizmlar va boshqalar.

ex: a glitterball adds a festive atmosphere to any party.
the disco had a large glitterball hanging from the ceiling that reflected colorful lights.
glitterball.meta: chiroqli shar – kichik oynali yuzalar bilan qoplangan, osilgan va yorqin, porloq bezak sifatida ishlatiladigan katta shar.

ex: They decorated the club with a giant glitterball for the party.
The glitterball spun slowly, casting sparkling lights across the dance floor.
glitterball.meta: Charaqlovchi shar — odatda shiftga osilgan, kichik oynalar bilan qoplangan va nurni taratib, raqs zallari yoki partiyalarda yorqin effektlar beradigan katta porloq shar.

ex: economic policies of the global north often influence global markets.
the global north includes countries like the United States, Canada, and many in Western Europe.
global north.meta: global shimol – iqtisodiy va sanoat jihatdan yuqori rivojlangan davlatlarning umumiy guruhini ifodalaydi; odatda rivojlangan va boy mamlakatlar tushuniladi; global janub bilan qarama-qarshi.

ex: international aid is often directed towards the global south to support development.
many countries in the global south face challenges like poverty and lack of infrastructure.
global south.meta: global janub – iqtisodiy va sanoat rivojlanishi nisbatan past bo‘lgan davlatlar guruhi; odatda rivojlanayotgan va kamroq boy mamlakatlarni anglatadi; global shimol bilan taqqoslanadi.

ex: the recipe calls for two teaspoons of ground green cardamom.
green cardamom is often used in cooking for its strong aromatic flavor.
green cardamom.meta: yashil kardamom – qayta ishlashda oqartirilmagan kardamom urug‘ kapsulalari (Elettaria cardamomum); rangi yashilroq va ta’mi kuchliroq bo‘ladi.

ex: historians debate the exact details of the halleluia victory.
the halleluia victory was a significant event in early British history.
halleluia victory.meta: alleluya g‘alabasi – 429-yilda britonlar armiyasi tomonidan saxsonlar va piktlarga qarshi qo‘lga kiritilgan g‘alaba nomi; “alleluya g‘alabasi” sifatida ham ataladi.

ex: investors sometimes fall victim to herd mentality during market crashes.
herd mentality often leads people to follow the crowd without questioning.
herd mentality.meta: jamoa aqliyati – guruhdagi odamlarning o‘z fikrlarini yoki xulq-atvorini shu guruh tomonidan o‘rnatilgan yoki kutilgan standartlarga moslashtirishga moyilligi.

ex: Sometimes herd mentality leads to poor decision-making.
Herd mentality can cause people to follow trends without questioning them.
herd mentality.meta: Jamolik fikrlashi — guruh a’zolarining o‘z fikr va harakatlarini guruh normasi yoki kutilmalariga muvofiq o‘zgartirish tendentsiyasi.

ex: holiday reading helps people relax and unwind.
she packed some light holiday reading for the beach.
holiday reading.meta: ta’til o‘qilishi – ta’til paytida o‘qiladigan yoki o‘qishga mos material; asosan, aqliy zo‘riqishdan ko‘ra yengil ko‘ngilochar asarlar.

ex: Holiday reading is usually light and entertaining.
I packed some holiday reading for the beach.
holiday reading.meta: Ta'til uchun o‘qiladigan kitoblar — ta’til vaqtida o‘qish uchun mo‘ljallangan, ko‘proq dam olish va zavq olishga qaratilgan, ko‘pincha yengil va qiziqarli badiiy asarlar.

ex: holiday romances are often exciting but short-lived.
they had a brief holiday romance during their trip to Italy.
holiday romance.meta: ta’til sevgi hikoyasi – ta’til davomida tanishgan ikki kishi orasidagi sevgi munosabatlari, odatda faqat ta’til davomida davom etadigan ehtirosli munosabat.

ex: Holiday romances are often intense but short-lived.
They had a holiday romance during their trip to Italy.
holiday romance.meta: Ta'til muhabbati — ta’til paytida tanishgan ikki kishining qisqa muddatli, ko‘pincha faqat ta’til davomida mavjud bo‘ladigan sevgi munosabati.

ex: housing insecurity can affect a person’s health and well-being.
many families face housing insecurity due to rising rents.
housing insecurity.meta: uy-joy noaniqligi – barqaror yoki yetarli yashash sharoitlariga ega bo‘lmaslik holati, ayniqsa, ko‘chirilish xavfi yoki xavfsizsiz, noqulay joyda yashash sababli yuzaga keladigan vaziyat.

ex: sometimes, the only way to succeed is to keep on keeping on despite obstacles.
even though things were tough, she decided to keep on keeping on.
to keep on keeping on.meta: davom etaverish – ayniqsa qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, oxir-oqibat muvaffaqiyatga erishish umidida biror ishni, harakatni sabr bilan davom ettirish, qat’iyat bilan davom ettirish.

ex: Sometimes you just have to keep on keeping on, no matter how hard it gets.
Despite all the obstacles, she kept on keeping on until she succeeded.
to keep on keeping on.meta: Mashaqqatga qaramay davom etmoq — qiyin sharoitlarda ham to‘xtamasdan, oxir-oqibat muvaffaqiyatga erishish umidida harakatni davom ettirish.

ex: The lava cake has a warm, gooey center that melts in your mouth.
I ordered a chocolate lava cake for dessert.
lava cake.meta: lava tort – pishirilgandan keyin ichki qismi yumshoq, qalin va suyuq bo‘lib qoladigan, odatda issiq holatda desert sifatida xizmat qilinadigan (asosan shokoladli) tort turi.

ex: The lava cake’s warm, gooey center makes it a favorite among chocolate lovers.
I ordered a chocolate lava cake for dessert, and it was delicious.
lava cake.meta: Lava torti — pishirish jarayonidan so‘ng ichki qismi yumshoq va suyuq qoladigan, odatda issiq holda desert sifatida taqdim etiladigan shokoladli tort.

ex: Creating a minimum viable product helps save time and resources.
Our startup launched the MVP version and received initial feedback from users.
minimum viable product.meta: Minimal ishlaydigan mahsulot (MVP) – bu eng asosiy funksiyalarga ega bo‘lgan, foydalanuvchilarga sinov tariqasida taqdim etilishi mumkin bo‘lgan dastlabki mahsulot.

ex: The startup released a minimum viable product to gather user feedback early.
We launched a minimum viable product to test the core idea before full development.
minimum viable product.meta: Minimal ishlaydigan mahsulot – bu mahsulotning dastlabki, eng sodda, lekin ishlash uchun zarur bo‘lgan asosiy funksiyalarini o‘z ichiga olgan versiyasidir.

ex: Media training helps executives deliver clear and confident messages during interviews.
The politician underwent media training before appearing on national television.
media training.meta: bu insonlarni, ayniqsa omma oldida chiqish qiladigan shaxslarni (siyosatchilar, rahbarlar, sportchilar) ommaviy axborot vositalarida (TV, radio, matbuot, internet) qanday qilib samarali, tushunarli va ishonchli muloqot qilishga o‘rgatish jarayonidir.

ex: Please put yourself on mute when you're not speaking.
You're on mute—we can't hear you.
on mute.meta: bu qurilma (telefon, mikrofon, kompyuter va h.k.) ning ovoz eshittirish yoki ovoz uzatish funksiyasi vaqtincha o‘chirilgan holatini anglatadi. Masalan, videoqo‘ng‘iroq vaqtida ishtirokchi gapirayotgan bo‘lsa-da, mikrofon o‘chirilgan bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Fish like salmon and mackerel are rich sources of PUFAs.
PUFAs are essential fats that the body cannot produce on its own.
polyunsaturated fatty acid.meta: Ko‘p to‘yinmagan yog‘ kislotasi (PUFA) – bu tarkibida uglerod atomlari o‘rtasida ikki yoki undan ortiq qo‘sh bog‘lar bo‘lgan yog‘ kislotasi turi. Ular asosan baliq yog‘i, kungaboqar moyi, zig‘ir urug‘i va yong‘oqlarda uchraydi.

ex: The politician’s secret life was like feasting with panthers—thrilling but inevitably destructive.
He knew she was trouble, but he was drawn to her—feasting with panthers, as they say.
to feast with panthers.meta: Yo‘lbarslar bilan ziyofat qilish iborasi dastlab taqiqlangan yoki axloqan buzuq jinsiy munosabatlarni anglatgan.

ex: in getting involved with the criminal underworld, he was feasting with panthers.
he knew she was dangerous, but he continued to feast with panthers.
to feast with panthers.meta: “panteralar bilan ziyofat qilish” iborasi dastlabda xavfli, noqonuniy yoki axloqiy jihatdan man etilgan jinsiy munosabatlarga ishora qilgan.

ex: Activists are calling for reproductive justice for women in underserved communities.
Reproductive justice includes access to contraception, abortion, and maternal care.
reproductive justice.meta: Reproduktiv adolat – bu insonning, ayniqsa ayollarning, farzand ko‘rish yoki ko‘rmaslik, oilani rejalashtirish va bolalarni xavfsiz hamda qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi sharoitda tarbiyalash huquqlariga nisbatan adolatli va teng yondashuv prinsiplarini ifodalaydi.

ex: Rich tea biscuits are perfect for a light snack.
She dipped a rich tea biscuit into her cup of tea.
rich tea.meta: Rich tea – bu yumaloq shakldagi, yengil, ozroq shirin va xiralashgan tuzilishga ega bo‘lgan pechene turi bo‘lib, u asosan maltlangan bug‘doy unidan tayyorlanadi.

ex: He’s not the fastest runner, but slow and steady wins the race.
She studied a little every day, proving that slow and steady wins the race.
slow and steady wins the race.meta: Bu maqol odamga shoshilmasdan, barqarorlik va sabr bilan harakat qilish orqali oxir-oqibatda muvaffaqiyatga erishish mumkinligini anglatadi.

ex: He’s working in a slow hurry, careful but determined.
We’re fixing up the house in a slow hurry—getting things done without stressing.
in a slow hurry.meta: "In a slow hurry" iborasi shoshmasdan, lekin izchil va maqsadli tarzda harakat qilish holatini bildiradi. Bu holatda odam vaqtni behuda sarflamaydi, lekin keragidan ortiq shoshilmaydi ham. U harakatini sokinlik bilan, lekin samarali tarzda olib boradi.

ex: The article about sandwich rankings shows it was a slow news day.
It must be a slow news day—they’re reporting on a cat stuck in a tree.
slow news day.meta: bu ommaviy axborot vositalari uchun muhim yoki jiddiy yangiliklar deyarli bo‘lmagan vaqt davrini bildiradi. Bunday kunlarda OAV odatda arzimas, noodatiy yoki ko‘ngilochar mazmundagi xabarlarni yoritishga majbur bo‘ladi, chunki katta voqealar yo‘q.

ex: I ordered the package a month ago—must’ve come on a slow boat to China.
Installing that software update was like taking a slow boat to China.
slow boat to china.meta: "Slow boat to China" iborasi nihoyatda uzoq vaqt talab qiladigan ish yoki safarni bildiradi. Ba’zida harakatda yoki tushunishda juda sekin bo‘lgan odam haqida ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: In that poker game, I put her on a slow boat to China—she didn’t even see it coming.+
He was down so many chips, I just had to get him on a slow boat to China.
to get (put, have) a person on a slow bo.meta: Bu ibora dastlab poker o‘yinida qo‘llanilgan bo‘lib, raqibni yutqazishiga hali anchagina vaqt bor, lekin u allaqachon yutqazishi aniq bo‘lgan holatga qo‘yishni anglatadi.

ex: That slow ball completely threw off the batter’s timing.
