The bowler tricked the batsman with a perfectly disguised slow ball.
slow ball.meta: Sekin to‘p — bu kriket yoki beysbol o‘yinida maxsus tarzda sekinroq uzatiladigan to‘p bo‘lib, u zarba beruvchini aldash va uning vaqtini buzish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: The audience gave a slow clap to mock the poorly executed performance.
He received a slow clap after tripping on stage during his big speech.
slow clap.meta: Sekin chapak – bu atayin sekin va muntazam tarzda qarsak chalish bo‘lib, odatda kinoya, masxara yoki norozilik bildiradi. Ba’zan u sharmandalik yoki g‘alati vaziyatni tan olish tarzida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The slow train arrives later because it makes many local stops.
We took a slow train through the countryside, stopping at every village.
slow train.meta: Sekin poyezd – bu yo‘nalish bo‘yicha harakatlanayotganda deyarli barcha yoki ko‘plab kichik bekatlarda to‘xtaydigan yo‘lovchi poyezdi.

ex: Slow-twitch fibers help maintain posture throughout the day.
Long-distance runners have a high proportion of slow-twitch muscle fibers.
slow-twitch.meta: Sekin qisqaruvchi mushak tolasi — bu mushakning sekin qisqaradigan va bo‘shashadigan, lekin uzoq muddat ishlashga chidamli turi hisoblanadi.

ex: He decided to go slow in the relationship after getting hurt before.
Let’s go slow with this project and make sure we do it right.
to go slow.meta: “To go slow” iborasi ishni yoki harakatni shoshmasdan, bosqichma-bosqich va ehtiyotkorlik bilan olib borish ma’nosini anglatadi. Bu ibora keskin yoki noaniq qarorlar qabul qilmaslik, balki og‘ir-bosiqlik bilan harakat qilish zarurligini bildiradi.

ex: Take it slow—there’s no need to rush back to work after surgery.
After finishing finals, I’m just going to take it slow this weekend.
to take it slow.meta: “To take it slow” iborasi shoshmasdan, xotirjam tarzda harakat qilish yoki vaqtni dam olish, bo‘shashish uchun sarflash ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: His slow-pacing during the presentation lost the audience’s attention.
The film’s slow-pacing made it feel thoughtful but also a bit boring.
slow-pacing.meta: Slow-pacing – bu biror jarayon yoki hodisaning asta-sekin rivojlanishi, sekin yurishi yoki sur’atda sust bo‘lishini bildiradi. U voqealar ketma-ketligi, hikoya dinamikasi yoki ishlash jarayoni haqida bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: She walked into the room, slow-stepping with quiet grace.
A slow-stepping procession entered the church in silence.
slow-stepping.meta: Slow-stepping — bu sekin va barqaror yuradigan, odatda og‘ir-bosiq, ba’zan esa tashqi jiddiylik yoki charchoqni ifodalovchi yurish uslubini bildiradi. Bu holat keksalik, muhim vaziyat, sog‘liq holati yoki ruhiy kechinma bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Many municipalities add sodium fluoride to drinking water for dental health.
Toothpaste containing sodium fluoride helps reduce cavities.
sodium fluoride.meta: Natriy ftorid — bu oq kristallsimon modda bo‘lib, ichimlik suvini ftorlash, tish pastalari tarkibida tish emalini mustahkamlash, tibbiy tasvirlash va metallarni ajratib olish (ekstraktiv metallurgiya) jarayonlarida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Toothpaste often contains sodium fluoride to strengthen enamel.
Sodium fluoride is commonly added to drinking water to prevent tooth decay.
sodium fluoride.meta: Natriy florid — oq rangdagi kristall modda bo‘lib, ichimlik suvini va tish pastasini florid bilan boyitishda, shuningdek tibbiy tasvir olish va metall qazib olish jarayonlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: She worked as a stable hand during her summer break.
The stable hand feeds the horses every morning at six.
stable hand.meta: Otxonadagi ishchi — bu otxonada ishlovchi shaxs bo‘lib, u otlarga qarash, ya’ni ularni ovqatlantirish, tozalash, parvarishlash, shuningdek, otxonaning kundalik tozaligi va ta’miri bilan shug‘ullanadi.

ex: She worked as a stable hand before becoming a professional rider.
The stable hand cleans the stalls and feeds the horses every morning.
stable hand.meta: Otxona xodimi — otxonada ishlovchi, otlarning parvarishi, oziqlantirish, tozalash va boshqa umumiy ishlarni bajaradigan shaxs.

ex: Please empty the swing bin when it's full.
She threw the apple core into the swing bin under the sink.
swing bin.meta: bu ustki qismi g‘ildirak yoki milga o‘rnatilgan va tebranadigan qopqog‘i bo‘lgan axlat idishidir. Qopqoq axlat tashlanayotgan paytda itarilsa ochiladi va keyin avtomatik tarzda yopiladi.

ex: She opened the swing bin and threw away the trash.
The kitchen had a swing bin attached to the cabinet door for easy waste disposal.
swing bin.meta: Sving-bin — devordan, shkafdan yoki boshqa joydan osilib, harakatlana oladigan eshikchasi yoki qopqog‘i bo‘lgan saqlash idishi yoki chiqindi qutisi. Ko‘pincha chiqindilar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: A therapy dog helped the children feel more relaxed during reading time.
The hospital invites therapy animals every week to comfort the patients.
therapy animal.meta: Terapiya hayvoni — bu insonlarga, ayniqsa keksalar, bolalar yoki ruhiy-emotsional muammolari bor bemorlarga ruhiy taskin berish, yolg‘izlik va xavotirni kamaytirish maqsadida ishlatiladigan maxsus o‘rgatilgan hayvon

ex: Children enjoyed petting the therapy animal during their visit to the care home.
The hospital uses therapy animals to help calm patients.
therapy animal.meta: Terapiya hayvoni — insonlarning ruhiy yoki jismoniy sog‘lig‘ini yaxshilash maqsadida foydalaniladigan hayvon. Ko‘pincha qarindoshlar uyida, bolalar bog‘chasida yoki shifoxonada bemorlar va yoshlar bilan uchrashish uchun olib kelinadi.

ex: The suspect was wearing a thug-like outfit with a hoodie and chains.
His thug-like attitude made everyone feel uncomfortable.
thug-like.meta: Thug-like sifatdosh shakli, odatda bezori, zo‘ravon, yoki jinoyatchiga o‘xshash harakat va ko‘rinishga ega insonlar yoki xatti-harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Mutations in transcription factors can lead to serious genetic disorders.
The transcription factor binds to the promoter region of the gene.
transcription factor.meta: Transkripsiya omili — bu DNKning ma’lum qismlariga birikib, undan RNK molekulasi sintezlanishini (transkripsiyani) nazorat qiladigan maxsus oqsillar guruhidir. Bu oqsillar gen ifodalanishini belgilaydi.

ex: The protein acts as a transcription factor by binding to DNA sequences.
Transcription factors play a crucial role in gene expression.
transcription factor.meta: Transkripsiya faktori — DNKning ma’lum joylariga bog‘lanib, RNK transkripsiyasini (DNK dan RNK ga genetik ma’lumotni ko‘chirish jarayonini) boshqaruvchi turli oqsillar.

ex: She uses a voice assistant to check the news every morning.
My voice assistant plays music when I say “Play jazz”.
voice assistant.meta: Ovozli yordamchi — bu ovoz orqali faollashtiriladigan dastur yoki qurilma bo‘lib, u buyruqlar yoki savollarga javoban turli elektron vazifalarni bajaradi. Odatda, u foydalanuvchi bilan tabiiy til orqali muloqot qiladi va intellektual yordam ko‘rsatadi.

ex: Wage theft affects millions of low-wage workers each year.
The restaurant was sued for wage theft after failing to pay overtime.
wage theft.meta: bu ish beruvchining ishchiga halol ishlagan mehnat haqini bermasligi bilan bog‘liq noqonuniy harakatlar shakli. Bu kamroq to‘lash, ish soatlarini yashirish, ortiqcha ish haqi to‘lamaslik yoki umuman to‘lovni kechiktirish kabi holatlarda yuz beradi.

ex: The company was fined for wage theft after underpaying its employees.
Wage theft is a serious problem that affects many workers.
wage theft.meta: Maosh o‘g‘irligi — ish beruvchi tomonidan xodimga to‘lanishi kerak bo‘lgan haq to‘liq yoki to‘g‘ri miqdorda berilmay, maosh yoki boshqa haq-huquqlar noqonuniy ravishda ushlab qolinishi yoki kamaytirilishi holati.

ex: The heavy bureaucracy amars progress on the project.
His constant interruptions amar her attempts to explain.
amar.meta: shaxs yoki harakatning erkin bajarilishiga to‘sqinlik qilish, uni sekinlashtirish, yoki halal berish deganidir. Bu atama odatda biror ishning oldini olish, harakatni cheklash yoki uni izdan chiqarishga sabab bo‘lish holatlari bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Amazonian communities rely on the rainforest for food and medicine.
The museum features Amazonian artifacts collected from indigenous tribes.
amazonian.meta: Amazonian so‘zi sifat sifatida Amazon daryosi atrofida yoki Amazon havzasida yashovchi tubjoy xalqlarga yoki ularning madaniyatiga oid degan ma’noni bildiradi.

ex: As an amicus, the legal scholar provided insight into constitutional implications.
The Supreme Court accepted a brief from an amicus supporting the plaintiff.
amicus.meta: bu sud ishi bilan bevosita bog‘liq bo‘lmagan, ammo ishga ta’sir qiluvchi muhim masala yuzasidan sudga yuridik maslahat yoki huquqiy fikr bildiruvchi shaxs yoki tashkilotdir. U tomonlardan biri emas, balki mustaqil va xolis ekspert sifatida ishtirok etadi.

ex: He rose amidward the conflict, determined to speak.
Amidward the storm, they found shelter in a cave.
amidward.meta: Amidward so‘zi ravish yoki predlog sifatida ishlatiladi va biror hodisa, holat yoki faoliyat davomida, uning o‘rtalarida yoki ichida sodir bo‘layotgan boshqa bir holatni bildiradi.

ex: Under Scots Law, the tenant faced amission of the leased property.
The court declared the amission of his trading rights due to repeated violations.
amission.meta: Amission — bu huquqiy atama bo‘lib, ayniqsa Shotlandiya qonunchiligida ishlatiladi va biror shaxsning o‘z huquqlari, mol-mulki yoki boshqa imtiyozlaridan ayrilishi yoki ularni yo‘qotishi holatini bildiradi.

ex: The prisoner went amok after hearing the sentence.
He ran amok through the streets, causing panic among the people.
amok.meta: Amok so‘zi insonning o‘ta kuchli, nazoratdan chiqqan, qo‘rqinchli va qotillikka moyil holatini ifodalaydi. Bu holat ko‘pincha vahshiyona, tartibsiz va xavfli hatti-harakatlar bilan kechadi.

ex: The chef prepared a delicious amok steamed in banana leaves.
We tried the traditional Cambodian amok made with fresh fish and spices.
amok.meta: Amok — Kamboja va Tailand oshxonasiga xos an’anaviy taom; odatda baliq, kokos suti va ziravorlardan tayyorlanib, banan yaprog‘ida bug‘da pishiriladi. Shuningdek, amok taomini tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan ziravor pastasi ham shu nom bilan ataladi.

ex: He gained ampleness over the winter months.
The ampleness of her figure was admired by many.
ampleness.meta: Ampleness so‘zi tananing yoki uning bir qismining to‘liq, dumaloq, to‘yingan shaklda bo‘lish holatini bildiradi. Bu atama odatda insonning jismoniy ko‘rinishidagi to‘qlik, qalinlik yoki semizlik ma’nolarida ishlatiladi.

ex: The gods fought to obtain the amrita to gain eternal life.
In Indian mythology, amrita is considered the nectar of immortality.
amrita.meta: Amrita — hind mifologiyasida va diniy rivoyatlarda xudolar tomonidan ichiladigan maxsus ichimlik yoki ovqat hisoblanadi. U abadiy hayot, kuch-quvvat va o‘limsizlikni ta’minlaydi. Bu tushuncha grek mifologiyasidagi ambrosiya ga o‘xshashdir.

ex: Historians criticized the book for anachronizing ancient events.
The movie anachronizes modern technology in a medieval setting.
anachronize.meta: tushunchani o‘z vaqtiga to‘g‘ri kelmaydigan tarixiy davrga noto‘g‘ri joylashtirishni anglatadi. Bu xato ko‘pincha tarixiy asarlarda yoki san’atda uchraydi, masalan, qadimgi davrda mavjud bo‘lmagan texnologiya yoki kiyim-kechakni o‘sha davrga bog‘lash.

ex: Anacrusis notes lead smoothly into the first stressed beat of the phrase.
The melody begins with an anacrusis before the main theme starts.
anacrusis.meta: Anakrüzis — musiqa sohasida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, u frazaning boshlanishida keladigan, asosiy urg‘uga ega bo‘lmagan nota yoki notalar ketma-ketligini anglatadi.

ex: Anarchical movements have historically opposed centralized state control.
The community was organized on an anarchical basis, without any formal government.
anarchical.meta: Anarchical sifat so‘zi siyosiy falsafa bo‘lgan anarkizmga oid yoki undan kelib chiqqan narsalarni bildiradi. Bu atama odatda jamiyat, boshqaruv yoki tizimlarning anarkizm tamoyillari asosida tashkil etilgan yoki ishlayotgan holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: The idea was anathematical to the traditionalists in the group.
His behavior was anathematical to all his colleagues.
anathematical.meta: Anathematical so‘zi shaxs uchun juda yoqimsiz yoki g‘azablantiruvchi, hatto mutlaqo rad etishga loyiq bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi. Bu atama odatda kuchli nafrat yoki qarshilik bildirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Anatolian languages provide valuable insight into early Indo-European speech.
Hittite is one of the best-known Anatolian languages.
anatolian.meta: Anatoliya tillari — qadimda Anatoliya (hozirgi Turkiya hududi)da so‘zlangan hind-yevropa tillari oilasi. Bu tillar hozirda o‘lgan, tarixiy va arxeologik manbalarda qoldiqlari mavjud bo‘lgan tillardir.

ex: Ancient Anatolic manuscripts are studied by theologians.
The Anatolic tradition influenced many aspects of Eastern Orthodox worship.
anatolic.meta: Anatolik so‘zi tarixiy va diniy kontekstda ishlatilib, Sharqiy pravoslav cherkoviga tegishli yoki unga oid narsalarni bildiradi. Bu atama hozirda kam ishlatiladi va ko‘proq tarixiy matnlarda uchraydi.

ex: players had to adjust for the biasing when aiming.
the biasing of the bowl caused it to curve away from the target.
biasing.meta: egilish harakati – ilgari sport o‘yini (masalan, boulingga o‘xshash qadimgi o‘yinlarda) ishlatilgan atama bo‘lib, og‘irligi notekis bo‘lgan to‘pning to‘g‘ri emas, balki egilgan yoki qiyshaygan yo‘l bo‘ylab harakatlanish tendensiyasini bildirgan

ex: They spent the whole lunch break just bitching about their boss.
There was a lot of bitching going on in the office after she left.
bitching.meta: Boshqa birov haqida yomonlab gapirish, g‘iybat qilish yoki hasad bilan tanqid qilish harakati; insonni orqasidan yomonlash, ayniqsa, hasadli yoki kinoyali ohangda.

ex: The browning of the city has changed its cultural landscape.
browning.meta: Mamlakat, jamoa yoki guruh tarkibida asosiy oq yevropalik bo‘lmagan odamlarning ulushi ortishi jarayoni yoki holati; demografik tarkibning rang-baranglashuvi va etnik xilma-xillikning oshishi.

ex: Browning is reshaping the demographic landscape of many cities.
The browning of the population has led to significant cultural changes.
browning.meta: Rang-baranglashish — mamlakat yoki jamoada asosiy aholi oq tanli yevropalik bo‘lmagan odamlar tomonidan to‘ldirilishi yoki ularning ulushining oshishi jarayoni.

ex: Browning women often have natural beauty and distinctive skin tone.
She is known as a beautiful browning in the Caribbean islands.
browning.meta: Browning — Karib dengizi mintaqasida ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, och jigarrang teriga ega bo‘lgan odamni, ayniqsa ayolni anglatadi. Bu teri rangi qora va oq orasidagi yengilroq jigarrang rangni bildiradi.

ex: The card carrier handed the visiting card to the gentleman.
In the past, a card carrier would deliver messages between noble families.
card carrier.meta: Vizitkalar yoki xabarlarni yetkazuvchi shaxs, ko‘pincha kasb sifatida faoliyat yuritgan. Bugungi kunda bu so‘z kam ishlatiladi va eski atama hisoblanadi.

ex: Carded athletes receive funding to help with their training expenses.
She is a carded athlete supported by the national sports program.
carded.meta: Amatör sportchi, davlat tomonidan trening yoki tayyorgarlik uchun moliyalashtirilgan yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlangan shaxs. Asosan Kanada terminologiyasidan kelib chiqqan.

ex: Factories use carders to process cotton efficiently.
The carder prepares wool fibers before spinning.
carder.meta: Jun, paxta va boshqa tolalarni kartlash uchun ishlatiladigan mashina yoki asbob. Kartlash tolalarni tekislashtirish va tozalash jarayonidir.

ex: Two sets have the same cardinality if there is a one-to-one correspondence between their elements.
The cardinality of the set {1, 2, 3} is 3.
cardinality.meta: o‘plamdagi elementlar soni yoki ikkita to‘plam o‘rtasida birma-bir moslik (bir-to-bir moslashuv) mavjud bo‘lganida, bu to‘plamlar teng kattalikdagi (ekvivalent) hisoblanadi. Matematikada to‘plamning kattaligi yoki quvvati sifatida tushuniladi.

ex: The set of natural numbers and the set of even numbers have the same cardinality, even though they seem different in size.
The cardinality of the set {1, 2, 3} is 3, because it contains three elements.
cardinality.meta: Kardinallik — matematika fanida to‘plamdagi elementlar sonini ifodalaydigan tushuncha. Ya’ni, ikki to‘plam o‘zaro bir-biriga mos (bir-biriga nisbatan bir- biriga to‘g‘ri keluvchi) elementlarga ega bo‘lsa, ularning kardinalligi teng bo‘ladi.

ex: zero is the cardinal number of the empty set.
the cardinal number of the set {a, b, c} is 3, because it contains three elements.
cardinal number.meta: kardinal son — bu to‘plamdagi elementlar sonini ifodalovchi matematik tushuncha. u chekli to‘plamlar uchun oddiy butun sonlar (0, 1, 2, ...) va cheksiz to‘plamlar uchun maxsus belgilar (masalan, ℵ 0 ℵ 0 ​ ) orqali ifodalanadi.

ex: he forgot his ID and couldn't get in because of the carding policy.
the bartender was strict about carding everyone who looked under 30.
carding.meta: hujjat so‘rash amaliyoti — asosan shimoliy amerika davlatlarida qo‘llaniladigan amaliyot bo‘lib, bu orqali biror kishidan odatda haydovchilik guvohnomasi yoki boshqa shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjatni ko‘rsatish so‘raladi.

ex: movement at the cardo allows the maxilla to pivot during feeding.
the cardo connects the insect’s maxilla to the head capsule.
cardo.meta: kardo — hasharotlarning jag‘ (maksilla) qismining tanaga yaqin (asosiy yoki pastki) bo‘g‘imi. bu bo‘lim maksillaning boshqa qismlarini tana bilan bog‘laydi va ovqatlanish paytida harakatga yordam beradi.

ex: guild members reported a cardower who was selling goods in the town illegally.
the council fined the cardower for working in the burgh without a license.
cardower.meta: ruxsatsiz hunarmand — o‘rta asr vaqtidagi shaharlarda (ayniqsa shotlandiyalik "burgh" deb atalgan shahar hududlarida) rasmiy fuqarolik maqomiga ega bo‘lmagan, ammo noqonuniy tarzda hunar yoki savdo bilan shug‘ullanayotgan shaxs.

ex: he spent most of the evening playing texas hold’em in the card room.
the casino’s card room hosts nightly poker tournaments.
card room.meta: karta o‘yinlari xonasi — (asosan a.q.sh.da) kazinoda maxsus ajratilgan, poker kabi karta o‘yinlarini o‘ynash uchun mo‘ljallangan joy.

ex: they crossed the river using an old carriage bridge built in the 19th century.
the carriage bridge was strong enough to support heavy horse-drawn carts.
carriage bridge.meta: ustidan aravalar yoki boshqa transport vositalari o‘tishi mumkin bo‘lgan, yetarlicha mustahkam va keng ko‘prik. bunday ko‘priklar yo‘l yo‘nalishlarini bog‘lash uchun quriladi va piyodalar emas, balki transport vositalarining o‘tishiga mo‘ljallangan.

ex: the goods were carriaged across the countryside by horse-drawn wagons.
the guests arrived at the manor house in a carriaged procession.
carriaged.meta: aravada sayohat qilgan — arava (yoki boshqa o‘xshash transport vositasi) yordamida harakat qilgan yoki tashilgan holatni ifodalovchi sifat. bu so‘z ko‘pincha tarixiy yoki rasmiy kontekstda, sayohat yoki yuk tashish uchun arava ishlatilganini bildiradi.

ex: in old times, a carriage man often wore a uniform and hat.
the carriage man skillfully guided the horses through the busy streets.
carriage man.meta: arava haydovchisi — otlar tortgan aravaning haydovchisi yoki aravaga xizmat qiluvchi oyoqchi yoki boshqa yordamchi. bu atama asosan tarixiy kontekstda ishlatiladi, zamonaviy hayotda kam uchraydi.

ex: the carried documents were checked by the customs officers.
the carried goods arrived safely at the destination.
carried.meta: tashilgan — biror narsaning ko‘tarilishi yoki bir joydan boshqa joyga olib o‘tilishini ifodalovchi sifat. bu so‘z carry fe’lining turli ma’nolarida qo‘llaniladi: qo‘l yoki boshqa vosita bilan olib yurish, transport vositasi orqali yetkazish va hokazo.

ex: many people prefer carry-aways when they don’t want to cook at home.
we ordered a carry-away from the pizza place for dinner.
carry-away.meta: olib ketiladigan ovqat — restorandan, do‘kondan yoki boshqa joydan xarid qilinib, darhol o‘sha joyda emas, balki boshqa joyda iste’mol qilish uchun olib ketiladigan taom yoki ichimlik. Bu atama ayniqsa hozirgi kunda ko‘p ishlatiladi.

ex: carryforward tax credits can reduce future tax liabilities.
the company reported a carryforward loss from the previous fiscal year.
carryforward.meta: ko‘chirib o‘tkazilgan — avvalgi holat, jarayon yoki davrdan keyingi holat, jarayon yoki davrga olib o‘tilgan yoki uzatilgan narsa yoki miqdor. Bu atama ko‘proq moliyaviy, buxgalteriya yoki hisob-kitob sohalarida ishlatiladi

ex: despite difficulties, the carrying-on of the project continued.
the carrying-on of negotiations was crucial for the deal.
carrying-on.meta: davom ettirish — biror faoliyat yoki harakatni bajarishda davom etish, uni davom ettirish jarayoni yoki harakati. Bu so‘z odatda ish, tadbir yoki boshqa biror faoliyatni amalga oshirishni davom ettirishni anglatadi.

ex: commonalty in the estate can sometimes lead to disputes.
the commonalty of the property meant that all partners shared ownership equally.
commonalty.meta: umumiy mulk — mol-mulk, boylik yoki boshqa narsalarning bir nechta shaxslar tomonidan birgalikda yoki qo‘shma egalik qilinishi holati. Shuningdek, bu atama bunday egalik holatining o‘zini ham ifodalaydi.

ex: funds collected from taxes were kept in the common chamber.
the common chamber held all the city’s revenues securely.
common chamber.meta: umumiy xazina — hukumat, shahar yoki boshqa tashkilotlarning mablag‘lari saqlanadigan joy. Bu yerda barcha kirimlar va davlatga yoki tashkilotga tegishli pul mablag‘lari qabul qilinadi. Hozirda bu so‘z eski va kamroq ishlatiladi.

ex: the community was made up of common holders who shared all goods.
common holders believe that property should not be privately owned.
common holder.meta: umumiy mulk egasi — barcha mulkni birgalikda bo‘lishish kerakligiga ishonadigan shaxs. Bu atama protestant diniy oqimlaridan birining a’zolariga nisbatan ishlatiladi, ular mulkni umumiy saqlash tizimini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

ex: in co-housing developments, the common house fosters community interaction.
the common house includes a kitchen, lounge, and laundry facilities for all residents.
common house.meta: umumiy uy — ko‘p oilalar yoki shaxslar yashaydigan ko‘p kvartirali uy yoki ko‘chmas mulk majmuasidagi, yashovchilar tomonidan umumiy foydalaniladigan xizmatlar yoki qulayliklar joylashgan bino.

ex: the term commoning is now considered obsolete and rarely used.
in older texts, commoning was used to refer to sexual intercourse.
commoning.meta: jinsiy aloqa — odamlar orasidagi jinsiy munosabat, hozirda eski adabiyotlarda uchraydigan, hozirgi til va madaniyatda kam qo‘llaniladigan so‘z.

ex: commonity members have the right to vote in borough elections.
the commonity of the town gathered to discuss local issues.
commonity.meta: shahar aholisi — bir shaharda yoki tuman hududida yashovchi fuqarolar yoki aholi guruhi. Bu so‘z odatda muayyan joyning jamoatchilik yoki fuqarolar yig‘ilmasini bildiradi.

ex: the automotive industry benefits greatly from commonization of components.
commonization of parts reduces manufacturing costs.
commonization.meta: standartlashtirish — asosan avtomobil sanoatida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, mahsulotlarda ishlatiladigan qismlar yoki komponentlarni yagona standartga keltirish jarayoni.

ex: they commonized the engine components to reduce costs.
the company plans to commonize parts across different car models.
commonize.meta: standartlashtirmoq — asosan avtomobil sanoatida ishlatiladigan fe’l bo‘lib, mahsulotlarda ishlatiladigan qismlar yoki komponentlarni yagona standartga keltirish jarayonini anglatadi.

ex: scientists use Latin names, but common names are easier for most people.
the common name for Felis catus is “cat.”
common name.meta: oddiy nom — organizm yoki organizmlar guruhiga berilgan xalq orasida qo‘llaniladigan nom. Bu nom ilmiy lotincha nomga qarshi qo‘yiladi va kundalik hayotda keng tarqalgan, oson tushuniladigan nomni bildiradi.

ex: in older literature, a commonplacer was seen as dull or uncreative.
the commonplacer often repeated well-known sayings without originality.
commonplacer.meta: so‘zlari takroriy odam — odatda oddiy, takroriy, zerikarli yoki umuman yangilik keltirmaydigan gaplarni doim aytib turadigan shaxs. Hozirda bu so‘z eskirgan va kamdan-kam ishlatiladi.

ex: Common Pleas courts handle both civil and criminal cases in certain states.
the case was brought before the Common Pleas court of Ohio.
common pleas.meta: umumiy da’volar sudi — Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlarida ayrim shtatlarda mavjud bo‘lgan va keng qamrovli yurisdiktsiyaga ega bo‘lgan sudlar. Bu sudlar turli turdagi da’volar bo‘yicha birinchi darajali sud sifatida xizmat qiladi.

ex: the common school charged a small fee for tuition in the early years.
common schools were established to provide basic education to all children.
common school.meta: xalq maktabi — ma’lum bir jamoa yoki tuman bolalari uchun ochiq bo‘lgan maktab. dastlab kirish uchun kichik to‘lov olinardi. keyinchalik esa bunday maktablar ko‘proq bepul va kengroq maqsadlarda faoliyat yuritgan.

ex: in medieval times, a commonty often referred to a trade guild.
the commonty gathered for their regular meeting.
commonty.meta: jamoat — ma’lum bir guruh yoki odamlar birlashmasi; diniy hamjamiyat, birodarlik yoki kasb uyushmasi. Hozirda bu so‘z eskirgan va kamdan-kam ishlatiladi.

ex: a commonwealth man works to strengthen ties among member nations.
he was known as a commonwealth man who promoted international cooperation.
commonwealth man.meta: hamjamiyat tarafdori — hamjamiyat (commonwealth) manfaatlarini himoya qiluvchi yoki targ‘ib qiluvchi erkak shaxs.

ex: the government implemented counter-terror measures after the attack.
counter-terror operations are essential to maintain national security.
counter-terror.meta: qarshi terror — mavjud terrorga qarshi yoki unga javoban uyushtirilgan terror harakatlari; siyosiy yoki harbiy chora-tadbirlar bo‘lib, terrorizmga qarshi kurashish, oldini olish yoki unga qarshi javob berishga qaratilgan.

ex: fast breaks are difficult to predict and require quick reflexes.
the bowler delivered a fast break that surprised the batsman.
fast break.meta: tez burilish — kriket sportida, to‘p yerga tegishi bilan tez va keskin yo‘nalishni o‘zgartirib, raqib o‘yinchini chalg‘itadigan tashlash turi.

ex: the fasted prisoner appeared very thin and weak.
he looked fasted after days without proper food.
fasted.meta: ochlikda qolgan — uzoq vaqt kam ovqat yoki umuman ovqat olmay qolish natijasida juda ozib ketgan, zaiflashgan holat (bu so‘z endi kam ishlatiladi).

ex: fastened towns were common during medieval times for protection.
the castle was fastened against any enemy attack.
fastened.meta: mustahkamlangan — joy yoki binoning tashqi hujumlardan himoyalangan, devorlar yoki qal’alar bilan qattiq saqlangan holati.

ex: fastening adverbs confirm the truth of a statement.
the word "yes" was once described as a fastening adverb.
fastening.meta: tasdiqlovchi — grammatikada ravish bo‘lib, gapda ifodalanayotgan fikr yoki holatni tasdiqlash yoki tasdiqlovchi ohang beruvchi.

ex: the meeting was a fast-flowing discussion with ideas exchanged freely.
she has a fast-flowing style of speaking that captivates the audience.
fast-flowing.meta: tez oquvchi — tasviriy ma’noda, biror jarayon yoki nutqning tez, ravon va oson kechishi, muammosiz, ravon va silliq harakatlanishi.

ex: doctors sometimes recommend a fasting day for detoxification.
she observes a fasting day every week to maintain her health.
fasting day.meta: ro‘za kuni — odam tomonidan oziq-ovqat yoki ichimliklarni cheklab yoki umuman iste’mol qilmaslik orqali o‘tkaziladigan kun; ko‘pincha sog‘liqni saqlash yoki parhez maqsadida bajariladi.

ex: fastland is preferred for building houses because it is stable.
the farm was located on fastland, safe from tidal floods.
fastland.meta: qattiq quruqlik — suv bosmaydigan, barqaror va quruq yer maydoni; sho‘rlik, botqoqlik yoki suv ostidagi hududlardan farqli.

ex: the horse galloped fastly across the field.
he fought fastly against his opponents.
fastly.meta: qattiq, shiddat bilan — kuchli, qattiq yoki zo‘r berilgan harakatni ifodalovchi ravishda; faoliyatni jiddiy va energiya bilan bajarish.

ex: the festucaceous family includes several species used for pasture.
festucaceous grasses are common in temperate regions.
festucaceous.meta: feska o‘tlariga oid — o‘tlar oilasining Festuca (feska) jinsi va unga yaqin boshqa turlariga tegishli yoki ular bilan bog‘liq xususiyatlarga ega.

ex: the crowd got gassed when the band started playing.
she was totally gassed after hearing the good news.
gassed.meta: hayajonlangan, juda quvongan — juda mamnun yoki juda hayajonlangan holat; o‘ta xursand bo‘lish.

ex: many political ideas start at the kitchen table before they reach the ballot box.
we had a kitchen table discussion about our finances last night.
kitchen table.meta: oshxona stoli — faqat ovqatlanish uchun emas, balki oila a’zolari o‘z hayoti, muammolari, jamiyat yoki siyosatdagi o‘zgarishlar haqida birga o‘tirib gaplashadigan, muhim qarorlar qabul qilinadigan markaziy joy sifatida qaraladigan stol.

ex: your strategy depends on choosing the right leading card.
he placed the leading card on the table — a queen of hearts.
leading card.meta: etakchi karta — karta o‘yinida bir davra (yoki “trik”)da birinchi bo‘lib tashlanadigan karta; bu karta davradagi qolgan o‘yinchilarning qaysi “kost” (rang) bilan o‘ynashini belgilaydi.

ex: the tech expo turned out to be a lollapalooza, drawing thousands of visitors.
they’re planning a real lollapalooza of a music festival this summer.
lollapalooza.meta: katta tomoshabop tadbir — odatda ko‘p odamlarni jalb qiluvchi, muhim yoki ko‘zga ko‘ringan voqea; bu konsert, festival, ko‘rgazma yoki boshqa yirik yig‘ilish bo‘lishi mumkin. Odatda madaniy, musiqiy yoki reklama maqsadida tashkil etiladi.

ex: The company’s product launch was a real lollapalooza with lots of excitement and media coverage.
The city hosted a lollapalooza music festival that attracted thousands of people.
lollapalooza.meta: Lollapalooza — odatda AQShda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, katta hajmdagi, ko‘zni qamashtiradigan tadbir yoki voqea; biror narsani katta miqyosda ko‘rsatish yoki targ‘ib qilish uchun o‘tkaziladigan ajoyib yig‘ilish.

ex: there was a deliberate muting of criticism in the official report.
the muting of the background noise helped us focus on the speaker.
muting.meta: muting — biror holat, tovush, hissiyot yoki kuchli ta’sirni yumshatish yoki kamaytirish jarayoni. Bu harakat tovushga, yorug‘likka, his-tuyg‘uga yoki boshqa intensiv hodisalarga nisbatan qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Using "power point" as a slur is disrespectful and offensive.
He used the term "power point" to insult the new neighbor from Malaysia.
power point.meta: Power point — Avstraliya slengida haqorat ma'noda ishlatiladigan atama, u Xitoy yoki Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo mamlakatlaridan bo‘lgan kishilarni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z kamsituvchi va nomaqbul hisoblanadi.

ex: An RFID reader scans the chip to identify the item automatically.
The warehouse uses RFID tags to keep track of all inventory.
rfid.meta: RFID — (Radio Frequency Identification) radio to‘lqinlari yordamida buyumlarni aniqlash va kuzatish texnologiyasi. Bu texnologiyada RFID chip, o‘quvchi va yorliq kabi qurilmalar ishlatiladi.

ex: The movie is a slow-burning drama that gradually builds tension.
Their slow-burning friendship eventually grew into a strong bond.
slow-burning.meta: Sekin rivojlanadigan — biror hodisa, his-tuyg‘u yoki jarayon uzoq vaqt davomida asta-sekin shakllanadigan yoki kuchayadigan holat.

ex: It’s best to slow-cook meat to bring out its natural flavors.
The stew slow-cooked all day to become tender and flavorful.
slow-cook.meta: Sekin pishmoq — taomning past haroratda uzoq vaqt pishib, yumshoq va mazali bo‘lib tayyorlanish jarayoni.

ex: The band played a slow march to honor the fallen heroes.
The soldiers marched to the slow march during the memorial ceremony.
slow march.meta: Sekin marş — harbiy marşlarning sekin harakat bilan va sekin ritmda ijro etilishi. Bu marşda baraban yoki barabanlar sekin uriladi va ritm asta-sekin bo‘ladi.

ex: He prefers slow-pitch games because they are less demanding.
Slow-pitch softball is less competitive and easier for beginners.
slow-pitch.meta: Sekin to‘p tashlash — oson, talabchan bo‘lmagan holat yoki o‘yin turi. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha sport (ayniqsa softball) kontekstida qo‘llanadi va juda qiyin bo‘lmagan, kam raqobatli o‘yinlarni bildiradi.

ex: He is slow-reacting in stressful situations, which sometimes causes problems.
The slow-reacting sensor delayed the alarm.
slow-reacting.meta: Sekin javob beruvchi — vaziyatga, harakatga yoki ta’sirga kechikib yoki sekin javob beradigan, reaksiya qiladigan shaxs, tizim yoki predmet.

ex: Foods like oats and barley are slow-release and help maintain blood sugar levels.
Slow-release carbohydrates provide a steady source of energy throughout the day.
slow-release.meta: Sekin ajraladigan — hazm qilinayotganda qonda shakar darajasini asta-sekin va barqaror oshiradigan uglevod yoki bunday uglevodlarga boy oziq-ovqat.

ex: The town observes daylight saving time, but the neighboring district stays on slow time.
In some parts of the U.S., people refer to “slow time” when clocks show an hour earlier than the official time.
slow time.meta: Sekin vaqt — bir hududda ikki xil soat tizimi amal qilganda, undan biri boshqasidan bir soat yoki ba’zan undan ko‘proq ortda qolgan vaqtni bildiradi.

ex: The project is on the slow track and progress is barely noticeable.
He was placed on the slow track at work, so his promotion took much longer.
slow track.meta: Sekin yo‘l — maqsadga yoki natijaga erishish jarayonida sekinlik yoki kam o‘sish bilan kechadigan yo‘l yoki yo‘nalish.

ex: She said, “I swear down, I’m telling the truth.”
I swear down I didn’t take your book!
swear down.meta: Katta ishonch bilan va’dabozlik qilmoq yoki qasam ichmoq — gapning haqiqat yoki chinligini ta’kidlash maqsadida ishlatiladigan ifoda. Bu odatda gapdan keyin yoki gap ichida kiritilib, ishonch bildiradi.

ex: Historical records describe the Thuggee as ruthless bandits and murderers.
The Thuggee cult was notorious for strangling their victims in India.
thuggee.meta: Tuğgi — Hindistonda mavjud bo‘lgan tarixiy guruh yoki diniy jamiyat, ular o‘g‘irlik va qotillik qilgan, ayniqsa qurbonlarini bo‘g‘ib o‘ldirish bilan mashhur bo‘lganlar.

ex: Police are cracking down on thuggism and bullying in schools.
The rise of thuggism in the city has caused concern among residents.
thuggism.meta: Jinoiy zo‘ravonlik — jinoyatga oid zo‘ravonlik, qo‘rqitish, kuch ishlatish yoki majburlash kabi tajovuzkor xulq-atvor.

ex: The rapper wrote new bars for his latest song.
He can really spit bars; his rap skills are amazing.
bars.meta: Qatorlar — rep qo‘shig‘idagi so‘zlar yoki she’rlar satrlaridan iborat to‘plam. Hip-hop madaniyatida bu so‘zlarni aytish, rap ijro etish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: She put him on blast for missing the deadline.
The coach really put the blast on the players after their poor performance.
to put the blast on.meta: Kimnidir qattiq tanqid qilish yoki tanbeh berish — kimnidir keskin tanqid qilish, qattiq ogohlantirish yoki qattiq tanbeh berish ma’nosida ishlatiladigan ifoda.

ex: The speakers were on blast during the concert.
They had the music on blast all night at the party.
on blast.meta: To‘liq quvvatda yoki baland ovozda — ovoz, musiqa yoki boshqa narsa eng yuqori darajada, juda baland yoki kuchli holatda bo‘lishi.

ex: He said, “I’m telling the truth, I swear down.”
I swear down I didn’t take your book!
to swear down.meta: Qat’iy qasam ichmoq — biror gap yoki fikrning haqiqatligini, rostligini yoki aniq ekanligini kuchli ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

ex: Her aegyo made everyone smile at the party.
Many K-pop idols use aegyo to charm their fans.
aegyo.meta: Aegyo — ayniqsa koreys pop madaniyatida xarakterli bo‘lgan yoqimli, shirin va jozibali xulq-atvor yoki qiyofa. Shuningdek, yoqimli va jozibali ko‘rinish yoki harakatlar majmuasi sifatida qaraladi.

ex: He was in an antical mood, joking and playing all day.
The child’s antical behavior made everyone laugh.
antical.meta: Antical — qiziqcha, o‘yinchoqona harakatlar qiladigan, o‘ynoqi, o‘yinqaroq xulq-atvorni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: She learned Antiguan English while living on the island.
Antiguan English has some unique words and pronunciations different from standard English.
antiguan english.meta: Antigua ingliz tili — Antigua orolida yoki Antigua aholisi tomonidan so‘zlashiladigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tili.

ex: Antiqua differs from black letter by its rounded and clear letterforms.
The book was printed using an antiqua typeface, making it easy to read.
antiqua.meta: Antiqua shrift — soddaligi, tik turishi va dumaloq shaklidagi harflari bilan ajralib turadigan yozuv yoki shrift turi; ayniqsa qora harflardan (black letter) farqlanadigan lotin shriftiga o‘xshash yozuv.

ex: The antiquaire specializes in rare furniture and artifacts.
He bought a beautiful vase from the antiquaire.
antiquaire.meta: Antikvar — qadimiy, noyob va qadim buyumlarni sotadigan yoki u bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxs.

ex: The room was decorated with antiquey furniture that gave it a nostalgic feel.
She wore an antiquey dress that looked like it was from the 19th century.
antiquey.meta: Antikvar uslubdagi — o‘tgan davrlarni eslatadigan, eski uslubdagi yoki qadimiy narsalarga o‘xshash ko‘rinish yoki sifatga ega.

ex: The anti-vax movement has influenced many parents to avoid vaccinations.
He is an anti-vax who refuses to get vaccinated.
anti-vax.meta: Antivaksin — emlashga qarshi bo‘lgan shaxs. Emlashga qarshi — emlashga qarshi fikr yoki harakat bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Many antivaxxers spread misinformation about vaccines.
The anti-vaxxer refused to get the COVID-19 vaccine.
Scholars study the migration of the Arya into the Indian subcontinent.
The Arya were ancient peoples who spoke Indo-Iranian languages.
arya.meta: Arya — hind-eron tillari oilasiga mansub tillarni so‘zlashuvchi xalqlarning vakili; shuningdek, qadimda Hindiston yarimoroliga ko‘chib kelgan deb hisoblangan qadimiy xalqlar guruhi a’zosi.

ex: Her research adopts an asiacentric approach to understanding cultural identity.
The exhibition had an asiacentric theme, highlighting Asian art and traditions.
asiacentric.meta: Asiatsentrik — Osiyoga yoki Osiyo kelib chiqishiga ega madaniyatlarga qaratilgan, markazlashtirilgan yoki diqqatni jamlagan; shuningdek, Osiyo nuqtai nazari yoki qadriyatlarini ta’kidlovchi.

ex: Asiacentrism can shape how history is interpreted in certain regions.
The professor discussed Asiacentricism in modern cultural studies.
asiacentrism.meta: Asiatsentrizm — Osiyoga yoki Osiyo kelib chiqishiga ega madaniyatlarga qaratilgan g‘oyalar, munosabatlar yoki urg‘u; Osiyoga yoki uning madaniyatlariga e’tibor qaratish.

ex: The Asiacentrist scholar emphasized the importance of Asian traditions.
She has an Asiacentrist perspective on cultural history.
asiacentrist.meta: Asiatsentrist (sifat): Osiyoga yoki Osiyo kelib chiqishiga ega madaniyatlarga qaratilgan, ularni markaz qilgan. Asiatsentrist (ot): Asiatsentrizm qarashlarini tutuvchi shaxs; Osiyo yoki uning madaniyatlariga e’tibor beruvchi kishi.

ex: Asiadollars are widely used in the Asian money market for international trade.
The company held large amounts of Asiadollars in their Asian bank accounts.
asiadollar.meta: Asiadollar: Osiyo tashqarisidagi valyutalarning (asosan AQSh dollari) birligi bo‘lib, u Osiyo banklarida depozit sifatida saqlanadi va Osiyo pul bozorlarida ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, ko‘plab holatlarda umumiy ravishda ishlatiladi.

ex: Asian American communities have rich and diverse traditions.
She is an Asian American writer who explores themes of identity and culture.
asian american.meta: Osiyo (asosan Sharqiy Osiyo yoki Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo) kelib chiqishiga ega bo‘lgan amerikalik shaxs yoki shaxslar. Shuningdek, bunday kelib chiqishga ega amerikaliklar bilan bog‘liq yoki ular haqidagi narsalar.

ex: Asian British communities contribute richly to the multicultural fabric of the UK.
She is an Asian British artist known for her work on cultural identity.
asian british.meta: Britaniya pasportiga ega bo‘lgan yoki unga huquqi mavjud bo‘lgan, Osiyo kelib chiqishiga ega shaxs yoki nasldan bo‘lgan shaxs. Shuningdek, sobiq Britaniya mustamlakasi yoki hududida yashagan (yoki yashayotgan) odam.

ex: Asian Indian cuisine is famous for its rich spices and flavors.
He is an Asian Indian who recently moved to the United States.
asian indian.meta: Hindistondan bo‘lgan shaxs; odatda, hind kelib chiqishi yoki nasliga ega bo‘lgan odam. Shuningdek, Hindiston bilan bog‘liq madaniy yoki etnik shaxsiyat.

ex: She is an Asianist specializing in the history and cultures of East Asia.
The Asianist style of oratory was popular among certain Greek speakers in Asia Minor.
asianist.meta: Klassik tarixda — Miloddan avvalgi III asrda Kichik Osiyo yunonlariga xos bo‘lgan murakkab, ritmik va hissiyotli uslubda so‘zlovchi notiq. Shuningdek, Osiyo bo‘yicha mutaxassis yoki tadqiqotchi.

ex: Asian-Pacific countries often cooperate on environmental issues.
The Asian-Pacific region is known for its diverse cultures and rapid economic growth.
asian-pacific.meta: Butun Osiyo va Tinch okeani sohilidagi mamlakatlarni o‘z ichiga olgan mintaqaga oid yoki shu mintaqada joylashgan. Shuningdek, ushbu mintaqadagi odamlar yoki davlatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Researchers study the Austroasiatic peoples and their languages.
The Austroasiatic languages include Mon-Khmer and Munda families.
austroasiatic.meta: Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo materik qismida va qo‘shni hududlarda so‘zlashiladigan tillar oilasi bo‘lib, Mon-Xmer va Munda oilalaridan iborat. Shuningdek, ushbu tillar bilan bog‘liq odamlar yoki madaniyatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The sports field was covered with healthy Bahama grass.
Bahama grass is commonly used for lawns and pastures.
bahama grass.meta: Bermuda o‘ti, ya’ni Cynodon dactylon — issiq iqlimlarda o‘sadigan, ko‘p joylarda o‘tloqlarda va bog‘larda foydalaniladigan o‘t turi.

ex: She speaks fluent Bahamian English and understands the local culture well.
Bahamian English has unique expressions different from standard English.
bahamian english.meta: Bahama ingliz tili: Bahamaliklar tomonidan gapiriladigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tili. Bahama inglizcha: Bahama orollari yoki ularning aholisi bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The Baje cuisine includes many unique Caribbean flavors.
He speaks with a Baje accent that is typical of Barbados.
baje.meta: Baje: Barbadosga oid yoki Barbados aholisi bilan bog‘liq narsalar yoki odamlar. Ba’zan Barbados madaniyati yoki xalqi ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: U festivalda an’anaviy bajie kiyimini kiygan edi.
She wore a traditional Bajie dress at the festival.
bajie.meta: Barbadosga tegishli yoki Barbados aholisiga oid. Shuningdek, Barbados madaniyati yoki odatlari bilan bog‘liq narsalarni ham ifodalaydi.

ex: Bammy is a traditional Jamaican flatbread made from cassava flour.
For breakfast, she ate bammy with fried fish.
bammy.meta: Bammi — Yamayka oshxonasiga xos, kassava unidan tayyorlangan dumaloq va yupqa non. Odatda bammi noni yoki bammi keki deb ham ataladi.

ex: Kimchi is one of the most popular types of banchan.
At the Korean restaurant, we were served various banchan with our meal.
banchan.meta: Banchan — Koreys oshxonasiga xos, odatda guruch bilan birga iste’mol qilinadigan kichik sabzavotli yoki boshqa qoʻshimcha taom.

ex: He has a bandulu attitude, always ready to fight.
The police arrested the bandulu involved in the scam.
bandulu.meta: Bandulu — noqonuniy, firibgar yoki jinoyatchilik faoliyati bilan shug‘ullanuvchi kishi. Shuningdek, kuchli va tajovuzkor odamni ifodalash uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The friends exchanged some bantery before starting the game.
Their bantery made the meeting much more enjoyable.
bantery.meta: Bantery — bir-biriga o‘yinchoq, kulgili yoki muloyim masxara bilan gapirish; odatda do‘stona va xushchaqchaq munosabatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Their bants kept the atmosphere light and fun.
The lads had some good bants after the game.
bants.meta: Bants — do‘stlar yoki guruh a’zolari o‘rtasida o‘yinchoq va hazilomuz gap-so‘z almashinuvi, ko‘pincha erkaklar orasida; shuningdek, qiziqarli va biroz shijoatli xulq-atvor.

ex: Barbadian English has unique pronunciation and expressions.
She speaks Barbadian English fluently.
barbadian english.meta: Barbadian ingliz tili — Barbados orolida yoki u yerliklar tomonidan ishlatiladigan ingliz tilining o‘ziga xos shakli. Barbadian — Barbadosga yoki uning aholisi, madaniyati bilan bog‘liq.

ex: She is a Barbudan who has lived on the island all her life.
Barbudan culture has unique traditions and customs.
barbudan.meta: Barbudan — Barbudaga tegishli yoki Barbudaning mahalliy aholisi bilan bog‘liq. Barbudan (ot) — Barbudada yashovchi yoki Barbudadan bo‘lgan kishi.

ex: Barbudian traditions are preserved by the local community.
He is a Barbudian who has lived on Barbuda all his life.
barbudian.meta: Barbudian — Barbuda orolining mahalliy aholisi yoki yashovchisi; Barbudaliklarning avlodi. Barbudian (sifat) — Barbudaga oid yoki Barbudaning aholisi bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The neighbors complained about the bassa-bassa coming from the party.
There was a bassa-bassa outside the club last night.
bassa-bassa.meta: Bassa-bassa — biror joyda yuzaga kelgan shovqin-suron, tinchlikni buzuvchi janjal yoki tortishuv.

ex: During the festival, locals performed various batuque dances accompanied by drums.
The batuque is considered an important ancestor of samba music.
batuque.meta: Batuque — Afro-Braziliyada kelib chiqqan, samba raqsining oldingi turi bo‘lgan dumaloq raqs; shuningdek, Kab-Verde va boshqa joylarda ijro etiladigan anʼanaviy xalq raqslari va musiqa uslubi.

ex: Beasting is often used in the military to build toughness and discipline.
The new recruits went through a week of beasting to prepare them for the demands of service.
beasting.meta: Beasting — yangi xizmatchini intizomga o‘rgatish yoki tartibga solish uchun qattiq mashqlar yoki qattiq munosabat qo‘llash jarayoni.

ex: The criminals treated their victims beastlily, showing no mercy.
He behaved beastlily during the argument, shouting and refusing to listen.
beastlily.meta: Beastlily — hayvonlarga xos yoki yovvoyi tarzda, odob-axloqdan yiroq tarzda harakat qilish yoki tutinish.

ex: When she starts working on her projects, she switches to beast mode to finish everything on time.
During the final match, the player went into beast mode and scored three goals.
beast mode.meta: Beast mode — boshlang‘ichda hayvonga aylanish holatini bildirgan so‘z, lekin hozirda bu ibora insonning maksimal kuch bilan, to‘liq diqqat va yuqori samaradorlikda faoliyat yuritishi holatini anglatadi.

ex: The company is in the bedding-in phase after introducing the new software system.
The gardener spent the morning bedding in new plants in the flower beds.
bedding in.meta: Bedding in — boshlang‘ichda urug‘ yoki o‘simlikni tuproqqa ekish jarayoni; so‘ngra yangi sharoit yoki tizimga asta-sekin moslashish, joylashish jarayoni.

ex: The beer hall was crowded with people celebrating Oktoberfest.
We met our friends at the local beer hall after work.
beer hall.meta: Pivo zali — pivo ichish uchun mo‘ljallangan, katta hajmdagi xona yoki joy, unda odamlar yig‘ilib pivo ichadilar.

ex: Békés have their own distinct culture and social status.
He was a béké, so the locals treated him differently.
béké.meta: Béké — asosan Karib dengizi orollarida yashovchi, oq tanli erkakni anglatadi. Bu atama ko‘pincha Yevropadan Karib orollariga mustamlakachilik davrida ko‘chib kelgan va shu yerda joylashib qolgan oilalarning avlodlariga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: She is learning to belly-dance at a dance class.
She performed a belly dance during the evening show.
belly-dance.meta: Belly-dance qilmoq — sharqona (odatda Yaqin Sharq, Shimoliy Afrika yoki Turkiya uslubidagi) qorin raqsini ijro etish. Bu raqs bel, qorin, son va kestani harakatlantirish orqali bajariladi.

ex: The child woke up during the night with bellywark.
He complained of a severe bellywark after breakfast.
bellywark.meta: Bellywark — qorin sohasidagi og‘riq; bu holat ichaklar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin (masalan, ich sanchig‘i yoki kolik). Bu so‘z shevaga xos yoki eski ingliz tilida ishlatiladi.

ex: Because of belly wuk, he didn’t go to school.
He drank unclean water and got belly wuk.
belly wuk.meta: Belly wuk — ichak faoliyatining buzilishi natijasida yuzaga keladigan holat bo‘lib, suyuq najas bilan tez-tez ich ketish holatini bildiradi. Bu so‘z Karib shevalarida ishlatiladi va odatda norasmiy yoki xalq tilidagi ifoda hisoblanadi.

ex: Every new project seems to come with some kind of bobol.
They were caught in a major bobol involving public funds.
bobol.meta: Bobol — firibgarlik faoliyati; ayniqsa, davlat mablag‘larini noqonuniy yo‘l bilan o‘zlashtirish yoki talon-taroj qilish holatini bildiradi. Bu so‘z odatda Karib shevalarida ishlatiladi va jinoiy yoki axloqan yaroqsiz moliyaviy ishlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: Market sellers often give brata to their regular customers.
The woman bought a kilo of apples, and the seller gave her two extra as brata.
brata.meta: Brata — bozorda yoki do‘konda xarid qilgandan so‘ng, sotuvchi tomonidan xaridorga beriladigan kichik qo‘shimcha mahsulot yoki sovg‘a. Bu xaridorni xursand qilish va uni yana qaytib kelishga undash uchun qilinadigan odatdir.

ex: It is said that a Bridport dagger was used in the murder — meaning the prisoner was hanged.
When someone says “stabbed with a Bridport dagger,” it means they were hanged.
bridport dagger.meta: Bridport pichog‘i — bu atama asosan osilish uchun ishlatiladigan rig‘ich, ya’ni osilish simi ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ingliz tilidagi ifoda "to be stabbed with a Bridport dagger" deganda, bu osib o‘ldirish (osilish) anglatiladi.

ex: To prepare bulgogi, the meat needs to be marinated for several hours.
Last night, we ordered bulgogi at the restaurant; it was very delicious.
bulgogi.meta: Bulgogi — Koreys oshxonasiga oid mashhur taom bo‘lib, yupqa bo‘laklarga kesilgan mol go‘shti yoki cho‘chqa go‘shtining maxsus marinadda namlanganidan keyin grilda yoki qovurilgan holda tayyorlanadi.

ex: The cane rows of the sugar cane are planted very neatly and straight.
The farmer waters the sugar cane along each cane row.
cane row.meta: Cane row — shakarqamish ekilgan qatordir. Bu qatorlarda shakarqamish urug‘lari yoki ko‘chatlari bir qatorga joylashtiriladi va bu qatorlar maydonda ketma-ket joylashgan bo‘ladi.

ex: Cardiffians love their city.
He is a Cardiffian and knows the city’s culture very well.
cardiffian.meta: Cardiffian — Buyuk Britaniyaning Uels qismidagi Kardiff shahrida tug‘ilgan yoki doimiy yashovchi shaxs. Bu so‘z Kardiff shahri aholisi yoki mahalliy odamlarini ifodalaydi.

ex: Cardiogenic shock occurs due to severe impairment of heart function.
The patient’s difficulty breathing is due to cardiogenic heart failure.
cardiogenic.meta: Kardiogen — tibbiyotda yurak bilan bog‘liq yoki yurak kasalligi yoki uning funksiyasining buzilishi natijasida kelib chiqadigan holatlarni ifodalaydi. Masalan, yurak yetishmovchiligi yoki yurakdan kelib chiqqan shikastlanishlar kardiogen hisoblanadi.

ex: With cardioplegia, surgeons can safely repair the heart.
During heart surgery, cardioplegia is used to temporarily stop the heart.
cardioplegia.meta: Kardioplegiya — yurak mushaklarining qisqarishini vaqtincha to‘xtatish amaliyoti yoki jarayoni bo‘lib, odatda bu kimyoviy moddalar (masalan, maxsus eritmalar) yoki boshqa fizik usullar yordamida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The cardioplegic procedure is used in heart surgery.
The cardioplegic solution temporarily stops the heart’s contractions.
cardioplegic.meta: Kardioplegik — yurak mushaklarining qisqarish faoliyatini yo‘qotish yoki jiddiy buzilishiga sabab bo‘luvchi yoki shunday holat bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Cardioversion is an effective method for treating atrial fibrillation.
The patient underwent cardioversion and the heart rhythm was restored.
cardioversion.meta: Kardioversiya — yurak ritmi buzilishlarini, ayniqsa atrial fibrillyatsiya kabi holatlarni davolash usuli bo‘lib, bemorning ko‘kragiga elektr tokining qisqa muddatli zarbasini berish orqali yurakning normal ritmga qaytishini ta’minlaydi.

ex: The student analyzed a story written in Caribbean English.
Caribbean English differs in many ways from standard British English.
caribbean english.meta: Karib ingliz tili — bu Karib orollarida (masalan, Yamayka, Trinidad va Tobago, Barbados va boshqalar) yashovchi aholining og‘zaki va yozma ravishda ishlatadigan ingliz tilining mintaqaviy shaklidir.

ex: This year was just catch-arse for me — nothing went right.
After he lost his job, a real catch-arse began.
catch-arse.meta: Karib shevalarida ishlatiladigan norasmiy so‘z bo‘lib, og‘ir davr, qiyin vaziyat, musibat yoki azob-uqubat holatlarini ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z odamning boshidan og‘ir vaqtlar o‘tayotganini, moliyaviy, jismoniy yoki ruhiy qiynalayotganini bildiradi.

ex: You can try the best chimaek in this Korean restaurant.
In South Korea, it's common for friends to gather and eat chimaek.
chimaek.meta: Chimek — Janubiy Koreyada va koreyscha uslubdagi restoranlarda mashhur bo‘lgan taom: qovurilgan tovuq go‘shti (fried chicken) pivo bilan birga tortiladi.

ex: she walked into a comess of arguments and shouting.
there was a real comess after the news broke out.
comess.meta: Comess — mojaro, janjal yoki mish-mishlar tufayli yuzaga kelgan shovqinli, tartibsiz holat; ba’zida shunchaki aralashib ketgan, boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan vaziyatni bildiradi.

ex: some locals still refer to mixed families as conchy joes.
he grew up as a conchy joe in the bahamas, blending both cultures.
conchy joe.meta: Conchy Joe — Bahamalik oq tanli yoki qora va oq irq aralashmasiga mansub odam. Bu atama ko‘pincha norasmiy yoki og‘zaki nutqda ishlatiladi va Bahama orollaridagi irqiy yoki madaniy kelib chiqishni bildiradi.

ex: they marked the cornholes evenly along the row.
the farmer dug several cornholes before planting season.
cornhole.meta: Qishloq xo‘jaligida: makkajo‘xori (yoki jo‘xori) urug‘i ekiladigan kichik chuqurcha yoki teshik. Ko‘pincha ko‘plikda ishlatiladi.

ex: That movie had a disturbing scene where someone got cornholed.
The prisoner was cornholing his cellmate.
cornhole.meta: Birov bilan orqa yo‘l (anal) orqali jinsiy aloqa qilish; birovning anusini jinsiy aloqada kirib borish orqali jinsiy aloqada bo‘lish.

ex: They joked about cornholing, but it made many people uncomfortable.
He was arrested for forcing someone into cornholing.
cornholing.meta: Cornholing — bu orqa yo‘l (anal) orqali jinsiy aloqa qilish amali; ya’ni, anusga jinsiy kirib borish orqali bajariladigan jinsiy munosabat turi. Bu atama asosan qo‘pol, so‘zlashuvdagi, ko‘pincha haqoratli yoki kamsituvchi kontekstlarda qo‘llanadi.

ex: She cyah deal with that stress no more.
Mi cyah go deh tonight, mi too tired.
cyah.meta: Cyah — bu ingliz tilidagi "cannot" yoki "can't" (ya’ni "qila olmayman", "eplay olmayman") degan so‘zning Karib shevalarida (ayniqsa, Yamayka Patua yoki Trinidad shevalarida) ishlatiladigan og‘zaki, noaniq talaffuz shaklidir.

ex: Daebak! You got tickets to the concert!
Finding that rare sneaker was a total daebak!
daebak.meta: Daebak — bu kutilmagan, katta foyda keltirgan yoki juda yoqimli narsa; shuningdek, odamlar hayrat yoki quvonchlarini ifodalash uchun ishlatadigan so‘z. Ko‘pincha janubiy koreys madaniyatida, ayniqsa K-pop va internet slangi sifatida mashhur.

ex: At the pub, I ordered a dandy shandy, a mix of beer and ginger beer.
When I was a kid, I loved drinking dandy shandy, the fizzy non-alcoholic soda.
dandy shandy.meta: Dandy shandy — dastlab spirtsiz, gazlangan ichimlik turining brendi sifatida ishlatilgan atama. Keyinchalik esa, ayniqsa Britaniya va boshqa joylarda, pivoni va zanjabil pivosini aralashtirib tayyorlangan ichimlik ma’nosida qo‘llanila boshlandi.

ex: Several organizations are working to decarcerate prisoners and reduce overcrowding in prisons.
The government aims to decarcerate non-violent offenders as part of criminal justice reform.
decarcerate.meta: Decarcerate — qamoqda saqlanayotgan mahbus yoki mahbuslarni ozod qilish, qamoqdan chiqarish. Ko‘pincha bu atama qamoqxona aholisi sonini kamaytirishga qaratilgan keng ko‘lamli tashabbus yoki siyosat doirasida ishlatiladi.

ex: The policy focuses on decarceration of non-violent offenders.
Decarceration is a key goal in criminal justice reform to reduce prison overcrowding.
decarceration.meta: Decarceration — dastlab, qamoqdan biror kishini ozod qilish jarayoni yoki harakati. Hozirgi kunda esa, odatda, ma’lum toifadagi shaxslarni qamoqqa olishni kamaytirish yoki ularni qamoqdan ozod qilish amaliyoti yoki holati sifatida tushuniladi

ex: He learned to play the dhantal from his grandfather.
The dhantal keeps the rhythm in traditional chutney music.
dhantal.meta: Karib dengizi hududida, ayniqsa Trinidadda keng tarqalgan zarbli (uriladigan) musiqa asbobi. Bu asbob temirdan yasalgan uzun tayoqchadan iborat bo‘lib, ularning uchi bir tomonda tig‘siz yoki o‘tkirlashgan, boshqa tomoni esa halqasimon egilgan bo‘ladi

ex: In the dinki mini, each couple enters the circle and performs intricate pelvic movements.
The dinki mini is performed during traditional mourning ceremonies in parts of Jamaica.
dinki mini.meta: Dinki mini — Afrika ildizlariga ega bo‘lgan an’anaviy raqs turi bo‘lib, asosan Karib mintaqasida, xususan Yamaykada keng tarqalgan. Bu raqs odatda doira shaklida bajariladi, raqqos juftliklar doira markazida navbat bilan raqsga tushadilar.

ex: The reconstruction contracts after the hurricane were classic examples of disaster capitalism.
Critics argue that disaster capitalism worsens inequality and exploits vulnerable communities.
disaster capitalism.meta: Disaster capitalism — bu tabiiy yoki inson qo‘li bilan yuzaga kelgan ofatlar kapitalistik maqsadlarda foydalanish, ya’ni ofat paytida yoki undan keyingi beqarorlik holatida foyda olish, sarmoyalarni kengaytirish yoki bozorni nazorat qilish amaliyotidir.

ex: Critics labelled the private contractors as disaster capitalists profiting from war zones.
The company acted like a disaster capitalist, raising prices right after the earthquake.
disaster capitalist.meta: Disaster capitalist — bu falokat yoki ofatlar (masalan, urush, zilzila, pandemiya, bo‘ron va boshqa inqirozlar) paytida yoki undan so‘ng foyda olish va kapitalistik manfaatlarini ilgari surish maqsadida harakat qiluvchi shaxs yoki kompaniya.

ex: Me nah like disya kinda talk.
Disya man bring food for all a we.
disya.meta: Disya — bu ingliz tilidagi shevaviy va norasmiy "this here" iborasining qisqa shakli bo‘lib, odatda Karib mintaqasi shevalarida (masalan, Yamayka patua) ishlatiladi. U yaqin joyda yoki hozirgi vaziyatda joylashgan narsaga yoki odamga ishora qiladi.

ex: (noun): Dominican English includes words borrowed from French Creole and African languages.
(adjective): He speaks with a strong Dominican English accent.
dominican english.meta: Dominican English — bu Dominika orolida yoki dominikaliklar tomonidan so‘zlanadigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tilining o‘ziga xos shaklidir.

ex: Unlike spicy kimchi, dongchimi has a mild, clean taste.
Dongchimi is a refreshing type of kimchi, especially popular in winter.
dongchimi.meta: Dongchimi — bu koreys milliy taomlaridan biri bo‘lib, asosan turpdan tayyorlanadigan sho‘r suvli kimchi turidir. Odatda tarkibida xitoy karam (napa karam), bahor piyoz, yashil qalampir, va ba’zan nok ham bo‘ladi.

ex: Drivage of the ventilation tunnel took three months.
The drivage was extended further to reach the new coal seam.
drivage.meta: Drivage — bu gorizontal yoki biroz qiyalik bilan qazilgan yer osti yo‘li yoki galereyasini anglatadi. Shuningdek, bu so‘z bunday yo‘lni qazish jarayoni yoki harakati ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi. Asosan konchilik va tunnel qurilishi sohalarida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: (adj.): The driveaway vehicle must be insured and inspected before transport.
(noun): The dealership offers a driveaway service for customers who live out of state.
driveaway.meta: Driveaway — bu yollangan haydovchi tomonidan avtomobilni xaridorga yoki belgilangan manzilga yetkazib berish xizmati. Ba’zida bu atama bunday yetkazilayotgan avtomobilning o‘zini ham anglatadi.

ex: (noun): Drive-by-wire eliminates the need for a physical connection between the accelerator and engine.
(adjective): A drive-by-wire steering system provides quicker response and can integrate with automated driving technologies.
drive-by-wire.meta: Drive-by-wire — bu avtomobilning dvigatel, boshqaruv, yoki osma tizimlari kabi funksiyalarini mexanik ulanishlar (masalan, tros, shatak, yoki gidravlika) o‘rniga elektron signallar orqali boshqarish texnologiyasi.

ex: The actor’s drivenness was evident in his intense preparation for every role.
Her drivenness and focus helped her become a successful entrepreneur.
drivenness.meta: Drivenness — bu insonning ichki motivatsiyasi, qat’iyati va biror maqsad sari intilishi sifatini anglatadi. Bu atama maqsadga intiluvchanlik, tirishqoqlik, yoki ichki turtki bilan harakat qilish holatini bildiradi.

ex: (adj.): We stopped at a drive-up coffee shop on our road trip.
(noun): The bank's drive-up closes at 6 p.m.
drive-up.meta: Drive-up — bu mijoz avtomobilidan tushmasdan turib xizmat olishi mumkin bo‘lgan xizmat turini bildiradi. Bunday xizmatlar bank, restoran, dorixona yoki do‘konlarga tegishli bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The CEO is now in the driving seat of the company.
He adjusted the driving seat before starting the car.
driving seat.meta: Driving seat — bu avtomobil yoki boshqa transport vositasida haydovchi o‘tiradigan o‘rindiqni anglatadi. Shuningdek, bu atama rahbarlik, boshqaruv yoki qaror qabul qilish pozitsiyasi ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Drover’s dogs are known for their intelligence and endurance.
The drover’s dog helped move the cattle across the rough terrain.
drover’s dog.meta: bu qishloq xo‘jaligida, ayniqsa sigirlarni bozorga yoki boshqa joyga haydashda yordam beradigan it. Bunday itlar chorvani yig‘ish, boshqarish va yo‘nalishda ushlab turishda xizmat qiladi. Ba’zida bu atama bir nechta it zotlariga nisbatan ishlatiladi

ex: (n.): The dutty in the streets is a problem for the community.
(adj.): The room was really dutty after the party.
dutty.meta: Dutty — bu so‘z asosan Karib mintaqasida ishlatiladi va “iflos” degan ma’noni bildiradi. Sifat sifatida u turli xil ma’nolarda “iflos”, “lo‘kta”, “nakash”, “axlatli” yoki “yoqimsiz” narsalarni ifodalashi mumkin.

ex: (n.): She identifies as East Asian and speaks Mandarin fluently.
(adj.): East Asian cultures have rich traditions and histories.
east asian.meta: East Asian — bu atama Sharqiy Osiyo mintaqasiga oid, unga tegishli yoki u yerlik odamlar bilan bog‘liq narsalarni bildiradi. Asosan hozirgi Xitoy, Yaponiya va atrofidagi hududlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: (n.): The Eurasianist believes in the cultural unity of Europe and Asia.
(adj.): Eurasianist ideas have influenced Russian political thought.
eurasianist.meta: bu atama Rus Eurasianizmi tarafdori yoki himoyachisini anglatadi. Eurasianizm — bu siyosiy va madaniy nazariya bo‘lib, Yevroosiyo mintaqasining o‘ziga xosligi va uning Markaziy Osiyo, Sharqiy Yevropa va Rossiya madaniyatlari uyg‘unligini ta’kidlaydi.

ex: The players must keep the ball within the fair ground during play.
The ball landed in the fair ground, so the batter is safe.
fair ground.meta: Fair ground — bu sportda, ayniqsa beysbolda, o‘yin maydonining foyda qilinadigan qismi, ya’ni foul liniyalari ichidagi va ularni o‘z ichiga olgan maydonni bildiradi.

ex: The doctor treated the fassy with an antibiotic cream.
He had painful fassy on his arms after the rash.
fassy.meta: bu so‘z teridagi yara, shishish yoki yallig‘lanish holatini bildiradi. Bu atama terida paydo bo‘ladigan og‘riqli yoki bezovta qiluvchi joylarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Ba’zan bu so‘z boshqa shunga o‘xshash teri muammolarini ham anglatishi mumkin.

ex: She came fi help us.
He wants fi learn English.
fi.meta: Fi — bu predlog bo‘lib, ingliz tilidagi “to” (infinitivni ifodalash uchun) ma’nosida ishlatiladi. U fe’lning asosiy shakli bilan qo‘llanib, harakatning maqsadini yoki niyatini bildiradi, ya’ni “... uchun”, “... maqsadida” degan ma’noni beradi.

ex: He fingoled the keys before putting them in his pocket.
She fingoled the fabric to check its texture.
fingle.meta: Fingle — bu fe’l biror narsani barmoqlar bilan ushlash, tegish, yoki butunlay teginish ma’nosini anglatadi. Bu so‘z “finger” fe’lining ma’nosiga yaqin, ya’ni narsani barmoqlar yordamida sinchiklab yoki sekinlik bilan tekshirishni bildiradi.

ex: (n.): The fly-by-wire of this spacecraft is highly advanced.
(adj.): Modern airplanes often use fly-by-wire systems for better control.
fly-by-wire.meta: Fly-by-wire — bu atama samolyot yoki kosmik apparatlarning uchish boshqaruvida mexanik bog‘lanishlar o‘rniga elektron boshqaruv tizimlaridan foydalanishni bildiradi.

ex: Force-ripe fruits often have a different taste compared to naturally ripened ones.
The force-ripe tomatoes were harvested earlier than usual.
force-ripe.meta: Force-ripe — bu atama meva yoki hosil uchun ishlatiladi va vaqtidan oldin yoki sun’iy ravishda pishirilgan degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ya’ni, meva tabiiy pishish jarayonidan avval yoki maxsus sharoitlarda tezlashtirilgan holda yetilgan bo‘ladi.

ex: Always pack your foulies when going out on a boat in bad weather.
The fishermen wore foulies to protect themselves from the rain and sea spray.
foulie.meta: Foulie — odatda ko‘plikda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, yog‘ga chidamli, og‘ir vaznli, suv o‘tmaydigan kiyimni bildiradi. Bu kiyim odatda to‘plam shaklida bo‘lib, ichiga kurtka va shim kiradi.

ex: It’s wrong to foul-mouth people just because you disagree with them.
He foul-mouthed his opponent during the heated argument.
foul-mouth.meta: Foul-mouth — bu fe’l kimnidir so‘z bilan haqorat qilish, tanqid qilish, kamsitish yoki yomon gapirish ma’nosini anglatadi. Ya’ni, biror kishiga og‘zaki tajovuz ko‘rsatish, uning obro‘sini tushirish yoki haqorat qilishdir.

ex: Foul-mouthing is not acceptable behavior in this workplace.
His foul-mouthing during the meeting offended many people.
foul-mouthing.meta: bu so‘z bilan haqorat qilish yoki qo‘pol, nojo‘ya so‘zlarni ishlatish harakati. Ya’ni, kimnidir yomon so‘zlar bilan la’natlash, so‘kib yoki haqoratlash. Shuningdek, bu atama bunday holatning o‘zi, ya’ni haqorat yoki kamsituvchi so‘zlarni bildiradi.

ex: The swamp was foul-stinking and unbearable.
The garbage had a foul-stinking odor that filled the entire room.
foul-stinking.meta: Foul-stinking — bu so‘z juda yomon hidli, iflos va yomon hid chiqargan degan ma’noni bildiradi. Shuningdek, ma’nosi figurativ (mavhum) bo‘lib, axloqiy yoki ruhiy ifloslik, buzilish yoki yomonlik haqida gapirganda ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The foul-tempered dog growled at everyone who came near.
He is known to be foul-tempered and hard to work with.
foul-tempered.meta: Foul-tempered — bu sifat juda yomon kayfiyatga ega bo‘lgan, tez asabiylashadigan yoki osongina jahli chiqadigan odam yoki jonivorni bildiradi.

ex: (n.): Free solo is one of the most dangerous forms of climbing.
(adj.): He is a free solo climber, scaling cliffs without any ropes or gear.
free solo.meta: Free solo — bu atama tog‘ga chiqishda sun’iy yordamlar, arqonlar yoki xavfsizlik uskunalarisiz, yolg‘iz bajarayotgan tog‘chini yoki bunday usul bilan qilinayotgan ko‘tarilishni bildiradi.

ex: He has been practicing free soloing for several years.
Free soloing is considered one of the most dangerous climbing practices.
free soloing.meta: Free soloing — bu atama tog‘ga chiqishning shunday usulini bildiradi, bunda odam yolg‘iz va hech qanday sun’iy yordam ishlatmasdan ko‘tariladi. Ya’ni, xavfsizlik choralarsisiz, faqat o‘z kuchi va mahorati bilan bajariladigan tog‘ga chiqish amaliyoti.

ex: The free soloist faced great risks during the climb.
He is a well-known free soloist who climbs without any ropes.
free soloist.meta: Free soloist — bu atama sun’iy yordamlar, arqonlar yoki boshqa xavfsizlik uskunalarisiz, yolg‘iz o‘zi tog‘ga chiqadigan odamni bildiradi. Ya’ni, xavfsizlik choralarsiz alohida yakka holda ko‘tariladigan tog‘chi.

ex: I don’t give a frick about his opinion
What the frick is going on here?
frick.meta: Frick — bu so‘z ingliz tilida qo‘pol yoki vulg‘ar fuck va frig so‘zlarining yumshatilgan, muloyimroq shakli sifatida ishlatiladi. Asosan kuchaytiruvchi sifatida va turli iboralarda qo‘llanadi, masalan: what the frick , not to give a frick kabi.

ex: I don’t give a frick about his opinion
What the frick is going on here?
frick.meta: Frick — bu so‘z ingliz tilida qo‘pol yoki vulg‘ar fuck va frig so‘zlarining yumshatilgan, muloyimroq shakli sifatida ishlatiladi. Asosan kuchaytiruvchi sifatida va turli iboralarda qo‘llanadi, masalan: what the frick , not to give a frick kabi.

ex: There was quite a fudder in the market this morning with everyone rushing about.
A sudden fudder blew through the valley, shaking the trees.
fudder.meta: tez va qattiq shamol esishi ma’nosini bildiradi. Shuningdek, ma’nosi figurativ (mavhum) bo‘lib, birdaniga yuzaga kelgan shovqinli yoki kuchli harakat, shoshilish, adashish yoki tartibsizlik, shovqin-sharash deb ham ishlatiladi.

ex: We grilled galbi at the table during the Korean barbecue.
Galbi is a popular Korean dish made from marinated beef short ribs.
galbi.meta: Galbi — koreys oshxonasida mol go‘shti qisqa suyagi (qovurg‘a)dan tayyorlangan taom. Odatda, soya sousi, sarimsoq va shakar bilan marinad qilinadi va ba’zan stol ustida grillda pishiriladi.

ex: The gho is an important symbol of Bhutanese culture.
The men wore the traditional gho during the festival in Bhutan.
gho.meta: Gho — Bhutan milliy kiyimi bo‘lib, erkaklar uchun mo‘ljallangan uzun kiyimdir. Bu kiyim tizzagacha ko‘tarilgan va belga mato kamar bilan mahkam bog‘langan uzun xalatga o‘xshaydi.

ex: Ghoema drums are an important part of Cape Malay culture.
The musician played the ghoema during the festival.
ghoema.meta: Ghoema — Janubiy Afrika, ayniqsa Cape Malay jamoalarida an’anaviy ravishda chaladigan kichik, barrel shaklidagi, bitta boshli qo‘l barabani. To‘liq nomi — ghoema barabani.

ex: In our childhood games, the ghoen was the most important piece.
He used a big ghoen to knock the smaller marbles out of the circle.
ghoen.meta: Ghoen — bolalar o‘yinlarida tashlanadigan, uloqtiriladigan tosh, shar yoki shunga o‘xshash buyum. Ayniqsa, kattaroq shar bo‘lib, boshqa kichik sharlarni urish uchun ishlatiladi (bunday shar shooter deb ataladi).

ex: The bride wore a ghoonghat to cover her face during the ceremony.
In some Hindu communities, married women observe the practice of ghoonghat.
ghoonghat.meta: Ghoonghat — ba’zi turmush qurgan (asosan hind) ayollar tomonidan bosh yoki yuzni yopib yurish an’anasi yoki odati. Shuningdek, bu so‘z bosh yoki yuzni yopuvchi sharflar yoki pardalarni ham anglatishi mumkin.

ex: A ghost account can be used for fraudulent transactions.
The bank discovered several ghost accounts opened without the owners’ knowledge.
ghost account.meta: Ghost account — dastlab, egasi vafot etgan yoki hisob mavjudligini unutgan bank hisobi. Keyinchalik esa asosan anonim yoki yashirin nom bilan ochilgan bank hisobini anglatadi.

ex: Many ghostbusters aim to debunk fake claims about ghosts and spirits.
The ghostbuster used special equipment to investigate the haunted house.
ghostbuster.meta: Ghostbuster — gumon qilingan paranormal hodisalarni yoki voqealarni tekshiruvchi yoki ular bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxs. Asosan, soxta paranormal da’volarni fosh qiluvchi shubhachilar (skeptiklar) ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Ghostbusting requires special tools and a skeptical approach.
They organized a ghostbusting expedition to investigate the haunted mansion.
ghostbusting.meta: Ghostbusting — gumon qilingan paranormal hodisalarni tekshirish yoki ular bilan shug‘ullanish harakati. Asosan, paranormal da’volarning soxtaligini fosh qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: They ghost dance every year to keep the tradition alive.
During the ceremony, the tribe members ghost danced to honor their ancestors.
ghost dance.meta: Ghost Dance — arvohlar raqsini bajarish, ya’ni Ghost Dance nomli an’anaviy ruhiy raqsni ijro etish (odatda Shimoliy Amerika hindulari orasida ruhiy yoki diniy marosim sifatida).

ex: Ghost hunts often involve using special equipment to detect paranormal activity.
The group went on a ghost hunt in the abandoned mansion.
ghost hunt.meta: Ghost hunt — arvohlar, poltergeistlar va boshqa paranormal mavjudotlarni qidirish; gumon qilingan paranormal hodisalarni tekshirish uchun olib boriladigan tergov yoki izlanish.

ex: They spent the night ghost-hunting in the old castle.
Ghost-hunting has become a popular hobby for many paranormal enthusiasts.
ghost-hunting.meta: Ghost-hunting — arvohlar, poltergeistlar va boshqa paranormal mavjudotlarni qidirish amaliyoti yoki faoliyati; gumon qilingan paranormal hodisalarni tekshirish.

ex: Some people believe that ghosties can communicate with the living.
The children were scared because they thought they saw a ghostie in the old house.
ghostie.meta: Ghostie — arvoh, ruh; o‘lik odamning ko‘rinishi yoki unga o‘xshash mavjudot.

ex: Legends tell of a ghost ship that appears suddenly on foggy nights.
Sailors often feared seeing a ghost ship, believing it was a bad omen.
ghost ship.meta: Bo‘sh yoki ekipajsiz suzayotgan kemа; ko‘pincha bu kemа o‘liklar kemasi yoki arvoh kemasi sifatida talqin qilinadi. Ma’lum bir sababga ko‘ra yo‘q bo‘lgan yoki kutilmagan joyda paydo bo‘lgan kemа; ba’zan sirli yoki g‘aroyib holatlarda uchraydigan kemа.

ex: Legends say that a ghoulie comes out at night to feed on the dead.
The story was about a ghoulie that haunted the old graveyard.
ghoulie.meta: Ghoulie — ghul; o‘liklardan go‘sht yeydigan yoki qabristonlarda yurgan afsonaviy yirtqich mavjudot.

ex: In old stories, Ginny Gall was described as a harsh and distant place.
He said he would send me to Ginny Gall if I kept misbehaving.
ginny gall.meta: Ginny Gall — Afrika-amerikalik tilida: tasavvur qilingan, uzoq, noqulay yoki qattiq joy; ayniqsa do‘zaxning chekka hududi sifatida ta’riflanadi. Hozirda kam ishlatiladi.

ex: He joined the Guillelmites, following the teachings of St William of Maleval.
The Guillelmites were known for their strict hermit lifestyle in the 12th century.
guillelmite.meta: Guillelmite — 12-asrda Muqaddas Uilyam Malevalning shogirdlari tomonidan tashkil etilgan monastik eremitlar diniy orderi a’zosi; Williamite bilan bir xil.

ex: She speaks Guyanese English fluently, reflecting her cultural background.
Guyanese English has unique pronunciations and vocabulary different from standard English.
guyanese english.meta: Guyanese English — Gayanada yoki gayanaliklar tomonidan so‘zlashiladigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tili. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Gayanaga xos ingliz tilining dialekti yoki lahjasi.

ex: Don’t believe everything you hear; it might just be gyaff.
They were having a bit of gyaff about the neighbors.
gyaff.meta: Gyaff — bo‘sh vaqt suhbat, mish-mish. Shuningdek, bunday suhbat yoki mish-mishning bir qismi.

ex: We spent the evening gyaffing about old times.
They like to gyaff every afternoon after work.
gyaff.meta: Gyaff — (fe’l) bo‘sh suhbatlashmoq; mish-mish qilmoq, gaplashmoq.

ex: You haffi finish your work before leaving.
I haffi go now.
haffi.meta: Haffi — (fe’l yordamchisi) — majbur bo‘lmoq, kerak bo‘lmoq; infinitiv shakldagi fe’l oldidan kelib, “… qilish kerak”, “majbur bo‘lish” ma’nosini bildiradi.

ex: In historical mining villages, a hagger was a respected worker.
The hagger worked deep underground, cutting coal from the seam.
hagger.meta: Hagger — (Cumberland mintaqasida, ingliz tili) tog‘ konchilik atamasi. Ko‘mir qatlamidan ko‘mirni kesib oluvchi konchi; hewer (konchi, tosh kesuvchi) so‘zining sinonimi. Hozirda tarixiy atama sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: He made a haggis-headed decision that cost him dearly.
Don’t be so haggis-headed; think before you act!
haggis-headed.meta: Haggis-headed — (odam haqida) ahmoq, aqldan ozgan, dangasa yoki ahmoqona harakat qiluvchi.

ex: Parents often invest in hagwons to give their children a competitive advantage.
Many students attend a hagwon after regular school hours to improve their grades.
hagwon.meta: Hagwon — Janubiy Koreyada keng tarqalgan xususiy maktab yoki ta’lim muassasasi, o‘quvchilarga qo‘shimcha ta’lim berish uchun tashkil etilgan. Odatda talabalar maktabdan tashqari vaqtlarida bilimlarini oshirish uchun bunday maskanlarga qatnaydi.

ex: Many countries have embraced Hallyu, leading to increased tourism in South Korea.
The global popularity of K-pop and Korean dramas is part of the Hallyu phenomenon.
hallyu.meta: Hallyu — Janubiy Koreyaga va uning mashhur madaniyatiga, ayniqsa, koreys musiqasi, kinolari va boshqa madaniy mahsulotlarining jahon miqyosidagi muvaffaqiyati orqali xalqaro qiziqishning ortishi.

ex: Hanbok is often worn during Korean holidays like Chuseok and Lunar New Year.
She wore a beautiful hanbok for the traditional Korean ceremony.
hanbok.meta: Hanbok — Koreyaning an’anaviy kiyimi, odatda ayollar uchun uzun yengli ko‘ylak yoki bluzka va uzun, beli yuqori ko‘ylakdan iborat bo‘lib, erkaklar uchun esa keng shimlar bilan kiyiniladi. Bu kiyim bayramlarda va maxsus tadbirlarda kiyiladi.

ex: The baker baked a fresh loaf of hard-dough this morning.
Hard-dough bread is a staple in many Caribbean households.
hard-dough.meta: Hard-dough — Qalin, zich oq non turini ifodalaydi, odatda to‘rtburchak shaklida va biroz shirin ta’mga ega bo‘ladi. Asosan hard-dough bread — zich oq non turi ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Hegiran dates are used in many Muslim countries for religious purposes.
The Hegiran calendar begins from the year 622 A.D.
hegiran.meta: Hegiran — Islom tarixiy kalendariga oid yoki unga tegishli bo‘lgan; milodiy 622-yildagi Hijra (Muhammad payg‘ambarning Makkadan Madinaga ko‘chishi) voqeasidan boshlab hisoblangan Islom yillik tizimi bilan bog‘liq.

ex: They inadvisably ignored the weather warnings before the trip.
He inadvisably invested all his savings in a risky business.
inadvisably.meta: inadvisably — maslahatga zid tarzda; ehtiyotsiz, ahmoqona yoki oqilona bo‘lmagan holda.

ex: She spoke fluent Jamaican English during her visit to Kingston.
Jamaican English has unique pronunciation and vocabulary compared to standard English.
jamaican english.meta: Jamaican English — Yamayka orolida yoki yamaykaliklar tomonidan gapiriladigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tili. Shuningdek, bu tilning o‘ziga xos talaffuzi, lug‘ati va grammatikasi bor.

ex: At the Korean restaurant, I ordered japchae for dinner.
Japchae is a popular Korean dish made with stir-fried glass noodles and vegetables.
japchae.meta: Japchae — koreys taomi bo‘lib, unda shirin kartoshka kraxmalidan tayyorlangan shaffof (selofan) noodle-lar sabzavotlar va boshqa ingredientlar bilan qovuriladi.

ex: The Juche ideology was developed by Kim Il-sung to promote national autonomy.
Juche is the official political ideology of North Korea, emphasizing self-reliance and independence.
juche.meta: Juche — Shimoliy Koreya (Koreya Xalq Demokratik Respublikasi) bilan bog‘liq siyosiy g‘oya va mafkura bo‘lib, u milliy mustaqillik va o‘z-o‘zini boshqarishni ta’minlashga qaratilgan.

ex: The Juche ideology was developed by Kim Il-sung to promote national autonomy.
Juche is the official political ideology of North Korea, emphasizing self-reliance and independence.
