juche.meta: Juche — Shimoliy Koreya (Koreya Xalq Demokratik Respublikasi) bilan bog‘liq siyosiy g‘oya va mafkura bo‘lib, u milliy mustaqillik va o‘z-o‘zini boshqarishni ta’minlashga qaratilgan.

ex: Many young people follow K-fashion trends.
K-pop is a popular music genre originating from South Korea.
k-.meta: K- — Janubiy Koreya va uning (ommabop) madaniyatiga oid atamalar hosil qiluvchi qo‘shimcha shakl. Masalan: K-beauty (Koreya go‘zallik sanoati), K-culture (Koreya madaniyati), K-food (Koreya taomlari), K-style (Koreya uslubi) va hokazo.

ex: The band played traditional kaiso and calypso songs.
Kaiso is often performed during Caribbean carnivals.
kaiso.meta: Kaiso — G‘arbiy Afrikadan kelib chiqqan Karib musiqasi uslubi, ayniqsa, karnavallar va shunga o‘xshash bayramlar bilan bog‘liq. Keyinchalik, ayniqsa, kalipso musiqasini anglatadi. Shuningdek, boshqa ma’nolari ham mavjud.

ex: K-dramas have gained huge popularity worldwide.
I love watching K-dramas because of their emotional stories.
k-drama.meta: K-drama — Janubiy Koreyada ishlab chiqarilgan va koreys tilida efirga uzatiladigan televidenie seriali. Shuningdek, bunday seriallarning umumiy nomi sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Kimbap is often served at picnics or parties in Korea.
I made kimbap for lunch; it’s delicious and easy to eat.
kimbap.meta: Kimbap — Koreys oshxonasiga mansub taom bo‘lib, unda pishirilgan guruch va boshqa ingredientlar dengiz yosini varaqlariga o‘ralib, kichik bo‘laklarga kesiladi.

ex: The Kittian community has a rich cultural heritage.
She is a proud Kittian who celebrates her island’s traditions.
kittian.meta: Kittian — Sent Kits orolidan bo‘lgan mahalliy aholi yoki uning aholisi; Sent Kitsdan kelgan odamlarning avlodi; = Kittitian.

ex: Konglish can sometimes cause confusion due to mixed grammar rules.
Many young Koreans use Konglish in everyday conversations.
konglish.meta: Konglish — koreys va ingliz tillarining aralashmasi, ayniqsa, koreyslar tomonidan gapiriladigan norasmiy gibrid til bo‘lib, unda koreys va ingliz tillarining elementlari birlashtirilgan.

ex: The term lightie can sometimes carry negative connotations depending on the context.
In some Afro-Caribbean communities, a lightie might be teased for having lighter skin.
lightie.meta: (ba’zan haqorat sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin) Asosan Britaniya Afro-Karib aholisi orasida ishlatiladi: terisi ochiq yoki nisbatan ochiq bo‘lgan qora tanli odam; shuningdek, aralash irqli shaxs.

ex: Many people use livestreaming apps to share their daily activities.
The concert was amazing thanks to the livestreaming service.
livestreaming.meta: Voqea yoki hodisani internet orqali jonli efirda uzatish jarayoni yoki harakati. Shuningdek, “livestreaming” so‘zi qo‘shimcha sifatida ham ishlatiladi, masalan, livestreaming ilova, livestreaming platformasi.

ex: They organized a livestreaming broadcast of the seminar.
The livestreaming event attracted a global audience.
livestreaming.meta: Video yoki audio orqali biror voqea yoki tadbirni internetda jonli tarzda efirga uzatishga oid.

ex: She is proud of her Lokono heritage.
The Lokono are indigenous people living in the Caribbean region.
lokono.meta: Karib dengizi hududi va Janubiy Amerikaning shimoliy qismlarida yashovchi mahalliy xalq vakili. Taqqoslash: Arawak (bir boshqa mahalliy xalq).

ex: The loud-mouthing protesters made their voices heard.
He is loud-mouthing about his achievements.
loud-mouthing.meta: Baland ovozda gapirishga moyil; shovqinli. Hozirda ko‘proq “ochiqchasiga gapiruvchi, so‘zsiz” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Love locks have become a popular tradition in many cities around the world.
The couple attached a love lock to the bridge to symbolize their everlasting love.
love lock.meta: Bir juftlik tomonidan ko‘prik, panjara, to‘siq va hokazolarga ulangan, ularning sevgisi va bir-biriga bo‘lgan sadoqatining ramzi sifatida ishlatiladigan qulflash.

ex: That mamaguy salesman tried to trick me into buying a faulty product.
His promises were just mamaguy to get my trust.
mamaguy.meta: Aldov; samimiy bo‘lmagan maqtov, yolg‘on maqtov.(sifat) Aldovli, soxta, yolg‘on ko‘rinadigan yoki bo‘lgan.

ex: They were mamaguing him about his new haircut.
He tried to mamaguy me into believing his story.
mamaguy.meta: (kimnidir) aldashga yoki chalg‘itishga urinish, ayniqsa, maqtov orqali. (shuningdek) kimnidir masxara qilish, kuldirish, kulgu qilish.

ex: There are stylistic differences between manhwa and manga, but both are very popular.
I read a new manhwa yesterday — the story was very interesting
manhwa.meta: Manxva — bu Koreyada yaratilgan komiks va chiziqli romanlar janri bo‘lib, ko‘pincha yaponcha manga janridan ilhomlangan bo‘ladi. Ushbu so‘z, shuningdek, shu janrga oid komiks yoki chiziqli romanni ham anglatadi.

ex: Mannish water is often prepared during celebrations or special ceremonies.
He tried mannish water for the first time when he was in Jamaica.
mannish water.meta: Mannish sho‘rva — Yamayka oshxonasiga oid an’anaviy quyuq sho‘rva bo‘lib, u echki ichki a’zolari (masalan, jigar, yurak, ichak) va boshqa mahsulotlar — batat (yam), kartoshka, yashil banan, xamirli dumaloqlar (dumpling) kabi ingredientlardan tayyorlanadi.

ex: The writer described their charming meet-cute in a very heartfelt way.
At the beginning of the movie, the main characters meet through a meet-cute.
meet-cute.meta: Yoqimli uchrashuv — asosan filmlar, romanlar va hikoyalarda uchraydigan, ikki insonning romantik munosabatlarga olib keladigan kulgili, noodatiy yoki jozibali birinchi uchrashuvi.

ex: The middlewalk was built high to avoid flooding during the rainy season.
The workers used the middlewalk every day to reach the back fields of the plantation.
middlewalk.meta: Markaziy yo‘lak — shakarqamish plantatsiyalarida qurilgan keng yo‘l yoki to‘g‘on bo‘lib, u ommaviy yo‘lni va mulkning old qismini plantatsiyaning orqa hududi (ya'ni backdam) bilan bog‘laydi.

ex: Language policies can minoritize certain groups.
They have long been minoritized in regard to their culture and traditions.
minoritize.meta: Ozchilikka aylantirmoq — biror shaxs, guruh yoki g‘oyani jamiyatda ozchilik sifatida ko‘rsatish, shuningdek, uni ijtimoiy, siyosiy yoki madaniy jihatdan chetga surish yoki quyi maqomga tushirish jarayonini anglatadi.

ex: This policy has historically harmed minoritized groups.
Minoritized communities often have less access to resources.
minoritized.meta: Ozchilikka aylantirilgan — dastlab: jamiyatdagi oz sonli guruhga mansub bo‘lgan yoki shu guruhni tashkil etuvchi.

ex: The blogger ate for hours and streamed a mukbang live.
He watches new mukbang videos every day to learn about different foods.
mukbang.meta: Mukbang — asosan jonli efir (livestream) tarzida suratga olingan va unda biror kishi juda katta miqdorda ovqat iste'mol qilayotgani va shu paytda tomoshabinlar bilan suhbatlashayotgani aks etgan video.

ex: In many K-dramas, the male lead affectionately refers to the female lead as "noona."
He always calls his older sister "noona" when asking for advice.
noona.meta: Nuna — koreys tilida yigit yoki erkak kishi o‘zidan katta bo‘lgan opasiga yoki yaqin bo‘lgan katta yoshli ayolga murojaat qilish uchun ishlatadigan so‘z. Bu atama hurmat yoki mehr ifodasi sifatida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: I brought some food for oonuh to share.
Oonuh better listen to what I’m saying!
oonuh.meta: Oonuh — asosan ko‘plikda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, ingliz tilidagi “you” (ya’ni “sizlar”) ma’nosini anglatadi. Ayrim hollarda oonuh so‘zi jamoaga, guruhdagi kishilarga yoki suhbatdoshlar to‘plamiga murojaat qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: In many K-dramas, female characters affectionately call their love interest “oppa.”
She called her older brother “oppa” when asking for help.
oppa.meta: Oppa — koreys tilida qiz yoki ayol o‘zidan katta aka (aka-uka orasidagi) yoki yaqin bo‘lgan katta yoshli erkakka murojaat qilish uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. Bu so‘z hurmat va mehr ifodasi sifatida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: The orhni can be used as a veil to cover the head in traditional ceremonies.
She wore a beautiful orhni draped over her shoulders during the wedding.
orhni.meta: Orhni — Janubiy Osiyo ayollari yoki ularning avlodlari tomonidan boshga, yelkaga yoki bo‘yniga o‘raladigan mato. U sharf, shal, to‘rlik yoki yelka o‘rami sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The ideology of pan-Asianism gained popularity in the early 20th century.
Pan-Asianism aimed to unite Asian countries against colonial powers.
pan-asianism.meta: Pan-osiyachilik — Osiyoning siyosiy birlashuvi yoki Osiyo davlatlari o‘rtasida birdamlikni targ‘ib qiluvchi turli mafkuralar va harakatlar.

ex: The pan-Asianist movement sought to reduce Western influence in Asia.
He was a prominent pan-Asianist who spoke about Asian unity.
pan-asianist.meta: Pan-osiyachi — Osiyoning siyosiy birlashuvi yoki Osiyo davlatlari o‘rtasida birdamlikni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs. Ko‘pincha g‘arbiy siyosiy tahdidlarga qarshi kurashish maqsadida Osiyo millatlarini birlashtirish tarafdori.

ex: Pan-Asiatic trade agreements aim to boost economic ties across Asia.
The conference focused on pan-Asiatic cooperation among nations.
pan-asiatic.meta: Pan-osiyalik — Osiyoning barcha davlatlari yoki xalqlari bilan bog‘liq, ularni ifodalovchi yoki ularni o‘z ichiga olgan. Pan-Asian (pan-osiyachilik) bilan sinonim sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The ideology of pan-Asiaticism influenced many political leaders in the early 20th century.
Pan-Asiaticism promoted unity among Asian countries to resist colonialism.
pan-asiaticism.meta: Pan-osiyachilik — Osiyoning siyosiy birlashuvi yoki Osiyo davlatlari o‘rtasida birdamlikni targ‘ib qiluvchi turli mafkuralar va harakatlar.

ex: She completed all the paperwork required for passporting.
The passporting process can take several weeks depending on the country.
passporting.meta: Pasport olish jarayoni — pasportni rasmiy ravishda olish yoki berish jarayoni. Bu atama hujjatlarni tayyorlash, ariza topshirish, tekshiruvdan o‘tish va oxir-oqibat pasportga ega bo‘lishni anglatadi.

ex: The PC bang charges an hourly fee for internet and gaming access.
Many teenagers in Seoul spend their evenings at the PC bang playing online games.
pc bang.meta: PC bang — Janubiy Koreyada ko‘p sonli kompyuter terminalari joylashgan, internetga kirish uchun to‘lov asosida xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi joy. Asosan video o‘yinlar o‘ynash uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: She cooked pelau with chicken, rice, and pigeon peas for the family dinner.
Pelau is a popular dish in many Caribbean households.
pelau.meta: Pelau — Karib oshxonasiga mansub, fransuz-kreol taʼmiga ega achchiq taom. Asosiy tarkibiy qismlari go‘sht (odatda tovuq), guruch va turna loviyasi (pigeon peas) bo‘ladi. Bu taom ko‘pincha maxsus bayramlar va oilaviy yig‘ilishlarda tayyorlanadi.

ex: Without the phukni, it was hard to maintain a strong flame in the furnace.
The blacksmith used a phukni to keep the fire burning hot.
phukni.meta: Phukni — olovni kuchaytirish uchun unga havo oqimini yo‘naltirishda ishlatiladigan shox shaklidagi quvur yoki naycha. Bu asbob yordamida olov yaxshiroq yonadi va tezroq olovlanadi.

ex: Postpaid internet services allow users to pay after using data.
She has a postpaid mobile phone plan that bills her monthly.
postpaid.meta: Keyinchalik to‘lanadigan — xizmat yoki mahsulotdan foydalangan yoki sotib olganidan keyin to‘lov amalga oshiriladigan tizim yoki holat. Hozirgi kunda ayniqsa mobil telefon yoki internet xizmatlari uchun ishlatiladi

ex: Powerbombs are one of the most dramatic moves in professional wrestling.
The wrestler executed a perfect powerbomb to win the match.
powerbomb.meta: Pauerbomb — kurash yoki professional wrestlingda ishlatiladigan bir usul bo‘lib, unda kurashchi raqibini yelkasiga o‘tirgan holda ko‘tarib, keyin uni orqa tarafiga yotqizib matga kuch bilan yiqitadi.

ex: Samgyeopsal is popular for its juicy and tender pork belly slices.
We enjoyed grilling samgyeopsal at the Korean BBQ restaurant.
samgyeopsal.meta: Samgyopsal — koreys oshxonasiga oid taom bo‘lib, yupqa qilib kesilgan cho'chqa qornidan tayyorlanadi. Odatda xom holda taqdim etilib, mijoz o‘z stolida joylashgan panjara ustida pishiradi.

ex: "Make sure to finish the report by tomorrow, seen?"
"We will meet at 6 pm, seen?"
seen.meta: Seen — rozilik, tasdiq yoki tushunishni ifodalovchi so‘z yoki ohang. Shuningdek, gap oxirida savol shaklida ishlatilib, suhbatdoshdan rozilik yoki tasdiqni olish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The creature was able to shapeshift to avoid capture.
In many myths, witches can shapeshift into animals.
shapeshift.meta: Shakl almashtirmoq — ayniqsa sehrli yoki g‘ayritabiiy kuchlar yordamida tashqi ko‘rinish yoki shaklini o‘zgartirish. Bundan tashqari, umumiy ma’noda ham kimningdir tashqi ko‘rinishi yoki holati tez va sezilarli darajada o‘zgarishini ifodalashi mumkin.

ex: Don’t sheg me by breaking your promises.
He liked to sheg his little brother just for fun.
sheg.meta: Sheg — (biror kishini) ranjitmoq, bezovta qilmoq yoki g‘azablantirmoq. Shuningdek, aldamoq yoki xiyonat qilmoq ma’nolarida ham ishlatiladi. Bu so‘z odamlarni ranjitish yoki ularni noto‘g‘ri ishga undash holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: The project was sheg-up after poor management.
That old car is completely sheg-up and barely runs.
sheg-up.meta: Sheg-up — hurmatsiz, qadr-qimmatga loyiq emas; foydasiz yoki yaroqsiz holat. Shuningdek, tartibsiz, buzilgan yoki ifloslangan, ahvoli yomonlashgan vaziyatni ham bildiradi.

ex: The movie showed many scenes of skinship between the couple.
Skinship between parents and children helps build a strong emotional bond.
skinship.meta: Jismoniy yaqinlik — asosan yapon va koreys madaniyatlarida ota-ona va bola o‘rtasidagi yoki keyinchalik sevgilar yoki do‘stlar o‘rtasidagi yaqin va muloyim jismoniy aloqani ifodalovchi tushuncha.

ex: The crowd expressed their disapproval with loud steups.
He made a steups when he heard the bad news.
steups.meta: Shvayish — Karib mintaqasida tishlar orqali havo va tupurikni so‘rib chiqariladigan ovoz. Bu ovoz ko‘pincha nafrat, norozilik, jahl yoki haqorat ifodasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: She bought a pair of suedine shoes for the party.
The jacket was made of soft suedine fabric.
suedine.meta: Suedin mato — zamshga o‘xshash, biroz to‘qilgan, mayin va yengil shimg‘ichka qoplamaga ega bo‘lgan mato turi. Ko‘pincha kiyim va poyabzal uchun ishlatiladi. So‘z modifier sifatida ham ishlatiladi, masalan, suedine kurtka (zamshga o‘xshash kurtka).

ex: His writing style is very Suetonian, focusing on personal details of rulers.
The book provides a Suetonian account of Julius Caesar’s life.
suetonian.meta: Suetoniyga oid — Suetonius yoki uning asarlari, xususan Rim hukmdorlarining hayoti haqidagi biografiyalari bilan bog‘liq yoki ularga xos bo‘lgan. Bu atama ko‘pincha tarixiy yoki adabiy kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Roman historians wrote about the Suevi's migrations.
The Suevi were known as a powerful Germanic tribe.
suevi.meta: Suevlar — qadimgi Germaniya xalqlari guruhiga kiruvchi xalq. Rim Respublikasi oxiri va Imperiyasi boshlarida Rim mualliflari tomonidan katta hududlarda istiqomat qilgan deb yozilgan. Ular Germaniya va uning atroflarida yashaganlar.

ex: Every week, each member contributes to the susu fund.
The community formed a susu to help each member save money.
susu.meta: Susu — norasmiy hamkorlik asosida tashkil etilgan tejash sxemasi yoki klubi. Har bir ishtirokchi haftalik belgilangan miqdorda pul qo‘shadi va umumiy yig‘ilgan summa navbat bilan bir ishtirokchiga berib boriladi.

ex: Sweet bread is popular during festivals and celebrations.
She bought some sweet bread for breakfast.
sweet bread.meta: Shirin non — shirin ta’mga ega bo‘lgan non, pishiriq, tort yoki pechene. Bu atama turli shakldagi shirinliklarni, asosan non mahsulotlari yoki pishiriqlarni ifodalaydi. Masalan, mevali yoki shakar qo‘shilgan non yoki pishiriqlar.

ex: Many songs express the feelings of tabanca and unrequited love.
After the breakup, he suffered from tabanca for months.
tabanca.meta: Tabantsa — ayniqsa sevgi yoki romantik munosabatlarning yakunlanishi natijasida yuzaga keladigan tushkunlik yoki g‘amginlik holati; sevgi qayg‘usi, chuqur ranjish va ruhiy holat.

ex: The movie showed casual talkee between friends.
They had a long talkee about their plans.
talkee.meta: Talkee — Afro-Karib va Sharqiy Osiyo lahjalarida noaniq yoki biroz pasaytirilgan shaklda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, gaplashish, suhbat yoki muloqot ma’nolarini anglatadi. Bu so‘z ko‘proq norasmiy yoki shevalarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Tang Soo Do focuses on discipline and self-defense techniques.
He has been practicing Tang Soo Do for five years.
tang soo do.meta: Tang Su Do — qo‘l va oyog‘ yordamida zarbalarni berish va bloklashga asoslangan koreys jang san’ati. Karatega o‘xshash uslubga ega bo‘lib, jangovar texnikalarni o‘rgatadi.

ex: Tassa drums are common in Caribbean celebrations with Indian heritage.
The musician played the tassa with great skill during the festival.
tassa.meta: Tassa — shimoliy Hindistonga oid, idish shaklidagi echki terisidan yasalgan baraban. Odatda bo‘yniga osilib, ikki tayoqcha bilan chaliladi. Bu asbob ko‘proq an’anaviy marosimlar va musiqa ansambllarida ishlatiladi.

ex: She is a dedicated tifoso of the local basketball team.
The tifosi cheered loudly during the football match.
tifoso.meta: Muxlis — biror sport yoki jamoani juda qiziqish bilan qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi, ishtiyoqli tarafdor. Ko‘pincha bu so‘z ko‘plik shaklida ham ishlatiladi va bunday muxlislar guruhini bildiradi.

ex: Besides the rain, it was too cold to go outside.
She is smart, and too besides, very hardworking.
too besides.meta: Bundan tashqari — qo‘shimcha ravishda, shuningdek, yana; biror gapga yoki holatga yana bir narsani qo‘shish uchun ishlatiladi, masalan, "besides that" ma’nosida.

ex: She speaks Trinidadian English with a distinct Caribbean accent.
Trinidadian English has unique expressions not commonly used elsewhere.
trinidadian english.meta: Trinidad ingliz tili — Trinidadda yoki Trinidadliklar tomonidan so‘zlanadigan yoki yoziladigan ingliz tili. Bu tilning o‘ziga xos talaffuzi, lug‘at boyligi va uslubi mavjud bo‘lib, Karib mintaqasidagi ingliz tili variantlaridan biridir.

ex: In Korean culture, younger women often address older women as “unni.”
She called her older sister “unni” with affection.
unni.meta: Unni — Koreys tilida qiz yoki ayolning katta singlisi uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. Shu bilan birga, hurmat ifodasi yoki mehr-muhabbat bilan murojaat qilish shakli sifatida ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Her speech was upful and filled with hope.
The upful melody made everyone smile.
upful.meta: Quvontiruvchi — baxt, optimizm yoki umid uyg‘otadigan; ayniqsa musiqa uchun ishlatilganda, kayfiyatni ko‘taruvchi, xursand qiluvchi.

ex: She greeted him with a casual “Wagwan!”
“Wagwan, bro? How have you been?”
wagwan.meta: Wagwan — norasmiy salomlashish so‘zi, “Nima gap?” yoki “Nima bo‘lyapti?” degan ma’noni bildiradi. Ko‘pincha do‘stlar o‘rtasida ishlatiladi va ingliz tilidagi “What’s going on?” iborasining qisqartmasi hisoblanadi.

ex: Washikong are popular among students for their comfort.
He wore his washikong shoes to the gym.
washikong.meta: Washikong — yupqa paypoq bilan kiyiladigan, rezina taglikli engil matodan tayyorlangan sport tuflisi yoki yugurish poyabzali. Ko‘pincha maktabda yoki sport mashg‘ulotlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: The cowboy called his horse with a loud “Whoo-ee!”
“Whoo-ee! Look at that amazing trick!”
whoo-ee.meta: Whoo-ee — diqqatni jalb qilish yoki odam yoki hayvonni chaqirish uchun ishlatiladigan ovoz. Shuningdek, hayrat, hayajon, hayqiriq kabi turli his-tuyg‘ularni ifodalashda ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: The team took a whoop-ass in yesterday’s game.
He gave his opponent a serious whoop-ass in the fight.
whoop-ass.meta: Whoop-ass — kimnidir jiddiy zarbalar bilan urish yoki kuchli mag‘lubiyatga uchratish holati. Ko‘pincha ma’nosi kinoyali yoki figurativ bo‘lib, kimnidir yengish yoki ustun kelishni ta’riflaydi.

ex: Children with Williams syndrome often have a friendly and outgoing personality.
Williams syndrome affects facial features and cognitive development.
williams.meta: Williams — tug‘ma holat bo‘lib, o‘ziga xos yuz tuzilishi va boshqa xususiyatlar bilan tavsiflanadi. Ko‘pincha “Williams sindromi” yoki “Williams elfin yuzlari sindromi” kabi kasallik nomlarida modifier sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: After the long hike, she enjoyed a willie-waught of cold water.
He took a big willie-waught of whiskey before speaking.
willie-waught.meta: Willie-waught — ayniqsa spirtli ichimlikning katta yutimi yoki chuqur, ko‘p miqdordagi chayish. Oddiy so‘z bilan aytganda, bir katta qadamda ichilgan ichimlik.

ex: The old man practiced witching with a wooden divining rod.
Witching is often used by farmers to find underground water sources.
witching.meta: Witching — er osti suvlarini, minerallarni yoki boshqa narsalarni topish uchun maxsus tayoqcha (divining rod) yoki shunga o‘xshash usullar yordamida qidirish jarayoni yoki texnikasi.

ex: Children played with a toy witch’s cauldron during Halloween.
The witch’s cauldron bubbled with a mysterious potion.
witch’s cauldron.meta: Witch’s cauldron — sehrgar ayollar tomonidan sehrli aralashmalar tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladigan katta qozon yoki pishirish idishi. Shuningdek, bu atama ko‘pincha o‘yinchoq yoki model shaklida ko‘rsatiladigan ramziy ob’ektni ham anglatadi.

ex: He bought a witch’s hat as a party accessory.
The witch’s hat completed her spooky Halloween costume.
witch’s hat.meta: Witch’s hat — ko‘pincha qora rangda, baland va uchi tik nuqtaga ega shlyapa, keng va tekis chet bilan. Odatda qora plash bilan birga sehrgar ayollar tasvirlarida kiyiladi.

ex: A woofling noise came from the old engine.
The dog gave a woofling sound in its sleep.
woofling.meta: Woofling — past darajada nafas olish, shing‘illash yoki g‘ichirlagan tovush bilan tavsiflanadigan yoki bunday tovush chiqaradigan.

ex: She shouted “Woo-hoo!” when she won the game.
The owl’s woo-hoo echoed through the forest at night.
woo-hoo.meta: Woo-hoo — ba’zi boyqush turlarining xarakterli “huu-hu” degandek chaqirig‘i. Shuningdek, bu so‘z quvonch, hayajon yoki zavq ifodasi sifatida interjektsiya sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: He was labeled a woo-woo because of his belief in crystals and energy healing.
Some people consider astrology to be woo-woo.
woo-woo.meta: Woo-woo — ilmiy asosga ega bo‘lmagan, mantiqsiz yoki g‘aroyib e’tiqodlar yoki amaliyotlarni tutuvchi shaxs yoki guruhni ifodalaydi. Ko‘pincha bunday e’tiqodlar mistik, sehrli yoki noodatiy g‘oyalar bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

ex: The dancers wuk to the Caribbean beat.
She loves to wuk on the dance floor all night.
wuk.meta: Wuk qilish — ayniqsa ayollarga nisbatan ishlatiladigan, bel va sonlarni ritmik aylantirib raqsga tushish; bel, son va qorin qismini doira shaklida harakatlantirish.

ex: The film explores the life of a zami in a conservative society.
She proudly identifies as a zami.
Fans of horror stories often imagine a zombocalypse scenario.
The movie shows what would happen during a zombocalypse.
zombocalypse.meta: Zombokalips — tasavvuriy hodisa, ko‘pincha filmlarda tasvirlanganidek, dunyo zombi degan jonli o‘liklar tomonidan egallab olinishi; ya’ni, “zombi apokalipsi” ga teng tushuncha.

ex: The zom-com blended horror and humor perfectly.
"Shaun of the Dead" is a popular zom-com film.
zom-com.meta: Zom-com — zombi obrazlari asosidagi komediya janridagi kino filmi.

ex: Artificial capital can sometimes cause inflation if not managed properly.
The central bank’s policies led to an increase in artificial capital in the economy
artificial capital.meta: Sun’iy kapital — bank ishi sohasida: milliy iqtisodiyotga bank sektori tomonidan (davlat tomonidan ruxsat berilgan) chora-tadbirlar orqali kiritilgan pul mablag‘lari; shuningdek, qarz yoki boshqa moliyalashtirish yo‘llari bilan yaratilgan aktivlar.

ex: Excessive CO2 emissions contribute to global warming.
Plants absorb CO2 during photosynthesis.
co2.meta: Karbon dioksid — rangsiz, hidsiz gaz bo‘lib, organik birikmalar va yoqilg‘i moddalari yonishi, nafas olish jarayonlari va boshqa biologik hamda kimyoviy jarayonlar natijasida hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: Many industrial plants use cogeneration systems to save energy.
Cogeneration improves energy efficiency by using waste heat.
cogeneration.meta: Qo‘shma energiya ishlab chiqarish — elektr energiyasi va foydali issiqlikni bir vaqtda ishlab chiqarish jarayoni; ayniqsa, elektr ishlab chiqarishdan qolgan bug‘ni isitish uchun foydalanish.

ex: Some environmentalists advocate degrowth to reduce ecological damage.
The old machinery showed signs of degrowth and decay.
degrowth.meta: Pasayish — biror narsaning buzilishi yoki vayron qilinishi harakati; eski ma’noda ishlatilgan. Shuningdek, iqtisodiyotda resurslar iste’molining kamayishi va iqtisodiy o‘sish sur’atining pasayishi sifatida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: The city invested in energy-from-waste technology to generate electricity.
Energy from waste plants help reduce landfill volumes.
energy from waste.meta: Chiqindidan energiya olish — chiqindilarni yonish orqali yoki avval ularni boshqa turdagi yoqilg‘iga aylantirib, foydalanish mumkin bo‘lgan energiya hosil qilish jarayoni.

ex: Scientists warn about the dangers of unchecked global heating.
Global heating causes melting of polar ice caps.
global heating.meta: Global isish — Yer atmosferasi, suvlari va yer yuzasining o‘rtacha haroratining oshishi; ayniqsa, uzoq muddatli va asta-sekin yuzaga keladigan harorat ko‘tarilishi jarayoni.

ex: The community practices kaitiakitanga by preserving local forests and rivers.
Kaitiakitanga is a core principle in Māori culture for protecting the environment.
kaitiakitanga.meta: Kaitiakitanga — ayniqsa bir joy yoki hududning tabiiy resurslarini muhofaza qilish yoki boshqarish; atrof-muhitga nisbatan mas’uliyat va burch sifatida qabul qilinadigan ekologik parvarish.

ex: The microgrid on the slide helped measure the specimen’s size precisely.
The scientist used the microgrid to accurately count cells under the microscope.
microgrid.meta: Mikroto‘r — mikroskopning ko‘zgu qismida yoki namunani joylashtirilgan yuzada joylashgan mayda chiziqlar yoki to‘r; kuzatuv, hisoblash yoki o‘lchash jarayonini osonlashtirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Economists emphasize preserving natural capital for sustainable development.
Forests and clean water are important components of natural capital.
natural capital.meta: Tabiiy kapital — moliyaviy sohada, qarzlar orqali moliyalashtirilmagan aktivlar; shuningdek, iqtisodiyotda tabiat tomonidan taqdim etilgan resurslar va xizmatlar majmui, masalan, o‘rmonlar, suv resurslari va mineral zahiralar.

ex: The city invested in waste-to-energy technology to manage its garbage sustainably.
Waste-to-energy plants help reduce landfill volumes while producing electricity.
waste-to-energy.meta: Qoldiqdan energiya olish — chiqindilarni yonish yoki boshqa usullar orqali foydalanishga yaroqli energiyaga aylantirish jarayoni, tizimi yoki qurilmasiga taalluqli.

ex: Thank you, a chara, for your kind support.
A chara, I hope you are doing well.
a chara.meta: A chara — murojaatda ishlatiladigan, yaqinlik va mehr ko‘rsatish maqsadida aytiladigan so‘z: “do‘stim”, “azizim”. Ko‘pincha rasmiy yoki norasmiy maktublarning boshida muloyim murojaat sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The ann is paid in addition to the regular stipend.
The executors received the ann as part of the deceased minister's estate.
ann.meta: Ann — Shotlandiya cherkovi vazirining vafotidan keyin uning vasiylariga qonuniy ravishda to‘lanadigan, yarim yillik maosh miqdoridagi pul; bu summa asosiy stipendiyadan tashqari beriladi.

ex: Fernand Braudel was a leading figure in the Annales movement, known for his work on the Mediterranean world.
The Annales school of history emphasizes long-term social structures rather than short-term political events.
annales.meta: tarixni harbiy-siyosiy voqealardan ko‘ra, ijtimoiy, iqtisodiy va madaniy jarayonlar orqali tahlil qiluvchi fransuz tarixshunoslik maktabi. Bu maktab tarixiy tafakkurda strukturaviy va uzoq muddatli jarayonlarni o‘rganishga katta e’tibor qaratadi.

ex: These fossils represent an annectant form between reptiles and birds.
The species is considered annectant, linking two otherwise separate genera.
annectant.meta: Annectant — bu atama biror narsani boshqasi bilan bog‘lovchi yoki ularning o‘rtasida o‘tish bosqichini ifodalovchi sifat so‘zdir.

ex: The experiment demonstrated successful annelation of a six-membered ring onto the base structure.
In organic chemistry, annelation is used to synthesize complex ring systems in drug molecules.
annelation.meta: Annelatsiya — bu kimyoviy reaksiya yoki jarayon bo‘lib, u mavjud molekulaga (odatda siklik) atomlar biriktirilishi natijasida bitta yoki bir nechta molekulyar halqalar (ringlar) hosil bo‘lishi bilan kechadi.

ex: The researchers observed increased expression of annexin proteins in inflamed tissues.
Annexin A5 is often used as a marker in apoptosis studies due to its binding to phosphatidylserine.
annexin.meta: Annexin — bu eukariot organizmlarda uchraydigan oqsillar oilasiga mansub molekulalar boʻlib, ular kalsiy ionlari ishtirokida hujayra membranasidagi fosfolipidlar bilan bog‘lanish xususiyatiga ega.

ex: Please refer to annexture A for technical specifications.
The contract includes an annexture detailing the payment terms.
annexture.meta: Annexture — bu asosiy hujjatga qo‘shilgan yoki uning ajralmas qismi bo‘lgan qo‘shimcha materialdir. Odatda bu yozma hujjatga ilova qilingan suplemеnt, ilova, yoki qo‘shimcha qismlarni anglatadi.

ex: Happy anni, my love — can’t believe it’s been a year already.
We’re celebrating our 5th anni this weekend!
anni.meta: Anni — bu qandaydir muhim voqea yoki sananing (to‘y, tashkil topish, uchrashuv, yutuq va hokazo) har yili takrorlanadigan kuni, ya’ni yillik sanasi yoki yubileyini bildiradi. Bu atama odatda shaxsiy yoki norasmiy kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: We didn’t buy the tickets — someone gave us a couple of Annie Oakleys.
He scored an Annie Oakley to the championship game through a friend who works at the stadium.
annie oakley.meta: Annie Oakley — bu pul to‘lamasdan tadbirga kirish huquqini beruvchi chipta yoki ruxsatnoma, odatda mehmonlar, tanishlar, matbuot vakillari yoki homiylar uchun ajratiladi. Bu atama asosan teatr, konsert yoki sport tadbirlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: His words had an annihilatory effect on her confidence.
The army launched an annihilatory strike that left nothing standing.
annihilatory.meta: Annihilatory — bu to‘liq vayron qiluvchi, butkul yo‘qotuvchi yoki ezib tashlovchi kuch yoki harakatni bildiruvchi sifat so‘z. U jismoniy, harbiy, ruhiy yoki ramziy yo‘q qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: You were there yesterday, annit?
It's been a long day, annit?
annit.meta: asosan ingliz tilining sheva yoki norasmiy shakllarida ishlatiladigan tag question bo‘lib, ingliz tilidagi "isn’t it?", "hasn’t it?", "doesn’t it?", "aren’t you?", "wasn’t I?" kabi savollarni umumlashtirgan, qisqartirilgan shaklidir.

ex: The geologist identified the dark prism as annite, a member of the biotite group.
Annite is commonly found in granite pegmatites and metamorphic rocks.
annite.meta: Annit — bu biotit guruhiga mansub, kamyob bo‘lgan mineral bo‘lib, odatda qora yoki to‘q jigarrang prizmalar ko‘rinishida uchraydi.

ex: In medieval monasteries, the anniversarian played a key role in liturgical life.
The anniversarian arranged the annual mass in memory of the abbey's founders.
anniversarian.meta: Anniversarian — bu diniy muassasada xizmat qiluvchi shaxs bo‘lib, u asoschilar, homiylar yoki boshqa muhim shaxslarning yillik xotira marosimlarini tashkil qilish va nazorat qilish uchun mas’uldir.

ex: She uses an anti-ageing cream that contains retinol and hyaluronic acid.
The clinic offers anti-ageing treatments like laser therapy and collagen injections.
anti-ageing.meta: Anti-ageing — bu qarish jarayonini sekinlashtirish yoki uning ta’sirini kamaytirish uchun mo‘ljallangan mahsulot, usul yoki texnikani ifodalovchi sifatdir.

ex: We installed an anti-backlash nut to reduce play in the lead screw.
The anti-backlash gear ensures smooth and precise motion in the robotic arm.
anti-backlash.meta: Anti-backlash — bu mexanizmlarda (ayniqsa tishli g‘ildiraklar, vintlardek uzatmalar, aktuatorlar kabi harakat uzatuvchi elementlarda) bo‘sh aylanish, oraliq bo‘shliq yoki zarbani kamaytirish yoki yo‘qotish uchun ishlab chiqilgan qurilma yoki tizimdir.

ex: The spice blend includes an anti-caking additive to prevent clumping.
Table salt usually contains an anti-caking agent to keep it free-flowing.
anti-caking.meta: Anti-caking — bu kukunsimon yoki donador moddalar (masalan, tuz, qahva, ziravorlar, o‘g‘itlar) qotib qolmasligi, yopishib qolmasligi yoki bir-biriga yelimlanib qattiqlashib ketmasligi uchun qo‘shiladigan maxsus qo‘shimcha yoki moddani tavsiflovchi sifat.

ex: Investing in infrastructure projects during downturns is an example of an anti-cyclical policy.
The government introduced anti-cyclical spending to stimulate the economy during the recession.
anti-cyclical.meta: Anti-cyclical — bu umumiy iqtisodiy siklga qarshi yo‘nalgan harakat, siyosat yoki hodisani bildiruvchi sifatdir

ex: I’ve been using an anti-dandruff treatment to help with my itchy scalp.
This shampoo is labeled as anti-dandruff and contains zinc pyrithione.
anti-dandruff.meta: Anti-dandruff — bu qasalloq (ya'ni bosh terisidagi oqish to‘kilmalarning) hosil bo‘lishining oldini oluvchi yoki uni kamaytiruvchi vosita yoki xususiyatni bildiradi.

ex: The country has faced international pressure to repeal its anti-gay laws.
The politician was criticized for making anti-gay remarks during the interview.
anti-gay.meta: Anti-gay — bu geylarga (ayniqsa erkak geylarga) yoki umuman homoseksual shaxslarga nisbatan qarama-qarshi, salbiy yoki dushmanona munosabatni bildiruvchi sifatdir.

ex: An anti-gun rally was held outside the capitol building.
The senator supports anti-gun legislation aimed at reducing mass shootings.
anti-gun.meta: Anti-gun — bu fuqarolar tomonidan qurol egaligi yoki ishlatilishiga qarshi bo‘lgan, ayniqsa qurol nazorati qonunlarini (ya’ni qurollarni cheklash yoki tartibga solish) qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi siyosiy yoki ijtimoiy pozitsiyani ifodalovchi sifatdir.

ex: Software companies have invested heavily in anti-piracy technologies.
The navy launched an anti-piracy operation near the Somali coast.
anti-piracy.meta: Anti-piracy — bu qaroqchilikning oldini olishga yoki unga qarshi kurashishga qaratilgan choralar, faoliyatlar yoki tashkilotlarni tavsiflovchi sifatdir.

ex: his writings reflect a deep antipolitics stance against the ruling elite.
the movement embraced antipolitics, rejecting all mainstream political parties.
antipolitics.meta: antisiyosat — bu ramsiy siyosiy tuzum, an’anaviy siyosatchilar yoki hukmron siyosiy tizimlarga qarshi bo‘lgan fikr, harakat yoki yondashuv.

ex: he gave an anti-regulation speech criticizing environmental controls
the party’s platform is strongly anti-regulation, favoring free markets and limited government.
anti-regulation.meta: anti-regulation — bu qonun-qoidalar, hukumat tomonidan joriy etilgan nazorat va regulyatsiya tizimlariga qarshi yo‘nalgan pozitsiyani bildiruvchi sifatdir.

ex: members of the anti-saloon league campaigned against bars and alcohol sellers.
the anti-saloon movement played a major role in the push for prohibition in the u.s.
anti-saloon.meta: bu atama ayniqsa amerika tarixidagi "anti-saloon league" (ichkilikxonalarga qarshi liga) faoliyati bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, ular sotsial va diniy asosda alkogolni taqiqlash uchun kurashgan.

ex: under anti-shipping rules, wine cannot be delivered across state lines.
the state implemented an anti-shipping law to restrict alcohol imports.
anti-shipping.meta: anti-shipping — bu ma’lum hududga tovarlar, ayniqsa spirtli ichimliklarni jo‘natishni taqiqlovchi yoki cheklovchi qonun, siyosat yoki tartibni bildiruvchi sifatdir.

ex: the software includes advanced anti-spam and antivirus protection.
our email system uses an anti-spam filter to keep your inbox clean.
anti-spam.meta: anti-spam — bu elektron pochta yoki xabarlar tizimida spam (ya’ni keraksiz yoki reklamaga asoslangan avtomatik xabarlar)ni aniqlovchi, yashiruvchi yoki bloklovchi dasturiy ta’minot yoki texnologiyani ifodalovchi sifatdir.

ex: the app includes anti-stalking features such as location-sharing controls.
the country recently passed anti-stalking legislation to protect victims.
anti-stalking.meta: anti-stalking — bu boshqa shaxsni takroriy, bezovta qiluvchi yoki tahdidli tarzda ta’qib qilishga qarshi kurashuvchi chora-tadbirlar, qonunlar yoki siyosatlar bilan bog‘liq sifatdir.

ex: anti-surface warfare plays a key role in naval defense strategy.
the navy tested a new anti-surface missile system.
anti-surface.meta: anti-surface — bu harbiy harakatlar, texnika yoki uskunalarning suv ustida harakatlanadigan kemalarga (masalan, harbiy fregatlar, kreyserlar) qarshi mo‘ljallanganligini bildiruvchi sifatdir.

ex: she bought an anti-sweat top designed for intense workouts.
the trainer covered the horse with an anti-sweat sheet after the race.
anti-sweat.meta: anti-sweat — bu ter ajralishini kamaytirishga yoki terlashning salbiy ta’siriga qarshi mo‘ljallangan mahsulot yoki materialni tavsiflovchi sifatdir.

ex: some parents hold anti-vaccine beliefs despite scientific evidence.
the anti-vaccine movement has gained traction on social media.
anti-vaccine.meta: anti-vaccine — bu emlash jarayoniga yoki vaksinadan foydalanishga qarshi bo‘lgan fikr, harakat yoki pozitsiyani ifodalovchi sifatdir.

ex: this serum has strong anti-wrinkle properties.
she uses an anti-wrinkle cream every night before bed.
anti-wrinkle.meta: bu ajinlar (teridagi bukilishlar yoki qarish belgilarining) paydo bo‘lishini kamaytirish yoki oldini olishga mo‘ljallangan mahsulot yoki vositani ifodalovchi sifatdir. bu atama odatda krem, loson, yoki teri parvarishi vositalari uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: as the banatee of the house, she oversaw all domestic affairs.
the banatee welcomed us warmly and showed us to our rooms.
banatee.meta: banatee — bu oilada boshqaruv rolini o‘z zimmasiga olgan ayol, ya’ni uy-ro‘zg‘orni yurituvchi, mehmon kutuvchi, yoki ijaraga uy beruvchi ayol degan ma’noni bildiruvchi eski yoki kam ishlatiladigan so‘zdir.

ex: don’t fall for her béal bocht—she just wants attention.
he’s always putting on the béal bocht when it’s time to pay the bill.
béal bocht.meta: béal bocht — bu moddiy yetishmovchilik yoki boshiga tushgan kulfatdan shikoyat qilish, ayniqsa achinish yoki yordam kutib aytilgan shikoyatni bildiruvchi atama.

ex: the bioink must maintain cell viability throughout the printing process.
scientists used bioink to print a functioning piece of human liver tissue.
bioink.meta: bioink — bu bioprinting (biologik 3D bosib chiqarish) jarayonida ishlatiladigan moddalar bo‘lib, ular tirik hujayralar va ularni himoya qiluvchi muhitdan iborat bo‘ladi. bu siyoh tirik to‘qimalar, hatto a'zolarni yaratish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: as an eight bisquer, he is still learning the basics of croquet.
she's considered a high bisquer and gets several extra turns.
bisquer.meta: bisquer — bu kroket o‘yinida qatnashuvchi o‘yinchi bo‘lib, unga ma’lum miqdorda qo‘shimcha yurish (bisque) beriladi, bu uning o‘yin darajasini (masalan, yangi boshlovchi yoki kamroq tajribali) ko‘rsatadi.

ex: he spoke english with a strong french blas.
you could hear the blas of the north in her voice.
blas.meta: bu biror tilning o‘ziga xos talaffuzi yoki aytilish uslubi, ko‘pincha ma’lum bir hudud, ijtimoiy guruh yoki millatga xos bo‘lgan aksent ma’nosida ishlatiladi. So‘z qadimgi yoki noaniq ishlatiladigan shakl bo‘lib, zamonaviy tilshunoslikda kam uchraydi.

ex: my old uncle’s gone bockety and can barely walk.
he’s a bit bockety in the knees after that fall.
bockety.meta: bockety — bu so‘z odatda yurishda qiynaladigan, oqsoqlangan yoki zaiflashgan odamga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, jarohatlangan tana a’zosi, yoki yaxshi ishlamayotgan, notekis harakat qiladigan mexanik qurilma yoki obyektni ham tasvirlashi mumkin.

ex: that software update was a real bodge-up—nothing works now.
the plumber made a complete bodge-up of the kitchen sink.
bodge-up.meta: bodge-up — bu shoshilinch, chala yoki be'maza tarzda bajarilgan ish yoki loyiha bo‘lib, odatda mahoratsiz ustalik, ko‘r-ko‘rona tuzatish, yoki to‘g‘ri rejalanmagan harakat natijasini bildiradi.

ex: he bought a bodgie phone charger and it caught fire.
that’s a bodgie repair job—it won’t last a week.
bodgie.meta: bodgie — bu sifatsiz, ishonchsiz, buzilishga moyil yoki be'maza ishlangan narsa yoki ta’mirni tasvirlaydigan norasmiy atama. U mahoratsiz bajarilgan ish, past darajadagi mahsulot, yoki noturar tuzatma uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: this is just a bodgied-up version of the original software.
the repairs were totally bodgied and didn’t last a day.
bodgied.meta: bodgied — bu biror ish yoki buyumning qoniqarsiz, mahoratsiz yoki vaqtinchalik usulda bajarilganini bildiruvchi norasmiy sifatdosh. Bu so‘z tuzatishlar, qo‘lda yasash, yoki arzon yechimlar haqida salbiy fikr bildirishda ishlatiladi.

ex: the kitchen renovation was handled by some bodging contractor.
a bodging plumber left the bathroom pipes leaking.
bodging.meta: bodging — bu so‘z mahoratsiz, qo‘pol yoki vaqtincha usulda bajarilgan ish yoki ta’mirni bildiradi. Ko‘pincha bu sifat yomon ishlaydigan ustalar yoki hunarmandlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: the teacher gave him a bualadh bos for his thoughtful answer.
she received a warm bualadh bos after her performance.
bualadh bos.meta: bu so‘z asosan olqishlash, ya’ni qo‘l chapaklari bilan quvvatlash yoki maqtashni bildiradi. Bu biror kishining harakatlari yoki nutqiga nisbatan beriladigan qarsaklar, ba’zan maqtov ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi. So‘z irland tilidan kirib kelgan.

ex: she is a professional canoer who has competed internationally.
the canoer paddled gently down the river at sunset.
canoer.meta: canoer — bu kanoeda eshkak eshib harakatlanadigan kishi, ayniqsa kanoe sporti bilan shug‘ullanuvchi yoki dam olish uchun kanoeda suzuvchi odamga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: the sound of the carnyx was loud and eerie, perfect for psychological warfare.
archaeologists discovered a well-preserved carnyx in a Celtic burial site.
carnyx.meta: carnyx — bu temir davrida keltlar tomonidan ishlatilgan bronzadan yasalgan uzun, vertikal karnay yoki truba bo‘lib, jang paytida foydalanilgan.

ex: archaeological finds suggest the Celtiberi had a unique blend of Celtic and Iberian traditions.
the Celtiberi fiercely resisted Roman conquest in the second century BCE.
celtiberi.meta: Celtiberi — bu miloddan avvalgi davrlarda Iberiya yarim orolining shimoliy-markaziy hududlarida yashagan qadimiy xalqlar bo‘lib, ular kelt va iberlarning aralash qabilalaridan tashkil topgan.

ex: archaeological evidence shows signs of Celticization in northern Spain.
the Celticization of Britain occurred gradually through migration and trade.
celticization.meta: hudud yoki madaniyatning kelt tilini, urf-odatlarini, qadriyatlarini yoki madaniy belgilarini o‘zlashtirish jarayoni. Bu jarayon keltlarning boshqa xalqlarga ko‘rsatgan madaniy ta’siri yoki ularning assimilyatsiya siyosati natijasida sodir bo‘lgan.

ex: he was a native Iberian who lived among the Celticized tribes.
the region became fully Celticized by the first century BCE.
celticized.meta: bu so‘z biror narsa (xalq, hudud, til, madaniyat) keltlarning ta’siri ostida o‘zgarib, ularning tili, madaniyati, urf-odatlari yoki san’atiga moslashganini bildiradi. Ya’ni u kelt madaniyatini qabul qilgan yoki o‘zlashtirgan degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: scholars debate the Celticness of certain ancient artifacts.
the Celticness of the music is evident in its rhythms and melodies.
celticness.meta: bu so‘z keltlik holati yoki sifati, ya’ni biror narsa yoki shaxsning kelt tiliga, madaniyatiga, urf-odatlariga yoki o‘ziga xos xususiyatlariga ega bo‘lishini bildiradi. Bu atama kelt madaniyatining o‘ziga xosliklarini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: they tried to celtify the festival by adding traditional music and dance.
the museum project aims to celtify the local history through exhibitions and events.
celtify.meta: celtify — bu fe’l biror narsani yoki kishini kelt madaniyatiga, tiliga, urf-odatlariga moslashtirish, unga keltlik xususiyatlarini berish degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: traditional ceol sessions are popular in Irish villages.
the pub was full of ceol and craic last night.
ceol.meta: Ceol — bu so‘z asosan musiqa, xususan irland an’anaviy musiqasi ma’nosini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha craic (ya’ni, ko'ngilochar, zavqli vaqt) so‘zi bilan birga ishlatiladi va Irland madaniyatida keng tarqalgan.

ex: the lads were joking with the chapess at the party.
she’s a friendly chapess who helps everyone in the neighborhood.
chapess.meta: Chapess — bu so‘z erkak yoki o‘g‘il bolani anglatuvchi chap so‘zining ayol shakli bo‘lib, qiz yoki ayol ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha norasmiy yoki suhbati erkin til uslubida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: she is naturally ciotóg and writes with her left hand.
he injured his ciotóg while playing football.
ciotóg.meta: Ciotóg — bu so‘z birinchi navbatda chap qo‘lni bildiradi. Shuningdek, chapqo‘l odam degan ma’noga ham ega. Bundan tashqari, ba’zan begona, noqulay yoki no‘noq odam ma’nosida ramziy ishlatiladi.

ex: the teacher raised her hand to bring ciunas to the noisy classroom.
there was complete ciunas in the room after the announcement.
ciunas.meta: Ciunas — bu so‘z asosan sukunat, sokinlik yoki jimjitlik ma’nosini bildiradi, ayniqsa, odamlar ijtimoiy muhitda gapirish yoki shovqindan tiyilgan payt. Shuningdek, undov sifatida jimjitlikka chaqirish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: critics argue that colonialization led to the exploitation of native peoples and resources.
the colonialization of Africa by European powers drastically changed the continent’s political landscape.
colonialization.meta: Koloniyalashuv — bu so‘z boshqa bir davlat yoki hududni mustamlaka sifatida egallash, boshqarish siyosati yoki amaliyotini anglatadi (asosan tarixiy).

ex: many colonialized peoples struggled for independence.
the colonialized goods were shipped back to Europe.
colonialized.meta: Koloniyalashgan — sifat sifatida bu so‘z asosan tarixiy kontekstda, biror tovar yoki mulkning mustamlaka yoki mustamlakachilik davlatiga tegishli yoki unga aylanganligini bildiradi (hozirda kam ishlatiladi).

ex: many countries suffered under colonializing regimes.
the colonializing powers expanded their territories aggressively.
colonializing.meta: Koloniyalashuvchi — bu sifat so‘z boshqa davlatlarni mustamlaka sifatida egallash va ularning aholisi ustidan siyosiy nazorat o‘rnatish amaliyotiga xos bo‘lgan yoki shu jarayon bilan bog‘liq narsalarni bildiradi.

ex: many neighborhoods feature houses built in the colonial revival style.
the colonial revival movement influenced architecture and interior design in the early 20th century.
colonial revival.meta: Kolonial tiklanish — bu atama Yevropa (ayniqsa Britaniya) mustamlakalari tomonidan AQSh tashkil topishidan oldin kiritilgan yoki rivojlantirilgan madaniyatga qiziqish va e’tiborning qayta jonlanishini bildiradi.

ex: the health campaign encourages people to always condomize during intercourse.
it is important to condomize to prevent sexually transmitted infections.
condomize.meta: Condomize — jinsiy aloqada homiladorlikdan saqlanish yoki infektsiyalardan himoyalanish maqsadida kondom taqish yoki foydalanish jarayonini bildiradi.

ex: the driver took a cowboyish risk by speeding through the red light.
his cowboyish attitude got him into trouble with the law.
cowboyish.meta: Kavboyish — bu so‘z kavboyga o‘xshash yoki uning xarakteriga ega narsalarni ifodalaydi. Ko‘pincha jasoratli, mustaqil, lekin so‘nggi paytlarda beparvo, ehtiyotsiz yoki qoidalarni buzishga moyil odamlarni tavsiflash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: the movie celebrates the cowboyism of the old west.
his cowboyism often got him into trouble.
cowboyism.meta: Kavboylik — bu so‘z kavboy bo‘lish holatini, ayniqsa, beparvolik yoki odatiy bo‘lmagan xulq-atvorni bildiradi. Shuningdek, kavboylarga xos madaniyat yoki uslubni anglatadi.

ex: the artisan demonstrated how to weave a colourful crios.
he wore a traditional crios around his waist.
crios.meta: Krios — bu so‘z asosan Aran orollarida erkaklar tomonidan taqilgan, qo‘l bilan to‘qilgan ko‘p rangli jun kamar yoki belbog‘ni anglatadi. Shuningdek, ushbu narsaga oid sifatlarda (modifikator sifatida) ham ishlatiladi.

ex: engineers must calculate the critical load to ensure building safety.
the bridge was designed to withstand a critical load of 10,000 tons.
critical load.meta: Kritik yuk — muhandislikda bu atama strukturaga tushirilgan eng katta yukni bildiradi, u strukturani egilishga yoki buzilishiga olib kelmaydi.

ex: karl popper is a major proponent of critical rationalism.
critical rationalism argues that scientific theories must be falsifiable.
critical rationalism.meta: Tanqidiy ratsionalizm — bu nazariya bo‘lib, unda bir gipoteza ilmiy yoki empirik deb hisoblanishi uchun uni inkor etish mumkin bo‘lishi, ya’ni qo‘shimcha dalillar bilan rad etilishi mumkinligi talab qilinadi.

ex: many critical theorists study the impact of media on culture.
the critical theorist analyzed the novel’s themes and symbols.
critical theorist.meta: Tanqidiy nazariyachi — adabiy va boshqa matnlarni tanqidiy tahlil qilish, baholash va chuqur tushunishga bag‘ishlangan shaxs.

ex: traditional garments often have a cross border design woven into the fabric.
the fabric features a cross border pattern along its edges.
cross border.meta: To‘qilgan chegarali naqsh — matoda gorizontal va vertikal yo‘nalishlarda to‘qilgan (yoki ba’zida bosma tarzda yaratilgan) to‘rtburchak yoki kvadrat shaklidagi chegara naqshi.

ex: cross checking is considered a foul in lacrosse.
the player was penalized for cross checking during the hockey game.
cross checking.meta: Krosscheking — xokkey va lakross sportlarida raqibni to‘xtatish yoki to‘siq qilish uchun tayoqni ikkala qo‘l bilan gorizontal holatda ushlab, raqibga qarshi surish harakati.

ex: it’s common to start with the cúpla focal before switching to English.
she began her speech with a cúpla focal in Irish.
cúpla focal.meta: Kuplа fokal — irland tilidagi bir necha so‘z; ayniqsa, ingliz tilida bo‘lgan nutq yoki matnni boshlash uchun ishlatiladigan belgili irlandcha ibora.

ex: decolonial studies focus on reversing colonial legacies.
the country underwent a decolonial process after independence.
decolonial.meta: Dekolonial — mustamlaka hukmronligi tugagandan keyingi davrga oid yoki shunga taalluqli. Shuningdek, mustamlaka ta’sirlarini madaniy, siyosiy va ijtimoiy jihatdan yo‘q qilishga qaratilgan harakatlar bilan bog‘liq.

ex: decolonialization led to the birth of new independent nations.
many countries experienced decolonialization after World War II.
decolonialization.meta: Dekolonializatsiya — ilgari mustamlaka hukmronligi ostida bo‘lgan mamlakatning siyosiy yoki iqtisodiy mustaqillikka erishishi; mustamlaka kuchining o‘z hududidan chiqib ketishi.

ex: activists work to decolonialize cultural institutions.
the government aims to decolonialize the education system.
decolonialize.meta: Dekolonizatsiya qilish — biror narsaning mustamlaka xarakteri, shakli yoki uslubidan xalos qilish; ayniqsa, muassasa yoki faoliyat sohasini mustamlaka ta’siridan ozod qilish.

ex: the shop sells antique delph and ceramics.
she set the table with fine delph for the dinner party.
delph.meta: Del'f — tuproq yoki chinni materialidan tayyorlangan likopchalar, idishlar va boshqalar; chinni idishlar to‘plami.

ex: demisexual people may not feel immediate sexual desire.
she identifies as demisexual, feeling attraction only after emotional connection.
demisexual.meta: Demiseksual — jinsiy xususiyatlari yoki faoliyati noaniq yoki aniq chegarasi bo‘lmagan holat. Asosan, kuchli hissiy aloqadan keyingina jinsiy jozibani his qiladigan shaxsni ifodalaydi.

ex: his theory seemed dinosauric compared to modern science.
the museum displays dinosauric fossils.
dinosauric.meta: Dinozavrlik — dinozavrga oid yoki dinozavrga o‘xshash; dinozavrlar bilan bog‘liq. Shuningdek, juda eski yoki zamonaviylikdan yiroq narsani ta’riflashda ishlatiladi.

ex: distance-based learning allows students to study remotely.
the company uses a distance-based pricing model.
distance-based.meta: Masofaga asoslangan — ikki joy yoki narsalar orasidagi masofa miqdoriga bog‘liq yoki shunga qarab amalga oshiriladigan.Shuningdek, masofani o‘lchash yoki hisobga olishga tayangan usullar yoki tizimlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: a plastic distancer was placed between the glass panes.
the workers used metal distancers to keep the bricks aligned.
distancer.meta: Distanser — ikki narsaning orasida joylashtiriladigan va ularni bir-biriga tegmasligini yoki orasidagi masofani saqlashga xizmat qiluvchi vosita yoki blok. Shuningdek, masofani saqlovchi yoki o‘lchovchi shaxs yoki qurilma ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: he acted like a complete div at the party.
don’t be such a div, think before you act.
div.meta: Div — ahmoq yoki ahmoqona harakat qiluvchi odam; juda aqldan ozgan kishi.

ex: some patients doctor shop to get multiple prescriptions.
he started to doctor shop after his symptoms didn’t improve.
doctor shop.meta: Doktorlar orasida aylanmoq — kerakli tibbiy fikr yoki davolashni olish uchun yoki ko‘p retseptlar yoki davolash usullarini qo‘lga kiritish maqsadida bir nechta shifokorlarni ketma-ket ko‘rishga urinmoq.

ex: doctors warned the doctor shopper about risks of drug misuse.
the doctor shopper was trying to get multiple prescriptions.
doctor shopper.meta: Doktorlar orasida yuruvchi — kerakli tibbiy fikr yoki davolashni olish uchun yoki ko‘p retseptlar yoki davolash usullarini qo‘lga kiritish maqsadida bir nechta shifokorlarni ketma-ket ko‘ruvchi shaxs.

ex: the patient was accused of doctor shopping for painkillers.
doctor shopping can lead to misuse of medications.
doctor shopping.meta: Doktorlar orasida yurish — kerakli tibbiy fikr yoki davolashni olish uchun yoki ko‘p retseptlar yoki davolash usullarini qo‘lga kiritish maqsadida bir nechta shifokorlarni ketma-ket ko‘rish amaliyoti yoki odati.

ex: the drawal of funds from the account must be authorized.
the drawal of water from the river started early in the morning.
drawal.meta: Tortib olish — harakat sifatida tortmoq fe’lining turli ma’nolaridagi harakat; ayniqsa nimanidir sudrab olish, olish yoki chiqarib olish jarayoni yoki holati. Shuningdek, bunday holatning bir misoli.

ex: a draw borer helps in precise fitting of wooden pegs.
the carpenter used a draw borer to align the joint holes.
draw borer.meta: Tortib burg‘ulovchi asbob — toraygan metall shaftadan tashkil topgan asbob bo‘lib, yog‘och bo‘g‘in qismlarini birlashtirish va teshiklarni moslashtirish uchun ishlatiladi, yog‘och tirgak joylashtirilishidan oldin qo‘llaniladi.

ex: the carpenter applied draw boring to ensure a tight joint.
draw boring is a traditional technique used in timber framing.
draw boring.meta: Tortib burg‘ulash — yog‘och bo‘g‘inlarini, ayniqsa, mortise va tenon (teshik va tirkama) bo‘g‘inlarini birlashtirish usuli yoki texnikasi bo‘lib, bo‘g‘in orqali teshik burg‘ulab, yog‘och tirgakni joylashtirish orqali qismlarni mahkam bog‘lashni anglatadi.

ex: players checked the draw sheet to know their opponents.
the draw sheet showed the matches for the quarterfinals.
draw sheet.meta: Turnir jadvali — charchoqlar yoki tanlov natijalarini ko‘rsatadigan varaq; ayniqsa, musobaqa yoki turnirda o‘yinlar tartibini va juftliklarini ko‘rsatadigan ro‘yxat.

ex: the children got a drooking while playing outside.
after the sudden rain, they were completely drooking.
drooking.meta: Namlanish — juda ko‘p suv bilan to‘liq nam bo‘lish yoki ho‘l holatga kirish.

ex: the epidemiologic data showed an increase in infections.
epidemiologic studies help track the spread of diseases.
epidemiologic.meta: Epidemiologik — epidemik kasalliklar yoki (keyinchalik) aholi orasida yuzaga keladigan boshqa sog‘liq bilan bog‘liq holatlarni o‘rganishga doir.

ex: the face-lifted actor appeared more youthful on the red carpet.
she looked very different after being face-lifted.
face-lifted.meta: Yuziga jarrohlik qilinib yoshartirilgan — yuz terisi asosan jarrohlik yo‘li bilan tortilib, keraksiz ajinlar olib tashlangan va yanada yoshroq ko‘rinish yaratilgan shaxs.

ex: in irish, a fada changes the vowel sound to a longer one.
the word “sí” contains a fada on the letter “í”.
fada.meta: Fada — irland tilida unli harf ustiga qo‘yiladigan va uning tovushini uzun unli qilib talaffuz qilishni ko‘rsatadigan belgidir. U ko‘rinishi bilan akut aksenti (´) ga o‘xshaydi.

ex: many irish speakers proudly display their fáinne.
she wore a fáinne to show she speaks irish.
fáinne.meta: Fáinne — irland tilida gaplasha olishini va bu tilda muloqot qilishga tayyorligini ko‘rsatish uchun taqiladigan uzuk shaklidagi broshka yoki igna. Bu belgini kiygan odam irland tilida gaplashishni xohlaydi degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: fasting during Ramadan is considered a fard act.
praying five times a day is a fard in Islam.
fard.meta: Ford — Qur’on, Hadislar yoki ikkala manbaga asoslangan, bajarilishi shart bo‘lgan diniy vazifa yoki amaliyot. Islom dinida bajarilishi majburiy bo‘lgan ibodat yoki harakatlar.

ex: as the first gentleman of the state, he often attends official functions with his wife.
he is considered the first gentleman of the industry due to his achievements.
first gentleman.meta: Birinchi janob — biror faoliyat yoki kasbda yetakchi, eng muhim yoki taniqli erkak shaxs. Bundan tashqari, ayol davlat rahbari yoki bosh vazirning eri sifatida ham atashadi.

ex: her flaithulach nature made her popular but also sometimes criticized.
he was very flaithulach at the party, buying drinks for everyone.
flaithulach.meta: Flaithulach — odamlar uchun saxiy, sarxush yoki ko‘p pul sarflashga tayyor bo‘lgan shaxsni bildiradi. Ba’zida bu so‘z ortiqcha sarf-xarajat qiluvchi yoki behad sarf qiluvchi odam haqida kinoyali tarzda ishlatiladi.

ex: she got fluthered at the party last night.
after several drinks, he was completely fluthered.
fluthered.meta: Fluthered — spirtli ichimlik ta’sirida mast bo‘lgan, ichkilikka berilgan holat.

ex: many vessels register under a foreign flag for tax benefits.
the ship was sailing under a foreign flag to avoid certain regulations.
foreign flag.meta: Xorijiy bayroq — boshqa bir davlatga mansub bayroq, asosan kema yoki boshqa suv transport vositasida ko‘tariladi. Hozirgi paytda kema yoki suzuvchi transport vositasining ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazilgan xorijiy davlat bayrog‘i sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: cultural foreignization can sometimes lead to loss of native traditions.
the foreignization of the local economy made it dependent on outside powers.
foreignization.meta: Xorijiylashtirish — biror narsaning, jamiyatning yoki hududning boshqa davlat, madaniyat yoki tashkilot ta’siri ostida qolishi yoki shunday holga kelishi.

ex: many traditions are now foreignized due to globalization.
the language had become heavily foreignized through centuries of contact with other cultures.
foreignized.meta: Xorijiylashtirilgan — boshqa mamlakat yoki madaniyat ta’siri ostida qolgan yoki shunday tarzda o‘zgartirilgan. Shuningdek, xorijiy ta’sir sababli begona yoki notanish ko‘rinadigan narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: foreignizing elements in the text make it feel exotic to readers.
the translator used a foreignizing approach to retain cultural nuances.
foreignizing.meta: Xorijiylashtiruvchi — boshqa mamlakat yoki madaniyat ta’sirini ko‘rsatadigan yoki shunday ta’sir o‘tkazishga intiladigan, biror narsani xorijiy xarakterga aylantiruvchi. Tarjimada esa asl madaniy unsurlarni saqlab qolish uslubini bildiradi.

ex: many volunteers joined the French Foreign Legion as foreign legionnaires.
the foreign legionnaire served bravely in overseas conflicts.
foreign legionnaire.meta: Xorijiy legioner — boshqa davlatlarning legionida xizmat qiluvchi shaxs, ko‘pincha Fransiya xorijiy legioni a’zosi sifatida tanilgan. Bu harbiy xizmatga qarashli maxsus bo‘linma a’zosi.

ex: many cities still have buildings featuring French colonial architecture.
the house was built in a classic French colonial style with wide porches.
french colonial.meta: sobiq fransuz koloniyalarida keng tarqalgan arxitektura uslubi, odatda yog‘ochdan yasalgan ramka va uzoq verandasi bilan ajralib turadi. Bundan tashqari, bu atama fransuz kolonial davri yoki madaniy ta’sir bilan bog‘liq narsalarni ifodalaydi.

ex: the school offers courses in Gaeilge.
she speaks Gaeilge fluently.
gaeilge.meta: Gaeilge — Irland xalqining rasmiy tili bo‘lib, irland gvelik tiliga kiradi. Bundan tashqari, bu atama irland tili yoki madaniyatiga oid bo‘lgan narsalarni bildiradi.

ex: many gaeilgeoirs participate in cultural festivals.
he is a fluent gaeilgeoir who teaches the language to others.
gaeilgeoir.meta: Gaeilgeoir — irland tilida bemalol gapira oladigan shaxs yoki irland tiliga alohida qiziqish bildiradigan, uni chuqur biladigan mutaxassis.

ex: victims of a gaslighter often feel confused and anxious.
the gaslighter made her doubt her own memory.
gaslighter.meta: Gaslighter — odamlarga aldov va psixologik bosim o‘tkazib, ularni o‘z haqiqatlarini, xotiralarini yoki onglarini shubha ostiga qo‘yishga majbur qiladigan kishi, ko‘pincha yaqin munosabatlardagi sherik.

ex: geologists support geoconservation to preserve natural heritage.
Geoconservation efforts protect unique rock formations.
geoconservation.meta: Geokonservatsiya — yer yuzasining geologik shakllari va yer tuzilishining o‘ziga xos xususiyatlarini, jumladan tog‘lar, jinslar, toshlar va yer yuzasi landshaftlarini himoya qilish va saqlash jarayoni.

ex: the park showcases a rich geodiversity of landscapes.
Geodiversity is important for maintaining ecosystem health.
geodiversity.meta: Geodiversity — yer yuzasining va unda yashovchi tirik organizmlarning geografik xilma-xilligi, shuningdek, bir hududdagi geologik va tabiiy sharoitlarning turli-tumanligi.

ex: gur cake is often enjoyed with a cup of tea.
i tried making gur cake following a traditional irish recipe.
gur cake.meta: Gur cake — irland oshxonasiga xos, ikki yupqa xamir qatlami orasida maydalangan go‘sht yoki quritilgan mevalar bilan to‘ldirilgan an’anaviy tort. Odatda patnisda pishiriladi va kesilgan bo‘laklarda xizmat qilinadi.

ex: his decision was based on a gut-level reaction rather than facts.
she had a gut-level feeling that something was wrong.
gut level.meta: Gut-level — insonning ichki, tabiiy va chuqur his qiladigan tuyg‘usi, ko‘pincha mantiqiy yoki aql bilan emas, balki instinkt bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan holat.

ex: many hijabis participate actively in community events.
she is a proud hijabi who advocates for women’s rights.
hijabi.meta: Hijabi — jamoat joylarida boshini yopadigan bosh kiyim yoki parda taqadigan musulmon ayol. Bundan tashqari, bunday ayolga tegishli yoki u bilan bog‘liq.

ex: the cave was a hollowed-out space in the rock.
the tree had a hollowed-out trunk where animals lived.
hollowed-out.meta: Hollowed-out — qazish, chirish yoki eroziya natijasida ichki qismi bo‘shab qolgan, ichkarisi teshilgan yoki cho‘kib ketgan holat.

ex: many churches hold a holy hour every week for meditation and reflection.
the faithful gathered for the holy hour of prayer before the Blessed Sacrament.
holy hour.meta: Holy hour — rim-katolik cherkovida Muqaddas Eucharistiya oldida o‘qiladigan yoki amalga oshiriladigan ibodat va meditatsiyadan iborat bir soatlik diniy mashg‘ulot.

ex: they were horse-trading for better terms in the contract.
he spent years horse-trading before opening his own stable.
horse-trade.meta: Horse-trade — otlarni sotib olish va sotish bilan shug‘ullanish. Bundan tashqari, kelishuv yoki muzokara jarayonida o‘zaro kelishuvga erishish uchun savdolashish, o‘zaro imtiyozlar almashinish degan ma’noni ham anglatadi.

ex: many Ismaili followers live in different parts of the world.
the Ismaili community has a rich cultural heritage.
ismaili.meta: Ismaili — shia islomining bir bo‘limi a’zosi bo‘lib, hijriy ikkinchi asrda oltinchi imom vafotidan keyin imomlik merosining boshqa yo‘nalish orqali davom etganiga ishonadigan guruh. Bundan tashqari, bu guruh yoki uning e’tiqodlari bilan bog‘liq.

ex: The jummah prayer is usually held at noon on Friday.
Muslims gather every jummah for congregational prayer.
jummah.meta: Jummah — musulmonlar uchun muqaddas sanalgan juma kuni; bu kuni ular jamoat bo‘lib ibodat qiladilar. Shu jumladan, juma namozi deb ataladigan jamoat namozi o‘tkaziladi.

ex: He was accused of kufr for rejecting the teachings.
Kufr is considered a major sin in Islam.
kufr.meta: Kufr — Allohga va Qur’on o‘gitlariga ishonmaslik, ularni rad etish yoki e’tiborsiz qoldirish holati.

ex: they were langered by midnight.
after the party, he got completely langered.
langered.meta: Langered — kuchli mastlik holati; mast bo‘lish, ichkilik tufayli ongning susayishi.

ex: they looked langers by the end of the night.
after drinking too much, he was completely langers.
langers.meta: Langers — kuchli mastlik holati; ichkilik sababli ongning susayishi, mast bo‘lish.

ex: The nanobody binds precisely to the virus antigen, making it a powerful diagnostic tool.
In physics, a nanobody may refer to a nanoscale fiber used in new material research.
nanobody.meta: (fizika) Nanoo‘lchamga ega bo‘lgan obyekt; ko‘pincha nanonaycha yoki nanoto‘r kabi moddalarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: She used a bit of plámás to convince her boss to approve the budget.
Don’t fall for his plámás — he just wants something from you.
plámás.meta: Plamas — yolg‘on yoki samimiy bo‘lmagan maqtov; odatda birovni ishontirish, ilintirish yoki foyda olish maqsadida beriladigan haddan tashqari maqtov.

ex: The plámáser complimented everyone at the meeting but had no genuine interest.
He’s a real plámáser — always praising people to get what he wants.
plámáser.meta: Plamaschi — ko‘pincha samimiy bo‘lmagan yoki haddan tashqari maqtovlar orqali boshqalarning ko‘nglini olishga, ularni ishontirishga yoki manipulyatsiya qilishga harakat qiladigan kishi.

ex: His constant plámásing annoyed everyone in the office.
Stop the plámásing — it’s not going to work on me.
plámásing.meta: Plamas qilish — yolg‘on, samimiy bo‘lmagan yoki ortiqcha maqtovlar orqali odamni ko‘ndirish, maqsadga erishishga urinish amali.

ex: The novel is an example of postcolonialism in literature, depicting the struggles of a people after colonial rule.
Postcolonialism explores how former colonies rebuild their identities after gaining independence.
postcolonialism.meta: Postmustamlakachilik — ilgari mustamlaka bo‘lgan davlat yoki jamiyatning mustaqillikka erishganidan keyingi davri, shu bilan birga, bu davrda yuzaga kelgan siyosiy, madaniy va ijtimoiy muammolarni o‘rganuvchi ilmiy yondashuv.

ex: The film reflects the struggles of a nation still grappling with its postcoloniality.
Scholars debate the relevance of postcoloniality in modern global politics.
postcoloniality.meta: Postmustamlakachilik holati — mustamlaka hukmronligi tugaganidan keyin jamiyatda yuzaga keladigan madaniy, ijtimoiy va siyosiy sharoitlar majmuasi. Bu tushuncha shuningdek, ushbu sharoitlarni o‘rganuvchi akademik yondashuvni ham anglatadi.

ex: Stop with the ráiméis and tell me what really happened.
His explanation was just a load of ráiméis.
ráiméis.meta: Ráiméis — asossiz, puch yoki haddan ortiq bo‘rttirilgan gap-so‘zlar; ko‘pincha hech qanday mazmunga ega bo‘lmagan, lekin jiddiy yoki muhimdek tuyuladigan ritorik ifodalar.

ex: He completed four rakats during the noon prayer.
The morning prayer consists of two rakats.
rakat.meta: Rakat — musulmonlarning namoz ibodatidagi har bir mustaqil takrorlanuvchi birlik. Har bir rakat sajda, ruku‘, qiyom kabi harakatlar va Qur’on oyatlari yoki duolarni ovozli yoki ichdan o‘qishdan iborat bo‘ladi.

ex: The kids caused such a ruaille buaille in the classroom.
There was a real ruaille buaille in the pub last night.
ruaille buaille.meta: Ruaille buaille — tartibsiz, baland ovozli va shovqinli holat; odamlar yoki vaziyatlar ishtirokida yuzaga keladigan notinch, g‘ala-g‘ovurli muhit. Ko‘pincha bolalar, olomon yoki mast kishilar bo‘lgan joyda uchraydi.

ex: Sean nós singing is passed down orally from generation to generation.
She sang a sean nós lament that moved everyone to tears.
sean nós.meta: Sean nós — bu Irlandiyaga xos bo‘lgan an’anaviy ashula aytish uslubi bo‘lib, odatda musiqiy asboblarsiz, yakkaxon tarzda va erkin ritmda ijro etiladi.

ex: Ah sure, segotia, it's been too long!
How are you keeping, old segotia?
segotia.meta: Ko‘pincha “old segotia” shaklida uchraydi, bu “ha, do‘stim” yoki “qadrdonim” degan ma’noni bildiradi. Irland tilidan olingan va ingliz nutqida norasmiy, do‘stona uslubda ishlatiladi.

ex: The actor walked onto the stage self-intoxicated, basking in the audience’s admiration.
He gave a long speech, clearly self-intoxicated by his own eloquence.
self-intoxicated.meta: Self-intoxicated — bu so‘z odamning o‘z shaxsiga haddan tashqari bog‘lanib qolganini, o‘zining kuchi, go‘zalligi, nutq so‘zlash qobiliyati yoki salohiyatidan "mast" bo‘lib, boshqalardan ustun his qiladigan holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: He engaged in self-sabotage by quitting the job just before promotion.
Her habit of missing deadlines is a form of self-sabotage.
self-sabotage.meta: Self-sabotage — bu shaxsning ongli yoki ongsiz ravishda o‘zining rivojlanishiga, muvaffaqiyatiga yoki farovonligiga zarar yetkazadigan fikrlar yoki xatti-harakatlaridir.

ex: I didn’t realize I was self-sabotaging until my therapist pointed it out.
He always seems to self-sabotage just when success is within reach.
self-sabotage.meta: Self-sabotage fe’li — bu insonning o‘zi bilmagan holda yoki ba’zida ongli ravishda o‘z maqsadlariga erishish yo‘lida o‘z harakatlari, qarorlari yoki fikrlari bilan o‘ziga zarar yetkazishi yoki to‘sqinlik qilishi.

ex: Self-sabotaging can prevent people from achieving their true potential.
Her constant lateness was a form of self-sabotaging that kept her from being promoted.
self-sabotaging.meta: Self-sabotaging — bu insonning o‘z manfaatlariga, maqsadlariga yoki rivojlanishiga ongli yoki ongsiz ravishda ziyon yetkazuvchi xatti-harakat yoki odatlaridir.

ex: Many self-saboteurs are unaware of the patterns that hold them back.
He’s a classic self-saboteur—every time things go well, he finds a way to mess them up.
self-saboteur.meta: Self-saboteur — bu o‘z harakatlari, qarorlari yoki fikrlari orqali o‘zining rivojlanishiga, muvaffaqiyatiga yoki farovonligiga to‘sqinlik qiladigan inson.

ex: Despite their arguments, their siblinghood kept them close.
The bond of siblinghood can be one of the strongest relationships in a person's life.
siblinghood.meta: Siblinghood — bu ikki yoki undan ortiq odam o‘rtasidagi aka-uka yoki opa-singil sifatida bo‘lgan tabiiy munosabat, rishta yoki holatdir. Bu atama ularning qon-qarindoshlik aloqalarini va bir oilada ulg‘ayganliklarini ifodalaydi.

ex: I get along really well with my brother-in-law, my sister’s husband.
My siblings-in-law are coming over for dinner tonight.
sibling-in-law.meta: Sibling-in-law — bu odamning turmush o‘rtog‘i (yoki doimiy hayotiy sherigi) ning aka-uka yoki opa-singillari, yoki aksincha: odamning o‘z aka-uka yoki opa-singillarining turmush o‘rtog‘i.

ex: Irish learners often forget to include the síneadh fada, which can change the meaning of the word.
The word "fáilte" has a síneadh fada over the "a" to indicate a long vowel sound.
síneadh fada.meta: Irland tilida ishlatiladigan, unli harflarning ustiga qoʻyiladigan oʻtkir urgʻu (á, é, í, ó, ú) belgisi boʻlib, bu unlining choʻziq, ya’ni uzoq talaffuz qilinishini bildiradi. Bu belgi unlining ma’nosini va talaffuzini sezilarli darajada oʻzgartiradi.

ex: It was their first time sixty-nining, and they found it very intimate.
They sixty-nined for over an hour last night.
sixty-nine.meta: Sixty-nine qilish — ikki kishi bir vaqtning o‘zida bir-birining jinsiy a’zosiga og‘zaki tarzda jinsiy zavq bag‘ishlaydigan pozitsiyada bo‘lishi.

ex: Some couples prefer to soixante-neuf as part of their foreplay.
They love to soixante-neuf before intercourse.
soixante-neuf.meta: Soixante-neuf qilish — ikki jinsiy sherikning bir vaqtning o‘zida bir-birining jinsiy a’zolarini og‘zaki tarzda og‘zaki stimulyatsiya qilish harakati bo‘lib, bu harakat odatda jinsiy lazzat olish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The suspect looked tweaky and couldn’t stop moving his hands.
He’s acting really tweaky after drinking too much coffee.
tweaky.meta: Bu sifat ko‘pincha psixotrop yoki stimul beruvchi moddalar (kofein, amfetaminlar va boshqalar) ta’sirida odamning haddan tashqari serharakat yoki xavotirli holatini tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Vaccinologists play a critical role in global health.
The vaccinologist led a team to develop a new vaccine against malaria.
vaccinologist.meta: Vaksinolog — vaksinalarni ishlab chiqish, tahlil qilish, ularni testdan o‘tkazish, emlash tizimlarini yaratish yoki emlash bo‘yicha ilmiy izlanishlar olib boradigan mutaxassis. Ular infeksion kasalliklar tarqalishining oldini olishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: She is studying vaccinology to help develop vaccines for emerging diseases.
Vaccinology has advanced rapidly due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
vaccinology.meta: Vaksinologiya — bu emlash, vaksinalarni yaratish, ularning immun tizimiga ta’siri, xavfsizligi va samaradorligini o‘rganadigan biotibbiyot fanining sohasi. U infeksion kasalliklarning oldini olish va ularni nazorat qilishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: The clinic is offering free vaxes this week.
Have you had your vax yet?
vax.meta: Vaks — bu norasmiy atama bo‘lib, emlash (vaksinatsiya) jarayonini yoki ayrim holatlarda emlash uchun ishlatiladigan vaksinaning o‘zini anglatadi. Asosan so‘zlashuv tilida, ommaviy axborot vositalari yoki ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: She got vaxxed last week.
I'm fully vaxxed and ready to travel.
vaxxed.meta: Emlangan — tanasiga vaksina yuborilgan, ya’ni ma’lum bir kasallikka qarshi immunitet hosil qilish uchun emlash jarayonidan o‘tgan kishi. “Vaxxed” so‘zi, ayniqsa, COVID-19 pandemiyasi davrida keng qo‘llanilgan.

ex: He was born into a family of ahoi who worked the land for generations.
The ahoi were allowed to farm the land as long as they pleased the landlord.
ahoi.meta: Ahoiy — ijtimoiy yoki tarixiy kontekstda, mulkdor tomonidan yer uchastkasini bepul yoki ixtiyoriy asosda ishlatishga ruxsat berilgan shaxs yoki odamlardan iborat qatlam.

ex: Animalizing in myths often serves to highlight certain traits, like bravery or cunning.
The cartoonist's animalizing of politicians added a humorous tone to his work.
animalizing.meta: Hayvonlashtirish — biror shaxs yoki narsani hayvonga o‘xshash tarzda tasvirlash yoki ko‘rsatish jarayoni. Bu tashqi ko‘rinish, xatti-harakat yoki ichki holat orqali amalga oshirilishi mumkin.

ex: The children reacted animately to the magician’s tricks.
She spoke animately, gesturing with her hands.
animately.meta: Jonli tarzda — harakat yoki ifodaning tiriklikka, hayotga yoki kuchli hissiyotga to‘la bo‘lgan holda bajarilishini bildiradi. Bu ko‘pincha odamning gapirish ohangi, yuz ifodasi, tanasi harakati yoki boshqa biror holatga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: She is proud of her Anishinaabe heritage.
The Anishinaabe have a rich oral tradition of storytelling.
anishinaabe.meta: Anishinaabe — Shimoliy Amerikadagi tubjoy xalqlardan biri yoki bir nechtasini anglatuvchi umumiy atama bo‘lib, u asosan Ojibva, Chippeva, Algonkin, Ottawa, va boshqa o‘xshash guruhlarga mansub odamlarni bildiradi.

ex: Anjeer is rich in fiber and antioxidants.
I ate dried anjeer for breakfast.
anjeer.meta: Anjir — Ficus carica nomli daraxt mevasidir. Yumshoq po‘stli, ichki qismi shirali va urug‘chali bo‘lgan bu meva yangi yoki quritilgan holatda iste’mol qilinadi.

ex: Ankara is commonly used in traditional African clothing.
She wore a dress made from colourful ankara fabric.
ankara.meta: Ankara — asosan G‘arbiy Afrika mamlakatlarida, ayniqsa Nigeriyada keng tarqalgan rang-barang naqshli paxta mato turi. Bu mato o‘zining mumli bosma texnikasi orqali yaratiladigan, ko‘zga tashlanadigan yorqin va kontrastli dizaynlari bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: The chef served chilled ankimo with ponzu sauce.
Ankimo is often referred to as the "foie gras of the sea" in Japanese cuisine.
ankimo.meta: Ankimo — Yapon milliy taomlaridan biri bo‘lib, monkfish jigaridan tayyorlanadi. Uni tayyorlash jarayonida jigar avval tuz bilan ishqalanadi, so‘ngra sake bilan chayiladi, silindrsimon shaklga keltirilib, bug‘da pishiriladi.

ex: I’m tired of all this ankle-biting from people who don’t understand the full picture.
The dog’s constant ankle-biting made it hard to walk through the yard.
ankle-biting.meta: To‘piqni tishlash — odatda it yoki kichik hayvon tomonidan odamning oyoq bilagini (to‘piqni) tishlash harakati.Yoqimsiz, sergap bola — kichik yoshli, betinim, tinmay gapiradigan va odamga tinchlik bermaydigan bola.

ex: She wore a delicate gold ankle bracelet with tiny charms.
The suspect was released under house arrest and fitted with an ankle bracelet.
ankle bracelet.meta: To‘piqqa taqiladigan elektron kuzatuv moslamasi – jinoyat sodir etgan yoki sud tomonidan muayyan shartlar asosida ozodlikka chiqarilgan shaxsning joylashuvini yoki holatini nazorat qilish uchun oyoq bilagiga taqiladigan maxsus elektron moslama.

ex: Those high heels look stylish but they're ankle-breakers.
That rocky path is a real ankle-breaker — be careful!
ankle-breaker.meta: To‘piq sindirgich – insonning to‘piq suyaklarini burib yoki sindirib yuborishi mumkin bo‘lgan narsa, joy yoki harakat. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha kinoyaviy yoki hajviy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: She wore ankle-breaking heels to the party.
The cobblestone street was full of ankle-breaking hazards.
ankle-breaking.meta: To‘piq sindiradigan – oyoqning to‘piq qismini burib olish yoki sindirib qo‘yishga olib kelishi mumkin bo‘lgan narsa yoki harakatni ifodalovchi sifat so‘z. Bu atama ko‘pincha kinoyaviy yoki mubolag‘ali shaklda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Proper ankling reduces knee strain and improves endurance.
Ankling helps cyclists maximize power with every pedal stroke.
ankling.meta: velosipedda yurishda oyoqning to‘piq qismi faol qatnashadigan pedallash uslubi. Bu texnikada tovon pastga tushiriladi va tepaga ko‘tariladi, bu esa energiyani to‘g‘ri taqsimlash, silliq aylanish va samaradorlikni oshirishga yordam beradi.

ex: The children at school learned how to play the anklung.
He performed a musical piece using the traditional Indonesian anklung.
anklung.meta: Anklung — bu musiqa asbobi bo‘lib, u yog‘och romga mahkamlangan va oktavalarga sozlangan bambuk tayoqchalardan iborat. Bu asbob ijrochining uni silkitishi orqali chaliladi.

ex: many spas now offer anma techniques as part of their therapy services.
the therapist performed a traditional anma massage to relieve tension.
anma.meta: anma — bu an’anaviy yapon massaji turi bo‘lib, unda qo‘l yordamida tana punktlariga bosim beriladi. bu muolaja asosan tana energiyasi oqimini yaxshilash va sog‘lomlashtirish uchun amalga oshiriladi.

ex: the manuscript is dated anno 1456.
the cathedral was completed anno 1310.
anno.meta: anno — xristian eramizdagi ma’lum bir yilga ishora qilish uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, ko‘pincha "anno domini" (ya'ni, "xudo yili", milodiy sana) iborasining qisqartmasi yoki tarkibiy qismi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: the annona ensured a steady food supply for the people of rome.
farmers were required to contribute to the annona during the roman empire.
