annona.meta: annona — qadimgi rim imperiyasida yer egalari tomonidan katta shaharlarga soliq sifatida to‘langan don yoki boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari. kengroq ma’noda, bu so‘z “oziq-ovqat ta’minoti” yoki “rasyonlar” degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: we need an annotatable version of the report for the review process.
the pdf file is fully annotatable, so you can highlight and add comments.
annotatable.meta: annotatable — izohlar, tushuntirishlar yoki eslatmalar bilan to‘ldirish mumkin bo‘lgan narsa; unga izoh yozish mumkin bo‘lgan holatdagi matn, hujjat yoki fayl.

ex: the professor handed out annoted lecture slides.
she read from an annoted edition of the novel.
annoted.meta: annoted — izohlar, tushuntirishlar yoki sharhlar bilan ta’minlangan; matn yoki hujjatga qo‘shimcha ma’lumotlar yozilgan holat.

ex: there was an announceable event during the conference.
the results of the election are announceable tomorrow.
announceable.meta: sifat (adjective): e’lon qilinadigan — bu ma’lumot, yangilik yoki voqea, uni rasman e’lon qilish mumkin yoki e’lon qilishga loyiq. ot (noun): e’lon qilinadigan narsa — e’lon qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan ma’lumot, xabar yoki voqea.

ex: he sighed annoyedly at the constant noise.
she spoke annoyedly when asked the same question again.
annoyedly.meta: annoyedly — norozilik yoki g‘azab tuyg‘usi bilan, bezovtalanib qilinadigan harakat yoki so‘zlashish usuli.

ex: the company’s contracts have an annuality clause that requires renewal every year.
the government follows the principle of annuality for its budget spending.
annuality.meta: moliya sohasida: byudjetga bir moliyaviy yil uchun ajratilgan mablag‘lar aynan shu yil ichida sarflanishi kerakligi siyosatining qabul qilinishi yoki unga rioya qilinishi.

ex: the company uses annualization to compare quarterly earnings on an annual basis.
annualization of the interest rate helps investors understand yearly returns.
annualization.meta: yilliklashtirish — bu o‘zgaruvchini (odatda foiz stavkasi, inflyatsiya, investitsiyadan qaytish darajasi va boshqalar) yil davomida hisoblash yoki o‘zgartirish amali yoki jarayoni.

ex: the fund allows investors to annuitize their investments after a certain period.
she decided to annuitize her retirement savings to receive monthly income.
annuitize.meta: (transitiv va intransitiv) investitsiyani yoki mablag‘ni yillik to‘lovlar yoki muntazam pul tushumlari ketma-ketligiga aylantirish.biror aktiv yoki investitsiya orqali doimiy yoki belgilangan muddatli to‘lovlarni boshlash jarayoni.

ex: an annuitized payment plan spreads the total amount over several years.
the annuitized value of her pension ensures steady income for life.
annuitized.meta: shaxsning umri davomida yoki to‘lovlar muddati davomida doimiy yoki ketma-ket yillik to‘lovlar yig‘indisini ifodalovchi. biror mablag‘ yoki investitsiyaning yillik to‘lovlar shakliga o‘tkazilgan yoki aylantirilgan holati.

ex: the annuitizing of the investment began after the contract expired.
annuitizing retirement savings provides a steady income stream.
annuitizing.meta: yillikka aylantirish — investitsiyani yoki boshqa bir summani yillik to‘lovlar yoki muntazam pul tushumlari ketma-ketligiga aylantirish jarayoni.

ex: his anodynic words helped calm the tense atmosphere.
the music had an anodynic effect on the anxious crowd.
anodynic.meta: ruh yoki his-tuyg‘ularni tinchlantiruvchi, xotirjam qiluvchi. zararsiz, yoqimsiz ta’sir qilmaydigan, muloyim yoki befarq.

ex: many online posts are attributed to anonym. users.
the letter was signed by anonym.
anonym.meta: anonym. — bu qisqartma bo‘lib, anonim (nomi oshkor qilinmagan) shaxs yoki manbani bildiradi. Ko‘pincha “anonymous” so‘zining grafik qisqartmasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: many anonyma from the medieval period are still studied today.
the library has a special collection of anonyma.
anonyma.meta: anonyma — nomi noma’lum yoki oshkor qilinmagan mualliflarga tegishli asarlar; anonim yozma yoki badiiy ishlar.

ex: many people use anonymizers to browse the web without revealing their identity.
an anonymizer helps protect user privacy online.
anonymizer.meta: anonimlashtiruvchi vosita — foydalanuvchining shaxsini aniqlovchi ma’lumotlarini yashirish orqali internetda anonim foydalanishni ta’minlaydigan dastur yoki proksi server kabi vosita.

ex: “anor” indicates there is one other party involved.
the case title read “smith anor vs. jones”.
anor.meta: anor — yuridik ishlar sarlavhalarida «and one other» (yana biri) degan ma’noni bildiruvchi qisqartma zamir. Ko‘pincha boshqa shaxs yoki tomonlarni anglatadi.

ex: she needed anothery to help with the project.
when he left, anothery took his place.
anothery.meta: anothery — yana bir kishi yoki narsa; “yana biri” ma’nosidagi so‘z.

ex: she said asante sana after receiving the gift.
asante sana for helping me with the project!
asante sana.meta: minnatdorchilik bildirish uchun ishlatiladi; “katta rahmat”, “chuqur tashakkur” degan ma’noda. ba’zan ushbu ifoda shukr yoki minnatdorchilik ramzi sifatida mustaqil ravishda ishlatiladi.

ex: the ashrama system guides individuals through stages of duty and spiritual growth.
according to hindu tradition, a person passes through four ashramas in life.
ashrama.meta: ashrama — ideal hayotning to‘rt bosqichidan har biri; hind falsafasiga ko‘ra, inson hayotini to‘rt bosqichga bo‘lib, har bir bosqichda ma’lum ijtimoiy va ruhiy vazifalar bajariladi.

ex: he’s, ati, the best player on the team.
ati, the event will happen next week.
ati.meta: ravish) kimdir aytganidek; xabar berilishicha; taxminan; aytilishicha. (kirish so‘zi) gapni boshlash yoki boshqalar aytgan fikrni keltirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: the instructions were all back to front and confusing.
he wore his shirt back to front by mistake.
back to front.meta: odatdagi yoki to‘g‘ri joylashuv yoki tartibdan teskari, aksincha tarzda joylashgan yoki tartiblangan. (ayniqsa kiyimga nisbatan) kiyimning orqa qismi odatda oldida bo‘lishi kerak bo‘lgan joyda bo‘lishi.

ex: the character in the film was portrayed as a proud bakla.
in filipino culture, the bakla identity is widely recognized.
bakla.meta: bakla — biologik jihatdan erkak sifatida tug‘ilgan, biroq o‘zini ayol sifatida tutadigan yoki ayolga xos harakatlar, kasblar, kiyinish uslublari orqali ifodalaydigan shaxs.

ex: oh bambi, that’s so sweet of you.
bambi! i didn’t expect to see you here!
bambi.meta: turli holatlardagi hissiyotlarni (hayrat, achinish, hayajon, mehr, quvonch va hokazo) ifodalovchi undov so‘z. ba’zan kinoya yoki yumor bilan ishlatiladi — beg‘uborlik, noziklik yoki haddan ortiq hissiylikni ifodalash uchun.

ex: the region’s music has a clearly Bantuized rhythm and style.
the local dialect includes many Bantuized words.
bantuized.meta: ayniqsa so‘zlar haqida: bantu tillaridan olingan unsurlarni o‘z ichiga olgan, bantu tillari ta’sirida shakllangan. bantu madaniyati ta’sirida bo‘lgan yoki unga moslashtirilgan.

ex: the band performed a lively benga song that got everyone dancing.
benga music is popular at celebrations and festivals in kenya.
benga.meta: benga — Keniya xalq musiqasidan ilhomlangan, ritmik va tez sur’atli ohanglar bilan ajralib turadigan mashhur musiqiy uslub. U elektr gitara, barabanlar va mahalliy cholg‘ularning uyg‘unligi bilan tanilgan.

ex: she learned to bobsled as part of the national team.
they trained every day to bobsled in the winter games.
bobsled.meta: bobsled — muzli yo‘lakda maxsus sport aravachasida (bob-sleyda) harakatlanmoq yoki poygada ishtirok etmoq. Bu qishki sport turi bo‘lib, tezlik va boshqaruv talab qiladi.

ex: the bobsledder prepared for the winter olympics.
she is a professional bobsledder representing her country.
bobsledder.meta: bob-sleychi — bob-sley (muzli yo‘lakda harakatlanadigan sport aravachasi) sport turi bilan shug‘ullanuvchi yoki unda qatnashadigan shaxs. Bu odam sportchi sifatida yoki vaqt o‘tkazish uchun bob-sleyda uchadi.

ex: they went bobsledding during their holiday in the alps.
bobsledding is one of the most thrilling winter sports.
bobsledding.meta: bob-sleyda uchish — muzli yo‘lakda maxsus aravachada harakatlanish sporti yoki mashg‘uloti; bobsled sport turi sifatida tanilgan qishki sport faoliyati.

ex: she became the first female bobsleigher from her country.
the bobsleigher trained for years to compete in the winter olympics.
bobsleigher.meta: bob-sleychi — bob-sley (muz yo‘lakda yuradigan sport aravachasi)da uchadigan shaxs; ayniqsa bu bilan sport yoki mashg‘ulot sifatida shug‘ullanuvchi odam.

ex: she released her first bongo flava album last year.
bongo flava is the most popular music genre among tanzanian youth.
bongo flava.meta: Bongo Flava — Tanzaniyada paydo bo‘lgan zamonaviy musiqa uslubi bo‘lib, Amerika hip-hop musiqasi elementlari bilan birga reggae, R&B, Afrobeat, dancehall va mahalliy Afrika ritmlarini o‘zida uyg‘unlashtiradi.

ex: in hindu cosmology, brahmaloka is the abode of brahma.
enlightened beings are believed to be reborn in brahmaloka.
brahmaloka.meta: Brahmaloka — buddizm va hinduizmda eng oliy osmoniy olam, ya’ni ruhlar yoki yuksak mavjudotlar yashaydigan eng yuqori jannat darajasi.

ex: scholars study the brahmana to understand ancient indian religious practices.
the brahmana texts explain the meaning behind vedic rituals.
brahmana.meta: Brahmana — miloddan avvalgi taxminan 800–600-yillar oralig‘ida Sanskrit tilida yozilgan vedik matnlar to‘plamidir.

ex: many brahmic customs are still observed in rural india.
the brahmic tradition emphasizes ritual purity and sacred knowledge.
brahmic.meta: braxmik — braxmanizm yoki braxmanlar (hind diniy sinfi) bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan, ularga xos yoki umuman hind xalqlari va hind dinlariga (ayniqsa hinduizmga) oid bo‘lgan xususiyatlarni ifodalaydigan sifat.

ex: in vedanta philosophy, brahmic knowledge leads to liberation.
the sages contemplated the brahmic nature of existence.
brahmic.meta: braxmik — hindu falsafasida Brahmaga (yaratuvchi xudo sifatida) yoki olamning mutlaq, abadiy, o‘zgarmas haqiqatiga (ya’ni Brahman tushunchasiga) oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan narsalarni ifodalaydigan sifat.

ex: they came home brahms and liszt from the pub.
after three pints, he was completely brahms and liszt.
brahms and liszt.meta: Brahms and Liszt — ingliz (ayniqsa londondagi kokni shevasida) sleng ifoda bo‘lib, mast bo‘lgan, ichib olgan holatni bildiradi. Iboradagi kompozitorlar nomlari (Brahms va Liszt) so‘z o‘yini sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: brotherboys often face unique challenges within both indigenous and wider australian society.
he came out as a brotherboy and was supported by his community.
brotherboy.meta: brotherboy — Avstraliya aborigenlari orasida, tug‘ilishda ayol deb ro‘yxatga olingan, ammo o‘zini erkak sifatida identifikatsiya qiluvchi yoki erkaklarcha tashqi ko‘rinish, xatti-harakat yoki ijtimoiy rolni namoyon qiluvchi shaxs.

ex: much of the forest was bulldozered to make room for a resort.
the bulldozered buildings left the street looking like a war zone.
bulldozered.meta: Buldozer yordamida buzilgan yoki tekislangan; yer maydoni, bino yoki boshqa inshoot texnika orqali yo‘q qilingan holat.Kuch ishlatish, bosim yoki qat’iylik bilan bostirib kirilgan, yo‘l ochilgan yoki istalmagan tarzda o‘zgartirilgan holat.

ex: he dressed like a gentleman, but acted like a true bully beau.
the tavern was full of bully beaux, each louder than the next.
bully beau.meta: bully beau — g‘ayritabiiy, tajovuzkor, zo‘ravon yoki maqtanchoq xatti-harakatlari bilan ajralib turuvchi erkak. Ayniqsa, o‘zini jozibali yoki dabdabali ko‘rsatishga urinadigan, lekin aslida qo‘pol va havfli bo‘lgan odam.

ex: increasing awareness about bullycide can help prevent more lives from being lost.
the school launched an anti-bullying campaign after a tragic bullycide.
bullycide.meta: Bullycide — ayniqsa bola yoki o‘smir bo‘lgan shaxs tomonidan maktabda yoki onlayn muhitda doimiy ruhiy yoki jismoniy zo‘ravonlikka uchraganidan so‘ng sodir etilgan o‘z joniga qasd holati.

ex: she couldn’t leave the streets because her bully hack controlled everything.
the bully hack stood on the corner, watching over the women.
bully hack.meta: bully hack — tajovuzkor yoki tahdidli xatti-harakatlarga moyil bo‘lgan erkak; xususan, fohishaning yonida yurib, uni “qo‘riqlash” evaziga uning daromadidan ulush oladigan, ba’zida uni ekspluatatsiya qiladigan shaxs.

ex: busaa is often made in large pots during community festivals.
they gathered in the village to drink freshly brewed busaa.
busaa.meta: Busaa — Keniyada an’anaviy usulda tayyorlanadigan kuchli uy pivosi bo‘lib, odatda tariq (millet), makkajo‘xori yoki jo‘xori uni (sorghum) achitilib tayyorlanadi. Bu ichimlik ijtimoiy yig‘inlar, marosimlar yoki oddiy xalq orasida keng iste’mol qilinadi.

ex: vendors still use buveera despite the regulations.
the government banned the use of buveera to protect the environment.
buveera.meta: Buveera — plastikdan tayyorlangan, odatda savdo-sotiqda yoki mahsulotlarni o‘rashda ishlatiladigan paketlar yoki o‘ramlar. Bu atama ko‘pincha ko‘plik shaklda ishlatiladi va atrof-muhit muammolari bilan bog‘liq kontekstlarda tilga olinadi.

ex: the letter was formally signed by bw njoroge.
bw omondi will address the community meeting tomorrow.
bw.meta: "Bw" — biror erkak shaxsga hurmat yoki rasmiylik bilan murojaat qilganda, uning ismi yoki familiyasi oldidan qo‘yiladigan unvon. Svaxili tilida va Sharqiy Afrika mintaqalarida keng tarqalgan.

ex: bystanding can sometimes enable bad behavior to continue.
his bystanding during the crisis was criticized by many.
bystanding.meta: Bystanding — voqea joyida bo‘lish, lekin unga aralashmaslik holati; ya’ni biror hodisa sodir bo‘layotganida, atrofda turgan, ammo faol ishtirok etmaydigan shaxsning holati yoki roli.

ex: casta paintings from the 18th century depicted racial mixtures in spanish america.
the colonial authorities classified people into different castas based on their ancestry.
casta.meta: Casta — odatda irqiy kelib chiqish yoki naslga asoslangan holda ajratilgan ijtimoiy yoki madaniy guruh. Ayniqsa Lotin Amerikasi tarixida ispaniyalik mustamlakachilar tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan ijtimoiy tizimda ishlatilgan.

ex: casteist attitudes still affect access to education and jobs in some regions.
the politician was accused of making casteist remarks during the speech.
casteist.meta: Insonlarga ularning kastaga mansubligi asosida salbiy munosabatda bo‘ladigan, kamsituvchi yoki adolatsiz ijtimoiy tizimni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi xatti-harakat yoki qarash.

ex: herbalists used catnep for treating mild colds and stomach aches.
the cat rolled happily in the dried catnep.
catnep.meta: Catnep — Nepeta cataria deb nomlanuvchi o‘simlik. Bu o‘simlikning barglari mushuklarga rag‘batlantiruvchi (stimulyator) ta’sir ko‘rsatadi va ba’zida dorivor maqsadlarda ham qo‘llaniladi. Ko‘pincha mushuklar ushbu o‘simlikka juda qiziqadi.

ex: changaa is often sold secretly due to strict alcohol laws.
the villagers gathered to drink homemade changaa during the ceremony.
changaa.meta: Changaa — Keniyada tariq, makkajo‘xori yoki jo‘xori kabi donlardan achitish yo‘li bilan tayyorlanadigan kuchli an’anaviy aroq. Odatda uy sharoitida ishlab chiqariladi va ko‘plab hollarda noqonuniy hisoblanadi.

ex: she knows how to make the softest chapo in the village.
we had beans and chapo for dinner.
chapo.meta: Chapo — yupqa, xamirturushsiz va to‘liq donli un (odatda bug‘doy uni)dan tayyorlanadigan an’anaviy non. Qizdirilgan temir tovada (gril yoki skovorodkada) pishiriladi. Odatda sabzavot, go‘sht yoki loviya bilan iste’mol qilinadi.

ex: i ordered a spicy chips mayai with kachumbari on the side.
chips mayai is one of the most popular street foods in dar es salaam.
chips mayai.meta: Chips mayai — Tanzaniya va Keniya oshxonasiga xos taom bo‘lib, u qovurilgan kartoshka (chips) va xom tuxum aralashmasidan tayyorlanadigan qalin omletdir.

ex: she loves to collabo with afrobeat producers.
two top rappers decided to collabo on a new track.
collabo.meta: Collabo — ayniqsa san’atkorlar, musiqachilar yoki boshqa ijodiy soha vakillarining biror loyiha ustida birgalikda ishlashi, qo‘shma ijodiy faoliyat yuritishi. Rasmiy nutqda kamroq, ammo kundalik suhbat va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: History often judges collabos harshly for their betrayal. (Tarix ko‘pincha xoin hamkorlarni ularning xiyonati uchun qattiq tanqid qiladi.)
The villagers shunned him, believing he was a collabo during the occupation.(Qishloq aholisi undan yuz o‘girdi, chunki u bosib olish davrida xoin hamkor bo‘lganiga ishongan edi.)
Collabos were sometimes motivated by fear, greed, or ideology.(Ba'zida xoin hamkorlar qo‘rquv, ochko‘zlik yoki mafkura sababli bunday ish qilgan.)
collabo.meta: Dushman bilan hamkorlik qiladigan, dushman tarafida ishlaydigan yoki bosqinchilar bilan til biriktiruvchi shaxs. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha urush yoki bosib olingan hududlar kontekstida ishlatiladi va salbiy, kamsituvchi ma’no beradi.

ex: each cyathium contains a single female flower surrounded by many male flowers.
the cyathium is a characteristic feature of euphorbia plants.
cyathium.meta: Siatiy — Euphorbia (sutli o‘tlar) urug‘iga mansub o‘simliklarda uchraydigan kosa shaklidagi gulli tuzilma (inflorescence). Bu markazda joylashgan bir nechta soddalashtirilgan urg‘ochi gul va uni o‘rab turgan erkak gullardan iborat bo‘ladi.

ex: daladala services are cheap but often unreliable.
we took a crowded daladala to get to the city center.
daladala.meta: Daladala — Tanzaniyada ishlatiladigan kichik yo‘lovchi avtobusi yoki mikroavtobus bo‘lib, u aholiga to‘lov evaziga xizmat qiladi. Bu transport tizimi rasmiy bo‘lmagan bo‘lsa-da, juda keng tarqalgan va arzon hisoblanadi.

ex: maize is often sold by the debe in rural areas.
he bought a debe of cooking oil from the market.
debe.meta: Debe — taxminan 20 litr sig‘imga ega bo‘lgan kvadrat temir idish. U suyuqliklar yoki don mahsulotlarini saqlash va tashish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: please don’t dirten the floors with your muddy boots.
the children dirtened their clothes while playing in the mud.
dirten.meta: Biror narsani iflos qilish, kir holatga keltirish yoki ustiga axloqsizlik (chang, dog‘, tuproq, va h.k.) tushirish.Obro‘siga dog‘ tushirmoq, nomusini bulg‘amoq yoki axloqiy jihatdan qoralamoq.

ex: the workers double-decked the shipping containers to save space.
they plan to double-deck the old bus to increase passenger capacity.
double-deck.meta: Biror narsani ikki qavatli (ikki qatlamli) shaklda qurmoq yoki jihozlamoq — masalan, avtobusga ikkinchi qavat (paluba) qo‘shmoq yoki narsalarni ustma-ust joylashtirmoq.

ex: Old furniture and appliances are often dumped at the dumpsite.
There is a large dumpsite outside the city where all household waste is taken.
dumpsite.meta: Dumpsite – bu chiqindilar yoki ortiqcha narsalar tashlab yuboriladigan maxsus ajratilgan joy. Odatda bu joylar shahar tashqarisida yoki chiqindilarni yig‘ish uchun belgilangan hududlarda bo‘ladi.

ex: His overconfidence is explained by the Dunning–Kruger effect.
Many beginners fall into the Dunning–Kruger effect, thinking they are experts.
dunning–kruger.meta: Danning–Kruger effekti – bu psixologik xatolik bo‘lib, odam o‘z bilim yoki qobiliyat darajasi past bo‘lsa ham, o‘zini yuqori malakali deb hisoblashga moyil bo‘ladi.

ex: He was impressed by the intricate stone pathways of the dwarven cities.
This sword was crafted by ancient dwarven smiths.
dwarven.meta: Fantastik adabiyot, o‘yinlar va shunga o‘xshash janrlarda: mittilar (dwarf) bilan bog‘liq yoki ularga oid, ularning madaniyati, qurollari, shahar qurilishi va boshqa xususiyatlariga tegishli.

ex: Their style of dressing indicates the growing process of effeminizing in society.
In culture, the excessive effeminizing of men is sometimes criticized.
effeminizing.meta: Effeminizing – bu biror kishi yoki narsani ayollarga xos bo‘lgan xususiyatlar bilan bezash, ayollik tomoniga yo‘naltirish yoki uni ayolga o‘xshatish jarayoni.

ex: The new movie was praised for positively portraying enby characters.
Sam identifies as enby and uses they/them pronouns.
enby.meta: Enby – bu non-binary (ikki jins chegarasiga kirmaydigan) jinsiy identifikatsiyaga ega shaxsni ifodalovchi so‘z. U erkak yoki ayol jinsiga qat'iy taalluqli bo‘lmagan insonni anglatadi.

ex: The military convoy was accompanied by an armed escorting team for security.
Strong escorting was provided during the president's visit.
escorting.meta: Hamrohlik qilish yoki kuzatib qo‘yish harakati, ayniqsa, himoya yoki xavfsizlik maqsadida biror kishini yoki narsani kuzatib borish amaliyoti.

ex: Sometimes short-term pressure can be eustress that enhances creativity.
The excitement he felt while preparing for the competition was eustress, which motivated him to work harder.
eustress.meta: Eustress – bu inson stressga duch kelganda yuzaga keladigan ijobiy ruhiy yoki emotsional javob bo‘lib, odatda motivatsiyaning oshishi, hayajon yoki baxt hissi bilan namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: Their new constitution might be based on a federo system.
Some politicians are proposing a federo system to govern the country.
federo.meta: Federo – taklif qilingan yoki mavjud bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan federatsion boshqaruv tizimi; ya’ni markaziy hukumat va mahalliy (mintaqaviy) hukumatlar o‘rtasida hokimiyat taqsimlanadigan siyosiy tuzilma.

ex: The terms for buying a new house are very favorable and fully financeable.
This project was considered financeable by the government.
financeable.meta: Financeable – bu moliyalashtirish yoki to‘lov uchun mablag‘ topish mumkin bo‘lgan, ya’ni moliya bilan ta’minlash mumkin bo‘lgan loyiha, mahsulot yoki harakatni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: The housing market has also been affected by financialization, turning into a financial speculation tool.
In the past decade, financialization has intensified in many countries, with the financial sector dominating over manufacturing.
financialization.meta: Financialization – bu moliyaviy institutlar, bozorlar va moliyaviy vositalarning iqtisodiyotda yoki biror hududda ta’siri va hajmi oshishi jarayoni. Bu jarayonda moliya sektori iqtisodiyotning asosiy va boshqaruvchi kuchiga aylanadi.

ex: The government was criticized for trying to financialize public healthcare.
Many universities have started to financialize education, focusing more on profit than on learning quality.
financialize.meta: Financialize – bu biror narsani faqat uning moliyaviy qiymati yoki foyda keltirish salohiyati nuqtai nazaridan ko‘rish yoki baholash; shuningdek, biror resurs yoki aktivni moliyaviy savdo yoki sarmoyaga aylantirish jarayoni.

ex: Housing has become a financialized asset, driving prices beyond the reach of many people.
In a financialized economy, even basic services like education and healthcare are treated as profit opportunities.
financialized.meta: Biror narsa faqat moliyaviy qiymati yoki foyda keltirish salohiyati asosida baholangan yoki shunday ko‘riladigan holat. Resurs, aktiv yoki xizmat moliyaviy bozorda savdo qilinadigan yoki sarmoya ob’ektiga aylantirilgan holat.

ex: A finger trap teaches that sometimes pulling harder makes the problem worse.
The child laughed when he realized he was stuck in the finger trap and couldn’t pull his fingers out.
finger trap.meta: Finger trap – bu kichik silindrsimon o‘yinchoq yoki boshqotirma bo‘lib, u bambuk, qog‘oz, somon yoki boshqa materiallardan to‘qilgan bo‘ladi.

ex: The DJ’s mix has a real old-school flava that people love.
That rapper brings his own flava to every track he drops.
flava.meta: Flava – asosan hip-hop va R&B musiqasida ishlatiladigan slang bo‘lib, san’atkor yoki musiqachining o‘ziga xos, ajralib turadigan musiqiy uslubi, ohangi yoki shaxsiyatini ifodalaydi.

ex: The workshop is open to all folx, regardless of background or identity.
Hey folx, thanks for coming to the event tonight!
folx.meta: Folx – bu ingliz tilidagi folk (xalq, odamlar) so‘zining zamonaviy va inklyuziv shakli bo‘lib, odamlar, jamoa, yoki umumiy omma ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The project was implemented at the gombolola level to better reach the rural population.
Each gombolola in Buganda has its own local leaders and administrative offices.
gombolola.meta: Gombolola – bu asosan Uganda, xususan Buganda qirolligi hududida qo‘llaniladigan atama bo‘lib, bir tuman (county) tarkibidagi kichik ma’muriy bo‘linma yoki qishloq darajasidagi hududiy boshqaruv birligini anglatadi.

ex: The gomesi is often passed down from mother to daughter as a family heirloom.
She wore a beautiful pink gomesi to the wedding ceremony.
gomesi.meta: Gomesi – bu Ugandada, ayniqsa Buganda qirolligi va boshqa mintaqalarda ayollar kiyadigan an’anaviy uzun libos bo‘lib, u to‘rtburchak yoqa, kalta va shishiq yenglar hamda bel atrofida bog‘lanadigan kamar (tasma) bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: She is studying Ho-Chunk history and language at the university.
The Ho-Chunk are known for their rich oral traditions and skilled craftsmanship.
ho-chunk.meta: Ho-Chunk – bu asosan Viskonsin va unga yaqin hududlarda yashagan tubjoy Amerika xalqi (hindular) bo‘lib, hozirgi kunda ularning asosiy aholisi Viskonsin va Nebraska shtatlarida istiqomat qiladi.

ex: Many critics argue that the hypersexualization of female characters in video games is harmful.
The hypersexualization of young girls in advertising has raised serious concerns among parents.
hypersexualization.meta: Hypersexualization – bu biror shaxs yoki narsani haddan tashqari, nomaqbul yoki noto‘g‘ri tarzda jinsiy jihatdan ko‘rsatish yoki taqdim etish jarayoni.

ex: Some advertisements hypersexualize young women to sell products.
The movie was criticized for hypersexualizing its female characters.
hypersexualize.meta: Hypersexualize – bu biror shaxs yoki narsani ortiqcha, nomaqbul yoki haddan tashqari jinsiy tarzda tasvirlash yoki aks ettirish; shuningdek, uni doimiy ravishda kuchli jinsiy yoki erotik belgilar bilan to‘ldirish.

ex: Many pop music videos feature hypersexualized images of young performers.
The female character in the game was heavily hypersexualized and not taken seriously by players.
hypersexualized.meta: Hypersexualized – bu biror shaxs yoki narsaga haddan tashqari, nomaqbul yoki ortiqcha jinsiy ko‘rinish, tasvir yoki ohang berilgan holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: The ignorability of background details in the painting made the main subject stand out.
His quiet nature gave him a certain ignorability in large groups.
ignorability.meta: Ignorability – bu biror narsaning e’tiborga olinmasligi, osonlik bilan inkor qilinishi yoki ko‘zdan qochirilishi mumkin bo‘lgan holati yoki xususiyati.

ex: She was hurt by his obvious ignoral during the meeting.
His repeated ignoral of the warnings led to serious consequences.
ignoral.meta: Ignoral – bu biror kishini yoki narsani ataylab e’tiborsiz qoldirish, ko‘rmaslikka olish yoki inkor qilish harakati. Ya’ni, bu ongli ravishda biror narsaga befarq bo‘lish yoki uni pisand qilmaslik holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: He arrogantly assumed that anyone who disagreed with him belonged to the ignorati.
The policy makers dismissed the concerns of the ignorati without proper consideration.
ignorati.meta: Ignorati – bu savodsiz, bilim darajasi past, yoki voqealardan bexabarligi bilan ajralib turadigan odamlar guruhi yoki ijtimoiy qatlamni ifodalovchi atama.

ex: The warning signs were ignored, leading to serious consequences.
His suggestions were completely ignored during the meeting.
ignored.meta: Ignored – bu biror narsa yoki kishiga e’tibor berilmagan, ataylab yoki bexabar tarzda inkor qilingan yoki sezilmasdan o‘tib ketilgan holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: She prepared irio using mashed sweet potatoes, maize, and spinach for dinner.
Irio is a staple dish in Kenyan households, often served with grilled meat.
irio.meta: Irio – bu Keniyaning an’anaviy taomi bo‘lib, kartoshka yoki shirin kartoshka pyuresi, jo‘xori (makkajo‘xori), noxat yoki boshqa dukkaklilar, va ismaloq kabi yashil bargli sabzavotlar aralashtirib tayyorlanadi.

ex: He learned to play the isukuti from his grandfather, who was a respected drummer.
The isukuti was played with energetic rhythms during the wedding celebration.
isukuti.meta: Isukuti – bu Keniyada keng tarqalgan an’anaviy yog‘och baraban cholg‘usi bo‘lib, odatda o‘yiq yog‘ochdan tayyorlanadi va yelka orqali osib olinib, barmoqlar va kaft yordamida urib chaliladi.

ex: She is studying the Kalenjin language as part of her research on Nilotic peoples.
The Kalenjin are renowned for producing world-class long-distance runners.
kalenjin.meta: Keniyaning markaziy va g‘arbiy hududlarida, shuningdek, Sharqiy Uganda va Shimoliy Tanzaniyada yashovchi etnik guruh nomi. Kalenjin xalqiga, ularning tiliga, madaniyatiga yoki urf-odatlariga oid.

ex: In many Ugandan homes, kalo is served as a staple food with meat stew.
She prepared kalo by mixing millet flour with cassava flour and water.
kalo.meta: Kalo – bu asosan tarvuz (millet) unidan tayyorlangan un yoki undan tayyorlangan non, ba’zan kassava uni bilan aralashtirib pishiriladi. Bu taom Ugandaning ayrim hududlarida asosiy oziq-ovqat hisoblanadi.

ex: Traditional kashata is made with roasted peanuts and flavored with cardamom.
She bought some kashata from the street vendor for an afternoon snack.
kashata.meta: Kashata – bu Sharqiy Afrikada keng tarqalgan shirinlik bo‘lib, odatda hindiston yong‘og‘i yoki yer yong‘og‘i (ba’zan ikkalasi birga) bilan tayyorlanadi.

ex: He was appointed Katikkiro after years of service to the royal family.
The Katikkiro is responsible for leading the cabinet in the Buganda kingdom.
katikkiro.meta: Katikkiro – bu Ugandaning markaziy qismida joylashgan Buganda qirolligidagi eng yuqori lavozimli rasmiy shaxs, ya’ni qirollik bosh vaziri. Katikkiro qirollik hukumatini boshqaradi va Kabaka (qirol) nomidan siyosiy va ma’muriy ishlarni yuritadi.

ex: She prepared katogo by cooking bananas and cassava with groundnut sauce.
Katogo is a popular breakfast dish in Uganda made with matoke and beef.
katogo.meta: Katogo – bu Uganda oshxonasiga xos nonushta taomi bo‘lib, odatda matoke (pishirilgan yashil banan) va ba’zan kassava (maniok) birga qozonda go‘sht, sabzavot yoki sos bilan pishiriladi.

ex: She carried her groceries in a kaveera from the market.
The government introduced a ban on kaveera to reduce plastic pollution.
kaveera.meta: Kaveera – bu Sharqiy Afrikada, ayniqsa Ugandada keng ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, plastik paketlar yoki plastik qadoqlash materiallarini anglatadi.

ex: The kipande system was seen as a symbol of oppression and racial discrimination.
During the colonial period, every black African man in Kenya was required to carry a kipande.
kipande.meta: Keniyada mustamlaka davrida qora tanli afrikaliklarga berilgan shaxsni tasdiqlovchi hujjat bo‘lib, ayniqsa Britaniya mustamlakachilik hukumatining barcha qora tanli afrikaliklardan doimo o‘zi bilan olib yurishni talab qilgan rasmiy hujjati edi

ex: During the kwanjula, the groom’s family presents gifts to the bride’s family.
The kwanjula is a colorful and highly respected tradition in Ugandan culture.
kwanjula.meta: Kwanjula – bu Ugandada o‘tkaziladigan an’anaviy unashtirish marosimi bo‘lib, bu marosimda kelin va kuyov oilalari rasmiy tarzda birinchi marta uchrashadi.

ex: Many Ugandans abroad are engaged in kyeyo jobs to make ends meet.
He traveled to Europe to find a kyeyo and support his family back home.
kyeyo.meta: Kyeyo – bu Ugandaliklarning chet elda, ayniqsa past maoshli yoki malaka talab qilmaydigan ishlarda band bo‘lishini ifodalovchi tushuncha. Ushbu so‘z ko‘pincha "kyeyo ishi" (kyeyo job) yoki "kyeyo ishchisi" (kyeyo worker) kabi birikmalarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Lesos are often given as gifts at weddings and celebrations.
She wrapped a bright leso around her waist before going to the market.
leso.meta: Leso – bu Sharqiy Afrikada keng tarqalgan paxtadan tayyorlangan, yorqin ranglarda naqshlar bilan bezatilgan mato bo‘lib, odatda to‘rtburchak yoki kvadrat shaklida bo‘ladi va to‘rt tarafida chet bezagi mavjud.

ex: The sound of rain on the mabati is familiar in many African homes.
They built a small house with mabati sheets for the roof.
mabati.meta: Mabati – bu go‘fralangan temir varaqlari bo‘lib, ayniqsa uy qurilishida tom yopish yoki devor qoplash materiali sifatida keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Many machingas offer affordable products to city residents.
The machinga walked through the market selling colorful scarves.
machinga.meta: Machinga – bu ko‘chalarda, bozorlar yoki jamoat joylarida harakatlanib tovar sotadigan ko‘cha sotuvchisi yoki ko‘chma savdogar.

ex: Authorities cracked down on magendo operations along the border.
During the shortages, magendo became the main way to obtain essential goods.
magendo.meta: Magendo – bu rasman nazorat ostida bo‘lgan yoki taqchillikdagi mahsulotlarning noqonuniy savdosi yoki ularga noqonuniy yo‘l bilan egalik qilish holati. Magendo odatda qora bozor tushunchasiga to‘liq mos keladi.

ex: Some politicians advocated for majimbo to promote regional development.
The majimbo system aimed to empower local governments in Kenya.
majimbo.meta: Majimbo – bu Kenyada siyosiy boshqaruv shakli bo‘lib, unda markaziy hukumat vakolatlari mahalliy yoki mintaqaviy ma’muriy organlarga topshiriladi.

ex: The mama ntilie served hot chapati and beans from her cart.
We stopped at a mama ntilie to enjoy some delicious street food.
mama ntilie.meta: Mama ntilie – bu ko‘chada pishirilgan taomlar sotadigan ayol sotuvchi bo‘lib, odatda arzon narxlarda ovqatlarni qo‘l aravachasi yoki kichik ko‘cha rastalarida sotadi.

ex: Many manambas were recruited from distant regions to work for low wages.
The manamba toiled in the sisal plantations under harsh conditions.
manamba.meta: Manamba – bu majburiy shartnoma asosida ishlaydigan yoki juda kam haq to‘lanadigan jismoniy ishchi, ayniqsa sisal plantatsiyalarida ishlovchi migratsion ishchilar.

ex: In old manuscripts, the manicule helped readers find key passages quickly.
The editor used a manicule to highlight the important note in the margin.
manicule.meta: Manicule – bu yo‘naltiruvchi bosh barmoq bilan ko‘rsatilgan qo‘l rasmi yoki tipografik belgi (☛) bo‘lib, ayniqsa yozuv yoki bosma materiallarda o‘quvchining e’tiborini muhim joyga jalb qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Mbege is made by fermenting bananas and finger millet flour together.
The Chagga people brew mbege for special ceremonies and celebrations.
mbege.meta: Mbege – bu Tanzaniyadagi Chagga xalqiga xos an’anaviy uy sharoobi bo‘lib, u fermentlangan banan va barmoq jo‘xori (finger millet) unidan tayyorlanadi.

ex: She mbu resigned from her position yesterday.
Mbu, the new project will start next month.
mbu.meta: Mbu – bu so‘z biror gap yoki voqea haqida rasmiy yoki norasmiy manbalardan eshitilgan, ammo to‘liq tasdiqlanmagan ma’lumotni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Many considered the year a mirabilis annus, full of signs and portents.
The year 1969 was a mirabilis annus due to the moon landing and other historic events.
mirabilis annus.meta: Mirabilis annus – bu nodir, ajoyib yoki favqulodda voqealar sodir bo‘lgan yil degan ma’noni anglatadi, ayniqsa bunday yil ko‘pincha bashorat yoki belgi sifatida qaraladi.

ex: After the party, he was completely Mozart and Liszt.
She came home Mozart and Liszt after a night out with friends.
mozart and liszt.meta: Mozart and Liszt – bu asosan Britaniya slengida ishlatiladigan so‘z birikmasi bo‘lib, mast, mast holatda bo‘lgan odamni tasvirlash uchun qo‘llanadi. Bu ibora ko‘pincha ichkilikbozlik yoki spirtli ichimlik ta’sirida bo‘lgan holatni bildiradi

ex: Many people in the community disapprove of mpango wa kando relationships.
He was rumored to have a mpango wa kando outside his marriage.
mpango wa kando.meta: Mpango wa kando – bu nikoh yoki rasmiy sheriklikdan tashqari jinsiy yoki romantik munosabatni anglatadi. Bu ibora shuningdek, bunday munosabatni davom ettirayotgan shaxsni ham bildirishi mumkin.

ex: The muhoi cultivated the land without paying rent to the owner.
Many muhoi rely on informal agreements to farm the land.
muhoi.meta: Muhoi – bu to‘lovsiz yer maydonini ekish huquqiga ega bo‘lgan shaxs, ya’ni yer egasidan ruxsat olib, yerni ishlatadigan, lekin rasmiy ijara haqini to‘lamaydigan fermer yoki dehqon.

ex: The community supports multisexual individuals and their relationships.
She identifies as multisexual, attracted to people of different genders.
multisexual.meta: Multisexual – bu turli jins yoki gender identitlariga ega bo‘lgan odamlar tomonida jinsiy yoki romantik jalb qilinish yoki ularga nisbatan jinsiy faoliyat bilan bog‘liq holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Locals use the muratina fruit to brew traditional alcoholic drinks.
The muratina tree is known for its large sausage-shaped fruits.
muratina.meta: Muratina – bu Kigelia africana deb ataladigan daraxtning nomi bo‘lib, u Afrika tropik hududlarida o‘sadi va ko‘pincha sosiska daraxti deb ataladi.

ex: A muxe is recognized as having a unique gender identity beyond male or female.
The muxe community plays an important cultural role in Zapotec society.
muxe.meta: Muxe – bu Meksikaning janubidagi Zapotek xalqlarida tug‘ilishda erkak sifatida ro‘yxatga olingan, ammo ayollarga xos jinsiy ifoda yoki rolni qabul qilgan yoki namoyon qilgan shaxs.

ex: She is a respected mwalimu at the local school.
The mwalimu explained the lesson clearly to the students.
mwalimu.meta: Mwalimu – bu o‘qituvchi yoki muallim ma’nosini anglatadi. Shuningdek, bu so‘z shaxsning ismidan oldin hurmat belgisi sifatida yoki murojaat shakli sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The government should listen to the concerns of its wananchi.
Every mwananchi has the right to vote in elections.
mwananchi.meta: Mwananchi – bu biror davlat yoki jamiyatning fuqarosi yoki oddiy a’zosi degan ma’noni anglatadi. Shuningdek, bu atama ko‘pincha keng jamoatchilik yoki oddiy odamlarni ifodalashda ishlatiladi. Ko‘plik shakli – wananchi.

ex: The animals are more active during nightertime.
We traveled by nightertime to avoid the daytime heat.
nightertime.meta: Nightertime – bu tun vaqti, kechasi degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ayniqsa, by nightertime iborasi “tun davomida”, “tun vaqtida” ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Shu bilan birga, a-nightertime sifatida ham qo‘llanilishi mumkin.

ex: The life of an nkuba kyeyo can be very challenging due to low wages.
Many nkuba kyeyo work abroad to support their families back home.
nkuba kyeyo.meta: Nkuba kyeyo – bu Ugandadan chiqqan va xorijda, ayniqsa, kam maoshli yoki malakasiz ish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxsni ifodalaydi. Bu atama ko‘pincha mehnat migrantlari haqida ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, kyeyo so‘zining kengroq ma’nosi bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Nyama choma is often served with ugali or kachumbari in East Africa.
We enjoyed delicious nyama choma at the family gathering.
nyama choma.meta: Nyama choma – bu Sharqiy Afrika oshxonasiga xos, qovurilgan yoki grilda pishirilgan go‘sht taomi. Odatda bu taom bayramlar, yig‘ilishlar va oilaviy uchrashuvlarda tayyorlanadi va juda mashhur.

ex: His actions set a positive nyayo for others to emulate.
The young leader decided to follow the nyayo of his predecessor.
nyayo.meta: Nyayo – bu biror shaxs tomonidan qo‘yilgan namuna yoki ilgari bosib o‘tilgan yo‘l, yo‘l-yo‘riq degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ko‘pincha to follow a person’s nyayo iborasi “kimningdir izidan borish”, “kimningdir yo‘lini davom ettirish” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The legal document mentioned "Brown and ors." as plaintiffs.
The case title reads "Smith and ors. v. Johnson".
ors..meta: ors. – bu huquqiy ishlar sarlavhalarida "boshqalar" degan ma’noda ishlatiladigan grafik qisqartma. Ko‘pincha and ors. shaklida, ya’ni “va boshqalar” ma’nosida keladi.

ex: The crowd shouted oyee! to encourage the team.
Oyee! You can do it!
oyee.meta: Oyee – bu rag‘batlantirish, dalda berish yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlash ma’nosida ishlatiladigan chaqiriq yoki shovqinli ifoda.

ex: A pangender person may feel connected to various genders fluidly over time.
She identifies as pangender, embracing multiple gender identities at once.
pangender.meta: Pangender – bu bir nechta jinsiy identifikatsiyalarni o‘zida mujassam etgan, ya’ni bir vaqtda yoki o‘zgaruvchan tarzda bir nechta jinslarni his qiluvchi yoki ularga tegishli deb hisoblaydigan no-binar shaxsni tasvirlovchi atama.

ex: The parabasketball tournament was held alongside the Paralympic Games.
She competes in paraswimming at the international level.
para-.meta: Para- – bu sport nomlaridan oldin qo‘shilib, ularning Paralimpiya shaklini ko‘rsatadigan prefiks. Masalan, parabasketball (Paralimpiya basketboli), paraswimming (Paralimpiya suzishi), parasnowboarding (Paralimpiya snoubordingi) kabi so‘zlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Take your time and do the work pole pole.
Walk pole pole on the slippery path to avoid falling.
pole pole.meta: Pole pole – bu sekin yoki ehtiyotkorlik bilan, shoshilmasdan amalga oshiriladigan harakatni ifodalovchi qo‘shimcha so‘z. Shuningdek, bu so‘z rag‘batlantirish yoki tinchlantirish ma’nosida istisno sifatida (interjektsiya sifatida) ham ishlatiladi.

ex: She said pole sana after breaking the vase.
Pole sana, I didn’t mean to upset you.
pole sana.meta: Pole sana – bu o‘z xatti-harakatlari uchun uzr so‘rash yoki afsus bildirish, shuningdek, noxush vaziyat uchun hamdardlik bildirish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora. Ma’nosi: “Kechirasiz”, “Juda afsusdaman”, “Afsuski” kabi ifodalar bilan teng.

ex: A postnup can help couples manage assets and debts fairly.
They signed a postnup to clarify their financial responsibilities after marriage.
postnup.meta: Postnup – bu er-xotin nikohdan keyin tuzadigan huquqiy shartnoma yoki kelishuv bo‘lib, unda ularning huquqiy va moliyaviy majburiyatlari hamda huquqlari batafsil belgilab qo‘yiladi.

ex: He sambaza credits to his friend’s phone.
Can you sambaza me some airtime? I’m running low.
sambaza.meta: Sambaza – bu asosan mobil telefon kreditini boshqasiga yuborish ma’nosini anglatadi. Shu bilan birga, so‘z keng ma’noda nimanidir boshqalar bilan bo‘lishish yoki yuborish harakatini ham ifodalaydi.

ex: The kitchen has several saucepots of different sizes.
She simmered the tomato sauce in a small saucepot.
saucepot.meta: Saucepot – bu dastlab sous tayyorlash yoki xizmat qilish uchun ishlatiladigan qozon bo‘lib, keyinchalik umumiy ma’noda, qopqoqli metalldan yasalgan va har qanday taomni pishirish uchun ishlatiladigan qozon sifatida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: The child looked up at the sky with saucered eyes full of wonder.
Her eyes were saucered with shock when she heard the news.
saucered.meta: ko‘zlar uchun ishlatilganda, bu so‘z dumaloq va kengaygan ko‘zlarni, odatda hayrat, qo‘rqish yoki boshqa kuchli his-tuyg‘ular bilan yuzaga kelgan ko‘z ifodasini ifodalaydi.

ex: She speaks Sena, which is widely used in parts of Mozambique.
The Sena people have a rich cultural heritage.
sena.meta: Sena – bu Mozambikning markaziy va shimoliy-g‘arbiy, shuningdek, Malawi va Zimbabvening qo‘shni hududlarida yashovchi Sena xalqi va ularning Bantu tillar oilasiga mansub tilidir.

ex: Many smallholders prefer to share-farm rather than lease the land outright.
They decided to share-farm the land to reduce individual risks.
share-farm.meta: Share-farm – bu yer egasi bilan fermer o‘rtasida xarajatlar va foydani bo‘lishish shartnomasiga ko‘ra yerda dehqonchilik qilish harakati.

ex: A durable share mould is essential for making effective ploughshares.
The blacksmith heated the share mould before shaping it into a ploughshare.
share mould.meta: Share mould – bu org‘a (ploughshare) yasash uchun mo‘ljallangan, shakllantirilib, o'tkir qilinadigan qalin temir yoki po‘lat plastinka. Ushbu plastinka org‘aning kesuvchi qismi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Experts warn about the risks of sharenting without children’s consent.
Many parents engage in sharenting to keep family and friends updated.
sharenting.meta: Sharenting – bu ota-onalar yoki vasiylar tomonidan o‘z farzandlari haqidagi yangiliklar, suratlar yoki videolarni ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda ulashish amaliyotidir.

ex: The kids decided to play sharesies with the toys.
Let’s go sharesies on the pizza and split it equally.
sharesies.meta: Sharesies – bu asosan bolalar yoki o‘yin-kulgi tilida, biror narsani boshqalar bilan bo‘lishish yoki birga ishlatish harakatini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha quyidagi iboralarda ishlatiladi:

ex: Many young people in Nairobi speak Sheng as their everyday language.
Sheng mixes Swahili grammar with English vocabulary.
sheng.meta: Sheng – bu Swahili tili bilan ingliz tili va boshqa tillarning leksik va grammatik elementlarini aralashtirgan ko‘cha tili bo‘lib, ayniqsa yoshlar subkulturasi doirasida paydo bo‘lgan

ex: The teacher noticed several examples of shrubbing during the pronunciation practice.
Language learners often struggle with shrubbing when they first start speaking.
shrubbing.meta: Shrubbing – bu biror so‘z yoki so‘zlarni boshqa tilda, lekin ularni aytishda ona tilining talaffuz odatlari ta’sirida chiqarish harakati yoki odatidir

ex: The DJ played a fast-paced singeli track at the party.
Singeli music is very popular among the youth in Tanzania.
singeli.meta: Singeli – bu Tanzaniyada paydo bo‘lgan, juda tez tempdagi elektron raqs musiqasi janri bo‘lib, unda hip-hop uslubi bilan birga Sharqiy Afrika xalq musiqasi va madaniyatining ta’sirlari uyg‘unlashgan.

ex: The term sistergirl recognizes gender diversity within Indigenous cultures.
In Aboriginal communities, a sistergirl plays an important social role.
sistergirl.meta: Sistergirl – bu Avstraliya aborigen jamiyatida, tug‘ilganida erkak deb ro‘yxatga olingan, lekin o‘zini ayol jinsida tan oladigan yoki ayolona jinsiy ifodani ko‘rsatadigan shaxsni bildiradi.

ex: The British authorities required a situpa for movement between regions.
During colonial times, many Africans carried a situpa as identification.
situpa.meta: Situpa – bu Janubiy Rodiziya (hozirgi Zimbabwe) va Shimoliy Rodiziya (hozirgi Zambia) hududlarida Britaniya mustamlakachilik hukumatlari tomonidan berilgan rasmiy hujjatdir.

ex: The recipe for sorpotel has been passed down through generations.
Sorpotel is a spicy pork dish popular in Goa and parts of Brazil.
sorpotel.meta: Sorpotel – bu portugal oshxonasidan kelib chiqqan va sobiq portugal mustamlakalarida, ayniqsa Braziliyaning shimoli-sharqiy qismi, Hindistonning Goa shahri va Zanzibar orolida mashhur bo‘lgan maxsus taomdir

ex: The South Sudanese government was established in 2011.
Many South Sudanese people speak several local languages.
south sudanese.meta: South Sudanese – bu so‘z Janubiy Sudan mamlakati yoki uning aholisi bilan bog‘liq narsalarni yoki odamlarni bildiradi. Hozirgi vaqtda aynan Janubiy Sudan Respublikasi bilan bog‘liq degan ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: Many vegetarians eat soya-based protein products.
She prefers soya-based milk instead of cow’s milk.
soya-based.meta: Soya-based – bu asosiy tarkibida soya loviyasi bo‘lgan yoki soya asosida tayyorlangan ovqat yoki ichimlikni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: Soy-based milk is popular among people who are lactose intolerant.
Many vegetarians prefer soy-based products instead of meat.
soy-based.meta: Soy-based – bu asosiy tarkibida soya loviyasi bo‘lgan yoki soya asosida tayyorlangan ovqat yoki ichimliklarni ifodalovchi sifat. Keyinchalik, ayniqsa, go‘sht o‘rnini bosuvchi yoki o‘rniga iste’mol qilinadigan mahsulotlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

ex: The restaurant offers delicious soysage for vegan customers.
Many people choose soysage as a healthier alternative to traditional sausage.
soysage.meta: Soysage – bu go‘sht o‘rniga soyadan tayyorlangan, odatda vegan odamlar iste’mol qiladigan vegetarian kolbasa. Go‘sht o‘rnini bosuvchi sog‘lom va hayvon mahsulotlarisiz tayyorlangan mahsulot hisoblanadi.

ex: Critics accuse the government of sportswashing to cover up human rights abuses.
Some countries try to sportswash their image by hosting international tournaments.
sportswash.meta: Sportswash – bu sport yoki sport tadbirlarini ishlatib, homiylik qiluvchi yoki mezbon bo‘lgan hukumat, tashkilot yoki kompaniyaning obro‘sini yaxshilash yoki ijobiy ko‘rsatish maqsadida amalga oshiriladigan harakat.

ex: Critics say sportswashing is used to distract from human rights violations.
The country was accused of sportswashing by hosting the World Cup.
sportswashing.meta: Sportswashing – bu sport yoki sport tadbirlari orqali homiylik qiluvchi yoki mezbon tashkilot (odatda hukumat yoki biznes) o‘zining ijobiy obro‘sini oshirish yoki salbiy e’tirozlardan e’tiborni chalg‘itish maqsadida qo‘llaydigan amaliyot.

ex: Improving standability helps prevent crop losses during storms
The wheat variety has excellent standability even in strong winds.
standability.meta: Standability – bu biror ekin yoki o‘simlikning, tashqi yordam yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlashsiz, o‘z-o‘zidan tik turish qobiliyatini bildiradi. Bu ko‘pincha qishloq xo‘jaligi sohasida ekinlarning barqarorligini va hosildorligini baholash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The standard class carriage is usually more crowded than first class.
I booked a standard class ticket for the train to London.
standard class.meta: Standard class – bu Buyuk Britaniya va Irlandiya temiryo‘l tizimlarida sayohat qiluvchilar uchun eng arzon narxdagi turar joy yoki o‘tirish joyini bildiradi.

ex: Editors often write the standfirst to attract readers’ attention.
The article’s standfirst gave a quick overview of the main points.
standfirst.meta: Standfirst – bu gazeta yoki veb-saytdagi maqola sarlavhasidan keyin joylashgan, maqolaning asosiy mazmunini qisqacha bayon qiluvchi kirish qismi.

ex: He exercised his stand your ground right when threatened at home.
The state has a stand your ground law allowing self-defence without retreat.
stand your ground.meta: Stand your ground – bu huquqiy printsip yoki ayrim shtatlar qonuni bo‘lib, u shaxsga o‘z jonini yoki mulkini himoya qilish uchun avval orqaga chekinmasdan, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri o‘ldiruvchi kuch qo‘llashga ruxsat beradi.

ex: Victims of stealthing often feel betrayed and unsafe.
Stealthing is considered a serious violation of consent.
stealthing.meta: Stealthing – bu jinsiy aloqada sherikning xabari yoki roziligisiz prezervativni yashirincha olib tashlash yoki ba’zida uni avvaldan ataylab buzish harakati.

ex: Listening to music has a stress-busting effect on many people.
Yoga is a popular stress-busting activity.
stress-busting.meta: Stress-busting – bu stressni kamaytirishga yoki yo‘q qilishga yordam beradigan harakat, vosita yoki holatni ifodalaydi. Shuningdek, bu atama stressdan qutulish uchun qilinadigan faoliyat yoki metodni ham anglatishi mumkin.

ex: Holding a squat for a long time can be a difficult stress position.
Prisoners were forced to maintain a painful stress position for hours.
stress position.meta: bu odamning mushaklari, bo‘g‘imlari va suyaklariga zo‘riqish yoki og‘irlik tushadigan tana holati yoki pozitsiyasi. Ko‘pincha bunday pozitsiyalar noqulay bo‘lib, uzoq vaqt davomida ushlab turilganda og‘riq yoki shikastlanishga olib kelishi mumkin.

ex: Listening to music can act as a stress reliever after a long day.
Exercise is a great stress reliever for many people.
stress reliever.meta: Stress reliever – bu insonga emotsional yoki jismoniy stressni yengillashtirishga yordam beradigan harakat, narsa yoki modda. Bunday vositalar odatda dam olish, xotirjamlik va ruhiy sog‘liqni yaxshilash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Administrative duties are often divided between locations and their sub-locations.
The village is part of a sub-location within the larger location area.
sub-location.meta: Keniya davlatining ma’muriy tuzilmasida joylashuv (location) ning kichikroq bo‘linmasi bo‘lib, ma’lum hududni boshqarishda yordam beruvchi kichik ma’muriy rayon hisoblanadi. Bu hududlar joylardagi boshqaruvni yanada samarali qilish uchun tashkil etilgan.

ex: She is proud of her Sudanian heritage.
The Sudanian desert stretches across parts of Sudan and neighboring countries.
sudanian.meta: Sudanian – bu Sudan mamlakatiga yoki uning aholisi, madaniyati, tabiati bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan. Odatda “Sudanese” (Sudanlik) so‘zi bilan almashtiriladi. Shu bilan birga, geografik yoki etnik ma’noda ham ishlatilishi mumkin.

ex: Cells that are sudanophil stain red when treated with Sudan dye.
The tissue sample was sudanophil, indicating high lipid content.
sudanophil.meta: Sudanophil – bu Sudan bo‘yoqni (lipidlarni belgilash uchun ishlatiladigan bo‘yoq) o‘zlashtiradigan yoki unga moyil bo‘lgan, ya’ni yog‘li moddalarni to‘qima yoki hujayralarda aniqlashda foydalaniladigan xususiyatni bildiradi

ex: Many artists blend taarab with modern music styles.
Taarab music is an important cultural expression in East Africa.
taarab.meta: Taarab – bu Zanzibardan kelib chiqqan musiqa shakli bo‘lib, u arabcha kuy va qo‘shiqlar uslubini Afrika va Hindiston musiqasi elementlari bilan uyg‘unlashtiradi.

ex: The group criticized the TERF stance on inclusion.
She was labeled a TERF because of her views on transgender rights.
terf.meta: bu ayollar huquqlarini himoya qiluvchi feminist, lekin transgendar ayollar huquqlarini kiritmaslik yoki inkor etish tarafdori bo‘lgan shaxsni ifodalaydi. Ko‘pincha bu so‘z tanqidi yoki nojo‘ya ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: She is a proud member of the Tonga community.
The Tonga people have a rich cultural heritage in Malawi.
tonga.meta: Tonga – bu Malaviya hududida yashovchi va Bantu til oilasiga mansub tillarda so‘zlashuvchi xalq vakili. Shu bilan birga, bu so‘z Malaviylik tongalik odam yoki unga oid narsalarni ifodalash uchun sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Drivers rely on turn-by-turn instructions to avoid getting lost.
The app provides turn-by-turn directions to your destination.
turn-by-turn.meta: Turn-by-turn – bu avtomobil yoki boshqa transport vositasining har bir burilish joyiga yetib kelganda (odatda GPS tizimi orqali) beriladigan aniq va ketma-ket yo‘nalish ko‘rsatmalari.

ex: The fermented millet flour gives the uji a slightly sour taste.
Many families in Kenya start their day with a bowl of uji.
uji.meta: Uji – bu Keniya va Tanzaniya oshxonalarida tayyorlanadigan, odatda nonushta vaqtida iste’mol qilinadigan yengil, suyuq holatdagi ovqat. U asosan jo‘xori, makkajo‘xori, yoki boshqa donlardan (ba’zida fermentlangan) qaynatilib tayyorlanadi.

ex: The cook mixed water with unga to prepare a thick porridge.
Unga is used to make ugali, a staple food in East Africa.
unga.meta: Unga – bu Sharqiy Afrika mintaqasida, xususan ugali (makkajo‘xori qovurmasi) tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan makkajo‘xori uni yoki makkajo‘xori uniga o‘xshash don unidir. Bu un asosiy oziq-ovqat mahsuloti hisoblanadi.

ex: The clinic offers free vaccines to the unjabbed.
Many people remain unjabbed due to vaccine hesitancy.
unjabbed.meta: Unjabbed – bu vaksina qilinmagan yoki emlash jarayonidan o‘tmagan holat yoki odamni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z odatda COVID-19 yoki boshqa kasalliklarga qarshi emlanmagan odamlarni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Many complained about the unprocedural handling of the election.
The decision was made in an unprocedural manner, causing controversy.
unprocedural.meta: Unprocedural – bu qonuniy yoki belgilangan tartibga binoan amalga oshirilmagan, rasmiy protsedura yoki qoidalarni buzgan holat yoki ishni ifodalaydi. Bu atama tartibsizlik yoki noqonuniylik ma’nolarini ham o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: The hospital is trying to encourage the unvaxxed to get vaccinated.
Many people remain unvaxxed due to vaccine hesitancy.
unvaxxed.meta: Unvaxxed – bu vaksina qilinmagan yoki emlash jarayonidan o‘tmagan odam yoki holat. Asosan COVID-19 va boshqa kasalliklarga qarshi emlanmagan odamlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: She is a strong vaxxer, encouraging everyone to get vaccinated.
The vaxxer administered vaccines to hundreds of people during the campaign.
vaxxer.meta: Vaxxer — bu vaksinatsiya qiluvchi shaxs yoki ommaviy emlashni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi odam. Ko‘pincha anti-vaxxer (emlashga qarshi odam)ga qarshi qo‘yiladi.

ex: During the conflict, many families were forcibly villagized.
The government decided to villagize remote communities to improve access to services.
villagize.meta: Villagize – bu oldin tarqalgan yoki tarqoq aholini boshqarish, nazorat qilish yoki ma'lum hududlarni boshqarishni osonlashtirish maqsadida odamlarni rejalashtirilgan qishloqlarga ko‘chirish jarayoni.

ex: During the negotiations, he showed some ankle about his real intentions.
The politician began to show some ankle by hinting at upcoming policy changes.
to show some ankle.meta: To show some ankle – bu (asosan siyosatda) o‘z niyatlari, rejasi yoki ma’lumotlaridan bir qismini bilish yoki ko‘rsatish, shubha tug‘dirish yoki ishora qilish ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: Traditional Indian dancers often use ankle bells to accentuate their footwork.
The dancers wore ankle bells that jingled as they moved.
ankle bell.meta: Ankle bell — bu oyoq bilagiga bog‘langan va raqqosalar tomonidan raqs chog‘ida tovush chiqarish uchun ishlatiladigan kichik metall qo‘ng‘iroqlarning bir nechtasi. Odatda ko‘p sonli qo‘ng‘iroqlar zanjir shaklida biriktiriladi.

ex: She wore a delicate gold ankle-chain as part of her summer outfit.
The prisoner was held by an ankle-chain to prevent escape.
ankle-chain.meta: a) oyoq bilagini cheklash yoki mahkamlash uchun ishlatiladigan zanjir yoki qo‘lbola taqiq (masalan, qullik davrida ishlatilgan); b) oyoq bilagiga taqiladigan, ko‘proq bezak yoki modani ifodalovchi zanjir

ex: No taxis available, so it was the ankle express for me today!
When the bus didn’t arrive, I had to take the ankle express to get home.
ankle express.meta: Ankle express — bu piyoda yurish harakatini kulgili yoki hazil tariqasida jamoat transporti shakli sifatida ta’riflash. Odatda odamlar o‘z oyog‘i bilan “sayohat qilish” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The skirt was ankle-grazing, giving her a graceful look.
She wore an elegant ankle-grazing dress to the party.
ankle-grazing.meta: Ankle-grazing — bu kiyimning uzunligi oyoq bilagini qisman yoki to‘liq qoplaydigan darajada bo‘lishini bildiradi. Odatda uzun ko‘ylaklar, yubkalar yoki shimlar haqida ishlatiladi.

ex: The doctor measured the ankle-height to check for swelling.
She wore ankle-height boots to protect her feet from the snow.
ankle-height.meta: a) Ankle-height — bu odam oyog‘ining yerga nisbatan balandligi, ya’ni oyog‘ bilagining balandligi. b) Ankle-height — bu kiyim yoki buyumning oyoq bilagigacha yetadigan yoki qoplaydigan uzunlikda ekanligini bildiruvchi sifat.

ex: The detective wore an ankle holster under his pants.
He kept his pistol in an ankle holster for easy access
ankle holster.meta: Ankle holster — bu qo‘l qurolini (masalan, tizza yoki to‘ponga qaraganda kichikroq) oyoq bilagiga osib yurish uchun mo‘ljallangan sumka yoki taqilma. Odatda maxfiy yoki qulay olib yurish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Authorities use an ankle monitor to track parolees.
The offender was released on bail with an ankle monitor attached.
ankle monitor.meta: Ankle monitor — bu odamning joylashuvini yoki ba’zida qon tarkibidagi spirt miqdorini nazorat qilish uchun oyoq bilagiga taqiladigan elektron qurilma. Odatda sud tomonidan jazo yoki nazorat ostidagi shaxslar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: He chose ankle-skimming trousers for the warm weather.
She wore an elegant ankle-skimming dress to the event.
ankle-skimming.meta: Ankle-skimming — bu kiyimning uzunligi oyoq bilagini qisman yoki to‘liq taqillata oladigan darajada bo‘lishini bildiradi. Odatda uzun ko‘ylaklar, yubkalar yoki shimlar haqida ishlatiladi.

ex: These ankle-strapped heels are very comfortable.
She wore elegant ankle-strapped sandals to the party.
ankle-strapped.meta: Ankle-strapped — bu oyoq kiyimining oyoq bilagiga tasma yoki bog‘ich yordamida mahkamlangan turini ifodalaydi. Odatda sandallar, tufli yoki boshqa ayollar uchun kiyimlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: He was injured due to an illegal ankle tap during the match.
The referee called a foul after the player committed an ankle tap.
ankle tap.meta: (a) Futbolda: raqibning oyoq bilagini tepib, qoida buzish; (b) Regbida: mudofaa o‘yinchisi raqibga qarab sakrab, uning oyoq bilagini ushlash yoki tepishga urinish turi.

ex: Dangerous ankle tapping is often discouraged to prevent injuries.
The player was penalized for ankle tapping during the football match.
ankle tapping.meta: (a) Futbolda: raqibning oyoq bilagini tepib, qoida buzish harakati; (b) Regbida: mudofaa o‘yinchisi raqibning oyoq bilagini ushlash yoki tepishga urinish orqali to‘xtatish harakati.

ex: The athlete used an ankle wrap to prevent injury during the game.
After twisting his ankle, he wore an ankle wrap for support.
ankle wrap.meta: ankle wrap — (a) Oyoq bilagini jarohatdan keyin bosim va qo‘llab-quvvatlash uchun o‘raladigan bandaj yoki tayanch; (b) sport bilan shug‘ullanish paytida oyoq bilagini barqarorlashtirish uchun ishlatiladigan vosita.

ex: She unzipped the ankle zip to make the pants looser around her ankles.
The boots have an ankle zip for easy wearing and removal.
ankle zip.meta: ankle zip — kiyim yoki poyabzalning oyoq bilagi qismida joylashgan fermuar.

ex: She planned her annual leave to coincide with the holidays.
Employees are entitled to annual leave every year.
annual leave.meta: Annual leave — ishchining yil davomida olish huquqiga ega bo‘lgan, odatda maosh bilan to‘lanadigan ruxsat etilgan ta’til davri.

ex: The annual parallax of a star helps determine how far it is from Earth.
Astronomers measure the annual parallax to calculate the distance to nearby stars.
annual parallax.meta: Yillik parallaks — yulduz yoki boshqa osmon jismining joylashuvidagi yil davomida Yerning orbitadagi o‘zgarishi sababli yuzaga keladigan maksimal ko‘zga ko‘rinadigan pozitsiya farqi.

ex: Meteorologists study the annual range to understand climate variability.
The annual range of temperature in this region is quite large.
annual range.meta: Yillik diapazon — bir yil davomida kuzatilgan iqlim o‘zgaruvchilarining (ayniqsa, o‘rtacha oylik haroratning) eng yuqori va eng past qiymatlari orasidagi farqning kattaligi.

ex: Shareholders review the annual report to assess the company’s performance.
The company published its annual report last week.
annual report.meta: Yillik hisobot — davlat tashkiloti, jamiyat yoki boshqa tashkilot tomonidan har yili chiqariladigan, o‘tgan yil davomida amalga oshirilgan faoliyatlar yoki voqealarni hujjatlashtiruvchi rasmiy qaydnoma

ex: The church held a special service to mark Annunciation Day.
Christians celebrate Annunciation Day on March 25th every year.
annunciation day.meta: Xushxabar kuni — cherkov bayrami bo‘lib, bunda Arximandrit Gavriil Farishtasi Payg‘ambar Maryamga ilohiy g‘ayrioddiy homiladorlik haqida xabar bergan kun eslanadi.

ex: Anomalous water behaves differently compared to regular water under certain conditions.
Scientists studied the properties of anomalous water in their experiments.
anomalous water.meta: Anomal suv — oddiy suvdan keskin farq qiluvchi xususiyatlarga ega bo‘lgan, polimer shaklida bo‘lishi taxmin qilingan suv turi; bu suv mayda kapillyarlarda aniqlangani haqida aytiladi.

ex: You can download the files using anonymous FTP without needing a username.
Many universities provide anonymous FTP access to share research papers.
anonymous ftp.meta: Anonim FTP — foydalanuvchidan autentifikatsiya (kirish uchun login va parol) talab qilmaydigan, bepul yoki jamoat FTP serveriga kirish imkoniyati; bunday kirish qobiliyati.

ex: She was one of the few anoraked attendees at the outdoor concert.
The festival was full of anoraked hikers prepared for the cold weather.
anoraked.meta: Anorak kiygan odam — anorak kiygan shaxs; anorak kiyim kiyganlik holati.

ex: Sorry, I can’t meet today. Maybe another time?
Can we talk about this another time? I’m busy right now.
another time.meta: Boshqa safar — keyingi safar, hozir emas, odatda savolga javob sifatida yoki suhbatni kechiktirish yoki rad etish ma'nosida ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, savol shaklida ham ishlatiladi: “buni boshqa safar qilamizmi?”

ex: If we had met another time, another place, things could have been different.
That event might happen another time, another place when conditions are different.
another time, another place.meta: Boshqa payt, boshqa joy — asosan AQShda ishlatiladi; uzoq yoki boshqa sharoitlarni, holatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha vaqt va joy jihatidan farqli, uzoq yoki noma’lum vaziyatlarni anglatadi.

ex: The hikers were all bandanaed to protect themselves from the sun.
She walked into the room bandanaed, looking stylish and confident.
bandanaed.meta: Bandanali — boshida yoki bo‘ynida bandana (katta va odatda rang-barang mato) taqib olgan, bandana bilan qoplangan yoki o‘ralgan holat.

ex: Proper maintenance of the bobsleigh shoes is essential for a successful race.
The technician replaced the worn-out bobsleigh shoes to improve the sled’s speed.
bobsleigh shoe.meta: Bobslay poyabzali (poshnasi) — yog‘ochdan yasalgan bobslay yuguruvchisining tag qismiga o‘rnatiladigan, silliq va odatda egilgan shakldagi temir qism bo‘lib, u ishqalanishni kamaytirish va tezlikni oshirish uchun xizmat qiladi

ex: Police arrested the bordel owner during the investigation.
The bordel owner was responsible for managing all the workers.
bordel owner.meta: Bordel egasi — jinsiy xizmat ko‘rsatadigan joy (bordel) mulkiga egalik qiluvchi shaxs.

ex: He dressed Brahmanically for the religious festival.
The ceremony was conducted Brahmanically, following ancient religious rituals.
brahmanically.meta: Brahmancha — Brahmanizm yoki Brahmanlar bilan bog‘liq, ularning an’analari, e’tiqodlari yoki odatlariga muvofiq bajarilgan yoki amalga oshirilgan tarzda.

ex: Police questioned the brothel madam during the investigation.
The brothel madam managed the business and the workers.
brothel madam.meta: Bordel xonimi — jinsiy xizmat ko‘rsatadigan joy (bordel) egasi yoki boshqaruvchisi bo‘lgan ayol.

ex: Remember, a bully is always a coward, so don’t be afraid to stand up to them.
They say a bully is always a coward because they are afraid to face real challenges.
a bully is always a coward.meta: Zo‘ravon doimo qo‘rqoq bo‘ladi — doim boshqalarni zo‘rlash, tahdid qilish yoki zo‘rlash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi odam aslida jasoratdan yiroq, qo‘rqoq kishidir, degan maqol.

ex: The bully van arrived quickly at the scene to detain the protesters.
The suspects were taken away in a bully van after the arrest.
bully van.meta: Politsiya mikroavtobusi — politsiya xodimlari yoki hibsga olinganlarni olib yurish uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus avtobus yoki yuk mashinasi.

ex: Bunker fuel is known to be one of the dirtiest types of marine fuel.
The ship was refueled with bunker fuel before setting sail.
bunker fuel.meta: Bunker yoqilg‘isi — kemalar dvigatellarini ishlatish uchun ishlatiladigan yoqilg‘i turi. Dastlab ko‘mir bo‘lgan, keyinchalik esa og‘ir yoqilg‘i moyi sifatida ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha eng past sifatdagi og‘ir yoqilg‘i moyi nazarda tutiladi.

ex: The country set a carbon budget to limit its greenhouse gas emissions by 2030.
Scientists calculated the carbon budget of the forest to understand its role in the carbon cycle.
carbon budget.meta: (a) organizmlar yoki ekotizimlarda karbon elementining kirish-chiqishlari va saqlanishini hisobga oluvchi yozuv yoki hisob-kitob. Bu karbon aylanishi jarayonining bir qismi hisoblanadi

ex: The community had a caste-like hierarchy that affected everyone’s status.
Some social structures are caste-like, with rigid divisions between groups.
caste-like.meta: Kastaga o‘xshash — kasta yoki ijtimoiy tabaqalarga bo‘linish tizimiga xos yoki shunga o‘xshash xususiyatlarni ko‘rsatadigan, shunday tizimni eslatadigan.

ex: Many social movements fight for castelessness to end discrimination.
The idea of castelessness promotes equality and social harmony.
castelessness.meta: Kastasizlik — ijtimoiy hayotda kasta tizimining yo‘qligi, odamlar orasida kasta asosidagi farqlarning bo‘lmasligi.

ex: The party featured vintage champagne served in classic champagne saucers.
She poured the champagne into elegant champagne saucers.
champagne saucer.meta: Shampan baklajkasi — shampan sharobini xizmat qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan, tayoqchasi bo‘lgan, keng va past qobiq shaklidagi shisha idish.

ex: Reality shows often have a strong cringe factor that makes viewers uncomfortable.
The cringe factor of his speech was high because of his awkward jokes.
cringe factor.meta: Uyatchoqlik omili — odamni keskin uyatga soladigan yoki qattiq noqulaylikka olib keladigan holat yoki voqeaning bir qismi.

ex: DMs are known for their durability and distinctive style.
She wore her favorite DMs to the concert.
dm (plural dms).meta: DMlar — Dr. Martens nomli mashhur oyoq kiyimlari brendiga oid etiklar yoki poyabzallar.

ex: Danger signs are usually bright and easy to notice.
The danger sign warned drivers about slippery roads ahead.
danger sign.meta: Xavf belgisi — odamlarni ehtiyot bo‘lishga chaqiruvchi, yuzaga kelishi mumkin bo‘lgan xavf yoki zarar haqida ogohlantiruvchi rasm yoki belgilar.

ex: He changed his opinion on a dime after hearing the new information.
The car can turn on a dime, making it easy to maneuver in tight spots.
on a dime.meta: Juda kichik joyda (tezda, birdaniga) — juda qisqa masofada yoki joyda sodir bo‘ladigan harakat; shuningdek, nimadir juda tez yoki kutilmaganda yuz berishini ifodalaydi.

ex: Children with disproportionate dwarfism may need special medical care.
Disproportionate dwarfism causes the limbs to be much shorter than the trunk.
disproportionate dwarfism.meta: Nisbiy nomutanosib kichik o‘sish — organizmning oyoq va qo‘llari tananing tanasi (torso) qismlariga nisbatan boshqacha darajada qisqarishi bilan tavsiflanadigan kichik bo‘yli bo‘lish holati.

ex: Drying oils help paint to harden and protect surfaces.
Linseed oil is a common type of drying oil used in painting.
drying oil.meta: Quriydigan yog‘ — havoda qotib, mustahkam va qattiq qoplama hosil qiluvchi, yog‘li bo‘yoqlar va laklarda keng qo‘llaniladigan yog‘ turi.

ex: Dwarf honeysuckle is an important plant in its native ecosystems.
The dwarf honeysuckle grows close to the ground in mountainous areas.
dwarf honeysuckle.meta: Kichkina asalarichilik o‘simligi — Yevropa, Osiyo va Shimoliy Amerikaning tog‘ va maysazor hududlarida o‘sadigan, past o‘suvchi, ko‘p yillik o‘t o‘simlik turi. Oilasi Cornaceae ga mansub.

ex: Dwarf lemurs are among the smallest members of the primate family.
The dwarf lemur is a nocturnal primate that lives in trees.
dwarf lemur.meta: Kichik lemur — Cheirogaleidae oilasiga kiruvchi, daraxtda yashaydigan va asosan kechqurun yoki tun davomida faol bo‘lgan juda kichik lemur turi.

ex: Dwarf galaxies are important for understanding the formation of larger galaxies.
The Milky Way has several dwarf galaxies orbiting around it.
dwarf galaxy.meta: Kichik galaktika — nisbatan kichik o‘lchamli va kam yorqinlikka ega bo‘lgan galaktika turi.

ex: Dwarf signals are used to provide additional safety at railway yards.
The train stopped at the dwarf signal before entering the station.
dwarf signal.meta: Kichik signal — temiryo‘l tizimida uyni bildiruvchi past darajadagi signal, odatda ko‘rish uchun pastroq joylashgan.

ex: Extracurricularly, students can join various interest groups.
She participates extracurricularly in sports and music clubs.
extracurricularly.meta: O‘quv dasturidan tashqari — ta’lim jarayonidagi asosiy fanlar va darslardan tashqari bajariladigan faoliyatlar yoki mashg‘ulotlar.

ex: A good financial adviser helps clients plan for their future.
She consulted a financial adviser before investing her savings.
financial adviser.meta: Moliyaviy maslahatchi — mijozlarga moliya, investitsiya va boshqa moliyaviy mahsulotlar bo‘yicha maslahat beradigan va ularning moliyaviy maqsadlariga erishishda yordam beradigan mutaxassis.

ex: During a financial crisis, many banks may fail or require government support.
The 2008 financial crisis had a huge impact on global markets.
financial crisis.meta: Moliyaviy inqiroz — iqtisodiyotda aktivlar qiymatining keskin tushishi, banklar yoki moliyaviy tashkilotlarning muammolarga duch kelishi va moliyaviy barqarorlikning buzilishi bilan tavsiflangan og‘ir iqtisodiy vaziyat.

ex: Financial instruments help investors diversify their portfolios.
Stocks and bonds are common types of financial instruments.
financial instrument.meta: Moliyaviy instrument — pul mablag‘larini boshqarish yoki investitsiya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan, bozorda savdosi amalga oshiriladigan moliyaviy shartnoma yoki vosita.

ex: Investors watch the financial market closely to make informed decisions.
The financial market plays a crucial role in the economy.
financial market.meta: Moliyaviy bozor — aksiyalar, obligatsiyalar va boshqa moliyaviy aktivlar savdosi uchun tashkil etilgan, investorlar va kompaniyalar o‘rtasida moliyaviy almashinuv yuz beradigan bozor.

ex: Many companies rely on financial services to manage their assets.
Financial services include banking, insurance, and investment management.
financial services.meta: Moliyaviy xizmatlar — bank, investitsiya, sug‘urta, pensiya va boshqa moliyaviy faoliyatlarga oid professional xizmatlar to‘plami.

ex: Financial statements include the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement.
The company released its annual financial statement yesterday.
financial statement.meta: Moliyaviy hisobot — moliyaviy faoliyat va moliyaviy holat haqida ma’lumot beruvchi, kompaniya yoki tashkilot tomonidan tayyorlangan rasmiy hujjat.

ex: Gender expression can vary widely among individuals.
Her gender expression includes wearing traditionally masculine clothing.
gender expression.meta: Jinsiy ifoda — shaxsning o‘z jinsini tashqi ko‘rinishda namoyon etishi; bu uning kiyimi, harakati, ovozi va boshqa tashqi belgilar orqali ifodalanadi.

ex: Gender presentation may not always align with a person’s biological sex.
Their gender presentation is fluid and changes depending on the situation.
gender presentation.meta: Jinsiy taqdimot — shaxsning jinsini tashqi ko‘rinishda ifoda etishi; bu uning kiyimi, harakati, ovozi va boshqa tashqi belgilar orqali namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: Grease nipples help ensure moving parts are properly lubricated.
The mechanic cleaned the grease nipple before applying lubricant.
grease nipple.meta: Yog‘ quyish joyi — mashina qismlariga, ayniqsa rulmanlarga, yog‘ purkagich yordamida yog‘ sepish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus moslama.

ex: Grease pencils are ideal for writing on non-porous materials.
The technician used a grease pencil to mark the glass surface.
grease pencil.meta: Yog‘li qalam — qattiq, silliq va porlanmaydigan yuzalarga, masalan shisha yoki porcelanga yozish yoki belgi qo‘yish uchun ishlatiladigan mum asosidagi rangli qalam.

ex: Heat stress can cause dehydration and heat exhaustion in humans.
Workers experienced heat stress while working outdoors in the summer.
heat stress.meta: Issiq stressi — yuqori harorat sababli obyekt yoki jonli organizmda yuzaga keladigan jismoniy zo‘riqish yoki organizmning harorat oshishiga javoban yuzaga keladigan fiziologik zo‘riqish holati.

ex: He was diagnosed as hypersexual due to his excessive sexual behavior.
Hypersexual individuals may struggle to control their sexual urges.
hypersexual.meta: Giperseksual — odatdagidan ko‘proq jinsiy xohish va faoliyat ko‘rsatadigan, jinsga haddan tashqari ko‘p e’tibor qaratadigan yoki jinsiy faoliyatga haddan tashqari qiziqish bildiradigan holat.

ex: Many banks now offer Islamic finance products to comply with Sharia law.
Islamic finance prohibits charging interest on loans.
islamic finance.meta: Islom moliyasi — foiz (riba) olish yoki berishni man etuvchi, Islom dini qonunlari (Shariat) asosida tashkil etilgan moliyaviy tizim.

ex: Bird watchers enjoy spotting the lark bunting in North America.
The lark bunting is known for its distinctive breeding plumage.
lark bunting.meta: Lark bunting — bu qushlarning ikki turi: birinchisi eski nom bilan makkajo‘xori buntingi deb ataladi; ikkinchisi Shimoliy Amerikada yashovchi, rangi mavsumga qarab o‘zgaradigan kichik qush.

ex: He gave a midgety effort, hardly enough to complete the task.
The plant looked midgety compared to the tall trees around it.
midgety.meta: Kichkina — juda kichik, mayda yoki ahamiyatsiz ko‘rinishga ega, midgetga o‘xshash yoki unga ishora qiluvchi.

ex: She took a course to improve her personal finance skills.
Good personal finance management helps individuals avoid debt.
personal finance.meta: Shaxsiy moliya — shaxs yoki oilaning moliyaviy holatini tashkil etuvchi daromad, xarajatlar, tejash va investitsiya kabi moliyaviy faoliyatlar majmui.

ex: Farmers apply fertilizers more efficiently with precision agriculture techniques.
Precision agriculture uses GPS and sensors to optimize crop yields.
precision agriculture.meta: Aniq qishloq xo‘jaligi — qishloq xo‘jaligi amaliyotida ekinlarning va maydonlarning tabiiy farqlarini hisobga olib, texnologiyalar va resurslarni aniq va samarali boshqarish usuli.

ex: Profoundly deaf individuals often need hearing aids or cochlear implants.
He is profoundly deaf and communicates using sign language.
profoundly deaf.meta: Chuqur eshitmaslik — nutqni faqat eshitish orqali tushunishga to‘sqinlik qiladigan darajada jiddiy eshitish buzilishi.

ex: People with proportionate dwarfism have body parts that are proportional but smaller than average.
In proportionate dwarfism, the limbs and trunk are shortened equally.
proportionate dwarfism.meta: Nisbiy kichik o‘sish — bu kasallikda shaxsning tana qismlari, ya’ni qo‘l-oyoqlari va tanasi o‘zaro nisbatan teng ravishda kichrayadi.

ex: The study of public finance helps understand how governments raise and spend money.
Public finance is essential for funding government services like education and healthcare.
public finance.meta: Davlat moliyasi — hukumatning moliyaviy resurslarini boshqarish, shu jumladan soliqlarni yig‘ish, davlat xarajatlarini amalga oshirish, qarz olish va qarzlarni boshqarish bilan bog‘liq iqtisodiy faoliyat.

ex: Public service announcements often promote health, safety, and environmental issues.
The government aired a public service announcement about the importance of vaccination.
public service announcement.meta: Ommaviy xizmat e’lonlari — jamoat manfaatidagi muhim muammolar haqida xabardorlikni oshirish maqsadida hukumat yoki boshqa tashkilotlar tomonidan tarqatiladigan e’lon yoki xabar.

ex: In queue voting, voters physically stand behind their chosen candidate.
Queue voting was used in some traditional African elections.
queue voting.meta: Navbatda ovoz berish — bu saylov tizimi bo‘lib, unda saylovchilar o‘z tanlagan nomzodlari yoki ularning fotosuratlari ortida navbatda turish orqali o‘z tanlovlarini bildiradilar.

ex: The city is growing rapidly. Sample this: new buildings are coming up every week.
Sample this: a child with no shoes walking five miles to school every day.
sample this.meta: Sample this — bu jumla boshida yoki o‘rtasida ishlatiladigan ifoda bo‘lib, misol keltirish yoki biror narsani tushuntirish uchun kirishib keladi. Asosan “masalan”, “mana misol” yoki “shuni ko‘rib chiqing” kabi tarjima qilinadi.

ex: She's a real sass-box, always speaking her mind without fear.
Don't be such a sass-box!
sass-box.meta: Sass-box — bu beadab, odobsiz yoki haddidan oshgan odamni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, dastlab kibrli yoki qo‘pol odam ma’nosida qo‘llanilgan.

ex: Sasswood trees grow widely across tropical West Africa.
The bark of the sasswood tree was traditionally used in ordeal trials.
sasswood tree.meta: Sasswood daraxti — G‘arbiy Afrikaning tropik hududlarida o‘sadigan, Erythrophleum turkumiga mansub bir nechta dukkakli daraxtlar turi.

ex: The saucer pass landed flat on the ice right in front of his teammate.
He made a perfect saucer pass over the defender's stick.
saucer pass.meta: Saucer pass — bu xokkey o‘yinida ishlatiladigan texnik uzatma bo‘lib, shayba (puck) past balandlikda havoda uchib, aylana harakatida uchuvchi likopchaga (soskaga) o‘xshab sirpanib, muzga tekis tushadi.
