ex: A saucer sled can spin while sliding down the hill.
The children were playing on the hill with a red saucer sled.
saucer sled.meta: Likopcha chana — bu keng, yassi, aylana shaklga ega, odatda plastmassa yoki metall materialdan tayyorlangan, pastga qarab qor yoki muz ustida sirpanish uchun ishlatiladigan chana turi.

ex: they hired a shamba boy to take care of the crops.
the shamba boy helped with planting and harvesting on the farm.
shamba boy.meta: shamba boy — bu asosan fermada yoki plantatsiyada ishlaydigan, jismoniy mehnat bilan shug‘ullanuvchi yigit yoki erkak. Odatda og‘ir qishloq xo‘jaligi ishlarini bajaradigan ishchi.

ex: in the village, the sharemaker is an important craftsman during the planting season.
the sharemaker repaired the broken ploughshare quickly.
sharemaker.meta: sharemaker — bu plug (yer shudgor qiladigan asbob) ning kesuvchi pichog‘i yoki uchi — ya’ni plug pichog‘i (sug‘orish pichog‘i) ni yasaydigan yoki ta’mirlaydigan odam. U yer haydash asboblarini tayyorlash va tuzatish bilan shug‘ullanadi.

ex: living in a share house helps save money on rent and utilities.
they rented a share house near the university.
share house.meta: birga ijaraga olingan uy — bu ikki yoki undan ortiq odam mustaqil ravishda yashaydigan, alohida yotoq xonalariga ega, lekin umumiy oshxona, hammom va boshqa umumiy xonalardan birga foydalaniladigan ijaradagi uy.

ex: the restaurant offers a variety of share plates for groups.
we ordered a share plate of appetizers for the whole table.
share plate.meta: share plate — bu restoranda yoki boshqa ovqatlanish joyida ikki yoki undan ortiq odam birgalikda baham ko‘rib yeyish uchun taqdim etiladigan ovqat yoki likopcha. Bunda bir nechta odam bitta likopchadagi ovqatdan foydalanadi.

ex: in many cities, share-taxis are a cheap and quick way to get around.
the share-taxi stopped several times to pick up other passengers.
share-taxi.meta: yo‘nalishli taksi — bu bir nechta yo‘lovchi bir vaqtning o‘zida umumiy ravishda foydalanadigan va odatda bir yo‘nalish bo‘ylab harakat qiladigan taksi yoki unga o‘xshash transport vositasi.

ex: the building society offers interest on share accounts with no fixed term.
she opened a share account to manage her investments in the company.
share account.meta: Aksiya hisob raqami — bu moliyaviy hisob bo‘lib, unda shaxs yoki tashkilotga tegishli aksiyalar yoki ulushlar saqlanadi yoki u bilan bog‘liq ma’lumotlar yuritiladi.

ex: investors prefer companies that offer regular share dividends.
the company declared a share dividend of $2 per share.
share dividend.meta: Aksiya dividendlari — bu kompaniya tomonidan o‘z aksiyadorlariga yiliga yoki belgilangan davrda muntazam ravishda to‘lanadigan pul miqdori bo‘lib, odatda kompaniya foydasi yoki zaxiralaridan to‘lanadi. Bu to‘lov aksiyaga egalik huquqi asosida beriladi.

ex: Share dividends are usually distributed annually to all shareholders.
The company announced a share dividend of $1 per share.
share dividend.meta: Aksiya dividendlari — bu kompaniya o‘z foydasidan yoki zahiralardan aksiyadorlarga muntazam to‘lanadigan pul miqdori. Bu tushuncha aksiyaning daromad shakllaridan biri bo‘lib, kompaniya o‘z foydasining bir qismini aksiyadorlar bilan bo‘lishadi.

ex: the credit union offers share draft accounts similar to regular checking accounts.
he wrote a share draft to pay for the new equipment.
share draft.meta: Hissa cheki — bu kredit ittifoqlarida ishlatiladigan yozma to‘lov buyruqnomasi bo‘lib, hisob egasining shaxsiy hisob raqamidagi mablag‘larini ishlatishga imkon beradi. Bu odatda chek hisob raqami (share draft account) orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: share ramping can mislead investors and destabilize the market.
the regulators are investigating the company for possible share ramping.
share ramping.meta: Aksiyalar narxini sun’iy oshirish — bu kompaniya aksiyalarining bozor narxini ataylab oshirish yoki narxga sun’iy ta’sir ko‘rsatish orqali undan foyda olishga qaratilgan harakat.

ex: After the share split, investors owned twice as many shares, but each was worth half as much.
The company announced a 2-for-1 share split to make its shares more affordable.
share split.meta: bu kompaniya aksiyalarining belgilangan nisbatda bir necha yangi aksiyalarga bo‘linish jarayoni. Bu jarayonda aksiyalar soni ortadi, lekin aksiyalarning umumiy qiymati o‘zgarmaydi, chunki aksiyaning narxi bo‘linish miqdoriga mos ravishda kamayadi.

ex: The magazine provides weekly share tipping to guide readers on stock market trends.
Share tipping is popular among investors looking for the next big opportunity.
share tipping.meta: Aksiyalar bo‘yicha tavsiya berish — bu muvaffaqiyatli yoki foydali investitsiya bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan aksiyalar haqida bashorat qilish yoki mutaxassis tavsiyalarini berish jarayoni.

ex: In a shared appreciation loan, the bank gets a share of the property’s increase in value when it is sold.
They took out a shared appreciation mortgage to buy their first home.
shared appreciation.meta: Ulushli baholanish — bu ipoteka turi bo‘lib, unda qarz beruvchi (kredit beruvchi) ipoteka muddati tugagach yoki mulk sotilganda, mulk qiymatining oshishidan ma’lum bir foiz ulush oladi.

ex: The hospital and the family agreed on a shared care plan for the patient’s recovery at home.
Shared care allows both parents to be actively involved in raising their child after separation.
shared care.meta: Hamkorlikda parvarish — bu bir nechta shaxslar yoki tashkilotlar tomonidan birgalikda taqdim etiladigan parvarish.

ex: Shared equity allows first-time buyers to afford homes with a lower initial deposit.
The couple bought their home through a shared equity scheme with the housing association.
shared equity.meta: Ulushli kapital — bu ipoteka sxemasi bo‘lib, unda hukumat, uy-joy jamiyati yoki boshqa tashkilot xaridor uchun boshlang‘ich to‘lovning bir qismini ta’minlaydi.

ex: Shared memory is essential in multi-processing systems for efficient communication.
The two applications use shared memory to exchange data quickly.
shared memory.meta: Umumiy xotira — bu ikki yoki undan ortiq dastur bir xil xotira qismini birgalikda ishlatishi yoki ma’lumotlarni samarali almashishi uchun foydalaniladigan xotira turi.

ex: Under the shared ownership scheme, the buyer pays rent on the portion they do not own.
Shared ownership helped the family buy a home they otherwise couldn’t afford.
shared ownership.meta: Ulushli mulk — bu mulkka egalik qilish shakli bo‘lib, unda mulkning bir qismi xaridor tomonidan, qolgan qismi esa ko‘pincha hukumat yoki uy-joy jamiyati tomonidan egallab turiladi.

ex: Shared parenting arrangements often help children maintain strong relationships with both parents.
Shared parenting allows both parents to remain actively involved in the child’s life after divorce.
shared parenting.meta: Birgalikdagi ota-onalik — bu farzand tarbiyasida ota va onaning (yoki ikki yoki undan ortiq shaxslarning) ota-onalik vazifalarini teng va faol tarzda bo‘lishib bajarishidir.

ex: Shared space designs encourage motorists to slow down and be more aware of pedestrians.
The city introduced shared spaces to improve pedestrian safety and reduce traffic congestion.
shared space.meta: Umumiy makon — bu yo‘l, maydon yoki shunga o‘xshash jamoat joyi bo‘lib, u transport oqimini sekinlashtirish yoki tartibga solish maqsadida yaratiladi.

ex: Shared taxis usually wait until all the seats are filled before departing.
We took a shared taxi from the airport to the city center.
shared taxi.meta: Yo‘nalishli taksi — bu bir nechta yo‘lovchilar tomonidan umumiy ravishda foydalaniladigan taksi bo‘lib, yo‘nalishi oldindan belgilangan bo‘ladi va taksi yo‘lovchilar to‘lishi bilan jo‘naydi.

ex: High profits and growing share prices usually indicate increasing shareholder value.
The CEO’s main goal is to maximize shareholder value.
shareholder value.meta: Aksiyador qiymati — bu aksiyadorlarning kompaniya aksiyalaridan oladigan daromadlari va foydalari yig‘indisi bo‘lib, ko‘pincha kompaniyaning muvaffaqiyati yoki samaradorligini baholash mezoni sifatida qaraladi.

ex: Investors track the share price index to monitor stock market trends.
The share price index rose by 2% after the release of positive economic data.
share price index.meta: Aksiya narxlari indeksi — bu fond bozorining umumiy holatini yoki o‘sish-pasayish tendensiyasini ko‘rsatadigan ko‘rsatkich bo‘lib, birja ro‘yxatidagi muhim va yirik kompaniyalar aksiyalarining narxlari asosida hisoblanadi.

ex: short loin steaks are known for their tenderness and rich flavor.
the short loin is often cut into t-bone and porterhouse steaks.
short loin.meta: bel qismi go‘shti — bu mol (buqa yoki sigir) tanasining orqa qismi, qovurg‘alar orqasidagi va son oldidagi go‘sht bo‘lagi bo‘lib, odatda yuqori bel (top loin) va yumshoq bel (tenderloin) qismlarini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: the dancer was so agile, she could spin on a sixpence.
this car can turn on a sixpence, making it perfect for city driving.
on a sixpence.meta: juda tor joyda — bu ifoda kichik makonda yoki qisqa masofada tez va oson harakat qilish yoki burilish qilish ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: many modern scams are just digital versions of the old snake-oil salesmen.
the snake-oil salesman promised his product could cure any disease.
snake-oil salesman.meta: bu dastlab ilon yog‘ini sotgan odam bo‘lib, keyinchalik majoziy ma’noda foydasiz, yolg‘on yoki tashqi ko‘rinishida jozibali, lekin amalda hech qanday haqiqiy foydasi bo‘lmagan mahsulot yoki xizmatni reklama qiluvchi yoki sotuvchi odamga aytiladi.

ex: the sofa set includes a three-seater sofa and two matching armchairs.
we bought a new sofa set for the living room.
sofa set.meta: divan jamlanmasi — bu odatda divan va unga mos keluvchi kreslolar to‘plamidan iborat mebel majmuasi. ayniqsa uch qismdan iborat bo‘lib, bir divan va ikkita kreslodan tashkil topgan variantlar keng tarqalgan.

ex: the restaurant offers soy burgers for vegetarian and vegan customers.
i ordered a soy burger because i wanted a meat-free meal.
soy burger.meta: soya burger — bu go‘sht o‘rniga soya oqsili (soya go‘shti) ishlatilgan vegetarian yoki odatda vegan burger turi. ba’zan bu burger go‘sht va soya aralashmasidan tayyorlanishi ham mumkin.

ex: the factory produces soy meal after extracting oil from soybeans.
soy meal is widely used as a protein-rich feed for cattle and poultry.
soy meal.meta: bu soya yog‘i olinib bo‘lingandan keyin qoladigan qattiq qismi bo‘lib, odatda maydalanib, chorva mollari, parranda va baliqlar uchun ozuqa sifatida ishlatiladi. soya shroti yuqori protein tarkibiga ega va hayvonlar uchun muhim ozuqa manbai hisoblanadi.

ex: i like adding roasted soy nuts to my salad for extra crunch.
soy nuts are a healthy snack and a good alternative to traditional nuts.
soy nut.meta: soya yong‘og‘i — bu qovurilgan va qarsildoq holatga keltirilgan soya doni bo‘lib, ko‘pincha yong‘oq o‘rnida iste’mol qilinadi. soya yong‘og‘i odatda yengil tamaddi sifatida yoki soya yong‘og‘i moyida (soy nut butter) ishlatiladi.

ex: the cafe serves soy sausage sandwiches for vegan customers.
many vegetarians prefer soy sausage as a meat alternative.
soy sausage.meta: soya kolbasasi — bu go‘sht o‘rniga soya oqsilidan tayyorlanadigan vegetarian yoki odatda vegan kolbasa turi. soya kolbasasi hayvoniy mahsulotlarni iste’mol qilmaydiganlar yoki sog‘lom ovqatlanishni xohlaydigan insonlar uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: soy sauce is a common ingredient in asian cooking.
i added some soy sauce to the noodles for extra flavor.
soya sauce.meta: soya sousi — bu fermentatsiya qilingan soya loviyalari asosida tayyorlanadigan suyuq sous bo‘lib, odatda jigarrang rangga ega, sho‘r yoki umami ta’miga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: many vegans use soya bean curd as a protein substitute.
tofu, or soya bean curd, is a key ingredient in many asian dishes.
soya bean curd.meta: soya pishlog‘i — bu soya suti pishirilganida hosil bo‘ladigan qattiq modda bo‘lib, odatda blok shaklida tayyorlanadi va asosan osiyo oshxonalarida hamda vegetarian va vegan taomlarda keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: many vegetarians eat soybean curd as a meat substitute.
soybean curd is often used in soups and stir-fried dishes.
soybean curd.meta: soya pishlog‘i — bu soya sutining pishishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan qattiq massa bo‘lib, odatda blok shaklida bo‘ladi. soya pishlog‘i (tofu) osiyo oshxonalarida va vegetarian yoki vegan taomlarda keng ishlatiladi

ex: the factory produces soybean meal after extracting oil from soybeans.
soybean meal is commonly used as livestock feed because of its high protein content.
soybean meal.meta: soya shroti — bu soya yog‘i ajratib olingandan keyin qoladigan qattiq qismi bo‘lib, maydalangan holatda chorva mollari, parranda va baliqlar uchun yuqori proteinli ozuqa sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: farmers monitor their fields closely to detect early signs of soybean rust.
soybean rust can spread rapidly and severely damage soybean crops.
soybean rust.meta: soya zang kasalligi — bu soya va boshqa dukkakli o‘simliklarda uchraydigan kasallik bo‘lib, uni asosan Phakopsora pachyrhizi (osiyo soya zangi) va Phakopsora meibomiae zamburug‘lari keltirib chiqaradi.

ex: we booked a special hire to take us directly to the hotel.
in kampala, many people prefer taking a special hire instead of a regular taxi.
special hire.meta: maxsus ijaraga olingan transport — bu odatda haydovchisi bilan birga ijaraga olinadigan transport vositasi bo‘lib, hozirda asosan taksi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: stand collars are popular in modern fashion for their clean look.
the jacket has a stand collar to keep the neck warm.
stand collar.meta: tik yoqa — bu kiyimdagi yoqa turi bo‘lib, bukilmaydi va tik holda turadi. tik yoqa odatda ko‘ylaklar, kurtkalar va palto kabi kiyimlarda uchraydi. u klassik va zamonaviy uslubda keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: the stand-side seats were sold out quickly.
the player celebrated his goal on the stand-side of the field.
stand-side.meta: tribuna tomoni — stadion, hipodrom yoki musobaqa maydonida tribunaga yaqin joy yoki shu hudud. bu atama o‘yinni tomosha qiladigan odamlar joylashgan tribuna qismiga eng yaqin bo‘lgan yon tomon yoki hududni ifodalaydi.

ex: a lamp was standing on the stand table next to the bed.
she placed the vase on the stand table by the window.
stand table.meta: kichik stol — bu odatda kichik o‘lchamdagi, ko‘chirish oson bo‘lgan, yonma-yon yoki burchakda turadigan stol. ko‘pincha bezak yoki kichik buyumlar qo‘yish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: every morning, the recruits stand in line before training begins.
the soldiers were ordered to stand in line for inspection.
to stand in line.meta: safga tizilish — bu harbiy termin bo‘lib, askarlarning belgilangan tartibda safda joy egallashi, ya’ni qatorda o‘z o‘rnini olish jarayonini anglatadi. safga tizilish harbiy tartib-intizom va tayyorgarlikning muhim qismidir.

ex: people stood in line outside the store waiting for it to open.
we had to stand in line for an hour to buy tickets.
to stand in line.meta: bu biror xizmat, mahsulot yoki joydan foydalanish uchun o‘z navbatini kutib, chiziqli yoki tartibli holda boshqa odamlar bilan birga turish. bu atama ko‘pincha do‘kon, kassalar, ommaviy tadbirlar yoki boshqa xizmat ko‘rsatish joylarida ishlatiladi.

ex: as surely as I stand here, I saw him take the money.
as I stand here, I tell you the truth.
as i stand here.meta: mana shu yerda turganimda ham — bu ibora o‘z fikrini yoki bayonotini qat’iyan tasdiqlash, haqiqatni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu gap odatda qasam, chin dildan aytilayotganini yoki rostligini urg‘ulash uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: the accused stood trial but was found not guilty.
he will stand trial for theft next month.
to stand trial.meta: sudda javob bermoq — jinoyat yoki huquqbuzarlikda ayblanib, rasmiy sud jarayonida ishtirok etish va sud qarorini kutish jarayoni. Bu ibora sud oldida o‘z aybi yoki aybsizligini himoya qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: the soldiers stood tall during the ceremony.
he stood tall and faced his fears.
to stand tall.meta: tik turmoq — bu to‘g‘ri, qaddi-qomatni tik tutgan holda turish. odatda bu holat jasorat, ishonch yoki g‘ururni ifodalaydi. bu ibora ba’zan ramziy ma’noda ham ishlatiladi, ya’ni qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, boshni baland ko‘tarib yurish.

ex: she stood tall despite all the challenges she faced.
after the defeat, he still stood tall and accepted the result with dignity.
to stand tall.meta: boshni baland tutmoq — bu ibora g‘urur, o‘ziga ishonch, qadr-qimmat yoki jasoratni ko‘rsatish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Bu kishi qiyinchiliklarga, tanqidlarga yoki mag‘lubiyatlarga qaramay, o‘zini hurmat qilishini va mustahkam turishini bildiradi.

ex: the plaintiff could not meet the required standard of proof.
in criminal cases, the standard of proof is very high.
standard of proof.meta: isbot darajasi — bu sud jarayonida da’vo yoki ayblovni isbotlash uchun zarur bo‘lgan dalil va isbotlarning yetarlilik darajasi.

ex: the company failed to meet the required standard of care, resulting in an accident.
doctors must maintain a high standard of care when treating patients.
standard of care.meta: g‘amxo‘rlik standarti — bu har qanday shaxs yoki mutaxassisdan boshqalarning xavfsizligi yoki farovonligini ta’minlash uchun kutilishi yoki talab qilinadigan ehtiyotkorlik, diqqat va javobgarlik darajasi.

ex: the company became a standard setter for environmental practices.
the international organization for standardization (ISO) is a leading standard setter in many industries.
standard setter.meta: standart belgilovchi — bu ma’lum bir soha, sanoat yoki faoliyat yo‘nalishida qoidalar, mezonlar yoki sifat talablarini ishlab chiqadigan shaxs yoki tashkilot.

ex: the agency played a standard-setting role in product safety.
this is a standard-setting report in the field of education.
standard setting.meta: standart belgilovchi — ma’lum bir soha, sanoat yoki faoliyat yo‘nalishida sifat yoki xavfsizlik mezonlarini belgilaydigan yoki yo‘naltiradigan narsa, jarayon yoki tashkilot.

ex: small numbers like 0.00032 are easier to write in standard form: 3.2 × 10⁻⁴.
the number 4,500,000 can be written in standard form as 4.5 × 10⁶.
standard form.meta: standart shakl — bu juda katta yoki juda kichik sonlarni yozish usuli bo‘lib, bunda butun qismdan keyin darhol kasr qismi keladi va son 10 ning darajasiga ko‘paytiriladi. Bunda faqat bitta butun son o‘nlik nuqtadan oldin turadi.

ex: the consumer had no opportunity to negotiate the terms of the standard form contract.
most mobile phone companies use standard form contracts.
standard form contract.meta: standart shartnoma — bu oldindan tayyorlangan, barcha shartlari belgilangan va odatda muzokara qilinmaydigan shartnomadir.

ex: standard gravity is used in physics calculations related to weight and free fall.
the standard gravity is approximately 9.81 meters per second squared.
standard gravity.meta: standart tortishish tezlanishi — bu Yer yuzasiga yaqin bo‘shliqdagi jismning tortishish tezlanishining nominal (belgilangan) qiymati bo‘lib, odatda 9,80665 m/s² deb qabul qilinadi.

ex: standard lenses provide a natural perspective similar to the human eye.
a 50 mm lens is typically considered a standard lens for full-frame cameras.
standard lens.meta: standart obyektiv — bu kameraning diqqat markazi uzunligi taxminan tasvir o‘lchamining diagonali bilan teng bo‘lgan obyektiv bo‘lib, inson ko‘zi qamrab oladigan ko‘rish burchagiga yaqin tasvir beradi.

ex: he bought a standard mattress to replace the old one.
a standard mattress typically fits a bed frame without special adjustments.
standard mattress.meta: standart matras — bu odatda barqaror yoki harakatsiz ramkaga o‘rnatiladigan, ma’lum balandlikdagi, ko‘pincha to‘rt oyoqli to‘shaklarda ishlatiladigan matras turi.

ex: the Standard Model successfully explains three of the four fundamental forces of nature.
the discovery of the Higgs boson confirmed a key prediction of the Standard Model.
standard model.meta: Standart Model — bu elementar zarralar va ularning o‘zaro ta’sirlarini (elektromagnit, kuchsiz va kuchli yadroviy kuchlar) matematik tarzda tavsiflovchi zamonaviy fizikadagi asosiy nazariya.

ex: the laboratory has strict standard operating procedures for handling chemicals.
all employees must follow the standard operating procedures to ensure safety.
standard operating procedure.meta: standart ish tartibi — bu kompaniya, sanoat yoki tashkilotda ma’lum bir jarayon yoki vazifani qanday qilib muntazam va xavfsiz bajarish kerakligini ko‘rsatib beruvchi yozma ko‘rsatmalar to‘plami.

ex: the standard poodle is known for its intelligence and elegance.
she has a standard poodle that participates in dog shows.
standard poodle.meta: standart pudel — bu pudel zotining eng katta turi bo‘lib, yelka balandligi odatda 45 dan 62 santimetrgacha bo‘ladi. Bu itlar aqlli, tez o‘rganuvchan, sodiq va ko‘pincha ko‘rgazmalarda, ovda yoki xizmat itlari sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: you will need a standard-size envelope for this document.
the bed comes with a standard-size mattress.
standard-size.meta: standart o‘lchamdagi — bu umumiy qabul qilingan yoki keng tarqalgan o‘lchamdagi narsa. Bunday o‘lcham odatda maxsus buyurtma yoki o‘zgartirish talab qilmaydi va ko‘pchilik mahsulotlar shu o‘lchamga mos bo‘ladi.

ex: standard-sized paper is used in most printers.
the table is standard-sized and fits most dining rooms.
standard-sized.meta: standart o‘lchamdagi — bu keng tarqalgan yoki qabul qilingan o‘lchamga ega bo‘lgan narsa. Bunday o‘lcham maxsus o‘zgartirishsiz yoki buyurtmasiz keng qo‘llaniladi va ko‘pchilik mahsulotlar shu o‘lchamda ishlab chiqariladi.

ex: the volume of gases is often measured at standard temperature and pressure.
standard temperature and pressure provide a reference point for scientific calculations.
standard temperature and pressure.meta: standart harorat va bosim — bu tajribalar yoki hisob-kitoblar uchun asos sifatida qabul qilingan oldindan belgilangan sharoitlar majmuasi. Odatda standart harorat 0°C (273,15 K), standart bosim esa 1 atmosfera (101,325 kPa) sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: linguists use the standard theory to analyze sentence formation.
the standard theory explains how sentences have both deep and surface structures.
standard theory.meta: standart nazariya — bu generativ grammatikaning modeli bo‘lib, jumlaning ikki xil ifodasini ajratib ko‘rsatadi: chuqur tuzilma (deep structure) va yuzaki tuzilma (surface structure).

ex: the computer remains on standby to save energy.
the TV is on standby when it’s plugged in but turned off.
on standby.meta: tayyor holatda — elektr energiyasi bilan ishlaydigan (ayniqsa elektron) qurilmaning quvvat manbai yoqilgan, ammo hozirda faol ishlamayotgan, kerak bo‘lganda tezda ishga tushirish mumkin bo‘lgan holati.

ex: the standard-bearer led the troops into battle.
he was the standard-bearer of the movement.
stander bearer.meta: standart tashuvchi — biror guruh, tashkilot yoki jamoani ramziy ravishda ifodalovchi, ularning standartini (bayrog‘ini) ko‘targan shaxs. Bu atama ko‘pincha harbiy, siyosiy yoki madaniy kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: a standing desk can help improve posture and reduce back pain.
many people use a standing desk to avoid sitting all day.
standing desk.meta: tik turish stoli — odam tik turgan holda ishlashi uchun mo‘ljallangan stol. Ko‘pincha bu stol o‘tirgan vaqtni kamaytirish va sog‘liqni saqlash maqsadida ishlatiladi. Tik turish stoli yordamida ish paytida tanani ko‘proq harakatlantirish mumkin.

ex: water flows slowly over the standing buddle to wash the ore.
the standing buddle is used to separate valuable minerals from ore.
standing buddle.meta: tik holatdagi buddle — suv bilan to‘ldirilgan, ingichka qiyalikka ega keng idish yoki havza bo‘lib, u ruda tarkibidagi qimmatbaho minerallarni ajratish va tozalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu qurilma rudani saralashda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: ships must navigate carefully around areas of standing ice.
standing ice is firmly attached to the shoreline
standing ice.meta: harakatsiz muz — joyida qolgan, harakat qilmaydigan muz qatlami. Ayniqsa, sohilga, okean tubiga yoki boshqa qattiq yuzaga yopishib qolgan dengiz muzlari uchun ishlatiladi. Bu turdagi muzlar ko‘pincha uzoq vaqt davomida joyida qoladi va harakat qilmaydi.

ex: a standing martingale helps keep the horse’s head steady.
the rider adjusted the standing martingale before the competition.
standing martingale.meta: otning egasi yoki minuvchisi uchun mo‘ljallangan, otning bo‘yin qismiga bog‘langan, old oyoqlari orasidan o‘tgan va otning boshini juda yuqoriga ko‘tarilishidan saqlaydigan sozlanadigan tasma. Bu asbob otning boshini nazorat qilishda yordam beradi.

ex: the message was carried from one standing post to another along the route.
couriers waited at the standing post to receive the dispatches.
standing post.meta: pochta yoki xabar tashish yo‘lida joylashgan bir nechta posilkalar (yoki elchilar)dan biri bo‘lib, ularning vazifasi xatlar, buyruqlar va boshqa hujjatlarni bir postadan boshqasiga yetkazishdir. Bu tizim eski pochta xizmatlarida keng qo‘llangan.

ex: a standing crust is often used in traditional pie recipes.
she baked a standing crust for the fruit pie without using a mold.
standing crust.meta: tik qobiq — idish yoki qolipdan foydalanmasdan tayyorlangan va pishirilgan, mustaqil turadigan pirog qobig‘i. Bu turdagi qobiq ko‘tarilgan va shaklli bo‘lib, o‘z-o‘zidan barqaror turadi.

ex: in some cultures, standing images are worshipped as gods.
the museum displayed a standing image of an ancient deity.
standing image.meta: tik haykal — odam yoki boshqa narsaning shaklida yasalgan haykal yoki maqom. Bundan tashqari, figurativ ma’noda, noto‘g‘ri yoki yolg‘on iloh sifatida qabul qilingan narsa ham bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: a standing knee helps maintain vertical stability in the framework.
the architect designed the structure with a standing knee for extra support.
standing knee.meta: tik turgan tizza — tizzaning vertikal qismi yuqoriga qaragan tizza turi. Bu tizza turi “osilgan tizza” (hanging knee) ga qarama-qarshi hisoblanadi.

ex: the standing press was used to flatten the pages after binding the book.
he performs the standing press to strengthen his shoulders.
standing press.meta: og‘ir taglikka ega vintli press bo‘lib, kitob sahifalarini birga bosish uchun ishlatiladi.bir kishi turib, og‘irlikni yuqoriga ko‘taradigan mashq turi; ko‘pincha yelka yoki qo‘l mushaklarini mustahkamlash uchun bajariladi.

ex: standing seams are common in modern metal roofing systems.
the roof panels were joined with a standing seam to prevent leaks.
standing seam.meta: tik payvand qirra — ikki yonma-yon metall tom panelini birlashtiruvchi ko‘tarilgan, o‘zaro moslashadigan tikuv. Bu turdagi payvand qirralar suv o‘tmasligi va mustahkam bog‘lanishi uchun ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha tom yopish ishlarida qo‘llanadi.

ex: the standing charge covers the cost of maintaining the service connection.
customers pay a standing charge in addition to their electricity usage.
standing charge.meta: doimiy to‘lov — ma’lum bir xizmat yoki mahsulotga kirish uchun belgilangan, ishlatilgan miqdordan qat’i nazar, muntazam to‘lanadigan barqaror summadir.

ex: in the past, standing rent was sometimes paid in grain instead of money.
the tenant pays a standing rent every month regardless of crop yield.
standing rent.meta: ijaraga olingan mulk yoki yer uchun belgilangan, har safar o‘zgarib turmaydigan, aniq miqdordagi to‘lov. So‘nggi paytlarda ayniqsa AQShda tarixiy ma’noda, yer uchun pul o‘rniga belgilangan miqdordagi hosil to‘lovi sifatida ishlatilgan.

ex: he was known as a standover merchant who bullied small businesses.
the local standover merchant forced the shop owner to pay protection money.
standover merchant.meta: qo‘rqituvchi shaxs — odatda erkak bo‘lib, boshqalarni qo‘rqitish yoki bosim o‘tkazish uchun tahdidli xulq-atvorni qo‘llaydigan shaxs. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha "qattiq odam" yoki "zoravon" ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: they found themselves in dire stress for medical supplies.
the village was in great stress for clean water after the drought.
in stress for.meta: in stress for — nimagadir muhtoj yoki zaruratda bo‘lish holati. Ko‘pincha kuchli ta’kid bilan qo‘llanadi, masalan, in great stress for (juda katta ehtiyojda), in dire stress for (jiddiy zaruratda). Bugungi kunda kam ishlatiladigan ifoda.

ex: the formation of stress fibres is crucial for cell adhesion and motility.
stress fibres help maintain the shape of the cell under mechanical stress.
stress fibre.meta: stress tolasi — hujayra shaklini saqlashda, hujayralarning bir-biriga yopishishi va harakatlanishida ishtirok etadigan tolali tuzilma turi.

ex: scientists analyze stress-optical effects to understand material deformation.
stress-optical properties of glass change under mechanical pressure.
stress-optical.meta: stress-optik — moddani fizik zo‘riqish ta’sirida uning optik xususiyatlaridagi o‘zgarishlarga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq. Bu atama moddalarning yorug‘likni qanday o‘tkazishi yoki singdirishidagi zo‘riqish natijasidagi o‘zgarishlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: don’t be such a stress bunny, try to relax!
she is a real stress bunny before exams.
stress bunny.meta: stressli odam — doimiy yoki osonlik bilan stress holatiga tushadigan, asabiylashuvchi yoki bosim ostida qoladigan shaxs. Bu ifoda ko‘proq kulgili yoki mehribon tarzda ishlatiladi.

ex: the patient was diagnosed with stress cardiomyopathy following a severe shock.
stress cardiomyopathy often occurs in older women after emotional trauma.
stress cardiomyopathy.meta: stress kardiyomiopatiyasi — asosan kattaroq yoshdagi ayollarda uchraydigan sindrom bo‘lib, ko‘pincha jismoniy yoki hissiy zo‘riqishdan keyin yuzaga keladi.

ex: stress disorder symptoms include anxiety, insomnia, and fatigue.
many soldiers suffer from stress disorders after combat.
stress disorder.meta: stress buzilishi — turli xil jismoniy yoki ruhiy holatlar bo‘lib, ularning paydo bo‘lishi asosan zo‘riqish yoki stress ta’siriga bog‘liq. Bu buzilishlar insonning salomatligi va ruhiy holatiga salbiy ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

ex: stress-eating can lead to weight gain and health problems.
she tends to stress-eat whenever she feels anxious.
stress-eat.meta: stress paytida ko‘p ovqatlanish — stress yoki zo‘riqishga javoban sog‘liq uchun zararli yoki haddan tashqari ko‘p ovqat iste’mol qilish harakati. Bu xulq ko‘pincha stress bilan kurashish usuli sifatida namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: stress eaters often struggle to control their eating habits during tough times.
she is a stress eater who turns to snacks when anxious.
stress eater.meta: stressda ko‘p ovqat yeydigan odam — stress yoki zo‘riqishga javoban sog‘liq uchun zararli yoki haddan tashqari ko‘p ovqat iste’mol qilishga moyil shaxs. Bu odamlar stress bilan kurashish uchun ovqatlanishni vosita sifatida ishlatadi.

ex: many people use stress eating as a way to cope with anxiety.
stress eating often leads to unhealthy weight gain.
stress eating.meta: stressli ovqatlanish — stress yoki zo‘riqish ta’sirida sog‘liq uchun zararli yoki ortiqcha ovqat iste’mol qilish harakati. Bu ko‘pincha stress bilan kurashish usuli sifatida namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: stress hormones prepare the body to respond to danger.
cortisol is a primary stress hormone released during stressful situations.
stress hormone.meta: stress gormoni — organizmda stress ta’sirida paydo bo‘ladigan va fiziologik holatni o‘zgartiradigan gormonlarning umumiy nomi. Asosan kortizol va katekolaminlar (adrenalin, noradrenalin) stressga javoban faol bo‘ladi.

ex: the doctor diagnosed her with stress-induced hypertension.
stress-induced headaches are common in people with high-pressure jobs.
stress-induced.meta: stress natijasida yuzaga kelgan — ayniqsa kasallik yoki tibbiy holat uchun ishlatiladi, stress tufayli paydo bo‘lgan yoki stress ta’siri bilan bog‘liq holat.

ex: effective stress management can improve overall well-being.
stress management techniques include meditation and exercise.
stress management.meta: stressni boshqarish — insonning stress darajasini nazorat qilish yoki stressga samaraliroq qarshi turish jarayoni. Bu jarayon ma’lum texnikalar va usullar yordamida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: many stress-related conditions improve with proper therapy.
stress-related illnesses can affect both the mind and body.
stress-related.meta: stress bilan bog‘liq — ayniqsa kasallik yoki tibbiy holat uchun ishlatiladi, stress ta’siri bilan bog‘liq yoki qisman stress tufayli yuzaga kelgan.

ex: stress-accented syllables are usually louder and longer.
the word is stress-accented on the first syllable.
stress-accented.meta: tovush urg‘uli — so‘z yoki so‘z birikmasida ma’lum bir qismga urg‘u berilishi, ya’ni stress yoki tovush urg‘usi bilan ajralib turishi xususiyati

ex: stressfulness in daily life can lead to burnout.
the stressfulness of the job affected her health.
stressfulness.meta: stresslilik — stress bilan bog‘liq bo‘lish sifati yoki stressli bo‘lish holati; biror vaziyat yoki hodisaning odamda stress uyg‘otishi.

ex: having a tall relative can open many doors in business.
he got the job through a tall relative who works in the company.
tall relative.meta: ta’sirli qarindosh — mol-mulk yoki qudratga ega bo‘lgan, boshqa biror kishining manfaatlarini ilgari surishda yordam beradigan qarindosh, do‘st yoki tanish; ta’sirli homiy yoki homiylik qiluvchi.

ex: the collection features several tank-topped designs for summer.
she appeared at the party tank-topped and casual.
tank-topped.meta: tank top kiygan — (kiyim, dizayn va boshqalar haqida) tank top uslubidagi kiyimni o‘z ichiga olgan yoki uni taqdim etadigan; (odam haqida) tank top kiygan.

ex: many young people are tarmacking because of high unemployment.
he spent the day tarmacking to find a job.
tarmacking.meta: tarmacking — ish topish maqsadida ko‘chalarda yurish yoki ish qidirish jarayoni.

ex: he parked the van perfectly on a tickey.
the car can turn on a tickey in narrow streets.
on a tickey.meta: on a tickey — ayniqsa transport vositasining kichik joyda aylanib yoki harakatlanib olish qobiliyatiga taalluqli bo‘lib, aniqlik bilan tor yoki kichik maydonda harakat qilish holati.

ex: that kid is only a tickey high and already running fast.
he’s only two bricks and a tickey high, but very clever.
two bricks and a tickey high.meta: ikki g‘isht va kichik joy balandligida — (insonga nisbatan) juda past bo‘lish yoki yosh bo‘lish holati; kichik balandlikda yoki yoshda.

ex: calculating the true anomaly is essential for predicting satellite movement.
the true anomaly defines the position of the satellite in its orbit.
true anomaly.meta: haqiqiy anomalya — orbitada harakatlanayotgan osmon jismi yoki sun’iy yo‘ldoshning o‘z apsidasidan (orbitaning eng yaqin yoki eng uzoq nuqtasidan) o‘lchanadigan burchak masofasi; orbitaning ma’lum bir pozitsiyasini ifodalaydi.

ex: we take turns driving on long trips.
the children took turns playing with the toy.
to take turns.meta: navbatma-navbat qilish — ikki yoki undan ortiq odam biror ishni almashib bajarishi, odatda har bir kishiga adolatli ulush yoki imkon berilishi.

ex: this phrase is now obsolete and rarely used.
in old literature, “to serve a person’s turn” meant to satisfy their needs.
to serve a person’s turn.meta: biror kishining (ayni paytda jinsiy ehtiyojlarini) qondirish ma’nosida bo‘lgan, ammo hozirda kam ishlatiladigan yoki eskirgan ifoda.

ex: soldiers take turns of duty at the checkpoint.
his turn of duty lasted eight hours.
turn of duty.meta: turn of duty — xizmatdagi navbat yoki boshqalar bilan navbatlashib o‘tiladigan xizmat davri.

ex: the election marked the turn of the tide in political affairs.
the turn of the tide happened at dawn.
turn of the tide.meta: turn of the tide — dengiz to‘lqinining pasayishdan ko‘tarilishga yoki aksincha o‘tishi nuqtasi; (badiiy ma’noda) insoniy ishlar yoki vaziyatlarda, ayniqsa foydali o‘zgarish yoki burilish nuqtasi.

ex: the weather took a turn for the worse suddenly.
his health took a turn for the worse after the surgery.
to take a turn for the worse.meta: to take a turn for the worse — biror narsa, ayniqsa sog‘liq yoki vaziyat kutilmaganda yoki birdan yomonlashishi, yomon tomonga o‘zgarishi.

ex: the economy took a turn for the better in the last quarter.
her condition took a turn for the better after the treatment.
to take a turn for the better.meta: to take a turn for the better — biror narsa, ayniqsa sog‘liq yoki vaziyat birdan yaxshilanishi, yaxshi tomonga o‘zgarishi

ex: This turn of events changed his life forever.
There was an unexpected turn of events during the meeting.
turn of events.meta: Voqealar burilishi – kutilgan voqealar ketma-ketligining o‘zgarishi; voqealarning yangi yo‘nalishda rivojlanishi yoki keskin o‘zgarishi.

ex: I prefer turn-based strategy games to real-time ones.
Chess is a classic turn-based game.
turn-based.meta: bu shunday o‘yin bo‘lib, unda har bir ishtirokchi yoki jamoa o‘z harakatini ma’lum tartibda, navbatma-navbat bajaradi. Bu turdagi o‘yinlarda har bir o‘yinchining harakati tugagandan so‘ng boshqa o‘yinchining navbati keladi.

ex: Children learn turn-taking in conversations from an early age.
Good turn-taking is essential for effective communication.
turn-taking.meta: bu kishilar yoki ishtirokchilarning navbat bilan harakat yoki gapirish jarayonida qatnashishi. Ayniqsa muloqotda: suhbatdoshlarning birin-ketin gapirishi, ya’ni bir kishi gapirganda boshqalar tinglaydi va keyin navbat bilan so‘zga chiqishadi.

ex: Don’t turn your back to your friends when they need you.
She turned her back to him and walked away.
to turn one’s back to.meta: biror narsaga yoki kishiga jismonan orqa tomonni burish, yuzini olib qochish. Ko‘pincha bepisandlik, befarqlik yoki rad etish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, kimnidir yoki nimanidir inkor etish yoki rad etish ma’nosida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: Let’s turn the page and forget the past.
After losing his job, he decided to turn a new page in his life.
to turn a (new) page.meta: Yangi sahifa ochmoq – og‘ir yoki qiyin davrdan keyin yangi boshlanishga qadam qo‘yish, yangi hayot yoki yangi yo‘nalishni boshlash. O‘tgan voqealarni ortda qoldirib, yangi imkoniyat yoki toza sahifadan boshlashni anglatadi.

ex: The factory turned its wheels again after months of shutdown.
The car turned a wheel and slowly moved forward.
to turn a wheel.meta: Asosiy ma’no: transport vositasining harakatga kelishi yoki g‘ildirakning aylanishi. Ko‘chma ma’no: biror ishni boshlash, harakatga kelish, taraqqiyot yoki rivojlanish yo‘liga kirish.

ex: Many Ugandan Asians were expelled from the country in the 1970s.
The Ugandan Asian community has played a key role in the country's economy.
ugandan asian.meta: Ugandalik osiyolik – Ugandada yashovchi yoki Ugandada tug‘ilgan, kelib chiqishi Janubiy Osiyodan (ayniqsa Hindiston, Pokiston yoki Bangladeshdan) bo‘lgan inson. Bu atama Ugandadagi osiyolik diaspora vakillarini ifodalaydi.

ex: Life in an ujamaa village was based on cooperation and shared labor.
The government encouraged people to move to ujamaa villages in the 1970s.
ujamaa village.meta: Ujamaa qishlog‘i – Tanzaniyada “ujamaa” sotsialistik siyosati doirasida tashkil etilgan, umumiy (kollektiv) fermalar asosida yashaydigan qishloq. Ushbu qishloqlar hamkorlikda ishlab, yer va resurslarni birgalikda boshqarishga asoslangan edi.

ex: Logos are usually designed using vector graphics.
Vector graphics do not lose quality when scaled.
vector graphics.meta: Vektor grafika – matematik formulalar asosida yaratiladigan raqamli tasvirlar bo‘lib, ular boshlanish va tugash nuqtalari, chiziqlar, egri chiziqlar va burchaklar orqali aniqlanadi.

ex: Yellow dwarfs can burn for billions of years.
The Sun is classified as a yellow dwarf.
yellow dwarf.meta: bu yadro reaksiyasi orqali energiya ishlab chiqaradigan, asosiy ketma-ketlikda joylashgan G-turdagi sariq yoki oq rangli yulduz. Quyosh ham ushbu turdagi yulduz hisoblanadi. Ushbu yulduzlar o‘rtacha harorat, yorqinlik va o‘lchamga ega.

ex: — Can I sit here? — Yes please.
— Are you the new student? — Yes please.
yes please.meta: Yes please – Ugand ingliz tilida tasdiqlash yoki rozilik bildiruvchi ibora bo‘lib, “to‘g‘ri”, “ha, aynan shunday” yoki “albatta” ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Bu ibora muloyim va ijobiy javob sifatida ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The team conducted a zooarchaeological analysis of the animal bones found at the site.
Zooarchaeological evidence shows that ancient people domesticated animals.
zooarchaeological.meta: Zooarxeologik – hayvon qoldiqlari va ularning arxeologik qazilmalaridagi o‘rni bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan, shu sohaga oid tushunchalarni ifodalaydi.

ex: The smell was so faint it was just above the absolute threshold.
The absolute threshold for hearing varies from person to person.
absolute threshold.meta: bu inson yoki tirik organizm tomonidan tashqi ta’sir (masalan, tovush, hid, yorug‘lik yoki teginish) ongli ravishda ilk bor sezilishi mumkin bo‘lgan eng kichik daraja yoki minimal intensivlik nuqtasidir.

ex: Alcohol use disorder can lead to serious health problems.
He was diagnosed with alcohol use disorder after years of heavy drinking.
alcohol use disorder.meta: Alkogol iste’moli buzilishi – bu shunday kasallik bo‘lib, unda inson ortiqcha va nazoratsiz alkogol iste’mol qilish odatini shakllantiradi.

ex: The disease spread annihilatingly across the region.
The army attacked annihilatingly, leaving nothing behind.
annihilatingly.meta: Butkul yo‘q qiladigan tarzda – shunday tarzda harakat qilmoq yoki ta’sir ko‘rsatmoqki, natijada biror narsa butunlay yo‘q bo‘ladi, barbod bo‘ladi yoki mutlaqo vayron bo‘ladi.

ex: Anti-medieval writers rejected the traditions of the Middle Ages.
The movement was strongly anti-medieval, promoting modern thinking.
anti-medieval.meta: o‘rta asrlarning qadriyatlari, madaniyati, g‘oyalari yoki tartiblariga ochiq qarshi bo‘lish yoki ularni rad etish. Bu tushuncha o‘rta asrlarning konservativ, ortga qarab fikrlovchi yoki sust rivojlangan jamiyatlarini tanqid qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: His anti-modern ideas clash with today’s progressive society.
The anti-modern group prefers traditional lifestyles over modern technology.
anti-modern.meta: Zamonaviylikka qarshi – zamonaviy g‘oyalar, texnologiyalar, jamiyat tuzilmalari yoki madaniyatga qarshi bo‘lish; yangi yoki hozirgi davr yutuqlarini rad etish yoki qadimgi, an’anaviy qadriyatlarni afzal ko‘rish.

ex: Farmers struggle to control barnyard grass because it competes with crops.
Barnyard grass is a common weed in rice fields.
barnyard grass.meta: Tovuqxona o'ti – Echinochloa turkumiga mansub bir nechta begona o't turlari nomi. Xususan, Echinochloa crus-galli (xo'roz panjasi o'ti) keng tarqalgan turi bo‘lib, dastlab tropik Osiyoda o‘sadigan bo‘lgan, hozir esa dunyoning ko‘plab mintaqalarida o‘sadi.

ex: That shelf is crooked—it looks like a bodge job.
The repair was just a bodge job; it broke again the next day.
bodge job.meta: Shoshma-shosharlik bilan yasalgan ish – bu biror ish yoki vazifaning sust, shoshqaloq, beparvo yoki tajribasiz tarzda bajarilishi natijasida sifatsiz yoki noto‘g‘ri chiqqan ish.

ex: She bought a burner phone for her trip to avoid high roaming charges.
The criminal used a burner phone to avoid being traced.
burner phone.meta: Bir martalik telefon – bu arzon, oldindan to‘langan mobil telefon bo‘lib, odatda qisqa muddat foydalanish uchun olinadi va keyin tashlab yuboriladi. Ko‘pincha foydalanuvchining shaxsini yashirish yoki maxfiylikni saqlash maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: Canoe camping allows you to explore remote natural areas.
We went canoe camping along the river for five days.
canoe camping.meta: Kanoeda sayohat va lager qilish – bu kanoe (kichik qayiq) yordamida daryo, ko‘l yoki boshqa suv yo‘llari bo‘ylab sayohat qilish va yo‘l davomida turli joylarda chodir tikib tunash yoki ochiq havoda dam olish faoliyati

ex: She plays beautiful melodies on her Celtic harp.
The Celtic harp is a symbol of Irish culture.
celtic harp.meta: Kelt arfası – odatda kelt xalqlari (Irlandiya, Shotlandiya, Uels va boshqa kelt mintaqalari) xalq musiqasida ishlatiladigan kichik arfa turi. Bu cholg‘u asbobi an’anaviy ravishda metal simlarga ega, egri ustun (tayanch) va katta korpusga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: Experienced canoe campers always pack light for easy travel.
The canoe camper paddled down the river and set up camp each night.
canoe camper.meta: kanoe (kichik qayiq) yordamida suv bo‘ylab sayohat qilib, yo‘l davomida turli joylarda chodir tikib, lager qurib tunaydigan inson. Bu shaxs odatda kanoeda suzish va tabiatda lager qilishni birgalikda bajaradigan sayohatchi hisoblanadi.

ex: Her necklace has a beautiful Celtic knot design.
The Celtic knot is a famous symbol in Irish and Scottish art.
celtic knot.meta: Kelt tuguni – uzluksiz chiziq shaklida chizilgan va o‘zini takrorlaydigan murakkab bezak shakli bo‘lib, chiziq bir necha marta o‘zini kesib o‘tadi, lekin hech qachon uzilmaydi.

ex: They used Celtic nard in ancient herbal medicines.
Celtic nard was once highly valued for its aromatic roots.
celtic nard.meta: Kelt nardi – xushbo‘y, dorivor o‘simlik bo‘lib, ilmiy nomi Valeriana celtica. Bu o‘simlik asosan Alp tog‘larida o‘sadi, pushti-oq rangdagi gullarga ega, va qadimda tibbiyotda va atirlar tayyorlashda keng qo‘llanilgan.

ex: Celtic studies includes the research of ancient Celtic languages and traditions.
She is studying Celtic studies at the university.
celtic studies.meta: Keltshunoslik – kelt xalqlari, ularning tillari, madaniyati, tarixi, adabiyoti va san’atini o‘rganadigan ilmiy soha.

ex: She is a fluent Celtic speaker and teaches Irish at school.
There are still many Celtic speakers in parts of Ireland and Scotland.
celtic speaker.meta: Kelt tili so‘zlovchisi – kelt tillaridan birida so‘zlashadigan yoki bu tilni biladigan inson. Bu atama kelt xalqlarining hozirgi yoki tarixiy tillarida erkin gapira oladigan kishilarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Celtic-speaking regions have rich cultural traditions.
There are several Celtic-speaking communities in Wales.
celtic-speaking.meta: Kelt tilida so‘zlashuvchi – kelt tillaridan birida (masalan, irland tili, shotland-gall tili, uels tili, breton tili va boshqalar) so‘zlashadigan yoki bu tilni kundalik hayotda ishlatadigan inson yoki jamiyat.

ex: The Celto-Germanic tribes once inhabited parts of Europe.
Some ancient artefacts show Celto-Germanic influence.
celto-germanic.meta: Kelt-german (kelt-germanik) – tarix, arxeologiya yoki tilshunoslik sohalarida kelt va german xalqlariga birgalikda tegishli bo‘lgan yoki ikkala madaniyat, til, yoki tarixiy xususiyatlarni o‘zida mujassam etgan hodisa yoki tushuncha.

ex: Clinical depression often requires medical treatment, including therapy and medication.
He was diagnosed with clinical depression after months of severe symptoms.
clinical depression.meta: Klinik depressiya – bu tibbiy jihatdan aniqlangan va ruhiy salomatlik bo‘yicha diagnostik mezonlarga to‘liq javob beradigan og‘ir depressiya holati.

ex: He’s a great player. – My colonial oath, he is!
Are you coming to the party? – My colonial oath, I wouldn’t miss it!
my colonial oath.meta: My colonial oath – Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya jargonida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, rozi bo‘lish, tasdiqlash yoki kuchli ishonch bildirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ba’zan bu ibora yumshoq qasam yoki hayrat ifodasi sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Colonial cringe can prevent nations from fully embracing their own cultural identity.
Some people still suffer from a colonial cringe, believing British culture is superior.
colonial cringe.meta: Mustamlakachilikdan uyalish – bu o‘z mamlakati yoki milliy madaniyatini sobiq mustamlakachi davlat (ayniqsa Buyuk Britaniya) madaniyatidan past, zaif yoki kamroq qadrli deb hisoblash tushunchasi

ex: Many African countries were once controlled by European colonial powers.
Britain was a major colonial power in the 19th century.
colonial power.meta: Mustamlakachi davlat – boshqa hududlar yoki mamlakatlarni bosib olib, ularni o‘z siyosiy va iqtisodiy nazorati ostiga olgan, ko‘pincha chet elda joylashgan hududlarga ega bo‘lgan davlat.

ex: The hotel’s colonial-style furniture gives it a historic charm.
They live in a beautiful colonial-style house built in the 1800s.
colonial-style.meta: Mustamlakachilik uslubidagi – bu uslub yoki dizayn turi bo‘lib, biror mamlakat mustamlakachi davlat tomonidan boshqarilgan davrga xos bo‘lgan me’moriy, madaniy yoki estetik elementlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: Colony collapse disorder has led to the loss of millions of bees worldwide.
Beekeepers are worried about colony collapse disorder affecting their hives.
colony collapse disorder.meta: Ari uyasining qulash sindromi – bu arilar koloniyasida ishchi arilar kutilmaganda va tezda katta miqdorda yo‘qolib ketishi bilan tavsiflanadigan kasallik yoki buzilish holati.

ex: A digital colony counter improves accuracy in microbiological studies.
The lab technician used a colony counter to count bacterial colonies.
colony counter.meta: Koloniya hisoblagich – laboratoriyalarda jel yoki o‘sish muhitida o‘sayotgan hujayra yoki mikroorganizmlar koloniyalarini sanash yoki sanash jarayonini osonlashtirish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus asbob.

ex: Colony-forming units are used to estimate the number of viable bacteria.
The water sample contained 500 colony-forming units per milliliter.
colony-forming unit.meta: bu o‘sish muhitida ko‘payib, yangi koloniya hosil qila oladigan tirik hujayra yoki hujayralar guruhi. Koloniya hosil qiluvchi birlik mikrobiologiyada bakteriyalar, zamburug‘lar yoki boshqa mikroorganizmlar sonini aniqlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Colony-stimulating factors are essential in treating patients after chemotherapy.
The doctor prescribed a colony-stimulating factor to help the patient recover white blood cells.
colony-stimulating factor.meta: Koloniya rag‘batlantiruvchi omil – bu suyak iligidagi gematopoetik (qon yaratuvchi) ildiz hujayralar yuzasiga birikib, ularni bo‘linishga va ma’lum turdagi qon hujayralari hosil qilishga rag‘batlantiruvchi glikoproteinlar guruhi.

ex: Condom machines provide easy access to contraception.
The hotel restroom had a condom machine next to the sink.
condom machine.meta: Prezervativ avtomati – bu avtomatik savdo qurilmasi bo‘lib, unda pul yoki kartani to‘lash orqali prezervativ sotib olish mumkin.

ex: Condomless sex increases the risk of sexually transmitted infections.
He regretted having condomless sex without considering the consequences.
condomless.meta: Prezervativsiz – prezervativ ishlatilmagan holat; jinsiy aloqa yoki vaziyatda himoya vositasisiz bo‘lish. Ba’zan bu atama prezervativga ega bo‘lmaslik ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Consumer-driven markets adapt products based on customer feedback.
The fashion industry is highly consumer-driven, responding quickly to trends.
consumer-driven.meta: Iste’molchi talabiga asoslangan – bu mahsulotlar, xizmatlar yoki jarayonlarning rivojlanishi va shakllanishi iste’molchilarning ehtiyojlari, istaklari va talablariga bog‘liq bo‘lishini anglatadi.

ex: The article began with a content warning about discussions of trauma.
The movie had a content warning for graphic violence and strong language.
content warning.meta: bu film, video o‘yin, matn, kitob yoki boshqa materiallar bilan birga beriladigan maxsus ogohlantirish bo‘lib,ba’zi odamlar uchun noqulay yoki ruhiy ta’sir qilishi mumkin bo‘lgan sahnalar, mavzular yoki tasvirlar mavjudligini bildiradi.

ex: Cowboy action shooting events often include historical reenactments.
He competes in cowboy action shooting and enjoys dressing up as a Wild West sheriff.
cowboy action shooting.meta: bu sport turi bo‘lib, ishtirokchilar 19-asrning o‘rtalaridan oxirigacha bo‘lgan Amerikaning G‘arbiy kovboy davriga xos kiyimlar kiyib, shu davr qurollarining nusxalaridan foydalanib, maqsadlarga o‘q uzish bo‘yicha bellashadilar.

ex: Some people consider cowboy caviar (calf testicles) a delicacy at certain food festivals.
I made cowboy caviar with black beans, corn, tomatoes, and cilantro.
cowboy caviar.meta: (Amerika xalq tilida) Ba’zi mintaqalarda bu buqa, qo‘y yoki boshqa hayvonlarning moyagi (testikulasi) bo‘lib, delikates (noan’anaviy taom) sifatida iste’mol qilinadi.

ex: Cowboy coffee is usually stronger and more bitter than regular coffee.
He made cowboy coffee over the campfire during their trip.
cowboy coffee.meta: Kovboy qahvasi – bu kuchli, qora qahva bo‘lib, qahva donachalari (maydalanmagan yoki qo‘pol maydalanadigan) suv bilan birga qozonda qaynatilib tayyorlanadi. Tayyor bo‘lgach, qahva donachalari qozonning tubiga cho‘kadi va ustki qismi ichiladi.

ex: They traveled through cowboy country, where wild horses and cattle roamed freely.
Texas is often considered cowboy country because of its ranches and Western traditions.
cowboy country.meta: Kovboy yurti – bu asosan Shimoliy Amerikada, ayniqsa AQShning g‘arbiy hududlarida joylashgan va kovboylar yashagan, boshqargan yoki faoliyat yuritgan yerlar.

ex: The cowboy-hatted performers entertained the crowd with country songs.
A cowboy-hatted man was riding a horse through the dusty street.
cowboy-hatted.meta: Kovboy shlyapali – kovboy shlyapasini kiygan odam yoki kovboy shlyapasi taqilgan holat. Bu atama ko‘pincha G‘arbiy uslubdagi kiyinishni yoki kovboy madaniyatiga oid tashqi ko‘rinishni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Cowgirl boots are often decorated with embroidery or colorful patterns.
She wore pink cowgirl boots to the rodeo.
cowgirl boot.meta: Kovgirl etik – bu o‘rta boldir balandligigacha yetadigan, odatda sigir terisidan yoki sun’iy charm materialidan tayyorlangan, uchli burun va past, keng poshnaga ega bo‘lgan klassik G‘arb uslubidagi etik.

ex: Cowgirl hats are often paired with cowgirl boots and denim jeans.
She wore a white cowgirl hat with silver decorations to the festival.
cowgirl hat.meta: Kovgirl shlyapa – bu keng qirrali, baland va yumshoq tepalikka ega bo‘lgan bosh kiyim bo‘lib, kovgirl (ayol kovboy) uslubiga xos.

ex: On the large farm, the cowman-gardener was responsible for both livestock and garden work.
The cowman-gardener milked the cows every morning and tended the vegetable garden.
cowman-gardener.meta: bu ferma yoki qishloq xo‘jaligida sigirlarni sog‘ish va boshqa uy-ro‘zg‘or ishlarini bajaradigan, shuningdek, bog‘ni parvarish qiladigan erkak xodim. U chorva parvarishi va sabzavot bog‘iga g‘amxo‘rlik qilish kabi vazifalarni bajaradi.

ex: If the fire spreads further, the situation will go critical.
The patient’s condition began to go critical after the surgery.
to go critical.meta: Kritik holatga kelmoq – bu jarayon yoki vaziyatning eng xavfli, muhim yoki hal qiluvchi bosqichiga yetishi; inqiroz yoki keskin o‘zgarish nuqtasiga chiqishi. Bunday holatda vaziyat boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan yoki jiddiy oqibatlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

ex: Funding for critical access hospitals is essential to provide emergency care in rural areas.
The critical access hospital serves remote communities where larger hospitals are not available.
critical access.meta: Kritik kirish – bu qishloq hududlarida joylashgan, bemorlarga tez tibbiy yordam ko‘rsatadigan kichik va qisqa muddatli xizmat ko‘rsatadigan kasalxona turini ifodalaydi.

ex: Scholars often rely on critical editions to study ancient manuscripts accurately.
The critical edition of Shakespeare’s plays includes extensive notes and variant readings.
critical edition.meta: Tanqidiy nashr – bu adabiy, musiqiy yoki boshqa biror matnning bir nechta qo‘lyozma yoki nashrlaridan taqqoslanib, solishtirilgan, ko‘pincha tushuntiruvchi sharhlar, izohlar va tahlillar bilan boyitilgan nashri.

ex: He received a payout from his critical illness insurance after being diagnosed with multiple sclerosis.
The insurance policy covers critical illnesses such as cancer, stroke, and heart attack.
critical illness.meta: bu sug‘urta shartnomasida ko‘rsatilgan, hayot uchun xavfli yoki o‘limga olib kelishi mumkin bo‘lgan og‘ir kasalliklarni anglatadi. Bunday kasallik tashxisi qo‘yilganda, sug‘urta kompaniyasi sug‘urtalanuvchiga pul to‘lovini amalga oshiradi.

ex: He was placed on the critical list after his heart surgery.
The nurse updated the critical list every morning to inform the doctors.
critical list.meta: Jiddiy ahvoldagi bemorlar ro‘yxati – kasalxonada og‘ir, hayot uchun xavfli holatda bo‘lgan bemorlarning ro‘yxati. Bu ro‘yxat shifokorlar va tibbiyot xodimlari uchun bemorlarning holatini kuzatish va tezkor yordam ko‘rsatish uchun muhimdir.

ex: The university offers a course on critical race theory in the law faculty
Critical race theory argues that racism is embedded in the laws and institutions of society.
critical race theory.meta: Tanqidiy irq nazariyasi – bu huquqshunoslikda rivojlangan nazariy yondashuv bo‘lib, unda irqiy kamsitish va adolatsizlik tizimning asosiy qismi sifatida qaraladi.

ex: The critical region is determined based on the chosen significance level of the test.
If the test statistic falls into the critical region, the null hypothesis is rejected.
critical region.meta: Kritik soha – statistikada qiziqishdagi gipotezani rad etishga olib keladigan, odatda tanlangan statistik parametrlar qiymatlari oralig‘i bilan belgilangan barcha namunalar to‘plami.

ex: Many dinosaur hunters work in teams to excavate ancient bones.
The dinosaur hunter discovered a new fossil in the remote desert.
dinosaur hunter.meta: Dinozavr ovchisi – bu dinozavrlarga oid fosillangan qoldiqlarni izlab topadigan shaxs. Ular ko‘pincha arxeologiya va paleontologiya sohasida ishlaydi, eski yer qatlamlaridan dinozavr qoldiqlarini qazib olish va o‘rganishga ixtisoslashgan.

ex: Dinosaur rock is often contrasted with more modern and experimental rock genres.
Some critics describe that band’s sound as dinosaur rock because it doesn’t innovate.
dinosaur rock.meta: Dinozavr rok – bu eski davr musiqasidan kelib chiqqan yoki undan kuchli ta’sirlangan rok musiqasi. Ko‘pincha bunday musiqa eskirgan, yangilik va ijodiy yondashuvdan mahrum, o‘tmishda qolgan deb hisoblanadi.

ex: The old machine looked dinosaur-like compared to modern technology.
The creature had dinosaur-like scales and a long tail.
dinosaur-like.meta: Dinozavrga o‘xshash – dinozavrga o‘xshaydigan, uning xususiyatlariga ega bo‘lgan yoki dinozavrni eslatadigan narsani ifodalovchi sifat. Bu atama jismoniy ko‘rinish, xatti-harakat yoki umuman dinozavr bilan bog‘liq belgilar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: She’s determined to go the distance in her boxing match tonight.
The horse was strong enough to go the distance and win the race.
to go the distance.meta: asosan ot poygasi sohasida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, poyga, jang yoki boshqa raqobatli faoliyat davomida belgilangan to‘liq masofani yoki muddatni muvaffaqiyatli yakunlash, oxirigacha chidab bormoq degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: She went the distance in completing the marathon despite the difficulties.
If you want to succeed, you have to go the distance and never give up.
to go the distance.meta: biror maqsadga erishish, vazifani to‘liq bajarish yoki topshiriqni yakunlash uchun zarur bo‘lgan majburiyatni olish va qat’iyat ko‘rsatish. Bu ibora insonning qat’iyati, sabr-toqati va uzluksiz mehnatini ifodalaydi.

ex: The new engine is designed to go the distance without frequent repairs.
This brand of shoes really goes the distance and lasts for years.
to go the distance.meta: Uzoq xizmat qilmoq — mashina, asbob yoki boshqa buyumning uzoq vaqt davomida ishlashga qodirligi, o‘z vazifasini davom ettirishi, mustahkamligi va chidamliligi. Bu ibora ob’ektning uzoq umr ko‘rishi yoki bardoshli bo‘lishini bildiradi.

ex: After many years apart, she realized that distance really lends enchantment to the view.
They say distance lends enchantment to the view, so don’t judge too quickly.
distance lends enchantment to the view.meta: Masofa manzaraga joziba beradi — bu maqol bo‘lib, narsalar uzoqdan qaraganda yanada go‘zal, qiziqarli yoki jozibadorroq ko‘rinadi degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: The distance chair is placed near the finish line for a clear view of the race.
The distance judge sat on the distance chair to observe the final stretch of the race.
distance chair.meta: Masofa stuli – poyga yoki musobaqaning masofa postida joylashgan, masofa hakami uchun mo‘ljallangan baland stul. Bu stuldan hakam poyganing oxirgi bosqichlarini kuzatib, natijalarni aniqlashda foydalanadi.

ex: Distance markers are important in crowded places to prevent close contact.
The store placed distance markers on the floor to help customers keep proper social distancing.
distance marker.meta: Masofa belgisі — ikki narsa orasidagi masofani ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladigan belgi yoki ko‘rsatkich. Ba’zida bu atama ijtimoiy masofani to‘g‘ri saqlash uchun pollar, devorlar va boshqa joylardagi maxsus belgilarni anglatadi.

ex: The Doctor of Physic is qualified to diagnose and treat complex medical conditions.
He earned his Doctor of Physic degree from a prestigious university.
doctor of physic.meta: Tibbiyot doktori — universitetning tibbiyot fakulteti tomonidan beriladigan eng yuqori darajadagi ilmiy unvon egasi. Bu unvon shifokorlik kasbida professional darajada bilim va tajriba egasi ekanligini bildiradi.

ex: Doctors of the Church contributed greatly to Christian theology and doctrine.
Saint Augustine is one of the most famous Doctors of the Church.
doctor of the church.meta: Cherkov doktori — xristianlik tarixida muhim o‘rin tutgan va uning ta’limotlari, yozgan asarlari cherkov tomonidan yuqori baholangan, diniy va teologik bilimlari bilan ajralib turadigan olim va ruhoniylarga berilgan unvon.

ex: In the game of doctors and nurses, one child pretends to be a patient while others take care of them
Children love playing doctors and nurses in the schoolyard.
doctors and nurses.meta: Shifokorlar va hamshiralar — bolalar o‘ynaydigan o‘yin bo‘lib, unda ishtirokchilar shifokor va hamshiralar rolini o‘ynab, kasallarni davolayotgandek harakat qilishadi. Ba’zida bemor rolini ham o‘ynashadi.

ex: If you want to win, you have to go for the doctor and give it your all.
He really went for the doctor during the final lap of the race
to go for the doctor.meta: To‘liq kuch bilan harakat qilmoq — Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya lahjasida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, biror ishga to‘liq kuch va diqqat bilan kirishish, to‘liq berilib harakat qilish, tez va qat’iyat bilan intilish ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: Some terminally ill patients choose doctor-assisted suicide to avoid prolonged suffering.
Doctor-assisted suicide is a controversial topic in medical ethics.
doctor-assisted suicide.meta: Shifokor yordamida o‘z joniga qasd qilish — hayot uchun umidsiz yoki davolanmaydigan og‘ir kasallikka chalingan odamning o‘z hayotini ixtiyoriy ravishda tugatishi jarayoni, bunda shifokor bemorga o‘z joniga qasd qilishda yordam beradi.

ex: The doctor–patient relationship is based on trust and confidentiality.
Good doctor–patient communication is essential for effective treatment.
doctor–patient.meta: shifokor va bemor o‘rtasidagi munosabatlarni yoki umumiy holda shifokorlar bilan bemorlar o‘rtasidagi aloqalarni ifodalovchi atama. Bu munosabat sog‘liqni saqlash jarayonidagi o‘zaro ishonch, muloqot va hamkorlikni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: The doctor’s office is equipped with all the necessary medical instruments.
She waited in the doctor’s office for her appointment.
doctor’s office.meta: Shifokor qabulxonasi — shifokor bemorlarni ko‘radigan, ularni davolaydigan yoki maslahat beradigan xona yoki joy. Bu yerda tibbiy ko‘riklar o‘tkaziladi va sog‘liq bilan bog‘liq masalalar hal qilinadi.

ex: Medical students must learn to understand and use doctorspeak fluently.
Patients often find doctorspeak confusing because of the technical terms.
doctorspeak.meta: Shifokor tili — shifokorlar va boshqa tibbiyot mutaxassislari tomonidan ishlatiladigan, ko‘pincha murakkab texnik atamalar va jargonlardan tashkil topgan yozish va nutq uslubi. Bu til oddiy odamlar uchun tushunish qiyin bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Doctor’s surgery hours are usually posted on the clinic door.
The patient went to the doctor’s surgery for a check-up.
doctor’s surgery.meta: Shifokor qabulxonasi — shifokor bemorlarni ko‘radigan, ularni davolaydigan yoki maslahat beradigan xona yoki joy. Shuningdek, ba’zan tibbiy muolaja o‘tkaziladigan vaqt yoki holatni ham anglatadi.

ex: She’s quick on the draw when it comes to solving problems at work.
The cowboy was quick on the draw and won the duel.
quick on the draw.meta: asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, odatda qurolni tez chiqarish yoki otish qobiliyatini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha bu ibora figurativ ma’noda qo‘llanilib, vaziyatga tez va o‘z vaqtida javob beradigan, tez harakat qiluvchi odamni ifodalaydi.

ex: Draw plays are effective when the defense expects a pass.
The team used a draw play to trick the defense and gain yardage.
draw play.meta: Draw o‘yini — futbol (ayniqsa, amerika futboli) terminologiyasida, bu hujum harakati bo‘lib, unda kvoterbek dastlab pas berishga tayyorlanyapti kabi orqaga chekinadi, shu bilan himoya chiziqlovchilarini oldinga tortib, ularni o‘z pozitsiyasidan chiqaradi.

ex: She was drawing her legs after her due to the illness that made walking difficult.
After the long hike, he drew his legs after him, exhausted and slow.
to draw one’s legs after (one).meta: Oyoqlarini orqasidan tortib yurmoq — juda sekin yoki qiynalib yurishni ifodalaydi, ayniqsa charchoq, kasallik yoki noqulaylik sababli oyoqlarini tortib, qiyinchilik bilan yurish.

ex: By introducing strict regulations, the authorities drew the teeth of illegal traders.
The government’s new policy drew the teeth of the opposition.
to draw the teeth of.meta: Tishlarini sug‘urib olmoq — ko‘chma ma’noda biror narsani yoki kishini zarar yetkazish, kuch yoki ta’sir ko‘rsatish qobiliyatidan mahrum qilish; kuchsizlantirish yoki zararsiz holga keltirish.

ex: The company drew fire for its poor handling of the crisis.
The politician’s recent comments drew fire from both the media and the public.
to draw fire.meta: Tanqidga tortilmoq — ko‘chma ma’noda qattiq tanqid yoki keskin e’tirozlarga sabab bo‘lish, tanqidchilar yoki jamoatchilik e’tiborini salbiy tomonga jalb qilish.

ex: He bravely exposed himself to draw the crabs away from his comrades.
The decoy unit was sent ahead to draw the crabs and protect the main force.
to draw the crabs.meta: Dushman o‘qini o‘ziga jalb qilmoq — harbiy jargon bo‘lib, dushmanning, ayniqsa artilleriyaning, o‘q otishini o‘ziga tortish, dushman hujumining e’tiborini boshqa joydan chalg‘itish yoki o‘ziga qaratish.

ex: The unauthorized protest drew the crabs from the city authorities.
His outspoken criticism of the management quickly drew the crabs.
to draw the crabs.meta: O‘zi tarafga e’tibor yoki g‘azabni jalb qilmoq — kuchli yoki salbiy reaktsiyani qo‘zg‘atish, ayniqsa rahbariyat yoki yuqori hokimiyat vakillari tomonidan istalmagan e’tiborni o‘ziga jalb qilish.

ex: A draw frame is essential in cold-working processes of metal fabrication.
The technician adjusted the draw frame to reduce the rod’s diameter.
draw frame.meta: Cho‘zish stanogi — metall novdalar yoki boshqa metall qismlarni sovuq ishlov berish orqali ularni ma’lum shakl, qalinlik yoki o‘lchamga keltirish uchun ishlatiladigan uskuna yoki ish stoli.

ex: He used a draw program to create the company logo.
CorelDRAW is a popular draw program used by many graphic designers.
draw program.meta: Chizish dasturi — foydalanuvchilarga raqamli grafikalar, ayniqsa vektor grafikalarini yaratish va tahrirlash imkonini beradigan dasturiy ta’minot. Bu dastur orqali shakllar, rasmlar va dizaynlar chizish mumkin.

ex: Draw-reins should be used carefully to avoid injuring the horse.
The rider used draw-reins to help correct the horse’s head position.
draw-rein.meta: Cho‘zma jilov — ot jilovining bir turi bo‘lib, jilovning uchi boshqaruvchi qo‘lga kelguncha og‘iz temiridan o‘tadi. Bu jilov otning bosh harakati yoki holatini to‘g‘rilash yoki boshqarish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: He used a draw stroke to move the kayak closer to the dock.
The draw stroke of the machine pulls the metal sheet towards the operator for shaping.
draw stroke.meta: Asbob yoki mashina qismining operator yoki mashinaning o‘zi tomon harakatlanishi (teskari harakatdan farqli ravishda). Bu harakat asbobning tortish yoki ishchi zarbasi hisoblanadi.

ex: In machine-made lace, the draw thread is essential for structural integrity.
The draw thread holds the separate sections of the lace together.
draw thread.meta: Tortuvchi ip — asosan matoning alohida qismlarini, ayniqsa mashinada tayyorlangan dantellarni bir-biriga ulash uchun ishlatiladigan ip. Bu ip matolar orasini mahkamlash yoki tikish jarayonida ishlatiladi.

ex: A higher draw weight increases the speed and power of the arrow.
The bow has a draw weight of 40 pounds, making it suitable for hunting.
draw weight.meta: Tortish kuchi — kamon torini ma’lum masofaga yoki maksimal darajada tortish uchun zarur bo‘lgan kuch. Bu kuch kamonda yig‘ilgan potentsial energiyani belgilaydi va o‘q uchish tezligiga bevosita ta’sir qiladi.

ex: Some communities adopt a drawbridge mentality to protect their cultural identity.
The country’s drawbridge mentality prevents it from engaging in international cooperation.
drawbridge mentality.meta: Yopiq ko‘prik tafakkuri — tashqi dunyodan yoki boshqa jamoalardan ataylab yakkalanish, o‘zini chetga olish yoki faqat o‘z manfaatlarini himoya qilishga intilish mentaliteti.

ex: He carefully performed draw filing to remove the last imperfections.
Draw filing is used to achieve a very smooth finish on metal surfaces.
draw filing.meta: Yonma silliqlash — fayl (silliqlovchi asbob) bilan material yuzasini faylni ish yuzasiga ko‘ndalang (yonlama) harakatlantirish orqali silliqlash jarayoni. Bu usul odatda silliqlik va tekislikka erishish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: He adjusted the drawing cord at the waist of his sweatpants.
The bag closes securely with a drawing cord.
drawing cord.meta: Tortuvchi arqon — narsalarni tortish yoki siqish uchun ishlatiladigan turli xil arqon yoki bog‘ichlar. Maxsus ma’noda: sumka og‘zi, kiyim bel qismi va shunga o‘xshash joylarga o‘rnatilgan, tortilganda qattiqlashadigan yoki yopiladigan ip yoki bog‘ich.

ex: A drawing hand can turn into a winning hand if the right card is drawn.
He was holding a drawing hand, hoping for a heart on the river.
drawing hand.meta: karta o‘yinida ma’lum bir karta yoki kartalarni olish orqali kuchli yoki g‘olib kombinatsiyaga aylanishi mumkin bo‘lgan qo‘l. Bunday qo‘l hali to‘liq yutish kombinatsiyasiga ega emas, lekin keyingi kartalar tortilganda kuchli holatga kelishi mumkin.

ex: Wool slivers pass through several drawing-machines to achieve uniform thickness.
The drawing-machine aligns and stretches the cotton fibres before spinning.
drawing-machine.meta: Tortish mashinasi — to‘qimachilikda ip gazlamaga tayyorlash jarayonida ishlatiladigan uskunadir. Bu mashina paxta, jun va boshqa tolalarni cho‘zib, ingichka va bir xil qalinlikdagi lenta (sliver) shakliga keltirish uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Drawing rolls ensure that the fibres are evenly stretched before spinning.
The wire passed through the drawing rolls to reduce its diameter.
drawing roll.meta: To‘qimachilikda tolalarni yigirishga tayyorlash jarayonida tolalarni cho‘zish va tekis qalinlikka keltirish uchun ishlatiladigan aylanuvchi valiklardan biri.

ex: She used a drawing program to design the company logo.
Adobe Illustrator is a popular drawing program for creating vector graphics.
drawing program.meta: Chizish dasturi — foydalanuvchilarga raqamli grafikalar, ayniqsa vektor grafikalarini yaratish va tahrirlash imkonini beradigan kompyuter dasturi. Bu dasturlar yordamida foydalanuvchilar shakllar, chiziqlar, matnlar va ranglar bilan ishlashlari mumkin.

ex: Several improvements to the system are currently on the drawing board.
The new stadium is still on the drawing board.
on the drawing board.meta: Loyiha bosqichida — hozircha faqat rejalashtirish yoki ishlab chiqish jarayonida bo‘lgan, hali amalga oshirilmagan yoki yakunlanmagan loyiha, taklif yoki rejaga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Our marketing strategy didn’t work, we have to go back to the drawing table.
The experiment failed, so it’s back to the drawing table.
back to the drawing table.meta: biror g‘oya, reja yoki loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz chiqqanda yoki ishlamaganida, uni qayta ko‘rib chiqish va yangidan boshlash zarurligini bildiruvchi ibora. Bu ifoda aslida loyihalash stoliga yana qaytib, yangi reja tuzish zarurligini anglatadi.

ex: The cause of epidemic neuromyasthenia remains uncertain, though it may follow viral outbreaks.
Several cases of epidemic neuromyasthenia were reported in the isolated community.
epidemic neuromyasthenia.meta: kelib chiqishi noma’lum bo‘lgan kasallik bo‘lib, ba’zan virusli infeksiyadan keyin yuzaga kelishi mumkin. Bu kasallik haddan tashqari charchash, mushak zaifligi va boshqa aniq bo‘lmagan (spetsifik bo‘lmagan) nevrologik belgilar bilan tavsiflanadi

ex: Foreign agents often work to gather sensitive information for their home countries.
He was arrested on suspicion of being a foreign agent.
foreign agent.meta: (a) Bitta davlat nomidan boshqa davlat hududida harakat qiladigan shaxs; (b) Keyingi qo‘llanilishida: yashirin ravishda ma’lumot yig‘adigan yoki biror davlat foydasiga ishlaydigan shaxs, josus yoki maxfiy agent.

ex: Foreign fighters often travel abroad to support ideological or religious causes.
Hundreds of foreign fighters have joined the conflict in the region
foreign fighter.meta: Chet el jangchisi — boshqa mamlakatdagi urush yoki qurolli mojaro ishtirokchisiga aylangan shaxs. U odatda o‘sha davlat fuqarosi bo‘lmaydi, lekin siyosiy, diniy yoki mafkuraviy sabablar tufayli mojaro tomonlaridan biriga qo‘shiladi.

ex: The festival features several foreign films from Europe and Asia.
We watched a foreign film with English subtitles.
foreign film.meta: Chet el filmi — boshqa mamlakatda ishlab chiqarilgan film, ayniqsa, subtitr yoki dublyaj qilishni talab qiladigan xorijiy til filmidir. Odatda, mahalliy kino sanoatiga qaraganda boshqa madaniyat va til vakili bo‘lgan film sifatida qaraladi.

ex: In the United Kingdom, the Foreign Secretary plays a key role in diplomatic relations.
The foreign secretary met with international leaders to discuss the peace process.
foreign secretary.meta: Tashqi ishlar vaziri — hukumatning tashqi siyosat uchun javobgar bo‘lgan vaziri. Xususan, Buyuk Britaniyada (odatda bosh harflar bilan yoziladi: Foreign Secretary) bu shaxs mamlakatning xalqaro aloqalarini boshqaradigan vazirlik rahbari hisoblanadi.

ex: The clinic provides gender-affirming treatments such as hormone therapy.
Gender-affirming care is essential for the well-being of many transgender people.
gender-affirming.meta: Genderni tasdiqlovchi — insonning o‘z genderini (jinsiy o‘zini anglashi) tasdiqlovchi yoki uni hurmat qiluvchi harakat, munosabat yoki xizmat.

ex: The debate between gender-critical activists and transgender rights advocates is ongoing.
Gender-critical feminists often question the idea that gender identity should override biological sex.
gender critical.meta: Gender tanqidchisi — gender (jinsiy o‘zlik) haqidagi an’anaviy yoki zamonaviy tushunchalarni tanqid qiladigan qarash. Bu atama odatda ikki asosiy ma’noda ishlatiladi

ex: The Great Asianism movement influenced political leaders in early 20th-century Asia.
Great Asianism promoted the idea of solidarity among Asian countries against Western imperialism.
great asianism.meta: Buyuk Osiyochilik — Osiyo davlatlari o‘rtasida siyosiy birlik yoki birdamlikni ilgari suruvchi harakat yoki mafkura.

ex: During the early 20th century, Greater Asianism became influential in shaping regional politics.
Greater Asianism sought to unite all Asian countries in opposition to Western dominance.
greater asianism.meta: Keng Osiyochilik — Osiyoning siyosiy birlashuvi yoki Osiyo mamlakatlari o‘rtasidagi chuqur birdamlikni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi harakat yoki mafkura.

ex: You’ve made a hames of that cake! It’s burnt.
He really made a hames of the report.
to make a hames of.meta: To make a hames of — biror ishni juda yomon, be’mahall yoki no‘noqlik bilan bajarish; ishni buzib qo‘yish yoki chalg‘itib yuborish. Odatda tanqid yoki kulgili ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The city is working on programs to support housing insecure individuals.
Many housing insecure families struggle to pay rent each month.
housing insecure.meta: Uy-joysizlik xavfi ostida bo‘lgan — odamning barqaror yoki yetarli turar joyga ega bo‘lmasligi; doimiy uy-joydan mahrum bo‘lish xavfi mavjud bo‘lishi, uyidan haydalish ehtimoli bo‘lishi yoki xavfli, yaroqsiz sharoitlarda yashash holati.

ex: Living in an information bubble limits exposure to different perspectives.
Social media algorithms can trap people in an information bubble.
information bubble.meta: Axborot pufagi — bu ma’lum axborot oqimi bilan chegaralangan vaziyat bo‘lib, bunda odamlar faqat o‘z fikrlarini yoki dunyoqarashlarini tasdiqlovchi ma’lumotlargina bilan to‘qnashadi.

ex: Some people prefer internal condoms because they can be inserted in advance.
An internal condom provides protection against sexually transmitted infections.
internal condom.meta: Ichki prezervativ — jinsiy aloqada homiladorlikdan saqlanish yoki jinsiy yo‘l bilan yuqadigan kasalliklardan himoyalanish uchun vaginaga yoki anusga ichkaridan taqiladigan yupqa rezina (lateks) qoplama.

ex: He decorated his house with items of deliberate kitschness.
The kitschness of the plastic flowers made the room feel less elegant.
kitschness.meta: san’at yoki buyumlarda haddan tashqari bezakdorlik, sun’iylik va estetik qiymatning pastligi bilan ajralib turuvchi sifat; ko‘pincha jiddiy san’atga zid bo‘lgan, lekin ba’zan ataylab shunday qabul qilinadigan yengil va ommaviy madaniyat mahsuloti.

ex: Becoming a kung fu master requires years of training and dedication.
The kung fu master taught his students discipline and patience.
kung fu master.meta: Kung-fu ustasi — Xitoy jang san’atida yuqori darajadagi mahorat va tajribaga ega bo‘lgan shaxs. U jangovar texnikalar, o‘zini boshqarish va ruhiy tayyorgarlik bo‘yicha yetuk hisoblanadi.

ex: This new phone leaves its rivals standing in terms of speed and performance.
She ran so fast that she left all her competitors standing.
to leave (a person) standing.meta: (Kimnidir) ortda qoldirmoq — raqibdan yoki boshqalardan ancha yaxshi, tez yoki muvaffaqiyatli bo‘lish; biror kishini yoki narsani ortda qoldirish, ancha ustun bo‘lish.

ex: You can fight it all you want, but sooner or later you’ll come to Limerick.
After much resistance, he finally came to Limerick and admitted his mistake.
to come to limerick.meta: O‘ziga kelmoq yoki oqibatiga rozi bo‘lmoq — o‘z xatolarini tushunib yetish, haqiqatni qabul qilish yoki qilingan harakatlarning salbiy oqibatlarini tan olish holati. Bu ibora hozir kam ishlatiladi.

ex: A made hand doesn’t need to draw another card to win.
He had a made hand with a full house, so he confidently raised the bet.
made hand.meta: kartalar o‘yinida (xususan, pokerda) hozirgi holatida allaqachon kuchli va qimmatli kombinatsiyaga ega bo‘lgan qo‘l. Bunday qo‘l g‘alaba qozonish uchun qo‘shimcha kartaga muhtoj emas. Bu drawing hand ga qarama-qarshi tushunchadir.

ex: Major depression often requires medical and psychological treatment.
She was diagnosed with major depression after experiencing persistent sadness for several weeks.
major depression.meta: Og‘ir depressiya — ruhiy tushkunlikning eng kuchli shakli bo‘lib, odatda kamida ikki hafta davom etadigan, chuqur qayg‘u, qiziqish va motivatsiyaning yo‘qolishi, charchoq, o‘zini ayblash, uyqu va ishtahaning buzilishi kabi simptomlar bilan tavsiflanadi.

ex: Male condoms are widely available at pharmacies and health centers.
He always uses a male condom to practice safe sex.
