male condom.meta: Erkaklar prezervativi — jinsiy aloqa paytida erkak jinsiy a’zosiga kiyiladigan yupqa rezinali qoplama bo‘lib, homiladorlikning oldini olish va jinsiy yo‘l bilan yuqadigan infeksiyalardan himoyalanish maqsadida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: In an open-world game, players can explore the map without restrictions.
GTA is one of the most popular open-world games.
open-world.meta: Ochiq dunyo (o‘yin) — bu o‘yin turi bo‘lib, unda o‘yinchi katta virtual muhit ichida erkin harakatlanishi, maqsadlarga qanday usul bilan erishishni o‘zi tanlashi va o‘yindagi ssenariyni o‘z ixtiyori bilan boshqarishi mumkin.

ex: A PCR test can accurately detect the presence of viral genetic material.
The PCR test is commonly used to detect COVID-19.
pcr test.meta: PCR testi — laboratoriya sharoitida ma’lum bir DNK ketma-ketligini aniqlash uchun PCR (polimer zanjir reaksiyasi) texnologiyasi asosida o‘tkaziladigan test. Bu usul orqali organizmdagi kasallik yoki virus mavjudligini aniqlash mumkin.

ex: Some people find the reverse cowgirl position enjoyable because it offers a different angle and perspective.
The reverse cowgirl is a common sexual position featured in many discussions of sexual health.
reverse cowgirl.meta: Teskarı kovgirl holati — jinsiy aloqa holati bo‘lib, unda ayol erkak ustida o‘tiradi, lekin yuzini undan orqaga, ya’ni erkakdan teskariga qaratadi. Bu holat kovgirl holatining teskari varianti hisoblanadi.

ex: She used a ride-hailing app to quickly get to the airport.
Ride-hailing services like Uber have changed the way people travel in cities.
ride-hailing.meta: mobil ilova yoki veb-sayt orqali shaxsiy haydovchini chaqirish va yo‘lovchini to‘lov evaziga belgilangan manzilga yetkazib qo‘yish xizmati. Odatda, bu xizmat Uber, Yandex Go yoki boshqa shunga o‘xshash ilovalar orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Without the work of those before us, we could not have made such progress; we stand on the shoulders of giants.
Modern scientists stand on the shoulders of giants like Newton and Einstein.
to stand on the shoulders of giants.meta: Ulug‘larning yelkasida turmoq — buyuk olimlar, mutafakkirlar va kashfiyotchilar tomonidan erishilgan yutuqlarga tayangan holda yangi yutuqlar va kashfiyotlar qilmoq; oldingi avlodlar ilmiy yoki intellektual asoslarini rivojlantirmoq.

ex: Excessive sib-breeding can lead to genetic disorders in animals.
Sib-breeding is sometimes used to preserve specific traits in animals.
sib-breeding.meta: Qarindosh hayvonlarni chatishtirish — bir uy hayvonining aka-uka yoki opa-singillari yoki juda yaqin qarindoshlari o‘rtasida naslchilik maqsadida chatishtirish amaliyoti.

ex: The church offers spiritual counselling to those who are struggling with grief.
Spiritual counselling can help people find peace during difficult times.
spiritual counselling.meta: Ma'naviy maslahat — odamlarga ruhiy va ma'naviy masalalarda, ayniqsa qiyinchilik yoki sinov davrlarida yo‘l-yo‘riq ko‘rsatish yoki yordam berish maqsadida beriladigan maslahat yoki terapiya.

ex: Steel can withstand high tensile stress without breaking.
The tensile stress on the rope increased as more weight was added.
tensile stress.meta: Tortish kuchlanishi — biror ob'ekt yoki materialni cho‘zishga intiladigan kuch; material ichida birlik yuzaga to‘g‘ri keladigan cho‘zish kuchi.

ex: You’ll see someone sitting by the window reading a book — that’s me.
I’ll be in the kitchen if you need me. — That’s me cooking dinner.
that’s me ——.meta: Bu men —— — (so‘zlashuv tili, asosan Britaniya ingliz tilida) — hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi holat, faoliyat yoki ahvolni ta’riflashda ishlatiladigan ibora. Biror kishi o‘zini yoki boshqasini ma’lum vaziyatda yoki holatda tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: That’s me finished, I’m ready to go.
That’s me done for the day.
that’s me.meta: that’s me — (so‘zlashuv tili) — Biror ishni tugatganini yoki ketishga tayyor ekanini bildiradigan ibora. Odatda shaxs bir ishni yakunlaganini, tamom bo‘lganini yoki hozir ketishga tayyorligini bildiradi.

ex: It’s not a bad car, and quite cheap at that.
He’s a good footballer, and a fair one at that.
at that.meta: at that — so‘zlovchining fikriga ko‘ra, biror narsaning qo‘shimcha jihatini yoki kutilmagan afzalligi yoki kamchiligini ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha "undan tashqari", "aslida", "buni ham hisobga olish kerak" ma’nosida keladi.

ex: That’s what she said.
This is so hard.
that’s what she said.meta: that’s what she said — asosan Amerika ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan kulgili ibora bo‘lib, avvalgi oddiy yoki begunoh so‘zlarda yashirin jinsiy ma’no borligini hazil tarzida ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu ibora kinoyaviy yoki misqollik bilan aytiladi.

ex: he loves to tweak the nose of his rivals with his sarcastic comments.
the journalist's article tweaked the nose of the government.
to tweak the nose of.meta: ataylab kimgadir hazil yoki qasddan achchiq qilib tegish, uni asabiga tegish yoki uni qasddan g‘azablantirish orqali javob reaksiya olish. bu ibora ko‘pincha birovni ataylab jahlini chiqarish yoki uni provokatsiya qilish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The government is working to reduce vaccine hesitancy through public education.
Vaccine hesitancy can lead to the resurgence of preventable diseases.
vaccine hesitancy.meta: bu o‘zini yoki farzandini yuqumli kasalliklarga qarshi emlashga nisbatan ikkilanib qolish, emlashdan bosh tortish yoki emlashga qarshilik ko‘rsatish holati. Bu ko‘pincha noto‘g‘ri tushuncha, shaxsiy e’tiqod yoki xavotir sabab yuzaga keladi.

ex: Doctors are working to build trust with the vaccine hesitant population.
Many vaccine hesitant people are influenced by misinformation.
vaccine hesitant.meta: bu yuqumli kasalliklarga qarshi o‘zini yoki farzandini emlashga nisbatan ikkilanuvchi, emlanishdan bosh tortuvchi yoki emlashga qarshi shaxs. Ular emlanishga nisbatan ehtiyotkor, shubhali yoki qaror qabul qilishda ikkilanadigan odamlar bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The practice of vaccine inoculation began in the 18th century.
Vaccine inoculation against smallpox saved millions of lives.
vaccine inoculation.meta: bu odamni emlash, ya'ni tanaga maxsus tayyorlangan vaksinani yuborish orqali kasallikka qarshi immunitet hosil qilish jarayoni. Dastlab bu atama qo‘ziqorin kasalligiga qarshi qorako‘zon (sigir chechagi) orqali emlash amaliyotiga nisbatan ishlatilgan.

ex: Many people downloaded their vaccine passport onto their smartphones.
You may need a vaccine passport to travel to some countries.
vaccine passport.meta: bu shaxsning ma'lum bir yuqumli kasallikka qarshi emlanganligini tasdiqlovchi hujjat. Bu hujjat rasmiy shaklda (qog‘oz yoki elektron tarzda) bo‘lishi mumkin va odatda sayohat yoki ommaviy tadbirlarda emlanganlikni isbotlash uchun talab qilinadi.

ex: Scientists study the vaccinia virus to develop new vaccines.
The vaccinia virus played a crucial role in eradicating smallpox.
vaccinia virus.meta: chechak kasalligiga qarshi emlashda ishlatiladigan yuqumli virus. Bu ortopoksvirus turiga kiradi va chechak virusi hamda qoramol chechagi (cowpox) virusidan farq qiladi. U laboratoriyalarda doimiy ravishda saqlanadi va emlash jarayonida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: What about your brother?
What about tomorrow?
what about ——.meta: What about —— — biror narsaga yoki kishiga nisbatan fikr yoki harakat haqida so‘rash, e’tibor qaratish yoki taklif bildirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Odatda suhbat davomida boshqa bir mavzuni yoki shaxsni eslatish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: This phone is cheap, fast, and reliable. What's not to like?
It's a beautiful day, free food, and great company. What's not to like?
what's to ——.meta: what's to —— — odatda salbiy savollar shaklida ishlatiladi va ma’qullash yoki yoqtirishni anglatadi. Ko‘pincha "what's not to like?" shaklida bo‘lib, "unda yoqmaydigan narsa bormi?" degan ma’noni beradi.

ex: What the what! How did you do that?
What the what is going on here?
what the what.meta: what the what — bu ibora (asosan AQShda) hazilomuz yoki yumshatilgan so‘z shakli bo‘lib, "what the hell" yoki "what the fuck" kabi kuchli hayrat yoki tushunmovchilikni bildiruvchi ifodaning muloyimroq, ehtiyotkor shakli.

ex: During the Whig Supremacy, the Tories had little influence in government.
The period of Whig Supremacy shaped the development of the British parliamentary system.
whig supremacy.meta: Whiglar ustunligi — Buyuk Britaniyada 1714–1790-yillar oralig‘idagi davr, asosan Jorj I, Jorj II va Jorj III hukmronlik yillarida, siyosiy hokimiyat Whig partiyasi qo‘lida bo‘lgan va ularning siyosiy ta’siri juda kuchli bo‘lgan davr.

ex: Some charity campaigns are accused of having a white saviour complex.
The film was criticized for promoting the white saviour narrative.
white saviour.meta: Oq najotkor — (odatda kinoyali yoki istehzoli tarzda ishlatiladi) — oq tanli inson, u qora tanli yoki boshqa rangli odamlarga yordam beradi, lekin bu yordam aslida o‘z manfaatlarini ko‘zlash yoki o‘zini yaxshi ko‘rsatish uchun qilingan deb hisoblanadi.

ex: The company offers ancilliary services such as technical support and maintenance.
Ancilliary staff play a crucial role in the hospital’s day-to-day functioning.
ancilliary.meta: Ancilliary — asosiy narsaga bo‘ysunuvchi yoki unga xizmat qiluvchi; yordamchi yoki qo‘shimcha; biror narsani to‘ldiruvchi yoki unga hamroh bo‘luvchi.

ex: many andalusi scholars contributed to science and philosophy.
the andalusi style of music is still performed in morocco today.
andalusi.meta: al-andalus yoki uning madaniyati, san’ati, musiqasi va xalqi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan narsalar; xususan, shimoliy afrikada mashhur bo‘lgan va o‘rta asrlardagi islomiy andalusdan kelib chiqqan arab musiqasi uslubiga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The mountains provided shelter to the andartes as they fought the occupation forces.
The andartes played a key role in the Greek resistance during World War II.
andartes.meta: andartes — Yunonistonda, ayniqsa 1941–1944 yillarda fashistik kuchlar (Axis kuchlari) bosqiniga qarshi kurashgan, muntazam bo‘lmagan harbiy, partizan yoki qarshilik ko‘rsatgan jangchi.

ex: Artifacts from the Andaste culture have been discovered by archaeologists.
The Andaste were known for their fortified villages along the Susquehanna River.
andaste.meta: andaste — Shimoliy Iroquois xalqlariga mansub, ilgari Pensilvaniyadagi Susquehanna daryosining quyi qismida yashagan xalq. Ular ko‘pincha susquehannock nomi bilan ham tanilgan.

ex: Andhra cuisine is famous for its spicy dishes.
The Andhra people have a rich cultural heritage.
andhra.meta: andhra — Hindistonning janubi-sharqida joylashgan Andhra yoki hozirgi Andhra Pradesh shtatining mahalliy aholisi yoki shu hududga mansub shaxs.

ex: Andiamo! We’re going to be late.
After dinner, she said: "Andiamo, let’s take a walk."
andiamo.meta: andiamo — (italyancha) "ketdik!", "yur!", "tezroq!" kabi harakatga chorlovchi, odatda birovni biror joyga borishga yoki ish boshlashga undovchi so‘z.

ex: She met an Andino farmer in the mountains of Venezuela.
The Andino people have rich cultural traditions.
andino.meta: andino — And tog‘lari mintaqasida yashovchi yoki shu hududdan bo‘lgan inson; xususan, Venesuelaning And mintaqasiga tegishli aholiga nisbatan qo‘llanadi.

ex: Andon lights alerted the entire team about the issue.
The worker activated the andon system to report the defect immediately.
andon.meta: andon — Ishlab chiqarish jarayonida muammo yoki nuqson aniqlanganda ogohlantirish berish yoki jarayonni to‘xtatish uchun ishlatiladigan tizim. Bu tizim ko‘pincha ishlab chiqarish liniyasida vizual yoki tovushli signal yordamida xabar beradi.

ex: The Andrewmas fair attracted people from neighboring villages.
The town holds a large market on Andrewmas each year.
andrewmas.meta: andrewmas — 30-noyabrda nishonlanadigan Avliyo Andrey bayrami kuni. Dastlabki ishlatishda ko‘pincha qo‘shimcha so‘z bilan birga, masalan, andrewmas yarmarkasi, andrewmas muddati kabi shakllarda uchraydi.

ex: Androcentrism can lead to biased research outcomes that neglect female perspectives.
The history book was criticized for its androcentrism, as it largely ignored women's contributions.
androcentrism.meta: androtsentrizm — erkaklarga birlamchi yoki mutlaq e'tibor qaratish; ayollar bilan solishtirganda erkaklarni markazga qo‘yuvchi xatti-harakatlar yoki qarashlar.

ex: The kitchen was filled with an aniseedy aroma.
The drink had an aniseedy flavour that reminded me of licorice.
aniseedy.meta: anis hidli yoki anis ta’mli — anis urug‘ining hidi yoki ta’miga o‘xshash; anis hidini yoki ta’mini eslatuvchi yoki o‘zida anis ta’mini mujassam qilgan.

ex: The models walked anorexically down the runway.
She looked anorexically thin in that dress.
anorexically.meta: anoreksik tarzda — anoreksiya kasalligiga chalingan odam kabi; haddan tashqari ozg‘in, juda oriq ko‘rinishda yoki shunday holatda harakat qilgan holda.

ex: The leader was known as a staunch apartheider during the South African regime.
He was criticized as an apartheider for supporting racial segregation policies.
apartheider.meta: apartheid tarafdori — Janubiy Afrikadagi apartheid siyosatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi yoki unga tarafdor bo‘lgan shaxs; keng ma’noda esa har qanday kamsitish, ajratish yoki alohidalashuv siyosatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi odam.

ex: The engine was running like billy-be-damned.
He was as stubborn as billy-be-damned.
billy-be-damned.meta: bu yumshatilgan (eufemistik) ifoda bo‘lib, taqqoslash iboralarida kuchaytiruvchi sifatida ishlatiladi. Odatda "(as) —— as billy-be-damned" yoki "like billy-be-damned" tarzida qo‘llanadi va haddan tashqari, nihoyatda, juda ma’nolarini beradi.

ex: He feared becoming the next victim of a blanket party.
The recruits gave him a blanket party for breaking the rules.
blanket party.meta: Blanket party — bu asosan AQSh harbiylari jargonida ishlatiladigan tushuncha bo‘lib, norasmiy jazolash yoki tahqirlash usuli hisoblanadi.

ex: She blanket stitched the edge of the fabric to prevent fraying.
The craftsman blanket stitched the woolen blanket to add strength and decoration.
blanket stitch.meta: mato chetlarini mustahkamlash, bezash yoki bog‘lash uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus tikuv turi. Bu tikuv ko‘pincha adyollar, matolar yoki kiyimlarning chet qismlarida qo‘llanadi. Fe’l sifatida "blanket tikish" matoni shu usul bilan tikishni anglatadi.

ex: Blousettes are perfect for warm weather because of their light fabric.
She wore a delicate silk blousette to the summer party.
blousette.meta: yengsiz yoki qisqa yengli, ko‘pincha yengil yoki shaffof matodan tikilgan, ayollar uchun mo‘ljallangan ustki kiyim turi. Odatda bel qismida siqilgan yoki yig‘ilgan bo‘ladi. Ba'zan bu kiyim turi ko‘proq dekorativ yoki yozgi variantlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: He dressed in a blouson noir style, wearing a black leather jacket and tight jeans.
The blouson noir movement was closely connected with the music and youth rebellion of that era.
blouson noir.meta: Blouson noir — 1950-1960-yillarda Fransiyada shakllangan yoshlar guruhiga mansub inson (ko‘pincha erkak) bo‘lib, qora charm kurtka kiyish va isyonkor ruhiyati bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: The dress had blousy sleeves that gave it a soft, romantic look.
She wore a blousy white shirt that fluttered in the wind.
blousy.meta: Blousy — Kiyim yoki matoning bluzkaga o‘xshash shaklda, bo‘sh, yumshoq va buklamali yoki shishiq tarzda osilib turishi. Odatda yengil, erkin turgan yoki tanaga yopishmaydigan kiyimlar tavsifida ishlatiladi.

ex: After the surgery, the doctor recommended wearing a breast binder for several weeks.
She wore a breast binder under her shirt to make her chest appear flatter.
breast binder.meta: Ko‘krak bog‘ichi — Ko‘krak qismini siqish yoki ushlab turish uchun ko‘krakka taqiladigan bog‘lama, maxsus kiyim yoki mato bo‘lagi. Odatda kiyim ostida taqiladi.

ex: In some cultures, breast binding was traditionally used to restrict breast growth.
Breast binding helped them feel more comfortable with their body.
breast binding.meta: Ko‘krakni bog‘lash — Ko‘krakni mato, bandaj, lenta yoki boshqa materiallar bilan mahkam siqib, tekis ko‘rinish hosil qilish amaliyoti. Bu jarayon odatda ko‘krak shaklini yashirish yoki uni kichikroq va tekisroq ko‘rsatish uchun qilinadi.

ex: The concept of a cabinet noir is related to government surveillance and intelligence gathering.
The cabinet noir intercepted letters and decoded secret messages during the monarchy.
cabinet noir.meta: Cabinet noir — Ilk davrlarda hukumatning maxfiy razvedka bo‘limi bo‘lib, u xatlar va boshqa kommunikatsiyalarni etkazilishidan oldin to‘xtatib, ochib o‘qib, maxfiy ma’lumotlarni aniqlardi.

ex: The cabinet particulier offers a quiet and intimate dining experience.
They reserved a cabinet particulier at the restaurant for their private dinner.
cabinet particulier.meta: Cabinet particulier — Fransuz kontekstida restoranda mijozlarga shaxsiy, maxfiy ovqatlanish uchun ajratilgan kichik xona yoki kabina. Bu xona mehmonlarga xususiy muhitda ovqatlanish imkonini beradi.

ex: He specializes in cabinetwork and custom furniture design.
The cabinetwork in this house is made of high-quality wood.
cabinetwork.meta: Shkaflar to‘plami — Uyda yoki boshqa joyda joylashgan bir nechta shkaf va mebel buyumlari jamlanmasi. Shkafsozlik ishlari — Shkaflar va boshqa yog‘och mebellarni yasash, bezash va o‘rnatish bilan bog‘liq hunar yoki kasb.

ex: She identifies as a Cape Muslim and speaks Afrikaans at home.
The Cape Muslims have a rich cultural heritage in South Africa.
cape muslim.meta: Janubiy Afrikaning G‘arbiy Kep hududida yashovchi, asosan Afrikaans tilida so‘zlashuvchi musulmon jamoasi yoki etnik guruh vakili. Bu guruh ko‘pincha Kap Malay deb ham ataladi. Kap musulmon (sifat) — Kap musulmonlarga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq.

ex: A chaffie sang beautifully in the garden this morning.
The children called the little bird "chaffie" because it was so cute.
chaffie.meta: Chaffie — Chaffinch (Fringilla coelebs) nomli kichik, rang-barang qushga mehr bilan berilgan chaqiruv nomi.

ex: Chest binders are often used by transgender men and non-binary people.
She wore a chest binder to flatten her chest under the shirt.
chest binder.meta: Ko‘krak bog‘ichi — Ko‘krak atrofiga kiyiladigan, odatda kiyim ostida taqiladigan bandaj, kiyim yoki mato bo‘lagi. Ko‘krakni siqib, ushlab turish yoki shaklini o‘zgartirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Many transgender men use chest binding as part of their daily routine.
Chest binding helped him feel more comfortable with his gender identity.
chest binding.meta: Ko‘krakni bog‘lash — Ko‘krakni mato, bandaj, lenta, maxsus ichki kiyim yoki boshqa vositalar bilan mahkam siqib, tekis yoki kichikroq ko‘rinishga keltirish amaliyoti.

ex: A coachable athlete listens carefully to feedback and makes adjustments.
She is very coachable and always eager to improve her skills.
coachable.meta: O‘rganuvchan — Yangi usullar yoki texnikalarni o‘rganishga, qabul qilishga qodir yoki tayyor bo‘lgan odam, munosabat yoki xulq-atvor.Maslahatga ochiq — Murabbiy yoki yo‘l-yo‘riq beruvchidan o‘rgangan narsalarni qabul qilish va amalda qo‘llashga tayyor.

ex: During the sailing competition, the coach boat stayed near the racecourse.
The coach boat followed the rowing team closely to provide real-time advice.
coach boat.meta: Murabbiy qayig‘i — Odatda kichik va motorli qayiq bo‘lib, yelkanli yoki eshkakli qayiq musobaqalarida murabbiylar tomonidan kuzatuv va maslahat berish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The lawyer prepared a coached witness for the trial.
The coached athlete performed well during the competition.
coached.meta: O‘rgatilgan — Ma’lum bir ko‘nikma yoki faoliyatni bajarishda trening yoki yo‘l-yo‘riq olgan, mashq qilingan. Huquqiy kontekstda — Sudda guvoh sifatida ko‘rsatma yoki maslahat olgan, tayyorlangan shaxs.

ex: The coaching stock was refurbished to meet modern safety standards.
The railway company invested in new coaching stock to improve passenger comfort.
coaching stock.meta: Yo‘lovchi vagonlari — Asosan Britaniya temir yo‘llarida yo‘lovchilar tashish uchun ishlatiladigan va ko‘pincha ma’lum bir temir yo‘l kompaniyasiga tegishli bo‘lgan vagonlar to‘plami.

ex: Antique coach lights are popular among collectors of vintage vehicles.
The coach light helped illuminate the road ahead during night travel.
coach light.meta: Ot tortadigan aravaning tashqi tomoniga o‘rnatilgan chiroq, odatda chiroq manbai to‘rt oynali panjaralar bilan o‘ralgan bo‘ladi. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Tarixiy transport vositalarida yoki hashamatli aravalarda ishlatiladigan tashqi chiroq.

ex: They booked tickets on a popular coach line for their journey.
The coach line offers daily trips between the two cities.
coach line.meta: Avtobus kompaniyasi — Yo‘lovchilarni tashish uchun xizmat ko‘rsatadigan avtobus kompaniyasi yoki tashkiloti. Avtobus yo‘nalishi — Avtobus yoki boshqa yo‘lovchi transport vositasining qatnov yo‘li yoki marshruti.

ex: The Coke bottle’s unique design is recognized worldwide.
She drank a cold Coke from a classic Coke bottle.
coke bottle.meta: Koka-kola shishasi — Asosan shisha bo‘lib, qalin taglik va o‘ziga xos egri shaklga ega, o‘rta qismida toraygan va Koka-kola ichimligi uchun mo‘ljallangan shisha idish

ex: Many rural communities practice cooperativism to improve their economic conditions.
Cooperativism promotes shared ownership and democratic decision-making in businesses.
cooperativism.meta: Kooperativchilik — Kapitalning umumiy egaligi va foyda yoki manfaatlarni bo‘lishish tamoyillariga asoslangan iqtisodiy faoliyatni tashkil etish nazariyasi yoki tizimi.

ex: Cooperativist principles emphasize democratic management and shared profits.
She is a dedicated cooperativist who promotes collective ownership.
cooperativist.meta: Kooperativchi (ism) — Kooperativchilik tamoyillarini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi yoki unga ergashuvchi shaxs, ya’ni kooperativchilik tarafdori. Kooperativchi (sifat) — Kooperativchilik tamoyillariga oid yoki ular bilan bog‘liq.

ex: They planned to cooperativize small local businesses into a single cooperative.
The government decided to cooperativize the agricultural sector to improve productivity.
cooperativize.meta: Kooperativlashtirmoq — Mahsulot, xizmat yoki sanoatni kooperativ nazorati yoki mulkchiligiga o‘tkazmoq; sanoat, jamoa yoki tashkilotni kooperativ tizimga tashkil qilmoq yoki qayta tuzmoq.

ex: Cornetti requires great strength and balance from both horse and rider.
The horse performed a beautiful cornetti during the dressage competition.
cornetti.meta: Kornetti — Klassik ot minish san’atida otning old va orqa oyog‘ini birga ushlab, oldinga siljimay, sakraydigan harakati.

ex: This straight wind instrument has finger holes for playing different notes.
The cornetto muto was a popular instrument in Renaissance music.
cornetto muto.meta: Kornetto muto — Asosan 15-17-asrlarda ishlatilgan, yog‘och, buzoq shoxi yoki fil suyagidan yasalgan, barmoq teshiklari bo‘lgan to‘g‘ri shamol cholg‘usi.

ex: The Cruyff turn is named after the famous Dutch footballer Johan Cruyff.
The player used a Cruyff turn to get past his defender.
cruyff turn.meta: Kruyf burilishi — Futbolda bir o‘yinchining boshqa o‘yinchidan qochish uchun qo‘llaydigan harakati. To‘pni olgan o‘yinchi bir tomonga qarab, pas berayotgandek harakat qilib, darhol to‘pni o‘z oyog‘i ostida aylantirib, boshqa tomonga buriladi.

ex: When asked about the missing documents, she just said, “Damfino.”
“Where did he go?” — “Damfino, I haven’t seen him all day.”
damfino.meta: «Damned if I know» iborasi qisqartmasi bo‘lib, savolga javob berishda noma’lumlik, tushunmovchilik yoki noaniqlikni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda ma’lum bir holat yoki fakt haqida hech qanday ma’lumotga ega emasligini bildirishda ishlatiladi.

ex: The punishment of damnatio memoriae sought to remove all traces of the person’s existence.
Damnatio memoriae was used in ancient Rome to erase disgraced emperors from history.
damnatio memoriae.meta: Damnatio memoriae — Davlat dushmani deb hisoblangan vafot etgan davlat arbobining tarixiy yozuvlardan, yodgorliklardan va jamoat esdaliklaridan butunlay o‘chirib tashlanishi orqali jazolanish shakli.

ex: In many cases, damnum absque injuria does not entitle the injured party to compensation.
Damnum absque injuria refers to harm suffered without any legal wrong.
damnum absque injuria.meta: Damnum absque injuria — Hech qanday shaxs yoki davlatning noto‘g‘ri, beparvolik, ayb yoki adolatsizligi sabab bo‘lmagan, shuning uchun ham qonuniy kompensatsiya yoki huquqiy da’vo talab qilinmaydigan zarar yoki yo‘qotish.

ex: The Dear Jane letter is the female equivalent of a Dear John letter.
He wrote a Dear Jane letter to end their relationship.
dear jane.meta: Hurmatli Jeyn — Ayolga yozilgan va u bilan bo‘lgan romantik yoki jinsiy munosabatlarni yakunlashni bildiruvchi xat. Bu atama “Dear John” (erkakka yozilgan o‘xshash xat) ga qarama-qarshi ishlatiladi.

ex: Enamelware is popular because it is durable and easy to clean.
The kitchen is filled with colorful enamelware dishes and utensils.
enamelware.meta: Emal qoplamali idishlar — Emal bilan bezatilgan yoki qoplangan buyumlar; asosan (keyingi davrlarda) emal qatlami bilan qoplangan yoki ichki tomoni emallangan idishlar, oshxona asboblari va boshqa buyumlar.

ex: She was welcomed warmly into the galdem of local women.
The galdem met every week to discuss community issues.
galdem.meta: Ayollar guruhi — Birgalikda bo‘lgan yoki umumiy maqsad bilan birlashgan ayollar to‘plami yoki jamiyati. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Ayollar orasidagi do‘stona yoki ijtimoiy guruh, ko‘pincha yaqin munosabatdagi ayollar jamoasi.

ex: He was accused of gatekeeping and not letting new people join the group.
Some communities gatekeep information, allowing only select members access.
gatekeep.meta: Asosan ma’lumot yoki resurslarga kirishni nazorat qilish, tanlab olish. Cheklov qo‘ymoq — Keyinchalik asosan boshqalar uchun imkoniyatlarni cheklash yoki ularni ma’lum narsalar haqida bilishni yoki ishtirok etishni to‘siqlash ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Gegenpress requires high stamina and teamwork to execute properly.
The team’s success is largely due to their effective gegenpress strategy.
gegenpress.meta: To‘pni yo‘qotgandan so‘ng, jamoa darhol va kuchli bosimni raqibga o‘tkazadigan futbol uslubi. Bu uslubda jamoa raqib to‘pni qo‘lga kiritishiga imkon bermaslik uchun tezkor harakat qiladi, hatto o‘z maydonining chuqur qismida bo‘lsa ham.

ex: The coach emphasized the importance of gegenpressing for quick ball recovery.
Gegenpressing has become a popular tactic among top football clubs.
gegenpressing.meta: Qaytarib bosim o‘tkazish — Futbolda to‘pni yo‘qotgandan so‘ng, jamoaning darhol va kuchli bosimni raqibga o‘tkazishi uslubi.

ex: Using terms like goo-goo can promote stereotypes and discrimination.
The word "goo-goo" is considered offensive when referring to Filipinos.
goo-goo.meta: Goo-goo — Filippinlik odamni haqorat qilish yoki kamsitish maqsadida ishlatiladigan so‘z.

ex: She was known as a gooh in the red-light area.
The gooh controlled the activities of the women working in the district.
gooh.meta: Gooh — Prostitutka sifatida ishlaydigan ayol yoki madam (prostitutkalarni boshqaruvchi ayol).

ex: The festival attracted many gori women from different regions.
She is a gori with fair skin and light hair.
gori.meta: Sifat: Oq terili yoki nisbatan ochiq terili, ayniqsa Janubiy Osiyo hududlarida oq tanli ayol yoki qizga taalluqli. Ism: Oq terili ayol yoki qiz; ba’zida chet ellik ayolni yoki Janubiy Osiyoda nisbatan ochiq terili ayolni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Great Andamanese language and traditions are studied by anthropologists.
The Great Andamanese are indigenous people of the Andaman Islands.
great andamanese.meta: Ism: Bay of Bengal dengizidagi Andaman orollarining asosiy arxipelagi — Buyuk Andaman orollarida yashovchi tub aholining vakili. Sifat: Buyuk Andaman yoki u bilan bog‘liq narsalarga oid; masalan, madaniyat, tili yoki odatlari.

ex: She grocery shops every Saturday morning.
I need to grocery shop this afternoon for the week’s meals.
grocery shop.meta: Grocery shop — Oshxona uchun kerakli oziq-ovqat va boshqa mahsulotlarni xarid qilish maqsadida do‘konga borish.

ex: She is a regular grocery shopper at the local supermarket.
The grocery shopper carefully selected fresh fruits and vegetables.
grocery shopper.meta: Grocery shopper — Oziq-ovqat va boshqa oshxona mahsulotlarini sotib oladigan shaxs.

ex: She enjoys grocery shopping at the local market for fresh produce.
Grocery shopping usually takes place once a week for most families.
grocery shopping.meta: Oshxona mahsulotlari xaridi — Oziq-ovqat va boshqa oshxona mahsulotlarini sotib olish amali yoki odati.

ex: The indigena communities maintain their traditional customs and languages.
Many indigenas in Latin America struggle to preserve their cultural identity.
indigena.meta: Indigena — Ispan va portugal tilli mintaqalarda (asosan Lotin Amerikasida) ma’lum bir joyga tubdan mansub bo‘lgan xalq vakili yoki tub aholining a’zosi sifatida farqlanadigan shaxs.

ex: Under the indigénat, natives had fewer rights than French citizens.
he indigénat system institutionalized legal discrimination against indigenous people in French colonies.
indigénat.meta: Ilgari Frantsuz koloniyalarida tub yoki mahalliy aholiga nisbatan ularni qonuniy jihatdan pastroq maqomda ko‘rsatadigan qonunlar tizimi. Bu tizim orqali mahalliy aholining huquqlari cheklangan va ular uchun alohida kod yoki qoidalar qo‘llanilgan.

ex: The indigeneity of the community is reflected in their language and customs.
Indigeneity is an important concept in discussions about indigenous rights and identity.
indigeneity.meta: Tublik — Ma’lum bir joyga mahalliy yoki tubdan mansub bo‘lish sifati yoki haqiqatidir, ayniqsa bir xalq yoki xalqaro guruhlar kontekstida.

ex: The government adopted indigenism policies to improve conditions for native communities.
Indigenism promotes the rights and culture of indigenous peoples in Latin America.
indigenism.meta: Indigenism — Tub aholining, ayniqsa, avval Yevropaliklar tomonidan bosib olingan yoki yashab o‘tilgan mamlakatlarda yashovchi mahalliy xalqning huquqlarini himoya qilish yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlash siyosati va harakatlari.

ex: Many leaders of indigenismo sought to revive indigenous cultures and languages.
Indigenismo aimed to increase indigenous people's representation in government.
indigenismo.meta: Indigenismo — Lotin Amerikasida tub aholining davlat ishlarida, jamiyatda ko‘proq ishtirok etishi, ta’siri va vakilligi uchun kurashuvchi ijtimoiy va siyosiy harakat.

ex: Indigenista policies focus on empowering indigenous communities.
He is an indigenista who works to improve indigenous rights in his country.
indigenista.meta: Sifat: Lotin Amerikasidagi tub xalqlar huquqlarini himoya qiluvchi va ularni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi ijtimoiy-siyosiy harakat — indigenismo bilan bog‘liq yoki unga oid.

ex: The report was prepared indigestly, missing many important details.
He answered the question indigestly, without thinking it through.
indigestly.meta: Indigestly — To‘liq e’tibor bermasdan, diqqat bilan ko‘rib chiqmasdan; qo‘pol, noaniq yoki shoshilinch tarzda bajarilgan holda.

ex: Many people are jabbed partially and still need booster shots.
She is fully jabbed against the flu this season.
jabbed.meta: Jabbed — Emlash yoki vaksina qilingan, ayniqsa to‘liq yoki qisman emlangan shaxs yoki hayvon. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha emlash darajasini bildiruvchi so‘zlar bilan (masalan, to‘liq, qisman) birga ishlatiladi.

ex: The robber threatened the victim at knifepoint.
The knifepoint of the blade was extremely sharp.
knifepoint.meta: Pichoqning uchi, ya’ni pichoq pichog‘ining eng ingichka va o'tkir qismi. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Shuningdek, «knifepoint» atamasi qo‘rqitish, zo‘rlash yoki majburlash ma’nosida ishlatilishi mumkin, ya’ni kimnidir pichoq bosimi ostida majburlash.

ex: The mandem always support each other no matter what.
He went out with his mandem last night.
mandem.meta: Mandem — Asosan Britaniyada ishlatiladigan atama, ko‘pincha ko‘plikda ishlatiladi; bir odamning, ayniqsa erkakning, do‘stlari yoki yaqin sheriklari, odatda bir jamoa yoki guruh sifatida ko‘riladi.

ex: During Nalukataq, celebrants are thrown into the air as part of the traditional festivities.
The Nalukataq festival celebrates the end of the whaling season among the Inupiaq people.
nalukataq.meta: Nalukataq — Shimoliy Alyaska Inupiaq xalqining kit ovlash mavsumining yakunini nishonlash uchun o‘tkazadigan bayrami.

ex: New Catholic beliefs differed from those of the Roman Catholic Church.
The New Catholics separated from the Roman Catholic Church in the mid-19th century.
new catholic.meta: Ism: 1844 yilda Rim katolik cherkovidan ajralib chiqqan Germaniyadagi diniy guruh a’zosi. Shu bilan birga German Catholic (Germaniya katoligi) deb ham ataladi.

ex: Overboost can increase engine performance but may cause wear if used excessively.
The car's engine achieved overboost for a short time during acceleration.
overboost.meta: Ortiqcha kuchayish — Avtomobilning ichki yonish dvigateliga supercharger (kompressor) orqali ko‘proq havo bosib kirishi natijasida vaqtincha kuchning oshirilishi.

ex: The Panenka is a risky but stylish way to take a penalty kick.
He scored with a Panenka penalty, fooling the goalkeeper completely.
panenka.meta: Panenka — Penalti zarbasi turi bo‘lib, to‘p uruvchi darvozabon bir tomonga sakragan paytda, to‘pni darvozaning markaziga yumshoq qilib chopish orqali gol urish usuli. Ko‘pincha bu usul nafislik va mahorat belgisi sifatida qaraladi.

ex: Many coffee shops offer pumpkin spice lattes during the fall season.
Pumpkin spice is a popular flavor in autumn desserts and drinks.
pumpkin spice.meta: Pumpkin spice — Asosan dolchin, muskat yong‘og‘i, zanjabil va qarag‘at kabi maydalangan ziravorlardan iborat aralashma bo‘lib, dastlab qovoq pirogining ichiga solinadigan ingredient sifatida ishlatilgan.

ex: The player surprised everyone with a perfect rabona pass.
He scored a stunning goal using a rabona kick.
rabona.meta: Rabona — Futbolda to'pni urishda noan’anaviy usul bo‘lib, zarba beruvchi oyoq tik turgan oyog‘ining orqasidan kesib o‘tib, to‘pga tegadi. Shuningdek, bu usulda berilgan uzatma, kross yoki boshqa o‘yin harakati ham rabona deb ataladi.

ex: He served as the Rix-chancellor during the 17th century.
The Rix-chancellor was a key figure in the Swedish government.
rix-chancellor.meta: Riks-kansler — Shvetsiya shaxsiy kengashining (privy council) oliy kansleri lavozimi, ya’ni mamlakatdagi muhim davlat masalalarini boshqaruvchi yuqori martabali amaldor.

ex: Materials with high shock absorbency are used in protective gear.
The shock absorbency of the shoe sole reduces foot injuries.
shock absorbency.meta: Shock absorbency — Zarba yoki to‘qnashuv ta’sirini yutish yoki so‘rib olish qobiliyati yoki sifati. Bu xususiyat materiallar yoki qurilmalar uchun muhim bo‘lib, ularning zarbalardan himoyalanishini ta’minlaydi.

ex: The helmet’s shock absorption protects the head during impacts.
Shock absorption in vehicle suspension improves ride comfort.
shock absorption.meta: Shock absorption — Mexanik zarbani yutish va tebranishlarni kamaytirish harakati yoki jarayoni. Bu jarayon materiallar yoki qurilmalar zarbadan himoya qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: It was a shockeroo when the underdog team won the championship.
The news of his resignation was a real shockeroo for everyone.
shockeroo.meta: Shockeroo — Kutilmagan voqea yoki holat sababli yuzaga keladigan hayrat yoki hayronlik.

ex: He replaced the old shockies to improve the car's suspension.
The shockie helps to smooth out bumps while driving.
shockie.meta: Shockie — Motorli transport vositasidagi tebranishlar va zarbalarni yutish uchun mo‘ljallangan qurilma; zarba yutgich.

ex: Some companies use shockvertising to make their ads memorable.
Shockvertising uses shocking images to grab the audience’s attention.
shockvertising.meta: Shockvertising — Diqqatni jalb qilish uchun, ayniqsa, provokatsion va hayratlantiruvchi grafik tasvirlar yordamida ishlatiladigan reklama usuli.

ex: The patient was shocky and trembling after the accident.
After hearing the bad news, she looked shocky and confused.
shocky.meta: Shocky — Hayratlantiradigan yoki hayratdan ta’sirlangan; ayniqsa odam haqida aytilganda, hayratdan hushidan ketgan yoki tebralayotgan holatda bo‘lgan.

ex: Tiki-taka requires excellent ball control and quick decision-making.
The team used tiki-taka to control the game and wear down their opponents.
tiki-taka.meta: Tiki-taka — Futbolda qisqa va juda aniq uzatmalar bilan xarakterlanadigan, to‘pni uzoq vaqt nazorat qilishga urg‘u berilgan o‘yin uslubi.

ex: She was topbilled for the theater play this season.
The famous actor was topbilled in the new movie.
topbill.meta: Topbill — (Fe’l sifatida) (aktyor yoki ijrochiga) bir tomosha, o‘yin va hokazolarning reklama ro‘yxatida eng yuqori o‘rinni berish; bosh rol yoki bosh ishtirokchi sifatida ko‘rsatish.

ex: The top-billed performer received the loudest applause.
She was the top-billed actress in the play.
top-billed.meta: Top-billed — (Inson haqida) tomosha, o‘yin yoki boshqa tadbirda reklama ro‘yxatining eng yuqori o‘rnida ko‘rsatilgan, bosh rol yoki bosh ishtirokchi sifatida tan olingan.

ex: You should top-coat the wall to protect it from moisture.
After priming, they top-coated the furniture with varnish.
top-coat.meta: Top-coat — (Fe’l sifatida) biror narsani qoplama yoki tashqi qatlam bilan yopish; ayniqsa, sirtga oxirgi bo‘yoq, lak yoki boshqa tugatish qatlami surish.

ex: He works as a topdresser on a large farm.
The topdresser spread fertilizer evenly across the field.
topdresser.meta: Yuqori qoplovchi mashina — Tuproq ustiga o‘g‘it yoki ko‘mir surish uchun ishlatiladigan mashina yoki transport vositasi. Yuqori qoplovchi operator — Bunday mashinani boshqaruvchi yoki ishlatuvchi shaxs.

ex: The batsman played a top edge, and the ball went straight to the wicketkeeper.
Be careful not to cut the top edge of the paper when trimming.
top edge.meta: Kriketda: Bata tomonidan cross-bat usulida zarba berishda raketaning yuqori qirrasi. Bu qism bilan nazoratsiz, tasodifan o‘ynalgan zarba. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Biror narsaning eng yuqori yoki ustki qirrosi yoki cheti.

ex: A top-edged shot often results in a catch behind the wicket.
The batsman top-edged the ball, and it was caught by the wicketkeeper.
top-edged.meta: Top-edged — (kriketda) Raketaning yuqori qirrasi bilan, odatda nazoratsiz yoki xatolik bilan o‘ynalgan zarba.

ex: The photographer used top lighting to highlight the model’s facial features.
Top lighting is used in theatre to create dramatic shadows.
top lighting.meta: Top lighting — Asosiy ravishda yuqoridan yoritish; ayniqsa fotografiya, teatr va boshqa sahna san’atlarida ma’lum muhit yoki effekt yaratish uchun ishlatiladigan yorug‘lik turi.

ex: The actor is set to topline the upcoming film.
She toplined the new Broadway production this season.
topline.meta: Topline — (Fe’l sifatida) tomosha, tadbir yoki boshqa ko‘ngilochar loyihada bosh rol yoki eng yuqori o‘rinni egallash; bosh ishtirokchi bo‘lish.

ex: Top loading dryers usually have a different design than front loaders.
A top loading washing machine is easier to load in small spaces.
top loading.meta: Top loading — Mashina yoki qurilma (ayniqsa, kir yuvish mashinasi) tepadan yuklash uchun mo‘ljallangan, old tomondan emas.

ex: The artist converted the top loft into a studio.
They bought a spacious top loft with a great view of the city.
top loft.meta: Bino tepasi lofti — Bino yuqori qismida joylashgan loft; yuqori qavat, qavat yoki kvartira. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Uy yoki binoning eng yuqori joyidagi keng, ochiq joy yoki ishchi xona sifatida ishlatiladigan xona.

ex: The team’s top order failed to score many runs in the last match.
The top order is crucial for setting a strong foundation in the innings.
top order.meta: Top order — Kriketda o‘yin boshida o‘ynaydigan uruvchilar qismi, odatda birinchi va ikkinchi uruvchilardan iborat. Shuningdek, dastlabki o‘yinchilar guruhini bildiradi.

ex: That toppie helped me fix the car yesterday.
The old toppie sat quietly by the fire.
toppie.meta: O‘rta yoshli yoki qariy erkak kishi. Umuman olganda, erkak, yigit yoki do‘st sifatida ishlatiladi. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Ko‘pincha oldiga sifat qo‘shimchalari qo‘yiladi, masalan, old toppie (qariy erkak).

ex: Top piecing is important for the garment’s overall appearance.
The tailor selected high-quality fabric for the top piecing of the jacket.
top piecing.meta: Yuqori qism uchun material — kiyim yoki boshqa buyumlarning yuqori qismini tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan material. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Turli qismlarni birlashtirish yoki ustki qismni to‘ldirish uchun ishlatiladigan material.

ex: The toppling of the statue was captured on video.
The toppling of the regime led to major political changes.
toppling.meta: Toppling — (Fe’l “topple” harakatining nomi sifatida) nimanidir ag‘darmoq, yiqitmoq yoki hokimiyatdagi shaxs yoki hukumatni quvmoq jarayoni. Shuningdek, turli kontekstlarda biror narsani yiqitish yoki o‘zgartirish harakati.

ex: After the storm, the garden was topsidown and messy.
The box was turned topsidown by the cat.
topsidown.meta: Topsidown — Teskari yoki ag‘darilgan holatda; tartibsiz, tartibsiz holatga tushgan yoki bosh-osti bo‘lgan.

ex: Topstitching is often done with a contrasting thread color for decoration.
The jacket’s topstitch along the seams adds strength and style.
topstitch.meta: Topstitch — Kiyim yoki boshqa tikilgan buyumning tashqi tomonida, odatda chetlar yoki tikuv joylari bo‘ylab qo‘llaniladigan tikuv turi. Bu tikuv funksional (masalan, mustahkamlash uchun) yoki bezak maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: The athlete was covered in sweat top-to-toe after the race.
She was dressed top-to-toe in black for the event.
top-to-toe.meta: Top-to-toe — Butun tana, boshdan oyoqqacha yoki to‘liq qamrab olingan holatni bildiradi.

ex: The Dutch national team popularized total football in the 1970s.
Total football requires players to be versatile and highly skilled.
total football.meta: Total football — Futbolda hujumkor uslub bo‘lib, unda maydonning har bir o‘yinchisi o‘yinning davomida talabga binoan har qanday pozitsiyada o‘ynay oladi, bu o‘yinda erkinlik va suyuqlikni ta’minlaydi.

ex: Famous players like Zidane and Messi have excelled as trequartistas.
The trequartista is crucial for linking the midfield with the attack.
trequartista.meta: Trequartista — Futbolda yarim himoyachilar va hujumchilar orasidagi bo‘shliqda o‘ynaydigan hujumkor o‘yinchi bo‘lib, uning asosiy vazifasi jamoa uchun gol imkoniyatlarini yaratishdir.

ex: She is one of the best female triple jumpers in the country.
The triple jumper trained hard for the upcoming championship.
triple jumper.meta: Triple jumper — Atletikada uch qadam sakrash harakatini bajaradigan shaxs; uch qadam sakrash bo‘yicha musobaqa qatnashchisi.

ex: She has been practicing triple jumping for several years.
Triple jumping requires excellent coordination and strength.
triple jumping.meta: Triple jumping — Atletikada uch qadam sakrash harakatini bajarish jarayoni yoki faoliyati.

ex: Valari was a traditional weapon used by tribes in Southern India.
The warrior skillfully threw the valari during the battle.
valari.meta: Valari — Janubiy Hindiston urf-odatlarida ov yoki jang uchun uloqtiriladigan, qisqa, og‘ir, egilgan yoki burchak shaklidagi yog‘och yoki temirdan yasalgan qurol.

ex: Connecting to a wireless network allows devices to communicate without cables.
The office uses a wireless network for internet access.
wireless network.meta: Har bir qurilma tarmoqda radio to‘lqinlari, mikroto‘lqinlar va boshqa simsiz usullar orqali muloqot qiladigan, jismoniy simli ulanishdan foydalanmaydigan kompyuter tarmog‘i. Qo‘shimcha ma’no: Simsiz internetga ulangan qurilmalar tarmog‘i, masalan, Wi-Fi.

ex: He is studying the influence of African American English on modern slang.
African American English has its own grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary.
african american english.meta: Afrikalik amerikalik ingliz tili — Afrikalik amerikaliklar tomonidan ishlatiladigan turli xususiy va o‘ziga xos ingliz tili dialektlari va uslublari yig‘indisi. Bu til shakli odatda qisqartma AAE (African American English) bilan belgilanadi.

ex: She is interested in learning ancient languages like Ancient Greek and Sanskrit.
Latin is an example of an ancient language that is no longer spoken in daily life.
ancient language.meta: Qadim zamonlarda so‘zlashilgan til, ayniqsa hozirgi kunda kundalik muloqotda ishlatilmaydigan yoki yo‘qolib ketgan til. Ayniqsa, klassik davr tillari kabi qadimgi yunon, qadimgi lotin, qadimgi misr, sanskrit va boshqa tillar shular jumlasiga kiradi.

ex: The old man, an ancient mariner type, insisted on telling us his sea adventures.
He is like an ancient mariner, always telling long stories about his travels.
ancient mariner.meta: Qadimgi dengizchi — Samuel Taylor Coleridge'ning mashhur "The Rime of the Ancient Mariner" (Qadimgi dengizchining dostoni) she’riga ishora qiluvchi obraz.

ex: Scholars have long studied the ancient world to understand the origins of modern society.
The ancient world was home to many great civilizations such as Egypt and Rome.
ancient world.meta: Qadimgi dunyo — Milodiy 476-yilda G‘arbiy Rim imperiyasi qulashidan oldingi davrda O‘rta yer dengizi atrofi va Yaqin Sharq hududlarini qamrab olgan mintaqa.

ex: She applied for ancillary relief to receive financial support from her former spouse.
The court granted ancillary relief to ensure a fair division of assets after the divorce.
ancillary relief.meta: Qo‘shimcha huquqiy yordam — Asosiy sud jarayoniga bog‘liq bo‘lgan, unga xizmat qiluvchi yoki uni to‘ldiruvchi huquqiy yordam yoki choralar.

ex: The Andean condor plays an important role in the ecosystem as a scavenger.
The Andean condor is one of the largest flying birds in the world.
andean condor.meta: And kondori — Janubiy Amerikadagi And tog‘lari va g‘arbiy qirg‘oq hududlarida yashovchi kondor qushi (yangi dunyo leykasi), ilmiy nomi Vultur gryphus (Cathartidae oilasiga mansub).

ex: There are strict rules governing the attorney–client relationship.
The court must respect the attorney–client privilege.
attorney–client.meta: Advokat–mijoz munosabati — bu advokat va uning mijozlari o‘rtasidagi huquqiy aloqani ifodalaydi. Bu munosabat doirasida advokat mijozga huquqiy maslahat beradi va mijoz advokatga sir saqlash majburiyati bilan murojaat qiladi.

ex: Availability bias can lead to incorrect assumptions in decision-making.
The researcher’s conclusion was affected by availability bias because they only used easily accessible data.
availability bias.meta: Mavjudlik og‘ishishi — bu tadqiqot yoki qaror qabul qilish jarayonida eng oson mavjud bo‘lgan, ya’ni tez topiladigan yoki esga tushadigan ma’lumotlardan foydalanish oqibatida yuzaga keladigan xatolik yoki noto‘g‘ri xulosa chiqarish holati.

ex: Social media often accelerates availability cascades by rapidly sharing alarming stories.
The fear of certain diseases can spread through an availability cascade in the media.
availability cascade.meta: bu ijtimoiy jarayon bo‘lib, biror fikr, e’tiqod yoki g‘oya ommaviy axborot vositalari, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va boshqa axborot kanallari orqali tez-tez takrorlanib, tobora kuchayib borishi natijasida keng qabul qilinadigan tushunchaga aylanishi.

ex: Because of the availability heuristic, people overestimate the risk of airplane crashes after seeing them on the news.
The availability heuristic makes rare events seem more common than they actually are.
availability heuristic.meta: Mavjudlik evristikasi — bu kognitiv jarayon (aqliy qisqartma usuli) bo‘lib, inson biror hodisa yoki voqeaning ehtimolini o‘z xotirasidan tezda esga tushirishi mumkin bo‘lgan misollar soniga qarab baholaydi.

ex: Engineers aim to maximize the available energy in power systems to improve efficiency.
The available energy in a battery decreases as it discharges.
available energy.meta: Mavjud energiya — bu tizim, jarayon yoki muhit tomonidan taqdim etilishi yoki undan olinishi mumkin bo‘lgan, foydalanishga yaroqli yoki boshqa energiya shakliga aylantirilishi mumkin bo‘lgan energiya miqdori.

ex: Shooting in available light can produce more realistic and emotional images.
The photographer used only available light to capture the natural atmosphere of the scene.
available light.meta: Mavjud yorug‘lik — bu tabiiy ravishda ob'ektga tushayotgan yorug‘lik bo‘lib, qo‘shimcha sun’iy yoritish vositalarisiz mavjud bo‘lgan yorug‘likni anglatadi.

ex: Farmers need to monitor the available water to ensure optimal plant growth.
The available water in sandy soils is much lower than in clay soils.
available water.meta: Mavjud suv — bu asosan tuproqdagi o‘simlik ildizlari tomonidan so‘rilishi mumkin bo‘lgan suv miqdorini anglatadi.

ex: Many BIPOC individuals face systemic inequalities in education and employment.
The organization focuses on supporting BIPOC communities.
bipoc.meta: BIPOC — bu qisqartma bo‘lib, ingliz tilida Black, Indigenous, and People of Colour (qora tanlilar, tub aholilar va rangli odamlar) iborasining bosh harflaridan tuzilgan. Bu atama odatda oq tanli bo‘lmagan shaxslar yoki guruhlarni ta’riflashda ishlatiladi.

ex: A blanket bond provides coverage for multiple locations and assets under one policy.
The bank purchased a blanket bond to cover all its employees against fraud.
blanket bond.meta: Umumiy kafolat (blanket bond) — bu bir guruh odamlar yoki aktivlarga jamoaviy tarzda taalluqli bo‘lgan sug‘urta polisi. Xususan, bu moliyaviy muassasalar yoki yirik kompaniyalar tomonidan xodimlar.

ex: Traditional blanket capots were often made from thick woolen blankets.
The hunter wore a blanket capot to stay warm during the winter expedition.
blanket capot.meta: Adyol plash (blanket capot) — bu bosh qismi qopqoqli (kapyushonli) bo‘lgan, adyol yoki shunga o‘xshash qalin matodan tikilgan uzun plash yoki qoplama kiyim.

ex: Traditional blanket capotes were made from brightly colored wool blankets.
The trapper wrapped himself in a blanket capote to keep warm in the wilderness.
blanket capote.meta: Adyol kapot (blanket capote) — bu uzun, keng, kapyushonli (bosh qismi qopqoqli) palto yoki plash bo‘lib, adyol yoki shunga o‘xshash qalin, to‘qilgan matodan tayyorlanadi.

ex: The blanket cylinder must be regularly cleaned to ensure high-quality prints.
In offset printing, the blanket cylinder transfers the image from the plate to the paper.
blanket cylinder.meta: Adyol silindr — bu asosan ofset bosma (offset printing) jarayonida ishlatiladigan silindr bo‘lib, uning tashqi qismi elastik qoplama (odatda kauchuk yoki matoga o‘xshash material) bilan qoplangan bo‘ladi.

ex: In some regions, the Arctic grayling is colloquially known as the blanket fish.
The blanket fish, or giant manta ray, can reach a wingspan of over 7 meters.
blanket fish.meta: Bu juda katta bo‘rdoqador dengiz baliqlari turiga kiradi. Ularning keng, adyolga o‘xshash yassi tanasi bo‘lgani uchun "adyol baliq" deb ataladi. Ular okeanlarda yashaydi va asosan plankton bilan oziqlanadi.

ex: We used chairs and a large blanket to build a blanket fort in the living room.
The children spent the afternoon playing inside their blanket fort.
blanket fort.meta: Adyol qal’a (blanket fort) — bu bolalar tomonidan tayyorlanadigan vaqtinchalik boshpana yoki yashirin joy bo‘lib, mebel ustiga adyollar yoki choyshablar yopish orqali quriladi.

ex: A blanket stiff carried all his belongings wrapped in a blanket tied over his shoulder.
During the Great Depression, many blanket stiffs roamed the country looking for work.
blanket stiff.meta: bu odatda vaqtincha yoki mavsumiy ish izlab yuradigan, joyidan joyga ko‘chib yuradigan ishchi (odatda erkak), u barcha shaxsiy buyumlarini adyolga yoki yotish uchun o‘ralgan ro‘mol (yotoq to‘plami) ichiga tugib olib yuradi.

ex: The traditional Inuit blanket toss is a highlight of their cultural celebrations.
The villagers played the blanket toss game during the festival.
blanket toss.meta: Adyolda uloqtirish (blanket toss) — bu biror kishini adyol yoki shunga o‘xshash matoning chetlaridan ushlab, uni havoga bir necha bor uloqtirish harakati yoki an’anaviy o‘yin.

ex: Blouson sleeves add a romantic and flowing look to the blouse.
The dress had elegant blouson sleeves that gathered tightly at the wrists.
blouson sleeve.meta: Bluzon yeng (blouson sleeve) — bu keng va biroz bo‘sh qirqilgan, tirsak yoki bilak qismida tor, yopishib turadigan manjet (bilak qisimi) bilan tugaydigan yeng turi.

ex: In the 16th century, many scholars built cabinets of curiosities to display natural wonders.
The nobleman’s cabinet of curiosities contained fossils, rare shells, and ancient coins.
cabinet of curiosities.meta: Qiziqishlar kabineti (cabinet of curiosities) — bu nodir, g‘ayrioddiy yoki ekzotik buyumlar to‘plami namoyish qilinadigan xona yoki maxsus vitrina.

ex: Cabinet cards became popular in the late 19th century for formal portrait photography.
The family displayed cabinet cards of their ancestors on the mantelpiece.
cabinet card.meta: Kabinet kartasi (cabinet card) — bu ramkaga solish yoki kabinet (vitrina) ichida ko‘rsatish uchun mos bo‘lgan maxsus o‘lchamdagi qog‘oz kartonga yopishtirilgan fotosurat.

ex: He holds a cabinet-level position in the administration.
The issue was discussed at cabinet level.
cabinet level.meta: Hukumat darajasi (cabinet level) — bu hukumatdagi eng yuqori boshqaruv darajasi bo‘lib, odatda vazirlar mahkamasi a’zolari va boshqa yuqori lavozimli rahbarlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: The long strings of the cabinet pianoforte produce a rich, resonant sound.
The cabinet pianoforte was popular in the 19th century for home music rooms.
cabinet pianoforte.meta: Kabinet pianino (cabinet pianoforte) — bu baland, vertikal shakldagi pianino bo‘lib, unda odatdagidan ancha uzun torlar mavjud. Bu turdagi pianino XIX asrda keng tarqalgan bo‘lib, chuqur va boy tovushga ega bo‘lishi uchun yaratilgan.

ex: Catholic guilt often leads people to feel responsible for even the smallest mistakes.
Even after apologizing, he still felt the weight of Catholic guilt.
catholic guilt.meta: Katolik ayb hissi (Catholic guilt) — bu katoliklar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan, odatda haddan tashqari, mantiqsiz yoki chuqur ichki aybdorlik hissini ifodalovchi tushuncha.

ex: The title of Catholicos Patriarch is used in several Eastern Christian traditions.
The Catholicos Patriarch of Georgia is the spiritual leader of the Georgian Orthodox Church.
catholicos patriarch.meta: Katolikos Patriarx (Catholicos Patriarch) — bu Sharqiy xristian cherkovlarida, ayniqsa Gruziya (Jorjiya) cherkovida va boshqa ayrim qadimiy Sharqiy cherkovlarda oliy diniy rahbar lavozimi.

ex: His arguments were swept away as chaff before the wind.
The enemy army fled as chaff before the wind.
as chaff before the wind.meta: Shamol oldidagi somon kabi (as chaff before the wind) — bu ibora o‘ta kuchsiz, qarshilik ko‘rsata olmaydigan, tezda yo‘q bo‘ladigan yoki shamol ta’sirida parchalanib ketadigan narsani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Old chaff boxes were operated manually with a turning handle.
The farmer used a chaff box to cut straw for the cattle.
chaff box.meta: Somon maydalagich qutisi (chaff box) — bu somon va pichanni yem uchun maydalashda ishlatiladigan uskuna. U odatda uzun qutidan iborat bo‘lib, ichida pichoqlar joylashgan.

ex: Chaff rockets are essential for modern aerial defense tactics.
The aircraft launched a chaff rocket to divert incoming missiles.
chaff rocket.meta: Somon raketasi (chaff rocket) — bu portlaganda atmosfera ichiga somon (chaff) deb ataladigan metall parchalar, alyuminiy tolalar yoki boshqa radarni chalg‘ituvchi materiallarni chiqaradigan kichik raketa turi.

ex: The chaffing machine made the process of fodder preparation much faster.
The farmer used a chaffing machine to quickly cut straw for the cattle.
chaffing machine.meta: Somon maydalagich mashina (chaffing machine) — bu somon yoki pichanni chorva uchun yemga aylantirish maqsadida mayda bo‘laklarga kesib beradigan qishloq xo‘jaligi uskunasi.

ex: Chancellor’s pudding is similar to cabinet pudding, made with dried fruits and steamed to perfection.
For dessert, they served a warm chancellor’s pudding with custard.
chancellor’s pudding.meta: Kansler pudingi (chancellor’s pudding) — bu quritilgan mevalar (masalan, mayiz, qand mevalar) solingan, bug‘da pishiriladigan an’anaviy ingliz shirinligi. Bu puding kabinet pudingi deb ham ataladi.

ex: In the 18th century, traveling by coach and pair was considered a sign of wealth.
The nobleman arrived at the estate in a coach and pair.
coach and pair.meta: Ikki otli arava (coach and pair) — bu ikkita ot tomonidan tortiladigan yopiq va odatda hashamatli arava. Ushbu transport vositasi asosan tarixiy davrlarda ishlatilgan va yuqori martabali shaxslar, zodagonlar yoki sayohatchilar tomonidan qo‘llanilgan.

ex: This amendment would drive a coach and horses through the entire tax system.
The lawyer drove a coach and horses through the new regulation by exploiting its loopholes.
to drive a coach and horses through.meta: To drive a coach and horses through — bu qonun, siyosat yoki qoidalarni butunlay bekor qiladigan yoki ularni samarasiz qiladigan harakatni ifodalovchi idiomatik ibora.

ex: The sound of the coach horn signaled the arrival of the mail coach.
The coachman blew the coach horn as they approached the village.
coach horn.meta: Arava nayi (coach horn) — bu uzun, misdan yasalgan va klapansiz (tugmasiz) bo‘lgan musiqiy asbob bo‘lib, ilgari ot aravalari kelayotganini e’lon qilish uchun ishlatilgan. Bu karnay aravaning kelishini oldindan ogohlantirish maqsadida chalinar edi.

ex: The old coach inn still stands along the main road as a historical landmark.
They stopped at a coach inn to rest and change horses.
coach inn.meta: Arava mehmonxonasi (coach inn) — bu ot aravalari qatnov yo‘nalishida joylashgan va aravakashlar hamda yo‘lovchilar to‘xtab dam oladigan mehmonxona yoki yotoqxona.

ex: The old coach had two brass coach lamps mounted on either side.
The coach lamp flickered in the wind as the carriage moved down the dark road.
coach lamp.meta: Arava chirog‘i (coach lamp) — bu ot aravalari tashqarisiga o‘rnatiladigan maxsus chiroq bo‘lib, odatda to‘rt tomoni shisha panellardan iborat bo‘ladi.

ex: The museum displayed an ornate porcelain coach pot from the 18th century.
During long journeys, women used a coach pot for convenience inside the carriage.
coach pot.meta: Arava idishi (coach pot) — bu tarixiy davrlarda uzoq safarlarda, ayniqsa ot aravalarida sayohat qilayotgan ayollar tomonidan yashirin ravishda siydik chiqarish uchun ishlatilgan kichik idish.

ex: A coaching glass is typically a stemmed glass without a base.
The antique shop had several coaching glasses on display.
coaching glass.meta: Coaching stakani (coaching glass) — bu tag qismi (oyoqligi) bo‘lmagan, lekin dastali (bo‘yinli) ichimlik stakani. U odatda tarixiy davrlarda ishlatilgan va aravalarda yoki safar davomida qulay ichimlik ichish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: In the 18th century, coaching horses were essential for long-distance travel.
The coaching horses were carefully selected for their strength and endurance.
coaching horse.meta: Arava oti (coaching horse) — bu ot aravani tortish uchun maxsus ishlatiladigan yoki shu maqsadda yetishtirilgan ot turi. Bunday otlar odatda kuchli, bardoshli va uzoq masofalarda harakatlanishga mos bo‘ladi.

ex: The old coaching inn is now a popular tourist attraction.
They spent the night at a coaching inn before continuing their journey.
coaching inn.meta: Arava mehmonxonasi (coaching inn) — bu ot aravalari harakatlanadigan yo‘nalishlarda joylashgan, yo‘lovchilar va aravakashlar to‘xtab dam oladigan mehmonxona.

ex: In some bird species, cooperative breeding involves siblings helping to raise the young.
Cooperative breeding of cattle helped the farmers increase their productivity.
cooperative breeding.meta: Hayvonlar yoki o‘simliklarni, ayniqsa chorva yoki qishloq xo‘jaligi ekinlarini jamoa, jamiyat yoki muassasa orqali birgalikda ko‘paytirish va yetishtirish jarayoni.

ex: Many engineering programs include cooperative education to prepare students for the workforce.
Cooperative education allows students to gain real-world experience while studying.
cooperative education.meta: Talabalarga o‘qish jarayonida haqiqiy ish tajribasi olish imkonini beruvchi ta’lim shakli. Bu tizimda talabalar o‘qish va amaliyot davrlarini navbatma-navbat o‘tashadi.

ex: Cooperative education combines classroom learning with practical work experience.
The cooperative provides low-cost goods to its members.
cooperative education.meta: Boshqalar bilan birgalikda ishlash yoki maqsadga erishish uchun tashkil etilgan, yoki hamkorlik asosida amalga oshiriladigan.

ex: It is necessary to follow the cooperative principle for effective communication.
He violated the cooperative principle during the conversation by going off-topic.
cooperative principle.meta: Hamkorlik prinsipi – bu muloqot jarayonida ishtirokchilar odatda bir-biriga yordam berishga harakat qilishlari, ya’ni gaplarida rostgo‘y, ma’lumotli, mavzuga tegishli va aniq bo‘lishga intilishlari haqidagi qoida.

ex: We need a cooperative team to complete this task efficiently.
The workers were very cooperative during the project.
cooperative shop.meta: Kooperativ do‘kon – bu kooperativ jamiyat yoki uyushmaga tegishli va ular tomonidan boshqariladigan do‘kon bo‘lib, uning foydasi a’zolar o‘rtasida taqsimlanadi.

ex: Cornetfish are commonly found in shallow tropical waters.
The cornetfish uses its long, slender body to sneak up on prey.
cornetfish.meta: Kornefis baliq – tropik dengiz sohillarida yashovchi, juda uzun, ingichka va yirtqich dengiz baliqlari turkumi. Ular boshqa kichik baliqlar va dengiz jonzotlari bilan oziqlanadi.

ex: The pharmacist recommended some cough sweets for my dry cough.
She took a cough sweet to soothe her sore throat.
cough sweet.meta: Yo‘tal shirinligi – yo‘talni yengillashtirish yoki tomoq og‘rig‘ini tinchlantirish uchun ishlatiladigan dorivor konfet yoki so‘riladigan shirinlik. Bu ko‘pincha yo‘tal dorikonfeti yoki yo‘tal konfetlari deb ham ataladi.

ex: Damn you! Why didn’t you listen to me?
Damn you! You ruined everything!
damn you.meta: "Damn you" – bu g‘azab yoki hafsala pir bo‘lish holatida ishlatiladigan, keskin norozilik, achchiqlanish yoki la’nat o‘qish ma’nosini bildiruvchi ibora. Bu ifoda odatda hissiyot bilan, ba’zan qo‘pol tarzda aytiladi.

ex: It’s one of those damned if you do and damned if you don’t situations — no matter what I decide, someone will be upset.
Parents are often damned if they do and damned if they don’t when it comes to disciplining their children.
damned if you do and damned if you don’t.meta: Bu ibora shunday vaziyatni ifodalaydiki, qanday qaror qabul qilinsa yoki nima qilinsa ham, baribir tanqidga uchrash yoki yomon oqibatlarga olib kelishi muqarrar bo‘ladi. Ya’ni har ikkala tanlov ham salbiy natija beradi.

ex: "Why is this happening?" "Damned if I know!"
Damned if I know where he went.
damned if i know.meta: Bu ibora biror fakt, mavzu yoki vaziyat haqida hech qanday ma’lumot yo‘qligini yoki chalkashlikni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda biroz hissiyot yoki hafsalasi pir bo‘lgan ohangda aytiladi.

ex: The general’s attitude was damn the torpedoes – full speed, no hesitation.
"We might fail, but damn the torpedoes, we’re going ahead!"
damn the torpedoes.meta: Bu ibora harakat yoki qaror natijasida xavf, zarar yoki salbiy oqibat bo‘lishi mumkinligini bilgan holda ham, bunga e’tibor bermay, dadil yoki hatto ehtiyotsiz harakat qilishni anglatadi. Odatda jasorat yoki qat’iyatni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Dim sum bonds have become popular among international investors seeking exposure to the Chinese currency.
The company raised funds through a dim sum bond issued in Hong Kong.
dim sum bond.meta: bu Xitoy valyutasi (yuan yoki RMB)da chiqarilgan, lekin Xitoy materik hududidan tashqarida (ko‘pincha Gonkongda) joylashtiriladigan obligatsiya. Bu moliyaviy vosita xorijiy investorlar uchun Xitoy valyutasida sarmoya kiritish imkoniyatini yaratadi.

ex: The plant with double mutant genes showed unexpected growth patterns.
Scientists discovered a double mutant strain of the virus that spreads more quickly.
double mutant.meta: Double mutant – bu ikki xil mutatsiyani o‘zida saqlaydigan organizm, gen yoki boshqa biologik tuzilma. Bunday organizm yoki gen ikkita alohida genetik o‘zgarishni o‘zida birlashtiradi.

ex: The government is working to reduce energy poverty by improving access to affordable electricity.
Many rural areas suffer from energy poverty due to lack of infrastructure.
energy poverty.meta: bu aholi yoki xonadonlarning asosiy ehtiyojlarini (isitish, yoritish, ovqat tayyorlash, suv isitish va boshqalar) ta’minlash uchun yetarli energiya resurslarini sotib olish yoki ularga ega bo‘lish imkoniyatiga ega bo‘lmaslik holati.

ex: The model predicts an exponential decay in population after the initial peak.
Radioactive substances undergo exponential decay over time.
exponential decay.meta: Eksponentsial so‘nish – bu matematik modellashtirishda miqdor yoki son qisqarishi shu qisqarayotgan umumiy son yoki o‘lchamga mutanosib ravishda kamayadigan jarayon. Ya’ni qancha ko‘p kamaygan bo‘lsa, shuncha sekinlashadi.

ex: In the early stages of an epidemic, cases can increase with exponential growth.
The company experienced exponential growth in sales last year.
exponential growth.meta: Eksponentsial o‘sish – bu matematik modellashtirishda o‘sish tezligi doimo mavjud bo‘lgan umumiy son yoki miqdorga mutanosib ravishda ortib boradigan jarayon. Ya’ni qancha ko‘p bo‘lsa, o‘sish tezligi ham shuncha ortadi.

ex: The nurse explained that exposure therapy helps some burns heal naturally.
In the past, exposure therapy was used to treat burns by leaving the wounds open to the air.
exposure therapy.meta: Bu teri kuyishlarini davolash usuli bo‘lib, kuygan joylarni bog‘lamasdan, havo ta’sirida ochiq holda qoldirish orqali sog‘ayishga yordam beradi. Bu usul hozirda juda kam qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The coach decided to start the game with a false nine instead of a traditional striker.
Using a false nine can confuse defenders and create more attacking space.
false nine.meta: Yolg‘on to‘qqiz – bu futbol taktikasi bo‘lib, markaziy hujumchi (klassik to‘qqizinchi raqam) odatdagidan ko‘ra orqaroq, yarim himoya zonasiga qaytib o‘ynaydi, natijada raqib himoyachilarni o‘z joyidan tortib chiqaradi va bo‘sh hududlar yaratadi

ex: The village grocer’s shop sells fresh fruits and vegetables.
I bought some bread and milk from the grocer’s shop this morning.
grocer’s shop.meta: Baqqol do‘koni – kundalik iste’mol qilinadigan oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari va maishiy (xonadon uchun zarur) buyumlarni sotadigan kichik do‘kon. Bu do‘konlarda odatda non, shakar, tuz, yog‘, choy, sabzavot kabi mahsulotlar bo‘ladi.

ex: I need to make enough this month to make groceries for my family.
He works two jobs just to make groceries.
to make groceries.meta: To make groceries – AQShning ayrim hududlarida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, odam oila yoki o‘zi uchun oziq-ovqat va zarur narsalarni ta’minlash, yoki kundalik ehtiyojlarni qoplash uchun yetarli daromad topish ma’nosida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: She went to make groceries at the local store.
I’m going to make groceries this afternoon.
to make groceries.meta: To make groceries – AQSh janubiy shtatlarida, ayniqsa Yangi Orlean va Luiziana mintaqasida ishlatiladigan mahalliy ibora bo‘lib, oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari xarid qilish, ya’ni ro‘zg‘or uchun kundalik mahsulotlar sotib olish ma’nosida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: My grandfather was a grocery keeper in a small village.
The grocery keeper was friendly and knew all his customers by name.
grocery keeper.meta: (a) oziq-ovqat va maishiy mahsulotlar sotadigan do‘kon egasi yoki shu do‘konda ishlovchi sotuvchi. (b) ayrim mintaqalarda aroqxo‘r do‘koni yoki bar egasi yoki xodimi ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: In some U.S. regions, the grocery man was also the local liquor supplier.
The grocery man used to sell fresh produce every morning.
grocery man.meta: (a) (AQSh, hozir tarixiy) aroqxo‘r do‘koni yoki bar egasi yoki u yerda ishlaydigan shaxs. (b) (aslida AQSh) oziq-ovqat do‘koni egasi yoki shu do‘konda ishlovchi sotuvchi.

ex: This mining machine can achieve a hash rate of 100 terahashes per second.
A higher hash rate increases the chance of successfully mining cryptocurrency.
hash rate.meta: bu bir soniyada bajariladigan xesh operatsiyalari soni. Odatda bu ko‘rsatkich kriptovalyuta qazib olish tezligi va hisoblash quvvatini o‘lchash uchun ishlatiladi. Xesh tezligi qanchalik yuqori bo‘lsa, mayner shunchalik samarali ishlaydi.

ex: In the empire, the high chancellor was second only to the emperor in authority.
The high chancellor presided over the final decision of the council.
high chancellor.meta: High chancellor – bu davlat yoki millatning oliy darajadagi amaldori yoki bosh mansabdor shaxslaridan biri. U turli mamlakatlarda eng yuqori darajadagi siyosiy yoki sud lavozimlarida bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Reading different types of books helps you broaden your horizons.
Traveling to other countries can broaden your horizon.
to broaden one’s horizon.meta: To broaden one’s horizon – bu o‘z bilimlari, qiziqishlari, faoliyatlari va dunyoqarashini kengaytirish, yangi imkoniyatlarni o‘rganish, boshqa madaniyatlar, tajribalar yoki fikrlar bilan tanishish orqali shaxsiy rivojlanish jarayoni.

ex: News reports described the man as a suspected kiddie fiddler.
The community was outraged when the kiddie fiddler was arrested.
kiddie fiddler.meta: Kiddie fiddler – bu ingliz tilida haqoratli va og‘ir ma’nodagi so‘z bo‘lib, bolalarni jinsiy zo‘ravonlik yoki suiste’mol qilishda ayblanadigan yoki shu ishni qiladigan shaxsni anglatadi.

ex: The painter mixed lead white with oil to prepare his canvas.
Ancient artists often used lead white to create bright highlights in paintings.
lead white.meta: Qo‘rg‘oshin oq bo‘yoq – tarkibida qo‘rg‘oshin karbonati va asosiy qo‘rg‘oshin karbonati bo‘lgan oq pigment. Bu bo‘yoq asosan rassomchilikda va bo‘yoq ishlab chiqarishda ishlatilgan.

ex: The lawyer refused to disclose the conversation, citing legal professional privilege.
Legal professional privilege protects confidential communication between lawyers and their clients.
legal professional privilege.meta: Huquqiy kasbiy daxlsizlik – bu advokat va mijoz o‘rtasida yuridik maslahat olish yoki berish jarayonida bo‘lib o‘tgan muloqot va yozishmalarni oshkor etilishidan qonuniy ravishda himoya qiluvchi huquq.

ex: Our team just hired a new defensive line coach.
The line coach focused on improving the offensive line’s blocking techniques.
line coach.meta: Line coach – bu amerika futbolida (va ba’zan boshqa sport turlarida) chiziq o‘yinchilari uchun mas’ul yordamchi murabbiy.

ex: Many performers use lip-syncing to ensure a perfect show, but a real lip-syncer relies on it entirely.
The singer was revealed to be a lip-syncer during the live show.
lip-syncer.meta: Lab bilan sinxronlashtiruvchi ijrochi – bu musiqa, qo‘shiq yoki nutq matniga sinxron tarzda faqat lab harakati qiluvchi, lekin haqiqiy ovoz chiqarmaydigan shaxs.

ex: The reforms significantly changed the responsibilities of the Lord Chancellorship.
He held the Lord Chancellorship for over a decade.
lord chancellorship.meta: Lord kanslerlik lavozimi – bu Lord kansler (Buyuk Britaniya hukumatidagi yuksak amaldor)ning rasmiy lavozimi yoki unvoni. Bu tushuncha shuningdek, Lord kanslerning xizmat muddati yoki bu lavozimdagi faoliyati davrini ham anglatishi mumkin.

ex: The duties of the Lord High Chancellorship have evolved over time.
He served in the Lord High Chancellorship for fifteen years.
lord high chancellorship.meta: Oliy Lord kanslerlik lavozimi – bu Buyuk Britaniyada Oliy Lord kansler (Lord High Chancellor)ning rasmiy lavozimi yoki unvoni. Bu atama shuningdek, Oliy Lord kanslerning xizmat muddati yoki lavozimdagi faoliyati davrini ham bildiradi.

ex: The clinic provides free treatment for patients in a state of medical indigence.
Many people in developing countries suffer from medical indigence.
medical indigence.meta: Tibbiy nochorlik – bu shaxs yoki oilaning zarur tibbiy yordamni olish uchun moliyaviy imkoniyatga ega bo‘lmaslik holati.

ex: Medical indigency prevents millions of people from getting necessary treatments.
The hospital offers free care for patients in medical indigency.
medical indigency.meta: Tibbiy nochorlik – bu inson zarur tibbiy xizmat yoki davolanishni olish uchun yetarli moliyaviy resurslarga ega bo‘lmagan holat.

ex: Optical tweezers allow precise manipulation of microscopic particles.
Scientists used optical tweezers to hold and move individual cells without damaging them.
optical tweezers.meta: Optik pensetalar – bu kuchli fokuslangan lazer nuri yordamida mikroskopik va submikroskopik ob’ektlarni (masalan, hujayralar, molekulalar va boshqa mayda zarrachalar) ushlab turish, ko‘chirish yoki boshqarish imkonini beradigan ilmiy asbob.

ex: During the pandemic, the demand for oxygen concentrators increased dramatically.
The patient used an oxygen concentrator to assist with breathing.
oxygen concentrator.meta: bu havodagi azot (yoki azot va karbonat angidrid)ni ajratib, toza kislorod yoki kislorodga boy gaz aralashmasi hosil qiladigan tibbiy qurilma. Bu asosan kislorod yetishmovchiligidan aziyat chekayotgan bemorlarga nafas olish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: POC have historically faced systemic discrimination.
The organization supports the rights of POC.
poc.meta: POC (People of Colour) – bu atama asosan G‘arb mamlakatlarida oq tanlilar guruhidan boshqa irqiy yoki etnik guruhlarga mansub insonlarni umumiy holda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The rain caused her mascara to run, giving her panda eyes.
After a sleepless night, she had noticeable panda eyes.
panda eyes.meta: Panda ko‘zlari – bu inson ko‘zlari atrofida paydo bo‘ladigan qorong‘i halqalar yoki qora dog‘lar. Bunday holat odatda bo‘yoqning tarqalishi, uxlamaslik, charchoq yoki ba’zan quyoshda kuyish natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ex: A polearm provides extended reach in close combat.
The soldiers were armed with polearms such as spears and halberds.
polearm.meta: Naydali qurol – bu qo‘l jangi uchun mo‘ljallangan, odatda yog‘och dastali va uchiga bir yoki bir nechta pichoqlar, bolta boshi yoki sanchuvchi, zarb beruvchi qismlar o‘rnatilgan uzoq qurol.

ex: The coffee shop’s pumpkin latte is their seasonal best-seller.
I always order a pumpkin latte in autumn.
pumpkin latte.meta: Qovoqli latte – bu qahvaga qovoq ziravorlari (odatda dolchin, muskat yong‘og‘i, zanjabil va ba’zan chinnigullar) qo‘shilgan, shirin va sutli issiq ichimlik. Bu ichimlik ko‘pincha kuz faslida ommalashadi va "pumpkin spice latte" deb ham ataladi.

ex: Pumpkin pie spice is essential for making a traditional pumpkin pie.
She added pumpkin pie spice to the cake batter for extra flavor.
pumpkin pie spice.meta: Qovoqli pirog ziravorlari – bu qovoqli pirog va boshqa shirinliklar tayyorlashda ishlatiladigan, odatda maydalangan dolchin, muskat yong‘og‘i, zanjabil va chinnigullar aralashmasidan iborat ziravor to‘plami.

ex: Google claimed to have achieved quantum supremacy in 2019.
Quantum supremacy marks a major milestone in the development of quantum computing.
quantum supremacy.meta: Kvant ustunligi – bu kvant kompyuteri klassik (an’anaviy) kompyuter amalda hal qila olmaydigan yoki juda uzoq vaqt talab qiladigan muammoni qisqa vaqt ichida yecha olishini amalda isbotlash holati.

ex: "He’s the best player on the team." – "Damn right!"
"Are you going to the game?" – "Damn right, I am!"
damn right.meta: Damn right – bu ibora kuchli tasdiq, qat’iy rozi bo‘lish yoki mutlaq ishonchni ifodalaydi. "Ha, albatta", "Shubhasiz", "Aniq" kabi ma’nolarni anglatadi va odatda keskin, hissiyotli yoki norasmiy suhbatlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: The seats in row Z are usually the cheapest in the stadium.
His shot was so wild it flew straight into row Z.
row z.meta: Row Z – bu teatr, stadion yoki katta zalning eng orqa qatori. Ayniqsa futbol va boshqa sport kontekstida, zarba yoki to‘p juda baland yoki stadiondan ancha uzoqqa uchib ketganda, hazil tariqasida “to‘p row Z ga ketdi” deb aytiladi.

ex: Some animal rights groups oppose the use of shock collars.
The trainer used a shock collar to correct the dog's aggressive behavior.
shock collar.meta: Elektr tasirli bo‘yinturuq – bu, ayniqsa, itlar uchun ishlatiladigan, ichiga radio boshqaruvli elektr toki uzatuvchi moslama o‘rnatilgan bo‘yinturuq bo‘lib, hayvonni tarbiyalash yoki ba’zi xatti-harakatlarini to‘xtatish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: A shock leader is essential when surfcasting to prevent the main line from snapping.
The angler tied a shock leader to handle the heavy weight.
shock leader.meta: Shock leader – bu baliq ovlashda asosiy ipga ulangan kuchli va qalin baliq ipi bo‘lib, og‘ir yuk yoki kuchli zarbalarda bosimni asosiy ipdan olib, uni himoya qilish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Shock metamorphism produces unique mineral structures not found elsewhere.
The scientists studied the shock metamorphism in rocks around the impact crater.
shock metamorphism.meta: meteoritlar yoki boshqa yuqori tezlikdagi kosmik jismlarning Yerga tushishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan zarba to‘lqinlari ta’sirida tog‘ jinslari va minerallarda yuzaga keladigan deformatsiya va qizish oqibatida ro‘y beradigan o‘zgarishlar.

ex: The phone's shock resistance makes it suitable for outdoor use.
This watch is known for its excellent shock resistance.
shock resistance.meta: bu biror mexanik qurilma, material yoki boshqa obyektning tashqi zarba, urilish yoki tebranishga jiddiy shikastlanmasdan bardosh bera olish qobiliyati. Bu xususiyat soat, telefon, sanoat uskunalari kabi mahsulotlarda juda muhim hisoblanadi.

ex: The presence of shocked quartz suggests a past asteroid collision.
Scientists found shocked quartz at the meteorite impact site.
shocked quartz.meta: Zarbalangan kvars – bu yuqori bosim, lekin nisbatan past haroratda (odatda meteorit zarbasi yoki yadroviy portlash natijasida) shakli buzilgan mikroskopik tuzilishga ega bo‘lgan kvars turi.

ex: She started a side hustle selling handmade jewelry online.
Many people have a side hustle to supplement their main income.
side hustle.meta: Qo‘shimcha ish – bu biror kishi asosiy ishidan tashqari, qo‘shimcha daromad topish maqsadida bajaradigan qisman vaqtli yoki qo‘shimcha bandlik. Bu ish odatda asosiy ish vaqtidan tashqari amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Smart glasses can help workers access information hands-free.
He wore smart glasses that displayed notifications right in front of his eyes.
smart glasses.meta: Aqlli ko‘zoynak — bu kompyuter texnologiyasi bilan jihozlangan, taqib oluvchiga ko‘rish maydoniga qo‘shimcha ma’lumot yoki interaktiv funksiyalarni taqdim etadigan ko‘zoynak turi.

ex: The building uses solar thermal panels to heat water.
Solar thermal energy is a clean and renewable resource.
solar thermal.meta: Quyosh issiqlik texnologiyasi — bu quyosh nurining issiqlik energiyasidan bevosita foydalanadigan qurilmalar yoki texnologiyalarni ifodalaydi.

ex: Speech act theory helps understand how language is used to perform actions.
According to speech act theory, saying “I apologize” is performing the act of apologizing.
speech act theory.meta: Nutq harakati nazariyasi – bu nazariya bo‘lib, unda bir so‘z yoki gap faqat ma’lumot berish emas, balki gapiruvchining ma’lum bir natijaga erishish niyati bilan amalga oshirilgan harakati sifatida ko‘riladi.

ex: The verb “request” is a common speech act verb used to make polite demands.
Verbs like “ask,” “promise,” and “apologize” are examples of speech act verbs.
