speech act verb.meta: Nutq harakati fe’li – bu gapiruvchining ma’lum bir nutq harakatini (masalan, so‘rash, buyurish, va’da berish, kechirim so‘rash) ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan fe’l. Bu fe’l so‘z orqali gapiruvchining gapirishdagi maqsadi va niyatini bildiradi

ex: The herbalist recommended taking spirit of anise for stomach discomfort.
Spirit of anise has been traditionally used to relieve digestive problems.
spirit of anise.meta: Anis ruhiyati — bu anis urug‘idan distillangan ekstrakt yoki keyingi paytlarda asosan anis moyining spirtli eritmasi bo‘lib, ko‘proq dorivor vosita sifatida ishlatiladi. U ichaklarni tinchlantirish va hazmni yaxshilash uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Make sure your sports kit includes appropriate shoes and clothing.
He packed his sports kit before going to the football match.
sports kit.meta: Sport anjomlari — ma’lum bir sport turida ishtirok etish uchun kerak bo‘ladigan kiyim va uskuna jamlanmasi. Bu kiyimlar sportchilarga qulaylik yaratish va sport faoliyatini yaxshilash maqsadida mo‘ljallangan.

ex: It was squeaky bum time as the teams battled for the championship.
The last five minutes of the game were pure squeaky bum time.
squeaky bum time.meta: Tortishuvli lahzalar — ayniqsa sport yoki muhim voqealar oldidan yuzaga keladigan, juda tarang va stressli vaqt davri. Bu paytda odamlar natijalar yoki yakuniy natija uchun juda xavotirda va siqilgan bo‘ladilar.

ex: The engineers performed surge testing to check the insulation material’s durability.
Surge testing is crucial for ensuring the reliability of electrical components.
surge testing.meta: Zaryad sinovlari — bu elektr uskunalari yoki izolyatsiya materiallari, shuningdek surge suppressor (kuchlanish to‘siqlari)ning kuchlanish toshqinlari (toshqin kuchlanish sharoitlari) ostida ishlash qobiliyatini sinovdan o‘tkazish jarayoni

ex: Researchers in synthetic biology create organisms with novel functions.
Synthetic biology aims to design and construct new biological parts and systems.
synthetic biology.meta: Sintetik biologiya — bu biologiyaning bir sohasi bo‘lib, u murakkab va integratsiyalashgan tizimlarni, ularning tarkibiy qismlarining xususiyatlaridan ko‘ra, umumiy tizim sifatida o‘rganishga qaratilgan yondashuvdir.

ex: The dish was flavored with Szechuan pepper for a unique spicy kick.
Szechuan pepper is a key ingredient in many Chinese dishes.
szechuan pepper.meta: Sychuan qalampiri — bu Rutaceae oilasiga mansub Zanthoxylum turiga oid daraxt va butalarning quritilgan, urug‘siz mevalaridan tayyorlangan ziravor. U Osiyo oshxonasida, ayniqsa Xitoyning Sichuan mintaqasida keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The television cabinet has shelves for DVDs and gaming consoles.
They bought a new television cabinet for the living room.
television cabinet.meta: Televizor shkafi — bu televizorni joylashtirish yoki ustiga qo‘yish uchun mo‘ljallangan mebel buyumidir. U televizorni himoya qilish, tartibga solish va xona bezagini to‘ldirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Throat sweets can help relieve coughing.
She took a throat sweet to soothe her sore throat.
throat sweet.meta: Tomoq tabletkasi — bu yo‘talni yengillashtirish yoki tomoqdagi og‘riq va bezovtalikni kamaytirish uchun ishlatiladigan dori vositasi shaklidagi shirinlik yoki lozenj. Ko‘pincha medikatsiyalangan va tibbiy maqsadlarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The bird landed on top of the tree.+
He wore a hat on top of his head.
on top.meta: Boshning yuqori qismi — boshning eng yuqori, tepada joylashgan qismi.

ex: She has a busy schedule, and on top of that, she’s studying for exams.
On top of his regular job, he also volunteers at the shelter.
on top.meta: Bunga qo‘shimcha — biror narsaga qo‘shimcha sifatida, yana bir narsani ham hisobga olganda yoki unga ustama sifatida.

ex: This car model is considered top-of-the-range because of its luxury and performance.
He bought a top-of-the-range smartphone with all the latest features.
top-of-the-range.meta: Eng yuqori darajadagi — ayniqsa tijoratda ishlab chiqarilgan mahsulotlarning eng yaxshi sifatga ega yoki o‘z turidagi eng qimmatlari qatoriga kiradiganini bildiradi.

ex: When thinking about healthy food, fruits are top of mind for many people.+
Customer satisfaction is always top of mind for our company.
top of mind.meta: Eng birinchi esga tushadigan — kimningdir fikrida, tashvishlarida yoki e’tiborida birinchi o‘rinda turgan, eng yaqin va ustuvor narsalar. Shuningdek, bu ibora tezkor, o‘ylamasdan qilingan yoki darhol paydo bo‘lgan holatlarni ham bildirishi mumkin.

ex: The company’s restructuring was done from the top down.
The manager reviewed the project from the top down to ensure nothing was missed.
from the top down.meta: Tepadan pastga qarab — biror jarayon yoki harakat boshidan (yuqori qismidan) boshlanib, pastga qarab davom ettirilishini ifodalaydi.

ex: In many organizations, policies are implemented from the top down.
The decision was made from the top down, starting with the CEO and going through all levels.
from the top down.meta: Yuqoridan pastgacha — guruh, tashkilot, yoki ierarxiya ichida eng yuqori lavozimdan eng past lavozimgacha bo‘lgan tartibda yoki ketma-ketlikda amalga oshiriladigan ish, boshqaruv yoki qaror qabul qilish usuli.

ex: He always keeps his top eye open for any signs of trouble.
You need to keep your top eye open when walking alone at night.
to keep one’s top eye open.meta: Diqqatli bo‘lish — atrofdagi holatlarga hushyorlik bilan qarash, doim hushyor va ogoh bo‘lib turish, ehtiyotkorlik bilan kuzatish.

ex: They took 10% off the top before dividing the rest of the money.
The company deducts taxes off the top of your salary.
off the top.meta: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri — dastlabki yoki umumiy summadan boshqa xarajatlar yoki chegirmalar olinmasdan avval, darhol ajratilgan yoki olib tashlangan miqdor yoki summa.

ex: Leaders often say, "It’s lonely at the top" because they face many pressures others don’t.
Being the CEO is rewarding, but it’s lonely at the top.
it’s lonely at the top.meta: Yuqorida yolg‘izlik bor — kuchli mavqega yoki yuqori lavozimga ega bo‘lgan odamlar ko‘pincha yolg‘izlik, bosim va izolyatsiyani his qilishlarini ta’kidlaydigan ibora.

ex: Top-fermented beers usually have a stronger taste than lagers.
Ale is typically a top-fermented beer.
top-fermented.meta: Yuqori fermentatsiyalangan — (pivo yoki ales uchun) fermentatsiya jarayoni pivo yuzasida (tepada) sodir bo‘ladigan, ya’ni yuqori haroratda va pivo yuzasidagi xamirturushlar tomonidan ishlab chiqarilgan tur.

ex: This beer is brewed using top-fermenting yeast.
Top-fermenting yeast strains are used in ale production.
top-fermenting.meta: Yuqoriga fermentatsiyalovchi — odatda Saccharomyces cerevisiae xamirturush shtammlarini ifodalovchi atama bo‘lib, fermentatsiya jarayonida suyuqlik yuzasiga chiqishga moyil bo‘lgan tur.

ex: Top fuel engines produce incredible amounts of power.
The car was competing in the top fuel drag racing category.
top fuel.meta: Top fuel — drag-reysing musobaqalarida ishlatiladigan yonilg‘i sinfi; odatda nitrometan asosida tayyorlangan va ko‘pincha metanol kabi qo‘shimchalar bilan aralashtirilgan, yuqori samaradorlik va tezlik uchun mo‘ljallangan yonilg‘i.

ex: A top-hung door opens by swinging from its upper hinges.
The bathroom window is top-hung for better ventilation.
top-hung.meta: Tepaga osilgan — biror narsaning yuqori qismiga osilgan yoki bog‘langan; ayniqsa, deraza yoki eshikda ramkaning yuqori qismiga menteşalar bilan biriktirilgan tur.

ex: Farmers use chemicals that result in top kill to control weeds.
The herbicide caused a top kill without harming the roots.
top kill.meta: Yuqori qismni o‘ldirish — o‘simliklarning yer ustidagi qismlarining, ayniqsa ildizlarga zarar yetkazmaydigan gerbitsidlar (begona o‘tlarni yo‘q qiluvchi vositalar) ta’siri ostida nobud bo‘lishi; bu o‘simlikning yuqori qismidagi o‘lim holati.

ex: Top loin is prized for its tenderness and flavor.
He ordered a top loin steak for dinner.
top loin.meta: Eng yaxshi bel go‘shti — hayvonning bel qismidan olinadigan yumshoq go‘sht; ayniqsa, AQShda qovurg‘alardan keyingi bel qismidan olingan mol go‘shti bo‘lagi bo‘lib, odatda steyk shaklida kesiladi.

ex: Getting a top pair in Texas Hold’em can be a strong start.
He won the hand with a top pair.
top pair.meta: Eng yuqori juftlik — (ayniqsa Texas Hold’em pokerida) mavjud eng yuqori qiymatli jamoaviy karta bilan bir juftlik hosil qilgan karta kombinatsiyasi.

ex: The butcher recommended the top round cut for roasting.
He grilled a top round steak for dinner.
top round.meta: Eng yuqori qirqim — (a) mol go‘shtining sonning ichki qismidan olingan bo‘lak yoki steykni ifodalaydigan sifatdosh; (b) aynan shunday turdagi mol go‘shti bo‘lagi.

ex: The top-scoring student received a scholarship.
She was the top-scoring player in the tournament.
top-scoring.meta: Eng ko‘p ochko to‘playdigan — sport musobaqasida yoki ballar yoki baholar beriladigan boshqa biror tadbirda ishtirokchilar orasida eng yuqori ochko yoki ballga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: The newspaper’s top story covers the recent economic changes.
The top story on the news tonight is about the election results.
top story.meta: Eng muhim xabar — ayni paytda eng ko‘p e’tibor qaratilayotgan va yetakchi o‘rin egallagan yangilik yoki xabar.

ex: A top tip for learning languages is to practice every day.
Here’s a top tip for saving money on groceries.
top tip.meta: Foydali maslahat — kichik, ammo juda amaliy va foydali bo‘lgan maslahat yoki tavsiya.

ex: The top tube connects the seat tube and the head tube of the bike.
The cyclist adjusted the height of the top tube for better comfort.
top tube.meta: Yuqori truba — velosiped ramkasining eng yuqori qismi bo‘lib, ayniqsa, olmos shaklidagi ramkaning gorizontal trubasi.

ex: The computer broke down, and to top it all, I lost my presentation file.
He missed the bus, and to top it all, it started raining.
to top it all.meta: Barchasiga ustiga — odatda noxush yoki omadsiz voqealar ketma-ketligining eng yomoni, eng yuqori cho‘qqisini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi; ya’ni voqealarning eng yomon yoki so‘nggi bosqichi.

ex: The sailors told him to top his boom before the captain noticed.
When trouble started, he decided to top his boom.
to top one’s boom.meta: Tezda ketmoq — asosan dengizchilar orasida ishlatilgan (hozir kam ishlatiladi) so‘z birikmasi; biror joydan ketib qolish, o‘zini yashirish yoki ko‘rinmas bo‘lish ma’nosida.

ex: After years of hard work, she finally achieved top-dog status in her field.
The company gained top-dog status in the tech industry.
top-dog status.meta: Eng yuqori mavqe — ma’lum bir sohada yoki kontekstdagi eng kuchli, eng nufuzli, hukmron pozitsiya yoki maqom.

ex: Convert the top-heavy fraction to a mixed number.
74\frac{7}{4}47​ is a top-heavy fraction because the numerator is greater than the denominator.
top-heavy fraction.meta: Yuqori kasr — kasrda yuqori son (chiziq ustidagi son, ya’ni numerator) pastki sondan (chiziq ostidagi son, ya’ni denominator) katta bo‘lgan kasr turi; boshqa nomi bilan noto‘g‘ri kasr.

ex: Common top-level domains include .com, .org, and .net.
The top-level domain for websites in Uzbekistan is .uz.
top-level domain.meta: Eng yuqori darajadagi domen — domen nomining oxirgi qismi bo‘lib, u tegishli IP-manzilni joylashuvi, faoliyat sohasi va boshqa xususiyatlari bo‘yicha tasniflaydi; qisqartmasi — TLD.

ex: The criminal was taken to the topping cheat.
In old times, the topping cheat was feared by many.
topping cheat.meta: Osma gilof — qadimiy yoki arxaik tilda gilof, ya’ni odamni osib o‘ldirish uchun ishlatiladigan asbob yoki joy; darvoza, qatl joyi.

ex: In the old days, the topping cove was a feared figure in the town.
The topping cove carried out his duties without hesitation.
topping cove.meta: Osuvchi — odamlarni osib qatl qiluvchi shaxs; qadimiy yoki arxaik tilda aytiladi.

ex: The topping shed was located at the far end of the prison yard.
The prisoner was taken to the topping shed to face his execution.
topping shed.meta: Osilish joyi — qamoqxona hududi yoki bino qismi bo‘lib, u yerda odamlarni osib o‘ldirish uchun gilof joylashgan.

ex: Many species of topple-crown birds are known for their distinctive head crests.
The topple-crown bird showed off its beautiful feathers during mating season.
topple-crown.meta: Tojli qush — boshining ustida maxsus, ko‘tarilgan tuklari yoki cho‘qqasi bo‘lgan qush turi.

ex: The crowd was carrying on all top ropes after the big game.
They started carrying on top ropes at the party last night.
to carry on top ropes.meta: Baland ovoz bilan shovqin solmoq — asosan Avstraliya tilida ishlatiladigan ibora; beqaror, mast yoki tartibsiz ravishda g‘alayon, shovqin ko‘tarmoq; ko‘pincha katta bezovtalik yoki shov-shuv chiqarishni bildiradi. Hozir kam ishlatiladi.

ex: The new policy turned out to be neither use nor ornament for the company.
That old machine is neither use nor ornament; it just takes up space.
to be neither use nor ornament.meta: Na foydasi, na bezagi bo‘lmoq — asosan Britaniya inglizchasida ishlatiladigan ibora; ma’nosi — hech qanday foydasi bo‘lmaslik, keraksiz yoki samarasiz bo‘lish.

ex: VOCs can contribute to indoor air pollution.
Paints often contain high levels of VOCs.
voc.meta: Uchuvchan organik birikma — xona haroratida osongina bug‘lanadigan turli organik kimyoviy moddalarning umumiy nomi.

ex: Early diagnosis of visual impairment is important for treatment.
People with visual impairment may need special assistance.
visual impairment.meta: Ko‘rish qobiliyatining buzilishi — ko‘rishning qisman yoki jiddiy darajada kamayishi yoki yo‘qolishi holati; ko‘z ko‘ruvining pasayishi yoki nuqsoni.

ex: Professional audio equipment often features XLR ports.
The microphone uses an XLR connector for a balanced audio signal.
xlr.meta: XLR ulagichi — odatda 3 ta, ba’zan 4 dan 7 tagacha pin yoki ulanish joylari bo‘lgan, silindrsimon qopqoq ichida joylashgan elektr ulagichining turi; asosan audio uskunalarda, mikrofonlar va ovoz uskunalarida ishlatiladi.

ex: Zonal marking requires good communication between defenders.
The team used zonal marking to defend against the opponents' attacks.
zonal marking.meta: Maydon belgilash — himoya o‘yinida, har bir o‘yinchiga maydonning ma’lum bir qismi (zona) ajratilib, u o‘sha zonani himoya qiladigan tizim.

ex: Scholars have debated the exact nature of the aestel for centuries.
The aestel mentioned in King Alfred’s letter is a mysterious historical artefact.
aestel.meta: Æstel — Angliya qirolligi davrida, ayniqsa Qirol Ælfredning "Pastoral Care" asarining tarjimasiga qo‘shilgan kirish xatida tilga olingan qadimiy buyum yoki artefakt. Bu buyum tarix davomida turlicha talqin qilingan va hozirda uning aniq shakli noma’lum.

ex: The project implemented an agrivoltaic farm combining agriculture and renewable energy.
Agrivoltaic systems enable farmers to grow crops and generate solar power on the same land.
agrivoltaic.meta: Agrivoltayik — qishloq xo‘jaligi yer maydonini bir vaqtning o‘zida dehqonchilik va quyosh fotovoltaik panellari yordamida elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqarish uchun ishlatishga imkon beradigan tizim yoki texnologiya.

ex: The study focuses on improving agrivoltaics to increase land efficiency.
Agrivoltaics allows farmers to produce food and solar energy simultaneously.
agrivoltaics.meta: Agrivoltayika — yer maydonining bir vaqtning o‘zida qishloq xo‘jaligi uchun ekin yetishtirish va fotovoltaik quyosh panellari yordamida elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqarishda foydalanilishi; bunday tizim yoki texnologiya.

ex: He behaved like a complete apeth at the meeting.
Don’t act like an apeth, think before you speak.
apeth.meta: Ahmoq — o‘ylamay harakat qiladigan, mantiqsiz yoki noxush ish qiladigan, aqlli bo‘lmagan odam; bejiz yoki befoyda shaxs.

ex: A staff with a snake coiled around it is known as the Asclepius.
The Asclepius symbol is commonly used by medical organizations worldwide.
asclepius.meta: Asklepiy — tibbiyot ramzi sifatida ishlatiladigan, uzun tayoq atrofida ilon o‘ralgan tasvir; keyinchalik tibbiyot va tibbiy tashkilotlarning belgisi sifatida qabul qilingan.

ex: She played a beautiful melody on the bandura.
The bandura is a traditional Ukrainian musical instrument.
bandura.meta: Bandura — Ukraina milliy musiqa asbobi; asimmetrik lutfaga o‘xshash, ko‘p torli katta torli cholg‘u, vertikal ushlab, tsiterga o‘xshab tirnaladi.

ex: We enjoyed a glass of dry Barbera with dinner.
Barbera is a popular red wine from the Piedmont region of Italy.
barbera.meta: Barbera — Italiya, ayniqsa Piyemont mintaqasiga xos qizil uzum navidan tayyorlangan, asosan quruq qizil sharoblarning har qanday turi; hozirda Italiya va boshqa joylarda ham yetishtiriladi.

ex: Be careful not to barberchair the tree when cutting it down.
When the tree was felled, it barberchaired, leaving a split stump.
barberchair.meta: Barberchair qilish — daraxt kesishda uning ustki qismi ustun bo‘lib, shox yoki shoxlar shaklida bo‘laklarga ajralib chiqishi, natijada stul shaklidagi taglik qolishi.

ex: The barbering profession requires skill and patience.
He works in a barbering salon.
barbering.meta: Barbering — soch yoki yuz sochlarini qirqadigan, taraydigan yoki turmagini qiladigan; soch kesuvchi sifatida ishlaydigan.

ex: The stylist barberized his hair before the event.
He asked the barber to barberize his beard neatly.
barberize.meta: Barberize qilish — erkakning sochini yoki soqolini kesish, qisqartirish yoki tartibga solish; soch kesuvchi kabi xizmat ko‘rsatish.

ex: In stories, a barber’s cat often symbolizes talkativeness or curiosity.
The barber’s cat was always sitting on the counter, watching customers.
barber’s cat.meta: Soch kesuvchining mushugi — soch kesuvchi tomonidan asrab saqlanadigan mushuk. Ushbu ibora ba’zida shunga o‘xshash mushukka xos bo‘lgan xususiyatlar, masalan, gapiruvchanlik, diqqatni tortish kabi sifatlarni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Barbershopping requires good harmony and teamwork.
They enjoy barbershopping on weekends.
barbershopping.meta: Barbershopping — barbershop uslubida yoki umumiy ma’noda yaqin uyg‘unlik (close harmony) bilan qo‘shiq kuylash san’ati; guruh bo‘lib chiroyli harmoniyalarda kuylash.

ex: Advances in biotechnology have expanded the scope of the bioeconomy.
The government is investing heavily in the bioeconomy sector.
bioeconomy.meta: (a) Biotexnologiya asosida rivojlanayotgan iqtisodiyotning bir qismi; (b) Tabiiy resurslarni barqaror va samarali tarzda boshqarish va foydalanish orqali iqtisodiy o‘sish va barqarorlikni ta’minlash tizimi.

ex: It is customary to drink blockan ale to celebrate a successful bargain.
After sealing the deal, they shared a glass of blockan ale.
blockan ale.meta: Blockan ale — savdo yoki bitim yakunlangach, bayramona yoki rasmiy tarzda ichiladigan ichimlik.

ex: The theater manager block-booked several rows of seats for the company event.
We decided to block-book ten hotel rooms for the conference.
block-book.meta: Block-book — (masalan, mehmonxona xonalari, chiptalar, o‘rinlar kabi) bir guruh narsani oldindan birgalikda band qilish yoki buyurtma berish.

ex: All exits were blocked-off during the emergency drill.
The street was blocked-off due to construction work.
blocked-off.meta: Blocked-off — kirish yoki chiqish yo‘li to‘sib qo‘yilgan yoki yopilgan; ayniqsa, ko‘cha, yo‘l yoki shunga o‘xshash joylar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: In arctic regions, blockfields are common on flat terrains.
The hikers crossed a vast blockfield covered with large boulders.
blockfield.meta: Blockfield — muzlash natijasida singan katta toshlardan iborat keng maydoncha, asosan tekis hududlarda, arktika yoki tog‘li iqlim sharoitlarida hosil bo‘ladi; toshli maydon yoki felsenmeer deb ham ataladi.

ex: Institutional investors often act as blockholders in large corporations.
The blockholder has significant influence over the company's decisions.
blockholder.meta: Blockholder — aksiyadorlar orasida, ayniqsa, bir kompaniyaning katta miqdordagi aksiyalariga egalik qiluvchi yirik institutsional investor yoki aksiador.

ex: The blockie takes care of his small orchard with great dedication.
Many blockies grow grapes in their vineyards.
blockie.meta: Blockie — asosan kichik bir qism yerda, qishloq xo‘jaligi maqsadida, masalan, bog‘ yoki uzumzor maydonida ishlaydigan yoki egasi bo‘lgan odam. Shuningdek, boshqa ma'noda ham ishlatiladi (masalan, kichik hududda yashovchi kishi).

ex: A blocking patent can delay the approval of new products in the market.
The company filed a blocking patent to prevent competitors from patenting a similar invention.
blocking patent.meta: To‘suvchi patent — boshqa patent arizasini to‘sib qo‘yuvchi patent (odatda yangi mahsulot, tovar, ixtiro va hokazolar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, ikkinchi patent arizasi ushbu mavjud patent doirasida ekanligi sababli rad etiladi).

ex: We hired a skilled blocklayer for the new house construction.
The blocklayer carefully placed each concrete block to build the wall.
blocklayer.meta: Blocklayer — turli qurilish ishlarida tosh, beton, yog‘och kabi bloklarni joylashtiruvchi yoki qo‘yuvchi odam; qurilish bloklarini yotqizish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassis.

ex: Proper block laying ensures the stability of the entire structure.
The block laying took several weeks to complete the building’s foundation.
block laying.meta: Block laying — turli qurilish ishlarida tosh, beton, yog‘och bloklarini joylashtirish yoki yotqizish jarayoni; blok qo‘yish kasbi yoki mahorati.

ex: Every summer, the city hosts a big blocko where everyone from the block comes together to celebrate.
The neighborhood organized a blocko with live music and food stalls.
blocko.meta: Blocko — ko‘pincha ko‘cha yoki mahalla aholisi tomonidan uyushtiriladigan katta ochiq havodagi bayram; odatda bu tadbirda temir cholg‘ular guruhi, DJlar va boshqa ijrochilar chiqish qiladi.

ex: Every year, the neighborhood celebrates with a big blockorama featuring steel bands and DJs.
The community held a blockorama with music, dancing, and food for everyone.
blockorama.meta: Blockorama — ko‘pincha mahalla yoki ko‘cha aholisi tomonidan tashkil etilgan katta ochiq havodagi bayram; odatda unda temir cholg‘u guruhlari, DJlar va boshqa ijrochilar chiqish qiladi.

ex: She wore a dress decorated with traditional block print patterns.
The artist created a beautiful block print of a floral design.
block print.meta: Bo‘lak bosma — blok usulida bosilgan rasm yoki naqsh. Ko‘pincha bunday naqsh yoki uslubdagi buyumlarni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi. (Qo‘shimcha ma’no) Bosilgan naqsh yordamida bezatilgan buyum yoki mato.

ex: Under the block schedule, students attend only four classes each day instead of seven.
The school switched to a block schedule to allow longer class periods for in-depth learning.
block schedule.meta: Blok jadval — o‘rta ta’limda (ba’zan boshlang‘ich maktablarda ham) qo‘llaniladigan dars jadvali turi. Bu jadvalda har kuni o‘quvchi qatnashadigan darslar soni kamroq bo‘lib, har bir dars muddati an’anaviy darslarga qaraganda uzoqroq bo‘ladi.

ex: Many schools have adopted block scheduling to improve student focus and reduce transitions.
Block scheduling allows teachers to spend more time on each subject during class.
block scheduling.meta: Blok jadval tuzish — maktab darslarini rejalashtirish tizimi bo‘lib, unda darslar an’anaviy tizimga qaraganda kamroq sonli, lekin uzoqroq davom etadi. Bu tizim o‘quvchilarga darslarni chuqurroq o‘rganish imkonini beradi.

ex: Block trades are common among institutional investors looking to move large positions discreetly.
The firm executed a block trade to buy one million shares without affecting the market price.
block trade.meta: Blok savdo — katta miqdordagi qimmatli qog‘ozlarni ochiq bozor tashqarisida sotish yoki sotib olish amali. Bunday savdo qiymatga ta’sirni kamaytirish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Experienced block traders know how to minimize the market impact of large transactions.
The block trader facilitated the purchase of 500,000 shares between two institutional investors.
block trader.meta: Blok treyder — katta miqdordagi qimmatli qog‘ozlarni sotib olish va sotish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi savdogar; shuningdek, bunday savdolarni vositachilik qilib amalga oshiruvchi broker yoki brokerlik firma.

ex: Block trading often involves institutional investors dealing large quantities of securities.
The company engaged in block trading to reduce the impact on the stock price.
block trading.meta: Blok savdosi — katta miqdordagi qimmatli qog‘ozlarni sotib olish yoki sotish amali yoki amaliyoti; ko‘pincha bunday savdolar ochiq bozorga ta’sir qilmaslik uchun rasmiy bozor tashqarisida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Thousands of people joined the bloco dancing through the streets.
The bloco performed lively samba music during the carnival parade.
bloco.meta: Bloko — ayniqsa Braziliya karnavali vaqtida mahalliy mahalla ko‘chalarida sambа musiqachilari va raqqoslaridan iborat guruh, ko‘cha paradi va bayramlarda chiqish qiladigan jamoa.

ex: The bowstave must be flexible yet durable to make an effective longbow.
The craftsman selected a strong piece of wood to use as a bowstave.
bowstave.meta: Kamon tayoqchasi — kamon yasash uchun kesilgan va tayyorlangan yog‘och bo‘lagi. Keyinchalik uzoq kamon yoki shunga o‘xshash qurolning egiluvchan yog‘och qismi sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: His broad-brushed comments didn’t address the finer points of the issue.
The report gave a broad-brushed overview of the economic situation without focusing on specific sectors.
broad-brushed.meta: keng doiradagi, ko‘p narsalarni o‘z ichiga olgan. Tafsilotlarga kam e’tibor berilgan, umumiy, keng qamrovli — aniq yoki maxsus detallarga kam e’tibor berib, umumiy va keng yondashilgan; silliq, keng qamrovli tavsif yoki yondashuv.

ex: His broad-brushing in the discussion led to some misunderstandings.
The broad-brushing of the problem ignored many important details.
broad-brushing.meta: Keng qamrovda yondashish yoki umumlashtirish harakati yoki natijasi — tafsilotlarga kam e'tibor berib, narsalarni umumiy, umumlashtirilgan tarzda ko‘rib chiqish.

ex: Not all jokes are broadcastable due to their content.
The program was edited to make it broadcastable on national television.
broadcastable.meta: Radio yoki televideniyeda uzatish uchun mos yoki maqbul bo‘lgan (gapirish yoki ko‘rish uchun mo‘ljallangan mazmuni) — odob-axloq, tartib va boshqalar nuqtai nazaridan qabul qilinadigan.

ex: The broadclothed nobles walked proudly through the hall.
He appeared broadclothed at the ceremony, wearing a heavy woolen suit.
broadclothed.meta: Qalin, zich va odatda ipak yoki jun matodan tikilgan kiyim kiygan holat.

ex: Broadhead arrows cause more damage than regular ones.
The hunter used a broadhead arrow to ensure a quick kill.
broadhead.meta: O‘qning keng va odatda tikanli (tikanlarga ega) uchi; ayniqsa ovda ishlatiladigan o‘q uchi. Shuningdek, bu so‘z keng o‘q uchi shaklidagi narsalarni ta’riflashda sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: She is a talented broad jumper who has won many medals.
The broad jumper trained hard for the upcoming athletics competition.
broad jumper.meta: Sport bilan shug‘ullanuvchi va uzoq masofaga sakrash bilan mashhur bo‘lgan odam; keng sakrash musobaqasida ishtirok etuvchi sportchi. Shuningdek, long jumper so‘zi bilan sinonim.

ex: He won the gold medal in broad jumping at the athletics meet.
Broad jumping requires strength and agility.
broad jumping.meta: Sport faoliyati sifatida uzoq masofaga sakrash harakati; keng sakrash musobaqasini bajarish; long jumping (uzoq sakrash) so‘zi bilan sinonim. Ba’zida uzoq sakrashning boshqa shakllarini ham anglatishi mumkin.

ex: Broad lands in the field were divided by narrow water furrows.
The farmer plowed the broad land carefully to prepare for planting.
broad land.meta: Odatda bir maydon ichida suvga ajratilgan bir qator kataklardan biri bo‘lgan, keng va so‘galgan yer maydoni. Suv kanallari bilan ajratilgan yer bo‘lagi.

ex: Broadline wholesalers supply a wide variety of products to retailers.
The company is a broadline distributor, offering everything from electronics to household goods.
broadline.meta: Biznes sohasida — keng turdagi, xilma-xil mahsulotlarni ishlab chiqaruvchi, tarqatuvchi yoki sotuvchi; bunday savdo faoliyati bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Broadloids aim to attract a wide readership by balancing quality journalism and entertainment.
The newspaper is considered a broadloid because it mixes serious news with celebrity gossip.
broadloid.meta: Asosan Britaniya va Avstraliyada ishlatiladi. Broadsheet (yirik formatli jurnallik) va tabloid (kichik formatli gazetalar) uslublarini birlashtirgan gazeta. Odatda jiddiy va ko‘ngilochar (yengil) mazmundagi maqolalar aralashmasini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: Broadloomed carpets are popular for their durability and wide coverage.
The living room was covered with a broadloomed carpet.
broadloomed.meta: Asosan kengligi 12 fut (taxminan 3,65 metr) yoki undan ko‘p bo‘lgan, keng to‘qish dastgohida to‘qilgan gilamni bildiradi. Shuningdek, keng to‘qilgan gilamga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Hozirda kamroq ishlatiladi.

ex: She has broad-ranging interests that include art, science, and politics.
The report provides a broad-ranging analysis of the economic situation.
broad-ranging.meta: Turli mavzular, imkoniyatlar va sohalarni o‘z ichiga oluvchi, keng ko‘lamli, keng qamrovli.

ex: Sailing on a broad reach is more comfortable than sailing close-hauled.
The sailors adjusted the sails for a broad reach to maximize speed.
broad reach.meta: Dengizchilikda kemaga shamol qalam (beam) va orqa (stern) orasidan yon tomondan esib turadigan yo‘nalish.

ex: They broad reached to catch the favorable wind.
The yacht was broad reaching smoothly across the bay.
broad reach.meta: (Intransitive) Kema yoki qayiq shamol qalam (beam) va orqa (stern) orasidan yon tomondan esib turadigan yo‘nalishda suzish. Ba'zan esa (transitive) ma'noda ham ishlatiladi.

ex: They held a steady broad reaching course throughout the afternoon.
The sailor practiced broad reaching to improve his skills.
broad reaching.meta: Kemaning shamol qalam (beam) va orqa (stern) orasidan esadigan yon shamol tomonida suzish harakati. Shuningdek, shu tarzda suzilgan yo‘nalish yoki kurs ham shunday ataladi.

ex: Her research has broad-reaching implications for environmental science.
The new policy has broad-reaching effects on the economy.
broad-reaching.meta: Keng doirani, mavzular yoki imkoniyatlarni qamrab oluvchi; keng ta’sirga ega yoki uzoq muddatli oqibatlarga ega bo‘lgan; keng ko‘lamli, keng tarqalgan.

ex: Hey bruz, how are you doing?
What’s up, bruz?
bruz.meta: Erkakka murojaat qilishda tanish, samimiy shakl sifatida ishlatiladi; ko‘pincha do‘stona yoki aka-uka o‘rtasidagi suhbatlarda qo‘llanadi. “Brother” (aka, aka-uka) so‘zining qisqargan shakli sifatida tushunilishi mumkin.

ex: Improving the buildability of the project can save time and reduce costs.
The buildability of this house design makes it popular among contractors.
buildability.meta: Loyihani yoki dizaynni qurish imkoniyati yoki sifati; biror narsaning qurilishi mumkinligi, shuningdek, dizaynni oson va samarali qurish darajasi.

ex: Improving the buildability of the project can save time and reduce costs.
The buildability of this house design makes it popular among contractors.
buildability.meta: Loyihani yoki dizaynni qurish imkoniyati yoki sifati; biror narsaning qurilishi mumkinligi, shuningdek, dizaynni oson va samarali qurish darajasi.

ex: Building and loan associations played a big role in helping families purchase houses.
Many people joined a building and loan to save money and buy their first home.
building and loan.meta: Aʼzolari tomonidan kiritilgan investitsiyalarga foiz to‘laydigan va aʼzolariga kapital qarz sifatida beradigan moliyaviy tashkilot, ayniqsa o‘zaro jamiyat shaklida bo‘lgan muassasa.

ex: Build-it-yourself projects are popular among hobbyists who enjoy hands-on work.
He bought a build-it-yourself furniture kit and assembled it over the weekend.
build-it-yourself.meta: Biror narsani tayyor versiyasini sotib olish o‘rniga, ayniqsa havaskor sifatida, o‘z qo‘ling bilan qurish yoki yig‘ish faoliyatiga oid.

ex: The buildout of new housing developments is scheduled to finish by next year.
The company announced a buildout of its data center to increase capacity.
buildout.meta: Asosan jismoniy infratuzilma, uy-joy va boshqalar uchun rejalashtirilgan qurilish yoki kengaytirish; shuningdek, ushbu jarayonning yakunlanishiga qaratilgan taraqqiyot. Keyingi ma'nolarda ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The built-out balcony provides extra space for seating.
The factory has a built-out section to accommodate new machinery.
built-out.meta: Tashqi tomonga qurilgan, kengaytirilgan yoki kattalashtirilgan; tashqariga tomon cho‘zilgan yoki chiqib turgan. Qo‘shimcha ma’noda: to‘liq yoki to‘la quvvat bilan ishlatiladigan yoki rivojlantirilgan.

ex: The buy-bust tactic is commonly used to catch drug dealers.
The police conducted a buy-bust operation last night.
buy-bust.meta: Yashirin politsiya xodimi tomonidan giyohvand moddalarni sotib olib, sotuvchini ushlashga qaratilgan huquqni muhofaza qilish taktikasiga oid.

ex: A buycott encourages people to purchase products from a specific company as a form of protest or solidarity.
The community organized a buycott to support local farmers.
buycott.meta: Buykot — bu norozilik ifodasi sifatida, odatda biror kompaniya, biznes yoki mahsulotdan foydalanishni rag‘batlantirish shakli. Ko‘pincha bu boykotga qarshi yoki unga javoban amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Some developers use buy-downs to attract more potential homeowners.
The home builder offered a buy-down to make the mortgage more affordable for the buyer.
buy-down.meta: Buy-down — bu kredit yoki qarz bo‘yicha to‘lanadigan foiz stavkasini kamaytirish uchun to‘lov qilish harakati.

ex: The buyership of the new product was mostly young adults.
His buyership experience helped the company secure better deals.
buyership.meta: Buyership — bu xaridorning mavqei, roli yoki vazifasi; xarid qilishdagi tajriba yoki malaka. Bundan tashqari, bu bir guruh xaridorlarni yoki ma’lum bir mahsulotning xaridorlarini ham anglatishi mumkin.

ex: Coinfection can complicate treatment and recovery.
The patient was diagnosed with a coinfection of influenza and bacterial pneumonia.
coinfection.meta: inson, hayvon yoki o‘simlik organizmida bir vaqtning o‘zida ikki yoki undan ortiq turdagi yoki shtammdagi mikroorganizmlar, parazitlar yoki viruslarning mavjud bo‘lishi holati. Shuningdek, bu bunday holatning o‘zi yoki misoli ham bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Unlike bullfighting, the course Camarguaise does not harm the bull.
The course Camarguaise is a traditional sport of the Camargue region in southern France.
course camarguaise.meta: Kurs Kamarguez — Fransiyaning janubida o‘tkaziladigan musobaqali o‘yin yoki sport turi bo‘lib, unda ishtirokchilar buqaga bog‘lab qo‘yilgan rozetkalar, tangalar yoki boshqa bezaklarni olib tashlash uchun raqobatlashadilar.

ex: Crash diets can lead to health problems if not done carefully.
She went on a crash diet before her wedding.
crash diet.meta: Keskin parhez — qisqa vaqt ichida juda tez vazn yo‘qotish maqsadida, kaloriya iste’molini keskin cheklash orqali amalga oshiriladigan parhez. Bu parhez odatda sog‘liq uchun xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin va uzoq muddatli yechim sifatida tavsiya qilinmaydi.

ex: He decided to crash diet to fit into his old suit.
She crash dieted for two weeks before the competition.
crash diet.meta: Keskin parhez tutmoq — o'zini qisqa vaqt ichida juda tez vazn yo‘qotishga yo‘naltirilgan, kaloriya iste’molini keskin cheklovchi parhezga o‘tkazmoq.

ex: Crypto has become a major topic in global finance.
He invested all his savings in crypto.
crypto.meta: Kripto — kriptovalyuta, ya'ni raqamli yoki virtual valyuta bo‘lib, uni himoya qilish va tasdiqlash uchun kriptografiya (maxfiy yozuv) ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, umumiy holda barcha kriptovalyutalar tushuniladi.

ex: I walked up to him and dapped him quickly.
They dapped each other before starting the game.
dap.meta: Dap bermoq — kimnidir tasodifiy, do‘stona va norasmiy tarzda salomlashish yoki tan olish harakati, odatda kaftlarni urish, mushtlarni to‘qnashirish yoki barmoqlarni qarsak tarzida urish orqali bajariladi.

ex: They started the game with some dapping and laughter.
Dapping is a common way of greeting among close friends.
dapping.meta: Dap berish — kimnidir tasodifiy, norasmiy va do‘stona tarzda salomlashish yoki tan olish amali. Odatda bu kaftlarni urish, mushtlarni to‘qnashirish yoki barmoqlarni qarsak tarzida urish orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Dry-walled partitions can be easily installed and removed.
The house was fully dry-walled and painted within a month.
dry-walled.meta: Dry-walled — Asosan Shimoliy Amerikada ishlatiladigan tushuncha. Gips, ba'zan mustahkamlovchi yoki kuchaytiruvchi material bilan qoplangan engil qurilish taxtalaridan foydalangan holda qurilgan.

ex: Many edgelands have become spaces for informal activities like skateboarding and graffiti.
The edgelands around the city are often overlooked but full of interesting wildlife.
edgeland.meta: Edgeland — Asosan Britaniyada ishlatiladigan atama. Shahar hududi bilan qishloq yoki tabiat zonasi orasidagi chegara yerlari

ex: Enslaving entire nations was a tactic used by many ancient empires.
The enslaving of people was a tragic part of human history.
enslaving.meta: Enslaving — Biror kishini, guruhni yoki millatni qullikka aylantirish harakati yoki jarayoni; ularning erkinligini tortib olish va majburiy xizmatga yoki to‘liq itoatkorlikka majburlash holati.

ex: escape rooms are great for team-building exercises.
we booked an escape room for sarah's birthday.
escape room.meta: escape room — bu dam olish va ko‘ngilochar faoliyat turi bo‘lib, unda bir guruh odamlar ma’lum vaqt ichida turli jumboq va muammolarni hal qilib, yopiq xonadan chiqish yo‘lini topishlari kerak bo‘ladi. Ba’zan virtual tarzda ham tashkil etiladi.

ex: His argument was all fluffernutter—sweet but without substance.
I had a fluffernutter for lunch today.
fluffernutter.meta: Fluffernatter — yer yong‘oqli pastasi va zefir (marshmallow) kremini solib tayyorlanadigan sendvich. Odatda “fluffernatter sendvichi” deb to‘liq ataladi.

ex: Some people use the term "gay boy" in a friendly way, while others may find it offensive.
He proudly identifies as a gay boy.
gay boy.meta: Gey yigit — gomoseksual erkak, ayniqsa yosh erkak. Ba’zan bu atama kamsituvchi yoki noqulay tarzda ishlatilishi mumkin, lekin hozirda ba'zi holatlarda neytral yoki o‘ziga xos tanlov sifatida ham qabul qilinadi.

ex: Ghettoism can lead to social and economic isolation.
The city's housing policies unintentionally promoted ghettoism.
ghettoism.meta: Gettoizm — ma’lum bir ijtimoiy, etnik yoki diniy guruhning jamiyatdan ajralgan, cheklangan hudud yoki sharoitlarda yashash holati yoki shunday sharoitlarni yaratish jarayoni. Bu odatda segregatsiya, ya’ni ajratish va cheklash bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

ex: He was granted a ghetto pass because of his deep respect for the culture.
Some celebrities try to earn a ghetto pass by associating with the hip-hop community.
ghetto pass.meta: Getto ruxsati — biror kishiga ichki shahar (ko‘pincha afro-amerikalik yoki xip-xop) madaniyatida ishonchli, haqiqiy yoki mos deb qabul qilinishini ta’minlaydigan maqom yoki imtiyoz.

ex: His plan was a half-boiled idea with no real structure.
The eggs were half-boiled and not ready to eat.
half-boiled.meta: Yarmi qaynatilgan — ozgina qaynatilgan; yarim pishgan holatda qolgan, to‘liq tayyor bo‘lmagan. Shuningdek, etarlicha qaynatilmagan, pishmagan yoki yetarli darajada qizdirilmagan narsaga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Don’t listen to his half-brained suggestions.
It was a half-brained idea to jump into the river in winter.
half-brained.meta: Yarmi miyasiz — aql, tafakkur yoki mantiq yetishmasligi; ahmoqona, tentakona yoki bema’ni fikr yoki xatti-harakat. Ko‘pincha haqorat yoki tanqid ohangida ishlatiladi.

ex: In the past, many young fishermen worked as halfdealsmen to gain experience.
The halfdealsman accepted half of one share of the profit from the fishing trip.
halfdealsman.meta: Yarim ulushli baliqchi — baliqchi qayig‘i jamoasining a’zosi bo‘lib, o‘lja tushumidan to‘liq ulush emas, balki yarim ulush oladigan kishi.

ex: I couldn’t find a half-decent jacket in the store.
The restaurant isn’t fancy, but they serve half-decent food.
half-decent.meta: Yarim yaxshi — to‘liq mukammal yoki a’lo bo‘lmagan, lekin qoniqarli yoki yetarlicha yaxshi holatda bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi. Odatda, “boshqacha qilib aytganda: yomon emas, lekin a’lo ham emas” ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: In a half-duplex system, data can only flow in one direction at a time.
Walkie-talkies usually work in half-duplex mode.
half-duplex.meta: Yarim-dupleks — Telekommunikatsiya va hisoblash texnologiyalarida: faqat bir vaqtning o‘zida bir yo‘nalishda signal uzatishga imkon beradigan qurilma yoki tizim

ex: The statue depicted a half-eyed warrior
The half-eyed sailor navigated the ship confidently.
half-eyed.meta: Yarim ko‘r — To‘liq ko‘ra olmaydigan; qisman ko‘r bo‘lgan holat. Ba’zan aynan bitta ko‘zidan ko‘ra olmaydigan yoki faqat bitta ko‘zi mavjud bo‘lgan odam yoki hayvonga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: A half-formed sculpture stood in the middle of the studio.
The half-formed idea needed more work to become a complete plan.
half-formed.meta: Yarim shakllangan — To‘liq shakllanmagan yoki rivojlanmagan; chala, nomukammal; aniq bo‘lmagan, noaniq.

ex: The falling chair did a half gainer before hitting the ground.
She performed a perfect half gainer from the diving board.
half gainer.meta: Yarim orqaga sakrash — (1) Sportda: suvga sakrash turi bo‘lib, sakrovchi havoda yarim marta orqaga aylanish orqali tushadi. (2) Ko‘chma va kengaytirilgan ma’noda: biror narsa yoki odamning havoda ag‘darilishi yoki ag‘darilib tushishi holati.

ex: Half-hips are commonly used in European countryside architecture.
The house was built with a half-hip roof to give it a more traditional look.
half-hip.meta: Yarim qiyshiq tom — tom konstruksiyasining bir turi bo‘lib, yuqori qismi qiyshiq (g‘ishtli) shaklda, pastki qismi esa to‘g‘ri (tikka) devor yoki uchburchakli shaklda bo‘ladi. Bunday tom shakli odatda yarim qiyshiq tom deb ataladi.

ex: The half hunter allows you to check the time without fully opening the cover.
My grandfather used to carry a half hunter pocket watch with him every day.
half hunter.meta: Yarim qopqoqli soat — cho‘ntak soatining bir turi bo‘lib, uning qopqog‘ida kichik deraza yoki teshik mavjud bo‘ladi. Bu teshik orqali soat qopqog‘ini ochmasdan ham vaqtni ko‘rish mumkin. Bu soat turi odatda "hunter" soatlarining o‘zgartirilgan shaklidir.

ex: Half-jacks were preferred by some cavalry units for ease of movement.
The soldier wore a pair of sturdy half-jacks during the march.
half-jack.meta: Yarim etik — tizzadan pastgacha yetadigan qisqa etik turi. Bu etik "jackboot" (baland etik) ning qisqaroq shakli bo‘lib, harbiylar va boshqa himoya vositalari uchun ishlatilgan.

ex: Half jackboots were easier to walk in compared to full-length jackboots.
The officer wore a pair of half jackboots on patrol.
half jackboot.meta: Yarim jackboot — bu tizzadan pastgacha yetadigan qisqa etik turi. Bu "jackboot" (baland harbiy etik) ning qisqartirilgan shakli bo‘lib, harbiy va amaliy foydalanishda qulaylik yaratish uchun ishlab chiqilgan.

ex: In some regions, half-ploughing is preferred to retain soil moisture.
The farmer decided to half-plough the field before planting seeds.
half-plough.meta: Yarim haydash — yerga ishlov berishda yerning faqat yuzaki yoki to‘liq bo‘lmagan qismini haydash, ya’ni chuqur haydalmasdan yoki to‘liq ag‘darilmasdan yerni yumshatish va ag‘darish jarayoni.

ex: The farmer chose the half ploughing method to prepare the field for planting.
Half ploughing is used to create ridges that help retain water in the soil.
half ploughing.meta: Yarim haydash usuli — haydash usullaridan biri bo‘lib, unda haydalgan yer yo‘laklar (o‘ralar) orasida haydalmasdan qoldirilgan qismlarga ag‘dariladi va natijada yerda ketma-ket tepaliklar hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: He signed a half-season contract with the football club.
The team made significant progress during the half-season break.
half-season.meta: Yarim mavsum — odatda sport mavsumi yoki yilning boshqa davrlarida bir faslning yoki mavsumning yarmiga tegishli bo‘lgan vaqt davri. Ba’zan boshqa kontekstlarda biron-bir jarayon yoki davrning yarmiga nisbatan ham ishlatiladi.

ex: She half-saw a shadow moving in the dark room.
I could only half-see the figure through the fog.
half-see.meta: Yarim ko‘rmoq — kimnidir yoki nimanidir qisqa, to‘liq bo‘lmagan yoki aniq bo‘lmagan tarzda ko‘rish; xira yoki tezda ko‘rinib qolgan tasvirni sezish.

ex: His half-seen memories troubled him throughout his life.
Through the mist, only half-seen shapes moved in the distance.
half-seen.meta: Yarim ko‘rilgan — faqat qisqa muddatga, to‘liq bo‘lmagan yoki noaniq tarzda ko‘ringan; xira yoki tezda paydo bo‘ladigan tasvir. Ko‘pincha ko‘chma ma’noda: faqat qisman tushunilgan yoki idrok qilingan.

ex: We went halfsies on the rent this month.
Let’s split the pizza halfsies.
halfsies.meta: Halfsies — ikki teng ulush yoki qismlarga bo‘lish; ayniqsa, biror narsani yarmi-yarmi qilib olish yoki da’vo qilish holatlarida ishlatiladi. Shuningdek, "bo‘lishamiz" yoki "yarimiga kiraman" ma’nosida norasmiy ravishda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: This shirt is half-size; it won’t fit you.
I bought a half-size model of the car.
half-size.meta: Half-size — odatdagi yoki to‘liq o‘lchamning yarmi yoki unga yaqin bo‘lgan o‘lchamni anglatadi. Bu so‘z buyumlar, kiyimlar yoki boshqa narsalarning yarim o‘lchamdagi ko‘rinishini yoki versiyasini ifodalaydi.

ex: The company produces half-sized copies of original documents.
They used a half-sized table in the small room.
half-sized.meta: Half-sized — odatdagi yoki to‘liq o‘lchamning yarmi yoki unga yaqin o‘lchamga ega bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi. Bu atama buyumlarning kichikroq, qisqartirilgan shaklini bildiradi.

ex: She responded with a half-smile, not really amused.
He gave a half-smile, hiding his disappointment.
half-smile.meta: Half-smile — juda yengil yoki nozik tabassum; ko‘pincha chin yurakdan kelmagan yoki haqiqiy his-tuyg‘ularni yashirish uchun qilingan tabassumni ifodalaydi.

ex: She hesitated, taking a half-step back.
The soldier was ordered to march in half-steps.
half-step.meta: Half-step — odatdagi qadam uzunligining yarmi bo‘lgan qadam; qisqa yoki kichik qadam. Musiqada: yarim ton oralig‘idagi tovush balandligi farqi.

ex: To‘liq bajarish o‘rniga faqat qisman yoki yetarlicha kuch sarflamasdan ish tutmoq.
Biror vaziyat yoki faoliyatga jiddiy yondashmaslik, sust harakat qilmoq.
half-step.meta: Half-step — biror faoliyat yoki vaziyatga to‘liq sadoqat yoki butun e’tibor bilan yondashmaslik; loqayd yoki yarim tayyor harakat qilmoq; reja yoki ishni to‘liq bajarish o‘rniga faqat qisman choralar ko‘rmoq.

ex: You can't succeed in life by half-stepping.
He was just half-stepping at work, so his boss was disappointed in him.
half-stepping.meta: Biror faoliyat yoki vaziyatga yarim jon bilan, to‘liq sadoqatsiz yoki yetarlicha harakat qilmasdan yondashish holati.

ex: Half-timbering is often seen in traditional European architecture.
The old cottage had beautiful half-timbering on its walls.
half-timbering.meta: Uy, devor yoki qavatning karkasini tashkil qiluvchi qalin yog‘och ustunlar tizimi bo‘lib, odatda bu yog‘ochlar ko‘rinib turadigan tarzda qoldiriladi. Yog‘ochlar orasidagi bo‘shliqlar boshqa materiallar (g‘isht, loy, suvoq va h.k.) bilan to‘ldiriladi.

ex: They ordered a half ton of cement for the construction.
The truck can carry a half ton of goods.
half ton.meta: Bir tonnaning yarmi bo‘lgan og‘irlik, ya’ni 500 kilogramm atrofidagi miqdor.

ex: Many people visit salt caves to experience the benefits of halotherapy.
Halotherapy is often used to treat respiratory problems like asthma and bronchitis.
halotherapy.meta: Inson organizmini tabiiy yoki sun’iy ravishda yaratilgan juda mayda tuz zarralari aerozollariga ta’sir qilish orqali davolash usuli.

ex: The airport was in a hassled state due to delayed flights.
It was such a hassled morning that I forgot my keys at home.
hassled.meta: Tinchligi buzilgan, doimiy ravishda bezovta qilingan yoki bosim ostida bo‘lgani sababli o‘zini siqilgan yoki charchagan holda his qiladigan

ex: He spent his savings on a hayburner that never won a race.
That old hayburner eats all day but won’t work.
hayburner.meta: Pichan iste’mol qiladigan hayvon, ayniqsa ot; ko‘pincha hazil yoki pichan ko‘p iste’mol qiladigan, lekin foydasi kam bo‘lgan hayvon haqida aytiladi.

ex: The homicider showed no remorse during the trial.
The police quickly arrested the suspected homicider.
homicider.meta: Boshqa bir kishini ataylab yoki bilib turib o‘ldirgan shaxs; qotillik sodir etgan inson.

ex: The clinic specializes in cosmetic procedures, including hymenoplasty.
Hymenoplasty is often requested for cultural or personal reasons.
hymenoplasty.meta: Gimen (qizlik pardasi) ni o‘zgartirish, tiklash yoki qayta shakllantirish maqsadida bajariladigan jarrohlik amaliyoti. Zamonaviy qo‘llanishda asosan qizlik pardasini “buzilmagan” holatga keltirish uchun amalga oshiriladi

ex: They tried to create a kumbaya atmosphere, but the underlying issues remained unresolved.
The meeting ended on a kumbaya note, but no real decisions were made.
kumbaya.meta: Tashqi ko‘rinishda hamjihatlik, uyg‘unlik va do‘stona muhit; lekin ko‘pincha bu holat soddadil, yuzaki yoki chuqur mazmunga ega bo‘lmagan deb baholanadi.

ex: Seeing the L plate, the other drivers gave him more space on the road.
In many countries, learner drivers must display an L plate on their cars.
l plate.meta: Haydovchilikni o‘rganayotgan shaxs boshqarayotgan transport vositasiga old va orqa tomoniga taqiladigan “L” harfi tushirilgan belgi.

ex: She became one of the few lumberjills in her region, working alongside male loggers.
During World War II, many women worked as lumberjills to support the war effort.
lumberjill.meta: Daraxtlarni yiqitadigan, ularni butalab log (tayyor yog‘och) shakliga keltiradigan yoki yog‘och kesish zavodiga tashuvchi ayol. Bu so‘z lumberjack (erkak daraxt kesuvchi) so‘zining ayol shaklidir.

ex: They import merch from several countries.
The store has a wide variety of merch on sale.
merch.meta: Umumiy savdoda sotiladigan yoki xarid qilinadigan har qanday mahsulot.

ex: The model minority label can create unfair expectations and ignore real struggles.
Asian Americans are often stereotyped as a model minority in the United States.
model minority.meta: Biror jamiyatda hukmron madaniyat yoki guruh tomonidan juda muvaffaqiyatli, mehnatkash, ta’limli deb qabul qilinadigan ozchilik etnik yoki irqiy guruh. Bunday qarash ko‘pincha stereotip bo‘lib, haqiqatda barcha a’zolarni to‘g‘ri aks ettirmaydi.

ex: In ancient history, many rulers were mononymous, like Cleopatra.
Madonna is a mononymous singer known worldwide.
mononymous.meta: Faqat bir so‘zdan iborat ism bilan tanilgan shaxs yoki narsa; familiyasiz yoki qo‘shimcha nomsiz mashhur bo‘lgan.

ex: The morninger reported the election results in its front-page article.
He always reads the morninger with his coffee before going to work.
morninger.meta: Ertalab sotish yoki tarqatish uchun nashr qilinadigan gazeta; odatda tongda yoki ish boshlanishidan oldin o‘qish uchun mo‘ljallangan gazeta.

ex: The potatoes were mushed perfectly for the soup.
The bananas were completely mushed after being in his bag all day.
mushed.meta: Biror narsa pishib, ezilib yoki bosim ostida maydalanib, xamir yoki yumshoq, quyuq holga kelgan.

ex: Her attachment to the TV character became intensely parasocial.
Many fans develop parasocial relationships with celebrities they follow online.
parasocial.meta: Mashhur shaxs, taniqli odam yoki ommaviy axborot vositalaridagi obraz bilan faqat bir tomonlama aloqaga asoslangan, javobsiz, biryoqlama yaqinlik hissi bilan tavsiflanadigan munosabat.

ex: A pinkie promise is something you can’t break.
They made a pinkie promise never to reveal each other's secrets.
pinkie promise.meta: Ikki kishi kichik barmoqlarini bir-biriga ilishtirish orqali beriladigan va juda jiddiy yoki chin dildan qilingan deb hisoblanadigan va’da yoki qasamyod. Kengroq ma’noda esa, bu har qanday qattiq, sodiq va’da ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: You can’t break a pinkie swear—it’s the strongest promise.
They made a pinkie swear to always remain best friends.
pinkie swear.meta: Ikki kishi kichik barmoqlarini bir-biriga ilishtirish orqali beriladigan va juda jiddiy, chin dildan qilingan yoki buzib bo‘lmaydigan deb hisoblanadigan va’da yoki qasamyod. Kengroq ma’noda esa, har qanday sodiq va’da yoki jiddiy kelishuvni ifodalaydi.

ex: Her apartment is decorated in a seasidey style with shells and blue tones.
The small town had a seasidey feel with its fresh breeze and seafood restaurants.
seasidey.meta: Dastlabki ma’no: Dengiz bo‘yidagi ta’tillar uchun qulay, shinam joy. Hozirgi keng ma’no: Dengiz bo‘yi yoki dengizbo‘yi ta’tillarini eslatuvchi, ularning xos muhitini aks ettiruvchi, dengizga oid yoki shunga o‘xshash kayfiyat yaratadigan.

ex: Fans were outraged by the shithousery in yesterday’s match.
The player’s constant time-wasting was pure shithousery.
shithousery.meta: Raqibni chalg‘itish yoki o‘yinni buzish orqali g‘alabaga erishishga qaratilgan yashirin yoki ochiqcha qoidabuzarlik, vaqt o‘tkazish, provokatsiya va boshqa o‘yin buzuvchi taktikalardan foydalanish.

ex: The cake had a thick slathering of chocolate icing.
He enjoyed a generous slathering of butter on his toast.
slathering.meta: Biror narsani (masalan, yog‘, murabbo, qaymoq va boshqalarni) yuzaga juda ko‘p miqdorda va keng maydonga surish yoki surtish harakati yoki holati.

ex: Authorities are trying to shut down slave factories that exploit vulnerable workers.
Many cheap clothes are produced in slave factories overseas.
slave factory.meta: Ishchilarning mehnat huquqlari buziladigan, og‘ir mehnat sharoitida va ko‘pincha ekspluatatsiya ostida ishlashga majbur bo‘ladigan ishlab chiqarish joyi. Bu odatda inson huquqlariga zid holat deb hisoblanadi.

ex: He spent his life fighting against slavehood and oppression.
Many people throughout history were born into slavehood and never knew freedom.
slavehood.meta: Qul bo‘lish holati yoki sharoiti; kishining ozodlikdan mahrum bo‘lib, boshqa birovga to‘liq bo‘ysunish majburiyatida yashash holati; qullikka tushish yoki qul bo‘lish.

ex: Some Russian Slavicism can be found in neighboring languages due to historical contact.
The sentence structure is a clear Slavicism introduced into the local dialect.
slavicism.meta: Slavyan tillarida mavjud bo‘lgan va aynan ularga xos bo‘lgan til shakli, jumla tuzilishi yoki lug‘aviy birlik. Ko‘pincha boshqa tilga kirib kelgan va slavyan til ta’sirida paydo bo‘lgan element sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The slaving population was forced to build the fortress.
The slaving workers had no freedom or rights.
slaving.meta: Qul bo‘lib ishlayotgan, ozodlikdan mahrum va majburiy mehnat qilayotgan holatda bo‘lgan shaxs yoki narsa.

ex: Slavonicization often involved changing place names and promoting Slavic traditions.
The Slavonicization of the region was achieved through language and cultural policies.
slavonicization.meta: Biror narsani (madaniyat, til, hudud, urf-odat va boshqalar) shakl yoki xarakter jihatidan slavyan (slav) xususiyatlariga moslashtirish yoki uni slavyan madaniyatiga singdirish jarayoni.

ex: Slavophilia became a powerful movement opposing Western influence.
His writings express strong Slavophilia and admiration for Russian culture.
slavophilia.meta: Slavyan mamlakatlari, xalqlari yoki ularning madaniyatiga muhabbat yoki faxr hissi; slavyan an’analari va qadriyatlarini qo‘llab-quvvatlash, ayniqsa G‘arb tamadduniga qarama-qarshi ravishda.

ex: His Slavophilic views led him to reject Western philosophies.
The author’s work has a clear Slavophilic tone, celebrating Russian heritage.
slavophilic.meta: Slavyan mamlakatlari, xalqlari yoki madaniyatiga muhabbat yoki faxr bilan tavsiflanadigan; slavyan an’analari va qadriyatlarini afzal ko‘radigan, ayniqsa G‘arb qadriyatlariga qarshi turgan holda.

ex: The politician was criticized for using Slavophobic rhetoric in his speech.
The rise of Slavophobia in some regions has led to discrimination against Slavic people.
slavophobia.meta: Slavyan mamlakatlari, xalqlari yoki madaniyatiga kuchli nafrat, yomon ko‘rish yoki dushmanlik hissi; slavyanlarga nisbatan kuchli salbiy munosabat.

ex: The conference welcomed Slavophones from across Eastern Europe.
The region is home to many Slavophones who speak different Slavic languages.
slavophone.meta: Slavyan tilida so‘zlashadigan kishi; xususan, ba’zan Makedoniyalik slavyan tilida so‘zlashuvchilarni ham bildiradi.

ex: He served in a Luftwaffe staffel during World War II.
The fighter planes were organized into a staffel for the mission.
staffel.meta: Germaniyada va nemis tilida so‘zlashuvchi mamlakatlarda: harbiy havo kuchlarida kichik taktik yoki operatsion birlik. Bu atama asosan tarixiy kontekstlarda, xususan Ikkinchi Jahon urushi davrida ishlatilgan.

ex: She bought some fresh stras from the market.
For breakfast, we had eggs and stras.
stras.meta: Stras — Strasburg kolbasasi so‘zining qisqartirilgan shakli; Fransiyaning Strasburg shahriga xos bo‘lgan va o‘ziga xos uslubda tayyorlanadigan kolbasa turi.

ex: Superyachts often include swimming pools, helipads, and luxurious suites.
The billionaire spent his summer vacation on his 100-meter superyacht.
superyacht.meta: O‘ta katta yoki kuchli yaxta; ayniqsa, hozirgi zamonda hashamatli, juda qimmat va ko‘pincha sayohatlar (kruizlar) uchun ishlatiladigan yirik yaxta.

ex: Stop acting like a tallywacker and focus!
He accidentally got hit in the tallywacker during the game.
tallywacker.meta: (Suhbat tili, odatda kulgili yoki qo‘pol tarzda) Erkak jinsiy a’zosi. (Ko‘pincha qadimgi yoki kam ishlatiladigan ma’no) Ahmoq, bezovta qiluvchi yoki yoqimsiz odam (ayniqsa erkak).

ex: The little boy asked an innocent question about his tallywag.
He accidentally got hit in the tallywags during the soccer match.
tallywag.meta: (Ko‘plikda) Moyaklar – erkak jinsiy a’zolarining tashqi jufti. (Yakkalikda, norasmiy) Erkak jinsiy a’zosi (penis). Bu so‘z odatda suhbat tili, kulgili yoki qo‘pol kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: She became a professional thereminist after years of practice.
The thereminist amazed the audience with the strange, ghostly sounds of the instrument.
thereminist.meta: Teremin cholg‘u asbobida chaladigan yoki ijro etadigan shaxs. Teremin — bu teginishsiz, faqat havo orqali qo‘llarning harakati bilan boshqariladigan elektron musiqiy asbob.

ex: Most smartphones are trackable if they are lost or stolen.
The package is fully trackable through the courier’s website.
trackable.meta: Izini kuzatish, aniqlash yoki ortidan borish mumkin bo‘lgan; keyingi ishlatilishda ayniqsa elektron yoki onlayn kuzatuv tizimi orqali nazorat qilinishi yoki topilishi mumkin bo‘lgan narsa.

ex: A twin-cab pickup is more comfortable for passengers.
They bought a twin-cab truck for family trips and carrying equipment.
twin-cab.meta: Yuk mashinasi, furgon yoki boshqa xizmat ko‘rsatish transport vositasi haqida: old (haydovchi va yo‘lovchi) va orqa o‘rindiqlarga ega bo‘lgan kabinaga, shuningdek, orqa qismida yuk tashish joyiga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: The protesters demanded respect for unceded territories.
This area is recognized as unceded indigenous land.
unceded.meta: Yer, hudud va hokazo haqida: mahalliy xalqlarga tegishli bo‘lib, hech qachon mustamlakachilar, hukumat yoki boshqa millatlarga topshirilmagan, berilmagan yoki rasmiy ravishda voz kechilmagan.

ex: She tends to undersing in live performances compared to studio recordings.
The singer undersang the chorus, and it lost its emotional impact.
undersing.meta: Biror qo‘shiq yoki vokal qismini sust, past ovozda yoki yetarlicha ta’sirchanliksiz ijro etmoq; kuchsiz yoki hissiz kuylamoq.Oddiy yoki kam urg‘u bilan kuylamoq; ataylab soddaroq, kamroq jo‘shqinlik bilan aytmoq.

ex: The film highlights the undersung contributions of women in history.
She is one of the most undersung heroes of the scientific community.
undersung.meta: Yetarli darajada tan olinmagan, maqtovga loyiq bo‘lsa ham etarlicha e’tirof qilinmagan yoki qadri bilinmagan; kam ma’lum yoki kam baholangan.

ex: At the Volksfest, visitors enjoyed traditional music, local food, and amusement rides.
The Oktoberfest in Munich is the world’s largest Volksfest.
volksfest.meta: An’anaviy ommaviy xalq bayrami, odatda pivo yoki sharob taqdim etiladigan, keyinchalik esa ovqat rastalari, attraksionlar va boshqa ko‘ngilochar tadbirlar bilan kengaygan festival turi. Bu so‘z asosan Germaniyada va nemis madaniyatida keng tarqalgan.

ex: "Volksgemeinschaft" rejected class divisions and promoted the idea that all Germans should be loyal to each other.
German fascists sought to unite the nation as a single community through the concept of "Volksgemeinschaft."
volksgemeinschaft.meta: Volksgemeinschaft — bu Germaniya tarixida, ayniqsa, fashistlar davrida ishlatilgan tushuncha bo‘lib, bir xalqning sinfiy, ijtimoiy va boshqa tafovutlardan ustun bo‘lgan yagona, birlashgan milliy jamoa sifatida tushunilgan.

ex: Every year, an international volksmarch event is held in our city, and hundreds of people participate.
Volksmarch is a great way to promote health and physical activity.
volksmarch.meta: bu sog‘liqni mustahkamlash yoki dam olish uchun o‘tkaziladigan yurish bo‘lib, odatda oldindan belgilanadigan masofada tashkil etiladi. Bu turdagi yurishlar ko‘pincha ommaviy tadbir sifatida o‘tkaziladi va unda qatnashish ko‘pchilik uchun ochiq bo‘ladi.

ex: Swimming and skiing are among the popular types of Volkssport events.
The Volkssport association organizes outdoor walking events every week.
volkssport.meta: Volkssport – asosan Shimoliy Amerikada tarqalgan sog‘lomlashtiruvchi va ko‘ngilochar ochiq havoda bajariladigan sport turlari majmui. Bu sport turlari odatda professional musobaqa shaklida bo‘lmaydi, balki sog‘liq va dam olish uchun tashkil etiladi.

ex: Nowadays, the air fryer is very popular among healthy eating enthusiasts.
When I fried potatoes using an air fryer, I hardly used any oil.
air fryer.meta: bu kichik konveksiya pech bo‘lib, ovqatlarni juda oz yog‘ bilan yoki butunlay yog‘siz qovurishga mo‘ljallangan. Bu qurilma ovqatni sog‘lomroq tarzda pishirish uchun keng qo‘llaniladi, chunki u an’anaviy qovurish usuliga nisbatan kamroq yog‘ sarflaydi.

ex: He loves all things related to space.
She is an expert in all things digital.
all things.meta: All things —— – bu ifoda ma’lum bir mavzu, faoliyat yoki shaxs bilan bog‘liq barcha narsalarni, tafsilotlarni yoki jihatlarni umumiy holda anglatadi.

ex: The barberry carpet is a widely distributed geometrid moth species in Europe and Asia.
The larvae of the barberry carpet moth can damage the barberry plant.
barberry carpet.meta: Barberry carpet – bu Yevropa, Shimoliy va G‘arbiy Osiyoda uchraydigan, och jigarrang rangga ega geometrid kapalak turi. Uning ilmiy nomi Pareulype berberata. Bu kapalak lichinkalari asosan zirk (barberry) o‘simligining barglari bilan oziqlanadi.

ex: They tried to put the blocks on the new regulation.
The manager put the blocks on the project because the budget was insufficient.
to put the blocks on.meta: bu ibora og‘zaki nutqda ishlatiladi va biror harakat, reja yoki jarayonni to‘xtatish, bekor qilish yoki unga qasddan to‘sqinlik qilish ma’nosini anglatadi. Bu odatda kutilmagan yoki norozilik sifatida amalga oshiriladigan harakatni bildiradi.

ex: It is inappropriate to say such things in public, as it implies "to put the blocks to."
He bragged that he put the blocks to that girl last night.
to put the blocks to.meta: bu amerikancha jargon ifoda bo‘lib, odatda erkak kishi haqida qo‘llaniladi va jinsiy aloqada bo‘lish ma’nosini anglatadi. Bu ifoda noo‘rin yoki qo‘pol bo‘lishi mumkin va ko‘proq norasmiy yoki erkaklar o‘rtasidagi suhbtlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: That guy’s always trying to put the blocks to every girl he meets.
He bragged that he put the blocks to her last night.
to put the blocks to.meta: Bu ibora Amerika slangida ishlatiladi va erkakning kim bilandir jinsiy aloqa qilganini bildiradi. Rasmiy va odobli til emas, ko‘proq og‘zaki, qo‘pol ifoda sanaladi.

ex: You can’t surprise him easily; he’s been around the block.
Don’t try to fool her; she’s been around the block a few times.
to have been around the block.meta: Bu ibora odatda shaxsning hayotda yoki ma'lum bir sohada katta tajribaga ega ekanini, ko‘p narsalarni boshidan kechirganini, shuningdek, aldovlarga, qiyinchiliklarga va turli vaziyatlarga tayyor ekanini ifodalaydi

ex: They say many girls on the block have no other options.
She’s been on the block since she was sixteen.
on the block.meta: Bu ibora Amerika slangida ishlatiladi va ko‘chada fohishalik bilan shug‘ullanish, ya'ni prostitutsiya bilan band bo‘lish ma’nosini anglatadi. Rasmiy va adabiy tilda emas, ko‘proq og‘zaki va jargon ifoda hisoblanadi.

ex: She told him she was up on blocks this week.
The car’s up on blocks until we can fix the engine.
up on blocks.meta: Nimadir yoki kimdir odatdagi faoliyatidan vaqtincha to‘xtagan, ishlamayotgan yoki foydalanishdan chiqarilgan holatni bildiradi. Bu texnik yoki umumiy holatlarda qo‘llanadi.

ex: Blockboard is cheaper than solid wood but still durable.
We used blockboard for the shelves because it’s strong but lightweight.
blockboard.meta: Blok taxta — bu qurilish materialidir. U o‘rtasi yog‘och bo‘laklaridan iborat yadro (tasma shaklida) va uning ikki tomoni kontrplak (plywood) bilan qoplangan bo‘ladi. Odatda mebel tayyorlashda va ichki ishlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Block caving is considered an efficient method for low-grade ore bodies.
The mine uses block caving to extract copper from deep underground.
block caving.meta: Blok qulash usuli — bu konchilikda qo‘llaniladigan qazib olish usuli bo‘lib, rudani (kon materialini) katta bloklarga bo‘lib, pastidan kesib, ustki qismini tabiiy ravishda qulatishga asoslanadi.

ex: The system uses block codes to automatically correct minor data errors.
Block codes are commonly used in digital communications to detect transmission errors.
block code.meta: Blok kodi — bu ma’lumot uzatishda yoki saqlashda xatolarni aniqlash yoki tuzatish uchun ishlatiladigan kodlash usuli bo‘lib, ma’lumotlar belgilangan o‘lchamdagi bloklar ko‘rinishida qayta ishlanadi.

ex: She wore a dress in a bold block colour with no patterns.
Block colours are very popular in modern minimalist design.
block colour.meta: Yakka rang — bir tekis, butun yuzani yoki buyumni qoplaydigan, hech qanday naqsh, soya yoki aralash rangsiz toza, aniq rang. Odatda kiyim-kechak, dizayn va san’atda ishlatiladi.

ex: The elasticity of the material comes from its block copolymer structure.
Block copolymers can self-assemble into unique nanostructures.
block copolymer.meta: bu polimer turi bo‘lib, uning molekulalari turli xil monomer qoldiqlaridan tarkib topgan bo‘laklarga (bloklarga) bo‘lingan bo‘ladi. Har bir blok bitta monomer turidan tashkil topadi va bu bloklar navbatma-navbat molekula zanjirida joylashadi.

ex: She played a simple tune on the block flute (recorder).
The block flute stop on the organ creates a soft, flute-like tone.
block flute.meta: Blok fleyta — bu organ cholg‘usida fleyta tovushini hosil qiluvchi registr (ovoz chiqarish tizimi) bo‘lib, ochiq yoki berkitilgan quvur orqali ovoz chiqarishi mumkin. Bu turdagi ovoz fleyta tovushiga o‘xshash, silliq va nafis bo‘ladi.

ex: Block front desks were popular in the eighteenth century.
The antique chest of drawers had a beautifully carved block front.
block front.meta: bu mebelning old yuzasi bo‘lib, uning markaziy qismi ichkariga botgan (chuqur) bo‘ladi, yon tomonlari esa oldinga chiqarilgan bo‘ladi. Bu shakl odatda antik mebel dizaynida uchraydi va mebelga nafis, qiziqarli ko‘rinish beradi.

ex: A block graph makes it easier for children to compare quantities.
The students drew a block graph to show their favorite fruits.
block graph.meta: Blok grafik — bu oddiy grafik turlaridan biri bo‘lib, kategoriyalar gorizontal o‘qda joylashadi va har bir kategoriya bo‘yicha miqdorlar vertikal bloklar (to‘sinlar) orqali ifodalanadi.

ex: Early video games used block graphics to display characters and environments.
Block graphics are made using keyboard characters like #, @, or █.
block graphics.meta: Blok grafikalar — bu past aniqlikdagi grafikalar bo‘lib, ular standart klaviatura belgilaridan (masalan, kvadrat, chiziq, nuqta, #, █, ░, va h.k.) yoki belgilarga teng maydonni egallovchi grafik komponentlardan foydalangan holda yaratiladi.

ex: The block heater helps prevent engine damage in freezing temperatures.
In winter, I plug in the block heater before starting the car.
block heater.meta: Dvigatel blok isitgichi — bu motorli transport vositasi dvigatelining blokini sovuq havoda oldindan isitish uchun ishlatiladigan qurilma.

ex: Block heels are more comfortable than stilettos for long walks.
She bought black boots with block heels for the winter.
block heel.meta: To‘rtburchak (blok) poshna — bu keng, to‘g‘ri chiziqli yoki to‘rtburchak shakldagi poshna bo‘lib, oyoq kiyimga barqarorlik va qulaylik beradi. U ko‘pincha oyoq kiyim, etik, sandallar va boshqa poyabzallarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Block-heeled boots are very stable and comfortable.
She wore block-heeled sandals to the party.
block-heeled.meta: Blok poshnali — bu to‘rtburchak shaklida, keng va barqaror poshnaga ega bo‘lgan poyabzal (oyoq kiyim) degani. Blok poshnali oyoq kiyimlar yurishda qulay, oyoqqa kamroq bosim beradi va ko‘pincha kundalik yoki rasmiy kiyimlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: The flight took five block hours from gate to gate.
The pilot’s salary is often calculated based on block hours.
block hour.meta: Blok soat — bu aviatsiyada vaqt o‘lchov birligi bo‘lib, samolyot harakatlana boshlagan paytdan (yerdagi stoyankadan chiqishidan) boshlab, manzilga yetib borguncha va to‘xtaguncha bo‘lgan umumiy vaqtni bildiradi.

ex: Each element in a block matrix can itself be a smaller matrix.
The block matrix simplifies complex system equations.
block matrix.meta: Blok matritsa — bu katta matritsa bo‘lib, uning har bir elementi yoki bo‘lagi o‘z-o‘zidan matritsa (kichik matritsa yoki blok) bo‘ladi. Ya’ni, matritsa satrlari va ustunlari kichik matritsalardan tashkil topgan bo‘ladi.

ex: Block paving is popular because damaged sections can be easily replaced.
The garden path was finished with block paving.
block paving.meta: Blokli qoplama — bu yo‘l, yo‘lak, hovli yoki maydonlarni qoplash uchun ishlatiladigan usul bo‘lib, u to‘g‘ri shakldagi tosh, g‘isht, beton yoki yog‘och bloklardan iborat bo‘ladi. Ushbu bloklar maxsus naqshda (o‘zaro tutash shaklda) yerga yotqiziladi.

ex: The block quotation should be indented from the left margin.
In academic writing, a long quotation is usually formatted as a block quotation.
block quotation.meta: Blok iqtibos — bu matnda boshqa manbadan olingan uzun iqtibos bo‘lib, odatda matndan alohida ajratib, chekinish (indentatsiya) bilan yoki alohida formatda ko‘rsatiladi.

ex: Pascal is a block-structured programming language.
In block-structured code, each function or loop has a clearly defined scope.
block-structured.meta: Blok tuzilmasiga ega — bu atama dasturlash tillarida ishlatiladi va buyruqlar guruhi (blok) asosida tuzilgan tartibli va iyerarxik (darajali) tuzilishga ega bo‘lgan tizim yoki tilni anglatadi.

ex: Workers stacked the bricks in the block-yard to dry.
The company owns a large block-yard where concrete blocks are produced.
block-yard.meta: Blok ishlab chiqarish maydoni — bu beton, g‘isht, tosh yoki boshqa turdagi qurilish bloklari ishlab chiqariladigan yoki saqlanadigan ochiq maydon yoki zavod hovlisi.

ex: As block captain, she keeps residents informed about safety issues.
The block captain organized a neighborhood watch meeting.
block captain.meta: Block captain — bu ma’lum bir ko‘cha, uylar guruhi yoki mahalla doirasida yashovchi shaxs bo‘lib, u jinoyatlarning oldini olish, mahalliy tadbirlarni muvofiqlashtirish yoki aholi faolligini oshirish kabi jamoaviy faoliyatlarga mas’ul bo‘ladi.

ex: A block group typically contains between 600 and 3,000 people.
The census data was collected and reported for each block group.
block group.meta: Blok guruhi — bu AQSh Aholi Ro‘yxati Byurosi tomonidan ishlatiladigan geografik birlik bo‘lib, aholining demografik statistikasi nashr qilinadigan eng kichik hududlardan biri hisoblanadi.

ex: They walked a block-long distance to reach the store.
There was a block-long line outside the concert hall.
block-long.meta: Bir blok uzunlikda — bu shahar blokining uzunligiga teng bo‘lgan masofani bildiradi. Shahar rejasida blok odatda bitta ko‘cha oraliq bo‘lib, ikki yo‘l yoki chorrahani ajratib turadigan hududdir.

ex: Block parents are trained to help children in emergencies.
The child ran to the house of a block parent after getting lost.
block parent.meta: Blok ota-ona — bu mahallada yashovchi voyaga yetgan ko‘ngilli shaxs bo‘lib, uning uyi favqulodda holatlarda (ayniqsa bolalar uchun) vaqtinchalik panoh yoki yordam so‘rash joyi sifatida ochiq bo‘ladi.

ex: We need some block-rocking music for this party.
The DJ played a block-rocking track that got everyone dancing.
block-rocking.meta: Block-rocking — bu musiqa yoki qo‘shiq haqida ishlatiladigan ifoda bo‘lib, juda kuchli, jo‘shqin, raqsga chorlovchi ritmga ega bo‘lgan musiqa turini bildiradi.

ex: The block watch program encourages residents to report suspicious activity.
Our neighborhood has an active block watch to prevent theft.
block watch.meta: Block watch — bu mahalla yoki ko‘cha aholisi tomonidan jinoyatchilikka qarshi kurashish maqsadida uyushtirilgan jamoaviy kuzatuv va nazorat dasturi.

ex: The funds in a blocked account cannot be accessed without permission.
Due to legal issues, his bank account was turned into a blocked account.
blocked account.meta: Bloklangan hisob — bu bank yoki uchinchi tomon tomonidan cheklangan bank hisobi bo‘lib, unga qisman yoki to‘liq kirish imkoni yo‘q.

ex: The cooking show is a blocktimer program produced by a private company.
The radio station sells airtime to several blocktimers.
blocktimer.meta: Bloktimer — bu mustaqil televideniye yoki radio ishlab chiqaruvchisi (yoki tashkiloti) bo‘lib, efir vaqtini telekanal yoki radiostansiyadan sotib olib, o‘sha vaqtda o‘zining dasturini efirga uzatadi.

ex: The blockiness of the design gives the building a bold appearance.
The blockiness of the video made it hard to see the details.
blockiness.meta: Blok shakldalik — bu blokli, to‘rtburchak shaklda bo‘lish holati yoki sifati. Bu tushuncha turli kontekstlarda qo‘llanadi

ex: A bought house gives more freedom than a council house.
They moved from a rented apartment to a bought house.
bought house.meta: Sotib olingan uy — bu uy-joy egasi yashaydigan va u to‘liq o‘z mulkida bo‘lgan uy. Bunday uy egalik huquqi bilan sotib olingan bo‘lib, ijaraga olingan uydan farq qiladi.

ex: The plan was painted in broad strokes without getting into details.
Let me explain the project in broad strokes.
in broad strokes.meta: In broad strokes — bu umumiy, qisqacha, asosiy fikrlar yoki katta yo‘nalishlar bo‘yicha tasvirlash yoki tushuntirish ma’nosini anglatadi. Tafsilotlarga e’tibor qaratmay, faqat asosiy nuqtalar haqida gapirilganda ishlatiladi.

ex: The director paints on a broad canvas, exploring themes of war, love, and politics.
The novel is a broad canvas of 20th-century American life.
broad canvas.meta: bu kitob, film, san’at asari yoki boshqa ijodiy mahsulot haqida aytiladigan ko‘chma ibora bo‘lib, u katta va murakkab voqelikni, turli xarakterlar, davrlar yoki mavzularni keng doirada va batafsil yoritadigan asarni tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: He stood staring into the broad sea, lost in thought.
The ship sailed into the broad sea, leaving the land far behind.
broad sea.meta: Broad sea — bu ochiq va keng dengiz hududi, ya'ni qirg‘oqdan uzoq, hech qanday orollar yoki quruqlik ko‘rinmaydigan, sokin yoki to‘lqinli, ammo chegaralanmagan dengiz maydoni.

ex: The broadwing is known for its long migrations.
We saw a broadwing soaring high above the forest.
broadwing.meta: Keng qanotli lochin (Buteo platypterus) — Shimoliy Amerikada uchraydigan, o‘rta kattalikdagi yirtqich qush turi.

ex: To prevent a broadcast storm, enable spanning tree protocol on your network.
The switch crashed due to a broadcast storm caused by a loop.
broadcast storm.meta: Broadcast storm — bu kompyuter tarmoqlarida yuzaga keladigan holat bo‘lib, unda haddan tashqari ko‘p avtomatik uzatmalar va javob paketlari tarmoqda tarqalib, uning ishlash samaradorligini pasaytiradi yoki butunlay ishdan chiqaradi.

ex: She dreams of producing a Broadway-style theatre in her city.
The show was a Broadway-style musical with spectacular dance numbers.
broadway-style.meta: Broadway-style — bu Broadway teatr sahnasiga xos yoki shu an’anaga mos uslubdagi sahna asarlari, musiqiylar yoki chiqishlarni ifodalovchi atama.

ex: The broad-winged hawk migrates thousands of kilometers each year.
We spotted a broad-winged hawk circling above the trees
broad-winged hawk.meta: Keng qanotli lochin — bu Shimoliy Amerikada uchraydigan o‘rta kattalikdagi yirtqich qush turi bo‘lib, ilmiy nomi Buteo platypterus.

ex: I’m built for comfort, not for speed, I prefer walking slowly.
This boat is built for comfort, not for speed.
to be built for comfort, not for speed.meta: Bu ibora asosan qayiq, avtomobil yoki boshqa transport vositalari haqida aytiladi va ularning asosiy maqsadi tezlik emas, qulaylik va shinamlik ekanligini bildiradi.

ex: Several builder’s jacks were placed under the beam to support it during repairs.
The workers used a builder’s jack to lift the corner of the house
builder’s jack.meta: Og‘ir bino elementlarini yoki butun binoni ko‘tarish yoki vaqtincha ushlab turish uchun ishlatiladigan mexanik yoki gidravlik qurilma. Bu domkratlar yakka yoki bir nechta bo‘lib ishlatilishi mumkin.

ex: The builder’s yard was full of bricks, timber, and other construction materials.
The ship was built at a large builder’s yard near the coast.
builder’s yard.meta: Kema, bino yoki boshqa inshootlar quriladigan o‘ralgan va maxsus ajratilgan hudud yoki maydon.Qurilish materiallari saqlanadigan yoki quruvchilar ishlaydigan ochiq joy, ombor yoki ishlab chiqarish maydoni.

ex: Failure to comply with the building code can lead to fines or the demolition of the structure.
The new shopping mall was designed to meet all current building codes.
building code.meta: Qurilish, binoni ta’mirlash, foydalanish va saqlash jarayonlariga oid turli qoidalar, talablar va standartlar to‘plami.

ex: The council refused to grant building consent for the proposed structure.
You must obtain building consent before starting construction.
building consent.meta: Mahalliy hokimiyat yoki vakolatli davlat organi tomonidan binoni qurish, o‘zgartirish yoki buzishga beriladigan rasmiy ruxsat. Bu ruxsat qurilish ishlarining qonunchilik va texnik me’yorlarga muvofiq ekanligini tasdiqlaydi.

ex: The building yard was full of half-finished boats and heavy machinery.
The new ship is being constructed at the building yard near the river.
building yard.meta: Dengiz, daryo yoki boshqa suv havzalari yaqinida joylashgan, o‘ralgan maxsus yer maydoni bo‘lib, u yerda kemalar, qayiq va boshqa suzuvchi vositalar quriladi.

ex: He made a fortune by buying low and selling high during the real estate boom.
The key to successful investing is to buy low and sell high.
