to buy low, sell high.meta: Mol-mulk, aksiyalar yoki boshqa aktivlarni narxi past bo‘lganida sotib olib, narxi oshgach sotish orqali foyda ko‘rish strategiyasi. Bu yondashuv savdo, investitsiya va moliyaviy bozorlarning asosiy tamoyillaridan biri hisoblanadi.

ex: The goalkeeper kicked the ball out to buy time for his teammates.
They negotiated to buy time for further preparations.
to buy time.meta: Biror harakat, hodisa yoki qarorni kechiktirish orqali ko‘proq tayyorgarlik ko‘rish, vaqt yutish yoki vaziyatni nazorat qilishga qo‘shimcha imkon yaratish. Bu ibora vaqtni ataylab cho‘zish yoki muammoni hozircha orqaga surish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: He bought on the dip after the stock market fell sharply.
Many investors prefer to buy on dip, expecting prices to recover soon.
to buy on dip.meta: Moliyaviy bozorlar: aksiyalar, tovarlar yoki boshqa aktivlar narxi vaqtinchalik tushganda ularni sotib olish. Bu strategiya narxlar tushgandan keyin ko‘tarilishi kutilib, foyda olish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: His silence was secured with a buy-off.
The company offered a large buy-off to prevent the lawsuit.
buy-off.meta: Biror kishini da’vosidan, qaroridan yoki harakatidan voz kechishga ko‘ndirish uchun unga pul to‘lash yoki boshqa moddiy foyda taklif qilish harakati.Ko‘pincha nohalol, bahsli yoki axloqan shubhali bitim orqali biror shaxsni o‘z fikridan qaytarish.

ex: The company’s shares rose after a buy rating was issued.
The stock received a buy rating from several analysts.
buy rating.meta: Investitsiya tahlilchisi tomonidan beriladigan tavsiya bo‘lib, kompaniya aksiyalarini, tovarlarni yoki boshqa aktivlarni sotib olish maqsadga muvofiq ekanini bildiradi.

ex: The buy-to-leave trend is contributing to the housing shortage.
Many luxury apartments in the city are bought on a buy-to-leave basis.
buy-to-leave.meta: Ko‘chmas mulk: Investor tomonidan uy yoki mulk sotib olinishi, lekin bu mulkda yashash yoki uni ijaraga berish rejalashtirilmaydi. Bu mulk odatda bo‘sh holda saqlanadi va mulkdor faqat aktiv qiymati oshishini kutadi.

ex: The company initiated a buy-up of its competitor’s shares.
There was a sudden buy-up of essential goods during the crisis.
buy-up.meta: Bozordan ma’lum bir mahsulot yoki aktivlarni katta miqdorda sotib olish jarayoni. Buning maqsadi mahsulotni bozor muomalasidan chiqarish, narxga ta’sir qilish yoki raqobatchilarga yetishmaslik holatini yaratish bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The buyback agreement allowed the seller to reclaim the asset within a year.
The company signed a buyback agreement to repurchase its shares in the future.
buyback agreement.meta: Biror narsa sotiladigan, lekin sotuvchi keyinchalik uni belgilangan muddat va shartlarda qayta sotib olish huquqini saqlab qoladigan bitim yoki shartnoma.

ex: Many people lost money in the buy-back game, not realizing the odds were against them.
The buy-back game tempted visitors with the chance to win big prizes and sell them back for cash.
buy-back game.meta: Ko‘rgazma, yarmarka yoki sayilgohlarda o‘tkaziladigan qimor tusidagi o‘yin turi bo‘lib, unda odatda pul bo‘lmagan yutuqlar taklif qilinadi.

ex: The seller refused to provide a warranty, reminding me that it was a buyer beware situation.
In private sales, the rule of buyer beware always applies.
buyer beware.meta: Xarid qilishdan oldin mahsulotning holati, sifati va mosligini tekshirish xaridor zimmasida bo‘lishi kerak, agar keyinchalik muammo chiqsa, sotuvchi javobgar bo‘lmasligi mumkin.

ex: With higher wages, people’s buying power increases.
Inflation reduces the buying power of consumers.
buying power.meta: Biror shaxs, guruh yoki tashkilotning moliyaviy imkoniyati — ya’ni mahsulot va xizmatlarni sotib olishga qanchalik qudrati borligi.

ex: There was a sudden buying up of fuel due to panic in the market.
The buying up of farmland by large corporations is becoming more common.
buying up.meta: Bozordagi ma’lum bir mahsulot, aksiyalar, aktivlar yoki resurslarni katta miqdorda sotib olish jarayoni. Maqsad — ularni bozordan chiqarish, narxni boshqarish yoki raqobatchilar uchun bu mahsulotni yetishmas holga keltirish.

ex: The Cape fox is a nocturnal hunter native to southern Africa.
The Cape fox is known for its beautiful silvery-grey fur.
cape fox.meta: Janubiy Afrikada yashovchi, itlar oilasiga (Canidae) mansub kichik yovvoyi hayvon. Cape fox — ilmiy nomi Vulpes chama bo‘lib, asosan kumushrang-kulrang junli, uzun dumli va tez yuguradigan tulki turi.

ex: When he pointed out the sun was hot, everyone called him Captain Obvious.
“Water is wet.” — “Thanks, Captain Obvious.”
captain obvious.meta: Kinoyaviy tarzda ishlatiladigan laqab bo‘lib, juda ravshan, hammaga ma’lum yoki ortiqcha bo‘lgan gaplarni aytadigan kishiga nisbatan qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The lessons were studied in course as set out in the book.
The prayers were read in course throughout the day.
in course.meta: O‘qish, dars yoki marosimlarda doimiy yoki belgilangan tartibda (navbatma-navbat) davom etish holati. Bu ibora asosan tarixiy matnlarda, ayniqsa ibodat kitoblari va diniy marosimlarda o‘qiladigan matnlarning ketma-ket o‘qilishi kontekstida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Sometimes, you just have to let nature take its course and trust the process.
The doctors decided to let nature take its course.
to let nature take its course.meta: Biror holat, jarayon yoki hodisaning hech qanday aralashuvsiz, tabiiy tarzda rivojlanishiga, o‘z oqimi bo‘yicha davom etishiga yoki yakun topishiga imkon berish.

ex: The navigator set the course to steer towards the nearest port.
The captain calculated the course to steer to avoid the storm.
course to steer.meta: Kema yoki samolyot boshqarilishi lozim bo‘lgan aniq yo‘nalish. Bu yo‘nalish kema yoki havo kemasini belgilangan manzilga olib borish uchun tanlanadi.

ex: The pilot had to course correct after realizing they were off track.
We need to course correct based on the latest feedback.
course correct.meta: Biror jarayon yoki harakat davomida yangi ma’lumotlar yoki sharoitlarga qarab yo‘nalishni yoki harakat rejasini to‘g‘rilash, zarur o‘zgarishlar kiritish.

ex: After realizing the project was failing, they made a course correction to save it.
The spacecraft made a course correction to stay on the correct trajectory.
course correction.meta: Kema, samolyot yoki boshqa transport vositasi belgilangan manzilga to‘g‘ri harakat qilishini ta’minlash uchun yo‘nalishni o‘zgartirish yoki tuzatish. Odatda yo‘ldan adashilganda yoki tashqi omillar tufayli aniqlik kiritilishi zarur bo‘lganda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: You need a total of 120 course credits to graduate from this program.
The student earned three course credits for completing the mathematics class.
course credit.meta: Ta’lim tizimida talaba yoki o‘quvchi o‘quv kursini muvaffaqiyatli yakunlaganida beriladigan o‘quv yuki o‘lchovi. Ma’lum miqdordagi kredit birliklari to‘planganda talaba diplom yoki daraja olish huquqiga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: My course load includes five classes this term.
The student is struggling to manage a heavy course load this semester.
course load.meta: Talaba yoki o‘quvchidan ma’lum o‘quv davri davomida bajarilishi kutiladigan darslar, topshiriqlar va o‘quv mashg‘ulotlari hajmi. Odatda, bir semestr yoki bir yilda olinadigan kurslar soni va shu kurslarga ajratilgan o‘quv yukini anglatadi.

ex: The course pack includes readings, case studies, and practice exercises.
The professor distributed the course pack at the beginning of the semester.
course pack.meta: Ma’lum bir kurs yoki ma’ruza seriyasi uchun tayyorlangan qo‘shimcha o‘quv materiallari to‘plami. Odatda, nusxa qilingan hujjatlar, maqolalar, dars qo‘llanmalari va boshqa chop etilgan yoki elektron materiallar shaklida bo‘ladi.

ex: The cyclist broke the course record that had stood for ten years.
He set a new course record at the city marathon.
course record.meta: Ma’lum bir sport yo‘nalishi yoki musobaqa trassasida qayd etilgan eng yaxshi rasmiy natija. Bu rekord aynan shu yo‘nalishda o‘tkazilgan musobaqalar tarixida erishilgan eng tez, eng yuqori yoki eng yaxshi ko‘rsatkichni anglatadi.

ex: The farm is officially certified as disease-free.
After surgery, the patient remained disease-free for five years.
disease-free.meta: Kasallik ta’sir qilmagan, sog‘lom, hech qanday kasallik alomatlari yoki kasallikni keltirib chiqaruvchi omillarga ega bo‘lmagan holat. Davolanishdan so‘ng kasallik, ayniqsa xavfli (masalan, saraton) kasallik qaytalanmagan holat.

ex: The hospital introduced a disease management program for diabetic patients.
Effective disease management can help patients live longer and healthier lives.
disease management.meta: Kasalliklarni davolash, ularning rivojlanishini oldini olish yoki simptomlarini nazorat ostida ushlab turish jarayoni.

ex: Disease mongering can create fear about normal human experiences.
Some argue that disease mongering leads to over-medication of healthy people.
disease mongering.meta: Odamlarni aslida shunchalik jiddiy bo‘lmagan yoki tabiiy holat bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan sog‘liq muammolarini kasallik sifatida qabul qilishga undash.

ex: The ship was found to be disease-ridden and was denied entry to the port.
The disease-ridden city was quickly quarantined to prevent further spread.
disease-ridden.meta: Kasallik ta’sirida bo‘lgan, ko‘plab kasalliklarni o‘zida saqlovchi yoki kasallik tarqalishi yuqori bo‘lgan joy, shaxs yoki hayvon. Odatda sog‘liq uchun xavfli yoki yuqumli holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Double-width fabrics are typically folded in half on bolts for easier handling.
The curtain is made from double-width fabric to avoid seams.
double-width.meta: Odatda bunday matolar standart o‘lchamdagi roliklarda ikki buklangan holda sotiladi. Bu mato kengroq maydonni qoplash yoki katta hajmdagi tikuv ishlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: The therapist guided the patient through EMDR sessions to process painful memories.
EMDR is widely used to treat post-traumatic stress disorder.
emdr.meta: Psixoterapiyada ishlatiladigan usul bo‘lib, u bezovta qiluvchi yoki travmatik xotiralar ta’sirini kamaytirish va ularni qayta ishlashga yordam beradi.

ex: Laurie Strode in Halloween is a classic example of the final girl.
In many horror films, the final girl is the one who ultimately survives.
final girl.meta: Asosan dahshat (horror) filmlarida, ayniqsa slasher janrida uchraydigan stereotip obraz bo‘lib, film oxirida qotil yoki hujumchidan qochib qutuladigan yoki uni yengib omon qoladigan yagona qiz yoki ayol qahramon.

ex: Many startups are now focusing on developing innovative financial technologies.
Financial technology is revolutionizing how people access banking services.
financial technology.meta: Ayniqsa, raqamli va onlayn texnologiyalar yordamida bank xizmatlari, investitsiyalar, pensiya tizimi, to‘lov tizimlari va moliyaviy boshqaruvni avtomatlashtirish yoki takomillashtirish bilan bog‘liq texnologiyalarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: She won the competition without any training. There’s talent for you!
He worked so hard and they just fired him. There’s gratitude for you!
there’s —— for you.meta: Biror kishi, narsa yoki holatning ajoyib yoki ajralib turadigan namunasi sifatida ishlatiladigan ifoda. Ko‘pincha maqtov, hayrat yoki istehzo (kinoya) bilan aytiladi.

ex: They promised to help but never showed up. That’s my friends for you!
He’s always late. That’s Tom for you!
that’s —— for you.meta: Odatda biror kishi yoki guruhga nisbatan ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, u aytilayotgan xatti-harakat yoki holat shu kishi yoki guruhning odatiy, xarakterli yoki kutiladigan fazilatini ko‘rsatishini bildiradi.

ex: From now on, I will exercise every day.
From here on in, we need to be more careful.
from here on in.meta: Ma’lum bir vaqtdan boshlab keyingi barcha vaqt yoki holatlarni anglatadi. Bu ifoda hozirgi vaqtdan yoki aniq ko‘rsatilgan nuqtadan boshlab nima bo‘lishini ta’kidlaydi.

ex: He wrote a gay-themed novel about self-acceptance.
The festival will showcase several gay-themed films.
gay-themed.meta: Asosan gey (homoseksual erkaklar) hayoti, tajribasi, madaniyati yoki his-tuyg‘ulari bilan bog‘liq mavzuni qamrab oladigan asar, film, kitob, voqea yoki boshqa ko‘rinishdagi material.

ex: He was known as a bit of a gay blade in his younger years.
In the old novels, the gay blade was always the life of the party.
gay blade.meta: Quvnoq, jozibali, bardam va serg‘ayrat yigit; ko‘pincha jamiyatda ko‘p qizlar e’tiborida bo‘ladigan, ozoda va xushchaqchaq odam.

ex: The paintings reflect the fashion and lifestyle of the Gay Nineties.
Many people remember the Gay Nineties as a time of great social change and lavish parties.
gay nineties.meta: Gay Nineties — asosan AQSh va ba’zan Buyuk Britaniya tarixida 1890-yillarni ifodalovchi ibora bo‘lib, bu davr optimizm, iqtisodiy yuksalish, jamiyatda farovonlik va hashamatli hayot davri sifatida tasvirlanadi.

ex: The gay bar is known for its welcoming atmosphere.
They met each other at a gay bar downtown.
gay bar.meta: Asosan geylar (homoseksual erkaklar) va LGBTQ+ hamjamiyatiga mansub odamlar tashrif buyuradigan jamoat barlari yoki dam olish maskanlari.

ex: Gay Day events often include parades, music, and educational programs.
The city held its annual Gay Day to celebrate diversity and inclusion.
gay day.meta: Odatda butun kun davom etadigan ommaviy tadbir bo‘lib, geylar va lesbianlar huquqlari, jamiyatdagi o‘rni, tenglik va qabul qilish kabi mavzularni targ‘ib qilish va bu borada xabardorlikni oshirishga qaratilgan.

ex: The gay ghetto is known for its vibrant nightlife and cultural events.
Many gay ghettos developed in major cities during the late 20th century.
gay ghetto.meta: Shahar hududida joylashgan va asosan geylar va LGBTQ+ hamjamiyati vakillari istiqomat qiladigan, ularning ehtiyojlariga mos do‘konlar, kafelar, barlar va xizmat ko‘rsatish maskanlari to‘plangan joy.

ex: Gay icons often challenge traditional gender roles and norms.
Madonna is widely regarded as a gay icon.
gay icon.meta: Geylar va kengroq LGBTQ+ hamjamiyati tomonidan alohida hurmat qilinadigan va seviladigan ommaviy shaxs (san’atkor, siyosatchi, jamoat arbobi va boshqalar).

ex: Gay liberationists fought for equal rights and social acceptance.
He became a prominent gay liberationist in the 1970s.
gay liberationist.meta: Gey ozodlik faoli — Gay Liberation Front (Gey Ozodlik Harakati) a’zosi bo‘lgan yoki geylar va kengroq LGBTQ+ hamjamiyatining huquqlari, tengligi va jamiyat tomonidan qabul qilinishi uchun faol kurashuvchi inson.

ex: Gay power emerged as a key force in the fight for LGBTQ+ rights.
The protesters chanted “Gay Power!” during the march.
gay power.meta: Gey kuchi — geylar jamiyatida ijtimoiy, madaniy yoki iqtisodiy ta’sirga ega bo‘lish, o‘z huquqlari va manfaatlarini himoya qilish uchun faol harakat qilish.

ex: The issue of male rape, including gay rape, is often underreported.
Gay rape is a serious and punishable crime under the law.
gay rape.meta: Gey zo‘rlash — erkak kishi tomonidan boshqa erkakka nisbatan amalga oshiriladigan jinsiy zo‘ravonlik

ex: Gay rights activists organized a large public demonstration.
They are fighting for gay rights in their country.
gay rights.meta: Gey huquqlari — geylar (homoseksual erkaklar) va kengroq LGBTQ+ hamjamiyatiga mansub shaxslarning fuqarolik huquqlari.

ex: The city has a vibrant gay scene with many bars and clubs.
He became well known in the local gay scene.
gay scene.meta: Gey muhiti — geylar va kengroq LGBTQ+ hamjamiyatiga oid bo‘lgan ijtimoiy va madaniy muhit. Bu atama odatda gey va lesbian barlari, klublari, kafe, tadbirlar, festivallar va boshqa jamiyat markazlarini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: Safe practices in gay sex are important for sexual health.
Gay sex is legal in many countries but still stigmatized in some societies.
gay sex.meta: bir jinsga mansub (asosan erkaklar o‘rtasida) shaxslar o‘rtasida bo‘ladigan jinsiy munosabat. Kengroq ma’noda, bu tushuncha homoseksual jinsiy faoliyatni bildiradi va ijtimoiy, huquqiy hamda tibbiy kontekstlarda muhim termin hisoblanadi.

ex: Many tourists visit the gay village for its unique atmosphere and festivals.
The city’s gay village is famous for its pride parades and nightlife.
gay village.meta: Gey qishlog‘i — shahardagi muayyan hudud bo‘lib, u yerda ko‘pchilik aholisi geylar yoki LGBTQ+ jamiyatiga mansub bo‘lgan shaxslar yashaydi yoki muntazam tashrif buyuradi.

ex: Gay-baiting often leads to increased harassment and violence.
The politician was accused of gay-baiting to win conservative votes.
gay-baiting.meta: Geylarni kamsitish (gay-baiting) — geylarga yoki LGBTQ+ jamiyatiga nisbatan nafrat yoki salbiy munosabatni ataylab qo‘zg‘atish, bu munosabatlardan siyosiy foyda ko‘rish, yoki gey insonlarni ataylab haqorat qilish

ex: Ghettoizing certain cultures prevents true social integration.
The media was accused of ghettoizing minority voices.
ghettoizing.meta: Gettolash — ma’lum bir ijtimoiy guruhni (odatda etnik, diniy yoki jinsiy ozchiliklarni) jamiyatning asosiy qismidan ajratib qo‘yish yoki ularni faqat cheklangan hududda yoki tor ijtimoiy maydonda yashashga yoki faoliyat yuritishga majbur qilish.

ex: Looking at the glass as half full can help you stay positive.
She always sees the glass as half full, even in difficult times.
the glass is half full.meta: Stakan yarim to‘la — bu ibora optimistik qarashni ifodalaydi. Odam voqealarga ijobiy, umid bilan va yaxshi tomondan qaraydigan inson sifatida tasvirlanadi.

ex: The river rose to the half of the bridge’s height.
Fill the cup to the half.
to the half.meta: Yarimigacha — qadimgi (hozir ishlatilmaydigan) ibora bo‘lib, idish yoki har qanday hajm o‘lchovini yarimigacha to‘ldirish yoki yarim nuqtaga yetkazish ma’nosida ishlatilgan.

ex: Life is a game of two halves — things can change completely after some time.
The first half was disappointing, but the second half changed everything — it was a game of two halves.
a game of two halves.meta: asosan britan ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, sport o‘yinlarida, ayniqsa futbolda, birinchi va ikkinchi bo‘lim butunlay boshqacha kechishi yoki o‘yin natijasining har ikkala bo‘limga qarab keskin o‘zgarishi haqida aytiladi.

ex: She can solve the problem given half a chance.
He would succeed if he had half a chance.
half a chance.meta: Yarim imkoniyat — bu ibora kichik imkoniyat, juda oz ehtimol yoki eng kichik imkoniyat bo‘lsa ham, undan foydalanish, harakat qilish yoki biror narsa sodir bo‘lishi mumkinligini anglatadi.

ex: The half-aum measure was commonly used in old European wine trade.
They stored the wine in a half-aum barrel.
half-aum.meta: Yarim aum — suyuqlik o‘lchov birligi bo‘lib, bir aumning yarmini bildiradi. Bu miqdor taxminan 15 dan 17 gallongacha (68–77 litr) ni tashkil qiladi.

ex: She grew up very close to her half-aunt from her mother’s side.
My father’s half-sister is my half-aunt.
half-aunt.meta: Yarim xola (agar onaning singlisi bo‘lsa) yoki yarim amma (agar otaning singlisi bo‘lsa) — bu shaxs bilan faqat ota yoki faqat ona orqali qarindoshlik rishtasi bor bo‘lgan xola yoki amma.

ex: I bought a half fare ticket for my daughter.
Children under five usually travel at half fare.
half fare.meta: Yarim yo‘l haqi — bu jamoat transportida (avtobus, poyezd, tramvay va hokazo) to‘liq yo‘l haqining yarmini to‘lash imkoniyati bo‘lib, odatda bolalar, talaba, nafaqadagi keksalar yoki maxsus toifalarga taalluqli chegirmali narxdir.

ex: The weather forecast predicted a half gale by evening.
The ship encountered a half gale on the open sea.
half gale.meta: Yarim bo‘ron — bu o‘rtacha kuchli shamol bo‘lib, Beyfort shkalasida 7-darajali shamol kuchiga to‘g‘ri keladi. Bu shamol odatda tebranuvchi kuchli shamol sifatida tasvirlanadi va kuchli bo‘lsa-da, hali to‘liq bo‘ron hisoblanmaydi.

ex: Half hands were often given lighter tasks compared to full hands.
As a child, he was classified as a half hand on the plantation.
half hand.meta: Yarim ishchi — qishloq xo‘jaligida, ayniqsa plantatsiyalarda, to‘liq ishchi mehnat hajmining yarmi miqdorida ish belgilangan ishchi. Bu tushuncha ko‘pincha qul bo‘lgan ishchilar kontekstida ishlatilgan.

ex: He paid using a half piece of silver.
The merchant sold me a half piece of cloth at a discount.
half piece.meta: Yarim bo‘lak — bu oddiy yoki to‘liq o‘lchovdagi narsaning yarmi, ya’ni uning hajmi, og‘irligi yoki qiymatining yarmini anglatadi. Odatda mato, tanga yoki har qanday o‘lchanadigan buyumlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: A car’s halfshafts transmit power from the differential to the wheels.
The mechanic replaced the broken halfshaft on the right side.
halfshaft.meta: Yarim o‘q (yarim val) — avvaliga standart o‘lcham yoki uzunlikning yarmiga teng bo‘lgan val ma’nosini anglatgan.

ex: In geometry, a plane divides space into two half-spaces.
She paused on the half-space between the stair flights.
half-space.meta: Narvon parraklari orasidagi kichik maydon yoki maydoncha. Bu joy odatda narvondan ko‘tarilish yoki tushish paytida qisqa to‘xtash yoki yo‘nalishni o‘zgartirish joyidir. (Sinonim: yarim qadam maydonchasi)

ex: Half-standard trees are easier to prune and harvest.
We planted a half-standard apple tree in the garden.
half-standard.meta: Yarim standart o‘simlik — asosan mevali daraxt bo‘lib, uning asosiy shoxi (yoki tanasi) yer sathidan nisbatan pastroq balandlikda (odatda 1,5 metr yoki undan past) shoxlanishni boshlaydi.

ex: His half-uncle visited him during the holidays.
My mother’s half-brother is my half-uncle.
half-uncle.meta: Yarim tog‘a yoki yarim amaki — bu shaxs bilan faqat ota yoki faqat ona orqali qarindoshlik bog‘langan amakidir.

ex: The coach assigned her to the halfback flank position for better defense.
He played on the halfback flank and made several key tackles.
halfback flank.meta: Yarim himoyachi qanoti — sport o‘yinlarida, ayniqsa regbi va Avstraliya futbolida, yarim himoya chizig‘ining tashqi pozitsiyalaridan biri.

ex: On half-day closing, most shops shut their doors after lunch.
Our town observes half-day closing every Wednesday afternoon.
half-day closing.meta: Yarim kun yopilish — bu savdo do‘konlari, korxonalar yoki xizmat ko‘rsatish joylarining haftaning ma’lum bir kunida tushdan keyin yopilishi yoki ishlamasligi amaliyoti.

ex: We had a half-day holiday at school for the local festival.
The employees were given a half-day holiday on Friday afternoon.
half-day holiday.meta: Yarim kunlik dam olish kuni — bu ish kuni yoki o‘qish kunining faqat yarmi (odatda tushdan oldin yoki tushdan keyin) dam olish kuni deb belgilangan vaqt.

ex: He was moved from midfield to the half-forward line to strengthen the attack.
The team’s half-forward line dominated the game with aggressive attacks.
half-forward line.meta: Yarim hujum chizig‘i — jamoaviy sport turlarida (ayniqsa Avstraliya futboli va regbi kabi o‘yinlarda) yarim hujumchilar joylashadigan maydon qismi yoki ularning umumiy pozitsiyasi.

ex: In medieval records, half-mark lands were common in rural areas.
The farmer leased a half-mark land from the local lord.
half-mark land.meta: Yarim markli yer — bu yillik ijarasi qadimiy pul birligi — yarim mark qiymatiga teng bo‘lgan yer maydoni. Bu atama asosan o‘rta asrlarda yerni baholash va soliq tizimida ishlatilgan. Yer narxi yoki ijarasi pul birligi (mark) asosida belgilangan.

ex: In those days, girls were expected to keep their hand on their halfpenny.
She was determined to keep her hand on her halfpenny until marriage.
to keep one’s hand on one’s halfpenny.meta: Bu Britaniya slang ifodasi bo‘lib, ayniqsa ayollar haqida gapirganda, jinsiy aloqadan tiyilish, o‘z nomusini saqlash yoki bokiralikni asrash ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: In that company, she always felt like she was in the halfpenny place.
He was left in the halfpenny place while others took the credit.
halfpenny place.meta: Halpenny place — bu ahamiyatsiz, ikkinchi darajali yoki quyi maqomdagi o‘rin yoki holatni ifodalovchi ibora. Odatda past darajadagi mavqe, e’tiborga loyiq bo‘lmagan pozitsiya yoki jamiyatdagi unchalik muhim bo‘lmagan holat nazarda tutiladi.

ex: The tennis player hit the return on the half-volley with precision.
He struck the ball on the half-volley and scored a spectacular goal.
on the half-volley.meta: Yarim zarbada — bu sport termin bo‘lib, to‘p yerga tushishi bilan, to‘liq sakrashidan oldin darhol zarba berish yoki tepish holatini bildiradi.

ex: She refused to go halfway in the negotiations.
If you go halfway, I will meet you there.
to go halfway.meta: Murosaga borish — bu ikki tomon o‘rtasida kelishuvga erishish uchun yon berish, taklif yoki urinishlarga javob qaytarish va o‘zaro tushunishga intilish.

ex: She half-wittedly trusted a stranger with her money.
He half-wittedly ignored the warning signs.
half-wittedly.meta: Ahmoqona tarzda — bu biror ishni aqlsizlik bilan, o‘ylamay, tentaklarcha yoki nodonlarcha bajarishni ifodalaydi. Bu atama odatda o‘ylamay qilingan yoki juda noo‘rin, bema’ni harakatlar va so‘zlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Halving joints provide a simple but strong connection in wooden frames.
The carpenter used a halving joint to connect the two wooden beams.
halving joint.meta: Yarim kesimli ulash — bu ikkita yog‘och yoki boshqa materiallarni bir-biriga ulash usuli bo‘lib, ulash nuqtasida har ikkala materialning teng qismi kesilib, ular bir-biriga yelim yoki mahkamlash orqali birlashtiriladi.

ex: The man committed a homicide-suicide after a family dispute.
The incident was reported as a homicide-suicide by the police.
homicide-suicide.meta: Qotillik-o‘zini o‘ldirish — bu biror shaxs biror kimsani o‘ldirgandan so‘ng, yoki o‘ldirish jarayonida o‘z joniga qasd qiladigan holat.Bu voqealar odatda psixologik buzilish, kuchli stress yoki shaxsiy ziddiyat natijasida sodir bo‘ladi.

ex: Using a keep cup helps reduce waste from disposable cups.
She always brings her keep cup to the coffee shop.
keep cup.meta: Qayta ishlatiladigan stakan — bu bir martalik stakan o‘rniga ko‘p marotaba foydalanish uchun mo‘ljallangan, odatda qopqog‘i va issiqlikni saqlovchi xususiyatga ega bo‘lgan stakan.

ex: Human trafficking is one of the most common forms of modern slavery.
Modern slavery affects millions of people worldwide.
modern slavery.meta: Zamonaviy qullik — bu hozirgi zamonda odamlarning majburiy mehnatga, jinsiy ekspluatatsiyaga, qarzdorlik tufayli qullikka, odam savdosiga yoki boshqa ekspluatatsion sharoitlarga majburlanishi holati.

ex: Morning breath is common after a full night's sleep.
He quickly brushed his teeth to get rid of his morning breath
morning breath.meta: Ertalabki nafas hidi — bu odam uxlab turganidan keyin og‘izdan chiqadigan noxush (yomon) hid. Bu holat og‘izdagi bakteriyalar faoliyati, og‘iz qurishi va uzoq vaqt davomida og‘iz gigiyenasiga rioya qilinmagani natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ex: Morning mouth can usually be fixed by brushing your teeth right after waking.
I woke up with terrible morning mouth today.
morning mouth.meta: Ertalabki og‘iz hidi — bu uyg‘ongandan keyin og‘izdan chiqadigan noxush (yomon) hid yoki og‘izdagi yoqimsiz holat.

ex: It’s unfair to paint all teenagers with a broad brush based on a few bad examples.
The report painted the entire community with a broad brush, ignoring individual differences.
to paint with a broad brush.meta: Umumiy qilib tasvirlash — bu biror odam yoki holatni juda keng, umumiy va yuzaki tarzda ta’riflash yoki tasvirlash, kichik, lekin muhim tafsilotlarga e’tibor bermaslik.

ex: She is trying to live a plastic-free lifestyle.
The store offers plastic-free packaging options.
plastic-free.meta: Plastiksiz (plastikdan xoli) — bu plastmassa (plastik) materiallar ishlatilmagan yoki ularni ishlatishni butunlay chetlab o‘tuvchi mahsulot, jarayon yoki yashash tarzi.

ex: Some fans criticize the show for giving the hero too much plot armour.
That character clearly has plot armour—he survived an explosion without a scratch.
plot armour.meta: Syujet zirhi — bu asosan badiiy asarlarda yoki filmlarda biror qahramonning mantiqsiz yoki ehtimoldan yiroq holatlarda ham tirik qolishi, faqat syujet uni himoya qilgani uchun.

ex: Porch pirates often target homes during the holiday season when deliveries are frequent.
The security camera caught a porch pirate stealing a package from the doorstep.
porch pirate.meta: Posilka o‘g‘risi — bu uy yoki binoning oldida qoldirilgan, egasiga hali topshirilmagan posilkalarni (jo‘natmalarni) o‘g‘irlab ketadigan shaxs. Bunday o‘g‘rilar asosan onlayn buyurtmalar ko‘paygan joylarda uchraydi.

ex: I planted seaside daisies along the pathway for their beautiful purple flowers.
The seaside daisy is popular in coastal gardens because it is salt-tolerant.
seaside daisy.meta: bu Shimoliy Amerikaning Tinch okeani sohillarida o‘sadigan ko‘p yillik o‘t o‘simligi. Bu gul hozirda ham bog‘larda bezak o‘simligi sifatida yetishtiriladi. Tarixan ba’zan "thrift" (Armeria maritima) deb atalgan, lekin bu hozir kam uchraydi.

ex: Sheet cakes are perfect for serving large crowds at weddings or celebrations.
We ordered a chocolate sheet cake for the birthday party.
sheet cake.meta: Katta qatlamli tort — bu katta, tekis, to‘rtburchak shakldagi bir qatlamdan iborat bo‘lib pishiriladigan tort bo‘lib, odatda usti krem, shokolad yoki boshqa bezaklar bilan bezatiladi. Bu tort ko‘pincha katta guruhlarga xizmat qilish uchun tayyorlanadi.

ex: The museum now displays an old slave bell as a reminder of the region’s history.
The slave bell rang at sunrise to summon the enslaved people to the fields.
slave bell.meta: Qul qo‘ng‘irog‘i — bu odatda baland inshootga o‘rnatilgan katta qo‘ng‘iroq bo‘lib, tarixda plantatsiyalarda qullarni chaqirish yoki ish boshlanishi va tugashini belgilash uchun ishlatilgan.

ex: Slave breakers used brutal methods to break the spirit of enslaved workers.
The plantation owner hired a slave breaker to discipline rebellious enslaved people.
slave breaker.meta: Qul sindiruvchi — bu jismoniy zo‘ravonlik yoki boshqa majburlov choralaridan foydalanib, qullarni itoatkor yoki bo‘ysunadigan qilishga urinish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxsdir.

ex: Under the slave codes, enslaved people could be severely punished for attempting to escape.
The slave codes prohibited enslaved people from learning to read and write.
slave code.meta: Qul kodeksi — bu qulchilik tizimini tartibga soluvchi huquqiy qoidalar majmuasi.

ex: He rejected his slave name and chose a new name to honor his African heritage.
Many African Americans today carry slave names that were passed down from their enslaved ancestors.
slave name.meta: Qul ismi — bu (dastlab) qul egasi tomonidan qullarga berilgan ism. Keyinchalik bu atama qullik avlodidan meros bo‘lib qolgan yoki qulchilik davrida majburan qabul qilingan familiya yoki ismni anglatadi.

ex: The shop is always understaffed — you can’t get the staff these days!
You can’t get the staff these days; nobody wants to work hard anymore.
you can’t get the staff these days.meta: “Bugun-kunduz ishchi topilmaydi” — bu ibora ko‘pincha hazil yoki kinoyali ohangda ishlatiladi va biror ish yoki xizmatning yetarlicha bajarilmayotganini, yoki kerakli odamlarni topish qiyinligini ifodalaydi.

ex: He owns a staff-acre of land behind his house for gardening.
The farm included a small staff-acre fenced off for vegetable growing.
staff-acre.meta: Xodim ar — bu ehtimol kichik bir yer maydoni bo‘lib, odatda o‘rnatilgan to‘siq yoki panjara bilan ajratilgan bo‘ladi. Bu atama yer o‘lchovi yoki maydonni ifodalash uchun ishlatilishi mumkin, ayniqsa kichik va belgilangan maydonlar uchun.

ex: Staff moulding often appears in classical architecture with intricate designs.
The architect used staff moulding to decorate the corners of the ceiling.
staff moulding.meta: Staf shaklidagi profillash — bu uzun tayoq yoki lenta shaklida, tashqi tomoni dumaloq (konveks) bo‘lgan, ba’zan juda bezatilgan (ornamentlangan) profillash turi. Ko‘pincha burchaklar va qirralarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Staff associations play an important role in representing employees' rights.
The staff association held a meeting to discuss the new workplace policies.
staff association.meta: Xodimlar uyushmasi — bu kompaniya, tashkilot yoki muassasa xodimlari tomonidan tashkil etilgan guruh bo‘lib, uning a’zolariga yordam ko‘rsatish va ularning manfaatlarini muhokamalarda himoya qilish uchun xizmat qiladi.

ex: The school’s teaching staff meeting is scheduled for next Monday.
The staff meeting will be held tomorrow to discuss the new policies.
staff meeting.meta: Xodimlar yig‘ilishi — tashkilot yoki muassasa xodimlari uchun o‘tkaziladigan yig‘ilish; ayniqsa, maktabdagi o‘qituvchilar tarkibining yig‘ilishi nazarda tutiladi.

ex: Traditional stave-built boats are made from narrow wooden planks.
The barrel was stave-built using carefully shaped wooden slats.
stave-built.meta: Taxtachalar bilan qurilgan — bu konstruktsiya yoki buyum, taxtachalar (ingliz tilida stave) yordamida, ya’ni uzun, yupqa yog‘och taxtachalardan yasalgan bo‘lib, ayniqsa shunday usulda qurilgan narsalarni anglatadi.

ex: The barrels are made from high-quality stave wood.
Stave wood is used to make barrels for storing wine and whiskey.
stave wood.meta: Taxta yog‘ochi — (a) shox yoki barrel (chelak) yasash uchun mos keladigan, asosan tropik yoki subtropik mintaqalarda o‘sadigan yog‘och turi; (b) yog‘och yoki yog‘ochning ma'lum bir turi.

ex: Treatment for substance use disorder often includes therapy and medication.
Substance use disorder can severely affect a person's daily life and relationships.
substance use disorder.meta: Modda ishlatish buzilishi — bu ruhiy sog‘liqning bir guruh kasalliklaridan biri bo‘lib, unda shaxs psixoaktiv moddalardan uzoq va doimiy ravishda foydalanadi, lekin undan voz kechish yoki nazorat qilish qobiliyati cheklangan bo‘ladi.

ex: The tailgate party atmosphere is lively with music, food, and drinks.
Fans often have a tailgate party before the football game starts.
tailgate party.meta: Avtoturargohda yig‘ilish — odatda sport tadbiri (ko‘pincha futbol o‘yini) oldidan stadionning avtoturargohida o‘tkaziladigan bayram yoki ziyofat bo‘lib, unda ochiq havoda taom va ichimliklar tortiladi.

ex: The topsite was shut down by the authorities due to illegal content.
Hackers often upload pirated software to a topsite.
topsite.meta: Topsayt — noqonuniy yoki piratlik materiallarini tarqatish va saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan FTP server.

ex: We bought a new TV cabinet that matches the living room decor.
The TV cabinet has shelves for storing DVDs and remote controls.
tv cabinet.meta: Televizor shkafi — televizorni joylashtirish yoki televizor ustiga qo‘yish uchun mo‘ljallangan mebel buyumi.

ex: We placed the new television on a stylish TV stand.
The TV stand is made of wood and has a modern design.
tv stand.meta: Televizor stendi — televizorni qo‘yish uchun mo‘ljallangan mebel buyumi.

ex: This old ventilating lamp has holes at the base to allow fresh air in.
The ventilating lamp helps improve air circulation in the room while providing light.
ventilating lamp.meta: Ventilyatsiyali chiroq — xona havosini ventilyatsiya qilish xususiyatiga ega bo‘lgan gazli chiroq turi; odatda pastdan havo kirishini ta'minlovchi teshiklari va yonuvchi qism ustida truba, kanal yoki tutun chiqaruvchi joyi bo‘ladi.

ex: Under the ADA, employers must provide reasonable accommodations for disabled employees.
The ADA ensures that people with disabilities have access to public buildings.
ada.meta: ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) — Qo‘shma Shtatlarda nogironligi bo‘lgan shaxslarga nisbatan kamsitishni taqiqlovchi fuqarolik huquqi qonuni.

ex: She gave a soft ae as a sign of agreement.
“Will you help us?” — “Ae,” he replied.
ae.meta: Ae — Maori tilida rozi bo‘lish, tasdiqlash yoki “ha” ma’nosini bildiruvchi so‘z. Shuningdek, ae alohida so‘z sifatida ham "ha" deb aytiladigan tasdiqlovchi ifoda bo‘lib, nutqda rozilik bildiradi.

ex: The community celebrates its Afro-Indigenous history through festivals and storytelling.
She proudly identifies as Afro-Indigenous, embracing both her African and Indigenous heritage.
afro-indigenous.meta: Afro-tubjoylik — odam haqida: Afrika ajdodlariga ham, Amerika qit'asining tub aholi ajdodlariga ham ega bo‘lgan shaxs. Shuningdek: bunday kelib chiqishga ega bo‘lgan odamlar yoki ularning madaniyatiga oid.

ex: Many students attended the after-ball to continue the celebration.
They are organizing an exclusive after-ball party at the hotel.
after-ball.meta: (Sifat sifatida): Balldan (yirik rasmiy raqs kechasidan) keyin bo‘lib o‘tadigan tadbir yoki bayramni ifodalaydi. (O‘rin sifatida): Balldan keyingi ziyofat yoki yig‘ilish.

ex: The country pursued an aggressionist foreign policy.
The aggressionists supported the invasion despite international protests.
aggressionist.meta: Agressiyachi — boshqalarga, ayniqsa boshqa davlatlarga nisbatan tajovuz yoki kuch ishlatishni qo‘llaydigan yoki targ‘ib qiladigan shaxs; ko‘pincha bir davlatning tashqi siyosatida tajovuzni himoya qiluvchi odam.

ex: Animal print fabrics are popular in modern fashion.
She wore a dress with a bold animal print.
animal print.meta: Hayvon terisi naqshi — hayvon (xususan, leopar, yo‘lbars yoki zebra) terisidagi chiziqli yoki dog‘li naqshga o‘xshash bezak, naqsh yoki tasvir. Shuningdek, bunday naqsh tushirilgan mato, kiyim yoki buyum.

ex: The movement promoted anti-Calvinistical doctrines during the religious debates.
His anti-Calvinistical views were not accepted by the church.
anti-calvinistical.meta: Kalvinizmga qarshi — Jon Kalvin yoki Kalvinizm ta’limotiga qarshi bo‘lgan; Kalvinist tamoyillariga mos kelmaydigan yoki ularga zid fikr yoki yo‘nalish.

ex: The contract specified antichresis as a way to secure the payment.
Through antichresis, the creditor used the debtor’s farmland to recover the loan.
antichresis.meta: qarzdor o‘z kreditoriga qarzni ta’minlash uchun mol-mulk yoki aktivdan foydalanish huquqini va undan olinadigan daromadni vaqtincha beradigan shartnomaviy kelishuv yoki bitim. Ushbu daromad odatda qarzni yoki foizlarni qoplash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: They installed anti-climb barriers on the building to enhance security.
The fence is coated with anti-climb paint to prevent trespassing.
anti-climb.meta: odatda devor, panjara yoki boshqa sirtlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi; odamlarning ularga chiqishini oldini olish yoki qiyinlashtirish uchun maxsus ishlab chiqilgan. Bunday yuzalarda sirpanchiq materiallar, tikanli elementlar yoki boshqa to‘siqlar bo‘ladi.

ex: Anticuchos are often served with potatoes and spicy sauce.
We tried delicious anticuchos made from beef heart at a street market in Peru.
anticucho.meta: Antikucho — Peru va Boliviya oshxonasida tayyorlanadigan taom bo‘lib, odatda mol yuragi bo‘lgan, maxsus marinad qilinib, shampurda (temir tayoqchada) grilda pishiriladigan go‘sht bo‘lagi. Bu taom ko‘pincha ko‘plik shaklida ishlatiladi.

ex: Anti-establishmentarians often advocate for social reforms and protest against traditional authorities.
His anti-establishmentarian views made him unpopular among political leaders.
anti-establishmentarian.meta: Tuzumga qarshi — mavjud siyosiy, ijtimoiy yoki diniy hokimiyatga, tuzumga yoki rasmiy institutlarga qarshi bo‘lgan; mavjud tuzum va tartibni tan olmaydigan yoki hurmatsizlik bilan qaraydigan.

ex: The movement was known for its strong anti-establishmentarianism and calls for radical change.
Anti-establishmentarianism grew among young people who felt excluded from political power.
anti-establishmentarianism.meta: mavjud siyosiy, ijtimoiy, diniy yoki boshqa hokimiyatga yoki rasmiy tizimlarga ochiq qarshilik, norozilik yoki dushmanlik bildiradigan mafkura, fikr yoki harakat. Bu tushuncha hukmron tizimga nisbatan ishonchsizlik yoki hurmatsizlik bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Many people supported the anti-expansion movement, fearing economic overreach.
The anti-expansion policy aimed to prevent the country from acquiring more territory.
anti-expansion.meta: Kengayishga qarshi — kengayish, ayniqsa hududiy yoki iqtisodiy kengayishga qarshi bo‘lgan; kengayishni yoqlamaydigan yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlamaydigan fikr, siyosat yoki harakat.

ex: The government adopted an anti-expansionist foreign policy to avoid conflicts.
The anti-expansionists protested against the country's plans to annex new territories.
anti-expansionist.meta: Kengayishga qarshi shaxs — hududiy yoki iqtisodiy kengayishga qarshi bo‘lgan, uni qo‘llab-quvvatlamaydigan yoki unga faol qarshilik qiladigan odam.

ex: The tiles were laid antigodlin, giving the floor a unique pattern.
The fence was built all antigodlin across the field.
antigodlin.meta: Qiyshiq, burilgan — belgilangan chiziqlarga yoki to‘g‘ri burchaklarga mos kelmaydigan; qiyalashgan yoki qiya holatda joylashgan.

ex: Anti-government protests spread rapidly throughout the country.
The rebels declared the formation of an anti-government in the northern region.
anti-government.meta: Hukumatga qarshi shaxs yoki guruh — mavjud hukumatga raqib bo‘lgan, unga qarshi harakat qiladigan yoki haqiqiy yoki qonuniy hukumatga zid deb qaraladigan muqobil hukumat yoki kuch. (Noyob ishlatilish)

ex: An antigram is a special type of anagram with an opposite meaning.
"United" and "untied" are an example of an antigram.
antigram.meta: Antigramma — bir so‘z yoki iboraning harflarini tartibini o‘zgartirib, ma’nosi asl so‘zga qarama-qarshi yoki zid bo‘lgan yangi so‘z yoki ibora hosil qilish.

ex: In ancient legal systems, the antigraphe was an essential part of the defense process.
The defendant submitted an antigraphe to deny the accusations.
antigraphe.meta: Yozma e’tiroz (antigraphe) — ayblanuvchi shaxs o‘zini oqlash yoki aybdan himoya qilish maqsadida ayblovga yozma ravishda bergan rasmiy javob yoki bayonot.

ex: As an anti-gunner, she supported background checks for all gun buyers.
The anti-gunners are calling for stricter gun laws to prevent violence.
anti-gunner.meta: Qurolga qarshi tarafdor — qurol-yarog‘ savdosini, egaligini yoki qurol ishlatishni cheklashni yoki nazorat qilishni qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs; qurol nazoratini talab qiluvchi odam.

ex: The anti-Jews in the region organized protests against the Jewish community.
The pamphlet was filled with anti-Jew messages and hateful propaganda.
anti-jew.meta: As an adjective (sifat sifatida): Yahudiylarga qarshi — yahudiylarga nisbatan diniy, madaniy yoki etnik asosda nafrat, kamsitish yoki dushmanlik bilan tavsiflanadigan.

ex: The book explores the roots of anti-Judaism in ancient religious conflicts.
Anti-Judaism was a serious issue in medieval Europe, often resulting in persecution.
anti-judaism.meta: Yahudiylikka qarshilik — yahudiy dini, yahudiylik e’tiqodi yoki yahudiy xalqiga nisbatan dushmanlik, nafrat yoki kamsitish. Bu diniy asosdagi qarshilik bo‘lib, ko‘pincha yahudiylik ta’limotlariga yoki yahudiy diniy amaliyotiga qarshi chiqishni bildiradi.

ex: The museum displayed antikas discovered in Syrian ruins.
The market in Cairo is famous for selling rare antikas from ancient Egypt.
antika.meta: Antika — asosan Yaqin Sharqda, xususan Misr yoki Suriyada topilgan qadimiy buyum yoki tarixiy artefakt. Bu odatda arxeologik ahamiyatga ega bo‘lgan va qadimgi davrlardan saqlanib qolgan buyumdir.

ex: Poets often use antimeria to create more vivid and unusual expressions.
In the phrase "Let’s movie tonight," the noun "movie" is used as a verb — this is an example of antimeria.
antimeria.meta: Antimeriya — stilistik usul bo‘lib, unda nutqdagi bir so‘z turkumi boshqa bir so‘z turkumi o‘rnida ishlatiladi. Bu usul ko‘pincha ta’sirchanlik yoki badiiy ifoda yaratish uchun qo‘llanadi. Enallaj (grammatik o‘rin almashtirish) usuliga o‘xshash.

ex: Anti-monarchal movements gained strength during the period of political unrest.
The revolution was driven by anti-monarchal sentiments among the people.
anti-monarchal.meta: Monarxiyaga qarshi — monarxiya tuzumiga, ya’ni qirol, malika yoki boshqa merosiy hukmdor boshchiligidagi boshqaruv shakliga qarshi bo‘lgan; monarxiyani yoqlamaydigan yoki unga dushmanlik qiladigan.

ex: Some sects were accused of promoting antinomial lifestyles that ignored traditional morality.
The preacher condemned the antinomial behavior of those who rejected moral laws.
antinomial.meta: Antinomial — antinomistlar e’tiqodi va amaliyotlariga oid; axloqiy cheklovlarni rad etuvchi yoki odob-axloqqa zid deb hisoblangan. Antinomistlar diniy qonun va axloqiy qoidalar inson uchun majburiy emas, deb hisoblashgan.

ex: Some sects were accused of promoting antinomial lifestyles that ignored traditional morality.
The preacher condemned the antinomial behavior of those who rejected moral laws.
antinomial.meta: Antinomial — antinomistlar e’tiqodi va amaliyotlariga oid; axloqiy cheklovlarni rad etuvchi yoki odob-axloqqa zid deb hisoblangan. Antinomistlar diniy qonun va axloqiy qoidalar inson uchun majburiy emas, deb hisoblashgan.

ex: The philosopher explored antinomial ideas about freedom and necessity.
His argument was antinomial, containing statements that directly contradicted each other.
antinomial.meta: Qarama-qarshilikka xos — o‘zida qarama-qarshilik yoki mantiqiy nomuvofiqlikni aks ettiruvchi; ichki ziddiyat yoki uyg‘unlik etishmasligi bilan tavsiflanadigan.

ex: The sect was known for its antinomical views on salvation and sin.
The preacher spoke against the antinomical beliefs that rejected moral laws.
antinomical.meta: Antinomizmga oid — antinomizm ta’limotiga yoki antinomistlarning e’tiqod va amaliyotlariga aloqador. Antinomizm — bu diniy va axloqiy qonunlarning majburiy emasligini ta’kidlaydigan falsafiy yoki diniy qarash.

ex: Some religious groups were accused of antinomism because they rejected traditional moral rules.
Antinomism teaches that strict obedience to religious laws is not essential for salvation.
antinomism.meta: Antinomizm — ayniqsa din yoki axloqiy sohalarda qonun-qoidalarga qat’iy rioya qilish zarurligini inkor etish yoki rad etish qarashi; inson axloqiy yoki diniy qonunlardan ozod deb hisoblanadigan e’tiqod.

ex: He was balls deep in his new business project and had no time for anything else.
In the middle of the night, they were balls deep in passion.
balls deep.meta: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri ma’no (qo‘pol slang, jinsiy): Erkak shaxs jinsiy aloqada bo‘lganda jinsiy a’zosining to‘liq kirishi holati. Ko‘chma ma’no: Biror ishga, vaziyatga yoki jarayonga juda chuqur va to‘liq darajada aralashgan yoki berilgan holat.

ex: Their dog has become quite chonky over the winter.
Look at that chonky cat, he’s so adorable!
chonky.meta: Chonky — aslida chunky (baquvvat, to‘ladan kelgan) so‘zining talaffuzga mos ravishda o‘zgargan ko‘rinishi bo‘lib, hozirda ko‘pincha hayvonlar, ayniqsa uy hayvonlari (mushuk, it) uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Oh, chur for the help!
Chur, mate! See you tomorrow!
chur.meta: Chur — uchrashishda yoki xayrlashishda yaxshi tilak bildirish, minnatdorchilik, ma’qullash yoki quvonch ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan norasmiy va do‘stona ifoda. Ingliz tilida "cheers!" so‘ziga mos keladi.

ex: Consensualism encourages open discussion and mutual respect in group settings.
The company follows consensualism in decision-making to ensure that all employees agree before taking action.
consensualism.meta: Konsensuschilik — har qanday faoliyat yoki qaror qabul qilishdan oldin barcha ishtirokchilarning roziligini olish yoki umumiy kelishuvga erishish tamoyili yoki amaliyoti.

ex: True consensuality requires open communication and voluntary participation.
The consensuality of the agreement was confirmed by all parties involved.
consensuality.meta: Rozilik holati — biror harakat, jarayon yoki qarorning barcha ishtirokchilar tomonidan o‘zaro kelishilgan va rozilik bildirilgan bo‘lish holati. Bu shuni anglatadiki, barcha tomonlar bir fikrga kelgan va harakat majburlikdan xoli amalga oshirilgan.

ex: The parties discussed the terms until they reached consensus ad idem.
Without consensus ad idem, the contract cannot be considered legally binding.
consensus ad idem.meta: Consensus ad idem — shartnoma huquqida barcha tomonlar shartnoma shartlari, mazmuni va mohiyatiga to‘liq va aniq rozilik bildirgan holat. Bu shartnomaning asosiy yaroqlilik shartlaridan biri bo‘lib, barcha ishtirokchilar bir fikrda ekanini anglatadi.

ex: The philosopher questioned whether consensus gentium truly proves universal truth.
The belief in the existence of a higher power was once considered a consensus gentium.
consensus gentium.meta: Consensus gentium — butun insoniyat yoki keng jamoatchilik tomonidan qabul qilingan, universal yoki keng tarqalgan kelishuv, fikr yoki e’tiqod. Bu tushuncha tarixan insoniyat orasida umumiy haqiqat yoki universal qarash sifatida qaralgan.

ex: The eight cards are wild in crazy eights and can change the suit.
We played crazy eights all evening with our friends.
crazy eight.meta: Crazy Eight — bu kartochka o‘yini bo‘lib, unda o‘yinchilar o‘z qo‘llaridagi kartalarni oldingi kartaning rangi yoki raqamiga mos ravishda qo‘yishga harakat qilishadi. Sakkizlik (8) kartasi maxsus karta bo‘lib, istalgan rangga o‘zgartirish huquqini beradi.

ex: Be careful with crazy glue, it bonds skin instantly.
He fixed the broken cup with crazy glue in just a few seconds.
crazy glue.meta: Crazy glue — kuchli va tez qotadigan yelim bo‘lib, asosan sianoakrilat asosida tayyorlanadi. Bu yelim juda kichik yuzalarni ham mustahkam biriktirish qobiliyatiga ega va ko‘pincha "super yelim" nomi bilan tanilgan.

ex: His crazy-making behavior drove everyone around him mad.
The constant noise from the construction was crazy-making.
crazy-making.meta: Aqlni charchatadigan, asab buzadigan — biror narsa yoki holat odamni mantiqsiz yoki nazoratsiz harakat qilishga olib keluvchi, ruhiy holatiga zarar yetkazuvchi, asabiylik yoki tushkunlik keltiradigan.

ex: Hey, crazy-pants, what are you doing up there?
Don’t listen to him, he’s a total crazy-pants.
crazy-pants.meta: Crazy-pants — Sarg‘aytiruvchi slang tarzida ishlatiladi. Odatda aql-idrokdan butunlay mahrum, g‘alati yoki mantiqsiz odam degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ba’zan masxarali yoki haqoratli ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: His back injury left him crippled-up for life.
After the accident, he was all crippled-up and could barely walk.
crippled-up.meta: Crippled-up — odatda kuyib qolgan, jiddiy jarohat olgan yoki tug‘ma nogironlik tufayli harakat qilish qobiliyati cheklangan odam haqida aytiladi. Ayniqsa, orqa yoki oyoqlarga shikast yetganda ishlatiladi.

ex: The old map showed a criss-crossing of trade routes.
The criss-crossing of paths in the park creates a beautiful pattern.
criss-crossing.meta: Criss-crossing — biror joyda yoki yuzada takror va takror kesib o‘tish, chiziqlarning kesishishi yoki qoplamasi. Bu tushuncha real shakllar (yo‘llar, chiziqlar, izlar) va ko‘chma ma’noda (murakkab aloqalar, qarama-qarshi yo‘nalishlar) ishlatiladi.

ex: The farmer walked along the criss-crossing paths between the fields.
The criss-crossing streets made the city difficult to navigate.
criss-crossing.meta: Criss-crossing — bir-birini takror va takror kesib o‘tadigan yoki chatishtirilgan chiziqlar, yo‘llar yoki tuzilishga ega bo‘lgan narsalarni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: In the play, the cuckolded husband becomes the subject of mockery.
He felt humiliated when he found out he had been cuckolded.
cuckolded.meta: Cuckolded — odatda er-xotin munosabatida ishlatiladi va erkak kishining turmush o‘rtog‘i unga xiyonat qilgan holatni bildiradi. Bu so‘z asosan erkakka nisbatan ishlatiladi va qadimdan ma’naviy yoki ijtimoiy kamsituvchi tusga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: He was known as a notorious cuckolder in the village.
The cuckolder in the story is never revealed.
cuckolder.meta: Cuckolder — boshqa erkakning xotini yoki rafiqasi bilan jinsiy aloqada bo‘lib, o‘sha erkakni xiyonat qilingan er (cuckold) holatiga tushiradigan shaxs. Odatda bu so‘z ayolning sevgilisi yoki unga yaqinlashgan erkak haqida aytiladi.

ex: Cuckolding is often used as a theme in classical literature.
The story revolves around the cuckolding of a proud husband.
cuckolding.meta: Bu atama odatda ayol tomonidan turmush o‘rtog‘iga xiyonat qilinishi yoki ayolning boshqa erkak bilan jinsiy aloqada bo‘lishi natijasida erkakning tahqirlangan deb hisoblanish holatini bildiradi.

ex: In the novel, the cuckolding character faced social disgrace.
The cuckolding wife had a secret lover.
cuckolding.meta: Cuckolding (sifat sifatida) — o‘z turmush o‘rtog‘iga xiyonat qilayotgan, nikohdagi sodiqlikni buzayotgan shaxs haqida aytiladi. Bu atama odatda ayollar uchun ishlatiladi, lekin umumiy holatda ham qo‘llanishi mumkin.

ex: They called the moderate politician a cuckservative for compromising on immigration.
The alt-right group dismissed him as just another cuckservative.
cuckservative.meta: U odatda konservator (an’anaviy qadriyatlarni himoya qiluvchi) siyosatchi yoki tarafdor bo‘lib, alt-right nuqtai nazaridan u o‘z qadriyatlariga xiyonat qilgan, murosaga ketgan yoki juda yumshoq deb hisoblanadi.

ex: Researchers studied methods of de-anonymization in big data.
De-anonymization of users on social media can lead to privacy violations.
de-anonymization.meta: Asosan internet, ma’lumotlar bazasi yoki boshqa tizimlarda kimligi noma’lum yoki yashirin bo‘lgan shaxs yoki ob’ekt haqida aniqlovchi ma’lumotlarni topish yoki oshkor qilish harakati.

ex: The software can de-anonymize large datasets to identify individuals.
Hackers tried to de-anonymize users by analyzing their data patterns.
de-anonymize.meta: De-anonymize — anonimlik holatini yo‘q qilish, ya’ni ilgari anonimlangan yoki yashirin bo‘lgan ma’lumotlardan shaxsni yoki identifikatsiyani aniqlash, topish harakati.

ex: Many people decorate their homes during Deepavali to welcome prosperity.+
Deepavali is celebrated with lights, fireworks, and family gatherings.
deepavali.meta: Deepavali — hind dinlari orasida keng nishonlanadigan yirik bayram. Odatda oktyabr yoki noyabr oylaridagi yangi oy davrida o‘tkaziladi.

ex: Information given on deep background can be used to inform reporting without naming the source.
The official spoke to the reporter on deep background about the upcoming policy changes.
deep background.meta: Deep background — jurnalistga, odatda hukumat rasmiylari tomonidan taqdim etilgan, maqolada to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri iqtibos keltirilmasdan, ammo uning mazmuni asosida ishlatilishi mumkin bo‘lgan ma’lumotlar.

ex: After the stressful meeting, he needed a deep breath to calm down.
She took a deep breath before starting her speech.
deep breath.meta: Deep breath — havoni kuchli yoki uzoq davomida chuqur tortish harakati. Ko‘pincha ko‘chma ma’noda ishlatiladi: o‘zini tinchlantirish, ruhiy barqarorlikni tiklash, ishonch to‘plash yoki muhim vaziyatga tayyorlanish uchun qisqa tanaffus olish.

ex: The armchair was upholstered in a deep-buttoned style, making it very comfortable and stylish.
The deep-buttoned sofa added elegance to the living room.
deep-buttoned.meta: Deep-buttoned — o‘rindiq, divan yoki boshqa yumshoq mebellarning yuzasi chuqur va muntazam joylashgan tugmalar bilan bezatilgan turini ifodalaydi. Bu uslub mebellarga o‘ziga xos qimmatbaho va bezakli ko‘rinish beradi.

ex: After the construction work, the office needed a deep clean.
The hospital underwent a deep clean to prevent infections.
deep clean.meta: Deep clean — biror joy yoki narsani e’tibor bilan, puxta va har tomonlama tozalash harakati yoki jarayoni. Odatda bu ish zararkunandalarning tarqalishini oldini olish, gigiyena va sanitariya talablarini ta’minlash maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: We hired a deep cleaner to thoroughly clean the carpets.
The deep cleaner used special disinfectants to clean the hospital rooms.
deep cleaner.meta: Deep cleaner — biror narsani yoki joyni e’tibor bilan, puxta va har tomonlama tozalaydigan shaxs yoki vosita. Odatda bu tozalash zararkunandalar va infeksiyalar tarqalishini oldini olish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: After the renovation, the office required a thorough deep cleaning.
Deep cleaning of the hospital is necessary to maintain hygiene.
deep cleaning.meta: Deep cleaning — biror narsani yoki joyni e’tibor bilan, puxta va har tomonlama tozalash jarayoni. Bu jarayon odatda zararkunandalarning tarqalishini va infeksiya oldini olish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The hospital uses deep-cleaning equipment to maintain hygiene standards.
We bought a deep-cleaning detergent for the kitchen floor.
deep-cleaning.meta: Deep-cleaning — narsalarni yoki joylarni puxta va har tomonlama tozalashga mo‘ljallangan, ayniqsa zararkunandalar va infeksiya tarqalishini oldini olish uchun ishlatiladigan. Bunday vosita yoki jarayon chuqur va puxta tozalashni ta’minlaydi.

ex: Deepfake technology can be used both for entertainment and for harmful purposes.
The politician was targeted by a deepfake video showing him saying things he never said.
deepfake.meta: Deepfake — turli media turlaridan biri, ayniqsa video, raqamli tarzda manipulyatsiya qilingan, unda bir kishining yuz qiyofasi boshqa bir kishining yuziga ishontiruvchi tarzda almashtirilgan.

ex: She bought a deep-filled pie with lots of meat and vegetables.
The sandwich was deep-filled, making it very satisfying.
deep-filled.meta: Deep-filled — piroglar, sendvichlar va shunga o‘xshash taomlar uchun ishlatiladi; odatdagidan chuqurroq va ko‘proq to‘ldirilgan, ya’ni ichligi ko‘p bo‘lgan degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: Many fishermen engage in deep fishing to catch large sea fish.
Deep fishing requires specialized equipment to reach the bottom of the sea.
deep fishing.meta: Deep fishing — chuqur suvda, ayniqsa dengizning chuqur qatlamlarida baliq ovlash faoliyati. Bu turdagi baliq ovlash maxsus uskunalar va qayiqlarni talab qiladi.

ex: Deep focus allows multiple layers of action to be visible at the same time.
The director used deep focus to keep both the foreground and background sharp in the scene
deep focus.meta: Deep focus — fotografiya va kinorejissura sohasida ishlatiladigan kamera texnikasi yoki sozlamasi, bunda kamera orqali olingan suratda oldidagi va orqadagi ob’ektlar birdek aniq ko‘rinadi, ya’ni tasvirning chuqurlik maydoni keng bo‘ladi.

ex: Deep-sea divers need specialized training and equipment for safety.
The deep-sea diver explored the underwater cave.
deep-sea diver.meta: Deep-sea diver — chuqur dengizda sho‘ng‘ish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxs. Ular maxsus jihozlar yordamida dengiz tubiga chuqur sho‘ng‘ib, ilmiy tadqiqotlar, texnik xizmatlar yoki qidiruv-qutqaruv ishlarini bajaradi.

ex: Many companies use deep-sea diving for underwater construction and repairs.
Deep-sea diving requires special training and equipment due to high pressure and risks.
deep-sea diving.meta: Deep-sea diving — standart ko‘ngilochar sho‘ng‘ishdan ancha chuqurroq chuqurliklarda amalga oshiriladigan sho‘ng‘ish turi. Odatda tijorat maqsadlarida bajariladi va maxsus jihozlar yordamida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Deep songs are an important part of Andalusian Romani culture.
The singer performed a deep song full of passion and sorrow.
deep song.meta: Deep song — Andalusiya romanlari an’anaviy kuylaydigan flamenko qo‘shig‘ining bir turi, chuqur va kuchli hissiy ifoda bilan ajralib turadi; ispan tilida cante hondo deb ham ataladi.

ex: The concept of the deep state is often discussed in political debates and conspiracy theories.
Some believe that the deep state controls the government behind the scenes.
deep state.meta: maxfiy tarzda davlat siyosatini yoki boshqaruvini manipulyatsiya qilayotgan, rasmiy hukumatdan mustaqil yoki unga qarama-qarshi faoliyat yuritayotgan tashkilot yoki guruh.

ex: Deep throaters often risk their careers to expose wrongdoing.
The deep throater provided crucial evidence about corruption within the company.
deep throater.meta: Deep throater — bir tashkilot ichida ishlaydigan va boshqa a’zolar tomonidan sodir etilgan noto‘g‘ri harakatlar yoki qonunbuzarliklar haqida anonim ravishda ma’lumot yetkazuvchi shaxs. Bu atama ko‘pincha siyosiy yoki korporativ muhitda ishlatiladi.

ex: Déformation professionnelle can lead to biased decisions in certain fields.
The lawyer’s opinion showed signs of déformation professionnelle.
déformation professionnelle.meta: Déformation professionnelle — shaxsning kasbi yoki faoliyat sohasiga xos qarashlari, ideologiyalari yoki dunyoqarashi shu kasb ta’sirida keskin shakllanib, ularga qaram yoki qisman noto‘g‘ri qarashi holati.

ex: The depthness of his knowledge impressed everyone.
The depthness of the ocean makes exploration difficult.
depthness.meta: Depthness — chuqurlikka ega bo‘lish sifati yoki holati; biror narsaning chuqur yoki keng qamrovli ekanligini ifodalaydi.

ex: After staying up all night, he looked a bit dipsy and confused
She was dipsy about the new movie and couldn’t stop talking about it.
dipsy.meta: Dipsy — dastlab (about yoki over bilan) ishlatilganda: juda hayajonlangan, biror narsaga oshiqib qolgan, ko‘ngli o‘chgan. Keyinchalik ko‘proq ahmoqona, bexush, boshini yo‘qotgan, aqlan biroz dangasa yoki beparvo odam ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The stock market has been on a dipsy-do all week, making investors nervous.
The car made a sudden dipsy-do to avoid the obstacle.
dipsy-do.meta: tez va kutilmagan yo‘nalish o‘zgarishi, tebranish yoki siljish harakati. Ko‘pincha bu so‘z rasmiy bo‘lmagan nutqda ishlatiladi va ma’no figurativ ham bo‘lishi mumkin, ya’ni hayotdagi yoki vaziyatdagi birdaniga va notekis o‘zgarishlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: She quickly dipsy-doed past her opponent with an impressive fake move.
The football player dipsy-doed around the defender to get a clear shot at the goal.
dipsy-do.meta: Dipsy-do – bu sport kontekstida ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, raqibni chalg‘itish, aldash yoki uni noto‘g‘ri yo‘lga boshlash uchun bajariladigan tez, mohirona, kutilmagan harakatlar yoki taktikalardan foydalanishni anglatadi.

ex: His mood went into a dipsy-doodle after hearing the surprising news.
The boat made a dipsy-doodle as it hit the rough waves.
dipsy-doodle.meta: Dipsy-doodle — tez va kutilmagan yo‘nalish o‘zgarishi, tebranish, siljish yoki burilish harakati yoki harakatlar ketma-ketligi. Ko‘pincha so‘z figurativ ma’noda ishlatiladi, ya’ni hayotdagi yoki vaziyatdagi notekis va o‘zgaruvchan holatlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: The child dipsy-doodled along the sidewalk, moving up and down unpredictably.
The player dipsy-doodled past the defenders in a zigzag motion.
dipsy-doodle.meta: Dipsy-doodle – bu to‘g‘ri yo‘nalishda emas, balki zigzag, egri-bugri yoki tebranma harakat bilan yurish yoki harakatlanishni anglatadi. Bu harakat odatda tartibsiz, noaniq va oldindan bilish qiyin bo‘lgan yo‘nalishda bo‘ladi.

ex: A well-executed droppie can quickly change the momentum of a rugby match.
He secured the win for his team with a droppie in the final minutes
droppie.meta: Droppie – Regbi yoki Avstraliya futbolida to‘pni yerga tushirib, yerga tegishi bilanoq tepib darvozaga yoki o‘yin maydoniga zarba berish orqali amalga oshiriladigan harakat. Bu usul orqali urilgan gol "drop goal" deb ataladi.

ex: They hurried to set up camp in the duskening light.
The duskening sky signaled the end of their journey.
duskening.meta: Duskening – Kunduzdan tunga o‘tish paytida yoki yorug‘lik asta-sekin kamayib, atrof qorong‘ilashayotgan holatni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: The sky glowed faintly in the duskus before night fully descended.
They arrived at the village just as duskus was settling over the fields.
duskus.meta: Duskus – Kech tushish arafasida, quyosh botib, yorug‘lik kamaygan, lekin hali to‘liq tun boshlanmagan vaqt. Bu holat shom yoki qorong‘ilikning boshlanishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘lib, odatda kun bilan tun o‘rtasidagi o‘tish davrini ifodalaydi.

ex: There was a brief ease-up in the fighting before it resumed again.
After hours of hard work, the team finally got an ease-up
ease-up.meta: Ease-up – Kuchli yoki og‘ir faoliyatdan so‘ng, yoki murakkab vaziyat davomida qisqa muddatli tinchlik yoki dam olish davri. Ba’zan bosim yoki qattiqlikni kamaytirish harakati ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Although labeled as an easybeat, the underdog surprised everyone with a strong performance.
They considered the opposing team an easybeat and didn’t prepare seriously.
easybeat.meta: Easybeat – Sportda yengish oson deb hisoblanadigan, kuchsiz yoki raqobatbardoshligi past bo‘lgan sportchi yoki jamoa. Bunday raqiblar odatda boshqa kuchli jamoalar yoki sportchilar tomonidan tez va oson yengiladi.

ex: Ebonizing can transform ordinary wood into something that looks like rare ebony.
The craftsman used ebonizing to give the table a luxurious black finish.
ebonizing.meta: Yog‘ochni maxsus bo‘yoqlar yoki kimyoviy moddalar yordamida qora rangga bo‘yash jarayoni. Bu usul yog‘ochni abanos yog‘ochiga o‘xshatish uchun qo‘llaniladi. Abanos yog‘ochi qimmat bo‘lgani uchun bu texnika arzonroq yog‘ochlarni bezashda ishlatiladi.

ex: Come with me, e hoa, let’s explore the forest together.
Kia ora, e hoa, how are you today?
e hoa.meta: E hoa – Asosan yaqin do‘stga yoki tanish kishiga murojaat qilish uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. Bu so‘z "do‘st" yoki "birodar" ma’nosida samimiy chaqirish yoki suhbat davomida ishlatiladi. Maorilik (Yangi Zelandiya mahalliy xalqi) tilidan olingan ibora.

ex: Let’s go, e hoa ma, the journey is waiting!
Kia ora, e hoa ma, welcome to our home!
e hoa ma.meta: E hoa ma – Bir guruh odamga murojaat qilganda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, "do‘stlar", "birodarlar" yoki "azizlar" ma’nosida samimiy va hurmat bilan chaqirish shaklidir. Bu so‘z Maorilik (Yangi Zelandiya mahalliy xalqi) tilida ishlatiladi.

ex: The constant fetishizing of beauty standards in media harms people’s self-esteem.
Fetishizing of wealth can lead people to ignore more important values like kindness and honesty.
fetishizing.meta: Fetishizing – Biror narsani keragidan ortiq ulug‘lash, uni mantiqsiz darajada muhim deb bilish yoki unga haddan tashqari e’tibor berish jarayoni.

ex: The flatette was small but cozy and perfect for a student.
She rented a flatette near the city center.
flatette.meta: Flatette – Odatda bitta yoki ikkita xonadan iborat bo‘lgan kichik hajmdagi kvartira yoki xonadon. Bu turdagi yashash joylari odatda yolg‘iz odamlar yoki kichik oilalar uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: The car was going flat stick down the highway.
When the alarm went off, they ran flat stick to the exit.
flat stick.meta: Flat stick – Juda tez, maksimal tezlikda yoki imkon boricha kuchli harakat qilish holati. Odatda shoshilish yoki favqulodda holatlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Her story had a folklorical charm, filled with old legends and mythical creatures.
The museum displayed folklorical costumes from different regions.
folklorical.meta: Folklorical – Xalq og‘zaki ijodi, afsonalar, rivoyatlar, xalq ertaklari, urf-odatlar yoki an’analar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan yoki shu asosga ega bo‘lgan narsalarni ifodalovchi sifat. Bu so‘z odatda madaniy, tarixiy yoki san’at asarlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: The hero’s journey is folklorically similar to legends passed down through generations.
The story was told folklorically, with traditional themes and moral lessons.
folklorically.meta: Folklorically – Xalq og‘zaki ijodi nuqtai nazaridan yoki xalq og‘zaki ijodiga xos uslubda; ertak, afsona, urf-odat yoki an’anaviy xalq hikoyalari shaklida yoki uslubida tasvirlash yoki ifodalash holati.

ex: Hospitals must provide special services for the frail aged to ensure their safety.
The government has introduced new care programs for the frail aged.
frail aged.meta: Frail aged – Odatda keksalik tufayli jismonan yoki ruhiy jihatdan kuchsiz, zaif bo‘lib qolgan, yordam va parvarishga muhtoj bo‘lgan odamlar. Bu ibora ko‘pincha qarindoshlar yoki ijtimoiy xizmat ko‘rsatish tizimida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Some schools have banned freak dancing at student events.
The club was full of people freak dancing to loud music.
freak dancing.meta: Freak dancing – Odatda erkak va ayol juftlik yaqin masofada raqsga tushadigan, tana harakatlari jinsiy jihatdan ochiq va provokatsion bo‘ladigan raqs uslubi.

ex: The 1960s were full of freakos who rejected traditional society.
He was considered a freako for his eccentric clothes and wild lifestyle.
freako.meta: Odatda salbiy yoki kulgili ohangda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, noodatiy kiyinish, g‘ayrioddiy fikrlash yoki 1960-yillardagi qarshi madaniyat bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan erkin, ozod, ba’zan esa jamiyat qoidalariga zid yashaydigan odamni ifodalaydi.

ex: That movie was full of freaky-deaky scenes.
They like to do the freaky-deaky on weekends.
freaky-deaky.meta: Freaky-deaky – Odatdagidan farq qiluvchi, noodatiy yoki g‘alati jinsiy faoliyat yoki harakat. Bu ibora ko‘pincha hazil yoki yengil ohangda ishlatiladi va ba’zan umumiy tarzda noodatiy, g‘alati yoki qiziq narsalarni ifodalash uchun ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: He was later identified as a genocidaire responsible for leading mass killings.
The court sentenced several genocidaires for their roles in the 1994 Rwandan massacre.
genocidaire.meta: Genocidaire – Genotsid (ma’lum bir etnik, diniy yoki milliy guruhni yo‘q qilishga qaratilgan harakat)da qatnashgan yoki uni amalga oshirgan odam.

ex: Some historians accuse the regime of being led by genocidists.
The court identified him as a leading genocidist during the civil war.
genocidist.meta: Genocidist – Genotsid (biror millat, etnik yoki diniy guruhni ataylab va tizimli ravishda yo‘q qilish)ni amalga oshirgan yoki unda faol ishtirok etgan odam.

ex: Some people enjoy taking the gimp role in consensual adult activities.
In the movie, the character dressed as a gimp during a BDSM scene.
gimp.meta: Jinsiy rollarda bo‘ysunuvchi yoki to‘liq itoat etuvchi shaxs, ayniqsa BDSM (bog‘lash, hukmronlik, sadomazoxizm) faoliyatida qatnashuvchi odam. Odatda bunday shaxs boshqalarning buyruqlarini bajaradi va ba’zan butun tanani qoplaydigan teri kiyim kiyadi.

ex: Golly gosh, that was an amazing performance!
Golly gosh, I didn’t expect to see you here!
golly gosh.meta: Golly gosh – Hayrat, hayajon, qiziqish yoki kuchli ta’sirni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan yumshoq va odatda muloyim undov so‘z. Ba’zan shunchaki gapga urg‘u berish uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Many Greek Cypriots emigrated to other countries in the 20th century.
The island is divided between Greek Cypriots and Turkish Cypriots.
greek cypriot.meta: Greek Cypriot – Kipr orolida, ayniqsa uning asosan yunonlar yashaydigan janubiy qismida tug‘ilgan yoki yashovchi yunon millatiga mansub shaxs.

ex: The groomswoman stood proudly beside the groom during the ceremony.
His sister was honored to be his groomswoman at the wedding.
groomswoman.meta: Groomswoman – To‘y marosimida kuyovning yonida turadigan va unga yordam beradigan ayol. Odatda bu rol erkak "groomsman"larga xos bo‘lsa-da, ba’zan kuyov o‘z yaqin do‘stlaridan ayol kishini ham yordamchi sifatida tanlashi mumkin.

ex: Nobody expected him to be a groomzilla, but he wanted everything to be perfect.
He turned into a total groomzilla, stressing over every little decoration.
groomzilla.meta: Groomzilla – To‘y tayyorgarligi bilan shug‘ullanayotganda barcha mayda detallarni haddan tashqari nazorat qiladigan, juda talabchan, boshqalarni siqib qo‘yadigan va o‘ta ta’sirchan kuyov. Bu so‘z kulgili va biroz salbiy ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: She is proud of her Gullah–Geechee heritage.
The festival celebrated Gullah–Geechee traditions and cuisine.
gullah–geechee.meta: Gulla va Gichi (Geechee) deb ataladigan afro-amerikalik etnik guruhga mansub yoki ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan. Ular asosan Amerika Qo‘shma Shtatlarining Janubiy Atlantika sohilida, xususan Janubiy Karolina, Jorjiya va Florida shtatlarida yashaydilar.

ex: His life story includes years of hoboing across the country.
During the Great Depression, many young men turned to hoboing to find work.
hoboing.meta: Hoboing – Ish yoki boshpana izlab shahar-shahar yurish, doimiy yashash joyiga ega bo‘lmay, ko‘pincha poyezdlarda yoki piyoda sayohat qilib yashash

ex: Many people travel home during the holiday season.
The holiday season is the busiest time for shops and restaurants.
holiday season.meta: Holiday season – Odatda Rojdestvo bayrami (Christmas) davrini anglatadi; keyingi yillarda bu atama kengroq ma’noda minnatdorchilik kuni (Thanksgiving) dan boshlab Yangi yilgacha bo‘lgan butun bayram vaqtini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: He was fined for hooning after performing burnouts in a residential area.
The police cracked down on hooning in the city streets.
hooning.meta: Hooning – Odatda yoshlar tomonidan sodir etiladigan, jamiyat tomonidan nomaqbul deb hisoblanadigan beparvo, tajovuzkor yoki javobgarlik hissidan yiroq xatti-harakatlar.

ex: The street was filled with hoonish behavior late at night.
His hoonish driving frightened other motorists.
hoonish.meta: Hoonish – Odatda "hoon" (xavfli haydovchi yoki tartib buzuvchi shaxs)ga xos bo‘lgan xatti-harakatlar yoki xarakterni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z beparvo, tajovuzkor, xavfli va boshqalarga zarar yetkazishi mumkin bo‘lgan xulq-atvorni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Misunderstandings often arise from idola fori, where words are used imprecisely.
Philosophers warn against falling victim to idola fori when interpreting complex ideas.
idolon fori.meta: Idolon fori – Asosan ko‘plikda ishlatiladi. Tilda noaniq, chalkash yoki noto‘g‘ri ishlatilgan ifodalar sababli yuzaga keladigan yolg‘on yoki chalg‘ituvchi e’tiqod yoki tushuncha.

ex: Personal prejudices can create idola specus that prevent objective reasoning.
He could not see beyond his idola specus, which limited his understanding of the problem.
idolon specus.meta: Idolon specus – Asosan ko‘plikda ishlatiladi. Bu shaxsiy fikr, tajriba yoki ichki xatolar sababli yuzaga keladigan yolg‘on yoki noto‘g‘ri tushunchalar. Bu atama ingliz faylasufi Frensis Bekon tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan

ex: The professor challenged the idola theatri that dominated his field for decades.
Scientists must be careful not to fall into idola theatri by blindly following outdated theories.
idolon theatri.meta: Idolon theatri – Asosan ko‘plikda ishlatiladi. Bu empirik (tajribaga asoslangan) dalillarga zid holda, nazariy dogmalarga (o‘rnatilgan fikr yoki tizimlarga) haddan tashqari ishonish tufayli yuzaga keladigan yolg‘on yoki noto‘g‘ri e’tiqoddir.

ex: The scientist warned against the idolon tribus that arises from trusting human senses too much.
People often fall into the idolon tribus by assuming that nature works according to human expectations.
idolon tribus.meta: Idolon tribus — Bu tushuncha Frensis Bekon tomonidan kiritilgan bo‘lib, inson tabiatiga haddan tashqari ishonish, ya'ni inson o‘z tabiiy qobiliyatlari va sezgilari doirasida haqiqatni to‘liq tushuna oladi, degan xato yoki noto‘g‘ri e'tiqoddir.

ex: she was chosen as the kaitiaki of the river to protect its health and resources.
the kaitiaki of the forest ensured that the trees were not cut down unnecessarily.
kaitiaki.meta: kaitiaki — asosan maoriy madaniyatida ishlatiladigan tushuncha bo‘lib, biror hudud yoki tabiat boyliklarining qo‘riqchisi, himoyachisi yoki boshqaruvchisi. kaitiaki shaxs bo‘lishi, hayvon, o‘simlik yoki hatto ruhiy kuch ham bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: she became a respected kaumatua in her community.
the kaumatua spoke to the young people about the traditions of their ancestors.
kaumatua.meta: kaumatua — asosan maoriy madaniyatida hurmatli, tajribali va jamoaning katta a'zosi, oqsoqol. Ular jamiyatda muhim maslahatchi va yo‘lko‘rsatuvchi sifatida tan olinadi.

ex: their kaupapa focuses on supporting indigenous communities.+
the kaupapa of the organisation is to promote environmental protection.
kaupapa.meta: kaupapa — asosan maoriy madaniyatida ishlatiladigan tushuncha bo‘lib, biror tamoyil, siyosat yoki falsafa ma'nosini anglatadi. Bu shaxs, guruh yoki tashkilotning asosiy maqsadi, qadriyatlari va yo‘nalishini ifodalaydi.

ex: in māori tradition, a kehua may appear to deliver a message to the living.
the kehua was said to haunt the old house.
kehua.meta: kehua — maoriy madaniyatida vafot etgan insonning ruhi yoki arvoh. Kehua – odatda ko‘rinmas yoki ba'zan ko‘rinadigan shaklda bo‘lib, o‘liklarning dunyodagi mavjudligini bildiradi.

ex: the girl kinkled her hair into small curls.
the rope began to kinkle after being twisted too many times.
kinkle.meta: (noto‘g‘ri yoki tartibsiz burilish): burishmoq, qiyshaymoq, tugun bo‘lish.(soch haqida): jingalak bo‘lish, bukilish, burilib qolish.(eski ma'noda, o‘rta asr inglizchasida): biror narsani, ayniqsa sochni, jingalak yoki bukma holatga keltirmoq.

ex: the article was accused of kink-shaming people with non-traditional preferences.
you shouldn’t kink-shame someone for what they enjoy in their private life.
kink-shame.meta: kink-shame — kimnidir noodatiy yoki odatiy bo‘lmagan jinsiy qiziqishlari yoki amaliyotlari tufayli masxara qilish, tanqid qilish yoki uyaltirish. Bu atama odatda jinsiy erkinlik va qabul qilish g‘oyalariga qarshi bo‘lgan holatlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: the forum warned users against acting like kink-shamers.
don’t be a kink-shamer; respect people’s private choices.
kink-shamer.meta: kink-shamer — noodatiy yoki jamiyatda qabul qilinmagan deb hisoblangan jinsiy odat yoki qiziqishlarga ega bo‘lgan insonlarni masxara qiluvchi, kamsituvchi yoki tanqid qiluvchi shaxs.

ex: the group promotes sex positivity and rejects kink-shaming.
kink-shaming can create feelings of guilt and low self-esteem in people.
kink-shaming.meta: kink-shaming — noodatiy yoki jamiyat odatiy deb hisoblamaydigan jinsiy amaliyotlarga ega yoki shunday xohishlarga moyil bo‘lgan insonlarni masxara qilish, tanqid qilish yoki ularni kamsitish amaliyoti.

ex: they made a kink-shaming comment about non-traditional relationships.
the article received backlash for its kink-shaming tone.
kink-shaming.meta: kink-shaming — noodatiy yoki jamiyat odatiy deb bilmaydigan jinsiy xohishlar yoki amaliyotlarga ega bo‘lgan insonlarni masxara qiluvchi, tanqid qiluvchi yoki kamsituvchi tavsif.

ex: kinksters often gather in online communities to share experiences.
as a proud kinkster, he openly discussed his preferences in safe spaces.
kinkster.meta: kinkster — noodatiy yoki jamiyat tomonidan odatiy deb hisoblanmaydigan jinsiy amaliyotlar yoki qiziqishlar bilan shug‘ullanuvchi yoki shunday xohishlarga ega bo‘lgan inson.

ex: the film captures the spirit and Kiwiness of New Zealand life.
his Kiwiness was evident in his relaxed attitude and love for the outdoors.
kiwiness.meta: kiwiness — yangi zelandiyalik bo‘lish sifati yoki holati. Shuningdek, bu atama Yangi Zelandiya yoki yangi zelandiyaliklarga xos bo‘lgan xarakter, urf-odat, madaniyat va turmush tarzini ifodalaydi.

ex: the organization follows the principles of knight templary in their ceremonies.
he studied the knight templary to understand the history of the Templar knights.
knight templary.meta: knight templary — templier ryitsarlari (xususan, mason templier ryitsarlari) tamoyillari, amaliyotlari va tashkilotlari majmui. Bu tushuncha o‘rta asrlardagi diniy-saroylik ryitsarlarining hayoti, urf-odatlari va tartiblarini anglatadi.

ex: giving koha is an important part of Māori culture.
visitors brought koha to show respect to the hosts.
koha.meta: koha — sovg‘a, ehson, xayriya yoki xayriya maqsadida berilgan hadya. Maoriy madaniyatida bu atama, odatda, hurmat, minnatdorchilik yoki ijtimoiy munosabatlarni mustahkamlash maqsadida beriladigan sovg‘a yoki xayriya uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: she likes to korero with her elders to learn about traditions.
they sat down to korero about the upcoming event.
korero.meta: korero — asosan maoriy madaniyatida ishlatiladigan fe’l bo‘lib, gapirish, so‘zlashish yoki munozara o‘tkazish ma'nolarini anglatadi.

ex: my kuia told me stories about our ancestors.
the kuia led the ceremony with wisdom and respect.
kuia.meta: maoriy madaniyatida yoshi katta ayol, ayniqsa oila yoki jamoaning hurmatga sazovor oqsoqol ayoli. Shuningdek, kuia so‘zi ko‘pincha buvingizni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Ular oilada va jamoada donolik, tajriba va madaniyatni saqlashda muhim o‘rin tutadi.

ex: don’t be such a lame-o, come hang out with us!
that movie was totally lame-o, I didn’t enjoy it at all.
