lame-o.meta: lame-o — sifati past yoki qiymatsiz narsaga nisbatan ishlatiladi; yetarlicha yaxshi bo‘lmagan, dangasa, qiziqarsiz, yoki ijtimoiy jihatdan mos kelmaydigan odamni ta’riflash uchun ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: lamestream news outlets often ignore alternative viewpoints.
many people distrust the lamestream media because of biased reporting.
lamestream.meta: lamestream — asosiy ommaviy axborot vositalarini tanqid qilish uchun ishlatiladigan atama

ex: they climbed the maunga to perform a traditional ceremony.
the maunga is a sacred place for the local Māori people.
maunga.meta: maunga — maoriy madaniyatida tog‘ni anglatadi, ayniqsa madaniy va ruhiy ahamiyatga ega bo‘lgan joy sifatida ko‘riladi. Maunga ko‘plab jamoalar uchun muqaddas joy, meros va tabiat bilan bog‘liq kuch manbai hisoblanadi.

ex: she proudly wore her moko kauae to show her status in the tribe.
the moko kauae is a symbol of pride and identity for Māori women.
moko kauae.meta: moko kauae — maoriy ayollar orasida an’anaviy ravishda og‘iz atrofidagi lab sohasiga solinadigan tatuirovka. Bu tatuirovka ularning ijtimoiy maqomi, mavqei va nasabini ifodalaydi.

ex: the match was like a murderball, full of intense physical clashes.
murderball is a rough game that requires strength and agility.
murderball.meta: murderball — dastlab AQShda paydo bo‘lgan, qoidalari kam va jismoniy kurashga tayanadigan to‘p o‘yini. Bu o‘yin ragbi va futbolning ayrim jihatlarini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: his over-dressy outfit didn’t fit the informal meeting.
she was over-dressy for the casual party.
over-dressy.meta: over-dressy — kiyinishda juda bezatilgan, ortiqcha nafis yoki rasmiy bo‘lib, voqea yoki muhitga mos kelmaydigan holat. Bu sifat odamning kiyinish uslubi juda ko‘p e’tibor tortuvchi, bezatilgan yoki tartibsiz ko‘rinishda ekanini bildiradi.

ex: he was a pai marire follower and embraced both Christian and Māori beliefs.
the pai marire movement played a key role in resisting land confiscation.
pai marire.meta: Pai Marire — 19-asrda Yangi Zelandiyada yuzaga kelgan maoriy diniy harakat bo‘lib, unda nasroniylik va maoriy ruhiy elementlar birlashgan. Bu harakat asosan yerlarning musodara qilinishiga qarshi kurashish uchun mashhur bo‘lgan.

ex: passwordless login methods often use biometrics or security keys.
many apps are moving towards passwordless authentication for better security.
passwordless.meta: passwordless — ayniqsa kompyuter tizimi yoki xizmatlari uchun ishlatiladi; parol ishlatmaydigan yoki parol talab qilmaydigan. Ko‘pincha, parol o‘rniga boshqa xavfsizlik usullaridan (masalan, barmoq izi, yuzni tanish, xavfsizlik kaliti) foydalaniladi.

ex: the term "peen" is informal and often used in casual speech.
he joked about the size of his peen.
peen.meta: peen — erkak jinsiy a’zosi, jinsiy aloqada va siydik chiqarishda ishtirok etuvchi tana qismi. Bu so‘z ko‘proq norasmiy yoki og‘zaki nutqda ishlatiladi.

ex: the pepeha connects the individual to their land and ancestors.
each Māori person recites their pepeha to introduce themselves.
pepeha.meta: pepeha — maoriy guruh yoki qabila o‘zini ma’lum bir joy va ajdodlari bilan bog‘lash orqali tanishtiradigan bayonot. Bu ifoda odamlarning kimligini, ularning ildizlari va mintaqaviy aloqalarini ko‘rsatadi.

ex: the device uses plasmonic effects to enhance sensor sensitivity.
plasmonic materials can manipulate light at the nanoscale.
plasmonic.meta: plasmonik — fizika sohasida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, plasmonlar bilan bog‘liq energiya chiqarish yoki boshqa energiya uzatish mexanizmlarini ifodalaydi.

ex: during the powhiri, speeches and traditional songs are performed.
the powhiri is an important ceremony to welcome guests in Māori culture.
powhiri.meta: powhiri — maoriy madaniyatida mehmonlarni iliq kutib olish uchun o‘tkaziladigan an’anaviy marosim. Bu marosimda ko‘plab urf-odatlar va rasm-rusumlar bajariladi, ularni hurmat va samimiylik ramzi sifatida qabul qilishadi.

ex: pre-arrest bail helps prevent unnecessary detention before trial.
he applied for pre-arrest bail fearing arrest on false charges.
pre-arrest bail.meta: pre-arrest bail — ayniqsa Janubiy Osiyo mamlakatlarida qo‘llaniladigan tushuncha bo‘lib, ayblovchi hali hibsga olinmasdan oldin, unga nisbatan qo‘yilgan ayblovlar bo‘yicha hibsga olinmaslik uchun beriladigan kafolat.

ex: the economy was stronger in the pre-pandemic years.
pre-pandemic travel habits were very different from those during the pandemic.
pre-pandemic.meta: pre-pandemic — pandemiya boshlanishidan oldingi davr yoki holatlarni ifodalaydi. Hozirgi kunda ko‘pincha aynan COVID-19 pandemiyasidan oldingi davr haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

ex: during the rahui, no fishing or swimming is allowed.
a rahui was placed on the beach to protect marine life.
rahui.meta: rahui — maoriy madaniyatida ma'lum bir hududga kirish yoki ma'lum faoliyat bilan shug‘ullanishni rasmiy yoki marosimiy tarzda vaqtincha taqiqlash. Odatda bu taqiq tabiatni asrash, resurslarni tiklash yoki hurmat yuzasidan qo‘yiladi.

ex: the program was designed to support rangatahi in education and employment.
the rangatahi are the future leaders of the Māori community.
rangatahi.meta: rangatahi — maoriy madaniyatida yoshlar, yigit-qizlar yoki umumiy holda yosh avlod vakillari. Rangatahi so‘zi maoriy jamiyatida kelajak avlodi, umid va o‘sib kelayotgan yoshlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: the chiefs exercised rangatiratanga over their lands and people.
rangatiratanga is a key principle in Māori self-determination.
rangatiratanga.meta: rangatiratanga — maoriy madaniyatida dastlab boshliq bo‘lish, qabilaning yetakchiligi yoki zodagonlik maqomini bildirgan.

ex: she speaks fluent reo and teaches it at the local school.
they are working to revitalize the reo among young people.
reo.meta: reo — umumiy ma’noda til degani, lekin maoriy kontekstida bu atama ko‘pincha bevosita maoriy tili (Te Reo Māori) ni anglatadi. Reo – maoriy xalqining madaniy va milliy o‘zligini ifodalovchi muhim til sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: they traveled across the rohe to visit other tribes.
each Māori iwi has its own rohe.
rohe.meta: rohe — maoriy madaniyatida ma’lum bir qabilaga tegishli hudud yoki qabila chegarasi. Kengroq ma’noda, rohe har qanday geografik hudud, mintaqa yoki zona sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin.

ex: don’t give me that shuck and jive, just tell me the truth.
the politician’s response was just shuck and jive to avoid the real issue.
shuck and jive.meta: shuck and jive — aslida bu ibora tarixiy jihatdan Afrika-Amerika jamiyatida shakllangan bo‘lib, hozirgi kunda ba’zan kamsituvchi yoki nojo‘ya ma’no kasb etishi mumkin.

ex: he parked his car all sigogglin across the lines.
the picture was hanging sigogglin on the wall.
sigogglin.meta: sigogglin — narsa yoki kimsaning diagonal tarzda, qiya yoki yon tomonga og‘ib turgan holatini ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z tartibsiz, yonboshlagan, egri yoki chalg‘igan holatlarni tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: She was always a bit of a skelpie in her youth.
The old woman scolded the skelpie who ran through her garden.
skelpie.meta: Skelpie — Odatda beadab, sho‘x, qoidalarga bo‘ysunmaydigan bola (ko‘pincha qiz bola) uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. Shuningdek, qadimiy yoki dialektal kontekstlarda hech qanday qadri yo‘q yoki past baholangan odamga nisbatan ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The baby gets snitchy when she’s tired.
Don’t talk to him now, he’s feeling a bit snitchy today.
snitchy.meta: Snitchy — Tez jahli chiqadigan, asabiy yoki mayda gaplardan oson ranjiydigan, odatda doimiy ravishda noxush yoki yomon kayfiyatda bo‘ladigan odam yoki holatni ifodalovchi sifat. Bu so‘z asosan Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiyada ishlatiladi.

ex: my brother works as a sparkie on construction sites.
we need to call a sparkie to fix the wiring.
sparkie.meta: sparkie — elektr tizimlari, elektr simlari va elektr jihozlari bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassis. bu so‘z ingliz tilida norasmi (slang) ravishda ishlatiladi va asosan avstraliya, yangi zelandiya va buyuk britaniyada keng qo‘llanadi

ex: scientists are studying several subvariants of the disease.
this new subvariant of the virus spreads faster than the original.
subvariant.meta: biror narsaning asosiy shaklidan ajralgan, unga yaqin, lekin kichik farqlarga ega bo‘lgan ikkilamchi yoki qo‘shimcha variant. tibbiyotda esa odatda virus yoki kasallikning asosiy turidan keyin paydo bo‘ladigan kichik farqli yangi turi tushuniladi.

ex: many tagata pasifika have migrated to urban centers for better opportunities.
tagata pasifika play an important role in the cultural life of new zealand.
tagata pasifika.meta: tagata pasifika — mikroneziya, polineziya va melaneziya hududlaridagi tub orol aholisi. bu ibora ushbu xalqlarni umumiy madaniy, etnik va tarixiy birlik sifatida tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi. ayniqsa yangi zelandiyada keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: he tends to taihoa when it comes to difficult tasks.
let’s taihoa and think this through before making a decision.
taihoa.meta: taihoa — biror ishni darhol bajarishni kechiktirish, vaqtincha to‘xtab kutish yoki ehtiyotkorlik bilan sekin harakat qilishni anglatadi. bu so‘z maori tilidan kelib chiqqan va yangi zelandiyada keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: each tamaiti is valued in the community.
the tamaiti played happily in the village.
tamaiti.meta: tamaiti — maori tilida "bola" ma’nosini beradi. bu so‘z yangi zelandiyaning mahalliy maori xalqlari tomonidan ishlatiladi va odatda yosh bolalarni tasvirlashda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: there are special songs for the tamariki.
the tamariki are playing in the yard.
tamariki.meta: tamariki — maori tilida "bolalar" ma’nosini bildiradi. bu so‘z yangi zelandiyaning mahalliy maori xalqlari tomonidan bolalar jamoasini yoki bolalar guruhini tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: tatau is a sacred tradition in samoan culture.
his tatau tells the story of his family and heritage.
tatau.meta: tatau — samoa madaniyatida qadimdan mavjud bo‘lgan, tanaga maxsus ma’noli va murakkab naqshlar shaklida tushiriladigan an’anaviy tatuirovka. bu nafaqat bezak, balki ijtimoiy maqom, jasorat va oilaviy meros ramzi hisoblanadi.

ex: archaeologists discovered a temple mound used by early civilizations.
the ancient city featured a large temple mound at its center.
temple mound.meta: temple mound — qadimiy madaniyatlarda ibodatxona, ziyoratgoh yoki marosim binolari qurish uchun qurilgan, ko‘pincha to‘rt burchakli va yuqori qismi kesilgan piramida shaklidagi sun’iy tepalik yoki poydevor.

ex: The beliefs of the Templers emphasized practical faith and moral discipline.
The Templers settled in Palestine in the 19th century to build communities in preparation for Christ's return.
templer.meta: Templer — 19-asrda Germaniyada tashkil topgan diniy harakat a’zosi bo‘lib, bu harakat a’zolari Xudoning shohligini dunyoda real shaklda barpo etish va shu orqali Iso Masihning ikkinchi kelishiga tayyorgarlik ko‘rishni maqsad qilgan.

ex: the templon separates the sanctuary from the rest of the church.
the templon in the ancient church is beautifully decorated with icons.
templon.meta: templon — vizantiya va pravoslav cherkovlarida muqaddas joy (altar) va asosiy cherkov zali (ibodatxona) o‘rtasida o‘rnatiladigan, o‘yma yog‘och yoki toshdan yasalgan, ko‘pincha bezakli eshik va ustunlarga ega bo‘lgan to‘siq yoki pardevor.

ex: the māori people continue to seek tino rangatiratanga over their lands and resources.
tino rangatiratanga is a central concept in the treaty of waitangi.
tino rangatiratanga.meta: tino rangatiratanga — maori xalqlarining o‘z ishlari, erlari va siyosiy tizimi ustidan to‘liq nazorat qilish va o‘zini o‘zi boshqarish huquqi. bu atama maori madaniyatida o‘zligini saqlash, siyosiy erkinlik va huquqlarni himoya qilish timsoli hisoblanadi.

ex: society’s understanding of transness has evolved over time.
transness is an important part of some people’s identity.
transness.meta: transness — insonning o‘zini biologik jinsidan farqli jinsiy o‘zlikka ega deb his qilishi holati yoki sifati. bu atama transgender, transseksual yoki transvestit insonlarning shaxsiy o‘zligini, ijtimoiy holatini va tajribasini ifodalaydi.

ex: in māori culture, the tuakana has a leadership role in the family.
my tuakana always gave me advice when I was younger.
tuakana.meta: tuakana — maori madaniyatida, agar suhbatda erkak bo‘lsa, uning katta akasi yoki agar ayol bo‘lsa, uning katta opasi tushuniladi. shuningdek, bu atama oila ichida yoshi katta bo‘lib, bir jinsdagi qarindosh uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: every person needs a turangawaewae, a place to stand.
this land is my turangawaewae; it is where I belong.
turangawaewae.meta: maori tilida "turanga" — joy, "waewae" — oyoq degan ma’noni beradi va "oyoqlar turgan joy" degan ma’noni anglatadi. Bu atama inson o‘zini o‘ziniki deb biladigan joyni, yashash huquqi bor yoki tayanch sifatida qabul qiladigan hududni ifodalaydi.

ex: turcophobia can lead to unfair stereotypes about turkish people.
some european policies in the 19th century were driven by turcophobia.
turcophobia.meta: turkofobiya — Turkiya davlati, (ilgari Usmoniylar imperiyasi), turk xalqi, turk madaniyati yoki turklarga oid qadriyatlarga nisbatan kuchli nafrat, dushmanlik yoki keskin salbiy munosabat.

ex: some 19th-century european leaders had turcophobic policies.
the article expressed a turcophobic attitude towards modern turkey.
turcophobic.meta: Turkiya, (ilgari Usmoniylar imperiyasi), turk xalqi, turk madaniyati yoki turklarga oid qadriyatlarga nisbatan kuchli dushmanlik yoki salbiy kayfiyatni ifodalovchi sifat. Bu tushuncha odatda tarixiy, siyosiy yoki ijtimoiy kontekstda qo‘llanadi.

ex: the local language gradually became turkified over centuries.
the region became largely turkified after the ottoman conquest.
turkified.meta: turklashgan — biror narsa (til, madaniyat, urf-odat, hudud yoki inson) turk yoki turkiy xalqning xususiyatlarini qabul qilgan yoki ularning ta’sirida o‘zgargan holat. Bu tushuncha til, madaniyat va siyosiy tarixda ko‘p uchraydi.

ex: turkish cymbals are known for their bright and sharp sound.
the drummer used a traditional turkish cymbal for the solo.
turkish cymbal.meta: turk simbalasi — kelib chiqishi Turk bo‘lgan yoki Turkiya uslubiga xos deb hisoblangan zarbli musiqa asbobi. Bu sumbal odatda yassi yoki biroz qiyshiq shaklda bo‘lib, kuchli va yorqin tovush chiqaradi.

ex: turkish cypriot culture combines turkish and cypriot traditions.
the turkish cypriots mainly live in the northern part of the island.
turkish cypriot.meta: turk kiprlik — Kipr orolida, ayniqsa, orolning shimoliy qismida yashovchi turk xalqi vakili yoki Kiprda yashaydigan turk ajdodlarining avlodi. turk kiprlikka oid — turk kiprliklar, ularning madaniyati, tili, urf-odatlari yoki tarixiga aloqador.

ex: the turkish knot creates a dense and durable carpet texture.
the carpet was woven using the turkish knot technique.
turkish knot.meta: turk tuguni — gilam to‘qishda qo‘llaniladigan tugun turi bo‘lib, ip ikkita yonma-yon joylashgan asos ipi (osma ip) atrofida simmetrik tarzda o‘ralib bog‘lanadi. Bu usul asosan Turkiya, Markaziy Osiyo va Yaqin Sharq gilamchilik an’analarida keng tarqalgan.

ex: she adopted a beautiful turkish van with bright orange markings.
the turkish van is known for its love of swimming.
turkish van.meta: uzoqroq va suvga chidamli juniga ega bo‘lgan uy mushugi zoti. Bu mushuklar odatda oppoq bo‘lib, boshida va dumida qizg‘ish yoki to‘q sariq dog‘lari bo‘ladi. Ular Van ko‘li hududidan kelib chiqqan va suzishni yaxshi ko‘rishi bilan mashhur.

ex: the turkistani culture is rich with ancient traditions and music.
he proudly calls himself a turkistani.
turkistani.meta: turkistonlik — tarixiy Turkiston mintaqasida yashovchi yoki shu yerda tug‘ilib o‘sgan inson. turkistonlikka oid — Turkiston hududi, uning xalqlari, madaniyati, tillari yoki tarixiga aloqador bo‘lgan narsalar.

ex: many turkmenians also live in neighboring countries like iran and afghanistan.
she is a turkmenian who was born and raised in ashgabat.
turkmenian.meta: turkmanistonlik — Turkmaniston Respublikasining fuqarosi yoki tarixiy Turkmaniya hududida yashagan inson. turkmanistonlikka oid — Turkmaniston mamlakati, uning xalqlari, madaniyati, tili yoki tarixiga aloqador bo‘lgan narsalar.

ex: she wore a traditional turkmenistani dress at the festival.
the turkmenistani flag is green with a white crescent and stars.
turkmenistani.meta: turkmanistonlikka oid — Turkmaniston mamlakati, uning xalqi, tili, madaniyati yoki tarixiga aloqador bo‘lgan narsalar. Bu sifat Turkmanistonga tegishli bo‘lgan barcha tushunchalarni ifodalashda ishlatiladi.

ex: some virginopara aphids have wings, while others do not.
the virginopara produces offspring without mating.
virginopara.meta: virginopara — shirali bitlarda uchraydigan, jinsiy ko‘payishsiz (partenogenez orqali) tirik bola tug‘adigan urg‘ochi bit. Bu bit qanotli yoki qanotsiz bo‘lishi mumkin. Ular odatda qisqa vaqt ichida ko‘plab avlod qoldiradi.

ex: many women see her as a true wahine toa.
she is celebrated as a wahine toa in her community.
wahine toa.meta: ayol jangchi — Maori madaniyatida jang maydonida qatnashadigan yoki jasorat va kuch timsoli bo‘lgan ayol. Keng ma’noda esa har qanday jasur, mustaqil, kuchli va mard ayolni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: her wairua is strong and peaceful.
they believe the wairua lives on after death.
wairua.meta: wairua — insonning ichki ruhi, joni yoki ruhiy mohiyati. Shuningdek, bu tushuncha umumiy ma’noda ma’naviyat yoki ruhiy hayotni ham anglatadi. Maori madaniyatida ruh va tana bir butun, ammo ruh abadiy deb qaraladi.

ex: he competes in waka ama races every summer.
the waka ama was traditionally used for fishing and travel.
waka ama.meta: waka ama — Maori xalqi tomonidan an’anaviy tarzda ishlatiladigan yon tayanchli kanoe turi. Keyinchalik bu kanoe dam olish, sport va poyga musobaqalarida ham qo‘llanila boshlandi. Hozirda bu atama shu kanoe bilan poyga sportini ham anglatadi.

ex: in maori culture, the whānau is central to social life.
she spent the holidays with her whānau.
whānau.meta: whānau — Maori madaniyatida bir joyda birga yashaydigan, qarindoshlik rishtalari bilan bog‘langan oilalar yoki katta oila jamoasi. Keng ma’noda esa har qanday oila kabi yaqin, o‘zaro mehribon va birdam guruhni ham ifodalashi mumkin.

ex: the wharekai was decorated for the wedding reception.
we all gathered in the wharekai for the celebration feast.
wharekai.meta: wharekai — Maori jamiyatida ovqat pishiriladigan, dasturxon yoziladigan va ovqat iste’mol qilinadigan bino. Bu o‘rta hajm yoki katta ovqatlanish zali bo‘lib, odatda marosimlar, bayramlar va jamoaviy yig‘inlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: important decisions are made inside the wharenui.
the wharenui is the heart of the marae.
wharenui.meta: wharenui — Maori jamoalarida markaziy o‘rin tutadigan, odatda katta, o‘yma naqshlar va bezaklar bilan bezatilgan bino. Ushbu bino jamoa yig‘ilishlari, muhim marosimlar, bayramlar va an’anaviy tadbirlar o‘tkaziladigan joy hisoblanadi.

ex: the whenua is sacred to the maori people.
they returned to their whenua to reconnect with their ancestors.
whenua.meta: whenua — umumiy ma’noda yer yoki hudud, lekin Maori madaniyatida bu so‘z odatda o‘zining ajdodiy vatani yoki inson tug‘ilib o‘sgan muqaddas joyni anglatadi.

ex: the government’s plan is all talk and no action.
he promised to fix it, but he’s all talk and no action.
all talk and no action.meta: faqat gap, amal yo‘q — bu ibora ko‘p gapirib, amalda hech qanday ish qilmaydigan holatni yoki shunday odatga ega bo‘lgan odamni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi. Bunday odamlar ko‘pincha katta rejalar tuzadi, lekin harakat qilmaydi.

ex: anticipatory bail can protect a person from wrongful arrest.
he applied for anticipatory bail to avoid arrest.
anticipatory bail.meta: oldindan garov bilan ozod qilish — bu sud orqali hibsga olinishi kutilayotgan shaxsga jinoyat sodir etilishida gumon qilinsa ham, hibsdan oldin garov asosida ozodlikka chiqish huquqi beriladigan huquqiy himoya chorasidir.

ex: the sky during astronomical twilight is still dark to the naked eye.
astronomical twilight is the best time to observe faint stars.
astronomical twilight.meta: astronomik shafaq — quyosh chiqishidan oldin va botishidan keyin to‘liq tun yetmagan, lekin osmonda quyosh nurlari deyarli ko‘rinmaydigan va astronomik kuzatuvlarni boshlash uchun yetarlicha qorong‘u bo‘ladigan vaqt oraliqlari.

ex: the government is reviewing its asylum-seeking policies.
asylum-seeking families often face long legal processes.
asylum-seeking.meta: boshpana izlovchi — o‘z mamlakatida xavfsizlik yoki erkinligi ta’minlanmaganligi sababli boshqa mamlakatdan rasmiy boshpana so‘rayotgan shaxs yoki ushbu jarayon bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Baha’is around the world celebrate the birth of Baha’u’llah.
the Baha’i Faith teaches the unity of all religions.
baha’i faith.meta: Bahoi dini — 19-asrda Bahoullo tomonidan Eron (o‘sha davrdagi Fors)da asos solingan yagonalikka asoslangan din. Bu din barcha dinlarning birligini, butun insoniyatning ruhiy birligini, tenglikni va dunyo tinchligini targ‘ib qiladi.

ex: each letter of the alphabet has a unique binary code.
computers process information using binary code.
binary code.meta: ikkilik kod — bu ma’lumotlarni ifodalash uchun faqat ikkita belgi (odatda 0 va 1) ishlatiladigan kodlash tizimi. Kompyuter texnologiyalarida barcha ma’lumotlar, dasturlar va buyruqlar aynan shu ikkilik kod orqali qayta ishlanadi.

ex: the new processor is not binary-compatible with previous models.
this software is binary-compatible with older versions of the operating system.
binary-compatible.meta: ikkilik mos — bu kompyuter yoki operatsion tizim boshqa ishlab chiqaruvchi yoki boshqa avloddagi tizim uchun yozilgan dasturlarni hech qanday o‘zgartirishsiz ishlata oladigan holat.

ex: in binary distribution, each trial results in success or failure.
the coin toss follows a binary distribution: heads or tails.
binary distribution.meta: matematikada yoki statistikada barcha obyekt yoki natijalarni faqat ikkita guruh yoki toifaga ajratish tizimi. Ehtimollar nazariyasida bu ikki holat: muvaffaqiyat yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlik, ha yoki yo‘q, to‘g‘ri yoki noto‘g‘ri kabi ko‘rinishlarda bo‘ladi.

ex: the function f(x, y) = x × y is a binary function.
addition is a binary function because it takes two numbers as input.
binary function.meta: ikkilik funksiya — matematikada yoki dasturlashda ikkita o‘zgaruvchini qabul qiladigan va ularga asoslanib natija beradigan funksiya. Bunday funksiya har doim ikki argumentga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: audio files can be saved as binary large objects.
the database stores images as binary large objects.
binary large object.meta: katta ikkilik obyekt — bu kompyuter tizimlarida rasm, ovoz, video yoki boshqa multimedia fayllari kabi tuzilmasiz ma’lumotlar bo‘lib, ular ikkilik kodda saqlanadi va bitta butun obyekt sifatida ko‘riladi.

ex: multiplication is a common binary operation in mathematics.
addition is a simple example of a binary operation.
binary operation.meta: ikkilik amal — bu matematik yoki mantiqiy jarayon bo‘lib, ikki element (operand) ustida bajariladi va natijada uchinchi element hosil bo‘ladi. Masalan: qo‘shish, ayirish, ko‘paytirish, bo‘lish va boshqa amallar.

ex: the trader bought a binary option predicting that the stock price would rise.
binary options are often considered high-risk investments.
binary option.meta: ikkilik opsiya — moliyaviy bozorlarda ishlatiladigan shartnoma turi bo‘lib, bunda faqat ikki xil natija mavjud: foyda olish (belgilangan pul miqdori) yoki hech narsa olmaslik.

ex: a binary relation can be represented as a set of ordered pairs.
the "less than" relation on numbers is a binary relation.
binary relation.meta: bu matematikada bir to‘plam elementlari ikkinchi to‘plam elementlari bilan bog‘langan va har bir bog‘lanish tartiblangan juftlik sifatida ifodalangan munosabat. Masalan, to‘plam A ning elementlari to‘plam B ning elementlariga mos keladi.

ex: binary scale is used in measuring digital signals (on/off).
computer memory is organized on a binary scale, doubling with each additional bit.
binary scale.meta: bu o‘lchov tizimi bo‘lib, unda birliklar orasidagi nisbat 2 ga teng. Har bir keyingi birlik oldingisidan ikki barobar ko‘p qiymatga ega bo‘ladi. Bundan tashqari, bu atama ikki qiymatli (masalan, yoqilgan/o‘chirilgan, ha/yo‘q) tizimni ham ifodalaydi.

ex: the algorithm uses binary search to find the target value efficiently.
binary search is faster than linear search for large sorted arrays.
binary search.meta: ikkilik qidiruv — saralangan massiv yoki ro‘yxatda ma’lum qiymatni topish uchun ishlatiladigan samarali usul.

ex: binary-coded decimal is often used in digital clocks and calculators.
the decimal number 59 is represented as 0101 1001 in binary-coded decimal.
binary-coded decimal.meta: ikkilik kodlangan o‘nlik raqam — bu raqamlar tizimi bo‘lib, unda har bir o‘nlik raqam (0 dan 9 gacha) to‘rt bitli ikkilik kod (binary) bilan ifodalanadi. Masalan, o‘nlikdagi 5 raqami ikkilikda 0101 sifatida yoziladi.

ex: the newspaper was accused of blasphemous libel for insulting religious figures.
publishing blasphemous libel is considered a serious offense in many countries.
blasphemous libel.meta: xudoga nisbatan haqoratli tuhmat — bu qonuniy javobgarlikni keltirib chiqaruvchi huquqbuzarlik

ex: many families use cargo bikes to carry their children and groceries.
cargo bikes are becoming popular in cities for eco-friendly deliveries.
cargo bike.meta: yuk tashuvchi velosiped — bu velosiped yoki uch g‘ildirakli velosiped bo‘lib, unga yukni yoki qo‘shimcha yo‘lovchilarni tashish uchun katta konteyner yoki maxsus platforma o‘rnatilgan.

ex: the team acted like headless chooks when the project suddenly changed direction.
he was running around like a headless chook trying to finish all the work on time.
like a headless chook.meta: boshisiz tovuqqa o‘xshash — bu ibora, odatda odam yoki guruhning maqsadsiz, tartibsiz va samarasi yo‘q tarzda harakat qilishini ifodalaydi. Bu holatda odam nima qilayotganini aniq bilmay, shoshqaloqlik bilan va tartibsiz ravishda harakat qiladi.

ex: during civil twilight, you can still see well enough without turning on lights.
civil twilight is the best time for photographers because of the soft natural light.
civil twilight.meta: fuqarolik shomg‘irligi — bu kunning quyosh chiqishidan oldingi va botishidan keyingi ikki qisqa davri bo‘lib, unda quyosh gorizont ostida 6 darajadan pastda joylashadi, ammo tabiiy yorug‘lik yetarli bo‘ladi.

ex: Marx argued that commodity fetishism makes people see products as having intrinsic value independent of labor.
commodity fetish obscures the real social relations behind production.
commodity fetish.meta: tovar fetişi — Marksistik iqtisodiyot nazariyasida bir tovarning qiymati uning haqiqiy foydaliligidan yoki ishlab chiqarishda sarflangan mehnatdan ko‘ra, bozor va kapitalistik almashinuv jarayonlari orqali belgilanadigan holat.

ex: the agreement was reached by consent of all parties involved.
the decision was made by consent of all the board members.
by consent.meta: kelishuv asosida — biror ish yoki qaror barcha manfaatdor tomonlarning roziligi, rozilik va kelishuviga ko‘ra amalga oshirilgan holat. Bu ibora, asosan, qaror qabul qilishda barcha ishtirokchilarning fikri inobatga olinganligini bildiradi.

ex: a consent decree avoids a lengthy trial by formalizing an agreement.
the court issued a consent decree settling the dispute between the two companies.
consent decree.meta: sud tomonidan tasdiqlangan hujjat bo‘lib, unda tomonlar o‘rtasida kelishilgan nizolar yoki da’volarning hal qilinish shartlari yozilgan. Bu qaror sud jarayonini yakunlash uchun ishlatiladi va tomonlar o‘rtasidagi kelishuvni rasmiylashtiradi.

ex: the school requires a consent form from parents for field trips.
patients must sign a consent form before undergoing surgery.
consent form.meta: rozilik shakli — bu shaxsning (yoki kichik yoshdagilar nomidan ota-ona yoki qonuniy vasiy tomonidan) ma’lum bir ish yoki xizmatga rozilik bildirishini tasdiqlovchi yozma hujjat.

ex: a consent judgment avoids a trial by formalizing the parties’ agreement.
the court entered a consent judgment to finalize the settlement.
consent judgment.meta: sudda tomonlar o‘rtasida kelishuvga erishilgach, sud tomonidan chiqarilgan va ushbu kelishuv shartlarini rasmiylashtiruvchi hukm. Bu hukm ishni sudda davom ettirmasdan, tomonlar o‘rtasidagi kelishuvni qonuniy kuchga ega qilish uchun xizmat qiladi.

ex: that was a crazy-ass idea, but somehow it worked.
he drove that crazy-ass motorcycle through the city streets.
crazy-ass.meta: crazy-ass — bu so‘z odam yoki holatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi, unda u kishi yoki vaziyat butunlay mantiqsiz, boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan va kutilmagan xatti-harakatlarga ega bo‘lib, odatdagi normal chegaralardan chiqib ketganligini bildiradi.

ex: he’s acting like a crazyhead again, totally ignoring the facts.
don’t be such a crazyhead, use your brain!
crazyhead.meta: crazyhead — bu so‘z odatda boshqa odamni haqorat qilish uchun ishlatiladi va uning aqlsizligi yoki umumiy odob-axloqdan mahrum ekanligini bildiradi. Bu atama do‘stona hazil sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin, lekin ko‘pincha salbiy ma’noda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: calling a psychiatric hospital a crazy house is offensive.
he was admitted to the crazy house after the accident.
crazy house.meta: crazy house — bu so‘z psixiatriya shifoxonasini nojo‘ya va haqoratli tarzda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Zamonaviy tibbiy va ijtimoiy nuqtai nazardan bunday atamalar nohurmatli va qo‘pol hisoblanadi, shuning uchun ularni ishlatishda ehtiyot bo‘lish lozim.

ex: crazywater like whisky can be dangerous if consumed excessively.
he drank too much crazywater last night and felt terrible this morning.
crazywater.meta: crazywater — kuchli alkogolli ichimlikni ifodalovchi noformal atama. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha viski yoki boshqa distillangan spirtli ichimliklarga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Ba’zan hazil yoki norasmiy muloqotda ishlatiladi.

ex: the story focused on the cuckold-making actions of the villain.
his infidelity led to cuckold-making and destroyed the family trust.
cuckold-making.meta: (a) — bir kishining eri bo‘lib, uning xotini unga sodiq bo‘lmaganda, bu holatni yuzaga keltirish harakati yoki hodisasi; (b) — shunday holatga olib keladigan, bunga sababchi bo‘ladigan narsa yoki vaziyat.

ex: the curb lane is often used by buses and bicycles.
please stay in the curb lane when parking your car.
curb lane.meta: curb lane — bu yo‘lning qirrasida, yo‘l chetidagi qirqim (curb) yonida joylashgan maxsus transport qatnov yo‘lagi. Odatda bu yo‘lak avtoulovlar uchun mo‘ljallangan bo‘lib, to‘xtash yoki harakatlanish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: this species is characterized by its deep-bodied shape.
the deep-bodied fish swam swiftly through the water.
deep-bodied.meta: hayvon yoki baliq tanasining balandligi (orqa qismidan qorinngacha bo‘lgan masofa) kengligidan (yon tomonlar oralig‘i) katta bo‘lgan shaklini ifodalaydi. Bu shakl baliqlarda ko‘pincha ularning suzish qobiliyatiga va yashash muhitiga moslashgan.

ex: researchers are studying deep brain stimulation for treating depression.
deep brain stimulation can help reduce symptoms of Parkinson’s disease.
deep brain stimulation.meta: deep brain stimulation — bu tibbiy usul bo‘lib, unda miyaga joylashtirilgan mayda elektrodlar orqali miya to‘qimasiga elektr impulslari yuboriladi.

ex: the band’s deep cuts are often more experimental than their hits.
this album has some amazing deep cuts that only true fans know about.
deep cut.meta: deep cut — bu atama asosan musiqada ishlatiladi va taniqli yoki hit bo‘lgan qo‘shiqlarga qaraganda kamroq tanilgan, kam eshitilgan yoki kam mashhur bo‘lgan trekni anglatadi.

ex: we did a deep dive into the company’s financial statements last week.
the report provides a deep dive into the causes of climate change.
deep dive.meta: deep dive — bu atama biror mavzuni yoki masalani yuzaki emas, balki chuqur va har tomonlama o‘rganish, tahlil qilish jarayonini bildiradi. Asosan ilmiy, biznes, ta’lim va boshqa sohalarda keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: deep ecologists argue that humans should live in harmony with nature.
she is a renowned deep ecologist advocating for radical environmental changes.
deep ecologist.meta: deep ecologist — bu atama chuqur ekologiya (deep ecology) falsafasi bo‘yicha bilimli mutaxassis yoki ushbu falsafani faol qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxsni anglatadi.

ex: Deep England is often portrayed with rolling hills, cottages, and traditional villages.
many novels set in Deep England evoke a sense of nostalgia for rural life.
deep england.meta: Angliyaning janubiy hududlarini, ayniqsa Ikkinchi jahon urushidan oldingi davrga oid nostaljik va idealizatsiyalangan qishloq manzarasi sifatida ko‘rsatadigan atama. Bu tasvir ko‘pincha tinch, osoyishta, an’anaviy qishloq hayotini ifodalaydi.

ex: deep funk emphasizes rhythm over melody, creating a powerful dance beat.
the band is known for playing deep funk with heavy grooves and raw sounds.
deep funk.meta: deep funk — bu funk musiqasining o‘ziga xos turi bo‘lib, unda ohangdan ko‘ra ritm va zarbaga katta e’tibor qaratiladi. Uning tovushi ko‘pincha xom, qattiq va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri bo‘lib, an’anaviy funkdan farq qiladi.

ex: many coal mines operate using deep mining techniques.
deep mining requires advanced safety measures due to the risks underground.
deep mining.meta: bu yer yuzasidan ancha chuqurda joylashgan ko‘mir yoki boshqa minerallarni qazib olish usuli bo‘lib, bu ish tunnel va shaftlar (burg‘u teshiklari) orqali amalga oshiriladi. Bu usul ochiq kon (opencast mining) yoki qatlamli kon qazib olishdan farq qiladi.

ex: deep-pan pizzas are known for their thick, doughy crust.
I ordered a deep-pan pizza with extra cheese.
deep-pan.meta: deep-pan — pizza tayyorlash uslubining biri bo‘lib, pizza chuqur idishda pishiriladi va uning asosiy qismi qalin, yumshoq xamirdan iborat bo‘ladi. Bu pizza ko‘pincha an’anaviy yupqa xamirli pizzadan farq qiladi.

ex: deep-pile carpets require regular cleaning to maintain their texture.
the living room has a deep-pile carpet that feels very soft.
deep-pile.meta: deep-pile — bu atama, asosan, gilam va gilamchalarda qo‘llanilib, uzun va yumshoq tolalardan yasalgan gilamni yoki bunday materialni bildiradi. Bunday gilamlar oyoq ostida qulay va yumshoq bo‘ladi.

ex: the deep-sky view revealed a distant star cluster.
astronomers use telescopes to observe deep-sky objects like galaxies and nebulae.
deep-sky.meta: deep-sky — astronomiyada Quyosh sistemasidan tashqaridagi osmon jismlarini ifodalovchi atama. Bu yulduzlar to‘plami, nebula yoki galaktika kabi ob’ektlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: artists like Otis Redding are famous for their deep soul performances.
deep soul music expresses strong emotions and spirituality.
deep soul.meta: deep soul — amerikalik ruhiy musiqa janrining turli turlari bo‘lib, ular gospel musiqasi va ritm-bluz elementlarini o‘z ichiga oladi. Ushbu janr odatda kuchli, jonli va hissiyotga boy vokal uslubi bilan tavsiflanadi.

ex: deep strikes can disrupt command centers far behind the front lines.
the air force launched a deep strike on enemy supply lines.
deep strike.meta: deep strike — harbiy termin bo‘lib, jang frontidan uzoqroq joylashgan muhim strategik ob’ektlarga amalga oshiriladigan hujumni bildiradi.

ex: investors are increasingly interested in deep tech innovations.
deep tech startups focus on breakthroughs in AI, robotics, and biotechnology.
deep tech.meta: deep tech — bu ilg‘or ilmiy va muhandislik yutuqlariga asoslangan texnologiyalar bo‘lib, ular sanoat yoki bozor sohasida sezilarli innovatsiyalarni amalga oshiradi.

ex: she found herself in deep when the project failed.
he’s really in deep with his debts now.
to be in deep.meta: to be in deep — qiyin, murakkab yoki xavfli vaziyatga chuqurroq aralashib qolish, undan chiqish qiyin bo‘lgan holatda bo‘lish. Bu ibora ko‘pincha stress, muammo yoki xavfli sharoitlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: cultural traditions run deep in this community.
his feelings of guilt run deep.
to run deep.meta: to run deep — biror narsa, masalan, his-tuyg‘u yoki e’tiqod, uzoq vaqt davomida chuqur joylashib, mustahkam o‘rnatilgan holatda bo‘lishi. Bu ifoda odatda kuchli va barqaror tuyg‘ular yoki qadriyatlarni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: deep-sea fishermen often spend weeks at sea.
the deep-sea fisherman caught a large tuna far from the shore.
deep-sea fisherman.meta: deep-sea fisherman — chuqur dengizlarda baliq tutadigan yoki baliq ovlash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi odam. Bu odamlar odatda dengizdan uzoqda, chuqur suvlarda professional tarzda baliq ovlaydilar.

ex: commercial deep-sea fishing requires specialized boats and equipment.
deep-sea fishing is popular among tourists visiting coastal cities.
deep-sea fishing.meta: deep-sea fishing — chuqur dengizda baliq ovlash faoliyati. Bu faoliyat tijoriy maqsadlarda yoki dam olish uchun amalga oshirilishi mumkin. Uzoq vaqt davomida dengizda qolishni va keng suv maydonlarini o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: many climbers enjoy deep-water soloing because it doesn’t require ropes or harnesses.
deep-water soloing is an extreme sport that combines rock climbing and the safety of deep water below.
deep-water soloing.meta: deep-water soloing — bu yakkaxon (bir kishi tomonidan) xavfsizlik asboblarisiz qoyani ko‘tarish sport turi bo‘lib, qoya tubida suv joylashgan. Agar ko‘tarilish vaqtida yiqilish yuz bersa, suv yengil jarohatlardan saqlaydi.

ex: strength in depth is vital for any successful military force.
the team has great strength in depth, with many skilled players ready to step in.
strength in depth.meta: strength in depth — bu ko‘p sonli va ayniqsa malakali a’zolar to‘plami bo‘lib, u jamoaga yoki guruhga muvaffaqiyat qozonishda katta yordam beradi.

ex: The coach updated the team’s depth chart before the championship game.
The scientists studied the depth chart to understand the seabed topography.
depth chart.meta: Depth chart (okeanografiya) — bu suv yuzasining turli joylarida chuqurlik darajasini ko‘rsatadigan xarita bo‘lib, dengiz yoki boshqa suv havzalarining tubini o‘rganishda ishlatiladi.

ex: Divers rely on a depth gauge to know how deep they have gone underwater.
The mechanic used a depth gauge to measure the hole in the engine part.
depth gauge.meta: depth gauge — bu teshiklar yoki boshqa joylarning chuqurligini aniqlash uchun ishlatiladigan o‘lchov asbobi. Suv ostida yoki muzda chuqurlikni o‘lchashda ham qo‘llaniladi, ko‘pincha bu qurilma tovush to‘lqinlari (sonar) yordamida ishlaydi.

ex: Depth hoar crystals can increase the risk of avalanches.
The mountaineers were cautious because the depth hoar made the snowpack unstable.
depth hoar.meta: depth hoar — qor qatlami ichidagi yoki uning tagidagi katta va nozik muz kristallari bo‘lib, ular suv bug‘ining mavjud qor kristallariga qotishi orqali hosil bo‘ladi. Bu holat qorning barqarorligini kamaytirishi va qor ko‘chkilariga olib kelishi mumkin.

ex: Babies develop depth perception as they grow and learn about their environment.
Good depth perception is essential for activities like driving and sports.
depth perception.meta: depth perception — bu insonning yoki hayvonning atrofdagi ob’yektlarning masofasini uch o‘lchamli fazoda aniqlash qobiliyati. Bu qobiliyat yordamida biz yaqin yoki uzoqdagi narsalarni farqlay olamiz va atrofimizdagi makonni tushunamiz.

ex: Fishermen use a depth sounder to find the best spots for fishing.
The boat is equipped with a depth sounder to avoid running aground.
depth sounder.meta: bu suv ostidagi yoki muz ostidagi chuqurlikni o‘lchash uchun ishlatiladigan asbob bo‘lib, ko‘pincha tovush yoki radio to‘lqinlari yordamida aniq chuqurlikni aniqlaydi. Dengizchilar, baliqchilar va sho‘ng‘inchilar tomonidan keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Accurate depth sounding is essential for safe navigation.
The crew performed a depth sounding before entering the shallow bay.
depth sounding.meta: depth sounding — suv yoki muzning chuqurligini o‘lchash jarayoni yoki uning natijasi. Bu jarayon ko‘pincha maxsus asboblar yordamida amalga oshiriladi va dengizchilik, baliq ovlash, geografiya va ilmiy tadqiqotlarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Some philosophers talk about the depthlessness of human understanding.
The depthlessness of the pond made it unsafe for diving.
depthlessness.meta: depthlessness — bu narsaning chuqurligi yo‘qligi, sirtqalik yoki o‘lchanmas chuqurlik holati. Ba’zan bu so‘z yuzaki yoki chuqur va o‘lchanmas holatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi, kontekstga qarab ma’nosi farqlanishi mumkin.

ex: The phrase derangement syndrome is often used to describe exaggerated political reactions.
Some commentators say that the president suffers from a derangement syndrome when criticized.
derangement syndrome.meta: derangement syndrome — siyosiy munozaralarda yoki muayyan shaxslar, g‘oyalarga nisbatan haddan tashqari hissiy yoki mantiqsiz salbiy munosabat, ko‘pincha oldindan mavjud bo‘lgan nafrat yoki qarshilik tufayli yuzaga keladigan holat.

ex: The dish dog worked hard to keep the kitchen clean and organized.
The restaurant hired a new dish dog to help in the kitchen.
dish dog.meta: dish dog — oshxonada idish-tovoqlarni yuvish, ularni joylashtirish va boshqa oddiy xizmat ishlarini bajaradigan yordamchi xodim.

ex: The dish pig spent the whole day washing dishes after the event.
The restaurant hired a new dish pig to help with cleaning.
dish pig.meta: dish pig — oshxonada idish-tovoqlarni yuvish, tozalash va boshqa oddiy xizmat ishlarini bajaradigan yordamchi xodim.

ex: A high diversity index usually indicates a rich variety of species.
Scientists use the diversity index to assess the health of an ecosystem.
diversity index.meta: diversity index — ekologik muhitda ma’lum bir hududda yoki populyatsiyada mavjud bo‘lgan turli turlar soni va ularning nisbatini ko‘rsatadigan statistik ko‘rsatkich.

ex: Diversity jurisdiction allows federal courts to handle cases involving state law when citizens are from different states.
The federal court invoked diversity jurisdiction because the parties were from different states.
diversity jurisdiction.meta: diversity jurisdiction — federal sudga qarama-qarshi tomonlar turli shtatlarga mansub bo‘lgan taqdirda, shtat qonunlariga oid ishlarni ko‘rish vakolati berilgan yurisdiktsiya turi.

ex: The country celebrates its dual heritage by honoring traditions from both indigenous and immigrant cultures.
She is proud of her dual heritage, having both Asian and European ancestors.
dual heritage.meta: dual heritage — bir kishining yoki jamiyatning ikki xil madaniy, etnik yoki tarixiy merosga ega bo‘lib, ular ikki turli omillar yoki an’analardan ta’sirlanganligi.

ex: The forest looked mysterious in the dusk dark just before nightfall.
We took a walk during the dusk dark when the sky was dim but not completely dark.
dusk dark.meta: dusk dark — quyosh botib, tun qorong‘iligi boshlanishidan oldingi soatlar, kechki soatlarning qorong‘iligi.

ex: Scientists study the habitat of the dusky grouper to protect its population.
The dusky grouper is a prized catch among Mediterranean fishermen.
dusky grouper.meta: dusky grouper — O‘rta yer dengizi va Sharqiy Atlantikada uchraydigan katta keta baliq turi bo‘lib, uning tanasi kulrang-jigarrang rangda va ustida noaniq och rangli dog‘lar mavjud.

ex: Hunters often seek the dusky grouse during the autumn season.
The dusky grouse is native to the forests of western North America.
dusky grouse.meta: dusky grouse — to‘tang‘il baliqchalari oilasiga mansub, ko‘k rangga yaqin qorong‘u soyalarga ega bo‘lgan qush turi.

ex: Scientists study the behavior of the dusky leaf monkey to learn more about primates.
The dusky leaf monkey lives in the forests of Southeast Asia.
dusky leaf monkey.meta: dusky leaf monkey — jigarrang, qora va kulrang ranglarning aralashmasidan tashkil topgan tuklarga ega, ko‘z atrofida oq dog‘lari bo‘lgan barg maymuni turi.

ex: Researchers observe the social behavior of the dusky titi in the wild.
The dusky titi inhabits the tropical forests of South America.
dusky titi.meta: dusky titi — Janubiy Amerikada yashovchi titi maymunlar oilasiga mansub maymun turi, qalin yumshoq kulrang-jigarrang tuklar bilan qoplangan, pastki qismi qizg‘ish rangda va dumida oq tasma bor.

ex: The gallery exhibited many beautiful easel paintings by local artists.
She prefers easel painting to mural art because it allows more flexibility.
easel painting.meta: easel painting — bu rasm stend (yoki easel) ustida chizilgan rasm yoki stendda ishlash usuli bilan bog‘liq rasm chizish san’atidir. Bu turdagi rasm odatda kichikroq bo‘lib, stendga qo‘yiladi, devorga bevosita bo‘yashdan farq qiladi.

ex: People who are easily-led may make poor decisions without thinking.
He is an easily-led child who often follows bad company.
easily-led.meta: easily-led — boshqalar ta’sirida osongina harakat qiladigan, ayniqsa yomon yoki ahmoqona ishlarni qilishga moyil bo‘lgan shaxs yoki odam haqida ishlatiladi.

ex: This website is designed to be easy of access even for beginners.
The library is easy of access for all students.
easy of access.meta: easy of access — biror joy yoki narsa oson topilishi yoki kirib borilishi mumkin bo‘lgan holat. Shuningdek, odam uchun samimiy, do‘stona va yaqinlashishga qulay xarakter.

ex: After the test results came back normal, she finally rested easy.
You can rest easy knowing that everything is under control.
to rest easy.meta: to rest easy — boshqalar yoki vaziyat haqida xavotir olmasdan, xotirjam bo‘lish; ruhiy osoyishtalikda bo‘lish.

ex: When he got upset, I told him to take it easy and relax.
“Don’t worry about the exam, take it easy!”
take it easy.meta: take it easy! — kimnidir xotirjam bo‘lishga, ortiqcha stress va tashvishlardan xalos bo‘lishga undash uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

ex: He waved goodbye and said, “Take it easy!”
“See you tomorrow! Take it easy!”
take it easy!.meta: take it easy! — kimdir bilan xayrlashganda, unga yaxshilik tilab, sog‘-salomat bo‘lishini, o‘ziga g‘amxo‘rlik qilishini aytish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

ex: The teacher decided to take it easy on the students during the exam.
Please take it easy on me; I’m doing my best.
to take it easy on.meta: to take it easy on (a person) — kimnidir qattiq tanqid qilmaslik, ozroq qattiqroq munosabatda bo‘lish yoki uning ustidan ko‘p tanqid qilmaslik, yumshoqroq, kechirimliroq bo‘lish.

ex: When she told me to calm down, I thought, “Easy for you to say!”
“Just try harder.” — “Easy for you to say, you don’t know what I’m going through.”
easy for you to say.meta: easy for you to say — kimdir maslahat berayotganda, lekin u vaziyatni o‘zi boshdan kechirmagan yoki qiyinligini sezmaganligi uchun bu so‘zlarni aytayotganini bildiruvchi ibora.

ex: The coach told the players to go easy during training today.
Please go easy on him, he’s new here.
to go easy.meta: to go easy (on someone) — kimnidir qattiq tanqid qilmaslik, ozroq yumshoqroq yoki ehtiyotkorlik bilan muomala qilish.

ex: This app has an easy-access menu for quick navigation.
The hotel offers easy-access parking for its guests.
easy-access.meta: easy-access — foydalanish yoki kirish uchun qulay joyda joylashgan, oson erishiladigan.

ex: This jacket is easy-fitting and perfect for casual outings.
She prefers easy-fitting clothes for everyday wear.
easy-fitting.meta: easy-fitting — kiyilganda qulay bo‘ladigan, tana shakliga qattiq yopishmaydigan kiyim yoki buyum.

ex: The phrase easy lay is often considered disrespectful.
He called her an easy lay, which was very offensive.
easy lay.meta: easy lay — odatda ayol kishi uchun ishlatiladi, jinsiy munosabatga kirishda osonlik bilan rozi bo‘ladigan shaxs.

ex: The term easy make is considered offensive in polite conversation.
He unfairly labeled her an easy make.
easy make.meta: easy make — odatda ayol kishi uchun ishlatiladigan, jinsiy munosabatga oson rozi bo‘ladigan shaxsni ifodalovchi so‘z.

ex: Many stores offer easy payment options to make expensive items more affordable.
I bought the television on an easy payment plan and pay a small amount each month.
easy payment.meta: easy payment — biror narsani to‘lashda xarajatlarni bo‘laklarga bo‘lib, odatda oyma-oy to‘lash shakli. Bu usul xaridni moliyaviy jihatdan yengillashtiradi.

ex: They work together like ebony and ivory — different but perfectly in tune.
The song "Ebony and Ivory" by Paul McCartney and Stevie Wonder celebrates racial harmony.
ebony and ivory.meta: ebony and ivory — ranglarning (qora va oq) qarama-qarshiligiga asoslanib, turli irqdagi (asosan qora va oq) insonlar o‘rtasidagi o‘zaro tushunish, hamkorlik va tinch yashashni ifodalovchi ibora.

ex: Steel can experience elastic deformation under certain loads without permanent damage.
Rubber bands undergo elastic deformation when stretched but return to their original shape when released.
elastic deformation.meta: Elastik deformatsiya — fizikada va materialshunoslikda biror jismga kuch ta’sir qilganda uning shakli yoki hajmi o‘zgarishi, biroq kuch olib tashlangach jism o‘zining asl holatiga to‘liq qaytishi. Bu jarayon jismning elastik xususiyatini ko‘rsatadi.

ex: In medieval churches, the evangelist book was often richly decorated with gold and jewels.
The witness placed his hand on the evangelist book to take the oath in court.
evangelist book.meta: Injil kitobi — to‘rt Injil muqaddas matnlari (Matto, Mark, Luqo va Yuhanno) to‘plangan kitob nusxasi; ko‘pincha qasamyod qilishda qo‘llaniladigan muqaddas kitob sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: I adopted an exotic shorthair because I wanted a Persian-like cat without the long hair.
The exotic shorthair is popular for its easy-to-maintain coat and calm temperament.
exotic shorthair.meta: Ekzotik qisqa junli mushuk — fors mushuki va amerika qisqa junli mushugini chatishtirish orqali yaratilgan uydagi qisqa junli mushuk zoti. Bu mushuklar zich juniga, ixcham gavdasiga va dumaloq, biroz yassi yuziga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: She really felt his pain when his father passed away.
I can feel your pain—I went through the same thing last year.
to feel someone’s pain.meta: Birovning og‘rig‘ini his qilmoq — boshqa bir insonning og‘riqli yoki qiyin holatdagi his-tuyg‘ularini tushunish yoki unga hamdard bo‘lish, ayniqsa o‘xshash vaziyatni boshdan kechirganingiz uchun.

ex: The sailors would spend their nights with the frail sisters of the port city.
In old novels, women like her were often called frail sisters.
frail sister.meta: Frail sister — bu ibora tarixiy yoki kinoyaviy ma’noda ishlatiladi va buzuq yurishli yoki ko‘plab jinsiy aloqaga kirishadigan ayolni, ba’zan fohishani anglatadi.

ex: He spent many nights among the frail sisterhood, losing his fortune and reputation.
The novel described the hardships faced by the frail sisterhood in the city slums.
frail sisterhood.meta: Frail sisterhood — bu ibora tarixan fohishalarni umumiy guruh sifatida tasvirlash uchun ishlatilgan. U odatda kinoyaviy yoki salbiy ohangda qo‘llanadi.

ex: She’s a freak of nature on the tennis court — her agility is unmatched.
The young basketball star is a real freak of nature; his speed and strength are unbelievable.
freak of nature.meta: bu ibora odatda sport yoki boshqa sohalarda noodatiy darajada yuqori mahorat yoki jismoniy qobiliyatga ega bo‘lgan insonni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bunday odamlar "tabiat mo‘jizasi" yoki "yaratilishdagi noyob hodisa" sifatida tasvirlanadi.

ex: The little boy was dressed in frock clothes typical of his era.
In the 19th century, gentlemen often wore frock clothes for formal occasions.
frock clothes.meta: bu tarixiy jihatdan erkaklar kiygan frok palto (uzun, oldi tugmali, ko‘pincha tantanali holatlarda kiyiladigan palto) to‘plamini yoki yosh bolalar kiygan yubkali kiyimlarni bildiradi. Hozirgi kunda bu kiyim turi tarixiy yoki eski urf deb hisoblanadi.

ex: Some people feel that the gender binary does not reflect their true identity.
Many cultures have historically accepted the gender binary as the only system.
gender binary.meta: bu jamiyatdagi jinsiy tasniflash tizimi bo‘lib, unda barcha odamlar faqat ikki guruhga: erkak yoki ayol sifatida ajratiladi. Boshqa gender identifikatsiyalar yoki o‘zini boshqa jinsda his qilish imkoniyatlari bu tizimda ko‘zda tutilmaydi.

ex: The school supports gender-nonconforming students by allowing flexible dress codes.
Alex identifies as gender-nonconforming and prefers to wear clothing not limited to one gender.
gender-nonconforming.meta: Genderga mos kelmaydigan — o‘z genderini yoki tashqi ko‘rinishini jamiyatdagi odatiy yoki an’anaviy erkak yoki ayol tasavvurlariga mos tarzda ifodalamaydigan odam. Bunday shaxslar gender binariyasidan tashqarida o‘zlarini erkin ifoda qiladilar.

ex: Some children show gender nonconformity from an early age.
Gender nonconformity is becoming more visible and accepted in many modern societies.
gender nonconformity.meta: Genderga mos kelmaslik — shaxs o‘z genderini yoki tashqi ko‘rinishini jamiyatdagi an’anaviy yoki erkak/ayolga xos deb hisoblangan odatiy mezonlarga mos tarzda ifodalamagan holat. Bunda shaxs gender stereotiplarini buzadi yoki ularga bo‘ysunmaydi

ex: The buffet was so good that we all left as full as a goog.
After the huge dinner, I was as full as a goog and couldn’t eat another bite.
as full as a goog.meta: To‘lib ketgan — o‘zining to‘liq sig‘imiga yetgan, ayniqsa juda ko‘p ovqat yeganda yoki ichganda ishlatiladi. Kishi ko‘proq ovqat yeyolmaydigan holatda bo‘ladi.

ex: She slapped him when he tried to go the grope on the bus.
He got into trouble for going the grope at the party.
to go the grope.meta: Kishi yoki odamni ruxsatisiz, qo‘pol yoki no‘noq tarzda jinsiy maqsadda ushlash yoki tegish. Bu odatda nomaqbul va noqonuniy harakat hisoblanadi.

ex: The Gurkha knife is famous for its distinctive curved blade.
The soldier carried a Gurkha knife as part of his uniform.
so‘z turkumi.meta: Gurka askarlari tomonidan an’anaviy tarzda ishlatiladigan va ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan egri shakldagi pichoq. Bu pichoq ko‘pincha jang va kundalik ishlarda qo‘llaniladi. Ushbu pichoq "kukri" nomi bilan ham tanilgan.

ex: The hotel provides handicap-accessible rooms on the first floor.
This restaurant is handicap-accessible with ramps and wide doors.
handicap-accessible.meta: Asosan bino, yo‘lak, transport vositasi va shunga o‘xshash joylar yoki narsalar nogironligi bor insonlar tomonidan bemalol foydalanish yoki kirish mumkin bo‘lgan holat.

ex: They renovated the entrance to be handicapped-accessible.
The library is handicapped-accessible with automatic doors and ramps.
handicapped-accessible.meta: Asosan bino, yo‘lak, transport vositasi va boshqa inshootlarning nogironligi bor insonlar tomonidan bemalol foydalanish yoki ularga erkin kirish imkonini beruvchi holati.

ex: Many health workers risked their lives during the pandemic.
The health worker visited the village to provide vaccinations.
health worker.meta: Shaxs, jamoa yoki jamiyat sog‘lig‘ini saqlash va sog‘liqni tiklash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi, maxsus tayyorgarlikka ega bo‘lgan kasb egalari (masalan, shifokor, hamshira va boshqalar).

ex: The hospital employs over 500 healthcare workers.
Healthcare workers are essential in the fight against infectious diseases.
healthcare worker.meta: Shaxsiy yoki jamoat sog‘lig‘ini saqlash, kasalliklarning oldini olish va davolash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi kasb egalari. Bu guruhga shifokor, hamshira, feldsher, tez yordam xodimi va boshqa sog‘liqni saqlash sohasida ishlaydigan mutaxassislar kiradi.

ex: The police cleared the hobo camp near the railway tracks.
The hobos gathered around a fire at the hobo camp outside the city.
hobo camp.meta: Ko‘pincha temiryo‘l yaqinida yoki shahar chetida joylashgan, hobo (ko‘chmanchi yoki sargardon ishchi) lar vaqtincha yashaydigan joy yoki lager.

ex: During the Great Depression, many unemployed people lived in hobo jungles outside cities.
The hobo jungle near the tracks was home to dozens of travelers.
hobo jungle.meta: Ko‘pincha temiryo‘l yaqinida yoki shahar chekkasida joylashgan, hobo (ko‘chmanchi yoki sargardon ishchi) lar vaqtinchalik lager qurib yashaydigan hudud. Ushbu hudud odatda tartibsiz va tabiiy yoki yarim-tashlangan joy bo‘ladi.

ex: We always go to the mountains on holiday.
She is on holiday in Spain this week.
on holiday.meta: Kishi odatdagi ish yoki majburiyatlardan vaqtincha ozod bo‘lib, odatda hordiq chiqarish yoki sayohat qilish maqsadida dam olayotgan davr.

ex: Holiday heart often occurs in people who do not usually have heart problems.
After the New Year’s party, he was diagnosed with holiday heart syndrome.
holiday heart.meta: Ko‘pincha bayram yoki tantanalar paytida yoki ortiqcha spirtli ichimlik iste’mol qilingandan so‘ng yurak ritmining keskin buzilishi (aritmiya) holati.

ex: She hung holiday lights on the tree to make it more festive.
The streets were covered in holiday lights during the Christmas season.
holiday lights.meta: Bayram mavsumida, ayniqsa Yangi yil va boshqa tantanalarda bezatish uchun ishlatiladigan shamlar, lampalar yoki kichik elektr chiroqlar zanjiri.

ex: The holiday park had a swimming pool, playground, and several restaurants.
We stayed in a holiday park near the beach during our summer vacation.
holiday park.meta: Avvaliga faqat karvon (prikol) uchun mo‘ljallangan dam olish joyi bo‘lib, keyinchalik turli turdagi turar joylar (kabinalar, karvonlar, chodirlar va boshqalar) va ko‘ngilochar hamda dam olish inshootlarini taklif qiladigan maskan.

ex: She was happy to find out that the company provides holiday pay for annual vacations.
Employees are entitled to receive holiday pay during national holidays.
holiday pay.meta: Xodimga ta’til yoki dam olish kunlari (shu jumladan davlat bayramlari) davomida to‘lanadigan ish haqi yoki maosh.

ex: Every year, we set up a big holiday tree in the living room.
They decorated the holiday tree with colorful ornaments and fairy lights.
holiday tree.meta: Bayram mavsumida, ayniqsa, Yangi yil yoki Rojdestvo davrida bezatiladigan, ignabargli daraxt yoki uni taqlid qiluvchi sun’iy daraxt. Daraxt odatda chiroqlar, bezaklar va jilolar bilan bezatiladi.

ex: The holiday village offered swimming pools, restaurants, and sports facilities.
We spent our summer vacation in a holiday village by the sea.
holiday village.meta: Dam oluvchilar orasida mashhur bo‘lgan qishloq, ayniqsa, maxsus dam olish manzili sifatida tashkil qilingan joy. Zamonaviy ma’noda — turar joy, ko‘ngilochar dasturlar va dam olish infratuzilmasi bilan ta’minlangan mustaqil dam olish majmuasi.

ex: The temple was severely damaged during an act of idoloclasm.
The rise of the new religion led to widespread idoloclasm across the region.
idoloclasm.meta: Butlarga sig‘inishni rad etish yoki butlarni qasddan buzish va yo‘q qilish jarayoni.

ex: She was found to be an illegal alien after an immigration inspection.
The government is strengthening border security to prevent the entry of illegal aliens.
illegal alien.meta: Qonuniy ruxsatsiz boshqa mamlakat hududida yashayotgan yoki ishlayotgan shaxs; rasmiy hujjatlarsiz yoki vizasiz muhojir.

ex: She was hospitalized after complications from an illegal operation.
In the past, many women risked their lives by undergoing illegal operations.
illegal operation.meta: Matematika yoki mantiqiy jarayonda ruxsat etilmagan yoki bajarilishi mumkin bo‘lmagan amaliyot, ko‘pincha hisoblash yoki dasturda xato yuzaga kelganda ishlatiladi.

ex: The doctor examined the urethral opening for signs of blockage.
The urethral opening can sometimes become inflamed due to infection.
urethral opening.meta: Erkak tanasida siydik va urug‘ tashqariga chiqadigan jinsiy a’zo uchidagi teshik.

ex: It is believed that the juju man can cast spells to bring good luck.
The villagers went to the juju man for protection from evil spirits.
juju man.meta: Juju tizimida muhim o‘rin tutadigan shaxs; odatda, sehr yoki g‘ayritabiiy kuchlar orqali insonlar hayotiga ta’sir qila oladigan, himoya qiladigan yoki zarar yetkazadigan deb hisoblanadigan kishi.

ex: The rise of Knight Templardom marked a new era of military religious orders.
Knight Templardom played a crucial role in the Crusades.
knight templardom.meta: Tamplier ritsarlari — o‘rta asrlarda tashkil topgan, diniy va harbiy vazifalarni bajargan maxsus ritsarlar ordenining jamiyati yoki butun birlashmasi.

ex: The traditions of Knight Templarism are preserved in some modern fraternal societies.
Knight Templarism emphasizes loyalty, bravery, and religious dedication.
knight templarism.meta: Tamplier ritsarlari harakati, tamoyillari, marosimlari va tashkilot tizimi — bu o‘rta asr harbiy-diniy ordeni yoki zamonaviy ritsarlik tashkilotlariga taalluqli bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Many controversial decisions are made in a lame-duck session when outgoing politicians have little to lose.
The bill was passed during the lame-duck session of Congress.
lame-duck session.meta: Saylovdan keyin, lekin yangi saylangan a’zolar o‘z lavozimiga kirishishidan oldin o‘tkaziladigan parlament yoki shtat qonunchilik organining yig‘ilishi.

ex: The dispute between the Church and the Crown was about lewd patronage and who had the right to make appointments.
The king exercised lewd patronage to appoint his supporters to important positions.
lewd patronage.meta: bu tarixiy kontekstda cherkov emas, balki qirol (yoki davlat) tomonidan lavozim tayinlash yoki imtiyozlar berish jarayoni. Bu odatda dunyoiy, ya’ni diniy tizimdan tashqarida bo‘lib, qirol tomonidan nazorat qilinadigan homiylik hisoblanadi.

ex: The lamp was chosen for its high luminous flux and energy efficiency.
The luminous flux of the new LED lamp is 800 lumens.
luminous flux.meta: Yorug‘lik oqimi – bu yorug‘lik manbasidan chiqadigan yoki sirt tomonidan qabul qilinadigan yorug‘lik energiyasining oqish tezligi. Bu inson ko‘zining turli to‘lqin uzunliklariga sezgirligi hisobga olingan holda o‘lchanadi.

ex: She speaks both Standard English and Māori English fluently.
Māori English includes many loanwords from the Māori language.
māori english.meta: Maori ingliz tili – bu asosan maorilar orasida ishlatiladigan, lekin faqat ular bilan cheklanmagan ingliz tilining bir nechta turlari bo‘lib, u maori tilining talaffuzi, so‘z boyligi va ba’zan grammatikasidan ta’sirlangan inglizcha shakldir.

ex: Maori onions are common in the grasslands of New Zealand’s South Island.
The Maori onion blooms in spring with bright yellow flowers.
maori onion.meta: Maori piyozi – Yangi Zelandiyaga xos bo‘lgan, Bulbinella hookeri (yoki Chrysobactron hookeri) nomi bilan tanilgan ko‘p yillik o‘simlik. Bu o‘simlik Liliaceae (lola) oilasiga mansub bo‘lib, zich sariq gul shingillariga ega.

ex: Maori potatoes are often used in traditional hangi cooking.
The Maori potato has a purple skin and is drier than regular potatoes.
maori potato.meta: Maori kartoshkasi – Maori xalqi tomonidan qadimdan yetishtirilgan, asosan qizg‘ish yoki binafsha po‘stlog‘iga ega bo‘lgan, ichi quruq va ezilganida bo‘lak-bo‘lak bo‘ladigan turli nav kartoshkalar.

ex: The presence of the Maori rat has affected native bird populations.
The Maori rat, or kiore, was the only land mammal introduced by the Māori to New Zealand.
maori rat.meta: Maori kalamushi – Rattus exulans turiga mansub kichik kalamush bo‘lib, Yangi Zelandiyaga Maori xalqi tomonidan olib kelingan. Bu kalamush madaniy va ekologik ahamiyatga ega.

ex: Disputes over Māori titles are still common in New Zealand courts.
The Māori title of the land was recognized by the Treaty of Waitangi.
māori title.meta: Maori mulk huquqi – Maori xalqining qadimiy egalik huquqlariga va urf-odatlariga asoslangan yerga egalik qilish huquqi bo‘lib, bu huquq 1840-yilda Waitangi shartnomasi orqali qonuniy ravishda tasdiqlangan.

ex: Maori weeds still roam freely in some parts of the countryside.
The rider struggled to tame the Maori weed.
maori weed.meta: Maori yovvoyi oti – Hali qo‘lga o‘rgatilmagan, yovvoyi holatda yashovchi ot; odam tomonidan boshqarish yoki minish uchun tarbiyalanmagan ot.

ex: Learning to use this app is as easy as one, two, three.
Don't worry, fixing this is as easy as one, two, three.
easy as one, two, three.meta: Bir, ikki, uchdek oson – Juda sodda, tushunish yoki bajarish uchun hech qanday qiyinchilik tug‘dirmaydigan holat yoki ish. Bu ibora narsaning osonligini ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: A pocket square can add elegance to any formal outfit.
He wore a blue suit with a white pocket square.
pocket square.meta: Cho‘ntak ro‘moli – Odatda ipak yoki linaldan tayyorlangan kvadrat shakldagi mato bo‘lib, kostyum yoki jaketning ko‘krak cho‘ntagiga chiroyli tarzda joylashtiriladigan bezak unsuri.

ex: She became a pop idol after her first hit single topped the charts.
The pop idol performed in front of thousands of screaming fans.
pop idol.meta: Pop yulduzi – Juda mashhur va katta muxlislar bazasiga ega bo‘lgan pop musiqasi ijrochisi; ko‘pchilik sevib tinglaydigan va katta ta’sirga ega san’atkor.

ex: During the praise break, the choir sang an upbeat gospel song that energized everyone.
The congregation erupted into a praise break, clapping and dancing with joy.
praise break.meta: Ba’zi Afrika-amerikalik va Pentakostal cherkovlarida xizmat davomida tez sur’atdagi ruhiy qo‘shiqlar (gospel) ijro etiladigan, qo‘shiq aytish, qarsak chalish, raqs tushish va his-tuyg‘ularni ochiq ifodalash bilan birga kechadigan ibodatning qisqa qismi.

ex: She proudly wore a ring symbolizing her purity pledge.
Many teenagers in the group took a purity pledge to abstain from sex until marriage.
purity pledge.meta: Poklik qasami – Kishi o‘zini axloqiy va to‘g‘ri yo‘lda tutishga, keyingi ma’noda esa, ayniqsa yoshlar tomonidan nikohgacha jinsiy aloqadan tiyilish haqida berilgan rasmiy va shaxsiy va’da yoki qasam.

ex: Many teenagers wear purity rings to show their commitment to abstinence.
She received a purity ring as a symbol of her decision to wait until marriage.
purity ring.meta: Poklik uzugi — odatda yoshlar tomonidan nikohgacha jinsiy aloqadan tiyilish majburiyatini ramziy ifodalovchi uzuk.

ex: The crew likes to roll deep to show their strength.
They always roll deep when they go to concerts.
to roll deep.meta: Slang so‘z, asosan Amerika inglizchasida ishlatiladi. Rap, hip-hop va grime madaniyatida ko‘p a’zolardan tashkil topgan guruh yoki jamoa tarkibida bo‘lish yoki shunday katta guruh bilan yurishni anglatadi.

ex: Don’t go schizo over small problems.
He started to go schizo after hearing the bad news.
to go schizo.meta: Endi ko‘pincha haqoratli deb hisoblanishi mumkin bo‘lgan ibora. “To go schizo” — odamning mantiqsiz, aqlga sig‘maydigan tarzda o‘ylay boshlashi yoki harakat qilishi, ayniqsa, bejiz g‘azab yoki zo‘ravonlik ko‘rsatishi.

ex: People with schizoid personality disorder may appear emotionally cold or detached.
Schizoid personality disorder often leads to isolation from others.
schizoid personality disorder.meta: Ijtimoiy va yaqin munosabatlardan doimiy qochish, his-tuyg‘ularni cheklangan ifodalash bilan tavsiflangan shaxsiyat buzilishi; odatda yosh kattalikda boshlanadi.

ex: The buildup of senile plaques affects brain function and memory.
Senile plaques are commonly found in the brains of Alzheimer’s patients.
senile plaque.meta: (a) Kattalikka yetgan kishilarda yuzaga keladigan g‘ayrioddiy teri joyi (eskirgan, kam uchraydigan ma’noda); (b) Altsgeymer kasalligida odamlar miyasi ichida yig‘ilgan oqsillar mikroskopik to‘planmasi.

ex: The buildup of senile plaques affects brain function and memory.
Senile plaques are commonly found in the brains of Alzheimer’s patients.
senile plaque.meta: (a) Kattalikka yetgan kishilarda yuzaga keladigan g‘ayrioddiy teri joyi (eskirgan, kam uchraydigan ma’noda); (b) Altsgeymer kasalligida odamlar miyasi ichida yig‘ilgan oqsillar mikroskopik to‘planmasi.

ex: His unexpected question brought me up short and I couldn’t answer immediately.
The teacher brought the student up short when he started to cheat during the exam.
to bring (a person) up short.meta: Biror kishini birdan to‘xtatish yoki to‘satdan harakatini to‘xtatib qo‘yish; kimningdir davom etayotgan ishini yoki harakatini tekshirish yoki to‘xtatib qo‘yish.

ex: Some people use the term "soy boy" to mock men they think are not traditionally masculine.
He is a soy boy who prefers plant-based milk over cow’s milk.
soy boy.meta: Go‘sht yoki sut mahsulotlariga alternativa sifatida soya mahsulotlarini iste’mol qiluvchi erkak. Ko‘pincha ijtimoiy yoki madaniy stereotip asosida zaif, nozik yoki odatdagi erkaklik xususiyatlariga ega bo‘lmagan erkakni kamsituvchi tarzda ta’riflash.

ex: Don’t chuck a spaz just because things aren’t going your way.
He really chucked a spaz when he found out someone had borrowed his car without asking.
to chuck a spaz.meta: Kimnidir o‘ta jahli chiqib, qo‘pollik bilan yoki qattiq norozilik bildirgan holda gapirish, jahl chiqarmoq.

ex: Don’t have a spaz attack just because things didn’t go your way.
He had a spaz attack when he lost his keys.
spaz attack.meta: Vaqtinchalik kuchli his-tuyg‘ularning, odatda hayajon yoki jahlning birdaniga chiqishi, tez o‘tuvchi ruhiy portlash.

ex: Swing dance is known for its lively and bouncing steps.
They took swing dance lessons to learn the energetic moves.
swing dance.meta: Har xil jonli, energiya bilan to‘la raqs turlari bo‘lib, odatda swing musiqasiga ijro etiladi va ko‘tarinki, sakrashga o‘xshash qadamlar hamda ritmik harakatlar bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: Swing dancing is a popular pastime in many cities around the world.
She enjoys swing dancing every weekend with her friends.
swing dancing.meta: Swing raqsini bajarish yoki unga qatnashish jarayoni, ko‘ngilochar yoki hordiq chiqarish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Many teen idols have a large following on social media.
Justin Bieber was a teen idol in the early 2010s.
teen idol.meta: O‘smirlar orasida juda mashhur bo‘lgan va ko‘pincha yosh qizlar tomonidan seviladigan, muvaffaqiyatli yosh aktyor yoki pop yulduz.

ex: Historically, temple dancers played an important role in religious ceremonies.
The temple dancer performed a traditional dance during the festival.
temple dancer.meta: Ibodatxonada raqs tushuvchi shaxs, ko‘pincha ayol yoki qiz; hind diniy an’analarida devadasi sifatida ibodatxonaga bag‘ishlangan ayol yoki qiz.

ex: In many temples, the temple flower is considered sacred.
The temple flower tree blossoms beautifully in the warm climate.
temple flower.meta: Janubiy Osiyoda keng tarqalgan, ibodatxona yoki qabriston atrofida ko‘p ekiladigan frangipani daraxtining turi.

ex: She wears her temple garment under her clothes as a symbol of faith.
Temple garments are an important part of the religious practice for Latter-day Saints.
temple garment.meta: Oxirgi Kunlarning Iso Masih Avlodlari cherkovi a’zolari kiyadigan, tanani qo‘llarning yuqori qismidan oyog‘ining yuqori qismigacha qoplaydigan maxsus diniy ichki kiyimlar to‘plami.

ex: Devadasis were often referred to as temple girls in historical texts.
The temple girl performed traditional dances during the festival.
temple girl.meta: Hind ibodatxonalariga bag‘ishlangan, diniy marosimlarda ibodat qiluvchi va devadasi sifatida xizmat qiluvchi qiz.

ex: Temple names are used in ancestor worship rituals in China.
The emperor was honored with a temple name after his death.
temple name.meta: Xitoyda o‘lgan imperatorga ajdodlarga hurmat ko‘rsatish uchun berilgan nom.

ex: She adopted a Turkish angora cat from the shelter.
The Turkish angora is known for its elegant, silky coat.
turkish angora.meta: Turkiyada paydo bo‘lgan, uzun va yumshoq tuklari, shuningdek, junli dumga ega bo‘lgan mushuk turi.

ex: Ancient warriors used the Turkish bow in battle.
The Turkish bow was renowned for its power and accuracy.
turkish bow.meta: Turkiy yoki turk o‘qchilari tomonidan foydalanilgan, orqa tomonlari egilgan va turli materiallardan tayyorlangan kamon turi. Bundan tashqari, shunga o‘xshash po‘latdan yasalgan kamon.

ex: Prices in Turkey are usually listed in Turkish pounds.
The Turkish pound has undergone several changes in value over the years.
turkish pound.meta: Turkiyaning milliy pul birligi bo‘lgan turk lirasi.

ex: She bought a robe made of Turkish towelling for the spa.
Turkish towelling is popular for its softness and absorbency.
turkish towelling.meta: Sochiq, xalat va plyaj kiyimlari tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladigan yengil, singdiruvchi paxta yoki zig‘ir mato turi.

ex: Those two-for-a-nickel cigars are known for their low quality.
He bought two-for-a-nickel cigars, but they didn't taste good.
two for a nickel.meta: Arzon narxda (ikki dona 5 sentga) sotiladigan past sifatli sigara (sigaret) uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

ex: Making an uneducated guess in science can lead to mistakes.
His answer was just an uneducated guess without any research.
uneducated guess.meta: Malakasiz yoki bilimsiz qilingan taxmin; tafsilotlarga yoki chuqur bilimga emas, balki faqat taxminga asoslangan qaror yoki faraz.

ex: She is a teacher, so she is on vacation in the summer.
The students are on vacation during July and August.
on vacation.meta: Maktab, o‘quv yurtlari yoki ta’lim muassasalari ta’til holatida bo‘lgan va shu davrda o‘quvchilar yoki o‘qituvchilar darslarga qatnashmaydigan vaqt.

ex: Many employees use vacation days during the summer.
I took a vacation day to spend time with my family.
vacation day.meta: Ish yoki kundalik faoliyat to‘xtatilgan, hordiq chiqarish yoki dam olish uchun ajratilgan kun. Ishchilarga ish vaqtidan bo‘sh vaqt berish maqsadida beriladigan kun.

ex: She received her vacation pay even though she didn’t work that week.
The company provides vacation pay to employees during their annual leave.
vacation pay.meta: Xodimga ta’til yoki dam olish uchun berilgan bo‘sh vaqt davomida to‘lanadigan ish haqi yoki maosh.

ex: The court is not in session during its summer vacation time.
During vacation time, the university closes its main offices for several weeks.
vacation time.meta: (a) Foydalanilmayotgan yoki bo‘sh turgan yer yoki mulk davri (hozirgi vaqtda kam ishlatiladi). (b) Sud yoki ta’lim muassasalari kabi joylarda ish faoliyatining to‘xtatilgan, ta’tilga chiqqan davri.

ex: The laboratory used virgin mercury for the experiment to ensure purity.
In ancient alchemy, virgin mercury was believed to hold mystical properties.
virgin mercury.meta: (a) Simyoda simobning asosiy printsipi sifatida qaralgan tushuncha (eskirgan). (b) Tabiatda sof va aralashmagan metall simob shaklida uchraydigan modda.

ex: Virgin sulphur deposits are mined for industrial uses.
In alchemical texts, virgin sulphur symbolized a fundamental element of transformation.
virgin sulphur.meta: (a) Simyoda oltingugurtning asosiy printsipi sifatida ko‘rilgan tushuncha (eskirgan). (b) Tabiatda sof va toza, kristall holatda uchraydigan oltingugurt moddasining turi.

ex: Conservation efforts focus on protecting virgin forests from logging.
The virgin forest is home to many rare species of plants and animals.
virgin forest.meta: Inson tomonidan keng miqyosda boshqarilmagan yoki qazib olinmagan, tabiiy shaklda saqlangan yetuk o‘rmon. Unda tabiiy ravishda o‘sib ulg‘aygan daraxtlar va boshqa o‘simliklar mavjud.

ex: Tadqiqotchilar tog‘larda keng oq yerni kashf etdilar.
The explorers discovered vast virgin territory in the mountains.
virgin territory.meta: Oq yer — o‘rganilmagan, kashf qilinmagan, hali insonlar tomonidan ishlatilmagan, rivojlantirilmagan hudud yoki yer. Begona yer — hali odamlar tomonidan foydalanilmagan, rivojlantirilmagan hudud.

ex: the story speaks about a virginal conception without any sexual intercourse.
the virginal generation of jesus by the virgin mary is a central belief in christianity.
virginal generation.meta: bakirona tug‘ilish — jinsiy aloqasiz farzand dunyoga keltirish, ayniqsa (a) bakira tomonidan homiladorlik va farzand tug‘ilishi, xususan, iso masihning bakira maryamdan tug‘ilishi; (b) boshqa holatlarda jinsiy aloqa bo‘lmagan holda nasl berish.

ex: the virginal membrane is often seen as a sign of virginity.
the doctor examined the virginal membrane carefully.
virginal membrane.meta: bakiralik parda — qiz yoki ayol bakiraligining belgisi sifatida qaraladigan qin kirishidagi yupqa parda (gimen).bakirona — jinsiy aloqasiz, bakiralik holatida bo‘lgan yoki bakira bilan bog‘liq.

ex: she applied virginal milk cream to her face every morning.
virginal milk is used to cleanse and whiten the skin gently.
virginal milk.meta: bakirona sut — sutga o‘xshash ko‘rinishda bo‘lgan kimyoviy tayyorlov, ayniqsa terini tozalash yoki oqartirish uchun kosmetik vosita sifatida ishlatiladi; shuningdek, virgin’s milk — tabiiy sut yoki ona suti ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: hunters often seek the virginia deer for sport.
the virginia deer is common in the forests of north america.
virginia deer.meta: virginia kiyik — oq dum kiyik (ilmiy nomi odocoileus virginianus), shimoliy amerikalik kiyik turi bo‘lib, dumining oq rangda bo‘lishi bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: the doctor conducted a virginity test to check if the hymen was intact.
in some cultures, a virginity test is performed before marriage.
virginity test.meta: bakiralik tekshiruvi — ayol yoki qizning bakira ekanligini aniqlash maqsadida o‘tkaziladigan test, ayniqsa gimenga (bakirona pardaga) jismoniy tekshiruv orqali uning buzilmaganligini aniqlash.

ex: the practice of virginity testing has been widely criticized by human rights organizations.
virginity testing is still practiced in some cultures as a tradition.
virginity testing.meta: bakiralik tekshiruvi o‘tkazish — ayol yoki qizning bakira ekanligini aniqlash uchun test o‘tkazish amaliyoti, odatiy yoki odatdagi marosim; bu amal ko‘pincha gimenga jismoniy tekshiruvni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: the organization supports woc in leadership roles.
woc often face unique social and cultural challenges.
woc.meta: rangli ayollar — oq teridan farqli ravishda boshqa rangdagi teriga ega bo‘lgan ayollar; ko‘pincha irqiy va etnik xilma-xillikni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: many athletes compete in wheelchair basketball at the paralympic games.
wheelchair basketball is a popular sport among people with physical disabilities.
wheelchair basketball.meta: aravachali basketbol — aravachada o‘tirgan odamlar uchun ishlab chiqilgan basketbolning maxsus shakli.

ex: wheelchair rugby is a fast-paced, full-contact sport for athletes in wheelchairs.
wheelchair rugby combines elements of rugby union, ice hockey, basketball, and volleyball.
wheelchair rugby.meta: aravachali regbi — aravachada o‘tirgan odamlar uchun ishlab chiqilgan regbi sportining maxsus shakli; ayniqsa, regbi uyuni, muz xokkeyi, basketbol va voleybol elementlarini o‘z ichiga olgan sport turi.

ex: many tournaments feature wheelchair tennis alongside able-bodied competitions.
wheelchair tennis is played by athletes with physical disabilities using specially designed wheelchairs.
wheelchair tennis.meta: aravachali tennis — aravachada o‘tirgan odamlar uchun maxsus ishlab chiqilgan tennis sportining turi.

ex: yangi kutubxonada nogironlar uchun aravachali kirish mavjud.
the new library has wheelchair access for people with disabilities.
wheelchair access.meta: aravachali kirish — bino, transport vositasi va boshqa joylarga aravachada yuradigan odamlar uchun mo‘ljallangan kirish imkoniyati; bunday kirishni ta’minlash uchun binoda yoki transport vositasida qilingan o‘zgartirishlar yoki jihozlar.

ex: the new train is fully wheelchair accessible.
the building is wheelchair accessible, with ramps and elevators.
wheelchair accessible.meta: aravachalar uchun moslangan — bino, transport vositasi, yo‘l va boshqa joylar aravachada yuradigan odamlar tomonidan foydalanish uchun qulay va kirish imkoniyati mavjud bo‘lgan holat.

ex: many restaurants are becoming more wheelchair-friendly.
the hotel is wheelchair-friendly, with wide doorways and ramps.
wheelchair-friendly.meta: aravachalar uchun qulay — bino, transport vositasi, yo‘l va boshqa joylar aravachalar foydalanuvchilari uchun moslashtirilgan yoki ularga qulay bo‘lgan holat.
