ex: this language reflects the cultural identity of african americans.
african american language includes unique vocabulary and grammatical structures.
african american language.meta: afrikalik amerikaliklarning tili — dastlab afrikalik amerikaliklar tomonidan keng qo‘llanilgan til; hozir esa turli o‘ziga xos lahjalar yoki tillar majmui sifatida qaraladi, ular ko‘pincha ingliz tilining xilma-xil variantlari sifatida ko‘riladi.

ex: when the air quality index is poor, people are advised to stay indoors.
the air quality index today shows high pollution levels.
air quality index.meta: havo sifati indeksi — o‘lchangan yoki bashorat qilingan havo ifloslanish darajasini ko‘rsatadigan bir nechta indekslardan biri; odatda sog‘liq uchun mumkin bo‘lgan ta’sirlarni ko‘rsatish maqsadida hukumat tashkilotlari tomonidan e’lon qilinadi.

ex: this dolphin plays an important role in the amazon river ecosystem.
the amazon river dolphin is known for its long snout and pinkish color.
amazon river dolphin.meta: amazon daryosi delfini — amazon va orinoko daryolari tizimlarida yashaydigan katta daryo delfini (inia geoffrensis, iniidae oilasiga mansub); u uzun ingichka burun va egiluvchan tanaga ega.

ex: amoled screens are thinner and more energy-efficient than lcds.
many smartphones use amoled displays for better color and contrast.
amoled.meta: amoled — organik yorug‘lik chiqaruvchi diodlar (oled) asosida ishlaydigan, ko‘pincha smartfonlar, noutbuklar va boshqa elektron qurilmalarda ishlatiladigan faol matritsali displey texnologiyasi.

ex: when the aqi is high, people with respiratory problems should stay indoors.
the aqi today indicates moderate air pollution.
aqi.meta: havo sifati indeksi — o‘lchangan yoki bashorat qilingan havo ifloslanish darajasini ko‘rsatadigan bir nechta indekslardan biri; odatda sog‘liq uchun mumkin bo‘lgan ta’sirlarni ko‘rsatish maqsadida hukumat tashkilotlari tomonidan e’lon qilinadi.

ex: meteorologists monitor atmospheric rivers to predict flooding.
an atmospheric river can bring heavy rainfall to coastal regions.
atmospheric river.meta: atmosfera daryosi — atmosfera ichida gorizontal harakat qiluvchi, ko‘p miqdorda suv bug‘ini o‘z ichiga olgan uzun va tor havo oqimi.

ex: Balloon pants have come back into style this summer.
She is wearing balloon pants today; they look very fashionable.
balloon pants.meta: Balloon pants – bu yuqori qismida keng va bo‘sh, tizzadan pastda yoki to‘piqda torayib ketadigan shim turi. Ushbu shimlar odatda qulay va erkin harakatlanish imkonini beradi.

ex: Balloon trousers are perfect for summer weather.
She bought new black balloon trousers yesterday.
balloon trousers.meta: Balloon trousers – bu yuqori son qismida keng va bo‘sh bo‘lib, to‘piq qismida torayadigan shim turi. Bu shimlar odatda qulay bo‘lib, zamonaviy yoki sport uslubida ishlatiladi.

ex: Improper ballot harvesting can potentially affect election results.
In some states, ballot harvesting is a legal and regulated practice.
ballot harvesting.meta: Ballot harvesting – bu saylovlarda uchinchi shaxs tomonidan to‘ldirilgan masofaviy yoki pochta orqali yuborilgan byulletenlarni yig‘ib, ularni saylov komissiyasiga topshirish jarayoni.

ex: Some people choose a butt lift to improve their overall appearance.
She decided to undergo a butt lift to enhance her body shape.
butt lift.meta: Butt lift – bu estetik jarrohlik amaliyoti bo‘lib, dumba shaklini, hajmini yoki ko‘rinishini o‘zgartirish uchun amalga oshiriladi. Odatda ortiqcha teri va yog‘larni olib tashlash orqali bajariladi.

ex: Some patients choose a buttock lift to remove excess skin after significant weight loss.
She wants to have a buttock lift to improve her body contour.
buttock lift.meta: bu estetik jarrohlik amaliyoti bo‘lib, dumba shakli, hajmi yoki ko‘rinishini yaxshilash maqsadida bajariladi. Odatda ortiqcha teri va yog‘larni olib tashlash orqali yoki boshqa to‘ldirish usullari yordamida dumba ko‘tariladi va shakllantiriladi.

ex: Stop the capping; we know you’re exaggerating.
His story sounded like pure capping to impress his friends.
capping.meta: Capping – bu ko‘cha nutqida ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, kimdir boshqalarni qoyil qoldirish yoki qo‘rqitish maqsadida bo‘rttirib gapirish yoki rost bo‘lmagan harakatlar qilishi holatini anglatadi.

ex: The concept of the celestial sphere is essential in understanding the movement of celestial bodies.
Astronomers map the positions of stars on the celestial sphere.
celestial sphere.meta: Osmon sferasi – bu tasavvuriy (xayoliy) shar bo‘lib, uning markazi Yer deb hisoblanadi. Osmon jismlarining joylashuvi Yerning aylanish o‘qiga nisbatan ushbu sfera yuzasida aniqlanadi.

ex: The chiminea is perfect for warming up outdoor spaces on chilly evenings.
She installed a beautiful chiminea in her garden.
chiminea.meta: Chiminea – bu dastlab Ispaniyada va ispan tilida so‘zlashuvchi mamlakatlarda ishlatilgan ochiq pech bo‘lib, ochiq og‘zi va konus shaklidagi tutun chiqarish quvuriga ega bo‘lgan o‘choqdir.

ex: The veterinarian diagnosed the lamb with coenurosis caused by tapeworm larvae.
Coenurosis in sheep often leads to neurological symptoms like unsteady walking.
coenurosis | cenurosis.meta: Ssenuroz – bu asosan qo‘ylar, echkilar, ba'zan esa boshqa hayvonlar va kamdan-kam hollarda insonlarda uchraydigan parazitar kasallikdir.

ex: This store sells a variety of comfort wear for everyday use.
She prefers comfort wear when relaxing at home.
comfort wear.meta: Comfort wear – bu kundalik hayotda, ayniqsa uyda yoki norasmiy holatlarda kiyiladigan, tanaga qulay va erkin harakat qilish imkonini beradigan kiyim yoki ba'zan poyabzal turi.

ex: Compression fractures are common in elderly people with osteoporosis.
He suffered a compression fracture in his spine after the car accident.
compression fracture.meta: Bosilish natijasida suyak sinishi – bu suyak yoki boshqa materialning kuchli bosim yoki yuk ta’sirida sinishi holati. Bu turdagi sinish odatda umurtqa pog‘onasi (vertebralar)da uchraydi, lekin boshqa suyaklarda ham bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The new rules confuddled everyone in the office.
He confuddled me with his complicated explanations.
confuddle.meta: Confuddle – bu kishi yoki narsani chalkashtirib yuborish, tushunmaslikka sabab bo‘lish yoki boshini qotirishni anglatadi. Bu so‘z asosan norasmiy til va hazil ohangida ishlatiladi.

ex: She looked confuddled by the complicated situation.
After all those instructions, I was completely confuddled.
confuddled.meta: Confuddled – bu chalkashib qolgan, nima bo‘layotganini tushunmay qolgan, boshqotgan yoki adashib qolgan holatni ifodalaydi. Ba'zan norasmiy nutqda yengil mastlik holatini ham anglatuvchi sifat sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The researchers controlled for income as a covariate in the analysis.
Age is often included as a covariate in health-related studies.
covariate.meta: Kovariata – bu tajriba yoki tadqiqot natijalarida kuzatilgan o‘zgarishlarga qisman ta’sir qilishi mumkin bo‘lgan o‘lchab bo‘ladigan o‘zgaruvchi (omil).

ex: Modern aviation distinguishes clearly between crewed and unmanned aircraft.
The next mission will be launched aboard a crewed spacecraft.
crewed.meta: Crewed – bu odatda samolyot, kema yoki kosmik kemalar haqida qo‘llanadigan sifat bo‘lib, ichida ekipaj bo‘lgan yoki ekipaj tomonidan boshqariladigan degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: Some parasites require multiple hosts, but only one definitive host supports their sexual reproduction.
The dog is the definitive host for certain species of tapeworms.
definitive host.meta: Asosiy mezbon – bu parazit organizm o‘zining to‘liq rivojlanish bosqichiga yetadigan yoki jinsiy ko‘payish jarayoni amalga oshadigan tirik organizm. Parazitlar hayot tsiklining asosiy qismi yoki ko‘payish bosqichi aynan shu mezbon organizmda kechadi.

ex: The line of violent windstorms destroyed several buildings and uprooted trees.
A powerful derecho swept through the region last night, causing widespread damage.
derecho.meta: Derecho – bu keng maydonda harakatlanadigan, kuchli va uzoq davom etadigan shamollar tizimi bo‘lib, odatda tez harakat qiluvchi momaqaldiroq chiziqlari bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

ex: Sharing downblouse videos is considered a serious invasion of privacy.
The website was shut down for hosting downblouse photos taken without consent.
downblouse.meta: Downblouse – bu odatda ayolning roziligisiz, uning ko‘ylagi yoki yengidan ichki qismlariga qaraladigan yoki yashirincha suratga olingan fotosurat yoki videolarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: She reported the man to the police for engaging in downblousing.
Downblousing is considered a serious invasion of privacy in most countries.
downblousing.meta: Downblousing – bu ayolning roziligisiz, uning ko‘ylagi yoki libosi ichiga yuqoridan qarab, yashirincha suratga olish yoki video tasvirga tushirish harakati yoki odati.

ex: DSLR cameras are known for their image quality and interchangeable lenses.
She bought a new DSLR for professional photography.
dslr.meta: DSLR – bu raqamli oynali refleks kamera bo‘lib, unda raqamli tasvir datchigi (sensor) va an’anaviy SLR (Single-Lens Reflex) kameralarining optik mexanizmi birlashtirilgan.

ex: Trisomy 18 often causes severe developmental issues in infants.
The doctor diagnosed the baby with Edwards’ syndrome.
edwards’ syndrome.meta: Edvards sindromi – bu tug‘ma genetik kasallik bo‘lib, 18-xromosomaning uch nusxasi (trisomiya) mavjudligi natijasida yuzaga keladi. Bu holat ko‘plab organlar va tana qismlarining rivojlanishida jiddiy buzilishlarga sabab bo‘ladi.

ex: Scientists used environmental DNA to identify the species living in the river ecosystem.
Environmentalists found traces of rare fish species in ocean environmental DNA samples.
environmental dna.meta: Muqit DNKsi – bu organizmdan bevosita olinmagan, balki tuproq, suv, havo yoki boshqa atrof-muhit namunalari orqali olingan DNK.

ex: Doctors acted quickly to prevent exsanguination after the injury.
The patient died from exsanguination following the accident.
exsanguination.meta: Exsanguination – bu jiddiy va hayot uchun xavfli bo‘lgan juda katta miqdorda qon yo‘qotish holati, odatda organizmdagi umumiy qon hajmining katta qismini yoki to‘liq qismini yo‘qotish bilan tavsiflanadi.

ex: In some beetles, the forewings have evolved into hard protective covers.
The butterfly's forewings are usually larger than its hindwings.
forewing.meta: Oldingi qanot – bu to‘rt qanotli hasharotlarda old tomonda yoki yuqori qismda joylashgan qanot juftlaridan biri. Oldingi qanotlar hasharot tanasining o‘rta bo‘g‘imi (mesotoraks) qismidan o‘sib chiqadi.

ex: When you free dive, you must control your breathing carefully.
She learned to free dive to explore coral reefs without scuba gear.
free dive.meta: Free dive – bu nafas olish moslamasisiz yoki qo‘shimcha kislorodsiz suv ostiga sho‘ng‘ish yoki suzish jarayoni. Bunday sho‘ng‘ish faqat o‘z nafasini ushlab, tabiiy ravishda suv ostida harakatlanishni anglatadi.

ex: Freight forwarding services help simplify customs procedures.
The company specializes in freight forwarding for international shipments.
freight forwarding.meta: Yuk jo‘natishni tashkil etish – bu tovarlarni ishlab chiqaruvchidan iste’molchiga yoki boshqa manzilga yetkazib berish jarayonini tashkillashtirish va boshqarish xizmatidir.

ex: His constant fuckery makes it impossible to work with him.
I can’t deal with this level of fuckery anymore.
fuckery.meta: Fuckery – bu odatda adolat­siz, bezovta qiluvchi yoki asabbuzar munosabat, harakat yoki holatni anglatadi. Ba'zan bu so‘z bema'nilik, ahmoqlik yoki axmoqona ishlar ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Gene-edited bacteria are being used to produce new medicines.
Scientists developed gene-edited crops that are resistant to pests.
gene-edited.meta: bu organizmlar, hujayralar yoki boshqa biologik tuzilmalar DNKsi sun’iy ravishda o‘zgartirilgan degan ma’noni anglatadi. Bu o‘zgarish DNKdagi nukleotidlarning kiritilishi, olib tashlanishi yoki almashtirilishi orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The Sun’s gravitational field governs the orbits of the planets.
The Earth’s gravitational field keeps everything anchored to its surface.
gravitational field.meta: Gravitatsion maydon – bu ma’lum massaga ega bo‘lgan har qanday jism atrofida shakllanadigan va boshqa jismlarga tortishish kuchi ta’sir etadigan fazoviy soha.

ex: The professor gave a hand-wavy response and quickly moved on.
His explanation was too hand-wavy to be convincing.
hand-wavy.meta: Hand-wavy – bu odatda javob, tushuntirish yoki fikr yuritish uslubi noaniq, aniq bo‘lmagan, yuzaki yoki befarqlik bilan aytilgan holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Some fans have headcanons that differ from the official storyline.
My headcanon is that these two characters were secretly friends.
headcanon.meta: Headcanon – bu o‘quvchi yoki tomoshabinning biror badiiy asar (kitob, film, serial, o‘yin va boshqalar) haqida o‘zicha shaxsiy tushunchasi yoki qabul qilgan versiyasi.

ex: Grasshoppers use their hindwings to glide over long distances.
The butterfly's hindwings often display vivid color patterns.
hindwing.meta: Orqa qanot – bu to‘rt qanotli hasharotlarning pastki yoki orqa juft qanotlari bo‘lib, ularning tanasining uchinchi bo‘limi – metatoraksdan o‘sib chiqadi.

ex: He had the virus before and then got vaccinated, so he now has hybrid immunity.
Studies suggest that hybrid immunity may provide stronger protection than vaccination or infection alone.
hybrid immunity.meta: Gibrid immunitet – bu odamning biror infeksion kasallikka yoki patogenga qarshi hosil qilgan immuniteti bo‘lib, u vaksina orqali va avval kasallikni boshdan kechirgan tajriba natijasida shakllanadi.

ex: Hydro-energy is a renewable energy source that does not pollute the environment.
Hydroelectric power stations generate electricity using hydro-energy.
hydro-energy.meta: Gidroenergiya – bu harakatlanayotgan suvning (ayniqsa daryolar, kanallar yoki suv omborlaridan oqayotgan suvning) kinetik energiyasi yoki harakat kuchi.

ex: The book describes beings that are capable of interdimensional movement.
In the movie, the characters travel through an interdimensional portal to another universe.
interdimensional.meta: O‘lchamlararo – bu odatda fantastik asarlarda qo‘llaniladigan tushuncha bo‘lib, fazo yoki vaqtning turli o‘lchamlari ichida mavjud bo‘lish yoki ular orasida harakatlana olish holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: The couple conceived after undergoing an IUI procedure.
The doctors recommended IUI (intrauterine insemination) as a fertility treatment.
iui.meta: IUI (Intrauterine insemination) – bu sun’iy urug‘lantirish usuli bo‘lib, spermani maxsus kateter orqali bevosita ayolning bachadoniga kiritish jarayonidir.

ex: Some species of jawfish protect their eggs by carrying them in their mouths.
The jawfish lives in burrows that it digs in the sandy sea floor.
jawfish.meta: Og‘izbosh baliq – bu Opistognathidae oilasiga mansub, odatda kichik o‘lchamli, bosh va og‘zi katta bo‘lgan, tuproqqa yoki qumga chuqur qazib yashaydigan baliqlar guruhi.

ex: Locals brew tea from kratom leaves for its stimulating effects.
The kratom tree is native to tropical forests in South-East Asia.
kratom.meta: Kratom – bu Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyoda o‘sadigan tropik doimiy yashil daraxt bo‘lib, ilmiy nomi Mitragyna speciosa, Rubiaceae (qahva) oilasiga mansub. Kratom daraxtining yirik, yaltiroq, tuxumsimon (ovate) barglari va dumaloq gul shamlari bor.

ex: Some people adapt to living with a limb difference after an accident.
She was born with a limb difference, but it hasn’t stopped her from pursuing sports.
limb difference.meta: Tana a’zosi farqi – bu insonning bir yoki bir nechta qo‘l yoki oyoqlari tug‘ma yoki orttirilgan holatda yo‘q bo‘lishi yoki tuzilishi yoki funksiyasida o‘zgarish bo‘lishi holati.

ex: A liquid biopsy provides a painless and safe diagnostic alternative.
The doctors performed a liquid biopsy to detect signs of cancer.
liquid biopsy.meta: Suyuq biopsiya – bu tashxis qo‘yish maqsadida bemordan olingan qon yoki boshqa tana suyuqligi namunasi tahlili. Suyuq biopsiya yordamida odatda saraton hujayralari, ularning DNK qoldiqlari yoki boshqa kasallik belgilari aniqlanadi.

ex: Electric cars are usually powered by lithium-ion batteries.
Your phone contains a lithium-ion battery that charges quickly and lasts long.
lithium-ion.meta: bu elektrolyti tarkibida litiy birikmasi bo‘lgan, odatda qayta zaryadlanadigan batareya texnologiyasi turi. Litiy-ion batareyalari eng ko‘p mobil telefonlar, noutbuklar, elektr transport vositalari va boshqa zamonaviy qurilmalarda keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The drill involved live-fire to simulate real combat scenarios.
The soldiers conducted live-fire exercises on the training field.
live-fire.meta: Jangovar o‘q-dorilar – bu real yoki haqiqiy o‘q-dorilardan foydalanish holati yoki o‘q uzish amaliyoti. Bu atama ko‘pincha harbiy mashg‘ulotlarda, poligonda yoki real jangovar vaziyatlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: They tried ice cream made with macapuno jelly-like coconut meat.
The soft flesh of the macapuno coconut is widely used in desserts.
macapuno.meta: Makapuno – bu tropik hududlarda, ayniqsa Filippin va boshqa Janubiy-Sharqiy Osiyo mamlakatlarida uchraydigan, tabiiy tarzda hosil bo‘ladigan kokos navidir.

ex: Doctors are mandated reporters and cannot ignore signs of neglect.
Teachers are mandated reporters who must report suspected child abuse.
mandated reporter.meta: Majburiy xabar beruvchi – bu kasbiy yoki qonuniy jihatdan zo‘ravonlik, suiiste’mol yoki e’tiborsizlik holatlarini tegishli davlat organlariga xabar berish majburiyatiga ega bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: A menstrual cup can collect menstrual blood for several hours if inserted correctly.
She started using a menstrual cup because it’s eco-friendly.
menstrual cup.meta: Hayz kubogi – bu odatda silikon yoki rezina materialidan tayyorlangan, qayta ishlatiladigan, qo‘ng‘iroqsimon shakldagi vosita bo‘lib, hayz davrida vaginal ichiga joylashtiriladi va hayz qonini to‘plash uchun xizmat qiladi.

ex: Studies show that mirror neurons are essential for empathy and social learning.
In children, mirror neurons develop through imitation of speech and gestures.
mirror neuron.meta: Aks nöron – bu miyada joylashgan sensor-motor nöron bo‘lib, u inson yoki hayvon biror harakatni bajarayotganda va boshqalarning xuddi shu harakatini kuzatayotganda faollashadi.

ex: Coffee made in a moka coffee maker is strong and rich in flavor.
She brews coffee every morning using a moka pot.
moka.meta: Moka kofe qaynatgichi – bu odatda sakkiz burchakli metall idish bo‘lib, unda suv bug‘ bosimi yordamida qahva donalari orqali yuqoriga suriladi va qahva tayyorlanadi.

ex: Some diet products contain monk fruit extract for sweetness.
Monk fruit is widely used as a natural sugar substitute.
monk fruit.meta: Monax mevasi – bu Siraitia grosvenorii (qovoqdoshlar oilasi) lianasiga mansub kichik, yumaloq meva bo‘lib, uning po‘sti silliq va yashil, ichi esa tolali va jigarrang bo‘ladi. Bu meva asosan Xitoy va Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyoda uchraydi.

ex: The Mooncup can safely collect menstrual blood for several hours if properly inserted.
She started using a Mooncup because it’s more economical and eco-friendly.
mooncup.meta: Mooncup – bu brend nomi bo‘lib, qayta ishlatiladigan, qo‘ng‘iroqsimon shakldagi hayz kubogini ifodalaydi. Odatda silikon yoki rezinadan tayyorlanadi va hayz davrida vaginal ichiga joylashtiriladi.

ex: Motor aphasia impairs the ability to produce speech but does not necessarily affect comprehension.
After the stroke, he developed motor aphasia and struggled to speak.
motor aphasia.meta: bu odamning nutq ishlab chiqarish qobiliyati yo‘qolishi yoki jiddiy darajada buzilishi holati bo‘lib, odatda bosh miyaning asosiy gapirish markazi – Broka maydonida shikastlanish (ko‘pincha insult yoki bosh miya jarohati) natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ex: People with narcissistic personality disorder often disregard the feelings of others.
His narcissistic personality disorder made him constantly seek attention and admiration.
narcissistic personality disorder.meta: Narsissistik shaxsiyat buzilishi – bu odam o‘zini haddan tashqari muhim va ustun deb biladigan, doimiy ravishda maqtov va e'tibor talab qiladigan, boshqalarning his-tuyg‘ularini tushunmaslik yoki ularga befarqlik bilan qaraydigan psixologik buzilishdir.

ex: Negationism can be dangerous to society as it distorts historical truth.
Some groups promote negationism by denying documented genocides.
negationism.meta: Negatsionizm – bu ilmiy yoki tarixiy dalillar bilan tasdiqlangan voqealarni bilib turib inkor etish yoki ularni yolg‘on yoki bo‘rttirilgan deb ko‘rsatish amaliyoti.

ex: The net domestic product (NDP) is calculated by subtracting depreciation from the gross domestic product.
This year, the net domestic product increased by 5% compared to last year.
net domestic product.meta: Sof ichki mahsulot (SIM) – bu mamlakat hududida bir yilda ishlab chiqarilgan barcha tovarlar va xizmatlarning umumiy qiymati bo‘lib, unda asosiy kapital (uskunalar, inshootlar va boshqalar) eskirishi yoki amortizatsiyasi chegirib tashlanadi.

ex: NIPT is usually performed starting from the 10th week of pregnancy.
The doctor recommended NIPT to check for potential genetic disorders in the fetus.
nipt.meta: Invaziv bo‘lmagan prenatal test (NIPT) – bu homilada xromosomal anomaliyalar (masalan, Daun sindromi, Edvards sindromi) va ayrim genetik kasalliklarni aniqlash uchun amalga oshiriladigan xavfsiz, qon orqali bajariladigan homiladorlik tekshiruvi.

ex: Scientists say the amount of ocean plastic is increasing every year.
Ocean plastic is causing serious harm to marine life.
ocean plastic.meta: Okean plastigi – bu dengiz va okeanlarda uchraydigan plastik chiqindilar bo‘lib, asosan inson faoliyati natijasida hosil bo‘ladi. Bunga plastik paketlar, butilkalar, baliqchilik tarmoqlari va boshqa plastik mahsulotlar kiradi.

ex: Her moves are modern, but the OG will always be remembered.
He’s the OG of this music style – he started it all.
og.meta: OG – bu biror narsa yoki yo‘nalishning boshlanishida bo‘lgan, uni yaratgan yoki asos solgan shaxs yoki narsa. Odatda ijobiy ma’noda qo‘llanib, hurmat va e’tirof ifodasi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Members of the papal household play a key role in implementing the pope’s decisions.
The papal household assists the pope in religious ceremonies and daily affairs.
papal household.meta: Papalik uyi – bu Rim papasiga xizmat qiluvchi rasmiy shaxslar va ma’muriy tizimlar majmuasidir. Papalik uyi papa faoliyatini tashkiliy, diniy va kundalik ishlarida qo‘llab-quvvatlash uchun xizmat qiladi.

ex: Parentification can negatively affect a child's emotional well-being.
Despite being very young, she had to take care of her family – this is a case of parentification.
parentification.meta: Bolaning erta kattalashishi – bu bola yoki o‘smirga oilada odatda ota-onalar bajaradigan majburiyatlar va javobgarliklarni yuklash jarayoni yoki holati.

ex: The pavonized metal ornament looked beautiful in the sunlight.
Her dress was made of pavonized fabric that shimmered in the light.
pavonized.meta: Pavonized – bu tovus patiga o‘xshab ranglari turli burchaklardan qaralganda jilvalanib, yaltirab ko‘rinadigan (iridescent) yuzaga ega bo‘lish holati.

ex: Global climate change and economic challenges are pushing the world into a permacrisis.
In recent years, the country has been living in a state of permacrisis.
permacrisis.meta: Uzluksiz inqiroz – bu uzoq davom etadigan, doimiy va jiddiy notinchlik yoki beqarorlik holati bo‘lib, odatda butun jamiyat yoki mamlakat miqyosida yuzaga keladi.

ex: Plasmonics allows light to be controlled at the nanoscale.
Scientists are working on developing a new optical sensor in the field of plasmonics.
plasmonics.meta: Plazmonika – bu elektromagnit to‘lqinlari (odatda optik yoki optikaga yaqin diapazonda) va materiallardagi erkin elektronlarning plazmon deb ataladigan tebranishlari o‘rtasidagi o‘zaro ta’sirni o‘rganadigan ilmiy sohaga aytiladi.

ex: When the polar vortex weakens, cold air can spread across Europe.
This year’s strong polar vortex brought a cold wave to North America.
polar vortex.meta: Qutb girdobi – bu shimoliy yoki janubiy qutb mintaqalarida mavjud bo‘lgan keng va uzoq davom etadigan, sovuq havo massalarining aylanib harakat qiluvchi tizimi.

ex: The mosquito serves as an intermediate host, but the parasite only matures in the primary host.
Humans are the primary host for some parasites during their adult stage.
primary host.meta: Asosiy mezbon – bu parazit to‘liq rivojlanadigan yoki jinsiy ko‘payadigan (yoki ikkalasi ham) tirik organizm. Asosiy mezbon parazit hayot tsiklining eng muhim bosqichida, ya’ni yetuklik va ko‘payish jarayonida zarur muhit hisoblanadi.

ex: Modern phone systems can connect via both PSTN and the Internet.
Traditional landline phones operate over the public switched telephone network (PSTN).
pstn.meta: Jamoat almashinuvchi telefon tarmog‘i (JATT) – bu dunyodagi barcha jamoat telefon stansiyalarini birlashtiradigan va ular orqali ovozli aloqani ta’minlaydigan an’anaviy telefon tarmog‘i.

ex: Some patients use puberty blockers to temporarily delay development.
The doctor prescribed a puberty blocker because puberty started too early.
puberty blocker.meta: bu bolalarda yoki o‘smirlarda balog‘at jarayonini vaqtincha to‘xtatish yoki sekinlashtirish uchun ishlatiladigan tibbiy vosita. Bu dorilar odatda organizmda estrogen va testosteron gormonlarining ishlab chiqarilishini bloklaydi.

ex: This phone is the real deal – it’s not a fake.
He’s the real deal in this field – everyone looks up to him.
real deal.meta: Real deal – bu biror kishi yoki narsaning chinakam, haqiqiy, eng yaxshi yoki asl vakili bo‘lish holatini ifodalaydi. Ushbu ibora odatda biror narsaning soxta emasligi yoki kimningdir o‘z sohasida juda yuqori darajada ekani ta’rifida ishlatiladi.

ex: Scientists are studying the role of resolvins in reducing inflammation.
Resolvins may help accelerate the body's healing process.
resolvin.meta: bu omega-3 yog‘ kislotalaridan hosil bo‘ladigan va yallig‘lanish jarayoni tugash bosqichida ishlab chiqariladigan biologik faol moddalar sinfiga kiradi. Rezolvinlar organizmda yallig‘lanishni nazorat qilish va uni tabiiy ravishda tugatishga yordam beradi.

ex: The school resource officer educates students about safety rules and helps maintain a secure environment.
Every school is required to have at least one school resource officer.
school resource officer.meta: Maktab xavfsizlik xodimi – bu maktab ichida xavfsizlik choralari bo‘yicha maslahat berish, o‘quvchilar va xodimlarga xavfsizlikni ta’minlash hamda yordam ko‘rsatish uchun ishga olingan huquqni muhofaza qiluvchi organlar xodimi.

ex: Using short rows allows for better fit and shaping of garments.
Short rows are used to shape sleeves in knitting.
short row.meta: Qisqa qator – bu to‘qish yoki g‘arish (kroşe) ishida to‘liq qator o‘rniga faqat qisman tikilgan qator bo‘lib, ishni aylantirishdan oldin faqat qisman tugunlar ishlanadi.

ex: A SPAC is a shell corporation set up to raise money from investors.
Many tech startups choose to go public through a special purpose acquisition company (SPAC).
spac.meta: Maqsadli sotib olish kompaniyasi (SPAC) – bu investorlardan mablag‘ yig‘ish uchun ochiq aksiyadorlik kompaniyasi sifatida tashkil etilgan, ammo o‘z faoliyatida aniq ishlab chiqarish yoki xizmat ko‘rsatish bilan shug‘ullanmaydigan “shell” kompaniya.

ex: She uses the speech-to-text feature to save time at work.
Modern smartphones have speech-to-text technology.
speech-to-text.meta: Nutqni matnga aylantirish texnologiyasi – bu inson nutqini avtomatik ravishda matn shakliga o‘giruvchi texnologiya yoki jarayon.

ex: Many users use stablecoins to avoid price volatility.
Tether is one of the most popular stablecoins.
stablecoin.meta: Barqaror kripto valyuta – bu narxi nisbatan barqaror bo‘lishi uchun ishlab chiqilgan kriptovalyuta. Odatda, uning qiymati an’anaviy aktivlarga (masalan, AQSh dollari, oltin) yoki boshqa barqaror qiymatga bog‘langan (pegged) bo‘ladi.

ex: Surgeons use sternotomy to access the heart and lungs.
The patient’s chest was opened by sternotomy for heart surgery.
sternotomy.meta: Sternotomiyа – bu ko‘krak suyagining (sternum) jarrohlik yo‘li bilan kesilishi yoki ochilishi bo‘lib, odatda ko‘krak qafasidagi organlarga, xususan yurak va o‘pkaga kirish uchun amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Strange matter is theoretically expected to exist in quark stars.
Physicists study the properties of strange matter.
strange matter.meta: G‘ayrioddiy modda – bu bir yoki bir nechta g‘ayrioddiy kvarklarni o‘z ichiga olgan modda yoki zarralar. Bu turdagi modda nazariy jihatdan yulduzlar yadrosida yoki juda zich sharoitlarda paydo bo‘lishi mumkin deb hisoblanadi

ex: The COVID-19 pandemic and mental health issues created a syndemic.
Poverty and infectious diseases are often part of a syndemic.
syndemic.meta: Sindemik – bu bir nechta kasalliklar yoki sog‘liq muammolarining birga mavjud bo‘lishi va ular o‘rtasida zararli o‘zaro ta’sirlar yuzaga kelishi holati.

ex: Radio waves can sometimes be considered a technosignature because they might come from artificial sources.
Astronomers search for technosignatures to find evidence of intelligent life in the universe.
technosignature.meta: Texnosignatura – bu astronomik ma’lumotlarda texnologiya mavjudligidan (hozirgi yoki o'tmishda) dalolat beruvchi ta’sir yoki o‘lchanadigan xususiyat.

ex: The military uses thermobaric weapons because they affect a wide area.
A thermobaric bomb releases a large fireball when detonated.
thermobaric.meta: Termobarik – bu portlatilganda yonuvchi yoqilg‘i yoki boshqa yonuvchi moddalar bulutini ajratib, havoni isitib, yuqori bosim hosil qiluvchi portlovchi qurilma yoki qurol turlarini ifodalovchi atama.

ex: Some surgeries are done using a transvaginal approach.
The doctor performed a transvaginal ultrasound to examine the uterus.
transvaginal.meta: bu jarrohlik yoki diagnostika protseduralarida qin orqali bajariladigan yoki qin bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan. Ushbu atama asosan tibbiyotda ayollar jinsiy tizimiga oid tekshiruvlar, biopsiyalar yoki jarrohlik amaliyotlarini ta’riflashda ishlatiladi.

ex: The transvaginal mesh helped support the woman’s bladder position.
The doctor implanted a transvaginal mesh to treat pelvic organ prolapse.
transvaginal mesh.meta: Transvaginal to‘ri – bu pelvik a’zolarning prolapsini (pastga tushishini) davolash uchun qin orqali jarrohlik amaliyotida qo‘llaniladigan jarrohlik to‘ri.

ex: The museum displayed large Tyrannosaurus rex fossils.
The T. rex is one of the most famous predatory dinosaurs.
t. rex.meta: T. rex — bu Tyrannosaurus rex ning qisqartmasi bo‘lib, yirik yirtqich dinozavr turi. U o‘rta quruq er davrining oxirgi yillarida yashagan va eng mashhur yirtqich dinozavrlardan biri hisoblanadi.

ex: Today, uncrewed drones are used in many industries.
Uncrewed spacecraft send data back from Mars.
uncrewed.meta: Yo‘lovchisiz yoki ekipsiz – bu insonlar yoki ekipaj tomonidan boshqarilmaydigan yoki ularning ishtirokisiz ishlaydigan kemalar, transport vositalari, samolyotlar yoki boshqa qurilmalarni ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: Summer fashion often includes clothes that reveal the underboob area.
She likes wearing outfits that show the underboob.
underboob.meta: Ko‘krak osti qismi – bu ayollarning ko‘kraklari ostidagi hudud, ayniqsa qisqa yoki tor kiyimlar kiyilganda, bu joyda ko‘krakning pastki qismi va uning ostidagi teri ko‘zga tashlanadigan joy.

ex: The teacher communicates with students via video calls during online classes.
They make at least one video call a day when working remotely.
video call.meta: Video qo‘ng‘iroq – bu video texnologiyasi yordamida amalga oshiriladigan telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i bo‘lib, ishtirokchilar suhbat davomida bir-birlarini ko‘rishlari va eshitishlari mumkin.

ex: It became easier to monitor visitors remotely with a video doorbell.
A video doorbell was installed at the house entrance so the owner can see visitors inside.
video doorbell.meta: Video qo‘ng‘iroq – bu elektron eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i bo‘lib, unga xavfsizlik kamerası o‘rnatilgan. U tashrif buyuruvchilarni video orqali uy egasiga ko‘rsatadi, shuningdek, ba’zan ikki tomonlama aloqa qilish imkonini ham beradi.

ex: In places without internet, only voice calls can be made.
She called her friend with a voice call only.
voice call.meta: Ovozli qo‘ng‘iroq – bu faqat ovozli aloqa orqali amalga oshiriladigan telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘i. Bu qo‘ng‘iroqda video yoki boshqa vizual elementlar ishlatilmaydi, odatda mobil telefon yoki boshqa aloqa qurilmalari orqali bajariladi.

ex: In some countries, certain ideas are labeled as wrongthink and censored.
He expressed opinions considered wrongthink by the majority.
wrongthink.meta: Noto‘g‘ri fikr – bu ijtimoiy, siyosiy yoki axloqiy nuqtai nazardan qabul qilinmaydigan yoki tanqid qilinadigan e’tiqod yoki qarash. Odatda bu fikr jamiyatda hukmron bo‘lgan g‘oyalarga zid bo‘lgani uchun rad etiladi.

ex: Objects created by 4D printing change shape in response to temperature.
Clothes of the future might be adaptive thanks to 4D printing technology.
4d printing.meta: 4D bosma – bu uch o‘lchovli (3D) raqamli modelni fizik ob’ektga aylantirish jarayoni bo‘lib, bu ob’ekt vaqt o‘tishi bilan o‘z shakli, holati yoki xususiyatlarini atrof-muhit sharoitlariga qarab o‘zgartira oladi.

ex: Assigning excessive responsibility to students at school is a form of adultification.
In some families, adultification causes children to lose their childhood.
adultification.meta: Bolalarni kattalar kabi qabul qilish – bu bolalar yoki yoshlarni zararli yoki tajovuzkor tarzda kattalar kabi munosabatda bo‘lish, mas’uliyat va vazifalarni ortiqcha yuklash amaliyoti.

ex: Many people prefer seafood prepared à la Tartare style.
He likes to eat beef à la Tartare, which means raw.
à la tartare.meta: Tartarcha usulida – bu go‘sht yoki dengiz mahsulotlarini pishirilmagan, xom holatda tayyorlash yoki iste’mol qilish usuli. Odatda mol go‘shti yoki baliq xom holatda mayda to‘g‘ralib, maxsus souslar bilan aralashtiriladi va shunday taqdim etiladi.

ex: Visually impaired users understand the content of images through alt text.
The web designer did not forget to add alt text for every image.
alt text.meta: bu veb-sahifadagi rasm kodiga kiritilgan matn bo‘lib, u rasmning ko‘rinishini yoki funksiyasini ta’riflaydi. Agar rasm yuklanmasa yoki ko‘rish qobiliyati cheklangan foydalanuvchilar uchun, bu matn rasm o‘rnida ko‘rsatiladi yoki o‘qiladi.

ex: Some artists prefer an anti-realistic approach.
This novel contains many anti-realistic elements.
anti-realistic.meta: Anti-realistik – bu xususan adabiyot va san’atda realizmga qarshi yoki realizmni rad etuvchi, undan oshib ketuvchi yondashuv yoki uslub. Shuningdek, bu atama falsafada anti-realizm nazariyasini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi yoki unga oid tushunchalarni ifodalaydi.

ex: Anti-republicans oppose the policies of the Republican Party.
He holds an anti-republican stance in politics.
anti-republican.meta: bu respublikanlik tamoyillariga, siyosiy qarashlariga yoki Respublika partiyasiga qarshi bo‘lgan shaxs yoki bunday qarashlarni ifodalovchi sifat. Bunday odamlar respublika boshqaruvi shaklini yoki aynan Respublika partiyasining siyosatini rad etadilar.

ex: Anti-rightism often appears in various social movements.
He advocates for anti-rightism in political discussions.
anti-rightism.meta: O‘ngga qarshi qarashlar – bu o‘ng qanot yoki reaksion siyosatchilar, g‘oyalar va fikrlarga qarshi bo‘lish holati yoki munosabat. Bu atama siyosiy spektrdagi o‘ng qanot fikrlariga qarshi kurashish yoki tanqid qilishni ifodalaydi.

ex: There are many anti-rightist activists in the community.
He holds an anti-rightist political stance.
anti-rightist.meta: O‘ngga qarshi (sifat) yoki o‘ng qanotga qarshi shaxs (ot) – bu o‘ng qanot yoki reaksion siyosatchilar, odamlar va ularning qarashlariga qarshi bo‘lgan yoki ularga qarshi chiqqan shaxs yoki fikr.

ex: Some literary critics see anti-romantic movements as a reaction to romanticism.
He expresses anti-romantic views about love and relationships.
anti-romantic.meta: Anti-romantik – bu romantizmga, romantik g‘oyalarga yoki romantikaga qarshi bo‘lgan yoki ularni rad etuvchi sifat yoki shaxs. Anti-romantik odamlar ko‘pincha romantik his-tuyg‘ularni, idealizatsiyani yoki hissiy o‘ylashni inkor etadi yoki tanqid qiladi.

ex: The movie is anti-sentimental, showing simple and real events.
He wrote the story in a very anti-sentimental style, avoiding excessive emotions.
anti-sentimental.meta: Anti-sentimental – bu hissiylikka, sadoqatga yoki ortiqcha his-tuyg‘ularga qarshi yoki ularni chetlab o‘tuvchi, hissiyotga asoslangan holatlarga zid bo‘lgan sifat.

ex: Some people take an anti-technology stance to protect natural lifestyles.
He prefers traditional methods and holds an anti-technology view towards modern gadgets.
anti-technology.meta: Texnologiyaga qarshi – bu texnologiyaga, uning rivojlanishiga yoki qo‘llanilishiga qarshi bo‘lgan yoki uni yoqtirmaydigan sifat yoki shaxs.

ex: Police regularly conduct anti-terror operations.
The government strictly enforces anti-terror laws.
anti-terror.meta: Terrorizmga qarshi – bu terrorchilar faoliyatining oldini olish yoki unga qarshi kurashishga qaratilgan, shuningdek zo‘ravonlik yoki qo‘rqitishga asoslangan siyosiy taktikalarning qo‘llanilishini taqiqlovchi yoki kamaytiruvchi.

ex: Anti-terrorism measures help increase national security.
The government is developing new strategies for anti-terrorism.
anti-terrorism.meta: Terrorizmga qarshi kurash – bu terrorizmga qarshi turish siyosati yoki pozitsiyasi; terrorizmni oldini olish yoki unga qarshi kurashish uchun qo‘llaniladigan harbiy yoki siyosiy choralar majmuasi.

ex: Anti-woman attitudes increase inequality in society.
His political stance is anti-woman in nature.
anti-woman.meta: Ayollarga qarshi – bu ayollarning huquqlari va manfaatlariga dushmanona munosabatda bo‘lgan yoki ayollarga qarshi chiqadigan sifat. Bunday shaxslar yoki qarashlar ayollarning teng huquqliligini inkor etishi yoki cheklashi mumkin.

ex: Some social attitudes are anti-women and deny women's rights.
Their political stance is clearly anti-women.
anti-women.meta: bu ayollarning huquqlari va manfaatlariga dushmanona yoki qarshi bo‘lgan, ayollarga nisbatan antagonistik munosabatni bildiruvchi sifat. Ko‘pincha ayollarning tenglik yoki adolatli munosabat talablariga qarshi bo‘lgan holatlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: Anti-Zionist groups oppose Zionism.
He holds an anti-Zionist political stance.
anti-zionist.meta: Anti-siyonist – bu siyonizm g‘oyalariga yoki siyosatiga qarshi bo‘lgan shaxs yoki bunday qarashlarni ifodalovchi sifat. Siyonizm – yahudiylarning tarixiy vatani bo‘lgan Isroil davlatini yaratish va qo‘llab-quvvatlash harakati hisoblanadi.

ex: Back-fanged snakes have grooves on their fangs to conduct venom.
Some venomous snakes are back-fanged, having fangs located at the rear of the mouth.
back-fanged.meta: Orqa tishli – bu (zaharlovchi ilonlar haqida) orqa qismida joylashgan bir yoki ikki juft tishi maxsus nayzasimon shaklga ega bo‘lib, unda zaharni o‘tkazadigan tirqishlar mavjud bo‘lgan holat.

ex: Backhaul plays a crucial role in mobile communication networks.
Telecom operators use backhaul systems to route calls efficiently within a region.
backhaul.meta: Orqa tarmoqli uzatish – bu telekommunikatsiya sohasida, ierarxik tarmoqda, bir hudud ichidagi qo‘ng‘iroqlar yoki ma’lumotlarni bitta yoki bir nechta mintaqaviy almashinuv markazlari orqali yo‘naltirish jarayoni.

ex: The vehicle transported different cargo on the return journey as a backhaul.
The trucking company plans to backhaul goods on the return route.
backhaul.meta: Orqa yo‘nalishda qaytish yukini tashish – bu oldin o‘tgan yo‘l bo‘ylab qaytishda boshqa yuk bilan birga mahsulot yoki tovarlarni olib kelish yoki tashish amali. Bu qaytish yo‘nalishidagi bo‘sh joylardan samarali foydalanish uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: There have been rumors about the existence of black sites in some countries.
Intelligence agencies conduct interrogations at a black site.
black site.meta: Maxfiy bazasi – bu maxfiy harbiy yoki razvedka operatsiyalari olib boriladigan sirli joy yoki inshoot. Odatiy holda, bu joylarda gumon qilingan shaxslarni ushlab turish, so‘roq qilish yoki boshqa yashirin faoliyatlar amalga oshiriladi.

ex: In New Zealand, block claims have clearly defined and marked borders.
Miners in Australia obtain mining rights based on a block claim with fixed boundaries.
block claim.meta: Blok da’vo – bu Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya hududlarida konchilik uchun berilgan, aniq belgilangan chegaralari bo‘lgan yer maydoni bo‘yicha ruxsatnoma yoki da’vo.

ex: A bow echo is often associated with strong winds and flash floods.
Meteorologists identified a bow echo on the radar indicating an approaching severe thunderstorm.
bow echo.meta: Yay shaklidagi aks – bu momaqaldiroq liniyasining radar tasvirida ko‘ringan egilgan, yay shaklini olgan xarakterli chiziq; shuningdek, bunday shakldagi oldingi qismi bo‘lgan momaqaldiroq bo‘roni ham shunday ataladi.

ex: This concept helps to understand the contrasting aspects of Scottish culture.
In Scottish literature, Caledonian antisyzygy is often seen as an integral part of national identity.
caledonian antisyzygy.meta: Kaledoniyalik antisi̇zigi – bu qarama-qarshi yoki ziddiyatli xususiyatlar, g‘oyalar yoki tamoyillarning bir vaqtda mavjud bo‘lishi, ayniqsa Shotland madaniyati va tabiatida ko‘zga tashlanadigan o‘ziga xos belgi sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: The cold chain is crucial for keeping fruits and vegetables fresh.
Vaccines are delivered safely and effectively through the cold chain.
cold chain.meta: Sovuq zanjir – bu ovqat, dorilar va boshqa mahsulotlarni doimiy past haroratda saqlash va tashish uchun mo‘ljallangan ta’minot zanjiri. Bu jarayon mahsulotlarning sifatini saqlash, ularning buzilishining oldini olish uchun juda muhimdir.

ex: The movie’s cold open was mysterious and thrilling.
Many TV shows start with a cold open to quickly grab the audience’s attention.
cold open.meta: Dastlabki sahna – bu film yoki ko‘rsatuv boshida, sarlavha ketma-ketligi yoki kreditlar boshlanishidan oldin namoyish etiladigan sahna yoki qisqa epizod. Maqsadi tomoshabinni qiziqtirish, e’tiborini jalb qilish va dastlabki syujetni yaratishdir.

ex: Fruits and vegetables are kept fresh using a reliable cold storage chain.
The cold storage chain is crucial for the safe transport of vaccines.
cold storage chain.meta: bu ovqat, dorilar va boshqa mahsulotlarni nazorat qilinadigan va doimiy past haroratda saqlash hamda tashish imkonini beruvchi ta’minot zanjiri. Bu jarayon mahsulotlarning sifatini saqlab qolish va ularning buzilishini oldini olish uchun juda muhimdir.

ex: Down-firing speakers reflect sound off the floor for richer audio experience.
The subwoofer is down-firing, directing sound towards the floor to enhance bass.
down-firing.meta: bu, ayniqsa subwooferlarda, ovoz chiqaruvchi qurilmaning tovushni pastga, ya’ni pol yuzasiga qarata yo‘naltirishini anglatadi. Bu usul asosan past tovush chastotalarini (bass) yaxshiroq tarqatish yoki aks ettirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Many investors focus on emerging markets looking for new opportunities.
China and India are among the largest emerging markets.
emerging market.meta: Rivojlanayotgan bozor – bu tez sur’atlarda iqtisodiy o‘sish va taraqqiyot bosqichida bo‘lgan mamlakat yoki hudud. Odatda o‘rta darajadagi daromadga ega bo‘lib, sanoatlashish va bozor infratuzilmasini rivojlantirish jarayonida bo‘ladi.

ex: The children started to figure-skate after getting new skates as gifts.
She figure-skates every weekend at the ice rink.
figure-skate.meta: Figura konkida uchmoq – bu figura konkida uchish sporti yoki sevimli mashg‘ulot bilan shug‘ullanish, maxsus harakatlar va raqs harakatlarini muz ustida bajarish.

ex: The coach is looking for a five-tool player to strengthen the team.
He is known as a five-tool player because of his speed, hitting, and fielding skills.
five-tool.meta: Besh qobiliyatli – bu sportda, ayniqsa beysbolda, tez yugurish, to‘pni aniq otish, maydonda yaxshi o‘ynash, barqaror urish va kuch bilan zarba berish kabi beshta muhim ko‘nikmaga ega bo‘lgan o‘yinchini ifodalovchi sifat.

ex: Many young people experience a flirtationship at school or work.
They have a flirtationship, but they are not a serious couple.
flirtationship.meta: Flirtatsion munosabat – bu ikki kishi o‘rtasida takroriy ravishda yoqimli va o‘yinchoqcha flört qilish asosida yuzaga kelgan, lekin romantik yoki jiddiy munosabatlarga o‘tmaydigan ijtimoiy aloqadir.

ex: “I don’t give a frack!” she shouted in frustration.
He didn’t give a frack about the rules.
frack.meta: Frack – bu asosan so‘zlashuvda va ko‘ngilsizlik, g‘azab yoki e’tiborsizlik bildiruvchi iboralarda, kuchli va haqoratli "fuck" so‘zining yumshatilgan, o‘rinsizroq almashtiruvchisi sifatida ishlatiladigan ifoda.

ex: engineers fracked the underground rock layers to improve oil flow.
the company plans to frack the shale rock to extract natural gas.
frack.meta: frack — bu chuqur yotqizilgan suv o‘tkazmaydigan tosh qatlamlarini yoki bunday qatlamdagi burg‘ilangan quduq devorlarini maxsus bosim ostida sindirish yoki yorish jarayonidir.

ex: Frack you! You knew this would happen!
Frack it! I missed the train!
frack.meta: Asosan so‘kinish yoki g‘azab, achchiqlanish, ajablanish holatlarini yumshoq, yumshatilgan tarzda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. “Fuck” so‘zining beozor, sensuradan o‘tuvchi o‘rnini bosuvchi variantidir.

ex: The snowboarder amazed the crowd with a perfect front-flip.
She performed a front-flip during her gymnastics routine.
front-flip.meta: Oldinga aylanma sakrash qilish – bu gimnastika, sakrash, snoubord va boshqa sport turlarida havoda oldinga qarab aylanib sakrash harakati. Ushbu harakatda sportchi tanasini oldinga burib, somersault (aylanma sakrash) bajaradi.

ex: The fronthaul link is critical for managing communication between network components.
In a wireless network, the fronthaul connects the base station controller to the switching centre.
fronthaul.meta: Old tarmoqli ulanish – bu simli yoki simsiz tarmoqda bazaviy stansiya nazoratchisi (base station controller) bilan almashinuv markazi (switching centre) o‘rtasidagi bog‘lanish.

ex: Many stories highlight the bravery of frontierswomen in harsh conditions.
She was a frontierswoman who helped settle the new western territories.
frontierswoman.meta: Chegaradosh ayol – bu chegara hududida yoki uning yaqinida yashovchi ayol; ayniqsa, Yevropa kelib chiqishiga ega bo‘lgan va yangi yoki oz aholi yashaydigan g‘arbiy hududlarda joylashgan mustamlaka yoki ko‘chmanchi ayol

ex: A frontlash often occurs as a counterreaction to political backlash.
The civil rights backlash was followed by a frontlash from progressive groups.
frontlash.meta: Oldingi qarshi ta’sir – bu biror voqea yoki hodisaga qarshi yuzaga kelgan qarshi reaksiyadan keyin keladigan javob reaksiyasi; ayniqsa siyosiy yoki ijtimoiy sohada yuzaga kelgan qarshi ta’sirga nisbatan paydo bo‘ladigan qarshi harakat yoki javob.

ex: The frontmost car in the traffic jam honked loudly.
She was standing in the frontmost row of the crowd.
frontmost.meta: Eng oldingi, oldingi qismda joylashgan – bu joylashuvi bo‘yicha eng oldinda, old qismga yaqin yoki old qismdagi eng yaqin nuqtada turgan narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: Her interview was worthy of front-paging on the magazine cover.
The political event received front-paging in the national newspaper.
front-paging.meta: Bosh sahifaga chiqish – bu biror voqea, yangilik yoki maqolani gazetaning bosh sahifasida yoki jurnalning old qopqasida joylashtirish jarayoni. Bu voqea yoki materialning katta ahamiyatga ega ekanligini ko‘rsatadi va keng e’tiborni jalb qiladi.

ex: Front-running is considered illegal in most financial markets.
Brokers engaged in front-running by making personal trades based on their analysts’ tips.
front-running.meta: Oldindan savdo qilish – bu moliyaviy sohada brokerlar yoki vositachilar o‘zining investitsiya tahlilchilari tomonidan oldindan berilgan ma’lumotlarga asoslanib

ex: It’s better to front-stab the issue openly than to act deceptively.
He decided to front-stab his opponent rather than use underhanded tactics.
front-stab.meta: bu kimnidir aldash yoki ikkiyuzlamalik qilmasdan, rostgo‘ylik va bevosita tarzda, ochiq yuzma-yuz qarshi chiqish yoki hujum qilish. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha shaxsiy yoki ijtimoiy munosabatlarda halol va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri harakat qilishni anglatadi.

ex: The car’s front-to-back dimension is important for parking.
Measure the table’s front-to-back length carefully.
front-to-back.meta: Oldindan orqaga qarab o‘lchanadigan – bu biror narsaning o‘lchami yoki o‘lchovlari uning old qismidan boshlab orqa tomonigacha bo‘lgan masofani yoki yo‘nalishni ifodalaydi.

ex: The government made the decision for the greater good of the community.
Sometimes, personal interests must be set aside for the greater good.
greater good.meta: Katta foyda, umumiy manfaat – bu biror guruh, jamiyat yoki butun jamoaning foydasiga xizmat qiladigan, shaxs yoki kichik guruh manfaatlaridan ustun qo‘yiladigan yaxshilik yoki foyda.

ex: Studying ancient Hebrew texts falls under the field of Hebraica.
The university offers courses in Hebraica studies.
hebraica.meta: Hebraica – bu ibron tilida yozilgan matnlar yoki ibron tili, tarixi va adabiyotiga oid materiallar majmuasi, ayniqsa ilmiy tadqiqot obyekti sifatida ko‘riladi. Shuningdek, bu soha yoki fan turi sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The number of hidden homeless increased during the pandemic due to temporary living situations.
Many hidden homeless people do not live on the streets but lack stable housing.
hidden homeless.meta: bu asosan kambag‘allik sababli yetarli yashash sharoitiga ega bo‘lmagan, lekin ularning qashshoqligi ko‘zga tashlanmaydigan odamlar. Ular ko‘pincha do‘stlar, qarindoshlar yoki turar joylarda vaqtinchalik yashab, an’anaviy uy-joysizlardan farq qiladi.

ex: The hydrofracking process involves injecting high-pressure fluid into the rock.
Hydrofracking is used to fracture underground rock layers to extract oil or natural gas.
hydrofrack.meta: Gidrofraking – bu yer ostidagi zich, suv o‘tmaydigan tosh qatlamlarini maxsus texnologiya yordamida sindirish jarayoni. Bu usul orqali toshlarning ichidagi neft yoki tabiiy gaz chiqishini osonlashtirish maqsad qilinadi.

ex: The company uses hydrofracking to increase production from the well.
Hydrofracking involves fracturing underground rock layers to extract oil or gas.
hydrofracking.meta: Gidrofraking – bu yer ostidagi suv o‘tmaydigan va zich tosh qatlamlarini maxsus yuqori bosimli suyuqlik yordamida sindirish jarayoni. Bu usul orqali neft yoki tabiiy gaz chiqishini osonlashtirish maqsad qilinadi.

ex: Managing your life admin well helps reduce stress.
I spend a couple of hours every week doing life admin tasks like paying bills and answering emails.
life admin.meta: Kundalik ma’muriy ishlar – bu shaxsiy hayotdagi muntazam bajariladigan ma’muriy vazifalar yoki uy ishlariga oid ishlar, masalan, hisob-kitoblarni to‘lash, xarid qilish, elektron pochtalarga javob berish va boshqalar.

ex: Many traditional crafts have become a lost art due to industrialization.
Handwriting is becoming a lost art in the digital age.
lost art.meta: Yo‘qolgan hunar – bu avval keng qo‘llanilgan yoki mashhur bo‘lgan, ammo hozirda kam ishlatiladigan yoki unutilgan ko‘nikma, mahorat yoki amaliyot. Ko‘pincha qadimiy yoki an’anaviy san’at yoki hunarlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Many white New Zealanders are collectively called Ngati Pakeha.
The term Ngati Pakeha humorously refers to non-Māori people in New Zealand.
ngati pakeha.meta: Ngati Pakeha – bu Maorilar madaniyatida, asosan Yangi Zelandiyadagi oq tanli yoki no-Maori odamlarni hazilomuz yoki ramziy tarzda “qabila” yoki “xalq” sifatida atash.

ex: Medical studies often use pseudonymization to keep patient information confidential.
Pseudonymization is essential for protecting personal data privacy.
pseudonymization.meta: bu biror shaxs yoki narsaga haqiqiy ism o‘rniga taxallus (psevdonim) berish amali yoki jarayoni; ayniqsa, shaxsni aniqlash mumkin bo‘lgan ma’lumotlarni ma’lumotlar bazasidan olib tashlash yoki almashtirish orqali maxfiylikni ta’minlash.

ex: Researchers pseudonymize personal details before publishing results.
The data was pseudonymized to protect patient privacy.
pseudonymize.meta: Psevdonimlashtirish – bu biror shaxs yoki narsaga haqiqiy ism o‘rniga taxallus (psevdonim) berish; shuningdek, ayniqsa ma’lumotlarni maxfiyligini ta’minlash uchun shaxsni aniqlash mumkin bo‘lgan ma’lumotlarni olib tashlash yoki almashtirish jarayoni.

ex: Many students take a year off to become a sabb and gain experience.
She works as a sabb in the student union.
sabb.meta: Sabb – bu to‘liq ish vaqtida to‘lanadigan lavozimni egallagan talabani ifodalovchi atama. Odatda talabalar ittifoqi yoki shunga o‘xshash tashkilotlarda ishlaydigan talabalar vakili yoki ma’muriy xodim sifatida faoliyat yuritadi.

ex: The restaurant served the steak with a special Tartare sauce.
I like to eat fish with sauce à la Tartare.
sauce à la tartare.meta: Tartare sousi – bu sovuq sous bo‘lib, asosan mayonez (yoki dastlabki paytlarda yog‘ va sirka) bilan tayyorlanadi. Unda mayda to‘g‘ralgan piyoz, xantal bodring (gherkin), kapers va turli xil ko‘katlar aralashtiriladi

ex: Sometimes people simp without realizing they’re losing their self-respect.
He’s always simping for that girl, doing whatever she asks.
simp.meta: bu odatda erkaklarga nisbatan ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, kimdir (ayniqsa, sevgi yoki jinsiy qiziqish bildirgan shaxs) uchun o‘zini haddan tashqari past tutish, o‘zini kamsitish yoki haddan tashqari e’tibor va itoatkorlik ko‘rsatish holatini anglatadi.

ex: don’t be a simp — have some self-respect!
he’s such a simp, always doing whatever she says without question.
simp.meta: simp — bu slang so‘z bo‘lib, dastlab haddan tashqari nozik, zaif, qo‘rqoq yoki jur’atsiz insonni ifodalagan.

ex: Some players use glitches to complete a speedrun faster.
He set a new speedrun record for Super Mario.
speedrun.meta: Tez o‘yin yakunlash – bu video o‘yinni yoki uning biror qismini imkon qadar eng qisqa vaqt ichida tugatishga qaratilgan urinish. Odatda o‘yinni mukammal bilish, xatolarni yodlash va maxsus strategiyalar orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The player speedran the game in less than 30 minutes.
He is trying to speedrun Super Mario to beat the world record.
speedrun.meta: O‘yinni maksimal tezlikda o‘ynab tugatmoq – bu video o‘yinni yoki uning ma’lum bir qismini imkon qadar eng qisqa vaqt ichida tugatishga harakat qilish.

ex: Many speedrunners use glitches to finish games faster.
He is a famous speedrunner who holds multiple world records.
speedrunner.meta: Tezkor o‘yinchi – bu video o‘yinlarni yoki uning ma’lum bir qismini imkon qadar eng qisqa vaqt ichida tugatishga harakat qiladigan odam.

ex: Speedrunning requires precision, memory, and a lot of practice.
He is passionate about speedrunning and participates in global competitions.
speedrunning.meta: O‘yinni maksimal tezlikda yakunlash faoliyati – bu video o‘yin yoki uning ma’lum bir qismini imkon qadar eng qisqa vaqt ichida tugatishga qaratilgan mashg‘ulot yoki raqobat.

ex: Sometimes I get a spider sense that something is wrong.
Spider-Man’s spider sense warns him of approaching danger.
spider sense.meta: O‘rgimchak sezgisi – bu aslida xayoliy qahramon Spider-Man bilan bog‘liq tushuncha bo‘lib, odatda yaqinlashayotgan xavf yoki maxfiy narsalarni oldindan sezish qobiliyatini anglatadi. Keyinchalik umumiy ma’noda ham ishlatiladi

ex: Sometimes people can sense danger without knowing why – it’s like they have a spidey sense.
Spider-Man’s spidey sense helps him detect danger almost instantly.
spidey sense.meta: Spidey sezgisi — Dastlab oʻylab topilgan qahramon Spider-Man bilan bogʻliq tushuncha boʻlib, odatda ong ostida yoki gʻayritabiiy tarzda yaqinlashayotgan xavf yoki noaniq holatlarni ilgʻash qobiliyati.

ex: He got turnt up after a few drinks and started dancing on the table.
The party last night was crazy – everyone was turnt.
turnt.meta: Turnt — (sleng) Spirtli ichimlik yoki giyohvand moddalar taʼsirida mast yoki ruhiy jihatdan koʻtarinki holatda boʻlish. Shuningdek, juda kuchli quvonch, hayajon yoki energiya bilan toʻlgan holatni ham ifodalaydi.

ex: In the warm sector, temperatures rise and humidity increases significantly.
The city experienced heavy rain as it moved through the warm sector of the cyclone.
warm sector.meta: Iliq sektor — Siklon ichida joylashgan, odatda uchburchak shaklga ega boʻlgan, issiq havo massasi joylashgan hudud. Bu sektor old tomonida iliq front, orqa tomonida esa sovuq front bilan chegaralangan boʻladi.

ex: A weighted blanket can help reduce anxiety and improve relaxation.
I sleep much better when I use my weighted blanket.
weighted blanket.meta: Og‘ir adyol — Maxsus tayyorlangan, ichida odatda shisha boncuklar yoki shunga o‘xshash materiallar bo‘lgan qopchali tuzilishga ega og‘ir adyol. Bu adyol asosan terapevtik maqsadlarda ishlatiladi

ex: He was a wild child in his youth but eventually settled down.
Everyone knew her as the wild child who never followed the rules.
wild child.meta: Wild child — Qarshilik qiluvchi, beparvo, impulsiv (o‘ylamasdan harakat qiladigan) yoki o‘zini cheklamaydigan yosh bola yoki o‘smir.

ex: He fell in love with wingsuiting after his first jump.
Wingsuiting is considered one of the most extreme sports in the world.
wingsuiting.meta: Wingsuiting — Maxsus parvoz kostyumi (wingsuit) kiyib osmondan sakrash yoki baland joylardan (tog‘, bino, qoyalar) sakrab uchish sporti yoki harakati.

ex: The philosopher developed an anti-rationalist critique of modern thought.
His anti-rationalist views made him skeptical of scientific explanations.
anti-rationalist.meta: Anti-ratsionalist — Ratsionalizmni rad etuvchi yoki unga qarshi bo‘lgan; aql va mantiqni hamma narsada universal yo‘lko‘rsatuvchi tamoyil deb hisoblamaydigan.

ex: His paintings are known for their anti-realism, blending fantasy with abstraction.
The novel’s anti-realism challenges traditional storytelling methods.
anti-realism.meta: Antirealizm — Ayniqsa adabiyot va san’atda hayotga yaqin tasvir yoki yagona haqiqat tushunchasini rad etish yoki undan yuqoriga ko‘tarilish yo‘nalishi.

ex: The artist was known as an anti-realist, always challenging traditional forms of representation.
As an anti-realist, the author prefers abstract and symbolic storytelling.
anti-realist.meta: Antirealist — Asosan adabiyot va san’atda realizmni rad etadigan yoki undan yuqoriga ko‘tarilishga intiladigan shaxs.

ex: Her writing style is deeply anti-realist, often blending dreams with reality.
The play takes an anti-realist approach, using abstract sets and symbolic characters.
anti-realist.meta: Antirealist — Asosan adabiyot va san’atda realizmni rad etishga yoki undan yuqoriga ko‘tarilishiga moyil bo‘lgan. Ushbu atama, shuningdek, falsafada realizmga qarshi nazariyani yoqlovchi yoki uni targ‘ib qiluvchi g‘oyalarni ham ifodalaydi.

ex: His writings express strong anti-religion sentiments.
The movement promoted anti-religion and sought to remove religious influence from public life.
anti-religion.meta: Dinga qarshilik — Diniy eʼtiqodlar, amaliyotlar yoki diniy tashkilotlarga ochiq qarshilik yoki dushmanlik. Bu qarash jamiyatdan dinni butunlay yo‘qotish yoki diniy ta’sirlarni cheklash, diniy faoliyatlarga yo‘l qo‘ymaslik kerak degan fikrni ilgari suradi.

ex: His anti-science views made him reject well-established medical advice.
The group spread anti-science misinformation about vaccines.
anti-science.meta: Ilmga qarshi — Ilm-fan va uning uslublariga qarshi bo‘lgan yoki unga dushmanlik bilan qaraydigan. Bu atama ilmiy uslub, ilmiy yondashuv yoki ilmiy natijalarga ishonmaslik, ularni rad etish yoki ularga faol qarshi chiqish holatlarini ifodalaydi.

ex: His anti-scripturalist arguments challenged long-held religious traditions.
The philosopher was labeled an anti-scripturalist for questioning the authority of sacred texts.
anti-scripturalist.meta: Anti-scripturalist — Muqaddas matnlarning (diniy kitoblar, masalan, Qur’on, Injil, Tavrot va boshqalar) hokimiyatini, haqiqatini yoki ular e’tiqod va diniy amaliyot asosida bo‘lishi kerakligini rad etadigan yoki shubha ostiga oladigan shaxs.

ex: The doctor applied an anti-shock treatment to stabilize the victim.
The patient was immediately wrapped in an anti-shock blanket to prevent hypothermia.
anti-shock.meta: Shokkaga qarshi — Tibbiyotda: organizmda yuzaga keladigan shok holatini oldini olish yoki uni davolashga yordam beradigan vosita, usul yoki himoya shakli.

ex: Anti-shock garments are essential in treating severe trauma victims.
The paramedics applied anti-shock trousers to help stabilize the patient’s blood pressure.
anti-shock.meta: Shokkaga qarshi bosimli — Tibbiyotda: oyoq va qorin sohasiga bosim berib, qonni hayotiy muhim a’zolarga (yurak, miya va boshqalar) qayta taqsimlashga yordam beradigan maxsus kiyimlar, moslamalar yoki tibbiy jihozlarni ifodalaydi.

ex: He was known for his anti-Stalinist stance within the socialist movement.
The party split due to rising anti-Stalinist sentiments among its members.
anti-stalinist.meta: Anti-Stalinist — Stalin siyosatiga, uning boshqaruv uslubiga va qarashlariga qarshi bo‘lgan. Bu atama ayniqsa kommunistik yoki sotsialistik harakatlar ichida Stalin siyosatini tanqid qiluvchi yoki rad etuvchi kishilar va harakatlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The poet cleverly employed antistoecon to create contrast within the verse.
In ancient rhetoric, antistoecon was used for stylistic wordplay.
antistoecon.meta: Antistoekon — So‘z ichida bir harf yoki tovushni boshqa bir harf yoki tovush bilan almashtirish hodisasi. Bu atama ko‘pincha so‘z o‘yini yoki stilistik uslub sifatida ishlatiladi. Ma’nosi keng ma’noda antitezis bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Many anti-terrorists supported the fall of Robespierre.
The anti-terrorists worked to dismantle the policies of the Reign of Terror.
anti-terrorist.meta: Fransuz inqilobi davrida Terror davriga (ya’ni, inqilobiy zo‘ravonlik va qatl hukmron bo‘lgan davrga) qarshi chiqqan shaxs. Ayniqsa, Termidor davrida terror siyosatini tanqid qilgan yoki unga faol qarshi chiqqan insonlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: His anti-theft stance was clear in his strict laws against stealing.
The company promotes an anti-theft policy to ensure customer security.
anti-theft.meta: O‘g‘rilikka qarshi — O‘g‘rilikni rad etadigan, unga qarshi bo‘lgan yoki o‘g‘rilikka yo‘l qo‘ymaslikni maqsad qilgan. Ushbu atama odatda o‘g‘rilikni qoralovchi, uni oldini olishga qaratilgan fikr, siyosat yoki yondashuvlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The antithetic demonstrates how the mind can logically support both opposing propositions.
Kant’s antithetic reveals the inherent contradictions in pure reason.
antithetic.meta: Antithetic — Kant falsafasida: aqlning o‘z-o‘ziga qarama-qarshiligi yoki ichki ziddiyat holati. Bu holat antinomiya orqali namoyon bo‘ladi, ya’ni aql bir vaqtning o‘zida ikki qarama-qarshi, lekin mantiqan asosli fikrni ilgari sura oladigan vaziyat.

ex: They introduced anti-ugly regulations to improve the city’s appearance.
The architect’s anti-ugly designs focused on creating visually pleasing public spaces.
anti-ugly.meta: Xunuklikka qarshi — Xunuklikni oldini oladigan yoki uni bartaraf etishga qaratilgan. Ko‘rinishdagi yoki estetik nuqtai nazardan xunuk bo‘lish holatini yo‘qotish yoki kamaytirish maqsadida ishlatiladigan tushuncha. Bu so‘z XIX asrga qadar kam ishlatilgan.

ex: Many science fiction stories explore anti-utopias with harsh governments and surveillance.
The novel depicts an anti-utopia where freedom is completely suppressed.
anti-utopia.meta: Antiutopiya — Tasavvur qilinadigan, mukammal jamiyat g‘oyasiga mutlaqo zid bo‘lgan joy yoki tizim. Antiutopiya odatda zulm, tartibsizlik, ijtimoiy adolatsizlik yoki haddan tashqari boshqaruv ostida bo‘lgan jamiyatni tasvirlaydi.

ex: The director’s new film offers an anti-utopian vision of the future.
George Orwell’s 1984 is a classic anti-utopian novel.
anti-utopian.meta: Antiutopik — Mukammal jamiyat (utopiya) g‘oyasiga mutlaqo zid bo‘lgan jamiyat tasviriga oid yoki shu jamiyat haqida hikoya qiluvchi (adabiy asar, film va hokazo).

ex: The preacher delivered an anti-work message, rejecting salvation by deeds.
His anti-work theology emphasizes grace over human effort.
anti-work.meta: Xususan, dinshunoslikda: Ishlar Ahdiga (Covenant of Works) qarshi bo‘lgan g‘oya yoki qarash. Bu ta’limotga ko‘ra, inson najot topishi yoki ilohiy rahmatga erishishi yaxshi yoki axloqiy amallar orqali qisman bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The event provided an Auslan interpreter for deaf participants.
She is learning Auslan to communicate with her deaf classmates.
auslan.meta: Avstraliyada eshitish qobiliyati cheklangan odamlar orasida keng qo‘llaniladigan ishorat tili. Auslan — "Australian Sign Language" (Avstraliya ishorat tili) qisqartmasi bo‘lib, bu til maxsus grammatikasi, so‘z boyligi va ishoralar tizimiga ega.

ex: She is fluent in both English and Australian Sign Language.
Australian Sign Language is an essential part of the deaf community in Australia.
australian sign language.meta: Avstraliya ishorat tili — Avstraliyada eshitish qobiliyati cheklangan odamlar orasida keng tarqalgan ishorat tili. Bu til maxsus grammatikaga, lug‘at boyligiga va o‘ziga xos ishoralar tizimiga ega. Avstraliya ishorat tili qisqacha Auslan deb ham ataladi.

ex: Efficient backhauling helps minimize empty vehicle mileage.
The trucking company reduced costs by backhauling goods on return trips.
backhauling.meta: Orqaga yuk tashish — Oldin bosib o‘tilgan yo‘nalish bo‘ylab qaytishda yuk yoki boshqa turdagi tovarlarni tashish jarayoni. Odatda bir yo‘nalishda yuk yetkazilgach, bo‘sh qaytmaslik uchun qaytishda boshqa yuk olib kelish amaliyotida ishlatiladi.

ex: Some species of beardfish can be found in deep-sea environments.
Beardfish live near the seabed and often use their barbels to search for food.
beardfish.meta: Mo'ylovli baliq — har xil turdagi, odatda pastki jag'ida mo'ylovchalar (barbellar) bo'lgan baliqlar; keyingi davrlarda ayniqsa Polymixiidae oilasiga mansub, dengiz tubida yashovchi, chuqur suv baliqlari shu nom bilan ataladi.

ex: The office was in a state of bedlamism after the system crashed.
The protest quickly turned into bedlamism as the crowd grew uncontrollable.
bedlamism.meta: Bedlamism — juda kuchli tartibsizlik, tartib-intizomning butunlay yo'qligi yoki shovqin-suron va g'alayon holati. Bu holatda muhit haddan tashqari chalkash va boshqarib bo'lmaydigan darajada bo'ladi.

ex: After the alarm went off, the building turned into a bedlamlike scene of panic.
The marketplace had a bedlamlike atmosphere with people shouting and pushing.
bedlamlike.meta: Bedlamlike — Avvalgi Bedlam (St Mary of Bethlehem kasalxonasi) bilan o'xshashlikka ega, ya'ni shovqinli, tartibsiz, g'alayonli yoki boshqarib bo'lmaydigan holatga o'xshash.

ex: As a Bethlehemite, she celebrated traditional festivals unique to the city.
The Bethlehemite shared stories about life in his ancient hometown.
bethlehemite.meta: Bethlehemite — Baytlahm shahridan bo‘lgan kishi; Baytlahm aholisi yoki shu shahar vakili.

ex: The actor adopted a blaccent for the role, though he is not part of the African American community.
He was criticized for using a blaccent to sound more relatable to a certain audience.
blaccent.meta: Blaccent — afro-amerikalik ingliz tiliga xos talaffuz, ohang, yoki grammatik xususiyatlarni o‘z ichiga olgan nutq uslubi; ayniqsa bu uslubni o‘rganib olgan yoki sun’iy ravishda taqlid qilayotgan shaxslar tomonidan ishlatilganda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Many songs and movies feature Black Vernacular English to reflect authentic cultural expression.
Black Vernacular English has its own unique grammar and pronunciation patterns.
black vernacular english.meta: Afro-amerikalik og‘zaki ingliz tili (Black Vernacular English) — asosan afro-amerikaliklar orasida, ko‘pincha norasmiy holatlarda ishlatiladigan, talaffuz, grammatika va lug‘at jihatidan o‘ziga xos bo‘lgan ingliz tili variantlari yig‘indisi.

ex: His behavior was shaped by years of Borstalian life.
The film depicted the harsh Borstalian discipline inside the institution.
borstalian.meta: Borstalian — borstal (ya'ni yosh jinoyatchilarni qayta tarbiyalash muassasasi) mahbusiga oid, shu joyga xos yoki shu muhitga tegishli bo‘lgan.

ex: The practice of female circumcision is condemned by many international organizations.
Female circumcised individuals often face serious health risks.
circumcised.meta: Circumcised — ayol yoki qizning tashqi jinsiy a'zolarining tibbiy sabablarsiz kesilgan yoki boshqa usullar bilan o‘zgartirilgan holati.

ex: Some comets are considered contact binaries because they are made of two bodies stuck together.
A contact binary consists of two stars sharing a common envelope of gas.
contact binary.meta: Contact binary — ikki yulduz atrofidagi gaz qatlamlari bir-biriga tegib turgan juft yulduz tizimi; keyinchalik bu atama ikki kichik sayyora yoki kometaning birlashgan holati uchun ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: In his speech, the politician offered a strong counter-thesis to his opponent’s claims.
The philosopher presented a counter-thesis to challenge the original argument.
counter-thesis.meta: Counter-thesis — boshqa bir fikr, nazariya yoki taklifga qarshi qo‘yilgan bayonot yoki g‘oya; ayniqsa, ritorika sohasida ikki gap yoki jumla ichida ikkinchi, qarshi fikrni ifodalovchi qism.

ex: The crusading against corruption requires persistent effort.
His crusading for human rights inspired many people.
crusading.meta: Crusading — ayniqsa axloqiy islohot yoki ijtimoiy o‘zgarishlarni amalga oshirish maqsadida, shijoat bilan va faol tarzda olib boriladigan targ‘ibot yoki harakat.

ex: He paid for the goods using cruzado coins.
The cruzado was introduced to stabilize Brazil’s economy in the 1980s.
cruzado.meta: Cruzado — 1986 yildan 1989 yilgacha Braziliyada asosiy pul birligi bo‘lgan valyuta. Shu nomdagi tangalar ham mavjud. Shuningdek, “yangi kruzado” (new cruzado) deb ataladigan valyuta ham bor edi.

ex: Diet drinks are popular among those who want to watch their calorie consumption.
She prefers diet drinks to avoid extra sugar intake.
diet drink.meta: Diet drink — odatda karbonatlangan, tarkibida nisbatan kam miqdorda shakar yoki sun’iy shirinlashtiruvchi moddalar bo‘lgan, shunday qilib kaloriyasi kamaytirilgan gazli yoki boshqa yumshoq ichimlik.

ex: Dieting people often avoid sugary and fatty meals.
She is a dieting individual trying to eat healthier foods.
dieting.meta: Dieting — ayniqsa vazn yo‘qotish maqsadida maxsus dietani tutayotgan odamni ta’riflovchi sifat.

ex: Don’t let negative thoughts drag you down.
The constant criticism really dragged him down.
to drag down.meta: Biror kishining kayfiyatini yoki ruhiyatini tushirish, uni xafa yoki kuchsiz his qilishiga sabab bo‘lish.

ex: Why do you keep dragging up the past?
She always drags up the mistakes I made years ago.
to drag up.meta: Odatda yoqimsiz, og‘riqli yoki boshqalar eslashni istamaydigan voqeani yoki faktni qayta tilga olish, eslatish yoki muhokamaga olib chiqish.

ex: The dragback is an effective move to change direction suddenly.
He used a quick dragback to get past the defender.
dragback.meta: Futbolda to‘pni oyoq tagi bilan orqaga tortib, yo‘nalishni o‘zgartirish va qarshi o‘yinchini aldab o‘tish uchun bajariladigan harakat.

ex: At the drag ball, participants showcased stunning costumes and performances.
The drag ball was a safe space for people to express their true selves.
drag ball.meta: Odatda gey erkaklar va boshqa LGBTQ+ hamjamiyat a’zolari ishtirok etadigan bal yoki kecha bo‘lib, unda qatnashchilar an’anaviy ravishda qarama-qarshi jinsga xos kiyimlarni kiyishadi

ex: A drag bunt is often used to surprise the infielders.
The player executed a perfect drag bunt to get on base.
drag bunt.meta: Bezbolda chap qo‘lli to‘p uruvchi to‘pni birinchi bazaga qarab sekin urib yuboradigan va shu paytda birinchi bazaga tezda yugurishni boshlaydigan o‘yin usuli.

ex: In a drag chain, one phoneme's movement can cause a series of shifts in other phonemes.
The Great Vowel Shift is often explained as a drag chain of phonetic changes in English
drag chain.meta: Lingvistika: Fonemalardan birining talaffuzidagi o‘zgarish fonematik tizimda bo‘shliq (bo‘sh joy) hosil qiladi va natijada bu bo‘shliqni to‘ldirish uchun boshqa tovushlar ham ketma-ket o‘zgaradi.

ex: The drag flick requires both skill and precision to execute successfully.
He scored with a powerful drag flick from the penalty corner.
drag flick.meta: Xokkeyda (maydon xokkeyida) qisqa burchakdan (penalti burchagi) foydalaniladigan usul bo‘lib, unda o‘yinchi to‘pni biroz oldida nazorat qiladi va to‘pni oldinga sudrab kuchli zarba beradi.

ex: Drag flicking requires excellent timing and body coordination.
His drag flicking is one of the best in the league.
drag flicking.meta: Maydon xokkeyida sudrab zarba (drag flick) bajarish harakati. O‘yinchining to‘pni biroz oldida olib borib, oldinga sudrab, kuchli va aniq zarba berish jarayoni. Bu texnika penalti burchaklari (short corner) paytida ko‘p qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The dragged-out negotiations exhausted everyone involved.
The meeting was dragged out and lasted for hours.
dragged out.meta: Juda uzun davom etadigan yoki ortiqcha cho‘zilib ketgan; zaruratdan ortiq vaqtni oladigan yoki ortiqcha cho‘zilgan jarayon yoki holat.

ex: Shrimp draggers operate mainly in this region during the summer season.
The scallop dragger returned to the harbor with a full load.
dragger.meta: Shimoliy Amerikada ishlatiladigan baliqchi qayiq turi bo‘lib, tortma to‘r (dragnet) yoki baliq ovlash uchun maxsus sudrab yuriladigan qurilmalar (dredge) yordamida baliq yoki mollyuskalarni tutadi.

ex: Dragging became popular among young car enthusiasts.
They spent the weekend dragging on the outskirts of the city.
dragging.meta: Asosan AQSh slangida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, drag poygasi — qisqa masofada ikki yoki undan ortiq avtomobillar o‘rtasida tezlikka poygalashish sporti yoki mashg‘ulotini anglatadi. Bu sport tez harakatlanish va startdagi chaqqonlikka asoslangan.

ex: His draggy look caught everyone's attention on stage.
He appeared very draggy at the costume party, wearing a sparkling dress and heavy makeup.
draggy.meta: qarama-qarshi jinsga xos bo‘lgan kiyim, bo‘yanish, soch turmagi va hokazolarni qasddan va ko‘pincha yorqin, ko‘zga tashlanadigan (flamboyant) tarzda qabul qilgan, shunday uslubda kiyingan yoki o‘zini shunday ko‘rsatadigan kishi.

ex: After winning several championships, he earned the title of drag king.
He was known as the drag king of the West Coast racing scene.
drag king.meta: Asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, drag poygalarda eng yetakchi bo‘lgan erkak poygachi, ya’ni drag poygasi chempioni yoki eng mashhur drag poygachiga nisbatan qo‘llanadi.

ex: The dragline snapped under the weight of the large boulder.
The workers used a dragline to pull the heavy logs across the field.
dragline.meta: Nimani yoki nimanidir sudrab tortish yoki olib yurish uchun ishlatiladigan arqon yoki kabel.

ex: In the old logging camps, the dragman was responsible for hauling the felled trees.
The dragman carefully operated the equipment to clear the path.
dragman.meta: Turli ma’nolardagi tortma uskunani (drag) boshqaruvchi yoki undan foydalanuvchi kishi. Bu atama hozir kam ishlatiladi va asosan Shimoliy Amerikada qo‘llangan.

ex: The smugglers found themselves dragnetted by border patrols.
The dragnetted suspects were quickly taken into custody.
dragnetted.meta: Dragnet (keng qamrovli qidiruv yoki to‘r) orqali yoki xuddi to‘r bilan qamalib, ushlangan yoki qo‘lga olingan holat. Biror narsa yoki kishi qidiruv, tintuv yoki qamrov natijasida tutib olingan bo‘lsa, shu sifat bilan ifodalanadi.

ex: The excessive dragnetting in the lake reduced the fish population.
Dragnetting was widely used by fishermen in coastal areas.
dragnetting.meta: Tortma to‘r (dragnet) yordamida baliq yoki ov qushlarini tutish amaliyoti yoki jarayoni. Bu usulda suv ostidan yoki yer yuzasidan to‘r sudralib yuradi va yo‘ldagi baliqlar yoki qushlarni tutib oladi.

ex: In the past, the drag queen title was given to the most celebrated woman at the ball.
She was crowned the drag queen of the evening at the dance party.
drag queen.meta: AQSh slangida ilgari ishlatilgan, hozir esa kam uchraydigan ma’no: raqs kechasida yoki balda eng faxrli maqomga ega bo‘lgan ayolga berilgan unvon.

ex: A drag sail helps prevent the vessel from drifting sideways.
The crew deployed a drag sail to stabilize the ship during the storm.
drag sail.meta: Dengizchilikda: suv kemasi tomonidan sudralib olib yuriladigan, ustunga yoki karkasga mahkamlangan yelkan yoki mato. Bu yelkan kema burun qismini to‘lqinlarga qarata ushlab turish yoki kemani sekinlashtirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Ficelle bread is perfect for making light sandwiches.
She bought a ficelle from the bakery for lunch.
ficelle.meta: Fransiyaning juda ingichka va uzun shaklda tayyorlanadigan non turi. Fisel non bagetga o‘xshaydi, lekin undan ancha ingichka bo‘ladi. Odatda, ficelle bread shaklida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: In ancient scripts, the figura and potestas of some letters were not always consistent.
The figura of the letter varies between cursive and block scripts.
figura.meta: Ma’lum bir yozuv tizimida yoki alifboda harfning yozma shakli yoki tashqi ko‘rinishi. Bu tushuncha ko‘pincha potestas (ya’ni harfning talaffuzi yoki fonetik qiymati) bilan qarama-qarshi qo‘yiladi.

ex: The costs of the project are figurable with proper data.
The potential losses are figurable based on current market trends.
figurable.meta: Raqamlar yoki matematik hisoblash orqali aniqlash, baholash yoki taxmin qilish mumkin bo‘lgan narsalar. Ya’ni, hisoblash yoki raqamli ko‘rsatkichlar bilan ifodalash mumkin bo‘lgan holat yoki miqdor.

ex: Figural representation of the results helps in better understanding the trends.
The figural data showed an increase in sales over the past year.
figural.meta: Raqamlar yoki belgilar yordamida sonlarni ifodalashga oid yoki raqamlarga asoslangan. Ya’ni, sonlar bilan bog‘liq yoki raqamlar yordamida ko‘rsatiladigan.

ex: Figuralism in art often involves symbolic figures representing abstract ideas.
The poet’s use of figuralism allowed deeper meanings to emerge beneath the surface.
figuralism.meta: Adabiyot yoki san’atda, yashirin yoki ko‘zga ko‘rinmaydigan chuqur ma’noni yetkazish uchun personifikatsiya (insoniy xususiyatlarni obyekt yoki tushunchaga berish) yoki ramziy ifoda usulidan foydalanish texnikasi.

ex: Figurated cloth was highly valued in traditional Scottish attire.
The old Scottish fabric was figurate, decorated with intricate patterns.
figurate.meta: Skotlandiyada ishlatilgan eski atama bo‘lib, mato yoki kiyimga naqsh yoki bezaklar bilan bezatilganligini bildiradi. Zamonaviy tilda bu ma’no kamroq ishlatiladi.

ex: Figurative numbers can be represented by dots arranged in specific geometric shapes.
Triangular and square numbers are common examples of figurative numbers.
figurative number.meta: Matematika sohasida: bunday sonlar o‘ziga xos xususiyatga ega bo‘lib, ular teng masofadagi nuqtalar yordamida ma’lum geometrik shaklda joylashtirilishi mumkin. Masalan, uchburchak sonlar, kvadrat sonlar kabi shaklli sonlar mavjud.

ex: Figurato materials are often used in traditional garments.
The dress was made of figurato fabric with intricate floral patterns.
figurato.meta: Nakshlar yoki bezaklar bilan bezatilgan mato yoki to‘qima materiali. Bu atama, ayniqsa, bezakli yoki naqshli matolarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: According to the latest figures, unemployment has decreased.
The company’s financial figures showed a significant increase this year.
