figures.meta: Raqamlar yordamida yozilgan, ifodalangan yoki tahlil qilingan ma’lumotlar; sonli ma’lumotlar, statistika. Ma’lum bir holat yoki jarayon haqida sonlar ko‘rinishidagi axborot.

ex: We’re going to finish this project ahead of schedule.
I think he's the best player on the team.
how do you figure?.meta: ‘How do you figure?’ — bu soʻz birikmasi ingliz tilida, ayniqsa AQSh nutqida, norasmiy (colloquial) tarzda ishlatiladi. Bu ibora suhbatdoshing fikri yoki bayonotiga sababni yoki izohni soʻrash uchun qoʻllanadi.

ex: The wrestler used a figure-four hold to immobilize his opponent.
He applied a figure-four leg lock to win the match.
figure-four.meta: Figure-four — bu atama asosan kurash (wrestling) sportida ishlatiladi. Bu usulda oyoq yoki qo‘llar arab raqami 4 shaklida joylashtiriladi. Bu holat odatda raqibni ushlab turish yoki unga og‘riq berish uchun qo‘llanadi.

ex: I’m a poor figurer, so I often make mistakes in calculations.
She’s a good figurer and always balances the books accurately.
figurer.meta: Figurer — raqamlar bilan ishlaydigan yoki hisob-kitob qiladigan shaxs. Bu so‘z odatda arifmetik hisoblashlarni bajaruvchi odamni bildiradi. Ko‘pincha oldida sifatlovchi so‘zlar bilan keladi

ex: The figure skates have a serrated edge at the front for better control during jumps.
She bought a new pair of figure skates for her skating lessons.
figure skate.meta: Figure skate — bu muz ustida figurali uchish (figurali konkida uchish) uchun mo‘ljallangan konki turi. U uzun va tor pichoq (tishli qirralarga ega) bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: she is very figuresome and turns heads wherever she goes.
that figuresome dress fits her perfectly.
figuresome.meta: figuresome — asosan shimoliy amerika ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, odatda jismoniy qaddi-qomati chiroyli, shakli jozibali bo‘lgan odamni ifodalaydi. shuningdek, tana shaklini chiroyli qilib ko‘rsatadigan kiyimlarga ham nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: the ancient pottery displayed beautiful figurework around its surface.
the painting is full of intricate figurework that captures human emotions.
figurework.meta: figurework — bu san’at asarida inson figurasi yoki inson shakllari tasvirlangan yoki shu shakllarga asoslangan san’at asari. shuningdek, bezakli naqshlar yoki dekorativ figuralar bilan bezatilgan ishlarga ham nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: ancient artists excelled at the figuring of mythological creatures.
the figuring of historical events in the mural is impressive.
figuring.meta: bu biror narsani yoki odamni tasvirlash, uni ifodalash yoki unga o‘xshash shakl yaratish harakati yoki shu harakat natijasi. bu so‘z odatda biror shaxs yoki buyumning ko‘rinishini san’at asari yoki boshqa shaklda namoyon etish jarayonini anglatadi.

ex: as a figurist, he interpreted the ancient rituals as signs pointing to later spiritual events.
the Figurists believed that the events in the old testament symbolized future Christian truths.
figurist.meta: figurist — asosan diniy matnlar va ilohiyot sohalarida ishlatiladigan tushuncha. bu shaxs biror hodisa, shaxs yoki voqeani ramziy yoki bashorat sifatida talqin qiladi.

ex: the final frontier was heavily guarded to prevent enemy incursions.
the river became the final frontier between the two rival kingdoms.
final frontier.meta: final frontier — bu ikki davlat yoki hududni ajratib turuvchi aniq va muhim chegara chizig‘i. bu chegara odatda tortishuvli, bahsli yoki harbiy jihatdan muhim bo‘ladi.

ex: he flirtily adjusted his tie as he approached her.
she smiled flirtily at him across the table.
flirtily.meta: flirtily — bu so‘z biror kishi noz-karashma qiladigan, o‘ynashib yoki jozibali tarzda harakat qiladigan yoki gapiradigan holatni ifodalaydi. ya’ni, noz qilish ohangida, noz bilan yoki biroz maftunkor uslubda bajarilgan harakat yoki so‘z.

ex: he tried to hide his flirtiness in front of his boss.
her natural flirtiness made her very popular at parties.
flirtiness.meta: flirtiness — bu noz-karashma qilishga moyillik, o‘ynashish xususiyati yoki biroz jozibador va e'tibor jalb qiluvchi, nozgo‘y harakatlar qilish holati yoki sifatidir. bu odatda biroz kulgili yoki yengil romantik ohangda bo‘ladi.

ex: the playful flirtship between them was obvious to everyone.
their flirtship lasted for months but never turned into a serious relationship.
flirtship.meta: flirtship — ikki kishi o‘rtasida takror-takror yuz beradigan noz-karashmali, o‘ynashishga asoslangan munosabatlar davri. bu atama, shuningdek, umumiy ma’noda noz-karashma yoki o‘ynashish holatini ham anglatadi.

ex: she fronted up to her critics without hesitation.
he fronted up to his manager about the unfair treatment.
to front up to.meta: asosan avstraliya, yangi zelandiya va shotlandiya ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan ibora. bu biror kishiga yaqinlashish, ayniqsa jasorat bilan yoki ochiq-oshkora qarshi chiqish, yuzma-yuz gaplashish, muammoni bevosita hal qilish ma’nosida qo‘llanadi.

ex: this rifle uses a front-action lock mechanism for improved balance.
the front-action gunlock was popular in the 19th century.
front-action.meta: front-action — bu atama qurolsozlikda ishlatiladi. u bolg‘a (tetiq) prujinasi qurolning tumblersimon mexanizmining quvur (muzzle) tomoniga, ya’ni old qismiga mahkamlangan qurollarni ifodalaydi.

ex: he always likes to be front and centre in any discussion.
the issue of climate change is now front and centre in global politics.
front and centre | front and center.meta: front and centre — bu biror narsaning yoki kishining asosiy, muhim yoki diqqat markazida bo‘lishini anglatadi. bu ibora "eng oldinga chiqmoq", "e'tibor markazida bo‘lmoq" yoki "asosiy o‘ringa chiqmoq" kabi ma’nolarni beradi.

ex: the house is stone-fronted and very sturdy.
a glass-fronted cabinet stood in the corner.
fronted.meta: fronted — bu sifat odatda old qismi qandaydir maxsus material, shakl yoki xususiyatga ega bo‘lgan narsani ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: the front end allows users to easily interact with the system.
the front end of the application is designed to be user-friendly.
front end.meta: front end — bu kompyuter yoki elektron tizimning foydalanuvchi bevosita ishlaydigan qismi yoki tizimga kirishni ta’minlaydigan qurilma yoki dasturiy ta’minotdir. bu foydalanuvchi ko‘radigan va o‘zaro aloqada bo‘ladigan qism hisoblanadi.

ex: they learned to play frontenis during their trip to Mexico.
frontenis is a fast-paced sport that requires quick reflexes.
frontenis.meta: frontenis — bu Meksikada kelib chiqqan sport o‘yini bo‘lib, devor bilan o‘ralgan maydonda raketka va rezina to‘p yordamida o‘ynaladi. bu o‘yin shaklan squash (skvosh) o‘yiniga biroz o‘xshaydi, lekin o‘ziga xos qoidalari va o‘yin uslubiga ega.

ex: he has worked his way into the front flight of international scientists.
the front flight quickly separated from the rest of the racers.
front flight.meta: front flight — bu ot poygalarida poyganing oldida ketayotgan guruhni anglatadi. keng ma’noda esa har qanday sohada yetakchi ishtirokchilar, eng yuqori darajadagi shaxslar yoki yuqori toifadagi guruh tushuniladi.

ex: the diver executed a front flip before entering the water.
she landed a perfect front flip during her gymnastics routine.
front flip.meta: front flip — bu gimnastika, suvga sakrash va shunga o‘xshash sport turlarida bajariladigan akrobatik harakat bo‘lib, unda kishi havoda oldinga qarab to‘liq aylanish (salto) bajaradi.

ex: the table’s front feet have intricate carvings.
the front foot of the chair was slightly damaged.
front foot.meta: front foot — odatda ko‘plikda ishlatiladi va stul, stol yoki boshqa mebellarning oldingi oyoqlari yoki pastki tayanch qismlarini anglatadi. bu so‘z "back foot" (orqa oyoq) bilan qarama-qarshi ma’noda qo‘llanadi.

ex: the batter played an elegant front foot drive.
he is known for his powerful front foot shots.
front foot.meta: front foot — bu atama kriket sportida ishlatiladi va old oyoq bilan zarba beriladigan zarbani yoki old oyoqqa tayanib o‘ynashni afzal ko‘radigan to‘p uruvchini ifodalaydi. bunday zarbalar odatda hujumkor va oldinga qadam tashlab bajariladigan harakatdir.

ex: she is on the front foot in the negotiations and leading the discussion.
the team started the match on the front foot and quickly scored.
on the front foot.meta: on the front foot — bu ibora biror kishi yoki jamoaning faol, hujumkor, ustun yoki qulay holatda ekanini bildiradi. bu holatda odam tashabbusni qo‘lga olgan yoki raqibga bosim o‘tkazayotgan bo‘ladi.

ex: the front garden was neatly trimmed and well-kept.
she planted roses in her front garden.
front garden.meta: front garden — bu uy yoki boshqa binoning old qismida joylashgan bog‘ yoki yashil maydon. odatda bezatish, dam olish yoki uyga chiroyli tashqi ko‘rinish berish uchun yaratiladi.

ex: the front gate was locked when we arrived.
she opened the front gate to let the guests in.
front gate.meta: front gate — bu uy yoki boshqa mulkning old qismida joylashgan yoki old qismiga olib boradigan darvoza. bu darvoza odatda uyning asosiy kirish qismiga xizmat qiladi.

ex: the spirit of frontiering drove settlers to explore unknown lands.
frontiering played a major role in the expansion of the United States.
frontiering.meta: frontiering — bu hali o‘rganilmagan yoki yovvoyi deb hisoblangan hududlarni o‘zlashtirish, u yerda yangi shaharchalar yoki aholi punktlari qurish orqali o‘z hududini kengaytirish harakati.

ex: the ideology of frontierism justified the settlement of indigenous lands.
frontierism was central to the American westward expansion.
frontierism.meta: frontierism — bu yangi yerlarni egallash, o‘zlashtirish yoki rivojlantirish amaliyoti, ayniqsa tarixan AQShning g‘arbga kengayishi jarayoni bilan bog‘liq tushuncha.

ex: fronting can sometimes mask the real risk holder in complex insurance structures.
fronting allows smaller insurers to access markets through larger companies.
fronting.meta: fronting — bu sug‘urta sohasida qo‘llaniladigan amaliyot bo‘lib, bir sug‘urta kompaniyasi sug‘urta polisi chiqaradi, lekin butun riskni boshqa bir sug‘urta kompaniyasiga o‘tkazadi.

ex: her pronunciation of the word had a frontish quality.
the vowel in this dialect is frontish rather than fully front.
frontish.meta: frontish — bu atama fonetikada ishlatiladi va biroz old til holatida, ya’ni tilning old qismiga yaqinroq hosil qilinadigan tovushni ifodalaydi. bu tovush to‘liq old tovush bo‘lmasligi mumkin, lekin talaffuzda unga yaqin bo‘ladi.

ex: they built houses on the frontland despite the risk of flooding.
the frontland was used for agriculture due to its fertile soil.
frontland.meta: frontland — bu daryo quyilish joyi, dengiz yoki boshqa suv havzasi yaqinida joylashgan past yotgan yer hududi. bu atama odatda suv bo‘yiga yaqin bo‘lgan, ba’zan suv toshqiniga moyil bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan yerlarni anglatadi.

ex: the boutique sells several stylish frontless tops.
she wore a stunning frontless evening gown.
frontless.meta: frontless — bu atama kiyim old tomoni chuqur ochilgan yoki past kesilgan bo‘lishini anglatadi. odatda bu ko‘ylak, bluzka yoki boshqa kiyimlarning old qismi ochiq bo‘lishini ta’riflashda ishlatiladi.

ex: the frontlet proved useful in protecting gunners during the siege.
the soldiers positioned a frontlet around the cannon to shield themselves.
frontlet.meta: frontlet — harbiy termin bo‘lib, to‘p atrofida joylashadigan va to‘pchini musket o‘qlaridan himoya qilish uchun maxsus shaklda yasalgan yog‘och qalqon.

ex: the front light in the theatre highlighted the main actor.
the photographer used front light to eliminate shadows on the model’s face.
front light.meta: front light — bu old tomondan kelayotgan yorug‘lik, ayniqsa fotografiya, san’at, teatr va boshqa sahnalashtirilgan jarayonlarda obyekt yoki manzarani yoritish uchun ishlatiladigan yorug‘lik turi.

ex: the bookstore prominently displays its frontlist titles near the entrance.
the publisher’s frontlist includes several anticipated bestsellers.
frontlist.meta: frontlist — bu nashriyot yoki kitob do‘koni tomonidan sotuvga chiqarilgan yoki yaqin orada chiqarilishi rejalashtirilgan yangi kitoblar ro‘yxati. Odatda, bu ro‘yxat tijoriy muvaffaqiyat keltirishi kutilayotgan kitoblarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

ex: they bought a front-loaded dishwasher for their new kitchen.
the front-loaded washing machine is more convenient for small spaces.
front-loaded.meta: front-loaded — bu mashina, jihoz yoki qurilma old tomondan yuklanadigan yoki to‘ldiriladigan bo‘lishini anglatadi. Ya’ni, yuk yoki material qurilmaning old qismidan joylanadi, tepadan emas.

ex: the dishwasher’s front-loading design makes it more practical for kitchen use.
front-loading allows easier access when placing laundry into the washing machine.
front-loading.meta: front-loading — bu mashina, jihoz yoki qurilmani old tomondan yuklash yoki to‘ldirish jarayoni. Bu usulda qurilmaning yuklanish qismi old tarafda joylashadi, tepadan emas.

ex: frontness is an important feature in distinguishing vowel sounds.
the vowel [i] in ‘see’ is characterized by high frontness.
frontness.meta: bu unli tovush talaffuzida til tanasining og‘izning old qismida joylashishi holati. Ya’ni, tilning old tomonga siljishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladigan tovush xususiyati. Fonetikada bu tilning joylashish o‘rniga nisbatan tovushlarning tavsifini beradi.

ex: the front of house staff welcomed the guests warmly.
she has worked in front of house roles for several years.
front of house.meta: front of house — bu restoran, mehmonxona yoki shunga o‘xshash muassasalarning mijozlar qabul qilinadigan, ularga xizmat ko‘rsatiladigan old qismi.

ex: his story was so powerful it turned into a front-pager overnight.
the scandal quickly became a front-pager in all major newspapers.
front-pager.meta: front-pager — asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, gazetaning birinchi sahifasida e’lon qilingan maqola yoki yangilik. Odatda bu juda muhim, dolzarb yoki e’tiborni tortadigan voqea yoki hikoya bo‘ladi.

ex: visitors were always received in the front parlor, which was kept tidy.
the family gathered in the front parlour to celebrate the holiday.
front parlour | front parlor.meta: front parlour — bu uy old qismida joylashgan mehmon qabul qilinadigan xona bo‘lib, odatda asosiy oila xonasi yoki mehmonlar uchun maxsus ajratilgan xona sifatida xizmat qilgan.

ex: the house has a beautiful front porch with wooden railings.
they sat on the front porch, enjoying the evening breeze.
front porch.meta: front porch — bu uy yoki boshqa binoning old kirish qismida joylashgan, usti yopiq ayvon yoki ayvonsimon maydon. Odatda dam olish, mehmon kutish yoki tashqarida o‘tirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: celebrities usually sit in the front row at fashion shows.
he had front row seats for the championship game.
front row.meta: front row — bu teatr tomoshasi, konsert, sport musobaqasi, moda namoyishi yoki shunga o‘xshash tadbirlarda sahnaga yoki maydonga eng yaqin bo‘lgan birinchi qator.

ex: he started his career as a front rower before moving to a back position.
the front rower must be strong enough to withstand pressure in the scrum.
front rower.meta: front rower — bu regbi o‘yinida skram (to‘qnashuv) tarkibining old qatorida o‘ynaydigan o‘yinchi. Old qator o‘yinchisi odatda prop (yon tomon o‘yinchisi) yoki hooker (markazdagi bog‘lovchi) bo‘lib, ular skramning kuch va barqarorligini ta’minlaydi.

ex: regulations strictly prohibit brokers from front-running trades.
the broker was accused of front-running his clients to make a personal profit.
front-run.meta: front-run — bu moliya sohasida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, asosan broker yoki vositachining mijozga tegishli bo‘lgan maxfiy yoki oldindan ma’lum bo‘lgan ma’lumotlardan foydalanib, o‘z manfaatiga oldindan bitim tuzishi degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: she always prefers sitting in the front seat at concerts.
they reserved front seats for the premiere of the play.
front seat.meta: front seat — bu cherkov, zal, teatr va shunga o‘xshash joylarda old yoki old tomonga yaqin joylashgan o‘rindiq. Ayniqsa, konsert, spektakl yoki boshqa tomosha qilinadigan tadbirlarda eng ko‘rinadigan, muhim o‘rinlardan biri hisoblanadi.

ex: the frontseaters were the first to applaud the actor’s entrance.
as a frontseater, he had a clear view of the entire performance.
frontseater.meta: frontseater — bu zal, teatr yoki shunga o‘xshash joylarda old yoki old tomonga yaqin o‘rindiqda o‘tiradigan kishi. Odatda eng yaxshi ko‘rinishga ega bo‘ladigan joylarda o‘tiruvchi tomoshabin nazarda tutiladi.

ex: frontstabbing may be harsh, but at least it is honest.
unlike backstabbing, frontstabbing shows clear opposition without deception.
frontstabbing.meta: frontstabbing — bu odamga nisbatan ochiq yoki yuzma-yuz tarzda hujum qilish yoki zarar yetkazish amaliyoti. Bu yashirin yoki hiyla bilan emas, balki to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri va ochiq harakat shaklida bo‘ladi.

ex: the musicians moved to the frontstage during the final song.
the main actor stepped into the frontstage to deliver his final lines.
frontstage.meta: frontstage — bu teatr, konsert zali, stadion va shunga o‘xshash joylarda sahnaning old qismi, ya’ni tomoshabinlarga eng yaqin bo‘lgan hudud. Bu sahnaning eng ko‘rinadigan va diqqat markazida bo‘ladigan joyidir.

ex: the frontwoman captivated the audience with her powerful voice.
she is the talented frontwoman of the rock band.
frontwoman.meta: frontwoman — dastlab musiqiy guruh yoki ansambl yetakchisi bo‘lgan ayol ijrochi yoki sahnada markaziy o‘rinni egallagan ayol san’atkor. Keyinchalik bu atama musiqiy guruhdagi bosh ayol qo‘shiqchi yoki solist ma’nosida keng qo‘llanila boshlagan.

ex: don’t fall for that fugazi deal — it’s a scam.
he tried to sell me a fugazi watch.
fugazi.meta: fugazi — bu soxta yoki qalbaki bo‘lgan narsa, asl emas, haqiqiy bo‘lmagan yoki aldovchi. Asosan amerikalik slangda ishlatiladi va keng ma’noda yolg‘on, ishonchsiz yoki firibga asoslangan narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: I’ve told you a gajillion times not to leave the door open.
there were a gajillion people at the concert last night.
gajillion.meta: gajillion — bu juda katta, aniq bo‘lmagan, cheksiz yoki sanab bo‘lmas darajadagi miqdorni ifodalovchi norasmiy va kulgili atama. Odatda sonlar yoki miqdor bildiruvchi so‘zlar bilan birga ishlatiladi va shunchaki "juda ko‘p" degan ma’noni beradi.

ex: the global economy is becoming increasingly interconnected.
changes in oil prices can have a huge impact on the global economy.
global economy.meta: global economy — bu butun dunyo bo‘ylab amalga oshiriladigan iqtisodiy faoliyatlar majmui yoki dunyo mamlakatlarining iqtisodiyotlari o‘rtasidagi o‘zaro bog‘liqlik.

ex: tracking gotaways is a major challenge for immigration authorities.
the border patrol reported a high number of gotaways this month.
gotaway.meta: gotaway — bu ayniqsa AQSh immigratsiya qonunchiligida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, mamlakatga noqonuniy ravishda kirib, bojxona yoki chegara xizmati tomonidan ushlanmay qolgan shaxsni bildiradi. Bu shaxs rasmiy nazoratdan yashiringan bo‘ladi.

ex: in gotipua, boys dress as girls to portray various mythological stories.
the gotipua dancers performed with remarkable grace and flexibility.
gotipua.meta: bu Hindistonning Odisha shtatida paydo bo‘lgan klassik raqs turi bo‘lib, unda yosh o‘g‘il bolalar ayollar kiyimida raqs ijro etishadi. Ushbu raqs odatda kichik guruh bo‘lib ijro etiladi va hind klassik raqsi — odissi raqsining ildizi hisoblanadi.

ex: many biblical passages contain hebraicisms that are difficult to render in other languages.
the translator carefully preserved the hebraicisms in the original text.
hebraicism.meta: hebraicism — bu ivrit tiliga xos bo‘lgan ibora yoki ifoda, ya’ni ivrit tilida o‘ziga xos tarzda shakllangan jumla yoki til birligi. Bu tushuncha ingliz tiliga yoki boshqa tillarga o‘tgan ivritcha uslub yoki iborani ham ifodalashi mumkin.

ex: as a committed hebraist, he believed Hebrew should unite all Jewish communities.
in the early 20th century, hebraists and yiddishists often debated the future language of the Jewish people.
hebraist.meta: hebraist — bu ivrit tilining butun dunyo yahudiylari tili sifatida ishlatilishini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs. Bu tushuncha ayniqsa tarixiy kontekstda, ivrit tilini umumiy yahudiy tili sifatida himoya qilgan shaxslarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: in the Midwest, hotdish is a popular comfort food.
she brought a tuna hotdish to the family gathering.
hotdish.meta: hotdish — bu pechda pishiriladigan taom, odatda turli ingredientlardan (masalan, go‘sht, kartoshka, makaron va boshqalar) aralashtirib tayyorlanadigan va bir idishda pishiriladigan ovqat.

ex: the politician’s jingoist speeches appealed to national pride but ignored international cooperation.
his jingoist attitude made him support military action without question.
jingoist.meta: jingoist — bu haddan tashqari yoki tajovuzkor vatanparastlikni ifodalovchi sifat. Bunday odam yoki fikr boshqalarga nisbatan keskin yoki ustunlik da’vo qiluvchi, ba’zan urush yoki agressiyani ham qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi milliy g‘urur bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: the figure of Krampus is often depicted with horns, dark fur, and a menacing face.
in Austrian tradition, Krampus punishes naughty children during the Christmas season.
krampus.meta: krampus — bu Markaziy va Sharqiy Yevropaning (ayniqsa Alp tog‘lari mintaqasida) xalq og‘zaki ijodida uchraydigan, Rojdestvo bayrami bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan dahshatli va jazolovchi ruh yoki afsonaviy mavjudot.

ex: as a ladner, his job was to ensure all goods were properly secured for shipping.
the ladner carefully loaded the crates onto the truck.
ladner.meta: ladner — bu tovarlarni yuklaydigan yoki jo‘natadigan shaxs. Bu odam yuklarni transport vositasiga joylashtirish yoki ularni tashish uchun tayyorlash bilan shug‘ullanadi.

ex: the old castle still had a laidner where food was stored centuries ago.
the household kept salted meat in the laidner to preserve it through the winter.
laidner.meta: laidner — bu go‘sht va boshqa oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarini saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan xona, bino yoki shkaf. Bu so‘z hozirda tarixiy va juda kam ishlatiladi. Mazmuni "larder" (oziq-ovqat ombori) so‘ziga o‘xshaydi.

ex: the writer larded on unnecessary details, which made the story boring.
the chef larded on the sauce, making the dish too heavy.
to lard on.meta: to lard on — bu biror narsani juda ko‘p yoki me’yoridan ortiqcha miqdorda berish yoki qo‘shish harakati. Ko‘pincha biror narsani keragidan ortiq darajada haddan tashqari ishlatishni ifodalaydi.

ex: the lardaceous folds of his arms hung heavily at his sides.
he struggled to move his lardaceous body up the stairs.
lardaceous.meta: lardaceous — bu odam yoki tana qismlariga nisbatan ishlatiladigan, haddan tashqari semiz, shalviragan yoki juda og‘ir ko‘rinishga ega bo‘lgan holatni ifodalovchi sifat. Ko‘pincha salbiy yoki kamsituvchi ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: they kept the lard bucket in a cool cellar to prevent spoilage.
the cook filled the lard bucket with fresh rendered fat.
lard bucket.meta: lard bucket — bu cho‘chqa yog‘i yoki shunga o‘xshash yog‘ mahsulotlarini saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan chelak yoki shunga o‘xshash idish. Odatda oshxonada yog‘ yig‘ish va saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: the meat was larded to keep it moist during cooking.
the roasting pan was larded with fat to prevent sticking.
larded.meta: larded — bu yog‘ surtilgan yoki yog‘ bilan qoplangan holatni ifodalovchi sifat. Keyinchalik ko‘chma ma’noda ham ishlatiladi: biror narsaga boyitilgan, ortiqcha qo‘shilgan.

ex: only a lardhead would forget something so important.
don’t be such a lardhead—think before you act!
lardhead.meta: lardhead — bu aqli past, nodon yoki ahmoq odamni ifodalovchi haqoratli so‘z. Mazmun jihatdan "fat-head" so‘ziga o‘xshaydi va kamsitish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: in medieval kitchens, larding often consisted of fat or grease to keep meat moist.
the cook prepared strips of larding to insert into the roast.
larding.meta: larding — bu biror narsani yog‘lash uchun ishlatiladigan mahsulot. Ilgari bu yog‘ yoki moy degan ma’noda ishlatilgan (hozir eskirgan).

ex: lardite, being similar to opal, has little crystalline structure.
the geologist discovered a rare sample of lardite in the Siberian region.
lardite.meta: lardite — bu asosan Rossiyada topilgan, gidratlangan kremniydan tashkil topgan amorf mineral bo‘lib, ehtimol opalning bir turi. Hozirda juda kam uchraydi va nodir hisoblanadi.

ex: the chef served thin slices of lardo that melted on the tongue.
we ordered a plate of lardo with fresh bread and olives.
lardo.meta: lardo — bu italyan oshxonasiga xos, tuzlab va ziravorlar bilan tayyorlanadigan cho‘chqa yog‘i bo‘lib, odatda juda ingichka tilimlarda kesilib tortiladi. Odatda antipasto (aperitif) sifatida iste’mol qilinadi.

ex: the village had a designated area for lardry to provide fresh meat for the community.
the lardry was conducted at the back of the estate where livestock were prepared for the household.
lardry.meta: lardry — bu go‘sht olish maqsadida chorva hayvonlarini so‘yish jarayoni. Bu so‘z "larder" so‘zining qadimgi yoki kam ishlatiladigan shakli sifatida ham uchraydi.

ex: in ancient Odisha, maharis were considered devoted servants of the deity Jagannāth.
the mahari performed sacred dances during temple rituals.
mahari.meta: mahari — bu Hindistondagi Odisha shtatidagi Jagannath ibodatxonasida xizmat qiluvchi ayol yoki qiz raqqosa. Ular ibodat marosimlarida raqs orqali xizmat ko‘rsatgan. Bu an’ana hozirda asosan tarixiy hisoblanadi.

ex: the patient was diagnosed with a melanated lesion on the skin.
the melanated tissue appeared darker under the microscope.
melanated.meta: melanated — bu melanin pigmentini o‘z ichiga oladigan yoki melanin mavjud bo‘lgan narsa yoki to‘qimani ifodalovchi atama. Tibbiyot va biologiyada kam uchraydi. "Melanotic" so‘ziga o‘xshash.

ex: the issue is multiplicitous, involving political, economic, and cultural factors.
her multiplicitous personality made her both fascinating and difficult to understand.
multiplicitous.meta: multiplicitous — bu bir nechta qism, jihat yoki tomonlarga ega bo‘lgan; murakkab, ko‘p qatlamli yoki turli yo‘nalishlarga ega bo‘lgan narsani ifodalovchi sifat. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha murakkablik yoki keng ko‘lamlilikni ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: nup, I’m not going to that boring meeting.
did you finish your homework? — nup.
nup.meta: nup — bu ‘yo‘q’ ma’nosida ishlatiladigan juda norasmiy va hazilomuz so‘z shakli. Suhbatlarda, do‘stona yoki yengil kayfiyatda tez-tez qo‘llaniladi.

ex: the doctrine of occultation is central to Twelver Shia Islam.
Shia Muslims believe the twelfth Imam has entered occultation and will return as the Mahdi.
occultation.meta: bu Islom, xususan Shia e’tiqodida, o‘n ikkinchi imom (Imom Mahdi) Alloh irodasi bilan yashirin holatga o‘tgan, ko‘zdan g‘oyib bo‘lgan ruhiy mavjudlik holati. Shialar bu imom yashirin holda mavjud bo‘lib, kelajakda paydo bo‘lishiga ishonadilar.

ex: pegging is increasingly being talked about in modern discussions of sexual preferences and boundaries.
the couple openly discussed their interest in pegging as a way to explore new experiences.
pegging.meta: pegging — bu odatda ayol kishi jinsiy aloqada strap-on (sun’iy jinsiy a’zo) yordamida erkak jinsiy hamkorining anusiga kirib boradigan jinsiy amaliyot turi. Bu termin asosan zamonaviy jinsiy madaniyat va kontekstlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: damage to the prefrontal cortex can affect personality and impulse control.
the prefrontal cortex is responsible for decision-making and planning.
prefrontal cortex.meta: prefrontal cortex — bu miya peshona qismining oldingi qismi bo‘lib, u bilish, o‘rganish va murakkab fikrlash jarayonlari uchun juda muhim integrativ funksiyalarga ega.

ex: each Sabbat marks a significant seasonal change in the Wiccan calendar.
the Wiccans gathered to celebrate the Sabbat on the summer solstice.
sabbat.meta: bu Wicca va unga o‘xshash zamonaviy pagan an’analarida nishonlanadigan bir nechta bayramlardan biri bo‘lib, quyosh chiqishi va botishi (sostislar), kun va tun tenglashishi (ekvinokslar) va oraliq fasllarga to‘g‘ri keladigan maxsus kunlarda o‘tkaziladi.

ex: sabbatary observance differs from the Sunday practices of most Christian denominations.
the sabbatary tradition was followed by some early Christian groups.
sabbatary.meta: sabbatary — bu shanba kunini sabbat (dam olish kuni) sifatida nishonlaydigan kishilar yoki odatlarni ta’riflovchi eski va kam ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: scholars studied the sabbathine documents for historical context.
the sabbathine bull issued by Pope John XXII had significant theological implications.
sabbathine.meta: sabbathine — bu Rim katolik cherkovida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, Papa Ioann XXII (1244–1334) tomonidan chiqarilgan va Muqaddas Maryamni sharaflovchi bir farmonga taalluqli.

ex: during her sabbatic, she traveled to several countries to study ancient languages.
the professor took a sabbatic to conduct research abroad.
sabbatic.meta: sabbatic — bu asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan tushuncha bo‘lib, universitet yoki kollej o‘qituvchisiga har yetti yilda bir marta beriladigan, odatda o‘qish yoki sayohat qilish uchun ajratilgan ta’til davri.

ex: as a strict sabbatist, he refused to work or travel on the Sabbath.
the sabbatist community gathered every week to observe the sacred day.
sabbatist.meta: sabbatist — bu sabbat (dam olish va ibodat kuni) ga rioya qiladigan odam, ayniqsa yahudiy an’analariga muvofiq tarzda sabbatni nishonlaydigan shaxs. Ba’zan bu atama yahudiylarning sabbatga bo‘lgan qat’iy qarashlarini ifodalash uchun ham ishlatiladi.

ex: children raised in same-sex families can thrive just as well as those in other families.
the number of same-sex families has increased in recent years.
same-sex family.meta: same-sex family — bu (a) farzandlari bir jinsga mansub bo‘lgan oila; (b) ota-onasi bir jinsli juftlik bo‘lgan oila (hozirgi kunda odatda shu ma’noda ishlatiladi).

ex: he shared some scammy news that quickly spread on social media.
the magazine always features scammy stories to attract readers.
scammy.meta: scammy — bu axborot yoki ma’lumotga nisbatan ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, yangi, hayajonli va shov-shuvli bo‘lgan ma’lumotni ifodalaydi. Bu ma’lumot odatda ko‘pchilik e’tiborini tez jalb qiladi.

ex: in earlier centuries, self-designation often influenced career choices.
his self-designation as a healer guided his life’s purpose.
self-designation.meta: self-designation — bu o‘zini ma’lum bir kasb yoki vazifa uchun mos yoki taqdirida shu ish belgilangan deb hisoblash ishonchi. Bu ma’no hozir eskirgan va kam qo‘llaniladi.

ex: after a long day, there’s nothing like the shucking off of tight shoes.
the quick shucking of his jacket signaled he was ready to fight.
shucking.meta: shucking — bu asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, umumiy ma’noda biror narsani olib tashlash, yechish yoki voz kechish harakati yoki holatini ifodalaydi. Ko‘pincha “off” bilan ishlatiladi.

ex: side-loading firearms were revolutionary in their time.
the truck is designed for easy side-loading of cargo.
side-loading.meta: side-loading — bu biror narsani (ayniqsa, qurol yoki transport vositasini) yon tomondan yuklash harakati, amaliyoti yoki tizimi.

ex: the cartoon was about a dancing skellington.
on Halloween, we saw a plastic skellington hanging on the door.
skellington.meta: skellington — bu so‘zlashuv nutqida va nutqni tasvirlashda "skelet" (inson yoki hayvon suyagi tizimi) so‘zining quvnoq, yumoristik yoki norasmiy shakli.

ex: he's always watching some kind of sportsball on tv.
i don't really follow sportsball, but i know there was a big game last night.
sportsball.meta: sportsball — bu aslida qanday sport turi ekani muhim bo‘lmagan holatlarda, ayniqsa, jamoaviy to‘p o‘yinlarini (masalan, futbol, basketbol, regbi) umumiy hazil yoki befarqlik ohangida ifodalash uchun ishlatiladigan slang atama.

ex: the restaurant serves stonkingly large portions.
it was a stonkingly good performance.
stonkingly.meta: stonkingly — bu nihoyatda kuchli, juda katta yoki hayratlanarli darajada bo‘lishni ifodalovchi so‘z. Ko‘pincha ta’kid va kuchli taassurot bildirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: the dining room was filled with straight-back chairs.
she sat on a straight-back wooden chair.
straight-back.meta: straight-back — bu orqa qismi to‘g‘ri va tik bo‘lgan narsani, ayniqsa stul yoki boshqa o‘rindiq turini ifodalaydi. Bunday stullar yoki o‘rindiqlar orqaga qiyshiq emas, balki tik va qattiq tuzilishga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: he straight-batted the bowler’s tricky spin.
the batsman straight-batted the fast delivery with ease.
straight-bat.meta: bu kriketda to‘pni to‘g‘ri ushlab turgan bit (kriket tayoqchasi) bilan o‘ynash, ayniqsa himoyaviy zarba berish uchun ishlatiladigan harakat. Bu harakat odatda xavfsiz o‘ynash yoki to‘pni ehtiyotkorlik bilan qaytarish maqsadida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: her straight-batted style made her a reliable player in difficult matches.
he played a straight-batted innings, focusing on defence rather than attack.
straight-batted.meta: straight-batted — bu kriketda to‘g‘ri bit (kriket tayoqchasi) uslubida o‘ynaladigan yoki shunday uslub bilan bajarilgan harakatni ifodalaydi. Bu odatda to‘g‘ri va texnik jihatdan to‘g‘ri himoya qilish, xavfsiz va ehtiyotkorona o‘ynash uslubini bildiradi.

ex: straight drivers were considered the most predictable targets.
the shooter easily hit the straight driver.
straight driver.meta: straight driver — bu trap otish sportida tez va to‘g‘ri chiziq bo‘ylab uchadigan nishon qush. Bu atama hozirda eskirgan va kam ishlatiladi.

ex: The event is designed to be straight-friendly and inclusive.
This bar is LGBTQ but very straight-friendly.
straight-friendly.meta: Straight-friendly — asosan LGBTQ bizneslari yoki muhitlari haqida qo‘llaniladi va heteroseksual (an’anaviy jinsiy orientatsiyaga ega) insonlarga ochiq, qulay va do‘stona bo‘lgan joy yoki sharoitni anglatadi.

ex: He always bets on straight-goers because they run hard all the way to the finish.
The straight-goer left the other horses far behind in the race
straight-goer.meta: Avstraliyada ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, tabiatan poygada yoki yugurishda kuchli va tez harakat qiladigan otni ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z hozir kam uchraydi.

ex: Due to low traffic, we were allowed a straight-in landing.
The aircraft was cleared for a straight-in approach to runway 27.
straight-in.meta: Aviatsiyada qo‘nish yoki qo‘nishga yaqinlashish usuli bo‘lib, bu usulda samolyot aylanma yoki odatdagi qo‘nish yo‘llariga amal qilmasdan, bevosita va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri qo‘nadi.

ex: These straight-leg trousers are both stylish and comfortable.
She prefers wearing straight-leg jeans instead of skinny ones.
straight-leg.meta: Asosan jinsi shimlar yoki boshqa shim turlarida ishlatiladigan atama. straight-leg shimlar — ustidan pastigacha kengligi o‘zgarmaydigan, torayib ketmaydigan yoki kengayib bormaydigan, tekis shaklda tikilgan shimlardir.

ex: Straight legs are back in fashion this season.
She bought a new pair of straight legs for work.
straight legs.meta: Straight legs — bu jinsi yoki boshqa shimlarning turi bo‘lib, shimning ustki qismidan to pastki qismigacha kengligi bir xil bo‘ladi. Bunday shimlar torayib boradigan (tapered) yoki kengayib boradigan (flared) shimlardan farq qiladi.

ex: In straight-line depreciation, the asset loses value evenly over time.
The company uses the straight-line method to calculate depreciation.
straight-line.meta: Biznes va buxgalteriyada "straight-line" — bu aktiv eskirishini (amortizatsiyasini) hisoblash usuli bo‘lib, bunda har yili bir xil miqdorda yoki foizda eskirish xarajati ajratiladi.

ex: They faced the issue straight on without avoiding the difficult parts.
He told me straight on that he disagreed with my decision.
straight on.meta: To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri, ochiqdan-ochiq, hech qanday yashirish yoki chalg‘itishsiz harakat qilish yoki gapirish tarzida. Bu holatda odam biron narsani yuzma-yuz aytadi yoki muammoni yashirmay ochiq ko‘rsatadi.

ex: It was a straight-out refusal — no room for negotiation.
He told me straight-out that he wasn’t interested.
straight-out.meta: Biror narsaning to‘liq, murakkabliksiz, ochiq va shubhasiz tarzda amalga oshirilishini yoki ifodalanishini bildiradi.

ex: The concept of straight pride is often discussed in debates about equality and identity.
Some people promote straight pride as a response to gay pride events.
straight pride.meta: Asosan faraziy (gipotetik) kontekstlarda ishlatiladi. Bu atama gay pride (gomoseksuallar faxri) tushunchasiga qarama-qarshi yoki unga javoban qo‘llanadi.

ex: Many biathlon rifles use straight-pull mechanisms for quick reloading.
The rifle has a straight-pull bolt system that allows faster cycling.
straight-pull.meta: Otish qurollari mexanizmlarida straight-pull — bu tizza (bolt) orqaga va oldinga faqat to‘g‘ri chiziqda harakat qiladigan, hech qanday burilish (aylantirish) yoki o‘q chiqarish mexanizmini burab ochish zarur bo‘lmagan tizimni anglatadi.

ex: The army trains its soldiers to become straight shooters in all conditions.
He’s known as a straight shooter on the shooting range.
straight shooter.meta: Straight shooter — bu nishonga aniq uradigan, otish bo‘yicha mahoratga ega bo‘lgan odam. Bu atama asosan AQShda ishlatiladi va otish sportida yoki qurol bilan ishlashda yuqori darajada aniqlikka ega shaxsni ifodalaydi.

ex: I appreciate his straight-shooting style; he doesn’t waste time with formalities.
She’s a straight-shooting manager who always tells her team the truth.
straight-shooting.meta: Straight-shooting — bu odamning gapirish yoki fikr bildirish uslubini tavsiflovchi sifat bo‘lib, ochiq, halol va to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri gapiradigan, yashirin yoki chalg‘ituvchi gaplardan qochadigan shaxsni ifodalaydi.

ex: His straight talking made him popular with the public.
I appreciate her straight talking — she always tells you exactly what she thinks.
straight talking.meta: Straight talking — bu ochiq, bevosita va bemalol fikr bildirish, yashirishsiz, qochishsiz, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri muloqot qilish uslubidir. Bunda odam o‘z fikrini aniq, shubhasiz va orqama-orqa so‘zlarsiz bildiradi.

ex: She is known as a straight-thinking person who makes wise decisions.
We need a straight-thinking leader to guide us through this crisis.
straight-thinking.meta: bu mantiqan to‘g‘ri, ravshan, tushunarli fikr yuritadigan, sog‘lom fikrga ega bo‘lgan insonni tasvirlovchi sifat. Bunday odam vaziyatni tushunishda, qaror qabul qilishda va fikr bildirishda mantiqqa, aniqlikka va xolislikka tayanadi.

ex: He always orders his eggs straight-up, just lightly fried on one side.
I’d like my eggs straight-up with toast, please.
straight-up.meta: Straight-up — bu atama asosan AQShda ishlatiladi va tuxum tayyorlash usulini ifodalaydi. Bunda tuxum faqat bir tomoni qovuriladi, tuxum sarig‘i yuqorida qoladi va usti yopilmaydi. Bu usul ingliz tilida sunny side up deb ham ataladi.

ex: They chose the straightway road instead of the winding one.
The straightway path led directly to the village.
straightway.meta: straightway — bu yo‘l, yo‘nalish va h.k. haqida aytilganda, egri-bugrisiz, bukilmasdan, to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri boradigan, burilishsiz yo‘nalish yoki yo‘lni ifodalaydi.

ex: They moved straightwise towards their goal without hesitation.
The road runs straightwise through the valley.
straightwise.meta: straightwise — bu biror harakat yoki yo‘nalishning bevosita oldinga yoki to‘g‘ri chiziq bo‘ylab davom etishini bildiradi.

ex: I like to dip my chips in tartare sauce.
They served the fried fish with tartare on the side.
tartare.meta: Tartare — bu sovuq sous bo‘lib, uning tarkibida mayonez, maydalangan piyoz, bodring (gherkin), kapers va turli ko‘katlar bo‘ladi. Bu sous odatda baliq va dengiz mahsulotlari bilan iste’mol qilinadi. Ba’zan go‘sht yoki boshqa taomlarga ham qo‘shiladi.

ex: There are two tidal bulges on Earth caused by the Moon, leading to high tides.
The Moon’s gravitational pull creates a tidal bulge on the Earth's oceans.
tidal bulge.meta: Tidal bulge — bu bir sayyora, yulduz yoki boshqa osmon jismi sirtida boshqa jism yoki jismlar tortishish kuchi ta’sirida hosil bo‘ladigan qavariqlik yoki ko‘tarilishdir.

ex: Scouts are always looking for toolsy athletes who can develop into top performers.
He’s a toolsy young player with the potential to become a star.
toolsy.meta: Toolsy — bu atama sportchilar, ayniqsa, faoliyatining boshida bo‘lgan o‘yinchilar haqida ishlatiladi. Bu so‘z bir nechta muhim sport ko‘nikmalari yoki fazilatlarga ega, rivojlanish va muvaffaqiyatga erishish salohiyatiga ega bo‘lgan sportchini ifodalaydi.

ex: The truckie carefully guided his horse-drawn truck through muddy roads.
In the 19th century, a truckie would often transport logs from forests to sawmills.
truckie.meta: Truckie — bu og‘ir yuk, ayniqsa, yog‘och tashiydigan otga ulangan yuk aravasini boshqaruvchi odam. Bu so‘z tarixiy bo‘lib, bugungi kunda deyarli ishlatilmaydi. Bu kasb sanoatning ot-arava davrida keng tarqalgan bo‘lgan.

ex: The company updated its Ts and Cs to include new privacy rules.
Please read the Ts and Cs carefully before using the software.
ts and cs.meta: Ts and Cs — bu bitim yoki shartnomaning shartlari va qoidalari degan qisqartma bo‘lib, ayniqsa iste’molchi mahsulot yoki xizmatdan qanday foydalanishi mumkinligi, cheklovlar, talablar va javobgarliklarni belgilab beruvchi hujjatlar to‘plamini anglatadi.

ex: The turnpikers repaired the damaged section of the highway overnight.
My uncle worked as a turnpiker on the Pennsylvania Turnpike.
turnpiker.meta: Turnpiker — bu AQShda pullik avtomagistral (turnpike) yo‘llarini qurish yoki ularni ta’mirlash, xizmat ko‘rsatish bilan shug‘ullanadigan ishchi. Ular yo‘llarning texnik holatini saqlash, tuzatish, asfaltlash va xavfsizlikni ta’minlash bilan shug‘ullanadi.

ex: The bus driver performed a smooth turnround at the end of the street.
She made a quick turnround when she heard her name.
turnround.meta: Turnround — bu burilish yoki qarama-qarshi yo‘nalishga harakat qilish harakati. Ayniqsa, biror shaxs yoki narsa to‘xtab, boshqa tomonga yuzlanishi yoki harakatini o‘zgartirishi jarayoni. Bu so‘z "turnaround" bilan sinonimdir.

ex: They drove along a turny road that twisted through the forest.
The mountain path was narrow and turny, making the hike challenging.
turny.meta: Turny — bu ko‘p burilishlarga ega, egri-bugri yoki yo‘nalishi tez-tez o‘zgaradigan yo‘l, yo‘nalish yoki harakatni ifodalaydigan sifat. Bu so‘z burilishlar bilan to‘la yoki silliq bo‘lmagan harakatni, murakkab yo‘nalishni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Madonna’s hit song “Vogue” helped bring Voguing into mainstream culture.
Voguing emerged as a form of expression in New York’s underground dance scene.
voguing.meta: bu odatda zamonaviy musiqaga ijro etiladigan, modellar harakatlarini taqlid qilish va ularni bo‘rttirib ko‘rsatishga asoslangan raqs uslubi. Ushbu raqs qo‘l, tana va yuz holatlarini o‘tkir, aniq va badiiy tarzda ifodalash orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: The juice of fresh amla is known to boost immunity.
Amla is widely used in Ayurvedic medicine for its health benefits.
amla.meta: Amla — bu tropik va janubiy Osiyoda o‘sadigan, Phyllanthus emblica (Phyllanthaceae oilasi) daraxtining kichik, yashil-sariq rangli mevasi. Mevaning go‘shti nordon va biroz achchiq ta’mga ega.

ex: His proposal was quickly binned by the management.
I’ve binned those old magazines — they were just gathering dust.
binned.meta: Binned — bu so‘zlashuv tilida ishlatiladigan sifat bo‘lib, biror narsa axlat qutisiga tashlangan yoki bekor qilingan degan ma’noni anglatadi. Hozirda ko‘pincha ko‘chma ma’noda ishlatiladi

ex: It’s so obvious that Blind Freddy would notice it.
Even Blind Freddy could see that the project was failing.
blind freddy.meta: Blind Freddy — bu asosan Avstraliyada ishlatiladigan hazilomuz va kinoyaviy ifoda bo‘lib, ochiq-oydin yoki juda ravshan narsani ham ko‘rmaydigan, anglamaydigan yoki tushunmaydigan insonni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Some blindisms help visually impaired people self-regulate their sensory experience.+
The child’s head movements were identified as a form of blindism.
blindism.meta: bu ko‘zi ojiz yoki ko‘rish qobiliyati zaif bo‘lgan odamlarda kuzatiladigan maxsus jismoniy harakatlar yoki xatti-harakatlar majmuasi. Ushbu harakatlar ko‘pincha ko‘r yoki ko‘zi ojiz odamlarning o‘ziga xos harakatlari sifatida qabul qilinadi.

ex: Curtains are often finished with blind stitching for a clean look.
The tailor used blind stitching to hem the trousers so the stitches wouldn’t show.
blind stitching.meta: Blind stitching — bu matoni tikishda ishlatiladigan uslub bo‘lib, unda tikuvchining igna harakatlari matoning faqat bir tomonida ko‘rinadi, ikkinchi tomonida tikuv izlari deyarli yoki umuman bilinmaydi.

ex: BVR missiles allow pilots to strike targets before visual contact.
The fighter jets engaged the enemy in a BVR combat.
bvr.meta: BVR — bu "beyond visual range" (ya’ni ko‘rish diapazonidan tashqarida) iborasining qisqartmasi bo‘lib, asosan aviatsiyada ishlatiladi.

ex: In good storytelling, Chekhov’s gun reminds us that every detail should serve a purpose.
The mention of the locked drawer was a classic example of Chekhov’s gun — it had to play a role later.
chekhov’s gun.meta: Chekhov’s gun — bu adabiy prinsip bo‘lib, rus yozuvchisi Anton Chexov tomonidan shakllantirilgan. Bu prinsipga ko‘ra, hikoyada, romanda yoki pyesada ahamiyatsiz yoki keyingi voqeaga ta’sir qilmaydigan tafsilotlar bo‘lmasligi kerak.

ex: The scandal revealed a deep-rooted chumocracy within the party leadership.
Critics accused the administration of chumocracy by appointing only their close friends.
chumocracy.meta: Chumocracy — bu yaqin do‘stlar va tanishlar tarmog‘i orqali shakllangan yoki boshqariladigan ijtimoiy yoki siyosiy tizim.

ex: The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2022 was awarded for the development of click chemistry.
Click chemistry allows scientists to quickly build complex molecules with minimal side reactions.
click chemistry.meta: Click chemistry — bu kimyoviy moddalarning oson, tez, yuqori natija beradigan va keng qo‘llaniladigan sintez usullarini ifodalovchi tushuncha bo‘lib, ayniqsa biokimyo sohasida ishlatiladi.

ex: People are frustrated by customer support’s copypasta responses that ignore specific questions.
When I complained to the company, they sent me a copypasta response that didn’t address my issue.
copypasta response.meta: Copypasta response — bu odatda umumiy, shablon yoki me’yorda tayyorlangan javob bo‘lib, shaxsiy yondashuvsiz, e’tiborsizlik bilan yuborilgan deb hisoblanadi

ex: They enjoyed the co-work because it allowed them to share ideas freely.
The success of the project depended on effective co-work between departments.
co-work.meta: Co-work — bu boshqa bir shaxs yoki guruh bilan hamkorlikda bajariladigan ish yoki faoliyat. Bu so‘z ayniqsa keyingi yillarda o‘xshash kasb yoki vazifaga ega bo‘lgan insonlar bilan birgalikda bajariladigan ish ma’nosida keng qo‘llanila boshlandi.

ex: She prefers to co-work with people from different industries to exchange ideas.
Freelancers and small businesses often co-work in shared office spaces.
co-work.meta: Co-work — har xil tashkilotlarda ishlovchi xodimlarning umumiy ish muhitidan foydalanishi; shuningdek, bir ofis yoki bir ish joyida boshqa odamlar bilan ishlash.

ex: Children loved playing frontier games in Davy Crockett outfits.
He wore a Davy Crockett hat with a raccoon tail hanging from the back.
davy crockett.meta: Davy Crockett — bu atama, ayniqsa Amerika chegarachilari va mashhur xalq qahramoni Davy Crockett bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan kiyim-kechak uslubini ifodalaydi.

ex: D/deaf communities often advocate for sign language rights.
The event was open to D/deaf people and hard-of-hearing participants.
d/deaf.meta: deaf (kichik harf bilan) — tibbiy jihatdan eshitish qobiliyatini yo‘qotgan odamlar. Ular har doim ham kar jamoasining madaniy qismiga tegishli bo‘lavermaydi. Bu shunchaki eshitish bilan bog‘liq nogironlikni bildiradi.

ex: De-identification ensures that individuals cannot be traced from the data.
The hospital performed de-identification on patient records before sharing them with researchers.
de-identification.meta: bu ma’lumotlar yoki hujjatlardan shaxsni aniqlash mumkin bo‘lgan ma’lumotlarni olib tashlash yoki o‘zgartirish jarayoni. Bu jarayon natijasida ma’lumotlarning kimga tegishli ekani noma’lum bo‘lib qoladi va shaxsni aniqlash imkoni yo‘q bo‘ladi.

ex: The chef prefers using Desiree for creamy mashed potatoes.
Desiree potatoes are perfect for boiling and roasting.
desiree.meta: Desiree — bu pushti po‘stlog‘i va mumli, sarg‘ish go‘shtga ega bo‘lgan kartoshka navi. Desiree kartoshkasi yaxshi pishadi, parchalanmaydi va yumshoq tuzilishga ega bo‘lgani uchun qaynatish, pishirish va qovurish uchun juda mos keladi.

ex: She is a divorcing mother trying to rebuild her life.
The divorcing couple attended mediation sessions to resolve their issues.
divorcing.meta: Divorcing — bu sifat sifatida ishlatilganda, asosan nikohni bekor qilish jarayonini boshlagan yoki hozirda shu jarayonda bo‘lgan shaxs yoki juftlikni bildiradi.

ex: His work focuses on the divorcing of emotion from logical reasoning.
The divorcing of art from politics is not always possible.
divorcing.meta: Avval bir-biriga bog‘langan yoki birlashtirilgan ikki narsani bir-biridan ajratish harakati yoki holati.

ex: In a double-blinded trial, neither the patients nor the doctors knew who received the placebo.
The study was double-blinded to ensure unbiased results.
double-blinded.meta: Double-blinded — bu tibbiyot yoki ilmiy tadqiqotlarda qo‘llaniladigan uslub bo‘lib, unda sinov yoki tadqiqot paytida ham testni o‘tkazayotgan shaxs (tadqiqotchi), ham ishtirokchi (sub’yekt) muayyan ma’lumotlardan mahrum qilinadi.

ex: The crowd stood pride-dumbed, unable to speak.
He was completely dumbed by the surprising news.
dumbed.meta: Dumbed — bu sifat bo‘lib, kimningdir yoki nimaningdir ta’siri ostida so‘zsiz, jim yoki lol qolgan holatni ifodalaydi. Bu holat ko‘pincha kuchli hayrat, taajjub, qo‘rqish yoki boshqa hissiy reaktsiya tufayli yuzaga keladi.

ex: You need to EQ the vocals to make them clearer in the mix.
The sound engineer EQed the guitar track to reduce unwanted frequencies.
eq qilmoq.meta: EQ qilish — bu audio qurilmaning turli chastotalar darajasini tenglashtirish yoki sozlash jarayoni. Bu jarayon yordamida musiqa yoki ovozning ohangi (tonal balans) o‘zgartiriladi, ovoz yanada sifatli, tiniq yoki kerakli uslubda eshitilishi ta’minlanadi.

ex: You must always use the equal sign to state that two expressions have the same value.
In the equation 2 + 3 = 5, the equal sign shows that both sides are equal.
equal sign.meta: Equal sign — bu matematika sohasida ishlatiladigan = belgisi bo‘lib, undan oldingi va keyingi ifodalar bir-biriga teng ekanligini bildiradi. Ushbu belgi tenglikni ifodalash uchun qo‘llaniladi va matematik tenglamalarda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: Some textiles are treated with forever chemicals to make them water-resistant.
Forever chemicals are found in many non-stick cookware products.
forever chemical.meta: Forever chemical — bu ko‘p turdagi sun’iy kimyoviy birikmalar bo‘lib, ular asosan pishirish idishlari, kosmetika va matolarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Non-stick pans often contain forever chemicals that do not break down easily.
Scientists are concerned about the health impact of forever chemicals in drinking water.
forever chemical.meta: Abadiy kimyoviy modda — tabiatda yoki inson organizmida deyarli parchalanmaydigan va juda uzoq vaqt saqlanib qoladigan sun’iy (laboratoriyada yaratilgan) kimyoviy birikmalar guruhiga berilgan nom.

ex: Many companies are investing in generative AI to automate content creation.
Generative AI can create realistic images from text descriptions.
generative ai.meta: bu matn, tasvir, musiqa va boshqa kreativ kontentlarni avtomatik yaratishga mo‘ljallangan sun’iy intellekt tizimi. Ushbu turdagi AI avval faqat insonlar bajara oladigan ijodiy vazifalarni bajarishi mumkin deb hisoblangan ishlarni bajaradi.

ex: Many apps now use generative artificial intelligence to help users create content.
Generative artificial intelligence can produce realistic images and coherent text.
generative artificial intelligence.meta: Generative artificial intelligence — bu inson intellektini talab qiladigan matn, rasm yoki boshqa ijodiy mahsulotlarni yaratish uchun mo‘ljallangan sun’iy intellektning turi.

ex: His Gradgrindian attitude made the classroom atmosphere very strict and cold.
The school’s Gradgrindian approach left little room for creativity or emotion.
gradgrindian.meta: bu so‘z Charlz Dikensning “Qiyin vaqtlar” (Hard Times, 1854) romanidagi maktab o‘qituvchisi Tomas Gradgrind xarakteriga xos bo‘lgan, qattiq, sovuq va faqat faktlar va raqamlarga asoslangan ta’lim yoki munosabatlarni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The sudden hypnic jerk startled her awake in the middle of the night.
I often experience a hypnic jerk just as I am about to fall asleep.
hypnic jerk.meta: Hypnic jerk — bu inson uyquga ketayotgan vaqtda yuzaga keladigan to‘satdan, ixtiyorsiz, mushaklarning qisqarishi yoki to‘lqinlanishi. Bu harakat odatda butun tanada yoki tananing bir qismida sodir bo‘ladi va insonni qisqa muddatga uyg‘otishi mumkin

ex: Getting insurance through mobile apps is a result of advancements in insurance technology.
New insurance technology helps companies provide insurance policies quickly and conveniently.
insurance technology.meta: Sugʻurta texnologiyasi — bu hozirgi kunda, ayniqsa, raqamli va onlayn texnologiyalar orqali sugʻurta mahsulotlari va xizmatlarini yaratish va tarqatishni yanada samaraliroq qilishga moʻljallangan texnologiya.

ex: Insurtech solutions make it easier for customers to buy insurance online.
Many startups are using insurtech to revolutionize the insurance industry.
insurtech.meta: bu sugʻurta texnologiyasi qisqartirilgan shakli boʻlib, ayniqsa raqamli va onlayn texnologiyalar yordamida sugʻurta mahsulotlari va xizmatlarini yaratish va tarqatishni yanada samarali qilishga qaratilgan texnologiyalar majmuasini anglatadi.

ex: Li-ion technology is common in electric vehicles.
My phone uses a Li-ion battery that charges quickly and lasts long.
li-ion.meta: Li-ion batareya — odatda qayta zaryadlanadigan batareya texnologiyasi boʻlib, uning elektroliti tarkibida litiy birikmasi boʻladi. Asosan litiy-ion batareya deb ham ataladi va bu atama koʻpincha aniqlovchi sifatida ishlatiladi

ex: A Mevlevi ceremony is a spiritual dance symbolizing the soul’s journey to God.
The Mevlevi order is famous for the whirling dervishes.
mevlevi.meta: Mevleviy — bu XIII asr oxirida hozirgi Turkiyaning Konya shahrida tashkil topgan sufiya diniy tariqatidir. Shuningdek, ushbu tariqat aʼzosi ham mevleviy deb ataladi.

ex: Researchers are studying the health effects of PFAS exposure.
PFAS are commonly used in non-stick cookware and water-resistant fabrics.
pfas.meta: PFAS moddalari — bu sunʼiy yaratilgan kimyoviy birikmalar guruhi boʻlib, ularning tarkibida bir yoki odatda bir nechta flyuor atomlari bo‘ladi.

ex: This power bank can charge your tablet twice before it needs recharging.
I always carry a power bank when I travel to keep my phone charged.
power bank.meta: Quvvat banki — bu elektr quvvat manbai bo‘lib, ayniqsa, keyingi yillarda portativ va qayta zaryadlanadigan batareya shaklida qo‘llaniladi. U mobil telefonlar va boshqa elektron qurilmalarni elektr tarmog‘iga ulanmagan paytda zaryadlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The system will prepopulate the fields based on your previous entries.
The registration form was prepopulated with my personal information.
prepopulate.meta: Oldindan to‘ldirmoq — biror narsani (ayniqsa, kompyuterda forma yoki ma’lumotlar bazasini) foydalanuvchi ish boshlashidan oldin avvaldan mavjud yoki oldindan ma’lum bo‘lgan ma’lumotlar bilan avtomatik ravishda to‘ldirish.

ex: You thought I was serious—psych!
I told you I won the lottery—psych! I didn’t!
psych.meta: Psych — bu asosan hazil yoki oʻyin maqsadida ishlatiladigan soʻz boʻlib, biror kishini qasddan chalgʻitib yoki aldaganini keyin ochiqlash uchun qoʻllaniladi. Odatda "hazil qildim", "aldandiz", "shunchaki oʻyin" degan maʼnoni beradi.

ex: Her decision was affected by recency bias, as she only remembered the last few presentations.
Investors often fall victim to recency bias, focusing too much on recent market trends.
recency bias.meta: Yaqinlik xatosi (recency bias) — bu odamlarning biror narsani baholash yoki qaror qabul qilish jarayonida yaqinda sodir bo‘lgan voqealar yoki tajribalardan haddan tashqari ta’sirlanish tendensiyasi.

ex: When the safe word is spoken, all activity must stop immediately.
They agreed on a safe word before starting the role play.
safe word.meta: Xavfsizlik so‘zi — bu, ayniqsa BDSM rolli oʻyinlarda yoki boshqa jinsiy faoliyatlarda ishtirokchilar tomonidan oldindan kelishilgan, faoliyatni darhol to‘xtatish yoki vaqtincha to‘xtatish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus so‘z yoki ibora.

ex: The teacher used a screen-share to explain the lesson.
Let’s start a screen-share so I can show you the presentation.
screen-share.meta: Ekranni ulash — bu kompyuter, telefon yoki boshqa qurilmaning ekranidagi tasvirni real vaqt rejimida boshqa foydalanuvchilar bilan bo‘lishish jarayoni. Odatda onlayn uchrashuvlar, taqdimotlar yoki texnik yordam paytida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The technician used screen-sharing to fix the software issue remotely.
Screen-sharing is useful for online meetings and presentations.
screen-sharing.meta: Ekranni ulash jarayoni — bu kompyuter ekranidagi tasvirni maxsus dasturiy taʼminot orqali masofadan va real vaqt rejimida boshqalarga ko‘rsatish yoki boshqalarga ekraningizni ko‘rish imkonini berish jarayoni.

ex: Please don’t whitesplain my own experiences to me.
He kept trying to mansplain basic facts to her.
-splain.meta: -splen — bu ingliz tilida ko‘pincha zarur bo‘lganda tuziladigan so‘z yasovchi qo‘shimcha boʻlib, biror shaxs yoki guruh (birinchi so‘z qismi orqali aniqlanadigan) qandaydir narsani tushuntirishi yoki izohlashini bildiradi.

ex: The professor was accused of whitesplaining racial issues to his students.
Mansplaining is when a man explains something to a woman in a condescending way.
-splaining.meta: -splaining — bu ingliz tilida yangi so‘zlar yasash uchun ishlatiladigan qoʻshimcha boʻlib, odatda biror shaxs yoki guruh (birinchi so‘z qismi orqali aniqlanadigan) qandaydir narsani tushuntirish uslubini bildiradi.

ex: She felt stalked after seeing the same man following her multiple times.
The deer was stalked by the hunter through the forest.
stalked.meta: Ta’qib qilingan — bu biror shaxs yoki hayvon yashirincha kuzatilgan, sekin-asta quvib borilgan yoki ov qilinayotgan holatni bildiradi.

ex: On St David’s Day, many children wear daffodils or leeks, the national symbols of Wales.
People in Wales celebrate St David’s Day with parades and traditional costumes.
st david’s day.meta: Avliyo Dovud kuni — bu 1-mart sanasida nishonlanadigan, Uelsning muqaddas himoyachisi hisoblangan Avliyo Dovud (St David) sharafiga bag‘ishlangan bayramdir. Uels xalqi ushbu kuni milliy ramzlarni taqib yuradi va turli anʼanaviy tadbirlar o‘tkazadi.

ex: As a Stephanian, he always spoke proudly of his college.
The Stephanian tradition values academic excellence and discipline.
stephanian.meta: Stephanian — bu "Stephen", "Stephens" yoki "Stephanus" ismiga ega mashhur shaxslar yoki ularga oid narsalarga taalluqli sifat.

ex: On St Patrick’s Day, it is common to wear green clothes.
People all over the world celebrate St Patrick’s Day with parades and festivals.
st patrick’s day.meta: Avliyo Patrik kuni — bu 17-mart sanasida nishonlanadigan bayram boʻlib, Irlandiyaning muqaddas homiysi sanalgan Avliyo Patrik xotirasiga bagʻishlangan.

ex: The office swear box collected quite a lot of money over the year.
Every time he swore, he had to put a dollar in the swear box.
swear box.meta: So‘kinish qutisi — bu biror kishi so‘kinganida yoki noo‘rin so‘z ishlatganida, jarima sifatida ma’lum miqdorda pul tashlashi shart bo‘lgan quti. Bu odatda hazil yoki tarbiya maqsadida oilalarda, ofislarda yoki do‘stlar guruhida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The swear jar is almost full after today’s meeting!
If you swear, you have to put a coin in the swear jar.
swear jar.meta: So‘kinish bankasi — bu biror kishi so‘kinganida yoki noo‘rin so‘z ishlatganida jarima sifatida ma’lum miqdorda pul tashlashi shart bo‘lgan idish yoki quti. Bu odatda hazil, odob o‘rgatish yoki tartib o‘rnatish maqsadida ishlatiladi.

ex: She became the team’s taliswoman, inspiring them to victory.
The small statue was a taliswoman believed to bring good luck.
taliswoman.meta: Taliswoman — bu ayol bilan bogʻliq bo‘lgan yoki ayol shaklida tasvirlangan talisman (himoya yoki omad ramzi). Shuningdek, bu so‘z biror ayol kishi omad, muvaffaqiyat yoki ruhiy kuch manbai sifatida qabul qilingan holatlarda ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The students created a talkboard to discuss their project.
I found the answer to my question on a technology talkboard.
talkboard.meta: Muloqot taxtasi — bu internet orqali foydalanuvchilar o‘zaro xabar almashadigan, mavzular bo‘yicha fikr bildirish va muhokama qilish imkonini beradigan onlayn forum yoki chat xonasi. Bu yerda odatda ochiq yoki yopiq suhbatlar bo‘lib o‘tadi.

ex: Toxinology helps scientists develop antivenoms for dangerous bites.
She specializes in toxinology, focusing on snake venoms.
toxinology.meta: Toksinologiya — bu biologik zaharlar, ayniqsa hayvonlarning (ilon, o‘rgimchak, chayon va boshqalar) zaharlari va ularning ta’siri, tarkibi, va davolash usullarini o‘rganuvchi ilmiy soha.

ex: Unfair practices unequalize opportunities in the workplace.
The new policy could unequalize access to education.
unequalize.meta: Tengsizlik yaratmoq — bu biror narsani teng bo‘lmagan, nomutanosib yoki notekis holatga keltirish; odamlar yoki guruhlar o‘rtasida tenglikni buzish, ularni bir-biridan farqli sharoitda yoki darajada qo‘yishga sabab bo‘lish.

ex: She works in visual merchandise, designing store displays to attract customers.
The store’s visual merchandise included colorful props and stylish mannequins.
visual merchandise.meta: Vizual mahsulotlar — bu chakana savdo do‘konlarida mijozlar e’tiborini jalb qilish uchun vitrina va ichki makonlarda namoyish etiladigan tovarlar, bezaklar yoki maxsus ko‘rgazmali jihozlar.

ex: Effective visual merchandising can significantly increase customer interest.
She works in visual merchandising, creating attractive displays for a clothing store.
visual merchandising.meta: bu chakana savdo do‘konlarida tovarlarni jozibador, chiroyli va e’tiborni tortadigan tarzda joylashtirish va bezash jarayoni. Bu faoliyat mijozlarning e’tiborini jalb qilish, sotuvni oshirish va do‘kon muhitini yanada yoqimli qilishga xizmat qiladi.

ex: Some brands pinkwash their products to appeal to LGBTQ+ consumers without supporting their rights in practice.
The company tried to greenwash its image by sponsoring an environmental event.
-wash.meta: -wash — bu ingliz tilida so‘z yasovchi qo‘shimcha bo‘lib, biror kompaniya, mahsulot, shaxs yoki tashkilotni biror ijtimoiy g‘oya, harakat yoki ijobiy qadriyat bilan bog‘liq qilib ko‘rsatish

ex: Many brands are accused of pinkwashing during Pride Month.
The company’s environmental campaign was just greenwashing.
-washing.meta: biror kompaniya, mahsulot, tashkilot yoki shaxs o‘zini biror ijtimoiy harakat, ekologik g‘oya yoki axloqiy qadriyatga sodiqdek ko‘rsatishi, lekin aslida bu faqat tashqi ko‘rinishda yoki marketing uchun qilinganligini anglatadi.

ex: The politician accused the university of promoting wokeism.
Some critics argue that wokeism is damaging free speech.
wokeism.meta: Voukizm — bu asosan tanqidiy ohangda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, ijtimoiy adolatsizlikka, kamsitish va tengsizlikka qarshi faol qarash va amaliyotlarni, ayniqsa progressiv yoki chap qanot g‘oyalarga sodiqlikni bildiradi.

ex: The company was accused of practicing performative wokery without real action.
Some newspapers complain about the rise of wokery in schools.
wokery.meta: Voukchilik — bu odatda tanqidiy ohangda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, ijtimoiy adolatsizlik yoki kamsitishlarga qarshi bo‘lgan progressiv yoki chap qanot qarashlar va harakatlarni anglatadi.

ex: His dream is to open his own wokery specializing in Cantonese cuisine.
We had lunch at a popular wokery near the city center.
wokery.meta: vok (kattakon dumaloq qozon) yordamida, ayniqsa kantoncha uslubda tayyorlanadigan taomlarni taqdim etuvchi restoran, taom stendi yoki oshxona. Shuningdek, vokda ovqat pishirish mahorati yoki jarayoni ham nazarda tutiladi.

ex: They gathered for some light-hearted women’s talk over tea.
The men left the room, saying it was time for women’s talk.
women’s talk.meta: Ayollar suhbati — bu odatda ayollar o‘rtasida bo‘ladigan, shaxsiy, kundalik, ijtimoiy yoki oila, moda, go‘zallik va shunga o‘xshash mavzularga oid suhbatlarni ifodalaydi. Ba’zan bu ibora kamsituvchi yoki stereotip tarzida ishlatilishi ham mumkin.

ex: The goalkeeper made a worldie save in the last minute.
That was a worldie of a goal from the halfway line!
worldie.meta: Worldie — norasmiy so‘z bo‘lib, futbol yoki boshqa sport turlarida juda ajoyib, aql bovar qilmas darajadagi gol, seyv (to‘pni qaytarish), tutib olish yoki boshqa sport harakatlarini ifodalaydi.

ex: She was freed a vinculo matrimonii after years of legal battles.
The court granted a divorce a vinculo matrimonii.
a vinculo matrimonii.meta: A vinculo matrimonii — bu huquqiy atama bo‘lib, nikohni mutlaqo bekor qiluvchi, ya’ni er-xotin o‘rtasidagi nikoh rishtalarini butunlay va huquqiy jihatdan to‘xtatib qo‘yuvchi ajralishni anglatadi.

ex: The hard water leaves a stubborn bathtub ring.
I need to clean the bathtub ring before guests arrive.
bathtub ring.meta: Vanna izi — bu vanna ichki devorida suv to‘kilgandan keyin qoladigan, ko‘pincha qattiq suv va sovun qoldiqlari aralashmasidan hosil bo‘ladigan kir va dog‘ shaklidagi halqa.

ex: The big blind for this table is 100 chips.
He was sitting in the big blind position when the hand started.
big blind.meta: Big blind — bu pokerning ayrim turlarida o‘yin boshlanishidan oldin majburiy qo‘yiladigan ikki garovdan kattasidir. Odatda, bu garovni dilerdan ikki o‘rin chapda o‘tirgan o‘yinchi tikadi.

ex: In old races, many horses were blinded to prevent distractions.
The blinded horse stayed focused on the path ahead.
blinded.meta: Blinded — bu ma’noda (asosan AQShda ishlatilgan, hozir eskirgan) ko‘zlariga maxsus to‘siq (blinker yoki blinder) taqilgan otni anglatadi.

ex: In races, blindered horses stay more focused.
The blindered horse walked calmly through the crowded street.
blindered.meta: ayniqsa otlarga nisbatan ishlatiladigan sifat bo‘lib, ko‘z to‘sig‘i taqilgan yoki shunday to‘siqlar bilan jihozlangan otni anglatadi. Bu to‘siqlar otning yon tomonlarini ko‘rishini cheklab, faqat oldini ko‘rishiga imkon beradi va chalg‘ishdan saqlaydi.

ex: The game required all players to wear blindfolders.
She tied a blindfolder around his head before the surprise.
blindfolder.meta: Blindfolder — bu boshga o‘raladigan va ko‘zlarni to‘sib, taqib olgan kishining ko‘rish imkoniyatini vaqtincha yo‘qotadigan mato bo‘lagi yoki maxsus ko‘z yopqich. Ko‘pincha o‘yinlarda, sinovlarda yoki ayrim mashqlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: She followed the path blindful, knowing nothing of the dangers ahead.
He stumbled blindful through the dark forest.
blindful.meta: bu hozir eskirgan so‘z bo‘lib, ko‘r odam kabi, ya’ni biror narsani ko‘rmasdan, anglamasdan yoki tushunmasdan harakat qilish yoki yashash tarzini ifodalaydi. Bu so‘z zamonaviy tilida deyarli ishlatilmaydi va hozirda blindly so‘zi bilan almashtirilgan.

ex: The miners dug into a blind hole with no further tunnels.
The screw fits into a blind hole in the metal plate.
blind hole.meta: Blind hole — bu bir tomoni ochiq, boshqa tomoni berk bo‘lgan teshik yoki yo‘lakni anglatadi. Ko‘rinishidan faqat bitta chiqish yo‘li bo‘ladi.

ex: In old literature, blind man’s bluff sometimes referred to intimate encounters.
The phrase “blind man’s bluff” was once used as slang for sexual activity.
blind man’s bluff.meta: Blind man’s bluff — aslida bolalar o‘ynaydigan o‘yinning nomi bo‘lsa-da, ba’zan norasmiy, eskirgan tilda jinsiy faoliyat yoki jinsiy aloqa ma’nosida ham ishlatilgan. Hozirda bunday qo‘llanish deyarli ishlatilmaydi va zamonaviy til uchun yaroqsiz.

ex: Drivers struggled through the blin’ drift during the snowstorm.
The road was dangerous because of the blin’ drift reducing visibility.
blin’ drift.meta: Blin’ drift — bu juda qalin, kuchli qorning shamol ta’sirida ko‘chishi va havo ko‘rinishini kamaytirishi yoki butunlay yo‘qotishi holatini ifodalaydi. Bunday qor yelqimi yo‘l va atrofdagi narsalarni ko‘rishni qiyinlashtiradi.

ex: The team was blindsided by the sudden defeat.
He was completely blindsided by the unexpected news.
blindsided.meta: Blindsided — dastlab bu so‘z behabar, ko‘zlari to‘silgan degan ma’noda ishlatilgan. Keyinchalik, ko‘proq to‘satdan yuz bergan hodisa yoki xabarsiz holat tufayli hayratga tushish, ruhiy charchoq yoki tushunmovchilik holatida bo‘lish ma’nolarini olgan.

ex: The patient showed symptoms of blind staggers, unable to walk steadily.
After drinking too much, he suffered from the blind staggers.
blind staggers.meta: Blind staggers — bu holat odatda vaqtinchalik bo‘lib, mastlik natijasida yuzaga keladigan ko‘rish qobiliyatining zaiflashishi va harakatlarda muvozanatning buzilishi, bosh aylanishi yoki to‘liq emas yura olmaslik holatini anglatadi.

ex: Many Burkinabe people live in the capital city, Ouagadougou.
She is a Burkinabe artist known internationally.
burkinabe.meta: Burkinabe — G‘arbiy Afrikada joylashgan Burkina Faso davlatida tug‘ilgan yoki shu davlat aholisi naslidan bo‘lgan shaxsni anglatadi. Burkina Faso 1984-yilgacha Yuqori Volta deb atalgan.

ex: Catfishing is popular in this region during the summer.
They spent the weekend catfishing by the river.
catfishing.meta: Catfishing — bu som baliqni ovlash harakati yoki amaliyotini anglatadi. Baliq ovlash bilan shug‘ullanish jarayoni sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Being chair-bound for long periods can lead to health problems.
After the surgery, he was chair-bound for several weeks.
chair-bound.meta: Chair-bound — stulda o‘tirib harakatlanishga cheklangan yoki doim stulda o‘tiradigan, faollik darajasi past bo‘lgan odamni ifodalaydi. Bu atama ko‘pincha sog‘liq yoki hayot tarzi bilan bog‘liq holda ishlatiladi.

ex: She chaired the discussion on environmental policies.
The meeting was chaired by the company director.
chaired.meta: Chaired — yig‘ilish, muhokama yoki boshqa rasmiy tadbirda rais, rahbar yoki boshqaruvchi tomonidan boshqarilgan, olib borilgan holatni anglatadi.

ex: The committee praised his chairing skills during the session.
Her chairing of the meeting was effective and organized.
chairing.meta: Chairing — yig‘ilish, kompaniya, qo‘mita va boshqa rasmiy uchrashuvlarda rais sifatida boshqaruvni olib borish yoki rahbarlik qilish harakati.

ex: She held the chairship of the committee for five years.
During his chairship, the company expanded significantly.
chairship.meta: Chairship — kompaniya, jamiyat, qo‘mita va boshqalardagi raislik lavozimi yoki ushbu lavozimni egallash davri. Bu atama rahbarlik maqomi va uni bajarish vaqtini bildiradi.

ex: He waited patiently at his teacher’s chairside for instructions.
The nurse stood at the patient’s chairside during the procedure.
at a person’s chairside.meta: At a person’s chairside iborasi — biror kishining stuli yonida yoki yon tarafida joylashgan holatni bildiradi. Ba’zida bu ibora ramziy ma’noda ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Most of the treatment is done chairside by the dentist.
The dental assistant prepared the tools at the chairside.
chairside.meta: Chairside — tish shifokori stulining yonidagi joy yoki maydon, bu yerda tish shifokori bemorni davolaydi. Bu hudud bemorning tibbiy muolaja ko‘riladigan joy sifatida qaraladi.

ex: China earth, also known as kaolin, is essential for porcelain production.
The pottery was made using fine China earth.
china earth.meta: China earth — Xitoy bilan bog‘liq mahsulotlar va tovarlar nomlarida ishlatiladigan atama. Asosan kaolin yoki xitoy g‘alampi deb ataladigan, keramika va chinni ishlab chiqarishda qo‘llaniladigan mayda oq tuproq.

ex: A china cap helps remove solids from liquids in cooking.
The chef used a china cap to strain the sauce.
china cap.meta: China cap — metallardan yasalgan, konus shaklida bo‘lgan elak yoki to‘r turi. U suyuqliklarni yoki mayda narsalarni filtrlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: She wore a dress in china blue that matched the porcelain.
The vase was decorated in a china-blue pattern.
china blue.meta: China blue — ko‘pincha tire bilan yoziladi (china-blue). Bu atama xitoy chinni idishlarida uchraydigan xos ko‘k rangni ifodalaydi. Odatda oq va ko‘k rangli chinni bezaklarida uchraydigan yumshoq, tiniq ko‘k tus.

ex: The china doll had a beautifully painted face.
She keeps her grandmother’s china doll in a glass cabinet.
china doll.meta: China doll — to‘liq yoki qisman chinni (porselan) materialidan yasalgan qo‘g‘irchoq. Bu qo‘g‘irchoqlar odatda nozik, sinuvchan va ko‘pincha kolleksionerlik uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: She collects antique china porcelain from different countries.
The teacups were made of fine china porcelain.
china porcelain.meta: China porcelain — porselan, ayniqsa yuqori sifatli chinni mahsulotlari nazarda tutiladi. Shuningdek, ushbu materialdan tayyorlangan chinni idishlar yoki buyumlar ham shunday ataladi.

ex: In the old markets, China wares were highly valued.
The merchant imported fine China wares from the East
chinaware.meta: Chinaware — Xitoydan keltirilgan savdo buyumlari yoki tovarlar, asosan tarixiy va eskirgan ma’noda ishlatiladi. Odatda ikki so‘z shaklida (“China ware”) va ko‘plikda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The artist preferred using china white pigments in his portraits.
The walls were painted in china white to create a bright, clean look.
china white.meta: China white — har xil oq rang soyalarining nomi yoki ma’lum oq bo‘yoqlar va pigmentlarning atamasi. Bu atama ko‘pincha chinni buyumlariga o‘xshash yumshoq yoki tiniq oq rangni ifodalaydi.

ex: The gang chined him in the alley.
He threatened to chine the man if he didn’t leave.
chine.meta: Chine — ingliz tilining ayrim hududiy lahjalarida ishlatilgan, hozir eskirgan soʻz. Biror kishini urib yerga yiqitish yoki uni doʻpposlash maʼnosini anglatadi.

ex: A chined roast is much simpler to slice at the table.
The butcher prepared a chined rack of lamb for easier carving.
chined.meta: Chined — go‘sht parchalashda: orqa suyagi (umurtqa) qovurg‘alardan qisman ajratilgan holat, bu go‘shtni kesishni (bo‘laklashni) osonlashtiradi.

ex: The term Chinee is now considered offensive.
In old literature, you may find references to Chinee merchants.
chinee.meta: Chinee — ingliz tilida ilgari xitoylik yoki Xitoyga oid ma’nosida ishlatilgan so‘z. Hozirgi kunda bu so‘z eskirgan va ko‘pincha haqoratli yoki kamsituvchi ohangda deb hisoblanadi. Zamonaviy ingliz tilida bu so‘z o‘rniga Chinese ishlatiladi.

ex: The Chinese dragon is a symbol of power and good fortune.
The parade featured a giant Chinese dragon that danced through the streets.
chinese dragon.meta: Xitoy bilan bogʻliq afsonaviy mavjudot yoki ilohni tasvirlovchi shakl yoki ramz. Xitoy ajdari odatda turli hayvonlarga xos elementlarga ega boʻlgan shaklda tasvirlanadi va Xitoy madaniyatida kuch, omad, va hosildorlik timsoli hisoblanadi.

ex: This variety of Chinese leaf gives the tea a delicate flavor.
The finest Chinese leaf is used to produce premium green teas.
chinese leaf.meta: Chinese leaf — choy o‘simligi (Camellia sinensis) ning bargi, ayniqsa Xitoyda yetishtirilgan yoki Xitoyga xos usulda tayyorlangan turlari. Bu choy barglari ko‘pincha an'anaviy Xitoy choylari tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: The farmer grows Chinese mustard alongside bok choy and other greens.
Chinese mustard is often stir-fried or pickled in Asian cuisine.
chinese mustard.meta: Chinese mustard — Sharqiy Osiyoda o‘sadigan turli bargli karam (brassica) turlari umumiy nomi. Ayniqsa, dastlab Brassica juncea (jigarrang yoki hind xantali) va keyinchalik Brassica rapa (bok choy) o‘simliklari shular jumlasiga kiradi.

ex: Chinese oranges are known for their sweet taste and easy-to-peel skin.
The market sells fresh Chinese oranges during the New Year festival.
chinese orange.meta: dastlab Xitoyda yetishtirilgan yoki hozir ham asosan Xitoyda yetishtiriladigan turli apelsin yoki sitrus mevalari. Ayniqsa, mandarin apelsini (mandarin) shu nom bilan mashhur. Shuningdek, bu mevalarni yetishtiradigan daraxt ham shu nom bilan ataladi.

ex: In old celebrations, Chinese wheels were commonly used for fire displays.
The festival featured a Chinese wheel that spun rapidly, scattering sparks.
chinese wheel.meta: Chinese wheel — aylanuvchi feyerverk turi, ehtimol, asl kelib chiqishi Xitoyga borib taqaladi. Ba’zan Ketrin g‘ildiragi deb ataluvchi feyerverk shakliga o‘xshaydi. Hozirda bu termin asosan tarixiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The chinstrap style is popular among young men.
He keeps his chinstrap neatly trimmed along his jawline.
chinstrap.meta: Chinstrap — quloqdan quloqqacha jag‘ chizig‘i bo‘ylab o‘sadigan, biroq mo‘ylov bilan ulanmaydigan soqol turi. Bu uslub “chinstrap beard” (jag‘ chiziqli soqol) deb ham ataladi.

ex: The plane circled back to the airport due to engine trouble
Let’s circle back to this topic after we’ve gathered more information.
to circle back.meta: To circle back — intransitiv fe’l; aylana bo‘ylab harakat qilib boshlang‘ich nuqtaga qaytmoq. Kengaytirilgan ma’noda esa ma’lum bir mavzuga yoki masalaga keyinroq yana qaytish, uni yana muhokama qilish.

ex: Unlike many of his contemporaries, he was a cold warrior who opposed military aggression.
The diplomat was known as a cold warrior who always sought peaceful solutions.
cold warrior.meta: Cold warrior — ochiq urush yoki qurolli to‘qnashuv tarafdori bo‘lmagan kishi. Bu ma’no hozirda eskirgan va juda kam ishlatiladi.

ex: He posted a famous copypasta to make everyone laugh.
The meme quickly became a copypasta shared across multiple forums.
copypasta.meta: internet forumlari va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda tez-tez ko‘chirilib va joylashtirib tarqatiladigan matn bo‘lagi. Odatda, bu matn hazil, internet memlari yoki faqatgina bir guruh foydalanuvchilarga tushunarli bo‘lgan ichki hazil sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: As a councilist, he rejected centralized political parties in favor of local councils.
The councilists believed that workers' councils should govern society directly.
councilist.meta: Councilist — kengash yoki kengashlar faoliyatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs; xususan, kengash kommunizmi (ishchilar kengashlari orqali boshqarishni yoqlovchi siyosiy oqim) tarafdori. Ko‘pincha dastlabki ishlatilishida shu siyosiy mazmunda uchraydi.

ex: As a councilwoman, she worked to support education reform in the city.
The councilwoman proposed a new policy to improve public transportation.
councilwoman.meta: Councilwoman — kengash, ayniqsa, shahar yoki mahalliy hokimiyat kengashining ayol a’zosi.

ex: She is now a well-counselled individual who knows how to manage stress.
The counselled employees showed noticeable improvement in their work.
counselled | counseled.meta: Counselled — biror shaxs yoki guruhga maslahat berilgan yoki maslahat olingan; hozirda, shuningdek, professional psixologik maslahat olgan shaxs yoki guruhni ham anglatadi.

ex: It is risky to proceed counselless in complex legal cases.
The defendant appeared counselless in court, having dismissed his lawyer.
counselless.meta: Counselless — huquqiy maslahat yoki yuridik vakil (advokat) yordamisiz; advokatsiz yoki huquqshunos yo‘qligida bo‘lish holati.

ex: As a counsellor, he was responsible for ensuring the safety of the campers.
The camp counsellor organized games and activities for the children.
