counsellor | counselor.meta: Counsellor (counselor) — Shimoliy Amerikada bolalar yozgi oromgohida bolalarga qaraydigan, ularni kuzatib boradigan va faoliyatlarini boshqaradigan yetakchi yoki tarbiyachi.

ex: The defendant threatened to countersue if the case continued.
After being sued for breach of contract, the company decided to countersue the plaintiff for fraud.
countersue.meta: Countersue — sud jarayonida javobgar (sudga berilgan shaxs) da’vogar (sudga bergan shaxs)ga qarshi yangi da’vo arizasi kiritishi; ya’ni, sud jarayonida qarshi da’vo ochish.

ex: His countersuit argued that he had been wrongfully accused.
The company filed a countersuit claiming the plaintiff had breached the original contract.
countersuit.meta: Countersuit — sud jarayonida javobgar (sudga berilgan shaxs) tomonidan da’vogar (sudga bergan shaxs)ga nisbatan ochilgan javob da’vo yoki qarshi da’vo.

ex: The company encourages co-working to increase collaboration between departments.
Co-working has become popular among freelancers and small businesses.
co-working.meta: Co-working — bir xil ofis yoki tashkilotda birga ishlash amaliyoti yoki holati; shuningdek, har xil tashkilotlar yoki shaxslarning umumiy ish joyidan birgalikda foydalanish amaliyoti.

ex: Many people enjoy reading creepypastas late at night for the thrill.
The creepypasta about the haunted video game quickly went viral.

Anti-professionalism behavior
anti-professionalism.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-professionalism — professionalizm (kasbiylik, ishda malaka va mehnat intizomi) ga qarshi bo‘lish yoki bunday yondashuvni tanqid qilish.

ex: He expressed antiscientism views.
Antiscientism attitudes
antiscientism.meta: so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Antiscientism — ilmiyizm yoki ilm-fanga haddan tashqari ishonch va unga bo‘lgan mutlaq e’tiqodga qarshi bo‘lish, ilm-fanning cheklovlarini ta’kidlash yoki unga nisbatan tanqidiy yondashuv.

ex: She is an active supporter of anti-sexism
Anti-sexism campaign
anti-sexism.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-sexism — jinsga qarab kamsitishga (seksizmga) qarshi bo‘lish, jinsiy tenglikni himoya qilish.

ex: He supports anti-statism ideas.
Anti-statism philosophy
anti-statism.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-statism — davlatning keng ko‘lamdagi nazoratiga yoki davlat hokimiyatining aralashuviga qarshi bo‘lish, davlatning roli va ta’sirini kamaytirishni istash.

ex: She is a prominent anti-vivisectionism activist.
Anti-vivisectionism movement
anti-vivisectionism.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-vivisectionism — tirik organizmlarda tajriba o‘tkazishga (viviseksiyaga) qarshi bo‘lish, hayvonlarni himoya qilish harakati.

ex: He is an anti-nationalization advocate.
Anti-nationalization protests
anti-nationalization.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-nationalization — mulk yoki sanoatning davlat tomonidan milliylashtirilishiga qarshi bo‘lish, xususiy mulkchilikni himoya qilish.

ex: The product is labeled as anti-allergenic.
Anti-allergenic cream
anti-allergenic.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-allergenic — allergiyaga sabab bo‘luvchi omillarga qarshi, allergiya keltirib chiqarmaydigan yoki uni kamaytiradigan.

ex: He took an antidiarrheal to stop his stomach upset.
Antidiarrheal medicine
antidiarrheal.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Antidiarrheal — diareyani (sichqonchani) kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi dori yoki vosita.

ex: Some vitamins have antimutagenic properties
Antimutagenic substances
antimutagenic.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Antimutagenic — genetik materialdagi mutatsiyalarni keltirib chiqaruvchi omillarga qarshi, mutatsiyalarni kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The government introduced anti-recessionary measures
Anti-recessionary policies
anti-recessionary.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-recessionary — iqtisodiy inqiroz yoki pasayishga qarshi choralar ko‘radigan yoki ularni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydigan

ex: Anti-reflective glasses reduce glare.
Anti-reflective coating
anti-reflective.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-reflective — yorug‘lik yoki aks sado berishni kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi xususiyat.

ex: She was prescribed anti-anxiety drugs
Anti-anxiety medication
anti-anxiety.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-anxiety — tashvish, bezovtalik yoki xavotirni kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The detergent contains anti-foaming ingredients.
Anti-foaming agent
anti-foaming.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-foaming — suyuqlikda yoki jarayonda ko‘pik hosil bo‘lishini kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The government implemented anti-locust programs.
Anti-locust measures
anti-locust.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-locust — chirindiga qarshi, chirindi zararini kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: They installed anti-mosquito nets on windows.
Anti-mosquito spray
anti-mosquito.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-mosquito — chivinlarga qarshi, ularni yo‘qotish yoki kamaytirish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: She took anti-nausea pills during the trip.
Anti-nausea medication
anti-nausea.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-nausea — ko‘ngil aynishni kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The device has an anti-radiation shield.
Anti-radiation suit
anti-radiation.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-radiation — zararli nurlanishga qarshi yoki uni kamaytiruvchi, oldini oluvchi.

ex: The glasses have an anti-reflection layer.
Anti-reflection coating
anti-reflection.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-reflection — yorug‘likning aks sado berishini kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The car is equipped with an anti-skidding system.
Anti-skidding tires
anti-skidding.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-skidding — sirpanishni oldini oluvchi yoki kamaytiruvchi, ayniqsa yo‘l harakati yoki transportda.

ex: The faucet has an anti-splash feature.
Anti-splash guard
anti-splash.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-splash — suyuqlik yoki boshqa moddalar sepilib chiqishini kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The machine is equipped with anti-vibration mounts.
Anti-vibration gloves
anti-vibration.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-vibration — tebranish (vibratsiya)ni kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: He is taking antilipoid therapy for his condition.
Antilipoid medication
antilipoid.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Antilipoid — lipoyd (yoki yog‘ moddalarga o‘xshash)ga qarshi bo‘lgan, ularni kamaytiruvchi yoki oldini oluvchi.

ex: The tank is equipped with anti-armour missiles
Anti-armour weapons
anti-armour.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-armour — zirhli harbiy texnika yoki zirhga qarshi ishlatiladigan yoki mo‘ljallangan.

ex: The navy deployed anti-ship weapons.
Anti-ship missiles
anti-ship.meta: anti- — so‘z boshida qo‘shilib, “qarshi”, “teskari” ma’nolarini bildiradi. Anti-ship — kemalarga qarshi ishlatiladigan yoki mo‘ljallangan (qurol, texnika va boshqalar).

ex: They tried to Toryize the local government’s approach.
The policy was Toryized after the party took power.
toryize.meta: Toryize — biror narsani Torylar (Buyuk Britaniyada konservativ siyosiy partiya) uslubi yoki qarashlariga moslashtirmoq, Torylarga xos siyosiy yoki ijtimoiy tamoyillarni qo‘llamoq.

ex: The government is Toryizing social programs gradually.
They are Toryizing the education policies.
toryizing.meta: Toryizing — biror narsani Torylar (Buyuk Britaniyaning konservativ partiyasi) uslubi yoki siyosiy qarashlariga moslashtirish jarayoni, Torylarga xos tamoyillarni qo‘llash.

ex: Athletes from many countries compete in the Deaflympics.
The Deaflympics are held every four years.
deaflympics.meta: Deaflympics — eshitish qobiliyati zaif yoki eshitmaydigan sportchilar uchun Olimpiya o‘yinlari modelida tashkil etilgan xalqaro sport musobaqasi. Ko‘plik shaklida “The Deaflympics” deb ishlatiladi.

ex: The loud engine deaved the speaker’s voice.
The noise of the crowd deaved the sound of the music.
deave.meta: Deave — biror tovushni boshqa, balandroq tovush bilan eshitilmas darajada yopib qo‘yish yoki bosib qo‘yish. Zamonaviy til uchun kam qo‘llaniladi, tarixiy yoki kam uchraydigan so‘z.

ex: He was decommitted from his responsibilities due to the changes.
The company decided to decommit from the project.
decommit.meta: Decommit — biror shaxs yoki guruhni ma’lum bir harakat, siyosat yoki yo‘nalishni bajarish majburiyatidan yoki mas’uliyatidan ozod qilmoq, bo‘yin tovlitmoq.

ex: The athlete announced his decommitment from the college team.
His decommitment surprised the coaches.
decommitment.meta: Decommitment — majburiyat, va’dadan yoki kelishuvdan voz kechish yoki undan chiqish holati yoki harakati. Keyinchalik, ayniqsa (AQSh sportida) bu atama o‘yinchining oldingi jamoaga bergan roziligidan qaytishi ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: De-identified individuals may experience a sense of detachment.
The patient felt de-identified from his usual environment.
de-identified.meta: De-identified — shaxs ma’lum bir vaziyat, holat yoki sharoitdan ajratilgan, shuningdek, uning shaxsiyatini shakllantiruvchi yoki ta’sir qiluvchi omillardan ajralgan holatda bo‘lgan.

ex: They de-identified the records before sharing them publicly.
The data was de-identified to protect privacy.
de-identify.meta: De-identify — biror shaxsdan uning shaxsiyatini tasdiqlovchi belgilar, hujjatlar yoki ramzlarni olib tashlash, yashirish yoki olib qo‘yish.

ex: She danced dervish-like, full of energy and passion.
He worked dervish-like to complete the task.
dervish-like.meta: Dervish-like — dervishga o‘xshab, dervish uslubida yoki dervishning shiddatli, tinimsiz harakatlarini ifodalovchi tarzda.

ex: The boss dhamkaos employees to work overtime.
He dhamkaoed his opponent to get what he wanted.
dhamkao.meta: Dhamkao — biror kishini qo‘rqitish, tahdid qilish, bosim o‘tkazish yoki zo‘rlik bilan qo‘rqitib, u ustidan hukmronlik qilish harakati.

ex: The digital age has transformed how people communicate.
We live in the digital age where information is easily accessible.
digital age.meta: Digital age — raqamli texnologiyalar, raqamli media va shu kabi ilg‘or texnologiyalarning keng rivojlanishi va keng qo‘llanilishi bilan ajralib turadigan zamonaviy davr.

ex: We need to decide the direction of travel for the new policy.
The direction of travel in the debate is towards more cooperation.
direction of travel.meta: Direction of travel — siyosat, strategiya, munozara va boshqalarning qayerga yo‘naltirilayotganligi, ya’ni maqsadga yoki natijaga intilishi.

ex: The economic and social aspects of the problem are divorceable and can be analyzed separately.
The two ideas are not divorceable; they must be considered together.
divorceable.meta: Biror narsadan ajratish mumkin bo‘lgan, alohida qilsa bo‘ladigan, ajratuvchi xususiyatga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: Ancient cultures practiced divorsion as a method of spiritual cleansing.
The priest performed a divorsion to expel the evil spirit from the man.
divorsion.meta: Inson tanasidan yovuz ruh yoki jinlarni majburan quvib chiqarish jarayoni. Bu ko‘pincha diniy yoki ruhiy marosim orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Double dummy design helps ensure that neither the patients nor the doctors know which treatment is active.
The researchers conducted a double dummy trial to compare the two asthma medications.
double dummy.meta: Tibbiyotda: ikki xil dori vositasi sinovdan o‘tkaziladigan klinik tadqiqot shakli bo‘lib, unda har bir haqiqiy dori uchun mos platsebo (befoyda, ta’sirsiz doriga o‘xshash modda) beriladi.

ex: After pulling the door that said 'push,' he laughed and blamed it on the dumbs.
I must have caught the dumbs today—I keep making silly mistakes.
the dumbs.meta: Shimoliy Amerikada so‘zlashuv uslubida: odamning vaqtinchalik ahmoqlarcha yoki tentaklarcha harakat qilishga moyil bo‘lishi. Ko‘pincha hazil yoki kinoya tarzida "ahmoqlik xuruji" yoki "aqlsiz bo‘lish holati" deb tasvirlanadi

ex: That dumb-arse forgot his own birthday.
Don’t be such a dumb-arse—you’re doing it completely wrong.
dumb-arse.meta: Juda ahmoq yoki johil, tushunishi past bo‘lgan odam. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha kamsitish yoki haqorat qilish maqsadida ishlatiladi. Ba’zan bevosita murojaat shaklida ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: In some materials, dumbbelling can occur during stress or deformation.
The dumbbelling of the molecule was observed under the microscope.
dumbbelling.meta: Ikki dumaloq yoki ovalsimon qismlarni oraliqdagi torroq qisqich (bog‘lovchi) orqali birlashtirgan shakl hosil bo‘lish jarayoni. Gantel (dumbbell) shakliga o‘xshash tuzilishga ega bo‘lish holati.

ex: The dumbek is a key instrument in Middle Eastern percussion ensembles.
He played a lively rhythm on the dumbek during the performance.
dumbek.meta: Asosan Yaqin Sharq, Shimoliy Afrika va Sharqiy Yevropa musiqa an’analarida ishlatiladigan, bir tomoni ochiq, o‘rtasi toraygan, ustki va pastki qismi kengaygan qo‘l barabani turi. Odatda oyoqlar orasida yoki qo‘ltiq ostida ushlab chalinadi.

ex: His sudden confession caused a moment of total dumbfoundering.
The dumbfoundering of the audience was clear after the shocking revelation.
dumbfoundering.meta: Odamni shunchalik hayrat, shok yoki tushunmovchilikka solish holatiki, natijada u so‘z topolmay qoladi yoki nima deyishni bilmay qoladi. Ba’zan o‘zi hayratdan lol qolgan holatni ham anglatadi.

ex: His expression was one of pure dumbfoundment.
There was a moment of complete dumbfoundment after the announcement.
dumbfoundment.meta: Kutilmagan yoki tushunib bo‘lmaydigan voqea yoki ma’lumot natijasida odamning hayratdan so‘zsiz qolish, tushunmaslik yoki shok holatiga tushish holati.

ex: They were pushing dumb hard to win the game.
He was working dumb hard to finish the project on time.
dumb hard.meta: Biror narsani nihoyatda kuch bilan, juda katta harakat yoki energiya sarflab bajarish holati. Ko‘pincha so‘zlashuv tilida kuchaytirish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: I can’t believe you made that dumbhead mistake again!
That was such a dumbhead idea—you didn’t think it through.
dumbhead.meta: Odamga nisbatan: ahmoq, tentak yoki bilimsiz bo‘lish holatini ifodalovchi sifat. Umumiy ma’noda esa: asabiylashtiruvchi, foydasiz yoki bemani bo‘lish xususiyatini bildiradi.

ex: They cut the dumble to make baskets and mats.
The riverbank was thick with dumbles and reeds.
dumble.meta: Nam joylarda o‘sadigan, uzun, ingichka va ko‘pincha ichi bo‘sh poyaga ega bo‘lgan o‘simlik turi. Odatda qamish yoki shunga o‘xshash suv bo‘yidagi o‘t-o‘lanlar nazarda tutiladi.

ex: He’s a bit of a dumbledore when it comes to work.
Don’t be such a dumbledore—get up and help us!
dumbledore.meta: Ahmoq yoki dangasa odam. Ko‘pincha biroz hazil yoki yengil kamsitish ohangida ishlatiladi. Bu odam aqlan sust yoki harakatga noloyiq deb tasvirlanadi.

ex: He switched from a smartphone to a dumb phone to avoid distractions.
I prefer using a dumb phone because it’s simple and has a long battery life.
dumb phone.meta: Zamonaviy aqlli funksiyalarga ega bo‘lmagan telefon turi. Odatda faqat qo‘ng‘iroq qilish va SMS yuborish kabi asosiy vazifalarni bajaradi. Internet, sensor ekran, mobil ilovalar kabi funksiyalar bo‘lmaydi.

ex: She was too dum-cowed to protest the unfair treatment.
The workers looked dum-cowed after the manager's harsh speech.
dum-cowed.meta: Qo‘rqitish, tahdid yoki kuchli bosim natijasida qo‘rqib qolgan, o‘z fikrini aytolmaydigan yoki o‘zini ojiz his qiladigan holat. Odatda ruhiy yoki ijtimoiy bosim sabab yuzaga keladi.

ex: They tried to dummify the population by spreading false information.
The constant exposure to low-quality media can dummify the audience.
dummify.meta: Biror odam yoki narsani aqlan sustlashtirish, ahmoq yoki kam idrokli holga keltirish. Ko‘pincha ongli ravishda yoki ma’lum jarayon natijasida inson yoki narsani tushunish, tafakkur qilish qobiliyatidan mahrum qilish.

ex: Dummying is an essential skill in rugby to bypass aggressive defenders.
His quick dummying tricked the defender and opened up a path to score.
dummying.meta: Sportda (asosan regbi va boshqa o‘yinlarda) raqibni chalg‘itish maqsadida soxta pas, zarba yoki harakat qiladigan usul. Bu harakat raqibni aldash va noto‘g‘ri yo‘nalishga tortish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Proper EQ can make a huge difference in the clarity of music.
The sound engineer adjusted the EQ to enhance the bass.
eq.meta: Tovush moslamalarida (masalan, musiqa apparatida yoki dasturiy ta’minotda) tovush chastotalarining darajalarini sozlash va muvozanatlash jarayoni.

ex: A good teacher should be equal-handed when dealing with students.
The judge was respected for her equal-handed decisions.
equal-handed.meta: Biror kishiga yoki guruhga nisbatan tarafkashliksiz, adolatli va xolis munosabatda bo‘lish holati. Barcha tomonlarga bir xil yondashadigan, hech kimni kamsitmaydigan yoki afzal ko‘rmaydigan shaxs yoki harakat.

ex: Equalists rejected the mensuralist view of varying note lengths in chant.
The equalist insisted that plainsong should be sung with all notes of equal length.
equalist.meta: Plainsong asarlarini barcha notalarni bir xil davomiylikda, ya’ni bir xil ritm bilan ijro etish tarafdori bo‘lgan musiqachi yoki nazariyotchi. Mensuralistga (ya’ni o‘lchangan, o‘zgaruvchan ritm tarafdoriga) zid qarash.

ex: Tax equalization policies aim to balance the financial burden among regions.
The equalization of pressure in the system is crucial for safety.
equalization.meta: Harakat, jarayon, xossa yoki holatni bir xil holga keltirish, tenglashtirish yoki muvozanatga solish jarayoni. Odatda aniq bir soha yoki obyektga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: No one has been his equaler in chess for years.
She became the equaller of the world record in the 100-meter race.
equaller | equaler.meta: Boshqa bir shaxs yoki narsaga natija, daraja, yutuq yoki maqom jihatidan teng bo‘lgan yoki unga erishgan kishi yoki narsa. Boshqacha aytganda, biror rekord, ko‘rsatkich yoki muvaffaqiyatga tenglashgan shaxs.

ex: Establishmentarianism can prevent social change by defending traditional power.
The journalist was criticized for his strong establishmentarianism.
establishmentarianism.meta: Jamiyatdagi mavjud tuzum, hokimiyat yoki rasmiy institutlarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash yoki ularning tarafida bo‘lish g‘oyasi. Bu tushuncha mavjud siyosiy yoki ijtimoiy tartibotdan norozi bo‘lmagan va uni himoya qiladigan yondashuvni bildiradi.

ex: Establishmentism often resists radical social changes.
The politician’s establishmentism made him unpopular among reformers.
establishmentism.meta: Jamiyatdagi mavjud hokimiyat, siyosiy tizim yoki rasmiy institutlarni qo‘llab-quvvatlash yoki ularning tarafida bo‘lish holati. Bu qarash odatda amaldagi tartibotga bog‘liqlik va uni himoya qilish bilan ifodalanadi.

ex: He was accused of fakirism after selling fake tickets.
The old slang ‘fakirism’ was used to describe acts of fraud and trickery.
fakirism.meta: AQShning eskirgan og‘zaki nutqida firibgarlik, aldov yoki odamlarni chuv tushirish amaliyotini anglatadi. Bu tushuncha ilgari firibgar yoki aldovchi shaxs sifatida ishlatilgan 'fakir' atamasi bilan bog‘liq. Hozirda bu ma’no ishlatilmaydi.

ex: The Glamorgan sausage is made with cheese, breadcrumbs, and leeks instead of meat.
Glamorgan sausage is a popular vegetarian dish in Wales.
glamorgan sausage.meta: Uelsning Glamorgan hududiga xos bo‘lgan, odatda non bo‘lagi, piyozi yoki ko‘k piyoz va Caerphilly yoki Cheddar pishloqidan tayyorlanadigan kolbasa shaklidagi taom. Bu kolbasa go‘shtsiz bo‘lib, vegetarianlarga mos hisoblanadi.

ex: Hearing loss can result from prolonged exposure to loud noise.
The patient is experiencing hearing loss in his right ear.
hearing loss.meta: Odamning tug‘ma, yoshga bog‘liq, jarohat, kasallik yoki boshqa tibbiy sabablar tufayli eshitish qobiliyatini to‘liq yoki qisman yo‘qotishi holati. Bu holat eshitishning zaiflashishi yoki butunlay eshitmaslik shaklida bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: She sat on the high settle, resting against the wooden panels.
The old tavern had a high settle near the fireplace.
high settle.meta: Yog‘ochdan yasalgan, uzun va baland orqa suyanchiqli o‘rindiq turi. Odatda orqa qismi panel shaklida bezatilgan bo‘ladi va ba’zan pastki qismida saqlash uchun qutilar bo‘ladi. Tarixiy yoki an’anaviy uy jihozlarida uchraydi

ex: ‘Cummerbund’ is a Hobson-Jobson derived from the Persian ‘kamarband’.
The English word ‘bungalow’ is a Hobson-Jobson from the Hindi ‘bangla’.
hobson-jobson.meta: Bir tildan boshqa tilga o‘tgan va yangi tilning talaffuz qoidalariga yoki fonetik tizimiga moslashtirilgan o‘zlashma so‘z. Bunday so‘zlar asl shaklidan fonetik va ba’zan morfologik jihatdan farq qilishi mumkin.

ex: They spent two weeks holidaying on the coast.
Holidaying in the mountains is very popular in the summer.
holidaying.meta: Ish, o‘qish yoki kundalik majburiyatlardan bo‘shab, vaqtni dam olish, hordiq chiqarish yoki sayohat qilishga bag‘ishlash jarayoni. Bu holat odatda ta’til yoki rasmiy dam olish kunlarida amalga oshiriladi.

ex: He stormed into the meeting like a howling dervish, shouting and waving his arms.
The children were running around like howling dervishes.
howling dervish.meta: Majoziy va taqqoslash ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Juda shovqinli, vahimali, tinimsiz harakat qiladigan yoki nazorat qilib bo‘lmaydigan odam yoki narsani ifodalash uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The government’s illegalization of the practice led to public protests.
The illegalization of certain drugs has been widely debated.
illegalization.meta: Qonuniy jihatdan biror narsani noqonuniy deb e’lon qilish yoki uni taqiqlash jarayoni. Bu harakat natijasida ilgari qonuniy bo‘lgan narsa noqonuniy maqomga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: In the past, people used the term ‘illegit’ to describe children born outside marriage.
They were selling illegit copies of the movie.
illegit.meta: Huquqiy yoki ijtimoiy me’yorlarga zid bo‘lgan, noqonuniy yoki ruxsatsiz holat. Dastlab, bu so‘z asosan nikohsiz ota-onadan tug‘ilgan bolani ifodalash uchun ishlatilgan.

ex: Amla, or Indian gooseberry, is widely used in traditional Indian medicine.
Indian gooseberry is rich in vitamin C and antioxidants.
indian gooseberry.meta: Phyllanthus turkumiga mansub o‘simliklarning mevasi, xususan Phyllanthus emblica (amla) daraxtining mevasi. Bu meva tarkibida juda ko‘p miqdorda vitamin C mavjud bo‘lib, hind tabobatida keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The new in-ear is comfortable and delivers high-quality sound.
I prefer in-ears because they block outside noise better.
in-ear.meta: Quloq kanalining ochilish qismiga joylashtiriladigan, odatda musiqa tinglash, ovoz eshitish yoki eshitish qobiliyatini yaxshilash uchun mo‘ljallangan kichik qurilma. Bunga quloq ichiga kiritiladigan quloqchinlar yoki eshitish moslamalari kiradi.

ex: Inequal treatment of employees led to dissatisfaction.
The decision was deemed inequal and unfair by many
inequal.meta: Adolatli yoki haqqoniy bo‘lmagan, nohaq holat yoki munosabatni ifodalovchi so‘z. Hozirgi kunda bu ma’no kamroq ishlatiladi va eskirgan hisoblanadi.

ex: Her name was inked in the attendance register.
The contract was inked last week.
inked.meta: Siyoh yordamida yozilgan yoki chizilgan. Siyoh bilan aniq yoki doimiy tarzda belgilangan narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: The company hired legal counsel to handle the lawsuit.
She sought legal counsel before signing the contract.
legal counsel.meta: Huquqiy masalalar bo‘yicha maslahat berish va himoya qilish; shuningdek, yuridik masalalarda maslahat beruvchi yoki shaxs yoki tashkilot nomidan qonuniy ishlarni yurituvchi advokat yoki advokatlar guruhi.

ex: Assistant referees, also called linos, play a crucial role in football matches.
The lino raised the flag to signal offside.
lino.meta: Sport o‘yinlarida, xususan futbol yoki tennisda, hakamga maydon chetidan yordam beruvchi rasmiy shaxs. U chiziq bo‘yicha qarorlar qabul qilishda yordam beradi va hakamning qarorlarini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

ex: Today, the word ‘madge’ is considered outdated and offensive.
The term ‘madge’ was used in old slang to refer to certain women.
madge.meta: Slangda ishlatilgan so‘z, hozir eskirgan. Ayolni ifodalaydi, ayniqsa jinsiy tajribaga ega yoki potentsial jinsiy sherik sifatida ko‘rilgan ayol. Ba’zida fohisha ma’nosida ishlatilgan bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Using such terms perpetuates negative stereotypes about sexuality.
‘Madge cull’ is an offensive slang term used to insult certain men.
madge cull.meta: Kamsituvchi so‘z, erkakni ayol yoki qizlarga xos deb hisoblangan xulq-atvor bilan ta’riflaydi. Ayniqsa, erkaklar bilan jinsiy aloqada bo‘ladigan erkakni ifodalaydi.

ex: The Monday hammer is used for heavy-duty demolition work.
He lifted the Monday hammer to break the concrete slab.
monday hammer.meta: Katta va og‘ir qo‘l bolg‘asi, ko‘pincha katta yuk ko‘tarish yoki zarba berish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Monobob sleds are designed for individual use in downhill racing.
The athlete competed in the monobob event at the Winter Olympics.
monobob.meta: Bitta sportchi uchun mo‘ljallangan sledi, u ikki juft raner (tayaqlar), bitta o‘rindiq, boshqaruv mexanizmi va tormoz bilan jihozlangan. Bu sledi asosan pastga qarab tezlikda yugurish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: While not essential, air conditioning is definitely a nice-to-have in this region.
A backup battery is a nice-to-have feature for a smartphone.
nice-to-have.meta: Majburiy emas, lekin mavjudligi yaxshi bo‘lgan yoki qo‘shimcha foyda keltiradigan narsa. Muhim emas, ammo mavjud bo‘lsa qulaylik yoki qo‘shimcha qiymat beradi.

ex: Nose beer is a dangerous drug with serious health risks.
He was caught with nose beer at the party.
nose beer.meta: Burun orqali tortiladigan narkotik vosita, ayniqsa kokain. Ushbu so‘z ko‘pincha slengda ishlatiladi va giyohvandlikka oid atama sifatida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: It’s coffee o’clock, time for a break.
We’ll start the meeting at fun o’clock!
o’clock.meta: Odatda hazilomuz va og‘zaki nutqda ishlatiladi, biror voqea, faoliyat yoki hodisaning qaysi vaqtda sodir bo‘lishini bildiradi. Odatda soatni ko‘rsatishda qo‘shimcha so‘z bilan ishlatiladi.

ex: Efficient onload procedures are crucial at busy airports.
The onload of cargo onto the ship took several hours.
onload.meta: Havo kemasi, kema yoki boshqa transport vositasiga yuk, odamlar va boshqalarni yuklash harakati yoki jarayoni. Ilk qo‘llanishda bu so‘z sifat sifatida ham ishlatilgan.

ex: The onloading of cargo onto the plane took several hours.
Onloading of passengers was delayed due to bad weather.
onloading.meta: Havo kemasi, kema yoki boshqa transport vositasiga yuk, odamlar va boshqa narsalarni yuklash jarayoni yoki harakati.

ex: An outside straight gives more chances than an inside straight.
He had an outside straight draw, needing either a 4 or a 9 to complete the straight.
outside straight.meta: Pokerda, ketma-ket to‘rt kartadan iborat bo‘lib, ketma-ketlikning tashqi tomonlaridan biridagi bo‘shliq to‘ldirilsa, beshinchi karta bilan to‘g‘ri chiziq hosil qiladigan kombinatsiya.

ex: They played padel doubles at the new sports club.
Padel is gaining popularity as a fun and social racket sport.
padel.meta: Squash va tennis elementlarini o‘zida mujassam etgan sport turi, odatda ikki kishilik jamoalarda o‘ynaladi. O‘yinchilar raketkalar o‘rniga maxsus padellar bilan to‘pni tor qoplangan maydon ichidagi tarmoqdan o‘tkazadilar.

ex: We keep the penalty box on the table during meetings to discourage interruptions.
Every time someone uses bad language, they must put money in the penalty box.
penalty box.meta: Kimdir noto‘g‘ri ish qilganida yoki kelishilgan qoidani buzganida, har safar jarima sifatida pul qo‘yilishi kerak bo‘lgan idish yoki quti.

ex: A pick-six is one of the most exciting plays in American Football.
He scored a pick-six, turning the game in his team’s favor.
pick-six.meta: Amerika futbolida, himoyachi tomonidan to‘pni ushlab olish (intersept) va shu o‘yin davomida to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri touchdown (ochko olish) amalga oshirilishi holati.

ex: Punching down is seen as unfair and mean-spirited behavior.
He tends to punch down by mocking those who struggle the most.
to punch down.meta: O‘zidan kuchsizroq yoki kam imkoniyatlarga ega odamlarga nisbatan masxara qilish, tanqid qilish yoki ularga qarshi adolatsiz harakat qilish.

ex: The central bank started quantitative tightening after years of quantitative easing.
Quantitative tightening is used to control inflation by reducing money supply.
quantitative tightening.meta: Markaziy bankning o‘z balansidagi qimmatli qog‘ozlarni sotish yoki ularning muddati tugashiga yo‘l qo‘yib, ularni qayta investitsiya qilmaslik orqali balans hajmini kamaytirish orqali pul massasini qisqartirish siyosati.

ex: Experienced sandbaggers know how to build strong flood barriers quickly.
The sandbaggers worked all night to protect the town from the rising river.
sandbagger.meta: Qum qoplarini ko‘taradigan, ularni tartibga soladigan yoki joylashtiradigan shaxs; ayniqsa, suv toshqinlaridan himoyalanish uchun qum qoplari yordamida himoya devorlari quradigan kishi.

ex: The army used traditional sandbagging for flood defense.
In the past, sandbagging was made from coarse hessian or burlap fabric.
sandbagging.meta: Avvallari qum qoplarini tayyorlashda ishlatilgan hessian, burlap yoki qo‘pol qop matosi turi. Bu ma'no hozir eskirgan hisoblanadi.

ex: Medieval maps often marked the Saracenesse as distant and exotic lands.
The knights marched into the Saracenesse in search of conquest.
saracenesse.meta: Saratsenlar (o‘rta asr Yevropasida musulmon xalqlarga, ayniqsa arablarga nisbatan ishlatilgan atama) yashagan yoki boshqargan yer yoki hudud. Bu so‘z tarixiy hisoblanadi.

ex: In medieval texts, Saracenians were often depicted as powerful warriors.
The knights encountered many Saracenians during their crusades.
saracenian.meta: Saratsen — O‘rta asr Yevropa manbalarida musulmon xalqlar, ayniqsa arablar uchun ishlatilgan tarixiy va hozir eskirgan atama. Saracenian so‘zi shu ma’nodagi qadimgi shakldir.

ex: A save-the-date email helps guests plan their schedules.
We sent out save-the-date cards six months before our wedding.
save-the-date.meta: Tadbir (odatda to‘y yoki muhim yig‘ilish) bo‘lishi rejalashtirilayotgan sanani oldindan mehmonlarga bildirish uchun yuboriladigan kartochka yoki bildirishnoma shakli.

ex: Vaccine sceptics often doubt the safety of vaccinations.
He is a climate sceptic who questions global warming data.
sceptic | skeptic.meta: Muayyan sohada, umumiy qabul qilingan tushunchalar, dalillar yoki e'tiqodlarning to‘g‘riligiga shubha bilan qaraydigan kishi. Bu atama odatda biror masalaga nisbatan ishonmaslikni ifodalash uchun boshqa so‘zlar bilan birga ishlatiladi.

ex: We went to the beach during the scorchio weather.
It’s scorchio today—don’t forget your sunscreen!
scorchio.meta: Juda issiq va quyoshli ob-havo holatini ifodalovchi og‘zaki so‘z. Ba’zan umumiy ma’noda ham haddan tashqari issiqlikni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The company settled him down in an apartment near the office.
They settled the new family down in a quiet village.
to settle down.meta: Biror shaxsni bir joyda yashashga, doimiy yoki uzoq muddatli yashash uchun o‘rnashishga sabab bo‘lish yoki shunday imkon yaratish.

ex: She settled up her debts before moving to another city.
I need to settle up the bill before we leave the restaurant.
to settle up.meta: Hisob, qarz yoki to‘lovlarni to‘liq to‘lash yoki barcha moliyaviy majburiyatlarni bajarish. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha xizmat yoki mahsulot narxini so‘nggi marta hisoblash va to‘lash ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: He is proud to be a Sharifian, descended from the royal family.
The Sharifians played an important role in Morocco's history.
sharifian.meta: Marokash sharifining tarafdori yoki Marokashdagi Sharifiylar sulolasining a’zosi. Bu so‘z Marokash monarxiyasi va tarixida muhim o‘rin tutuvchi shaxslarni yoki ularning tarafdorlarini ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Can you help me shift the boxes round?
He shifted the chairs round to make more space.
to shift round.meta: Biror narsani bir joydan olib, boshqa joyga ko‘chirish yoki atrofidagi boshqa narsalarga nisbatan holatini o‘zgartirish. Ba’zan fikr, rejalar yoki tizimlarda o‘zgarish qilish ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Many modern vehicles come with shiftable transmissions for sportier driving.
The car has a shiftable automatic transmission for better control.
shiftable.meta: Avtomobilning avtomatik uzatma tizimi: haydovchi uzatmalarni avtomatik rejimdan mustaqil ravishda qo‘lda boshqarish imkoniga ega bo‘ladigan tizim.

ex: His shiftful moods made him difficult to understand.
The shiftful sands of the desert changed shape with every breeze.
shiftful.meta: Tez-tez harakat qiluvchi, joylashuvi yoki holati o‘zgaradigan; doimo o‘zgarishda yoki harakatda bo‘lishga moyil. Adabiy matnlarda ko‘proq uchraydi.

ex: His opinions were shiftingly expressed during the debate.
The clouds moved shiftingly across the sky.
shiftingly.meta: Harakat yoki o‘zgarish bilan belgilangan tarzda; o‘zgarib yoki doimiy harakatda bo‘lib amalga oshiriladigan harakat shakli.

ex: The slanginess of his manner suggested a life of crime.
His slanginess made people suspicious of him.
slanginess.meta: Jinoyatchi yoki o‘g‘riga xos bo‘lgan tashqi ko‘rinish yoki xatti-harakat sifati. Bu ma’no zamonaviy ingliz tilida eskirgan va hozirda ishlatilmaydi.

ex: Many slanguists track how slang changes across generations.
He is a natural slanguist, always coming up with new street terms.
slanguist.meta: Avvalgi ma’noda: Slang so‘z yoki iboralarni tez-tez ishlatadigan yoki ularni yangidan ixtiro qiladigan kishi. Keyingi ma’noda: Slang so‘zlarning ishlatilishi va tarixiy rivojlanishini o‘rganuvchi tadqiqotchi.

ex: The player in the small blind position has to bet first.
He placed the small blind before the hand started.
small blind.meta: Ba’zi poker turlarida: kartalar tarqatilishidan oldin qo‘yilishi shart bo‘lgan ikki majburiy tikishdan kichigi. Odatda bu tikish dilerdan chapda o‘tirgan o‘yinchi tomonidan amalga oshiriladi.

ex: Many actors complain about stalkerazzi invading their private lives.
The celebrity was harassed by a group of stalkerazzi outside the hotel.
stalkerazzo.meta: Mashhurlarni suratga olish maqsadida ularni tajovuzkor tarzda va haddan tashqari ta’qib qiladigan mustaqil fotograf. Bu so‘z odatda salbiy (kamsituvchi) ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: I didn’t mean to sound stalkery, but I saw your schedule online.
His constant texting was starting to feel a bit stalkery.
stalkery.meta: Stalkerni eslatuvchi yoki unga o‘xshash xatti-harakatga ega bo‘lgan; obsesif, noo‘rin yoki yoqimsiz tarzda birovga qiziqish bildiradigan. Odatda salbiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The stalking predator moved carefully through the bushes.
The stalking tiger silently approached its prey.
stalking.meta: O‘ljasini, odamni yoki boshqa nishonni yashirincha yoki qat’iyat bilan izlab, uni jimjitlik bilan ta’qib qiladigan yoki ovlaydigan.

ex: She said his messages were getting stalky and made her uncomfortable.
His constant staring felt a little stalky.
stalky.meta: Birovga obsesif, noo‘rin yoki yoqimsiz tarzda qiziqish ko‘rsatadigan yoki shunday harakat qiladigan. Odatda salbiy va bezovta qiluvchi ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: She lives with her mother and stepdad.
My stepdad has always treated me like his own child.
stepdad.meta: Onaning eridan bo‘lsa-da, biologik ota bo‘lmagan shaxs. Onaning keyingi yoki boshqa eriga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Being a good stepdad means building trust with your stepkids.
I have two stepkids from my wife’s previous marriage.
stepkid.meta: Biror kishining turmush o‘rtog‘ining avvalgi munosabatidan bo‘lgan, lekin biologik farzandi bo‘lmagan bola.

ex: She moved in with her dad and stepmom after the divorce.
My stepmom is very kind and supportive.
stepmom.meta: Otaning rafiqasi bo‘lsa-da, biologik ona bo‘lmagan ayol. Ota boshqa ayolga uylanganda u farzandlari uchun ogay ona bo‘ladi.

ex: After my father remarried, I lived with my stepmum and half-brothers.
My stepmum is very understanding and kind.
stepmum.meta: Otaning hozirgi rafiqasi, lekin biologik ona bo‘lmagan ayol. Ota boshqa ayolga uylanganda u bolalar uchun ogay ona hisoblanadi.

ex: She lives with her mother, stepfather, and step-siblings.
I have two step-siblings from my stepdad’s previous marriage.
step-sibling.meta: O‘gay ota yoki o‘gay onaning oldingi nikohidan yoki munosabatidan bo‘lgan farzand. Odatda ogay aka yoki ogay opa deb ataladi. Ba’zan bu so‘z yarim aka-uka yoki yarim opa-singil (yarim ona yoki yarim otadan) ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Many people wear green during the St Patrick’s Day parade.
The city hosts a large St Patrick’s Day parade every year.
st patrick’s day parade.meta: Avliyo Patrik sharafiga o‘tkaziladigan parad yoki bayram yurishi. Odatda Irlandiya va boshqa mamlakatlarda 17-mart kuni bo‘lib o‘tadi. Bu yurishlarda musiqa, raqs va irland madaniyati namoyishlari bo‘ladi.

ex: She didn’t want to come at first, but we talked her around.
I finally talked him around to accepting the job offer.
to talk around.meta: Biror kishini muayyan fikrga yoki harakatga gap bilan ko‘ndirish, uni ishontirish yoki rozi qilish. Odatda ehtiyotkor va muloyim tarzda fikrni o‘zgartirish maqsadida olib boriladi.

ex: She talks away whenever she gets excited.
They were talking away all evening at the café.
to talk away.meta: To‘xtovsiz yoki erkin ravishda gaplashish; bemalol, ochiq va cheklanmagan tarzda fikr bildirish yoki suhbatni davom ettirish. Odatda qulay, yaqin yoki jonli suhbat holatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The pilot talked back to the control tower.
You can talk back to the security guard through the intercom.
to talk back.meta: Ikki tomonlama aloqa tizimi orqali javob qaytarish yoki suhbatlashish. Odatda radioaloqa, interkom, yoki boshqa ikki tomonlama aloqa vositalarida ishlatiladi.

ex: She was standing on the ledge, but the police managed to talk her down.
The firefighters talked him down from the rooftop.
to talk down.meta: Yuqori yoki xavfli joyda turgan kishini muloyim gaplar bilan, murosali suhbat orqali pastga tushishga ko‘ndirish. Odatda shoshilinch yoki xavfli holatlarda ishlatiladi, masalan, odam baland joyda turib qo‘rqib qolgan yoki tushishni istamayotgan bo‘lsa.

ex: The villagers talked out about the problems they faced.
He was not afraid to talk out when he saw injustice.
to talk out.meta: Ochiq va erkin ravishda, ba’zan baland ovozda fikr bildirish yoki so‘zlash. Odatda hech narsani yashirmasdan, erkin gapirish holatini ifodalaydi. Hozirgi kunda bu ma’no kam ishlatiladi.

ex: They talked through the proposal carefully and agreed on the changes.
We need to talk this through before we make a final decision.
to talk through.meta: Biror masalani yoki vaziyatni barcha jihatlari bilan batafsil muhokama qilish. Odatda qaror, kelishuv yoki yakuniy xulosaga kelish uchun olib boriladigan suhbat.

ex: The company talked up its new product to attract investors.
The government tried to talk up the national currency to stabilize the market.
to talk up.meta: Biror tovar, valyuta yoki aktivning narxi yoki qiymatini jamoat oldida maqsadli bayonotlar yoki gaplar orqali oshirishga urinish. Odatda iqtisodiy yoki moliyaviy strategiya sifatida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: They are always talking about politics.
We talked about the new project yesterday.
to talk about ——.meta: Biror shaxs, narsa yoki mavzu haqida gapirish, so‘z yuritish yoki muhokama qilish. Oddiy kundalik suhbatlarda ham, rasmiy yig‘ilishlarda ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Talking about the weather, it’s been very cold lately.
Talking about sports, did you see the game last night?
talking about ——.meta: Biror mavzu yoki masala haqida gapirganda; shu mavzuga oid ravishda. Shuningdek, ba’zida hazil yoki kinoya bilan, avvalgi suhbat mavzusidan biroz boshqa yoki bog‘liq bo‘lmagan mavzuni kirgizish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Politicians often talk around sensitive topics to avoid controversy.
He tends to talk around the issue instead of giving a clear answer.
to talk around ——.meta: Biror nozik, murakkab yoki bahsli mavzuni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytmaslik, balki uni aylantirib, bilvosita yoki noaniq tarzda gapirish. Mavzudan qochish yoki uni aniq ochib bermaslik ma’nosida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Sometimes teachers talk at students instead of having a conversation.
He just talked at me the whole time without listening.
to talk at ——.meta: Kimnidir javoblarini inobatga olmasdan, unga e’tibor bermasdan, u bilan munosabatda bo‘lmay, faqat o‘z fikrini bildirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ya’ni, muloqot emas, balki bir tomonlama nutq.

ex: She likes to talk on books and authors.
They talked on politics for hours.
to talk on ——.meta: Biror mavzu, predmet yoki masala haqida so‘zlash, gapirish, fikr almashish ma’nosini anglatadi.

ex: During the debate, both sides talked past one another.
They kept talking past each other without really listening.
to talk past ——.meta: Kimningdir fikrini yoki javobini eshitmasdan, unga amal qilmasdan, masalani tushunmasdan yoki unga javob bermasdan gapirish. Bu — muloqot emas, balki bir-birining gapini tushunmaslik yoki e’tiborsizlik ko‘rinishidir.

ex: Politicians often talk round controversial topics to avoid offending anyone.
Instead of answering the question, he talked round the issue.
to talk round ——.meta: Biror nozik, murakkab yoki bahsli mavzu haqida bevosita gapirishdan qochib, mavzuni aylanib, ayyorona yoki bilvosita tarzda muhokama qilish. To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri aytmaslik yoki noaniq ifodalash usuli.

ex: He was talking to himself while working on the project.
Sometimes, when I’m alone, I talk to myself to organize my thoughts.
to talk to oneself.meta: O‘zining fikr yoki so‘zlarini o‘ziga aytish, go‘yo boshqa bir kishi bilan suhbatlashayotgandek o‘z-o‘ziga gapirish holati.

ex: Her talkability made her a great team leader.
The talkability of the topic made the meeting productive.
talkability.meta: Biror mavzu yoki masala haqida ochiqchasiga, erkin muhokama qilish mumkinligi, muhokama qilishga yaroqlilik. Ba’zan shaxs uchun ishlatiladi — gaplashish osonligi, samimiylik, do‘stona munosabatda bo‘lish xususiyati.

ex: Being a talkaholic can sometimes annoy people around you.
He’s such a talkaholic that he hardly lets anyone else speak.
talkaholic.meta: Gapirishga qaram bo‘lgan, juda ko‘p va ortiqcha gapiradigan, suhbatni to‘xtata olmas odam.

ex: After the argument, she used a gentle talkdown to ease his anger.
The negotiator’s talkdown helped calm the distressed person.
talkdown.meta: Kimnidir kuchli, qo‘rqinchli yoki hayajonli ruhiy holatdan so‘zlab, muloyim gaplar bilan tinchlantirish yoki tushunishga harakat qilish jarayoni.

ex: In old texts, the talkful were described as restless chatterers.
The talkful often dominate conversations in the room.
talkful.meta: Ko‘p gapiradigan, doim gaplashib turadigan odamlar guruhi. Bu so‘z hozirda kam ishlatiladi yoki eskirgan hisoblanadi.

ex: In ancient communities, talking circles were used to resolve conflicts and strengthen bonds.
They gathered in a talking circle to share stories and experiences.
talking circle.meta: Suhbat doirasi — suhbatlashish yoki muloqot qilish maqsadida tashkil etilgan ijtimoiy yig‘ilish. Bu atama hozir eskirgan hisoblanadi.

ex: In the circle, only the person with the talking stick was allowed to speak.
The elder held the talking stick and began to address the group.
talking stick.meta: So‘zlash tayoqchasi — Shimoliy Amerikaning ayrim mahalliy xalqlari tomonidan ishlatiladigan o‘yilgan yog‘och tayoq. Ushbu tayoqni ushlab turgan shaxs jamoat oldida so‘zlash yoki fikr bildirish huquqiga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: Each talk line in the musical was carefully written to match the rhythm of the song.
The actor forgot his talk line during the final scene.
talk line.meta: Dialog satri — teatr asari, musiqiy chiqish yoki qo‘shiqda aytiladigan gap yoki jumla. Bu atama juda kam ishlatiladi.

ex: Frequent talk-outs made it difficult for the lesson to continue smoothly.
The teacher warned the class that another talk-out would result in detention.
talk-out.meta: Darsni gap bilan buzish — asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan atama; ta'lim jarayonida o‘quvchining baland ovozda yoki navbatini kutmasdan gapirib, darsni buzishi holati.

ex: After a long talkover, they finally reached an agreement.
Let’s have a quick talkover before we make a final decision.
talkover.meta: Muhokama, gaplashib olish — norasmiy tilda: biror narsani muhokama qilish yoki gaplashib olish jarayoni. Qarang: to talk over (muhokama qilmoq).

ex: The elders loved to talk story and pass down their wisdom to the younger generation.
During family gatherings, they would often talk story late into the night.
talk story.meta: Hikoya aytish yoki suhbatlashish — voqealar, xotiralar yoki bilimlarni bo‘lishish amaliyoti yoki faoliyati; shuningdek, bu maqsadda o‘tkaziladigan uchrashuv. Ba’zan shunchaki suhbat yoki muloqot ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: A talk-through amplifier ensures that signals can be retransmitted without loss.
The system uses a talk-through device to maintain clear voice communication.
talk-through.meta: Ovoz uzatuvchi (qayta uzatuvchi) qurilma — telekommunikatsiya sohasida: ovoz signallarini qabul qiluvchi va ularni qayta uzatuvchi elektron qurilma. Qarang: repeating coil (qayta uzatish induksion qurilmasi).

ex: Early detection of toxaemia can help prevent serious complications for both mother and child
The patient showed severe symptoms of toxaemia during the late stages of pregnancy.
toxaemia | toxemia.meta: homiladorlik davrida yuzaga keladigan kasallik holati; bu moddalar almashinuvi buzilishi bilan tavsiflanadi. Odatda, qondagi glyukoza miqdorining pasayishi, ketoatsidoz va ensefalopatiya (miya faoliyatining buzilishi) kabi alomatlar bilan kechadi.

ex: They argued toxically, damaging their friendship beyond repair.
He toxically manipulated his colleagues to maintain control.
toxically.meta: Zararli tarzda, zaharli tarzda (ko‘chma ma’noda) — insonning ruhiy yoki hissiy holatiga yoki bir guruh ichidagi ijtimoiy munosabatlarga salbiy, buzg‘unchi yoki vayron qiluvchi tarzda ta’sir ko‘rsatish uslubida.

ex: The party quickly turned chaotic due to widespread toxification.
His toxification was obvious after just a few drinks.
toxification.meta: Mastlik, zaharlanish (norasmiy) — norasmiy tilda: spirtli ichimlik yoki boshqa moddalar ta’sirida hushyorlikni yo‘qotish holati; mast bo‘lish yoki zaharlanib qolish holati. Qarang: toxify (zaharlamoq), toxified (zaharlangan).

ex: They found him toxified and unable to speak clearly.
He stumbled out of the bar completely toxified.
toxified.meta: Mast, zaharlangan (norasmiy) — shaxsga nisbatan: spirtli ichimlik yoki boshqa mast qiluvchi moddalardan ta’sirlangan, mast bo‘lgan. Bu atama hozir kam ishlatiladi.

ex: In the old taverns, sailors would quickly toxify after a long voyage.
He would easily toxify after just a few drinks.
toxify.meta: Mast bo‘lmoq, zaharlanmoq — spirtli ichimlik yoki boshqa mast qiluvchi moddalardan ta’sirlanib mast holatga tushmoq. Bu ma’noda atama hozir eskirgan.

ex: In traditional hunts, a trigger law was respected to ensure sportsmanship.
The hunter observed the trigger law and gave the deer a fair chance to escape.
trigger law.meta: Oldindan imkon berish — Britaniyada ishlatilgan, hozir eskirgan va kam qo‘llaniladigan atama; otishdan oldin hayvonga ma’lum vaqt yoki masofa berish amaliyoti. Bu ovchilik qoidalarida qo‘llanilgan.

ex: The tweeded fabric made the coat durable and perfect for outdoor wear.
He wore a tweeded jacket with a classic speckled pattern.
tweeded.meta: Tvitga o‘xshash, tvit matoli — matoga nisbatan: tuzilishi qo‘pol va bardoshli bo‘lishi yoki mayda nuqtali, dog‘li ko‘rinishga ega bo‘lishi bilan tvit matoni eslatuvchi. Shuningdek, tvit matodan tikilgan kiyimlarga ham nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The unequalness of her skills for the task led to significant delays.
His unequalness to the challenges of leadership soon became apparent.
unequalness.meta: Mos kelmaslik, ojizlik, layoqatsizlik — biror vazifa yoki mas’uliyatni bajarishga teng yoki munosib bo‘lmaslik holati; yetarlicha qobiliyat yoki kuchga ega emaslik.

ex: As a visualist, she brought complex ideas to life through powerful illustrations.
The director is a true visualist, known for his stunning cinematic imagery.
visualist.meta: Tasvir ustasi, vizual mutaxassis — yozuvchi, rassom, kinochi va hokazo: tasviriy ifoda yoki biror narsani vizual shaklda ko‘rsatish san’atida mohir inson; asosan vizual tasvirlar ustida ishlovchi shaxs.

syn: sight (ko‘rish) – • Her sight was gradually fading. (Uning ko‘rish qobiliyati asta-sekin yo‘qolayotgan edi.)vision (ko‘rish

nigoh) – • Human vision is limited in the dark. (Inson ko‘rish qobiliyati qorong‘uda cheklangan.)perception (idrok) – • Perception and visuality are closely linked. (Idrok va vizuality bir-biriga chambarchas bog‘langan.)
ex: The theory of visuality suggested that vision involved rays emanating from the eyes.

Ancient philosophers debated the nature of visuality and how the eye perceives objects. • Modern art often explores the boundaries of visuality and perception.(Zamonaviy san’at ko‘pincha vizuality va idrok chegaralarini o‘rganadi.)• The book examines the role of visuality in shaping cultural identities.(Kitob vizualityning madaniy o‘zliklarni shakllantirishdagi rolini o‘rganadi.)
visuality.meta: Ko‘rish nuri — qadimgi tasavvurlarda ko‘zdan chiqqan nur yoki oqim sifatida tasavvur qilingan modda bo‘lib, bu nur biror narsaga tushganda uni ko‘rish imkonini beradi. Qarang: visual.

ex: Sales trends over time are easily visualizable in a line graph.
The complex data is visualizable through interactive charts.
visualizable.meta: Vizual ko‘rinishga keltiriladigan, tasviriy ifodalash mumkin bo‘lgan — ma’lumotlarga nisbatan: grafik, diagramma, jadval va boshqa tasviriy shakllar orqali ko‘rsatish va shu orqali tushunishni yoki talqin qilishni osonlashtirish mumkin bo‘lgan.

ex: The concept was easier to grasp when it was visualized on a chart.
The visualized data helped the team quickly understand the trends.
visualized.meta: Vizual shaklda taqdim etilgan, ko‘rsatilgan — ko‘z bilan ko‘rish mumkin bo‘ladigan tarzda tasvirlangan yoki namoyish etilgan.

ex: The music player comes with a built-in visualizer that responds to the beat.
The visualizer projected the image onto the screen for the entire class to see.
visualizer.meta: Vizualizator, tasvirlovchi qurilma (yoki dastur) — biror narsaning tasviriy ko‘rinishini yaratadigan yoki ekranga chiqaradigan qurilma yoki (keyinchalik) kompyuter dasturi.

ex: Shelves, mannequins, and display stands are common visual merchandisers.
The store invested in new visual merchandisers to make their displays more attractive.
visual merchandiser.meta: Vizual savdo jihozi, mahsulot ko‘rsatkich vositasi — do‘kon yoki savdo joylarida mahsulotlarni namoyish qilish yoki taqdim etishda ishlatiladigan turli jihozlar va vositalar.

ex: The office waste-paper bin was overflowing by the end of the day.
She tossed the draft into the waste-paper bin.
waste-paper bin.meta: Qog‘oz axlat qutisi — keraksiz qog‘ozlar yoki boshqa ortiqcha materiallar uchun mo‘ljallangan quti, odatda ofis yoki ish joylarida ishlatiladi. (Ko‘chma ma’noda ham ishlatilishi mumkin: biror narsaning bekor qilinadigan, rad etiladigan joyi.)

ex: The team played a weak-ass game and lost badly.
That was a weak-ass excuse for missing the meeting
weak-ass.meta: Juda kuchsiz, juda zaif — so‘zlashuv tilida va jargon tarzida ishlatiladi; nihoyatda ta’sirsiz, qoniqarsiz yoki sifatsiz bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: He heard the weakening sound of the engine as it lost power.
The weakening storm posed less of a threat to the coastal towns.
weakening.meta: Zaiflashayotgan, kuchsizlanayotgan — kuchsiz yoki yanada zaif holga kelayotgan (turli ma’nolarda).

ex: The weakfish mentioned in old texts has not been clearly identified by modern science.
Early travelers reported catching weakfish in the coastal waters of Southeast Asia.
weakfish.meta: Zaif baliq — Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyoda uchraydigan, aniqlanmagan dengiz baliq turi. Bu atama hozir eskirgan va kam ishlatiladi.

ex: Weakies are known for their delicate mouths, which make them easy to lose during fishing.
The fisherman proudly displayed the weakie he had just caught.
weakie.meta: Weakie baliq — Cynoscion jinsiga mansub bo‘lgan, odatda "weakfish" deb ataladigan baliq turi. Bu baliq Shimoliy Amerikaning Atlantika qirg‘oqlarida uchraydi.

ex: The linebacker quickly shifted to cover the weak side of the formation.
The quarterback called a play to the weak side to exploit the defensive gap.
weak side.meta: Zaif tomon — Amerika futbolida: hujum yoki himoya tizimidagi notekis (nomutanosib) tuzilishda kamroq o‘yinchi joylashgan chiziqdagi tomon; ayniqsa, hujum chizig‘ida tight end (qo‘shimcha himoya yoki hujum o‘yinchisi) bo‘lmagan taraf.

ex: A wheelchair man was waiting at the airport to assist elderly travelers.
The wheelchair man helped the patient move across the hospital corridors.
wheelchair man.meta: Nogironlar aravachasi haydovchisi, aravacha itaruvchi — odatda erkak bo‘lgan shaxs; nogironlar aravachasi, hammom aravachasi yoki shunga o‘xshash transport vositalarini itarish yoki boshqarish bilan shug‘ullanadigan kishi.

ex: The child spun around the playground like a whirling dervish.
She moved through the kitchen like a whirling dervish, preparing food for everyone.
whirling dervish.meta: Gir aylanadigan darvish (ko‘chma ma’noda) — ko‘chma va taqqoslov ma’noda: shiddatli, cheksiz harakat yoki energiya namoyon qiladigan shaxs yoki narsa; bu holat ritual tarzda gir aylanadigan darvishlarga o‘xshatiladi.

ex: Critics pointed out the whitewashing in the novel’s portrayal of colonial history.
The whitewashing of historical events often erases the contributions of minority communities.
whitewashing.meta: Tarixni buzib ko‘rsatish, oq tanlilarni ustun qo‘yish — tarixiy yoki adabiy kontekstda: oq tanli bo‘lmagan insonlarni tasvirlash yoki ularning vakilligini ataylab buzib ko‘rsatish, ularni e'tibordan chetda qoldirish yoki butunlay o‘chirish jarayoni.

ex: They offered a wokely excuse for their poor performance.
He was paid a wokely sum for his hard work.
wokely.meta: Arzimas, past sifatli, ahamiyatsiz — qadrsiz, sifatsiz yoki juda kam qimmatga ega bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: The movie features scenes of heartfelt woman’s talk between the main characters.
They gathered for some private woman’s talk away from the men.
woman’s talk.meta: Ayollar suhbati — ayollar o‘rtasida bo‘ladigan, odatda shaxsiy yoki kundalik mavzular atrofida kechadigan suhbat.

ex: The novel explores themes often considered woman talk by critics of the time.
He dismissed the story as mere woman talk.
woman talk.meta: Ayollarga xos gap, ayollar gaplari — ayollar tomonidan aytiladigan yoki odatda ayollarga xos deb hisoblanadigan so‘zlar yoki nutq; ko‘pincha bu tushuncha gapning haqiqatga zid, arzimas yoki bekorchi ekanini nazarda tutadi.

ex: I opened the file and thought, WTAF is this?
WTAF just happened here?
wtaf.meta: Nima balo bu? / Bu nima o‘zi? — asosan elektron muloqotda ishlatiladigan qo‘pol, hayrat, jahllanish yoki tushunmaslikni ifodalovchi qisqartma.

ex: During the ad break, viewers often switch channels.
The show paused for an ad break before the final scene.
ad break.meta: Reklama tanaffusi — radio yoki televizion dasturlar davomida yoki ular orasida rejalashtirilgan reklama ko‘rsatiladigan vaqt oralig‘i.

ex: They were worried he might turn into an alco after losing his job.
He used to be an alco, but he’s been sober for years now.
alco.meta: Ichkilikboz, alkogolik — ko‘p ichimlik ichadigan yoki spirtli ichimliklarga qaram bo‘lgan shaxs. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha so‘zlashuv tili yoki norasmiy nutqda ishlatiladi.

ex: The Auskick program helps young players develop skills and teamwork.
Many children join Auskick to learn the basics of Australian Rules football.
auskick.meta: Auskick — Avstraliya qoidalariga asoslangan futbolni o‘ynash va undan zavqlanish uchun boshlang‘ich maktab yoshidagi bolalarni rag‘batlantirish maqsadida tashkil etilgan milliy faoliyat va trening dasturi.

ex: The movie captures the Aussieness of rural life perfectly.
His strong Aussieness was evident in his accent and humor.
aussieness.meta: Avstraliyaliklik, avstraliyaliklarga xoslik — Avstraliyadan bo‘lish sifati; Avstraliya yoki avstraliyaliklarga xos deb hisoblangan xususiyatlar, odatlar yoki fazilatlar.

ex: The program auto-generates code to speed up development.
The software can auto-generate reports based on the data entered.
auto-generate.meta: Avtomatik yaratmoq, avtomatik hosil qilmoq — kompyuter yoki kompyuter dasturi tomonidan kod, ma’lumot va hokazolarni inson aralashuvisiz avtomatik tarzda yaratish jarayoni.

ex: Many websites use auto-generated content to update information quickly.
The auto-generated report saved the team hours of work.
auto-generated.meta: Avtomatik yaratilgan — kompyuter yoki kompyuter dasturi tomonidan inson aralashuvisiz avtomatik tarzda yaratilgan kod, ma’lumot va boshqalar.

ex: The jeans have two large back pockets for convenience.
He kept his wallet in his back pocket.
back pocket.meta: Orqa cho‘ntagiga, orqa cho‘ntak — biror kiyimning, ayniqsa shim yoki jinsi shimning o‘rindig‘ida joylashgan cho‘ntagi (odatda ikkita bo‘ladi).

ex: The documentary portrayed the group’s Bible bashing as overly aggressive.
Some people avoid discussions with him because of his constant Bible bashing.
bible bashing.meta: Bibliya ta’limotlarini qattiq targ‘ib qilish — Bibliya o‘gitlarini juda faol va ba’zan majburlovchi tarzda targ‘ib qilish harakati; ko‘pincha salbiy yoki tanqidiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The Bible beater preached loudly at the public square.
He was known in the town as a zealous Bible beater.
bible beater.meta: Bibliya targ‘ibchisi — asosan ruhoniy bo‘lib, Bibliya ta’limotlarini juda faol va ba’zan majburlovchi tarzda targ‘ib qiluvchi shaxs; ko‘pincha salbiy yoki tanqidiy ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: She grew tired of the Bible beating during every meeting.
The preacher’s constant Bible beating alienated some members of the congregation.
bible beating.meta: Bibliya ta’limotlarini qattiq targ‘ib qilish — Bibliya o‘gitlarini juda faol, ba’zan majburlovchi va agressiv tarzda targ‘ib qilish harakati; ko‘pincha salbiy yoki tanqidiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: Critics often use the term Bible belter to describe socially conservative groups.
The Bible belter community is known for its strict religious values.
bible belter.meta: Bibliyaga qat’iy e’tiqod qiluvchi protestant — asosan AQSh janubida yashovchi, qat’iy, evangelistik va ijtimoiy jihatdan konservativ protestant xristianlik e’tiqodini tutuvchi odam. Ko‘pincha bu atama tanqidiy yoki kam hurmat bilan ishlatiladi.

ex: Many people rely on the Bible Society for affordable copies of the Bible.
The Bible Society works to make the scriptures accessible to all.
bible society.meta: Bibliya jamiyati — dunyo bo‘ylab faoliyat yurituvchi, Bibliyaning mahalliy tillardagi arzon yoki bepul tarjimalarini taqdim etishni maqsad qilgan ko‘plab xayriya tashkilotlari.

ex: The preacher was known to Bible-thump passionately in the streets.
He tends to Bible-thump during every conversation about faith.
bible-thump.meta: Bibliya ta’limotlarini qattiq targ‘ib qilmoq — Bibliyaning o‘gitlarini juda faol, majburlovchi va agressiv tarzda targ‘ib qilish; ko‘pincha salbiy yoki tanqidiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: The community was tired of the constant Bible thumping at public gatherings.
His speeches were full of Bible thumping, which alienated some listeners.
bible thumping.meta: Bibliya ta’limotlarini qattiq targ‘ib qilish — Bibliya o‘gitlarini juda faol, majburlovchi va agressiv tarzda targ‘ib qilish harakati; ko‘pincha salbiy yoki tanqidiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: Students are required to compile a bibliog. for their thesis.
The research paper included an extensive bibliog. at the end.
bibliog.meta: Bibliografiya — asosan akademik kontekstlarda ishlatiladigan atama; ma’lum bir mavzu yoki ish bo‘yicha foydalanilgan yoki tavsiya etilgan yozma manbalar ro‘yxati.

ex: Bibliographing is an essential part of academic research.
The librarian spent the afternoon bibliographing new acquisitions.
bibliographing.meta: Bibliografiya tuzish, kitobshunoslik — bibliografiya (ya’ni manbalar ro‘yxati)ni tuzish jarayoni yoki kitoblar va ularning tarixini o‘rganish faoliyati.

ex: Bibliometric data helps evaluate the impact of scientific publications.
The study used bibliometric methods to analyze research trends.
bibliometric.meta: Bibliometrik, bibliometriyaga oid — bibliometriya bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan; bibliografiyaga matematik va statistik tahlil usullarini qo‘llashni o‘z ichiga oladi, ko‘pincha ilmiy nashrlar yoki ma’lumotlarni kuzatish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Many collectors share a deep bibliophilia for rare editions.
Her bibliophilia was evident from the thousands of books in her home.
bibliophilia.meta: Kitobsevarlik, kitobga muhabbat — o‘qishga yoki kitoblar to‘plamini yig‘ishga bo‘lgan kuchli ishtiyoq va mehr-muhabbat.

ex: Some students become bibliophobes due to negative experiences with schooling.
Despite being well-educated, he was a bibliophobe who avoided reading.
bibliophobe.meta: Kitobdan qo‘rquvchi yoki kitobga qarshi bo‘lgan odam — kitob o‘qishdan, kitoblarga yoki kitob orqali o‘rganishdan nafratlanadigan yoki ulardan qochadigan shaxs.

ex: She trained as a bibliotherapist to support mental health patients.
The bibliotherapist recommended specific books to help with anxiety.
bibliotherapist.meta: Biblioterapevt — biblioterapiya bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassis; kitob o‘qish va yozilgan materiallar yordamida ruhiy yoki emotsional muammolarni davolash bilan shug‘ullanadi.

ex: I forgot the name of that bizzo we use in the kitchen.
Can you pass me that bizzo on the table?
bizzo.meta: Narsachalik — Avstraliya va Yangi Zelandiya so‘zlashuvida ishlatiladigan so‘z; odatda nomini eslay olmagan yoki bilmagan buyum yoki jihoz uchun ishlatiladi, ya’ni "narsachalik", "narsa" degan ma’noda.

ex: A sudden blow caused her to have a blood nose.
He got a blood nose after being hit during the game.
blood nose.meta: Qonli burun, burundan qon oqishi — burundan qon chiqishi holati, ayniqsa urilish, zarba yoki jarohat natijasida yuzaga kelgan burun qonashi.

ex: She called him a bloss because of his unkempt hair.
That old man looked like a real bloss with his messy clothes.
bloss.meta: Tartibsiz, chalg‘igan odam yoki narsa — asosan Ingliz tilining shimoliy va shimoliy markaziy hududlarida ishlatiladigan so‘z; ayniqsa, Lincolnshire hududida tartibsiz yoki tartibsiz sochli shaxsni ifodalaydi.

ex: In historical contexts, a blowsabella was seen as someone untidy or coarse.
The old novel described her as a blowsabella from the countryside.
blowsabella.meta: Tartibsiz, ozg‘in ayol — ko‘pincha to‘qimasligi, qo‘pol yoki qishloqcha ko‘rinishga ega bo‘lgan ayolni ifodalovchi so‘z; hozirda faqat tarixiy matnlarda uchraydi.

ex: The character in the novel was said to blowse around the taverns
She began to blowse about the streets late at night.
blowse.meta: Blowse — bu so‘z ingliz tilida odatda ayol kishining o‘zini axloqsiz yoki jinsiy jihatdan sha'nsiz tarzda tutishini ifodalaydi. Odatda bu so‘z kamsituvchi bo‘lib, ayolning fohishalarcha harakat qilishini anglatadi.

ex: The novel depicts a life ruined by poverty and blowsing.
His nights were spent in blowsing and carousing.
blowsing.meta: Blowsing — bu so‘z haddan tashqari ko‘p ichimlik ichish, ya’ni ichkilikbozlik holatini bildiradi. Odatda bu salbiy holat sifatida ko‘riladi va kishining o‘zini tutishi yoki hayot tarzi ichishga qaram bo‘lganini anglatadi.

ex: These blunnies are perfect for both work and casual wear.
He pulled on his blunnies before heading out to the farm.
blunnies.meta: Blunnies — bu so‘z avval boshda ish uchun mo‘ljallangan, tovonigacha baland bo‘lmagan, yon tomonlari elastik (cho‘ziluvchan) bo‘lgan charm etiklarni anglatadi. Ular odatda mustahkam bo‘ladi va oyoqqa oson kiyiladi.

ex: It was a boilover as the underdog team defeated the reigning champions.
The race ended in a boilover when the 80-to-1 outsider won.
boilover.meta: Boilover — bu so‘z sport musobaqalarida (dastlab ot poygalari kontekstida) kutilmagan yutqazish yoki ajablanarli natijani anglatadi. Odatda bu favorit sportchi yoki jamoaning yutqazishi, yoki hech kim kutmagan raqibning g‘alaba qozonishini bildiradi.

ex: Breakcore combines chaos and rhythm in a unique way.
He listens to a lot of breakcore while working on his art.
breakcore.meta: Breakcore — bu elektron raqs musiqasining bir janri bo‘lib, tez temp, kuchli va murakkab breakbeat (uzilgan, notekis ritm) lar, va turli xil, g‘ayrioddiy semplar (audio parchalar) ishlatilishi bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: She was seen as the breaker-up of their long friendship
The machine is used as a breaker-up of rocks in the quarry.
breaker-up.meta: Breaker-up — bu biror narsani buzadigan, ajratadigan, yoki parchalab tashlaydigan shaxs yoki narsa degani. Bu so‘z turli kontekstlarda ishlatiladi

ex: These muffins are so breakfasty — perfect with some orange juice.
The kitchen smelled very breakfasty with the aroma of coffee and toast.
breakfasty.meta: Breakfasty — bu sifatdosh bo‘lib, nonushtaga xos, nonushtani eslatadigan, yoki nonushtaga mos, tayyor degan ma’nolarni anglatadi. Bu so‘z taom, hid, muhit yoki kayfiyatni nonushta bilan bog‘laydi. Odatda norasmiy uslubda ishlatiladi.

ex: In old telegraph systems, a break key was essential for manual control.
The operator pressed the break key to interrupt the transmission.
break key.meta: Break key — bu qo‘l bilan boshqariladigan tugma yoki tutqich bo‘lib, u elektr zanjirini uzish yoki ba’zan ulash uchun ishlatiladi. Dastlab bu atama telegraf tizimlarida ishlatilgan bo‘lib, uzatish zanjirini uzish uchun foydalangan.

ex: Fishermen stood along the breakwall casting their lines into the sea.
The breakwall protected the harbor from the storm surge.
breakwall.meta: Breakwall — bu suvni ushlab qolish yoki yo‘nalishini o‘zgartirish uchun qurilgan devor bo‘lib, ayniqsa sohil yoki portni to‘lqinlarning kuchidan himoya qilish maqsadida dengizga qarab quriladi.

ex: He lives in a broke-down trailer on the edge of town.
We had to walk because our broke-down car wouldn't start.
broke-down.meta: Broke-down — bu sifatdosh bo‘lib, mexanik qurilma, motorli transport vositasi va boshqa uskunalar haqida aytiladi. Ular nosoz holga kelgan, mexanik nuqson tufayli ishlamay qolgan yoki umuman ishdan chiqqan holatni bildiradi.

ex: She joked about her brokeness after paying all the bills
His brokeness kept him from going out with friends.
brokeness.meta: Brokeness — bu pulning yo‘qligi, mablag‘sizlik, yoki juda kambag‘allik holatini anglatadi. Bu atama rasmiy bo‘lmagan (norasmiy) ingliz tilida keng ishlatiladi va "broke" sifatdoshining holat sifatida ifodalangan shaklidir.

ex: The touchdown came after a brilliant piece of broken-field running.
He's one of the best broken-field runners in the league.
broken field.meta: Broken field — bu atama, ayniqsa sportda, ayniqsa rugbi va amerika futbolida, himoyachilar tartibsiz joylashgan yoki tarqoq holatda bo‘lgan maydonni anglatadi.

ex: Scientists believe the Broken Hill man lived over 300,000 years ago.
The Broken Hill skull is one of the most important paleoanthropological discoveries in Africa.
broken hill.meta: Broken Hill — bu atama Avstraliyaning Yangi Janubiy Uels shtatidagi bir shaharga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Biroq antropologik va arxeologik kontekstda, bu nom Zambiyada joylashgan boshqa bir hudud

ex: Fisherman bulldog bats can catch small fish from the surface of the water.
The bulldog bat is named for its short, wrinkled snout that resembles a bulldog's face.
bulldog bat.meta: Bulldog bat — bu atama Molossidae va Noctilionidae oilalariga mansub ayrim yarasalar turini bildiradi. Bu yarasalar keng, kuchuknikiga o‘xshash burni bilan ajralib turadi va shuning uchun bulldog (it zoti) nomi bilan ataladi.

ex: The protest was carnivalized with music, costumes, and dancing.
The media carnivalized the trial, turning it into public spectacle.
carnivalize.meta: Carnivalize — bu fe’l biror narsa yoki holatni karnavalga aylantirish, bayramona ko‘rinish berish, yoki uni xursandchilik va shodlikka to‘la, rang-barang, shovqinli muhit sifatida taqdim etish yoki shunday deb qarash ma’nolarini bildiradi.

ex: My grandfather was a lifelong catnapper — he never slept long, but often dozed off in his chair.
As a frequent traveler, he's become an expert catnapper on long flights.
catnapper.meta: Catnapper — bu so‘z tez-tez yoki odat tusiga kirgan holda qisqa vaqt uxlovchi insonni anglatadi. Odatda bu uxlab qolish emas, balki ataylab qisqa muddatga — bir necha daqiqa yoki o‘n daqiqalarga — mizg‘ib olishni bildiradi.

ex: His habit of catnapping made it difficult for him to sleep properly at night.
Regular catnapping throughout the day helped her stay alert during long study sessions.
catnapping.meta: Catnapping — bu so‘z qisqa, yengil uxlab olishni odat qilish yoki buni amalda muntazam bajarish holatini bildiradi.

ex: The new charge cap will protect low-income families from excessive utility bills.
The government introduced a charge cap on mobile roaming fees.
charge cap.meta: Charge cap — bu ma’lum bir mahsulot yoki xizmat uchun belgilangan maksimal to‘lov miqdori, ya’ni eng yuqori ruxsat etilgan narx.

ex: Local authorities opposed charge-capping, arguing it restricted their budgeting flexibility.
Charge-capping has been introduced on energy bills to prevent unfair pricing.
charge-capping.meta: Charge-capping — bu ma’lum bir mahsulot yoki xizmatlar uchun eng yuqori to‘lov miqdorini belgilash jarayoni.

ex: A charge-off doesn't mean the debt is forgiven — the creditor may still try to collect it.
After 180 days of non-payment, the bank listed the loan as a charge-off.
charge-off.meta: Charge-off — bu qarzdorlik yoki aktivning bank yoki boshqa kreditor tomonidan rasmiy ravishda yo‘qotilgan yoki qaytmas mablag‘ sifatida tan olinishini bildiradi.

ex: Charge transfer between donor and acceptor molecules plays a key role in photosynthesis.
The color of the compound is due to an intramolecular charge transfer.
charge transfer.meta: Zaryad uzatish — bu ikki jism o‘rtasida elektr zaryadining biridan boshqasiga o‘tishi jarayoni. Ayniqsa kimyo sohasida bu atama molekulalar yoki kimyoviy guruhlar o‘rtasidagi elektronlarning o‘tishini anglatadi.

ex: I prefer chicken salt over regular salt for extra flavor.
Australians love sprinkling chicken salt on their hot chips.
chicken salt.meta: Chicken salt — bu tuz, turli o‘simliklar, ziravorlar va boshqa lazzat beruvchi moddalardan iborat sariq-to‘q sariq rangli aralashma bo‘lib, odatda issiq qovurilgan ovqatlar, ayniqsa kartoshka fri uchun ziravor sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The early morning choralling of birds filled the forest with melody.
Her love for choralling started when she joined the school choir.
choralling | choraling.meta: Choralling — bu xor tarkibida yoki guruh bo‘lib kuylash amaliyotini anglatadi. Bu atama ko‘pincha cho‘rlar (choir) tomonidan qo‘shiq kuylash, ayniqsa diniy yoki tantanali tadbirlarda bajariladigan kuylash jarayoniga taalluqli.

ex: Horticulturists often study color breaks to understand flower pigmentation.
The tulip displayed a vivid color break with unexpected purple streaks.
colour break | color break.meta: Colour break — bu biror gulning ota-navi (asosiy turi)dan farqli, g‘ayrioddiy yoki sezilarli rang o‘zgarishini anglatadi. Bunday rang o‘zgarishi odatda mutatsiya, virusli infeksiya, yoki genetik o‘zgarishlar natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ex: His commercialistic approach to education raised ethical concerns.
The art exhibition felt too commercialistic, focusing more on sales than creativity.
commercialistic.meta: Commercialistic sifati — bu tijorat (savdo) ruhida yuritiladigan, daromad yoki foyda olishni asosiy maqsad qilgan, hamda savdo-sotiq bilan bog‘liq faoliyatlarga qaratilgan harakat yoki munosabatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Coolites are perfect for kids and beginners because they are safe and float easily.
He started learning on a coolite before moving on to a fiberglass surfboard.
coolite.meta: bu **arzon va yengil material — polistirol ko‘pigi **dan tayyorlangan serf doskasi bo‘lib, asosan yangi boshlovchi serfchilar tomonidan ishlatiladi. U suzish osonligi va xavfsizligi sababli professional darajaga yetmaganlar uchun qulay vosita hisoblanadi.

ex: Couta is often smoked or grilled and served with lemon.
The fishermen caught a dozen couta near the reef.
couta.meta: Couta — bu asosan janubiy yarimsharda uchraydigan va ovlanadigan yirtqich dengiz baliqlaridan biri bo‘lib, ilmiy nomi Thyrsites atun sanaladi. Ko‘pincha "snuk" nomi bilan tanilgan. Baliq uzun, o‘tkir tishli va tez suzadi.

ex: Couta boats were originally designed for fishing fast-moving barracuda.
He restored an old couta boat and now sails it for leisure along the coast.
couta boat.meta: Couta boat — bu asosan barrakuda (yoki snuk) baliqlarini ovlash uchun ishlatilgan tez suzuvchi yelkanli qayiq turidir. Avvaliga tijorat baliq ovlashda ishlatilgan bo‘lsa, hozirda u rekreatsion (dam olish, sport) maqsadlarda ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Dead air is considered highly unprofessional in live broadcasting.
The program experienced dead air for nearly 30 seconds before the signal returned.
dead air.meta: Dead air — bu radio yoki teleefir davomida kutilmagan, rejasiz sukunat yoki jimlik holati bo‘lib, odatda texnik nosozlik, signal uzilishi, yoki efir rejasidagi uzilishlar sabab yuzaga keladi.

ex: That dead-ass never does anything right.
Don’t be such a dead-ass — help us clean up!
dead-ass.meta: (Noun sifatida) — kamsituvchi yoki haqoratli ma’noda ishlatiladi: dangasa, ahmoq, bir ishga yaramaydigan odam. (Adjective/adverb sifatida) — "jiddiy", "to‘liq darajada", "rostdan", "mutlaqo" ma’nolarida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The evidence had him dead bang; conviction was inevitable.
He was caught dead bang robbing the store — there's no way he'll walk free.
dead bang.meta: Dead bang — bu so‘z huquqiy yoki jinoyat tergovida ishlatiladi va shuni anglatadiki, gumonlanuvchi yoki ayblanuvchi shaxsga qarshi dalillar shunchalik kuchliki, u holatda jazoga tortilishi yoki sudda aybdor deb topilishi deyarli muqarrar bo‘ladi.

ex: If a card is exposed by accident, it becomes a dead card.
That ace was a dead card after the misdeal.
dead card.meta: Dead card — bu karta o‘yinlarida, ayniqsa pokerda, o‘yinda hech qanday rol o‘ynamaydigan yoki qo‘l davomida ishtirok etmaydigan karta.

ex: That old phone is a dead dog — it doesn’t even turn on anymore.
After the scandal, his political career was a dead dog.
dead dog.meta: Dead dog — so‘zma-so‘z “o‘lik it” degani bo‘lsa-da, og‘zaki nutqda qiziqish yoki ahamiyatini yo‘qotgan narsa yoki odam, foydasi qolmagan yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchragan shaxs yoki holatni bildiradi.

ex: The negotiations were going nowhere — they had completely dead-ended.
He realized he was stuck in a dead-ended job with no chance of promotion.
dead-ended.meta: Dead-ended — bu sifat hech qanday rivojlanish, yaxshilanish yoki muvaffaqiyatga olib bormaydigan vaziyat, ish, harakat yo‘nalishi yoki holatni ifodalaydi. Bu tugagan, chiqish yo‘li yo‘q, umidsiz degan ma’nolarda ishlatiladi.

ex: The suspect dead-eyed the officer as he was being questioned.
She dead-eyed him from across the room, saying nothing.
dead-eye.meta: Dead-eye — bu fe’l biror kishiga hissiz, sovuq, hazil-mutoyibasiz yoki iliqliksiz tarzda tikilmoq, qaramoq degan ma’noni anglatadi. Ko‘pincha ruhiy aloqasiz, sovuq yoki qo‘rqinchli qarashni ifodalaydi.

ex: Several deadheading pilots were seated at the back of the aircraft.
The flight attendant was deadheading to New York to start her shift the next morning.
deadheading.meta: Deadheading — temiryo‘l, aviakompaniya yoki boshqa transport tashkiloti xodimining yo‘l haqi to‘lamasdan, xizmatga borish yoki xizmatdan qaytish maqsadida yo‘lovchi sifatida sayohat qilishini bildiradi.

ex: I started dead-lifting regularly to strengthen my lower back.
He can dead-lift over 200 kilograms without using a belt.
dead-lift.meta: Dead-lift — bodibilding va og‘ir atletikada qo‘llaniladigan mashq bo‘lib, og‘irlikni (masalan, shtangani) yerda harakatsiz holatda turib, to‘g‘ri bel va tizzalarni ishlatgan holda ko‘tarishni bildiradi.

ex: He injured his back due to poor form while dead lifting.
Dead lifting is one of the best exercises for building overall strength.
dead lifting.meta: Dead lifting — bu og‘ir atletika va bodibildingda qo‘llaniladigan mashq bo‘lib, sportchi og‘ir shtangani yoki boshqa og‘irlikni yerda harakatsiz holatdan tik turgan holatgacha ko‘taradi.

ex: Deadlocking latches prevent the door from being opened without a key.
The door is fitted with a deadlocking bolt for extra security.
deadlocking.meta: Deadlocking — bu eshik qulfining yoki tilkalarning (bolt, latch) xususiyatini ifodalaydi. Bunday qulflar eshik yopilganda mahkam qulflanadi va faqat kalit bilan ochiladi

ex: Pilots used to dead reckon their routes before advanced navigation systems were invented.
The captain had to dead reckon their position after losing GPS signal.
dead reckon.meta: Dead reckon — bu asosan dengizchilik yoki aviatsiyada ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, kompas yo‘nalishlari, vaqt va tezlik asosida kemaning yoki samolyotning taxminiy joylashuvini aniqlashni anglatadi.

ex: Only a dillbrain would forget their own birthday.
Don’t be such a dillbrain — of course the door is locked!
dillbrain.meta: Dillbrain — bu og‘zaki, kinoyali yoki kulgili tarzda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, aqli past, tentak yoki ahmoq odamni nazarda tutadi. Bu so‘z ingliz tilidagi "dill" so‘zining (ahmoq degan ma’noda) kuchaytirilgan shaklidir.

ex: These dimmies taste amazing with soy sauce.
I grabbed a couple of dimmies from the corner shop for lunch.
dimmie.meta: bu "dim sim" so‘zining qisqartma yoki so‘zlashuvdagi shakli bo‘lib, Avstraliyada keng tarqalgan, Osiyo (xususan, Xitoy) taomidan ilhomlangan bug‘da pishirilgan yoki qovurilgan go‘shtli xamirli taomni anglatadi. U ko‘pincha fastfud shaklida sotiladi.

ex: Fried dim sims are my favourite snack.
I bought a steamed dim sim from the food truck.
dim sim.meta: Dim sim — bu Xitoy oshxonasidan ilhomlangan, ammo Avstraliyada yaratilgan taom bo‘lib, tandirda bug‘da pishirilgan yoki yog‘da qovurilgan, qiymalangan go‘sht va sabzavotlar bilan to‘ldirilgan xamirli dumaloq yoki cho‘zilgan shakldagi taomdir.

ex: The dirty dozens got so intense that it almost turned into a real fight.
They were playing the dirty dozens on the school steps until the teacher broke it up.
dirty dozens.meta: Dirty dozens — bu ikki kishi navbatma-navbat bir-birining qarindoshlari, ayniqsa onasi haqida haqoratli, odobsiz yoki jinsiy tusdagi kinoyali so‘zlar aytib, og‘zaki jangda qatnashadigan so‘z o‘yini.

ex: Dirty fries are perfect for sharing at parties.
I ordered dirty fries with cheese and bacon.
