dirty fries.meta: Dirty fries — bu qovurilgan kartoshka (fri) ustiga turli xil souslar, pishloq, dudlangan go‘sht (masalan, bekon), piyoz, qalampir kabi qo‘shimchalar solib tayyorlanadigan mazali va boy taomdir.

ex: That war doco was really moving.
We watched a great doco about climate change last night.
doco.meta: Doco — bu hujjatli film yoki teleko‘rsatuvni anglatuvchi norasmiy atama bo‘lib, ayniqsa Avstraliya ingliz tilida ishlatiladi. Bu atama dokumental janrdagi videomateriallarni qisqacha va norasmiy shaklda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Donburi is a simple but delicious Japanese rice bowl dish.
I ordered a beef donburi for lunch.
donburi.meta: Donburi — bu yapon oshxonasiga oid taom bo‘lib, bir piyola oq guruch ustiga dengiz mahsulotlari, go‘sht, sabzavot yoki boshqa ingredientlar solinib tayyorlanadi.

ex: Stories about the dooligah are passed down from generation to generation.
The elder warned us not to enter the forest at night because of the dooligah.
dooligah.meta: Dooligah — Avstraliyaning ayrim aborigen madaniyatlarida tasvirlanadigan, katta, tukli, yomon hidli va dahshatli maxluq yoki yovuz ruh.

ex: Downball requires quick reflexes and good hand-eye coordination.
We used to play downball every day after school on the netball courts.
downball.meta: Downball — bu bolalar o‘rtasida o‘ynaladigan o‘yin bo‘lib, tennis yoki skvoshga o‘xshaydi, biroq raketka o‘rniga qo‘l bilan to‘p uriladi. O‘yin odatda chiziqlar bilan bo‘lingan beton maydonchada o‘ynaladi.

ex: Dramality shows blur the line between fact and fiction.
The network is launching a new dramality series about aspiring musicians in Los Angeles.
dramality.meta: Dramaliti — bu televizion janr bo‘lib, drama (syujetli, sahnalashtirilgan voqealar) va realiti (haqiqiy odamlar va holatlar asosida yaratilgan) unsurlarini birlashtiradi.

ex: His latest work is a dramatico-musical piece inspired by Shakespeare's tragedies.
The festival featured several dramatico-musical performances, including a modern opera and a dance musical.
dramatico-musical.meta: Dramatik-musikal — bu atama teatr san’ati, xususan opera, balet, musiqiy drama yoki mюzikal kabi asarlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Ushbu asarlarda dramatik voqealar (syujet, dialog, aktyorlik ijrosi) bilan bir qatorda musiqa ham muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: As a dramaturg, she works closely with writers and directors to develop new productions.
The theatre hired a dramaturg to assist with the historical accuracy of the play.
dramaturg.meta: teatr yoki kinostudiyada ishlovchi adabiy tahrirchi yoki maslahatchi bo‘lib, u asar mualliflari bilan hamkorlik qiladi, sahna yoki ekran uchun moslashuv jarayonida prodyuserlar,tarixiy yoki kontekstual maslahatlar beradi.

ex: The playwright approached the story dramaturgically to ensure a coherent structure.
The scene works dramaturgically, but it still lacks emotional depth.
dramaturgically.meta: Dramaturgik jihatdan — asarning dramatik tuzilmasi, syujet rivoji, obrazlar dinamikasi, sahna harakati yoki teatr asarining badiiy va funksional elementlariga oid tarzda; dramaturgiya tamoyillari asosida baholangan yoki ishlab chiqilgan holda.

ex: Scratches on the duco can lower the resale value of the car.
The car was given a fresh coat of duco to restore its shine.
duco.meta: Duko — avtomobil kuzovi uchun ishlatiladigan yorqin va chidamli bo‘yoq turi. Bu bo‘yoq mashina tanasiga silliq, jilo beruvchi qatlam hosil qiladi. Shuningdek, bu atama avtomobilning umumiy bo‘yoq qoplamasini ham anglatadi.

ex: Emergency vehicles have the right of way at intersections.
The ambulance is an emergency vehicle used to transport injured people
emergency vehicle.meta: bu favqulodda vaziyatlarda ishlatiladigan, ayniqsa, tez yordam, politsiya va yong‘in xavfsizligi xizmatlari tomonidan ishlatiladigan transport vositasidir. Bu transport vositalari odatda maxsus sirena va chiroqlarga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: The experiencing of fear is a natural human reaction.
Her experiencing of loss was deeply personal and painful.
experiencing.meta: Boshdan kechirish — bu qandaydir hodisa, holat, tuyg‘u yoki voqeani bevosita his qilish, sezish yoki unda ishtirok etish jarayonidir. Bu harakat insonning ichki yoki tashqi tajribasining bir ko‘rinishi sifatida namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: Philosophy often explores the nature of the experiencing self.
An experiencing subject must be conscious and aware.
experiencing.meta: Boshdan kechiruvchi — tajriba yoki hodisani bevosita his qilayotgan yoki his qila oladigan (qobiliyatga ega bo‘lgan) shaxs yoki narsa. Bu sifat odatda tirik mavjudotlar yoki ongli mavjudotlarga nisbatan qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Science thrives on the experimentalness of bold hypotheses.
The experimentalness of the artist's new work impressed the critics.
experimentalness.meta: Eksperimental bo‘lish holati — yangi, sinovdan o‘tmagan g‘oyalar yoki usullarga asoslanganlik; tajriba o‘tkazishga moyillik yoki ochiqlik holati. Bu sifat biror narsa innovatsion yoki yangilikni sinovdan o‘tkazishga tayyor bo‘lganligini bildiradi.

ex: The scientist devoted much time to experimenting in the laboratory.
His success came after years of experimenting with different techniques.
experimenting.meta: Eksperiment o‘tkazish — biror narsani tekshirish, sinab ko‘rish yoki aniqlash maqsadida tajriba o‘tkazish harakati; turli usullarni amaliyotda sinash jarayoni. Ilmiy yoki ijodiy jarayonda yangi g‘oyalarni sinovdan o‘tkazish holati.

ex: Critics argued that the scene was unnecessary and was just fan service.
The show added some fan service to attract a larger audience.
fan service.meta: Fan service — bu, ayniqsa anime yoki manga asarlarida uchraydigan, voqea rivojiga zarur bo‘lmagan, lekin tomoshabinni hayajonga solish yoki ko‘nglini olish uchun maxsus qo‘shilgan ochiq-sochiq yoki jinsiy xarakterdagi sahnalar.

ex: Stop fatmouthing about how you're going to fix everything — just do it.
He tends to fatmouth when he's had a few drinks.
fatmouth.meta: Fatmouth — bekorchi, o‘zini bilmasdan yoki haddan tashqari ishonch bilan, ko‘pincha maqtanchoq yoki nojo‘ya tarzda, uzoq va keraksiz gapirish. Shuningdek, bajarilmaydigan va’da yoki tahdidlar qilish ma’nosini ham anglatadi.

ex: Weather and water clarity both affect the fishability of the river.
The lake's high fishability makes it a favorite among local anglers.
fishability.meta: Fishability — biror hudud, suv havzasi yoki sharoitning baliq ovlash uchun qanchalik mos yoki qulay ekanligini bildiradi. Bu suvning chuqurligi, tozaligi, baliq ko‘pligi va ob-havo kabi omillar bilan belgilanadi.

ex: Fishapods had both gills and rudimentary lungs, helping scientists understand vertebrate evolution.
The discovery of Tiktaalik, a famous fishapod, shed light on the transition from water to land animals.
fishapod.meta: qadimda yashagan, hozirda yo‘q bo‘lib ketgan suvda yashovchi umurtqali hayvonlar guruhi bo‘lib, ular baliqlar (ayniqsa, qanotlari jizzimli baliqlar) bilan quruqlikda yashovchi to‘rtoyoqli hayvonlar (tetrapodlar) orasidagi o‘tish shakli hisoblanadi.

ex: The new restaurant offers a spicy fish burger as part of their seafood menu.
I ordered a fish burger with tartar sauce and lettuce.
fish burger.meta: Baliq burgeri — baliq go‘shtidan tayyorlangan kotlet (ba'zan boshqa ingredientlar bilan aralashtirilgan bo‘ladi) bo‘lib, odatda bulochka (non) orasiga solinib, burger shaklida taqdim etiladi.

ex: Some religions restrict meat but allow fish-eating during fasting periods.
Fish-eating is common in coastal regions where seafood is abundant.
fish-eating.meta: Baliq iste'moli — oziq-ovqat sifatida baliq iste'mol qilish amaliyoti; inson yoki hayvon tomonidan baliq yeyish odati.

ex: Salmon is one of the most commonly fished species in this river.
The lake is heavily fished during the summer months.
fished.meta: Ovlangan — baliq ovlash uchun ishlatiladigan suv havzasi (masalan, ko‘l, daryo, dengiz) yoki baliqchilik orqali tutib olingan baliq yoki baliq turi.

ex: Over the years, the once-rich lake has become fished-out.
The bay is now fished-out and no longer supports commercial fishing.
fished-out.meta: Haddan tashqari ovlangan — baliq yoki dengiz mahsulotlari shu darajada ko‘p ovlanganki, suv havzasidagi zaxira deyarli tugagan yoki jiddiy kamaygan. Bu atama baliq turlari yoki ularning yashash joylari haqida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Many fishetarians choose this diet for health or ethical reasons.
After giving up meat, she became a fishetarian and now eats fish twice a week.
fishetarian.meta: Baliqxўr vegetarian — Asosan sabzavot, meva va boshqa o‘simlik mahsulotlarini iste’mol qiladigan, ammo shuningdek, baliq va dengiz mahsulotlarini ham ovqatiga qo‘shadigan odam.

ex: Her words fishhooked into his pride, leaving him speechless. (figurative)
The wire fishhooked into his finger, causing a deep cut.
fishhook.meta: Fishhook — Nimadandir qarmoqdek sanchib, teshib yoki ilg‘ab olish harakati. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha tananing bir qismiga yoki boshqa narsalarga og‘riqli tarzda kirib borishni bildiradi.

ex: In the fantasy novel, the cursed man slowly became fishified, his hands turning into fins.
The sculpture had a strange, fishified appearance with scales and gills.
fishified.meta: Fishified — Narsaning tashqi ko‘rinishi, tuzilishi yoki sifati baliqqa o‘xshash holga keltirilgan yoki baliqqa aylantirilgan holat. Bu atama haqiqiy baliqqa aylanishni ham, shunchaki baliqsimon xususiyat kasb etishni ham ifodalashi mumkin.

ex: Japan has one of the largest fishing fleets in the world.
The fishing fleet set out at dawn to catch tuna in the open sea.
fishing fleet.meta: Baliqchilik floti — Umumiy boshqaruv ostida yoki birgalikda faoliyat yuritadigan baliq ovlash kemalari guruhi. Ular ko‘pincha bir korxona yoki mamlakatga tegishli bo‘ladi va baliq ovlash maqsadida dengiz yoki boshqa suv havzalarida birga harakatlanadi.

ex: The fishing hole near the old bridge is popular among local anglers.
He showed me his secret fishing hole where he always catches the biggest trout.
fishing hole.meta: Daryo, soy, ko‘l yoki boshqa suv havzasining baliq ovlash uchun qulay yoki samarali bo‘lgan qismi. Bu joylar odatda baliqlar ko‘p to‘planadigan chuqurliklar, suv oqimi sustroq bo‘lgan hududlar yoki ozuqa mo‘l bo‘lgan nuqtalar bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: The dancer’s fishnetted legs were highlighted under the spotlight.
She walked onto the stage in a leather dress and fishnetted tights.
fishnetted.meta: Torbali paypoq kiygan — Odam yoki uning qo‘l-oyoqlari tor shaklidagi to‘rli (ko‘pincha paypoq yoki kalgaskada bo‘ladi) materialdan tayyorlangan kiyimda bo‘lishi. Bunday kiyimlar odatda jozibali yoki moda uslubida taqdim etiladi.

ex: The old market echoed with the traditional call of “Fisho!” in the early mornings.
As he pushed his cart through the alley, the fisherman cried out “Fisho!” to attract customers.
fisho.meta: Fisho — Baliqchi yoki baliq sotuvchining odamlarni jalb qilish uchun qiladigan chaqiruvi; bu chaqiriq orqali u yangi baliq borligini bildiradi. Bu atama tarixiy ahamiyatga ega bo‘lib, asosan eski zamonlarda bozorlarda ishlatilgan.

ex: In old heraldry, the fish wheel represented sustenance and resourcefulness.
The family’s coat of arms features a fish wheel, symbolizing their ancestors' fishing trade.
fish wheel.meta: Baliq g‘ildiragi — Asosan Britaniya geraldikasida ishlatiladigan ramziy tasvir bo‘lib, baliq tutishda ishlatiladigan to‘r yoki savatchaga o‘xshash tuzoqning tasviridir. Ba’zida bu so‘z aynan o‘sha turdagi baliq tuzog‘iga ham nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Early North American communities relied heavily on the fishwheel for their subsistence fishing.
The fishwheel made it easier for the villagers to harvest large numbers of salmon during the migration season.
fishwheel.meta: Baliq aylana g‘ildiragi — Asosan Shimoliy Amerikada ishlatiladigan baliq (ayniqsa losos) tutish moslamasi bo‘lib, daryo yoki soyga o‘rnatiladi.

ex: Folk horror explores how old beliefs and superstitions still haunt modern life.
The movie is a classic example of British folk horror, with eerie rituals and isolated villages.
folk horror.meta: Xalq dahshati — bu film yoki adabiyot janri bo‘lib, u odatda qadimiy xalq ertaklari, butparastlik an'analari, xurofotlar, qishloq hayotidan ajralganlik va tabiatdagi qorong‘i kuchlar mavzulariga asoslanadi.

ex: In the army, we often joked that our main transport was the foot falcon.
I missed the last bus, so I had to rely on the old foot falcon to get home.
foot falcon.meta: Oyoq lochini — kinoyaviy tarzda ishlatiladigan ifoda bo‘lib, odamning o‘z oyoqlari orqali harakatlanishini anglatadi. Transport vositasi, ot yoki boshqa vositalardan foydalangan holda yurishga qarama-qarshi ma’noda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Frig! This stupid computer won’t turn on.
Oh frig, I forgot my keys again!
frig.meta: bu aslida qo‘pol so‘zning yumshatilgan, yumor aralashgan yoki odobliroq muqobili bo‘lib, odatda g‘azab, asabiylik, hayrat, yoki charchoq kabi his-tuyg‘ularni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu so‘z ko‘proq norasmiy nutqda ishlatiladi.

ex: Unlike albatrosses, giant petrels are known to scavenge carcasses of dead seals and penguins.
The giant petrel can often be seen following ships in the Southern Ocean.
giant petrel.meta: bu asosan Antarktida yaqinidagi janubiy okean hududlarida uchraydigan Macronectes jinsiga mansub yirik dengiz qushlarining umumiy nomi. Ular ko‘pincha katta gavdasi, oq va jigar rangli patlari va o‘lik hayvonlar bilan oziqlanishi bilan tanilgan.

ex: Using the term "global majority" highlights the fact that white people are not the numerical majority worldwide.
The conference aimed to amplify voices from the global majority.
global majority.meta: Global ko‘pchilik — odatda oq tanli bo‘lmagan barcha odamlarga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan atama. Ushbu ibora shuni ta’kidlaydiki, dunyo aholisining katta qismi oq tanli bo‘lmagan insonlardan iborat.

ex: Unlike GDP, GNI includes income from nationals working abroad.
The country's GNI increased significantly due to its overseas investments.
gni.meta: YAIM (Yalpi milliy daromad) — ma’lum vaqt oralig‘ida bir mamlakat fuqarolari va bizneslari tomonidan ishlab topilgan jami daromad.

ex: Look at that little chick hatching from the googie!
Do you want a nice soft-boiled googie for breakfast?
googie.meta: Tuxumcha — tuxum so‘zining bolalar tilidagi yoki kinoyali shakli. Odatda kichik bolalar bilan muloyim tarzda gaplashayotganda ishlatiladi yoki kulgili uslubda aytiladi.

ex: Higher grammage means thicker and more durable fabric.
This printing paper has a grammage of 80 gsm.
grammage.meta: Grammali o‘lchov (grammaj) — qog‘oz yoki matoning zichligini bildiruvchi birlik bo‘lib, odatda har bir kvadrat metr uchun grammda o‘lchanadi. Bu ko‘rsatkich materialning qalinligi va sifatini belgilashda muhim hisoblanadi.

ex: In many languages, direction or aspect is shown through grammaticizing rather than using new vocabulary.
The shift from a full verb to an auxiliary is an example of grammaticizing.
grammaticizing.meta: Grammatikalashtirish — bu lingvistik jarayon bo‘lib, biror tushuncha so‘z boyligi orqali emas, balki grammatik vositalar (masalan, affikslar, yordamchi fe’llar, ko‘plik yoki zamon shakllari) yordamida ifodalanadi.

ex: A grammatico-lexical approach combines grammatical rules with word meaning in language analysis.
The grammatico-historical method interprets texts by analyzing both grammatical structure and historical context.
grammatico-.meta: Grammatiko- — bu bir nechta so‘zlar tarkibida ishlatiladigan old qo‘shimcha bo‘lib, “grammatikaga va —— ga oid” degan ma’noni bildiradi.

ex: I get grossed-out whenever I see insects in the kitchen.
She was totally grossed-out by the sight of the rotten food.
grossed-out.meta: Grossed-out — bu sifat so‘z bo‘lib, kimgadir yoki nimagadir nisbatan kuchli jirkanish yoki nafrat hissini bildiradi. Odatda noxush, iflos yoki g‘ayritabiiy holatlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The fog rolled in with such grosshead that you could barely see two feet ahead.
The grosshead of the sauce made it unappetizing.
grosshead.meta: Grosshead — bu ot bo‘lib, biror narsa hajman qalin, zich, qo‘pol yoki og‘ir bo‘lgan holatini bildiradi. Bu so‘z ko‘pincha modda yoki tarkibning dag‘alligi yoki zichligi ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: The grosso featured the image of the Doge and the patron saint of Venice
Merchants in 14th-century Venice commonly used the grosso for large transactions.
grosso.meta: Grosso — bu 12-asr oxiridan boshlab Venetsiya Respublikasida, va 13-asr boshidan boshlab turli italyan shaharlarida zarb qilingan yirik kumush tanga. Bu tangalar savdo va xalqaro aloqalarda muhim rol o‘ynagan.

ex: The gross-up payment covered all tax liabilities for the relocation benefit.
The company offered a gross-up on the bonus to ensure the employee received the full amount after tax.
gross-up.meta: Gross-up — bu soliq to‘lovchiga to‘lanadigan daromad yoki to‘lovga soliqdan keyin qo‘shimcha ravishda qo‘shiladigan summa bo‘lib, bu summa qabul qiluvchi shaxsning soliq majburiyatini qoplash uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: The old man muttered something about not trusting a gubba.
For many in the community, the word "gubba" expresses long-standing resentment towards colonial systems.
gubba.meta: Gubba — Avstraliya mahalliy (aborigen) xalqlari orasida aborigen bo‘lmagan odamlarga nisbatan ishlatiladigan kamsituvchi yoki tanqidiy atama. Ba'zida butun aborigen bo‘lmagan aholiga nisbatan yakka birlik shaklida umumlashtirilib qo‘llanadi.

ex: The mob boss sent a gun for hire to deal with the problem.
He made a living as a gun for hire, taking dangerous jobs no one else would do.
gun for hire.meta: Pul evaziga yollangan qurolli shaxs — bu odatda ma'lum bir vazifani bajarish (masalan, suiqasd, qo‘riqlash yoki urush harakatlarida ishtirok etish) uchun yollanadigan, o‘zida qurol olib yuradigan yoki undan foydalanadigan shaxs.

ex: The injury to his gun hand made it difficult for him to shoot.
He aimed carefully with his gun hand.
gun hand.meta: Qurol ushlaydigan qo‘l — bu otishma yoki quroldan foydalanish vaqtida ishlatiladigan asosiy qo‘l bo‘lib, odatda odam qurolni ushlab turadigan yoki o‘q uzadigan qo‘lga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Bu qo‘l ko‘pincha ustun qo‘l (ya’ni o‘ng yoki chap qo‘l) bo‘ladi.

ex: His gunslinging attitude made him feared among his rivals.
The film features a gunslinging sheriff who defends the town from outlaws.
gunslinging.meta: Gunslinging sifat sifatida — doimiy ravishda qurol ko‘tarib yuradigan, uni tezda ishlatishga tayyor bo‘lgan kishini ifodalaydi. Bu atama odatda qahramonlarcha, hujumkor, yoki vahshiy G‘arb (Wild West) obrazlariga xos harakterni tasvirlashda ishlatiladi

ex: Gunsmithing requires both precision engineering and a deep understanding of firearms.
He studied gunsmithing and opened his own workshop.
gunsmithing.meta: Qurolsozlik — bu qurolsozning ishi, hunari yoki kasbi bo‘lib, o‘qotar qurollarni yasash, ta’mirlash, sozlash yoki modifikatsiya qilish bilan shug‘ullanadi.

ex: Through the haze of gunsmoke, they could barely see the enemy.
The smell of gunsmoke still lingered in the air after the battle.
gunsmoke.meta: Qurol tutuni — bu o‘qotar qurol otish natijasida yuzaga keladigan tutun, odatda poroxning yonishi natijasida hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: She was known as a feared gunwoman in the criminal underworld.
The police arrested the gunwoman after a brief standoff.
gunwoman.meta: Qurollangan ayol — bu qurol (odatda o‘qotar qurol) olib yuruvchi yoki undan foydalanishda mohir bo‘lgan ayol, shuningdek jinoyat sodir etishda quroldan foydalangan ayolga nisbatan ham qo‘llanadi.

ex: Hair-strings were traditionally worn as belts or headbands.
The elder taught the children how to make hair-string from human hair.
hair-string.meta: Soch ipi — ayrim Avstraliya aborigen madaniyatlarida inson sochidan o‘rilgan ip yoki arqon, u boshbog‘, etak, belbog‘ kabi kiyim-kechaklar tayyorlashda yoki turli narsalarni bog‘lash, bog‘ich sifatida ishlatilgan.

ex: The machine uses plastic-hubbed rollers to reduce weight.
A steel-hubbed wheel provides more durability.
hubbed.meta: Markazli — g‘ildirak va shunga o‘xshash mexanik qismlar haqida: markazi (galtagi) bo‘lgan; ko‘pincha oldindan kelgan so‘z bilan birga ishlatiladi va markazning materiali yoki turi ko‘rsatiladi.

ex: Iffen it rains, we’ll stay home.
I’ll go with you, iffen you want me to.
iffen.meta: Iffen — so‘zlashuv tili yoki dialektal nutqda ishlatiladigan “agar” so‘zining variantidir. Bu forma asosan shevalarda, xalq og‘zaki nutqida yoki nostandart ingliz tilida uchraydi.

ex: Invasion Day protests are held across the country.
Many Indigenous Australians refer to Australia Day as Invasion Day.
invasion day.meta: Bosqin kuni — Avstraliyada 1788-yil 26-yanvarda britaniyaliklar tomonidan tubjoy aholining (aborigenlar) yerlariga bostirib kirilishi va Britaniya mustamlakasining boshlanishini esga olish kuni.

ex: Isekai stories often involve characters gaining magical powers after being transported to another world.
"Sword Art Online" is one of the most popular isekai anime.
isekai.meta: yapon fantastik yoki ilmiy-fantastik adabiyot va animelarda uchraydigan janr bo‘lib, bosh qahramon odatda boshqa, g‘alati yoki notanish dunyoga ko‘chiriladi yoki qayta tug‘iladi. Bu dunyo ko‘pincha o‘yin, sehr-jodu yoki boshqa o‘lchamga o‘xshaydi.

ex: Jean jackets became popular in the 1980s and are still in fashion.
He wore a faded jean jacket over a white T-shirt.
jean jacket.meta: Jin jaket — og‘ir va zich to‘qilgan paxtadan (odatda denim matosidan) tikilgan kurtka; hozirgi kunda, ayniqsa, qisqa, kundalik kiyiladigan jinsi matodan tikilgan kurtka shaklida keng tarqalgan.

ex: Jeff caps are often associated with working-class fashion in the early 20th century.
He wore a brown leather jeff cap that matched his jacket.
jeff cap.meta: Jeff qalpoq — yumaloq shakldagi, odatda tvid, korduroy, charm yoki boshqa mustahkam matolardan tikilgan qalpoq bo‘lib, old tomonida kichik, qattiq qirrali soyabon (vizor) bo‘ladi

ex: Jeff Davis hats became a symbol of Union military style during the Civil War.
The soldier's Jeff hat was tilted slightly to the left.
jeff hat.meta: Jeff shapka (to‘liq shakli: Jeff Davis shapkasi) — Amerika fuqarolar urushi davrida Union (Shimoliy) armiyasi askarlari tomonidan kiyilgan qora mo‘ynali (felt) bosh kiyimi bo‘lib, rasmiy forma tarkibiga kirgan.

ex: He was jive talking so fast I could barely understand him.
The musicians started to jive talk backstage, cracking jokes in fast slang.
jive talk.meta: Jivcha gapirmoq — Amerikalik afroamerikaliklar orasida XX asr o‘rtalarida rivojlangan jive nomli sleng tilida (erkin, ko‘pincha ritmik va quvnoq ifodalar bilan) gapirish. Bu uslub ko‘pincha jazz musiqasi va shahar madaniyati bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan.

ex: The film is full of classic jive-talking from the jazz era.
His smooth jive-talking made everyone laugh.
jive-talking.meta: Jivcha gaplashish — Amerikalik afroamerikaliklar orasida XX asr o‘rtalarida shakllangan jive deb nomlangan o‘ziga xos sleng tilida gaplashish; bu uslub odatda ritmik, tezkor, kulgili yoki bo‘rtma nutq bilan xarakterlanadi.

ex: Stop joning me about my haircut!
They spent the afternoon joning on each other’s clothes
jone.meta: Jone — (noan’anaviy, og‘zaki uslubda) Biror kishini masxara qilish yoki ustidan kulish; ko‘pincha so‘zlashuv o‘yini yoki hazil-mutoyiba tarzida qilinadi. Bu harakat ikki yoki undan ortiq kishi o‘rtasida og‘zaki “hazil jangi” shaklida bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: They rented a jumping castle for the school fun day.
The kids had a great time jumping in the jumping castle at the birthday party.
jumping castle.meta: Jumping castle — Havo bilan to‘ldiriladigan katta o‘yin jihozi bo‘lib, odatda qasr yoki boshqa binoga o‘xshatilgan shaklda bo‘ladi. Unda ayniqsa bolalar sakrab, o‘ynashadi.

ex: Kagome design is admired for its symmetry and strength.
The artisan used a traditional kagome pattern to weave the basket.
kagome.meta: Kagome — bu yapon savat to‘qish san’atida ishlatiladigan naqsh bo‘lib, teng tomonli uchburchaklar va olti burchaklardan iborat ochiq shakldagi geometrik tuzilmani hosil qiladi.

ex: The chicken karaage was crispy on the outside and juicy inside.
Karaage is one of the most popular items in Japanese izakayas.
karaage.meta: Karaage — bu yapon taomi bo‘lib, mayda bo‘laklarga bo‘lingan tovuq go‘shti (yoki boshqa go‘sht yoki dengiz mahsuloti) oldindan marinadlab, un, kartoshka kraxmal yoki makkajo‘xori kraxmaliga botirib, chuqur yog‘da qovuriladi.

ex: Katsu is often served with shredded cabbage and rice.
I ordered chicken katsu with curry sauce.
katsu.meta: Katsu — bu yapon oshxonasida tayyorlanadigan taom bo‘lib, go‘sht (odatda tovuq, ba’zida cho‘chqa yoki baliq), dengiz mahsuloti yoki sabzavot bo‘lagi un, tuxum va panko (yapon non bo‘lagi)ga botirib, chuqur yog‘da qovuriladi.

ex: Katsu curry is a comfort food for many in Japan.
I had chicken katsu curry for lunch.
katsu curry.meta: Katsu karri — bu yapon oshxonasiga oid mashhur taom bo‘lib, unga katsu (ya’ni panada qovurilgan go‘sht bo‘lagi — tovuq, cho‘chqa yoki boshqa turdagi go‘sht), qaynatilgan oq guruch va yumshoq, mazali karri sousi kiradi

ex: The artist used kintsugi to repair the old vase, making it even more precious.
Kintsugi teaches that brokenness can be beautiful.
kintsugi.meta: Kintsugi — bu yapon san’ati bo‘lib, sinib ketgan sopol buyumlarni alohida e’tibor va mahorat bilan qayta birlashtirishdan iborat. Bu jarayonda yoriqlar maxsus lak bilan yopishtiriladi va ustiga oltin kukuni sepiladi.

ex: Unlike origami, kirigami includes cutting to add more detail to the design.
Kirigami allows artists to create stunning 3D paper sculptures.
kirigami.meta: Kirigami — bu yapon san’at turi bo‘lib, qog‘ozni buklash va kesish orqali murakkab, uch o‘lchamli (3D) bezaklar va shakllar yaratish usulidir. Origamidan farqli ravishda, kirigami san’atida qog‘oz faqat buklanmaydi, balki kesiladi ham.

ex: Kriol has its own grammar and vocabulary, distinct from standard English.
Many Aboriginal communities in northern Australia speak Kriol as a first language.
kriol.meta: Kriol — Avstraliyaning shimoliy hududlarida yashovchi aborigen xalqlari tomonidan so‘zlashiladigan ingliz tiliga asoslangan kreol tili.

ex: Treatment for lichen sclerosus often involves topical corticosteroids to reduce inflammation and itching.
Lichen sclerosus is more common in postmenopausal women but can affect people of any age.
lichen sclerosus.meta: Liken skleroz — asosan jinsiy a’zolar sohasida uchraydigan, terida qattiq, oq rangli va ko‘pincha qichishadigan dog‘lar bilan ifodalanadigan surunkali teri kasalligi. Bu kasallik ko‘proq ayollarda uchrasa-da, erkaklar va bolalarda ham kuzatilishi mumkin.

ex: The report was light on details, so we had to ask for more information.
He was a bit light on cash after paying all the bills.
light on.meta: Yetishmovchi, kam ta’minlangan — odatda odam haqida ishlatilganda, nimadandir (ayniqsa pul) yetishmaydigan holat; qiyinchilikda bo‘lish. Buyum yoki narsalar haqida gapirganda esa yetarli emas, kam, kamchilikka ega degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: The mangaka spent years perfecting the story and art for his manga series.
Osamu Tezuka is considered the father of modern manga and a famous mangaka.
mangaka.meta: Mangaka — manga (yapon komikslari) muallifi yoki rassomi. Manga yaratadigan shaxs.

ex: Be careful not to misclick on any ads while browsing.
I made a misclick and closed the important document by mistake.
misclick.meta: Xato bosish — sichqoncha tugmasini yoki sensorli ekran tugmasini tasodifan bosish holati; ayniqsa, bu harakat dastur funksiyasini noto‘g‘ri faollashtirishi yoki kutilmagan natijaga olib kelishi.

ex: She identifies as a Mizrahi and celebrates the customs of her ancestors from the Middle East.
Mizrahi Jews have unique cultural traditions distinct from other Jewish communities.
mizrahi.meta: Mizrahi — O‘rta Sharq, Shimoliy Afrika yoki Osiyo (ayniqsa, G‘arbiy yoki Markaziy Osiyo) kelib chiqishi bo‘lgan yahudiylarga oid yoki ularni ifodalovchi atama; shuningdek, shunday odamni anglatadi.

ex: She’s a bit molly-handed when it comes to fixing things around the house.
He is molly-handed, so he writes with his left hand.
molly-handed.meta: Molly-handed — boshida “chap qo‘l bilan ishlaydigan” ma’nosida; keng ma’noda esa “beqaror, no‘noq, noqulay harakat qiladigan” odamni ifodalaydi.

ex: Enabling multifactor authentication helps protect your account from unauthorized access.
Many online services now use multifactor authentication to improve security.
multifactor authentication.meta: Ko‘p faktorli autentifikatsiya — foydalanuvchining shaxsini tasdiqlash usuli bo‘lib, raqamli xizmat yoki tizimga kirishni ta’minlash uchun bir nechta identifikatsiya dalillarini talab qiladi.

ex: In Arrernte culture, the ngangkari holds an important spiritual and healing role.
The ngangkari used traditional herbs to heal the sick.
ngangkari.meta: Ngangkari — ba’zi Avstraliya aborigen madaniy guruhlarida, ayniqsa markaziy Avstraliyaning Arrernte xalqida an’anaviy tibbiyot amaliyotchisi, shifokor yoki shifobaxsh shaxs.

ex: Forgetting your passport is no bueno when you’re traveling abroad.
His behavior at the meeting was no bueno.
no bueno.meta: No bueno — sifat va interjektsiya sifatida ishlatiladi; ma’nosi — yaxshi emas, yomon, istalmagan holat yoki narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: “Sorry for the delay!” — “No wuckers, take your time.”
“Can you help me move this weekend?” — “No wuckers, I’ll be there.”
no wuckers.meta: No wuckers — bu ibora “hammasi joyida”, “muammo yo‘q”, “xavotir olmang” degan ma’noda ishlatiladi. Bu odatda biror kishining roziligini, tasalli berishini yoki hammasi yaxshi ekanligini bildiradi. Ingliz tilidagi “no worries” iborasi bilan o‘xshash.

ex: “Sorry I’m late!” — “No wucking furries, take your time.”
“Can you fix the issue by tomorrow?” — “No wucking furries, I’ll handle it.”
no wucking furries.meta: No wucking furries — bu ibora “hammasi joyida”, “hech qanday muammo yo‘q”, “xavotir olmang” ma’nolarida ishlatiladi. Bu odamning roziligini, tasalli berishini yoki hammasi yaxshi ekanligini ifodalaydi.

ex: Increasing the nuclear charge increases the force pulling electrons closer to the nucleus.
The nuclear charge affects the attraction between the nucleus and the electrons.
They cooked okonomiyaki on a hot griddle, mixing cabbage and seafood into the batter.
Okonomiyaki is a popular savory pancake in Japan made with various ingredients.
okonomiyaki.meta: Yapon oshxonasida: un va tuxumdan tayyorlangan, unga karam, go‘sht, dengiz mahsulotlari kabi turli qo‘shimcha ingredientlar qo‘shilgan sho‘r pancake.

ex: The hotel staff showed great omotenashi by anticipating every need of their guests.
Omotenashi is a unique Japanese concept of attentive and thoughtful hospitality.
omotenashi.meta: Yaponiya madaniyatida: mehmonlarga ko‘rsatiladigan samimiy mehmondo‘stlik, diqqat-e’tibor, va mehmonning ehtiyojlarini oldindan anglash bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: She packed onigiri with pickled plum filling for the picnic.
Onigiri is a popular Japanese rice ball often wrapped in dried seaweed.
onigiri.meta: Yapon taomida: ichida tuzlangan yoki sirka solingan to‘ldiruvchi mavjud bo‘lgan, kichik guruch shar yoki uchburchak shaklidagi taom, odatda quritilgan dengiz yosini bilan o‘ralgan.

ex: She prefers over-ear headphones because they are more comfortable for long listening sessions.
Over-ear headphones provide better sound isolation than in-ear ones.
over-ear.meta: Quloq usti — quloq ustiga kiyiladigan, odatda musiqa yoki nutqni tinglash uchun mo‘ljallangan qurilmani ifodalaydi; ayniqsa, quloq usti naushniklar yoki minigarnituralar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

ex: Overfished waters struggle to replenish their fish populations naturally.
The coral reef is overfished, causing a decline in marine biodiversity.
overfished.meta: (Asar suv havzasi haqida) — baliq, mollyuskalar va boshqa dengiz mahsulotlari zaxiralari juda kamayib ketgan, ya’ni ortiqcha baliq ovlangan.

ex: Pash rash is common when kissing someone with a rough beard.
After kissing her boyfriend, she noticed a red irritation called pash rash around her mouth.
pash rash.meta: Lablar, og‘iz va iy atrofida yuzaga keladigan qizarish yoki yallig‘lanish, asosan soqolli yoki sochilgan odam bilan ehtirosli o‘pish natijasida paydo bo‘ladi.

ex: The P-plate warns other drivers that the person behind the wheel is inexperienced.
New drivers in many countries must display a P-plate on their cars.
p-plate.meta: Yangi haydovchi ekanligini ko‘rsatish uchun avtomobilning old va orqa qismiga iltiladigan, ustida “P” harfi yozilgan belgi.

ex: Many accidents involve P-platers who are still gaining experience on the road.
A P-plater must follow certain driving restrictions until they gain full licence.
p-plater.meta: Avtomobilni P-platalar bilan boshqaruvchi haydovchi; vaqtinchalik yoki sinov haydovchilik guvohnomasiga ega shaxs.

ex: Winning a quaddie requires correctly predicting the outcome of all four races.
He placed a quaddie bet on four horse races happening this weekend.
quaddie.meta: To‘rtta belgilangan poyga yoki voqeaga tikilgan garov yoki shu poygalar o‘zi; quadrella so‘zining qisqartmasi.

ex: Many punters enjoy placing quadrella bets because of the high potential payout.
The quadrella bet requires predicting the winners of four races correctly.
quadrella.meta: To‘rtta belgilangan poyga, musobaqa yoki voqealarning g‘oliblarini to‘g‘ri taxmin qilishni talab qiluvchi akkumulyator turidagi garov; shuningdek, bunday garov uchun belgilangan voqealar.

ex: When doing a Romanian deadlift, it is important to keep your back straight to avoid injury.
Romanian deadlift is an effective exercise for strengthening the hamstrings and lower back.
romanian deadlift.meta: Qisqacha: odam og‘irlikni (odatda barbellni) kestirib, bilak darajasida ushlab turadi, so‘ng yelkalarni orqaga tortib, bel sohasidan egilib, og‘irlikni tizzalardan pastga tushiradi. Bu mashq orqa va son mushaklarini mustahkamlash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The team’s performance was so bad that fans felt they were rooned for the season.
After the storm destroyed the crops, the farmer said, “We’ll all be rooned.”
rooned.meta: Kelajak haqida pessimistlikni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi; ayniqsa, “we’ll all be rooned” (biz hammamiz vayron bo‘lamiz) iborasi bilan qo‘llanib, biror shaxs yoki guruhning qiyin ahvolda yoki halokatga yuz tutganini bildiradi.

ex: Many chefs prefer santoku knives because of their lightweight and versatility.
The santoku knife is perfect for slicing, dicing, and chopping vegetables.
santoku.meta: Yaponiya kelib chiqishi bo‘lgan yengil, ko‘p maqsadli oshxona pichog‘i; qisqa, tekis pichoqcha bo‘lib, uchida egilgan shaklga ega. To‘liq nomi santoku bocho, ya’ni “uchta foydali narsa” degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: Volunteers performed seva by helping build homes for the community.
Seva is an important concept in many spiritual traditions, emphasizing selfless service
seva.meta: O‘z manfaatlarini ko‘zlamay, boshqalarga yordam berish; odatda ko'ngilli ishlarda, o‘zaro yordam yoki ijtimoiy ehsonlarda namoyon bo‘ladigan xizmat.

ex: The healer performed the ritual shamanically to connect with the spirit world.
The drum was played shamanically during the ceremony to invoke ancient energies.
shamanically.meta: Shamanizm uslubida yoki shamanning odatiga ko‘ra bajarilgan tarzda.

ex: Traditional shibori is often done with indigo dye on cotton or silk.
She created beautiful patterns on the fabric using the shibori technique.
shibori.meta: Yaponiyaning matoni bo‘yashga qarshi usulda ishlanadigan bir necha qo‘l texnikalaridan biri; bu usullar orasida matoni buklash, burash, bog‘lash, tikish yoki siqish orqali bo‘yoq (ko‘pincha indigo) qo‘llanadi. Natijada noyob naqshlar hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: She begins each morning with simran to center her mind and soul.
Simran is a central spiritual practice in Sikhism, focused on remembering God through repetition of His name.
simran.meta: Ilohiy zotni eslash; Xudoni yoki ilohiy ismlarni mulohaza qilish, zikr qilish yoki meditatsiya tarzida takroriy ravishda tilga olish amaliyoti. Bu tushuncha asosan sikhizm va boshqa Sharqiy dinlarda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: During sorry business, cultural protocols must be strictly followed.
The community gathered to observe sorry business after the elder passed away.
sorry business.meta: Avstraliya aborigenlari yoki Torres bo‘g‘ozi orollari jamoalarida o‘lim yoki chuqur qayg‘uga sabab bo‘lgan holat; xususan, marhumni xotirlash bilan bog‘liq marosimlar, urf-odatlar va ruhiy amaliyotlar.

ex: That speccy will be remembered as one of the best marks of the season.
He took an incredible speccy over two defenders and the crowd went wild.
speccy.meta: Avstraliya futbolida: havodagi to‘pni ushlash uchun sakrayotgan futbolchining boshqa o‘yinchining (ko‘pincha raqibning) yelkasidan yoki orqasidan tayanch sifatida foydalanib, yuqoriga sakrab amalga oshirgan ajoyib ushlovi.

ex: Spy balloons are often equipped with cameras and sensors to collect intelligence.
The military detected a spy balloon flying over the country’s airspace.
spy balloon.meta: harbiy tashkilot yoki razvedka xizmati tomonidan foydalaniladigan havo shari; hozirgi kunda — maxsus uskunalar bilan jihozlangan, masofadan boshqariladigan yoki avtomatik tarzda harakatlanuvchi, ekipajsiz havo shari.

ex: As a skilled stockwoman, she can herd sheep, ride horses, and manage farm duties.
She works as a stockwoman on a large cattle station in the Australian outback.
stockwoman.meta: Mol yoki boshqa turdagi chorva hayvonlariga qarash bilan shug‘ullanadigan ayol; chorvachilik sohasida ishlaydigan ayol xodima.

ex: The injured animal moved stot, barely keeping its balance.
The ball hit the ground and rolled away stot.
stot.meta: Sakrab, sapchib yoki orqaga qaytib harakatlanish tarzida. Shuningdek (ilk ishlatishda): sal mog‘orlab yoki titrab yurish holatida.

ex: A classic stottie ball is small, rubbery, and bounces high.
The kids played catch with a stottie ball in the schoolyard.
stottie ball.meta: Sakrab tushadigan yoki orqaga sapchiydigan to‘p; ayniqsa, hind rezinasidan yasalgan va bolalar o‘yinlarida ishlatiladigan to‘p. Qarang: stotting ball.

ex: The Sydney language includes several dialects spoken by Aboriginal communities.
Efforts are being made to revive the Sydney language through educational programs.
sydney language.meta: Asosan “the” artikli bilan qo‘llanadi. Avstraliya aborigenlariga mansub, hozirgi Sidney shahri va uning atrofidagi hududlarda so‘zlashilgan, bir nechta lahjalarga ega bo‘lgan til.

ex: Traditional takoyaki is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
We tried takoyaki at a street food stall in Osaka.
takoyaki.meta: Yapon oshxonasida: unli quyuq xamirda tayyorlangan, odatda ahtapot bo‘lakchalari, tempura qoldiqlari, tuzlangan qizil zanjabil va yashil piyoz bilan to‘ldirilgan kichik yumaloq shar shaklidagi gazak. Maxsus qolipli panjara (pan)da pishiriladi.

ex: In our community, your tidda is someone you trust with your life.
She’s not my real sister, but she’s my tidda — we’ve been through everything together.
tidda.meta: O‘z avlodiga mansub ayol (shu jumladan, biologik opa yoki singil). Kengaytirilgan ma’noda: yaqin munosabat yoki kuchli bog‘liqlikka ega bo‘lgan ayol do‘st, dugona, ruhiy opa-singil.

ex: Many children grew up watching tokusatsu heroes like Ultraman and Kamen Rider.
Godzilla is one of the most iconic examples of tokusatsu cinema.
tokusatsu.meta: Yapon filmlari yoki televizion ko‘rsatuvlar janri bo‘lib, asosan maxsus (amaliy) effektlardan keng foydalanilishi bilan ajralib turadi. Bu janrda odatda ulkan mahluqlar (kaiju), superqahramonlar yoki robotlar ishtirok etadi.

ex: Tonkatsu is one of the most popular comfort foods in Japan.
I ordered a tonkatsu set meal that came with rice, miso soup, and shredded cabbage.
tonkatsu.meta: Yapon oshxonasida: cho‘chqa go‘shtidan kesilgan kotlet, un, tuxum va panko non bo‘lakchalariga botirib, chuqur yog‘da qovuriladi va bo‘laklarga bo‘linadi. Shuningdek, bu usulda tayyorlangan taomning o‘zi ham shunday nomlanadi.

ex: You can also use tonkatsu sauce as a dip for fried vegetables or chicken.
Tonkatsu sauce adds a rich, tangy flavor to the crispy pork cutlet.
tonkatsu sauce.meta: Yapon oshxonasida ishlatiladigan shirin va sho‘rta’m (mazali) sous bo‘lib, meva va sabzavotlardan, soya sousi va boshqa ziravorlardan tayyorlanadi. Asosan tonkatsu yoki boshqa qovurilgan taomlar bilan birga tortiladi.

ex: He kept his pipe and tobacco in an old tonkotsu passed down from his grandfather.
The antique shop displayed a beautifully carved tonkotsu made of rosewood.
tonkotsu.meta: Yapon madaniyatida odatda tamaki saqlash uchun ishlatiladigan quti yoki xaltacha. U yog‘och yoki boshqa materialdan yasalgan bo‘lib, o‘ymakorlik yoki boshqa usulda bezatilgan bo‘ladi va iplar bilan bog‘lanadi.

ex: Strict regulations are in place to prevent overfishing of the Antarctic toothfish.
Toothfish is highly valued in gourmet cuisine and often sold as Chilean sea bass.
toothfish.meta: Asosan Antarktika va subantarktika suvlarida uchraydigan Dissostichus turkumiga mansub ikkita yirik perchsimon (perciform) baliq turlaridan biri. Ular Nototheniidae oilasiga kiradi.

ex: Trimethylaminuria is also known as “fish odor syndrome.”
People with trimethylaminuria may struggle with social anxiety due to the persistent body odor.
trimethylaminuria.meta: Tanada trimetilamin birikmasining to‘planishi natijasida odamdan chirigan baliq hidiga o‘xshash yoqimsiz hid taralishiga olib keladigan holat. Bu kasallik metabolik buzilish bo‘lib, organizm trimetilaminni yetarlicha parchalay olmaydi.

ex: The Tudor bonnet is often associated with academic dress in British universities.
At the graduation ceremony, the professors wore traditional gowns and Tudor bonnets.
tudor bonnet.meta: 16- va 17-asr boshlarida ommalashgan uslubdagi yumshoq, yumaloq bosh kiyimi. U past tojli (kronli) va tor qirrali bo‘ladi, ko‘pincha cho‘qqisida to‘rg‘aycha (tassel) bilan bezatiladi.

ex: A diet high in ultra-processed foods is linked to various health risks.
Many breakfast cereals are considered ultra-processed due to added sugars and preservatives.
ultra-processed.meta: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlari haqida: ishlab chiqarish jarayonida kuchli sanoat qayta ishlovidan o‘tgan, odatda tarkibida ko‘p miqdorda qo‘shimchalar (masalan, tuz, shakar, sun’iy ta’m beruvchilar, konservantlar) bo‘ladi.

ex: Croissants and pain aux raisins are classic examples of viennoiserie.
She picked up a selection of viennoiseries from the bakery for breakfast.
viennoiserie.meta: Xamiriga sariyog‘, sut, tuxum yoki shakar kabi boyituvchi mahsulotlar qo‘shilgan, qatlamli yoki xamirturushli xamir asosida tayyorlanadigan fransuz uslubidagi pishiriqlar. Ular non va shirindan keyingi o‘rinda turadi.

ex: The accident resulted in partial vision loss in her left eye.
Early treatment can help prevent permanent vision loss.
vision loss.meta: Ko‘z kasalligi yoki shikastlanish natijasida insonning qisman yoki to‘liq ko‘rish qobiliyatini yo‘qotishi. Bu holat vaqtinchalik yoki doimiy bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: I bought three new washi tapes with floral designs for my scrapbook.
She used washi tape to decorate the edges of her journal pages.
washi tape.meta: Yaponiyaga xos dekorativ yopishqoq lenta, asosan qog‘ozdan yasalgan bo‘lib, turli bezak ishlarida, daftar dizayni, sovg‘a o‘rash va boshqa hunarmandchilikda ishlatiladi.

ex: Yakiniku is a popular dish in Japan, especially for group dining.
We went to a yakiniku restaurant where we grilled our own meat at the table.
yakiniku.meta: Yapon oshxonasida: qovurilgan yoki grilda pishirilgan go‘sht, ayniqsa g‘arbcha yoki koreyscha barbekyu uslubida tayyorlangan taom. “Yakiniku” so‘zi ko‘pincha restoranlar nomida yoki taomlar ta’rifida sifatlovchi sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The community event was led by several respected yorgas.
She is a proud Yorta Yorta yorga who teaches traditional language and culture.
yorga.meta: Asosan Avstraliya aborigen xalqlari tilida ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, ayol kishini, ayniqsa aborigen ayolni anglatuvchi ifodadir. Bu so‘z madaniy va hurmat bilan qo‘llaniladi, ba’zan yaqinlik yoki oila doirasidagi ayol kishiga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: In an absolutive–ergative system, the subject of an intransitive verb is treated like the object of a transitive verb.
Basque is a well-known example of an absolutive–ergative language.
absolutive–ergative.meta: Tilshunoslikda: absolut–ergativ tuzilishga ega bo‘lgan tillarni ifodalaydi. Bu kabi tillarda tovushsiz fe’l (intransitive) subyekti va tovushli fe’l (transitive) obyekti bir xil grammatik shaklda bo‘ladi

ex: Afro-Latina artists are gaining more visibility in mainstream media.
She proudly identifies as Afro-Latina, honoring both her African and Latin American roots.
afro-latina.meta: Qora tanli afrikalik ajdodlarga ega, lotinamerikalik kelib chiqishga ega bo‘lgan, hozirda AQShda yashayotgan qiz yoki ayol.Ana shunday kelib chiqishga ega bo‘lgan ayolni yoki u bilan bog‘liq madaniyat, tajriba yoki identitetni ifodalovchi so‘z.

ex: Afro-Latino musicians have greatly influenced Latin American music styles.
He embraces his heritage as an Afro-Latino from the Dominican Republic.
afro-latino.meta: Qora tanli afrikalik ajdodlarga ega, Lotin Amerikasida yashovchi yoki u yerdan kelgan, hozirda ko‘pincha AQShda yashayotgan erkak yoki o‘g‘il bola.

ex: Afro-Latinx voices are essential in discussions about diversity within the Latin community.
As an Afro-Latinx, they navigate both racial and cultural intersections every day.
afro-latinx.meta: Qora tanli afrikalik ajdodlarga ega bo‘lgan va Lotin Amerikasidan kelgan, ayni paytda ko‘pincha AQShda yashayotgan shaxs. Bu atama gender neytral bo‘lib, erkak yoki ayol deb ajratmasdan ishlatiladi.

ex: AGI systems would be capable of learning any intellectual task that a human can do.
Scientists believe that achieving AGI could revolutionize every aspect of human life.
agi.meta: Sun’iy umumiy intellekt (AGI) — bu sun’iy intellekt shakli bo‘lib, mashina yoki dastur inson darajasida fikrlash, tushunish, o‘rganish va muammolarni hal qilish qobiliyatiga ega bo‘lishi (nazariy jihatdan) mumkin.

ex: In environmental science, alkaline hydrolysis can help decompose organic waste safely.
Alkaline hydrolysis is often used in the breakdown of esters and amides.
alkaline hydrolysis.meta: Ishqoriy gidroliz — bu kimyoviy reaksiya bo‘lib, unda birikmaning parchalanishi yoki ajralishi ishqor (bazik modda) ishtirokida sodir bo‘ladi. Bu reaksiya gidroliz deb ataladi va ishqor (masalan, natriy gidroksid) katalizator vazifasini bajaradi.

ex: The speech was delivered from an amalgamationist perspective, emphasizing unity over division.
As an amalgamationist, she advocated for the merger of the two companies.
amalgamationist.meta: Birlashtirish tarafdori — turli elementlar, guruhlar, tashkilotlar yoki irqlarning bir-biriga qo‘shilishi yoki birlashishini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs. Shuningdek, bu so‘z bunday birlashtirish ishlarini amalga oshiradigan shaxs ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: As an amalgamist, she believed that diversity could be a strength when combined thoughtfully.
The amalgamist worked to unify the rival political factions.
amalgamist.meta: Birlashtirish tarafdori — turli elementlar, tashkilotlar yoki guruhlarning yagona butunlikka aylanishini qo‘llab-quvvatlaydigan yoki amalga oshiradigan shaxs.

ex: Fossils of Amia species have been found in North American rock formations.
The Amia calva is known for its ability to breathe both air and water.
amia.meta: Amia — bu Amiidae oilasiga mansub ibtidoiy suyakli baliqlar jinsidir. Ushbu jindan faqat Amia calva turi (bowfin) hozirgacha saqlanib qolgan yagona mavjud turning vakilidir.

ex: In polar regions, many lakes remain amictic throughout the year.
The lake is considered amictic due to its permanent ice cover.
amictic.meta: atrof-muhit fanlarida, suvning vertikal aralashuvi yoki aylanishi sodir bo‘lmaydigan ko‘l yoki boshqa suv havzalarini ifodalovchi atama. Bunday suv havzalarida suv qatlamlari yil davomida deyarli harakatlanmaydi va o‘z holicha qoladi.

ex: The activity of amidase can be influenced by pH and temperature.
Amidase plays a key role in the metabolism of nitrogen-containing compounds.
amidase.meta: Amidaza — bu amidlarni amin (yoki ammiak) va kislotali radikalga ajratilishini katalizlaydigan fermentlar guruhiga mansub moddadir. Amidazalar biologik jarayonlarda, xususan azot almashinuvida muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: The reaction conditions must be controlled to achieve selective amidation.
Amidation is a crucial step in peptide synthesis.
amidation.meta: Amidlanish — bu moddani amidga aylantirish yoki **birikma tarkibiga amid guruhi (–CONH₂)**ni kiritish jarayonidir. Bu jarayon kimyo va biokimyoda, ayniqsa peptidlar sintezi va dori moddalari ishlab chiqarishda muhim hisoblanadi.

ex: The amidine group enhances the basicity of the molecule.
Amidine compounds are often used in medicinal chemistry.
amidine.meta: Amidin — bu tarkibida —C(NH₂)NH guruhi (yoki uning o‘zgargan shakli) mavjud bo‘lgan asosiy birikmalar sinfiga kiruvchi moddalardir. Amidinning kimyoviy xossalari uni dori vositalari va boshqa organik sintezlarda muhim qiladi.

ex: Unlike other diuretics, amiloride helps retain potassium in the body.
Amiloride is used to treat high blood pressure and congestive heart failure.
amiloride.meta: bu organizmdan natriy va xlorid ionlarini chiqarishni rag‘batlantiruvchi, ammo kaliy ionlarini chiqarilishini to‘xtatuvchi zaif diuretik dori vositasidir. Ko‘pincha yurak yetishmovchiligi yoki gipertenziya (yuqori qon bosimi)da ishlatiladi.

ex: The reaction vessel was prepared for the aminate process.
The chemist decided to aminate the compound to improve its solubility.
aminate.meta: Aminlash — bu amin guruhi (—NH₂) ni biror bir birikma yoki molekulaga kiritish jarayonidir. Bu kimyoviy modifikatsiya jarayoni bo‘lib, ko‘pincha farmatsevtik yoki organik sintez sohalarida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The selective amination of aromatic rings requires precise conditions.
Amination is an important step in the synthesis of pharmaceutical compounds.
amination.meta: Aminlash jarayoni — bu amin guruhi (—NH₂) ni molekula yoki birikmaga kiritish orqali amin hosil bo‘lishi yoki uning sintezi jarayonidir. Bu jarayon ko‘pincha organik kimyo va farmatsevtik moddalarning ishlab chiqarilishida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: Aminoglycosides are effective against many Gram-negative bacteria.
The doctor prescribed an aminoglycoside to treat the infection.
aminoglycoside.meta: Aminoglikozid — keng ta'sir doirasiga ega bo‘lgan antibiotiklar sinfiga mansub moddalar bo‘lib, ayniqsa jiddiy Gram-manfiy bakterial infeksiyalarni davolashda qo‘llaniladi. Ular bakteriyalar oqsillarini sintez qilishiga to‘sqinlik qiladi.

ex: Aminol has a distinct odor and is usually produced in small-scale chemical experiments.
The production of aminol involves the use of calcium hydroxide and brine-derived amines.
aminol.meta: Aminol — baʼzi aminlar (ayniqsa, seld balig‘i tuzlangan sho‘r suvdan olingan aminlar) ustida kaltsiy gidroksidi taʼsirida hosil bo‘ladigan gazsimon modda. Baʼzan u maxsus sanoat yoki kimyo jarayonlarida qo‘llanadi.

ex: Amiodarone is often used in emergency situations involving ventricular arrhythmias.
The doctor prescribed amiodarone to stabilize the patient’s irregular heartbeat.
amiodarone.meta: Amiodaron — yurak ritmining buzilishi (aritmiya)ni davolashda ishlatiladigan dori vositasi. Bu dori yurakning elektr impulslarini tartibga solishga yordam beradi.

ex: Amniotic membrane transplantation is used in eye surgery.
Amniocentesis is a procedure used to sample the amniotic fluid.
amnio-.meta: Amnio- — so‘z boshida kelib, amnion (embrionni o‘rab turuvchi yupqa parda) bilan bog‘liq yoki unga oid narsalarni bildiruvchi birikuvchi shakl. Asosan tibbiyot terminologiyasida ishlatiladi.

ex: The doctor performed an amniography to assess the fetus’s development.
Amniography is rarely used today due to advances in ultrasound technology.
amniography.meta: homiladorlikda amnion qopchasi (homila atrofidagi suyuqlik to‘plangan parda) ichidagi suyuqlikka rengen nurlari bilan ko‘rinadigan modda yuborilgach, ichki tuzilmalarni rengen tekshiruvi orqali ko‘rish usuli. Tibbiy diagnostika usuli hisoblanadi.

ex: The researchers studied the properties of the amnionic membrane.
Amnionic fluid surrounds the developing fetus in the womb.
amnionic.meta: Amnionik — amnion (homila atrofini o‘rab turuvchi yupqa parda) bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan yoki shu pardaga tegishli bo‘lgan. Homila rivojlanayotgan paytda uni o‘rab turadigan himoya qopchasining xususiyatlarini bildiradi.

ex: Amnionitis can lead to complications during pregnancy if not treated promptly.
The patient was diagnosed with amnionitis following premature rupture of membranes.
amnionitis.meta: Amnionit — amnion (homila atrofidagi himoya qatlami)ning yallig‘lanishi yoki infeksiyalanishi. Odatda bu holat amnionning erta yorilishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi va homila hamda ona salomatligi uchun xavf tug‘dirishi mumkin.

ex: An amnioscope allows for direct visualization of the fetus and membranes.
The doctor used an amnioscope to examine the amniotic fluid.
amnioscope.meta: Amnioskop — amnioskopiya uchun ishlatiladigan endoskopik asbob bo‘lib, homila atrofidagi butun amnion qopchasi va uning ichidagi tarkibni ko‘z bilan tekshirish imkonini beradi.

ex: The obstetrician performed an amnioscopy to check for signs of fetal distress.
Amnioscopy is often used to assess the color and clarity of amniotic fluid.
amnioscopy.meta: Amnioskopiya — bachadon bo‘yni (kamroq hollarda qorin devori) orqali endoskop yordamida homilaning atrofidagi butun amnion qopchasi va uning ichidagi suyuqlik va holatni ko‘z bilan tekshirish usuli.

ex: Amniotomy is a common procedure during the active phase of childbirth.
The doctor performed an amniotomy to speed up labor.
amniotomy.meta: tug‘ruqni sun’iy ravishda boshlash yoki tezlashtirish maqsadida amnion qopchasini (homila suv pufagini) sun’iy yo‘l bilan yorish usuli. Bu usul odatda tibbiy nazorat ostida amalga oshiriladi va homilaning chiqishini tezlashtirishga xizmat qiladi.

ex: Researchers noted the amoebal characteristics of the cell structure.
The organism displayed amoebal movement under the microscope.
amoebal.meta: Amöbaga oid — amöba yoki amöbalarga aloqador bo‘lgan; shakli, harakati yoki tuzilishi jihatidan amöbaga o‘xshaydigan narsa. Bu atama biologiyada bir hujayrali, shaklini o‘zgartira oladigan organizmlarni tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: This compound has strong amoebicide properties.
The doctor prescribed an amoebicide to treat the infection.
amoebicide.meta: amöba (bir hujayrali mikroorganizmlar)ni yo‘q qiluvchi yoki ularni o‘ldirishga qaratilgan xususiyatga ega vosita yoki modda. Amöba o‘ldiruvchi vosita — aynan amöbalarga qarshi kurashishda ishlatiladigan kimyoviy preparat yoki dori.

ex: Scientists observed the movement of the amoebula under the microscope.
The amoebula migrates from the parent cell before maturing.
amoebula.meta: Amöbula — turli xil mayda amöbasimon hujayralar; xususan, ayrim protistlar va zamburug‘lar hayot tsiklining tarqaluvchi bosqichida shakllanadigan hujayra. Bu hujayralar erkin harakatlana oladi va ko‘pincha yangi muhitlarga ko‘chish uchun xizmat qiladi.

ex: That amphib can both float on water and drive on land.
The military deployed an amphib to cross the river and continue on land.
amphib.meta: Amfib — quruqlikda ham, suvda ham harakatlana oladigan transport vositasi (samolyot, tank yoki boshqa vosita); amfibiyali transport.

ex: Perfume was once stored in delicate amphoriskoi made of glass or clay.
The museum displayed a beautifully painted amphoriskos from ancient Greece.
amphoriskos.meta: Amforiskos — qadimgi yunon va rim davrida ishlatilgan, kosmeetika, moylar yoki atirlar saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan kichik amfora shaklidagi idish.

ex: Researchers designed primers to target a 200-base-pair amplicon.
The PCR test amplifies a specific amplicon from the viral genome.
amplicon.meta: Amplikon — tabiiy yoki sun’iy yo‘l bilan ko‘paytirish (amplifikatsiya) jarayonida qolip (shablon) sifatida ishlatiladigan gen yoki boshqa nuklein kislota ketma-ketligi.

ex: Only amplifiable signals were recorded during the experiment.
The DNA sample must be amplifiable for successful PCR analysis.
amplifiable.meta: Kuchaytirilishi mumkin bo‘lgan — turli ma'nolarda "kuchaytirish" (amplify) fe’li bilan bog‘liq holda: ovoz, signal, biologik material (masalan, DNK) va boshqa narsalarni ko‘paytirish, kengaytirish yoki kuchaytirish mumkin bo‘lgan.

ex: After the accident, he lay anaemiated on the ground.
The anaemiated patient appeared pale and weak.
anaemiated | anemiated.meta: Qon yo‘qotgan yoki kamqon bo‘lgan — tanada yetarli miqdorda qon yoki gemoglobin bo‘lmagan holatni ifodalaydi. Bu holat odatda kuchli qon yo‘qotish, temir tanqisligi yoki boshqa sog‘liq muammolari natijasida yuzaga keladi.

ex: The team played anaemically throughout the match.
She smiled anaemically, unable to hide her exhaustion.
anaemically | anemically.meta: Kamqon holatda, zaif, hayotiy kuchsiz, jonlilikdan yiroq tarzda bajarilgan yoki ifodalangan holatni bildiradi. Bu ko‘pincha kuch-quvvat, energiya yoki jozibaning yetishmasligini anglatadi.

ex: Modern anesthetics allow for painless surgeries.
He decided to specialize in anaesthetics during medical school.
anaesthetics | anesthetics.meta: Organizmni og‘riqni sezishdan vaqtincha mahrum qiluvchi dori vositalari (anesteziklar) qo‘llanishi va o‘rganilishi bilan shug‘ullanuvchi tibbiyot sohasi.

ex: Annulating compounds are commonly used in organic synthesis.
The annulating agent triggered the formation of a six-membered ring.
annulating.meta: Kimyoviy reaksiya davomida halqasimon tuzilmani hosil qiluvchi yoki halqa hosil bo‘lishini boshlovchi reagentga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Bu holat ko‘pincha organik sintezda, ayniqsa, annulyatsiya reaksiyalarida kuzatiladi.

ex: Chemists study annulenes to understand delocalized π-electron systems.
[14]-Annulene is aromatic despite its non-planar structure.
annulene.meta: To‘liq kon’yugatsiyalashgan (ya’ni, mumkin bo‘lgan maksimal darajada bir-biriga qo‘shilmagan juft bog‘lar mavjud bo‘lgan) bir halqali uglevodorod. Annulenlar organik kimyoda halqasimon tuzilmalarning elektron xossalarini o‘rganishda muhim hisoblanadi.

ex: Youth gangs often use anti-languages to resist mainstream culture.
The prison inmates developed an anti-language to communicate secretly.
anti-language.meta: Anti-til — tilshunoslik va adabiyot nazariyasida jamiyatdagi kichik ijtimoiy guruh tomonidan ishlatiladigan maxsus til shakli bo‘lib, uning asosiy vazifasi shu guruhni asosiy jamiyatdan ajratib turish

ex: Many anti-marketeers feared losing national sovereignty to European institutions.
He was a prominent anti-marketeer during the 1975 referendum campaign.
anti-marketeer.meta: Anti-bozorchi — Buyuk Britaniya siyosatida Yevropa Umumiy Bozori (hozirgi Yevropa Ittifoqi)ga qo‘shilish yoki a’zo bo‘lishga qarshi bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: Some environmentalists adopt antinatalism as a response to overpopulation.
Antinatalism argues that bringing new life into the world inevitably causes suffering.
antinatalism.meta: Antinatalizm — odamlarning farzand ko‘rishiga yoki katta oilalar qurishiga qarshi bo‘lgan qarash; tug‘ilish darajasini nazorat qilish yoki kamaytirishni, ayniqsa davlat siyosati orqali amalga oshirishni yoqlovchi fikr yoki harakat.

ex: The government faced criticism from antinatalists for promoting population growth.
She holds strong antinatalist views and believes that not having children is ethically better.
antinatalist.meta: (sifat) Farzand ko‘rishga yoki katta oila qurishga qarshi bo‘lgan qarashlarga oid; tug‘ilish darajasini kamaytirishni yoki nazorat qilishni yoqlovchi. (ot) Farzandli bo‘lishga qarshi bo‘lgan odam; tug‘ilish darajasining pasaytirilishini yoqlovchi shaxs.

ex: She has written several anti-nuke articles warning of the dangers of radiation.
The protest was organized by anti-nuke activists calling for the shutdown of nuclear plants.
anti-nuke.meta: (sifat) Yadro qurollari yoki yadro energiyasidan foydalanishga qarshi bo‘lgan; bunga oid qarshilik bilan bog‘liq. (ot) Yadro qurollari yoki yadro energiyasiga qarshi bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: The verb form in this sentence is clearly antipassive, omitting the direct object.
In many ergative languages, antipassive constructions allow the agent to be emphasized.
antipassive.meta: Asosan ergativ hol tizimiga ega tillarda qo‘llaniladigan grammatik qurilish bo‘lib, bunda o‘tkazgich (tranzitiv) fe’lning to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri obyekti tushirib qoldiriladi yoki ikkinchi darajali holga o‘tkaziladi.

ex: The linguist studied how antipassivization affects sentence structure in Mayan languages.
Antipassivization is common in ergative-absolutive languages such as Basque and Inuit.
antipassivization.meta: Asosan ergativ hol tizimiga ega tillarda kuzatiladigan tilshunoslik hodisasi bo‘lib, unda o‘tkazgich (tranzitiv) fe’lning to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri obyekti tushirib qoldiriladi yoki ikkinchi darajali holga (masalan, ergativ emas, ko‘makchi holga) o‘tkaziladi.

ex: Some ergative languages frequently antipassivize verbs for pragmatic reasons.
The researcher showed how to antipassivize the verb in Inuit to focus on the agent.
antipassivize.meta: ergativ hol tizimiga ega tillarda: gap qurilmasini antipassiv shaklga keltirmoq, ya’ni o‘tkazgich fe’lni to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri obyektni tushirib qoldirish yoki uni ikkinchi darajali holga o‘tkazish orqali nofaol konstruktsiyaga aylantirmoq.

ex: In many ergative languages, antipassivized constructions are used to background the object or make it indefinite.
The verb in this sentence is antipassivized to emphasize the agent rather than the object.
antipassivized.meta: Antipassivlangan – asosan ergativ hol mavjud bo‘lgan tillarga nisbatan ishlatiladi; antipassiv konstruksiyaga o‘tkazilgan yoki antipassiv shaklida tuzilgan gap yoki so‘z birikmasini ifodalaydi.

ex: Many schools support anti-pornography education to protect young people from harmful materials
The organization launched an anti-pornography campaign to reduce exposure to explicit content.
anti-pornography.meta: Pornografiyaning qonuniylashtirilishiga yoki keng tarqalishiga qarshi bo‘lgan; pornografiyani ishlab chiqarish, tarqatish yoki iste’mol qilishni oldini olish yoki cheklash maqsadida yaratilgan.

ex: His views were strongly influenced by anti-psychiatric theories.
The anti-psychiatric movement challenged the traditional understanding of mental illness.
anti-psychiatric.meta: Psixiatriyaga qarshi bo‘lgan; xususan, keyingi qo‘llanishlarda antipsixiatriya harakati yoki uning qarashlariga oid, unga xos yoki uni ifodalovchi.

ex: Appendiceal inflammation often leads to appendicitis.
The patient was diagnosed with an appendiceal tumor.
appendiceal.meta: Appendiks (ichakning kichik, ko‘r qismi bo‘lgan, ko‘pincha “ko‘r ichak” deb ataladigan qo‘shimcha) bilan bog‘liq, unga tegishli yoki unga aloqador.

ex: An appendicolith is often associated with acute appendicitis.
The CT scan revealed the presence of an appendicolith causing obstruction.
appendicolith.meta: Appendiks (ichakning kichik, ko‘r qismi) ichida hosil bo‘ladigan ohaklashgan (toshga o‘xshash) qattiq birikma. Appendikolit odatda appenditsit (ko‘r ichak yallig‘lanishi) rivojlanishida sabab bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: Appendicostomy can provide an alternative route for bowel irrigation.
The child underwent an appendicostomy to help manage chronic constipation.
appendicostomy.meta: Appendiks (ichakning ko‘r qismi) va tana yuzasi o‘rtasida vaqtinchalik yoki doimiy teshik (ochilish) hosil qilish uchun bajariladigan jarrohlik amaliyoti. Ushbu protsedura odatda ichakni tozalash yoki maxsus tibbiy maqsadlarda amalga oshiriladi.

ex: In some species, a small appendicula can be found near the digestive tract.
The structure was identified as an appendicula attached to the main organ.
appendicula.meta: Turli ma’nolarda ishlatiladigan kichik yoki qisqa appendiks (ichak yoki boshqa tuzilmalar qo‘shimchasi) yoki kichik qo‘shimcha. Bu atama appendicle so‘zi bilan sinonim.

ex: The funeral home now offers aquamation as an option for body disposition.
Aquamation is considered a more environmentally friendly alternative to cremation.
aquamation.meta: Inson yoki hayvon jasadini utilizatsiya qilish jarayoni bo‘lib, bunda tana kaliy gidroksid (yoki natriy gidroksid) va suv aralashmasida isitiladi. Ushbu jarayonda tana kimyoviy ravishda parchalanadi

ex: As the firstborn, he was recognized as the ariki of his family.
The ariki was responsible for leading important ceremonies in the community.
ariki.meta: Polineziyaning turli hududlarida: yuqori martabali boshliq yoki hukmdor; shuningdek, nufuzli oiladagi to‘ng‘ich farzand. Ariki odatda jamiyatda katta hurmatga ega va rahbarlik lavozimlarini egallaydi.

ex: She’s just a girl from around the way, nothing fancy.
I saw him around the way yesterday, just down the street.
around the way.meta: Yaqin joyda, ko‘chada, yaqin atrofda joylashgan; keyinchalik ko‘pincha kishining yashash joyi yoki ulg‘aygan hududiga nisbatan ishlatiladi: shu yerlar atrofida, mahalla yoki o‘z shahridan bo‘lgan.

ex: She’s an around the way girl, known and loved by everyone in the neighborhood.
He always said he wanted an around the way girl who understands his roots.
around the way girl.meta: O‘zi yashaydigan shahar, mahalla yoki yaqin hududdan bo‘lgan qiz yoki ayol; odatda soddaligi, samimiyligi, mahalliy tarbiya ko‘rganligi va o‘ziga xos jozibasi bilan tavsiflanadi.

ex: Artificial general intelligence would be able to solve problems across multiple domains without task-specific programming.
Scientists are working towards creating artificial general intelligence capable of human-like reasoning.
artificial general intelligence.meta: Shunday mashina, dastur yoki tizimki, u (nazariy jihatdan) inson darajasida yoki undan ham yuqori darajada aqlli xatti-harakatlarni ko‘rsatishi yoki simulyatsiya qilishi mumkin.

ex: The detective investigated the scene of the brutal axe murder.
The shocking axe murder terrified the small village.
axe murder.meta: Bolta yordamida qasddan odam o‘ldirish harakati yoki bu jinoyatning sodir etilishi.

ex: The film depicts the story of an axe-murdered family.
The victim was found axe-murdered in his home.
axe-murdered.meta: Boltaning yordamida o‘ldirilgan; bolta bilan qilingan qotillik natijasida halok bo‘lgan.

ex: Budget axing led to the cancellation of the project.
The company’s axing of several departments caused widespread concern.
axing.meta: Asl ma’nosi bolta bilan kesish harakati; hozirgi kunda asosan xodimlarni qisqartirish yoki xarajatlarni kamaytirish ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: Babyccinos are popular in family-friendly cafes.
She ordered a cappuccino for herself and a babyccino for her son.
babyccino.meta: Bolalar uchun mo‘ljallangan ichimlik bo‘lib, bug‘ yordamida ko‘pik hosil qilingan issiq sutdan iborat. Tashqi ko‘rinishi kapuchino ichimligiga o‘xshaydi, lekin tarkibida qahva bo‘lmaydi.

ex: Over time, the baby hair will be replaced by thicker hair.
The baby's baby hair was soft and curly.
baby hair.meta: Yangi tug‘ilgan chaqaloq boshida o‘sadigan, odatda yumshoq, nozik va ingichka sochlar. Ba’zan bu sochlar juda yengil va havoda tarqalib turuvchi bo‘ladi.

ex: The bac is a crucial qualification for French students pursuing higher education.
She passed her bac and applied to several universities.
bac.meta: O‘rta maktabni tamomlagan o‘quvchilarga universitetga kirish huquqini beruvchi turli malakalar; shuningdek, bu imtihon yoki bitiruv ishi orqali olinadigan rasmiy baho yoki diplom.

ex: Backfat adds flavor and moisture to sausages.
The butcher trimmed the excess backfat from the pork.
backfat.meta: Asosan hayvonning (keyinchalik ayniqsa cho‘chqaning) orqa qismida joylashgan yog‘ qavati. Shuningdek, ushbu yog‘ qatlamining bir bo‘lagi yoki parchasi ham shunday ataladi. Ba’zi oshxona madaniyatlarida bu yog‘ ovqat tayyorlashda ishlatiladi.

ex: He scored with a clever back header that surprised the goalkeeper.
The defender made a quick back header to clear the ball from danger.
back header.meta: Futbolda: o‘yinchi qaragan yo‘nalishining teskari tomonga bosh bilan zarba berish, pas uzatish yoki to‘pni uzoqlashtirish harakati.

ex: The back history of the town revealed a series of mysterious events.
The detective needed to understand the suspect’s back history before questioning him.
back history.meta: Muayyan shaxs, joy, voqea yoki hikoya bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan avvalgi voqealar; ushbu shaxs yoki narsaning ilgari sodir bo‘lgan tarixiga oid ma’lumotlar. Bu atama ko‘pincha back story (orqa hikoya) bilan yaqin ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: He quickly turned to the back page to check the sports results.
The advertisement was printed on the back page of the magazine.
back page.meta: Kitob, risola, gazeta va shunga o‘xshash nashrlarning oxirgi sahifasi yoki tashqi orqa sahifasi; (ko‘plikda) bunday nashrlarning so‘nggi bir necha sahifalari, ayniqsa gazetada odatda reklama, sport yoki boshqa ikkilamchi yangiliklar joylashadigan qism.

ex: The editor assigned him to write a back-pager about the local festival.
His story was featured as a back-pager in the Sunday newspaper.
back-pager.meta: Gazetaning orqa sahifasida joylashgan maqola; ilgari ayniqsa qisqa hikoya shaklida ham ishlatilgan.

ex: In rugby, back players are typically faster and more agile.
The back player made a crucial tackle to stop the opponent’s attack.
back player.meta: Sportda, ayniqsa regbida: maydon yoki kortning har ikki yarmi orqa qismida o‘ynaydigan, odatda himoya vazifasini bajaruvchi o‘yinchi.

ex: She was often teased for having what others called bad hair.
The term "bad hair" is offensive and rooted in harmful beauty standards.
bad hair.meta: Tug‘ma tarzda juda jingalak, qattiq yoki notekis soch turi bo‘lib, ba’zi jamiyatlarda nomaqbul yoki boshqarish qiyin deb noto‘g‘ri qaraladi. Bu tushuncha ko‘pincha ijtimoiy stereotiplar bilan bog‘liq va good hair tushunchasiga qarama-qarshi qo‘yiladi.

ex: All staff were instructed to barrier nurse those with contagious diseases.
The patient was barrier nursed to prevent the infection from spreading to others.
barrier nurse.meta: Infeksion kasallik tarqalishini oldini olish maqsadida bemorni maxsus izolyatsiya choralariga rioya qilgan holda parvarish qilish. Bu usulda sog‘liqni saqlash xodimlari maxsus himoya kiyimlari va sanitariya qoidalariga qat’iy amal qiladi.

ex: Proper barrier nursing requires strict hygiene and protective equipment.
Barrier nursing was implemented throughout the hospital during the outbreak.
barrier nursing.meta: Infeksion kasalliklarning bemorlar orasida tarqalishini oldini olishga qaratilgan parvarishlash usullari majmuasi.

ex: Battle fatigue can severely impact a soldier’s ability to function in combat.
The soldier was suffering from battle fatigue after months on the front lines.
battle fatigue.meta: Jang yoki urushda qatnashishdan kelib chiqadigan jismoniy va ruhiy charchoq; xususan, uzoq muddat jangovar vaziyatda bo‘lish natijasida yuzaga keladigan psixologik holat. Bu holat odatda doimiy stress, qo‘rquv va xavf ta’sirida rivojlanadi.

ex: In some songs, the term beezy is used to insult women.
He was warned not to call anyone a beezy because it’s offensive.
beezy.meta: Ko‘pincha salbiy yoki haqoratli ma’noda ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, yoqimsiz, yoqtirilmaydigan yoki jinsiy jihatdan erkin tutadigan deb qaraladigan ayol yoki qizga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: The bhuna was rich in spices and had a thick, savory sauce.
I ordered a chicken bhuna with naan bread for dinner.
bhuna.meta: Janubiy Osiyo (ayniqsa Hindiston va Pokiston) oshxonasida: ziravorlar va go‘sht yoki sabzavotlarni yuqori haroratda qovurib tayyorlanadigan taom. Ushbu usul natijasida qalin va mazali sous hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: A bidding war broke out over the rare painting at the auction.
The house was sold after a fierce bidding war between several buyers.
bidding war.meta: Ikki yoki undan ortiq tomon biror narsani sotib olish uchun bir-biridan yuqori takliflar berib, raqobatlashadigan holat. Odatda kim eng yuqori narxni taklif qilsa, o‘sha g‘olib bo‘ladi.

ex: The bifold doors open up to the garden, creating a large, open area.
We installed a bifold in the kitchen to save space.
bifold.meta: Ikki qismdan iborat bo‘lib, bo‘g‘inlar orqali bukiladigan eshik. Odatda ochilganda qog‘oz yoki garmon kabi bukilib ketadi va kam joy egallaydi.

ex: The athlete's big break came when he was selected for the national team.
She got her big break when she starred in a popular TV series.
big break.meta: Professional muvaffaqiyat yoki tan olinishga olib keladigan muhim imkoniyat; ayniqsa sport yoki ko‘ngilochar sohalarda kutilmagan katta imkon yoki burilish nuqtasi.

ex: She became a billionairess through her successful tech startup.
The young billionairess owns several international companies.
billionairess.meta: Kamida bir milliard dollar, funt yoki boshqa valyutada boylikka ega bo‘lgan ayol yoki qiz. Kengroq ma’noda: nihoyatda boy ayol.

ex: This technology could make data processing a billionfold faster.
The star's brightness increased a billionfold over time.
billionfold.meta: Ko‘pincha noaniq artikl bilan ishlatiladi. Ma’lum yoki tushunilgan miqdordan bir milliard marta ko‘p; bir milliardga bir nisbatda; milliardlab miqdorda.

ex: The ice cream is so binge-worthy that we finished the whole tub in one sitting.
These cookies are totally binge-worthy; I can’t stop eating them.
binge-worthy.meta: Oziq-ovqat yoki ichimlik haqida: juda mazali yoki zavqli bo‘lib, uni haddan tashqari ko‘p iste’mol qilish istagini uyg‘otuvchi.

ex: The street is always full of bins on bin night.
Don’t forget, tonight is bin night — take the rubbish out.
bin night.meta: Maishiy va tijorat chiqindilarini ertasi kuni yig‘ib ketish uchun tashqariga olib chiqish belgilangan kecha. Bu atama ko‘pincha bin day (chiqindi tashlash kuni) bilan bog‘liq.

ex: Biofabrication allows for the production of complex tissue structures.
Scientists are exploring biofabrication to create artificial organs.
biofabrication.meta: To‘qimalar, hujayralar, organik molekulalar va biomateriallardan tirik, biomolekulyar yoki qisman biologik tizimlar va mahsulotlarni ishlab chiqarish jarayoni; biologik tuzilmalarni texnologik usullar bilan yaratish.

ex: The phenomenon of black flight followed years of white flight in urban areas.
Black flight reshaped many suburban communities in the United States.
black flight.meta: Dastlab AQShda: qora tanli aholining shaharning markaziy hududlaridan ko‘proq farovon va boyroq shahar atrofidagi hududlarga ko‘chishi jarayoni.

ex: The old wall showed signs of blotchiness due to moisture.
The blotchiness on her skin was caused by an allergic reaction.
blotchiness.meta: Teri yoki boshqa yuzada notekis, joylari bo‘lak-bo‘lak yoki dog‘larcha joylashgan dog‘lar, notekis ranglar holati.

ex: Blunt force injuries often cause bruises and swelling.
The victim suffered blunt force trauma after being hit with a bat.
blunt force.meta: Teri yuzasiga kirib bormay, teri osti to‘qimalariga ta’sir qilmaydigan, zarba, to‘qnashuv yoki ta’sir natijasida yuzaga keladigan kuch.

ex: Blunt trauma can result in bruising, swelling, and internal bleeding.
The car accident caused blunt trauma to his chest and abdomen.
blunt trauma.meta: Teri osti to‘qimalariga kirib bormaydigan, urilish, to‘qnashuv yoki zarba natijasida tanada yuzaga keladigan jarohat, ko‘pincha tashqi va ichki shikastlanishlarga olib keladi.

ex: The deep, rhythmic sound of the bodhran adds a unique feel to the music.
The musician played the bodhran skillfully during the Irish folk concert.
bodhran.meta: Irland xalq musiqasida ishlatiladigan, o‘yinchining tizzasida ushlab o‘ynaladigan, qo‘l tizzasi yoki yog‘och tayoqcha bilan uriladigan baraban turidir.

ex: The bomb shelter was stocked with food and water in case of emergency.
During the air raid, the family took shelter in the bomb shelter.
bomb shelter.meta: Odatda yer ostida joylashgan, portlovchi qurollardan, xususan, samolyotdan tashlangan bombalardan odamlarni himoya qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan yopiq joy yoki bino.

ex: The wig was styled bone-straight to look natural.
She always wears her hair bone-straight without any curls.
bone-straight.meta: Soch yoki soch to‘ldiruvchi buyum, parik va hokazo uchun: butunlay tekis, jingalak yoki to‘lqinlarsiz.

ex: Saying “bore da” is a common way to say good morning in Wales.
He greeted me with a cheerful “bore da” this morning.
bore da.meta: Uels tilida ishlatiladigan, salomlashish yoki ba’zida xayrlashish ma’nosida ishlatiladigan so‘z; "hayrli tong" degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: She told all her secrets to her bosom buddy.
They have been bosom buddies since childhood.
bosom buddy.meta: Juda yaqin, samimiy va ishonchli do‘st.

ex: He learned to play several brass instruments, including the trombone and French horn.
The trumpet is a popular brass instrument in orchestras.
brass instrument.meta: Odatda misdan yasalgan, shamol asbobi bo‘lib, tovush ijrochining lablari titrab, havoni nayga yoki truba shaklidagi asbobga chiqarishi bilan hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: Brass knuckles are illegal in many countries because they can cause serious injury.
He used brass knuckles in the fight to increase the impact of his punches.
brass knuckles.meta: Qo‘l barmoqlari atrofiga kiyiladigan, odatda metall (misdan) yasalgan himoya vositasi bo‘lib, barmoqlarni himoya qiladi va urilganda zarbani kuchaytiradi.

ex: The table contains values of Briggsian logarithms for various numbers.
Briggsian logarithms are widely used in scientific calculations.
briggsian.meta: 10-asosli logarifmga tegishli yoki shunday logarifmlarga oid.

ex: He suffered severe burns after the fire accident.
Every year, Scots celebrate Burns with poetry readings and a special meal.
burns.meta: 25 yanvarga yaqin yoki shu kuni Skotland shoiri va qo‘shiq muallifi Robert Bernsning tavallud kunini nishonlash uchun o‘tkaziladigan tadbir.(koplik)Teri yoki to‘qimalarda issiqlik, olov, kimyoviy moddalar ta’sirida hosil bo‘lgan jarohatlar.

ex: The creamy texture of burrata makes it a favorite in Italian cuisine.
Burrata is often served fresh with tomatoes and basil.
burrata.meta: Italiya yumshoq oq pishlog‘i bo‘lib, nozik ta’mga ega. Odatda krem va mozzarella qatiq aralashmasi mozzarella pishlog‘i qobig‘iga o‘ralib tayyorlanadi.

ex: Designers often try to avoid camel toe in their clothing to ensure comfort and modesty.
Wearing very tight leggings can sometimes cause a camel toe effect.
camel toe.meta: Ayolning qin sohasiga juda mahkam yopishadigan shim, shortik va boshqa kiyimlar tufayli qinning tashqi qismining chizig‘i ko‘rinib qolishi holati.

ex: We went on a weekend camp-out in the mountains.
The group organized a camp-out in the park to raise awareness about environmental issues.
camp-out.meta: Odatda dam olish maqsadida yoki norozilik sifatida tashqarida, ochiq havoda tunda qolish yoki yashash holati.

ex: Her cancanning impressed the judges at the talent competition.
The dancers’ cancanning was the highlight of the show.
cancanning.meta: Kankan raqsi — bu kankan deb nomlanuvchi mashhur fransuzcha raqsni ijro etish harakati yoki holatidir. Ushbu raqs odatda yuqori energiyali, oyoqlarni baland ko‘tarib tepkilash va sinxron harakatlar bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: Only the toughest ships could become Cape Horners.
The old sailor was a proud Cape Horner, having rounded the Horn three times.
cape horner.meta: Keyp Horndan o‘tgan kemachi — bu Keyp Horn (Janubiy Amerikaning eng janubiy nuqtasi) atrofidan suzib o‘tgan yoki o‘tishni maqsad qilgan kema (ayniqsa yelkanli kema), yoki shu xavfli dengiz yo‘lidan o‘tgan insonni ifodalaydi.

ex: His expressions were so cartoony, it was hard to take him seriously.
The movie had a cartoony style that appealed to children.
