cartoony.meta: bu so‘z predmet, obraz yoki holatning multfilmdagidek bo‘rttirilgan, soddalashtirilgan va ko‘pincha kulgili tarzda tasvirlanganligini bildiradi. Reallikka yaqin bo‘lmagan, ammo yorqin, jozibali va ifodali bo‘lishi bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: A cease and desist order was issued against the illegal business.
The company received a cease and desist letter for copyright infringement.
cease and desist.meta: To‘xtatish va voz kechish buyrug‘i — sud yoki hukumat organi tomonidan chiqarilgan, shaxsni muayyan faoliyatni darhol to‘xtatishga majbur qiluvchi rasmiy va qonuniy kuchga ega buyruqni bildiradi.

ex: The tournament provided each player with a chess set and clock.
He bought a wooden chess set as a birthday gift.
chess set.meta: Shaxmat to‘plami — bu shaxmat o‘yinida ishlatiladigan 32 dona figuradan iborat to‘plam (har bir tomon uchun 16 tadan), ba’zida bu atama shaxmat taxtasi bilan birgalikdagi butun jamlanmani ham bildiradi.

ex: She liked the chewiness of the fresh bread crust.
The steak’s chewiness made it hard to eat without a knife.
chewiness.meta: Chaynalgulik xossasi — ovqatning chaynashni talab qiladigan darajada qattiq yoki qattiq-elastik tuzilishga ega bo‘lish holati. Bu sifat ko‘pincha go‘sht, saqich, non va shunga o‘xshash mahsulotlar uchun qo‘llaniladi.

ex: You praised everyone but me—what am I, chopped liver?
She served chopped liver on rye bread as an appetizer.
chopped liver.meta: Tug‘ralgan jigar pastasi — bu, asosan yahudiy oshxonasiga xos bo‘lgan taom bo‘lib, yog‘da qovurilgan jigar va piyoz, qaynatilgan tuxum bilan aralashtirib maydalangan holda tayyorlanadi. Ko‘pincha non ustiga surtib yeyiladi.

ex: The hospital hired a clinical psychologist to work with trauma patients.
She is seeing a clinical psychologist for anxiety and stress management.
clinical psychologist.meta: Klinik psixolog — bu ruhiy kasalliklar, emotsional muammolar va psixologik buzilishlarni aniqlash, baholash va davolash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi mutaxassis.

ex: clinical psychology focuses on diagnosing and treating mental disorders.
she studied clinical psychology at university to become a therapist.
clinical psychology.meta: bu ruhiy kasalliklar, emotsional buzilishlar va psixologik muammolarni aniqlash, baholash va davolash bilan shug‘ullanuvchi psixologiyaning sohasi. klinik psixologiya sog‘liqni saqlash, ruhiy salomatlik va psixoterapiya bilan bevosita bog‘liqdir.

ex: the clubbies gathered every friday for their regular game night.
he’s been a loyal clubbie at the tennis club for over ten years.
clubbie.meta: klub a’zosi — bu qandaydir klub (sport, ijtimoiy, madaniy yoki boshqa tashkilot)ga a’zo bo‘lgan shaxs. bu so‘z ko‘pincha norasmiy yoki do‘stona ohangda ishlatiladi.

ex: there was a certain clubbiness among the old staff that newcomers found hard to break into.
the clubbiness of the board made new members feel excluded.
clubbiness.meta: clubbiness — bu odamning o‘z guruhidagi yoki klubdagi a’zolar bilan do‘stona, yaqin va ochiq bo‘lishi, biroq guruhdan tashqaridagilar bilan bunday bo‘lmasligi holati. bu sifat ko‘pincha ijtimoiy yopiq guruhlar haqida gapirganda ishlatiladi.

ex: with many players still on the course, she remained the clubhouse leader.
he sat as the clubhouse leader after finishing his round at 5 under par.
clubhouse leader.meta: klub yetakchisi — golf turnirida birinchi yoki oraliq davralarni tugatgan va ayni paytda eng past (eng yaxshi) natijani qo‘lga kiritgan o‘yinchiga nisbatan ishlatiladigan atama.

ex: good clubmanship means supporting your fellow members and participating actively.
his clubmanship and dedication earned him the respect of all members.
clubmanship.meta: bu klub faoliyatlarida mohirona ishtirok etish, shuningdek, klub a’zosiga xos bo‘lgan ijobiy fazilatlar (hamjihatlik, sadoqat, madaniyat, odob)ni namoyon etish. bu atama, odatda, a’zolik madaniyatini, hurmat va faol ishtirokni ifodalaydi.

ex: after leaving the national team, she returned to her club side.
he plays for a top club side in the spanish league.
club side.meta: klub jamoasi — bu muayyan sport klubini ifodalovchi jamoa bo‘lib, odatda ichki (milliy) chempionat yoki ligalarda ishtirok etadi. bu atama milliy terma jamoalardan yoki yulduzlar jamoasidan farqli o‘laroq, bir klubga tegishli bo‘lgan jamoani anglatadi.

ex: you need to be clued-in to survive in this competitive industry.
she's really clued-in when it comes to the latest tech trends.
clued-in.meta: clued-in — bu biror mavzu yoki vaziyatdan yaxshi xabardor bo‘lgan, yangiliklardan boxabar, voqealarga moslashgan va zamonaviy bilimga ega odamni ifodalaydi. bu sifat, odatda, ogohlik va tez tushunish qobiliyatini anglatadi.

ex: he was accused of being colour-struck for making negative remarks about dark-skinned people.
some communities still suffer from being color-struck, favoring lighter skin tones.
colour-struck / color-struck.meta: colour-struck — bu, asosan qora tanlilar orasida, odamlarning teri rangi asosida kamsituvchi, xususan qoraroq terililarga nisbatan salbiy munosabatda bo‘lish holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: her sweater brought a sense of warmth and comfiness on a cold day.
i love the comfiness of this armchair — it’s perfect for reading.
comfiness.meta: comfiness — bu jismonan yoki ruhiy jihatdan o‘zini qulay, tinch, yoqimli va rohatda his qilish holati. bu holat yumshoq muhit, qulay kiyim, iliqlik yoki xavfsizlik bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.

ex: they acted confrontationally instead of trying to negotiate calmly.
he spoke confrontationally, challenging every point she made.
confrontationally.meta: bu qandaydir masalani hal qilishda yoki muomala qilishda ochiqdan-ochiq qarama-qarshilik, ziddiyat, yoki to‘qnashuv yo‘li bilan harakat qilish tarzini bildiradi. bu uslubda odamlar murosadan ko‘ra bahs, tortishuv yoki qarshilik orqali yechim izlaydi.

ex: not all prisons allow conjugal visits for inmates.
he was granted a conjugal visit with his wife after six months in prison.
conjugal visit.meta: turmush o‘rtog‘i bilan uchrashuv — avvaliga bu turmush o‘rtoklar o‘rtasidagi, ayniqsa jinsiy yaqinlik uchun mo‘ljallangan uchrashuvni bildirgan.

ex: conjugal visitation is not permitted in all prisons.
some countries allow conjugal visitation to help prisoners maintain family bonds.
conjugal visitation.meta: nikohiy uchrashuv — bu qamoqxona tizimida turmush o‘rtog‘i (yoki keyinchalik, hamkori) bilan maxfiy ravishda vaqt o‘tkazishga ruxsat etilgan uchrashuv bo‘lib, ko‘pincha jinsiy yaqinlik uchun mo‘ljallanadi.

ex: many jazz musicians in the 1940s had conked hairstyles.
he walked in with a sharp suit and perfectly conked hair.
conked.meta: conked — bu atama asosan tabiiy jingalak sochlarning kuchli (ko‘pincha gidroksidli) kimyoviy vositalar yordamida tekis holga keltirilganini bildiradi. shuningdek, bu uslubda yasalgan silliq, jilvali soch turmagi haqida ham qo‘llaniladi.

ex: the cosmic web shows how galaxies are not randomly scattered but form a vast interconnected structure.
scientists use supercomputers to simulate the formation of the cosmic web.
cosmic web.meta: koinot to‘ri — bu kuzatiladigan butun koinotning tuzilmasini ifodalaydi. u yulduz turkumlari va galaktika klasterlaridan tashkil topgan ulkan iplar (filamentlar) shaklida bo‘lib, ular orasida bo‘sh (void) hududlar joylashgan.

ex: the cosseted celebrity was used to luxury and special treatment.
he grew up as a cosseted only child, never having to lift a finger.
cosseted.meta: cosseted — bu so‘z haddan tashqari erkalatilib, ehtiyotkorlik bilan asrab-avaylangan, hatto me’yoridan ortiq g‘amxo‘rlik ko‘rsatilgan kishini yoki narsani ifodalaydi.

ex: crabmeat is a delicacy in many coastal cuisines.
she made a salad with fresh crabmeat and avocado.
crabmeat.meta: qisqichbaqa go‘shti — ovqat sifatida tayyorlanadigan yoki iste’mol qilinadigan qisqichbaqaning go‘shti. u ko‘pincha dengiz mahsulotlari tarkibida bo‘lib, salat, sho‘rva, sushi va boshqa taomlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: she received several crank calls in the middle of the night.
the police warned that crank calls to emergency services would be punished.
crank call.meta: crank call — bu atama kimnidur aldash, asabiga tegish yoki qo‘rqitish maqsadida qilingan telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘ini bildiradi. bu qo‘ng‘iroqlar odatda anonim bo‘ladi, qo‘ng‘iroq qiluvchi gapirmay qo‘yadi, yolg‘on ma’lumot beradi

ex: she was frightened by a crank caller who kept asking inappropriate questions.
the police tracked down the crank caller who was disturbing residents at night.
crank caller.meta: crank caller — bu birovni aldash, asabiga tegish yoki qo‘rqitish maqsadida telefon orqali qo‘ng‘iroq qiladigan shaxsdir. u ko‘pincha o‘zini tanishtirmaydi, yolg‘on gapiradi yoki nojoiz hazillar qiladi.

ex: fried crawdad is a local delicacy in southern U.S. cuisine.
they spent the afternoon catching crawdads in the creek behind the house.
crawdad.meta: crawdad — bu daryolar, soylar yoki boshqa chuchuk suv havzalarida yashovchi kichik qisqichbaqa turidir. u tashqi ko‘rinishi bilan kichik omar (lobster)ga o‘xshaydi va ko‘plab mintaqalarda ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilinadi.

ex: she cooked a big pot of spicy crawdaddies for the family dinner.
the kids caught a few crawdaddies in the shallow part of the stream.
crawdaddy.meta: crawdaddy — bu so‘z “crawdad” so‘zining boshqa, ayniqsa janubiy amerika mintaqalarida ishlatiladigan norasmiy shakli bo‘lib, daryo yoki boshqa chuchuk suv havzalarida yashaydigan, kichik omarga o‘xshash qisqichbaqa turini bildiradi

ex: he's acting a little cray today — must be the heat.
that party last night was totally cray!
cray.meta: cray — bu ingliz tilidagi “crazy” (telba, jinni) so‘zining qisqartirilgan va norasmiy shakli bo‘lib, odatda hazil aralash, biror narsa yoki kishining haddan tashqari g‘alati, aqldan ozgandek yoki sarguzashtli ekanligini ifodalaydi.

ex: there was a certain creakiness in his voice that revealed his age.
the creakiness of the old stairs made it impossible to sneak out unnoticed.
creakiness.meta: creakiness — bu biror narsaning (masalan, eshik, pol, yoki eski mebelning) harakatga keltirilganda yoki bosim ostida bo‘lganda baland va yoqimsiz qirsillovchi ovoz chiqarishga moyilligi yoki holatini ifodalaydi.

ex: his stare gave me a feeling of real creepiness.
there was a certain creepiness to the abandoned house at night.
creepiness.meta: creepiness — bu insonda qo‘rquv, xavotir yoki noqulaylik hissini uyg‘otadigan holat yoki sifat. Bu hissiyot ko‘pincha nimadandir bezovtalik, terida biror narsa sudralayotgandek tuyulish yoki nimadir noto‘g‘ri bo‘layotgandek sezgi orqali yuzaga keladi.

ex: crème anglaise is often served with fruit tarts or sponge cakes.
the chef poured warm crème anglaise over the chocolate cake.
crème anglaise.meta: tuxum sarig‘i, sut yoki qaymoq, shakar va vanildan tayyorlanadigan shirin, qaymoqsimon sous bo‘lib, asosan desertlarga qo‘shib iste’mol qilinadi. U juda yumshoq va qaymoqli tuzilishga ega bo‘lib, pishiriqlar va mevalar bilan yaxshi uyg‘unlashadi.

ex: his resistance made the cuffing more difficult for the arresting officers
the officer performed the cuffing quickly and professionally.
cuffing.meta: cuffing — bu shaxsning qo‘llariga kishan taqish yoki kishan bilan bog‘lash harakati yoki holatini anglatadi. Bu ko‘pincha huquqni muhofaza qilish organlari tomonidan jinoyatchilar yoki gumonlanuvchilarni hibsga olishda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: he wasn’t looking for anything serious, just someone for the cuffing season.
every year during cuffing season, dating apps see a spike in new users.
cuffing season.meta: cuffing season — odatda kuz va qish oylarida sodir bo‘ladigan davr bo‘lib, bu vaqtda odamlar yolg‘izlikdan qochish yoki iliqlik izlab, ko‘proq romantik munosabatlarga kirishishni istaydilar. Bu munosabatlar ba’zida vaqtinchalik bo‘lishi ham mumkin.

ex: in the 90s, dooky braids became a popular hairstyle among young girls.
she wore colorful beads on her dooky braids.
dooky braid.meta: dooky braid — odatda qora tanli odamlar orasida mashhur bo‘lgan soch turmagi bo‘lib, unda soch bir nechta bo‘limlarga ajratilib, har biri alohida va yo‘g‘on qilib o‘riladi. Bu o‘rimlar ko‘pincha uzun bo‘ladi va boncuk yoki soch bezaklari bilan bezatiladi.

ex: nobody likes a dry snitch in the crew — it ruins the trust.
he didn’t mean to be a dry snitch, but his comment got his friend in trouble.
dry snitch.meta: dry snitch — bu atama, ayniqsa qamoqxona yoki ko‘cha jargonida, boshqa bir kishining ustidan bilvosita, yashirincha yoki bexabar ko‘rinishda axborot bergan shaxsni anglatadi.

ex: dry snitching can get you in serious trouble in prison.
that was dry snitching — you just told the boss we were late without saying it outright.
dry snitching.meta: dry snitching — bu boshqalarning ustidan bevosita emas, bilvosita yoki yashirincha axborot berish harakati. Bu odam ko‘rinishda "xabar bermayotgan" bo‘lsa-da, gap-so‘zlari yoki harakatlari orqali boshqalarga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

ex: the gift box included an eau de parfum with floral notes.
she prefers eau de parfum because it lasts longer than eau de toilette.
eau de parfum.meta: eau de parfum — bu atirning bir turi bo‘lib, uning tarkibida efir moylari nisbatan yuqori miqdorda (odatda 10–20%) bo‘ladi. Toza parfumga (parfum) qaraganda efir moylari kamroq, lekin eau de toilette ga nisbatan ko‘proq.

ex: the post was full of dark jokes and insults — classic edgelord behavior.
don’t take him seriously — he’s just being an edgelord on that forum.
edgelord.meta: ayniqsa internetda, ataylab bahsli, keskin yoki xafa qiladigan fikrlar bildiradigan odam. Bu odamlar odatda e'tibor qozonish, boshqalarni hayratga solish yoki "shunchalik qiziqki, xavfli" degan taassurot qoldirish uchun bunday uslubda chiqish qiladi.

ex: the electrician wrapped the damaged cable with black electrical tape.
he used electrical tape to cover the exposed wires.
electrical tape.meta: elektr lentalar — bu elektr tokini o‘tkazuvchi simlar yoki materiallarni izolyatsiya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan yopishqoq lenta turi. Odatda vinil kabi dielektrik moddalardan tayyorlanadi va tok o‘tishini oldini olish uchun xizmat qiladi.

ex: you need a strong elevator pitch if you want to stand out at the startup event.
she gave a compelling elevator pitch to the investor during their elevator ride.
elevator pitch.meta: elevator pitch — bu qisqa va aniq taqdimot, odatda 30–60 soniya davom etadi, va maqsadi — potensial mijoz, investor yoki ish beruvchini qiziqtirib, o‘z g‘oyangiz, mahsulotingiz yoki xizmatlaringizni ishonchli va samarali tarzda tushuntirish.

ex: she had only one goal — to win.
he was going to speak — then suddenly stopped.
em dash.meta: em tire — bu yozuvda ishlatiladigan uzun tire belgisi (—) bo‘lib, odatda bir em kengligida bo‘ladi (bu "M" harfining kengligiga teng). Em tire matnda pauza, fikrda uzilish, yoki izohli qo‘shimchalarni ajratish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: every train has an emergency brake for passenger use during danger.+
he pulled the emergency brake when the main brakes failed.
emergency brake.meta: favqulodda tormoz — bu transport vositasini, masalan, avtomobil, avtobus yoki poyezdni to‘satdan yoki favqulodda holatda to‘xtatish uchun ishlatiladigan tormoz.

ex: misuse of the emergency cord can result in a fine.
a passenger pulled the emergency cord when someone fainted in the carriage.
emergency cord.meta: favqulodda shnuri — bu poyezd vagonlarida joylashgan, tortilganda favqulodda tormoz tizimini ishga tushiradigan arqon yoki tutqich. Odatda, bu vosita yong‘in, kasallik, to‘satdan xavf kabi holatlarda poyezdni tezda to‘xtatish uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: there was an emollience in his tone that calmed the angry crowd.
the emollience of the lotion soothed her dry skin.
emollience.meta: yumshoqlik — bu narsaning yoki harakatning yumshatuvchi, tinchlantiruvchi yoki yengil ta’sirga ega bo‘lish holati. Bu so‘z to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri (masalan, kremning tuzilmasi) va ko‘chma (masalan, ohangdor nutq) ma’nolarda ishlatiladi.

ex: appendices and notes are often found in the end matter of academic books.
the end matter includes a detailed bibliography and an index.
end matter.meta: kitob oxiri materiallari — bu kitobning asosiy matnidan keyin joylashadigan yordamchi materiallar bo‘lib, odatda ko‘rsatkich (indeks), adabiyotlar ro‘yxati (bibliografiya), ilovalar (appendikslar), lug‘at, eslatmalar kabi qismlardan iborat bo‘ladi.

ex: weather can affect the enjoyability of an outdoor event.
the enjoyability of the movie surprised everyone.
enjoyability.meta: yoqimlilik — bu biror narsa yoki holatning zavq berishi, yoqimli va maroqli bo‘lishi, kishiga rohat va huzur bag‘ishlashi holatidir.

ex: Unlike shaving, an epilator removes hair from the root.
She uses an epilator to keep her legs smooth.
epilator.meta: Epilyator — bu tanadagi ortiqcha tuklarni ildizi bilan sug‘urib olib tashlash uchun mo‘ljallangan vosita. Hozirda asosan elektr quvvatida ishlaydigan qurilma shaklida qo‘llaniladi. Tuklarni uzoq muddatga olib tashlaydi.

ex: They released their eponymously titled debut album in 2005.
The brand was eponymously named after its founder, Giorgio Armani.
eponymously.meta: Eponim tarzda — bu biror narsa yaratuvchisi, asoschisi yoki kashf etuvchisi nomi bilan nomlanganligini ifodalovchi holatni bildiradi. Ya’ni, bu so‘z biror narsa kimningdir ismi bilan atalganini ko‘rsatadi.

ex: In ergative–absolutive languages, the same form is used for the subject of "he sleeps" and the object of "he sees him".
Basque is an ergative–absolutive language.
ergative–absolutive.meta: Ergativ–absolyut — bu til tuzilmasini ifodalaydigan atama bo‘lib, unda bitimli (intransitiv) fe’lning egasi va bitimli (transitiv) fe’lning to‘ldiruvchisi grammatik jihatdan bir xil shaklda, transitiv fe’lning egasi esa boshqacha shaklda ifodalanadi.

ex: (adjective): The politician gave an exceptionalist speech about the country's global role.
(noun): He is an exceptionalist who believes in the uniqueness of American democracy.
exceptionalist.meta: Istisnochilik tarafdori — bu biror xalq, guruh, yoki mafkurani boshqalardan alohida, yagona, yoki namunali deb hisoblovchi shaxs. Shuningdek, bu tushuncha istisnochilik g‘oyasiga oid narsalarni ifodalash uchun sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: The children ran excitably towards the ice cream truck.
She spoke excitably about her trip to Paris.
excitably.meta: Hayajon bilan — bu qandaydir voqea yoki holatga haddan tashqari hissiy, jo‘shqin, yoki tez hayajonlanadigan tarzda munosabat bildirish holati. Odatda bu holat aniq seziladigan hissiyotlar orqali ifodalanadi.

ex: In some companies, employees feel a sense of expendability during layoffs.
The soldiers were treated with a sense of expendability by their superiors.
expendability.meta: bu biror narsa yoki kishining muqarrar qurbon qilinishi yoki yo‘qotilishi mumkinligi, chunki u zarur deb hisoblanmaydi yoki o‘rnini boshqa narsa bosishi mumkin deb qaraladi. Bu atama ko‘pincha harbiy, texnik, yoki iqtisodiy kontekstda ishlatiladi.

ex: He bought the tickets extortionately late, and they cost him double.
The restaurant charges extortionately for bottled water.
extortionately.meta: Haddan tashqari yoki asossiz darajada yuqori narxda, ko‘p miqdorda bajarilgan yoki belgilangan holat. Odatda narx yoki to‘lovlar uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: The activity of fibroblasts is crucial for tissue repair.
Fibroblasts produce collagen during the healing process.
fibroblast.meta: Mezenximal kelib chiqishga ega, odatda cho‘zilgan yoki yulduzsimon shakldagi, yirik yadroga ega bo‘lgan hujayralar guruhi.

ex: Modern fighter jets are equipped with advanced radar and missile systems.
The fighter jet soared through the sky at supersonic speed.
fighter jet.meta: Asosan havo janglari uchun mo‘ljallangan, reaktiv dvigatelli, juda yuqori tezlikda harakatlana oladigan harbiy samolyot.

ex: Once the money runs out, the project is finito.
The show is finito—time to go home.
finito.meta: Biror narsa tugaganini, yakuniga yetganini yoki nihoyasiga yetganini bildiruvchi so‘z. Ko‘pincha norasmiy yoki kinoyali uslubda ishlatiladi.

ex: It was a five-alarm situation—people were running everywhere!
The warehouse blaze turned into a five-alarm fire overnight.
five-alarm.meta: “Five-alarm” — odatda yong‘in xizmati tomonidan yong‘inning qanchalik jiddiyligini ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladigan atama. “Besh darajali yong‘in” juda katta va xavfli yong‘inni anglatadi, ko‘plab yong‘in ekipajlarining aralashuvini talab qiladi.

ex: A five-door model offers more practicality than a three-door version.
They bought a five-door hatchback for their growing family.
five-door.meta: Besh eshikli — odatda yo‘lovchilar uchun to‘rtta yon eshikka va orqa yuk joyiga kirish uchun yuqoriga ochiladigan katta orqa eshikka ega bo‘lgan avtomobil turi. Bu turdagi avtomobillar ko‘pincha xetchbek yoki krossover bo‘lishi mumkin

ex: She liked the fizziness of sparkling water over still water.
The fizziness of the soda made it very refreshing.
fizziness.meta: Gazlilik — suyuqlikning tarkibida gaz pufakchalari bo‘lishi holati; ichimlikning ko‘pikli yoki pufakli bo‘lish holati. Ko‘chma ma’noda — jonli, quvnoq, shodlik kayfiyati.

ex: I bought this jacket during an online flash sale.
The store is having a flash sale with up to 70% off on electronics.
flash sale.meta: Tezkor chegirma savdosi — juda qisqa vaqt davom etadigan va mahsulotlarga katta chegirmalar beriladigan savdo aksiyasi.

ex: He learned the skill of fletching from his grandfather, a master bowyer.
Traditional fletching involves gluing three feathers to the shaft of the arrow.
fletching.meta: O‘q patlash — o‘qlarga pat o‘rnatish harakati yoki san’ati; ilgari bu hunar sifatida bajarilgan. Hozirda ko‘proq o‘qning o‘zida mavjud patlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: She was considered a flight risk due to her dual citizenship and access to funds abroad.
The judge denied bail, saying the defendant was a flight risk.
flight risk.meta: Qochish xavfi — sud jarayonini kutayotgan yoki garov bilan ozod qilinishdan avval bo‘lgan shaxsning hududdan yashirinib ketishi ehtimoli; shuningdek, umumiy ma’noda qochishga moyil deb hisoblangan kishi

ex: Only flightworthy equipment is allowed on the test flight.
The plane was inspected thoroughly to ensure it was flightworthy.
flightworthy.meta: Parvozga yaroqli — havo kemasi, uning qismlari yoki uskunalari xavfsiz parvoz uchun texnik jihatdan to‘liq yaroqli holatda bo‘lishi. Ba’zan bu so‘z odamga nisbatan ham ishlatiladi: ya’ni jismoniy va ruhiy jihatdan uchishga tayyor bo‘lgan shaxs.

ex: Much of folk wisdom is based on generations of experience.
Folk wisdom says that eating garlic keeps you healthy.
folk wisdom.meta: Xalq donishmandligi — oddiy odamlardan kelib chiqqan, avloddan-avlodga o‘tib kelayotgan hayotiy tajriba, kuzatuv va e’tiqodlarga asoslangan bilimlar majmuasi.

ex: Food sovereignty allows communities to decide what crops to grow and how to distribute them.
The movement for food sovereignty emphasizes local farming and traditional agricultural practices.
food sovereignty.meta: Oziq-ovqat suvereniteti — davlat yoki jamoaning o‘zining oziq-ovqat tizimi, ishlab chiqarish siyosati ustidan to‘liq nazorat o‘rnatish huquqi va imkoniyatiga ega bo‘lishi; oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarini ishlab chiqarish va taqsimlashda mustaqil bo‘lish holati.

ex: When he speaks, everyone listens. He’s a force of nature.
She’s a true force of nature—no challenge can stop her.
force of nature.meta: Tabiat kuchi kabi inson — shunday bir odamki, u o‘zining kuchli energiyasi, jozibasi va qat’iyati bilan boshqalarga kuchli ta’sir o‘tkazadi; bunday odamni inkor etish, e’tibordan chetda qoldirish yoki qarshilik ko‘rsatish juda qiyin bo‘ladi.

ex: If an app isn’t responding, you can force quit it by pressing Ctrl + Alt + Delete.
The browser froze, so I had to force quit it.
force quit.meta: Majburan yopmoq — kompyuterda javob bermayotgan yoki ishdan to‘xtab qolgan dastur yoki ilovani klaviatura tugmalari yoki buyruq orqali majburan yopish harakati.

ex: She looked stunning in her black formalwear at the gala.
The invitation specifies formalwear, so I’ll wear a tuxedo.
formalwear.meta: Rasmiy kiyim — turli tantanali tadbirlar, rasmiy uchrashuvlar yoki kechki marosimlar uchun mos bo‘lgan kiyim-kechak; odatda, erkaklar uchun smoking yoki kostyum-shim, ayollar uchun esa kechki liboslar (gown) nazarda tutiladi.

ex: Many children in foster care hope to be adopted one day.
After his parents passed away, he was placed in foster care.
foster care.meta: Foster care — bu bolaning ota-onasi vafot etgan yoki unga g‘amxo‘rlik qila olmaydigan holatlarda, davlat yoki maxsus tashkilotlar tomonidan uni boshqa oilaga vaqtincha tarbiyaga yoki vasiylikka berish tizimi.

ex: Many foster families provide love and stability to children in need.
He was raised by a foster family after his mother became ill.
foster family.meta: Foster family — bu ota-onasi vafot etgan yoki bolaning parvarishiga qodir bo‘lmagan holatlarda, unga vaqtincha g‘amxo‘rlik qilish va tarbiyalash uchun mas’uliyatni o‘z zimmasiga olgan oila.

ex: She regularly freecycles clothes her children have outgrown.
I decided to freecycle my old desk instead of throwing it away.
freecycle.meta: Freecycle — bu foydalanilmayotgan yoki keraksiz bo‘lib qolgan narsani sotmasdan yoki tashlab yubormasdan, uni boshqalarga bepul berish harakati, ayniqsa, bu internetdagi maxsus guruhlar yoki platformalar orqali amalga oshirilganda.

ex: She got her dining table through a freecycling group on Facebook.
Freecycling is a great way to reduce waste and help others.
freecycling.meta: Freecycling — bu foydalanilmayotgan yoki endi kerak bo‘lmagan narsalarni boshqalarga bepul berish jarayoni bo‘lib, odatda internet orqali (masalan, maxsus guruhlar yoki platformalar orqali) tashkil etiladi.

ex: The guitar’s fretboard is made of rosewood.
He pressed the string against the fretboard to play a G chord.
fretboard.meta: Fretboard — bu gitara yoki boshqa torli cholg‘ularda tovush balandligini o‘zgartirish uchun torlar bosiladigan va lad (metall chiziqlar) bilan ajratilgan taxtacha. U odatda asbobning bo‘yin (g‘ilof) qismida joylashadi.

ex: Amazon's fulfilment centres operate around the clock.
The company opened a new fulfilment centre to speed up delivery times.
fulfilment centre / fulfillment centre.meta: Buyurtmalarni bajarish markazi — bu omborxona bo‘lib, u yerda mahsulotlar qadoqlanadi va mijozlarning, ayniqsa onlayn buyurtmalari asosida, jo‘natiladi. Bunday markazlar elektron tijorat (e-commerce)da muhim rol o‘ynaydi.

ex: The runway was full of glamazons towering in heels.
She walked into the room like a true glamazon—confident and radiant.
glamazon.meta: bu baland bo‘yli, jozibali (glamurli) ayolga nisbatan qo‘llaniladigan atama. Keyinchalik bu so‘z nafaqat tashqi ko‘rinishi, balki kuchi, o‘z fikrini ochiq ayta olishi, qat’iyatliligi bilan ajralib turadigan ayollarni ham ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: She carried herself with a glamorousness that was hard to ignore.
The actress's glamorousness captivated everyone at the event.
glamorousness.meta: Jozibadorlik — odamga yoqimli, chiroyli va hayratomuz taassurot qoldiradigan holat; tashqi ko‘rinishdagi nafislik, chiroy, zamonaviylik yoki o‘ziga xos shukuh bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan sifat.

ex: The reality of being a writer is often far more glamourless than people think.
He worked a glamourless job in a windowless basement office.
glamourless.meta: Jozibadorsiz — o‘zida hech qanday nafislik, chiroy, o‘ziga xoslik yoki hayajon uyg‘otmaydigan; oddiy, zerikarli va jozibasi yo‘q holat.

ex: Each glampsite includes a private bathroom and a cozy bed.
We booked a weekend at a remote glampsite in the mountains.
glampsite.meta: Hashamatli lager joyi — tabiiy muhitda, ochiq havoda tashkil etilgan, lekin oddiy lagerdan farqli ravishda zamonaviy qulayliklar (yumshoq yotoqlar, elektr, hammom, internet va boshqalar) bilan ta’minlangan dam olish maskani.

ex: The band’s glam rocker style included glittery outfits and heavy makeup.
David Bowie was one of the most influential glam rockers of the 1970s
glam rocker.meta: Glam rok ijrochisi — 1970-yillarda mashhur bo‘lgan glam rok uslubida kuylovchi musiqachi; odatda yorqin, jozibali kiyimlar, bo‘yanish va sahnadagi dramatik chiqishlari bilan ajralib turadi. Ba’zida bu atama glam rok qo‘shig‘iga ham nisbatan ishlatiladi.

ex: Hair gel can give a wet look or a firm hold depending on the type.
He used hair gel to keep his hair spiked all day.
hair gel.meta: Soch geli — soch turmagini shakllantirish yoki uni ma’lum bir holatda ushlab turish uchun ishlatiladigan jel konsistensiyasidagi kosmetik vosita. Bu vosita orqali sochni jilvirli, tik turgan yoki silliq ko‘rinishda saqlab turish mumkin.

ex: The moon hung in the sky, pale and half-waxen.
The sailors caught a half-waxen stockfish, not fully matured.
half-waxen.meta: Half-waxen — tarixiy jihatdan, asosan quritilgan baliq (masalan, stockfish) haqida aytilib, hali to‘liq yetilmagan yoki o‘sishda bo‘lgan degan ma’noni bildirgan (hozirda eskirgan).

ex: Unlike native ladybirds, the harlequin ladybird comes in many color variations.
The harlequin ladybird has spread rapidly across Europe.
harlequin ladybird.meta: Harlekin qo‘ng‘izi — Harmonia axyridis turiga mansub qo‘ng‘iz bo‘lib, dastlab Sharqiy Osiyoda yashagan, lekin boshqa hududlarga ham ko‘chirilgan. U o‘zining turli xil rang va naqshlari bilan ajralib turadi.

ex: Under the heat dome, the air becomes stagnant, making it feel even hotter.
A massive heat dome over the western U.S. caused record-breaking temperatures.
heat dome.meta: Issiqlik gumbazi — muayyan geografik hudud ustida uzoq vaqt davomida saqlanib qoluvchi yuqori bosimli ob-havo tizimi bo‘lib, u ostidagi issiq havoni “tutib qoladi” va bu esa odatdagidan ancha yuqori haroratlarga olib keladi.

ex: He drives an HGV for a logistics company.
Only heavy goods vehicles are allowed on this industrial route.
heavy goods vehicle.meta: Og‘ir yuk tashuvchi transport vositasi — og‘ir yuklarni, ayniqsa, katta miqdordagi tovar yoki yuklarni yo‘l orqali tashishga mo‘ljallangan katta yuk mashinasi yoki yuk avtomobili. Ko‘pincha katta yuk mashinalari (fura, treyler) tushuniladi.

ex: That car looks expensive, but he still lives with his mom—classic hood rich behavior.
He just got his first paycheck and already bought a gold chain—he’s trying to be hood rich.
hood rich.meta: ba'zida kamsituvchi ma'noda ishlatiladi. Bu atama odatda ko‘p pul sarflab, hashamatli, dabdabali turmush tarzini namoyish qiladigan, lekin boyligi barqaror yoki uzoq muddatli bo‘lmasligi mumkin bo‘lgan odamlarni tasvirlashda qo‘llanadi.

ex: I added a spoonful of horseradish sauce to give the sandwich some extra kick.
Horseradish sauce is a perfect complement to roast beef.
horseradish sauce.meta: maydalangan xren ildizi (tishqon) asosida tayyorlanadigan ziravorli sous bo‘lib, odatda smetana yoki qaymoq bilan aralashtiriladi. An’anaviy tarzda qovurilgan mol go‘shti (roast beef) bilan tortiladi. Bu sous o‘tkir va achchiq ta’mga ega bo‘ladi.

ex: The actor’s hunkiness was a major reason for his casting in the action film.
His hunkiness made him popular among fans.
hunkiness.meta: Baquvvat joziba — erkak kishining jismonan baquvvatligi, jozibador tashqi ko‘rinishi va jinsiy jihatdan o‘ziga tortuvchi bo‘lishi kabi xususiyatlarini ifodalaydi.

ex: As an implementer, her role was to ensure that every step of the strategy was followed.
The project failed not because of the idea, but due to a lack of competent implementers.
implementer.meta: Amalga oshiruvchi — qaror, reja, bitim yoki boshqa harakat dasturini hayotga tatbiq qiluvchi shaxs yoki tashkilot. U odatda tashabbus egasi emas, balki belgilangan topshiriq yoki rejani amalga oshiruvchi sifatida harakat qiladi.

ex: That was inarguably the best performance of the evening.
Inarguably, she is one of the greatest writers of our time.
inarguably.meta: Shubhasiz — hech qanday tortishuv yoki inkor etishga o‘rin qoldirmasdan, hammaga ayon bo‘lgan holda; inkor qilib bo‘lmaydigan tarzda. Bu so‘z odatda bir gapning to‘g‘riligi yoki haqiqat ekanligini qat’iy ko‘rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: He joined an independentist movement campaigning for the region’s autonomy.
The independentists organized a protest demanding a referendum on statehood.
independentist.meta: Mustaqillik tarafdori — biror hudud yoki davlatning siyosiy mustaqilligini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxs; hududning ajralib chiqib, o‘zini mustaqil davlat sifatida tan olishini istaydigan yoki bu yo‘lda faoliyat yuritadigan shaxs.

ex: An independentista party won a majority in the regional parliament.
The independentistas in Catalonia continue to push for full independence from Spain.
independentista.meta: asosan ispan tilida so‘zlashuvchi mintaqalarda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, hozirda mustaqil bo‘lmagan davlat yoki hududning siyosiy mustaqilligini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi shaxsni anglatadi; yoki bu g‘oyani ifodalaydigan harakatga oid.

ex: (adjective): The Indo cuisine blends Dutch and Indonesian flavors.
(noun): Many Indos migrated to the Netherlands after Indonesian independence.
indo.meta: Indo — asosan sobiq Gollandiya Sharqiy Hindistonida (hozirgi Indoneziya) ishlatilgan atama bo‘lib, odatda Yevropalik (ko‘pincha gollandiyalik) va Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyolik (ko‘pincha malay) ajdodlarga ega bo‘lgan aralash millatli kishilarni anglatadi.

ex: (noun): The UK has a large Indo-Asian population.
(adj.): Indo-Asian cuisine is known for its rich spices and flavors.
indo-asian.meta: Indo-osiyolik — Janubiy Osiyo mintaqasiga (ba’zan unga yaqin Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo davlatlarini ham o‘z ichiga olgan holda) tegishli yoki shu hudud bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan narsa, shaxs yoki madaniyatni ifodalaydi.

ex: Scientists study Indo-Australian fauna to understand species migration.
The Indo-Australian region has a unique biodiversity found nowhere else on Earth.
indo-australian.meta: Indo-avstraliyalik — Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyo materigi bilan Shimoliy Avstraliya o‘rtasidagi ko‘plab orollarni o‘z ichiga olgan biogeografik hududga oid bo‘lgan.

ex: Many Indo-Caribbean people trace their roots back to Indian indentured laborers.
Indo-Caribbean cuisine blends Indian spices with Caribbean flavors.
indo-caribbean.meta: Indo-kariblik — Janubiy Osiyo (asosan Hindiston) ajdodlariga ega bo‘lgan Karib mintaqasi aholisi yoki ushbu insonlarga, ularning madaniyati, urf-odatlari va hayot tarziga oid bo‘lgan tushuncha.

ex: Indo-Islamic culture flourished under the Mughal dynasty.
The Taj Mahal is a masterpiece of Indo-Islamic architecture.
indo-islamic.meta: Indo-islomiy — Janubiy Osiyoga, xususan Mug‘allar imperiyasi davridagi islom hukmronligi davriga oid yoki tegishli bo‘lgan; ayniqsa, islomiy va hindcha uslublarni uyg‘unlashtirgan me’moriy uslubni ifodalaydi.

ex: The musician showcased his unique style in an Indo-jazz concert.
Indo-jazz combines the rhythms of jazz with traditional Indian melodies.
indo-jazz.meta: Jazz va an'anaviy hind musiqasi elementlarini o'zida jamlagan musiqa uslubi. Shuningdek, bu so'z birikmasi dastlab sifatdosh sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: Many unique species of plants and animals are native to the Indo-Malaysian area.
The Indo-Malaysian region is known for its rich biodiversity.
indo-malaysian.meta: Janubiy va Janubi-Sharqiy Osiyoning ko‘pchilik qismini, jumladan Hindiston, Janubiy Xitoy, Filippinlar va boshqa hududlarni o‘z ichiga olgan biogeografik mintaqani ifodalovchi so‘z.

ex: many artifacts from the indo-parthian period have been discovered by archaeologists.
the indo-parthian kingdom existed in parts of modern iran and afghanistan.
indo-parthian.meta: asosan ko‘plikda ishlatiladi. hozirgi sharqiy eron, afg‘oniston, pokiston va shimol-g‘arbiy hindistonning baʼzi qismlariga to‘g‘ri keladigan hududning aholisi yoki unga oid.

ex: the contract contained several infringeable clauses that worried the parties.
some rules are infringeable if not properly enforced.
infringeable.meta: buzilishi, sindirilishi yoki qo‘pol tarzda buzilishi mumkin bo‘lgan (qonun, huquq yoki qoidalar haqida).

ex: animals instinctually know how to find food and shelter.
the mother instinctually protected her child from danger.
instinctually.meta: tabiiy instinkt yoki impuls asosida, ichki sezgi bilan amalga oshiriladigan harakat.

ex: the problems are interconnected, so solving one helps with others.
the internet is a vast and interconnected network.
interconnected.meta: bir-biri bilan murakkab yoki o‘zaro bog‘liq tarzda bog‘langan yoki ulangan; o‘zaro bog‘langan qismlardan tashkil topgan.

ex: understanding the interconnectivity of ecosystems is important for environmental protection.
the interconnectivity of modern devices makes communication easier.
interconnectivity.meta: o‘zaro bog‘langanlik xususiyati yoki holati; narsalarning bir-biriga qanchalik bog‘langan yoki ulangan darajasi.

ex: many historians discuss the problematic nature of the jig show performances.
the jig show was a popular form of entertainment in early 20th century america.
jig show.meta: keyingi davrlarda ko‘pincha kamsituvchi va haqoratli deb hisoblanishi mumkin bo‘lgan atama. Afro-amerikalik artistlar tomonidan, ayniqsa karnaval, sirk yoki davlat yarmarkalarida o‘tkazilgan revyu, minstrel-shou yoki turli ko‘ngilochar chiqishlar.

ex: some performers demonstrated the six-count jig walk step with great skill.
the jig walk was once a popular dance style to ragtime music.
jig walk.meta: keyingi davrlarda ko‘pincha kamsituvchi va haqoratli deb hisoblanishi mumkin bo‘lgan atama. Dastlab: ragtime musiqasi ohangida ijro etiladigan, burilishli qadamlar va silliq harakatlar bilan ajralib turadigan raqs turi.

ex: she dreamed of being a jillionaire with endless wealth.
the billionaire joked that he wanted to become a jillionaire one day.
jillionaire.meta: nihoyatda katta, ayniqsa, cheksiz yoki aniq hisoblab bo‘lmaydigan boylikka ega bo‘lgan kishi.

ex: many volunteers participate in kar seva as a way to give back to society.
the community came together for a day of kar seva to repair the temple.
kar seva.meta: boshqalarga ixtiyoriy qo‘l mehnati orqali xizmat qilish harakati yoki amaliyoti, ayniqsa binolarni qurish, tiklash yoki ta’mirlash ishlari bilan bog‘liq.

ex: sometimes you have to be careful, knowwhaddamean?
he was talking about the problem, knowwhaddamean?
knowwhaddamean.meta: odatda noaniq, ehtiyotkor yoki muloyim gapirganda, o‘z fikringiz tushunilgan-chi tushunilmaganini so‘rash uchun ishlatiladi; «(agar) nima demoqchimanki, tushundingmi?» ma’nosida.

ex: in the long scale system, a billion equals one million millions.
the long scale is used in many european countries for large numbers.
long scale.meta: milliondan kattaroq o‘nlik darajalarini nomlash tizimi bo‘lib, har bir yangi atama oldingisidan 1 000 000 marta katta hisoblanadi; masalan, milliard bu millionning 1 000 000 baravaridir.

ex: scientists study megadroughts to understand their impact on ecosystems.
the region experienced a megadrought that lasted for over a decade.
megadrought.meta: juda kuchli qurg‘oqchilik; ayniqsa, ko‘p yillar davom etadigan, davomiyligi, hududi yoki qattiqligi odatdagi tarixiy qurg‘oqchilikdan ancha oshib ketgan qurg‘oqchilik holati.

ex: children laughed when they heard the goat mehh loudly.
the lamb went "mehh" as it followed its mother.
mehh.meta: qo‘ylarning belgi ovozini ifodalovchi so‘z. taqqoslash uchun: maa (qo‘ylarning ovozi).

ex: health authorities monitor mpox outbreaks to prevent widespread infection.
mpox is a viral disease that can spread from animals to humans.
mpox.meta: kichik qorayish (smallpox) kasalligiga o‘xshash kasallik bo‘lib, orthopoksvirus tomonidan yuzaga keladi; bu virus g‘arbiy va markaziy Afrikada turli xil kemiruvchilar, maymunlar va o‘rmon maymunlari orasida mahalliy hisoblanadi.

ex: many fighters train in muay thai to improve their combat skills.
muay thai is known for its powerful strikes using elbows and knees.
muay thai.meta: taylanddan kelib chiqqan jang san’ati sporti bo‘lib, unda ishtirokchi raqibga barmoqlar, tirsaklar, oyoqlar, sonlar yoki tizzalar bilan urish huquqiga ega. taqqoslash uchun: thai boxing.

ex: linguists study mundari to understand the austro-asiatic language family.
mundari is spoken by many indigenous people in jharkhand.
mundari.meta: janubiy osiyoda, asosan hindistonning sharqiy qismidagi jharkhand shtatida so‘zlashiladigan, shimoliy munda guruhiga mansub avstro-osiyatik til.

ex: sometimes you have to be subtle, nah mean?
he explained the plan, nah mean?
nah mean.meta: odatda noaniq, ehtiyotkor yoki muloyim gapirganda, o‘z fikringiz tushunilgan-chi tushunilmaganini so‘rash uchun ishlatiladi; «(agar) nima demoqchimanki, tushundingmi?» ma’nosida.

ex: many countries adopted neoliberalism policies in the late 20th century.
neoliberalism emphasizes free market capitalism and limited government intervention.
neoliberalism.meta: an'anaviy liberalizmning turli o‘zgartirilgan yoki qayta jonlangan shakllaridan biri bo‘lib, odatda bozor iqtisodining erkinligi va shaxsiy huquqlariga ishonchga asoslanadi.

ex: non-monogamous couples communicate openly about their boundaries.
some people prefer non-monogamous relationships to traditional monogamy.
non-monogamous.meta: monogamiyaga rioya qilmaydigan yoki monogamiya bilan tavsiflanmaydigan. keyingi ishlatilishlarda ayniqsa: faqat bitta sherik bilan cheklanmagan romantik yoki jinsiy munosabatlarga oid.

ex: the book discusses the challenges of non-monogamy in modern relationships.
non-monogamy is practiced in various cultures around the world.
non-monogamy.meta: bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta turmush o‘rtog‘i yoki sherigi bo‘lish an’anasi yoki amaliyoti. keyingi ishlatilishlarda ayniqsa: bir nechta romantik yoki jinsiy munosabatlarni bir vaqtning o‘zida yuritish printsipi yoki amaliyoti.

ex: the study of bones through osteoarchaeology provides insights into past diets and diseases.
osteoarchaeology helps researchers learn about ancient human populations.
osteoarchaeology.meta: suyaklarning, ayniqsa arxeologik qazilma joylaridan topilgan inson skelet qoldiqlarining ilmiy o‘rganilishi; arxeologiyaning shu sohasiga oid tarmoq.

ex: she prefers to wear parfum for special occasions.
parfum has a stronger and longer-lasting scent than eau de toilette.
parfum.meta: atir formulasi bo‘lib, unda eng yuqori konsentratsiyadagi hid beruvchi efir moylari mavjud. taqqoslash uchun: eau de parfum, eau de toilette.

ex: scientists study pyrocumulus clouds to understand fire behavior and weather patterns.
the wildfire produced a massive pyrocumulus cloud visible from miles away.
pyrocumulus.meta: suv bug‘ining kondensatsiyasi natijasida hosil bo‘lgan kумулус bulutining bir turi bo‘lib, u katta olov yoki vulqon otilishi natijasida yuqoriga ko‘tarilgan issiq, chang bilan to‘ldirilgan havoda shakllanadi.

ex: she ordered a cold glass of red drink to refresh herself.
red drink is popular in many soul food restaurants in the southern united states.
red drink.meta: turli xil qizil rangli, alkogolsiz ichimliklardan biri bo‘lib, odatda shirin (yoki shirin va nordon aralash) ta’mga ega; ayniqsa, soul food restoranlarida xizmat qilinadigan ichimlik.

ex: many remoaners continued to campaign for closer ties with the eu.
the remoaners expressed disappointment after the brexit vote.
remoaner.meta: brexit referendumida buyuk britaniyaning yevropa ittifoqida qolishini qo‘llab-quvvatlagan yoki shunga ovoz bergan shaxs

ex: the residential school provides both education and accommodation.
many students live at the residential school during the academic year.
residential school.meta: o‘quvchilar yashash uchun maktab hududida qoladigan maktab; keyingi ishlatilishda ba’zida maxsus yordamga muhtoj bolalar uchun internat maktabi nazarda tutiladi.

ex: the body was disposed of through resomation in a controlled facility.
resomation is considered an environmentally friendly alternative to cremation.
resomation.meta: inson yoki hayvon qoldiqlarini yo‘q qilish jarayoni bo‘lib, unda jasadlar kaliy (yoki natriy) gidroksidi va suv aralashmasiga solinib, isitiladi.

ex: you need some savviness to navigate complex social situations.
her business savviness helped the company grow rapidly.
savviness.meta: umumiy fikr, amaliy aql, zukkolik; shuningdek, bunday qobiliyatning namoyon bo‘lishi.

ex: this old watch has great sentimental value to me because it belonged to my grandfather.
many people keep items with sentimental value even if they are not expensive.
sentimental value.meta: biror narsaning shaxsiy yoki hissiy bog‘lanishlar tufayli egallagan ahamiyati yoki qimmati; uning moddiy yoki moliyaviy qiymatidan ko‘ra ko‘proq shaxsiy his-tuyg‘ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan qiymat.

ex: the set list included both new songs and old favorites.
the band prepared their set list for the concert carefully.
set list.meta: biror shaxs yoki guruh ma’lum bir jonli tadbirda ijro etmoqchi bo‘lgan qo‘shiqlar, musiqa asarlari va hokazolar ro‘yxati; bir to‘plamni tashkil etuvchi asarlar ro‘yxati.

ex: coaches spend a lot of time practicing set plays before matches.
the team scored a goal from a well-executed set play.
set play.meta: oldindan rejalashtirilgan yoki mashq qilingan harakat, ijro yoki strategiya. hozirda ayniqsa sportda: diqqat bilan tashkil etilgan va mashq qilingan o‘yin yoki taktika.

ex: hormone therapy is often part of the sex reassignment process.
sex reassignment surgery can help transgender individuals align their physical characteristics with their gender identity.
sex reassignment.meta: tug‘ilishda shaxsga rasmiy ravishda berilgan jinsni o‘zgartirish; odatda gormonal terapiya va jinsiy a’zolarni jarrohlik yo‘li bilan o‘zgartirishni o‘z ichiga olgan davolash jarayoni.

ex: many organizations promote sexual equality in the workplace.
sexual equality is essential for building a fair and just society.
sexual equality.meta: jinsidan qat’i nazar, boshqalar bilan teng huquq va imkoniyatlarga ega bo‘lish holati yoki haqiqat; imkoniyatlarga teng kirish ta’minlangan vaziyat.

ex: hormone therapy is a key part of sexual reassignment treatment.
sexual reassignment procedures help transgender individuals align their bodies with their gender identity.
sexual reassignment.meta: tug‘ilishda shaxsga rasmiy ravishda berilgan jinsni o‘zgartirish; odatda gormonal terapiya va jinsiy a’zolarni jarrohlik yo‘li bilan o‘zgartirishni o‘z ichiga olgan davolash jarayoni.

ex: education about sexual rights is important for promoting health and equality.
sexual rights include the freedom to choose one’s partner and decide about contraception.
sexual rights.meta: shaxslarning jinsiy faoliyat va ko‘payish bilan bog‘liq shaxsiy qarorlarni boshqarish va qabul qilish huquqlari.

ex: don’t pay attention to his shit talk; he tends to exaggerate.
he was known for his shit talk during the game to distract opponents.
shit talk.meta: qo‘pol sleng. Rost bo‘lmagan, samimiy bo‘lmagan yoki ortiqcha aytilgan gaplar. shuningdek, kimnidir yoki nimanidir kuchli tanqid qilish yoki kamsitish ma’nosida.

ex: the shit talker spread false rumors about his colleagues.
don’t listen to him, he’s just a shit talker trying to cause trouble.
shit talker.meta: qo‘pol sleng. yolg‘on gapiruvchi, ortiqcha gapiruvchi yoki ahmoqona gapiruvchi shaxs. shuningdek, kimnidir tahdid qilish, kamsitish yoki hujum qilish maqsadida zararli yoki haqoratli so‘zlar aytuvchi odam.

ex: he was known for his shit talking before every match.
shit talking is common in competitive sports to unsettle opponents.
shit talking.meta: qo‘pol sleng, asosan AQShda ishlatiladi. raqibni ruhiy tushkunlikka solish, qo‘rqitish yoki kamsitish uchun qo‘pol yoki haqoratli til ishlatish. shuningdek, umumiy ma’noda: keraksiz yoki zararli gaplarni aytish harakati.

ex: in the short scale, a billion equals one thousand million.
the short scale is commonly used in the united states for large numbers.
short scale.meta: milliondan kattaroq o‘nlik darajalarini nomlash tizimi bo‘lib, har bir yangi atama oldingisidan 1 000 marta katta hisoblanadi; masalan, milliard — ming millionga teng.

ex: companies use shrinkflation as a way to manage rising production costs without raising prices.
many consumers don’t notice shrinkflation when product sizes get smaller but prices stay the same.
shrinkflation.meta: chakana mahsulotlar, ayniqsa qadoqlangan oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining hajmi yoki og‘irligining kamayishi, narxi esa o‘zgarmas qolishi holati.

ex: many companies allow employees to take sick days without penalty.
she took a sick day because she had a high fever.
sick day.meta: dastlab: insonning o‘zini yomon his qilgan har qanday kun. keyingi ishlatilishda ayniqsa: kasallik sababli ish yoki maktabdan qatnashmaydigan kun.

ex: feeling tired is a sign that your sleep pressure is high.
sleep pressure increases the longer you stay awake during the day.
sleep pressure.meta: uyqu zaruriyati bo‘lib, odatda uyg‘onganda eng past bo‘ladi va inson uyg‘iq qolgan sari asta-sekin oshib boradi.

ex: special effects artists often use smoke machines in movies and theater.
the concert used a smoke machine to create a dramatic atmosphere.
smoke machine.meta: tutun yoki tutunga o‘xshash modda, masalan, suv bug‘i yoki quruq muz chiqaradigan turli xil qurilmalardan biri; shuningdek, ma’nan: haqiqatni yashirish yoki chalg‘itish uchun ishlatiladigan narsaga nisbatan ham ishlatiladi.

ex: smooth talk can sometimes hide insincerity.
he used smooth talk to convince them to invest in his project.
smooth talk.meta: nozik, mahoratli yoki yoqimli til bilan gapirish, ayniqsa boshqalarni ishontirish, ta’sirlantirish yoki o‘z tomoniga og‘dirish uchun ishlatilganda.

ex: smooth talkers often succeed in sales because of their charm.
he’s a smooth talker who can convince almost anyone.
smooth talker.meta: nozik, mahoratli yoki yoqimli til bilan gapiradigan shaxs, ayniqsa boshqalarni ishontirish, ta’sirlantirish yoki o‘z tomoniga og‘dirish uchun.

ex: the store offers a variety of snackable items like chips and cookies.
fruits and nuts are popular snackables for busy people.
snackable.meta: yengil atirlik sifatida iste’mol qilish uchun mo‘ljallangan yoki mos keladigan oziq-ovqat mahsuloti. ko‘pincha ko‘plik shaklida ishlatiladi.

ex: the south-going train departs at noon every day.
their south-going journey took several days through the mountains.
south-going.meta: janubga yo‘l olish harakati yoki janubga sayohat qilish holati.

ex: france is a sovereign state recognized by the united nations.
a sovereign state has the authority to make its own laws and policies.
sovereign state.meta: ma’lum hududi va doimiy aholisi bo‘lgan, o‘z hukumatini boshqaradigan va boshqa davlatlarga bo‘ysunmaydigan davlat yoki millat.

ex: special counsels often handle sensitive or high-profile legal cases.
the special counsel was appointed to investigate the allegations of corruption.
special counsel.meta: ma’lum bir ehtiyojni qondirish uchun tayinlangan advokat; ayniqsa (AQSh qonunlarida) sud yoki davlat idorasi tomonidan tergov o‘tkazish va zarur bo‘lsa sud jarayonini olib borish uchun tayinlangan advokat.

ex: she cared not a squillionth about the rumors.
the difference was only a squillionth of a millimeter.
squillionth.meta: juda mayda ulush; biror narsaning juda kichik, mikroskopik qismi.

ex: the car’s engine was making a stop-start noise.
the project had a stop-start progress due to funding issues.
stop-start.meta: tez-tez to‘xtab, keyin yana boshlanadigan; tartibsiz, spasmodik; takroriy uzilishlar bilan oraliq rivojlanadigan yoki harakat qiladigan.

ex: streaky bacon has alternating layers of meat and fat.
she fried streaky bacon for breakfast.
streaky bacon.meta: cho‘chqaning yonlari va qorindig‘idan olingan bekon bo‘lib, aniq yog‘li chiziqlarga ega, odatda ingichka chiziqlar yoki bo‘laklar shaklida sotiladi.

ex: tanning beds emit ultraviolet rays to darken the skin.
she used the tanning bed to get a tan before the beach vacation.
tanning bed.meta: odam tanasini quyoshda kuygan kabi qizartirish uchun yotib foydalaniladigan uskuna; uzun, tekis pastki yuzasi va yuqoridan yopiladigan eshikcha qismi bor, har ikkala qismida ultrabinafsha nurlar chiqaradigan lampalar o‘rnatilgan.

ex: tech-savvy employees are highly valued in modern companies.
she is very tech-savvy and can easily fix computer problems.
tech-savvy.meta: texnologiya, ayniqsa raqamli yoki kompyuter texnologiyalaridan yaxshi xabardor yoki mohir foydalanuvchi.

ex: the company faced several teething problems during its first year.
every new software has some teething problems at the beginning.
teething problem.meta: odatda ko‘plikda ishlatiladi; yangi loyiha yoki ish boshlanishining dastlabki bosqichlarida yuzaga keladigan qisqa muddatli muammo yoki kichik qiyinchiliklardan biri.

ex: during the pandemic, many doctors switched to telepsychiatry consultations.
telepsychiatry allows patients in rural areas to access mental health care.
telepsychiatry.meta: telekommunikatsiya texnologiyalari yordamida amalga oshiriladigan psixiatriya, ko‘pincha uzoq joylardagi bemorlarga yordam berish yoki tashriflarni kamaytirish uchun.

ex: test patterns help ensure the broadcast quality is consistent.
the technician displayed a test pattern to calibrate the television screen.
test pattern.meta: ekran ko‘rsatkichlarini yoki uzatish sifatini, nusxa olish va boshqa texnik vositalarni sinash uchun ishlatiladigan tasvir; ayniqsa, televidenie orqali uzatiladigan geometrik naqsh.

ex: he trained in thai boxing for several years before competing professionally.
thai boxing is known for its powerful strikes using elbows and knees.
thai boxing.meta: tayland kelib chiqishi bo‘lgan jang san’ati sporti, bunda ishtirokchi raqibga barmoqlar, tirsaklar, oyoqlar, boldirlar yoki tizzalar bilan zarba berishga ruxsat etiladi; muay thai bilan bir xil.

ex: many theatricians contribute to set design, lighting, and costume as well.
the theatrician was involved in both directing and acting in the play.
theatrician.meta: teatrda ishlaydigan shaxs; hozirda ko‘pincha teatr ishlab chiqarish yoki ijroining bir nechta sohalarida faoliyat yuritadigan odam.

ex: third-person perspective allows players to have a wider view of the surroundings.
this is a popular third-person shooter game where you see your character on screen.
third-person.meta: o‘yin yoki hikoyada o‘yinchining boshqaradigan qahramoni (yoki obyekti) ekranda ko‘rsatiladigan, odatda asosiy diqqat markazi bo‘lib, uchinchi shaxs nuqtai nazaridan tasvirlangan.

ex: His thrill-seeking nature led him to bungee jump off the highest bridge in the world.
Thrill-seeking is common among extreme sports athletes like skydivers and mountain climbers.
thrill-seeking.meta: bu kuchli hayajon yoki hissiy qo‘zg‘alish tuyg‘ularini izlab, xavfli yoki keskin faoliyatlarda ishtirok etishga intilish. Ko‘pincha ekstremal sport turlari yoki sarguzashtli faoliyatlar orqali namoyon bo‘ladi.

ex: In natural language processing, tokenization involves splitting text into words or symbols.
Tokenization helps protect credit card data during online transactions.
tokenization.meta: Tokenlash — bu ma’lumotni, ayniqsa, maxfiy yoki sezgir qismini, tasodifiy yaratilgan identifikator (token) bilan almashtirish jarayoni. Bu texnologiya ko‘pincha axborot xavfsizligi, raqamli to‘lovlar yoki dasturlashda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The algorithm tokenizes the sentence into individual words for analysis
The payment system tokenizes card information before sending it to the server.
tokenize.meta: Tokenlash — bu biror narsani (odatda ma'lumotni) token shakliga o‘zgartirish yoki token bilan almashtirish jarayoni. Zamonaviy texnologiyalarda, ayniqsa axborot xavfsizligi, moliyaviy texnologiyalar va tabiiy tilni qayta ishlashda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The company uses tokenized customer data to prevent identity theft.
All credit card numbers are stored as tokenized values to enhance security.
tokenized.meta: Tokenlangan — bu biror narsa, ayniqsa sezgir ma’lumot yoki raqamli aktiv, token bilan almashtirilgan yoki token shakliga keltirilgan holatni bildiradi.

ex: The closet features a trifold door that saves space in small rooms.
She handed me a trifold brochure outlining the company’s services.
trifold.meta: Uch buklamali — bu uch qismga buklanadigan tarzda yaratilgan obyektni ifodalaydi. Odatda buklanadigan eshiklar, derazalar, broshyuralar yoki bukletlar uchun ishlatiladi. Trifold dizayn qulay saqlash va tashish imkonini beradi.

ex: If that idea works, its impact could be trillionfold greater than expected.
The universe has expanded a trillionfold since the Big Bang.
trillionfold.meta: Trillionfold — bu son yoki miqdorni trillion marta ortganini yoki trillion baravar ko‘payganini bildiradi. Bu so‘z sifat (adjective) yoki ravish (adverb) sifatida ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha mubolag‘ali yoki ilmiy kontekstda qo‘llaniladi.

ex: She was troublingly quiet during the entire meeting, which was unusual for her.
The number of infections is troublingly high this month.
troublingly.meta: Troublingly — bu qandaydir voqea, holat yoki harakat odamda tashvish, havotir yoki bezovtalik uyg‘otadigan tarzda yuz berishini bildiradi. Odatda xavotirli yoki salbiy holatni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: Her motivational speech gave the team a turbo boost of energy before the final game.
The new funding gave the startup a much-needed turbo boost.
turbo boost.meta: bu nimagadir kuchli qo‘shimcha turtki yoki tezkor o‘sish, rivojlanish, yoki samaradorlikning keskin oshishini bildiradi. Bu ibora ko‘pincha obrazli ma’noda ishlatiladi va odatda texnologik, iqtisodiy yoki shaxsiy yutuqlar kontekstida qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The new model features a turbo-boosted engine for higher performance and better speed.
He bought a turbo-boosted sports car that hits 100 km/h in just a few seconds.
turbo-boosted.meta: Turbo-boosted — bu turbozaryadkaga ega bo‘lgan dvigatelga yoki shunday dvigatel o‘rnatilgan transport vositasiga nisbatan ishlatiladigan sifat. Bu texnologiya dvigatelga qo‘shimcha havo bosimi berib, quvvatini va unumdorligini oshiradi.

ex: This gaming laptop comes with a built-in turbo booster for maximum performance.
The jet engine’s turbo booster activated during takeoff, providing extra thrust.
turbo booster.meta: Turbo kuchaytirgich — bu dvigatel yoki elektron qurilmalarda ishlatiladigan, ishlab chiqarilayotgan quvvat yoki tezlikni sezilarli darajada oshirishga mo‘ljallangan komponent yoki tizim.

ex: The defender couldn’t catch the striker with those twinkle toes.
Look at him move on the dance floor—real twinkle toes!
twinkle toes.meta: Twinkle toes — bu odatda raqqosa, futbolchi yoki boshqa sportchilar kabi chaqqon va tez harakat qiladigan kishilarning oyoqlariga nisbatan ishlatiladigan obrazli ifoda.

ex: His Type A behavior makes him a great leader, but he often struggles with stress.
She’s a classic Type A personality—always planning, pushing, and competing.
type a.meta: A tipdagi shaxsiyat — bu shaxsiyatlarni ikki qarama-qarshi turga ajratuvchi tizimga ko‘ra, yuqori darajada raqobatchi, maqsadga intiluvchan, ambitsiyali, sabrsiz va ko‘p hollarda stressga moyil bo‘lgan odamlar tavsifini bildiradi.

ex: Her Type B approach to life makes her a calming presence in high-pressure situations.
He’s more of a Type B personality—relaxed, easygoing, and rarely stressed.
type b.meta: B tipdagi shaxsiyat — bu ikki qarama-qarshi shaxsiyat turini ajratuvchi tizimga ko‘ra, sokin, hotirjam, sabrli, stressga kamroq beriladigan, hayotni zavq bilan qabul qiladigan, raqobatni unchalik muhim deb hisoblamaydigan shaxsni tavsiflaydi.

ex: This cleanser is great for balancing the T-zone without drying the cheeks.
I have oily skin, especially in my T-zone, so I use a mattifying moisturizer.
t-zone.meta: T-zona — bu teri parvarishi va kosmetika kontekstida ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, yuzning peshona, burun va iyak qismlarini o‘z ichiga oladi. Bu hududlar birgalikda "T" shaklini hosil qilgani uchun shunday nomlangan.

ex: Many companies underinvest in employee training, which affects long-term performance.
The government has underinvested in public transportation for decades.
underinvest.meta: Underinvest — bu biror loyiha, bozor yoki faoliyat yo‘nalishiga kerakli darajada mablag‘ yoki kapital ajratmaslik, ya’ni yetarli investitsiya qilmaslikni bildiradi. Bu holat natijasida kutilgan natijalar olinmaydi yoki rivojlanish sekinlashadi.

ex: The region’s poor infrastructure is a result of decades of underinvestment.
Chronic underinvestment in healthcare has left hospitals unprepared for emergencies
underinvestment.meta: bu biror loyiha, bozor yoki faoliyatga zarur darajada mablag‘ yoki kapital ajratilmasligi holatini bildiradi. Bu holat iqtisodiy o‘sishni sekinlashtiradi, infratuzilmaning yemirilishiga yoki kutilgan samaradorlikka erishilmasligiga olib keladi.

ex: The job may seem unglamorously routine, but it’s essential to the company’s success.
She worked unglamorously behind the scenes to keep the project running smoothly.
unglamorously.meta: Unglamorously — bu odatiy, jozibasiz, shunchaki kundalik yoki ko‘zga tashlanmaydigan tarzda bajariladigan harakat yoki holatni bildiradi.

ex: Prices are going up and away, and there's no sign of slowing down.
The balloon floated up and away into the sky.
up and away.meta: Up and away — bu harakatni bildiruvchi fe’llardan so‘ng kelib, biror narsa yoki kimsaning yuqoriga qarab harakatlanishini va ayni paytda uzoqlashishini ifodalaydi.

ex: She has served on the usher board at her church for over ten years.
The usher board welcomed every visitor with a warm smile and a church program.
usher board.meta: asosan Afrika–Amerikalik baptist cherkovlarida uchraydigan ibora bo‘lib, cherkovga kelganlarni kutib olish, dasturlarni tarqatish, o‘rindiqlarga joylashtirish, tartibni saqlash kabi vazifalarni bajaradigan ko‘ngilli a’zolar guruhini bildiradi.

ex: They picked the vic at random from the crowd.
The detective asked if the vic had any enemies.
vic.meta: Vic — bu so‘z aslida jinoyatchilar orasida ishlatilgan jargon bo‘lib, jinoyat uchun mo‘ljallangan yoki nishonga olingan shaxsni bildiradi.

ex: His speech focused on victimary narratives in modern politics.
The film explores the victimary experience of war refugees.
victimary.meta: jabrlanuvchi yoki jabrlanuvchilar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan narsalarni bildiradi. U jinoyat, zo‘ravonlik, adolatsizlik yoki boshqa zararli holatlarda jabrlangan shaxs yoki guruhga doir muammolar, yondashuvlar yoki tafakkurni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

ex: She wrote a memoir about her victimed childhood during the conflict.
The victimed communities demanded justice and recognition.
victimed.meta: Victimed — bu sifat bo‘lib, biror shaxs yoki guruhning jabrlanuvchiga aylanganini yoki qandaydir zarar yoki adolatsizlik qurboni bo‘lganini bildiradi. Bu atama ko‘pincha zo‘ravonlik, zulm, kamsitish yoki jinoyat kontekstida qo‘llanadi.

ex: Excessive victimism can undermine personal accountability and growth.
The politician was accused of promoting victimism to gain sympathy and votes.
victimism.meta: Victimism — bu atama biror kishining (yoki guruhning) o‘zini doimiy ravishda jabrlanuvchi (qurbon) sifatida ko‘rsatishi yoki boshqalar tomonidan shunday tasvirlanishini bildiradi.

ex: Visual kei artists often challenge gender norms through their theatrical appearances.
The band's elaborate costumes and makeup reflect their visual kei influences.
visual kei.meta: Visual kei — bu Yaponiya rok musiqasida paydo bo‘lgan estetika va musiqiy harakat bo‘lib, ayniqsa glam-rok, pank va metall janrlarida ko‘zga tashlanadi.

ex: Several states have recently legalized water cremation as a method of body disposal.
Water cremation is considered a more environmentally friendly alternative to traditional cremation.
water cremation.meta: Water cremation — bu inson yoki hayvon jasadini yo‘qotish (utilizatsiya qilish) usuli bo‘lib, jasad suv va kaliy gidroksid (yoki natriy gidroksid) aralashmasida isitiladi.

ex: Urban planners are incorporating wildscapes into city parks to support biodiversity.
The reserve has been maintained as a wildscape, allowing native species to flourish.
wildscape.meta: Wildscape — bu o‘simliklar va hayvonlar oz yoki umuman inson aralashuvisiz tabiiy tarzda yashab, rivojlanayotgan hududdir. Bu joylar odatda inson faoliyatidan chetda bo‘ladi yoki ataylab yovvoyi holatda saqlanadi.

ex: As stated in the aforenoted section, the contract is legally binding.
The aforenoted figures clearly demonstrate the trend in sales.
aforenoted.meta: Aforenoted — bu so‘z matnda yoki nutqda ilgari aytilgan yoki qayd etilgan ma’lumot, shaxs yoki voqeaga ishora qilish uchun ishlatiladi. Odatda rasmiy yoki yozma kontekstlarda qo‘llanadi.

ex: “Buckle up,” the driver said, “you’re about to get an African massage.”
After two hours on that rocky road, we all got a free African massage.
african massage.meta: African massage — bu kinoyaviy va kulgili ibora bo‘lib, Afrika yo‘llarining notekis, o‘nqir-cho‘nqir holatida harakatlanayotgan avtomobilda bo‘lish natijasida yuzaga keladigan silkinish, tebranish va qaltirash holatini tasvirlaydi.

ex: He completed the project anyhowly, caring little for the details.
The tools were thrown anyhowly into the box without order.
anyhowly.meta: Anyhowly — bu so‘z tarixan “har qanday yo‘l bilan” yoki “qanday bo‘lmasin” degan ma’noni bildirgan. Keyinchalik bu so‘z “rejasiz”, “tartibsiz”, “tasodifiy tarzda” kabi ma’nolarda ishlatilgan. Odatda norasmiy yoki eskirgan nutq uslublarida uchraydi.

ex: This Aotearoan tradition dates back hundreds of years.
The Aotearoan spoke passionately about the importance of preserving Māori culture.
aotearoan.meta: O’t sifatida (noun): Aotearolik — Aotearoa (Yangi Zelandiya) fuqarosi yoki aholisi. Sifat sifatida (adjective): Aotearoaga oid — Yangi Zelandiya (xususan, uning madaniyati, xalqi yoki tabiati) bilan bog‘liq narsalar.

ex: In ancient star maps, Ara was depicted as an altar used by the gods.
The constellation Ara is best observed from the southern hemisphere during winter.
ara.meta: Ara — bu janubiy yarimsharda joylashgan, Somon yo‘lining chetida, Chayon (Scorpius) yulduz turkumining janubida joylashgan kichik va uncha ko‘zga tashlanmaydigan yulduz turkumidir.

ex: The politician’s speech relied heavily on argumentum ad populum rather than factual evidence.
Saying "millions of people believe it, so it must be true" is a classic argumentum ad populum.
argumentum ad populum.meta: Argumentum ad populum — bu mantiqiy xatolik bo‘lib, biror g‘oya yoki fikr ko‘pchilik tomonidan ma’qullangani sababli u to‘g‘ri yoki haqiqat deb qabul qilinadi, degan noto‘g‘ri taxminga asoslanadi.

ex: The lawyer used an argumentum ad verecundiam by quoting a physicist on a legal issue.
Saying "this must be true because a famous actor said so" is an argumentum ad verecundiam.
argumentum ad verecundiam.meta: Argumentum ad verecundiam — bu mantiqiy xatolik bo‘lib, biror fikr yoki pozitsiyani qo‘llab-quvvatlash uchun mashhur yoki obro‘li shaxsning (odatda mutaxassis bo‘lmagan sohada) fikriga tayaniladi.

ex: Bafumbira music and dance play an important role in their cultural ceremonies.
The Bafumbira are known for their agricultural traditions in the Kisoro region.
bafumbira.meta: Bafumbira — bu Uganda janubi-g‘arbida, xususan Kisoro tumanida yashovchi bantu tillarida so‘zlashuvchi xalq nomidir. Bu atama bu xalq vakillarini jamoaviy tarzda ifodalaydi.

ex: He’s a cool banna, always got your back when things go bad.
What’s up, banna? Haven’t seen you in a while!
banna.meta: Banna — bu so‘z norasmiy tarzda odam, ayniqsa yosh yigit yoki do‘st ma’nosida ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha yoshlar orasida tengdosh yoki yaqin do‘stlarga murojaat shakli sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Bantu knots not only look stylish but also protect the hair from damage.
She styled her natural hair into neat Bantu knots for the cultural event.
bantu knot.meta: Bantu tuguni — bu sochning alohida qismlari burab, aylantirib kichik va qattiq tugun shaklida jamlanadigan soch turmagidir. Bu turmak ko‘pincha bosh terisida muayyan naqsh hosil qiladigan tarzda bir nechta tugunlardan iborat bo‘ladi.

ex: Despite its name, the Basilosaurus was not a reptile, but a prehistoric whale.
The fossilized skeleton of a Basilosaurus was discovered in Egypt’s Western Desert.
basilosaurus.meta: qadimda yashagan, hozirda yo‘qolib ketgan dengiz sutemizuvchilari (kitlar) turkumiga mansub bo‘lib, Basilosauridae oilasiga kiradi. Ular Eotsen davrining o‘rtasidan oxirigacha Shimoliy Amerika va Shimoliy Afrikada yashagan.

ex: The infamous beer baron controlled several speakeasies across the city.
During Prohibition, many beer barons built criminal empires by smuggling alcohol.
beer baron.meta: Pivo baroni — ayniqsa AQShda Taqiq davrida (1920–1933 yillar) noqonuniy ravishda pivo ishlab chiqarish, tarqatish yoki sotish bilan shug‘ullangan shaxs, ayniqsa bu faoliyatning rahbari yoki boshlig‘i.

ex: It’s not competitive — just a beer league for fun on weekends.
I joined a beer league hockey team to stay active and meet new people.
beer league.meta: Beer league — bu havaskor yoki hordiq uchun tashkil etilgan sport ligasi bo‘lib, asosan norasmiy muhit, ijtimoiylashuv va ko‘ngilochar ishtirok ustuvor hisoblanadi.

ex: Every Guyanese kitchen has a belna passed down through generations.
She used a belna to roll the dough into perfect circles for roti.
belna.meta: Belna — bu odatda yog‘ochdan yasalgan, xamirni yoyish uchun ishlatiladigan yoyuvchi tayoqcha bo‘lib, ayniqsa Hindiston va Karib havzasi mamlakatlarida (xususan, Gayanada) roti kabi nonlarni tayyorlashda keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: The bicarbonate ion plays an important role in maintaining pH balance in the blood.
Sodium bicarbonate is commonly used in baking as a leavening agent.
bicarbonate.meta: Bikarbonat — tarkibida HCO₃⁻ (gidrokarbonat) anioni bo‘lgan tuz; shuningdek, ushbu anionning o‘zi ham shu nom bilan ataladi.

ex: The old town is full of historic bierkellers that date back centuries.
We spent the evening drinking lager and listening to live music in a traditional bierkeller.
bierkeller.meta: Bierkeller — Germaniyada va boshqa nemis tilida so‘zlashuvchi hududlarda pivo ichish va sotib olish mumkin bo‘lgan joy, ayniqsa podval yoki yer osti qavatida joylashgan bar.

ex: Bierwurst is often enjoyed with mustard and a slice of rye bread.
I bought some bierwurst from the German deli for our picnic.
bierwurst.meta: Biervurst — Germaniyadan kelib chiqqan, pishirilgan va tutatib quritilgan kolbasa turi. U mol go‘shti va cho‘chqa go‘shtidan tayyorlanadi hamda odatda sarimsoq, xantal urug‘i, piyoz va boshqa ziravorlar bilan tatib ko‘riladi.

ex: Her face was on every billboarded street in the downtown area.
The billboarded walls of the city center were filled with movie ads.
billboarded.meta: Billborded — billbord(lar) bilan qoplangan yoki unda reklama qilingan. Bundan tashqari, biror narsa billbord orqali targ‘ib qilingan yoki ko‘z-ko‘z qilingan ma’nolarini ham anglatadi.

ex: Billboarding remains one of the most effective forms of outdoor advertising.
The city's aggressive billboarding made the new product impossible to ignore.
billboarding.meta: Billboarding — 1) billbord yoki billbordlar jamlanmasi; 2) biror narsani (ayniqsa, reklama e’lonlarini) billbordda ko‘rsatish, joylashtirish yoki targ‘ib qilish jarayoni.

ex: Merchants used bills of adventure to claim profits from colonial expeditions.
He presented a bill of adventure proving his financial backing of the voyage.
bill of adventure.meta: Bill of adventure — ayniqsa Yevropa mustamlakalari tashkil etilgan davrda ishlatilgan hujjat bo‘lib, biror shaxs ma’lum miqdorda sarmoya kiritganini tasdiqlovchi hujjat hisoblanadi.

ex: I heard a boop every time the scanner completed a task.
The microwave made a soft boop when the timer ended.
boop.meta: Boop — 1) Ot sifatida: past ohangli, ko‘pincha elektron qurilmalar chiqaradigan piqillovchi yoki signal tovushi. 2) Undov so‘z sifatida: shu tovushni taqlid qiluvchi boop! degan ifoda, ko‘pincha hazil yoki o‘yin kayfiyatida ishlatiladi.

ex: Citizens of a British Overseas Territory may have different rights than those in the UK
Bermuda is one of the most well-known British Overseas Territories.
british overseas territory.meta: Britaniya dengizorti hududi — dastlab: Buyuk Britaniya suvereniteti yoki nazorati ostidagi (masalan, mamlakat, provinsiya, mustamlaka va h.k.) hudud.

ex: A Burundian won the international poetry competition. (ot)
She studied Burundian culture at university. (sifat)
burundian.meta: Sifat sifatida: Burundiga yoki uning aholisi, madaniyati, tili yoki boshqa jihatlariga oid. Ot sifatida: Burundi fuqarosi yoki vakili, ya’ni bu mamlakatda tug‘ilgan yoki shu yerga mansub shaxs.

ex: She baked a batch of butter flaps for the family gathering.
For breakfast, we had butter flap with cheese and tea.
butter flap.meta: Butter flap — Gayanalik oshxonada tayyorlanadigan, yumshoq, biroz shirindan ta’mli, sariyog‘ qo‘shilgan oq non bo‘lib, pishirilishdan oldin buklab qo‘yiladi. Uning tuzilishi nozik, ichi esa yog‘li va yumshoq bo‘ladi.

ex: On windy days, you can see dozens of caddy ole punches flying over the village.
The children made a caddy ole punch from their old schoolbooks.
caddy ole punch.meta: Caddy ole punch — odatda bolalar tomonidan uchiriladigan, uy sharoitida tayyorlangan qog‘oz laylak (sharqona “sharshara laylaki”ga o‘xshash). U maktab daftarining sahifalari va kokos daraxtining barg bandlaridan yasaladi.

ex: Each child received a coin as a Calennig gift.
The children went door to door singing for their Calennig.
calennig.meta: Kalenning — Uels (Welsh) xalq an’analarida Yangi yil kuni ertalab beriladigan sovg‘a yoki bolalar tomonidan eshikma-eshik yurib qo‘shiq aytish evaziga sovg‘a yoki pul yig‘ish odati.

ex: Canis gleamed brightly above the horizon just before dawn.
Ancient astronomers identified Sirius as Canis, the brightest star in the sky.
canis.meta: Kanis — Sirius yulduzining yana bir nomi bo‘lib, u Canis Major (lotincha: “Buyuk It”) yulduz turkumidagi eng yorqin va osmondagi eng yorqin birinchi darajali yulduz hisoblanadi.

ex: Canis Major is easily visible in the southern sky during winter.
Sirius is the brightest star in the constellation Canis Major.
canis major.meta: Canis Major — Janubiy yarimsharning osmonida, Somon yo‘lining chekkasida, Orion yulduz turkumining janubi-sharqida joylashgan yulduz turkumi. Lotin tilidan tarjimada “Buyuk It” degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: The constellation Canis Minor lies just east of Orion.
Canis Minor contains only a few bright stars, including Procyon.
canis minor.meta: Canis Minor — Shimoliy yarimsharning osmonida, Somon yo‘li chekkasida, Orion yulduz turkumining sharqiy tomonida joylashgan kichik yulduz turkumi. Lotin tilidan tarjimada “Kichik It” degan ma’noni anglatadi.

ex: Cawl is considered the national dish of Wales.
We had a warm bowl of cawl on a cold winter evening.
cawl.meta: Kaul — Uels oshxonasiga xos an’anaviy sho‘rva bo‘lib, odatda qo‘y go‘shti yoki mol go‘shti hamda piyoz, kartoshka, sholg‘om (turpning bir turi), sabzi kabi sabzavotlardan tayyorlanadi.

ex: She placed her phone in the storage compartment of the centre console.
The car's center console includes a touchscreen display and cup holders.
centre console / center console.meta: Markaziy konsol — avtomobil ichki qismida, old panel (dashbord) dan pastga qarab cho‘zilgan va turli boshqaruv tugmalari, uzatmalar qutisi tutqichi, saqlash bo‘limlari, multimedia boshqaruvi, ichimlik qo‘yiladigan joylar kabi elementlar joylashgan qism

ex: Damage to the cerebral cortex can affect a person’s ability to speak or move.
The cerebral cortex plays a crucial role in memory and decision-making.
cerebral cortex.meta: Bosh miya po‘stlog‘i — bu bosh miya yarim sharlarining eng tashqi qatlami bo‘lib, kulrang modda burmalaridan iborat.

ex: Her uncle moved to Canada first, and through chain migration, the rest of the family followed.
Chain migration helped build tight-knit immigrant communities in major cities.
chain migration.meta: Zanjirli migratsiya — bu bir kishi yoki guruhning muvaffaqiyatli ko‘chib o‘tishi natijasida, oila a’zolari yoki jamiyatdagi boshqa odamlarning ham xuddi shu mamlakat yoki hududga ko‘chib o‘tishiga sabab bo‘ladigan amaliyot yoki jarayon.

ex: Don’t be a Chatty Cathy during the movie.
She’s such a Chatty Cathy — I couldn’t get a word in!
chatty cathy.meta: Chatty Cathy — asosan ayol yoki qizlarga nisbatan ishlatiladigan ibora bo‘lib, haddan tashqari ko‘p va tinimsiz gapiradigan, sergap, doimiy suhbatga chanqoq odamni bildiradi.

ex: (noun) Don’t be such a cheap-arse — just pay for the good stuff.
(adjective) I bought this cheap-arse phone and it broke in a week.
cheap-arse.meta: Sifat (adjective) sifatida: "cheap-arse" — arzon va sifatsiz, past sifatli yoki arzimagan qiymatdagi narsa yoki holatni ifodalaydi.

ex: (adjective) I don’t want your cheap-ass excuse, just tell me the truth.
(noun) He’s such a cheap ass — he never pays his share at dinner.
cheap ass.meta: Ot (noun) sifatida: "Cheap ass" — bu pul sarflashni yoqtirmaydigan, juda qizg‘anchiq yoki baxil odam. U odatda zaruriy narsalarga ham pul tejashga harakat qiladi.

ex: Don’t buy that jacket; it looks cheap-shit and won’t last long.
This phone is cheap-shit; it broke after just one week.
cheap-shit.meta: Arzon-kalit — juda past sifatga ega, sifatsiz, yaxshi qilinmagan yoki arzon materiallardan tayyorlangan.

ex: He was fined for cheap-shotting an unsuspecting player during the match.
The player cheap-shot his opponent just after the whistle.
cheap shot.meta: Past hujum qilmoq — sportda tayyor bo‘lmagan yoki himoyasiz raqibga norozi va adolatga zid ravishda kuchli va zo‘rlik bilan zarba berish.

ex: Don’t forget to bring the chilly bin if you want your food to stay fresh.
We packed the drinks in a chilly bin to keep them cold during the picnic.
chilly bin.meta: Sovutgich quti — oziq-ovqat yoki ichimliklarni sovuq va yangi saqlash uchun maxsus izolyatsiyalangan, tashish uchun qulay idish.

ex: Coco bread is very popular in Jamaica and often eaten with patties.
I had a delicious sandwich made with coco bread for breakfast.
coco bread.meta: Koko non — Karib mintaqasining an’anaviy noni bo‘lib, u biroz shirin va sariyog‘ bilan boyitilgan, pishirishdan oldin bukilgan oq nondir

ex: I heard the gentle cooing of a collared dove near my house.
The collared dove is often seen in gardens and parks.
collared dove.meta: Bo‘yli to‘rtqush — Streptopelia turkumiga kiruvchi, bo‘ynida qora-oq halqa shaklidagi chiziqlar bo‘lgan, asosan kulrang-jigarrang rangdagi qush.

ex: The comfa ceremonies include dancing and singing to honor the spirits.
He is a comfa priest who leads traditional rituals in his village.
comfa.meta: Komfa — Gayananing qishloq joylarida mavjud bo‘lgan xalq diniy amaliyotlari va marosimlarida ishtirok etadigan yoki ular bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan odam yoki narsa.

ex: HIV uses a coreceptor to enter human cells.
The coreceptor helps the immune cell recognize pathogens more effectively.
coreceptor.meta: Koreseptor — hujayra yuzasidagi boshqa reseptorga bog‘langan molekulani sezib, uning faoliyatini qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi yoki kuchaytiruvchi maxsus receptor.

ex: The firm focuses on its core competence to improve market share.
Innovation is the company’s core competence that sets it apart from competitors.
core competence.meta: Asosiy kompetensiya — kompaniya yoki tashkilotning raqobatda ustunlik beradigan, uni boshqalardan ajratib turadigan asosiy qobiliyati yoki imkoniyati.

ex: Developing software quickly is a core competency that gives the firm an edge.
Customer service excellence is the company’s core competency.
core competency.meta: Asosiy malaka — kompaniya yoki tashkilotning raqobatdoshlardan farq qiladigan, uning muvaffaqiyatini ta’minlaydigan asosiy qobiliyati yoki ustunligi.

ex: Understanding coreference helps in natural language processing.
In the sentence "Ali said he is tired," "Ali" and "he" are in coreference.
