coreference.meta: Koreferens — lingvistikada, bir matn yoki muloqot doirasida bir xil ma’noga ega bo‘lgan so‘zlar yoki iboralar orasidagi bog‘lanish.

ex: Many coreid species are considered agricultural pests.
The coreid bugs damage plants by sucking their sap.
coreid.meta: Koreid — heteropteran hashoratlar oilasi Coreidae ga tegishli, shira bilan oziqlanadigan va turli turlarga ega bo‘lgan hashoratlar.

ex: Without the corepressor, the repressor protein cannot inhibit gene transcription effectively.
The corepressor helps regulate gene expression by activating the repressor protein.
corepressor.meta: Korepressor — repressor oqsilga birikib, uning faoliyatini kuchaytiradigan va gen ifodasini (transkripsiya yoki tarjimani) bostiruvchi molekula.

ex: The lab course is a corequisite of the theory class.
Mathematics is a corequisite for studying physics.
corequisite.meta: Birgalikda talab qilinadigan — boshqa bir shart yoki talab bilan bir vaqtda bajarilishi yoki mavjud bo‘lishi lozim bo‘lgan shart yoki narsa.

ex: Environmental protection requires co-responsibility from everyone.
Parents and teachers have co-responsibility for the child’s education.
co-responsibility.meta: Birgalikdagi mas’uliyat — ikki yoki undan ortiq shaxs yoki guruh tomonidan bo‘lishilgan yoki umumiy tarzda bajarilishi lozim bo‘lgan majburiyat.

ex: The team members are co-responsible for the project’s success.
Both parents are co-responsible for their children’s welfare.
co-responsible.meta: Birgalikda mas’ul — biror ish yoki vazifa uchun ikki yoki undan ortiq shaxs yoki guruh tomonidan birga javobgarlik yuklangan.

ex: Ancient astronomers named this constellation after the crow.
Corvus is a small constellation located near Virgo.
corvus.meta: Korvus — janubiy yarimsharda joylashgan, kichik va kam ko‘zga tashlanadigan yulduzlar to‘plami bo‘lib, Qarg‘a yoki Bo‘ri nomi bilan ataladi.

ex: My grandmother always used curling papers to get craped hair.
She had craped hair styled for the party.
craped.meta: Burmalangan — soch qattiq burilgan yoki maxsus burama qog‘ozlarda joylashtirilgan holda burma qilingan.

ex: My mother used to make my hair creped with curling papers.
She wore her hair creped for the special event.
creped.meta: Kreplangan — soch qattiq burilgan yoki kreplash qog‘ozlari yordamida burama qilingan soch turmagi.

ex: Guernsey is one of the Crown Dependencies in the English Channel.
The Isle of Man is a Crown Dependency with its own parliament.
crown dependency.meta: Qirol taxtiga bog‘liq hudud — Buyuk Britaniya qirolligining boshqaruvi ostida bo‘lgan, lekin to‘liq mustaqil bo‘lmagan hudud yoki viloyat.

ex: Cyberstalking is a serious crime that can cause emotional distress.
He was cyberstalked by an obsessive fan for months.
cyberstalk.meta: Kiber ta’qib qilish — onlayn muhitda kimnidir takroran bezovta qilish, qo‘rqitish yoki haqoratli xabarlar va tasvirlar yuborib, uning ruhiy holatiga salbiy ta’sir ko‘rsatish.

ex: She avoided dagginess by updating her wardrobe regularly.
His old-fashioned clothes showed a bit of dagginess.
dagginess.meta: Daggilik — nimadir hurmatga loyiq emasligi, qabul qilinmasligi yoki odatda zamonaviy emasligi, noqulay va nojo‘ya ko‘rinishi.

ex: Critics argue that degenerationism oversimplifies complex social changes.
Degenerationism was a popular theory in the 19th century about human decline.
degenerationism.meta: Degeneratsionizm — insoniyatning rivojlanishi davomida jismoniy, ruhiy yoki axloqiy jihatdan pasayish yoki buzilish tendentsiyasiga ega ekanligi va bu holatni tasdiqlovchi hodisalar mavjudligi haqidagi nazariya.

ex: In zoology, a dentate shell has toothlike projections along its edge.
The leaf is serrate-dentate, meaning it has saw-toothed edges.
-dentate.meta: -Dentat — ma’lum turdagi yoki miqdordagi tishlar yoki tishsimon qirralarga ega ekanligini ifodalovchi zoologiya va botanika sohasida ishlatiladigan qo‘shimcha.

ex: Some medications have depressogenic side effects.
Stressful life events can be depressogenic factors.
depressogenic.meta: Depressiya keltiruvchi — ruhiy tushkunlik (depressiya) rivojlanishiga sabab bo‘ladigan yoki ta’sir qiluvchi.

ex: Dholuo is widely spoken in parts of Kenya and Tanzania.
She speaks Dholuo fluently because her family is Luo.
dholuo.meta: Dholuo — Keniya va Tanzaniya hududida yashovchi Luo xalqining tili bo‘lib, u Nilo-Saharan tillar oilasining Nilotik tarmoqlaridan biridir.

ex: He was admiring the dime piece across the room.
She’s a real dime piece with a great smile.
dime piece.meta: Dime pis — jozibali, ko‘rkam ko‘rinishdagi, ayniqsa ayollarni ta’riflash uchun ishlatiladigan norasmiy so‘z.

ex: She trained to become a drama therapist to support mental health.
The drama therapist helps patients express their emotions through acting.
drama therapist.meta: Drama terapevti — drama terapiyasi usullaridan foydalangan holda bemorlarni davolaydigan yoki ruhiy yordam ko‘rsatadigan mutaxassis.

ex: She attends drama therapy sessions to cope with anxiety.
Drama therapy helps people express feelings they find hard to talk about.
drama therapy.meta: Drama terapiyasi — bemorlarning ruhiy holatini yaxshilash uchun drama va teatr elementlarini terapevtik tarzda qo‘llash usuli.

ex: The dwarf forest near the summit has trees only a few feet tall.
Dwarf forests are common in mountainous regions with harsh climates.
dwarf forest.meta: Kichkina o‘rmon — daraxt chegarasida joylashgan va qattiq tabiiy sharoitlar tufayli daraxtlar kichik o‘sadigan yoki to‘qimalashgan o‘rmon turi.

ex: He is an East African who was born in Tanzania.
The East African region is known for its diverse wildlife.
east african.meta: Sharqiy Afrika — Afrikaning sharqiy qismiga oid yoki shu mintaqada yashovchi odam yoki narsani ifodalovchi atama.

ex: In folklore, Elfame is often described as a hidden realm beyond our world.
The story takes place in Elfame, a magical land full of elves and fairies.
elfame.meta: Elfem — elf va boshqa sehrli mavjudotlar yashaydigan, tasavvur qilinadigan afsonaviy yoki fantastik olam.

ex: Elfdom is often depicted as a magical and eternal realm.
The stories are set in the mysterious elfdom beyond the human world.
elfdom.meta: Elfdоm — elflarning fantastik yoki tasavvuriy yashash maydoni yoki ularning jamlanmasi; elf bo‘lish holati.

ex: The horse seemed elf-shot after suddenly falling ill without explanation.
The old villagers believed he was elf-shot and needed a healer.
elf-shot.meta: Elf-o‘tgan — inson yoki hayvonni sehrli kuchlar sabab bo‘lgan deb hisoblangan kasallik yoki aziyatlangan holatda bo‘lishi.

ex: Endomorphisms are studied in algebra and category theory.
An endomorphism maps every element of a set to another element within the same set.
endomorphism.meta: Endomorfizm — matematikada bir to‘plamning elementlarini o‘z to‘plamiga moslab o‘zgartiruvchi homomorfizm.

ex: The Little Horse constellation is located near Pegasus and Aquarius.
Equuleus is one of the smallest constellations in the night sky.
equuleus.meta: Ekvleyus — samoviy ekvator yaqinida joylashgan, kichik va unchalik ko‘zga tashlanmaydigan yulduzlar to‘plami bo‘lib, u kichik ot yoki bolakay nomi bilan tanilgan.

ex: This constellation stretches from Orion to near Hydrus.
Eridanus is known as the River in the night sky.
eridanus.meta: Eridanus — janubiy yarimsharda joylashgan uzun va kam ko‘zga tashlanadigan yulduzlar to‘plami, u Orion yulduz turkumining janubidan boshlab Hydrus yaqinigacha cho‘zilgan bo‘lib, daryo tasvirini beradi.

ex: hiring an estate planner can simplify the process of writing a will.
the estate planner helped the family organize their assets for future generations.
estate planner.meta: asosan shimoliy amerika mintaqasida ishlatiladi. oldindan mol-mulkni taqsimlash, soliqlarni boshqarish va meros hujjatlarini tayyorlash bo‘yicha reja tuzadigan shaxs (odatda advokat, buxgalter yoki moliyaviy maslahatchi)

ex: many people seek professional help for estate planning to avoid legal issues.
estate planning ensures your assets are distributed according to your wishes.
estate planning.meta: asosan shimoliy amerika mintaqasida ishlatiladi. inson vafotidan keyin yoki nogironlik holatida mol-mulkini boshqarish va taqsimlash bo‘yicha oldindan tuziladigan reja.

ex: extra-constitutional powers are often controversial in democratic societies.
the military took extra-constitutional actions during the crisis.
extra-constitutional.meta: rasmiy yozma konstitutsiya doirasida qamrab olinmagan; davlat yoki siyosiy tizimning yuridik va siyosiy doirasidan tashqarida mavjud bo‘lgan yoki olib boriladigan.

ex: fashion design requires creativity and attention to detail.
she studied fashion design at a prestigious art school.
fashion design.meta: kiyim-kechak, aksessuarlar va shunga o‘xshash buyumlarni loyihalash san’ati yoki amaliyoti; ayniqsa bu faoliyat akademik yo‘nalish sifatida o‘rganilganda.

ex: the strength of the fashioning pieces affects the stability of the ship.
the shipbuilder carefully shaped the fashioning piece to fit the stern.
fashioning piece.meta: kema orqa qismidagi eng tashqi chetlarini hosil qiluvchi va kemaning shaklini belgilovchi ikkita katta yog‘ochdan har biri; ularning pastki uchi kema karkasi bilan birlashadi.

ex: fashion mongering can sometimes distract from genuine personal style.
his obsession with fashion mongering made him spend all his savings on clothes.
fashion mongering.meta: eng so‘nggi moda yoki tendensiyalarga, ayniqsa kiyinish yoki tashqi ko‘rinishda, ortiqcha va jiddiy bo‘lmagan tarzda ergashish amaliyoti. ko‘pincha tanqidiy ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: she always keeps up with the latest fashionwear trends.
the store specializes in fashionwear for young adults.
fashionwear.meta: kiyimlarning umumiy nomi; ayniqsa zamonaviy va urfdagi kiyimlar.

ex: the restaurant has a very fashiony interior design.
she always wears fashiony clothes that follow the latest trends.
fashiony.meta: moda bilan bog‘liq yoki modaga tegishli bo‘lgan; zamonaviy, uslubli.

ex: he added a feg of garlic to the sauce.
she peeled the orange and ate one feg at a time.
feg.meta: sitrus mevasining bir bo‘lagi, ayniqsa apelsin bo‘lagi; shuningdek, sarimsoqning bir bo‘lagi ham anglatilishi mumkin.

ex: he used flash photography to capture the subject in low light.
flash photography is not allowed in the museum.
flash photography.meta: kamera bilan suratga olish usuli bo‘lib, qisqa va kuchli yorug‘lik (chaqnash) beruvchi moslama yoki ichki funksiya yordamida amalga oshiriladi; ayniqsa yopiq joylarda yoki yorug‘lik yetarli bo‘lmaganda ishlatiladi.

ex: most flat-packed furniture comes with instructions and tools.
the table was delivered flat-packed and required assembly at home.
flat-packed.meta: ayniqsa mebellarda: transport va xaridor tomonidan yig‘ish uchun qulay bo‘lishi maqsadida qismlarga ajratilgan va yassi quti ichida sotiladigan.

ex: they used a flipboard to display the project plan to the team.
the presenter wrote key points on the flipboard during the meeting.
flipboard.meta: stendga o‘rnatilgan yoki o‘rnatilishi mumkin bo‘lgan doska bo‘lib, yig‘ilishlar yoki taqdimotlarda ma’lumotlarni ko‘rsatish yoki yozib olish uchun flip-chart, qog‘oz bloki va shunga o‘xshash materiallar joylashtiriladi.

ex: he made a simple flip book showing a stick figure running.
the children enjoyed watching the animation in the flip book.
flip book.meta: bir-biridan ozgina farq qiluvchi ketma-ket tasvirlardan iborat kitobcha yoki daftar bo‘lib, sahifalar tez-tez varaqlanganda harakat yoki animatsiya effekti hosil bo‘ladi.

ex: he lowered the flip-down tray on the airplane seat to place his meal.
the car has flip-down screens for the backseat passengers.
flip-down.meta: ilova yoki qism pastga bukiladigan yoki ochiladigan mexanizmga ega bo‘lgan narsani ifodalaydi; burama yoki bukiladigan bo‘lak orqali pastga tushiriladigan.

ex: her flip-flopping decisions confused the whole team.
voters criticized the candidate for his flip-flopping stance on healthcare.
flip-flopping.meta: asosan amerika ingliz tilida ishlatiladi; biror masala yoki savol yuzasidan doimiy yoki qayta-qayta fikrini, pozitsiyasini yoki sadoqatini o‘zgartirish holati bilan tavsiflanadigan.

ex: the company's flip-floppy policies confused its employees.
his flip-floppy attitude made him unreliable as a leader.
flip-floppy.meta: fikrida yoki qarorida mustahkam bo‘lmagan, tez-tez o‘zgaradigan; qat’iylik yoki barqarorlik yetishmaydigan; ayniqsa biror masala bo‘yicha tez-tez fikrini yoki pozitsiyasini o‘zgartiradigan.

ex: he bought a flip-open wallet with multiple compartments.
the phone has a flip-open cover for easy access.
flip-open.meta: ayniqsa ilgak yoki o‘qi atrofida burilib ochilishi mumkin bo‘lgan narsa; bukilib ochiladigan qismga ega bo‘lgan.

ex: the sudden flip-out surprised everyone in the room.
he had a flip-out when he heard the bad news.
flip-out.meta: kutilmagan holda o‘z hissiyotlari yoki xatti-harakatlari ustidan nazoratni yo‘qotish holati; kuchli ruhiy bezovtalik holati, ayniqsa (ilk ishlatishda) giyohvand modda ta’siri natijasida yuzaga keladigan.

ex: he did a quick flip-over of the pancake in the pan.
the gymnast performed a perfect flip-over on the mat.
flip-over.meta: to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri va ko‘chma ma’noda: biror narsani yoki o‘zini tezda ag‘darish, aylantirish yoki teskari holatga keltirish harakati.

ex: the phone has a flippable cover for easy access.
the pancake is flippable when it starts to bubble.
flippable.meta: turli ma’nolarda ag‘darish, aylantirish yoki teskari qilish mumkin bo‘lgan narsa.

ex: the flipped image appeared reversed on the screen.
he looked at the flipped pancake in the frying pan.
flipped.meta: ag‘darilgan, aylantirilgan yoki teskari holatga keltirilgan (turli ma’nolarda).

ex: she flipped-out and started shouting at everyone.
he completely flipped-out when he heard the shocking news.
flipped-out.meta: so‘zlashuv uslubida (asosan amerika ingliz tilida): o‘z his-tuyg‘ulari, xatti-harakati yoki ongini nazorat qila olmaydigan holat, ayniqsa dastlab giyohvand moddalar ta’sirida yuzaga kelgan deb qaralgan.

ex: they discovered a fossil of a flippered dinosaur.
the seal is a flippered marine mammal.
flippered.meta: hayvon yoki afsonaviy mavjudot haqida: suzgichlarga ega bo‘lgan, ayniqsa ma’lum bir turdagi suzgichlarga ega bo‘lishi ta’kidlanadi. ko‘pincha murakkab so‘zlarda ishlatiladi.

ex: a flipperless seal would struggle to swim effectively.
the rare species of turtle was born flipperless.
in the movie, the flippy character constantly flirts with everyone.
she has a flippy personality and changes her mind all the time.
flippy.meta: inson haqida: beqaror, tez-tez fikr yoki kayfiyat o‘zgartiradigan, oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan. haddan tashqari erkin, dangal yoki ochiq flirt qiladigan tarzda. keyinchalik yanada yumshoqroq: erkin, quvnoq, hazilkash.

ex: he adjusted the angle of the flip screen to get a better view.
the camera has a flip screen that helps with taking selfies.
flip screen.meta: turli qurilmalarga ulangan, orqaga bukiladigan yoki tashqariga ochiladigan har xil turdagi ekranlar; xususan, kameralar va boshqa elektron qurilmalarda harakatlanadigan ekran.

ex: deciding who would go first was a flip-up.
they settled the argument with a quick flip-up
flip-up.meta: tanga otish orqali qaror qabul qilish usuli, odatda ikki variant orasidan birini tanlash uchun ishlatiladi. keyinchalik (ko‘proq hozirgi ishlatishda): tasodif yoki oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydigan holat, natijasi noma’lum bo‘lgan vaziyat.

ex: the theatre’s fly loft is equipped with advanced lighting rigs.
the scenery was quickly lifted into the fly loft between scenes.
fly loft.meta: tomoshabinlar ko‘rinmaydigan tarzda sahna ustida joylashgan katta yopiq bo‘shliq bo‘lib, u yerdan yoritish moslamalari, parda, dekoratsiya va boshqa sahna qismlari boshqariladi va saqlanadi.

ex: the city is quiet and peaceful in the foreday morning.
we started our journey in the foreday morning to avoid traffic.
foreday morning.meta: erta tong, ayniqsa quyosh chiqishidan oldingi vaqt.

ex: she took her french poodle for a walk every morning.
the french poodle is known for its intelligence and elegance.
french poodle.meta: pudel zotiga mansub it. "french poodle" atamasi ko‘pincha oddiy pudel bilan bir ma’noda ishlatiladi.

ex: physical therapy can help relieve the symptoms of frozen shoulder.
she couldn’t lift her arm properly because of a frozen shoulder.
frozen shoulder.meta: yelkada kuchli qotish va ko‘pincha (ayniqsa dastlab) og‘riq bilan kechadigan holat; bu holat yelka bo‘g‘imi to‘qimalarining qalinlashishi va qisqarishi natijasida harakat cheklanishi bilan bog‘liq deb hisoblanadi.

ex: the delay turned out to be the biggest frustrator of the project.
he was the main frustrator of their plans.
frustrator.meta: boshqaga xalaqit beradigan yoki uni to‘xtatadigan shaxs. xafa qiluvchi, to‘sqinlik qiluvchi yoki umidsizlikka sabab bo‘luvchi narsa yoki holat.

ex: he has a fuckton of work to finish before tomorrow.
there was a fuckton of people at the concert.
fuckton.meta: juda katta miqdor yoki juda ko‘p son. odatda "of" bilan ishlatiladi. bu so‘z qo‘pol va so‘zlashuv tilida ishlatiladi, rasmiy vaziyatlarda ishlatish tavsiya etilmaydi.

ex: the sweet taste of galia makes it perfect for fruit salads.
galia is one of my favorite types of melon in summer.
galia.meta: to‘liq shakli galia qovuni – cucumis melo var. reticulatus turiga mansub qovun navlaridan biri bo‘lib, yoqimli, shirin va xushbo‘y och yashil-sariq rangli go‘shtga va qo‘pol po‘stloqqa ega.

ex: many insect species are named using the suffix -gaster to describe their abdominal features.
the term epigaster refers to the upper part of the abdomen.
-gaster.meta: so‘z yasovchi qo‘shimcha bo‘lib, qorin, oshqozon yoki hayvon tanasidagi ichki bo‘shliqlar bilan bog‘liq qismlar yoki tuzilmalarni ifodalovchi otlar yasashda ishlatiladi. masalan: epigaster (qorin usti qismi).

ex: the genome map shows the locations of important genes.
scientists created a genome map to study genetic diseases.
genome map.meta: genomdagi genlar va boshqa nukleotid ketma-ketliklarining nisbiy joylashuvi va ular orasidagi masofani ko‘rsatuvchi tasvir yoki sxema, ayniqsa muayyan turning genetik tuzilishini tushunishda ishlatiladi.

ex: they used satellite technology to geolocate the missing hiker.
the app can geolocate your phone within seconds.
geolocate.meta: odatda gps yordamida biror qurilma, shaxs, nishon va hokazolarning aniq geografik joylashuvini aniqlash.

ex: social media apps often use geolocation to tag your posts.
the phone’s geolocation feature helps track its exact position.
geolocation.meta: qurilma, shaxs, nishon va hokazolarning geografik joylashuvini aniqlash jarayoni yoki amaliyoti, odatda gps, uchta nuqtadan masofa o‘lchash (triangulyatsiya) yoki boshqa texnologiyalar orqali amalga oshiriladi.

ex: the geolocator provided valuable data about the animal’s movements.
scientists attached a geolocator to the bird to track its migration.
geolocator.meta: qushlar yoki boshqa hayvonlarning migratsiya harakatlarini qayd etish uchun ishlatiladigan kichik moslama bo‘lib, odatda tashqi yorug‘lik darajasini qayd etadi va bu orqali ularning safar yo‘nalishi aniqlanadi.

ex: ghost guns are difficult to trace because they have no serial numbers
the police discovered a ghost gun at the crime scene.
ghost gun.meta: ro‘yxatga olinmagan yoki kuzatib bo‘lmaydigan otish quroli; ayniqsa egasi tomonidan yig‘ilgan yoki ishlab chiqarilgan, xususan 3d chop etish orqali tayyorlangan qurol.

ex: the girlboss culture encourages women to be independent leaders.
she became a successful girlboss by starting her own company.
girlboss.meta: tashabbuskor, maqsadga intiluvchi va ko‘pincha o‘z biznesini yuritadigan ayol. keyinchalik ko‘pincha tanqidiy yoki shubha bilan ishlatiladi. ko‘pincha "girlboss feminismi" iborasida sifatlovchi sifatida qo‘llanadi.

ex: the group chat was full of messages about the upcoming event.
we created a group chat to plan the trip together.
group chat.meta: onlayn platforma yoki xizmat bo‘lib, foydalanuvchilarga bir guruh ichida xabarlar almashish imkonini beradi; odatda umumiy qiziqish yoki maqsad asosida yaratiladi.

ex: the bright star alnair belongs to the grus constellation.
grus is a faint constellation visible in the southern hemisphere.
grus.meta: janubiy yarimsharda joylashgan, nisbatan sezilmaydigan yulduz turkumi. bu yulduz turkumi "turna" deb ham ataladi. baʼzan "gruis" shaklida ham ishlatiladi.

ex: many gur languages are spoken across west africa.
the mooré language is part of the gur language family.
gur.meta: sifat: g‘arbiy afrikada, ayniqsa burkina-faso va unga tutash hududlarda so‘zlashiladigan niger-kongo tillari oilasining gur tarmoqlariga oid. ot: gur tillaridan biri. bu guruhga mooré, dagbani va boshqa tillar kiradi.

ex: don’t be hard ears, just do as you’re told.
he’s a hard ears child who never listens to advice.
hard ears.meta: ayniqsa bola yoki yosh kishi haqida: gapga quloq solmaydigan, itoatsiz yoki o‘jar.

ex: hash collisions can lead to security vulnerabilities in cryptography.
the system encountered a hash collision while storing data.
hash collision.meta: xesh jadvalida ikki yoki undan ortiq ma’lumot bir xil xesh qiymatiga ega bo‘lishi holati. bu holat xesh funksiyasining kamchiligi yoki cheklangan xesh qiymatlari diapazoni tufayli yuzaga keladi.

ex: heart massage is a critical part of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (cpr).
the doctor performed heart massage to revive the patient.
heart massage.meta: yurakning ritmik siqilishi (ko‘pincha ko‘krak qafasiga bosim berish orqali yoki jarrohlik yo‘li bilan ochilgan holda) bo‘lib, odatda qon aylanishini vaqtincha davom ettirish yoki yurakni yana urdirish uchun bajariladi.

ex: in the game, high elves are known for their wisdom and agility.
the high elf used powerful magic to protect the kingdom.
high elf.meta: fantastik adabiyot, video o‘yinlar va rolli o‘yinlarda uchraydigan elflarning bir turi yoki guruhiga mansub bo‘lib, odatda bo‘yi uzun, aqlli, kuchli sehrga ega va boshqa elf turlaridan ustun deb tasvirlanadi.

ex: “iechyd da!” he shouted before taking a sip of his drink.
they raised their glasses and said, “iechyd da!”
the four inner planets are made mostly of rock and metal.
mercury is the smallest inner planet in the solar system.
inner planet.meta: orbitasi asteroid kamaridan quyoshga yaqin bo‘lgan sayyoralar; ya’ni merkuri, venera, yer va mars. baʼzan dastlabki foydalanishda faqat merkuri va venera tushunilgan.

ex: intermittent fasting can help improve metabolic health.
many people practice intermittent fasting to lose weight.
intermittent fasting.meta: qisqa va muntazam vaqt oralig‘ida ro‘za tutish yoki ba’zi kunlarda ovqatlanish miqdorini cheklash amaliyoti. odatda sog‘liqni yaxshilash yoki vazn nazorati maqsadida bajariladi.

ex: interstellar wind consists of particles from distant stars and galaxies.
the spacecraft detected interstellar wind beyond the solar system.
interstellar wind.meta: heliopauzadan tashqarida, koinot bo‘shlig‘ida oqib o‘tuvchi zaryadlangan zarrachalar, gaz va chang oqimi. bu oqim quyosh shamoli va yulduz shamoliga o‘xshash, lekin quyosh tizimi tashqarisida joylashgan.

ex: intore dancers wear traditional costumes and carry spears or shields.
the intore performed a powerful dance at the wedding ceremony.
intore.meta: ruanda va burundida: urush mavzusiga bag‘ishlangan an’anaviy raqs bo‘lib, odatda baraban chalish bilan birga ijro etiladi.

ex: kapa haka groups compete in national cultural events.
the kapa haka performed a traditional welcome at the festival.
kapa haka.meta: maorilarning anʼanaviy ijro sanʼat guruhi bo‘lib, qo‘shiq, raqs, hakatik va boshqa madaniy ko‘rinishlarni birlashtiradi. bu guruhlar maori madaniyatini namoyish qilish va saqlashga xizmat qiladi.

ex: ketcha is a fun game that keeps everyone running and laughing.
the children played ketcha in the school yard.
ketcha.meta: bolalar o‘yini bo‘lib, u tag yoki berkinmachoq o‘yinlariga o‘xshaydi. o‘yinda bir ishtirokchi boshqalarni quvib yetishga harakat qiladi va ushlangan o‘yinchi keyingi quvuvchi bo‘ladi.

ex: his fingers were sore from the kinning caused by the icy wind.
she had a kinning on her hands after working outside in the cold.
kinning.meta: ingliz tilining yorkshir shevasida ishlatiladi. sovuq yoki shamol ta’sirida paydo bo‘ladigan, yorilgan yoki og‘riqli teri qismi; qattiq sovuqdan chiqqan jarohat yoki "chilblain" holati bilan o‘xshash.

ex: i am learning kinyarwanda to communicate better with my friends from rwanda.
many people in rwanda speak kinyarwanda as their first language.
kinyarwanda.meta: bantu tillariga mansub til bo‘lib, ruandaning milliy tili hisoblanadi. bu til burundi, demokratik kongo respublikasi, uganda va boshqa qo‘shni hududlarda ham so‘zlashiladi.

ex: kitu kidogo is a common term for small bribes in some countries.
the officer was arrested for accepting kitu kidogo.
kitu kidogo.meta: pora yoki rag‘batlantirish sifatida taklif qilinadigan yoki qabul qilinadigan pul. bu atama swahili tilida "kichkina narsa" degan ma’noni anglatadi, lekin amaliyotda pora ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

ex: knee fans are still used in traditional farming communities.
the farmer used a knee fan to separate the grain from the chaff.
knee fan.meta: g‘alla tozalash (separatsiya) jarayonida ishlatiladigan sayoz savat yoki yelpig‘ich bo‘lib, odatda tizza yordamida boshqariladi. bu usul shamol yordamida ishlatiladigan "wind fan" usulidan farq qiladi.

ex: the flight attendant tied her knot scarf in a neat bow.
she wore a stylish knot scarf with her coat.
knot scarf.meta: turli usullarda bo‘yin atrofiga tugun qilib bog‘lanadigan shar turlari; (ayniqsa dastlabki ishlatishda) odatda ingichka va to‘g‘ri to‘rtburchak shaklida bo‘lib, bo‘yin atrofiga bog‘lash uchun mo‘ljallangan.

ex: the bright star arneb is the alpha star in lepus.
lepus is located just below the constellation orion.
lepus.meta: janubiy yarimsharda, orion yulduz turkumining darhol janubida joylashgan, uncha sezilmaydigan yulduz turkumi. bu yulduz turkumi "quyon" deb ham ataladi. shuningdek, "leporis" shaklida yulduz nomlarida ishlatiladi.

ex: live chat support is available 24/7 for customer questions.
i used the live chat on the website to ask about my order.
live chat.meta: kompyuter tarmog‘ida (ayniqsa internetda) ikki yoki undan ortiq foydalanuvchilar o‘rtasida real vaqt rejimida xabar almashish jarayoni; hozirda ayniqsa veb-saytlarda mijozlarga tezkor xizmat ko‘rsatish shakli sifatida keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: some traditional festivals are celebrated according to the lunar calendar.
the islamic calendar is based on the lunar calendar.
lunar calendar.meta: vaqtni o‘lchash va sanalarni belgilashda oy fazalarining aylanishi asosida tuzilgan turli tizimlardan biri; odatda bir yangi oydan keyingi yangi oygacha bo‘lgan davr hisobga olinadi.

ex: finding the right mahi is important for personal growth.
they take pride in their mahi and contribute to their community.
mahi.meta: maori madaniyatida: ish, faoliyat, bandlik yoki kasb. baʼzan sanog‘li holda ham ishlatiladi va "ish joyi" yoki "vazifa" maʼnosida qo‘llanadi.

ex: major depressive disorder can seriously affect work and relationships.
he was diagnosed with major depressive disorder after months of persistent sadness.
major depressive disorder.meta: kamida 2 hafta davom etadigan va odatda kundalik hayot faoliyatining buzilishi bilan birga kechadigan chuqur tushkunlik holatlari bilan tavsiflanadigan ruhiy kasallik.

ex: mamgu always told us the best bedtime stories.
i used to spend weekends with my mamgu in the countryside.
mamgu.meta: buviga nisbatan ishlatiladigan so‘z; "buvijon" yoki "buvi" maʼnosida. ayniqsa uels (wales) hududida keng qo‘llaniladi.

ex: riding a mechanical bull requires balance and quick reflexes.
he fell off the mechanical bull after just a few seconds.
mechanical bull.meta: odamga rodeo buqasi yoki otida minish tajribasini simulyatsiya qiladigan qurilma; ayniqsa, ustida odam o‘tirishi va muvozanatni saqlashga harakat qilishi uchun mo‘ljallangan, tez-tez ko‘ngilochar markazlar va festivallarda uchraydi.

syn: musical (musiqiy spektakl) • We watched a beautiful musical at the theater last night. (Kechagi kechada teatrdan chiroyli musiqiy spektakl tomosha qildik.)stage musical (sahnadagi musiqiy spektakl) • The stage musical was full of energy and emotion. (Sahnadagi musiqiy spektakl energiya va hissiyotlarga boy edi.)
ex: Musical theatre combines acting, singing, and dancing on stage. (Musiqiy teatr sahnada aktyorlik, qoʻshiq aytish va raqsni birlashtiradi.)
She loves performing in musical theatre productions.(U musiqiy teatr tomoshalarida ishtirok etishni yaxshi koʻradi.)
Broadway is famous for its high-quality musical theatre shows.(Broadway sifatli musiqiy teatr tomoshalari bilan mashhur.)
Musical theatre requires strong vocal and dance skills.(Musiqiy teatr kuchli ovoz va raqs mahoratini talab qiladi.)
musical theatre | musical theater.meta: qoʻshiq aytish va raqs asosiy oʻrinni egallaydigan drama janri. bu turdagi spektakllarda voqealar, dialoglar, qoʻshiqlar va raqslar bir-birini toʻldiradi.

syn: kangaroo court (shoshilinch va adolatsiz sud) • That meeting turned into a kangaroo court. (U uchrashuv shoshilinch va adolatsiz sudga aylanishdi.)mock trial (hazil yoki norasmiy sud) • The students held a mock trial for fun. (Talabalar hazil uchun norasmiy sud o‘tkazishdi.)
ex: Mustang courts are known for making quick and often unfair decisions. (Mustang sudlari odatda tez va ko‘pincha adolatsiz qarorlar chiqarishi bilan mashhur.)
The crew held a mustang court to decide if the sailor had broken the rules.(Ekipaj dengizchining qoidalarni buzgan-buzmaganini hal qilish uchun mustang sudi o‘tkazdi.)
It felt like a mustang court when they blamed him without listening to his side.(Uning gapini eshitmasdan ayblashgani mustang sudiga o‘xshab ketdi.)
No one took the mustang court seriously, but the accused felt humiliated.(Hech kim mustang sudini jiddiy qabul qilmadi, lekin ayblanuvchi o‘zini xor his qildi.)
mustang court.meta: hech qanday yuridik kuchga ega bo‘lmagan norasmiy sud bo‘lib, odatda shoshilinch yoki o‘z holicha tuzilib, biror kishini, ayniqsa ishonchli dalillarsiz, aybdor deb topish maqsadida tashkil etiladi.

syn: military phonetic alphabet (harbiy fonetik alifbo) • The military phonetic alphabet is crucial in noisy environments. (Harbiy fonetik alifbo shovqinli muhitda juda muhimdir.)ICAO phonetic alphabet (ICAO fonetik alifbosi) • The ICAO phonetic alphabet is also used by commercial pilots. (ICAO fonetik alifbosi tijorat uchuvchilari tomonidan ham ishlatiladi.)
ex: Pilots and military personnel rely on the NATO phonetic alphabet for clear communication. (Uchuvchilar va harbiy xodimlar aniq aloqa uchun NATO fonetik alifbosiga tayanadilar.)
The NATO phonetic alphabet uses words like "Alpha" for A and "Bravo" for B.(NATO fonetik alifbosi A harfi uchun “Alpha”, B harfi uchun esa “Bravo” so‘zlarini ishlatadi.)
He spelled his name using the NATO phonetic alphabet: “Charlie, Oscar, Delta, Echo.”(U ismini NATO fonetik alifbosi orqali harflab aytdi: “Charlie, Oscar, Delta, Echo.”)
Air traffic controllers require a solid grasp of the NATO phonetic alphabet.(Havo harakati dispecherlari NATO fonetik alifbosini yaxshi bilishlari kerak.)
nato phonetic alphabet.meta: nato tomonidan ishlab chiqilgan, signal berish va audio aloqada harflarni aniq va tushunarli tarzda ifodalash uchun mo‘ljallangan maxsus kod so‘zlari to‘plami. har bir lotin alifbosi harfiga mos ravishda alohida kod so‘zi belgilanadi.

syn: digital bank (raqamli bank) • A digital bank offers services through apps
not branches. (Raqamli bank xizmatlarni filial emas
ilovalar orqali ko‘rsatadi.)online-only bank (faqat onlayn ishlaydigan bank) • She switched to an online-only bank for convenience. (U qulaylik uchun faqat onlayn ishlaydigan bankka o‘tdi.)
ex: Neobanks offer lower fees compared to traditional banks. (Neobanklar an’anaviy banklarga qaraganda pastroq to‘lovlarni taklif qiladi.)
Many people prefer using a neobank for its easy mobile services.(Ko‘pchilik qulay mobil xizmatlari tufayli neobankdan foydalanishni afzal ko‘radi.)
She opened an account with a neobank in just five minutes.(U neobankda hisobni atigi besh daqiqada ochdi.)
Unlike traditional banks, neobanks don’t require paperwork.(An’anaviy banklardan farqli o‘laroq, neobanklar hujjat talab qilmaydi.)
neobank.meta: chakana bank xizmatlari bozorida yaqinda tashkil etilgan, ayniqsa katta va uzoq yillik tajribaga ega milliy yoki xalqaro banklar bilan raqobatlashish maqsadida yaratilgan bank.

syn: synthetic narcotic (sintetik narkotik) • This synthetic narcotic is stronger than traditional opioids. (Bu sintetik narkotik an’anaviy og‘riq qoldiruvchilardan kuchliroq.)illicit opioid (noqonuniy og‘riq qoldiruvchi) • The lab found traces of illicit opioids like nitazene. (Laboratoriyada nitazen kabi noqonuniy og‘riq qoldiruvchilarning izlari topildi.)
ex: The illegal use of nitazene has raised serious health concerns. (Nitazendan noqonuniy foydalanish sog‘liq uchun jiddiy xavotir uyg‘otmoqda.)
Nitazene is considered far more potent than fentanyl.(Nitazen fentanildan ancha kuchli deb hisoblanadi.)
Many overdoses are now linked to nitazene-laced substances.(Ko‘plab dozadan oshish holatlari nitazen qo‘shilgan moddalar bilan bog‘liq.)
Authorities are struggling to detect nitazene in street drugs.(Hokimiyatlar ko‘cha dorilarida nitazeni aniqlashda qiynalmoqda.)
nitazene.meta: benzimidazol guruhiga mansub bo‘lgan, juda kuchli sintetik opioid moddalar guruhi; ko‘pincha noqonuniy ravishda narkotik vosita sifatida ishlatiladi.

syn: opioid blocker (opioid to‘xtatuvchi) • The opioid blocker saved his life during an overdose. (Opioid to‘xtatuvchi doza oshganda uning hayotini saqlab qoldi.)antidote (qarshi dori) • The doctor used an antidote to neutralize the drug's effects. (Shifokor dori taʼsirini yo‘qotish uchun qarshi dori ishlatdi.)
ex: The doctor administered an opioid antagonist to save the patient's life. (Shifokor bemorning hayotini saqlab qolish uchun opioid antagonist qo‘lladi.)
Naloxone is a widely used opioid antagonist to reverse opioid overdoses.(Nalokson opioid dozasini bekor qilish uchun keng qo‘llaniladigan opioid antagonistdir.)
Emergency responders always carry opioid antagonists like naloxone.(Favqulodda xizmat xodimlari har doim nalokson kabi opioid antagonistlarni olib yurishadi.)
Opioid antagonists can quickly restore breathing in overdose patients.(Opioid antagonistlari doza oshgan bemorlarda nafas olishni tezda tiklay oladi.)
opioid antagonist.meta: opioidlarning taʼsirini to‘xtatuvchi, susaytiruvchi yoki unga qarshi ishlaydigan dori vositasi; ayniqsa opioid retseptorlari bilan bog‘lanib, opioidlar taʼsirini bloklaydi.

syn: tentak) • Are you crazy? That’s too risky! (Tentakmisan? Bu juda xavfli-ku!)nutty (ahmoqona) • He’s a bit nutty
aqlga zid) • That’s an irrational fear. (Bu aqlga zid qo‘rquv.)
ex: She laughed and called her brother pagalee for his silly ideas. (U kuldi va ukasining tentak g‘oyalari uchun uni tentak deb atadi.)
Everyone thought he was a bit pagalee for trying such a dangerous stunt.(Hamma uni bunday xavfli ishni sinab ko‘rganiga biroz tentak deb o‘yladi.)
You’re pagalee if you believe that story!(Agar sen bu hikoyaga ishonayotgan bo‘lsang, tentaksan!)
He acts pagalee when he's excited.(U hayajonlanganda tentakdek harakat qiladi.)
pagalee.meta: aqliy nogironligi bor shaxsga nisbatan ishlatilgan; keyinchalik va hozirda asosan: tentak, nodon, irratsional yoki haqiqatdan uzilgan odamni ifodalash uchun qo‘llaniladi. baʼzan haqorat yoki yengil kulgu ohangida ishlatiladi.

syn: smuggling route (kontrabanda yo‘li) • The smuggling route crossed several national parks. (Kontrabanda yo‘li bir nechta milliy bog‘lar orqali o‘tgan.)back road (chetlab o‘tuvchi yo‘l) • We took a back road to avoid traffic. (Tirbandlikdan qochish uchun chetlab o‘tuvchi yo‘lni tanladik.)trail (yashirin yo‘l
iz) • They followed a narrow trail into the hills. (Ular tepaliklarga olib boradigan tor izdan yurishdi.)
ex: The village is connected to the next town by an old panya route. (Qishloq qo‘shni shaharcha bilan eski yashirin yo‘l orqali bog‘langan.)
The smugglers used a panya route to avoid border patrols.(Kontrabandachilar chegara nazoratidan qochish uchun yashirin yo‘ldan foydalandilar.)
Many panya routes are known only to locals.(Ko‘pgina yashirin yo‘llarni faqat mahalliy odamlar biladi.)
Authorities discovered a new panya route used for wildlife trafficking.(Hokimiyat yovvoyi hayvonlarni noqonuniy tashish uchun ishlatiladigan yangi yashirin yo‘lni aniqladi.)
panya route.meta: maxfiy yoki yashirin yo‘l, ayniqsa kontrabanda yoki noqonuniy yuk tashish uchun ishlatiladigan aylanma yoki chetlab o‘tuvchi yo‘l.

syn: summary table (umumlashtiruvchi jadval) • A summary table provides a quick overview of your data. (Umumlashtiruvchi jadval sizning ma’lumotlaringizning tez ko‘rinishini beradi.)data analysis table (ma’lumot tahlil jadvali) • Use a data analysis table to track performance indicators. (Natijalarni tahlil qilish uchun ma’lumot tahlil jadvalidan foydalaning.)
ex: Pivot tables help to organize and analyse complex datasets. (Pivot jadvallar murakkab ma’lumotlar to‘plamini tartibga solish va tahlil qilishga yordam beradi.)
I used a pivot table to quickly summarize the sales data.(Men pivot jadval yordamida savdo ma’lumotlarini tezda umumlashtirdim.)
The pivot table allows users to sort and filter by any category.(Pivot jadval foydalanuvchilarga har qanday toifa bo‘yicha saralash va filtrdan foydalanish imkonini beradi.)
With a pivot table, you can calculate averages and totals with just a few clicks.(Pivot jadvali yordamida o‘rtacha qiymatlar va umumiy sonlarni bir necha bosish bilan hisoblash mumkin.)
pivot table.meta: turli jadvallardan yoki elektron jadvallardan tanlangan maʼlumotlarni yig‘ib, ularni saralash, taqqoslash yoki tahlil qilish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus elektron jadval shakli.

plasmodial slime mould | plasmodial slim.meta: myxogastria sinfiga mansub har qanday shilimshiq mog‘or turi bo‘lib, u baʼzan yakka amoebasimon hujayra shaklida, baʼzan esa ko‘p yadrolik, katta amoebasimon massa shaklida mavjud bo‘lishi mumkin.
