ex: She is responsible for stage managing during the entire play. (U butun spektakl davomida sahna boshqaruvi uchun mas'ul.)
Stage managing requires strong organizational skills.(Sahna boshqaruvi kuchli tashkilotchilik qobiliyatini talab qiladi.)
He started his career in theatre by stage managing student productions.(U teatr faoliyatini talabalar spektakllarini sahna boshqaruvi orqali boshlagan.)
Effective stage managing helps avoid technical issues during live shows.(Samarali sahna boshqaruvi jonli chiqishlar paytida texnik muammolarning oldini oladi.)
stage managing.meta: teatr sohasida sahna boshqaruvchisining ishi yoki kasbi; sahnaning barcha texnik, tashkiliy va ijro jarayonlarini muvofiqlashtirish va nazorat qilish.

syn: scaffold board – iskala taxtasi• The scaffold board gave them access to the roof.(Iskala taxtasi ularga tomga chiqishga imkon berdi.)platform board – platforma taxtasi• They laid down platform boards for safety.(Ular xavfsizlik uchun platforma taxtalarini qo‘yishdi.)
ex: They used a metal stage plank to create a stable platform for painting the wall. (Ular devorni bo‘yash uchun barqaror platforma yaratish maqsadida metall ishchi platforma taxtasidan foydalandilar.)
The workers stood on the stage plank to reach the upper parts of the ship.(Ishchilar kemaning yuqori qismlariga yetishish uchun ishchi platforma taxtasida turishdi.)
Always secure the stage plank to avoid accidents during construction.(Qurilish paytida baxtsiz hodisalarning oldini olish uchun har doim ishchi platformasi taxtasini mustahkamlang.)
Stage planks must be strong enough to hold multiple workers and equipment.(Ishchi platforma taxtalari bir nechta ishchi va jihozlarni ko‘tara oladigan darajada mustahkam bo‘lishi kerak.)
stage plank.meta: dastlab kemasozlikda ishlatiladigan, ishchilar uchun vaqtincha platforma yaratishda qo‘llaniladigan qalin va keng yog‘och taxta. keyinchalik bu atama kengroq ma’noda, har qanday yog‘och yoki metall taxtani anglatadi

syn: performance duration – ijro davomiyligi• The performance duration was only 15 minutes.(Ijro davomiyligi atigi 15 daqiqa edi.)onstage presence – sahnadagi ishtirok• Her strong onstage presence made her stand out.*(Uning sahnadagi kuchli ishtiroki uni ajratib ko‘rsatdi.)
ex: Musicians often practice to maximize their stage time during concerts. (Musiqachilar konsertlarda sahnadagi vaqtini maksimal darajada ishlatish uchun mashq qilishadi.)
The actor’s stage time was longer than expected in the play.(Pyesada aktyorning sahnadagi vaqti kutilganidan uzoqroq bo‘ldi.)
She’s new to comedy and still working on improving her stage time.(U komediyada yangi va hali sahnadagi vaqtini yaxshilash ustida ishlayapti.)
The presenter had only five minutes of stage time to make an impact.(Taqdimotchiga ta’sir ko‘rsatish uchun atigi besh daqiqa sahna vaqti berildi.)
stage time.meta: biror spektakl yoki chiqishning ma’lum bir qismi uchun sarflangan vaqt; ayniqsa, ma’lum bir aktyor, musiqachi yoki boshqa ijrochining sahnada bo‘lgan jami vaqti.

syn: steampunky – steampunkga xos• The interior was very steampunky
with gears on every wall.(Ichki dizayn steampunkga xos edi — devorlarda tishli g‘ildiraklar bor edi.)retro-futuristic – o‘tmish uslubidagi zamonaviy• The artwork looked retro-futuristic
like a blend of old and new tech.*(Rasm retro-futuristik edi — eski va yangi texnologiyalarning uyg‘unligi.)
ex: Her dress had a steampunkish design with gears and brass details. (Uning ko‘ylagi tishli g‘ildiraklar va mis bezaklar bilan steampunk uslubida edi.)
The movie featured steampunkish gadgets and costumes.(Filmda steampunkga o‘xshash moslamalar va kiyimlar aks ettirilgan edi.)
They built a steampunkish clock with visible gears and copper tubes.(Ular tishli g‘ildiraklar va mis trubkalar bilan steampunk uslubidagi soat yasashdi.)
The city in the novel had a steampunkish vibe — full of airships and fog.*(Romandagi shahar steampunkga xos kayfiyatda edi — havo kemalari va tuman bilan to‘la.)
steampunkish.meta: steampunk janriga xos bo‘lgan yoki steampunk dunyosidagi narsalarga o‘xshash, ularning xarakterini yoki estetikasini eslatadigan. steampunk — asosan viktorian davri texnologiyalari va ilmiy fantastika elementlarini o‘z ichiga olgan janr.

syn: steampunkish – steampunk uslubidagi• The novel had a steampunkish charm.(Roman steampunk uslubidagi jozibaga ega edi.)retro-futuristic – eski va zamonaviyni uyg‘unlashtirgan• The building has a retro-futuristic design.(Bino retro-futuristik dizaynga ega.)
ex: Her costume had a steampunky vibe, mixing old-fashioned and futuristic styles. (Uning kostyumi steampunk uslubini eslatardi — eski zamonaviy va kelajakni uyg‘unlashtirgan.)

The film’s set design was very steampunky, with lots of gears and steam-powered machines.(Film dekoratsiyasi juda steampunkga xos edi — tishli mexanizmlar va bug‘ bilan ishlovchi qurilmalar ko‘p edi.)
He decorated his workshop in a steampunky style with brass pipes and vintage clocks.(U ustaxonasini mis trubkalar va eski soatlarla steampunk uslubida bezatgan.)
The robot had a steampunky appearance, with exposed gears and leather fittings.(Robotning ko‘rinishi steampunkga o‘xshar edi — ochiq tishli g‘ildiraklar va charm detallar bilan.)
steampunky.meta: steampunk janriga xos bo‘lgan yoki steampunk dunyosidagi narsalarga o‘xshaydigan; odatda viktorian davri texnologiyalari, mexanik elementlar va ilmiy fantastika uslubini eslatadi. steampunkish so‘ziga yaqin maʼnoda.

syn: bobo• My grandfather loved gardening.(Mening buvam bog‘dorchilikni yaxshi ko‘rardi.)grandparent – katta avlod vakili (buva yoki buvi)• Children often stay with their grandparents during holidays.(Bolalar bayramlarda ko‘pincha buvalari yoki buvilari bilan bo‘ladilar.)
ex: She visited her tadcu during the summer holidays. (U yozgi ta’til davomida buvasinikiga bordi.)
My tadcu used to tell me stories about our family history.(Mening buvam menga oilamiz tarixidan hikoyalar aytib bergan.)
We often spent weekends with tadcu and learned about old traditions.(Biz ko‘pincha dam olish kunlarini buvam bilan o‘tkazar va eski urf-odatlarni o‘rganar edik.)
Her tadcu taught her how to cook traditional food.(Uning buvasi unga an’anaviy taom tayyorlashni o‘rgatgan.)
tadcu.meta: bir kishining bobosi yoki buvisi; ota tarafdagi katta avlod vakili. cf. taid (ota tarafdagi buva), mamgu (ona tarafdagi buva)

syn: bobo• My grandfather taught me how to fish.(Buvam menga baliq tutishni o‘rgatgan.)elder – keksalar
oqsoqol• We always listened to the elders in our family.(Biz har doim oilamizdagi keksalarning gaplariga quloq solardik.)
ex: She told stories her taid used to share with the family. (U buvisi oilaga aytib bergan hikoyalarni esladi.)
My taid fought in the war many years ago.(Mening buvam bundan ko‘p yillar avval urushda qatnashgan.)
His taid passed down many traditional customs.(Uning buvasi ko‘plab an’anaviy urf-odatlarni avlodlarga o‘rgatgan.)
I remember visiting my taid every summer in the countryside.(Men har yozda qishloqda buvamni ziyorat qilganimni eslayman.)
taid.meta: bir kishining bobosi yoki ota tarafdagi katta avlod vakili. cf. tadcu (ota tarafdagi aka-uka), nain (ota yoki ona tarafdagi katta ota)

syn: Berber – berber• Berber languages are part of the Afro-Asiatic family.(Berber tillari Afro-Osiyo tillar oilasiga kiradi.)Amazigh language – amazigh tili• The Amazigh language has been preserved through oral tradition.(Amazigh tili og‘zaki an’ana orqali saqlanib qolgan.)
ex: The government recognized Tamazight as an official language in Morocco. (Marokash hukumati Tamazight tilini rasmiy til sifatida tan oldi.)
Tamazight is spoken by millions of people across North Africa.(Tamazight tili Shimoliy Afrikada millionlab odamlar tomonidan so‘zlashiladi.)
Schools in Algeria have introduced Tamazight classes to preserve cultural identity.(Jazoirdagi maktablarda madaniy o‘zlikni saqlash maqsadida Tamazight darslari joriy etildi.)
The alphabet used to write Tamazight is called Tifinagh.(Tamazight tilini yozishda Tifinagh alifbosi ishlatiladi.)
tamazight.meta: amazigh xalqining turli tillaridan biri yoki ularning umumiy nomi; afro-osiyo tillari oilasining bir bo‘lagi sifatida qaraladi. asosan shimoliy afrikada, jumladan marokash, jazoir, tunis va boshqalarida so‘zlashiladi.

syn: framing – doiraga solish / kontekstga joylashtirish• Framing the problem differently helped find a solution.(Muammoni boshqacha doirada ko‘rib chiqish yechim topishga yordam berdi.)highlighting – ajratib ko‘rsatish• Highlighting key ideas made the lecture clearer.(Asosiy fikrlarni ajratib ko‘rsatish ma’ruzani tushunarliroq qildi.)
ex: In philosophy, thematizing an idea allows deeper analysis. (Falsafada biror g‘oyani mavzu qilish uni chuqurroq tahlil qilish imkonini beradi.)
Thematizing a concept helps clarify its significance in a discussion.(Biror tushunchani mavzuga aylantirish uning muhokamadagi ahamiyatini aniqlashtirishga yordam beradi.)
Literary critics often focus on thematizing identity and power.(Adabiyotshunoslar ko‘pincha shaxs va hokimiyatni mavzulashtirishga e’tibor qaratadilar.)
The exhibition succeeded in thematizing the relationship between humans and nature.(Ko‘rgazma inson va tabiat o‘rtasidagi munosabatni mavzuga aylantirishda muvaffaqiyatli bo‘ldi.)
thematizing.meta: nimanidir mavzu yoki asosiy g‘oya sifatida tanlash, taqdim etish yoki shu tarzda ko‘rsatish harakati yoki jarayoni; ayniqsa falsafada nimanidir mavzu sifatida ko‘rib chiqish.

syn: concept design – g‘oya asosidagi dizayn• The concept design was based on a fairy-tale theme.(G‘oya asosidagi dizayn ertak mavzusiga qurilgan edi.)styling – uslub bilan bezash• The product’s styling reflects modern minimalism.(Mahsulotning uslubi zamonaviy minimalizmni aks ettiradi.)
ex: The theme park’s theming includes decorations, music, and costumes. (Mavzuli bog‘ning mavzulashtiruvi bezaklar, musiqa va kostyumlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.)
Theming a party around a holiday makes it more festive.(Bayram mavzusida ziyofatni mavzulashtirish uni yanada bayramona qiladi.)
Good theming helps guests feel immersed in the experience.(Yaxshi mavzulashtirish mehmonlarni voqealarga sho‘ng‘ishlariga yordam beradi.)
The restaurant’s theming was inspired by 1950s America.(Restoranning mavzulashtiruvi 1950-yillardagi Amerika uslubidan ilhomlangan.)
theming.meta: nimanidir ma’lum bir mavzu yoki konsept asosida tashkil etish, bezash yoki shakllantirish harakati yoki jarayoni. bu so‘z “theme” fe’lining turli ma’nolaridagi harakatni ifodalaydi.

syn: outsider – begona• I felt like an outsider at their family dinner.(Men ularning oilaviy kechasida o‘zimni begona his qildim.)tagalong – izdan yuruvchi
ergashib yuruvchi• She came along but felt like a tagalong during the whole trip.(U birga bordi
lekin butun safar davomida o‘zini ergashib yurgandek his qildi.)
ex: He was the third wheel during their conversation and decided to leave. (U ularning suhbatida ortiqcha odam edi va chiqib ketishga qaror qildi.)
I felt like a third wheel when they went on a date without me.(Ular uchrashuvga mendan boshqa birga borishganda, o‘zimni ortiqcha his qildim.)
Nobody wants to be a third wheel on a romantic getaway.(Hech kim romantik sayohatda ortiqcha bo‘lishni xohlamaydi.)
She invited me to the movie, but I didn’t want to be the third wheel.(U meni kinoga taklif qildi, lekin men o‘zimni ortiqcha his qilishni istamadim.)
third wheel.meta: odatda juftlik orasida ortiqcha yoki keraksiz bo‘lgan shaxs; ko‘pincha ikki kishilik munosabatlarda uchinchi bo‘lib, o‘zini begona yoki noo‘rin his qiladigan kishi. shuningdek, keraksiz yoki foydasiz narsa yoki shaxs ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

syn: companion planting – birgalikda ekish usuli• The three sisters is a type of companion planting used for centuries.(Uch opa-singil asrlar davomida qo‘llanilgan birgalikda ekish usulidir.)polyculture – ko‘p turlik dehqonchilik• Polyculture methods like the three sisters can reduce pests and diseases.(Uch opa-singil kabi ko‘p turlik usullar zararkunandalar va kasalliklarni kamaytiradi.)
ex: Many Indigenous communities rely on the three sisters for their diet. (Ko‘plab tub jamoalar o‘z ovqatlanishida uch opa-singil o‘simliklariga tayanadilar.)
The three sisters planting method helps improve soil fertility.(Uch opa-singil usulida ekish tuproq unumdorligini oshiradi.)

The three sisters work together: maize provides support, beans enrich the soil, and squash shades the ground.(Uch opa-singil birgalikda ishlaydi: makkajo‘xori tayanch bo‘ladi, loviya tuproqni boyitadi, qovoq esa tuproqni soya qiladi.)
The legend of the three sisters teaches the value of cooperation and balance in nature.(Uch opa-singil haqidagi afsona tabiatdagi hamkorlik va muvozanat ahamiyatini o‘rgatadi.)
three sisters.meta: shimoliy va markaziy amerika tub aholisi orasida qadimdan bog‘dorchilikda uchta asosiy o‘simlik — makkajo‘xori (maize), qovoq (squash) va tok o‘simligi (climbing bean) — birgalikda yetishtiriladigan o‘simliklar guruhi.

syn: fineable – jarimaga tortiladigan• Jaywalking is a fineable offense in some cities.(Ba’zi shaharlarda yo‘lni belgilangan joydan o‘tmasdan kesib o‘tish — jarimaga sabab bo‘ladi.)punishable – jazoga tortiladigan• That kind of public disturbance is punishable by law.(Bunday jamoat bezovtasi qonun bilan jazolanadi.)
ex: Parking in a no-parking zone is ticketable and can lead to fines. (Ta’qiqlangan joyda mashina qo‘yish — jarima solinadigan holat bo‘lib, pul jazosi bilan yakunlanadi.)
Speeding is a ticketable offense in most countries.(Aksar davlatlarda tezlikni oshirish jarimaga sabab bo‘ladi.)
Littering in the park is ticketable under local regulations.(Mahalliy qoidalarga ko‘ra bog‘da axlat tashlash jarimaga sabab bo‘ladi.)
Blocking a fire hydrant is a ticketable violation in this city.(Ushbu shaharda yong‘in gidrantini to‘sib qo‘yish — jarima solinadigan huquqbuzarlikdir.)
ticketable.meta: chiptasi berilishi yoki belgilanishi mumkin bo‘lgan; keyinchalik ayniqsa yo‘l harakati qoidalarini buzish kabi qonunbuzarliklar uchun ishlatiladi — jarima yoki jazoga tortilishi mumkin bo‘lgan.

syn: turnstile – burilma eshik• The stadium entrance had electronic turnstiles instead of ticket gates.(Stadion kirish qismida chipta darvozalari o‘rniga elektron burilma eshiklar o‘rnatilgan edi.)fare gate – yo‘l haqi darvozasi• Subway stations often use fare gates to control passenger access.(Metro bekatlarida yo‘lovchilar kirishini nazorat qilish uchun yo‘l haqi darvozalari ishlatiladi.)
ex: The ticket gate beeped when someone tried to enter without a valid ticket. (Chipta darvozasi amal qilmaydigan chipta bilan kirishga uringan kishini aniqlab signal berdi.)
Passengers showed their tickets at the ticket gate before boarding the train.(Yo‘lovchilar poyezdga chiqishdan oldin chipta darvozasida chiptalarini ko‘rsatishdi.)
We waited at the ticket gate until it opened at 9 a.m.(Biz chipta darvozasida soat 9:00 da ochilguncha kutdik.)
She scanned her QR code at the ticket gate to enter the concert hall.(U kontsert zali ichiga kirish uchun QR-kodini chipta darvozasida skanerladi.)
ticket gate.meta: tadbir yoki joyga kirishda chiptalarni tekshirish uchun o‘rnatilgan to‘siq yoki darvoza; ayniqsa temiryo‘l stantsiyasida yoki boshqa transport punktlarida, odamlar chipta ko‘rsatib kirishlari kerak bo‘lgan avtomatik burilma eshik yoki to‘siq.

syn: land permit – yerga ruxsatnoma• Colonists needed a land permit to settle in new areas.(Yangi hududlarga joylashish uchun mustamlakachilar yerga ruxsatnoma olishlari kerak edi.)pastoral lease – yaylovni ijaraga olish huquqi• Many settlers later upgraded their tickets of occupation to pastoral leases.(Ko‘plab ko‘chmanchilar egallash guvohnomalarini keyinchalik yaylov ijarasiga aylantirishgan.)
ex: The ticket of occupation allowed European settlers to use specific land areas for farming. (Egallash guvohnomasi yevropalik mustamlakachilarga muayyan yer maydonlaridan dehqonchilik uchun foydalanish imkonini bergan.)

During British colonial rule, settlers received a ticket of occupation to graze their livestock.(Britaniya mustamlakachiligi davrida ko‘chmanchilar chorvalarini boqish uchun yer egallash guvohnomasini olishgan.)
The ticket of occupation system contributed to the displacement of Aboriginal communities.(Egallash guvohnomasi tizimi aborigen jamoalarning ko‘chishga majbur bo‘lishlariga sabab bo‘lgan.)
Many early settlers built homesteads on lands granted through tickets of occupation.(Dastlabki ko‘chmanchilar ko‘pincha egallash guvohnomasi asosida berilgan yerda uy-joylar qurganlar.)
ticket of occupation.meta: avstraliya tarixida, britaniya mustamlakachilik davrida, yevropalik mustamlakachi qishloq xo‘jaligi chorvachiligini olib borish uchun ma’lum bir yer maydonini ishlatish yoki yaylov sifatida foydalanish huquqini beruvchi rasmiy ruxsatnoma.

syn: custom – odat• Each tribe has its own customs and traditions.(Har bir qabila o‘zining odat va an’analariga ega.)protocol – ramsiy tartib• The welcoming was conducted according to cultural protocol.(Kutib olish madaniy ramsiy tartibga ko‘ra o‘tkazildi.)law (in cultural sense) – qonun
tikanga functions similarly to law.(Ba’zi hollarda tikanga qonun vazifasini bajaradi.)
ex: Respecting tikanga is important when participating in traditional Māori ceremonies. (An’anaviy Māori marosimlarida qatnashishda tikanga’ga hurmat bilan yondashish muhimdir.)
Tikanga plays a central role in Māori culture and community life.(Tikanga Māori madaniyati va jamoaviy hayotida markaziy rol o‘ynaydi.)
Many schools in New Zealand incorporate tikanga into their teaching.(Yangi Zelandiyadagi ko‘plab maktablarda darslarda tikanga o‘rgatiladi.)

Some court decisions in New Zealand now recognize tikanga as part of the legal process.(Yangi Zelandiya sudlarining ayrim qarorlarida hozirda tikanga huquqiy jarayonning bir qismi sifatida tan olinmoqda.)
tikanga.meta: maʼlum bir jamiyat, ayniqsa māori xalqining xulq-atvori va amaliyotlarini tartibga soluvchi odat, norma, qadriyat yoki tamoyil; shuningdek, qonun maʼnosida ham ishlatiladi.

syn: Māori custom – Māori odati• Each iwi follows its own Māori custom.(Har bir iwi o‘zining Māori odatiga amal qiladi.)cultural protocol – madaniy qoidalar• Tikanga Māori acts as a cultural protocol during formal events.(Tikanga Māori rasmiy tadbirlarda madaniy qoidalar rolini o‘ynaydi.)
ex: Understanding tikanga Māori is essential for respecting Māori culture. (Māori madaniyatiga hurmat bilan yondashish uchun tikanga Māori’ni tushunish zarur.)
Tikanga Māori guides the traditional ceremonies and social behavior of the Māori people.(Tikanga Māori — Māori xalqining an’anaviy marosimlari va ijtimoiy xulq-atvorini belgilaydi.)
In formal gatherings, participants often follow the rules of tikanga Māori.(Rasmiy yig‘inlarda ishtirokchilar ko‘pincha tikanga Māori qoidalariga amal qilishadi.)
The elders shared stories to teach the younger generation about tikanga Māori.(Keksalar yosh avlodga tikanga Māori haqida hikoyalar orqali saboq berishdi.)
tikanga māori.meta: māori xalqining xulq-atvori va amaliyotlarini tartibga soluvchi odatlar, normalar, qadriyatlar yoki tamoyillar majmuasi.

syn: intestinal gas – ichak gazlari• He complained of pain caused by intestinal gas.(U ichak gazlari sababli og‘riqdan shikoyat qildi.)bloating – qorin shishishi• Bloating is often related to trapped wind.(Qorin shishishi ko‘pincha havo to‘planishi bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.)
ex: Trapped wind can cause discomfort and bloating in the abdomen. (Havo to‘planishi qorin sohasida noqulaylik va shishishga olib kelishi mumkin.)
After eating quickly, he often suffers from trapped wind.(U tez ovqatlangach, ko‘pincha qorin gazlaridan aziyat chekadi.)
Drinking carbonated drinks can increase the risk of trapped wind.(Gazli ichimliklar ichish havo to‘planishi ehtimolini oshiradi.)
Gentle stomach massage helps release trapped wind in babies.(Yumshoq qorin massaji chaqaloqlarda havo to‘planishini kamaytirishga yordam beradi.)
trapped wind.meta: ovqatlanish paytida yutilgan havo yoki hazm jarayonida oshqozon va ichaklarda hosil bo‘lgan gaz, odatda qorin shishishi yoki noqulaylikka sabab bo‘ladi.

syn: Northern Triangle – Shimoliy Uchburchak• The Northern Triangle is another name for Triangulum.(Shimoliy Uchburchak — bu Triangulumning boshqa nomi.)
ex: Astronomers often study Triangulum for its distinct triangular shape. (Astronomlar Triangulumni o‘ziga xos uchburchak shakli uchun o‘rganadilar.)
Triangulum is a small constellation located near Andromeda.(Triangulum Andromeda yaqinida joylashgan kichik yulduzlar guruhidir.)
The three stars of Triangulum form a noticeable isosceles triangle in the night sky.(Triangulumdagi uchta yulduz tun osmonida ko‘zga tashlanadigan teng yonli uchburchak hosil qiladi.)
Unlike many constellations, Triangulum is simple but geometrically interesting.(Ko‘pgina yulduzlar guruhidan farqli o‘laroq, Triangulum sodda, lekin geometrik jihatdan qiziqarli.)
triangulum.meta: shimoliy yarimsharda, andromeda va aries yulduz to‘plamlari orasida joylashgan kichik va ko‘zga unchalik tashlanmaydigan yulduzlar guruhi; asosiy uchta yulduzi teng yonli uchburchak hosil qiladi.

syn: Southern Triangle – Janubiy Uchburchak• The Southern Triangle is another name for Triangulum Australe.(Janubiy Uchburchak — bu Triangulum Australening boshqa nomi.)
ex: The three main stars of Triangulum Australe form a distinct triangle in the night sky. (Triangulum Australe guruhining uch asosiy yulduzi tun osmonida yaqqol uchburchak hosil qiladi.)
Triangulum Australe is visible only from the southern hemisphere.(Triangulum Australe faqat janubiy yarimshardan ko‘rinadi.)
The constellation lies close to the Milky Way and can be spotted near Alpha Centauri.(Bu yulduzlar guruhi sut yo‘li yaqinida joylashgan bo‘lib, Alpha Centauri atrofida ko‘rish mumkin.)
Early navigators used Triangulum Australe for guidance in the southern seas.(Dastlabki dengizchilar janubiy dengizlarda yo‘l topishda Triangulum Australedan foydalanganlar.)
triangulum australe.meta: janubiy yarimsharda joylashgan kichik yulduzlar guruhi bo‘lib, sut yo‘li yaqinida, alfa tsentavri va janubiy osmon qutbi atroflarida joylashgan; uchta asosiy yulduzdan iborat.

syn: ethical dilemma – etik muammo / axloqiy dilemma• Doctors often face ethical dilemmas in emergency situations.(Shifokorlar ko‘pincha shoshilinch holatlarda axloqiy muammolarga duch kelishadi.)moral dilemma – axloqiy tanlov muammosi• The character in the film struggles with a moral dilemma.(Film qahramoni axloqiy tanlov muammosiga duch keladi.)
ex: Philosophers often debate the ethical implications of the trolley problem. (Falsafa mutaxassislari ko‘pincha trolley muammosining axloqiy oqibatlarini muhokama qiladilar.)
The trolley problem challenges people to make difficult moral choices.(Trolley muammosi odamlarni murakkab axloqiy qarorlar qabul qilishga majbur qiladi.)
The experiment is hypothetical, but it reveals how we value lives in moral reasoning.(Bu tajriba faraziy bo‘lsa-da, axloqiy fikrlashda hayotlarga qanday baho berishimizni ochib beradi.)
Many AI researchers use the trolley problem to study machine ethics.(Ko‘plab sun’iy intellekt tadqiqotchilari trolley muammosidan mashina etikasi bo‘yicha foydalanishadi.)
trolley problem.meta: falsafiy fikriy tajriba bo‘lib, tasavvur qilinadigan vaziyatda to‘xtatib bo‘lmaydigan tramvay yoki trolley temir yo‘lda bir guruh odamga qarab harakat qilmoqda.

syn: daft – ahmoqona• What a daft idea!(Qanday ahmoqona fikr!)silly – tentak• Stop being silly and be serious.(Tentak bo‘lishni bas qil
jiddiy bo‘l.)foolish – nodon• It was a foolish decision to ignore the warnings.(Ogohlantirishlarga e’tibor bermaslik nodonlik edi.)
ex: Only the twp would believe that story. (Bu voqeaga faqat ahmoqlar ishonadi.)
He’s acting so twp today.(U bugun juda tentaklarcha harakat qilayapti.)
Don’t be twp – check the fuel before starting the car.(Ahmoq bo‘lma – mashinani yoqishdan oldin yoqilg‘ini tekshir.)
She called her brother twp after he spilled juice on the laptop.(U ukasini laptopga sharbat to‘kib yuborgani uchun tentak deb atadi.)
twp.meta: Twp – bu aqlsiz, tentak yoki juda nodon kishilarni yoki harakatlarni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan so‘z. Ba’zida ko‘plik shaklida (the twp) jamiyatdagi ahmoq odamlar to‘plamini ifodalash uchun ham qo‘llanadi.

syn: infatuation – mahliyo bo‘lish• His infatuation clouded his judgment.(Uning mahliyo bo‘lishi uning aqliga ta’sir qildi.)yearning – intilish
sog‘inch• She felt a deep yearning to see him again.(U yana uni ko‘rishga chuqur sog‘inch his qildi.)longing – sog‘inch
orziqish• There was a longing in her voice when she spoke of him.(U haqda gapirganda
ex: His typee for her lasted for years. (Uning unga bo‘lgan oshuftaligi yillar davom etdi.)
After meeting her, he was in a complete typee.(U bilan uchrashgach, u butunlay muhabbat azobiga tushib qoldi.)
She wrote poetry filled with typee after their breakup.(Ular ajrashganidan keyin u chuqur oshuftalik bilan to‘la she’rlar yozdi.)
The typee he felt made it impossible for him to focus on work.(U his qilgan oshuftalik uni ishdan chalg‘itdi.)
typee.meta: bu kuchli oshuftalik yoki sevgi sog‘inchi holatini ifodalovchi so‘z. Odamni chalg‘itadigan, kuchli sevgi yoki qattiq maftunkorlik holatini bildiradi. Shuningdek, bu so‘z romantik musiqaning bir janrini ifodalash uchun sifat sifatida ham ishlatiladi.

syn: underdeliver – kam yetkazib bermoq• The plant underdelivered during the critical months.(Zavod muhim oylar davomida kam yetkazib berdi.)fail to meet demand – talabni qondira olmaslik• Suppliers failed to meet demand during the crisis.(Ta’minotchilar inqiroz paytida talabni qondira olishmadi.)
ex: If farmers underproduce, the country may face food shortages. (Agar dehqonlar kam ishlab chiqarsa, mamlakat oziq-ovqat tanqisligiga duch kelishi mumkin.)
The company has been underproducing essential medicines for the past year.(Kompaniya o‘tgan yil davomida zarur dori vositalarini kam ishlab chiqarmoqda.)
Due to drought, the region severely underproduced grain this season.(Qurg‘oqchilik sababli bu mavsumda mintaqa g‘allani juda kam ishlab chiqardi.)
The team underproduced in the final quarter, missing key targets.(Jamoa so‘nggi chorakda kam ishlab chiqardi, asosiy maqsadlarga erisha olmadi.)
underproduce.meta: Underproduce – Bu biror mahsulot yoki tovarni odatdagidan yoki zarur bo‘lgandan kamroq miqdorda ishlab chiqarish; biror hudud yoki tizimni odatdagi hosildorlik darajasidan pastroq darajada ishlab chiqarishga sabab bo‘lish.

syn: tayyor emas• The song had a raw energy that made it special.(Qo‘shiqda uni o‘ziga xos qiladigan xom energiya bor edi.)unfinished – tugallanmagan• The underproduced demo sounded unfinished but promising.(Kam ishlab chiqilgan demo tugallanmagandek eshitildi
ex: Some indie bands prefer an underproduced sound to keep their music raw and authentic. (Ba’zi mustaqil guruhlar musiqalarini xom va tabiiy saqlash uchun kam ishlab chiqilgan ohangni afzal ko‘radilar.)
The album felt underproduced, with many tracks sounding unfinished.(Albom kam ishlab chiqilgandek tuyuldi, chunki ko‘p treklar tugallanmagan kabi eshitildi.)
His first single was a bit underproduced, but it had emotional power.(Uning birinchi qo‘shig‘i biroz kam ishlab chiqilgandi, lekin unda hissiyot kuchli edi.)
The podcast episode was underproduced and lacked sound clarity.(Podkast epizodi kam ishlab chiqilgandi va tovush aniqligi yo‘q edi.)
underproduced.meta: Bu atama asosan qo‘shiq yoki musiqa asari haqida ishlatiladi va u yetarlicha ishlab chiqilmagan, yozishda yoki aranjirovkada yetarli darajada mukammallikka erishilmagan, natijada musiqa xom, noaniq yoki sayqallanmagan tarzda eshitilishi anglatadi.

syn: low productivity – past unumdorlik• Low productivity among staff caused project delays.(Xodimlar orasida past unumdorlik loyiha kechikishiga sabab bo‘ldi.)inefficiency – samara bermaslik
sust ishlash• Inefficiency in the system resulted in financial loss.(Tizimdagi samarasizlik moliyaviy yo‘qotishga olib keldi.)
ex: Long working hours often lead to employee fatigue and underproductivity. (Uzoq ish soatlari ko‘pincha xodimlarning charchashi va kam samaradorlikka olib keladi.)
The factory’s underproductivity is causing delays in shipments.(Zavoddagi kam ishlab chiqarish yuk jo‘natmalarining kechikishiga sabab bo‘lmoqda.)
Poor management can lead to widespread underproductivity in teams.(Yomon boshqaruv jamoalarda keng ko‘lamli kam samaradorlikka olib kelishi mumkin.)
Underproductivity in agriculture has been a long-standing issue in the region.(Qishloq xo‘jaligidagi kam unumdorlik mintaqadagi uzoq yillik muammo hisoblanadi.)
underproductivity.meta: Underproductivity – bu yetarlicha darajada mahsulot ishlab chiqarmaslik yoki mehnat samaradorligining past bo‘lishi holati. Ya’ni, ishlab chiqarish yoki faoliyat kutilgan yoki zarur darajaga yetmaydi.

syn: secure – xavfsiz• The server is secure from external threats.(Server tashqi tahdidlardan himoyalangan.)tamper-proof – aralashuvga chidamli• They installed a tamper-proof locking system.(Ular aralashuvga chidamli qulflash tizimini o‘rnatishdi.)
ex: There is no such thing as an unhackable network; all systems have vulnerabilities. (Xakerlikka chidamli tarmoq degan narsa yo‘q; barcha tizimlarda zaifliklar mavjud.)
The company claims its new system is completely unhackable.(Kompaniya yangi tizimi butunlay buzib bo‘lmaydiganligini da’vo qilmoqda.)
They invested heavily in creating an unhackable encryption method.(Ular buzib bo‘lmaydigan shifrlash usulini yaratishga katta sarmoya kiritishdi.)
No device is truly unhackable in the long run.(Uzoq muddatda hech bir qurilma chinakam xakerlikka chidamli emas.)
unhackable.meta: Unhackable – bu kompyuter, dastur, tarmoq va shunga o‘xshash texnologik tizimlar haqida qo‘llanadigan atama bo‘lib, uni buzish, noqonuniy ravishda kirish yoki xakerlik hujumlari orqali zarar yetkazish mumkin emas degan ma’noni anglatadi.

syn: voice call – ovozli qo‘ng‘iroq• He made a voice call through the app.(U ilova orqali ovozli qo‘ng‘iroq qildi.)audio chat – audio suhbat• Audio chat is a useful feature for remote teams.(Audio suhbat uzoqdan ishlovchilar uchun foydali imkoniyatdir.)
ex: Many messaging apps now offer free voice chat options. (Ko‘pgina xabarlashuv ilovalari endi bepul ovozli chat imkoniyatini taklif qiladi.)
We used voice chat to coordinate during the online game.(Biz onlayn o‘yin paytida muvofiqlashish uchun ovozli chatdan foydalandik.)
Voice chat helps remote teams feel more connected.(Ovozli suhbat uzoqdan ishlovchi jamoalarga bir-biriga yaqinroq bo‘lishga yordam beradi.)
Teenagers often prefer voice chat to texting.(O‘smirlar ko‘pincha yozishdan ko‘ra ovozli suhbatni afzal ko‘rishadi.)
voice chat.meta: Voice chat – bu kompyuter tarmog‘i (ayniqsa, internet) orqali jonli audio (ovoz) almashinuvi orqali olib boriladigan aloqa shakli. Bunda ikki yoki undan ortiq foydalanuvchilar real vaqt rejimida ovoz orqali muloqot qiladilar.

syn: talk online – onlayn gaplashmoq• They talk online using voice chat apps.(Ular ovozli chat ilovalari orqali onlayn gaplashadi.)use voice call – ovozli qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoq• She used a voice call instead of video.(U video o‘rniga ovozli qo‘ng‘iroqdan foydalandi.)
ex: I prefer to voice chat rather than type messages. (Men xabar yozishdan ko‘ra ovozli chat qilishni afzal ko‘raman.)
We usually voice chat while playing games online.(Biz odatda onlayn o‘yin o‘ynaganimizda ovoz orqali suhbatlashamiz.)
Let’s voice chat later tonight instead of texting.(Kechroq yozishmasdan ko‘ra, ovozli suhbatlashamiz.)
They voice chat every day to stay in touch while living in different countries.(Ular turli davlatlarda yashaganiga qaramay har kuni ovozli muloqot qilishadi.)
voice chat.meta: Voice chat – internet yoki kompyuter tarmog‘i orqali jonli audio orqali og‘zaki muloqot qilish; real vaqt rejimida ovoz orqali suhbatlashish.

syn: defect (from a party) – partiyadan chiqib ketmoq• He defected from the ruling party to join the opposition.(U hukmron partiyani tark etib
muxolifatga qo‘shildi.)switch sides – tomon o‘zgartirmoq• The MP switched sides just before the confidence vote.(Deputat ishonch ovoz berishidan oldin tomonini o‘zgartirdi.)
ex: Several MPs waka jumped during the recent crisis. (Yaqinda yuz bergan inqiroz vaqtida bir necha deputat partiyasini almashtirdi.)
The opposition accused him of waka jumping to gain political advantage.(Muxolifat uni siyosiy foyda olish uchun partiya almashtirishda aybladi.)
He threatened to waka jump if the party didn’t support his proposal.(U taklifini qo‘llab-quvvatlashmasa, partiyasini almashtirish bilan tahdid qildi.)
MPs who waka jump are often criticized by their voters.(Partiyasini almashtirgan deputatlar ko‘pincha saylovchilari tomonidan tanqid qilinadi.)
waka jump.meta: Waka jump – bu atama parlament a’zosi o‘zining amaldagi parlament muddatida bir siyosiy partiyadan boshqasiga o‘tishini anglatadi. Ya’ni, bir partiyani tashlab, boshqa partiyaga o‘tish harakati.

syn: party defector – partiyadan chiqib ketgan deputat• The party defector joined the opposition just before the election.(Partiyadan chiqib ketgan deputat saylov oldidan muxolifatga qo‘shildi.)floor crosser – parlament ichida partiyani o‘zgartirgan shaxs• Several floor crossers were blamed for the fall of the coalition.(Bir nechta partiya o‘zgartirgan deputatlar koalitsiyaning parchalanishida ayblandi.)
ex: Waka jumpers often cause instability in parliamentary coalitions. (Partiya almashtirgan deputatlar ko‘pincha parlament koalitsiyalarida beqarorlikka sabab bo‘ladi.)
The waka jumper faced criticism from his former party members.(Ushbu partiya almashtirgan deputat sobiq partiyadoshlarining tanqidiga uchradi.)
Many voters accused the waka jumper of betrayal.(Ko‘plab saylovchilar bu deputatni xiyonatda aybladilar.)
The rise in waka jumpers has led to calls for reform in electoral laws.(Partiya almashtirgan deputatlar sonining oshishi saylov qonunlariga islohot chaqiriqlarini keltirib chiqardi.)
waka jumper.meta: Waka jumper – bu o‘zining parlament muddatida bir siyosiy partiyadan boshqasiga o‘tgan parlament a’zosiga nisbatan ishlatiladigan atama. Ya’ni, amaldagi partiyasini tashlab, boshqa partiyaga o‘tgan shaxs.

syn: party switching – partiyani almashtirish• Party switching is a common practice in coalition governments.(Koalitsion hukumatlarda partiyani almashtirish odatiy hol.)floor crossing – parlament ichida partiya o‘zgartirish• Floor crossing has led to changes in the balance of power.(Parlament ichidagi partiya o‘zgartirish kuch muvozanatini o‘zgartirib yubordi.)
ex: Some countries have laws to prevent waka jumping. (Ba’zi mamlakatlarda partiya almashtirishning oldini olish uchun qonunlar mavjud.)
Waka jumping is a controversial issue in many parliamentary systems.(Ko‘plab parlament tizimlarida partiya almashtirish bahsli masala hisoblanadi.)
The MP faced criticism after his unexpected waka jumping to the ruling party.(Deputat hukmron partiyaga kutilmagan tarzda o‘tganidan so‘ng tanqidga uchradi.)
Waka jumping may undermine the trust of voters in their elected representatives.(Partiya almashtirish saylovchilarning o‘z vakillariga bo‘lgan ishonchini susaytirishi mumkin.)
waka jumping.meta: Waka jumping – bu parlament a’zosining o‘zining amaldagi parlament muddati davomida bir siyosiy partiyadan boshqasiga o‘tish harakati yoki amaliyoti. Bu jarayon ko‘pincha siyosiy beqarorlik yoki shaxsiy manfaatlar bilan bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.

syn: rambling – cho‘zilgan va tartibsiz gap• Her rambling confused the audience.(Uning cho‘zilgan gaplari tinglovchilarni chalg‘itdi.)blathering – bo‘lar-bo‘lmas gapirish• We sat through hours of blathering without a clear point.(Biz aniq fikrsiz soatlab bo‘lar-bo‘lmas gaplarga quloq tutdik.)waffling – harakatsiz
aniq fikrsiz gapirish• Stop waffling and answer the question!(Bo‘sh gapirishni bas qil va savolga javob ber!)
ex: His speech quickly turned into pointless windbagging. (Uning nutqi tezda behuda va uzun gapirishga aylandi.)
The meeting was full of windbagging and no real decisions were made.(Yig‘ilish faqat cho‘ziq gaplar bilan o‘tdi, hech qanday qaror qabul qilinmadi.)
I couldn’t stand the windbagging tone of the article.(Men maqolaning cho‘ziq va dabdabali uslubiga chiday olmadim.)
His windbagging speech bored the entire audience.(Uning ma’nosiz va cho‘ziq nutqi butun tinglovchilarni zeriktirdi.)
windbagging.meta: Windbagging – bu biror mavzu haqida uzoq, zerikarli va dabdabali tarzda gapirish yoki yozish, lekin bunda hech qanday qiziqarli, muhim yoki foydali ma’lumot berilmaydi; shunchaki behuda vaqt olish.

syn: verbose – keragidan ortiq gapiradigan• His verbose response made the meeting drag on.(Uning keragidan ortiqcha javobi yig‘ilishni cho‘zdi.)wordy – so‘z bilan to‘lib-toshgan• The contract was too wordy to be understood easily.(Shartnoma juda ko‘p so‘zli bo‘lgani uchun osongina tushunilmadi.)long-winded – cho‘ziq va zerikarli• She gave a long-winded answer to a simple question.(U oddiy savolga cho‘ziq va zerikarli javob berdi.)
ex: His explanation was so windbaggy that I lost interest halfway through. (Uning tushuntirishi shu qadar cho‘ziq va zerikarli ediki, men yarim yo‘lida qiziqishni yo‘qotdim.)
The politician’s windbaggy speech lasted over an hour but said very little.(Siyosatchining cho‘ziq va dabdabali nutqi bir soatdan ko‘proq davom etdi, ammo deyarli hech narsa aytilmadi.)
I can’t stand windbaggy lectures with no clear message.(Men mazmunsiz, cho‘zilgan ma’ruzalarni yoqtirmayman.)
Her windbaggy writing style makes it hard to understand the point.(Uning cho‘ziq va dabdabali yozuv uslubi asosiy fikrni tushunishni qiyinlashtiradi.)
windbaggy.meta: Windbaggy – bu odam yoki nutq uslubi haqida aytiladi va behuda, cho‘ziq, zerikarli hamda dabdabali gapirish yoki yozish xususiyatiga ega bo‘lishni bildiradi.

syn: wind tower – shamol minorasi• Wind towers help cool down buildings using natural airflow.(Shamol minoralari binolarni tabiiy havo oqimi yordamida sovitishga yordam beradi.)badgir (Persian origin) – shamol tutuvchi inshoot• Badgirs are a symbol of ancient Iranian architecture.(Badgirlar qadimiy Eron me’morchiligining timsoli hisoblanadi.)
ex: The ancient wind catcher design is an early form of air conditioning. (Qadimiy shamol tutgich dizayni erta davrdagi konditsioner shaklidir.)
Traditional houses in Iran often have wind catchers to cool the rooms naturally.(Eronning an’anaviy uylarida xonalarni tabiiy sovitish uchun shamol tutgichlar bo‘ladi.)
The wind catcher directed fresh air into the home during hot summers.(Shamol tutgich issiq yoz kunlarida uyga yangi havo yo‘naltirardi.)
They restored the wind catcher on the historic building as part of the renovation.(Ular ta’mirlash ishlarida tarixiy binodagi shamol tutgichni tiklashdi.)
wind catcher.meta: asosan Yaqin Sharq me’morchiligida uchraydigan, bino tomida joylashgan minoraga o‘xshash tuzilma bo‘lib, unda vertikal ochilishlar mavjud. Bu ochilishlar orqali shamol ichkariga yo‘naltiriladi va bino ichini tabiiy ravishda sovitish uchun ishlatiladi.

syn: air-dried – havo bilan quritilgan• Air-dried meat is also common in rural areas.(Havo bilan quritilgan go‘sht ham qishloq joylarida keng tarqalgan.)sun-dried – quyoshda quritilgan• Sun-dried tomatoes are rich in flavor.(Quyoshda quritilgan pomidorlar lazzatga boy.)
ex: The wind-dried meat can be stored for several months without refrigeration. (Shamolda quritilgan go‘shtni muzlatkichsiz bir necha oy saqlash mumkin.)
They served wind-dried fish as a local delicacy.(Ular shamolda quritilgan baliqni mahalliy taom sifatida tortishdi.)
Wind-dried herbs are common in traditional medicine.(Shamolda quritilgan o‘tlar an’anaviy tabobatda keng qo‘llaniladi.)
The villagers packed wind-dried fruit for the winter.(Qishloq aholisi qish uchun shamolda quritilgan mevalarni yig‘ishdi.)
wind-dried.meta: Wind-dried – shamol yordamida quritilgan, ayniqsa ovqat (go‘sht, baliq va boshqalar) haqida qo‘llanadi. Bu usulda mahsulot ochiq havoda shamolda osib qo‘yish orqali tabiiy tarzda quritiladi va saqlanadi.

syn: air-dry – havo bilan quritmoq• We air-dried the fabrics under the sun.(Biz matolarni quyoshda havo bilan quritdik.)sun-dry – quyoshda quritmoq• They sun-dry tomatoes for preservation.(Ular pomidorlarni saqlash uchun quyoshda quritadilar.)
ex: They wind-dry the fish on racks by the seaside. (Ular baliqni dengiz bo‘yidagi panjaralarda shamolda quritishadi.)
The villagers used to wind-dry meat to preserve it for the winter.(Qishloq aholisi qish uchun go‘shtni shamolda quritib saqlashardi.)
Farmers wind-dry herbs on wooden frames in the backyard.(Dehqonlar o‘t-o‘lanlarni orqa hovlidagi yog‘och ramkalarda shamolda quritadilar.)
We wind-dried the mushrooms to use them during the cold season.(Qo‘ziqorinlarni sovuq mavsumda ishlatish uchun shamolda quritdik.)
wind-dry.meta: Wind-dry – biror narsani, ayniqsa ovqat (go‘sht, baliq va boshqalar)ni shamolga ta’sir qilish orqali quritish yoki saqlash. Bu jarayon odatda mahsulotni shamolda osib qo‘yish orqali amalga oshiriladi.

syn: air-drying – havo bilan quritish• Air-drying preserves the natural taste of the food.(Havo bilan quritish mahsulotning tabiiy ta’mini saqlab qoladi.)sun-drying – quyoshda quritish• Sun-drying is common in warm regions
unlike wind-drying used in coastal areas.(Quyoshda quritish issiq hududlarda keng tarqalgan bo‘lsa-da
shamolda quritish dengiz bo‘yida ko‘proq qo‘llaniladi.)
ex: The locals rely on wind-drying to store fish for the off-season. (Mahalliy aholi mavsumdan tashqari baliqni saqlash uchun shamolda quritishga tayanadi.)
Wind-drying is one of the oldest methods of food preservation.(Shamolda quritish oziq-ovqatni saqlashning eng qadimiy usullaridan biridir.)
They used traditional wind-drying racks to prepare dried meat.(Ular quritilgan go‘sht tayyorlash uchun an’anaviy shamolda quritish moslamalaridan foydalandilar.)
Wind-drying gives fish a unique flavor and texture.(Shamolda quritish baliqqa o‘ziga xos ta’m va tuzilma beradi.)
wind-drying.meta: Wind-drying – bu biror narsani, ayniqsa ovqat mahsulotlarini (asosan go‘sht yoki baliqni) shamol ta’sirida ochiq havoda osib qo‘yish orqali tabiiy quritish jarayoni. Bu usul mahsulotni uzoq muddat saqlash uchun qadimdan qo‘llanib kelinadi.

syn: burial shroud – dafn yopinchig‘i / kafan• They placed the body in a burial shroud for the final rites.(Ular jasadni dafn yopinchig‘iga o‘rab
oxirgi marosimni o‘tkazishdi.)funeral cloth – dafn matosi• The funeral cloth was embroidered with religious symbols.(Dafn matosi diniy belgilar bilan bezatilgan edi.)
ex: Ancient tombs often contain remnants of winding clothes. (Qadimiy qabrlarda ko‘pincha kafan matolarining qoldiqlari topiladi.)
The body was carefully wrapped in winding clothes before burial.(Jasad dafn etilishidan oldin ehtiyotkorlik bilan kafanga o‘raldi.)
They prepared the winding clothes according to traditional customs.(Ular kafanni an’anaviy urf-odatlarga muvofiq tayyorlashdi.)
The museum displayed a sample of linen winding clothes from Egypt.(Muzeyda Misrdan topilgan zig‘ir matoli kafan namunasi namoyish etildi.)
winding clothes.meta: Winding clothes – bu o‘lik jasadni o‘rash uchun ishlatiladigan matolar yoki o‘ramlar. Odatda dafn marosimida jasad shu matolarga o‘raladi. "Kafan" tushunchasiga juda yaqin.

syn: gradual ending – asta-sekin tugash• The project faced a gradual ending due to budget cuts.(Byudjet qisqarishi tufayli loyiha asta-sekin tugadi.)slow decline – sekin pasayish• There was a slow decline in interest over time.(Vaqt o‘tishi bilan qiziqish sekin pasayib bordi.)cooling-off period – tinchlanish davri• They took a cooling-off period after the long negotiations.(Ular uzoq muzokaralardan so‘ng tinchlanish davrini olishdi.)
ex: After the busy season, there was a noticeable winding down of activity in the office. (Band mavsumdan so‘ng ofisdagi faollikning asta-sekin kamaygani sezildi.)
The winding down of the project took several months.(Loyihaning sekin-asta yakunlanishi bir necha oy davom etdi.)
We're now in the winding down phase of the negotiations.(Hozir biz muzokaralarning yakunlanish bosqichidamiz.)
She enjoyed the peaceful winding down at the end of her day.(U kun oxiridagi sokin dam olish jarayonidan zavq oldi.)
winding down.meta: bu biror jarayon, faoliyat yoki holatning asta-sekin yakuniga yetishi yoki tugatilishi jarayoni; harakat, hajm yoki ko‘lamning pasayishi. Shuningdek, inson faoliyatining sekinlashishi yoki dam olish holatiga o‘tishi ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

syn: turning basin – burilish havzasi• The boat waited in the turning basin for clearance.(Qayiq ruxsat olish uchun burilish havzasida kutib turdi.)canal loop – kanal halqasi (less common)• Some boats used the canal loop instead of a winding hole.(Ba’zi qayiqchilar burilish joyi o‘rniga kanal halqasidan foydalandilar.)
ex: Winding holes are essential for navigation on narrow canals. (Toru kanallarda harakatlanish uchun burilish joylari muhim hisoblanadi.)
The boat had to travel to the next winding hole to turn around.(Qayiq burilish uchun keyingi burilish havzasigacha borishga majbur bo‘ldi.)
Without a winding hole nearby, they couldn't reverse direction.(Yaqin atrofda burilish joyi bo‘lmagani uchun ular yo‘nalishni o‘zgartira olmadilar.)
Most narrowboats plan routes according to available winding holes.(Ko‘pchilik tor kemalar yo‘nalishlarini mavjud burilish joylariga qarab rejalashtiradi.)
winding hole.meta: Winding hole – Britaniya kanal tizimida uchraydigan, kanalning kengaytirilgan qismi bo‘lib, kemalar yoki qayiqchilar shu yerda oson burilish yoki yo‘nalish o‘zgartirish imkoniga ega bo‘ladilar.

syn: sail – suzmoq• They sailed for weeks without seeing land.(Ular yer ko‘rmasdan haftalab suzdilar.)voyage – safar qilmoq• He voyaged across the Atlantic in a wooden boat.(U yog‘och kemada Atlantika bo‘ylab sayohat qildi.)
ex: The sailors spent years windjamming on distant seas. (Dengizchilar uzoq dengizlarda yillar davomida suzishdi.)
They windjammed across the Atlantic in an old merchant ship.(Ular qadimiy savdo kemasida Atlantika bo‘ylab suzdilar.)
As a boy, he dreamed of windjamming to exotic islands.(U bola bo‘lganida ekzotik orollarga suzishni orzu qilgan edi.)
The novel tells the tale of men who windjammed through storms and war.(Roman bo‘ronlar va urushlardan o‘tib suzgan erkaklar haqida hikoya qiladi.)

apollo.meta: Apollon – qadimgi Yunon (va keyinchalik Rim) mifologiyasida: Zevs va Leto o‘g‘li, Artemida (Diana) ning egizak ukasi. Apollon quyosh, musiqa, she’riyat, san’at, otish (kamonchilik), bashorat va shifo xudosi sifatida tanilgan.

syn: archipallium – (older anatomical term)hippocampal cortex – (gipokampus po‘stlog‘i)limbic cortex – (ba'zi kontekstlarda bog‘liq atama)
ant: ko‘p qatlamli miyaning tashqi qismipaleocortex – o‘rta darajadagi evolyutsion qadimgi po‘stloq qismi
ex: Unlike the neocortex, the archicortex has a simpler, three-layered structure. (Neokorteksdan farqli o‘laroq, arkikorteks sodda, uch qatlamli tuzilishga ega.)
The archicortex plays an essential role in memory formation.(Arkikorteks xotirani shakllantirishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)
Damage to the archicortex can result in severe memory loss and disorientation.(Arkikorteksga zarar yetishi jiddiy xotira yo‘qotish va chalkashliklarga olib kelishi mumkin.)
The hippocampus is the primary component of the archicortex in humans.(Odamlarda arkikorteksning asosiy qismi bu — gipokampus.)
archicortex.meta: Archicortex – miyaning archipallium deb ataluvchi qadimgi qavati; xususan, yetuk sutemizuvchilarda bu tushuncha gipokampal korteksni (gipokampus sohasidagi po‘stloq qismi) anglatadi.

syn: street thug – (ko‘cha bezori)touts – (noqonuniy xizmat ko‘rsatuvchilar)hoodlum – (jirkanch jinoyatchi yoki mushtlashuvchi shaxs)area boys (plural
ex: Area boys often control parking spaces and demand fees from drivers. (Ko‘cha yigitlar ko‘pincha to‘xtash joylarini nazorat qilib, haydovchilardan pul talab qilishadi.)
The police arrested several area boys involved in street extortion.(Politsiya ko‘chada tovlamachilik qilgan bir nechta hudud yigitlarini hibsga oldi.)
Area boys are sometimes hired by local politicians to intimidate rivals.(Ba’zida mahalliy siyosatchilar raqiblarini qo‘rqitish uchun ko‘cha yigitlardan foydalanishadi.)
Many residents feel unsafe due to the activities of area boys in their neighborhood.(Ko‘plab aholi yashayotgan joydagi hudud yigitlari faoliyati tufayli o‘zlarini xavfsiz his qilishmaydi.)
area boy.meta: – Nigeriyada ishlatiladigan og‘zaki ifoda bo‘lib, odatda yosh yigitlarni anglatadi. Bu yoshlar ko‘pincha jinoyatchilik, tovlamachilik, o‘g‘rilik, giyohvandlik savdosi yoki noqonuniy faoliyatlar orqali pul yoki ta’sir kuchi orttirishga harakat qilishadi.

syn: vulnerability footprintsystem exposure pointsentry points for attacksecurity risk surface
ex: Unpatched software increases the attack surface for cybercriminals. (Yangilanmagan dasturiy ta’minot kiberjinoyatchilar uchun hujum yuzasini kengaytiradi.)
Reducing the attack surface is crucial for improving system security.(Tizim xavfsizligini oshirish uchun hujum yuzasini kamaytirish juda muhim.)
Misconfigured servers added to the company’s overall attack surface.(Noto‘g‘ri sozlangan serverlar kompaniyaning umumiy hujum yuzasini kengaytirdi.)
Developers must consider the attack surface during the software design phase.(Dasturchilar dasturiy ta’minotni loyihalash jarayonida hujum yuzasini inobatga olishlari kerak.)
attack surface.meta: Attack surface – kompyuter tizimi yoki dasturiy muhitdagi barcha mumkin bo‘lgan kirish nuqtalari yoki zaifliklarning yig‘indisi. Bu nuqtalar orqali tizimga hujum qilish yoki zarar yetkazish ehtimoli mavjud.

syn: axled – (less common but similar in meaning)axle-based – (asosiy mexanik tuzilma sifatida o‘qqa ega)wheeled – (g‘ildirakli — closely related but broader)
ex: They repaired the single-axed cart used for carrying goods. (Ular yuk tashish uchun ishlatiladigan bitta o‘qli aravani ta’mirlashdi.)
The machine has a double-axed design for better stability.(Uskuna yaxshiroq barqarorlik uchun ikki o‘qli dizaynga ega.)
Multi-axed trucks are commonly used for transporting heavy loads.(Ko‘p o‘qli yuk mashinalari odatda og‘ir yuklarni tashish uchun ishlatiladi.)
The single-axed trailer was easier to maneuver on narrow roads.(Bitta o‘qli tirkama tor yo‘llarda boshqarish uchun qulayroq edi.)
axed.meta: Axed – ob’ekt, tuzilma va hokazolarga nisbatan qo‘llanilib, ularning o‘qi yoki o‘qlari mavjudligini bildiradi. Ko‘pincha oldida boshqa so‘zlar bilan birga ishlatiladi (masalan, “single-axed” — bitta o‘qli, “multi-axed” — ko‘p o‘qli).

ex: Azonto involves energetic and expressive movements. (Azonto raqsi jo‘shqin va ifodali harakatlardan iborat bo‘ladi.)
They performed the azonto dance at the cultural festival.(Ular madaniy festivalda azonto raqsini ijro etishdi.)
Azonto gained international popularity through viral music videos.(Azonto musiqiy videolar orqali butun dunyoda mashhurlikka erishdi.)
The dance mimics daily actions with humor and creativity.(Bu raqs kundalik harakatlarni kulgili va ijodiy tarzda taqlid qiladi.)
azonto.meta: Azonto – Gana kelib chiqishi bo‘lgan freestyle (erkin uslubdagi) raqs turi. Bu raqsda odatda harakatlar suyuq, ritmik va kundalik hayotdagi harakatlarni taqlid qiluvchi bo‘ladi. Raqs paytida odatda bir oyog‘ini burish yoki siljitish bilan bajariladi.

ex: The baby gate prevented the child from entering the kitchen. (Bola eshigi bolaning oshxonaga kirishini to‘sib qo‘ydi.)
We installed a baby gate at the top of the stairs to keep our toddler safe.(Biz zinaning yuqori qismiga bola eshigi o‘rnatdikki, kichik farzandimiz xavfsiz bo‘lsin.)
The baby gate opens easily for adults but stays locked for children.(Bola eshigi kattalar uchun oson ochiladi, lekin bolalar uchun yopiq qoladi.)
Modern baby gates are designed to blend with home décor.(Zamonaviy bolalar to‘siqlari uy jihozlari bilan uyg‘un bo‘lishi uchun ishlab chiqilgan.)
baby gate.meta: Baby gate – bolalar va kichik yoshdagi bolalarni xavfli joylarga (ayniqsa zinapoyalar yoki oshxona kabi joylarga) kirishdan saqlash uchun mo‘ljallangan himoya eshigi yoki to‘siq turi. Bu eshiklar odatda uy ichida o‘rnatiladi va xavfsizlikni ta’minlaydi.

ex: Babywear includes bodysuits, rompers, and sleepwear. (Bolalar kiyimlariga bodilar, romperlar va uyqu kiyimlari kiradi.)
She bought soft and comfortable babywear for her newborn.(U yangi tug‘ilgan chaqalog‘i uchun yumshoq va qulay kiyim-kechak sotib oldi.)
Organic cotton babywear is gentle on a baby’s sensitive skin.(Organik paxtadan tikilgan bolalar kiyimi chaqaloq terisi uchun yumshoq bo‘ladi.)
The store has a wide selection of winter babywear.(Do‘konda qishki bolalar kiyimlarining katta tanlovi bor.)
babywear.meta: Babywear – chaqaloqlar va kichik yoshdagi bolalar uchun maxsus ishlab chiqarilgan kiyim-kechaklar. Bu kiyimlar bolalarning qulayligi, xavfsizligi va harakat erkinligini ta’minlashga mo‘ljallangan.

syn: listener feedback – (tinglovchining javobi)active listening signals – (faol tinglash belgilari)conversational cues – (suhbat davomidagi ishoralar)supportive responses – (qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi javoblar)
ex: Effective back-channelling can encourage the speaker to continue sharing more information. (Samarali orqa aloqa berish suhbatdoshni ko‘proq gapirishga undaydi.)
Back-channelling signals like "uh-huh" and nodding show the speaker that you are listening.(“Ha”, bosh silkish kabi orqa aloqa belgilar tinglayotganingizni ko‘rsatadi.)
Different cultures use different styles of back-channelling.(Turli madaniyatlarda orqa aloqa berish uslublari farq qiladi.)
Too much back-channelling might interrupt the speaker’s train of thought.(Haddan tashqari ko‘p orqa aloqa berish suhbatdoshning fikrini bo‘lishi mumkin.)
back-channelling | back-channeling.meta: Suhbat davomida tinglayotgan inson tomonidan suhbatdoshga e'tibor berayotganini yoki tushunayotganini bildirish uchun ishlatiladigan harakatlar (masalan, bosh silkish, “ha”, “hmm”, “tushunarli” kabi qisqa so‘zlar) yoki ishoralar berish jarayoni.

syn: ball pit – (more common in American English)soft play area – (broader term including ball pools and other padded play equipment)indoor play zone – (general area with various play structures)
ex: Ball pools are popular attractions in indoor playgrounds. (Sharcha hovuzlari yopiq o‘yin maydonlarida mashhur attraksionlardan biridir.)
The children jumped excitedly into the ball pool at the play center.(Bolalar o‘yin markazidagi sharcha hovuziga quvonch bilan sakrashdi.)
She spent nearly an hour playing in the ball pool.(U sharcha hovuzida deyarli bir soat o‘ynadi.)
The ball pool was cleaned and sanitized every evening.(Sharcha hovuzi har kech tozalab va dezinfeksiya qilinardi.)
ball pool.meta: Katta, yumshoq devorlarga ega bo‘lgan va ichiga rang-barang plastik sharchalar to‘ldirilgan o‘yin havzasi. Odatda bolalar o‘ynashi uchun mo‘ljallangan.

syn: but steamed in banana leaves)fufu – (a similar starchy West African dish made from yam or plantain)sadza/ugali – (stiff maize porridge in Southern/Eastern Africa
ex: The preparation of banku involves careful fermentation of maize and cassava dough. (Banku tayyorlash makkajo‘xori va kassava xamirini ehtiyotkorlik bilan achitishni talab qiladi.)
Banku is traditionally served with grilled fish and pepper sauce.(Banku odatda grilda pishirilgan baliq va qalampirli sous bilan tortiladi.)
Many Ghanaians grow up eating banku as a staple dish.(Ko‘plab ganaliklar bankuni asosiy oziq-ovqat sifatida iste’mol qilib ulg‘ayishadi.)
Banku has a slightly sour taste due to fermentation.(Fermentatsiya tufayli bankuning ta’mi biroz nordon bo‘ladi.)
banku.meta: Makkajo‘xori va kassava (maniok) unidan tayyorlanadigan, achitilgan xamir turi. Odatda sho‘r suvda qaynatiladi yoki bug‘da pishiriladi hamda dumaloq shaklga keltiriladi. Ko‘pincha baliq yoki sous bilan birga iste’mol qilinadi.

syn: fatso – (semiz odam – qo‘pol so‘z)lard-arse – (orqasi yog‘li odam – haqoratli)tubby – (semiz
ex: He was often teased and called barge-arse at school. (U maktabda ko‘pincha “orqasi katta” deb masxara qilinar edi.)
Stop calling me barge-arse, it’s rude!(Menga “semiz” deb murojaat qilishni bas qil, bu qo‘pol!)
They made a cartoon about a character named Bargearse who was always slow and clumsy.(Ular har doim sust va no‘noq bo‘lgan “Bargearse” ismli qahramon haqida multfilm qilishgan.)
barge-arse.meta: So‘zlashuv uslubida, haqoratli: Juda katta yoki keng orqaga ega bo‘lgan odam; umumiy ma’noda semiz odam. Ko‘pincha laqab yoki kamsituvchi murojaat shaklida ishlatiladi.

syn: biceps – (common short form)upper arm flexor – bilakni bukuvchi mushakanterior arm muscle – bilakning old mushagi
ex: He injured his biceps brachii while lifting heavy weights. (Og‘ir yuk ko‘tarayotganda u bilak ikki boshli muskulini jarohatladi.)
The biceps brachii is responsible for flexing the elbow and rotating the forearm.(Bilak ikki boshli muskuli tirsakni bukish va kaftni burishda mas’uldir.)
During arm curls, the biceps brachii is one of the most engaged muscles.(Qo‘lni bukish mashqida biceps brachii eng faol ishlatiladigan mushaklardan biridir.)
The long head of the biceps brachii helps stabilize the shoulder joint.(Biceps brachiining uzun qismi yelka bo‘g‘imini barqarorlashtirishga yordam beradi.)
biceps brachii.meta: Bilakning old tomonida joylashgan, ikki boshli mushak bo‘lib, kurak suyagining ikki nuqtasidan boshlanadi va bilak suyaklaridan biri bo‘lgan radiusga birikadi. Ushbu mushak bilakni bukish va kaftni burish (supinatsiya) harakatlarida asosiy rol o‘ynaydi.

syn: hamstring muscle – son orqa mushaklarining biriposterior thigh muscle – sonning orqa mushagilong head/short head of biceps femoris – biceps femorisning uzun/kalta qismi
ex: He strained his biceps femoris during a sprinting exercise. (U yugurish mashqi vaqtida sonning ikki boshli mushagini cho‘zib oldi.)
The biceps femoris plays a key role in bending the knee and extending the hip.(Sonning ikki boshli muskuli tizzani bukish va sonni orqaga tortishda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)
Weakness in the biceps femoris can lead to poor running mechanics.(Son orqa mushagidagi zaiflik yugurish texnikasining buzilishiga olib kelishi mumkin.)
The biceps femoris is more prone to injury in explosive sports like sprinting or football.(Biceps femoris portlovchi sport turlarida, masalan, sprint yoki futbolda, jarohatlanishga moyil bo‘ladi.)
biceps femoris.meta: Sonning orqa qismida joylashgan mushak bo‘lib, son suyagi (femur) va o‘tirish suyagidan (ischium) boshlanadi va boldir suyagining tashqi tomoni (fibula) ga birikadi.

syn: dark beeApis mellifera mellifera – (scientific name)European black beenative bee (depending on region)
ex: Unlike some other bees, the black bee has a darker, almost entirely black body. (Boshqa arilardan farqli o‘laroq, qora arining tanasi deyarli butunlay qora rangda bo‘ladi.)
The black bee is known for its resilience in cold climates.(Qora ari sovuq iqlimlarga chidamliligi bilan mashhur.)
Black bees tend to be more defensive but highly productive in honey making.(Qora arilar odatda tajovuzkorroq bo‘lishadi, lekin asal ishlab chiqarishda juda samarali.)
Conservationists are working to preserve native black bee populations.(Tabiatni muhofaza qiluvchilar mahalliy qora arilar populyatsiyasini saqlab qolishga harakat qilishmoqda.)
black bee.meta: Tanasining asosiy qismi qora yoki to‘q jigarrang rangga ega bo‘lgan har xil turdagi arilar. Xususan, G‘arbiy asal arisining shimoli-sharqiy Yevropa va boshqa mintaqalarda uchraydigan bir kichik turi ham shular jumlasiga kiradi.

ex: During the breeding season, the black guillemot's red feet become even more vivid. (Uruğlanish mavsumida qora guillemotning qizil oyoqlari yanada yorqinlashadi.)
The black guillemot is often seen diving for fish along rocky coastlines.(Qora guillemotni ko‘pincha qoyali sohillarda baliq ovlayotganini ko‘rish mumkin.)
Black guillemots typically nest in crevices along cliffs or under rocks.(Qora guillemotlar odatda qoyalar orasidagi yoriqlarda yoki toshlar ostida uya qurishadi.)
Unlike other seabirds, black guillemots are often solitary during feeding.(Boshqa suv qushlaridan farqli o‘laroq, qora guillemotlar ovlanish paytida ko‘pincha yolg‘iz bo‘ladi.)
black guillemot.meta: Qora guillemot – Asosan Shimoliy Atlantika va Arktika okeanlari qirg‘oqlarida yashaydigan suv qushi. Uning tanasi asosan qora patlar bilan qoplangan, qanotlarida oq dog‘lari va oyoqlari yorqin qizil rangda bo‘ladi.

ex: Critics argue that the new regulations have led to the blandification of local television content. (Tanqidchilarga ko‘ra, yangi qoidalar mahalliy televideniye kontentini zerikarli holga keltirib qo‘ygan.)
The blandification of the city center has removed much of its historic charm.(Shahar markazining bemazalash jarayoni uning tarixiy jozibasini yo‘qotgan.)

Some fans worry about the blandification of their favorite video games due to mass-market appeal.(Ba’zi muxlislar ommaviy bozorga moslashtirish tufayli sevimli video o‘yinlarining bemaza bo‘lib qolishidan xavotirda.)
The blandification of modern architecture has left cities looking more alike.(Zamonaviy arxitekturaning soddalashtirilishi shaharlarga bir xil ko‘rinish berib qo‘ydi.)
blandification.meta: Biror narsani oddiy, jozibasiz, mazmunsiz yoki ta’sirsiz holga keltirish yoki shunday holga aylanish jarayoni. Bu atama ko‘pincha biror narsaning o‘ziga xosligini yo‘qotib, uni zerikarli yoki umumiy qilib yuborishni ifodalaydi.

ex: Many traditional dishes are blandified to suit international palates. (Ko‘plab an’anaviy taomlar xalqaro didga moslash uchun mazasizlantiriladi.)
The blandified version of the novel removed much of its emotional depth.(Romanning oddiylashtirilgan talqini ko‘p hissiy chuqurlikni yo‘qotgan edi.)
Critics called the film a blandified remake that lacked the intensity of the original.(Tanqidchilar filmni asl nusxadagi kuchni yo‘qotgan mazasiz remeyk deb atashdi.)
This blandified design might be safe, but it fails to stand out.(Bu soddalashtirilgan dizayn xavfsiz bo‘lishi mumkin, lekin ajralib turmaydi.)
blandified.meta: Oldingi jozibasi, o‘ziga xosligi yoki mazmunini yo‘qotib, soddalashtirilgan, ta’sirsiz yoki zerikarli holga keltirilgan narsa. Bu sifat odatda biror narsa o‘ziga xosligini yo‘qotib, umumiy va e’tiborga loyiq bo‘lmagan holga aylanganida ishlatiladi.

syn: sustlashtirmoq)simplify (excessively) (ortiqcha soddalashtirmoq)Example (synonym):• The message was toned down for international audiences.(Xabar xalqaro auditoriya uchun yumshatildi.)
ex: The publisher blandified the book’s language to make it more suitable for children. (Nashriyot kitobning tilini bolalar uchun mos bo‘lishi uchun oddiylashtirib yubordi.)
They blandified the traditional recipe to appeal to a wider audience.(Ular an’anaviy retseptni ko‘proq odamga yoqishi uchun mazasiz qilib yuborishdi.)
The movie studio blandified the script by removing all controversial parts.(Kino studiyasi tortishuvli qismlarni olib tashlab, ssenariyni zerikarli holga keltirdi.)
The company blandified its logo to look more "modern" but lost its original charm.(Kompaniya logotipini "zamonaviy" ko‘rinish berish uchun soddalashtirdi, lekin asl jozibasini yo‘qotdi.)
blandify.meta: Biror narsani mazasiz, jozibasiz, xususiyatsiz yoki zerikarli holga keltirish; uni umumiy, oddiy va e’tiborni tortmaydigan shaklga o‘zgartirish.

syn: tabletop gamer – (stol usti o‘yinlarini o‘ynovchi)strategy gamer – (strategik o‘yinlar o‘yinchisi)game night enthusiast – (o‘yin kechalari ishqibozi)
ex: Many board gamers meet weekly to play strategy games. (Ko‘plab stol o‘yinchilari har hafta strategik o‘yinlar o‘ynash uchun uchrashishadi.)
He is an experienced board gamer who competes in tournaments.(U turnirlarda qatnashadigan tajribali stol o‘yinchisi.)
As a board gamer, she enjoys both cooperative and competitive games.(Stol o‘yinchisi sifatida u hamkorlikka asoslangan va raqobatli o‘yinlarni yoqtiradi.)
New cafes are opening to serve the growing community of board gamers.(Yangi kafelar stol o‘yinchilari jamiyatiga xizmat qilish uchun ochilmoqda.)
board gamer.meta: Stol o‘yinlarini o‘ynaydigan inson; ayniqsa, bu o‘yinlarni muntazam yoki tez-tez o‘ynaydigan shaxs.

syn: tomboy – (erkaklarcha kiyinadigan yoki harakat qiladigan qiz)masc-presenting – (erkaklarcha tashqi ko‘rinishga ega)gender nonconforming – (an’anaviy jinsga mos bo‘lmagan)stud (used in Black LGBTQ+ communities) – (erkaklarcha o‘zini tutadigan ayol)
ex: The boi style often includes baggy clothes and a youthful, playful attitude. (Boi uslubi ko‘pincha keng kiyimlar va bolalarcha, quvnoq munosabat bilan tavsiflanadi.)
He identifies as a boi within the LGBTQ+ community.(U o‘zini LGBTQ+ jamiyatida boi sifatida tanlaydi.)
The term boi challenges traditional ideas of gender and masculinity.(“Boi” atamasi an’anaviy jins va erkaklik tushunchalariga qarshi chiqadi.)

Some bois prefer masculine pronouns, while others choose neutral or mixed ones.(Ba’zi boilar erkaklar uchun ishlatiladigan olmoshlarni afzal ko‘rsa, boshqalari neytral yoki aralash olmoshlarni tanlaydi.)
boi.meta: Turli submadaniyatlar yoki alternativ madaniy guruhlarga mansub bo‘lgan va odatda bolalarcha yoki erkaklarcha kiyinish, xulq-atvor yoki tashqi ko‘rinish bilan tavsiflanadigan shaxs.

syn: border patrol (chegara patruli)customs enforcement (bojxona nazorati)immigration control (immigratsiyani nazorat qilish)border security agency (chegara xavfsizligi agentligi)
ex: The new policy strengthens the authority of the border force at key entry points. (Yangi siyosat muhim kirish nuqtalarida chegara xizmatining vakolatini kuchaytiradi.)
The border force intercepted several illegal crossings last night.(Chegara xizmati kecha bir nechta noqonuniy o‘tishlarni to‘xtatdi.)
Border force officers work closely with customs and immigration departments.(Chegara qo‘shinlari xodimlari bojxona va immigratsiya bo‘limlari bilan yaqin hamkorlikda ishlaydi.)
The UK Border Force operates under the Home Office.(Buyuk Britaniya Chegara Xizmati Ichki Ishlar Vazirligi tarkibida faoliyat yuritadi.)
border force.meta: keyingi davrlarda, ayniqsa, immigratsiya, kontrabanda va noqonuniy kirish-chiqishlarni nazorat qiluvchi huquqni muhofaza qiluvchi tashkilot sifatida ishlatiladi.

syn: completely new (to‘liq yangi)spotless (jilva beruvchi darajada yangi)fresh out of the box (yangi ochilgan)mint condition (as new
perfect state – yangi holatda)Example (synonym):• That phone looks like it’s fresh out of the box.(Bu telefon go‘yo endi qutidan olinganga o‘xshaydi.)
ex: I just bought a brand spanking new laptop for my studies. (Yaqinda o‘qishim uchun butunlay yangi noutbuk sotib oldim.)
He drove a brand spanking new car off the lot yesterday.(U kecha avtomobil salonidan mutlaqo yangi mashinani haydab chiqdi.)
Her shoes were brand spanking new and still had the tag on.(Uning tuflilari butunlay yangi edi va hali ham yorlig‘i bor edi.)
They moved into a brand spanking new apartment in the city center.(Ular shahar markazidagi mutlaqo yangi kvartiraga ko‘chib o‘tishdi.)
brand spanking new.meta: Juda yangi, hali hech ishlatilmagan, butunlay yangiligini ko‘rsatib turadigan narsa. Ko‘pincha ta’kidlovchi ma’no beradi va narsaning mutlaqo yangiligini urg‘ulaydi.

syn: market landscape (bozor manzarasi)brand environment (brend muhiti)competitive set (raqobatdoshlar to‘plami)brand ecosystem (brend ekotizimi)
ex: Companies must understand the brandscape to position their products effectively. (Kompaniyalar o‘z mahsulotlarini samarali joylashtirish uchun brend manzarasini tushunishi kerak.)
The smartphone brandscape is dominated by a few major players.(Smartfon bozoridagi brend manzarasi bir nechta yirik kompaniyalar tomonidan nazorat qilinadi.)
In the luxury brandscape, image and identity matter as much as quality.(Has hamkor brendlar muhitida obro‘ va imidj sifat bilan bir darajada muhim.)
brandscape.meta: Ma’lum bir bozor yoki sohada iste’molchilar tanlashi mumkin bo‘lgan brendlar yig‘indisi; kompaniyalar yoki mahsulotlar bir-biri bilan raqobatlashadigan va o‘z o‘rnini belgilaydigan tijorat muhiti.

syn: fire barrier layer (yong‘inga qarshi qatlam)fireproof ceiling shield (yong‘inbardosh shift qatlami)roof firestop (tom yong‘in to‘xtatuvchisi)
ex: Traditional builders always included a brandsolder in thatched houses for extra safety. (An’anaviy quruvchilar somon tomli uylarning xavfsizligini oshirish uchun har doim yonishdan himoya qatlamini qo‘shishgan.)
The brandsolder helped prevent fires from spreading to the living areas of the house.(Yonishdan himoya qatlami yong‘inning yashash hududiga tarqalishini oldini oldi.)
A well-maintained brandsolder was essential in old rural homes with thatched roofs.(Yaxshi saqlangan o‘tinbosuvchi qatlam eski qishloq uylari uchun juda muhim bo‘lgan.)
brandsolder.meta: An’anaviy somon tomli uylarning shiftining yuqori qismiga qo‘yilgan loy yoki g‘isht qatlami. Bu qatlam asosan tom yonganda uyning qolgan qismini yong‘indan himoya qilish uchun ishlatilgan.

syn: Afrikaner nationalism – (Afrikaaner millatchiligi)Boer identity movement – (buurlar milliy harakati)pro-German South African factions (WWII era) – (Ikkinchi jahon urushi davridagi Germaniyani qo‘llab-quvvatlovchi Janubiy Afrika guruhlari)
ex: During World War II, the Brandwag opposed South Africa’s involvement on the side of the Allies. (Ikkinchi jahon urushi davrida Brandwag Janubiy Afrikaning ittifoqchilar tomonida urushga kirishishiga qarshi chiqqan.)
The Brandwag played a significant role in Afrikaner nationalist movements in the early 20th century.(Brandwag 20-asr boshlarida Afrikaaner milliy harakatlarida muhim rol o‘ynagan.)
Many members of the Brandwag were arrested for sabotage and anti-government activities.(Brandwagning ko‘plab a’zolari sabotaj va hukumatga qarshi harakatlar uchun hibsga olingan.)
brandwag.meta: Janubiy Afrikada: Dastlab “Ossewa Brandwag” deb atalgan harbiy va afrikaaner millatchi tashkilot. Bu tashkilot tarixiy jihatdan afrikaanerlarning siyosiy va madaniy manfaatlarini himoya qilgan.

syn: obliterative bronchiolitis – (oblitere bronxiolit – sinonimi sifatida ishlatiladi)popcorn lung (informal term
especially when caused by diacetyl) – “popkorn o‘pka” kasalligi
ex: The patient was diagnosed with bronchiolitis obliterans after a workplace accident involving gas inhalation. (Bemor ish joyida gazni nafas orqali qabul qilganidan so‘ng oblitere bronxiolit tashxisi qo‘yildi.)

Bronchiolitis obliterans can be caused by exposure to toxic fumes or certain chemicals.(Oblitere bronxiolit zaharli gazlar yoki ayrim kimyoviy moddalarga ta’sir qilish natijasida yuzaga kelishi mumkin.)

It is sometimes referred to as “popcorn lung” due to cases linked to artificial butter flavoring.(Bu ba’zida “popkorn o‘pka” deb ataladi, chunki u sun’iy sariyog‘ aromatizatoriga bog‘liq holatlarda aniqlangan.)
bronchiolitis obliterans.meta: Asosan zaharli gazlarni nafas orqali qabul qilish natijasida kelib chiqadigan o‘pka kasalligi. Bu kasallikda o‘pkaning mayda havo yo‘llari – bronxiolalar yallig‘lanadi va to‘qimalar qalinlashib, bronxiolalar torayadi yoki to‘silib qoladi.

syn: electronic highlife (elektron haylayf)Euro-highlife (Yevropa ta’siridagi haylayf)Afro-disco fusion (afro-diskotek uyg‘unligi)
ex: The energetic rhythms of burger highlife make it popular at dance parties. (Burger haylayfining quvnoq ritmlari uni raqs kechalarida mashhur qiladi.)
Burger highlife emerged in the 1980s among Ghanaian communities in Germany.(Burger haylayfi 1980-yillarda Germaniyadagi Gana jamoalari orasida paydo bo‘lgan.)
This album combines traditional highlife with the synth sounds of burger highlife.(Bu albom an’anaviy haylayfni burger haylayfidagi sintez tovushlari bilan uyg‘unlashtiradi.)
Burger highlife brought a modern twist to Ghana’s musical identity.(Burger haylayfi Gana musiqiy uslubiga zamonaviy tus berdi.)
burger highlife.meta: Bu janr an’anaviy Gana haylayf musiqasi, Yevropa diskotek musiqasi (Eurodisco) va funk uslublarini o‘zida uyg‘unlashtiradi. "Burger" atamasi Germaniyada yashagan Gana muhojirlariga nisbatan ishlatilgan.

syn: game code (o‘yin kodi)unlock code (ochish kodi)exploit (o‘yindagi kamchilikdan foydalangan holda yengillik)
ex: Some classic games are famous for their secret cheat codes. (Ba’zi eski o‘yinlar yashirin firib kodlari bilan mashhur.)
He used a cheat code to unlock all the levels in the game.(U barcha bosqichlarni ochish uchun o‘yin kodidan foydalandi.)
Entering the cheat code gave him unlimited ammo.(Firib kodini kiritish unga cheksiz o‘q-dorilar berdi.)
Players often shared cheat codes in gaming magazines.(O‘yinchilar ko‘pincha firib kodlarini o‘yin jurnallarida bo‘lishar edi.)
cheat code.meta: Video o‘yinlarda: O‘yinda yashirin imkoniyatlar, cheksiz resurslar yoki osonroq o‘yin jarayoniga kirish imkonini beruvchi maxsus belgi ketma-ketligi yoki pult orqali kiritiladigan harakatlar.

syn: perfection (mukammallik)• Her dish was pure perfection. (Uning taomi to‘la mukammallik edi.)masterpiece (san’at asari
durdona)• That dress is a masterpiece. (Bu ko‘ylak san’at asari.)on point (aniq
joyida)• Her makeup was on point. (Uning makiyaji juda joyida edi.)
ex: His presentation was a chef’s kiss of perfection. (Uning taqdimoti mukammallikning oshpaz ishorasi bo‘ldi.)
The pasta was absolutely delicious – chef’s kiss!(Makaron juda mazali edi – oshpaz ishorasi!)
The combination of the music and visuals was just chef’s kiss.(Musiqa va videoning uyg‘unligi shunchaki mukammal edi.)
Her final touch on the cake? Chef’s kiss!(Uning tortdagi yakuniy bezagi? Mukammallikdan darak!)
chef's kiss.meta: Mukammallik yoki juda zo‘r, ajoyib narsa ifodalanadigan imo-ishora. Odatda barmoq uchlarini birlashtirib, labga tegizib "o‘pish" orqali ifodalanadi. Bu imo biror narsa a’lo darajada bo‘lishini ta’kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

syn: Dalit (kastadan chiqarilgan odam) – broader term for oppressed castesuntouchable (kamsitilgan kasta a’zosi) – outdated and now considered offensivemanual scavenger (qo‘lda axlat tozalovchi) – occupational term related to the caste’s traditional work
ex: Many Chuhras have fought for better working conditions and social rights. (Ko‘plab Chuhra vakillari yaxshiroq mehnat sharoitlari va ijtimoiy huquqlar uchun kurashgan.)
Chuhra communities have historically faced social discrimination and exclusion.(Chuhra jamoalari tarixan ijtimoiy kamsitish va chetlatishga duch kelgan.)
Some Chuhras have overcome social barriers through education and activism.(Ba’zi Chuhra vakillari ta’lim va faollik orqali ijtimoiy to‘siqlardan o‘tishga muvaffaq bo‘lgan.)
chuhra.meta: Hindiston va Pokistonda: An’anaviy ravishda hojatxonalar va kanalizatsiyalardan tozalanmagan inson chiqindilarini olib tashlash bilan shug‘ullangan pastki ijtimoiy tabaqaga mansub kasta a’zosi.

syn: mental resilience (aqliy bardoshlilik)brain compensation (miya kompensatsiyasi)cognitive flexibility (kognitiv moslashuvchanlik)
ex: Engaging in mentally stimulating activities can help build cognitive reserve. (Aqliy faollik talab qiladigan mashg‘ulotlar bilan shug‘ullanish kognitiv zaxirani oshirishi mumkin.)

People with higher cognitive reserve may show fewer symptoms of dementia despite brain damage.(Kognitiv zaxirasi yuqori bo‘lgan odamlar miyada shikast bo‘lsa ham, demensiya belgilarini kamroq ko‘rsatishi mumkin.)
Education and lifelong learning are believed to strengthen cognitive reserve.(Ta’lim va umr bo‘yi o‘qish kognitiv zaxirani mustahkamlashi mumkin, deb hisoblanadi.)
cognitive reserve.meta: Miyaning jismoniy yoki ruhiy kasalliklar, ayniqsa demensiya (aqliy pasayish) yoki qarish jarayonida kognitiv (aqliy) funksiyalarni saqlab qolish yoki yo‘qotishga qarshi turish qobiliyati.

syn: traffic tolling – yo‘l to‘lovi• Traffic tolling during peak hours is becoming more common in major cities.(Yirik shaharlarda tig‘iz vaqtlarda yo‘l to‘lovi tobora keng tarqalmoqda.)road user charge – yo‘l foydalanuvchisi to‘lovi• The road user charge is designed to manage heavy traffic areas._(Yo‘l foydalanuvchisi to‘lovi zich harakatli hududlarni boshqarish uchun mo‘ljallangan.)
ex: The city council approved a congestion pricing plan for the business district. (Shahar kengashi ishbilarmonlar hududi uchun tirbandlik tariflash rejasini ma’qulladi.)
Congestion pricing encourages people to avoid driving during rush hour.(Tirbandlik tariflash odamlarga tig‘iz paytlarda mashina haydashdan voz kechishga undaydi.)
Congestion pricing has reduced traffic in central areas of the city.(Tirbandlik tariflash shaharning markaziy hududlarida harakatni kamaytirdi.)
Some argue that congestion pricing is unfair to low-income drivers.(Ba’zilar tirbandlik tariflash kam daromadli haydovchilarga nisbatan adolatsiz deb hisoblaydi.)
Congestion pricing is a tool to improve air quality and urban mobility.(Tirbandlik tariflash havo sifatini va shahar harakatini yaxshilash vositasidir.)
congestion pricing.meta: Ayniqsa gavjum (cho‘qqi) vaqtlarda yoki tirband yo‘llarda transport vositalarini boshqarish uchun maxsus to‘lov yoki tarif joriy etish siyosati.

syn: media development – media ishlab chiqish• Media development is crucial in educational platforms.(Ta’limiy platformalarda media ishlab chiqish muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)content production – kontent ishlab chiqarish• The studio specializes in high-quality content production._(Studiyada yuqori sifatli kontent ishlab chiqarishga ixtisoslashgan.)
ex: Content creation requires creativity, consistency, and knowledge of digital platforms. (Kontent yaratish ijodkorlik, izchillik va raqamli platformalarni bilishni talab qiladi.)
She made a career out of content creation on YouTube and Instagram.(U YouTube va Instagram’da kontent yaratish orqali o‘z kasbini shakllantirdi.)
Successful content creation often involves researching trends and audience preferences.(Muvaffaqiyatli kontent yaratish ko‘pincha trendlar va auditoriya didini o‘rganishni o‘z ichiga oladi.)
Content creation can be time-consuming but highly rewarding.(Kontent yaratish vaqt talab qiluvchi bo‘lsa-da, juda foydali bo‘lishi mumkin.)
The marketing team focuses heavily on content creation to attract customers.(Marketing jamoasi mijozlarni jalb qilish uchun kontent yaratishga katta e’tibor qaratadi.)
content creation.meta: Ommaviy tarqatish uchun material tayyorlash jarayoni; ayniqsa, raqamli kontent (masalan, videolar, bloglar, ijtimoiy tarmoq postlari va boshqalar) ishlab chiqarish faoliyati, kasbi yoki sohasi.

syn: digital producer – raqamli mahsulot ishlab chiqaruvchi• Digital producers play a key role in modern media.(Raqamli ishlab chiqaruvchilar zamonaviy ommaviy axborotda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)media creator – media kontent ishlab chiqaruvchi• As a media creator
she publishes weekly photo stories.(Media kontent ishlab chiqaruvchisi sifatida u har hafta foto hikoyalar e’lon qiladi.)
ex: Many brands collaborate with content creators to promote their products. (Ko‘plab brendlar mahsulotlarini targ‘ib qilish uchun kontent yaratuvchilar bilan hamkorlik qiladi.)
She works as a full-time content creator on social media platforms.(U to‘liq stavkada ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda kontent yaratuvchi sifatida ishlaydi.)
The rise of content creators has changed the way we consume media.(Kontent yaratuvchilarning ko‘payishi bizning ommaviy axborotni iste’mol qilish uslubimizni o‘zgartirdi.)
He became a successful content creator after his videos went viral.(Videolari virusli bo‘lib ketgach, u muvaffaqiyatli kontent yaratuvchiga aylandi.)
Content creators often need to understand marketing and audience engagement.(Kontent yaratuvchilar ko‘pincha marketing va auditoriyani jalb qilishni tushunishlari kerak bo‘ladi.)
content creator.meta: Ommaviy tarqatish uchun material tayyorlaydigan shaxs; ayniqsa, zamonaviy raqamli maydonda videolar, bloglar, podkastlar va boshqa raqamli kontentlarni yaratadigan va ko‘pincha internet yoki ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali tarqatadigan inson.

ex: Politicians who frequently cross-carpet are often viewed with suspicion.
