The senator decided to cross-carpet to the ruling party.
cross-carpet.meta: Siyosatchi haqida: Bir siyosiy partiyadan boshqa siyosiy partiyaga o‘tish harakati. Bu hodisa odatda siyosiy pozitsiyani o‘zgartirish, shaxsiy manfaat yoki ideologik qarashlar sababli amalga oshiriladi.

syn: party defection – partiyadan chiqib ketish• The lawmaker's defection weakened the ruling coalition.(Qonunchining partiyadan chiqib ketishi hukmron koalitsiyani zaiflashtirdi.)party switching – partiyani almashtirish• Frequent party switching has caused political instability.(Tez-tez partiya almashtirish siyosiy beqarorlikka sabab bo‘ldi.)
ex: His cross-carpeting to the opposition party surprised many voters. (Oppozitsiya partiyasiga partiya almashtirishi ko‘plab saylovchilarni hayratda qoldirdi.)
Cross-carpeting is becoming more common in the country's political system.(Mamlakat siyosiy tizimida partiya almashtirish tobora ko‘proq uchramoqda.)
The parliamentarian faced criticism for cross-carpeting just before the election.(Parlament a’zosi saylov oldidan boshqa partiyaga o‘tgani uchun tanqidlarga uchradi.)
Cross-carpeting can affect party loyalty and voter trust.(Partiya almashtirish partiyaga sadoqat va saylovchilar ishonchiga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.)
He denied rumors of cross-carpeting despite public speculation.(U, jamoatchilikda mish-mishlar bo‘lishiga qaramay, partiya almashtirish haqida bo‘lgan mish-mishlarni rad etdi.)
cross-carpeting.meta: Bir siyosiy partiyadan boshqa siyosiy partiyaga o‘tish jarayoni yoki amaliyoti. Bu tushuncha siyosatchilar partiya a’zoligini o‘zgartirganda yoki boshqa partiyaga qo‘shilganda qo‘llaniladi.

syn: gender-affirming hormone therapy – jinsni tasdiqlovchi gormon terapiyasi• Gender-affirming hormone therapy helps align physical traits with gender identity.(Jinsni tasdiqlovchi gormon terapiyasi jismoniy xususiyatlarni jinsiy identifikatsiyaga moslashtirishga yordam beradi.)opposite-sex hormone therapy – qarama-qarshi jinsiy gormon terapiyasi• Opposite-sex hormone therapy is part of the medical transition process.(Qarama-qarshi jinsiy gormon terapiyasi tibbiy o‘tish jarayonining bir qismidir.)
ex: She began cross-hormone treatment to develop more feminine characteristics. (U ayollarga xos jismoniy xususiyatlar rivojlanishi uchun kross-gormon davosini boshladi.)
Cross-hormone therapy is essential for many transgender individuals during transition.(Jins o‘zgartirish jarayonida kross-gormon terapiyasi ko‘plab transgender insonlar uchun juda muhimdir.)
The doctor explained the effects of cross-hormone treatment in detail.(Shifokor kross-gormon davosining ta’sirini batafsil tushuntirdi.)
He started cross-hormones as part of his medical transition.(U tibbiy o‘tish jarayonining bir qismi sifatida kross-gormonlarni qabul qilishni boshladi.)
Cross-hormones influence secondary sex characteristics.(Kross-gormonlar ikkilamchi jinsiy belgilarga ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.)
cross-hormone.meta: (sifat sifatida) – Shaxsga tabiiy ravishda o‘z jinsida ko‘p ishlab chiqarilmaydigan, boshqa jins vakillarida ko‘proq uchraydigan jinsiy gormon (masalan, testosteron, estrogen va boshqalar) bilan qilinadigan davolashni bildiradi.

syn: qurilgan (kiyim)• These constructed pieces are made with precision and handcraft.(Bu tikilgan buyumlar aniqlik va qo‘l mehnati bilan tayyorlangan.)assembled (garment) – yig‘ilgan (kiyim qismi)• The jacket is assembled from five different fabric panels.(Kurtka beshta turli mato qismlaridan yig‘ilgan.)
ex: Cut-and-sew garments often offer more flexibility in design. (Kesib-tikilgan kiyimlar dizayn jihatdan ko‘proq moslashuvchanlikni ta’minlaydi.)
The factory specializes in cut-and-sew production for small clothing brands.(Zavod kichik kiyim brendlari uchun kesib-tikish usulidagi ishlab chiqarishga ixtisoslashgan.)
Cut-and-sew methods are popular for custom-made clothing.(Moslashtirilgan kiyimlar uchun kesib-tikish usullari ommabop.)
He launched a brand focusing on high-quality cut-and-sew T-shirts.(U yuqori sifatli kesib-tikilgan futbolkalar ishlab chiqarishga yo‘naltirilgan brend ochdi.)
Cut-and-sew allows designers to use different fabrics in one garment.(Kesib-tikish dizaynerlarga bir kiyimda turli matolarni ishlatish imkonini beradi.)
cut-and-sew.meta: Matoni qismlarga kesib, keyin ularni tikish orqali kiyim tayyorlash usuliga oid. Bu usul odatda matoni tayyor shaklda emas, balki alohida qismlar shaklida ishlatib, keyin ularni tikish orqali kiyim yaratishni bildiradi.

syn: side-eye – yon qarash (mensimagancha)• He shot me a side-eye when I asked a silly question.(Men ahmoqona savol berganimda u menga yon qarash bilan qaradi.)dirty look – yomon qarash• She gave him a dirty look across the table.(U unga stol narigi tomonidan yomon qarash otib qaradi.)
ex: The cut-eye from the teacher warned the students to behave. (O‘qituvchining keskin qarashi o‘quvchilarga o‘zini tutishlarini ogohlantirdi.)
She gave him a sharp cut-eye when he interrupted her.(U uni gapini bo‘lganida, keskin yomon nigoh bilan qaradi.)
He walked away without saying a word, but threw a nasty cut-eye on his way out.(U hech narsa demasdan ketdi, lekin ketayotib yomon nigoh otib ketdi.)
Don’t give me that cut-eye—you know you’re wrong.(Mengamas bunday yomon nigoh bilan qaramang — o‘zingiz aybdorsiz.)
The aunt gave a serious cut-eye when the kids started shouting.(Xola bolalar baqira boshlaganida, jiddiy yomon nigoh bilan qaradi.)
cut-eye.meta: Asosan Karib hududlarida ishlatiladigan ibora. Bu boshni burmasdan yon tomonga tez, qattiq, mensimaydigan, norozilik yoki jahldorlik ifodasi bilan qarash harakati. Ko‘pincha kimdirni kamsitish, e'tiroz bildirish yoki g‘azabni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

syn: tear-out – yulib olinadigan• There was a tear-out shopping list in the centerfold of the magazine.(Jurnalning markaziy betida yulib olinadigan xarid ro‘yxati bor edi.)pull-out – ajratib olinadigan• The pull-out supplement had coloring pages for children.(Ajratib olinadigan qo‘shimchada bolalar uchun rangli sahifalar bor edi.)
ex: She collected cut-out-and-keep recipes from old newspapers. (U eski gazetalardan kesib-olib saqlashga mo‘ljallangan retseptlarni yig‘ar edi.)
The magazine included a cut-out-and-keep guide to home gardening.(Jurnal kesib-olib saqlashga mo‘ljallangan uy bog‘dorchiligi bo‘yicha qo‘llanmani o‘z ichiga oldi.)
This issue features a cut-out-and-keep calendar for the school year.(Ushbu son maktab yiliga mo‘ljallangan kesib-olib saqlanadigan taqvimni o‘z ichiga oladi.)
They printed a cut-out-and-keep map for visitors to use around the city.(Ular shaharda foydalanish uchun tashrif buyuruvchilarga kesib-olib yuriladigan xarita bosib chiqarishdi.)
I still have a cut-out-and-keep health chart from a fitness magazine.(Men hali ham fitnes jurnalidan olingan kesib-olib saqlanadigan sog‘liq jadvalini saqlayman.)
cut-out-and-keep.meta: Jurnal, gazeta yoki boshqa nashrlarda uchraydigan, kesib olib keyinchalik foydalanish yoki saqlash uchun tayyorlangan maqola yoki materialni ifodalovchi tushuncha.

syn: square cut – kvadrat zarba• He played a fierce square cut off the back foot.(U orqa oyoqda turib kuchli kvadrat zarba berdi.)offside slash (informal) – offside zarbasi• The batsman’s offside slash pierced the gap at point.(Batsmanning offside zarbasi "point" maydonidan o‘tdi.)
ex: He scored several boundaries with his powerful cut shot. (U kuchli kat shot zarbasi bilan bir necha chegara urdi.)
The batsman executed a perfect cut shot through the gap in the offside field.(Batsman offside maydonidagi bo‘shliqdan mukammal kat shot zarbasi berdi.)
The cut shot is one of the most effective ways to punish a short and wide delivery.(Kat shot qisqa va keng uzatmalarni jazolashning eng samarali usullaridan biridir.)
Young players often struggle to master the timing of the cut shot.(Yosh o‘yinchilar ko‘pincha kat shot vaqtini to‘g‘ri aniqlashda qiynalishadi.)
He tried a cut shot but mistimed it and got caught behind.(U kat shot qilishga harakat qildi, lekin vaqtni noto‘g‘ri tanlab, orqada ushlab qolindi.)
cut shot.meta: To‘pni gorizontal holatda ushlab turilgan tayoq (kriket kaltagi) bilan "offside" (tashqi maydon) tomon, ya’ni "cover" va "slip" orasidagi hududga kesib zarba berish usuli.

syn: meat yield – go‘sht hosildorligi• The meat yield of this animal is among the highest in the region.(Bu hayvonning go‘sht hosildorligi mintaqadagi eng yuqorilaridan biridir.)carcass value – so‘yilgan hayvon qiymati• Cutability increases the overall carcass value.(Go‘sht chiqarish darajasi so‘yilgan hayvon qiymatini oshiradi.)
ex: Cutability is an important factor in the meat processing industry. (Go‘sht sanoatida go‘sht chiqarish darajasi muhim omil hisoblanadi.)
The breed is known for its high cutability and lean meat yield.(Bu zot yuqori go‘sht olish ulushi va yog‘siz go‘shti bilan tanilgan.)
Farmers prefer animals with better cutability for commercial purposes.(Fermachilar tijorat maqsadlarida go‘sht ajratish ko‘rsatkichi yuqori bo‘lgan hayvonlarni afzal ko‘rishadi.)
Improved feeding can positively affect cutability scores.(Yaxshilangan ovqatlantirish go‘sht chiqarish darajasiga ijobiy ta’sir ko‘rsatishi mumkin.)
Cutability is measured to assess profitability in meat production.(Go‘sht ishlab chiqarishda foyda darajasini baholash uchun go‘sht ajratish ko‘rsatkichi o‘lchanadi.)
cutability.meta: Asosan AQShda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, so‘yilgan hayvon jasadidan olinadigan toza, yog‘siz, savdoga yaroqli go‘sht miqdorini yoki ulushini bildiradi. Bu tushuncha ko‘pincha go‘sht sifati va unumdorligini baholashda ishlatiladi.

syn: scrap – qoldiq parcha• She turned scraps of fabric into a quilt.(U mato qoldiqlaridan yostiqchali adyol tikdi.)remnant – ortiqcha bo‘lak• They sold fabric remnants at a reduced price.(Ular mato qoldiqlarini arzon narxda sotishdi.)
ex: The tailor kept all the cutpieces for future repairs. (Tikuvchi barcha qirqim qoldiqlarini keyingi ta’mirlashlar uchun saqlab qo‘ydi.)
She used a cutpiece of fabric to make a small pouch.(U matoning qolgan parchasi yordamida kichkina sumkacha yasadi.)
I made a patchwork blanket using several cutpieces.(Men bir nechta mato bo‘laklaridan iborat yostiqchali adyol tikdim.)
Don’t throw that cutpiece away—we can use it for lining.(Bu qolgan bo‘lakni tashlama — uni astar uchun ishlatishimiz mumkin.)
Cutpieces are often sold at a discount in fabric stores.(Tikuvchilik do‘konlarida qirqim qoldiqlari ko‘pincha arzonroq narxda sotiladi.)
cutpiece.meta: Asosan mato yoki boshqa materiallardan katta qism kesib olingandan so‘ng qolib ketgan kichik bo‘lak yoki qoldiq. Bu qismlar ko‘pincha ortiqcha yoki boshqa kichik ishlarda foydalanish uchun qoldiriladi.

syn: cutting board – kesish taxtasi• She placed the carrots on the cutting board.(U sabzini kesish taxtasiga qo‘ydi.)butcher block – qassoblar uchun maxsus kesish yuzasi• The butcher block is designed to endure heavy use.(Qassoblar taxtasi og‘ir ishlarga bardosh berish uchun yaratilgan.)
ex: A wooden cutting block is often preferred for its durability. (Yog‘ochdan tayyorlangan kesish taxtasi ko‘pincha mustahkamligi tufayli afzal ko‘riladi.)
The butcher placed the meat on the cutting block before slicing it.(Qassob go‘shtni bo‘laklashdan oldin kesish taxtasiga qo‘ydi.)
She cleaned the cutting block after preparing the chicken.(U tovuqni tayyorlagach, kesish taxtasini tozaladi.)
Using a separate cutting block for raw meat helps prevent contamination.(Xom go‘sht uchun alohida kesish taxtasidan foydalanish ifloslanishning oldini oladi.)
The chef sharpened his knife before setting the fish on the cutting block.(Oshpaz baliqni kesish taxtasiga qo‘yishdan oldin pichog‘ini charxlagan edi.)
cutting block.meta: Qalin va mustahkam yuzaga ega bo‘lgan kesish yoki chopish uchun mo‘ljallangan taxta yoki blok. Ayniqsa, go‘shtni kesish yoki so‘yish jarayonida ishlatiladigan qattiq taxta.

syn: uzish• There was a disconnection in the phone line.(Telefon liniyasida uzilish yuz berdi.)termination – to‘xtatish
bekor qilish• The termination of the contract surprised everyone.(Shartnomaning bekor qilinishi hammani hayratda qoldirdi.)severance – ajratib yuborish
aloqani uzish• The severance of ties was sudden and unexpected.(Aloqalarning uzilishi to‘satdan va kutilmagan bo‘ldi.)
ex: Cutting off communication can lead to misunderstandings. (Aloqani uzish tushunmovchiliklarga olib kelishi mumkin.)
The cutting off of electricity left the entire neighborhood in darkness.(Elektr ta’minotining uzilishi butun mahallani zulmatda qoldirdi.)
Cutting off the water supply caused panic in the village.(Suv ta’minotining to‘xtatilishi qishloqda vahima keltirib chiqardi.)
They protested against the cutting off of their internet access.(Ular internetga kirish imkoniyatining uzilishiga qarshi norozilik bildirishdi.)
The cutting off of diplomatic ties worsened the conflict.(Diplomatik aloqalarning uzilishi mojaroni yanada kuchaytirdi.)
cutting off.meta: Biror narsani kesib tashlash, ajratib yuborish yoki uzib qo‘yish harakati. Shuningdek, ta’minot, xizmat yoki resurslarning to‘xtatilishi yoki uzilishi ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi.

syn: riding crop – ot minish qamchisi• She switched to a shorter riding crop for better control.(U yaxshiroq boshqarish uchun qisqaroq ot minish qamchisiga o‘tdi.)jockey whip – jokey qamchisi• Every jockey is allowed to carry a jockey whip.(Har bir jokeyga o‘zining jokey qamchisini olib yurishga ruxsat beriladi.)training whip – mashq qamchisi• He used a training whip during the riding lessons.(U mashq darslarida mashq qamchisidan foydalandi.)
ex: She tapped the horse lightly with the cutting whip to encourage it to move faster. (U otni tezroq yurishga undash uchun qattiq qamchi bilan yengilgina urdi.)
The jockey carried a cutting whip during the race.(Jokey poygada qattiq qamchi ko‘targan edi.)
Cutting whips are often used in professional equestrian competitions.(Qattiq qamchilar ko‘pincha professional chavandozlar musobaqasida ishlatiladi.)
Unlike longer crops, a cutting whip provides more direct contact.(Uzunroq qamchilardan farqli o‘laroq, qattiq qamchi bevosita ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.)
He trained the horse with gentle use of the cutting whip.(U otni muloyim tarzda qattiq qamchi bilan o‘rgatdi.)
cutting whip.meta: Uchi tasmasiz, qattiq shaklda bo‘lgan qamchi; ayniqsa, ot minishda yordamchi vosita sifatida ishlatiladi. Bunday qamchi chavandozlar va jokeylar tomonidan otni boshqarish yoki tezlatish uchun qo‘llaniladi.

syn: o‘tkirlik• There was a note of acerbity in his jokes.(Uning hazillarida achchiqlik ohangi bor edi.)sarcasm – kinoya• Her sarcasm carried a cuttingness that wasn’t funny.(Uning kinoyasida kulgili emas
balki o‘tkirlik bor edi.)scornfulness – istihzo bilan qarash• His scornfulness and cuttingness hurt the team spirit.(Uning istihzosi va keskinligi jamoaviy ruhni buzdi.)
ex: His cuttingness in the debate left the opponents speechless. (Bahsda uning keskinligi raqiblarni so‘zsiz qoldirdi.)
The cuttingness of her remarks made everyone uncomfortable.(Uning gaplaridagi achchiqlik hammada noqulaylik tug‘dirdi.)
The review was written with such cuttingness that the author was deeply offended.(Sharh shunchalik keskinlik bilan yozilganki, muallif juda ranjidi.)
He’s known for the cuttingness of his satire.(U o‘zining kinoyali sarkazmida bo‘lgan o‘tkirligi bilan tanilgan.)
There was a cuttingness in her tone that silenced the room.(Uning ohangidagi keskinlik xonani jimjit qildi.)
cuttingness.meta: Nutq yoki yozishda sarkazm, achchiqlik, yoki noqulay darajada o‘tkir va keskin bo‘lish sifati. Bu sifat ko‘pincha tanqidiy, achchiq yoki hissiyotlarga ta’sir qiladigan ifodalar uchun ishlatiladi.

syn: linen thread – zig‘ir ipi• Linen thread was the standard before nylon took over.(Zig‘ir ipi

najlon ommalashishidan oldin asosiy ip edi.)braided fishing line – o‘ralgan baliq ovlash ipi• Braided fishing lines are known for their strength.(O‘ralgan baliq ovlash ipi mustahkamligi bilan mashhur.)twine – ipcha
burilgan ip• They used strong twine to tie the boat.(Ular qayiqni bog‘lash uchun kuchli ipchadan foydalandilar.)
ex: Cuttyhunk lines were common before the invention of synthetic fishing lines. (Sintetik baliq ovlash ipi ixtiro qilinishidan oldin cuttyhunk ipi keng qo‘llanilgan.)
The fishermen preferred using cuttyhunk line for its strength and durability.(Baliqchilar mustahkamligi va chidamliligi sababli cuttyhunk ipidan foydalanishni afzal ko‘rishgan.)
The old sailmaker still kept rolls of cuttyhunk in his workshop.(Qadimgi yelkan tikuvchisi hali ham ustaxonasida cuttyhunk rulonlarini saqlardi.)
Some traditionalists believe cuttyhunk provides better tension than modern lines.(Ba’zi an’anachilar cuttyhunk zamonaviy iplar bilan solishtirganda yaxshiroq taranglikni ta’minlaydi deb hisoblaydi.)
cuttyhunk.meta: Tikuvchilikda yoki baliq ovlashda ishlatiladigan, zig‘ir tolalaridan to‘qilgan yoki burilgan ip turi. Asosan baliq ovlash simlari sifatida ishlatilgan, hozirda tarixiy yoki eskirgan atama hisoblanadi.

ex: Cyberflashers often use social media or messaging apps to send explicit images.
The victim reported the cyberflasher to the authorities.
cyberflasher.meta: Boshqa odamning kompyuteri yoki mobil telefoniga istalmagan, ko‘pincha o‘zining jinsiy mazmundagi rasmlarini yuboradigan shaxs. Bu atama "flasher" so‘zining internet versiyasidir va ko‘pincha nojo‘ya yoki bezovta qiluvchi harakat sifatida qaraladi.

syn: unsolicited explicit content – so‘ralmagan ochiq jinsiy kontent• Unsolicited explicit content sent online can be distressing.(Internetda yuborilgan so‘ralmagan ochiq jinsiy kontent odamni larzaga solishi mumkin.)digital flashing – raqamli ochinmoq• Digital flashing is increasingly seen as a public safety issue.(Raqamli ochinmoq tobora ko‘proq jamoat xavfsizligi muammosi sifatida qaralmoqda.)
ex: Victims of cyberflashing often feel violated and uncomfortable. (Kiberflash qurbonlari odatda o‘zini haqoratlangan va noqulay his qilishadi.)
Cyberflashing has become a serious issue on many social media platforms.(Kiberflash ko‘plab ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda jiddiy muammoga aylangan.)
Some countries have introduced laws to criminalize cyberflashing.(Ba’zi davlatlar kiberflashni jinoyat deb hisoblovchi qonunlar qabul qilgan.)
She reported the incident of cyberflashing to the police immediately.(U darhol kiberflash holatini politsiyaga xabar berdi.)
Cyberflashing is often carried out via Bluetooth or AirDrop in crowded areas.(Kiberflash odatda gavjum joylarda Bluetooth yoki AirDrop orqali amalga oshiriladi.)
cyberflashing.meta: Boshqa odamning kompyuteri yoki mobil telefoniga istalmagan, ko‘pincha o‘zining jinsiy mazmundagi suratlarini jo‘natish harakati. Bu hodisa bezovta qilish va shaxsiy hayotni buzish sifatida qaraladi.

syn: whipped coffee – ko‘pirtirilgan qahva• Whipped coffee is another name for dalgona coffee.(Ko‘pirtirilgan qahva — dalgona qahvasining yana bir nomi.)frothy coffee drink – ko‘pikli qahvali ichimlik• This frothy coffee drink looks as good as it tastes.(Bu ko‘pikli qahvali ichimlik ko‘rinishi ham
ex: To make dalgona coffee, you need to whip instant coffee, sugar, and hot water until frothy. (Dalgona qahvasini tayyorlash uchun tezkor qahva, shakar va qaynoq suvni ko‘pirtirib, ko‘pik hosil qilishingiz kerak.)
Dalgona coffee became viral on social media during the lockdown.(Dalgona qahvasi karantin davrida ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda mashhur bo‘lib ketdi.)
She shared a video showing how to make dalgona coffee at home.(U dalgona qahvasini uyda qanday tayyorlashni ko‘rsatgan video ulashdi.)
The texture of dalgona coffee is smooth and creamy on top of the cold milk.(Dalgona qahvasining tuzilishi sovuq sut ustida silliq va kremga o‘xshash bo‘ladi.)
Many people tried making dalgona coffee as a fun quarantine activity.(Ko‘plab odamlar karantin davrida qiziqarli mashg‘ulot sifatida dalgona qahvasini tayyorlab ko‘rishdi.)
dalgona coffee.meta: Teng miqdordagi tezkor qahva (instant coffee), shakar va qaynoq suvni bir necha marta ko‘pirtirib, qalin va kremga o‘xshash massa hosil qilinadigan, so‘ngra sut ustiga quyilib tayyorlanadigan qahva turi.

syn: Korean honeycomb toffee – koreys pufakli toffisi• Korean honeycomb toffee is a light and airy candy.(Koreys pufakli toffisi yengil va havoli shirinlikdir.)traditional Korean candy – an’anaviy koreys shirinligi• This traditional Korean candy is still popular with kids.(Bu an’anaviy koreys shirinligi hanuz bolalar orasida mashhur.)sugar puff candy – shakar pufakli shirinlik• Sugar puff candy melts in your mouth.(Shakarli pufakli shirinlik og‘izda eriydi.)
ex: The street vendors sell dalgona in various shapes like stars and hearts. (Ko‘cha sotuvchilari dalgonani yulduz va yurak kabi turli shakllarda sotadilar.)
Children often enjoy playing with dalgona candy before eating it.(Bolalar ko‘pincha dalgona konfet bilan o‘ynab, keyin uni yeyishadi.)
Dalgona became globally known after the success of a Korean drama.(Koreys seriali mashhur bo‘lgach, dalgona butun dunyoga tanildi.)
Making dalgona at home requires only two ingredients: sugar and baking soda.(Uyda dalgona tayyorlash uchun faqat ikki masalliq kerak: shakar va pishirish soda.)
dalgona.meta: A traditional South Korean candy made from melted sugar and baking soda, usually flat and shaped with simple figures like stars or hearts, often sold by street vendors.

syn: analytics – tahlil texnologiyalari• Business analytics is a subset of data science.(Biznes tahlili — ma’lumotlar fanining bir bo‘lagi.)data analytics – ma’lumotlar tahlili• She specializes in data analytics for marketing.(U marketing uchun ma’lumotlar tahliliga ixtisoslashgan.)
ex: She studied data science to work in artificial intelligence and machine learning. (U sun’iy intellekt va mashinali o‘qitish sohasida ishlash uchun ma’lumotlar fanini o‘rgandi.)

Data science helps companies make better business decisions based on data analysis.(Ma’lumotlar fanlari kompaniyalarga ma’lumot tahliliga asoslangan yaxshiroq biznes qarorlarini qabul qilishda yordam beradi.)
Many tech companies are hiring people with data science skills.(Ko‘plab texnologik kompaniyalar ma’lumotlar fani bo‘yicha ko‘nikmalarga ega odamlarni yollamoqda.)
Data science projects often involve cleaning and organizing raw data.(Ma’lumotlar fani loyihalari ko‘pincha xom ma’lumotlarni tozalash va tartibga solishni o‘z ichiga oladi.)
He gave a talk on how data science is transforming healthcare.(U ma’lumotlar fanining sog‘liqni saqlash sohasini qanday o‘zgartirayotgani haqida ma’ruza qildi.)
data science.meta: data fanlariKeng miqdordagi ma’lumotlarni tahlil qilish va ulardan foydali ma’lumotlarni olish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi ko‘p fanli soha. Bu soha statistika, kompyuter fanlari, matematika va sun’iy intellekt elementlarini o‘z ichiga oladi.

syn: gratin dauphinois – dofino grateni• Gratin dauphinois is another name for potato dauphinoise.(Gratin dauphinois — bu dofino kartoshkasi uchun yana bir nom.)au gratin – pishloqli qobiq bilan pishirilgan• The vegetables were cooked au gratin
golden and crispy on top.(Sabzavotlar pishloqli qobiq bilan pishirildi
ex: She prepared a creamy dauphinoise with layers of sliced potatoes and cheese. (U yupqa to‘g‘ralgan kartoshka va pishloqdan iborat smetanali dofino uslubidagi taom tayyorladi.)
Dauphinoise potatoes are a classic French side dish.(Dofino kartoshkasi — klassik fransuzcha garnir hisoblanadi.)
He served the roast with dauphinoise and green beans.(U qovurmani dofino kartoshkasi va yashil loviya bilan birga tortdi.)
This dauphinoise recipe adds garlic for extra flavor.(Bu dofino retsepti qo‘shimcha ta’m uchun sarimsoq qo‘shadi.)
We had chicken with dauphinoise on the side.(Biz tovuq go‘shtini dofino kartoshkasi bilan yedik.)
dauphinoise.meta: (Sifat sifatida): Asosan kartoshka yoki ba’zan boshqa sabzavotlar uchun ishlatiladi; kartoshka yupqa qilib kesilib, krem yoki sutda pishiriladi, ko‘pincha ustiga pishloq sepiladi. (Ot sifatida): Shu uslubda tayyorlangan taom.

syn: rejuvenate – yoshartirmoq• The spa treatment is said to rejuvenate the skin.(SPA muolajasi terini yoshartiradi

deyishadi.)reverse aging effects – qarish ta’sirini orqaga qaytarmoq• This software claims to reverse aging effects in photos.(Ushbu dastur suratlarda qarish ta’sirini orqaga qaytarishni va’da qiladi.)
ex: Photographers sometimes de-age celebrities in magazines using editing software. (Fotograflar ba’zan tahrir dasturlari yordamida jurnallardagi mashhurlarni yoshroq qilib ko‘rsatishadi.)
The filmmakers used CGI to de-age the actor in the flashback scenes.(Kinoyaratuvchilar orqaga qaytish sahnalarida aktyorni yoshroq ko‘rsatish uchun CGI’dan foydalandilar.)
They managed to de-age the president in the campaign photos.(Ular saylovoldi suratlarida prezidentni yoshroq qilib ko‘rsatishga muvaffaq bo‘lishdi.)
This software can de-age a person’s face in real time.(Ushbu dastur inson yuzini real vaqtda yoshartira oladi.)
She asked the editor not to de-age her photo for the article.(U maqola uchun surati yoshartirilmasligini muharrirdan so‘radi.)
de-age.meta: Bir kishini yoshroq ko‘rsatish, ayniqsa fotosuratda, filmda yoki boshqa raqamli usullarda uning yoshini kamaytirish uchun ishlatiladigan harakat.

syn: yoshlikni tiklash• The skincare product promises facial rejuvenation.(Ushbu teri parvarishi mahsuloti yuzni yoshartirishni va’da qiladi.)youth-enhancing – yoshlikni oshiruvchi
yoshroq ko‘rsatadigan• Youth-enhancing treatments are popular in beauty clinics.(Go‘zallik salonlarida yoshlikni oshiruvchi muolajalar mashhur.)
ex: De-ageing filters are popular on social media apps. (Ijtimoiy tarmoqlardagi ilovalarda yoshlashtiruvchi filtrlari mashhur.)
The movie used de-ageing effects to show the character as a young man.(Filmda qahramonni yoshligida ko‘rsatish uchun yoshlashtiruvchi effektlardan foydalanilgan.)
Advances in technology have improved the de-ageing process significantly.(Texnologiyaning taraqqiyoti yoshlashtirish jarayonini sezilarli darajada takomillashtirdi.)
The movie’s de-ageing of the lead actor was very convincing.(Filmda bosh qahramonning yoshlikdagi ko‘rinishi juda ishonarli chiqqan.)
Skincare companies often market their products as de-ageing solutions.(Teri parvarishi kompaniyalari mahsulotlarini ko‘pincha yoshlashtiruvchi yechimlar sifatida reklama qilishadi.)
de-ageing.meta: Bir kishini yoshroq ko‘rsatadigan yoki shunday ta’sir beruvchi; ayniqsa, fotosurat, film va boshqa raqamli tasvirlarda odamning yoshini kamaytirish uchun ishlatiladigan usul yoki texnologiya.

syn: devolution – vakolatlarni markazdan mintaqaga o‘tkazish• The UK has experienced decades of devolution.(Buyuk Britaniya o‘n yillar davomida devolution jarayonini boshdan kechirdi.)power transfer – hokimiyatni topshirish• Power transfer from London to local authorities is ongoing.(London hokimiyatining mahalliy organlarga o‘tishi davom etmoqda.)
ex: Many regions seek devo to have more control over their affairs. (Ko‘plab mintaqalar o‘z ishlarini mustaqil boshqarish uchun hokimiyatni markazdan o‘tkazishni istaydi.)
Devo has increased the powers of the Scottish Parliament.(Devolyutsiya Shotlandiya parlamenti vakolatlarini kuchaytirdi.)
The push for devo continues as regions want greater autonomy.(Hududlar ko‘proq mustaqillik istagani uchun devolution harakati davom etmoqda.)
Local leaders believe devo would help improve services.(Mahalliy yetakchilar devo xizmatlarni yaxshilashga yordam beradi, deb hisoblashadi.)
Debates around devo are common during election campaigns.(Saylov kampaniyalari paytida devo haqida bahslar tez-tez bo‘lib turadi.)
devo.meta: Markaziy hukumatdan mahalliy yoki mintaqaviy boshqaruv organlariga vakolatlarning o‘tkazilishi jarayoni. Ayniqsa, Buyuk Britaniyada Westminsterdan Shotlandiya, Uels yoki Shimoliy Irlandiyaga ba’zi vakolatlarning berilishi ma’nosida ishlatiladi.

syn: Japanese pancake sandwich – yapon blinchikli sendvichi• This Japanese pancake sandwich is filled with sweet red bean paste.(Bu yapon blinchikli sendvichi ichiga shirin qizil loviya pastasi solingan.)sweet red bean cake – shirin qizil loviyali pirogcha• She bought a sweet red bean cake from the Japanese bakery.(U yapon nonvoyxonasidan shirin qizil loviyali pirogcha sotib oldi.)
ex: The two pancakes in dorayaki are soft and fluffy. (Dorayakidagi ikki blinchik yumshoq va havodor bo‘ladi.)
Dorayaki is a popular Japanese sweet snack.(Dorayaki Yaponiyada mashhur shirin gazak hisoblanadi.)
Children in Japan often enjoy dorayaki as an after-school treat.(Yapon bolalari dorayakini ko‘pincha maktabdan keyin yeyishadi.)
The red bean filling in dorayaki gives it a unique taste.(Dorayakidagi qizil loviya pastasi unga o‘ziga xos ta’m beradi.)
You can now find dorayaki in Asian bakeries around the world.(Bugungi kunda dorayakini dunyo bo‘ylab Osiyo qandolatxonalarida topish mumkin.)
dorayaki.meta: Yaponiyaga xos shirinlik bo‘lib, ikkita kichik pancake (qalinroq blinchik) orasiga odatda shirin adzuki loviya pastasi solinadi. Bu an’anaviy va mashhur yapon taomlaridan biridir.

syn: dual descent – ikki naslli tizim• Dual descent can give individuals access to multiple social groups.(Ikki naslli tizim odamga bir nechta ijtimoiy guruhlarga kirish imkonini beradi.)complementary descent – to‘ldiruvchi nasl tizimi• Complementary descent systems divide responsibilities between paternal and maternal lines.(To‘ldiruvchi nasl tizimlarida mas’uliyat otalik va onalik nasl o‘rtasida bo‘linadi.)
ex: Double descent systems affect inheritance and clan membership rules. (Ikki tomonlama nasl tizimlari merosxo‘rlik va urug‘ a’zoligi qoidalariga ta’sir qiladi.)
Some cultures practice double descent, tracing lineage through both parents.(Ba’zi madaniyatlar ikkala ota-onaning naslini hisobga olgan holda ikki tomonlama nasl tizimini qo‘llaydi.)

In societies with double descent, land may pass through the father's line while rituals are inherited through the mother's line.(Ikki tomonlama nasl tizimiga ega jamiyatlarda yer otalik nasl orqali, marosimlar esa onalik nasl orqali o‘tadi.)
Double descent provides a balanced system of inheritance and identity.(Ikki tomonlama nasl meros va shaxsiylikni muvozanatli tizimda ta’minlaydi.)
Anthropologists study double descent to understand dual clan affiliations.(Antropologlar ikki tomonlama nasl tizimini ikki urug‘ a’zoligini tushunish uchun o‘rganishadi.)
double descent.meta: Nasab yoki urug‘lik tizimi bo‘lib, unda odamlar ota (patrilineal) va ona (matrilineal) tomonlaridan kelib chiqqan naslni bir vaqtda hisobga olishadi. Bu tizim ko‘pincha o‘ziga xos ijtimoiy va madaniy an’analar bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

syn: talabga javob beradigan• Only eligible players can enter the draft.(Faqat talabga javob beradigan o‘yinchilar tanlovda qatnasha oladi.)selectable – tanlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan• He's a selectable candidate for the national team.(U milliy jamoa uchun tanlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan nomzoddir.)
ex: The young player is highly draftable by several professional teams. (Yosh o‘yinchi bir nechta professional jamoalar tomonidan tanlanishi uchun juda yaroqli.)
He is draftable for the upcoming military service.(U yaqinlashayotgan harbiy xizmat uchun chaqirilishga yaroqli.)
Only citizens between 18 and 25 are considered draftable in this country.(Bu mamlakatda faqat 18–25 yosh orasidagi fuqarolar harbiy xizmatga yaroqli hisoblanadi.)
She trained hard to become draftable in the national volleyball league.(U milliy voleybol ligasida tanlovga yaroqli bo‘lish uchun qattiq mashq qildi.)
The scouts think he’s draftable, but he needs to improve his defense.(Skautlar uni tanlovga yaroqli deb o‘ylashadi, lekin u himoyasini yaxshilashi kerak.)
draftable.meta: Turli ma’nolarda “chizilishi” yoki tanlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan; ayniqsa, harbiy xizmatga chaqirilishi yoki sport jamoasiga tanlanishi mumkin bo‘lgan shaxs yoki narsa haqida ishlatiladi.

syn: draft analyst – tanlov tahlilchisi• The draft analyst gave each team a grade after the selections.(Tanlov tahlilchisi har bir jamoaga tanlovdan so‘ng baho berdi.)scouting enthusiast – skautlik ishqibozi• He’s a scouting enthusiast who tracks college athletes all year.(U butun yil davomida kollej sportchilarini kuzatadigan skautlik ishqibozi.)
ex: Many draftniks follow the draft process closely each year. (Ko‘plab draft mutaxassislari har yili tanlov jarayonini diqqat bilan kuzatib boradi.)
The draftnik analyzed the strengths and weaknesses of the players.(Draft mutaxassisi o‘yinchilarning kuchli va zaif tomonlarini tahlil qildi.)
He became a respected draftnik after years of writing scouting reports online.(U internetda skautlik hisobotlarini yozib yurgan yillaridan so‘ng hurmatli draft mutaxassisiga aylandi.)
Some draftniks predict the picks more accurately than official analysts.(Ba’zi draft mutaxassislari rasmiy tahlilchilarga qaraganda aniqroq tanlovlar qiladi.)
As a passionate draftnik, she spends months preparing her mock drafts.(Ishtiyoqli draft mutaxassisi sifatida u oylar davomida o‘zining taxminiy tanlovlarini tayyorlaydi.)
draftnik.meta: Professional sport jamoasiga o‘yinchilarni tanlash jarayonini kuzatib, tahlil qiluvchi yoki haqida hisobot beruvchi shaxs, ko‘pincha bu ishni ishtiyoq bilan bajaradigan muxlis yoki mutaxassis.

syn: wind guard – shamol to‘suvchi himoya• The jacket’s wind guard keeps the zipper area warm.(Kurtkadagi shamol to‘suvchi himoya fermuar atrofini issiq tutadi.)wind flap – shamol to‘sig‘i• The tent door has a wind flap to stop cold air.(Palatka eshigida sovuq havoni to‘sish uchun shamol to‘sig‘i bor.)
ex: Make sure the draught flap is properly closed to prevent chills. (Sovuq urmasligi uchun shamol to‘sig‘i to‘g‘ri yopilganiga ishonch hosil qiling.)
The sleeping bag has a draft flap to keep cold air out.(Uyqu xaltasi sovuq havoni to‘sish uchun shamol to‘sig‘iga ega.)
His winter coat features an insulated draft flap behind the zipper.(Uning qishki kurtkasida fermuar ortida izolyatsiyalangan shamol to‘sig‘i bor.)
Most camping gear now includes draft flaps for extra warmth.(Ko‘pgina lager jihozlarida endi qo‘shimcha issiqlik uchun shamol to‘sig‘i mavjud.)
I adjusted the draught flap inside my sleeping bag to stay warm at night.(Uyqu xaltamdagi shamol to‘sig‘ini kechasi issiq qolish uchun sozladim.)
draught flap || draft flap.meta: Turli xil sovuq havoning kirib kelishini oldini olish uchun mo‘ljallangan pardachiq yoki qopqoq. Hozirda ayniqsa yotoq sumkasidagi (sleeping bag) yoki kiyimdagi fermuar ichida joylashgan uzun pardachiq shaklida qo‘llaniladi.

syn: weatherstripping – havo o‘tkazmas materiallar bilan yopish• Weatherstripping the door can cut down on energy loss.(Eshikni havo o‘tkazmas material bilan yopish energiya yo‘qotilishini kamaytiradi.)insulation – izolyatsiya
issiqlikni saqlash• Good insulation and draught-proofing keep the house comfortable.(Yaxshi izolyatsiya va shamoldan himoyalash uyda qulaylikni ta’minlaydi.)
ex: The house underwent draught-proofing to keep it warm in winter. (Uyni qishda issiq saqlash uchun shamoldan himoyalash ishlari olib borildi.)
Draught-proofing your windows can help reduce heating costs.(Derazalarni shamoldan himoyalash isitish xarajatlarini kamaytirishi mumkin.)
Effective draught-proofing makes old homes more energy efficient.(Samarali shamoldan himoyalash eski uylarni yanada energiya tejamkor qiladi.)
They used rubber seals and brushes for door draught-proofing.(Ular eshikni shamoldan himoyalash uchun rezina muhrlar va cho‘tqalardan foydalandilar.)
DIY draught-proofing kits are available at most hardware stores.(Aksariyat xo‘jalik do‘konlarida o‘zing qiladigan shamoldan himoyalash to‘plamlari mavjud.)
draught-proofing || draft-proofing.meta: Biror narsani shamoldan himoya qilish yoki shamolning kirib kelishini oldini olish jarayoni; shuningdek, binolar yoki inshootlardan shamollarni chiqarib tashlash uchun ishlatiladigan materiallar yoki vositalar.

syn: chillingly – sovuq tarzda• The wind blew chillingly through the cracks.(Shamol yoriqlardan sovuq tarzda esdi.)blustery (used as adjective) – shamolli
kuchli shamolli• It was a blustery night in the countryside.(Qishloqda shamolli tun edi.)
ex: She shivered draughtily as the wind blew through the cracked window. (Derazadagi yoriqdan shamol urib, u shamolli tarzda titradi.)
The old house was draughtily cold during the winter.(Qari uy qishda shamolli va sovuq edi.)
He sat draughtily near the open door, clutching his jacket.(U ochiq eshik yonida shamol ta’sirida o‘tirib, kurtkasini mahkam ushlab turdi.)
The curtains moved draughtily whenever the wind blew through the gaps.(Shamol yoriqlardan o‘tganida parda shamolli tarzda tebranardi.)
They ate dinner draughtily in the chilly back room.(Ular orqa xonada sovuq va shamolli holatda kechki ovqatni tanovul qilishdi.)
draughtily || draftily.meta: Shamol yoki havo oqimlari ta’sirida bo‘lgan yoki shunday tarzda harakat qilgan holda.

syn: handbrake – qo‘l tormozi• He pulled the handbrake tightly before stepping out.(U mashinadan tushishdan oldin qo‘l tormozini mahkam tortdi.)parking brake – to‘xtatish tormozi• Use the parking brake on steep roads.(Tik yo‘llarda to‘xtatish tormozidan foydalaning.)
ex: The driver pulled the e-brake to prevent the car from rolling. (Haydovchi mashinaning sirg‘alib ketmasligi uchun e-brakeni tortdi.)
Always engage the e-brake when parking on a slope.(Yonbag‘irda to‘xtaganingizda har doim e-brakeni ishga tushiring.)
Modern cars often have an automatic e-brake function.(Zamonaviy avtomobillarda ko‘pincha avtomatik e-brake funksiyasi mavjud.)
He forgot to release the e-brake before driving off.(U haydashdan oldin e-brakeni bo‘shatishni unutdi.)
Using the e-brake during a skid can be dangerous.(Sirpanish vaqtida e-brakeni ishlatish xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin.)
e-brake.meta: Avtomobil yoki treylerda qo‘lda boshqariladigan tormoz turi bo‘lib, mashina to‘xtatilganda uning harakatsiz turishini ta’minlash uchun ishlatiladi. Ko‘pincha “favqulodda tormoz” (emergency brake) bilan sinonim sifatida ishlatiladi.

ex: The cassava meal is boiled and kneaded to make eba. (Kassava unidan olingan taom qaynatiladi va eba tayyorlash uchun qoriladi.)
Eba is a staple food in many parts of West Africa.(Eba G‘arbiy Afrikaning ko‘plab hududlarida asosiy ovqat hisoblanadi.)
She served eba with a rich okra soup for lunch.(U tushlikka boy bamya sho‘rva bilan eba tortdi.)
Most Nigerian homes prepare eba daily as part of their diet.(Nigeriyaliklar uylarining aksariyatida eba har kuni tayyorlanadi.)
Eba is best eaten hot with vegetable or meat-based soup.(Eba issiq holda sabzavotli yoki go‘shtli sho‘rva bilan yeyilganda mazaliroq bo‘ladi.)
eba.meta: Qaynatilgan kassava unidan tayyorlangan xamir turi bo‘lib, odatda shar shaklida shakllantiriladi va G‘arbiy Afrikaning ba’zi hududlarida asosiy taom hisoblanadi. Garri ga o‘xshash.

syn: terminal – o‘lim bilan tugaydigan / o‘limga olib boradigan• She has a terminal illness and is receiving palliative care.(U o‘limga olib boradigan kasallikka chalingan va palliyativ parvarish olayapti.)palliative – yengillik beruvchi (davolash emas)• Palliative treatment aims to relieve pain._(Palliyativ davolash og‘riqni kamaytirishga qaratilgan.)
ex: End-of-life decisions are often emotionally challenging for families. (Umrining oxiriga oid qarorlar ko‘pincha oilalar uchun hissiy jihatdan og‘ir bo‘ladi.)
The hospital provides specialized end-of-life care for terminally ill patients.(Shifoxona o‘limi yaqin og‘ir kasallarga maxsus hayotining oxiriga oid parvarish xizmatini ko‘rsatadi.)
Doctors discussed end-of-life options with the patient's family.(Shifokorlar bemorning oilasi bilan umrining oxiriga oid variantlar haqida gaplashishdi.)
End-of-life care focuses on comfort, not cure.(Hayotining oxiriga oid parvarish qulaylikni ta’minlashga qaratilgan, davoga emas.)
Planning for end-of-life can help reduce stress during critical times.(Umrining oxiriga oid rejalashtirish muhim paytlarda bosimni kamaytirishga yordam beradi.)
end-of-life.meta: Hayotining oxiriga oid — inson umrining tugash bosqichiga, ayniqsa qarilik yoki og‘ir kasallik tufayli vafotga yaqinlashayotgan davrga oid. Bu atama ko‘pincha tibbiy yordam, psixologik qo‘llab-quvvatlash yoki ijtimoiy xizmatlar bilan bog‘liq

syn: default setting – standart sozlama• The app goes back to the default setting after reinstalling.(Ilova qayta o‘rnatilgach
standart sozlamaga qaytadi.)original setup – asl sozlash holati• Restoring the original setup may fix the system error.(Asl sozlash holatiga qaytish tizim xatolarini tuzatishi mumkin.)
ex: The device will restart and return to its factory settings. (Qurilma qayta ishga tushadi va zavod sozlamalariga qaytadi.)
I had to reset my phone to the factory settings to fix the problem.(Muammoni hal qilish uchun telefonimni zavod sozlamalariga tiklashimga to‘g‘ri keldi.)
Restoring factory settings will erase all your personal data.(Zavod sozlamalariga qaytish shaxsiy ma’lumotlaringizni o‘chirib yuboradi.)
Some users prefer the factory setting because it’s simpler.(Ba’zi foydalanuvchilar zavod sozlamasini afzal ko‘rishadi, chunki u oddiyroq.)
Factory settings ensure that the device works as intended by the manufacturer.(Zavod sozlamalari qurilmaning ishlab chiqaruvchi ko‘zlaganidek ishlashini ta’minlaydi.)
factory setting.meta: zavod sozlamasi — qurilma, mashina yoki tizim ishlab chiqaruvchi tomonidan dastlab o‘rnatilgan asl sozlamalar holati. bu sozlamalar foydalanuvchi tomonidan keyinchalik o‘zgartirilishi yoki moslashtirilishi mumkin.

syn: seasoning mix – ziravor aralashmasi• This seasoning mix adds flavor like furikake.(Bu ziravor aralashmasi furikake kabi ta’m qo‘shadi.)rice topping – guruch ustiga sepiladigan narsa• Furikake is one of the most common rice toppings in Japan.(Furikake Yaponiyada eng keng tarqalgan guruch usti qo‘shimchalaridan biridir.)
ex: Furikake is a popular seasoning in Japanese cuisine. (Furikake Yapon oshxonasida mashhur ziravor hisoblanadi.)
I sprinkled some furikake on my rice for extra flavor.(Qo‘shimcha ta’m uchun guruchim ustiga furikake sepdim.)
Furikake adds a salty, umami-rich crunch to plain dishes.(Furikake oddiy taomlarga sho‘r va umami lazzatli qarsillovchi tuyg‘u qo‘shadi.)
Many bento lunches include rice topped with furikake.(Ko‘plab bento tushliklarida guruch furikake bilan bezatilgan bo‘ladi.)
You can find furikake in various flavors, from spicy to sweet.(Furikake turli xil ta’mlarda mavjud — achchiqdan tortib shirinlargacha.)
furikake.meta: yapon oshxonasida ishlatiladigan ziravor aralashmasi bo‘lib, tarkibida quritilgan baliq bo‘lakchalari, maydalangan dengiz o‘tlari (nori), kunjut urug‘lari va tuz bo‘ladi. u odatda guruch, makaron yoki boshqa taomlar ustiga sepib iste’mol qilinadi.

syn: wrapping cloth – o‘rov matosi• The wrapping cloth can be used again and again.(O‘rov matosidan qayta-qayta foydalanish mumkin.)fabric gift wrap – mato sovg‘a o‘rovi• She used fabric gift wrap instead of paper.(U qog‘oz o‘rniga mato sovg‘a o‘rovidan foydalandi.)
ex: Furoshiki is both practical and environmentally friendly. (Furoshiki ham amaliy, ham ekologik jihatdan foydalidir.)
She wrapped the gift in a beautiful furoshiki cloth.(U sovg‘ani chiroyli furoshiki matosiga o‘radi.)
Many people now use furoshiki instead of disposable gift wrap.(Ko‘p odamlar hozir bir martalik sovg‘a o‘rov qog‘ozlari o‘rniga furoshikidan foydalanishmoqda.)
You can carry lunch or books in a properly tied furoshiki.(To‘g‘ri tugunlangan furoshiki ichida tushlik yoki kitoblar tashish mumkin.)
The art of folding and tying furoshiki is passed down through generations.(Furoshikini buklash va bog‘lash san’ati avloddan-avlodga o‘tadi.)
furoshiki.meta: furoshiki — yapon an’anaviy bezakli o‘rov matosi bo‘lib, sovg‘alarni o‘rash yoki narsalarni tashish uchun ishlatiladi. u turli o‘lcham va naqshlarga ega bo‘ladi, matoning tugunlab bog‘lanishi orqali turli shakllarda o‘rash mumkin.

syn: illegal mining – noqonuniy kon qazish• Illegal mining (galamsey) threatens local ecosystems.(Noqonuniy kon qazish (galamsey) mahalliy ekotizimlarga xavf tug‘diradi.)informal gold mining – norasmiy oltin qazib olish• Informal gold mining like galamsey is hard to regulate.(Galamsey kabi norasmiy oltin qazib olishni nazorat qilish qiyin.)
ex: Galamsey mining often leads to river pollution and deforestation. (Galamsey qazish ishlari ko‘pincha daryolarning ifloslanishi va o‘rmonlarning kesilishiga olib keladi.)
The government is cracking down on galamsey operations to protect the environment.(Hukumat atrof-muhitni himoya qilish uchun galamsey faoliyatiga qarshi keskin choralar ko‘rmoqda.)
Galamsey is a serious challenge for both economic regulation and environmental protection.(Galamsey iqtisodiy nazorat va atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish bo‘yicha jiddiy muammoga aylangan.)
Communities living near galamsey sites often face health risks.(Galamsey hududlari yaqinida yashovchi jamoalar ko‘pincha sog‘liq muammolariga duch keladi.)
Some people turn to galamsey due to lack of employment opportunities.(Ba’zi odamlar ish o‘rni yo‘qligi sababli galamseyni tanlaydilar.)
galamsey.meta: galamsey — asosan G‘arbiy Afrikada, ayniqsa Gana mamlakatida uchraydigan, oltinni kichik hajmda va ruxsatsiz tarzda qazib olish amaliyoti. bu faoliyat ko‘pincha noqonuniy bo‘lib, ekologik muammolar va xavfli mehnat sharoitlari bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

syn: illegal miner – noqonuniy konchi• Illegal miners often destroy forest land.(Noqonuniy konchilar ko‘pincha o‘rmon yerlarini vayron qiladilar.)artisanal gold miner (context-dependent) – kichik hajmda oltin qazuvchi• Artisanal gold miners may or may not be regulated by the government.(Kichik hajmda oltin qazuvchilar ba’zida hukumat tomonidan nazorat qilinadi
ex: Galamseyers often risk their lives working in unsafe conditions. (Galamseychilar ko‘pincha xavfli sharoitlarda hayotlarini xavf ostiga qo‘yib ishlaydilar.)
The police arrested several galamseyers operating in the forest.(Politsiya o‘rmon hududida faoliyat yuritayotgan bir nechta galamseychilarni qo‘lga oldi.)
Local communities are divided over how to deal with galamseyers.(Mahalliy jamoalar galamseychilar bilan qanday muomala qilish bo‘yicha ikkilanmoqda.)
Some galamseyers use dangerous chemicals like mercury during mining.(Ba’zi galamseychilar qazish jarayonida simob kabi xavfli kimyoviy moddalarni ishlatishadi.)

The government has launched campaigns to remove illegal galamseyers from protected lands.(Hukumat muhofaza etiladigan yerlardan noqonuniy galamseychilarni chiqarib yuborish bo‘yicha kampaniyalar boshladi.)
galamseyer.meta: galamseyer — kichik hajmda va ruxsatsiz tarzda oltin qazib olish bilan shug‘ullanuvchi shaxs. bu atama asosan G‘arbiy Afrikada, ayniqsa Gana mamlakatida ishlatiladi va galamsey (noqonuniy oltin qazib olish amaliyoti) bilan bog‘liq.

syn: francization – fransuzlashtirish• Francization and gallicization are often used interchangeably in cultural contexts.(Fransuzlashtirish va galllashtirish ko‘pincha madaniy kontekstda bir xil ma’noda ishlatiladi.)assimilation into French culture – fransuz madaniyatiga singdirish• Assimilation into French culture was a slow process driven by gallicization.(Fransuz madaniyatiga singdirish galllashtirish orqali asta-sekin kechgan jarayon edi.)
ex: Gallicization led to the decline of regional languages in some parts of France. (Galllashtirish Fransiyaning ayrim hududlarida mintaqaviy tillarning qisqarishiga olib keldi.)
The gallicization of local names was part of the colonial policy.(Mahalliy nomlarni galllashtirish mustamlakachilik siyosatining bir qismi edi.)
Some resisted the cultural gallicization of their community.(Ba’zilar o‘z jamoalarining madaniy galllashtirilishiga qarshilik ko‘rsatishdi.)
Gallicization influenced not only language but also architecture and fashion.(Galllashtirish nafaqat tilga, balki me’morchilik va kiyinish uslubiga ham ta’sir ko‘rsatgan.)
The policy of gallicization was enforced through schools and administration.(Galllashtirish siyosati maktablar va boshqaruv tizimi orqali amalga oshirilgan.)
gallicization.meta: galllashtirish — biror shaxs, guruh yoki narsaga gallik (ya’ni, fransuz) xususiyatlarini berish yoki ularni fransuz madaniyati, tili, urf-odatlari yoki hayot tarzini qabul qilishga majbur qilish yoki undash jarayoni.

syn: Northern Italian (linguistic) – shimoliy italyan (tiliga oid)• Northern Italian dialects include Gallo-Italian varieties.(Shimoliy italyan lahjalari tarkibida Gallo-Italiya turlari ham mavjud.)Western Romance (language group) – g‘arbiy roman tillar guruhi• Gallo-Italian is part of the Western Romance family.(Gallo-Italiya G‘arbiy Roman tillari oilasiga kiradi.)
ex: Gallo-Italian culture reflects a blend of Celtic and Latin influences. (Gallo-Italiya madaniyati keltlar va lotinlarning aralash ta’sirini aks ettiradi.)
The Gallo-Italian dialects are distinct from standard Italian.(Gallo-Italiya lahjalari adabiy italyan tilidan farq qiladi.)
He studied Gallo-Italian phonology for his thesis on regional linguistics.(U o‘zining mintaqaviy tilshunoslik bo‘yicha dissertatsiyasi uchun Gallo-Italiya fonologiyasini o‘rgandi.)
Many Gallo-Italian words differ significantly in vocabulary and pronunciation.(Ko‘plab Gallo-Italiya so‘zlari lug‘at va talaffuz jihatdan sezilarli farq qiladi.)
Traditional Gallo-Italian music features regional instruments and melodies.(An’anaviy Gallo-Italiya musiqasida mintaqaviy cholg‘ular va kuylar ishlatiladi.)
gallo-italian.meta: gallo-italiya — shimoliy italyaning Piemont, Lombardiya, Emiliya-Romanya va Liguriya hududlariga oid yoki shu hududlarda so‘zlashiladigan italyan tilining lahjalari va madaniy xususiyatlariga tegishli bo‘lgan sifat.

syn: endurance – chidamlilik• Her endurance during hardship reminded others of gaman.(Qiyinchilikdagi chidamliligi boshqalarga gamanni eslatdi.)stoicism – boshidan kechirayotganini bildirmaslik• He faced loss with calm stoicism.(U yo‘qotishni sokin stoiklik bilan qabul qildi.)self-restraint – o‘zini tuta bilish• Gaman emphasizes self-restraint and composure.(Gaman o‘zini tuta bilish va sokinlikni ta’kidlaydi.)
ex: Gaman is a deeply rooted concept in Japanese values. (Gaman yapon qadriyatlarida chuqur ildiz otgan tushunchadir.)
During the crisis, she showed true gaman by staying calm and strong.(Inqiroz paytida u xotirjam va bardoshli bo‘lib, chinakam gaman ko‘rsatdi.)
He endured the pain with silent gaman.(U og‘riqqa jim turgan holda gaman bilan chidadi.)
Gaman teaches people not to complain, even when times are tough.(Gaman odamlarni, qiyin paytda ham, shikoyat qilmaslikka o‘rgatadi.)
In traditional families, children are raised with the value of gaman.(An’anaviy oilalarda bolalar gaman qadriyati bilan tarbiyalanadi.)
gaman.meta: gaman — yapon madaniyatida qiyinchilik va musibatlarga sabr, matonat va or-nomus bilan bardosh berish qobiliyati. bu fazilat insonning ichki kuchini, qat’iyatini va vazminligini ifodalaydi.

syn: Endure (chidamoq): She endured the cold without a complaint. (U sovuqqa shikoyatsiz chidadi.)Bear (bardosh bermoq): He bore the loss with great strength. (U yo‘qotishga katta kuch bilan bardosh berdi.)Persevere (sabr qilmoq): They persevered through the crisis with dignity. (Ular inqirozga or-nomus bilan sabr qilishdi.)
ex: In difficult times, people are expected to gaman and stay strong. (Qiyin paytlarda odamlar gaman qilishi va kuchli bo‘lib qolishi kutiladi.)

Instead of complaining, he chose to gaman through the pain. (Shikoyat qilish o‘rniga, u og‘riqqa gaman qilishni tanladi.)She had to gaman through the long hours of work to support her family. (U oilasini boqish uchun uzoq soatlar ishlashga sabr qildi.)
Despite the challenges, he gamanned silently and completed the task. (Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u jimgina sabr qilib vazifani yakunladi.)
gaman.meta: og‘irlik, musibat yoki sinovlarga sabr, matonat va or-nomus bilan chiday olish, norozilik bildirmasdan ichki bardosh ko‘rsatish. bu harakat odatda ijtimoiy burch, madaniy qadriyat va shaxsiy kuch ifodasi sifatida qaraladi.

syn: trash day – axlat kuni• Trash day is the same as garbage day in most places.(Ko‘pgina joylarda axlat kuni chiqindi to‘plash kuni bilan bir xil.)waste collection day – chiqindilarni yig‘ish kuni• Waste collection day varies by district.(Chiqindilarni yig‘ish kuni har bir tumanga qarab farq qiladi.)
ex: Garbage day in our neighborhood is every Monday morning. (Bizning mahallada chiqindi to‘plash kuni har dushanba tongida bo‘ladi.)
Don't forget to put the bins out—tomorrow is garbage day.(Chiqindilarni tashqariga chiqarishni unutmang — ertaga axlat yig‘ish kuni.)
Because of the holiday, garbage day was moved to Thursday this week.(Bayram tufayli bu hafta chiqindi to‘plash kuni payshanbaga ko‘chirildi.)
The smell gets bad if you miss garbage day.(Agar chiqindi to‘plash kunini o‘tkazib yuborsangiz, hid juda yomon bo‘ladi.)
They set reminders on their phones for garbage day.(Ular chiqindi to‘plash kuni uchun telefonlariga eslatmalar o‘rnatishgan.)
garbage day.meta: ma’lum bir hududda maishiy yoki tijorat chiqindilari (axlat) yig‘ib ketiladigan belgilangan kun. bu kun odatda mahalliy hokimiyat yoki xizmat ko‘rsatuvchi tashkilot tomonidan belgilanadi va har hafta yoki boshqa davriylikda takrorlanadi.

syn: headwrap – bosh ro‘mol• She styled her headwrap like a gele.(U bosh ro‘molini gele singari bog‘ladi.)head tie – bosh bog‘ich / ro‘mol• The head tie is a common fashion piece in African ceremonies.(Bosh bog‘ich Afrikadagi marosimlarda keng tarqalgan moda unsuri hisoblanadi.)
ex: Gele is a symbol of elegance and cultural pride among Yoruba women. (Gele Yoruba ayollari orasida nafislik va madaniy faxr ramzi hisoblanadi.)
She wore a beautifully wrapped gele to the wedding ceremony.(U to‘y marosimiga chiroyli o‘ralgan gele kiyib keldi.)
Each gele style tells a story of status, tradition, or personal taste.(Har bir gele uslubi maqom, an’ana yoki shaxsiy didni aks ettiradi.)
The gele was color-coordinated with her lace outfit.(Gele uning dantelli libosi bilan mos rangda edi.)
Learning how to tie a gele takes practice and patience.(Gele bog‘lashni o‘rganish amaliyot va sabr talab qiladi.)
gele.meta: gele — G‘arbiy Afrikada, ayniqsa Nigeriyadagi yoruba ayollari tomonidan an’anaviy tarzda taqiladigan bosh ro‘molcha. u odatda qattiq, shaklini saqlaydigan, yorqin rangli naqshli matodan tayyorlanadi.

syn: holiday week – dam olish haftaligi• It’s the longest holiday week of the year in Japan.(Bu Yaponiyadagi yilning eng uzun dam olish haftaligidir.)national break – milliy tanaffus• This national break is when many people take vacations.(Bu milliy tanaffusda ko‘plab odamlar ta’tilga chiqadi.)
ex: Hotels and trains are often fully booked during Golden Week in Japan. (Yaponiyada Oltin hafta davrida mehmonxonalar va poezdlar ko‘pincha to‘la bo‘ladi.)
Many people travel during Golden Week to visit family or go on vacation.(Ko‘plab odamlar Oltin haftada sayohat qilish yoki oila a’zolarini ziyorat qilish uchun yo‘lga chiqadi.)
Businesses often shut down for the entire Golden Week.(Korxonalar ko‘pincha butun Oltin hafta davomida yopiladi.)
Traffic congestion during Golden Week is a serious issue in big cities.(Oltin hafta davridagi tirbandlik yirik shaharlarda jiddiy muammoga aylangan.)
He took advantage of Golden Week to go hiking in the mountains.(U Oltin haftadan foydalanib tog‘larga piyoda sayrga chiqdi.)
golden week.meta: oltin hafta — Yaponiyada (va keyinchalik Xitoyda ham) har yili nishonlanadigan 7–8 kunlik bayramlar davri bo‘lib, bu vaqt ichida bir nechta milliy dam olish kunlari ketma-ket keladi.

syn: triangular knot – uchburchak shaklidagi tugun• The triangular shape of the half-Windsor gives it a balanced look.(Yarim vindzorning uchburchak shakli unga muvozanatli ko‘rinish beradi.)necktie knot – galstuk tuguni• There are several types of necktie knots including the half-Windsor.(Galstuk tugunlarining bir nechta turlari mavjud
ex: The half-Windsor is a versatile knot, perfect for most collar types. (Yarim Vindzor ko‘p turdagi yoqalar uchun juda mos keladigan ko‘p funksiyali tugundir.)
He tied his tie with a neat half-Windsor knot for the interview.(U suhbat uchun galstukni chiroyli yarim vindzor tugunida bog‘ladi.)
The half-Windsor strikes a balance between casual and formal.(Yarim vindzor rasmiylik va oddiylik o‘rtasida muvozanatni saqlaydi.)
Use the half-Windsor when wearing a shirt with a narrow collar.(Tor yoqali ko‘ylak kiyganingizda yarim vindzordan foydalaning.)
It took him a while to master the half-Windsor knot.(U yarim vindzor tugunini o‘rganishga ancha vaqt sarfladi.)
half-windsor.meta: bo‘yinga taqiladigan galstuk uchun ishlatiladigan, o‘rtacha kattalikdagi uchburchak shaklidagi tugun. bu tugun to‘liq Windsor tuguniga qaraganda ingichkaroq bo‘lib, yengilroq matoli yoki tor yoqali ko‘ylaklar bilan yaxshi mos keladi.

syn: jalopy – eski mashina• He drove an old jalopy to the market every day.(U har kuni bozorga eski mashinada borardi.)farm truck – ferma yuk mashinasi• The farm truck was patched up like a hoopie but worked just fine.(Ferma yuk mashinasi hoopiga o‘xshab tuzatilgan bo‘lsa-da
ex: The boys fixed up a hoopie to use on the farm. (Yigitlar fermer xo‘jaligida ishlatish uchun eski hoopi mashinasini tuzatishdi.)
He drove an old hoopie down the dirt road, loaded with tools.(U eski hoopi mashinasida changli yo‘ldan qurollar bilan to‘la holatda haydab o‘tdi.)
Their grandfather’s hoopie still runs after all these years.(Bobolarining hoopi mashinasi shuncha yil o‘tgach ham hanuz yuradi.)
We used a hoopie to haul hay bales during summer.(Biz yozda pichan to‘plarini tashish uchun hoopi mashinasidan foydalandik.)
The old hoopie creaked and groaned, but it got the job done.(Eski hoopi g‘ichirlayotgan va nola qilayotgan bo‘lsa-da, ishni uddaladi.)
hoopie.meta: hoopi — dastlab, ochiq tomli (ko‘pincha usti ochiq) eski rusumdagi, ayniqsa Ford Model T kabi avtomobillarni ifodalagan atama bo‘lib, bu mashinalar qayta jihozlangan va orqa qismiga yog‘ochdan tayyorlangan yuk platformasi (kuzov) o‘rnatilgan bo‘ladi.

syn: disaster – falokat• The whole plan was a disaster from the beginning.(Butun reja boshidanoq falokat edi.)train wreck – halokatli holat• That interview was a total train wreck.(O‘sha suhbat to‘liq halokatli holat edi.)nightmare – dahshatli holat• Her travel experience turned into a nightmare.(Uning sayohati dahshatli holatga aylandi.)
ex: The project turned into a horror show of poor planning and bad decisions. (Loyiha yomon rejalashtirish va noto‘g‘ri qarorlar tufayli dahshatli tomoshaga aylandi.)
Their performance in the second half was a horror show of missed chances.(Ularning ikkinchi bo‘limdagi o‘yini imkoniyatlarni boy berish bo‘yicha dahshatli tomoshaga aylandi.)
The meeting was a horror show — technical issues, delays, and confusion everywhere.(Uchrashuv dahshatli tomosha edi — texnik muammolar, kechikishlar va umumiy chalkashlik.)

syn: lickety-split – nihoyatda tez• We got there lickety-split.(Biz u yerga ildamlik bilan yetib bordik.)in a flash – bir lahzada• She was gone in a flash.(U bir lahzada g‘oyib bo‘ldi.)at lightning speed – yashin tezligida• He typed at lightning speed.(U yashin tezligida yozdi.)
ex: We packed our things lickety-brindle and rushed to the station. (Biz narsalarimizni yashin tezligida yig‘ishtirib, bekatga chopdik.)
When the dog saw the squirrel, it ran lickety-brindle across the yard.(Kuchuk sincapni ko‘rishi bilan hovlidan ildamlik bilan yugurib o‘tdi.)
As soon as the bell rang, the students dashed out lickety-brindle.(Qo‘ng‘iroq chalilishi bilan o‘quvchilar yashin tezligida yugurib chiqib ketishdi.)
The cat disappeared lickety-brindle as soon as the vacuum started.(Changyutgich ishga tushishi bilan mushuk ildamlik bilan g‘oyib bo‘ldi.)
lickety-brindle.meta: lickety-brindle — norasmiy va kam ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, juda tezlikda, nihoyatda tez, iloji boricha tez harakatlanish ma’nolarini bildiradi. bu ibora odatda harakatning yashin tezligida sodir bo‘lishini obrazli tarzda ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

syn: sycophantic – yaltoqlanadigan• His sycophantic praise annoyed his colleagues.(Uning yaltoqlanadigan maqtovlari hamkasblarini g‘azablantirdi.)obsequious – pasaygan

haddan tashqari bo‘ysunuvchi• Her obsequious behavior made the manager uncomfortable.(Uning haddan tashqari bo‘ysunuvchi harakati boshliqni noqulay ahvolga solib qo‘ydi.)flattering in excess – ortiqcha maqtovli• The reporter’s tone was overly flattering and unprofessional.(Muxbirning ohangi haddan tashqari maqtovli va noxush edi.)
ex: She gave a lickspittling speech, full of exaggerated praise and flattery. (U haddan tashqari maqtov va yaltoqlik bilan to‘la laganbardorona nutq so‘zladi.)
His lickspittling compliments to the manager made everyone cringe.(Uning xo‘jako‘rsin yaltoqlik bilan aytilgan maqtovlari hammaga yoqimsiz tuyuldi.)
The article was criticized for its lickspittling tone toward the politician.(Maqola siyosatchiga nisbatan laganbardorona ohangda yozilgani uchun tanqid qilindi.)
The team disliked his lickspittling behavior during the meeting.(Jamoa yig‘ilishdagi uning yaltoqlanadigan harakatlaridan norozi bo‘ldi.)
lickspittling.meta: kishi, uning so‘zlari yoki harakatlariga nisbatan ishlatiladigan sifat bo‘lib, o‘ta maqtovchan, samimiy bo‘lmagan tarzda yoqishga harakat qiladigan, pastkashlarcha bo‘ysunuvchi, xizmatkorona yoki maqsadli tarzda yaltoqlanadigan holatni bildiradi.

syn: greedy – ochko‘z• He’s greedy and always takes the biggest piece.(U ochko‘z va har doim eng katta bo‘lakni oladi.)gluttonous – to‘ymas• His gluttonous habits make him unpopular at shared meals.(To‘ymas odatlari uni umumiy ovqatlanishlarda yoqtirmaslikka olib keladi.)sycophantic (if used for flattering for gain) – yaltoqlanadigan• The sycophantic assistant agreed with everything the boss said.(Yaltoqlanadigan yordamchi boshliq aytgan hamma gapga rozilik bildirdi.)
ex: He’s too licky-licky when it comes to money. (U pulga kelganda juda ochko‘z.)
Don’t be so licky-licky — leave some food for others!(Shunchalik ochko‘z bo‘lma — boshqalar uchun ham ovqat qoldir!)
That guy is always licky-licky with the boss to get favors.(U yigit har doim boshliq oldida manfaat uchun yaltoqlanadi.)
She’s acting licky-licky again just to get extra snacks.(U yana qo‘shimcha tamaddi olish uchun tamaj bo‘lib harakat qilyapti.)
licky-licky.meta: licky-licky — norasmiy (asosan G‘arbiy Afrika ingliz tilida ishlatiladigan) so‘z bo‘lib, juda ham ochko‘z, har narsaga og‘iz soladigan, yoki manfaatparast odamni ifodalaydi.

syn: lick-prone – yalashga moyil• The lick-prone puppy needs training.(Yalashga moyil kuchukchani o‘rgatish kerak.)wet-nosed (sometimes used affectionately for licking dogs)• My wet-nosed friend jumped on me.(Mening ho‘l burunli do‘stim ustimga sakradi.)
ex: The child gave the ice cream a big licky swipe. (Bola muzqaymoqni katta yalovchan harakat bilan yaladi.)

My puppy is very licky — he licks everyone he meets.(Kuchugim juda yalovchan — u uchratgan har bir kishini yalaydi.)• That cat isn't cuddly, but she’s quite licky when she’s happy.(Bu mushuk quchoqlashishni yoqtirmaydi, lekin xursand bo‘lsa, juda yalovchan bo‘ladi.)• The baby gave a licky kiss on her mom’s cheek.(Bola onasining yuzidan yalovchan o‘pdi.)
licky.meta: yalashga moyil (licky) — bu sifat odatda hayvonlar (masalan, kuchuklar) yoki ba’zida odamlar haqida ishlatiladi va ko‘p yalaydigan, yalash odati bor, yalovchan degan ma’noni anglatadi.

syn: Spring Festival – bahor festivali (commonly used for Chinese New Year)• The Spring Festival is celebrated at the start of the lunar calendar.(Bahor festivali oy taqvimining boshida nishonlanadi.)Lunisolar New Year – oy-quyosh taqvimiga asoslangan yangi yil• The lunisolar New Year varies in date each year.(Oy-quyosh taqvimiga asoslangan yangi yil har yili turli kunga to‘g‘ri keladi.)
ex: The Lunar New Year is marked with fireworks, red decorations, and traditional food. (Oy taqvimi bo‘yicha yangi yil bayrami mushakbozlik, qizil bezaklar va an’anaviy taomlar bilan nishonlanadi.)

Many families travel long distances to reunite during the Lunar New Year.(Ko‘plab oilalar Oy yangi yilida qayta uchrashish uchun uzoq masofalarni bosib o‘tadilar.)• People clean their houses before the Lunar New Year to sweep away bad luck.(Insonlar Oy yangi yili oldidan yomon omaddan xalos bo‘lish uchun uylarini tozalashadi.)• Each Lunar New Year is associated with one of the twelve zodiac animals.(Har bir Oy yangi yili o‘n ikki burj hayvonlaridan biri bilan bog‘liq bo‘ladi.)
lunar new year.meta: oy taqvimi bo‘yicha yangi yil — oy yoki oy-quyosh (lunisol) taqvimiga asoslangan kalendardagi yilning birinchi kuni yoki bir necha kuni. Bu sana ko‘plab Osiyo mamlakatlarida (xususan, Xitoy, Koreya, Vetnam va boshqalar) bayram sifatida keng nishonlanadi.

syn: here are approximate equivalents in English:youngest member – eng yosh a’zo• The youngest member is loved for her innocence.(Eng yosh a’zo o‘zining beg‘uborligi bilan seviladi.)baby of the group – guruhning kichigisi• He’s known as the baby of the group.(U guruhning kichigisi sifatida tanilgan.)
ex: Every K-pop group has a maknae, and fans love their charm. (Har bir K-pop guruhida eng kichik a’zo bo‘ladi va muxlislar ularning jozibasini yaxshi ko‘rishadi.)

As the maknae, she often gets teased by her older members.(U guruhning eng kichik a’zosi bo‘lgani uchun, katta a’zolar uni ko‘p hazil qilishadi.)• The maknae of the group is known for his energetic personality.(Guruhning kichik a’zosi o‘zining energiyaga to‘la fe’l-atvori bilan tanilgan.)• Although he's the maknae, he’s the most responsible one.(U eng kichik a’zo bo‘lsa ham, eng mas’uliyatli hisoblanadi.)
maknae.meta: maknae — koreys tilida oiladagi yoki biror guruhdagi eng yosh a’zoni bildiradi. Hozirgi kunda bu atama ayniqsa K-pop guruhlari kontekstida keng ishlatiladi va guruhning eng yosh ishtirokchisini ifodalaydi.

syn: male genital cutting – erkak jinsiy a’zosini kesish• Male genital cutting is practiced for various cultural reasons.(Erkak jinsiy a’zosini kesish turli madaniy sabablarga ko‘ra bajariladi.)ritual circumcision – diniy sunnat qilish• Ritual circumcision is performed during special ceremonies in many cultures.(Ko‘plab madaniyatlarda diniy sunnat qilish maxsus marosimlar davomida bajariladi.)
ex: The boy underwent male circumcision at the age of seven. (Bola yetti yoshida sunnat qildirilgan edi.)

Male circumcision is a common practice in many Muslim and Jewish communities.(Erkak sunnat qilish musulmon va yahudiy jamiyatlarida keng tarqalgan amaliyotdir.)• Some studies suggest that male circumcision reduces the risk of certain infections.(Ba’zi tadqiqotlarga ko‘ra, erkak sunnat qilish ayrim infeksiyalar xavfini kamaytiradi.)• Male circumcision is often performed by a medical professional in clinical settings.(Erkak sunnat qilish ko‘pincha klinik sharoitda tibbiyot xodimi tomonidan amalga oshiriladi.)
male circumcision.meta: erkak sunnat qilish — o‘g‘il bola yoki erkak kishining jinsiy a’zosi uchidagi teri (qovuqcha)ni kesib olib tashlash jarayoni. Bu amaliyot ko‘pincha diniy, madaniy yoki tibbiy sabablar tufayli amalga oshiriladi.

syn: lucky cat – omadli mushuk• The lucky cat in the store was waving its paw.(Do‘kondagi omadli mushuk panjasini silkitib turardi.)fortune cat – baxt mushugi• People believe the fortune cat brings in more customers.(Odamlar baxt mushugi ko‘proq mijoz olib keladi
ex: Maneki-neko figurines are popular souvenirs in Japan. (Maneki-neko haykalchalari Yaponiyada mashhur suvenir hisoblanadi.)

The shopkeeper placed a maneki-neko at the entrance for good luck.(Do‘kon egasi omad uchun eshik oldiga maneki-neko qo‘ydi.)• Some maneki-neko statues have their left paw raised, while others raise the right.(Ba’zi maneki-neko haykalchalari chap panjasini, boshqalari esa o‘ng panjasini ko‘targan bo‘ladi.)• A golden maneki-neko is thought to bring wealth and success.(Oltin rangli maneki-neko boylik va muvaffaqiyat olib keladi, deb ishoniladi.)
maneki-neko.meta: maneki-neko — yapon an’anaviy madaniyatida bir panjasini ko‘targan holda o‘tirgan mushuk haykalchasi bo‘lib, u baxt, omad va boylik olib keladi, deb ishoniladi. Odatda do‘konlar, restoranlar yoki ishxonalar eshigi oldida yoki ichkarisida qo‘yiladi.

syn: human waste cleaner – inson najasini tozalovchi• Human waste cleaners need access to safety gear.(Inson najasini tozalovchilar himoya vositalariga ega bo‘lishi kerak.)sewer cleaner (unprotected context) – kanalizatsiya tozalovchisi• In rural areas
sewer cleaners often work in unsafe conditions.(Qishloq joylarda kanalizatsiya tozalovchilari ko‘pincha xavfli sharoitda ishlaydi.)
ex: The government launched a program to rehabilitate former manual scavengers. (Hukumat sobiq qo‘lda axlat tozalovchilarni qayta jamiyatga qo‘shish dasturini ishga tushirdi.)

Manual scavengers often work without proper protective equipment.(Qo‘lda najas tozalovchilar ko‘pincha to‘g‘ri himoya vositalarisiz ishlashadi.)• A manual scavenger risks serious health issues due to exposure to human waste.(Qo‘lda tozalovchi inson najasiga duchor bo‘lishi sababli jiddiy sog‘liq muammolari xavfi ostida bo‘ladi.)• Many manual scavengers come from marginalized communities.(Ko‘plab qo‘lda tozalovchilar ijtimoiy jihatdan chetlatilgan qatlamlardan chiqishadi.)
manual scavenger.meta: qo‘lda axlat tozalovchi — Janubiy Osiyoda, ayniqsa Hindistonda, hojatxonalar, kanalizatsiyalar yoki septik tanklardan qo‘l mehnati bilan tozalanmagan inson najasi yoki chiqindilarini tozalovchi shaxs.

syn: human waste cleaning – inson najasini tozalash• Human waste cleaning without protection is a health hazard.(Himoyasiz inson najasini tozalash salomatlik uchun xavflidir.)unsanitary labor – nosanitariya mehnati• Unsanitary labor often leads to severe health problems.(Nosanitariya mehnati ko‘pincha jiddiy sog‘liq muammolariga olib keladi.)
ex: Activists are calling for a complete end to manual scavenging practices. (Faollar qo‘lda axlat tozalash amaliyotlariga butunlay barham berishni talab qilmoqdalar.)

Manual scavenging remains a serious human rights issue in parts of South Asia.(Qo‘lda najas tozalash Janubiy Osiyoning ba’zi hududlarida jiddiy inson huquqlari muammosi bo‘lib qolmoqda.)• The government introduced strict laws to ban manual scavenging.(Hukumat qo‘lda axlat tozalashni taqiqlash uchun qat’iy qonunlarni joriy qildi.)• Despite the ban, manual scavenging still exists in rural areas.(Taqiqqa qaramay, qishloq joylarda hanuzgacha qo‘lda tozalash mavjud.)
manual scavenging.meta: qo‘lda axlat tozalash — insonlar tomonidan chiqindi yoki najasni bevosita qo‘l mehnati bilan tozalash jarayoni.

syn: gentle suction – yumshoq so‘rib olish• Gentle suction is used during eye surgeries to prevent damage.(Ko‘z jarrohlik amaliyotlari paytida zarar yetkazmaslik uchun yumshoq so‘rib olish ishlatiladi.)vacuum-assisted removal – vakuum yordamida olib tashlash• Vacuum-assisted removal helps in cleaning sensitive areas.(Vakuum yordamida olib tashlash nozik joylarni tozalashga yordam beradi.)
ex: The doctor used microsuction to clear the patient’s ear canal. (Shifokor bemorning quloq kanalini tozalash uchun mikrosўrib olishdan foydalandi.)

Microsuction is a safe and effective method for removing excess earwax.(Mikrosўrib olish – quloqdagi ortiqcha quloq mumini olib tashlash uchun xavfsiz va samarali usuldir.)• Microsuction is often used in medical settings to remove fluid without damaging tissue.(Mikrosўrib olish ko‘pincha tibbiy sharoitda to‘qimalarga zarar yetkazmasdan suyuqlikni olib tashlash uchun qo‘llaniladi.)• Unlike traditional syringing, microsuction is more precise and causes less discomfort.(An’anaviy yuvish usulidan farqli o‘laroq, mikrosўrib olish aniqroq va kamroq noqulaylik tug‘diradi.)
microsuction.meta: mikroso‘rib olish — maxsus mikropipetkalar yoki shunga o‘xshash kichik qurilmalar yordamida suyuqlik yoki boshqa moddalarning juda kichik miqdorini ehtiyotkorlik bilan so‘rib olish jarayoni.

syn: Nigeriyaga oid• Nigerian fashion is influencing global trends.(Nigeriyaliklarning modasi dunyo tendensiyalariga ta’sir ko‘rsatmoqda.)9ja – an alternative spelling of Naija used in text or online
ex: (noun) He’s proud to be a Naija. (U o‘zini Nayja deb atashdan faxrlanadi.)
(adj) Naija music is now popular all over the world.(Nayja musiqasi hozir butun dunyoda mashhur bo‘lmoqda.)
She loves Naija fashion for its vibrant colors.(U Nayja modasini yorqin ranglari uchun yaxshi ko‘radi.)
Naija slang is full of energy and attitude.(Nayja shevasi energiya va xarakterga boy.)
They celebrated in true Naija style—with loud music and dancing.(Ular chinakam Nayjacha uslubda — baland musiqa va raqs bilan nishonlashdi.)
naija.meta: Nigeriya yoki nigeriyaliklarga oid norasmiy so‘z bo‘lib, asosan Nigeriya xalqiga, madaniyatiga, musiqasiga yoki uslubiga nisbatan ishlatiladi. Bu so‘z nigeriyaliklar orasida o‘z milliy iftixorini ifodalovchi, ijobiy ma’noga ega so‘z sifatida qo‘llanadi.

syn: aesthetic neuroscience – estetik neyrofan• Aesthetic neuroscience investigates how we experience art at the neural level.(Estetik neyrofan biz san’atni miya darajasida qanday qabul qilishimizni o‘rganadi.)
ex: She is doing research in neuroaesthetics to understand creative thinking. (U ijodiy fikrlashni tushunish uchun neyroestetika sohasida tadqiqot olib bormoqda.)
Neuroaesthetics explores how the brain responds to beauty and art.(Neyroestetika miya go‘zallik va san’atga qanday munosabat bildirishini o‘rganadi.)
Neuroaesthetics bridges the gap between neuroscience and the arts.(Neyroestetika neyrofan va san’at o‘rtasidagi bog‘liqlikni ta’minlaydi.)

Researchers in neuroaesthetics use brain imaging to study emotional responses to paintings.(Neyroestetika tadqiqotchilari rasmlarga bo‘lgan hissiy javoblarni o‘rganish uchun miya tasvirlash texnologiyalaridan foydalanadi.)
Neuroaesthetics can help explain why certain music gives us chills.(Neyroestetika nega ba’zi musiqalar bizni larzaga solishini tushuntirishga yordam beradi.)
neuroaesthetics.meta: neyroestetika — san’at, go‘zallik va estetik tajribani inson miyasi qanday qabul qilishi va qayta ishlashini o‘rganadigan fan sohasi.

syn: karaoke room – karaoke xonasi• Each karaoke room has its own screen and microphone.(Har bir karaoke xonasida alohida ekran va mikrofon bo‘ladi.)singing booth – kuylash kabinasi• We rented a singing booth for our group.(Biz guruhimiz uchun kuylash kabinasini ijaraga oldik.)
ex: Most noraebangs have thousands of songs in different languages. (Ko‘pchilik noraebanglarda turli tillarda minglab qo‘shiqlar mavjud.)
After dinner, we went to a noraebang to sing for hours.(Kechki ovqatdan so‘ng, biz noraebangga borib soatlab qo‘shiq kuyladik.)
She celebrated her birthday at a local noraebang with friends.(U tug‘ilgan kunini do‘stlari bilan mahalliy noraebangda nishonladi.)
Noraebangs often offer snacks and drinks for guests.(Noraebanglar ko‘pincha mehmonlar uchun yeguliklar va ichimliklar taklif qiladi.)
The noraebang had soundproof walls, so no one outside could hear us.(Noraebangning ovoz o‘tkazmaydigan devorlari bor edi, shuning uchun tashqaridagi hech kim bizni eshitmadi.)
noraebang.meta: noraebang — Janubiy Koreyada keng tarqalgan xususiy karaoke xonasi bo‘lib, odamlar yoki guruhlar bu xonalarni ijaraga olib, o‘z do‘stlari bilan yolg‘iz yoki jamoada qo‘shiq kuylashlari mumkin.

syn: game character – o‘yin qahramoni• This game character is not controlled by the player.(Bu o‘yin qahramoni o‘yinchi tomonidan boshqarilmaydi.)non-controllable figure – boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan qahramon• That non-controllable figure plays a key role in the story.(Bu boshqarib bo‘lmaydigan qahramon syujetda muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)
ex: The game is full of interesting NPCs with unique stories. (O‘yin noyob hikoyalarga ega bo‘lgan qiziqarli NPC'lar bilan to‘la.)
That NPC gave me a quest to find a magic sword.(U NPC menga sehrli qilichni topish topshirig‘ini berdi.)
The NPC at the shop sells potions and armor.(Do‘kondagi NPC ichimliklar va zirhlar sotadi.)
You can’t control NPCs, but they guide the storyline.(Siz NPC'larni boshqara olmaysiz, lekin ular syujetni boshqaradi.)
The villagers are all NPCs programmed to react to your actions.(Qishloq aholisi – bu sizning harakatlaringizga javob berish uchun dasturlashtirilgan NPC'lardir.)
npc.meta: NPC — bu “non-player character” so‘zining qisqartmasi bo‘lib, rolli o‘yinlar va videoo‘yinlarda o‘yinchi tomonidan boshqarilmaydigan qahramonni bildiradi.

syn: travel gift – sayohat sovg‘asi• They gave us travel gifts from their vacation.(Ular bizga ta’tildan sayohat sovg‘alari olib kelishdi.)regional treat – hududiy shirinlik yoki taom• Every town in Japan has its own regional treat as omiyage.(Yaponiyaning har bir shahri o‘ziga xos hududiy taomini omiyage sifatida taklif qiladi.)
ex: Bringing omiyage after a trip is a well-respected tradition in Japan. (Sayohatdan so‘ng omiyage olib kelish Yaponiyada hurmatga sazovor an’anadir.)
I bought local snacks as omiyage for my coworkers.(Men hamkasblarim uchun omiyage sifatida mahalliy gazaklar sotib oldim.)
Tourists often stop at shops to buy omiyage before returning home.(Sayyohlar odatda uyga qaytishdan oldin omiyage olish uchun do‘konlarga kirishadi.)
These handmade fans make great omiyage for relatives.(Bu qo‘l mehnati bilan tayyorlangan yelpig‘ichlar qarindoshlar uchun ajoyib omiyage bo‘ladi.)
He felt embarrassed when he forgot to bring omiyage to the host family.(U mehmon qilgan oilaga omiyage olib kelishni unutib qo‘yganidan uyaldi.)
omiyage.meta: omiyage — yapon madaniyatida sayohatdan qaytgan yoki tashrif buyurgan shaxs tomonidan do‘stlar yoki qarindoshlarga olib kelinadigan sovg‘a. Bu sovg‘alar ko‘pincha o‘sha hududga xos shirinliklar, hunarmandchilik buyumlari yoki boshqa esdaliklar bo‘ladi.

syn: omelet rice – omletli guruch• Omelet rice is another name for omurice.(Omletli guruch — bu omuraysning boshqa nomi.)
ex: Omurice is popular among kids because of its soft texture and sweet ketchup topping. (Omurays yumshoq tuzilmasi va shirin ketchup bilan bezatilgani uchun bolalar orasida mashhur.)
I ordered omurice for lunch at the Japanese café.(Yapon kafeida tushlik uchun omurays buyurdim.)
She cooked omurice for her family using leftover rice.(U ortiqcha guruchdan foydalangan holda oilasi uchun omurays pishirdi.)
The chef decorated the omurice with a smiley face in ketchup.(Oshpaz omurays ustini ketchup bilan kulgich shaklida bezadi.)
Omurice is a staple of Japanese yoshoku (Western-style Japanese cuisine).(Omurays Yaponiyadagi yoshoku (G‘arb uslubidagi yapon taomlari)ning ajralmas qismidir.)
omurice.meta: omurays — yapon oshxonasiga oid taom bo‘lib, qiyma go‘sht (odatda tovuq), sabzavot va qovurilgan guruchdan tayyorlanadi. U yupqa omletga o‘raladi va ustiga ketchup yoki boshqa sous bilan bezatiladi.

syn: single-attempt – bir urinishda• A single-attempt reaction shows rapid memory formation.(Bir urinishdagi reaksiya tez xotira shakllanishini ko‘rsatadi.)instantaneous – darhol yuzaga keladigan• It was an almost instantaneous fear response.(Bu deyarli darhol yuzaga kelgan qo‘rquv reaksiyasi edi.)
ex: One-trial conditioning is common in fear-based responses. (Qo‘rquvga asoslangan reaksiyalarda bir martalik tajriba asosidagi shartlanish ko‘p uchraydi.)
The rat exhibited one-trial learning after receiving a shock near the lever.(Kalit yaqinida zarba olgach, kalamush bir urinishda shakllangan o‘rganishni namoyon etdi.)
One-trial learning can have lasting effects in trauma-related situations.(Bir martalik tajriba asosidagi o‘rganish travma bilan bog‘liq holatlarda uzoq ta’sirga ega bo‘lishi mumkin.)
The dog developed a one-trial aversion to the new food.(It yangi ovqatga nisbatan bir martalik tajriba asosida nafrat hosil qildi.)
Children may develop one-trial phobias after frightening incidents.(Bolalar qo‘rqinchli voqealardan so‘ng bir martalik tajriba asosidagi fobiyalarni rivojlantirishi mumkin.)
one-trial.meta: bir martalik tajriba asosidagi — bu atama birgina tajriba yoki stimul asosida yuzaga keladigan o‘rganish yoki xatti-harakat shaklini bildiradi.
