syn: bony protuberance – suyakdan hosil bo‘lgan o‘sma• The giraffe’s bony protuberance helps in dominance battles.(Jirafanining suyakdan hosil bo‘lgan o‘smalari ustunlik janglarida yordam beradi.)
ex: The ossicones of young giraffes are not yet fused to the skull. (Yosh jirafalarning ossikonlari hali bosh suyagiga birikmagan bo‘ladi.)
Giraffes use their ossicones during fights by swinging their necks.(Jirafalar jang paytida bo‘ynini siltab ossikonlaridan foydalanadi.)
Male giraffes have thicker ossicones than females.(Erkak jirafalarning ossikonlari urg‘ochilarinikiga qaraganda qalinroq bo‘ladi.)
The ossicones help with thermoregulation and combat.(Ossikonlar issiqlikni tartibga solish va jangda yordam beradi.)
Okapis also have small ossicones, though they are less noticeable.(Okapilarda ham kichik ossikonlar bo‘ladi, lekin ular kamroq seziladi.)
ossicone.meta: ossikon — jirafalar, erkak okapilar va ayrim boshqa hayvonlarning boshining yuqori qismida joylashgan, suyakdan hosil bo‘lgan shoxsimon o‘sma. Bu o‘sma odatda ikki dona bo‘ladi va qon tomirlari bilan to‘yingan teri bilan qoplangan bo‘ladi.

syn: musical narrative – musiqali hikoya• Pansori is a unique form of musical narrative in Korean culture.(Pansori Korey madaniyatidagi noyob musiqali hikoya shaklidir.)
ex: Pansori performances require years of vocal and dramatic training. (Pansori ijrolari uchun yillar davomida ovoz va dramatik tayyorgarlik talab qilinadi.)
The pansori singer captivated the audience with her powerful voice and emotion.(Pansori xonandasi kuchli ovozi va hissiyotlari bilan tomoshabinlarni o‘ziga rom etdi.)
Pansori is recognized by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage.(Pansori YuNESKO tomonidan nomoddiy madaniy meros sifatida tan olingan.)
In pansori, the singer often improvises based on the audience’s reaction.(Pansorida xonanda ko‘pincha tomoshabinlarning reaksiyasiga qarab improvizatsiya qiladi.)
Traditional pansori performances can last for several hours.(An’anaviy pansori chiqishlari bir necha soat davom etishi mumkin.)
pansori.meta: pansori — bu Koreyaning an’anaviy musiqiy hikoya aytish san’ati bo‘lib, bitta xonanda tomonidan baraban chaluvchi musiqachi (gosu) hamrohligida ijro etiladi. Xonanda hikoya qiladi, kuylaydi, ba’zida sahnaviy harakatlar bilan obraz yaratadi.

syn: personal project – shaxsiy loyiha• He spends his evenings on a personal project about local history.(U kechqurunlarini mahalliy tarixga oid shaxsiy loyihasida o‘tkazadi.)creative pursuit – ijodiy mashg‘ulot• Painting became her favorite creative pursuit after retirement.(Nafaqaga chiqqach
rasm chizish uning eng sevimli ijodiy mashg‘ulotiga aylandi.)
ex: His passion project combines photography and environmental activism. (Uning shaxsiy ishtiyoq loyihasi fotografiya va ekologik faollikni birlashtiradi.)
Writing her novel started as a passion project, not a commercial venture.(Roman yozish uning uchun tijorat loyihasi emas, balki shaxsiy ishtiyoq loyihasi sifatida boshlandi.)
He worked nights and weekends on his passion project.(U o‘zining shaxsiy ishtiyoq loyihasida tunu kun va dam olish kunlari ishladi.)
Launching the charity was her lifelong passion project.(Xayriya jamg‘armasini yo‘lga qo‘yish uning umrboqiy orzusiga aylangan loyihasi edi.)
This small bakery started as a passion project between two friends.(Bu kichik nonvoyxona ikki do‘stning shaxsiy ishtiyoq loyihasi sifatida boshlangan.)
passion project.meta: shaxsiy ishtiyoq loyihasi — bu moliyaviy foydadan ko‘ra ko‘proq ichki qoniqish, shaxsiy zavq yoki qiziqish uchun amalga oshiriladigan loyiha yoki faoliyat.

syn: around childbirth – tug‘ruq atrofida• Health risks increase around childbirth.(Tug‘ruq atrofida sog‘liq xavflari ortadi.)maternal period-related – ona bilan bog‘liq davrga oid• Maternal period-related care is essential for both lives.(Ona bilan bog‘liq davrdagi parvarish har ikki hayot uchun muhim.)
ex: (adv): The condition developed peripartum and required close monitoring. (Bu holat tug‘ruq davrida yuzaga keldi va doimiy kuzatuvni talab qildi.)
(adj): She was diagnosed with peripartum depression.(Uga tug‘ruq davriga oid depressiya tashxisi qo‘yildi.)
Peripartum complications can affect both the mother and the baby.(Tug‘ruq davridagi asoratlar ona va bolaga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.)
The hospital has a special unit for peripartum care.(Shifoxonada tug‘ruq davridagi parvarish uchun maxsus bo‘lim mavjud.)
He studied peripartum psychological disorders during his residency.(U o‘z rezidenturasi davomida tug‘ruq davridagi ruhiy buzilishlarni o‘rgandi.)
peripartum.meta: tibbiyotda ishlatiladigan atama bo‘lib, tug‘ruqdan oldingi va keyingi qisqa vaqt oralig‘iga oid holatlarni bildiradi. Bu atama ona yoki bolaning sog‘lig‘i, ruhiy holati yoki tibbiy muolajalari bilan bog‘liq bo‘lgan holatlarni tavsiflashda ishlatiladi.

syn: religious academic hall – diniy akademik maskan• She lived in a religious academic hall during her theology studies.(U ilohiyot tahsili davomida diniy akademik maskanda yashagan.)private theological institution – xususiy ilohiyot muassasasi• Many priests train at private theological institutions.(Ko‘plab ruhoniylar xususiy ilohiyot muassasalarida tayyorlanadi.)
ex: Permanent private halls are affiliated with the University but often have a religious foundation. (Doimiy xususiy zallar universitetga aloqador bo‘lsa-da, ko‘pincha diniy asosga ega bo‘ladi.)
He studied theology at a permanent private hall in Oxford.(U Oksforddagi doimiy xususiy zalda ilohiyot bo‘yicha tahsil olgan.)
Oxford has several permanent private halls offering theological studies.(Oksfordda ilohiyot bo‘yicha tahsil beradigan bir nechta doimiy xususiy zallar mavjud.)
Most permanent private halls have smaller student communities.(Ko‘pchilik doimiy xususiy zallarda talabalarning soni kam bo‘ladi.)
He preferred a permanent private hall for its religious atmosphere.(U diniy muhit tufayli doimiy xususiy zalni afzal ko‘rdi.)
permanent private hall.meta: doimiy xususiy zal — Oksford universiteti tizimidagi ta’lim muassasasi bo‘lib, odatda muayyan nasroniy konfessiyasi tomonidan diniy xizmat uchun talabalarni tayyorlash maqsadida tashkil etilgan.

syn: clinical assistant – klinik yordamchi• The clinical assistant helped take the patient's history.(Klinik yordamchi bemorning tarixini yozib oldi.)medical support professional – tibbiy yordam mutaxassisi• Medical support professionals are vital in delivering patient care.(Tibbiy yordam mutaxassislari bemor parvarishida juda muhim hisoblanadi.)
ex: Physician associates are trained to perform many clinical tasks independently. (Shifokor yordamchilari ko‘plab klinik vazifalarni mustaqil bajarish uchun tayyorgarlikdan o‘tgan.)
The physician associate examined the patient before the doctor arrived.(Shifokor yordamchisi vrach yetib kelishidan oldin bemorni ko‘zdan kechirdi.)
The hospital hired three new physician associates last month.(Shifoxona o‘tgan oyda uchta yangi shifokor yordamchisini ishga oldi.)
A physician associate can prescribe medication in some countries.(Ba’zi mamlakatlarda shifokor yordamchilari dorilarni yozib bera oladi.)
Patients often see a physician associate for follow-up appointments.(Bemorlar ko‘pincha nazorat ko‘rigi uchun shifokor yordamchisiga murojaat qiladilar.)
physician associate.meta: shifokor yordamchisi — bu maxsus tibbiy tayyorgarlikka ega bo‘lgan va shifokor rahbarligida oddiy yoki rejalashtirilgan tibbiy xizmatlarni ko‘rsatadigan mutaxassis.

syn: avatar – avatar• Choose your avatar before entering the game.(O‘yinga kirishdan oldin avatarni tanlang.)hero – qahramon• The hero gains strength as the game progresses.(O‘yinda davom etar ekan
ex: The player character decided to help the villagers instead of attacking them. (O‘yinchi qahramoni aholini hujum qilish o‘rniga ularga yordam berishga qaror qildi.)
In this game, each player controls one player character with unique abilities.(Ushbu o‘yinda har bir o‘yinchi o‘ziga xos qobiliyatga ega bitta o‘yinchi qahramonini boshqaradi.)
You can customize your player character’s appearance and skills.(Siz o‘yinchi qahramoningizning tashqi ko‘rinishi va ko‘nikmalarini sozlashingiz mumkin.)
The player character levels up by gaining experience points.(O‘yinchi qahramoni tajriba ballari orqali darajasini oshiradi.)
During the cutscene, only the player character is shown interacting with the enemy.(O‘yin kadrida faqat o‘yinchi qahramoni dushman bilan muloqotda bo‘ladi.)
player character.meta: o‘yinchi qahramoni — bu rolli o‘yinlarda (RPG – role-playing games) o‘yinchi tomonidan tanlanadigan yoki yaratiladigan xayoliy personaj bo‘lib, o‘yinchi uning roliga kiradi, uning nomidan qarorlar qabul qiladi va harakatlarini boshqaradi.

syn: Zounds! – Xudo haqqi!• Zounds! You startled me!(Xudo haqqi! Meni cho‘chitib yubording!)By heaven! – Olloh haqqi!• By heaven
ex: He cried out, “Plutteranails! What treachery is this?” (U baqirib yubordi: “Xudo haqqi! Bu qanday xiyonat?”)
“By plutteranails, I’ll not let this insult pass!”(Jonim haqqi, bu haqoratni kechirmayman!)
Plutteranails! You dare challenge me in my own house?(Xudo haqqi! Mening uyimda menga qarshi chiqyapsanmi?)
“Plutteranails,” muttered the old knight, “these are strange times indeed.”(“Xudo haqqi,” deb ming‘irladi qari ritsar, “rostdan ham g‘alati zamonlar ekan.”)
plutteranails.meta: bu qasam yoki keskin ta’kid shaklida ishlatiladigan so‘z bo‘lib, “blood and nails” iborasining uelshcha talaffuziga mos buzilgan shaklidir. Ingliz tili tarixida asosan diniy ohangdagi qasamlar yoki hayrat ifodalarida uchragan.

syn: Bronchiolitis obliterans – kichik bronxlar yallig‘lanishi• Bronchiolitis obliterans is the medical term for popcorn lung.(Bronxiolit obliterans — bu popkorn o‘pkasining tibbiy atamasi.)
ex: Popcorn lung can cause permanent damage to the airways. (Popkorn o‘pkasi havo yo‘llariga doimiy zarar yetkazishi mumkin.)

Several factory workers were diagnosed with popcorn lung after years of exposure to diacetyl.(Bir nechta zavod ishchilarida yillar davomida diatsetilga ta’sirlangandan so‘ng popkorn o‘pkasi aniqlangan.)
E-cigarette use has raised concerns about the risk of popcorn lung.(Elektron sigaretalar popkorn o‘pkasi xavfi borasida xavotir uyg‘otmoqda.)
There is no cure for popcorn lung, but symptoms can be managed.(Popkorn o‘pkasining davosi yo‘q, ammo alomatlarini boshqarish mumkin.)
Popcorn lung got its name after workers in a microwave popcorn plant developed the illness.(Popkorn o‘pkasi nomi mikroto‘lqinli popkorn zavodi ishchilarida bu kasallik aniqlangani sababli berilgan.)
popcorn lung.meta: popkorn o‘pkasi — bu “bronchiolitis obliterans” nomli kamyob, ammo jiddiy surunkali o‘pka kasalligining norasmiy atamasidir. U kichik bronxiolalarning yallig‘lanishi va shikastlanishi bilan kechadi, natijada o‘pka havoni to‘g‘ri o‘tkaza olmay qoladi.

syn: Miscarriage – tushish• She had a miscarriage at 10 weeks.(U 10 haftaligida tushib qoldi.)Fetal loss – homilaning nobud bo‘lishi• Fetal loss can occur at any stage of pregnancy.(Homila har qanday homiladorlik bosqichida nobud bo‘lishi mumkin.)
ex: Doctors are studying the causes of early pregnancy loss. (Shifokorlar erta homiladorlik yo‘qolishining sabablarini o‘rganmoqdalar.)
She experienced a pregnancy loss in her first trimester.(U birinchi trimestrda homiladorlik yo‘qolishini boshidan kechirdi.)
The hospital offers counseling services for women after pregnancy loss.(Kasalxona homiladorlik yo‘qolishidan keyingi ayollar uchun psixologik yordam xizmatlarini taklif qiladi.)
Stress and age can increase the risk of pregnancy loss.(Stress va yosh homiladorlik yo‘qolishi xavfini oshirishi mumkin.)
Pregnancy loss is a deeply emotional experience for many women.(Ko‘plab ayollar uchun homiladorlik yo‘qolishi juda og‘riqli ruhiy tajriba hisoblanadi.)
pregnancy loss.meta: homiladorlik yo‘qolishi — bu homiladorlikning tirik chaqaloq tug‘ilishi bilan yakunlanmasligi holati. Bunga embrion yoki homilaning homiladorlik davrida yoki ba’zida tug‘ruq vaqtida nobud bo‘lishi sabab bo‘ladi.

syn: deflate (xamirni gazdan tozalamoq)• She deflated the dough gently after the first rise.(Birinchi ko‘tarilishdan so‘ng u xamirni ehtiyotkorlik bilan bosib tushirdi.)
ex: The punch-down step helps redistribute the yeast and sugar. (Xamirni bosib tushirish bosqichi xamirturush va shakarning qayta taqsimlanishiga yordam beradi.)
After the dough had risen for an hour, she gave it a quick punch-down.(Xamir bir soat ko‘tarilgandan so‘ng, u uni tezda mushtlab bosib tushirdi.)
You should do a punch-down after the first rise to improve texture.(Birinchi ko‘tarilishdan keyin xamirni bosib tushirish kerak, bu tuzilmani yaxshilaydi.)
Don't skip the punch-down or your bread may be too airy.(Xamirni bosib tushirishni o‘tkazib yubormang, aks holda noningiz haddan tashqari yengil bo‘lishi mumkin.)
The punch-down also strengthens gluten development.(Xamirni bosib tushirish glyutinning rivojlanishini ham kuchaytiradi.)
punch-down.meta: xamirni bosib tushirish — bu oshgan xamirni (odatda non yoki boshqa xamirturushli mahsulotlar uchun) gazini chiqarish maqsadida mushtlab yoki qo‘l bilan bosib, qayta ishlash jarayoni.

syn: octave key – oktava kaliti• He used the octave key to play a higher note.(U yuqori notani chalish uchun oktava kalitidan foydalandi.)
ex: Using the register key changes the pitch to a higher octave. (Rejister kalitidan foydalanish ohangni yuqori oktavaga o‘zgartiradi.)
The saxophone player pressed the register key to reach a higher note.(Saksofonchi yuqoriroq notani chalish uchun rejister kalitini bosdi.)
You need to press the register key while fingering the note C to reach its octave.(Notaning oktavasiga chiqish uchun C notasi bosilgan paytda rejister kalitini bosish kerak.)
Beginners often struggle with when to use the register key properly.(Yangi boshlovchilar ko‘pincha rejister kalitidan qachon to‘g‘ri foydalanishni tushunmaydi.)
The register key is crucial for smooth transitions between low and high notes.(Rejister kaliti past va baland notalar o‘rtasidagi silliq o‘tish uchun juda muhim.)
register key.meta: Nafasli musiqa asboblarida (masalan, qayta-qayta chaladigan asboblarda) qo‘llaniladigan kalit bo‘lib, u mavjud barmoq bosilgan notadan yuqori oktavada (rejisterda) tovush chiqarishga xizmat qiladi.

syn: net-patterned giraffe – to‘rli naqshli jirafapolygon-spotted giraffe – ko‘pburchakli dog‘li jirafa
ex: Reticulated giraffes are native to Kenya and the Horn of Africa. (To‘riqonli jirafalar Keniyada va Afrika Shoxida yashaydi.)
The reticulated giraffe is known for its distinctive polygonal coat pattern.(To‘riqonli jirafa o‘zining o‘ziga xos ko‘pburchak shaklidagi teri naqshlari bilan mashhur.)
We saw a reticulated giraffe in the Samburu National Reserve.(Biz Samburu milliy qo‘riqxonasida to‘riqonli jirafa ko‘rdik.)
Reticulated giraffes are taller than many other land animals.(To‘riqonli jirafalar boshqa ko‘pgina quruqlik hayvonlaridan balandroq bo‘ladi.)
The unique coat of the reticulated giraffe helps it blend into its surroundings.(To‘riqonli jirafaning o‘ziga xos terisi unga atrof-muhit bilan uyg‘unlashishga yordam beradi.)
reticulated giraffe.meta: Keniya va Afrika Shoxida yashovchi jirafa turi bo‘lib, tanasi katta, qizil-jigarrang ko‘pburchak shaklidagi dog‘lar bilan qoplangan va ularning orasida tor oq chiziqlar bo‘ladi.

syn: Japanese sandwich – yaponcha sendvichfilled white bread – to‘ldirilgan oq non
ex: Egg salad sando is a common choice in Japanese cafes. (Tuxum salatli sando Yapon kafelarida keng tarqalgan tanlov hisoblanadi.)
Sando is a popular Japanese sandwich enjoyed as a snack or light meal.(Sando — yaponcha mashhur sendvich bo‘lib, yengil ovqat yoki gazak sifatida iste’mol qilinadi.)
She packed a fruit sando in her lunchbox.(U tushlik qutisiga mevali sando solib oldi.)
The pork katsu sando is crispy and flavorful.(Cho‘chqa katsu sendvichi tiniq va mazali bo‘ladi.)
Many convenience stores in Japan sell pre-made sandos.(Yaponiyadagi ko‘plab do‘konlarda tayyor sando sendvichlari sotiladi.)
sando.meta: Yaponiyaga xos sendvich turi bo‘lib, ikkita qobiqsiz, yumshoq oq non bo‘lagi orasiga turli xil sho‘r yoki shirin to‘ldirishlar solinadi. Masalan, cho'chqa katsu, tuxum salatasi yoki boshqa mahsulotlar.

syn: starter culture – boshlang‘ich madaniyat• You need a starter culture to ferment the tea.(Choyni fermentatsiya qilish uchun boshlang‘ich madaniyat kerak.)
ex: A healthy SCOBY looks like a gelatinous pancake floating on the liquid. (Sog‘lom SCOBY suyuqlik ustida suzuvchi jele shaklidagi krepga o‘xshaydi.)
The SCOBY is essential for brewing kombucha tea.(Kombucha choyini tayyorlashda SCOBY juda muhim hisoblanadi.)
You need to keep the SCOBY at room temperature during fermentation.(Fermentatsiya vaqtida SCOBYni xona haroratida saqlash kerak.)
She gave me a SCOBY to start my own kombucha batch.(U menga o‘z kombuchamni tayyorlash uchun SCOBY berdi.)
The growth of the SCOBY depends on the sugar and tea mixture.(SCOBYning o‘sishi shakar va choy aralashmasiga bog‘liq.)
scoby.meta: Asosan kombucha tayyorlashda fermentatsiyani boshlash uchun ishlatiladigan, bakteriya va xamirturushlarning simbiotik (o‘zaro foydali) madaniyati. Suv ustida suzuvchi jelatinli qatlam hosil qiladi.

syn: • one-time – bir martalik• immediate – darhol yuz beradigan• The behavior changed after a one-time experience.(Xatti-harakat bir martalik tajribadan so‘ng o‘zgardi.)• It was an immediate response to the shock.(Bu zarbaga nisbatan darhol javob edi.)
ex: The experiment demonstrated single-trial conditioning in animals. (Tajriba hayvonlarda bir martalik tajriba asosidagi shartlanuvchanlikni ko‘rsatdi.)
Single-trial learning occurs after just one exposure to a stimulus.(Bir martalik o‘rganish faqat bir marta ta’sir etgan stimulyatsiyadan so‘ng sodir bo‘ladi.)
In some cases, a phobia can develop through single-trial learning.(Ba’zi hollarda, fobiya bir martalik o‘rganish orqali rivojlanishi mumkin.)
The rat avoided the food after a single-trial taste aversion experience.(Kalampirni yeb ko‘rganidan so‘ng kalamush bir martalik ta’mdan voz kechdi.)
Single-trial memory formation has been observed in neuroscience studies.(Bir martalik xotira shakllanishi neyrofan tadqiqotlarida kuzatilgan.)
single-trial.meta: Faqat bitta tajriba yoki stimulyatsiya natijasida yuzaga kelgan o‘rganish turi, xulq-atvor shakli yoki shunga oid holat.

syn: • decisive match – hal qiluvchi o‘yin• head-to-head clash – to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri raqobat o‘yini• The match was a decisive match for both teams.(Bu o‘yin har ikki jamoa uchun hal qiluvchi edi.)• The head-to-head clash will shape the final standings.(To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri raqobat o‘yini yakuniy jadvalga ta’sir ko‘rsatadi.)
ex: Fans are excited for the six-pointer game this weekend. (Muxlislar bu hafta oxiridagi olti ballik o‘yin uchun hayajonda.)
The upcoming match between the top two teams is a real six-pointer.(Eng yuqori ikkita jamoa o‘rtasidagi yaqinlashayotgan o‘yin haqiqiy olti ballik o‘yindir.)
Relegation rivals will face off in a tense six-pointer.(Chekinish xavfi ostidagi raqiblar keskin olti ballik o‘yinda to‘qnash kelishadi.)
It’s more than just a game—it’s a six-pointer that could decide the season.(Bu shunchaki o‘yin emas — bu butun mavsum taqdirini hal qiladigan olti ballik o‘yin.)
Coaches call it a six-pointer because the stakes are double.(Murabbiylar buni olti ballik o‘yin deb atashadi, chunki yutuq ikki baravar ahamiyatga ega.)
six-pointer.meta: Asosan futbol (soccer) terminologiyasida ishlatiladigan atama. Liga jadvalida o‘zaro yaqin pozitsiyada turgan ikki jamoa o‘rtasidagi o‘yinni bildiradi, bunda g‘alaba ayniqsa muhim hisoblanadi, chunki bu nafaqat o‘z jamoangizga 3 ochko beradi

syn: • activist – faol• rights defender – huquq himoyachisi• campaigner – kampaniya yurituvchi• She is a passionate activist for women's rights.(U ayollar huquqlari uchun jon kuydiruvchi faol.)
ex: Some people use the term social justice warrior sarcastically. (Ba’zi odamlar “ijtimoiy adolat uchun kurashuvchi” iborasini kinoya bilan ishlatishadi.)
She is known as a social justice warrior fighting against inequality.(U tengsizlikka qarshi kurashayotgan ijtimoiy adolat himoyachisi sifatida tanilgan.)
Social justice warriors often advocate for gender, racial, or environmental issues.(Ijtimoiy adolat himoyachilari ko‘pincha gender, irqiy yoki ekologik masalalar tarafdori bo‘lishadi.)
The phrase “social justice warrior” is sometimes used to mock activism.(“Ijtimoiy adolat uchun kurashuvchi” iborasi ba’zida faollikni masxara qilish uchun ishlatiladi.)
Despite criticism, many social justice warriors bring attention to real issues.(Tanqidlarga qaramay, ko‘plab ijtimoiy adolat himoyachilari muhim muammolarga e’tibor qaratishadi.)
social justice warrior.meta: Ijtimoiy adolatsizlikka qarshi turuvchi yoki kamsitishlarga duchor bo‘lganlarning huquqlarini himoya qiluvchi shaxs. Hozirgi kunda ko‘pincha bu atama kamroq hurmat bilan, tanqidiy yoki kinoyali ma’noda ishlatiladi.

syn: • voluntary nervous system – ixtiyoriy asab tizimi• motor-sensory system – harakat va sezgi tizimi• The somatic nervous system
also called the voluntary nervous system
ex: Sensory information from the skin is processed by the somatic nervous system. (Teri orqali kelgan sezgi ma’lumotlari somatik asab tizimi tomonidan qayta ishlanadi.)
The somatic nervous system controls voluntary muscle movements.(Somatik asab tizimi ixtiyoriy mushak harakatlarini boshqaradi.)
Damage to the somatic nervous system can impair limb function.(Somatik asab tizimidagi shikastlanish oyoq-qo‘llar harakatiga ta’sir qilishi mumkin.)
Through the somatic nervous system, we can consciously move our arms or legs.(Somatik asab tizimi orqali biz qo‘l yoki oyoqlarimizni ongli ravishda harakatlantira olamiz.)
The somatic nervous system works in contrast to the autonomic nervous system.(Somatik asab tizimi avtonom asab tizimidan farq qiladi.)
somatic nervous system.meta: Periferik asab tizimining bir bo‘lagi bo‘lib, skelet mushaklariga va ma’lum sezgi organlariga xizmat qiluvchi asablardan iborat. Bu tizim ixtiyoriy harakatlarni boshqaradi va ichki organlarni boshqaruvchi avtonom tizimdan farq qiladi.

syn: • sound healing – tovush orqali davolash• vibrational therapy – tebranish terapiyasi• acoustic meditation – akustik meditatsiya• Sound baths are a form of sound healing used in alternative medicine.(Ovoz vannalari muqobil tibbiyotda tovush orqali davolash shakli sifatida ishlatiladi.)
ex: She attended a sound bath session to relax and meditate. (U dam olish va meditatsiya qilish uchun ovoz vannasi mashg‘ulotiga qatnashdi.)
Sound baths use instruments like singing bowls and gongs.(Ovoz vannalarida kuylovchi kosalar va gong kabi asboblar ishlatiladi.)
He felt calmer after participating in a 30-minute sound bath.(U 30 daqiqalik ovoz vannasidan so‘ng o‘zini tinchroq his qildi.)
The sound bath helped clear her mind and reduce anxiety.(Ovoz vannasi uning ongini tozalashga va bezovtalikni kamaytirishga yordam berdi.)
During the sound bath, the room was filled with soothing vibrations.(Ovoz vannasi paytida xona xotirjam tebranishlar bilan to‘lgan edi.)
sound bath.meta: O‘zini atrofini tovushlar bilan o‘rab olish yoki tovushlar ichida bo‘lish jarayoni, ayniqsa meditatsiya yoki terapevtik mashq sifatida amalga oshiriladi; shuningdek, bunday jarayonda ishlatiladigan tovushlar majmuasi.

syn: • sprechgesang – gapiruvga o‘xshab kuylamoq• deliver in spoken rhythm – ritm bilan gapirib aytmoq• She chose to speak-sing rather than fully sing the song.(U qo‘shiqni to‘liq kuylash o‘rniga gapirib kuylashni tanladi.)
ex: The performer speak-sang the lyrics with great emotion. (Ijrochi qo‘shiq so‘zlarini katta hissiyot bilan gapirib kuyladi.)
She learned how to speak-sing her part for the musical.(U musiqali spektakl uchun o‘z rolini gapirib kuylashni o‘rgandi.)
He speak-sings the introduction in every show.(U har bir ko‘rsatuvda kirish qismini gapirib kuylaydi.)
The actor speak-sang the dialogue instead of fully singing it.(Aktyor dialogni to‘liq kuylash o‘rniga gapirib kuyladi.)
Children enjoy speak-singing in story-based songs.(Bolalar hikoyali qo‘shiqlarda gapirib kuylashni yoqtirishadi.)
speak-sing.meta: Gapirish va kuylash orasidagi uslubda, ya’ni so‘zlab-kuylash tarzida biror qo‘shiq yoki matnni ovoz chiqarish. Fe’l sifatida ham mustaqil, ham maqsadli harakatni bildiradi.

syn: • sprechgesang – gapiruvga o‘xshash kuylash uslubi• sprechstimme – gapiruvchi ovoz texnikasi• Sprechgesang is often used in avant-garde music similar to speak-singing.(Sprechgesang ilg‘or musiqa janrlarida speak-singing uslubiga o‘xshab ishlatiladi.)
ex: The singer’s speak-singing added intensity to the performance. (Qo‘shiqchining gapirib kuylash uslubi chiqishiga kuch bag‘ishladi.)
Speak-singing is often used in musical theater to convey emotions.(Musical teatrlarda hissiyotlarni ifodalash uchun ko‘pincha gapirib kuylash uslubidan foydalaniladi.)
Her speak-singing voice fit the character perfectly.(Uning gapirib kuylagan ovozi obrazga juda mos tushdi.)
The composer preferred speak-singing for the dramatic scenes.(Bastakor dramatik sahnalar uchun gapirib kuylashni afzal ko‘rdi.)
He used speak-singing to tell the story through music.(U hikoyani musiqa orqali aytib berish uchun gapirib kuylash uslubidan foydalandi.)
speak-singing.meta: Gapirish va kuylash orasidagi dramatik vokal uslub. Bu uslubda so‘zlar kuylangan kabi, lekin to‘liq kuylashdan ko‘ra ko‘proq nutqga yaqin bo‘ladi. Sprechgesang ga o‘xshash.

syn: • pronounceability – talaffuz qilish imkoniyati• articulateness – aniq gapira olish• The pronounceability of the word helped it gain global use.(So‘zning talaffuz qilish qulayligi uni butun dunyoda qo‘llanilishiga yordam berdi.)
ex: Some words have greater speakability than others in daily conversation. (Ba’zi so‘zlarni kundalik suhbatda aytish boshqalariga qaraganda osonroq.)
The speakability of the brand name helped it become popular.(Brend nomining oson talaffuz qilinishi uni mashhur bo‘lishiga yordam berdi.)
Designers consider the speakability of new product names.(Dizaynerlar yangi mahsulot nomlarini tanlashda ularning so‘zlanish qulayligini hisobga olishadi.)
Speakability matters in naming websites and companies.(Sayt va kompaniya nomlarida so‘zlanish qulayligi muhim hisoblanadi.)
High speakability improves memorability and marketing success.(Yaxshi so‘zlanish qulayligi eslab qolinishni va marketing muvaffaqiyatini oshiradi.)
speakability.meta: Biror so‘z yoki ifodaning oson, ravon va aniq talaffuz qilinishi yoki samarali tarzda gapirilishi qobiliyati.

syn: • addressee – murojaat qilinayotgan shaxs• listener – tinglovchi• The addressee (speakee) showed interest in the topic.(Murojaat qilinayotgan shaxs mavzuga qiziqish bildirdi.)
ex: In a conversation, the speakee plays an important role. (Suhbatda gapirilayotgan kishi muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)
The speaker directed his message to the speakee carefully.(Gapiruvchi o‘z xabarini gapirish oluvchisiga ehtiyotkorlik bilan yo‘naltirdi.)
The speakee didn’t respond immediately to the question.(Gapirilayotgan kishi savolga darhol javob bermadi.)
Good communication depends on the interaction between the speaker and the speakee.(Yaxshi muloqot gapiruvchi va tinglovchi o‘rtasidagi o‘zaro aloqaga bog‘liq.)
The speakee must also interpret the tone and context.(Gapirilayotgan kishi ham ohang va kontekstni tushunishi kerak.)
speakee.meta: Gapiruvchi tomonidan so‘z qilingan, gapirilayotgan shaxs yoki tinglovchi.

syn: • power density – quvvat zichligi• power-to-weight ratio – quvvat va og‘irlik nisbati• A battery with high power density also has high specific power.(Yuqori quvvat zichligiga ega batareya
ex: High specific power indicates a very efficient energy source. (Yuqori maxsus quvvat juda samarali energiya manbaini anglatadi.)
The engine’s specific power is measured in kilowatts per kilogram.(Dvigatelning maxsus quvvati har kilogrammga kilovattlarda o‘lchanadi.)
Batteries with higher specific power can deliver more energy for the same weight.(Yuqori maxsus quvvatga ega batareyalar bir xil og‘irlikda ko‘proq energiya bera oladi.)
Engineers compare motors based on their specific power ratings.(Muhandislar motorlarni ularning maxsus quvvat ko‘rsatkichlari asosida solishtiradilar.)
Specific power is a crucial factor in designing electric vehicles.(Maxsus quvvat elektr transport vositalarini loyihalashda muhim omildir.)
specific power.meta: Dvigatel, batareya va boshqa texnik qurilmalarning ish samaradorligi yoki quvvati, uning quvvat yoki kuch qiymatining og‘irlik, hajm yoki boshqa o‘lchov birligiga nisbati orqali ifodalanadi.

syn: • Dutch syrup waffle – golland siropli vafli• caramel waffle – karamelli vafli• A stroopwafel is sometimes called a Dutch syrup waffle.(Stroopvafelni ba’zida Golland siropli vaflisi deb ham atashadi.)
ex: I enjoyed a warm stroopwafel with my coffee. (Men qahvam bilan iliq stroopvafel yedim.)
Stroopwafel is a popular Dutch sweet snack.(Stroopvafel — Gollandiyada mashhur shirin tamaddi.)
You can place the stroopwafel on top of your cup to soften it.(Stroopvafelingizni yumshatish uchun uni stakanning ustiga qo‘yishingiz mumkin.)
The caramel inside the stroopwafel melts perfectly when warm.(Stroopvafeling ichidagi karamel iliq holatda mukammal eriydi.)
Many tourists buy stroopwafels as souvenirs from the Netherlands.(Ko‘plab sayyohlar Gollandiyadan stroopvafelni esdalik sifatida sotib olishadi.)
stroopwafel.meta: Ikki kichik, juda ingichka, dumaloq vafli orasiga sirop yoki karamel solingan shirin atir-ovqat.

syn: • Nigerian kebab – Niger shashligi• spiced meat skewer – ziravorlangan go‘shtli cho‘pchalar• Suya is sometimes called a Nigerian kebab.(Suyani ba’zida Niger shashligi deb ham atashadi.)
ex: The spicy meat in suya is grilled on skewers. (Suyadagi achchiq go‘sht cho‘pchalarda qovuriladi.)
Suya is a popular street food in Nigeria.(Suya Nigeriyada mashhur ko‘cha taomi hisoblanadi.)
I tried suya during my trip to Lagos.(Men Lagosga safarimda suya tatib ko‘rdim.)
Suya is often served with onions and tomatoes.(Suyani ko‘pincha piyoz va pomidor bilan tortishadi.)
Many people enjoy suya as a late-night snack.(Ko‘pchilik suyaning kechki tamaddi sifatida iste’mol qilishadi.)
suya.meta: Nigeriya oshxonasida mashhur bo‘lgan taom bo‘lib, ingichka qilib kesilgan, ziravorlangan go‘sht bo‘laklari skovorodkada yoki panjara ustida pishiriladi. Ko‘pincha ko‘cha sotuvchilari tomonidan sotiladi.

syn: • broccolini – brokkolining ingichka novdali navi• baby broccoli – kichik brokkoli• Broccolini is another name for tenderstem.(Brokkolini — tenderstemning boshqa nomidir.)
ex: It has tender stems and delicate flavor. (Unda mayin novdalar va nozik ta’m mavjud.)
Tenderstem is a hybrid vegetable combining broccoli and Chinese kale.(Tenderstem brokkoli va xitoy karamining gibrid sabzavotidir.)
Many chefs prefer tenderstem for its fast cooking time.(Ko‘plab oshpazlar tenderstemni tez pishishi uchun afzal ko‘rishadi.)
You can steam or stir-fry tenderstem as a side dish.(Tenderstemni garnir sifatida bug‘da pishirish yoki qovurish mumkin.)
Tenderstem is rich in nutrients and easy to digest.(Tenderstem oziq moddalarga boy va hazm qilish oson.)
tenderstem.meta: Brokkoli (Brassica oleracea var. italica) va xitoy karamining (Brassica oleracea var. alboglabra) sun’iy gibridi bo‘lib, mayin va yumshoq novdalar bilan tavsiflanadi. Odatda sabzavot sifatida ishlatiladi.

syn: • mental model of text – matnning aqliy modeli• conceptual representation – g‘oyaviy ifoda• A well-formed text base improves critical reading skills.(Yaxshi shakllangan matn asoslari tanqidiy o‘qish ko‘nikmalarini yaxshilaydi.)
ex: Text base helps in comprehending the overall meaning of a passage. (Matn asoslari parchaning umumiy ma’nosini tushunishga yordam beradi.)
The reader builds a text base to understand the main ideas.(O‘quvchi asosiy g‘oyalarni tushunish uchun matn asoslarini shakllantiradi.)
Good comprehension requires building a strong text base.(Yaxshi tushunish uchun mustahkam matn asoslarini yaratish zarur.)
Without a clear text base, students struggle to summarize content.(Aniq matn asoslarisiz, talabalar mazmunni qisqacha bayon qilishda qiynaladilar.)
Teachers train students to develop text base skills for deeper understanding.(O‘qituvchilar o‘quvchilarda chuqur tushunish uchun matn asoslari ko‘nikmalarini rivojlantirishadi.)
text base.meta: Psixologiyada o‘qish tushunishda: o‘quvchi matnning g‘oyalarini va tushunchalarini butunlay tahlil qilib, umumiy mazmun asosida ongida hosil qilgan tasavvuri yoki mental modeli.

syn: • body of text – matn asosiy qismi• text area – matn joylashgan hudud• print section – chop qilingan bo‘lim• The text block was carefully aligned to improve layout.(Matn bloki maketni yaxshilash uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan tekislandi.)
ex: Designers adjust the size of the text block for better readability. (Dizaynerlar o‘qilishi oson bo‘lishi uchun matn blokining hajmini sozlaydi.)
The text block occupies the central part of the page.(Matn bloki sahifaning markaziy qismini egallaydi.)
The header was placed above the main text block.(Sarlavha asosiy matn blokining yuqori qismiga joylashtirildi.)
The article had a narrow text block with wide margins.(Maqola tor matn blokiga va keng bo‘sh joylarga ega edi.)
Every chapter begins with a bolded text block.(Har bir bob qalin shriftli matn bloki bilan boshlanadi.)
text block.meta: Chop etishda: sahifada matn, rasm, jadval va boshqalarni o‘z ichiga olgan belgilangan, ajratilgan qism. Shuningdek, sahifaning asosiy matn joylashgan qismi ham.

syn: • overly theoretical – ortiqcha nazariy• formal – rasmiy• standardized – standartga tushirilgan• conventional – an’anaviy• Her textbooky style didn’t suit the informal setting.(Uning darslikka xos uslubi norasmiy muhitga to‘g‘ri kelmadi.)
ex: The argument was textbooky, following a predictable pattern. (Bahs darslikka o‘xshash edi, oldindan aytib bo‘ladigan namunaga amal qilgan.)
His explanation was textbooky and lacked real-world examples.(Uning tushuntirishi darslikka xos edi va real hayotdan misollar yetishmas edi.)
The report felt too textbooky for a creative presentation.(Hisobot ijodiy taqdimot uchun haddan tashqari darslikcha tuyuldi.)
I want ideas that are fresh, not so textbooky.(Men yangicha fikrlarni istayman, bunchalik darslikcha bo‘lmasin.)
The textbooky nature of his essay made it less engaging.(Uning insho yozish uslubi darslikka xos bo‘lgani sababli u unchalik qiziqarli bo‘lmadi.)
textbooky.meta: Darslikni eslatadigan, darslik uslubiga o‘xshash (turli jihatlardan); shakllangan, cheklangan ko‘lamli, original bo‘lmagan. Shuningdek, nazariy jihatdan to‘liq yoki formal bo‘lgan.

syn: • transcription – ko‘chirib yozish• documentation – hujjatlashtirish• writing down – yozib qo‘yish• The transcription and textualization of the interview were done simultaneously.(Intervyuning ko‘chirib yozilishi va matnlashtirilishi bir vaqtda amalga oshirildi.)
ex: Textualization is important in turning speeches into written records. (Nutqni yozma shaklga keltirish matnlashtirish jarayonida muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)
The textualization of oral traditions helps preserve cultural heritage.(Og‘zaki an’analarni matnlashtirish madaniy merosni saqlashga yordam beradi.)
The textualization of the event allowed it to be documented for future study.(Voqeaning matnlashtirilishi uni kelajakdagi tadqiqotlar uchun hujjatlashtirish imkonini berdi.)
Without textualization, many folk stories would be forgotten.(Matnlashtirishsiz ko‘plab xalq ertaklari unutilgan bo‘lardi.)
Scholars study the process of textualization in different cultures.(Olimlar turli madaniyatlarda matnlashtirish jarayonini o‘rganadilar.)
textualization.meta: Nimani yozma yoki chop etilgan shaklga keltirish jarayoni, ayniqsa nutqni yoki so‘zlarni matnga aylantirish; shuningdek, biror narsani kitob yoki boshqa yozma shaklga aylantirish natijasi.

syn: • document – hujjatlashtirmoq• transcribe – ko‘chirib yozmoq• write down – yozib qo‘ymoq• The students transcribed and textualized the recorded lecture.(Talabalar yozib olingan ma’ruzani ko‘chirib yozib
ex: She textualized her speech into a detailed article. (U nutqini batafsil maqolaga matnlashtirdi.)
The historian textualized the interview for publication.(Tarixchi intervyuni nashr uchun matn shakliga keltirdi.)
They are working to textualize traditional folk tales.(Ular an’anaviy xalq ertaklarini matnlashtirish ustida ishlayapti.)
He textualized the conversation to preserve it.(U suhbatni saqlab qolish uchun matnlashtirdi.)
Scholars often textualize oral traditions for academic research.(Olimlar ko‘pincha og‘zaki an’analarni ilmiy tadqiqot uchun matnlashtiradilar.)
textualize.meta: Biror narsani, ayniqsa nutq yoki gap-so‘zlarni, yozma yoki chop etilgan shaklga keltirmoq; uni kitob yoki boshqa yozma yoki bosma asarga aylantirmoq.

syn: • documented – hujjatlashtirilgan• written down – yozib qo‘yilgan• transcribed – ko‘chirilgan (og‘zaki matndan)• The interview was transcribed and then textualized into a report.(Intervyu ko‘chirildi va keyin hisobot shaklida matnlashtirildi.)
ex: Many oral stories remain untextualized and at risk of being lost. (Ko‘plab og‘zaki hikoyalar hali matnlashtirilmagan va yo‘qolib ketish xavfi ostida.)
The textualized version of the speech was published online.(Nutqning matnlashtirilgan shakli internetda e’lon qilindi.)
Their experiences were eventually textualized in a memoir.(Ularning tajribalari oxir-oqibat xotira kitobida matnlashtirildi.)
The myths were textualized by ancient scribes.(Bu afsonalar qadimiy kotiblar tomonidan matn shakliga keltirilgan.)
Once textualized, the ritual gained a new formal status.(Matnlashtirilgach, marosim yangi rasmiy maqomga ega bo‘ldi.)
textualized.meta: Yozma yoki bosma shaklga keltirilgan yoki ifodalangan; kitob yoki boshqa yozma yoki bosma asarga aylantirilgan.

syn: • blackletter – qora yozuv shrift turi• Gothic script – gotik yozuv• Blackletter and Textur are similar in appearance but used in different regions.(Blackletter va Textur ko‘rinish jihatidan o‘xshash
ex: The angular shapes of Textur letters give it a distinctive look. (Textur harflarining burchakli shakllari unga o‘ziga xos ko‘rinish beradi.)
Textur was commonly used in the earliest printed books.(Textur shriftlari dastlabki bosma kitoblarda keng qo‘llangan.)
Many medieval manuscripts feature text written in the Textur style.(Ko‘plab o‘rta asr qo‘lyozmalarida Textur uslubidagi yozuvlar mavjud.)
The printer replicated the look of a 15th-century Textur script.(Bosmaxona XV asr Textur yozuvi ko‘rinishini takrorladi.)
Textur fonts are rarely used today except in historical reproductions.(Bugungi kunda Textur shriftlari faqat tarixiy nusxalarda deyarli ishlatiladi.)
textur.meta: Bosma kitoblarning eng dastlabki davrlarida ishlatilgan shriftlar guruhiga kiruvchi shrift turi. Bu shriftlar ingichka, burchakli harflardan iborat bo‘lib, egri qismalari kesilgan chiziqlardan tashkil topgan.

syn: verbal – og‘zaki / yozma• Verbal and textual sources were compared.(Og‘zaki va matnga asoslangan manbalar solishtirildi.)written – yozma• The contract contains written and textual explanations.(Shartnomada yozma va matnga asoslangan tushuntirishlar mavjud.)
ex: Textual evidence in manuscripts helps scholars understand historical contexts. (Qo‘lyozmalardagi matnga asoslangan dalillar olimlarga tarixiy kontekstlarni tushunishda yordam beradi.)
The researcher conducted a textual analysis of Shakespeare’s plays.(Tadqiqotchi Shekspir asarlarining matniy tahlilini o‘tkazdi.)
The textual structure of the poem reveals its hidden meaning.(She’rning matn tuzilishi uning yashirin ma’nosini ochib beradi.)
Differences in textual versions of the Bible have been widely studied.(Bibliyaning turli matnli nusxalari keng tadqiq qilingan.)
textural.meta: Textual means relating to written or printed text, or based on a text. It refers to anything derived from or concerned with texts, especially in literature, linguistics, or document analysis.

syn: • gelling agent – quyuqlashtiruvchi vosita• stabilizer – barqarorlashtiruvchi• The chef used a stabilizer instead of a texturizer.(Oshpaz teksturayzer o‘rniga barqarorlashtiruvchidan foydalandi.)
ex: Food manufacturers add texturizers to enhance product consistency. (Oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqaruvchilari mahsulot tarkibini yaxshilash uchun teksturayzerlar qo‘shadi.)
The chef used a texturizer to improve the mouthfeel of the dessert.(Oshpaz shirinlikning og‘izdagi tuyg‘usini yaxshilash uchun teksturayzerdan foydalandi.)
Some low-fat products rely on texturizers to maintain a creamy feel.(Ba’zi kam yog‘li mahsulotlar silliq ta’mni saqlash uchun teksturayzerdan foydalanadi.)
Texturizers help make processed foods more palatable.(Teksturayzerlar qayta ishlangan ovqatlarni lazzatliroq qiladi.)
Natural texturizers like agar or gelatin are common in desserts.(Agar yoki jele kabi tabiiy teksturayzerlar shirinliklarda keng qo‘llaniladi.)
texturizer.meta: Biror narsaga, ayniqsa ovqatga, maxsus tuzilish yoki to‘qima beruvchi modda yoki mahsulot; oziq-ovqatning tuzilishini o‘zgartirib, uni yanada jozibador qiluvchi.

syn: • conditioning – yumshatuvchi• shaping – shakl beruvchi• This conditioning treatment also works as a texturizing agent.(Bu yumshatuvchi muolaja ham to‘qimalashtiruvchi vosita sifatida ishlaydi.)
ex: Hairdressers use texturizing techniques to add volume and shape. (Sartaroshlar hajm va shakl qo‘shish uchun to‘qimalashtiruvchi texnikalardan foydalanishadi.)
The texturizing process improved the fabric’s feel and appearance.(To‘qimalashtirish jarayoni matoning tuyg‘usi va ko‘rinishini yaxshiladi.)
She prefers texturizing sprays over heavy gels.(U og‘ir gel emas, balki to‘qimalashtiruvchi spreylarga ustunlik beradi.)
Texturizing products help create a natural-looking hairstyle.(To‘qimalashtiruvchi mahsulotlar tabiiy ko‘rinishdagi soch turmagini yaratishda yordam beradi.)
The chef used a texturizing agent to enhance the food’s mouthfeel.(Oshpaz ovqatning og‘izda tuyilish tuyg‘usini yaxshilash uchun to‘qimalashtiruvchi vositadan foydalandi.)
texturizing.meta: Biror narsaga, ayniqsa ovqat, mato yoki sochga, maxsus tuzilish beruvchi yoki uning tuzilishini o‘zgartirib, uni yanada jozibador qiluvchi.

syn: • 3D printer – 3D printer• additive manufacturing device – qo‘shma qatlamli ishlab chiqarish moslamasi• A 3D printer helped them test multiple versions of the part.(3D printer ularga qismlarning bir nechta versiyasini sinab ko‘rishga yordam berdi.)
ex: The three-dimensional printer created a prototype of the new design. (Uch o‘lchovli printer yangi dizaynning prototipini yaratdi.)
3D printers are revolutionizing manufacturing by enabling rapid prototyping.(3D printerlar tez prototip tayyorlash orqali ishlab chiqarishni tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda.)
A three-dimensional printer can produce parts overnight.(Uch o‘lchovli printer qismlarni bir kechada ishlab chiqarishi mumkin.)
Engineers used a three-dimensional printer to build a working model.(Muhandislar ishlaydigan modelni yaratish uchun uch o‘lchovli printerdan foydalanishdi.)
The school installed a three-dimensional printer in its science lab.(Maktab ilmiy laboratoriyasiga uch o‘lchovli printer o‘rnatdi.)
three-dimensional printer.meta: Biror suyuq, plastik yoki kukun shaklidagi materialning qatlamma-qatlam qo‘shilishi orqali avtomatik ravishda qattiq jismlarni yasaydigan mashina.

syn: • 3D printing – 3D bosib chiqarish• additive manufacturing – qatlamli ishlab chiqarish• 3D printing is revolutionizing the way we manufacture tools.(3D bosib chiqarish asboblarni yasash usulini tubdan o‘zgartirmoqda.)
ex: Three-dimensional printing allows rapid production of complex objects. (Uch o‘lchovli bosib chiqarish murakkab obyektlarni tezda ishlab chiqarishga imkon beradi.)
Advances in three-dimensional printing have transformed prototyping in many industries.(Uch o‘lchovli bosib chiqarishdagi yutuqlar ko‘plab sohalarda prototip tayyorlashni o‘zgartirib yubordi.)
Three-dimensional printing is used in medicine to create custom implants.(Uch o‘lchovli bosib chiqarish tibbiyotda maxsus implantlar yaratishda qo‘llaniladi.)
Designers use three-dimensional printing to experiment with form and texture.(Dizaynerlar shakl va tuzilmani sinab ko‘rish uchun uch o‘lchovli bosib chiqarishdan foydalanishadi.)
Three-dimensional printing reduces material waste compared to traditional manufacturing.(Uch o‘lchovli bosib chiqarish an’anaviy ishlab chiqarishga nisbatan kamroq chiqindiga sabab bo‘ladi.)
three-dimensional printing.meta: Mashina yordamida suyuq, plastik yoki kukun shaklidagi materiallarning ketma-ket qatlamlari qo‘shilishi orqali qattiq jismni avtomatik tarzda yasash jarayoni.

syn: • ancestral knowledge – ajdodiy bilim• local knowledge – mahalliy bilim• The project aims to document ancestral knowledge before it disappears.(Loyiha ajdodiy bilimlar yo‘qolib ketmasidan oldin ularni hujjatlashtirishni maqsad qilgan.)
ex: Traditional knowledge helps communities manage natural resources sustainably. (An’anaviy bilim jamoalarga tabiiy resurslardan barqaror foydalanishda yordam beradi.)
Many medicinal plants are known through traditional knowledge passed down generations.(Ko‘plab shifobaxsh o‘simliklar avloddan-avlodga o‘tadigan an’anaviy bilim orqali ma’lum.)
Traditional knowledge includes farming techniques adapted to local environments.(An’anaviy bilim mahalliy muhitga moslashtirilgan dehqonchilik usullarini ham o‘z ichiga oladi.)
Elders are often the main holders of traditional knowledge in many communities.(Ko‘plab jamoalarda kattalar an’anaviy bilimning asosiy saqlovchilaridir.)
Protecting traditional knowledge helps preserve cultural identity.(An’anaviy bilimni himoya qilish madaniy o‘zlikni saqlashga yordam beradi.)
traditional knowledge.meta: Biror madaniyatda, ayniqsa tub aholining og‘zaki anʼanalari orqali, ko‘p avlodlar davomida o‘tib kelgan bilim, ko‘nikma yoki maʼlumotlar.

syn: • upper arm extensor muscle – yuqori qo‘lning cho‘zuvchi mushagi• The upper arm extensor muscle
also known as the triceps brachii

plays a vital role.(Triseps brachii deb ham ataluvchi yuqori qo‘l cho‘zuvchi mushagi muhim rol o‘ynaydi.)No spelling mistakes were found in the Uzbek explanation. Let me know if you'd like exercises based on this word
ex: The triceps brachii is essential for arm extension movements. (Triseps brachii qo‘lni cho‘zish harakatlari uchun muhimdir.)
Bodybuilders focus on exercises that strengthen the triceps brachii.(Bodibilderlar triseps brachiini mustahkamlovchi mashqlarga e’tibor berishadi.)
Injuries to the triceps brachii can limit arm mobility.(Triseps brachii mushagining shikastlanishi qo‘l harakatchanligini cheklashi mumkin.)
The triceps brachii helps in pushing movements.(Triseps brachii itarish harakatlarida yordam beradi.)
Effective training of the triceps brachii leads to stronger arms.(Triseps brachiini samarali mashq qilish qo‘llarni kuchliroq qiladi.)
triceps brachii.meta: A large three-headed muscle located on the back of the upper arm. It originates from the scapula (shoulder blade) and humerus (upper arm bone) and inserts into the ulna (forearm bone).

syn: Korean rice cake dish (koreys guruchli taomi)• Tteokbokki is a type of Korean rice cake dish.(Tteokbokki koreys guruchli taomlaridan biridir.)spicy street food (achchiq ko‘cha taomi)• It is known as a spicy street food loved by locals.(Bu mahalliylar sevgan achchiq ko‘cha taomi sifatida tanilgan.)
ex: The spicy sauce makes tteokbokki flavorful and addictive. (Achchiq sous tteokbokkini mazali va qiziqarli qiladi.)
Tteokbokki is a popular street food in Korea.(Tteokbokki Koreyada mashhur ko‘cha taomidir.)
I tried tteokbokki for the first time and loved the spicy taste.(Men tteokbokkini birinchi marta sinab ko‘rdim va achchiq ta'mi yoqdi.)
You can find tteokbokki in most Korean food stalls.(Tteokbokkini ko‘pchilik koreys ovqat rastalarida topish mumkin.)
Tteokbokki is often served with boiled eggs and green onions.(Tteokbokki ko‘pincha qaynatilgan tuxum va ko‘katlar bilan beriladi.)
tteokbokki.meta: A popular Korean dish made from soft rice cakes (tteok), fish cakes, and a spicy-sweet chili sauce, often served as street food.

syn: portable hand-washing station – ko‘chma qo‘l yuvish stansiyasi• Portable hand-washing stations were provided during the festival.(Festival vaqtida ko‘chma qo‘l yuvish stansiyalari taqdim etildi.)tippy tap (simpler version used in rural areas)• A tippy tap is a hands-free way to wash hands.(Tippi tep qo‘lsiz qo‘l yuvish usulidir.)
ex: Veronica buckets help improve hand hygiene in areas without running water. (Veronika chelkalari ichimlik suvi yo‘q joylarda qo‘l gigiyenasini yaxshilashga yordam beradi.)
The Veronica bucket is widely used in public places in Ghana.(Veronika chelkasi Ganadagi jamoat joylarida keng qo‘llaniladi.)
We placed a Veronica bucket at the school entrance.(Maktab kirish joyiga Veronika chelkasi qo‘ydik.)
The health worker demonstrated how to use a Veronica bucket properly.(Tibbiyot xodimi Veronika chelkasidan to‘g‘ri foydalanishni ko‘rsatdi.)
veronica bucket.meta: Veronica bucket – A portable hand-washing device with a tap, commonly used in areas lacking running water, especially in public places for hygiene purposes.

syn: feasibly – mumkin tarzda• The plan can be feasibly implemented. (Rejani amalga oshirish mumkin.)practically – amalda• We need a practically achievable solution. (Biz amalda erishish mumkin bo‘lgan yechimga muhtojmiz.)
ex: The company plans to operate viably despite economic challenges. (Kompaniya iqtisodiy qiyinchiliklarga qaramay muvaffaqiyatli faoliyat yuritishni rejalashtirmoqda.)
The project can be completed viably within the given budget.(Loyiha ajratilgan byudjet doirasida amalga oshiriladigan tarzda yakunlanishi mumkin.)
Small businesses must adapt quickly to remain viably competitive.(Kichik bizneslar raqobatbardosh tarzda yashab qolish uchun tez moslashishi kerak.)
We need to find a way to run the service viably without increasing costs.(Xizmatni xarajatlarni oshirmasdan amalga oshiriladigan tarzda yuritish yo‘lini topishimiz kerak.)
Renewable energy must be viably integrated into the national grid.(Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya milliy tarmoqqa muvaffaqiyatli integratsiya qilinishi kerak.)
viably.meta: Used to describe an action that can be done successfully or effectively, especially in a practical, financial, or functional way.

syn: thoroughly studied – chuqur o‘rganilgan• The thoroughly studied material helped him pass the test.(Chuqur o‘rganilgan material unga testdan o‘tishda yordam berdi.)mastered – mukammal egallangan• He mastered the technique through practice.(U mashq orqali texnikani mukammal egalladi.)
ex: His well-learned routine made the performance flawless. (Uning yaxshi o‘rganilgan rutinası chiqishning mukammal bo‘lishini ta’minladi.)
The students recited the poem because it was well-learned.(Talabalar she’rni yod olib aytib berishdi, chunki u to‘liq o‘rganilgan edi.)
Her well-learned speech impressed the audience.(Uning yaxshi o‘zlashtirilgan nutqi tinglovchilarni hayratda qoldirdi.)
The actor delivered his lines perfectly, thanks to his well-learned script.(Aktyor matnni mukammal aytdi, sababi u ssenariyni yaxshi o‘rganib chiqqan edi.)
A well-learned process saves time in professional work.(Yaxshi o‘zlashtirilgan jarayon professional ishda vaqtni tejaydi.)
well-learned.meta: Something that has been learned thoroughly or mastered completely through study or repetition.

syn: more technical) – G‘arbiy Afrika bilan bog‘liq• Western African nations face similar challenges. (G‘arbiy Afrika davlatlari o‘xshash muammolarga duch kelishadi.)
ex: She studied West African history at university. (U universitetda G‘arbiy Afrika tarixini o‘rgangan.)
West African culture is rich and diverse.(G‘arbiy Afrika madaniyati boy va xilma-xildir.)
West African music has influenced many global artists.(G‘arbiy Afrika musiqasi ko‘plab xalqaro ijodkorlarga ta’sir ko‘rsatgan.)
He is proud of his West African roots.(U G‘arbiy Afrikalik ildizlari bilan faxrlanadi.)
A group of West African leaders met to discuss economic issues.(G‘arbiy Afrikalik yetakchilar iqtisodiy muammolarni muhokama qilish uchun yig‘ilishdi.)
west african.meta: Adjective: Related to the western region of the African continent, including its people, cultures, countries, or geography. Noun: A person who comes from the western part of Africa.

syn: adipose tissue – yog‘ to‘qimasi• Adipose tissue includes both white and brown fat.(Yog‘ to‘qimasi oq va jigarrang yog‘ni o‘z ichiga oladi.)
ex: Excess white fat can lead to health problems. (Ortiqcha oq yog‘ sog‘liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.)
White fat stores energy in the body.(Oq yog‘ tanada energiyani saqlaydi.)
A healthy balance of white fat and brown fat is important.(Oq yog‘ va jigarrang yog‘ning sog‘lom muvozanati muhimdir.)
Scientists are studying how to convert white fat into brown fat.(Olimlar oq yog‘ni jigarrang yog‘ga aylantirish usullarini o‘rganmoqdalar.)
White fat accumulates around the abdomen in many adults.(Ko‘plab kattalarda oq yog‘ qorin atrofida to‘planadi.)
white fat.meta: White fat is a type of body fat that stores energy in large fat droplets and cushions organs. It is the most common type of fat in the human body.

syn: Scammer – firibgar• He is a scammer who cheats people online. (U odamlarni internet orqali aldovchi firibgar.)Fraudster – firibgar shaxs• The fraudster was caught after months of investigation. (Firibgar bir necha oylik tergovdan so‘ng qo‘lga olindi.)
ex: Many people fall victim to yahoo boys on social media. (Ko‘p odamlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda “yahoo boy”lar qurboniga aylanishadi.)
The yahoo boy was arrested for online scams.(Yahoo boy onlayn firibgarlik uchun hibsga olindi.)
He posed as a wealthy businessman, but turned out to be a yahoo boy.(U boy biznesmen sifatida ko‘rindi, lekin aslida “yahoo boy” edi.)
The police launched a raid to catch yahoo boys operating in the area.(Politsiya hududda ishlayotgan “yahoo boy”larni qo‘lga olish uchun reyd o‘tkazdi.)
Many yahoo boys use fake identities to trick people.(Ko‘plab “yahoo boy”lar odamlarni aldash uchun soxta shaxsiy ma’lumotlardan foydalanadi.)
yahoo boy.meta: Yahoo boy – a slang term, especially in Nigeria, for a young man who engages in internet fraud or cyber scams, usually by tricking people online, often via email, social media, or fake romantic relationships.

syn: Expression Uzbek Nuanceoh no! / oh dear! voy! General surprise or regret.aiyo! (Singlish/Tamil origin) voy! Often used similarly but may convey tired disbelief.ala-mak (misspelling) — Incorrect variant; correct spelling is alamak
ex: Alamak, that was a terrible mistake! (Voy, bu dahshatli xato bo‘ldi!)
Alamak! I forgot my keys at home!(Voy dod! Kalitlarimni uyda unutibman!)
Alamak, I left my phone in the taxi!(Voy, telefonimni taksida qoldiribman!)
The cake burned in the oven – alamak!(Pirog pechda kuyib ketdi – voy!)
Alamak, the meeting starts in five minutes and I’m still here!(Voy bo‘ldi, uchrashuv besh daqiqada boshlanadi-yu, men hâli shu yerdaman!)
alamak.meta: Alamak – an informal Malaysian/Singaporean exclamation used to show sudden surprise, shock, dismay, or frustration, similar to “oh no!”, “yikes!”, or “whoops!” in colloquial English.

syn: Romantic dance (romantik raqs)• Bachata is a type of romantic dance.(Bachata romantik raqs turlaridan biridir.)Latin dance (lotincha raqs)• She specializes in Latin dances like salsa and bachata.(U salsa va bachata kabi lotincha raqslarda ixtisoslashgan.)
ex: They danced bachata all night at the party. (Ular bazmda butun tun bachata raqsini tushishdi.)
Bachata music is popular in Latin America.(Bachata musiqasi Lotin Amerikasida mashhur.)

We took a class to learn how to dance bachata.(Biz bachata raqsini o‘rganish uchun darsga yozildik.)• His favorite genre is bachata because of its emotional melodies.(Uning sevimli janri bachata, chunki u hissiyotli ohanglarga ega.)• Bachata is often played at weddings and festivals.(Bachata ko‘pincha to‘ylar va bayramlarda ijro etiladi.)
bachata.meta: Bachata is a style of music and dance that originated in the Dominican Republic, characterized by romantic lyrics and guitar-based rhythms. It is now popular across Latin America and other parts of the world.

syn: Dance event – raqs tadbiri• The dance event was held outdoors. (Raqs tadbiri ochiq havoda o‘tkazildi.)Folk dance night – xalq raqsi kechasi• The folk dance night included music and food. (Xalq raqsi kechasida musiqa va ovqat ham bor edi.)
ex: Traditional dances are performed at the baile. (An’anaviy raqslar bayleda ijro etiladi.)
The community organized a baile last weekend.(O'tgan hafta oxiri jamoa bayle tashkil qildi.)
We dressed up for the town’s annual baile.(Biz shaharning har yili o‘tkaziladigan baylesi uchun chiroyli kiyndik.)
Everyone was invited to the summer baile in the plaza.(Hamma yozgi baylega taklif qilindi.)
The baile started with a group of children dancing in traditional clothes.(Bayle milliy kiyimdagi bolalarning raqsi bilan boshlandi.)
baile.meta: Baile – a social event, especially in Latin American or Spanish-speaking cultures, where traditional or cultural dances are performed.

syn: but Mexican 12-string guitar is sometimes used informally.• He replaced his bajo sexto with a Mexican 12-string guitar.(U bajo seksasini Meksikaning 12 torli gitarasiga almashtirdi.)
ex: It is a popular instrument in northern Mexican folk music. (Bu Meksikaning shimoliy xalq musiqasida mashhur cholg‘u asbobidir.)
The bajo sexto player added depth to the band’s performance.(Bajo seksa chaluvchisi guruh ijrosiga chuqurlik qo‘shdi.)
He learned to play the bajo sexto from his grandfather.(U bajo seksani bobosidan chalishni o‘rgangan.)
This song features a solo on the bajo sexto.(Bu qo‘shiqda bajo seksa chalguvchisining yakkaxonasi bor.)
bajo sexto.meta: Bajo sexto is a 12-string Mexican musical instrument resembling a guitar, traditionally used in Northern Mexican and Tejano music. It provides both melody and rhythm, especially in folk and conjunto bands.

ex: They served tacos filled with spicy barbacoa. (Ular achchiq barbakao to‘ldirilgan takoslar tortishdi.)
Barbacoa is a traditional Mexican dish made from slow-cooked meat.(Barbakao sekin pishirilgan go‘shtdan tayyorlanadigan an’anaviy Meksika taomidir.)
She prepared beef barbacoa for the family’s Sunday lunch.(U yakshanba tushligiga mol go‘shtidan barbakao tayyorladi.)
The restaurant’s lamb barbacoa sold out within an hour.(Restorandagi qo‘y go‘shtidan barbakao bir soatda sotilib ketdi.)
Many cooks use a pressure cooker to make quick barbacoa at home.(Ko‘plab oshpazlar barbakao­ni uyda tez tayyorlash uchun bosimli qozondan foydalanadi.)
barbacoa.meta: A traditional Mexican dish of shredded meat—commonly beef, lamb, or goat—slow-cooked (originally in an underground pit or steamed) until tender and richly seasoned, often served in tacos, burritos, or on its own.

syn: guerrilla (gerilyachi) — broader term for irregular fighter.• The guerrillas operated in the jungle. (Gerilyachilar o‘rmonda harakat qilishdi.)
ex: Fidel Castro and his barbudos fought for change. (Fidel Kastro va uning barbudolari o‘zgarish uchun kurashdilar.)
The barbudos played a key role in the Cuban Revolution.(Barbudolar Kuba inqilobida muhim rol o‘ynadi.)
Many barbudos grew their beards as a symbol of defiance against Batista.(Ko‘plab barbudolar soqollarini Batista rejimiga qarshi qarshilik ramzi sifatida o‘stirishdi.)
After victory, the barbudos marched into Havana to cheering crowds.(G‘alabadan so‘ng, barbudolar Gavanaga olqishlar ostida kirib kelishdi.)

Some historians argue that the barbudos’ rural tactics reshaped modern guerrilla warfare.(Baʼzi tarixchilar barbudolarning qishloq taktikasi zamonaviy gerilya urushini qayta shakllantirganini taʼkidlashadi.)
barbudo.meta: A barbudo is a member of Fidel Castro’s bearded guerrilla fighters who took part in the Cuban Revolution (1956 – 1959); by extension, any Cuban revolutionary combatant identified with that force.

syn: Not to be confused with:bed and breakfast (hotel service with overnight stay and breakfast)• We stayed at a lovely bed and breakfast in the countryside.(Biz qishloqda yoqimli bir bed and breakfast mehmonxonasida qolgan edik.)Related financial concept:wash sale – similar practice in the US• A wash sale is disallowed for tax loss purposes under IRS rules.(Wash sale AQSHda soliq zararini kamaytirish maqsadida ruxsat etilmaydi.)
ex: Some investors engage in bed and breakfasting to reduce their tax liabilities. (Ba’zi investorlar soliq majburiyatlarini kamaytirish uchun bed and breakfasting bilan shug‘ullanadilar.)
Bed and breakfasting is used to gain tax advantages in the stock market.(Bed and breakfasting fond bozorida soliq afzalliklarini olish uchun qo‘llaniladi.)
The government introduced rules to prevent bed and breakfasting tactics.(Hukumat bed and breakfasting usullarining oldini olish uchun qoidalar kiritdi.)
Bed and breakfasting was once a popular strategy before tax year deadlines.(Bed and breakfasting ilgari soliq yilining yakuniga yaqin mashhur strategiya edi.)
The investor used bed and breakfasting to offset capital gains.(Investor kapital daromadlarni qoplash uchun bed and breakfastingdan foydalandi.)
bed and breakfasting.meta: “Bed and breakfasting” is a financial practice in which an investor sells shares before the end of a tax year and repurchases them shortly afterward, usually the next day, to realize a capital loss or gain for tax purposes.

syn: restless sleeper – betinch uxlaydigan odam• He’s a restless sleeper and keeps waking up.(U betinch uxlaydi va tez-tez uyg‘onadi.)bed wanderer – informal synonym (less common)• The child’s a bit of a bed wanderer at night.(Bola kechasi karovatlar o‘rtasida yuraveradi.)
ex: The baby is a bed-hopper and rarely stays in one bed all night. (Bola bed-hopper, ya’ni u kechasi bir joyda uxlamaydi.)
She’s such a bed-hopper, always changing places to sleep.(U haqiqiy bed-hopper, doim uxlaydigan joyini o‘zgartiradi.)
Our toddler turned into a bed-hopper once we moved him to a big bed.(Farzandimiz katta karovatga o‘tgach, haqiqiy bed-hopperga aylandi.)
The dog is a little bed-hopper, sneaking into everyone’s bed.(Itimiz ham bed-hopperga o‘xshab qolgan, hammaning karovatiga kirib oladi.)
As a bed-hopper, he often ends up in his parents’ room by morning.(Bed-hopper bo‘lgani uchun u ko‘pincha ertalabgacha ota-onasining xonasiga o‘tib qoladi.)
bed-hopper.meta: A “bed-hopper” is a person, especially a child, who frequently moves from one bed to another during the night instead of sleeping in one bed the whole time. It is often used in informal or humorous contexts to describe restless sleepers.

syn: bedtime (uxlab yotish vaqti): Standard and more common.• It’s your bedtime. (Bu sening uxlaydigan vaqting.)nap time (kunduzgi uyqu vaqti): Often confused with beddy-baw
but refers to daytime sleep.• It’s nap time for the toddlers. (Yosh bolalar uchun uxlash vaqti.)
ex: After a long day, it’s time for beddy-baw. (Uzoq kundan so‘ng, endi to‘shakka yotish vaqti keldi.)
The child asked for beddy-baw early tonight.(Bola bugun kechqurun erta uxlashni so‘radi.)
Let’s read a story before beddy-baw.(Beddy-bawdan oldin ertak o‘qiylik.)
She kissed her daughter goodnight and said, “Time for beddy-baw!”(U qizini o‘pib xayrli tun dedi va: “Endi beddy-baw vaqti!” dedi.)
He didn’t want to go to beddy-baw without his teddy bear.(U beddy-bawga ayiqchasiz yotishni xohlamadi.)
beddy-baw.meta: “Beddy-baw” is an informal and childish expression meaning bedtime or going to bed. It’s often used affectionately by parents or adults when talking to or about children.

syn: immobile – harakatsiz• She was immobile after the accident.(U baxtsiz hodisadan keyin harakatsiz bo‘ldi.)confined to bed – yotoqda qolgan• He has been confined to bed for two weeks.(U ikki haftadan beri yotoqda.)
ex: She was bedridden after the surgery. (U operatsiyadan keyin yotoqda qolgan edi.)
The illness bedrid him for several weeks.(Kasallik uni bir necha haftaga yotoqqa mixladi.)
My grandmother has been bedridden for months.(Buvi bir necha oydan beri yotoqdan turolmaydi.)
He became bedridden after the accident.(U baxtsiz hodisadan keyin yotoqdan turolmaydigan bo‘ldi.)
Being bedridden can lead to muscle loss and pressure sores.(Yotoqda qolish mushaklarning yo‘qolishiga va yara paydo bo‘lishiga olib keladi.)
bedrid.meta: Bedridden means confined to bed, usually because of illness, injury, or old age.

syn: furniture set (mebel to‘plami)• We ordered a new furniture set for the bedroom.(Biz yotoq xonasi uchun yangi mebel to‘plami buyurtma qildik.)hotel room suite (mehmonxona apartamenti)• The hotel suite came with a balcony and minibar.(Mehmonxona apartamentida balkon va minibar mavjud edi.)
ex: The hotel offers luxurious bedroom suites for its guests. (Mehmonxona mehmonlari uchun hashamatli yotoq xonasi suitlarini taklif qiladi.)

They booked a bedroom suite with a private bathroom.(Ular shaxsiy hammomli yotoq xonasi apartamentini band qilishdi.)• The new house came with a full bedroom suite in the master bedroom.(Yangi uyda asosiy yotoq xonasida to‘liq yotoq xonasi mebellari mavjud edi.)
Their honeymoon package included a deluxe bedroom suite with ocean views.(Ularning asal oyi to‘plamiga dengiz manzarali hashamatli yotoq xonasi suitasi kiritilgan edi.)
We bought a bedroom suite that includes a wardrobe, two nightstands, and a bed.(Biz shkaf, ikki tumba va karavotdan iborat yotoq xonasi mebellarini xarid qildik.)
bedroom suite.meta: A bedroom suite refers either to a set of matching bedroom furniture (like a bed, dresser, nightstands) or a luxurious hotel accommodation that includes a bedroom and additional connected rooms such as a private bathroom or living area.

syn: bed frame (karavot karkasi)• We bought a new bed frame for the mattress.(Biz matras uchun yangi karavot karkasini sotib oldik.)base (in this context
asos)• The base of the bed was too low.(Karavotning asosi juda past edi.)
ex: She repaired the bedstead before assembling the mattress. (U to‘shakni yig‘ishdan oldin karavat ramkasini ta’mirladi.)

The old bedstead was made of sturdy wood.(Eski karavat ramkasi mustahkam yog‘ochdan yasalgan edi.)• The antique bedstead was beautifully carved.(Qadimiy karavot ramkasi chiroyli o‘ymakorlik bilan bezatilgan edi.)
They moved the bedstead into the guest room.(Ular karavot ramkasini mehmonxona tomon ko‘chirishdi.)
The bedstead creaked whenever she turned over.(U ag‘darilganda karavat ramkasi qarsillab ketardi.)
bedsteadle.meta: A bedstead is the frame of a bed, typically made of wood or metal, that supports the mattress and keeps it elevated from the floor.

syn: sleepwear – uxlash kiyimi• I bought new sleepwear. (Men yangi uxlash kiyimi sotib oldim.)nightwear – tungi kiyim• Her nightwear is made of silk. (Uning tungi kiyimi ipakdan tikilgan.)pajamas – pajama• He wore pajamas to bed. (U yotish uchun pajama kiygan.)
ex: Comfortable bedwear helps improve sleep quality. (Qulay yotoq kiyimi uyqu sifatini yaxshilashga yordam beradi.)
I prefer cotton bedwear during the summer.(Men yozda paxtadan tikilgan yotoq kiyimini afzal ko‘raman.)
Children’s bedwear often features cartoon characters.(Bolalarning yotoq kiyimi ko‘pincha multfilm qahramonlari bilan bezatilgan bo‘ladi.)
He packed his bedwear for the trip.(U safar uchun yotoq kiyimini yig‘ishtirdi.)
